const fs = require("fs");

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const TARGET = 165;
const IMPORTED = 83;

function uleb(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[p++];
        v += (b & 127) * 2 ** s;
        if (!(b & 128)) return { value: v, next: p };
        s += 7;
    }
}

function readCode() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];
        const z = uleb(p);
        const start = z.next;
        const end = start + z.value;

        if (id === 10) return { start, end };

        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

const code = readCode();

let p = code.start;
const n = uleb(p);
p = n.next;

let targetBody = null;

for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const z = uleb(p);
    const start = z.next;
    const end = start + z.value;

    if (IMPORTED + i === TARGET) {
        targetBody = { start, end, size: z.value };
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

if (!targetBody) throw new Error("FUNC 165 NOT FOUND");

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const targetFunc = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function u32(pos: number): number {
    return (
        wasm[pos] |
        (wasm[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 83 BASIC-BLOCK / CONTROL-FLOW ANALYSIS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`TARGET GLOBAL FUNC = ${targetFunc}`);

let pos = 8;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find sections
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let codeSectionStart = -1;
let codeSectionEnd = -1;
let codeSectionPayload = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];
    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const payload = pos;
    const end = payload + size;

    if (id === 10) {
        codeSectionStart = payload;
        codeSectionPayload = payload;
        codeSectionEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeSectionPayload < 0) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

console.log(`CODE SECTION = ${hex(codeSectionStart)} .. ${hex(codeSectionEnd)}`);

let p = codeSectionPayload;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const functionCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS = ${functionCount}`);

let func83Start = -1;
let func83End = -1;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < functionCount; ordinal++) {
    const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
    const bodySizeStart = p;

    p = bodySizeInfo.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    if (ordinal === targetFunc - 83) {
        func83Start = bodyStart;
        func83End = bodyEnd;
        console.log(`CODE ORDINAL = ${ordinal}`);
        console.log(`BODY        = ${hex(bodyStart)} .. ${hex(bodyEnd)}`);
        console.log(`SIZE        = ${bodySize}`);
        break;
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

if (func83Start < 0) {
    throw new Error("FUNC 83 BODY NOT FOUND");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Read locals
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let q = func83Start;

const localDeclInfo = readULEB(q);
const localDeclCount = localDeclInfo.value;
q = localDeclInfo.next;

console.log(`LOCAL DECL GROUPS = ${localDeclCount}`);

let totalLocals = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
    const countInfo = readULEB(q);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    q = countInfo.next;

    const type = wasm[q++];

    totalLocals += count;

    console.log(
        `  LOCAL GROUP ${i}: COUNT=${count} TYPE=0x${type.toString(16)}`
    );
}

console.log(`TOTAL EXTRA LOCALS = ${totalLocals}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Basic block discovery
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const blockStarts = new Set<number>();
const controlStack: { kind: string; start: number }[] = [];

blockStarts.add(q);

function addTarget(addr: number) {
    if (addr >= q && addr < func83End) {
        blockStarts.add(addr);
    }
}

for (let x = q; x < func83End;) {
    const opPos = x;
    const op = wasm[x++];

    switch (op) {

        // unreachable
        case 0x00:
            break;

        // nop
        case 0x01:
            break;

        // block / loop / if
        case 0x02:
        case 0x03:
        case 0x04: {
            controlStack.push({
                kind:
                    op === 0x02
                        ? "block"
                        : op === 0x03
                            ? "loop"
                            : "if",
                start: opPos
            });

            // blocktype
            x++;
            blockStarts.add(x);
            break;
        }

        // else
        case 0x05:
            blockStarts.add(x);
            break;

        // end
        case 0x0b:
            controlStack.pop();
            blockStarts.add(x);
            break;

        // br
        case 0x0c: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            blockStarts.add(x);
            break;
        }

        // br_if
        case 0x0d: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            blockStarts.add(x);
            break;
        }

        // br_table
        case 0x0e: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
                const t = readULEB(x);
                x = t.next;
            }

            const d = readULEB(x);
            x = d.next;

            blockStarts.add(x);
            break;
        }

        // return
        case 0x0f:
            blockStarts.add(x);
            break;

        // call
        case 0x10: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            break;
        }

        // call_indirect
        case 0x11: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            x++; // reserved/table byte
            break;
        }

        // local/global indices
        case 0x20:
        case 0x21:
        case 0x22:
        case 0x23:
        case 0x24: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            break;
        }

        // memory loads/stores
        case 0x28:
        case 0x29:
        case 0x2a:
        case 0x2b:
        case 0x2c:
        case 0x2d:
        case 0x2e:
        case 0x2f:
        case 0x30:
        case 0x31:
        case 0x32:
        case 0x33:
        case 0x34:
        case 0x35:
        case 0x36:
        case 0x37:
        case 0x38:
        case 0x39:
        case 0x3a:
        case 0x3b:
        case 0x3c:
        case 0x3d:
        case 0x3e: {
            const align = readULEB(x);
            x = align.next;

            const offset = readULEB(x);
            x = offset.next;

            break;
        }

        // memory.size / grow
        case 0x3f:
        case 0x40:
            x++;
            break;

        // i32.const
        case 0x41: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            break;
        }

        // i64.const
        case 0x42: {
            while (true) {
                const b = wasm[x++];
                if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
            }
            break;
        }

        // f32.const
        case 0x43:
            x += 4;
            break;

        // f64.const
        case 0x44:
            x += 8;
            break;

        // memory prefix
        case 0xfc: {
            const sub = readULEB(x);
            x = sub.next;

            // Most bulk-memory instructions have additional immediates.
            if (
                sub.value === 8 ||
                sub.value === 9 ||
                sub.value === 10 ||
                sub.value === 11
            ) {
                const a = readULEB(x);
                x = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(x);
                x = b.next;
            }

            break;
        }

        default:
            break;
    }

    // conditional/unconditional branch creates a new successor
    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d || op === 0x0e || op === 0x0f) {
        if (x < func83End) blockStarts.add(x);
    }
}

const starts = [...blockStarts].sort((a, b) => a - b);

console.log(`BASIC BLOCK CANDIDATES = ${starts.length}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let i = 0; i < starts.length; i++) {
    const start = starts[i];
    const end = i + 1 < starts.length
        ? starts[i + 1]
        : func83End;

    console.log(
        `BLOCK ${i.toString().padStart(3, "0")}  ` +
        `${hex(start)} .. ${hex(end)}  SIZE=${end - start}`
    );
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Interesting instruction scan
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("INTERESTING CONTROL / MEMORY OPERATIONS");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let x = q; x < func83End;) {
    const addr = x;
    const op = wasm[x++];

    let name = "";

    switch (op) {
        case 0x02: name = "block"; break;
        case 0x03: name = "loop"; break;
        case 0x04: name = "if"; break;
        case 0x05: name = "else"; break;
        case 0x0b: name = "end"; break;
        case 0x0c: name = "br"; break;
        case 0x0d: name = "br_if"; break;
        case 0x0e: name = "br_table"; break;
        case 0x0f: name = "return"; break;
        case 0x10: name = "call"; break;
        case 0x11: name = "call_indirect"; break;
        case 0x20: name = "local.get"; break;
        case 0x21: name = "local.set"; break;
        case 0x22: name = "local.tee"; break;
        case 0x23: name = "global.get"; break;
        case 0x24: name = "global.set"; break;
        case 0x28: name = "i32.load"; break;
        case 0x36: name = "i32.store"; break;
        case 0x37: name = "i64.store"; break;
        case 0x41: name = "i32.const"; break;
        case 0x42: name = "i64.const"; break;
        case 0x6a: name = "i32.add"; break;
        case 0x6b: name = "i32.sub"; break;
        case 0x71: name = "i32.and"; break;
        case 0x72: name = "i32.or"; break;
        case 0x73: name = "i32.xor"; break;
        case 0x74: name = "i32.shl"; break;
        case 0x75: name = "i32.shr_s"; break;
        case 0x76: name = "i32.shr_u"; break;
        case 0x77: name = "i32.rotl"; break;
    }

    if (name) {
        console.log(`${hex(addr)}  ${name}`);
    }

    switch (op) {
        case 0x20:
        case 0x21:
        case 0x22:
        case 0x23:
        case 0x24: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            break;
        }

        case 0x10:
        case 0x0c:
        case 0x0d: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next + 1;
            break;
        }

        case 0x28:
        case 0x36:
        case 0x37: {
            const a = readULEB(x);
            x = a.next;

            const o = readULEB(x);
            x = o.next;
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            break;
        }

        case 0x42:
            while ((wasm[x++] & 0x80) !== 0) {}
            break;

        case 0x43:
            x += 4;
            break;

        case 0x44:
            x += 8;
            break;
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x6e81;
const END   = 0x74a6;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v -= 2 ** (shift + 7);

      return { value: v, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

let p = START;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Skip local declarations
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const groups = uleb(p);
p = groups.next;

for (let i = 0; i < groups.value; i++) {
  const n = uleb(p);
  p = n.next;
  p++;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Track simple constant stack values
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const stack = [];

const loads = [];
const stores = [];
const globals = [];
const constants = [];
const branches = [];

function pop() {
  return stack.length ? stack.pop() : null;
}

function push(x) {
  stack.push(x);
}

while (p < END) {
  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Constants
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = sleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    push(x.value);

    constants.push({
      at,
      kind: "i32.const",
      value: x.value
    });

    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x42) {
    const x = sleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    push(x.value);

    constants.push({
      at,
      kind: "i64.const",
      value: x.value
    });

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // locals
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    push(`L${x.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    const v = pop();

    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    const v = stack.length ? stack[stack.length - 1] : null;

    push(`L${x.value}`);

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // globals
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x23) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    push(`G${x.value}`);

    globals.push({
      at,
      op: "global.get",
      index: x.value
    });

    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x24) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    const v = pop();

    globals.push({
      at,
      op: "global.set",
      index: x.value,
      value: v
    });

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // memory load/store
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) {
    const align = uleb(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = uleb(p);
    p = offset.next;

    const address = stack.length
      ? stack[stack.length - 1]
      : null;

    const value = pop();

    loads.push({
      at,
      opcode: op,
      offset: offset.value,
      address
    });

    // load result
    push(`LOAD(${address ?? "?"}+${hex(offset.value)})`);

    continue;
  }

  if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {
    const align = uleb(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = uleb(p);
    p = offset.next;

    const value = pop();
    const address = pop();

    stores.push({
      at,
      opcode: op,
      offset: offset.value,
      address,
      value
    });

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Branches
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    branches.push({
      at,
      opcode: op,
      target: x.value
    });

    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x0e) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;

    const targets = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      targets.push(x.value);
    }

    branches.push({
      at,
      opcode: op,
      targets
    });

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Memory.size/grow
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
    p++;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Comparisons / arithmetic
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    (op >= 0x45 && op <= 0x4f) ||
    (op >= 0x50 && op <= 0x5b) ||
    (op >= 0x67 && op <= 0x78)
  ) {
    pop();
    pop();
    push("EXPR");
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // block / loop / if
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    p++;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // drop
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x1a) {
    pop();
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // select
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x1b) {
    pop();
    pop();
    pop();
    push("SELECT");
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Misc stack operators
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (op === 0x0f || op === 0x0b) {
    continue;
  }

  // For unhandled instructions, don't attempt dangerous
  // immediate parsing. We only need the access inventory.
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Output
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 83 MEMORY / GLOBAL ANALYSIS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY : ${hex(START)} .. ${hex(END)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

console.log("CONSTANTS:");

for (const x of constants) {
  if (
    x.value === 0x195348 ||
    x.value === 0x19534c ||
    x.value === 0x195350 ||
    x.value === 0x195354 ||
    x.value === 0x195358 ||
    x.value === 0x19535c ||
    x.value === 0x195360
  ) {
    console.log(
      `  ${hex(x.at)}  ${x.kind} ${hex(x.value >>> 0)}`
    );
  }
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("MEMORY ACCESSES:");

for (const x of loads) {
  console.log(
    `  LOAD  ${hex(x.at)}  opcode=0x${x.opcode.toString(16)}` +
    ` offset=${x.offset} base=${x.address ?? "?"}`
  );
}

for (const x of stores) {
  console.log(
    `  STORE ${hex(x.at)}  opcode=0x${x.opcode.toString(16)}` +
    ` offset=${x.offset} base=${x.address ?? "?"}`
  );
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("GLOBALS:");

for (const x of globals) {
  console.log(
    `  ${hex(x.at)}  ${x.op} ${x.index}` +
    (x.value !== undefined ? ` value=${x.value}` : "")
  );
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("BRANCHES:");

for (const x of branches) {
  if (x.targets)
    console.log(`  ${hex(x.at)}  br_table -> ${x.targets.join(",")}`);
  else
    console.log(`  ${hex(x.at)}  opcode=0x${x.opcode.toString(16)} target=${x.target}`);
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const path =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(path);

const START = 0x001243d3;
const END   = 0x00124729;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 3550 LIMB ANALYSIS v55");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`WASM size : ${b.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Range     : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");

function hex(n: number, width = 16): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readU32(p: number): number {
    return (
        b[p] |
        (b[p + 1] << 8) |
        (b[p + 2] << 16) |
        (b[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(p: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[p++];

        result |=
            BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (
        shift < 64n &&
        (byte & 0x40)
    ) {
        result |=
            (-1n) << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        next: p
    };
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;

const TARGET_SLOT = 7697;

const CANDIDATES = [
  0x002bacae,
  0x002bbfa9,
  0x002bf7e6,
  0x002ced71,
  0x0030211a,
  0x0030229c,
];

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { v, p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/*
   Build function-body ranges.

   There are 83 imported functions.
   Therefore:

      global function = body ordinal + 83
*/

function getCodeBodies() {

  let p = CODE_START;

  const bodyCountR = uleb(p);
  const bodyCount = bodyCountR.v;
  p = bodyCountR.p;

  const bodies: {
    ordinal: number;
    global: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
  }[] = [];

  for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < bodyCount; ordinal++) {

    const sizeR = uleb(p);
    p = sizeR.p;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sizeR.v;

    bodies.push({
      ordinal,
      global: ordinal + 83,
      start,
      end,
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = getCodeBodies();

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x00008111;
const END   = 0x00008174;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[p++];

    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[p++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {

      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << shift);

      return {
        value: v | 0,
        next: p
      };
    }
  }
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function main() {

  let p = START;

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("FUNCTION 96 INPUT / LOCAL1 ANALYSIS");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`RANGE : ${hex(START)} .. ${hex(END)}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  let step = 0;

  while (p < END) {

    const at = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    step++;

    if (op === 0x20) {

      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  local.get ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x21) {

      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  local.set ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x22) {

      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  local.tee ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x41) {

      const x = sleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.const ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x6a) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.add`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x71) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.and`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {

      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  call ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x28) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x36) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x45) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.eqz`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x47) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.ne`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x04) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  if`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x02) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  block`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x0d) {

      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  br_if ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (op === 0x0f) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  return`

    }

    else if (op === 0x0b) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  end`

        p = mem.next;

        console.log(

        );
      }

      else {

        console.log(
          `${hex(at)}  0xfc subopcode=${sub.value}`
        );
      }
    }

    else {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      );
    }

import { Address, Cell } from "@ton/core";
import { TonClient } from "@ton/ton";

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    "EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval"
);

const LIBRARY_HASHES = [
    "050ed2107f730a4493cfcddbc67bdb83854f1905b3486236530d5a50721d1817",
    "631cf98bbb3ee540dacc48256975d8e2c3080c6342e3ff4a9edaac6db73730041",
    "7c1f3aa01265453058887378a358cf37314856350400804c169b648c3fdfbe4c",
    "1b63154f10acd98345a65890997094e9856aa2be4f1e37060865519fa42032fd",
];

const ENDPOINT = "https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com";

async function inspectLibrary(
    client: TonClient,
    index: number,
    hash: string
) {
    console.log(`\n===== LIBRARY [${index}] =====`);
    console.log("Hash:", hash);

    try {
        const result = await client.runMethod(
            ROUTER,
            "get_router_data",
            []
        );

        console.log("Router getter still returns:", result.exitCode);

        const cell = Cell.fromBoc(
            Buffer.from(result.result[0], "base64")
        )[0];

        console.log("Getter result cell:");
        console.log("  bits:", cell.bits.length);
        console.log("  refs:", cell.refs.length);
    } catch (e: any) {
        console.log(
            "Router getter error:",
            e?.message ?? e
        );
    }

    console.log("Library reference hash only.");
    console.log("Global library resolution must be tested separately.");
}

async function main() {
    console.log("========================================");
    console.log(" ROUTER LIBRARY ANALYSIS");
    console.log("========================================");
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.");
    console.log("Router:", ROUTER.toString());
    console.log("Endpoint:", ENDPOINT);

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: ENDPOINT,
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < LIBRARY_HASHES.length; i++) {
        await inspectLibrary(
            client,
            i,
            LIBRARY_HASHES[i]
        );
    }

    console.log("\n========================================");
    console.log("ANALYSIS FINISHED");
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION");
    console.log("========================================");
}

export async function run() {
    await main();
}

    (wasm[p] |
    (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
    (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |

  const xor = v ^ TARGET;
  const add = (v + TARGET) >>> 0;
  const sub = (v - TARGET) >>> 0;

  console.log(

    (v >>> 16) === (TARGET >>> 16)
  ) {

      `  *** INTERESTING *** XOR=0x${xor.toString(16)} ` +
      `ADD=0x${add.toString(16)} SUB=0x${sub.toString(16)}`
    );
  }

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LIBRARY_HASH_HEX =
    'C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const TARGET_HASH_HEX =
    'DB8B6488B1D9B9051532EE339C86B249DF8F923B6E29975E8E474009157F601A';

const LITESERVER_HOST =
    'tcp://49.12.147.32:27842';

const LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY =
    'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM=';

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

function findCell(
    cell: Cell,
    targetHash: string
): Cell | null {
    const hash =
        cell.hash().toString('hex').toUpperCase();

    if (hash === targetHash) {
        return cell;
    }

    for (const ref of cell.refs) {
        const found = findCell(ref, targetHash);

        if (found) {
            return found;
        }
    }

    return null;
}

function getBits(
    cell: Cell,
    start: number,
    length: number
): string {
    const slice = cell.beginParse();
    slice.skip(start);

    let result = '';

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        result += slice.loadBit() ? '1' : '0';
    }

    return result;
}

function bitsToHex(bits: string): string {
    let padded = bits;

    while (padded.length % 8 !== 0) {
        padded += '0';
    }

    let hex = '';

    for (let i = 0; i < padded.length; i += 8) {
        const byte = parseInt(
            padded.slice(i, i + 8),
            2
        );

        hex += byte
            .toString(16)
            .toUpperCase()
            .padStart(2, '0');
    }

    return hex;
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LIBRARY_HASH_HEX =
    'C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const TARGET_CELL_HASH_HEX =
    'DB8B6488B1D9B9051532EE339C86B249DF8F923B6E29975E8E474009157F601A';

const LITESERVER_HOST =
    'tcp://49.12.147.32:27842';

const LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY =
    'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM=';

const TARGET_OPCODE = '50C6A654';

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

function cellBits(cell: Cell): string {
    let result = '';

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.bits.length; i++) {
        result += cell.bits.at(i) ? '1' : '0';
    }

    return result;
}

function bitsToHex(bits: string): string {
    let result = '';

    for (let i = 0; i + 4 <= bits.length; i += 4) {
        result += parseInt(bits.slice(i, i + 4), 2)
            .toString(16)
            .toUpperCase();
    }

    return result;
}

function hexToBytes(hex: string): number[] {
    const bytes: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < hex.length; i += 2) {
        bytes.push(parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
    }

    return bytes;
}

function bytesToHex(bytes: number[]): string {
    return bytes
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0').toUpperCase())
        .join(' ');
}

function readUint32(bytes: number[], offset: number): number {
    return (
        bytes[offset] * 0x1000000 +
        bytes[offset + 1] * 0x10000 +
        bytes[offset + 2] * 0x100 +
        bytes[offset + 3]
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readUint16(bytes: number[], offset: number): number {
    return (
        (bytes[offset] << 8) |
        bytes[offset + 1]
    ) >>> 0;
}

function printByteTable(
    bytes: number[],
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    console.log();
    console.log('Offset   Bytes                         UInt16        UInt32');
    console.log('-------  ----------------------------  ------------  ------------');

    for (let offset = start; offset <= end; offset += 4) {
        const remaining = Math.min(4, bytes.length - offset);

        if (remaining <= 0) {
            break;
        }

        const row = bytes.slice(offset, offset + remaining);

        let u16 = '';
        let u32 = '';

        if (offset + 2 <= bytes.length) {
            u16 =
                '0x' +
                readUint16(bytes, offset)
                    .toString(16)
                    .padStart(4, '0')
                    .toUpperCase();
        }

        if (offset + 4 <= bytes.length) {
            u32 =
                '0x' +
                readUint32(bytes, offset)
                    .toString(16)
                    .padStart(8, '0')
                    .toUpperCase();
        }

        console.log(
            `${offset.toString().padStart(7)}  ` +
            `${bytesToHex(row).padEnd(28)}  ` +
            `${u16.padEnd(12)}  ` +
            `${u32}`
        );
    }
}

function analyzeCell(
    cell: Cell,
    label: string
) {
    const hash =
        cell.hash()
            .toString('hex')
            .toUpperCase();

    const bits = cellBits(cell);
    const hex = bitsToHex(bits);

    console.log();
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(label);
    console.log('================================================================');

    console.log(`Hash: ${hash}`);
    console.log(`Bits: ${bits.length}`);
    console.log(`Refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);

    if (bits.length % 8 !== 0) {
        console.log(
            'WARNING: Cell is not byte aligned.'
        );
        return;
    }

    const bytes = hexToBytes(hex);

    console.log(`Bytes: ${bytes.length}`);
    console.log();

    console.log('FULL HEX:');
    console.log(hex);

    const opcodeOffset = hex.indexOf(TARGET_OPCODE);

    if (opcodeOffset === -1) {
        console.log();
        console.log(
            `Target ${TARGET_OPCODE} NOT FOUND in this Cell.`
        );
    } else {
        const byteOffset = opcodeOffset / 2;

        console.log();
        console.log('****************************************************************');
        console.log(`TARGET ${TARGET_OPCODE}`);
        console.log('****************************************************************');
        console.log(`Hex character offset: ${opcodeOffset}`);
        console.log(`Byte offset:         ${byteOffset}`);
        console.log(`Bit offset:          ${byteOffset * 8}`);

        console.log();
        console.log('32-bit value:');

        const value = readUint32(bytes, byteOffset);

        console.log(
            `0x${value.toString(16).padStart(8, '0').toUpperCase()}`
        );

        console.log(
            `Decimal: ${value}`
        );

        const start = Math.max(0, byteOffset - 32);
        const end = Math.min(bytes.length - 1, byteOffset + 31);

        console.log();
        console.log(
            `BYTE WINDOW: ${start} .. ${end}`
        );

        printByteTable(bytes, start, end);

        console.log();
        console.log('Exact surrounding bytes:');

        const aroundStart =
            Math.max(0, byteOffset - 16);

        const aroundEnd =
            Math.min(bytes.length, byteOffset + 48);

        console.log(
            bytesToHex(
                bytes.slice(
                    aroundStart,
                    aroundEnd
                )
            )
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('32-BIT WORD SCAN:');

    for (let offset = 0; offset + 4 <= bytes.length; offset += 4) {
        const value = readUint32(bytes, offset);

        if (
            value === 0x50c6a654 ||
            value === 0xf8416f17 ||
            value === 0xf8416f13
        ) {
            console.log(
                `  offset ${offset
                    .toString()
                    .padStart(3)} -> ` +
                `0x${value
                    .toString(16)
                    .padStart(8, '0')
                    .toUpperCase()}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('FIRST 32-BIT WORDS:');

    const firstWords =
        Math.min(16, Math.floor(bytes.length / 4));

    for (let i = 0; i < firstWords; i++) {
        const offset = i * 4;
        const value = readUint32(bytes, offset);

        console.log(
            `  [${offset
                .toString()
                .padStart(3)}] ` +
            `0x${value
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, '0')
                .toUpperCase()}`
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('REFERENCES:');

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
        const ref = cell.refs[i];

        console.log();
        console.log(`ref${i}:`);

        console.log(
            `  Hash: ${ref.hash()
                .toString('hex')
                .toUpperCase()}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  Bits: ${ref.bits.length}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  Refs: ${ref.refs.length}`
        );

        if (ref.bits.length % 8 === 0) {
            const refHex =
                bitsToHex(cellBits(ref));

            console.log(
                `  Hex: ${refHex}`
            );
        }
    }
}

        const started = Date.now();

        while (!engine.isReady()) {
            if (Date.now() - started > 15000) {
                throw new Error(
                    'LiteServer did not become ready within 15 seconds'
                );
            }

            await sleep(250);
        }

        console.log('ADNL READY');
        console.log();

        const client = new LiteClient({
            engine,
        });

        const result =
            await client.getLibraries([
                Buffer.from(
                    LIBRARY_HASH_HEX,
                    'hex'
                ),
            ]);

        const entry =
            result.result.find(
                item =>
                    Buffer.from(item.hash)
                        .toString('hex')

        if (!entry) {

        let targetPath = '';

        function find(
            cell: Cell,
            path: string
        ): boolean {
            const hash =
                cell.hash()
                    .toString('hex')
                    .toUpperCase();

            if (hash === TARGET_CELL_HASH_HEX) {
                target = cell;
                targetPath = path;
                return true;

                }

            return false;

        find(root, 'root');

        if (!target) {
            throw new Error(
                'Target Cell not found'

    }

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const U32 = (p: number) =>
  wasm[p] |
  (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
  (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
  (wasm[p + 3] << 24);

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

const DATA_START = 0x324ef5;
const DATA_PAYLOAD = DATA_START + 4;

let p = DATA_PAYLOAD;
const seg = [];

const count = readULEB(p);
p = count.next;

for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
  const flags = readULEB(p);
  p = flags.next;

  let memoryIndex = 0;

  if (flags.value & 2) {
    const mi = readULEB(p);
    memoryIndex = mi.value;
    p = mi.next;
  }

  const exprOpcode = wasm[p++];
  if (exprOpcode !== 0x41) {
    throw new Error(
      `Unexpected data offset opcode at ${p - 1}: 0x${exprOpcode.toString(16)}`
    );
  }

  const off = readULEB(p);
  p = off.next;

  const end = wasm[p++];
  if (end !== 0x0b) {
    throw new Error(`Bad init_expr end at ${p - 1}`);
  }

  const size = readULEB(p);
  p = size.next;

  const dataStart = p;
  const dataEnd = p + size.value;

  seg.push({
    index: i,
    memoryIndex,
    offset: off.value,
    size: size.value,
    fileStart: dataStart,
    fileEnd: dataEnd,
  });

  p = dataEnd;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET RECORD SCHEMA ANALYSIS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`WASM size = ${wasm.length}`);
console.log(`DATA segments = ${seg.length}`);

const memorySize = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
const memory = new Uint8Array(memorySize);

let mapped = 0;

for (const s of seg) {
  if (s.memoryIndex !== 0) continue;

  const end = s.offset + s.size;
  if (end > memory.length) continue;

  memory.set(
    wasm.subarray(s.fileStart, s.fileEnd),
    s.offset
  );

  mapped += s.size;
}

function memU32(addr: number): number {
  return (
    memory[addr] |
    (memory[addr + 1] << 8) |
    (memory[addr + 2] << 16) |
    (memory[addr + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function hex(v: number) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function region(addr: number) {
  if (addr >= 0x187000 && addr < 0x18ab8d) return "SEG412";
  if (addr >= 0x18ab98 && addr < 0x18f512) return "SEG413";
  return "OTHER";
}

console.log(`MEMORY mapped bytes = ${mapped}`);
console.log("");

const targets = [
  {
    value: 2053,
    addr: 0x00189dec,
    function: 8952,
  },
  {
    value: 2101,
    addr: 0x00189f9c,
    function: 8927,
  },
  {
    value: 2612,
    addr: 0x0018a8b0,
    function: 8637,
  },
];

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET RECORDS");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const t of targets) {
  console.log(
    `${t.value} @ ${hex(t.addr)} -> Function ${t.function}`
  );
}

console.log("");

/*
 * The target values occur in repeated metadata records.
 * Inspect a generous window around each target.
 *
 * We print:
 *   - aligned u32 values
 *   - decimal value
 *   - possible memory pointer region
 *
 * This lets us compare the record schema without assuming
 * the record size beforehand.
 */

const WINDOW_BEFORE = 0x50;
const WINDOW_AFTER = 0x50;

for (const t of targets) {
  console.log("");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(
    `TARGET ${t.value} / FUNCTION ${t.function}`
  );
  console.log(
    `CENTER = ${hex(t.addr)}`
  );
  console.log("============================================================");

  const start = t.addr - WINDOW_BEFORE;
  const end = t.addr + WINDOW_AFTER;

  for (let a = start; a <= end; a += 4) {
    const v = memU32(a);

    let tag = "";

    if (v === t.value) {
      tag = " <-- TARGET";
    } else if (v >= 2000 && v <= 3000) {
      tag = " [FUNC/INDEX]";
    } else if (v >= 0x187000 && v <= 0x18f512) {
      tag = ` [${region(v)} PTR]`;
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(a)} : ${hex(v)} = ${v}${tag}`
    );
  }
}

/*
 * Find all exact target occurrences again, then print
 * neighboring u32 values in a compact record form.
 */

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET OCCURRENCE CONTEXT");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const t of targets) {
  const hits: number[] = [];

  for (let a = 0x187000; a + 4 <= 0x18ab8d; a += 4) {
    if (memU32(a) === t.value) {
      hits.push(a);
    }
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log(
    `TARGET ${t.value}: ${hits.length} aligned occurrence(s)`
  );

  for (const addr of hits) {

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

let p = 8; // wasm magic + version

function u8() {
    return buf[p++];
}

function u32() {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return result >>> 0;

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function bytes(n) {
    const start = p;
    p += n;
    return buf.subarray(start, p);
}

function readVec(fn) {
    const n = u32();
    const out = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
        out.push(fn());

    return out;
}

function readName() {
    const n = u32();
    const s = Buffer.from(bytes(n));
    return s.toString("utf8");
}

function hex(x, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function signedI32(x) {
    return x | 0;
}

function valTypeName(v) {
    const map = {
        0x7f: "i32",
        0x7e: "i64",
        0x7d: "f32",
        0x7c: "f64",
        0x7b: "v128",
        0x70: "funcref",
        0x6f: "externref"
    };

    return map[v] || `0x${v.toString(16)}`;
}

function parseLimits() {
    const flags = u8();
    const min = u32();

    let max = null;

    if (flags & 0x01)
        max = u32();

    return { flags, min, max };
}

    if (functionIndex < importedFunctionCount) {
        const imp = imports[functionIndex];

        return imp ? imp.typeIndex : null;
    }

    const definedIndex = functionIndex - importedFunctionCount;

    return functionTypeIndices[definedIndex] ?? null;

function isType4(functionIndex) {
    return functionType(functionIndex) === 4;
}

console.log("ELEMENT SEGMENTS");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`ELEMENT COUNT : ${elementCount}`);

for (let seg = 0; seg < elementCount; seg++) {

    const flags = u32();

    let tableIndex = 0;
    let offset = null;
    let functionIndices = [];

    /*
       flags 0:
         active table 0
         offset expr
         vec(funcidx)

       flags 2:
         active explicit table
         offset expr
         elemkind
         vec(funcidx)

       flags 1 / 3:
         passive/declarative legacy forms

       flags 4 / 6:
         expression-based active segments
    */

    if (flags === 0) {

        // offset expression
        const opcode = u8();

        if (opcode !== 0x41)
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${seg}: expected i32.const, got 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
            );

        offset = signedI32(u32());

        const end = u8();

        if (end !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${seg}: expected end`
            );

        const n = u32();

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
            functionIndices.push(u32());
    }

    else if (flags === 2) {

        tableIndex = u32();

        const opcode = u8();

        if (opcode !== 0x41)
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${seg}: expected i32.const`
            );

        offset = signedI32(u32());

        const end = u8();

        if (end !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${seg}: expected end`
            );

        const elemKind = u8();

        if (elemKind !== 0x00)
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${seg}: unsupported elemkind 0x${elemKind.toString(16)}`
            );

        const n = u32();

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
            functionIndices.push(u32());
    }

    else if (flags === 1 || flags === 3) {

        if (flags === 1) {
            u8(); // elemkind
        }
        else {
            u32(); // table index
            u8();  // elemkind
        }

        const n = u32();

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
            u32();

        continue;
    }

    else if (flags === 4 || flags === 6) {

        if (flags === 6)
            tableIndex = u32();

        // offset expression
        const opcode = u8();

        if (opcode !== 0x41)
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${seg}: unsupported offset expression opcode 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
            );

        offset = signedI32(u32());

        const end = u8();

        if (end !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${seg}: expected end`
            );

        // elemtype
        u8();

        const n = u32();

        /*
          expression form:
             vec(expr)
             each expr = ref.func funcidx end
        */

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            const refFunc = u8();

            if (refFunc !== 0xd2) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Segment ${seg}: expected ref.func, got 0x${refFunc.toString(16)}`
                );
            }

            const f = u32();

            functionIndices.push(f);

            const endExpr = u8();

            if (endExpr !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Segment ${seg}: expected expr end`
                );
            }
        }
    }

    else {
        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported element segment flags: ${flags}`
        );
    }

    const info = {
        segment: seg,
        flags,
        tableIndex,
        offset,
        count: functionIndices.length,
        functionIndices
    };

    table0Segments.push(info);

    console.log(
        `SEG ${seg.toString().padStart(3)} ` +
        `FLAGS=${flags} ` +
        `TABLE=${tableIndex} ` +
        `OFFSET=${offset} ` +
        `COUNT=${functionIndices.length}`
    );
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readU32(buf, p) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readName(buf, p) {
    const n = readU32(buf, p);
    return {
        next: n.next + n.value
    };
}

function skipLimits(buf, p) {
    const flags = buf[p++];

    const min = readU32(buf, p);
    p = min.next;

    if (flags & 1) {
        const max = readU32(buf, p);
        p = max.next;
    }

    return p;
}

function getSections(buf) {
    const sections = [];
    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readU32(buf, p);
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = start + sizeInfo.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start,
            end
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseTypes(buf, section) {
    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const types = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {
        const form = buf[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unexpected type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at type ${i}`
            );
        }

        const pc = readU32(buf, p);
        p = pc.next;

        const params = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
            params.push(buf[p++]);
        }

        const rc = readU32(buf, p);
        p = rc.next;

        const results = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
            results.push(buf[p++]);
        }

        types.push({
            params,
            results
        });
    }

    return types;
}

function parseImports(buf, section) {
    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const importedTypes = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {
        const module = readName(buf, p);
        p = module.next;

        const name = readName(buf, p);
        p = name.next;

        const kind = buf[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const t = readU32(buf, p);
            p = t.next;

            importedTypes.push(t.value);
        }

        else if (kind === 1) {
            p += 1;
            p = skipLimits(buf, p);
        }

        else if (kind === 2) {
            p = skipLimits(buf, p);
        }

        else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;
        }

        else {
            throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind}`);
        }
    }

    return importedTypes;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(buf, section) {
    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const result = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {
        const t = readU32(buf, p);
        p = t.next;

        result.push(t.value);
    }

    return result;
}

function typeSignature(types, typeIndex) {
    const t = types[typeIndex];

    if (!t) {
        return "UNKNOWN";
    }

    const p = t.params
        .map(x => `0x${x.toString(16)}`)
        .join(",");

    const r = t.results
        .map(x => `0x${x.toString(16)}`)
        .join(",");

    return `(${p})->(${r})`;
}

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("ANALYZE TYPE 4 FAMILIES");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log();
console.log("WASM SIZE :", wasm.length);

const sections = getSections(wasm);

const typeSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 1);
const importSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 2);
const functionSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 3);
const elementSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 9);

if (!typeSection || !functionSection || !elementSection) {
    throw new Error("Required WASM sections missing");
}

const types = parseTypes(wasm, typeSection);

const importedTypes = importSection
    ? parseImports(wasm, importSection)
    : [];

const definedTypes =
    parseFunctionTypes(wasm, functionSection);

const functionTypes =
    importedTypes.concat(definedTypes);

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// REAL ELEMENT TABLE
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = elementSection.start;

const seg = readU32(wasm, p);
p = seg.next;

if (seg.value !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
        `Expected 1 element segment, got ${seg.value}`
    );
}

const flags = readU32(wasm, p);
p = flags.next;

if (flags.value !== 0) {
    throw new Error(
        `Expected flags 0, got ${flags.value}`
    );
}

if (wasm[p++] !== 0x41) {
    throw new Error("Expected i32.const");
}

let offset = 0;
let shift = 0;

while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    offset |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
        break;
    }

    shift += 7;
}

if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b) {
    throw new Error("Expected end opcode");
}

const countInfo = readU32(wasm, p);
p = countInfo.next;

const count = countInfo.value;

if (count !== 8992) {
    throw new Error(
        `Expected 8992 table entries, got ${count}`
    );
}

const table = new Array(offset + count);

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const f = readU32(wasm, p);
    p = f.next;

    table[offset + i] = f.value;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// COLLECT TYPE 4 TARGETS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const type4 = [];

for (let tableIndex = 0; tableIndex < table.length; tableIndex++) {
    const func = table[tableIndex];

    if (func === undefined) {
        continue;
    }

    const typeIndex = functionTypes[func];

    if (typeIndex === 4) {
        type4.push({
            tableIndex,
            func,
            typeIndex
        });
    }
}

console.log();
console.log("TABLE ENTRIES :", count);
console.log("TABLE OFFSET  :", offset);
console.log("TYPE 4 COUNT  :", type4.length);
console.log(
    "ELEMENT END VERIFIED :",
    p === elementSection.end ? "YES" : "NO"
);

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// GROUP CONSECUTIVE TYPE 4 TABLE ENTRIES
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const groups = [];

let current = null;

for (const item of type4) {

    if (!current) {
        current = {
            start: item.tableIndex,
            end: item.tableIndex,
            funcs: [item.func]
        };
        continue;
    }

    if (item.tableIndex === current.end + 1) {
        current.end = item.tableIndex;
        current.funcs.push(item.func);
    }
    else {
        groups.push(current);

        current = {
            start: item.tableIndex,
            end: item.tableIndex,
            funcs: [item.func]
        };
    }
}

if (current) {
    groups.push(current);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// GROUP STATISTICS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const lengthDistribution = new Map();

for (const g of groups) {
    const len = g.end - g.start + 1;

    lengthDistribution.set(
        len,
        (lengthDistribution.get(len) || 0) + 1
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const targetFunc = 656;

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);
let p = 8;

function u8() {
  return b[p++];
}

function readULEB() {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = u8();
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) return v >>> 0;

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB() {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = u8();
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
        v -= 2 ** s;
      }
      return v | 0;
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v, n = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

function readName() {
  const n = readULEB();
  const start = p;
  p += n;
  return b.subarray(start, start + n).toString("utf8");
}

function skipLimits() {
  const flags = readULEB();
  readULEB();

  if (flags & 1) {
    readULEB();
  }
}

// PARSE MODULE
// ============================================================

let importedFunctions = 0;
let funcTypeIndices = [];
let codeBodies = [];
let types = [];

while (p < b.length) {
  const sectionId = u8();
  const sectionSize = readULEB();
  const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

  // TYPE
  if (sectionId === 1) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const form = u8();

      if (form !== 0x60) {
        throw new Error(
          `Unexpected type form ${hex(form, 2)}`
        );
      }

      const np = readULEB();
      const params = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < np; j++) {
        params.push(u8());
      }

      const nr = readULEB();
      const results = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < nr; j++) {
        results.push(u8());
      }

      types.push({
        params,
        results
      });
    }
  }

  // IMPORT
  else if (sectionId === 2) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      readName();
      readName();

      const kind = u8();

      if (kind === 0) {
        readULEB();
        importedFunctions++;
      }

      else if (kind === 1) {
        u8();
        skipLimits();
      }

      else if (kind === 2) {
        skipLimits();
      }

      else if (kind === 3) {
        u8();
        u8();
      }
    }
  }

  // FUNCTION
  else if (sectionId === 3) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      funcTypeIndices.push(readULEB());
    }
  }

  // CODE
  else if (sectionId === 10) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const size = readULEB();

      const start = p;
      const end = p + size;

      codeBodies.push({
        start,
        end,
        size
      });

      p = end;
    }
  }

  p = sectionEnd;
}

function blockType() {
  const x = u8();

  if (x === 0x40) return "0x40";
  if (x === 0x7f) return "i32";
  if (x === 0x7e) return "i64";
  if (x === 0x7d) return "f32";
  if (x === 0x7c) return "f64";

  return hex(x, 2);
}

function memArg() {
  const align = readULEB();
  const offset = readULEB();

  return {
    align,
    offset
  };
}

while (p < body.end) {
  const at = p;
  const op = u8();

  let line =
    names[op] ||
    `opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

  const rec = {
    at,
    op,
    line
  };

  switch (op) {

    case 0x02:
    case 0x03:
    case 0x04: {
      const bt = blockType();

      line += ` blocktype=${bt}`;
      rec.blockType = bt;

      break;
    }

    case 0x0c:
    case 0x0d: {
      const depth = readULEB();

      line += ` ${depth}`;
      rec.depth = depth;

      break;
    }

    case 0x0e: {
      const n = readULEB();
      const labels = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        labels.push(readULEB());
      }

      const def = readULEB();

      line +=
        ` labels=[${labels.join(",")}]` +
        ` default=${def}`;

      break;
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const func = readULEB();

      line += ` FUNC ${func}`;
      rec.func = func;

      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const ti = readULEB();
      const table = readULEB();

      line +=
        ` TYPE ${ti}` +
        ` TABLE ${table}`;

      rec.typeIndex = ti;
      rec.tableIndex = table;

      break;
    }

    case 0x20:
    case 0x21:
    case 0x22: {
      const local = readULEB();

      line += ` L${local}`;
      rec.local = local;

      break;
    }

    case 0x23:
    case 0x24: {
      const global = readULEB();

      line += ` G${global}`;
      rec.global = global;

      break;
    }

    case 0x28:
    case 0x29:
    case 0x2d:
    case 0x2f:
    case 0x36:
    case 0x37:
    case 0x3a:
    case 0x3b: {
      const m = memArg();

      line +=
        ` align=${m.align}` +
        ` offset=${m.offset}`;

      rec.align = m.align;
      rec.offset = m.offset;

      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const value = readSLEB();

      line +=
        ` ${value}` +
        ` (${hex(value)})`;

      rec.value = value;

      break;
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const value = readSLEB();

      line += ` ${value}`;
      rec.value = value;

      break;
    }

    case 0xfc: {
      const sub = readULEB();

      line +=
        ` subopcode=0x${sub.toString(16)}`;

      rec.subopcode = sub;

      break;
    }

    default:
      break;
  }

  rec.line = line;
  instructions.push(rec);

  console.log(
    `${hex(at)}  ${line}`
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const START = 0x23a188;
const END   = 0x23a21b;

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    if (x === undefined)
      throw new Error(`ULEB out of range @ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`);

    v += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, s);

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    s += 7;

    if (s > 35)
      throw new Error(`ULEB too long @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
  }
}

function readSLEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    if (x === undefined)
      throw new Error(`SLEB out of range @ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`);

    v += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, s);

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v -= Math.pow(2, s + 7);

      return {
        value: v | 0,
        next: p
      };
    }

    s += 7;

    if (s > 35)
      throw new Error(`SLEB too long @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
  }
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function blockType(p: number) {
  const x = b[p];

  if (x === undefined)
    throw new Error(`BLOCKTYPE out of range @ ${hex(p)}`);

  /*
   * MVP block types:
   * 0x40 = empty result
   * 0x7f = i32
   * 0x7e = i64
   * 0x7d = f32
   * 0x7c = f64
   */

  if (x === 0x40)
    return { text: "type=void", next: p + 1 };

  if (x === 0x7f)
    return { text: "type=i32", next: p + 1 };

  if (x === 0x7e)
    return { text: "type=i64", next: p + 1 };

  if (x === 0x7d)
    return { text: "type=f32", next: p + 1 };

  if (x === 0x7c)
    return { text: "type=f64", next: p + 1 };

  const r = readSLEB(p);

  return {
    text: `type=typeidx(${r.value})`,
    next: r.next
  };
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 6919 EXACT DECODER / AUDIT");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`RANGE : ${hex(START)} .. ${hex(END)}`);
console.log("TARGET: MEM[0x25100C]");
console.log("============================================================");

let p = START;
let depth = 0;

while (p < END) {

  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  if (op === undefined)
    break;

  let s = "";

  switch (op) {

    case 0x00:
      s = "unreachable";
      break;

    case 0x01:
      s = "nop";
      break;

    case 0x02: {
      const r = blockType(p);
      p = r.next;
      depth++;
      s = `block ${r.text}  depth=${depth}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x03: {
      const r = blockType(p);
      p = r.next;
      depth++;
      s = `loop ${r.text}  depth=${depth}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x04: {
      const r = blockType(p);
      p = r.next;
      depth++;
      s = `if ${r.text}  depth=${depth}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x05:
      s = `else depth=${depth}`;
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      s = `end depth=${depth}`;
      if (depth > 0)
        depth--;
      break;

    case 0x0c: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `br ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `br_if ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0e: {
      const n = readULEB(p);
      p = n.next;

      const labels: number[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        labels.push(r.value);
      }

      const d = readULEB(p);
      p = d.next;

      s = `br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${d.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0f:
      s = "return";
      break;

    case 0x10: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `call FUNC ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = readULEB(p);
      p = t.next;

      const table = readULEB(p);
      p = table.next;

      s = `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x1a:
      s = "drop";
      break;

    case 0x1b:
      s = "select";
      break;

    case 0x20: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `local.get ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `local.set ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `global.get ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `global.set ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      s = `i32.load align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;

      if (off.value === 0x25100c)
        s += "  <<< TARGET ADDRESS AS OFFSET";

      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      s = `i32.store align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;

      if (off.value === 0x25100c)
        s += "  <<< TARGET ADDRESS AS OFFSET";

      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const r = readSLEB(p);
      p = r.next;

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const ranges = [
  { fn: 821, start: 0x0003899d, end: 0x00038a21 },
  { fn: 822, start: 0x00038a22, end: 0x00038a47 },
];

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    if (x === undefined)
      throw new Error(`ULEB OOB @ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`);

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    if (x === undefined)
      throw new Error(`SLEB OOB @ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`);

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v -= 2 ** (s + 7);

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function blockType(p: number) {
  const x = b[p];

  if (x === 0x40) return { text: "void", next: p + 1 };
  if (x === 0x7f) return { text: "i32", next: p + 1 };
  if (x === 0x7e) return { text: "i64", next: p + 1 };
  if (x === 0x7d) return { text: "f32", next: p + 1 };
  if (x === 0x7c) return { text: "f64", next: p + 1 };

  const r = readSLEB(p);

  return {
    text: `typeidx(${r.value})`,
    next: r.next,
  };
}

function decode(start: number, end: number, fn: number) {
  console.log("");
  console.log("############################################################");
  console.log(`FUNC ${fn}`);
  console.log("############################################################");
  console.log(`BODY : ${hex(start)} .. ${hex(end)}`);
  console.log(`SIZE : ${end - start}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  let p = start;
  let depth = 0;

  while (p < end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === undefined)
      break;

    let s = "";

    switch (op) {
      case 0x00:
        s = "unreachable";
        break;

      case 0x01:
        s = "nop";
        break;

      case 0x02: {
        const r = blockType(p);
        p = r.next;
        depth++;
        s = `block ${r.text} depth=${depth}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x03: {
        const r = blockType(p);
        p = r.next;
        depth++;
        s = `loop ${r.text} depth=${depth}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x04: {
        const r = blockType(p);
        p = r.next;
        depth++;
        s = `if ${r.text} depth=${depth}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x05:
        s = `else depth=${depth}`;
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        s = `end depth=${depth}`;
        if (depth > 0) depth--;
        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        s = `br ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        s = `br_if ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0f:
        s = "return";
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        s = `CALL FUNC ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const t = readULEB(p);
        p = t.next;

        const table = readULEB(p);
        p = table.next;

        s = `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x1a:
        s = "drop";
        break;

      case 0x1b:
        s = "select";
        break;

      case 0x20: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        s = `local.get ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        s = `local.set ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        s = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        s = `global.get ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        s = `global.set ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x28: {
        const a = readULEB(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = readULEB(p);
        p = o.next;

        s = `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x36: {
        const a = readULEB(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = readULEB(p);
        p = o.next;

        s = `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {

        p = r.next;
        s = `i32.const ${r.value} (${hex(r.value)})`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x45:
        s = "i32.eqz";
        break;

      case 0x46:
        s = "i32.eq";
        break;

      case 0x47:
        s = "i32.ne";
        break;

      case 0x48:
        s = "i32.lt_s";
        break;

      case 0x49:

        break;

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const START = 0x0003899d;
const END   = 0x00038a21;

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    if (x === undefined)
      throw new Error(`ULEB OOB @ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`);

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p: number, bits = 32) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    if (x === undefined)
      throw new Error(`SLEB OOB @ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`);

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < bits && (x & 0x40))
        v -= 2 ** (s + 7);

      return { value: v, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;

    if (s > bits + 7)
      throw new Error(`SLEB too long @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
  }
}

function hex(x: number | bigint) {
  if (typeof x === "bigint")
    return "0x" + x.toString(16);

  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function blockType(p: number) {
  const x = b[p];

  if (x === 0x40) return { text: "void", next: p + 1 };
  if (x === 0x7f) return { text: "i32", next: p + 1 };
  if (x === 0x7e) return { text: "i64", next: p + 1 };
  if (x === 0x7d) return { text: "f32", next: p + 1 };
  if (x === 0x7c) return { text: "f64", next: p + 1 };

  const r = readSLEB(p);

  return {
    text: `typeidx(${r.value})`,
    next: r.next,
  };
}

function readF64(p: number) {
  if (p + 8 > b.length)
    throw new Error("f64 OOB");

  return { next: p + 8 };
}

====================================================================================================
FILE: scripts\auditStatePath.mjs
