import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

let p = 8;

function u8() {
  return b[p++];
}

function u32() {
  const v = b.readUInt32LE(p);
  p += 4;
  return v >>> 0;
}

function readULEB() {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = u8();
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) return v >>> 0;

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB() {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = u8();
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
        v -= 2 ** s;
      }
      return v | 0;
    }
  }
}

function hex(v, n = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

function readName() {
  const n = readULEB();
  const start = p;
  p += n;
  return b.subarray(start, start + n).toString("utf8");
}

function skipLimits() {
  const flags = readULEB();
  readULEB();

  if (flags & 1) {
    readULEB();
  }
}

const types = [];
const importedFuncTypes = [];
const funcTypeIndices = [];
const codeBodies = [];

let dataSegments = [];
let tableSegments = [];

let importedFunctions = 0;

// ============================================================
// PARSE MODULE
// ============================================================

while (p < b.length) {
  const sectionId = u8();
  const sectionSize = readULEB();
  const sectionStart = p;
  const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sectionSize;

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // TYPE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (sectionId === 1) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const form = u8();

      if (form !== 0x60) {
        throw new Error(
          `Unexpected type form ${hex(form, 2)}`
        );
      }

      const np = readULEB();
      const params = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < np; j++) {
        params.push(u8());
      }

      const nr = readULEB();
      const results = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < nr; j++) {
        results.push(u8());
      }

      types.push({
        params,
        results
      });
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // IMPORT
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 2) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      readName();
      readName();

      const kind = u8();

      if (kind === 0) {
        const typeIndex = readULEB();

        importedFuncTypes.push(typeIndex);
        importedFunctions++;
      }

      else if (kind === 1) {
        u8();
        skipLimits();
      }

      else if (kind === 2) {
        skipLimits();
      }

      else if (kind === 3) {
        u8();
        u8();
      }
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // FUNCTION
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 3) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      funcTypeIndices.push(readULEB());
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // TABLE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 4) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const elemType = u8();
      const flags = readULEB();
      const min = readULEB();

      let max = null;

      if (flags & 1) {
        max = readULEB();
      }

      tableSegments.push({
        elemType,
        flags,
        min,
        max
      });
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // ELEMENT
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 9) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const segStart = p;

      const flags = readULEB();

      let tableIndex = 0;

      if (flags & 2) {
        tableIndex = readULEB();
      }

      // Active segment offset expression
      if ((flags & 1) === 0 || (flags & 2)) {
        const op = u8();

        if (op === 0x41) {
          readSLEB();
        }
        else if (op === 0x23) {
          readULEB();
        }
        else {
          throw new Error(
            `Unexpected element offset opcode ${hex(op, 2)}`
          );
        }

        const end = u8();

        if (end !== 0x0b) {
          throw new Error("Missing element offset END");
        }
      }

      const elemKind = flags & 4;

      if (elemKind) {
        // expression elements
        const n = readULEB();

        for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
          while (u8() !== 0x0b) {}
        }
      }
      else {
        const n = readULEB();
        const funcs = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
          funcs.push(readULEB());
        }

        tableSegments.push({
          elementSegment: i,
          tableIndex,
          start: segStart,
          funcs
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // CODE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 10) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const bodySize = readULEB();

      const bodyStart = p;
      const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

      codeBodies.push({
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
        bodySize
      });

      p = bodyEnd;
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // DATA
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 11) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const flags = readULEB();

      let memoryIndex = 0;
      let offset = null;

      if ((flags & 1) === 0) {
        const op = u8();

        if (op === 0x41) {
          offset = readSLEB();
        }
        else if (op === 0x23) {
          readULEB();
          offset = null;
        }
        else {
          throw new Error(
            `Unexpected data offset opcode ${hex(op, 2)}`
          );
        }

        const end = u8();

        if (end !== 0x0b) {
          throw new Error("Missing data offset END");
        }
      }
      else if (flags === 2) {
        memoryIndex = readULEB();

        const op = u8();

        if (op === 0x41) {
          offset = readSLEB();
        }
        else if (op === 0x23) {
          readULEB();
          offset = null;
        }

        const end = u8();

        if (end !== 0x0b) {
          throw new Error("Missing data offset END");
        }
      }

      const size = readULEB();

      const dataStart = p;
      const dataEnd = p + size;

      dataSegments.push({
        memoryIndex,
        offset,
        dataStart,
        dataEnd,
        size
      });

      p = dataEnd;
    }
  }

  p = sectionEnd;
}

// FUNCTION RESOLUTION
// ============================================================

function functionInfo(funcIndex) {
  if (funcIndex < importedFunctions) {
    const typeIndex = importedFuncTypes[funcIndex];

    return {
      funcIndex,
      imported: true,
      typeIndex,
      body: null
    };
  }

  const definedIndex = funcIndex - importedFunctions;

  if (
    definedIndex < 0 ||
    definedIndex >= codeBodies.length
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const typeIndex = funcTypeIndices[definedIndex];

  return {
    funcIndex,
    imported: false,
    typeIndex,
    body: codeBodies[definedIndex]
  };
}

function signature(funcIndex) {
  const info = functionInfo(funcIndex);

  if (!info) return "UNKNOWN";

  const t = types[info.typeIndex];

  if (!t) return `TYPE ${info.typeIndex} UNKNOWN`;

  const map = {
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64"
  };

  return (
    "(" +
    t.params.map(x => map[x] || hex(x, 2)).join(",") +
    ") -> (" +
    t.results.map(x => map[x] || hex(x, 2)).join(",") +
    ")"
  );
}

function scanIndirect(funcIndex) {
  const info = functionInfo(funcIndex);

  if (!info || !info.body) return;

  let q = info.body.bodyStart;

  // skip locals
  const groups = (() => {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;

    while (true) {
      const x = b[q++];

      v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

      if (!(x & 0x80)) return v;

      s += 7;
    }
  })();

  for (let i = 0; i < groups; i++) {
    // local count
    let done = false;

    while (!done) {
      const x = b[q++];

      if (!(x & 0x80)) done = true;
    }

    q++;
  }

  while (q < info.body.bodyEnd) {
    const at = q;
    const op = b[q++];

    if (op === 0x11) {
      let typeIndex = 0;
      let shift = 0;

      while (true) {
        const x = b[q++];

        typeIndex += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if (!(x & 0x80)) break;

        shift += 7;
      }

      let tableIndex = 0;
      shift = 0;

      while (true) {
        const x = b[q++];

        tableIndex += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if (!(x & 0x80)) break;

        shift += 7;
      }

      console.log(
        `FUNC ${funcIndex} CALL_INDIRECT @ ${hex(at)}` +
        ` TYPE ${typeIndex} TABLE ${tableIndex}`
      );
    }

    // enough for this audit:
    // stop at body end; unknown operands are not interpreted here
  }
}

scanIndirect(656);

console.log("AUDIT DONE");

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(p:number) {
  let v=0,s=0;
  while(true){
    const x=b[p++];
    v |= (x&127)<<s;
    if(!(x&128)) return {v:v>>>0,p};
    s+=7;
  }
}

function sleb(p:number) {
  let v=0,s=0,x=0;
  while(true){
    x=b[p++];
    v |= (x&127)<<s;
    s+=7;
    if(!(x&128)) break;
  }
  if(s<32 && (x&64)) v |= (~0<<s);
  return {v:v|0,p};
}

function str(p:number) {
  const x=uleb(p);
  return x.p+x.v;
}

let types:any[]=[];
let imported=0;
let defTypes:number[]=[];

// ---------------- TYPES / IMPORTS / FUNCTION SECTION ----------------

let p=8;

while(p<b.length){
  const id=b[p++];
  const z=uleb(p);
  const start=z.p;
  const end=start+z.v;

  if(id===1){
    let q=start;
    const n=uleb(q); q=n.p;

    for(let i=0;i<n.v;i++){
      q++; // 0x60

      const np=uleb(q); q=np.p;
      const params:number[]=[];
      for(let j=0;j<np.v;j++) params.push(b[q++]);

      const nr=uleb(q); q=nr.p;
      const results:number[]=[];
      for(let j=0;j<nr.v;j++) results.push(b[q++]);

      types.push({params,results});
    }
  }

  if(id===2){
    let q=start;
    const n=uleb(q); q=n.p;

    for(let i=0;i<n.v;i++){
      q=str(q);
      q=str(q);

      const kind=b[q++];

      if(kind===0){
        q=uleb(q).p;
        imported++;
      }
      else if(kind===1){
        q++;
        const fl=uleb(q); q=fl.p;
        q=uleb(q).p;
        if(fl.v&1) q=uleb(q).p;

      else if(kind===2){

  if(id===3){

}

type F={fn:number,start:number,end:number,code:number};

const funcs:F[]=[];

p=8;

}

function decode(f:F){
  const ins:any[]=[];
  let q=f.code;

  while(q<f.end-1){
    const off=q;
    const op=b[q++];

    let text=`op 0x${op.toString(16)}`;

    try{
      if(op===0x20){
        const x=uleb(q); q=x.p;
        text=`local.get ${x.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x21){
        const x=uleb(q); q=x.p;
        text=`local.set ${x.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x22){
        const x=uleb(q); q=x.p;
        text=`local.tee ${x.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x41){
        const x=sleb(q); q=x.p;
        text=`i32.const ${x.v} (0x${(x.v>>>0).toString(16)})`;
      }
      else if(op===0x28){
        const a=uleb(q); q=a.p;
        const o=uleb(q); q=o.p;
        text=`i32.load offset=${o.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x29){
        const a=uleb(q); q=a.p;
        const o=uleb(q); q=o.p;
        text=`i64.load offset=${o.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x36){
        const a=uleb(q); q=a.p;
        const o=uleb(q); q=o.p;
        text=`i32.store offset=${o.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x6a){
        text="i32.add";
      }
      else if(op===0x6b){
        text="i32.sub";
      }
      else if(op===0x6c){
        text="i32.mul";
      }
      else if(op===0x10){
        const x=uleb(q); q=x.p;
        text=`call ${x.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x11){
        const x=uleb(q); q=x.p;
        const y=uleb(q); q=y.p;
        text=`call_indirect type=${x.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x1a){
        text="drop";
      }
      else if(op===0x45){
        text="i32.eqz";
      }
      else if(op===0x47){
        text="i32.lt_u";
      }
      else if(op===0x04){
        q=uleb(q).p;
        text="if";
      }
      else if(op===0x05){
        text="else";
      }
      else if(op===0x0b){
        text="end";
      }
      else if(op===0x0c){
        const x=uleb(q); q=x.p;
        text=`br ${x.v}`;
      }
      else if(op===0x0d){
        const x=uleb(q); q=x.p;
        text=`br_if ${x.v}`;
      }
      else{
        // known no-immediate opcodes are left as-is
      }
    }catch{
      break;
    }

    ins.push({off,op,text});
  }

  return ins;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 4154;
const TARGET_SLOT = 114;
const TARGET_TYPE = 0;
const TARGET_TABLE = 0;

type Instr = {
    off: number;
    op: number;
    imm: number[];
    size: number;
    text: string;
};

type Value =
    | { kind: "const"; value: number; origin: string }
    | { kind: "local"; index: number; origin: string }
    | { kind: "unknown"; origin: string };

type Body = {
    func: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    bytes: Buffer;
};

function uleb(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        b = buf[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (-1 << shift);
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function readName(buf: Buffer, p: number): { name: string; next: number } {
    const n = uleb(buf, p);
    const end = n.next + n.value;
    return {
        name: buf.subarray(n.next, end).toString("utf8"),
        next: end,
    };
}

function readVec(buf: Buffer, p: number): { count: number; next: number } {
    const r = uleb(buf, p);

    return {
        count: r.value,
        next: r.next,
    };
}
function decodeInstructions(bytes: Buffer, base: number): Instr[] {
    const out: Instr[] = [];
    let p = 0;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const off = base + p;
        const start = p;
        const op = bytes[p++];

        const imm: number[] = [];
        let text = `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = sleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x42) {
            const r = sleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x20) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x21) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x22) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `call ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x11) {
            const a = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = a.next;

            const b = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = b.next;

            imm.push(a.value, b.value);
            text = `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x1a) {
            text = "drop";
        } else if (op === 0x45) {
            text = "i32.eqz";
        } else if (op === 0x46) {
            text = "i32.eq";
        } else if (op === 0x47) {
            text = "i32.ne";
        } else if (op === 0x48) {
            text = "i32.lt_s";
        } else if (op === 0x49) {
            text = "i32.lt_u";
        } else if (op === 0x4a) {
            text = "i32.gt_s";
        } else if (op === 0x4b) {
            text = "i32.gt_u";
        } else if (op === 0x4c) {
            text = "i32.le_s";
        } else if (op === 0x4d) {
            text = "i32.le_u";
        } else if (op === 0x4e) {
            text = "i32.ge_s";
        } else if (op === 0x4f) {
            text = "i32.ge_u";
        } else if (op >= 0x6a && op <= 0x78) {
            text = `numeric op 0x${op.toString(16)}`;
        } else if (op === 0x0b) {
            text = "end";
        } else if (op === 0x0f) {
            text = "return";
        } else if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
            if (p >= bytes.length) throw new Error("Missing blocktype");

            const first = bytes[p++];

            if (first === 0x40) {
                imm.push(first);
            } else if (first >= 0x40) {
                imm.push(first);
            } else {
                let val = first & 0x7f;
                let shift = 7;
                let b = first;

                while (b & 0x80) {
                    if (p >= bytes.length) throw new Error("Blocktype overflow");
                    b = bytes[p++];
                    val |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
                    shift += 7;
                }

                imm.push(val);
            }

            text = op === 0x02 ? "block" : op === 0x03 ? "loop" : "if";
        } else if (op === 0x05) {
            text = "else";
        } else if (op === 0x0c) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `br ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x0d) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x0e) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = r.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < r.value + 1; i++) {
                const x = uleb(bytes, p);
                p = x.next;
                imm.push(x.value);
            }

            text = "br_table";
        } else if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 ||
                   op === 0x2c || op === 0x2d ||
                   op === 0x2e || op === 0x2f ||
                   op === 0x30 || op === 0x31 ||
                   op === 0x32 || op === 0x33 ||
                   op === 0x34 || op === 0x35 ||
                   op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 ||
                   op === 0x38 || op === 0x39 ||
                   op === 0x3a || op === 0x3b ||
                   op === 0x3c || op === 0x3d ||
                   op === 0x3e || op === 0x3f ||
                   op === 0x40) {
            const a = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = a.next;

            const b = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = b.next;

            imm.push(a.value, b.value);
            text = `memory op 0x${op.toString(16)}`;
        } else if (op === 0x25 || op === 0x26) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = op === 0x25 ? `table.get ${r.value}` : `table.set ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x24) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x23) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            imm.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
            text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29) {
            const a = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = a.next;
            const b = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = b.next;
            imm.push(a.value, b.value);
        }

        out.push({
            off,
            op,
            imm,
            size: p - start,
            text,
        });
    }

    return out;
}

function parseSections(wasm: Buffer) {
    let p = 8;

    let typeSec: { start: number; size: number } | undefined;
    let importSec: { start: number; size: number } | undefined;
    let funcSec: { start: number; size: number } | undefined;
    let codeSec: { start: number; size: number } | undefined;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const s = uleb(wasm, p);
        const size = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;

        if (id === 1) typeSec = { start, size };
        if (id === 2) importSec = { start, size };
        if (id === 3) funcSec = { start, size };
        if (id === 10) codeSec = { start, size };

        p += size;
    }

    return { typeSec, importSec, funcSec, codeSec };
}

function parseTypes(wasm: Buffer, sec: { start: number; size: number }) {
    let p = sec.start;
    const end = p + sec.size;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);
    const count = v.count;
    p = v.next;

    const types: { params: number[]; results: number[] }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const form = wasm[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(`Unsupported type form ${form}`);
        }

        const pc = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = pc.next;

        const params = Array.from(wasm.subarray(p, p + pc.value));
        p += pc.value;

        const rc = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = rc.next;

        const results = Array.from(wasm.subarray(p, p + rc.value));
        p += rc.value;

        types.push({ params, results });
    }

    if (p !== end) {
        throw new Error(`Type section cursor mismatch ${p} != ${end}`);
    }

    return types;
}

function parseImports(wasm: Buffer, sec: { start: number; size: number }) {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);
    const count = v.count;
    p = v.next;

    let importedFuncs = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const mod = readName(wasm, p);
        p = mod.next;

        const name = readName(wasm, p);
        p = name.next;

        const kind = wasm[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;
            importedFuncs++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
            p += 4;
        } else if (kind === 2) {
            p += 1;
            const a = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = a.next;

            if (a.value === 0x40) {
                const b = uleb(wasm, p);
                p = b.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;
        } else {
            throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind}`);
        }
    }

    return importedFuncs;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number }
) {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);
    const count = v.count;
    p = v.next;

    const types: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const r = uleb(wasm, p);
        types.push(r.value);
        p = r.next;
    }

    return types;
}

function parseCodeBodies(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number },
    importedFuncs: number
): Body[] {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);
    const count = v.count;
    p = v.next;

    const bodies: Body[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const s = uleb(wasm, p);
        const size = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + size;

        bodies.push({
            func: importedFuncs + i,
            start,
            end,
            bytes: wasm.subarray(start, end),
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function cloneValue(v: Value): Value {
    if (v.kind === "const") {
        return {
            kind: "const",
            value: v.value,
            origin: v.origin,
        };
    }

    if (v.kind === "local") {
        return {
            kind: "local",
            index: v.index,
            origin: v.origin,
        };
    }

    return {
        kind: "unknown",
        origin: v.origin,
    };
}

function valueText(v: Value): string {
    if (v.kind === "const") {
        return `CONST(${v.value})`;
    }

    if (v.kind === "local") {
        return `LOCAL(${v.index})`;
    }

    return "UNKNOWN";
}

    for (const site of sites) {

                                        kind: "const",

                                        `${src.text} @ 0x${src.off.toString(16)}`
                                    );
                                    break;
                                }

                                if (

        }

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 114;

function uleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 128))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }

  throw Error("ULEB");
}

function sleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    x = b[p++];

    v |= (x & 127) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 128))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 64))
    v |= -1 << s;

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function skipName(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  return n.next + n.value;
}

function sections(b: Buffer): any {
  let p = 8;
  const r: any = {};

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    r[id] = {
      start: p,
      size: s.value
    };

    p += s.value;
  }

  return r;
}

function importedFuncs(b: Buffer, sec: any) {
  let p = sec.start;

  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  let count = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    p = skipName(b, p);
    p = skipName(b, p);

    const kind = b[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      p = uleb(b, p).next;
      count++;
    }
    else if (kind === 1 || kind === 2) {
      const f = uleb(b, p);
      p = f.next;

      p = uleb(b, p).next;

      if (f.value & 1)
        p = uleb(b, p).next;
    }
    else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return count;
}

function getBodies(
  b: Buffer,
  sec: any,
  imported: number
) {
  let p = sec.start;

  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  const out: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    out.push({
      func: imported + i,
      start: p,
      end: p + s.value,
      bytes: b.subarray(p, p + s.value)
    });

    p += s.value;
  }

  return out;
}

type I = {
  off: number;
  op: number;
  imm: number[];
  text: string;
};

function decode(b: Buffer, base: number): I[] {
  const a: I[] = [];

  let p = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const off = base + p;
    const op = b[p++];

    const imm: number[] = [];
    let text = `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`;

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22
    ) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x20
          ? `local.get ${r.value}`
          : op === 0x21
          ? `local.set ${r.value}`
          : `local.tee ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x23
          ? `global.get ${r.value}`
          : `global.set ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `call ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = uleb(b, p);
      p = t.next;

      const tab = uleb(b, p);
      p = tab.next;

      imm.push(t.value, tab.value);

      text =
        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
    }

    else if (
      op >= 0x28 &&
      op <= 0x3e
    ) {
      const al = uleb(b, p);
      p = al.next;

      const of = uleb(b, p);
      p = of.next;

      imm.push(al.value, of.value);

      text = `load offset=${of.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x6a)
      text = "i32.add";

    else if (op === 0x6b)
      text = "i32.sub";

    else if (op === 0x6c)
      text = "i32.mul";

    else if (op === 0x1a)
      text = "drop";

    else if (op === 0x0f)
      text = "return";

    else if (op === 0x0b)
      text = "end";

    else if (op === 0x05)
      text = "else";

    else if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04
    ) {
      if (p < b.length)
        p++;

      text =
        op === 0x02
          ? "block"
          : op === 0x03
          ? "loop"
          : "if";
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d
    ) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x0c
          ? `br ${r.value}`
          : `br_if ${r.value}`;
    }

    a.push({
      off,
      op,
      imm,
      text
    });
  }

  return a;
}

function show(
  a: I[],
  i: number
) {
  for (
    let j = Math.max(0, i - 10);
    j <= Math.min(a.length - 1, i + 2);
    j++
  ) {
    console.log(
      `${j === i ? " >>>" : "    "} ` +
      `0x${a[j].off.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
      a[j].text
    );
  }
}

export async function run() {
  const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
  const sec = sections(wasm);

  const imported = importedFuncs(
    wasm,
    sec[2]
  );

  const bodies = getBodies(
    wasm,
    sec[10],
    imported
  );

  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );
  console.log(
    " BACKTRACE LOCAL -> INDIRECT INDEX 114"
  );
  console.log(
    " READ ONLY - OFFLINE"
  );
  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );

  console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length}`);
  console.log(`Target    : ${TARGET}`);
  console.log();

  let sites = 0;
  let locals = 0;
  let const114 = 0;
  let constOther = 0;
  let loadSource = 0;
  let localSource = 0;
  let callSource = 0;
  let arithmeticSource = 0;
  let unknownSource = 0;

  for (const body of bodies) {
    let a: I[];

    try {
      a = decode(
        body.bytes,
        body.start
      );
    }
    catch {
      continue;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      const c = a[i];

      if (
        c.op !== 0x11 ||
        c.imm[0] !== 0 ||
        c.imm[1] !== 0
      )
        continue;

      if (i < 1)
        continue;

      const outer = a[i - 1];

      if (
        outer.op < 0x28 ||
        outer.op > 0x3e
      )
        continue;

      if (i < 3)
        continue;

      const inner = a[i - 2];
      const base = a[i - 3];

      if (
        inner.op < 0x28 ||
        inner.op > 0x3e ||
        base.op !== 0x20
      )
        continue;

      sites++;
      locals++;

      const localId = base.imm[0];

      /*
       * Search backward for the nearest definition
       * of this local.
       */
      let def = -1;

      for (
        let j = i - 4;
        j >= 0;
        j--
      ) {
        if (
          (a[j].op === 0x21 ||
           a[j].op === 0x22) &&
          a[j].imm[0] === localId
        ) {
          def = j;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (def < 0) {
        unknownSource++;

        console.log(
          `NO LOCAL DEF: func=${body.func} ` +
          `local=${localId} ` +
          `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
        );

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * The value assigned to local is normally
       * the stack value immediately before local.set/tee.
       */
      const src = def - 1;

      if (src < 0) {
        unknownSource++;
        continue;
      }

      const s = a[src];

      if (
        s.op === 0x41 &&
        s.imm[0] === TARGET
      ) {
        const114++;

        console.log(
          `FOUND 114: func=${body.func} ` +
          `local=${localId} ` +
          `def=0x${a[def].off.toString(16)} ` +
          `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
        );

        show(a, def);
        continue;
      }

      if (s.op === 0x41) {
        constOther++;

        console.log(
          `CONST SOURCE: func=${body.func} ` +
          `local=${localId} ` +
          `value=${s.imm[0]} ` +
          `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
        );

        continue;
      }

      if (
        s.op >= 0x28 &&
        s.op <= 0x3e
      ) {
        loadSource++;

        console.log(
          `LOAD SOURCE: func=${body.func} ` +
          `local=${localId} ` +
          `offset=${s.imm[1]} ` +
          `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
        );

        continue;
      }

      if (s.op === 0x20) {
        localSource++;

        console.log(
          `LOCAL SOURCE: func=${body.func} ` +
          `local=${localId} ` +
          `fromLocal=${s.imm[0]} ` +
          `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
        );

        continue;
      }

      if (s.op === 0x10) {
        callSource++;

        console.log(
          `CALL SOURCE: func=${body.func} ` +
          `local=${localId} ` +
          `callFunc=${s.imm[0]} ` +
          `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
        );

        continue;
      }

      if (
        s.op === 0x6a ||
        s.op === 0x6b ||
        s.op === 0x6c
      ) {
        arithmeticSource++;

        console.log(
          `ARITH SOURCE: func=${body.func} ` +
          `local=${localId} ` +
          `op=${s.text} ` +
          `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
        );

        continue;
      }

      unknownSource++;
    }
  }

  console.log();

  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );
  console.log("SUMMARY");
  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );

  console.log(
    `Local-base sites     : ${sites}`
  );

  console.log(
    `CONST(114) source    : ${const114}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Other CONST source  : ${constOther}`
  );

  console.log(
    `LOAD source         : ${loadSource}`
  );

  console.log(
    `LOCAL source        : ${localSource}`
  );

  console.log(
    `CALL source         : ${callSource}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Arithmetic source   : ${arithmeticSource}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Unknown source      : ${unknownSource}`
  );

  console.log();

  console.log(
    "NEXT: resolve LOAD/CALL sources that feed the local."
  );
}

====================================================================================================

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_TYPE = 0;
const TARGET_TABLE = 0;

type I = {
  off: number;
  op: number;
  imm: number[];
  text: string;
};

function uleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
  throw new Error("ULEB");
}

function sleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  while (p < b.length) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 127) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 128)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 64)) v |= -1 << s;
  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function name(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  return {
    next: n.next + n.value,
    value: b.subarray(n.next, n.next + n.value).toString()
  };
}

function sections(b: Buffer) {
  let p = 8;
  const r: any = {};

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    r[id] = { start: p, size: s.value };
    p += s.value;
  }

  return r;
}

function imports(b: Buffer, sec: any) {
  let p = sec.start;
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  let count = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    p = name(b, p).next;
    p = name(b, p).next;

    const kind = b[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      p = uleb(b, p).next;
      count++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;
      const f = uleb(b, p); p = f.next;
      p = uleb(b, p).next;
      if (f.value & 1) p = uleb(b, p).next;
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const f = uleb(b, p); p = f.next;
      p = uleb(b, p).next;
      if (f.value & 1) p = uleb(b, p).next;
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return count;
}

function funcTypes(b: Buffer, sec: any) {
  let p = sec.start;
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  const a: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const r = uleb(b, p);
    a.push(r.value);
    p = r.next;
  }

  return a;
}

function bodies(b: Buffer, sec: any, imported: number) {
  let p = sec.start;
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  const a: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    a.push({
      func: imported + i,
      start: p,
      end: p + s.value,
      bytes: b.subarray(p, p + s.value)
    });

    p += s.value;
  }

  return a;
}

function decode(b: Buffer, base: number): I[] {
  const out: I[] = [];
  let p = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const off = base + p;
    const op = b[p++];
    const imm: number[] = [];
    let text = `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`;

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text =
        op === 0x20 ? `local.get ${r.value}` :
        op === 0x21 ? `local.set ${r.value}` :
        `local.tee ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `call ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const a = uleb(b, p); p = a.next;
      const t = uleb(b, p); p = t.next;
      imm.push(a.value, t.value);
      text = `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${t.value}`;
    }
    else if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
      const a = uleb(b, p); p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(b, p); p = o.next;
      imm.push(a.value, o.value);

      const names: Record<number,string> = {
        0x28:"i32.load",
        0x29:"i64.load",
        0x2c:"i32.load8_s",
        0x2d:"i32.load8_u",
        0x2e:"i32.load16_s",
        0x2f:"i32.load16_u"
      };

      text = `${names[op] ?? "memory"} offset=${o.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x23) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x24) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x6a) text = "i32.add";
    else if (op === 0x6b) text = "i32.sub";
    else if (op === 0x6c) text = "i32.mul";
    else if (op === 0x1a) text = "drop";
    else if (op === 0x0b) text = "end";
    else if (op === 0x05) text = "else";
    else if (op === 0x04) {
      if (p >= b.length) throw new Error("if");
      p++;
      text = "if";
    }
    else if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03) {
      if (p >= b.length) throw new Error("block");
      p++;
      text = op === 0x02 ? "block" : "loop";
    }
    else if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = op === 0x0c ? `br ${r.value}` : `br_if ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x0f) text = "return";
    else if (op >= 0x45 && op <= 0x4f)
      text = "i32.compare";
    else if (op >= 0x6d && op <= 0x78)
      text = "i32.arith";

    if (p <= off - base) throw new Error("stalled");

    out.push({ off, op, imm, text });
  }

  return out;
}

function window(a: I[], i: number, n = 6) {
  for (
    let j = Math.max(0, i - n);
    j <= Math.min(a.length - 1, i + n);
    j++
  ) {
    console.log(
      `${j === i ? " >>>" : "    "} ` +
      `0x${a[j].off.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ${a[j].text}`
    );
  }
}

export async function run() {
  const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
  const s = sections(wasm);

  const imported = imports(wasm, s[2]);
  const types = funcTypes(wasm, s[3]);
  const bs = bodies(wasm, s[10], imported);

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" BACKTRACE MEMORY INDEX -> TYPE 0 / TABLE 0");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`WASM size      : ${wasm.length}`);
  console.log(`Imported funcs : ${imported}`);
  console.log(`Defined funcs  : ${types.length}`);
  console.log(`Bodies         : ${bs.length}`);
  console.log();

  let sites = 0;
  let memorySites = 0;
  let const114 = 0;
  let localSources = 0;
  let arithmeticSources = 0;

  const results: any[] = [];

  for (const body of bs) {
    let a: I[];

    try {
      a = decode(body.bytes, body.start);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      if (
        a[i].op !== 0x11 ||
        a[i].imm[0] !== TARGET_TYPE ||
        a[i].imm[1] !== TARGET_TABLE
      ) continue;

      sites++;

      const prev = a[i - 1];

      if (!prev) continue;

      if (prev.op === 0x41 && prev.imm[0] === 114) {
        const114++;
        continue;
      }

      if (
        prev.op >= 0x28 &&
        prev.op <= 0x3e
      ) {
        memorySites++;

        let source = "UNKNOWN";

        const before = a[i - 2];

        if (before) {
          if (before.op === 0x20 || before.op === 0x22)
            source = `local ${before.imm[0]}`;

          else if (
            before.op === 0x41
          )
            source = `const ${before.imm[0]}`;

          else if (
            before.op === 0x6a ||
            before.op === 0x6b ||
            before.op === 0x6c
          )
            source = before.text;
        }

        if (source.startsWith("local"))
          localSources++;

        if (
          source === "i32.add" ||
          source === "i32.sub" ||
          source === "i32.mul"
        )
          arithmeticSources++;

        results.push({
          func: body.func,
          call: a[i].off,
          load: prev.off,
          offset: prev.imm[1],
          source
        });
      }
    }
  }

  console.log("SUMMARY");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`call_indirect sites : ${sites}`);
  console.log(`direct CONST(114)   : ${const114}`);
  console.log(`memory index loads  : ${memorySites}`);
  console.log(`local-derived base  : ${localSources}`);
  console.log(`arithmetic base     : ${arithmeticSources}`);
  console.log();

  console.log("FIRST 50 MEMORY INDEX CHAINS");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (const r of results.slice(0, 50)) {
    console.log(
      `func=${r.func} ` +
      `load=0x${r.load.toString(16)} ` +
      `offset=${r.offset} ` +
      `call=0x${r.call.toString(16)} ` +
      `base=${r.source}`
    );
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("DETAILED FIRST 10");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  let shown = 0;

  for (const body of bs) {
    if (shown >= 10) break;

    let a: I[];

    try {
      a = decode(body.bytes, body.start);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < a.length && shown < 10; i++) {
      if (
        a[i].op === 0x11 &&
        a[i].imm[0] === 0 &&
        a[i].imm[1] === 0 &&
        i > 0 &&
        a[i-1].op >= 0x28 &&
        a[i-1].op <= 0x3e
      ) {
        console.log();
        console.log(`FUNCTION ${body.func}`);
        window(a, i);
        shown++;
      }
    }
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION - NO WASM MODIFICATION");
  console.log("============================================================");
}

function assertEqual(
    label: string,
    actual: string,
    expected: string
) {
    if (actual !== expected) {
        throw new Error(
            `${label} FAILED\n` +
            `Expected: ${expected}\n` +
            `Actual:   ${actual}`
        );
    }

    console.log(`${label}: PASS`);
}

function assertBigInt(
    label: string,
    actual: bigint,
    expected: bigint
) {
    if (actual !== expected) {
        throw new Error(
            `${label} FAILED\n` +
            `Expected: ${expected}\n` +
            `Actual:   ${actual}`
        );
    }

    console.log(`${label}: PASS`);

        'Provide LP opcode',
        `0x${provideOpcode.toString(16)}`,
        `0x${PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE.toString(16)}`
    );

    assertEqual(
        'Router pTON wallet',
        routerWallet.toRawString(),
        EXPECTED_ROUTER_PTON_WALLET.toRawString()
    );

    assertEqual(
        'Refund address',
        refundAddress.toRawString(),
        USER.toRawString()
    );

    assertEqual(
        'Excesses address',
        excessesAddress.toRawString(),
        USER.toRawString()
    );

    assertBigInt(
        'Deadline',
        encodedDeadline,
        BigInt(deadline)
    );

    assertBigInt(
        'minLpOut',
        minLpOut,
        MIN_LP_OUT
    );

    assertEqual(
        'Receiver',
        receiver.toRawString(),
        USER.toRawString()
    );

    if (bothPositive !== true) {
        throw new Error(
            'bothPositive FAILED'
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'bothPositive: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        '\nForward gas decoded:',
        forwardGas.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        '\nProvide custom payload:',
        provideCustomPayloadPresent
    );

    console.log('\n=================================================');
    console.log(' ALL SDK TX GUARDS PASSED');
    console.log('=================================================');

    console.log(
        '\nNO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.'
    );

    console.log(
        'NO sender.send() EXISTS IN THIS FILE.'
    );

    console.log(
        '================================================='
    );
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const AMOUNT_ROOSTER = 500000000000000n;
const AMOUNT_PTON = 500000000n;

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' DIRECT ADD LIQUIDITY BUILD ONLY');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY / NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('');

    const pool = provider.open(
        DEX.v2_2.Pool.CPI.create(POOL)
    );

    const lpAccount = await pool.getLpAccount({
        ownerAddress: USER
    });

    console.log('LP Account:');
    console.log(lpAccount.address.toString());
    console.log('');

    const contractProvider = provider.provider(
        lpAccount.address
    );

    const data = await lpAccount.getLpAccountData(
        contractProvider
    );

    console.log('===== CURRENT LP ACCOUNT DATA =====');
    console.log('User:', data.userAddress.toString());
    console.log('Pool:', data.poolAddress.toString());
    console.log('Amount 0:', data.amount0.toString());
    console.log('Amount 1:', data.amount1.toString());
    console.log('');

    if (data.amount0 !== AMOUNT_ROOSTER) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected amount0. Expected ${AMOUNT_ROOSTER}, got ${data.amount0}`
        );
    }

    if (data.amount1 !== AMOUNT_PTON) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected amount1. Expected ${AMOUNT_PTON}, got ${data.amount1}`
        );
    }

    const tx = await lpAccount.getDirectAddLiquidityTxParams(
        contractProvider,
        {
            amount0: AMOUNT_ROOSTER,
            amount1: AMOUNT_PTON,
            minimumLpToMint: 1n,
            userWalletAddress: USER,
            refundAddress: USER,
            excessesAddress: USER
        }
    );

    const boc = tx.body
        ? tx.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
        : '';

    fs.writeFileSync(
        'current_direct_add_liquidity.boc',
        boc
    );

    console.log('===== TRANSACTION BUILD =====');
    console.log('TO:', tx.to.toString());
    console.log('VALUE:', tx.value.toString());
    console.log(
        'VALUE TON:',
        Number(tx.value) / 1e9
    );
    console.log('');

    console.log('Amount 0:', AMOUNT_ROOSTER.toString());
    console.log(
        'Amount 0 ROOSTER:',
        Number(AMOUNT_ROOSTER) / 1e9
    );

    console.log('Amount 1:', AMOUNT_PTON.toString());
    console.log(
        'Amount 1 pTON:',
        Number(AMOUNT_PTON) / 1e9
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Minimum LP to mint: 1');
    console.log('');
    console.log('BODY BOC:');
    console.log(boc);
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Saved: current_direct_add_liquidity.boc'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' BUILD COMPLETED');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('==========================================');
}

FILE: scripts\buildExactSdkMatchedBocV22.ts

import { Address, beginCell, Cell } from "@ton/core";
import * as fs from "fs";

const USER_WALLET =
  "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix";

const ROUTER =
  "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3";

const ROUTER_PTON_WALLET =
  "EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3";

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 200073535827652n;
const MIN_LP_OUT = 300329052918n;

const FORWARD_TON_AMOUNT = 240000000n;

const DEADLINE = 1790586870;

const JETTON_TRANSFER_OPCODE = 0x0f8a7ea5;
const PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE = 0x37c096df;

const OUTPUT_FILE =
  "./exact_sdk_matched_v22_rooster_liquidity.boc";

function hashCell(cell: Cell): string {
  return cell.hash().toString("hex");
}

export async function run(provider: any) {
  console.log("=================================================");
  console.log(" STON.fi v2.2 EXACT SDK-MATCHED BOC BUILDER");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT");
  console.log("=================================================");

  const user = Address.parse(USER_WALLET);
  const router = Address.parse(ROUTER);
  const routerPtonWallet =
    Address.parse(ROUTER_PTON_WALLET);

  console.log("\n===== VALUES =====");

  console.log("ROOSTER amount:");
  console.log(ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString());

  console.log("minLpOut:");
  console.log(MIN_LP_OUT.toString());

  console.log("forwardTonAmount:");
  console.log(FORWARD_TON_AMOUNT.toString());

  console.log("deadline:");
  console.log(DEADLINE.toString());

  console.log("router:");
  console.log(router.toString());

  console.log("routerWalletAddress:");
  console.log(routerPtonWallet.toString());

  console.log("user:");
  console.log(user.toString());

  /*
   * SDK createProvideLiquidityBody():
   *
   * opcode
   * routerWalletAddress
   * refundAddress
   * excessesAddress
   * deadline
   * reference:
   *   minLpOut
   *   receiverAddress
   *   bothPositive
   *   dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount
   *   dexCustomPayload
   */

  const provideLpParameters = beginCell()
    .storeCoins(MIN_LP_OUT)
    .storeAddress(user)
    .storeUint(1, 1)
    .storeCoins(0n)
    .storeMaybeRef(null)
    .endCell();

  const provideLpBody = beginCell()
    .storeUint(PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE, 32)
    .storeAddress(routerPtonWallet)
    .storeAddress(user)
    .storeAddress(user)
    .storeUint(DEADLINE, 64)
    .storeRef(provideLpParameters)
    .endCell();

  /*
   * SDK createJettonTransferMessage():
   *
   * opcode
   * queryId
   * amount
   * destination
   * responseDestination
   * customPayload
   * forwardTonAmount
   * forwardPayload as reference
   */

  const jettonTransferBody = beginCell()
    .storeUint(JETTON_TRANSFER_OPCODE, 32)
    .storeUint(0, 64)
    .storeCoins(ROOSTER_AMOUNT)
    .storeAddress(router)
    .storeAddress(user)
    .storeMaybeRef(null)
    .storeCoins(FORWARD_TON_AMOUNT)
.storeBit(1)
.storeRef(provideLpBody)
.endCell();

  const boc = jettonTransferBody.toBoc();
  const base64 = boc.toString("base64");

  fs.writeFileSync(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    base64,
    "utf8"
  );

  console.log("\n===== RESULT =====");

  console.log("Root bits:");
  console.log(jettonTransferBody.bits.length);

  console.log("Root refs:");
  console.log(jettonTransferBody.refs.length);

  console.log("Root SHA256:");
  console.log(hashCell(jettonTransferBody));

  console.log("BOC bytes:");
  console.log(boc.length);

  console.log("BOC chars:");
  console.log(base64.length);

  console.log("\nBOC saved:");
  console.log(OUTPUT_FILE);

  console.log("\nBOC base64:");
  console.log(base64);

  console.log("\n===== SDK COMPARISON TARGET =====");

  console.log(
    "SDK SHA256:"
  );
  console.log(
    "1a1651ed7a231143443f7cb52b6170f7cebe6a6da217d5519bf2ea9b35affe79"
  );

  console.log(
    "SDK bytes: 266"
  );

  console.log(
    "SDK chars: 356"
  );

  console.log("\n=================================================");
  console.log(" BOC BUILD COMPLETE");
  console.log(" NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT");
  console.log("=================================================");
}

import { Address, TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const RPC_ENDPOINT = 'https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const ROOSTER_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const KNOWN_POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq'
);

const EXPECTED_PTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3'
);

const EXPECTED_USER_ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh'
);

const PTON_AMOUNT = 500_000_000n;

const TX_DEADLINE =
    Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 900;

export async function run() {
    console.log(
        '======================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STON.FI v2.2 FINAL LIQUIDITY BUILD'
    );
    console.log(
        '======================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        'BUILD ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.'
    );

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: RPC_ENDPOINT,
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. CREATE ROUTER
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('\n===== 1. CREATE ROUTER =====');

    const router =
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(ROUTER);

    const routerProvider =
        client.provider(ROUTER);

    console.log(
        'Router:',
        ROUTER.toString()
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. VERIFY KNOWN POOL
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('\n===== 2. VERIFY POOL =====');

    const pool =
        DEX.v2_2.Pool.CPI.create(KNOWN_POOL);

    const poolProvider =
        client.provider(KNOWN_POOL);

    console.log(
        'Known Pool:',
        KNOWN_POOL.toString()
    );

    const data =
        await pool.getPoolData(poolProvider);

    console.log(
        'Reserve0 ROOSTER:',
        data.reserve0.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Reserve1 pTON:',
        data.reserve1.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Total LP:',
        data.totalSupplyLP.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Token0 Wallet:',
        data.token0WalletAddress.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Token1 Wallet:',
        data.token1WalletAddress.toString()
    );

    if (
        !data.token0WalletAddress.equals(
            EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'TOKEN0 ROOSTER WALLET CHECK FAILED'
        );
    }

    if (
        !data.token1WalletAddress.equals(
            EXPECTED_PTON_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'TOKEN1 pTON WALLET CHECK FAILED'
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'POOL TOKEN WALLETS: PASS'
    );

    if (data.reserve0 <= 0n) {
        throw new Error(
            'ROOSTER RESERVE INVALID'
        );
    }

    if (data.reserve1 <= 0n) {
        throw new Error(
            'pTON RESERVE INVALID'
        );
    }

    if (data.totalSupplyLP <= 0n) {
        throw new Error(
            'LP SUPPLY INVALID'
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'POOL DATA: PASS'
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. FRESH POOL DATA
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('\n===== 3. FRESH POOL DATA =====');

    console.log(
        'Reserve0 ROOSTER:',
        data.reserve0.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Reserve1 pTON:',
        data.reserve1.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Total LP:',
        data.totalSupplyLP.toString()
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. LIQUIDITY CALCULATION
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('\n===== 4. LIQUIDITY CALCULATION =====');

    console.log(
        'pTON amount:',
        PTON_AMOUNT.toString(),
        '=',
        Number(PTON_AMOUNT) / 1e9,
        'TON'
    );

    const roosterAmount =
        PTON_AMOUNT *
        data.reserve0 /
        data.reserve1;

    const expectedLpFromRooster =
        roosterAmount *
        data.totalSupplyLP /
        data.reserve0;

    const expectedLpFromPton =
        PTON_AMOUNT *
        data.totalSupplyLP /
        data.reserve1;

    console.log(
        'LP from ROOSTER side:',
        expectedLpFromRooster.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'LP from pTON side:',
        expectedLpFromPton.toString()
    );

    if (
        expectedLpFromRooster !==
        expectedLpFromPton
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'LP CALCULATION MISMATCH'
        );
    }

    const expectedLp =
        expectedLpFromPton;

    const minLpOut =
        expectedLp *
        95n /
        100n;

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER amount:',

        '=',
        Number(roosterAmount) / 1e9,
        'ROOSTER'
    );

        'minLpOut:',

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    const roosterTx =

            {
                userWalletAddress: USER,

                sendTokenAddress:
                    ROOSTER_MASTER,

                sendAmount:
                    roosterAmount,

                otherTokenAddress:
                    PTON_MASTER,

                minLpOut:
                    minLpOut,

                receiverAddress:
                    USER,

                refundAddress:
                    USER,

          excessesAddress:
    USER,

deadline:
    TX_DEADLINE,
            }
        );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER destination:',
        roosterTx.to.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER value:',
        roosterTx.value.toString(),
        'nanoTON'
    );

    if (!roosterTx.body) {
        throw new Error(
            'ROOSTER BODY IS EMPTY'
        );
    }

    const roosterBoc =
        roosterTx.body
            .toBoc()
            .toString('base64');

    if (!roosterBoc) {
        throw new Error(

        );
    }

    fs.writeFileSync(

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    );

    /*

     *
     * The installed SDK declaration confirms:
     *
     * DEX.v2_2.pTON === PtonV2_1
     *
     * and constructor:
     *
     * constructor(address: AddressType, ...)
     */

    const proxyTon =
        new DEX.v2_2.pTON(
            PTON_MASTER
        );

    console.log(
        'pTON master:',
        PTON_MASTER.toString()
    );

    console.log(

        proxyTon.version
    );

    const ptonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams(

            {
                userWalletAddress:
                    USER,

                receiverAddress:
                    USER,

                proxyTon:
                    proxyTon,

                otherTokenAddress:
                    ROOSTER_MASTER,

                sendAmount:
                    PTON_AMOUNT,

                minLpOut:
                    minLpOut,

                refundAddress:
                    USER,

                excessesAddress:
                    USER,

                bothPositive:
    true,

deadline:
    TX_DEADLINE,
            }
        );

    console.log(
        'pTON destination:',
        ptonTx.to.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON value:',
        ptonTx.value.toString(),
        'nanoTON'
    );

   if (ptonTx.body == null) {
    throw new Error(
        'PTON BODY IS EMPTY'
    );
}

const ptonBoc =
    ptonTx.body
        .toBoc()
        .toString('base64');

    if (!ptonBoc) {
        throw new Error(

        );

    );

     * The Jetton liquidity builder targets the user's ROOSTER wallet.
     */

    if (

        throw new Error(

    console.log(

if (

console.log(

function sameAddress(a: Address, b: Address): boolean {
    return a.equals(b);

function printSeparator() {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    printSeparator();
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 FINAL TONCONNECT REQUEST BUILDER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    printSeparator();

    const wallet = provider.sender().address;

    if (!wallet) {
        throw new Error('Connected wallet address is unavailable.');
    }

    console.log(`Connected wallet: ${wallet.toString()}`);

    const router = provider.open(
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(ROUTER)
    );

    const proxyTon = DEX.v2_1.pTON.create(PTON_MASTER);

    /*
     * Fresh deadline.
     *
     * We deliberately create it at runtime so the resulting
     * TonConnect request cannot contain an expired deadline.
     */
    const deadline = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 600;

    console.log(`Deadline: ${deadline}`);
    console.log(`ROOSTER amount: ${ROOSTER_AMOUNT}`);
    console.log(`pTON amount: ${PTON_AMOUNT}`);
    console.log(`minLpOut: ${MIN_LP_OUT}`);

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * 1. ROOSTER LEG
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * This is exactly the SDK call already passed by
     * finalTwoMessageGateV22.ts.
     */
    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams({
            userWalletAddress: USER,
            sendTokenAddress: ROOSTER_MASTER,
            otherTokenAddress: PTON_MASTER,
            sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
            minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
            receiverAddress: USER,
            refundAddress: USER,
            excessesAddress: USER,
            deadline,
        });

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * 2. pTON LEG
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * This is exactly the SDK call already passed by
     * finalTwoMessageGateV22.ts.
     */
    const ptonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams({
            userWalletAddress: USER,
            otherTokenAddress: ROOSTER_MASTER,
            sendAmount: PTON_AMOUNT,
            minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
            receiverAddress: USER,
            refundAddress: USER,
            excessesAddress: USER,
            deadline,
            proxyTon,
        });

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * 3. DESTINATION SAFETY CHECKS
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log('');
    console.log('DESTINATION CHECKS');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterTx.to,
            EXPECTED_USER_ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            `ROOSTER destination mismatch:\n` +
            `Expected: ${EXPECTED_USER_ROOSTER_WALLET}\n` +
            `Actual:   ${roosterTx.to}`
        );
    }

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            ptonTx.to,
            EXPECTED_POOL_PTON_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            `pTON destination mismatch:\n` +
            `Expected: ${EXPECTED_POOL_PTON_WALLET}\n` +
            `Actual:   ${ptonTx.to}`
        );
    }

    if (BigInt(roosterTx.value) !== ROOSTER_OUTER_VALUE) {
        throw new Error(
            `ROOSTER outer value mismatch: ${roosterTx.value}`
        );
    }

    if (BigInt(ptonTx.value) !== PTON_OUTER_VALUE) {
        throw new Error(
            `pTON outer value mismatch: ${ptonTx.value}`
        );
    }

    console.log('ROOSTER destination: PASS');
    console.log('pTON destination: PASS');
    console.log('ROOSTER outer value: PASS');
    console.log('pTON outer value: PASS');

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * 4. BUILD EXACT TONCONNECT MESSAGE OBJECTS
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * IMPORTANT:
     * We only serialize the already-built SDK transaction bodies.
     *
     * connector.sendTransaction() is NOT called.
     * provider.sender().send() is NOT called.
     */
    if (!roosterTx.body) {
    throw new Error('ROOSTER body was not produced.');
}

if (!ptonTx.body) {
    throw new Error('pTON body was not produced.');
}

const roosterPayload = roosterTx.body
    .toBoc()
    .toString('base64');

const ptonPayload = ptonTx.body
    .toBoc()
    .toString('base64');
    const tonConnectRequest = {
        validUntil: deadline,
        network: -3,
        messages: [
            {
                address: roosterTx.to.toString(),
                amount: roosterTx.value.toString(),
                payload: roosterPayload,
            },
            {
                address: ptonTx.to.toString(),
                amount: ptonTx.value.toString(),
                payload: ptonPayload,
            },
        ],
    };

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * 5. DISPLAY REQUEST
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log('');
    printSeparator();
    console.log(' TONCONNECT REQUEST');
    printSeparator();

    console.log(JSON.stringify(
        tonConnectRequest,
        null,
        2
    ));

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * 6. BASIC FINAL CHECKS
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (tonConnectRequest.messages.length !== 2) {
        throw new Error('TonConnect message count is not 2.');
    }

    if (
        tonConnectRequest.messages[0].address !==
        roosterTx.to.toString()
    ) {
        throw new Error('Message 1 address mismatch.');
    }

    if (
        tonConnectRequest.messages[1].address !==
        ptonTx.to.toString()
    ) {
        throw new Error('Message 2 address mismatch.');
    }

    if (!roosterPayload) {
        throw new Error('ROOSTER payload is empty.');
    }

    if (!ptonPayload) {
        throw new Error('pTON payload is empty.');
    }

    console.log('');
    printSeparator();
    console.log(' FINAL RESULT');
    printSeparator();

    console.log('Two messages: PASS');
    console.log('ROOSTER BOC: PASS');
    console.log('pTON BOC: PASS');
    console.log('validUntil: PASS');
    console.log('network = -3: PASS');

    console.log('');
    console.log('SAFETY');
    console.log('connector.sendTransaction(): NOT CALLED');
    console.log('sender.send(): NOT CALLED');
    console.log('wallet.send(): NOT CALLED');
    console.log('Tonkeeper approval: NOT REQUESTED');
    console.log('Transaction broadcast: NO');
    console.log('Wallet state change: NO');
    console.log('Pool state change: NO');

    console.log('');
    printSeparator();
    console.log(' FINAL TONCONNECT REQUEST BUILT');
    printSeparator();
}

    const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 200_073_535_827_652n;

    // Required minimum LP tokens
    const MIN_LP_OUT = 300_329_052_918n;

    const ROUTER = Address.parse(
        "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3"
    );

    const USER_WALLET = Address.parse(
        "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix"
    );

    // Router's pTON Jetton Wallet
    const ROUTER_PTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
        "EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3"
    );

    // Keep the same SDK-matched value used by the
    // previously verified builder until independently
    // confirmed against the installed SDK gas constants.
    const FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT = 240_000_000n;

    // Outer transaction value for the ROOSTER Jetton wallet.
    const GAS_AMOUNT = 300_000_000n;

    const JETTON_TRANSFER_OPCODE = 0x0f8a7ea5;
    const PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE = 0x37c096df;

    const QUERY_ID = 0n;

    // =================================================
    // 1. PROVIDE_LP BODY
    //
    // Current @ston-fi/sdk structure:
    //
    //   uint32  PROVIDE_LP
    //   address routerWalletAddress
    //   coins   minLpOut
    //
    // No deadline.
    // No refund address.
    // No excesses address.
    // =================================================

    const provideLpPayload = beginCell()
        .storeUint(PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE, 32)
        .storeAddress(ROUTER_PTON_WALLET)
        .storeCoins(MIN_LP_OUT)
        .endCell();

    // =================================================
    // 2. JETTON TRANSFER BODY
    // =================================================

    const body = beginCell()
        .storeUint(JETTON_TRANSFER_OPCODE, 32)

        // query_id
        .storeUint(QUERY_ID, 64)

        // amount
        .storeCoins(ROOSTER_AMOUNT)

        // destination = STON.fi Router
        .storeAddress(ROUTER)

        // response destination = user
        .storeAddress(USER_WALLET)

        // custom payload = none
        .storeBit(false)

        // forward TON
        .storeCoins(FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT)

        // forward payload = reference
        .storeBit(true)

        // PROVIDE_LP body
        .storeRef(provideLpPayload)

        .endCell();

    // =================================================
    // 3. SERIALIZE BOC
    // =================================================

    const boc = body.toBoc({
        idx: false
    });

    const base64 = boc.toString("base64");

    const outputFile =
        "./final_v22_rooster_liquidity.boc";

    fs.writeFileSync(
        outputFile,
        base64,
        "utf8"
    );

    );

        ROUTER.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        "Router pTON wallet:",
        ROUTER_PTON_WALLET.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        "Response destination:",
        USER_WALLET.toString()
    );

    console.log(

        FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT.toString()

    console.log(
