import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x1226d;
const END   = 0x1295b;

const TARGETS = new Set([
    0x12680,
    0x12681,
    0x126f6,
    0x126fa,
    0x12700,
    0x1270b,
    0x12713,
    0x1273d,
    0x12791,
    0x127bd,
    0x1283e,
    0x1289c,
    0x128b4,
    0x128fb,
    0x1293b,
    0x12950,
]);

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u8(p: number): number {
    return wasm[p] ?? 0;
}

function uleb(p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = u8(p++);
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function sleb(p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = u8(p++);
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if ((b & 0x40) !== 0 && shift < 32)
        value -= Math.pow(2, shift);

    return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(x: number): string {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

type Insn = {
    addr: number;
    end: number;
    op: number;
    mnemonic: string;
    targetDepth?: number;
    targets?: number[];
    defaultDepth?: number;
    immediate?: number;
};

type Frame = {
    kind: "block" | "loop" | "if";
    start: number;
    label: number;
};

function blocktype(p: number): number {
    return u8(p);
}

/*
 * Decode only instructions needed for CFG construction,
 * but advance over all common WASM immediates correctly.
 */
function decodeOne(p0: number): Insn {
    const addr = p0;
    const op = u8(p0++);
    let mnemonic = `op_0x${op.toString(16)}`;
    let immediate: number | undefined;

    switch (op) {

        case 0x00:
            mnemonic = "unreachable";
            break;

        case 0x01:
            mnemonic = "nop";
            break;

        case 0x02:
            mnemonic = "block";
            p0++;
            break;

        case 0x03:
            mnemonic = "loop";
            p0++;
            break;

        case 0x04:
            mnemonic = "if";
            p0++;
            break;

        case 0x05:
            mnemonic = "else";
            break;

        case 0x0b:
            mnemonic = "end";
            break;

        case 0x0c: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            immediate = r.value;
            mnemonic = `br depth=${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            immediate = r.value;
            mnemonic = `br_if depth=${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x0e: {
            const c = uleb(p0);
            p0 = c.next;

            const ds: number[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
                const r = uleb(p0);
                p0 = r.next;
                ds.push(r.value);
            }

            const d = uleb(p0);
            p0 = d.next;

            return {
                addr,
                end: p0,
                op,
                mnemonic: `br_table count=${c.value}`,
                targets: ds,
                defaultDepth: d.value,
            };
        }

        case 0x0f:
            mnemonic = "return";
            break;

        case 0x10: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            immediate = r.value;
            mnemonic = `call ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
            const a = uleb(p0);
            p0 = a.next;

            const b = uleb(p0);
            p0 = b.next;

            mnemonic = `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x1a:
            mnemonic = "drop";
            break;

        case 0x1b:
            mnemonic = "select";
            break;

        case 0x20: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            mnemonic = `local.get ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            mnemonic = `local.set ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            mnemonic = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x23: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            mnemonic = `global.get ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x24: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            mnemonic = `global.set ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        /*
         * Loads/stores.
         */
        case 0x28: case 0x29: case 0x2a: case 0x2b:
        case 0x2c: case 0x2d: case 0x2e: case 0x2f:
        case 0x30: case 0x31: case 0x32: case 0x33:
        case 0x34: case 0x35:
        case 0x36: case 0x37: case 0x38: case 0x39:
        case 0x3a: case 0x3b: case 0x3c: case 0x3d:
        case 0x3e: case 0x3f: case 0x40: {
            const a = uleb(p0);
            p0 = a.next;

            const b = uleb(p0);
            p0 = b.next;

            mnemonic = `mem op=0x${op.toString(16)} align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const r = sleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            immediate = r.value;
            mnemonic = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x42: {
            /*
             * i64.const is signed LEB128.
             * We only need its length here.
             */
            const r = sleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            mnemonic = "i64.const";
            break;
        }

        /*
         * 0xfc prefixed instructions.
         */
        case 0xfc: {
            const sub = uleb(p0);
            p0 = sub.next;

            mnemonic = `0xfc.${sub.value}`;

            /*
             * Saturating conversions 0-7: no extra immediate.
             * Memory bulk operations have memory/table immediates.
             */
            if (sub.value >= 8 && sub.value <= 11) {
                const a = uleb(p0);
                p0 = a.next;

                const b = uleb(p0);
                p0 = b.next;

                mnemonic += ` ${a.value} ${b.value}`;
            }
            break;
        }

        /*
         * Reference types.
         */
        case 0xd0:
            p0++;
            mnemonic = "ref.null";
            break;

        case 0xd1:
            mnemonic = "ref.is_null";
            break;

        case 0xd2: {
            const r = uleb(p0);
            p0 = r.next;
            mnemonic = `ref.func ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        default:
            /*
             * Most numeric opcodes have no immediate.
             * This is sufficient for this function's CFG once
             * the known instruction boundaries are verified.
             */
            break;
    }

    return {
        addr,
        end: p0,
        op,
        mnemonic,
        immediate,
    };
}

const insns: Insn[] = [];

let p = START;

while (p < END) {
    const ins = decodeOne(p);

    if (ins.end <= p) {
        console.log(`DECODER STALL @ ${hex(p)}`);
        break;
    }

    insns.push(ins);
    p = ins.end;
}

const byAddr = new Map<number, Insn>();

for (const x of insns)
    byAddr.set(x.addr, x);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 122 REAL INSTRUCTION / CFG ANALYSIS");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`Range: ${hex(START)} .. ${hex(END)}`);
console.log(`Decoded instructions: ${insns.length}`);
console.log();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" TARGET INSTRUCTION BOUNDARIES");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const t of [...TARGETS].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {
    const x = byAddr.get(t);

    if (x) {
        console.log(
            `${hex(t)}  VALID  ${x.mnemonic}  end=${hex(x.end)}`
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            `${hex(t)}  NOT-INSTRUCTION-BOUNDARY`
        );
    }
}

console.log();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" CONTROL FLOW");
console.log("============================================================");

const frames: Frame[] = [];

function resolveDepth(depth: number): Frame | null {
    if (depth < 0 || depth >= frames.length)
        return null;

    return frames[frames.length - 1 - depth] ?? null;
}

for (const x of insns) {

    if (
        x.op === 0x02 ||
        x.op === 0x03 ||
        x.op === 0x04
    ) {
        const kind =
            x.op === 0x02 ? "block" :
            x.op === 0x03 ? "loop" :
            "if";

        frames.push({
            kind,
            start: x.addr,
            label: x.op === 0x03 ? x.end : x.end,
        });

        continue;
    }

    if (x.op === 0x05) {
        /*
         * ELSE keeps the same IF frame.
         */
        continue;
    }

    if (x.op === 0x0b) {
        if (frames.length > 0)
            frames.pop();

        continue;
    }

    if (x.op === 0x0c || x.op === 0x0d) {

        const depth = x.immediate ?? -1;
        const target = resolveDepth(depth);

        console.log(
            `${hex(x.addr)}  ${x.mnemonic}` +
            `  => ${target ? hex(target.label) : "UNRESOLVED"}` +
            `${target ? ` (${target.kind} @ ${hex(target.start)})` : ""}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (x.op === 0x0e) {

        const targets: string[] = [];

        for (const d of x.targets ?? []) {
            const f = resolveDepth(d);
            targets.push(
                f
                    ? `${d}->${hex(f.label)}`
                    : `${d}->UNRESOLVED`
            );
        }

        const d = x.defaultDepth ?? -1;
        const df = resolveDepth(d);

        console.log(
            `${hex(x.addr)}  br_table` +
            ` cases=[${targets.join(", ")}]` +
            ` default=${d}->${df ? hex(df.label) : "UNRESOLVED"}`
        );
    }
}

console.log();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" PREDECESSORS OF TARGETS");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const target of [...TARGETS].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {

    const preds: string[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {

        const x = insns[i];
        const next = insns[i + 1];

        /*
         * Direct fall-through.
         */
        if (
            next &&
            next.addr === target &&
            x.op !== 0x00 &&
            x.op !== 0x0f &&
            x.op !== 0x0c &&
            x.op !== 0x0e
        ) {
            preds.push(
                `${hex(x.addr)} FALLTHROUGH (${x.mnemonic})`
            );
        }

        /*
         * br_if also has fall-through, handled above.
         */
        if (x.op === 0x0d) {
            const depth = x.immediate ?? -1;
            // Exact target is printed in CONTROL FLOW section.
            void depth;
        }
    }

    console.log(
        `${hex(target)} <- ` +
        (preds.length ? preds.join(" | ") : "NO DIRECT FALLTHROUGH")
    );
}

console.log();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" INSTRUCTION WINDOW AROUND 0x12680");
console.log("============================================================");

const idx = insns.findIndex(x => x.addr >= 0x12670);

if (idx >= 0) {
    for (
        let i = Math.max(0, idx - 5);
        i < Math.min(insns.length, idx + 35);
        i++
    ) {
        const x = insns[i];

        console.log(
            `${hex(x.addr)} .. ${hex(x.end - 1)}  ${x.mnemonic}`
        );
    }
}

console.log();
console.log("DONE");

function addressToCell(address: Address): Cell {
    return beginCell()
        .storeAddress(address)
        .endCell();
}

function checkAddress(
    name: string,
    actual: Address,
    expected: Address
) {
    const ok = actual.equals(expected);

    console.log(`${name}:`, ok ? 'YES' : 'NO');

    if (!ok) {
        console.log('  ACTUAL  :', actual.toString());
        console.log('  EXPECTED:', expected.toString());
    }
}

    // ================================================================

    const routerProvider = provider.provider(ROUTER);

    // 1. POOL VERIFICATION
    // ================================================================

    if (!pool.equals(EXPECTED_POOL)) {
        throw new Error(

    // ================================================================
    // 2. pTON v2.1
    // ================================================================

    const proxyTon = new DEX.v2_2.pTON(PTON_MASTER);

    console.log(
        'pTON VERSION:',
        proxyTon.version
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON ADDRESS:',
        proxyTon.address.toString()
    );

    if (proxyTon.version !== 'v2_1') {
        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Router v2.2 requires pTON v2.1.'
        );
    }

    if (!proxyTon.address.equals(PTON_MASTER)) {
        throw new Error(
            'STOP: pTON address mismatch.'
        );
    }

    console.log('pTON VERSION MATCH: YES');
    console.log('pTON ADDRESS MATCH: YES');

    // ================================================================
    // 3. ROOSTER SIDE
    // ================================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log('3. ROOSTER SIDE');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER AMOUNT:',
        ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString(),
        'nano-ROOSTER'
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER DISPLAY:',
        Number(ROOSTER_AMOUNT) / 1_000_000_000,
        'ROOSTER'
    );

    console.log(
        'MIN LP OUT:',
        MIN_LP_OUT.toString()
    );

    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                userWalletAddress: USER,
                sendTokenAddress: ROOSTER_MASTER,
                otherTokenAddress: PTON_MASTER,
                sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
                minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
                receiverAddress: USER,
                refundAddress: USER,
                excessesAddress: USER,
                transferExcessAddress: USER,
            }
        );

    const roosterBody = roosterTx.body;

    if (!roosterBody) {
        throw new Error(
            'STOP: SDK returned empty ROOSTER transaction body.'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'ROOSTER TX TO:',
        roosterTx.to.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER TX VALUE:',
        roosterTx.value.toString(),
        'nanoTON'
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER TX VALUE:',
        Number(roosterTx.value) / 1_000_000_000,
        'TON'
    );

    checkAddress(
        'ROOSTER DESTINATION MATCH',
        roosterTx.to,
        USER_ROOSTER_WALLET
    );

    writeFileSync(
        './rooster_v22_generated.boc',
        roosterBody.toBoc()
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER BOC SAVED:',
        './rooster_v22_generated.boc'
    );

    printCellInfo(
        'ROOSTER TRANSACTION BODY',
        roosterBody
    );

    // 4. pTON SIDE
    // ================================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log('4. pTON SIDE');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'pTON AMOUNT:',
        PTON_AMOUNT.toString(),
        'nano-pTON'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON DISPLAY:',
        Number(PTON_AMOUNT) / 1_000_000_000,
        'pTON'

    const ptonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                userWalletAddress: USER,
                proxyTon,
                otherTokenAddress: ROOSTER_MASTER,
                sendAmount: PTON_AMOUNT,
                minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
                receiverAddress: USER,
                refundAddress: USER,
                excessesAddress: USER,
            }
        );

    const ptonBody = ptonTx.body;

    if (!ptonBody) {
        throw new Error(
            'STOP: SDK returned empty pTON transaction body.'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'pTON TX TO:',
        ptonTx.to.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON TX VALUE:',

        'nanoTON'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON TX VALUE:',
        Number(ptonTx.value) / 1_000_000_000,
        'TON'
    );

    writeFileSync(
        './pton_v22_generated.boc',
        ptonBody.toBoc()
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON BOC SAVED:',
        './pton_v22_generated.boc'
    );

    printCellInfo(
        'pTON TRANSACTION BODY',
        ptonBody
    );

    // 5. pTON VALUE
    // ================================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const ROOSTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('       STON.fi V2.2 BUILD-ONLY CHECK');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');
    console.log('READ-ONLY');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');

    const router =
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(ROUTER);

    const proxyTon =
        DEX.v2_2.pTON.create(PTON);

    const routerProvider =
        provider.provider(ROUTER);

    // ================================================
    // GET REAL POOL
    // ================================================

    const pool =
        await router.getPool(
            routerProvider,
            {
                token0: ROOSTER,
                token1: PTON,
            }
        );

    const poolAddress = pool.address;

    console.log('===== REAL POOL =====');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Pool:');
    console.log(poolAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // READ REAL POOL DATA
    // ================================================

    const poolProvider =
        provider.provider(poolAddress);

    const poolData =
        await pool.getPoolData(poolProvider);

    console.log('===== CURRENT POOL =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER reserve:',
        Number(poolData.reserve0) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON reserve:',
        Number(poolData.reserve1) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'Total LP:',
        poolData.totalSupplyLP.toString()
    );

    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // PROPOSED LIQUIDITY
    // ================================================

    // Test deposit:
    // 100 ROOSTER

    const roosterAmount =
        100n * 1_000_000_000n;

    // Calculate proportional pTON amount:
    //
    // pTON = ROOSTER *
    //        reserve1 /
    //        reserve0

    const ptonAmount =
        roosterAmount *
        poolData.reserve1 /
        poolData.reserve0;

    console.log('===== PROPOSED DEPOSIT =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER:',
        Number(roosterAmount) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON raw:',
        ptonAmount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON:',
        Number(ptonAmount) / 1e9
    );

    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // LP CALCULATION
    // ================================================

    const lpFromRooster =
        roosterAmount *
        poolData.totalSupplyLP /
        poolData.reserve0;

    const lpFromPton =
        ptonAmount *
        poolData.totalSupplyLP /
        poolData.reserve1;

    const expectedLp =
        lpFromRooster < lpFromPton
            ? lpFromRooster
            : lpFromPton;

    const minLpOut =
        expectedLp * 95n / 100n;

    const deadline =
        Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600;

    console.log('===== LP CALCULATION =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'LP from ROOSTER:',
        lpFromRooster.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'LP from pTON:',
        lpFromPton.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected LP:',
        expectedLp.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Minimum LP (95%):',
        minLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // BUILD ROOSTER TRANSACTION
    // ================================================

    console.log('===== BUILD ROOSTER TX =====');
    console.log('');

    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                sendTokenAddress: ROOSTER,
                otherTokenAddress: PTON,
                sendAmount: roosterAmount,
                userWalletAddress: USER,
                receiverAddress: USER,
                refundAddress: USER,
                excessesAddress: USER,
                minLpOut,
                deadline,
            }
        );

    console.log('Destination:');
    console.log(roosterTx.to.toString());

    console.log('');

    console.log('TON value:');
    console.log(roosterTx.value.toString());

    console.log(
        'TON value:',
        Number(roosterTx.value) / 1e9,
        'TON'
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('Body exists:');
    console.log(roosterTx.body !== undefined);

    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // BUILD pTON TRANSACTION
    // ================================================

    console.log('===== BUILD pTON TX =====');
    console.log('');

    const ptonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                proxyTon,
                otherTokenAddress: ROOSTER,
                sendAmount: ptonAmount,
                userWalletAddress: USER,
                receiverAddress: USER,
                refundAddress: USER,
                excessesAddress: USER,
                minLpOut,
                deadline,
            }
        );

    console.log('Destination:');
    console.log(ptonTx.to.toString());

    console.log('');

    console.log('TON value:');
    console.log(ptonTx.value.toString());

    console.log(
        'TON value:',
        Number(ptonTx.value) / 1e9,
        'TON'
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('Body exists:');
    console.log(ptonTx.body !== undefined);

    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // FINAL
    // ================================================

    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('             BUILD-ONLY RESULT');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Pool:');
    console.log(poolAddress.toString());

    console.log('');

    console.log('ROOSTER amount:');
    console.log(
        Number(roosterAmount) / 1e9,
        'ROOSTER'
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('pTON amount:');
    console.log(
        Number(ptonAmount) / 1e9,
        'pTON'
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('Expected LP:');
    console.log(expectedLp.toString());

    console.log('');

    console.log('Minimum LP:');
    console.log(minLpOut.toString());

    console.log('');

    console.log('ROOSTER transaction built: YES');
    console.log('pTON transaction built: YES');

    console.log('');

    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('NO ROOSTER WAS TRANSFERRED.');
    console.log('NO TON WAS TRANSFERRED.');
    console.log('');
}

import { Address, toNano } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const router = DEX.v2_1.Router.CPI.create(
        Address.parse(
            'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
        )
    );

    const roosterMaster = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const userWallet = provider.sender().address;

    if (!userWallet) {
        throw new Error('Wallet address is not available.');
    }

    const roosterAmount = 100000n * 1000000000n;
    const tonAmount = toNano('0.1');

    const routerProvider = provider.provider(router.address);

    console.log('===== BUILD INITIAL LIQUIDITY =====');
    console.log('Router:', router.address.toString());
    console.log('ROOSTER:', roosterMaster.toString());
    console.log('User:', userWallet.toString());
    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER amount:', roosterAmount.toString());
    console.log('ROOSTER human:', Number(roosterAmount) / 1e9);
    console.log('TON amount:', tonAmount.toString());
    console.log('TON human:', Number(tonAmount) / 1e9);

    /*
     * Build ROOSTER -> Router transaction
     */
    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                userWalletAddress: userWallet,
                sendTokenAddress: roosterMaster,
                otherTokenAddress: Address.parse(
                    'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
                ),
                sendAmount: roosterAmount,
                minLpOut: '1',
                refundAddress: userWallet,
                excessesAddress: userWallet,
                transferExcessAddress: userWallet,
            }
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== ROOSTER TX =====');
    console.log('To:', roosterTx.to.toString());
    console.log('Value:', roosterTx.value.toString());
    console.log('Value TON:', Number(roosterTx.value) / 1e9);

    if (roosterTx.body) {
        console.log(
            'Body BOC:',
            roosterTx.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
        );
    }

    /*
     * Build TON -> pTON -> Router transaction
     */
    const proxyTon = DEX.v2_1.pTON.create(
        Address.parse(
            'kQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT-Px'
        )
    );

    const tonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                userWalletAddress: userWallet,
                sendAmount: tonAmount,
                otherTokenAddress: roosterMaster,
                minLpOut: '1',
                proxyTon,
            }
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== TON/pTON TX =====');
    console.log('To:', tonTx.to.toString());
    console.log('Value:', tonTx.value.toString());
    console.log('Value TON:', Number(tonTx.value) / 1e9);

    if (tonTx.body) {
        console.log(
            'Body BOC:',
            tonTx.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== NO TRANSACTION SENT =====');
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const ROOSTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const router = provider.open(
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(ROUTER)
    );

    const tx = await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams({
        sendTokenAddress: ROOSTER,
        otherTokenAddress: PTON,
        sendAmount: 500000000000000n,
        userWalletAddress: USER,
        receiverAddress: USER,
        refundAddress: USER,
        excessesAddress: USER,
        minLpOut: 0n
    });

    const boc = tx.body
        ? tx.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
        : '';

    fs.writeFileSync(
        'current_rooster_liquidity.boc',
        boc
    );

    console.log('===== ROOSTER BUILD ONLY =====');
    console.log('TO:', tx.to.toString());
    console.log('VALUE:', tx.value.toString());
    console.log('VALUE TON:', Number(tx.value) / 1e9);

        )

    const proxyTon = pTON.v2_1.create(
        Address.parse(
            'kQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT-Px'

FILE: scripts\buildRoosterMetadata.ts

import { beginCell, Dictionary } from '@ton/core';
import { createHash } from 'crypto';

function keyOf(name: string): bigint {
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(name).digest();
    return BigInt('0x' + hash.toString('hex'));
}

function valueOf(value: string) {
    return beginCell()
        .storeStringTail(value)
        .endCell();
}

export async function run() {
    const metadata = Dictionary.empty<bigint, ReturnType<typeof valueOf>>(
        Dictionary.Keys.BigUint(256),
        Dictionary.Values.Cell()
    );

    metadata.set(keyOf('name'), valueOf('Rooster Coin'));
    metadata.set(keyOf('symbol'), valueOf('ROOSTER'));
    metadata.set(keyOf('decimals'), valueOf('9'));
    metadata.set(
        keyOf('description'),
        valueOf('Rooster Coin - Fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 ROOSTER')
    );

    const content = beginCell()
        .storeUint(0, 8)
        .storeDict(metadata)
        .endCell();

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== ROOSTER METADATA =====');
    console.log('Name: Rooster Coin');
    console.log('Symbol: ROOSTER');
    console.log('Decimals: 9');
    console.log('Description: Rooster Coin - Fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 ROOSTER');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Metadata Cell:');
    console.log(content.toBoc().toString('base64'));
    console.log('');
    console.log('Cell hash:', content.hash().toString('hex'));
    console.log('============================');
}

function printCell(
    label: string,
    body: Cell | null | undefined
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`--- ${label} ---`);

    if (!body) {
        console.log('EMPTY');
        return;
    }

    console.log('BOC:');
    console.log(
        body.toBoc().toString('base64')
    );

    console.log('Hash:');
    console.log(
        body.hash().toString('hex')
    );

    console.log('Bits:', body.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', body.refs.length);
}

import { Address } from "@ton/core";
import { TonClient4 } from "@ton/ton";
import { DEX } from "@ston-fi/sdk";
import { writeFileSync } from "fs";

export async function run() {
  console.log("========================================");
  console.log(" SDK v2.2 TON LIQUIDITY BODY CHECK");
  console.log(" READ ONLY — NO TRANSACTION SENT");
  console.log("========================================");

  const client = new TonClient4({
    endpoint: "https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com",
  });

  const router = DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(
    Address.parse(
    "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3"
    )
  );

  const user = Address.parse(
    "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix"
  );

  const proxyTon = DEX.v2_2.pTON.create(
    Address.parse(
      "EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S"
    )
  );

  const result = await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams(
    client.provider(router.address),
    {
      proxyTon,
      userWalletAddress: user,
      otherTokenAddress: Address.parse(
        "EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx"
      ),
      sendAmount: 249908000000000n,
      minLpOut: 150109265n,
      receiverAddress: user,
      refundAddress: user,
      excessesAddress: user,
      deadline: 1790531314,
    }
  );

  const body = result.body;

if (!body) {
  throw new Error("SDK returned empty transaction body");
}

console.log("");
console.log("===== SDK RESULT =====");
console.log("to:", result.to.toString());
console.log("value:", result.value.toString());
console.log("bits:", body.bits.length);
console.log("refs:", body.refs.length);
console.log("body hash:", body.hash().toString("hex"));

const boc = body.toBoc();

  console.log("BOC:", boc.toString("base64"));

  writeFileSync(
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\scripts\\sdk_v22_ton_body.boc",
    boc
  );

  console.log("");
  console.log("BOC saved.");
  console.log("NO TRANSACTION SENT.");
}

function sameAddress(
    a: Address,
    b: Address
): boolean {

    return (
        a.toRawString() ===
        b.toRawString()
    );
}


function section(
    title: string
): void {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(title);
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
}


function nanoToTon(
    value: bigint
): string {

    const whole =
        value / 1000000000n;

    const fraction =
        (value % 1000000000n)
            .toString()
            .padStart(9, '0');

    return (
        whole.toString() +
        '.' +
        fraction
    );
}


function sha256Hex(
    data: Buffer
): string {

    const crypto =
        require('crypto');

    return crypto
        .createHash('sha256')
        .update(data)
        .digest('hex');
}


// ============================================================
// TONCONNECT STORAGE
// ============================================================

function createStorage(
    storagePath: string
) {

    return {

        async setItem(
            key: string,
            value: string
        ): Promise<void> {

            let obj: Record<string, string> = {};

            try {

                obj =
                    JSON.parse(
                        await fs.promises.readFile(
                            storagePath,
                            'utf8'
                        )
                    );

            } catch {

                obj = {};
            }

            obj[key] = value;

            await fs.promises.mkdir(
                path.dirname(storagePath),
                {
                    recursive: true
                }
            );

            await fs.promises.writeFile(
                storagePath,
                JSON.stringify(obj)
            );
        },


        async getItem(
            key: string
        ): Promise<string | null> {

            try {

                const obj =
                    JSON.parse(
                        await fs.promises.readFile(
                            storagePath,
                            'utf8'
                        )
                    );

                return (
                    obj[key] ??
                    null
                );

            } catch {

                return null;
            }
        },


        async removeItem(
            key: string
        ): Promise<void> {

            let obj: Record<string, string> = {};

            try {

                obj =
                    JSON.parse(
                        await fs.promises.readFile(
                            storagePath,
                            'utf8'
                        )
                    );

            } catch {

                return;
            }

            delete obj[key];

            await fs.promises.writeFile(
                storagePath,
                JSON.stringify(obj)
            );
        }

    };
}

import { beginCell, Address } from "@ton/core";
import * as fs from "fs";

const OP_PROVIDE_LP = 0x37c096df;

const routerWalletAddress = Address.parse(
  "EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3"
);

const refundAddress = Address.parse(
  "0QDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N6R-"
);

const excessesAddress = refundAddress;
const receiverAddress = refundAddress;

const minLpOut = 150109265n;
const bothPositive = true;

const deadline = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600;

const forwardPayload = beginCell()
  .storeUint(OP_PROVIDE_LP, 32)
  .storeAddress(routerWalletAddress)
  .storeAddress(refundAddress)
  .storeAddress(excessesAddress)
  .storeUint(deadline, 64)
  .storeRef(
    beginCell()
      .storeCoins(minLpOut)
      .storeAddress(receiverAddress)
      .storeUint(bothPositive ? 1 : 0, 1)
      .storeCoins(0n)
      .storeMaybeRef(null)
      .endCell()
  )
  .endCell();

const boc = forwardPayload.toBoc();

fs.writeFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\scripts\\v22_provide_lp_payload.boc",
  boc
);

console.log("========================================");
console.log("STON.fi V2.2 PROVIDE_LP PAYLOAD");
console.log("READ ONLY / BUILD ONLY");
console.log("========================================");

console.log("Opcode:", "0x" + OP_PROVIDE_LP.toString(16));
console.log("minLpOut:", minLpOut.toString());
console.log("bothPositive:", bothPositive);
console.log("deadline:", deadline);

console.log("");
console.log("===== ROOT =====");
console.log("bits:", forwardPayload.bits.length);
console.log("refs:", forwardPayload.refs.length);
console.log("hash:", forwardPayload.hash().toString("hex"));

console.log("");
console.log("===== BOC =====");
console.log(boc.toString("base64"));

console.log("");
console.log("===== FILE =====");
console.log(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\scripts\\v22_provide_lp_payload.boc"
);

console.log("");
console.log("===== REF =====");
const ref = forwardPayload.refs[0];
console.log("bits:", ref.bits.length);
console.log("refs:", ref.refs.length);
console.log("hash:", ref.hash().toString("hex"));

console.log("");
console.log("NO TRANSACTION SENT.");

FILE: scripts\calculateCurrentV22Amounts.ts

import { Address } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 100_000_000_000n;

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(70));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 CURRENT LIQUIDITY CALCULATOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));

    const pool = DEX.v2_2.Pool.CPI.create(POOL);
    const poolProvider = provider.provider(POOL);

    const data = await pool.getPoolData(poolProvider);

    const roosterReserve = data.reserve0;
    const ptonReserve = data.reserve1;
    const totalLp = data.totalSupplyLP;

    const proportionalPton =
        (ROOSTER_AMOUNT * ptonReserve) / roosterReserve;

    const lpFromRooster =
        (ROOSTER_AMOUNT * totalLp) / roosterReserve;

    const lpFromPton =
        (proportionalPton * totalLp) / ptonReserve;

    const expectedLp =
        lpFromRooster < lpFromPton
            ? lpFromRooster
            : lpFromPton;

    const minLp95 =
        (expectedLp * 95n) / 100n;

    console.log('');

    console.log('ROOSTER RESERVE:', roosterReserve.toString());
    console.log('pTON RESERVE   :', ptonReserve.toString());
    console.log('TOTAL LP       :', totalLp.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('FOR 100 ROOSTER');
    console.log('ROOSTER AMOUNT  :', ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString());
    console.log('PROPORTIONAL pTON:', proportionalPton.toString());
    console.log(
        'PROPORTIONAL pTON TON:',
        Number(proportionalPton) / 1e9
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('LP FROM ROOSTER:', lpFromRooster.toString());
    console.log('LP FROM pTON   :', lpFromPton.toString());
    console.log('EXPECTED LP    :', expectedLp.toString());
    console.log('95% MIN LP OUT :', minLp95.toString());

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

function integerSqrt(value: bigint): bigint {
    if (value < 0n) {
        throw new Error('Square root of negative number');
    }

    if (value < 2n) {
        return value;
    }

    let x0 = value;
    let x1 = (x0 + 1n) >> 1n;

    while (x1 < x0) {
        x0 = x1;
        x1 = (x1 + value / x1) >> 1n;
    }

    return x0;
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
    );

    const roosterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const ptonMasterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
    );

    const router = DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(routerAddress);

    const roosterAmount = 100_000n * 1_000_000_000n;
    const ptonAmount = 1n * 1_000_000_000n;

    const requiredMinLiquidity = 1001n;

    const product = roosterAmount * ptonAmount;
    const sqrtProduct = integerSqrt(product);

    const lpAfterMinimum =
        sqrtProduct > requiredMinLiquidity
            ? sqrtProduct - requiredMinLiquidity
            : 0n;

    const poolAddress = await router.getPoolAddress(
        provider.provider(routerAddress),
        {
            token0: roosterAddress,
            token1: ptonMasterAddress,
        }
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('        ROOSTER INITIAL LP CALCULATION');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Router:');
    console.log(routerAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Pool:');
    console.log(poolAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('INPUT AMOUNTS');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');
    console.log('ROOSTER:');
    console.log('100,000 ROOSTER');
    console.log('nano:', roosterAmount.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('pTON:');
    console.log('1 pTON');
    console.log('nano:', ptonAmount.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('CALCULATION');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');
    console.log('Product:');

import { Address, beginCell, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { pTON } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
);

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' pTON V1 DEPLOY REQUIREMENT ANALYSIS');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');
    console.log('READ-ONLY MODE');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');

    const owner = provider.sender().address;

    if (!owner) {
        console.log('Wallet address unavailable.');
        return;
    }

    console.log('OWNER:');
    console.log(owner.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('PTON MASTER:');
    console.log(PTON_MASTER.toString());
    console.log('');

    const pton = pTON.v1.create(PTON_MASTER);
    const masterProvider = provider.provider(PTON_MASTER);

    /*
     * Build the exact V1 deploy-wallet body.
     * This does NOT send anything.
     */
    const deployTx = await pton.getDeployWalletTxParams(
        masterProvider,
        {
            ownerAddress: owner,
            gasAmount: 50_000_000n
        }
    );

    if (!deployTx.body) {
        console.log('Deploy body is missing.');
        return;
    }

    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('DEPLOY MESSAGE');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Destination:');
    console.log(deployTx.to.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Deploy body BOC:');
    console.log(
        deployTx.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
    );
    console.log('');

    /*
     * Calculate the user pTON wallet address.
     */
    const walletAddress = await pton.getWalletAddress(
        masterProvider,
        owner
    );

    console.log('USER PTON WALLET:');
    console.log(walletAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    /*
     * Check current wallet state.
     */
    const walletState = await provider.provider(walletAddress)
        .getState();

    console.log('PTON WALLET STATE:');
    console.log(walletState);
    console.log('');

    /*
     * Estimate the external/inbound fee of the deploy message.
     * This is read-only.
     */
    const api: any = provider.api();

    if (!api || !api.api) {
        console.log('Internal HttpApi unavailable.');
        return;
    }

    try {
        const fee = await api.api.estimateFee(
            PTON_MASTER,
            {
                body: deployTx.body,
                initCode: null,
                initData: null,
                ignoreSignature: true
            }
        );

        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('NETWORK FEE ESTIMATE');
        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('');

        console.log(JSON.stringify(fee, null, 2));
        console.log('');

        const source = fee.source_fees;

        const inboundForward =
            BigInt(source.in_fwd_fee ?? 0);

        const storage =
            BigInt(source.storage_fee ?? 0);

        const gas =
            BigInt(source.gas_fee ?? 0);

        const forward =
            BigInt(source.fwd_fee ?? 0);

        const total =
            inboundForward +
            storage +
            gas +
            forward;

        console.log('TOTAL ESTIMATED FEES:');
        console.log(total.toString(), 'nanoTON');
        console.log(
            Number(total) / 1_000_000_000,
            'TON'
        );
        console.log('');

        /*
         * Official pTON V1 source requirement:
         *
         * MSG_VALUE >
         * (FWD_FEE * 3)
         * + storage_fee::minter
         * + gas::minter::deploy_wallet
         * + storage_fee::wallet
         * + gas::wallet::internal_deploy
         *
         * From official pTON source:
         *
         * storage_fee::minter       = 0.01 TON
         * gas::minter::deploy_wallet = 0.01 TON
         * storage_fee::wallet       = 0.01 TON
         * gas::wallet::internal_deploy = 0.01 TON
         *
         * Fixed part = 0.04 TON
         */

        const fixed =
            40_000_000n;

        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('KNOWN CONTRACT REQUIREMENT');
        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('');

        console.log('Fixed contract requirement:');
        console.log('0.04 TON');
        console.log('');

        console.log('Formula:');
        console.log(
            'MSG_VALUE > (FWD_FEE × 3) + 0.04 TON'
        );
        console.log('');

        /*
         * Show conservative examples for different
         * possible internal forwarding fees.
         */
        const candidates = [
            1_000_000n,
            2_000_000n,
            3_000_000n,
            5_000_000n,
            10_000_000n
        ];

        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('SCENARIO ANALYSIS');
        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('');

        for (const fwd of candidates) {
            const minimum =
                fixed + (fwd * 3n);

            console.log(
                `If FWD_FEE = ${
                    Number(fwd) / 1_000_000_000
                } TON`
            );

            console.log(
                `Required MSG_VALUE > ${
                    Number(minimum) / 1_000_000_000
                } TON`
            );

            console.log('');
        }

        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('IMPORTANT');
        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'The 0.05 TON value used above was ONLY for analysis.'
        );

        console.log(
            'No transaction was created or sent.'
        );

        console.log(
            'We will NOT deploy the pTON wallet yet.'
        );

        console.log('');
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('Fee analysis failed.');
        console.log('');
        console.log(error);
        console.log('');
        console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    }

    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('END');
    console.log('================================================');
}

import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { Address } from '@ton/core';

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
);

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' pTON V1 MINIMUM DEPLOY GAS CALCULATION');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');
    console.log('READ-ONLY MODE');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');

    console.log('pTON MASTER:');
    console.log(PTON_MASTER.toString());
    console.log('');

    const api = provider.api();

    console.log('API TYPE:');
    console.log(api.constructor.name);
    console.log('');

    if (!(api instanceof TonClient)) {
        console.log('Unexpected API type.');
        console.log('');
        console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
        return;
    }

    /*
     * Read the pTON master account.
     * This is only a read operation.
     */
    const masterState = await api.getContractState(PTON_MASTER);

    console.log('pTON MASTER STATE:');
    console.log(masterState.state);
    console.log('');

    /*
     * Contract source:
     *
     * MSG_VALUE >
     *     (FWD_FEE * 3)
     *     + storage_fee::minter
     *     + gas::minter::deploy_wallet
     *     + storage_fee::wallet
     *     + gas::wallet::internal_deploy
     *
     * Known fixed values:
     *
     * storage_fee::minter       = 0.01 TON
     * deploy_wallet gas         = 0.01 TON
     * storage_fee::wallet       = 0.01 TON
     * internal_deploy gas       = 0.01 TON
     *
     * Total fixed requirement = 0.04 TON
     */

    const fixedRequirement = 40_000_000n;

    console.log('FIXED CONTRACT REQUIREMENT:');
    console.log('0.04 TON');
    console.log('');

    console.log('FORMULA:');
    console.log('MSG_VALUE > (FWD_FEE × 3) + 0.04 TON');
    console.log('');

    console.log('IMPORTANT:');
    console.log('FWD_FEE is calculated by the TON transaction engine.');
    console.log('It is not a fixed value in the pTON source code.');
    console.log('');

    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('KNOWN DEPLOY AMOUNTS');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    const amounts = [
        0.045,
        0.050,
        0.055,
        0.060,
        0.065,
        0.070,
        0.080,
        0.100
    ];

    for (const amount of amounts) {
        const nano = BigInt(Math.round(amount * 1_000_000_000));

        console.log(
            `${amount.toFixed(3)} TON -> ${nano.toString()} nanoTON`
        );

        if (nano > fixedRequirement) {
            console.log('  Fixed requirement: PASSES');
        } else {
            console.log('  Fixed requirement: FAILS');
        }

        console.log('');
    }

    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('CONCLUSION');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');
    console.log('0.04 TON is the fixed part of the requirement.');
    console.log('');
    console.log('The actual minimum is:');
    console.log('0.04 TON + 3 × FWD_FEE');
    console.log('');
    console.log('We still need the actual forwarding fee before');
    console.log('selecting the final deployment amount.');
    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('END');
    console.log('================================================');
}

const USER_WALLET =
  "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix";

const ROUTER =
  "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3";

async function checkJettonWallet(
  provider: any,
  label: string,
  masterAddress: Address,
  ownerAddress: Address
) {
  console.log(`\n===== ${label} =====`);

  console.log("Master:");
  console.log(masterAddress.toString());

  console.log("Owner:");
  console.log(ownerAddress.toString());

  try {
    const result = await provider.provider(masterAddress).get(
      "get_wallet_address",
      [
        {
          type: "slice",
          cell: beginCell()
            .storeAddress(ownerAddress)
            .endCell(),
        },
      ]
    );

    const wallet = result.stack.readAddress();

    console.log("Derived Jetton Wallet:");
    console.log(wallet.toString());

    console.log("STATUS: PASS");

    return wallet;
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.log("STATUS: FAIL");

    if (error?.message) {
      console.log("Error:");
      console.log(error.message);
    } else {
      console.log(error);
    }

    return null;
  }
}

FILE: scripts\checkCaller12287.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = new Set([87, 122]);
const IMPORTS = 83;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: pos };

    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8;
let codeStart = -1;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  p = sz.next;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = p;
    break;
  }

  p += sz.value;
}

if (codeStart < 0)
  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

let q = codeStart;
const count = uleb(q);
q = count.next;

console.log("FUNC 122 -> FUNC 87 DIRECT CHECK");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (let body = 0; body < count.value; body++) {

  const bs = uleb(q);
  q = bs.next;

  const start = q;
  const end = q + bs.value;
  const realFunc = IMPORTS + body;

  let calls87 = 0;
  let calls122 = 0;

  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {

    if (wasm[i] !== 0x10)
      continue;

    const r = uleb(i + 1);

    if (r.value === 87) calls87++;
    if (r.value === 122) calls122++;
  }

  if (realFunc === 122 || calls87 || calls122) {

    if (realFunc === 122 || calls87 || calls122) {
      console.log(
        `FUNC ${realFunc} BODY ${body} ` +
        `CALL87=${calls87} CALL122=${calls122}`
      );
    }
  }

  q = end;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

export async function run() {
    const roosterReserve = 600000000000000n;
    const ptonReserve = 1499448684n;

    const roosterIn = 100000000000n;
    const ptonIn = 249908n;

    const roosterEquivalentFromPton =
        (ptonIn * roosterReserve) / ptonReserve;

    const ptonEquivalentFromRooster =
        (roosterIn * ptonReserve) / roosterReserve;

    const roosterDiff =
        roosterIn > roosterEquivalentFromPton
            ? roosterIn - roosterEquivalentFromPton
            : roosterEquivalentFromPton - roosterIn;

    const ptonDiff =
        ptonIn > ptonEquivalentFromRooster
            ? ptonIn - ptonEquivalentFromRooster
            : ptonEquivalentFromRooster - ptonIn;

    const roosterRatioNumerator = roosterIn * ptonReserve;
    const ptonRatioDenominator = ptonIn * roosterReserve;

    const ratioDifference =
        roosterRatioNumerator > ptonRatioDenominator
            ? roosterRatioNumerator - ptonRatioDenominator
            : ptonRatioDenominator - roosterRatioNumerator;

    const ratioPercent =
        Number(ratioDifference) /
        Number(ptonRatioDenominator) *
        100;

    console.log("================================================");
    console.log(" STON.fi v2.2 EXACT PROPORTION CHECK");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT");
    console.log("================================================");

    console.log("");
    console.log("===== LIVE RESERVES =====");
    console.log(`ROOSTER reserve: ${roosterReserve}`);
    console.log(`pTON reserve:    ${ptonReserve}`);

    console.log("");
    console.log("===== TEST INPUT =====");
    console.log(`ROOSTER input: ${roosterIn} nano = 100 ROOSTER`);
    console.log(`pTON input:    ${ptonIn} nano = 0.000249908 TON`);

    console.log("");
    console.log("===== EQUIVALENT AMOUNTS =====");

    console.log(
        `ROOSTER equivalent from pTON: ${roosterEquivalentFromPton} nano`
    );

    console.log(
        `ROOSTER difference:           ${roosterDiff} nano`
    );

    console.log(
        `pTON equivalent from ROOSTER: ${ptonEquivalentFromRooster} nano`
    );

    console.log(
        `pTON difference:              ${ptonDiff} nano`
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("===== RATIO DIFFERENCE =====");

    console.log(`Absolute ratio difference: ${ratioDifference}`);
    console.log(`Relative difference: ${ratioPercent.toFixed(8)}%`);

    console.log("");

    if (ratioPercent < 0.001) {
        console.log("PROPORTIONALITY TOLERANCE: PASS");
    } else {
        console.log("PROPORTIONALITY TOLERANCE: CHECK");
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("===== FINAL =====");
    console.log("READ ONLY");
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION SENT");
    console.log("================================================");
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

async function getJettonWalletMaster(
    provider: NetworkProvider,
    walletAddress: Address
) {
    const result = await provider.provider(walletAddress).get(
        'get_wallet_data',
        []
    );

    const stack = result.stack;

    const balance = stack.readBigNumber();
    const owner = stack.readAddress();
    const jettonMaster = stack.readAddress();

    return {
        balance,
        owner,
        jettonMaster,
    };
}

const servers = [
    {
        host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
        key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
    },
    {
        host: 'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088',

export async function run() {

    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');

    const engines: LiteEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {

        const key = Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64');

        engines.push(
            new LiteSingleEngine({
                host: server.host,
                publicKey: key,
                reconnectTimeout: 5000,
            })
        );
    }

    const engine =
        new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines);

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine,
        batchSize: 1,
    });

        const master =
            await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log(
            'Masterchain seqno:',
            master.last.seqno
        );

        for (let i = 0; i < LIBRARY_HASHES.length; i++) {

            const hashHex = LIBRARY_HASHES[i];

            console.log('');
            console.log(`===== INTERNAL LIBRARY [${i}] =====`);
            console.log('Hash:', hashHex);

            try {

                const hash =
                    Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');

                const result =
                    await client.getLibraries([hash]);

                console.log('');
                console.log('RAW RESULT:');

                console.dir(result, {
                    depth: 20
                });

                console.log('');

                if (
                    result &&
                    Array.isArray(result.result)
                ) {

                    console.log(
                        'Entries:',
                        result.result.length
                    );

                    if (result.result.length > 0) {
                        console.log(
                            '>>> LIBRARY FOUND'
                        );
                    } else {
                        console.log(
                            '>>> LIBRARY NOT RETURNED'
                        );
                    }

                } else {

                    console.log(
                        'Unexpected result structure'
                    );
                }

            } catch (error) {

                console.log('ERROR:');
                console.error(error);
            }
        }

    } finally {

        console.log('');
        console.log('Closing engines...');

        for (const e of engines) {
            e.close();
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('              TEST FINISHED');
    console.log('              NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================');
}

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';

const ROOSTER_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'

    // --------------------------------------------------

    const ptonResult = await provider

            {
                type: 'slice',

                    .storeAddress(USER_WALLET)

            },
        ]);

    const ptonWallet = ptonResult.stack.readAddress();

function formatJettonAmount(amount: bigint): string {
    const decimals = 9n;
    const base = 10n ** decimals;

    const whole = amount / base;
    const fraction = amount % base;

    if (fraction === 0n) {
        return whole.toString();
    }

    const fractionText = fraction
        .toString()
        .padStart(Number(decimals), '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return `${whole.toString()}.${fractionText}`;
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const ROOSTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('       STON.fi V2.2 LP CALCULATION CHECK');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    const router =
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(ROUTER);

    const routerProvider =
        provider.provider(ROUTER);

    // ================================================
    // GET REAL POOL
    // ================================================

    const pool =
        await router.getPool(
            routerProvider,
            {
                token0: ROOSTER,
                token1: PTON,
            }
        );

    const poolAddress = pool.address;

    const poolProvider =
        provider.provider(poolAddress);

    console.log('Pool:');
    console.log(poolAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // READ POOL DATA
    // ================================================

    const poolData =
        await pool.getPoolData(poolProvider);

    const reserveRooster =
        poolData.reserve0;

    const reservePton =
        poolData.reserve1;

    const totalSupplyLP =
        poolData.totalSupplyLP;

    // ================================================
    // AMOUNTS WE WANT TO ADD
    // ================================================

    const roosterAmount =
        100_000n * 1_000_000_000n;

    const ptonAmount =
        1n * 1_000_000_000n;

    // ================================================
    // CALCULATE LP FROM EACH SIDE
    // ================================================

    const lpFromRooster =
        roosterAmount *
        totalSupplyLP /
        reserveRooster;

    const lpFromPton =
        ptonAmount *
        totalSupplyLP /
        reservePton;

    // The smaller side limits LP creation.
    const expectedLp =
        lpFromRooster < lpFromPton
            ? lpFromRooster
            : lpFromPton;

    // 95% safety margin.
    const minLpOut =
        expectedLp * 95n / 100n;

    // ================================================
    // DISPLAY
    // ================================================

    console.log('===== CURRENT POOL =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER reserve:',
        Number(reserveRooster) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON reserve:',
        Number(reservePton) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'Total LP:',
        totalSupplyLP.toString()
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('===== PROPOSED DEPOSIT =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER:',
        Number(roosterAmount) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON:',
        Number(ptonAmount) / 1e9
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('===== LP CALCULATION =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'LP from ROOSTER:',
        lpFromRooster.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'LP from pTON:',
        lpFromPton.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected LP:',
        expectedLp.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Minimum LP (95%):',
        minLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // CHECK USER LP ACCOUNT
    // ================================================

    console.log('===== USER LP ACCOUNT =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'User:',
        USER.toString()
    );

    const lpAccountAddress =

        'NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.'

async function main() {
    const servers = [
        {
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            ip: -1468575011,

            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    const engines: LiteSingleEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {
        engines.push(
            new LiteSingleEngine({
                host: `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`,
                publicKey: Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64'),
                reconnectTimeout: 3000,
            })
        );
    }

    const engine = new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines);

    const client = new LiteClient({

        console.dir(version, {

            depth: 5,
        });

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== DONE =====');

    } finally {
        for (const e of engines) {
            e.close();
        }
    }
}

function intToIP(int: number) {
    const part1 = int & 255;
    const part2 = (int >> 8) & 255;
    const part3 = (int >> 16) & 255;
    const part4 = (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

main().catch((error) => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('===== ERROR =====');
    console.error(error);
    process.exit(1);
});

export async function run() {
    await main();
}

import { LiteClient, LiteRoundRobinEngine, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { Address } from '@ton/core';

async function main() {
    const pton = Address.parse(
        'EQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT1h7'
    );

    const servers = [
        {
            host: 'tcp://49.12.147.32:27842',
            key: 'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM=',
        },
        {
            host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            host: 'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088',
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    console.log('===== OFFICIAL pTON LITESERVER CHECK =====');
    console.log('pTON:', pton.toString());
    console.log('');

    const engines = servers.map(s =>
        new LiteSingleEngine({
            host: s.host,
            publicKey: Buffer.from(s.key, 'base64'),
        })
    );

    const engine = new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines);

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine,
    });

    console.log('Getting masterchain info...');
    const master = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

    console.log('Masterchain seqno:', master.last.seqno);
    console.log('');

    console.log('Getting pTON account state...');

    const result = await client.getAccountState(
        pton,
        master.last
    );

    console.log('Account state received.');
    console.log('');

    console.log('===== ACCOUNT INFORMATION =====');

    console.log(
        'State:',
        result.state === null ? 'UNINIT / NO ACCOUNT' : 'ACTIVE'
    );

    console.log(
        'Balance:',
        result.balance.coins.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Balance TON:',
        Number(result.balance.coins) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'Raw bytes:',
        result.raw.length
    );

    console.log(
        'Proof bytes:',
        result.proof.length
    );

    console.log('');

    if (result.lastTx) {
        console.log('Last TX LT:', result.lastTx.lt.toString());
        console.log('Last TX hash:', result.lastTx.hash.toString());
    } else {
        console.log('Last TX: none');
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== DONE =====');
}

main().catch(e => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('===== ERROR =====');
    console.error(e);
    process.exit(1);
});

FILE: scripts\checkPoolViaSdk.ts

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    const router = Address.parse(
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
    );

    const rooster = Address.parse(
        'kQAmO8BvKx4ta9jkCCDx197VqrUrsaC42Dv6yhDAyKzFppYY'
    );

    const pton = Address.parse(
        'kQBbJjnahBMGbMUJwhAXLn8BiigcGXMJhSC0l7DBhdYABhG7'
    );

    const slice = (address: Address) => ({
        type: 'slice' as const,
        cell: beginCell()
            .storeAddress(address)
            .endCell(),
    });

    console.log('===== ROUTER =====');
    console.log(router.toString({
        urlSafe: true,
        bounceable: true,
        testOnly: true,
    }));

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Router data
    // --------------------------------------------------

    try {
        console.log('===== GET ROUTER DATA =====');

        const r = await client.runMethod(
            router,
            'get_router_data',
            []
        );

        console.log(r.stack);

    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'ROUTER DATA ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Pool: ROOSTER -> pTON
    // --------------------------------------------------

    try {
        console.log('===== POOL ROOSTER -> PTON =====');

        const r = await client.runMethod(
            router,
            'get_pool_address',
            [
                slice(rooster),
                slice(pton),
            ]
        );

        console.log('POOL:',
            r.stack.readAddress().toString({
                urlSafe: true,
                bounceable: true,
                testOnly: true,
            })
        );

    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'ROOSTER -> PTON ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Pool: pTON -> ROOSTER
    // --------------------------------------------------

    try {
        console.log('===== POOL PTON -> ROOSTER =====');

        const r = await client.runMethod(
            router,
            'get_pool_address',
            [
                slice(pton),
                slice(rooster),
            ]
        );

        console.log('POOL:',
            r.stack.readAddress().toString({
                urlSafe: true,
                bounceable: true,
                testOnly: true,
            })
        );

    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'PTON -> ROOSTER ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    }
}

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const USER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    '0QDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N6R-'
);

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' ROOSTER COIN - PTON BALANCE CHECK');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY ONLY');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log('User wallet:');
    console.log(USER_WALLET.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('pTON v2.1 Master:');
    console.log(PTON_MASTER.toString());
    console.log('');

    // Calculate pTON Jetton Wallet address
    const masterProvider = provider.provider(PTON_MASTER);

    const result = await masterProvider.get('get_wallet_address', [
        {
            type: 'slice',
            cell: beginCell()
                .storeAddress(USER_WALLET)
                .endCell(),
        },
    ]);

    const ptonWallet = result.stack.readAddress();

    console.log('pTON Jetton Wallet:');
    console.log(ptonWallet.toString());
    console.log('');

    // Read pTON wallet data
    const walletProvider = provider.provider(ptonWallet);

    const walletData = await walletProvider.get('get_wallet_data', []);

    const balance = walletData.stack.readBigNumber();

    console.log('pTON balance:');
    console.log(balance.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('pTON balance in TON:');
    console.log(Number(balance) / 1e9);
    console.log('');

    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' PTON BALANCE CHECK COMPLETED');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('==========================================');
}
