import { Address, toNano } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { pTON } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'kQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT-Px'
);

const USER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    '0QDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N6R-'
);

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' ROOSTER COIN - PTON TON TRANSFER CHECK');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY ONLY');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('');

    const pton = pTON.v2_1.create(
        PTON_MASTER
    );

    console.log('pTON v2.1 Master:');
    console.log(pton.address.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('User wallet:');
    console.log(USER_WALLET.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Test amount:');
    console.log('0.1 TON');
    console.log('');

    const contractProvider = provider.provider(pton.address);

    const txParams = await pton.getTonTransferTxParams(
        contractProvider,
        {
            tonAmount: toNano('0.1'),
            destinationAddress: USER_WALLET,
            refundAddress: USER_WALLET,
        }
    );

    console.log('Generated transaction parameters:');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Destination:');
    console.log(txParams.to.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Value:');
    console.log(txParams.value.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Value in TON:');
    console.log(Number(txParams.value) / 1e9);
    console.log('');

    if (txParams.body) {
        console.log('Body BOC:');
        console.log(txParams.body.toBoc().toString('base64'));
    } else {
        console.log('Body BOC:');
        console.log('No body returned.');
    }

    console.log('');

    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' CHECK COMPLETED');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('==========================================');
}

    console.log('================================================');

    try {

        const result = await provider.provider(poolAddress).get(

        );

        const token1Cell = stack.readCell();
        const lpFee = stack.readBigNumber();
        const protocolFee = stack.readBigNumber();
        const extraCell = stack.readCell();
        const protocolFeeEnabled = stack.readBigNumber();
        const lastK = stack.readBigNumber();

        console.log('===== BASIC DATA =====');
        console.log('Locked:', locked.toString());
        console.log('Total LP:', totalLp.toString());
        console.log('Reserve 0:', reserve0.toString());
        console.log('Reserve 1:', reserve1.toString());
        console.log('LP Fee:', lpFee.toString());
        console.log('Protocol Fee:', protocolFee.toString());
        console.log('Protocol Fee Enabled:', protocolFeeEnabled.toString());
        console.log('Last K:', lastK.toString());
        console.log('');

        console.log('===== RAW CELLS =====');
        console.log('Router Cell:', routerCell.toString());
        console.log('Token 0 Cell:', token0Cell.toString());
        console.log('Token 1 Cell:', token1Cell.toString());
        console.log('');

        try {
            const routerSlice = routerCell.beginParse();
            const router = routerSlice.loadAddress();

            console.log('Router Address:');
            console.log(router?.toString());
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('Router decode failed');
        }

        console.log('');

        try {
            const token0Slice = token0Cell.beginParse();
            const token0 = token0Slice.loadAddress();

            console.log('Token 0 Wallet:');
            console.log(token0?.toString());
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('Token 0 decode failed');
        }

        console.log('');

        try {
            const token1Slice = token1Cell.beginParse();
            const token1 = token1Slice.loadAddress();

            console.log('Token 1 Wallet:');
            console.log(token1?.toString());
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('Token 1 decode failed');
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('                 DECODE FINISHED');
        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('');

    } catch (error: any) {

        console.log('get_pool_data: FAILED');
        console.log('');
        console.log(error?.message ?? error);
        console.log('');

    }
}

        throw new Error('Wallet address not available.');

        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'

        RoosterCoin.createFromAddress(roosterCoinAddress)

import { Address, toNano } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX, pTON } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const userWalletAddress = provider.sender().address;

    if (!userWalletAddress) {
        throw new Error('Wallet address not available.');
    }

    const router = DEX.v2_1.Router.CPI.create(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    const proxyTon = pTON.v2_1.create(
        'kQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT-Px'
    );

    const roosterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== ROOSTER / TON LIQUIDITY TX CHECK =====');
    console.log('Wallet:', userWalletAddress.toString());
    console.log('Router:', router.address.toString());
    console.log('pTON:', proxyTon.address.toString());
    console.log('ROOSTER:', roosterAddress.toString());
    console.log('');
    console.log('Test TON amount: 1 TON');
    console.log('Test ROOSTER amount: 100,000,000 ROOSTER');
    console.log('Min LP out: 1');
    console.log('');

    try {
        const tx = await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams(
            provider.provider(router.address),
            {
                userWalletAddress,
                proxyTon,
                otherTokenAddress: roosterAddress,
                sendAmount: toNano('1'),
                minLpOut: 1n,

        );

        console.log('Body BOC:');

        if (tx.body) {

                tx.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
            );
        } else {
            console.log('Body: undefined');
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== NO TRANSACTION SENT =====');
        console.log('This script only generated transaction parameters.');

    } catch (error) {

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
    );

    const roosterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const ptonAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT1h7'
    );

    console.log('===== ROOSTER / pTON POOL CHECK =====');
    console.log('Router v2.2:', routerAddress.toString());
    console.log('ROOSTER:', roosterAddress.toString());
    console.log('pTON v2.1:', ptonAddress.toString());

    const router = provider.open(
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(routerAddress)
    );

    try {
        const routerData = await router.getRouterData();

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== ROUTER DATA =====');

        console.log('dexType:', routerData.dexType);
        console.log('isLocked:', routerData.isLocked);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Router data FAILED');
        console.log(e?.message || e);
        return;
    }

    try {
        const poolAddress = await router.getPoolAddressByJettonMinters({
            token0: roosterAddress,
            token1: ptonAddress,
        });

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== POOL ADDRESS =====');

            console.log(poolData);
        } catch (e: any) {
            console.log('');

            console.log(e?.message || e);
        }

    } catch (e: any) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('getPoolAddress FAILED');
        console.log(e?.message || e);
    }
}

        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    const pton = pTON.v2_1.create(
        'kQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT-Px'
    );

    const roosterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== ROOSTER / TON POOL ADDRESS CHECK =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Router:', router.address.toString());
    console.log('pTON:', pton.address.toString());
    console.log('ROOSTER:', roosterAddress.toString());

    try {
        // Router's ROOSTER Jetton Wallet
        const roosterRouterWallet =
            await provider
                .provider(roosterAddress)
                .open(
                    // The SDK's internal JettonMinter class is not exported
                    // from the package root, so we use the Router helper.
                    DEX.v2_1.Router.CPI.create(router.address)
                );

        console.log('');

        console.log('ROOSTER Router Wallet calculation will be tested next.');

        // Use the Router's public helper.
        const poolAddress =
            await router.getPoolAddress(
                provider.provider(router.address),
                {
                    token0: roosterAddress,
                    token1: pton.address,
                }
            );

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== POOL ADDRESS =====');
        console.log(poolAddress.toString());
        console.log('========================');
    } catch (error) {

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';
import { execSync } from 'child_process';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

const PROJECT_ROOT =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin';

const MASTER =
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx';

const USER_WALLET =
    '0QDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N6R-';

const ROOSTER_WALLET =
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh';

const ROUTER =
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3';

const PTON_MASTER =
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S';

const PTON_ROUTER_WALLET =
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3';

const POOL =
    'EQB2Ijt3RHMCfzYBUH44pPD04IYZOj8Ol4RsyNDgQhWwMvd_';

let passed = 0;
let failed = 0;
let warnings = 0;

// ------------------------------------------------
// BIGINT-SAFE JSON
// ------------------------------------------------

function safeStringify(
    value: unknown
): string {

    return JSON.stringify(
        value,
        (_key, value) =>
            typeof value === 'bigint'
                ? value.toString()
                : value,
        2
    );
}

// ------------------------------------------------
// RESULT HELPERS
// ------------------------------------------------

function ok(
    label: string,
    message = ''
) {

    passed++;

    console.log(
        `  [OK] ${label}${message ? ` - ${message}` : ''}`
    );
}

function fail(
    label: string,
    message = ''
) {

    failed++;

    console.log(
        `  [FAIL] ${label}${message ? ` - ${message}` : ''}`
    );
}

function warn(
    label: string,
    message = ''
) {

    warnings++;

    console.log(
        `  [WARN] ${label}${message ? ` - ${message}` : ''}`
    );
}

function section(
    title: string
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '================================================'
    );
    console.log(title);
    console.log(
        '================================================'
    );
}

// ------------------------------------------------
// FILE CHECK
// ------------------------------------------------

function checkFileCandidates(
    label: string,
    candidates: string[]
) {

    for (
        const relativePath of candidates
    ) {

        const fullPath =
            path.join(
                PROJECT_ROOT,
                relativePath
            );

        if (
            fs.existsSync(fullPath)
        ) {

            ok(
                label,
                `Found: ${relativePath}`
            );

            return;
        }
    }

    warn(
        label,
        `Not found in expected locations`
    );
}

// ------------------------------------------------
// COMMAND CHECK
// ------------------------------------------------

function commandExists(
    command: string
): boolean {

    try {

        execSync(
            `where.exe ${command}`,
            {
                stdio: 'ignore',
                shell: 'powershell.exe'
            }
        );

        return true;

    } catch {

        return false;
    }
}

function getCommandVersion(
    command: string
): string {

    try {

        return execSync(
            `${command} --version`,
            {
                encoding: 'utf8',
                shell: 'powershell.exe'
            }
        ).trim();

    } catch {

        return 'Unavailable';
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------
// ADDRESS CHECK
// ------------------------------------------------

function checkAddress(
    addressText: string,
    label: string
) {

    try {

        const address =
            Address.parse(
                addressText
            );

        ok(
            label,
            address.toString()
        );

    } catch {

        fail(
            label,
            'Invalid TON address'
        );
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------
// HTTP CHECK
// ------------------------------------------------

async function checkHttp(
    url: string,
    label: string
) {

    try {

        const response =
            await fetch(url);

        if (
            response.ok
        ) {

            ok(
                label,
                `HTTP ${response.status}`
            );

        } else {

            warn(
                label,
                `HTTP ${response.status}`
            );
        }

    } catch (error) {

        fail(
            label,
            error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : String(error)
        );
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------
// MAIN
// ------------------------------------------------

export async function run(
    provider: NetworkProvider
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        '          ROOSTER COIN PROJECT CHECK'
    );
    console.log(
        '================================================'
    );
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'READ-ONLY CHECK'
    );
    console.log(
        'NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT'
    );
    console.log('');

    // =================================================
    // 1. SOFTWARE ENVIRONMENT
    // =================================================

    section(
        '1. SOFTWARE ENVIRONMENT'
    );

    console.log('');

    if (
        commandExists('node')
    ) {

        ok(
            'Node.js',
            getCommandVersion('node')
        );

    } else {

        fail(
            'Node.js',
            'node command not found'
        );
    }

    if (
        commandExists('npm.cmd')
    ) {

FILE: scripts\checkRouterLibrary.ts

import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

export async function run() {
    const libraryHash = Buffer.from(
        '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86',
        'hex'
    );

    console.log('===== ROUTER LIBRARY CHECK =====');
    console.log('Library hash:');
    console.log(libraryHash.toString('hex'));

    const servers = [
        {
            host: 'tcp://49.12.147.32:27842',
            key: 'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM='
        },
        {
            host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk='
        },
        {
            host: 'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088',
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek='
        }
    ];

    for (const server of servers) {
        console.log('\n--------------------------------');
        console.log('Server:', server.host);

        try {
            const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
                host: server.host,
                publicKey: Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64'),
                reconnectTimeout: 3000
            });

            console.log('Connecting...');

            for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                if (engine.isReady()) {
                    break;
                }

                await sleep(500);

                console.log(
                    `Waiting... ${i + 1}/20 | closed=${engine.isClosed()} ready=${engine.isReady()}`
                );
            }

            if (!engine.isReady()) {
                console.log('ENGINE NOT READY');
                continue;
            }

            console.log('ENGINE READY');

            const client = new LiteClient({
                engine
            });

            const info = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

            console.log('Masterchain seqno:', info.last.seqno);

            const result = await client.getLibraries([
                libraryHash
            ]);

            console.log('Result count:', result.result.length);

            if (result.result.length === 0) {
                console.log('LIBRARY NOT FOUND');
                continue;
            }

            const lib = result.result[0];

            console.log('LIBRARY FOUND');
            console.log('Hash:', lib.hash.toString('hex'));
            console.log('Data bytes:', lib.data.length);

        } catch (e) {
            console.log('ERROR:');
            console.log(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
        }
    }
}

async function main() {
    const libraryHash = Buffer.from(
        '5A34C333BCDCAC70D41F9AFCA79AA6E782F1C80A5E4B2EF896EC5E20E9182C86',
        'hex'
    );

    const engine = new LiteRoundRobinEngine([
        {
            ip: 822907680,
            port: 27842,
            key: 'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM=',
        },
        {
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            ip: -1468575011,
            port: 51088,
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ]);

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine,
        batchSize: 1,
    });

    console.log('===== ROUTER LIBRARY DIRECT CHECK =====');
    console.log('Library hash:', libraryHash.toString('hex'));
    console.log('');

    const master = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

    console.log('Masterchain seqno:', master.last.seqno);
    console.log('');

    const result = await client.getLibraries([libraryHash]);

    console.log('===== RESULT =====');
    console.log(result);
    console.log('');

    if (result.result.length === 0) {
        console.log('LIBRARY NOT RETURNED BY LITESERVER');
    } else {

    }

FILE: scripts\checkRouterLibraryFromTestnetConfig.ts

import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

function ipToString(ip: number): string {
    const unsigned = ip >>> 0;

    return [
        (unsigned >>> 24) & 255,
        (unsigned >>> 16) & 255,
        (unsigned >>> 8) & 255,
        unsigned & 255,
    ].join('.');
}

export async function run() {
    const libraryHash = Buffer.from(
        '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86',
        'hex'
    );

    const configUrl =
        'https://ton-blockchain.github.io/testnet-global.config.json';

    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER LIBRARY TESTNET CONFIG CHECK');
    console.log('========================================');

    console.log('\nConfig:');
    console.log(configUrl);

    console.log('\nRouter Library ID:');
    console.log(libraryHash.toString('hex'));

    console.log('\nDownloading official Testnet config...');

    const response = await fetch(configUrl);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Config download failed: HTTP ${response.status}`
        );
    }

    const config: any = await response.json();

    if (!Array.isArray(config.liteservers)) {
        throw new Error('No liteservers array found in config.');
    }

    console.log(
        '\nLiteServers in config:',
        config.liteservers.length
    );

    const servers = config.liteservers.slice(0, 8);

    for (let i = 0; i < servers.length; i++) {
        const item = servers[i];

        const host = `tcp://${ipToString(item.ip)}:${item.port}`;
        const key = item.id?.key;

        console.log('\n--------------------------------');
        console.log(`Server ${i + 1}/${servers.length}:`, host);

        if (!key) {
            console.log('Missing public key.');
            continue;
        }

        try {
            const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
                host,
                publicKey: Buffer.from(key, 'base64'),
                reconnectTimeout: 3000,
            });

            console.log('Connecting...');

            for (let j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                if (engine.isReady()) {
                    break;
                }

                await sleep(500);

                console.log(
                    `Waiting... ${j + 1}/20 | closed=${engine.isClosed()} ready=${engine.isReady()}`
                );
            }

            if (!engine.isReady()) {
                console.log('ENGINE NOT READY');
                continue;
            }

            console.log('ENGINE READY');

            const client = new LiteClient({
                engine,
            });

            const info = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

            console.log(
                'Masterchain seqno:',
                info.last.seqno
            );

            const result = await client.getLibraries([
                libraryHash,
            ]);

            console.log(
                'Result count:',
                result.result.length
            );

            if (result.result.length === 0) {
                console.log('LIBRARY NOT FOUND');
                continue;
            }

            const lib = result.result[0];

            console.log('*** LIBRARY FOUND ***');
            console.log(
                'Returned hash:',
                lib.hash.toString('hex')
            );
            console.log(
                'Data bytes:',
                lib.data.length
            );

            console.log(
                '\nLibrary hash matches:',
                lib.hash.equals(libraryHash)
            );

            console.log('\n===== SUCCESS =====');
            console.log(
                'Router Library is available from this Testnet LiteServer.'
            );

            return;
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('ERROR:');
            console.log(
                e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('\n========================================');
    console.log(' FINAL RESULT');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(
        'Router Library was not returned by the tested Testnet LiteServers.'
    );
}

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

const LIBRARY_HASH = Buffer.from(
    '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86',
    'hex'
);

const SERVERS = [
    {
        name: 'Server 1',
        host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
        key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
    },
    {
        name: 'Server 2',
        host: 'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088',
        key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
    },
];

export async function run() {
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER LIBRARY PER-SERVER TEST');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Library ID:');
    console.log(LIBRARY_HASH.toString('hex'));

    for (const server of SERVERS) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log(server.name);
        console.log('Host:', server.host);

        let engine: LiteSingleEngine | undefined;

        try {
            engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
                host: server.host,
                publicKey: Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64'),
                reconnectTimeout: 5000,
            });

            for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                if (engine.isReady()) {
                    break;
                }

                await sleep(500);
            }

            if (!engine.isReady()) {
                console.log('ENGINE NOT READY');
                continue;
            }

            console.log('ENGINE READY');

            const client = new LiteClient({
                engine,
                batchSize: 1,
            });

            const master = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

            console.log(
                'Masterchain seqno:',
                master.last.seqno
            );

            const result = await client.getLibraries([
                LIBRARY_HASH,
            ]);

            console.log(
                'Result count:',
                result.result.length
            );

            if (result.result.length === 0) {
                console.log('LIBRARY NOT RETURNED');
                continue;
            }

            const lib = result.result[0];

            console.log('LIBRARY FOUND');
            console.log(
                'Returned hash:',
                lib.hash.toString('hex')
            );
            console.log(
                'Data bytes:',
                lib.data.length
            );

            console.log(
                'Hash matches:',
                lib.hash.equals(LIBRARY_HASH)
            );

        } catch (error) {
            console.log('ERROR:');
            console.log(
                error instanceof Error
                    ? error.message
                    : String(error)
            );
        } finally {
            if (engine) {
                engine.close();
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' TEST FINISHED');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================');
}

import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run() {
    console.log('===== STON SDK ROUTER INSPECTION =====');

    console.log('\n===== DEX.v2_1.Router =====');
    console.log(Object.keys(DEX.v2_1.Router));

    for (const [name, RouterClass] of Object.entries(DEX.v2_1.Router)) {
        try {
            console.log(`\n--- ${name} ---`);

            const R: any = RouterClass;

            console.log('Static properties:',
                Object.getOwnPropertyNames(R)
            );

            if (typeof R.create === 'function') {
                console.log('create(): available');

                try {
                    const router = R.create();

                    console.log('Created router:');
                    console.log(router);

                    if (router.address) {
                        console.log(
                            'Address:',
                            router.address.toString({
                                urlSafe: true,
                                bounceable: true,
                                testOnly: true,
                            })
                        );
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log(
                        'create() ERROR:',
                        e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
                    );
                }
            } else {
                console.log('create(): NOT available');
            }

        } catch (e) {
            console.log(
                'ERROR:',
                e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
            );
        }
    }
}

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    const roosterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const ptonAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== JETTON WALLET ADDRESS CHECK =====');
    console.log('Router :', routerAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    async function getWalletAddress(
        master: Address,
        owner: Address
    ): Promise<Address> {

        const contract = provider.provider(master);

        const ownerCell = beginCell()
            .storeAddress(owner)
            .endCell();

        const result = await contract.get('get_wallet_address', [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: ownerCell
            }
        ]);

        return result.stack.readAddress();
    }

    console.log('Getting ROOSTER wallet of Router...');

    const roosterWallet = await getWalletAddress(
        roosterAddress,
        routerAddress
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER Router Wallet:',
        roosterWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Getting pTON wallet of Router...');

    const ptonWallet = await getWalletAddress(
        ptonAddress,
        routerAddress
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON Router Wallet:',
        ptonWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== DONE =====');
}

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    const tesReed = Address.parse(
        'kQDLvsZol3juZyOAVG8tWsJntOxeEZWEaWCbbSjYakQpuYN5'
    );

    const testBlue = Address.parse(
        'kQB_TOJSB7q3-Jm1O8s0jKFtqLElZDPjATs5uJGsujcjznq3'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== STON.FI TESTNET REFERENCE PAIR =====');
    console.log('Router:', routerAddress.toString());
    console.log('TesREED:', tesReed.toString());
    console.log('TestBlue:', testBlue.toString());
    console.log('');

    const routerProvider = provider.provider(routerAddress);

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 1. TesREED wallet owned by Router
    // --------------------------------------------------
    console.log('1. Getting TesREED Router wallet...');

    const tesReedResult = await provider.provider(tesReed).get(
        'get_wallet_address',
        [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(routerAddress)
                    .endCell(),
            },
        ]
    );

    const tesReedWallet = tesReedResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log(
        'TesREED Router wallet:',
        tesReedWallet.toString()
    );

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 2. TestBlue wallet owned by Router
    // --------------------------------------------------
    console.log('');
    console.log('2. Getting TestBlue Router wallet...');

    const testBlueResult = await provider.provider(testBlue).get(
        'get_wallet_address',
        [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(routerAddress)
                    .endCell(),
            },
        ]
    );

    const testBlueWallet = testBlueResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log(
        'TestBlue Router wallet:',
        testBlueWallet.toString()
    );

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Ask Router for pool address
    // --------------------------------------------------
    console.log('');
    console.log('3. Calling Router get_pool_address...');

    try {
        const poolResult = await routerProvider.get(
            'get_pool_address',
            [
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: beginCell()
                        .storeAddress(tesReedWallet)
                        .endCell(),
                },
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: beginCell()
                        .storeAddress(testBlueWallet)
                        .endCell(),
                },
            ]
        );

        const poolAddress = poolResult.stack.readAddress();

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== SUCCESS =====');
        console.log('Reference pool:', poolAddress.toString());
        console.log('');
        console.log('Router getter works for the official testnet pair.');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');

    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('===== FAILED =====');
        console.log('Router get_pool_address failed.');
        console.log('');

        if (error instanceof Error) {
            console.log(error.message);
        } else {
            console.log(error);
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
    }
}

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    if (provider.network() !== 'testnet') {
        throw new Error('STOP: This script is only for TON Testnet.');
    }

    const roosterMaster = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const ptonMaster = Address.parse(
        'EQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT1h7'
    );

    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== STON TESTNET JETTON WALLETS =====');
    console.log('Router:', routerAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    const roosterProvider = provider.provider(roosterMaster);
    const ptonProvider = provider.provider(ptonMaster);

    const roosterResult = await roosterProvider.get('get_wallet_address', [
        {
            type: 'slice',
            cell: beginCell()
                .storeAddress(routerAddress)
                .endCell(),
        },
    ]);

    const ptonResult = await ptonProvider.get('get_wallet_address', [
        {
            type: 'slice',
            cell: beginCell()
                .storeAddress(routerAddress)
                .endCell(),
        },
    ]);

    const roosterWallet = roosterResult.stack.readAddress();
    const ptonWallet = ptonResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log('Rooster Wallet:', roosterWallet.toString());
    console.log('pTON Wallet:', ptonWallet.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('=======================================');
}

import { Address, TonClient4, fromNano } from '@ton/ton';

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const RPC_ENDPOINT = 'https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com';

export async function run() {
    console.log('='.repeat(70));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 USER TON BALANCE CHECK');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - RPC ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));

    console.log('\n===== 1. USER =====');
    console.log(USER.toString());

    console.log('\n===== 2. RPC =====');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: RPC_ENDPOINT,
    });

    const last = await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log('RPC: PASS');
    console.log('Masterchain seqno:', last.last.seqno);

    console.log('\n===== 3. ACCOUNT =====');

    const result = await client.getAccount(
        last.last.seqno,
        USER
    );

    const account = result.account;
    const balanceNano = BigInt(account.balance.coins);

    console.log('State:', account.state.type);
    console.log('Balance nanoTON:', balanceNano.toString());
    console.log('Balance TON:', fromNano(balanceNano));

    console.log('\n===== 4. LIQUIDITY MESSAGE VALUES =====');

    const roosterValue = 300_000_000n;
    const ptonValue = 810_000_000n;
    const combined = roosterValue + ptonValue;

    console.log('ROOSTER message:', fromNano(roosterValue), 'TON');
    console.log('pTON message:', fromNano(ptonValue), 'TON');
    console.log('Combined:', fromNano(combined), 'TON');

    console.log('\n===== 5. BALANCE VS MESSAGE VALUE =====');

    if (balanceNano > combined) {
        console.log(
            'PASS | Balance is greater than combined message values'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            'FAIL | Balance is NOT greater than combined message values'
        );
    }

    console.log('\n===== 6. CONSERVATIVE CHECK =====');

    const conservativeTarget = 1_300_000_000n;

    console.log(
        'Conservative target:',
        fromNano(conservativeTarget),
        'TON'
    );

    if (balanceNano >= conservativeTarget) {
        console.log(
            'PASS | Balance >= 1.30 TON conservative target'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            'WARNING | Balance < 1.30 TON conservative target'
        );
    }

    console.log('\n===== FINAL =====');

    console.log('READ ONLY: YES');
    console.log('RPC USED: YES');
    console.log('TRANSACTION SENT: NO');

    console.log('='.repeat(70));
}

FILE: scripts\classify25100C.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGET = 0x25100c;
const hits = [
  0x000112ac,
  0x0001130f,
  0x00038491,
  0x000384d8,
  0x0006f756,
  0x0006f773,
  0x0006f780,
  0x0006f78e,
  0x0006f7cd,
  0x000fdc9b,
  0x0023a03b,
  0x0023a18b,
  0x0023a1a8,
  0x0023a1d7,
  0x0023a201,
];

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function readName(p: number) {
  const r = readULEB(p);
  return { name: "", next: r.next + r.value };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse CODE section and associate body ranges with FUNC indexes
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const s = readULEB(p);
  const size = s.value;
  p = s.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

let q = codeStart;
const count = readULEB(q);
q = count.next;

const bodies: {
  func: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
}[] = [];

const importedCount = 83;

for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
  const sz = readULEB(q);
  q = sz.next;

  const bodyStart = q;
  const bodyEnd = q + sz.value;

  bodies.push({
    func: importedCount + i,
    start: bodyStart,
    end: bodyEnd,
  });

  q = bodyEnd;
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("FUNC 25100C CLASSIFICATION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET : ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log(`HITS   : ${hits.length}`);
console.log("============================================================");

for (const hit of hits) {
  const body = bodies.find(x => hit >= x.start && hit < x.end);

  console.log(`\nHIT ${hex(hit)}`);

  if (!body) {
    console.log("FUNC : NOT FOUND");
    continue;
  }

  console.log(
    `FUNC : ${body.func}`
  );
  console.log(
    `BODY : ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`
  );

  const from = Math.max(body.start, hit - 20);
  const to = Math.min(body.end, hit + 40);

  const bytes = Array.from(b.subarray(from, to))
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");

  console.log(`RAW  : ${bytes}`);

  // Look for store/load following the target constant.
  const rel = hit - body.start;
  const scanEnd = Math.min(body.end, hit + 35);

  let foundStore = false;
  let foundLoad = false;

  for (let x = hit; x < scanEnd; x++) {
    // i32.load
    if (b[x] === 0x28) foundLoad = true;

    // i32.store
    if (b[x] === 0x36) foundStore = true;
  }

  if (foundStore) {
    console.log("CLASS : WRITER-CANDIDATE (i32.store found)");
  } else if (foundLoad) {
    console.log("CLASS : READER-CANDIDATE (i32.load found)");
  } else {
    console.log("CLASS : INDIRECT / NEEDS DECODING");
  }
}

console.log("\n============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

FILE: scripts\classifyDispatchRefs.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = new Set([
  0x195348,
  0x19534c,
  0x195350,
  0x195354,
  0x195358,
  0x195360,
  0x195364,
]);

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sectionBodies() {
  const bodies: { func: number, start: number, end: number }[] = [];

  let p = 8;
  let imported = 0;

  // First get imported function count.
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 2) {
      let q = p;
      const n = uleb(q);
      q = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const ml = uleb(q); q = ml.next + ml.value;
        const nl = uleb(q); q = nl.next + nl.value;
        const kind = wasm[q++];

        if (kind === 0) {
          const x = uleb(q);
          q = x.next;
          imported++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
          q++;
          const x = uleb(q); q = x.next;
          const y = uleb(q); q = y.next;
          if (x.value !== 0x70) {}
        } else if (kind === 2) {
          const flags = uleb(q); q = flags.next;
          const min = uleb(q); q = min.next;
          if (flags.value & 1) {
            const max = uleb(q); q = max.next;
          }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
          q += 2;
        }
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  // Locate code section.
  p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      let q = p;
      const n = uleb(q);
      q = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const bs = uleb(q);
        q = bs.next;

        const bodyStart = q;
        const bodyEnd = q + bs.value;

        bodies.push({
          func: imported + i,
          start: bodyStart,
          end: bodyEnd
        });

        q = bodyEnd;
      }

      break;
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function funcAt(pos: number, bodies: ReturnType<typeof sectionBodies>) {
  return bodies.find(x => pos >= x.start && pos < x.end);
}

const bodies = sectionBodies();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("CLASSIFY DISPATCH TABLE REFERENCES");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`FUNCTION BODIES : ${bodies.length}`);
console.log("");

let hits = 0;

for (const body of bodies) {
  for (let p = body.start; p < body.end - 2; p++) {

    if (wasm[p] !== 0x41) continue;

    const c = uleb(p + 1);

    if (!TARGETS.has(c.value)) continue;

    const next = c.next;
    const op = wasm[next];

    let kind = "UNKNOWN";

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x2b) {
      kind = "LOAD";
    } else if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {
      kind = "STORE";
    } else if (op === 0x6a || op === 0x6b || op === 0x6c) {
      kind = "ADDRESS_ARITHMETIC";
    } else if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      kind = "LOCAL_OPERATION";
    } else if (op === 0x10) {
      kind = "CALL";
    }

    console.log(
      `FUNC ${body.func.toString().padStart(5)} ` +
      `CONST 0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
      `ADDR 0x${c.value.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
      `NEXT=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} ` +
      `${kind}`
    );

    // Short raw context.
    const from = Math.max(body.start, p - 4);
    const to = Math.min(body.end, next + 8);

    let raw = "";
    for (let q = from; q < to; q++) {
      raw += wasm[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0") + " ";
    }

    console.log(`  RAW: ${raw}`);

    hits++;
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TOTAL BODY-AWARE REFERENCES : ${hits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

FILE: scripts\compareDispatchFuncs.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [91, 119, 656];

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSections() {
    let p = 8;
    const sections: {
        id: number;
        start: number;
        end: number;
    }[] = [];

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];
        const s = uleb(p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        sections.push({ id, start, end });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

const sections = readSections();

const funcSec = sections.find(x => x.id === 3);
const codeSec = sections.find(x => x.id === 10);

if (!funcSec || !codeSec) {
    throw new Error("Function/code section not found");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Function section: defined function type indices
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = funcSec.start;
const fc = uleb(p);
p = fc.next;

const definedType: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    definedType.push(x.value);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Code section: function body ranges
// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = codeSec.start;

const cc = uleb(p);
p = cc.next;

const bodies: {
    globalFunc: number;
    ordinal: number;
    bodyStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;
}[] = [];

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < cc.value; ordinal++) {
    const bs = uleb(p);
    p = bs.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + bs.value;

    bodies.push({
        globalFunc: 83 + ordinal,
        ordinal,
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("COMPARE DISPATCH FUNCTIONS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGETS = ${TARGETS.join(", ")}`);
console.log("TARGET ADDRESS = 0x00195354");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (const target of TARGETS) {
    const fn = bodies.find(x => x.globalFunc === target);

    if (!fn) {
        console.log(`FUNC ${target} NOT FOUND`);
        continue;
    }

    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`FUNC ${target}`);
    console.log(`ORDINAL = ${fn.ordinal}`);
    console.log(
        `BODY    = 0x${fn.bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${fn.bodyEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
    );
    console.log(`SIZE    = ${fn.bodyEnd - fn.bodyStart}`);
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    const start = Math.max(codeSec.start, fn.bodyStart);
    const end = Math.min(codeSec.end, fn.bodyEnd);

    for (let off = start; off < end; off += 16) {
        const e = Math.min(off + 16, end);

        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let i = off; i < e; i++) {
            bytes.push(buf[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
        }

        console.log(
            `0x${off.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
        );
    }

    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Find exact 0x195354 constant inside this function
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const pattern = [0x41, 0xd4, 0xa6, 0xe5, 0x00];

    for (let off = start; off <= end - pattern.length; off++) {
        let ok = true;

        for (let j = 0; j < pattern.length; j++) {
            if (buf[off + j] !== pattern[j]) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!ok) continue;

        console.log(
            `DISPATCH LOAD @ 0x${off.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
        );

        const contextStart = Math.max(start, off - 24);
        const contextEnd = Math.min(end, off + 64);

        for (let c = contextStart; c < contextEnd; c += 16) {
            const ce = Math.min(c + 16, contextEnd);

            const bytes: string[] = [];

            for (let i = c; i < ce; i++) {
                bytes.push(buf[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
            }

            console.log(
                `  0x${c.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
            );
        }
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Find direct calls to FUNC 83 and FUNC 91
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    console.log();
    console.log("DIRECT CALL REFERENCES");

    for (let off = start; off < end; off++) {
        if (buf[off] !== 0x10) continue;

        const x = uleb(off + 1);

        if (x.value === 83 || x.value === 91) {
            console.log(
                `  call FUNC ${x.value} @ 0x${off.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
            );
        }
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // call_indirect
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    console.log();
    console.log("CALL_INDIRECT REFERENCES");

    for (let off = start; off < end; off++) {
        if (buf[off] !== 0x11) continue;

        const type = uleb(off + 1);

        console.log(
            `  call_indirect @ 0x${off.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} | type=${type.value}`
        );
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const TARGETS = [2088, 3403];
const IMPORTED = 83;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Sections                                                   */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */

let p = 8;
let functionSection = null;
let codeSection = null;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];

  const z = uleb(p);
  const size = z.value;
  p = z.next;

  if (id === 3)
    functionSection = { start: p, end: p + size };

  if (id === 10)
    codeSection = { start: p, end: p + size };

  p += size;
}

function getBody(target) {

  const ordinal = target - IMPORTED;

  let fp = functionSection.start;
  const fc = uleb(fp);
  fp = fc.next;

  let typeIndex = null;

  for (let i = 0; i <= ordinal; i++) {
    const x = uleb(fp);
    fp = x.next;

    if (i === ordinal)
      typeIndex = x.value;
  }

  let cp = codeSection.start;
  const cc = uleb(cp);
  cp = cc.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {

    const z = uleb(cp);
    const size = z.value;
    cp = z.next;

    const start = cp;
    const end = cp + size;

    if (i === ordinal)
      return { start, end, typeIndex };

    cp = end;
  }

  return null;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Decoder                                                    */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */

function decode(p) {

  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  const result = (next, text) => ({
    next,
    text:
      `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${text}`
  });

  switch (op) {

    case 0x00:
      return result(p, "UNREACHABLE");

    case 0x01:
      return result(p, "NOP");

    case 0x02:
      return result(p + 1, `BLOCK type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x03:
      return result(p + 1, `LOOP type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x04:
      return result(p + 1, `IF type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x05:
      return result(p, "ELSE");

    case 0x0b:
      return result(p, "END");

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return result(x.next, `BR ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return result(x.next, `BR_IF ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x0f:
      return result(p, "RETURN");

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return result(x.next, `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(p);
      p = t.next;

      const tb = uleb(p);
      p = tb.next;

      return result(
        tb.next,
        `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tb.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x1a:
      return result(p, "DROP");

    case 0x1b:
      return result(p, "SELECT");

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return result(x.next, `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return result(x.next, `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return result(x.next, `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return result(x.next, `GLOBAL.GET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return result(x.next, `GLOBAL.SET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      return result(
        p,
        `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x29: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      return result(
        p,
        `I64.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      return result(
        p,
        `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      return result(
        x.next,
        `I32.CONST ${x.value} (0x${(x.value >>> 0).toString(16)})`
      );
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      return result(
        x.next,
        `I64.CONST ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x45:
      return result(p, "I32.EQZ");

    case 0x46:
      return result(p, "I32.EQ");

    case 0x47:
      return result(p, "I32.NE");

    case 0x48:
      return result(p, "I32.LT_S");

    case 0x49:
      return result(p, "I32.LT_U");

    case 0x4a:
      return result(p, "I32.GT_S");

    case 0x4c:
      return result(p, "I32.LE_S");

    case 0x6a:
      return result(p, "I32.ADD");

    case 0x6b:
      return result(p, "I32.SUB");

    case 0x71:
      return result(p, "I32.AND");

    case 0x72:
      return result(p, "I32.OR");

    case 0x73:
      return result(p, "I32.XOR");

    case 0x74:
      return result(p, "I32.SHL");

    case 0x75:
      return result(p, "I32.SHR_S");

    case 0x76:
      return result(p, "I32.SHR_U");

    default:
      return result(
        p,
        `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      );
  }
}

  });

  switch (op) {

    case 0x00: return R(p, "UNREACHABLE");
    case 0x01: return R(p, "NOP");
    case 0x05: return R(p, "ELSE");
    case 0x0b: return R(p, "END");
    case 0x0f: return R(p, "RETURN");
    case 0x1a: return R(p, "DROP");
    case 0x1b: return R(p, "SELECT");

    case 0x02:

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `BR ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `BR_IF ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x10: {

      return R(x.next, `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`);

  }
}

console.log("DONE");
console.log("============================================================");

function decode(name: string, boc: string) {
    const cell = Cell.fromBase64(boc);
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const amount0 = s.loadCoins();
    const amount1 = s.loadCoins();
    const minLpOut = s.loadCoins();

    const fwdAmount = s.loadCoins();
    const bothPositive = s.loadBit();

    const toAddress = s.loadAddress();

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(name);
    console.log('================================================');

    console.log('ROOT BITS:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('ROOT REFS:', cell.refs.length);

    console.log(
        'OPCODE:',
        '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
    );

    console.log(
        'QUERY ID:',
        queryId.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('AMOUNT 0 RAW:', amount0.toString());
    console.log(
        'AMOUNT 0 DISPLAY:',
        Number(amount0) / 1e9,
        'ROOSTER'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('AMOUNT 1 RAW:', amount1.toString());
    console.log(
        'AMOUNT 1 DISPLAY:',
        Number(amount1) / 1e6,
        'pTON'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('MIN LP OUT:', minLpOut.toString());

    console.log(
        'FWD AMOUNT:',
        Number(fwdAmount) / 1e9,
        'TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'BOTH POSITIVE:',
        bothPositive ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    console.log(
        'TO ADDRESS:',
        toAddress?.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('REMAINING BITS:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('REMAINING REFS:', s.remainingRefs);

    return {
        amount0,
        amount1,
        minLpOut,
        bothPositive
    };
}

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import crypto from 'crypto';

const DESTINATION = Address.parse(
    'EQCEwfJtb6ZmPJdNw387eJwed2N51K6dFFbH82jTxe_cf31e'
);

const KNOWN_LP_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCNnXhynq5G7RZ8glhXSNg6eXby1kzqD-p8HNxu6PN5SIgd'
);

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

function sha256Hex(data: Buffer): string {
    return crypto
        .createHash('sha256')
        .update(data)
        .digest('hex');
}

async function inspect(
    client: TonClient,
    address: Address,
    name: string
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(name);
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        `Address: ${address.toString()}`
    );

    const state =
        await client.getContractState(address);

    console.log(
        `state: ${state.state}`
    );

    console.log(
        `balance: ${state.balance}`
    );

    console.log(
        `balance TON: ${(Number(state.balance) / 1e9).toFixed(9)}`
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `code bytes: ${state.code?.length ?? 0}`
    );

    console.log(
        `data bytes: ${state.data?.length ?? 0}`
    );

    if (state.code && state.code.length > 0) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('CODE SHA256:');
        console.log(
            sha256Hex(state.code)
        );

        try {
            const codeCell =
                Cell.fromBoc(state.code)[0];

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `CODE BITS: ${codeCell.bits.length}`
            );

            console.log(
                `CODE REFS: ${codeCell.refs.length}`
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('CODE BOC(base64):');

            console.log(
                codeCell
                    .toBoc()
                    .toString('base64')
            );
        } catch (e) {
            console.log(
                `code Cell decode failed: ${e}`
            );
        }
    }

    if (state.data && state.data.length > 0) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('DATA SHA256:');
        console.log(
            sha256Hex(state.data)
        );

        try {
            const dataCell =
                Cell.fromBoc(state.data)[0];

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `DATA BITS: ${dataCell.bits.length}`
            );

            console.log(
                `DATA REFS: ${dataCell.refs.length}`
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('DATA BOC(base64):');

            console.log(
                dataCell
                    .toBoc()
                    .toString('base64')
            );
        } catch (e) {
            console.log(
                `data Cell decode failed: ${e}`
            );
        }
    }
}

async function main() {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP DESTINATION CODE COMPARATOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('================================================================');

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: TONCENTER,
    });

    await inspect(
        client,
        DESTINATION,
        'POOL OUTGOING DESTINATION'
    );

    await inspect(
        client,
        KNOWN_LP_WALLET,
        'KNOWN LP WALLET'
    );

    const a =
        await client.getContractState(
            DESTINATION
        );

    const b =
        await client.getContractState(
            KNOWN_LP_WALLET
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(' COMPARISON');
    console.log('================================================================');

    if (
        a.code &&
        b.code &&
        a.code.length > 0 &&
        b.code.length > 0
    ) {
        const hashA = sha256Hex(a.code);
        const hashB = sha256Hex(b.code);

        console.log(
            `Destination code hash: ${hashA}`
        );

        console.log(
            `Known LP wallet hash:  ${hashB}`
        );

        console.log('');

        if (hashA === hashB) {
            console.log(
                'RESULT: CODE HASHES MATCH'
            );
        } else {
            console.log(
                'RESULT: CODE HASHES DIFFER'
            );
        }
    } else {
        console.log(
            'Could not compare code hashes.'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(' COMPLETE');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('================================================================');
}

    provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    await main();
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

function integerSqrt(value: bigint): bigint {
    if (value < 0n) {
        throw new Error('Square root of negative number');
    }

    if (value < 2n) {
        return value;
    }

    let x0 = value;
    let x1 = (x0 + 1n) >> 1n;

    while (x1 < x0) {
        x0 = x1;
        x1 = (x0 + value / x0) >> 1n;
    }

    return x0;
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    // =================================================
    // REAL v2.2 POOL
    // =================================================

    const poolAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
    );

    // =================================================
    // CURRENT REAL POOL STATE
    // Obtained previously with get_pool_data
    // =================================================

    const reserveRooster = 600000000000000n;
    const reservePton = 1499448684n;
    const totalLp = 948058954033n;

    // =================================================
    // CURRENT BOC INPUT
    // =================================================

    const ptonAmount = 500000000n; // 0.5 TON

    // For a balanced proportional deposit, calculate
    // the ROOSTER amount corresponding to the pTON input.

    const roosterAmount =
        (ptonAmount * reserveRooster) / reservePton;

    // =================================================
    // METHOD 1
    // PROPORTIONAL LP FROM ROOSTER
    // =================================================

    const lpFromRooster =
        (roosterAmount * totalLp) / reserveRooster;

    // =================================================
    // METHOD 2
    // PROPORTIONAL LP FROM pTON
    // =================================================

    const lpFromPton =
        (ptonAmount * totalLp) / reservePton;

    // =================================================
    // INTEGER RESULT
    // =================================================

    const expectedLp =
        lpFromRooster < lpFromPton
            ? lpFromRooster
            : lpFromPton;

    // =================================================
    // BOC minLpOut
    // =================================================

    const minLpOut = 300329052918n;

    // =================================================
    // EXPECTED 95% MINIMUM
    // =================================================

    const expectedMinLpOut =
        (expectedLp * 95n) / 100n;

    // =================================================
    // DIFFERENCE
    // =================================================

    const minDifference =
        expectedMinLpOut - minLpOut;

    const lpDifference =
        lpFromRooster > lpFromPton
            ? lpFromRooster - lpFromPton
            : lpFromPton - lpFromRooster;

    // =================================================
    // OLD INITIAL-POOL FORMULA
    // Shown only for comparison.
    // NOT used for current pool.
    // =================================================

    const product =
        roosterAmount * ptonAmount;

    const sqrtProduct =
        integerSqrt(product);

    const oldInitialLp =
        sqrtProduct > 1001n
            ? sqrtProduct - 1001n
            : 0n;

    // =================================================
    // OUTPUT
    // =================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('       ROOSTER / pTON V2.2 LP MATH');
    console.log('       REAL POOL / CURRENT BOC INPUT');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log('POOL');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');
    console.log('Pool:');
    console.log(poolAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('CURRENT POOL');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log('ROOSTER reserve:');
    console.log(reserveRooster.toString());
    console.log(
        'ROOSTER:',
        Number(reserveRooster) / 1e9
    );
    console.log('');

    console.log('pTON reserve:');
    console.log(reservePton.toString());
    console.log(
        'pTON:',
        Number(reservePton) / 1e9
    );
    console.log('');

    console.log('Total LP:');
    console.log(totalLp.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('BOC INPUT');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log('pTON amount:');
    console.log(ptonAmount.toString());
    console.log(
        'pTON:',
        Number(ptonAmount) / 1e9
    );
    console.log('');

    console.log('PROPORTIONAL ROOSTER');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log('Calculated ROOSTER amount:');
    console.log(roosterAmount.toString());
    console.log(
        'ROOSTER:',
        Number(roosterAmount) / 1e9
    );
    console.log('');

    console.log('LP CALCULATION');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log('LP from ROOSTER:');
    console.log(lpFromRooster.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('LP from pTON:');
    console.log(lpFromPton.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Difference between sides:');
    console.log(lpDifference.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Expected LP:');
    console.log(expectedLp.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('BOC minLpOut:');
    console.log(minLpOut.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Expected 95% minLpOut:');
    console.log(expectedMinLpOut.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Difference: expected 95% - BOC minLpOut');
    console.log(minDifference.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('OLD INITIAL FORMULA');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log('sqrt(product):');
    console.log(sqrtProduct.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('sqrt(product) - 1001:');
    console.log(oldInitialLp.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('FINAL CHECK');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'Pool address:',
        poolAddress.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected LP:',
        expectedLp.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'BOC minLpOut:',
        minLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected 95%:',
        expectedMinLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log('');

    if (lpDifference === 0n) {
        console.log(
            'OK   ROOSTER/pTON proportional LP values match'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            'INFO LP sides differ by:',
            lpDifference.toString()
        );

    if (minLpOut === expectedMinLpOut) {
        console.log(

        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            'WARNING BOC minLpOut differs from calculated 95%'
        );
    }

    console.log('');

    console.log('');

    console.log('================================================');

    console.log('');

const ROOSTER_ROUTER_WALLET =

const PTON_ROUTER_WALLET =

const KNOWN_POOL =

const CALCULATED_POOL =

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI get_pool_address INPUT COMPARISON');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: ENDPOINT,
    });

    const latest =
        await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log(
        `MASTERCHAIN SEQNO: ${latest.last.seqno}`,
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(`ROUTER: ${ROUTER}`);

    console.log('');
    console.log('KNOWN ACTIVE POOL:');
    console.log(KNOWN_POOL);

    console.log('');
    console.log('PREVIOUS CALCULATED POOL:');
    console.log(CALCULATED_POOL);

    const router = Address.parse(ROUTER);

    const tests = [
        {
            name: '1. ROOSTER Router Wallet -> pTON Router Wallet',
            token0: ROOSTER_ROUTER_WALLET,
            token1: PTON_ROUTER_WALLET,
        },
        {
            name: '2. pTON Router Wallet -> ROOSTER Router Wallet',
            token0: PTON_ROUTER_WALLET,
            token1: ROOSTER_ROUTER_WALLET,
        },
        {
            name: '3. ROOSTER Master -> pTON Master',
            token0: ROOSTER_MASTER,
            token1: PTON_MASTER,
        },
        {
            name: '4. pTON Master -> ROOSTER Master',
            token0: PTON_MASTER,
            token1: ROOSTER_MASTER,
        },
    ];

    for (const test of tests) {
        console.log('');

        console.log(test.name);
