        console.log(`TOKEN1: ${test.token1}`);

        try {
            const token0 = Address.parse(test.token0);
            const token1 = Address.parse(test.token1);

            const result =
                await client.runMethod(
                    latest.last.seqno,
                    router,
                    'get_pool_address',
                    [
                        {
                            type: 'slice',
                            cell: beginCell()
                                .storeAddress(token0)
                                .endCell(),
                        },
                        {
                            type: 'slice',
                            cell: beginCell()
                                .storeAddress(token1)
                                .endCell(),
                        },
                    ],
                );

            console.log('');
            console.log(`EXIT CODE: ${result.exitCode}`);

            if (result.exitCode === 0) {
                try {
                    const pool =
                        result.reader.readAddress();

                    console.log(
                        `POOL: ${pool.toString()}`,
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `RAW : ${pool.toRawString()}`,
                    );

                    console.log('');

                    if (
                        pool.toString() ===
                        KNOWN_POOL
                    ) {
                        console.log(
                            'MATCH: KNOWN ACTIVE POOL',
                        );
                    } else if (
                        pool.toString() ===
                        CALCULATED_POOL
                    ) {
                        console.log(
                            'MATCH: PREVIOUS CALCULATED POOL',
                        );
                    } else {
                        console.log(
                            'MATCH: DIFFERENT ADDRESS',
                        );
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.log('');
                    console.log(
                        'ADDRESS DECODE FAILED:',
                    );

                    console.log(
                        e instanceof Error
                            ? e.message
                            : String(e),
                    );

                    console.log('');
                    console.log(
                        'RESULT RAW:',
                    );

                    console.log(
                        result.resultRaw,
                    );
                }
            } else {
                console.log(
                    'GET_POOL_ADDRESS FAILED',
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('RESULT RAW:');
                console.log(result.resultRaw);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('CALL ERROR:');

            console.log(
                e instanceof Error
                    ? e.message
                    : String(e),
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' FINISHED - READ ONLY');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

import { Address, Cell, beginCell } from "@ton/core";
import { DEX } from "@ston-fi/sdk";
import * as fs from "fs";
import * as crypto from "crypto";

const ROOSTER_MASTER =
  "EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx";

const PTON_MASTER =
  "EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S";

const ROUTER =
  "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3";

const USER =
  "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix";

const EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET =
  "EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh";

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 200073535827652n;
const MIN_LP_OUT = 300329052918n;

const GAS_AMOUNT = 300000000n;
const FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT = 240000000n;

const BOC_FILE =
  "./final_v22_rooster_liquidity.boc";

function sha256(buffer: Buffer): string {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(buffer).digest("hex");
}

export async function run(provider: any) {
  console.log("==============================================");
  console.log(" STON.fi v2.2 SDK BODY EXACT COMPARISON");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT");
  console.log("==============================================");
  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 1. Load prepared BOC
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("===== 1. PREPARED BOC =====");

  if (!fs.existsSync(BOC_FILE)) {
    throw new Error(`BOC file not found: ${BOC_FILE}`);
  }

  const base64 = fs.readFileSync(BOC_FILE, "utf8").trim();

  console.log("File:", BOC_FILE);
  console.log("Base64 chars:", base64.length);

  const preparedBytes = Buffer.from(base64, "base64");

  console.log("BOC bytes:", preparedBytes.length);
  console.log("SHA-256:", sha256(preparedBytes));

  const decoded = Cell.fromBoc(preparedBytes);

  if (decoded.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`Expected exactly 1 root cell, got ${decoded.length}`);
  }

  const preparedBody = decoded[0];

  console.log("Prepared root cell: PASS");
  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 2. Create SDK router
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("===== 2. SDK ROUTER =====");

  const routerAddress = Address.parse(ROUTER);
  const userAddress = Address.parse(USER);
  const roosterMaster = Address.parse(ROOSTER_MASTER);
  const ptonMaster = Address.parse(PTON_MASTER);

  const routerContract =
    DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(routerAddress);

  console.log("Router class: PASS");
  console.log("Router:", routerAddress.toString());
  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 3. Derive user ROOSTER wallet independently
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("===== 3. USER ROOSTER JETTON WALLET =====");

  const roosterWalletResult =
    await provider.provider(roosterMaster).get(
      "get_wallet_address",
      [
        {
          type: "slice",
          cell: beginCell()
  .storeAddress(userAddress)
  .endCell(),
        },
      ],
    );

  const roosterWallet =
    roosterWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

  console.log("Derived:", roosterWallet.toString());
  console.log(
    "Expected:",
    EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET,
  );

  const walletMatch =
    roosterWallet.toString() === EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET;

  console.log(
    "Wallet match:",
    walletMatch ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
  );

  if (!walletMatch) {
    throw new Error("User ROOSTER Jetton Wallet mismatch");
  }

  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 4. Ask the real SDK to build transaction params
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("===== 4. SDK METHOD =====");

  const params =
    await routerContract.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
      provider.provider(routerAddress),
      {
        userWalletAddress: userAddress,
        sendTokenAddress: roosterMaster,
        otherTokenAddress: ptonMaster,
        sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
        minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
        gasAmount: GAS_AMOUNT,
        forwardGasAmount: FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT,
        transferExcessAddress: userAddress,
      },
    );

  console.log("SDK method: PASS");
  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 5. Transaction-level comparison
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("===== 5. SDK TX PARAMETERS =====");

  console.log("SDK to:", params.to.toString());
  console.log("Expected to:", EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET);

  const toMatch =
    params.to.toString() === EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET;

  console.log(
    "TX destination:",
    toMatch ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
  );

  console.log("SDK value:", params.value.toString());
  console.log("Expected value:", GAS_AMOUNT.toString());

  const valueMatch =
    BigInt(params.value) === GAS_AMOUNT;

  console.log(
    "TX gas:",
    valueMatch ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
  );

  if (!toMatch || !valueMatch) {
    throw new Error(
      "SDK transaction parameter mismatch",
    );
  }

  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 6. Extract exact SDK body
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("===== 6. SDK BODY =====");

  const sdkBody = params.body;

if (!sdkBody) {
  throw new Error("SDK returned empty transaction body");
}

const sdkBodyBytes = sdkBody.toBoc({
  idx: false,
});

  const sdkBodyBase64 =
    sdkBodyBytes.toString("base64");

  console.log("SDK body bytes:", sdkBodyBytes.length);
  console.log("SDK body Base64 chars:", sdkBodyBase64.length);
  console.log("SDK body SHA-256:", sha256(sdkBodyBytes));

  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 7. Exact byte comparison
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("===== 7. EXACT BODY COMPARISON =====");

  const preparedBodyBytes =
    preparedBody.toBoc({
      idx: false,
    });

  console.log(
    "Prepared body bytes:",
    preparedBodyBytes.length,
  );

  console.log(
    "Prepared body SHA-256:",
    sha256(preparedBodyBytes),
  );

  const byteExact =
    sdkBodyBytes.equals(preparedBodyBytes);

  console.log(
    "BYTE-EXACT MATCH:",
    byteExact ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
  );

  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 8. Base64 comparison
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("===== 8. BASE64 COMPARISON =====");

  const base64Exact =
    sdkBodyBase64 === base64;

  console.log(
    "BASE64-EXACT MATCH:",
    base64Exact ? "PASS" : "FAIL",
  );

  console.log();

  // --------------------------------------------------
  // 9. Final result
  // --------------------------------------------------

  console.log("==============================================");

  if (byteExact && base64Exact) {
    console.log(" FINAL STATUS: PASS");
    console.log();
    console.log(
      "The prepared BOC body is byte-for-byte identical",
    );
    console.log(
      "to the body generated by the installed",
    );
    console.log(
      "STON.fi v2.2 SDK.",
    );
    console.log();
    console.log(
      "SDK TX destination: USER ROOSTER JETTON WALLET",
    );
    console.log(
      "SDK gas value: 0.3 TON",
    );
    console.log();
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.");
  } else {
    console.log(" FINAL STATUS: FAIL");
    console.log();

    if (!byteExact) {
      console.log(
        "Reason: SDK body and prepared BOC differ.",
      );
    }

    if (!base64Exact) {
      console.log(
        "Reason: Base64 representations differ.",
      );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log(
      "NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.",
    );
  }

  console.log("==============================================");
}

FILE: scripts\compareSelectorFunctions.ts

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGETS = [122, 656, 91, 787];

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function opName(op: number): string {
    switch (op) {
        case 0x10: return "call";
        case 0x11: return "call_indirect";
        case 0x20: return "local.get";
        case 0x21: return "local.set";
        case 0x22: return "local.tee";
        case 0x23: return "global.get";
        case 0x24: return "global.set";
        case 0x28: return "i32.load";
        case 0x29: return "i64.load";
        case 0x36: return "i32.store";
        case 0x37: return "i64.store";
        case 0x3a: return "i32.store8";
        case 0x3b: return "i32.store16";
        case 0x41: return "i32.const";
        case 0x42: return "i64.const";
        case 0x45: return "i32.eqz";
        case 0x46: return "i32.eq";
        case 0x47: return "i32.ne";
        case 0x48: return "i32.lt_s";
        case 0x49: return "i32.lt_u";
        case 0x4a: return "i32.gt_s";
        case 0x4b: return "i32.gt_u";
        case 0x4e: return "i32.ge_s";
        case 0x4f: return "i32.ge_u";
        case 0x6a: return "i32.add";
        case 0x6b: return "i32.sub";
        case 0x71: return "i32.and";
        case 0x72: return "i32.or";
        case 0x73: return "i32.xor";
        case 0x74: return "i32.shl";
        case 0x75: return "i32.shr_s";
        case 0x76: return "i32.shr_u";
        case 0x7c: return "i32.rotl";
        case 0x0b: return "end";
        default: return `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`;
    }
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Locate sections
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const sections: {
    id: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
}[] = [];

let p = 8;

while (p < buf.length) {

    const id = buf[p++];

    const s = readULEB(p);
    const size = s.value;
    p = s.next;

    sections.push({
        id,
        start: p,
        end: p + size
    });

    p += size;
}

function getSection(id: number) {
    return sections.find(x => x.id === id);
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Function section
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const funcSec = getSection(3);

if (!funcSec)
    throw new Error("FUNCTION SECTION NOT FOUND");

let f = funcSec.start;

const fc = readULEB(f);
f = fc.next;

const functionTypes: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {

    const r = readULEB(f);

    functionTypes.push(r.value);

    f = r.next;
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Type section
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const typeSec = getSection(1);

if (!typeSec)
    throw new Error("TYPE SECTION NOT FOUND");

let t = typeSec.start;

const tc = readULEB(t);
t = tc.next;

const types: {
    params: number[];
    results: number[];
}[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < tc.value; i++) {

    const form = buf[t++];

    if (form !== 0x60)
        throw new Error("Unexpected type form");

    const pc = readULEB(t);
    t = pc.next;

    const params: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++)
        params.push(buf[t++]);

    const rc = readULEB(t);
    t = rc.next;

    const results: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++)
        results.push(buf[t++]);

    types.push({
        params,
        results
    });
}

function vt(v: number): string {

    switch (v) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        default: return hex(v);
    }
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const codeSec = getSection(10);

if (!codeSec)
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

let c = codeSec.start;

const cc = readULEB(c);
const codeCount = cc.value;
c = cc.next;

const bodies = new Map<
    number,
    {
        start: number;
        end: number;
        instrStart: number;
    }
>();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < codeCount; ordinal++) {

    const bs = readULEB(c);
    const size = bs.value;
    c = bs.next;

    const start = c;
    const end = c + size;

    let x = start;

    const groups = readULEB(x);
    x = groups.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < groups.value; i++) {
        const n = readULEB(x);
        x = n.next;
        x++;
    }

    bodies.set(ordinal, {
        start,
        end,
        instrStart: x
    });

    c = end;
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Analyze target functions
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SELECTOR FUNCTION COMPARISON");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const globalFunc of TARGETS) {

    //
    // 83 imported functions
    //
    if (globalFunc < 83) {
        console.log(`FUNC ${globalFunc} = IMPORTED`);
        continue;
    }

    const ordinal = globalFunc - 83;

    const body = bodies.get(ordinal);

    if (!body) {
        console.log(`FUNC ${globalFunc} = BODY NOT FOUND`);
        continue;
    }

    const typeIndex = functionTypes[ordinal];
    const ft = types[typeIndex];

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC ${globalFunc}`);
    console.log(`CODE ORDINAL = ${ordinal}`);
    console.log(`TYPE INDEX   = ${typeIndex}`);
    console.log(
        `SIGNATURE    = (${ft.params.map(vt).join(",")}) -> (${ft.results.map(vt).join(",")})`
    );
    console.log(`BODY         = ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`);
    console.log(`INSTRUCTIONS = ${hex(body.instrStart)}`);
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    let x = body.instrStart;

    let instructionCount = 0;
    let callCount = 0;
    let indirectCount = 0;
    let loadCount = 0;
    let storeCount = 0;
    let globalCount = 0;
    let target1953Count = 0;

    const calls: number[] = [];
    const indirectTypes: number[] = [];

    while (x < body.end) {

        const pos = x;
        const op = buf[x++];

        instructionCount++;

        if (op === 0x0b) {
            break;
        }

        if (op === 0x10) {

            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            callCount++;
            calls.push(r.value);

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x11) {

            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            //
            // table index
            //
            const table = readULEB(x);
            x = table.next;

            indirectCount++;
            indirectTypes.push(r.value);

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {

            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {

            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            globalCount++;

            continue;
        }

        if (
            op === 0x28 ||
            op === 0x29
        ) {

            const a = readULEB(x);
            x = a.next;

            const o = readULEB(x);
            x = o.next;

            loadCount++;

            continue;
        }

        if (
            op === 0x36 ||
            op === 0x37 ||
            op === 0x3a ||
            op === 0x3b
        ) {

            const a = readULEB(x);
            x = a.next;

            const o = readULEB(x);
            x = o.next;

            storeCount++;

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x41) {

            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            //
            // Absolute selector block addresses.
            //
            if (
                r.value === 0x195348 ||
                r.value === 0x19534c ||
                r.value === 0x195350 ||
                r.value === 0x195354 ||
                r.value === 0x195358 ||
                r.value === 0x19535c
            ) {
                target1953Count++;

                console.log(
                    `  TARGET ADDRESS @ ${hex(pos)} = ${hex(r.value)}`
                );
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x42) {

            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            continue;
        }

        //
        // Structured control instructions
        //
        if (
            op === 0x02 ||
            op === 0x03 ||
            op === 0x04
        ) {
            x++;
            continue;
        }

        if (
            op === 0x0c ||
            op === 0x0d
        ) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        //
        // Memory.size / grow
        //
        if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
            x++;
            continue;
        }
    }

    console.log(`INSTRUCTION COUNT = ${instructionCount}`);
    console.log(`LOADS             = ${loadCount}`);
    console.log(`STORES            = ${storeCount}`);
    console.log(`DIRECT CALLS      = ${callCount}`);
    console.log(`CALL_INDIRECT     = ${indirectCount}`);
    console.log(`GLOBAL ACCESS     = ${globalCount}`);
    console.log(`TARGET 0x1953xx   = ${target1953Count}`);

    if (calls.length) {
        console.log(
            `CALL TARGETS      = ${calls.join(", ")}`
        );
    }

    if (indirectTypes.length) {
        console.log(
            `INDIRECT TYPES    = ${indirectTypes.join(", ")}`
        );
    }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("END");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("============================================================");

    console.log('Valid TON BOC header detected.');

    console.log('Unexpected BOC header.');

import { Address, toNano } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const owner = provider.sender().address;

    if (!owner) {
        throw new Error('Tonkeeper wallet address not available');
    }

    const pton = DEX.v2_2.pTON.create(
        Address.parse(
            'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
        )
    );

    const destinationWallet = Address.parse(
        'EQCFe1J8epgixmnGvSWBsB6O7gEABl1BiY8NJkL2pjqv1I6S'
    );

    console.log('pTON Master:', pton.address.toString());
    console.log('pTON Wallet:', destinationWallet.toString());
    console.log('Amount:', '0.5 TON');
    console.log('Gas:', '0.01 TON');

    await pton.sendTonTransfer(
        provider.provider(pton.address),
        provider.sender(),
        {
            tonAmount: toNano('0.5'),
            destinationAddress: destinationWallet,
            destinationWalletAddress: destinationWallet,
            refundAddress: owner,
        }
    );

    console.log('0.5 TON -> pTON transaction sent.');
}

import { Cell, Slice, Address } from '@ton/core';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const ROOSTER_BOC_FILE =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\rooster_v22_generated.boc';

const PTON_BOC_FILE =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\pton_v22_generated.boc';

const EXPECTED_ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const EXPECTED_USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const EXPECTED_ROUTER_ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq'
);

const EXPECTED_ROUTER_PTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3'
);

const EXPECTED_USER_ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh'
);

const JETTON_TRANSFER_OPCODE = 0x0f8a7ea5;
const TON_TRANSFER_OPCODE = 0x01f3835d;
const PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE = 0x37c096df;

function loadBocFile(file: string): Cell {
    let data = fs.readFileSync(file);

    if (data.subarray(0, 4).toString('hex') !== 'b5ee9c72') {
        const text = data.toString('utf8').trim();
        data = Buffer.from(text, 'base64');
    }

    if (data.subarray(0, 4).toString('hex') !== 'b5ee9c72') {
        throw new Error(`INVALID BOC: ${file}`);
    }

    const roots = Cell.fromBoc(data);

    if (roots.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(
            `EXPECTED 1 ROOT CELL, GOT ${roots.length}: ${file}`
        );
    }

    return roots[0];
}

function readAddress(slice: Slice): Address {
    const address = slice.loadAddress();

    if (address === null) {
        throw new Error('Expected non-null address');
    }

    return address;
}

function assertEqual(
    name: string,
    actual: string | number | bigint | boolean,
    expected: string | number | bigint | boolean
) {
    if (actual !== expected) {
        throw new Error(
            `FAIL | ${name} | actual=${actual} | expected=${expected}`
        );
    }

    console.log(
        `PASS | ${name} | ${actual}`
    );
}

function assertAddress(
    name: string,
    actual: Address,
    expected: Address
) {
    if (!actual.equals(expected)) {
        throw new Error(
            `FAIL | ${name} | actual=${actual.toString()} | expected=${expected.toString()}`
        );
    }

    console.log(
        `PASS | ${name} | ${actual.toString()}`
    );
}

function decodeRooster(root: Cell) {
    const s = root.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    assertEqual(
        'ROOSTER JETTON_TRANSFER opcode',
        opcode,
        JETTON_TRANSFER_OPCODE
    );

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
    const amount = s.loadCoins();

    const destination = readAddress(s);
    const responseDestination = readAddress(s);

    const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

    if (hasCustomPayload) {
        s.loadRef();
    }

    const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();
    const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

    if (!hasForwardPayload) {
        throw new Error(
            'FAIL | ROOSTER forward payload missing'
        );
    }

    const forwardPayload = s.loadRef();

    const p = forwardPayload.beginParse();

    const provideLpOpcode = p.loadUint(32);

    assertEqual(
        'ROOSTER PROVIDE_LP opcode',
        provideLpOpcode,
        PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE
    );

    const routerPtonWallet =
        readAddress(p);

    const refundAddress =
        readAddress(p);

    const excessesAddress =
        readAddress(p);

    const deadline =
        p.loadUintBig(64);

    const inner =
        p.loadRef();

    const i =
        inner.beginParse();

    const minLpOut =
        i.loadCoins();

    const receiverAddress =
        readAddress(i);

    const bothPositive =
        i.loadBit();

    const customForwardGas =
        i.loadCoins();

    const hasDexCustomPayload =
        i.loadMaybeRef() !== null;

    return {
        queryId,
        amount,
        destination,
        responseDestination,
        hasCustomPayload,
        forwardTonAmount,
        routerPtonWallet,
        refundAddress,
        excessesAddress,
        deadline,
        minLpOut,
        receiverAddress,
        bothPositive,
        customForwardGas,
        hasDexCustomPayload,
    };
}

function decodePton(root: Cell) {
    const s = root.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    assertEqual(
        'pTON TON_TRANSFER opcode',
        opcode,
        TON_TRANSFER_OPCODE
    );

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
    const tonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    const refundAddress =
        readAddress(s);

    const hasForwardPayload =
        s.loadBit();

    if (!hasForwardPayload) {
        throw new Error(
            'FAIL | pTON forward payload missing'
        );
    }

    const forwardPayload =
        s.loadRef();

    const p =
        forwardPayload.beginParse();

    const provideLpOpcode =
        p.loadUint(32);

    assertEqual(
        'pTON PROVIDE_LP opcode',
        provideLpOpcode,
        PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE
    );

    const routerRoosterWallet =
        readAddress(p);

    const lpRefundAddress =
        readAddress(p);

    const excessesAddress =
        readAddress(p);

    const deadline =
        p.loadUintBig(64);

    const inner =
        p.loadRef();

    const i =
        inner.beginParse();

    const minLpOut =
        i.loadCoins();

    const receiverAddress =
        readAddress(i);

    const bothPositive =
        i.loadBit();

    const customForwardGas =
        i.loadCoins();

    const hasDexCustomPayload =
        i.loadMaybeRef() !== null;

    return {
        queryId,
        tonAmount,
        refundAddress,
        routerRoosterWallet,
        lpRefundAddress,
        excessesAddress,
        deadline,
        minLpOut,
        receiverAddress,
        bothPositive,
        customForwardGas,
        hasDexCustomPayload,
    };
}

import { beginCell, contractAddress, toNano } from '@ton/core';
import { compile } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const adminAddress = provider.sender().address;

    if (!adminAddress) {
        throw new Error('Admin address not available');
    }

    const content = beginCell()
    .storeUint(2, 32)
    .endCell();

    const jettonWalletCode = await compile('JettonWallet');
    const minterCode = await compile('RoosterCoin');

    const data = beginCell()
        .storeCoins(0n)
        .storeAddress(adminAddress)
        .storeRef(content)
        .storeRef(jettonWalletCode)
        .storeBit(false)
        .endCell();

    const address = contractAddress(0, {
        code: minterCode,
        data,
    });

    console.log('Admin:', adminAddress.toString());
    console.log('RoosterCoin code hash:', minterCode.hash().toString('hex'));
    console.log('JettonWallet code hash:', jettonWalletCode.hash().toString('hex'));
    console.log('Data hash:', data.hash().toString('hex'));
    console.log('Calculated NEW address:', address.toString());
}

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';

export async function run() {
    const recipient = Address.parse(
        'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
    );

    const queryId = 0n;

    const jettonAmount = 1000000000000000000n;

    const internalTransferMsg = beginCell()
        .storeUint(0x178d4519, 32)
        .storeUint(queryId, 64)
        .storeCoins(jettonAmount)
        .storeBit(false)
        .storeBit(false)
        .storeCoins(0n)
        .endCell();

    const body = beginCell()
        .storeUint(0x00000015, 32)
        .storeUint(queryId, 64)
        .storeAddress(recipient)
        .storeCoins(100000000n)
        .storeRef(internalTransferMsg)
        .endCell();

    console.log('Recipient:');
    console.log(recipient.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Body BOC Base64:');
    console.log(body.toBoc().toString('base64'));

    console.log('');
    console.log('Body BOC Hex:');
    console.log(body.toBoc().toString('hex'));

    console.log('');
    console.log('Body bits:', body.bits.length);
    console.log('Body refs:', body.refs.length);

    console.log('');
    console.log('Internal transfer BOC Base64:');
    console.log(internalTransferMsg.toBoc().toString('base64'));

    console.log('');
    console.log('SUCCESS: Payload created locally.');
}

====================================================================================================
FILE: scripts\debugPushcontOperandV22.ts
====================================================================================================
import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const tactCore: any =
    require('@tact-lang/opcode/node_modules/@ton/core');

const LIBRARY_HASH =
    'C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const TARGET_HASH =
    'DB8B6488B1D9B9051532EE339C86B249DF8F923B6E29975E8E474009157F601A';

const LITESERVER_HOST =
    'tcp://49.12.147.32:27842';

const LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY =
    'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM=';

const PUSHCONT_OFFSET = 120;
const PUSHCONT_PREFIX_BITS = 7;
const R_BITS = 2;
const XX_BITS = 7;

async function getTargetCell(): Promise<any> {
    const {
        LiteClient,
        LiteSingleEngine,
    } = require('ton-lite-client');

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host: LITESERVER_HOST,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(
            LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY,
            'base64'
        ),
    });

    try {
        const started = Date.now();

        while (!engine.isReady()) {
            if (Date.now() - started > 15000) {
                throw new Error(
                    'LiteServer READY timeout'
                );
            }

            await new Promise(resolve =>
                setTimeout(resolve, 250)
            );
        }

        const client = new LiteClient({
            engine,
        });

        const result =
            await client.getLibraries([
                Buffer.from(
                    LIBRARY_HASH,
                    'hex'
                ),
            ]);

        if (!result.result?.length) {
            throw new Error(
                'Library was not returned'
            );
        }

        const root =
            Cell.fromBoc(
                Buffer.from(
                    result.result[0].data
                )
            )[0];

        // Important:
        // Rebuild through the nested @ton/core used
        // by @tact-lang/opcode.
        const rebuilt =
            tactCore.Cell.fromBoc(
                root.toBoc()
            )[0];

        function find(
            cell: any,
            wanted: string
        ): any | null {
            const hash =
                cell.hash()
                    .toString('hex')
                    .toUpperCase();

            if (hash === wanted) {
                return cell;
            }

            for (const ref of cell.refs) {
                const found =
                    find(ref, wanted);

                if (found) {
                    return found;
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        const target =
            find(
                rebuilt,
                TARGET_HASH
            );

        if (!target) {
            throw new Error(
                'Target Cell not found'
            );
        }

        return target;
    } finally {
        engine.close();
    }
}

function loadBitsHex(
    slice: any,
    count: number
): string {
    return slice
        .loadBits(count)
        .toString()
        .replace(/^x\{/, '')
        .replace(/\}$/, '')
        .toUpperCase();
}

export async function run(
    _provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STON.FI v2.2 PUSHCONT OPERAND DEBUGGER'
    );
    console.log(
        ' READ ONLY - EXACT SUBSLICE RECONSTRUCTION'
    );
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log();

    const target =
        await getTargetCell();

    console.log(
        `Target hash: ${target.hash()
            .toString('hex')
            .toUpperCase()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Target bits: ${target.bits.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Target refs: ${target.refs.length}`
    );

    console.log();

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * STEP 1
     * Locate PUSHCONT
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    const slice =
        target.beginParse();

    slice.skip(
        PUSHCONT_OFFSET
    );

    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STEP 1 - PUSHCONT HEADER'
    );
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log();

    console.log(
        `Start offset: ${slice.offsetBits}`
    );

    const prefix =
        loadBitsHex(
            slice,
            PUSHCONT_PREFIX_BITS
        );

    console.log(
        `Prefix (${PUSHCONT_PREFIX_BITS} bits): ${prefix}`
    );

    const r =
        slice.loadUint(R_BITS);

    console.log(
        `r (${R_BITS} bits): ${r}`
    );

    const xx =
        slice.loadUint(XX_BITS);

    console.log(
        `xx (${XX_BITS} bits): ${xx}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Offset after header: ${slice.offsetBits}`
    );

    const bitLength =
        xx * 8;

    const refLength =
        r;

    console.log();
    console.log(
        `bitLength = ${xx} * 8 = ${bitLength}`
    );

    console.log(
        `refLength = ${r}`
    );

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * STEP 2
     * Read the exact continuation bits
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log();
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STEP 2 - LOAD CONTINUATION BITS'
    );
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log();

    const offsetBits =
        slice.offsetBits;

    console.log(
        `Continuation start: ${offsetBits}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Requested bits: ${bitLength}`
    );

    const continuationBits =
        slice.loadBits(
            bitLength
        );

    console.log(
        `Continuation end: ${slice.offsetBits}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Remaining bits in source Cell: ${slice.remainingBits}`
    );

    const continuationHex =
        continuationBits
            .toString()
            .replace(/^x\{/, '')
            .replace(/\}$/, '')
            .toUpperCase();

    console.log();
    console.log(
        `Continuation hex length: ${continuationHex.length} hex chars`
    );

    console.log(
        `Expected hex chars: ${bitLength / 4}`
    );

    console.log();

    console.log(
        'Continuation HEX:'
    );

    console.log(
        continuationHex
    );

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * STEP 3
     * Load the refs
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log();
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STEP 3 - LOAD PUSHCONT REFS'
    );
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log();

    const refs: any[] = [];

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < refLength;
        i++
    ) {
        console.log(
            `Loading ref ${i}...`
        );

        const ref =
            slice.loadRef();

        refs.push(ref);

        console.log(
            `ref[${i}] hash: ${
                ref.hash()
                    .toString('hex')
                    .toUpperCase()
            }`
        );

        console.log(
            `ref[${i}] bits: ${ref.bits.length}`
        );

        console.log(
            `ref[${i}] refs: ${ref.refs.length}`
        );

        console.log();
    }

    console.log(
        `Source slice offset after refs: ${slice.offsetBits}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Source slice remaining refs: ${slice.remainingRefs}`
    );

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * STEP 4
     * Rebuild exactly like operand-loader.js
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log();
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STEP 4 - REBUILD SUBSLICE CELL'
    );
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log();

    console.log(
        'Creating Builder...'
    );

    const builder =
        new tactCore.Builder();

    console.log(
        'Builder created.'
    );

    console.log(
        `Storing ${bitLength} continuation bits...`
    );

    builder.storeBits(
        continuationBits
    );

    console.log(
        'Continuation bits stored.'
    );

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < refs.length;
        i++
    ) {
        console.log(
            `Storing ref ${i}...`
        );

        builder.storeRef(
            refs[i]
        );

        console.log(
            `Ref ${i} stored.`
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log(
        'Calling builder.endCell()...'
    );

    let rebuiltCell: any;

    try {
        rebuiltCell =
            builder.endCell();

        console.log(
            'builder.endCell(): SUCCESS'
        );
    } catch (err: any) {
        console.log(
            'builder.endCell(): FAILED'
        );

        console.log(
            err?.stack ??
            err?.message ??
            String(err)
        );

        throw err;
    }

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * STEP 5
     * Validate reconstructed Cell
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log();
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STEP 5 - RECONSTRUCTED CELL'
    );
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log();

    console.log(
        `Bits: ${rebuiltCell.bits.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Refs: ${rebuiltCell.refs.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Hash: ${
            rebuiltCell.hash()
                .toString('hex')
                .toUpperCase()
        }`
    );

    console.log();

    /*
     * Compare reconstructed refs.
     */

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < rebuiltCell.refs.length;
        i++
    ) {
        console.log(
            `rebuilt ref[${i}] hash: ${
                rebuiltCell.refs[i]
                    .hash()
                    .toString('hex')
                    .toUpperCase()
            }`
        );
    }

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * STEP 6
     * Compare source continuation with reconstructed Cell
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log();
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STEP 6 - VALIDATION'
    );
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log();

    const rebuiltBits =
        rebuiltCell.bits
            .toString()
            .replace(/^x\{/, '')
            .replace(/\}$/, '')
            .toUpperCase();

    const bitsMatch =
        rebuiltBits === continuationHex;

    console.log(
        `Continuation bits match: ${bitsMatch}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Bit count match: ${
            rebuiltCell.bits.length === bitLength
        }`
    );

    console.log(
        `Ref count match: ${
            rebuiltCell.refs.length === refLength
        }`
    );

    console.log();

    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' DEBUG COMPLETE'
    );
    console.log(
        '========================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        'No blockchain transaction was sent.'
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

const start = 0xeec8;
const end   = 0xef43;

function op(p) {
  const x = b[p];

  if (x === 0x20) {
    const [v,q] = u(p+1);
    return [`local.get L${v}`,q];
  }

  if (x === 0x21) {
    const [v,q] = u(p+1);
    return [`local.set L${v}`,q];
  }

  if (x === 0x22) {
    const [v,q] = u(p+1);
    return [`local.tee L${v}`,q];
  }

  if (x === 0x41) {
    const [v,q] = u(p+1);
    return [`i32.const ${v} (0x${v.toString(16)})`,q];
  }

  if (x === 0x28) {
    const [a,q1] = u(p+1);
    const [o,q2] = u(q1);
    return [`i32.load align=${a} offset=${o}`,q2];
  }

  if (x === 0x04) return ["IF",p+1];
  if (x === 0x05) return ["ELSE",p+1];
  if (x === 0x0b) return ["END",p+1];

  if (x === 0x02) return ["BLOCK",p+1];
  if (x === 0x03) return ["LOOP",p+1];

  if (x === 0x0c) {
    const [v,q] = u(p+1);
    return [`BR ${v}`,q];
  }

  if (x === 0x0d) {
    const [v,q] = u(p+1);
    return [`BR_IF ${v}`,q];
  }

  if (x === 0x0f) return ["RETURN",p+1];

  if (x === 0x10) {
    const [v,q] = u(p+1);
    return [`CALL ${v}`,q];
  }

  if (x === 0x11) {
    const [t,q1] = u(p+1);
    const [tab,q2] = u(q1);
    return [`CALL_INDIRECT type=${t} table=${tab}`,q2];
  }

  const cmp = {
    0x45:"i32.eqz",
    0x46:"i32.eq",
    0x47:"i32.ne",
    0x48:"i32.lt_s",
    0x49:"i32.lt_u",
    0x4a:"i32.gt_s",
    0x4b:"i32.gt_u",
    0x4c:"i32.le_s",
    0x4d:"i32.le_u",
    0x4e:"i32.ge_s",
    0x4f:"i32.ge_u"
  };

  if (cmp[x]) return [cmp[x],p+1];

  return [`opcode=0x${x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`,p+1];
}

console.log("FUNC 122 EXACT LOGIC");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let p=start;

while(p<end) {

  const pos=p;

    depth=Math.max(0,depth-1);

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function uleb(buf: Buffer, pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }
        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
}

function hex(buf: Buffer, start: number, end: number): string {
    return Array.from(buf.subarray(start, end))
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

function decodeOps(buf: Buffer, start: number, end: number) {
    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const op = buf[p];

        let name = "";
        let extra = "";

        switch (op) {
            case 0x41: {
                const r = uleb(buf, p + 1);
                name = "i32.const";
                extra = ` ${r.value} (0x${r.value.toString(16)})`;
                p = r.next;
                break;
            }

            case 0x20:
                name = "local.get";
                extra = ` ${buf[p + 1]}`;
                p += 2;
                break;

            case 0x21:
                name = "local.set";
                extra = ` ${buf[p + 1]}`;
                p += 2;
                break;

            case 0x22:
                name = "local.tee";
                extra = ` ${buf[p + 1]}`;
                p += 2;
                break;

            case 0x28: {
                const align = uleb(buf, p + 1);
                const off = uleb(buf, align.next);
                name = "i32.load";
                extra =
                    ` align=${align.value}` +
                    ` offset=${off.value} (0x${off.value.toString(16)})`;
                p = off.next;
                break;
            }

            case 0x36: {
                const align = uleb(buf, p + 1);
                const off = uleb(buf, align.next);
                name = "i32.store";
                extra =
                    ` align=${align.value}` +
                    ` offset=${off.value} (0x${off.value.toString(16)})`;
                p = off.next;
                break;
            }

            case 0x6a:
                name = "i32.add";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x6b:
                name = "i32.sub";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x71:
                name = "i32.and";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x72:
                name = "i32.or";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x73:
                name = "i32.xor";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x74:
                name = "i32.shr_u";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x75:
                name = "i32.shr_s";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x76:
                name = "i32.rotl";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x77:
                name = "i32.rotr";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x45:
                name = "i32.eqz";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x46:
                name = "i32.eq";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x47:
                name = "i32.ne";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x48:
                name = "i32.lt_s";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x49:
                name = "i32.lt_u";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x4a:
                name = "i32.gt_s";
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x4b:
                name = "i32.gt_u";
                p++;
                break;

            default:
                name = `op 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
                p++;
                break;
        }

        console.log(
            `0x${(p - (name === "i32.const" || name.includes("load") || name.includes("store") ? 0 : 1))
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, "0")}  ${name}${extra}`
        );
    }
}

function main() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(WASM)) {
        throw new Error(`WASM not found:\n${WASM}`);
    }

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    const start = 0x14470;
    const end = 0x14530;

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" EXACT WASM WINDOW 0x14470 - 0x14530");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`WASM size : ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`);
    console.log(`START     : 0x${start.toString(16)}`);
    console.log(`END       : 0x${end.toString(16)}`);
    console.log("");

    console.log("RAW BYTES:");
    console.log(hex(buf, start, end));
    console.log("");

    console.log("BYTE OFFSETS:");
    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const e = Math.min(p + 16, end);
        console.log(
            `0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${hex(buf, p, e)}`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("DECODE:");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    decodeOps(buf, start, end);
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

// Known exact locations
const CODE_START = 0x093e1b;
const CODE_END   = 0x093f30;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 2057 DATAFLOW");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`CODE : 0x${CODE_START.toString(16)} .. 0x${CODE_END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos, b = 0;
  while (true) {
    b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << shift);
  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

let p = CODE_START;
let depth = 0;

while (p < CODE_END) {
  const at = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  let text = "";

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00: text = "unreachable"; break;
    case 0x01: text = "nop"; break;

    case 0x02:
      text = "block";
      depth++;
      if (wasm[p] === 0x40) p++;
      else p++;
      break;

    case 0x03:
      text = "loop";
      depth++;
      if (wasm[p] === 0x40) p++;
      else p++;
      break;

    case 0x04:
      text = "if";
      depth++;
      if (wasm[p] === 0x40) p++;
      else p++;
      break;

    case 0x05:
      text = "else";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      text = "end";
      depth--;
      break;

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text = `br ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text = `br_if ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0f: text = "return"; break;
    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text = `call ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(p); p = t.next;
      const tab = uleb(p); p = tab.next;
      text = `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x1a: text = "drop"; break;

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text = `global.get ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text = `global.set ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p); p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p); p = o.next;
      text = `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x29: {
      const a = uleb(p); p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p); p = o.next;

      text = `i32.const ${x.value} (${hex(x.value >>> 0)})`;
      break;

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = new Set([3328, 3331, 3332]);
const IMPORTS = 83;

function u32(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;

function s32(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40)) v -= 2 ** (s + 7);
      return { value: v, next: p };
    }
    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function opcodeName(op: number) {
  switch (op) {
    case 0x20: return "local.get";
    case 0x21: return "local.set";
    case 0x22: return "local.tee";
    case 0x23: return "global.get";
    case 0x24: return "global.set";
    case 0x28: return "i32.load";
    case 0x36: return "i32.store";
    case 0x41: return "i32.const";
    case 0x42: return "i64.const";
    case 0x45: return "i32.eqz";
    case 0x47: return "i32.ne";
    case 0x4b: return "i32.gt_u";
    case 0x6a: return "i32.add";
    case 0x6b: return "i32.sub";
    case 0x71: return "i32.and";
    case 0x72: return "i32.or";
    case 0x74: return "i32.shl";
    case 0x76: return "i32.shr_u";
    case 0x7c: return "i64.shl";
    case 0x7f: return "i64.shr_s";
    case 0x0c: return "br";
    case 0x0d: return "br_if";
    case 0x0e: return "br_table";
    case 0x0f: return "return";
    case 0x10: return "call";
    case 0x1a: return "drop";
    case 0x02: return "block";
    case 0x03: return "loop";
    case 0x04: return "if";
    case 0x05: return "else";
    case 0x0b: return "end";
    default: return `OP_0x${op.toString(16)}`;
  }
}

let found = 0;

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x1242e0;
const END   = 0x124340;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number; bytes: number[] } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    const bytes: number[] = [];

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        bytes.push(b);
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: p, bytes };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too long");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF in ULEB");
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number; bytes: number[] } {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let p = pos;
    const bytes: number[] = [];
    let b = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        bytes.push(b);

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (-1n) << shift;
            }

            return {
                value,
                next: p,
                bytes
            };
        }

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error("SLEB too long");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF in SLEB64");
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8): string {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x124303;
const END = 0x124333;

function readU32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readS32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (-1 << shift);
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function readS64Leb(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[pos++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (-1n) << shift;
    }

    return {
        value,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function hexByte(b: number): string {
    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const START = 0x0022ccb5;
const END   = 0x0022ccdc;

function u32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function i32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      s += 7;
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);
      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }
    s += 7;
  }
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("EXACT PROLOGUE OF FUNC 6618");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let p = START;
const stack = [];

function push(x) {
  stack.push(x);
}

function pop() {
  return stack.length ? stack.pop() : "<?>"; 
}

while (p < END) {

  const off = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  // block
  if (op === 0x02) {
    const type = wasm[p++];
    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} block type=0x${type.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // loop
  if (op === 0x03) {
    const type = wasm[p++];
    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} loop type=0x${type.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // if
  if (op === 0x04) {
    const type = wasm[p++];
    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} if type=0x${type.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // else
  if (op === 0x05) {
    console.log(`${hx(off)} else`);
    continue;
  }

  // end
  if (op === 0x0b) {
    console.log(`${hx(off)} end`);
    continue;
  }

  // br
  if (op === 0x0c) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;
    console.log(`${hx(off)} br ${x.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // br_if
  if (op === 0x0d) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;
    const cond = pop();
    console.log(`${hx(off)} br_if ${x.value} [${cond}]`);
    continue;
  }

  // return
  if (op === 0x0f) {
    console.log(`${hx(off)} return`);
    continue;
  }

  // global.get
  if (op === 0x23) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = `GLOBAL[${x.value}]`;

    push(e);

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} global.get ${x.value} -> ${e}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // global.set
  if (op === 0x24) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = pop();

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} global.set ${x.value} = ${e}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = `local${x.value}`;

    push(e);

    console.log(

    );

    continue;

  // local.set
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = pop();

    console.log(

    push(e);

    console.log(

    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = i32(p);
    p = x.next;

    push(String(x.value));

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} i32.const ${x.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.eqz
  if (op === 0x45) {
    const a = pop();
    const e = `(${a} == 0)`;

    push(e);

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} i32.eqz -> ${e}`

  // i32.sub
  if (op === 0x6b) {

function extractBoc(text: string): string {
    const match = text.match(
        /const\s+BOC\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/
    );

    if (!match) {
        throw new Error(
            'Could not find const BOC in source file'
        );
    }

    return match[1].replace(/\s+/g, '');
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const contractAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQBTl2I95DKuMGD4X91du7820Ll4cVozfKIRna_iJp2fPKO_'
    );

    const contract = provider.provider(contractAddress);

    const result = await contract.get('get_jetton_data', []);

    // get_jetton_data:
    // 1. totalSupply
    // 2. mintable
    // 3. adminAddress
    // 4. content
    // 5. jettonWalletCode

    const totalSupply = result.stack.readNumber();
    const mintable = result.stack.readNumber();

    const adminCell = result.stack.readCell();
    const adminAddress = adminCell.beginParse().loadAddress();

    console.log('Rooster Coin:', contractAddress.toString());
    console.log('Total Supply:', totalSupply);
    console.log('Mintable:', mintable);
    console.log('ADMIN STORED IN CONTRACT:', adminAddress.toString());
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, pos: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
    bytes: string;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    const start = pos;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value,
                next: pos,
                bytes: buf
                    .subarray(start, pos)
                    .toString("hex")
                    .match(/../g)!
                    .join(" "),
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF in ULEB");
}

function opName(op: number): string {
    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x36: "i32.store",

        0x41: "i32.const",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",

        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",

        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",

        0x74: "i32.shr_u",
        0x75: "i32.shr_s",
        0x76: "i32.rotl",
        0x77: "i32.rotr",

        0x02: "block",
        0x03: "loop",
        0x04: "if",
        0x0b: "end",
        0x0c: "br",
        0x0d: "br_if",
    };

    return names[op] ?? `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function decodeWindow(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number,
    title: string
) {
    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(title);
    console.log("============================================================");

    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const at = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        if (op === undefined) break;

        const name = opName(op);
        let detail = "";

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, p);
            detail =
                ` value=${r.value}` +
                ` hex=0x${r.value.toString(16)}` +
                ` bytes=[${r.bytes}]`;
            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
            const local = buf[p++];
            detail = ` local=${local}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x36) {
            const align = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = offset.next;

            detail =
                ` align=${align.value}` +
                ` offset=${offset.value}` +
                ` hex=0x${offset.value.toString(16)}` +
                ` offsetBytes=[${offset.bytes}]`;

            if (offset.value >= 0x240000 && offset.value <= 0x270000) {
                detail +=
                    `  *** STATE REGION ***` +
                    ` relative=0x${(offset.value - 0x255000).toString(16)}`;
            }
        }

        else if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, p);
            detail = ` label=${r.value}`;
            p = r.next;
        }

        console.log(
            `0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ` +
            `${name.padEnd(12)}${detail}`
        );
    }
}

function raw(buf: Buffer, start: number, end: number) {
    console.log("");
    console.log(
        `RAW 0x${start.toString(16)} - 0x${end.toString(16)}`
    );

    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const e = Math.min(p + 16, end);

        const bytes = Array.from(buf.subarray(p, e))
            .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
            .join(" ");

        console.log(
            `0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${bytes}`
        );
    }
}

function main() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(WASM)) {
        throw new Error(`WASM not found:\n${WASM}`);
    }

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`WASM size : ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`);

    const windows = [

const PTON_BOC = './pton_v22_generated.boc';

);

const EXPECTED_ROUTER_ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq'

const EXPECTED_MIN_LP_OUT = 150109265n;

function loadCell(path: string): Cell {
    const data = readFileSync(path);
    return Cell.fromBoc(data)[0];
}

function addressText(address: Address | null): string {
    return address ? address.toString() : 'null';
}

function check(
    name: string,
    actual: string,
    expected: string
) {
    console.log(
        `${name}:`,
        actual === expected ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    if (actual !== expected) {
        console.log('  ACTUAL  :', actual);
        console.log('  EXPECTED:', expected);
    }
}

function checkBigInt(
    name: string,
    actual: bigint,
    expected: bigint
) {
    console.log(
        `${name}:`,
        actual === expected ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    if (actual !== expected) {
        console.log('  ACTUAL  :', actual.toString());
        console.log('  EXPECTED:', expected.toString());
    }
}


/*
 * STON.fi v2.2 PROVIDE_LP payload
 *
 * createProvideLiquidityBody() from @ston-fi/sdk 2.7.0:
 *
 * beginCell()
 *   .storeUint(PROVIDE_LP, 32)
 *   .storeAddress(routerWalletAddress)
 *   .storeAddress(refundAddress)
 *   .storeAddress(excessesAddress ?? refundAddress)
 *   .storeUint(deadline, 64)
 *   .storeRef(
 *      beginCell()
 *        .storeCoins(minLpOut)
 *        .storeAddress(receiverAddress)
 *        .storeUint(bothPositive ? 1 : 0, 1)
 *        .storeCoins(dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount ?? 0)
 *        .storeMaybeRef(dexCustomPayload)
 *        .endCell()
 *   )
 *   .endCell()
 */
function decodeProvideLp(cell: Cell) {

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    const routerWallet = s.loadAddress();

    const refundAddress = s.loadAddress();

    const excessesAddress = s.loadAddress();

    const deadline = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const nested = s.loadRef();

    const n = nested.beginParse();

    const minLpOut = n.loadCoins();

    const receiverAddress = n.loadAddress();

    const bothPositive = n.loadBit();

    const dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount =
        n.loadCoins();

    const hasDexCustomPayload = n.loadBit();

    if (hasDexCustomPayload) {
        n.loadRef();
    }

    return {
        opcode,

        routerWallet,

        refundAddress,

        excessesAddress,

        deadline,

        minLpOut,

        receiverAddress,

        bothPositive,

        dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount,

        hasDexCustomPayload,

        remainingBits: s.remainingBits,

        remainingRefs: s.remainingRefs,

        nestedRemainingBits: n.remainingBits,

        nestedRemainingRefs: n.remainingRefs,
    };
}


/*
 * ROOSTER SIDE
 *
 * Jetton Transfer:
 *
 * opcode
 * queryId
 * amount
 * destination
 * responseDestination
 * customPayload
 * forwardTonAmount
 * forwardPayload
 */
function decodeRooster() {

    const root = loadCell(ROOSTER_BOC);

    const s = root.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const amount = s.loadCoins();

    const destination = s.loadAddress();

    const responseDestination = s.loadAddress();

    const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

    if (hasCustomPayload) {
        s.loadRef();
    }

    const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

    let provide = null;

    if (hasForwardPayload) {

        const forwardPayload = s.loadRef();

        provide = decodeProvideLp(
            forwardPayload
        );
    }

    return {
        rootBits: root.bits.length,

        rootRefs: root.refs.length,

        opcode,

        queryId,

        amount,

        destination,

        responseDestination,

        hasCustomPayload,

        forwardTonAmount,

        hasForwardPayload,

        remainingBits: s.remainingBits,

        remainingRefs: s.remainingRefs,

        provide,
    };
}


/*
 * pTON v2.1 SIDE
 *
 * TON_TRANSFER:
 *
 * opcode
 * queryId
 * tonAmount
 * refundAddress
 * forwardPayload
 */
function decodePton() {

    const root = loadCell(PTON_BOC);

    const s = root.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const tonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    const refundAddress = s.loadAddress();

    const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

    let provide = null;

    if (hasForwardPayload) {

        const forwardPayload = s.loadRef();

        provide = decodeProvideLp(
            forwardPayload
        );
    }

    return {
        rootBits: root.bits.length,

        rootRefs: root.refs.length,

        opcode,

        queryId,

        tonAmount,

        refundAddress,

        hasForwardPayload,

        remainingBits: s.remainingBits,

        remainingRefs: s.remainingRefs,

        provide,
    };
}

function printBody(
    title: string,
    body: unknown
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(title);
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    if (!body) {
        console.log('Body: NONE');
        return;
    }

    console.log(
        'Body type:',
        body.constructor?.name ?? typeof body
    );

    try {
        const cell = body as Cell;

        console.log(
            'Cell hash:',
            cell.hash().toString('hex')
        );

        console.log(
            'Cell BOC hex length:',
            cell.toBoc().toString('hex').length
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('BOC hex:');
        console.log(
            cell.toBoc().toString('hex')
        );

    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'Body could not be decoded as Cell.'
        );

        console.log(
            String(error)
        );
    }
}

export async function run(
    provider: NetworkProvider
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('      STON.fi V2.2 LIQUIDITY BODY CHECK');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const target = 0x00317503;

const b = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) throw new Error("ULEB too long");
  }

  return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DECODE CALL @ 0x00317503");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`BYTE @ target = 0x${b[target].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`);

if (b[target] !== 0x10) {
  console.log("ERROR: target byte is not CALL opcode 0x10");
  process.exit(1);
}

const r = readULEB(target + 1);

console.log(`CALL ULEB VALUE = ${r.value}`);
console.log(`CALL TARGET FUNC = ${r.value}`);
console.log(`NEXT BYTE       = 0x${b[r.next].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`);

console.log("");
console.log("RAW CONTEXT");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let p = target - 12; p <= target + 12; p++) {
  console.log(
    `0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${b[p].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
  );
}

    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x258525;
const END   = 0x258620;

function readULEB(pos: { value: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos.value++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}
