import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteRoundRobinEngine,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

import { BitReader } from '@ton/core';

async function main() {
    const servers = [
        {
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            ip: -1468575011,
            port: 51088,
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    const engines: LiteSingleEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {
        engines.push(
            new LiteSingleEngine({
                host: `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`,
                publicKey: Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64'),
                reconnectTimeout: 3000,
            })
        );
    }

    const engine = new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines);

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine,
        batchSize: 1,
    });

    try {
        console.log('===== DECODE CONFIG 43 =====');

        const master = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log('Seqno:', master.last.seqno);

        const result = await client.getConfig(master.last);

        const config43 = result.config.get(43);

        if (!config43) {
            console.log('Config 43 NOT FOUND');
            return;
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('Bits:', config43.bits.length);
        console.log('Refs:', config43.refs.length);
        console.log('Type:', config43.type);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Bits:');
        console.log(config43.bits.toString());

       const reader = new BitReader(config43.bits);

console.log('');
console.log('===== RAW UINT32 FIELDS =====');

let index = 0;

while (reader.remaining >= 32) {
    const value = reader.loadUint(32);

    console.log(
        `UINT32[${index}]:`,
        value.toString()
    );

    index++;
}

console.log('');
console.log('Remaining bits:', reader.remaining);

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== DONE =====');

    } finally {
        for (const e of engines) {
            e.close();
        }
    }
}

function intToIP(int: number) {
    const part1 = int & 255;
    const part2 = (int >> 8) & 255;
    const part3 = (int >> 16) & 255;
    const part4 = (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

main().catch((error) => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('===== ERROR =====');
    console.error(error);
    process.exit(1);
});

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000009n;

function readUint(slice: any, bits: number, name: string) {
    try {
        const value = slice.loadUintBig(bits);
        console.log(`${name}: ${value.toString()}`);
        return value;
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(`${name}: <FAILED>`);
        console.log(`  ${String(e)}`);
        return null;
    }
}

function readAddress(slice: any, name: string) {
    try {
        const address = slice.loadAddress();
        console.log(`${name}: ${address?.toString() ?? 'null'}`);
        return address;
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(`${name}: <FAILED>`);
        console.log(`  ${String(e)}`);
        return null;
    }
}

function dumpBits(cell: any, label: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`===== ${label} RAW CELL =====`);
    console.log(`bits: ${cell.bits.length}`);
    console.log(`refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);

    try {
        console.log(
            cell.toBoc().toString('base64')
        );
    } catch {
        console.log('<BOC ERROR>');
    }
}

function decodeProvideLp(body: any) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================');
    console.log('DECODE stonfi_provide_lp_v2');
    console.log('==============================================');

    dumpBits(body, 'INPUT');

    const s = body.beginParse();

    readUint(s, 32, 'opcode');
    readUint(s, 64, 'query_id');

    console.log('');
    console.log('--- candidate fields ---');

    readUint(s, 128, 'field_1_uint128');
    readUint(s, 128, 'field_2_uint128');

    readAddress(s, 'field_address_1');

    readUint(s, 64, 'field_uint64_1');
    readUint(s, 128, 'field_uint128_3');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Remaining bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Remaining refs:', s.remainingRefs);
}

function decodeAddLiquidity(body: any) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================');
    console.log('DECODE stonfi_add_liquidity_v2');
    console.log('==============================================');

    dumpBits(body, 'OUTPUT');

    const s = body.beginParse();

    readUint(s, 32, 'opcode');
    readUint(s, 64, 'query_id');

    console.log('');
    console.log('--- candidate amount fields ---');

    const amount0 = readUint(s, 128, 'amount0_candidate');
    const amount1 = readUint(s, 128, 'amount1_candidate');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Remaining bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Remaining refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================');
    console.log('INTERPRETATION');
    console.log('==============================================');

    if (amount0 !== null) {
        console.log(
            `amount0 raw: ${amount0.toString()}`
        );
    }

    if (amount1 !== null) {
        console.log(
            `amount1 raw: ${amount1.toString()}`
        );
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' CURRENT POOL AMOUNT DECODER v2.2');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL:');
    console.log(POOL.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET LT:');
    console.log(TARGET_LT.toString());

    const client = provider.api() as TonClient;

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(
        POOL,
        {
            limit: 20,
        }
    );

    const tx = txs.find(
        (t) => t.lt === TARGET_LT
    );

    if (!tx) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('TARGET TRANSACTION NOT FOUND');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('TARGET FOUND');
    console.log('================================================');

    console.log(`LT:   ${tx.lt.toString()}`);
    console.log(
        `HASH: ${tx.hash().toString('base64')}`
    );

    if (tx.now) {
        console.log(
            `TIME: ${new Date(tx.now * 1000).toISOString()}`
        );
    }

    if (!tx.inMessage) {
        console.log('No input message.');
        return;
    }

    const inBody = tx.inMessage.body;

    decodeProvideLp(inBody);

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('OUTPUT MESSAGE');
    console.log('================================================');

    for (let i = 0; i < tx.outMessagesCount; i++) {
        const msg = tx.outMessages.get(i);

        if (!msg) continue;

        const opBody = msg.body;

        let op = 'NONE';

        try {
            if (opBody.bits.length >= 32) {
                const p = opBody.beginParse();
                op =
                    '0x' +
                    p.loadUint(32)
                        .toString(16)
                        .padStart(8, '0');
            }
        } catch {}

        console.log('');
        console.log(`OUTPUT #${i + 1}`);
        console.log(`OPCODE: ${op}`);

        if (op === '0x50c6a654') {
            decodeAddLiquidity(opBody);
        } else {
            dumpBits(opBody, `OUTPUT #${i + 1}`);
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' READ ONLY CHECK COMPLETE');
    console.log(' Transaction submission: NONE');
    console.log('================================================');
}

import { Address, Cell, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const TARGET_POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000009n;

const OP_PROVIDE_LP = 0x37c096df;
const OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY = 0x50c6a654;
const OP_JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER = 0x178d4519;
const OP_CALLBACK_ADD_LIQUIDITY = 0x06ecd527;

function cellInfo(cell: Cell): string {
    return `${cell.bits.length} bits / ${cell.refs.length} refs`;
}

function opcodeHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';
    return '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function getOpcode(cell: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function formatInteger(value: bigint): string {
    return value.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
}

function formatRooster(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    if (fraction.length === 0) {
        return whole.toLocaleString();
    }

    return `${whole.toLocaleString()}.${fraction}`;
}

function formatTon(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    if (fraction.length === 0) {
        return whole.toLocaleString();
    }

    return `${whole.toLocaleString()}.${fraction}`;
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

            console.log('');

            console.log('');

        const body = inMessage.body;

        console.log('');
        console.log('INPUT BODY:');
        console.log(cellInfo(body));

        console.log('');
        console.log('INPUT BODY BOC:');
        console.log(
            body.toBoc().toString('base64')
        );

        const opcode = getOpcode(body);

        console.log('');
        console.log('INPUT OPCODE:');
        console.log(opcodeHex(opcode));

        if (opcode === OP_PROVIDE_LP) {
            console.log('IDENTIFICATION: STON.fi PROVIDE_LP');
        } else if (opcode === OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
            console.log('IDENTIFICATION: STON.fi ADD_LIQUIDITY');
        } else if (opcode === OP_CALLBACK_ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
            console.log('IDENTIFICATION: STON.fi CALLBACK ADD_LIQUIDITY');
        } else {
            console.log('IDENTIFICATION: OTHER / UNKNOWN');
        }

        /*
         * Raw structural inspection of provide_lp.
         *
         * We intentionally do NOT assume the complete layout here.
         * The BOC is printed so that the exact v2.2 structure can be
         * decoded from the real transaction.
         */
        if (opcode === OP_PROVIDE_LP) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('============================================================');
            console.log(' PROVIDE_LP STRUCTURE');
            console.log('============================================================');

            try {
                const s = body.beginParse();

                s.loadUint(32);

                console.log('');
                console.log('REMAINING BITS AFTER OPCODE:');
                console.log(s.remainingBits);

                console.log('');
                console.log('REMAINING REFS AFTER OPCODE:');
                console.log(s.remainingRefs);

                if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
                    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

                    console.log('');
                    console.log('QUERY ID:');
                    console.log(queryId.toString());
                }

                console.log('');
                console.log('REMAINING BITS AFTER QUERY ID:');
                console.log(s.remainingBits);

                console.log('');
                console.log('REMAINING REFS:');
                console.log(s.remainingRefs);

            } catch (error) {
                console.log('');

        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log(' OUTGOING MESSAGES');
        console.log('============================================================');

        let outIndex = 0;

        for (const outMessage of tx.outMessages.values()) {
            console.log('');
            console.log(`---------------- OUT #${outIndex} ----------------`);

            console.log('');
            console.log('MESSAGE TYPE:');
            console.log(outMessage.info.type);

            if (outMessage.info.type === 'internal') {
                console.log('');
                console.log('SOURCE:');
                console.log(outMessage.info.src.toString());

                console.log('');
                console.log('DESTINATION:');
                console.log(outMessage.info.dest.toString());

                console.log('');
                console.log('VALUE:');
                console.log(
                    `${outMessage.info.value.coins.toString()} nanoTON`
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('VALUE TON:');
                console.log(
                    formatTon(outMessage.info.value.coins)
                );
            }

            const outBody = outMessage.body;

            console.log('');
            console.log('BODY:');
            console.log(cellInfo(outBody));

            console.log('');
            console.log('BODY BOC:');
            console.log(
                outBody.toBoc().toString('base64')
            );

            const outOpcode = getOpcode(outBody);

            console.log('');
            console.log('OPCODE:');
            console.log(opcodeHex(outOpcode));

            if (outOpcode === OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
                console.log(
                    'IDENTIFICATION: STON.fi ADD_LIQUIDITY'
                );
            } else if (
                outOpcode === OP_JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'IDENTIFICATION: JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER'
                );
            } else if (
                outOpcode === OP_CALLBACK_ADD_LIQUIDITY
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'IDENTIFICATION: STON.fi CALLBACK ADD_LIQUIDITY'
                );
            } else if (outOpcode === OP_PROVIDE_LP) {
                console.log(
                    'IDENTIFICATION: STON.fi PROVIDE_LP'
                );
            } else {
                console.log(
                    'IDENTIFICATION: OTHER / UNKNOWN'
                );
            }

            /*
             * Decode jetton_internal_transfer amount.
             */
            if (outOpcode === OP_JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER) {
                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    'JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER INSPECTION'
                );

                try {
                    const s = outBody.beginParse();

                    s.loadUint(32);

                    if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {

                        console.log('');
                        console.log('QUERY ID:');
                        console.log(queryId.toString());

                        console.log(
                            formatRooster(amount)
                        );
                    }

                    console.log('');
                    console.log('REMAINING BITS:');
                    console.log(s.remainingBits);

                    console.log('');
                    console.log('REMAINING REFS:');
                    console.log(s.remainingRefs);

                } catch (error) {
                    console.log('');
                    console.log(
                        'JETTON TRANSFER DECODER WARNING:'

                    console.log(String(error));
                }
            }

            /*
             * Decode add_liquidity structure only as far as safely

             * from the real BOC in the next step if required.
             */
            if (outOpcode === OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    'ADD_LIQUIDITY STRUCTURE INSPECTION'

                try {
                    const s = outBody.beginParse();

                    s.loadUint(32);

                    console.log('');

                        console.log('');

                } catch (error) {

import { Cell, Slice } from '@ton/core';
import * as fs from 'fs';

const EXPECTED_PTON_OPCODE = 0x01F3835D;
const EXPECTED_PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE = 0x37C096DF;

const EXPECTED_ROUTER_WALLET =
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq';

const EXPECTED_USER =
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix';

function readAddress(slice: Slice): string {
    const address = slice.loadAddress();
    return address ? address.toString() : 'null';
}

function ok(label: string) {
    console.log(`OK   ${label}`);
}

function warn(label: string) {
    console.log(`WARN ${label}`);
}

export async function run() {
    const boc = fs
        .readFileSync('current_pton_liquidity.boc', 'utf8')
        .trim();

    const root = Cell.fromBase64(boc);

    const rootSlice = root.beginParse();

    const rootOpcode = rootSlice.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = rootSlice.loadUintBig(64);
    const tonAmount = rootSlice.loadCoins();

    const rootRefund = readAddress(rootSlice);
    const hasForwardPayload = rootSlice.loadBit();

    const forwardCell = rootSlice.loadRef();
    const forwardSlice = forwardCell.beginParse();

    const provideLpOpcode = forwardSlice.loadUint(32);

    const routerWallet = readAddress(forwardSlice);
    const refundAddress = readAddress(forwardSlice);
    const excessesAddress = readAddress(forwardSlice);

    const deadline = forwardSlice.loadUintBig(64);

    const paramsCell = forwardSlice.loadRef();
    const paramsSlice = paramsCell.beginParse();

    const minLpOut = paramsSlice.loadCoins();
    const receiverAddress = readAddress(paramsSlice);
    const bothPositive = paramsSlice.loadBit();
    const customGas = paramsSlice.loadCoins();
    const hasCustomPayload = paramsSlice.loadBit();

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' PTON LIQUIDITY FINAL BOC CHECK');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== OPCODES =====');

    console.log(
        `pTON opcode:    0x${rootOpcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`
    );

    if (rootOpcode === EXPECTED_PTON_OPCODE) {
        ok('pTON TON_TRANSFER opcode');
    } else {
        warn('pTON TON_TRANSFER opcode mismatch');
    }

    console.log(
        `PROVIDE_LP:     0x${provideLpOpcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`
    );

    if (provideLpOpcode === EXPECTED_PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE) {

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 8952;
const TARGET_POS  = 2052;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DECODE ELEMENT SEGMENT AROUND 2052");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log("TARGET FUNC:", TARGET_FUNC);
console.log("TARGET POS :", TARGET_POS);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readU32LE(pos) {
    return (
        buf[pos] |
        (buf[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (buf[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (buf[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large at 0x" + pos.toString(16));
        }
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        next: p
    };
}

function readName(pos) {
    const r = readULEB(pos);
    const end = r.next + r.value;

    return {
        value: buf.subarray(r.next, end).toString("utf8"),
        next: end
    };
}

function sectionName(id) {
    const names = {
        1: "TYPE",
        2: "IMPORT",
        3: "FUNCTION",
        4: "TABLE",
        5: "MEMORY",
        6: "GLOBAL",
        7: "EXPORT",
        8: "START",
        9: "ELEMENT",
        10: "CODE",
        11: "DATA"
    };

    return names[id] || "UNKNOWN";
}

let p = 8;
let elementSection = null;

while (p < buf.length) {
    const sectionStart = p;

    const id = buf[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + size;

    console.log(
        `SECTION ${id} ${sectionName(id)} START 0x${sectionStart.toString(16)} SIZE ${size}`
    );

    if (id === 9) {
        elementSection = {
            sectionStart,
            payloadStart,
            payloadEnd,
            size
        };
        break;
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
}

if (!elementSection) {
    throw new Error("ELEMENT SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

console.log("");
console.log(">>> ELEMENT SECTION FOUND");
console.log(
    "PAYLOAD : 0x" +
    elementSection.payloadStart.toString(16) +
    " .. 0x" +
    elementSection.payloadEnd.toString(16)
);

let q = elementSection.payloadStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(q);
const segmentCount = countInfo.value;
q = countInfo.next;

console.log("ELEMENT COUNT :", segmentCount);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount; seg++) {

    const segStart = q;

    console.log("");
    console.log("ELEMENT SEGMENT", seg);
    console.log("START :", "0x" + segStart.toString(16));

    const flagInfo = readULEB(q);
    const flags = flagInfo.value;
    q = flagInfo.next;

    console.log("FLAGS :", flags, "0x" + flags.toString(16));

    let tableIndex = 0;
    let elemKind = null;
    let offsetExpr = null;

    /*
     * MVP / active element segment:
     *
     * flags 0:
     *   offset expr
     *   elemkind 0x00
     *   vec(funcidx)
     *
     * flags 1:
     *   elemkind
     *   vec(funcidx)
     *
     * flags 2:
     *   tableidx
     *   offset expr
     *   elemkind
     *   vec(funcidx)
     */

    if (flags === 0) {

        console.log("MODE  : active");
        console.log("TABLE : 0");

        const opcode = buf[q++];

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
            console.log(
                "OFFSET EXPR FIRST OPCODE : 0x" +
                opcode.toString(16)
            );
        }

        let offsetValue = null;

        if (opcode === 0x41) {
            const oi = readULEB(q);
            offsetValue = oi.value;
            q = oi.next;

            const endOpcode = buf[q++];

            offsetExpr = {
                opcode,
                value: offsetValue,
                endOpcode
            };
        } else {
            throw new Error(
                "Unexpected offset expression opcode at 0x" +
                (q - 1).toString(16)
            );
        }

        console.log(
            "OFFSET VALUE :",
            offsetExpr.value
        );

        console.log(
            "OFFSET END   : 0x" +
            offsetExpr.endOpcode.toString(16)
        );

    } else if (flags === 1) {

        console.log("MODE  : passive");

        elemKind = buf[q++];

        console.log(
            "ELEM KIND : 0x" +
            elemKind.toString(16)
        );

    } else if (flags === 2) {

        console.log("MODE  : active + explicit table");

        const ti = readULEB(q);
        tableIndex = ti.value;
        q = ti.next;

        console.log("TABLE INDEX :", tableIndex);

        const opcode = buf[q++];

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
            throw new Error(
                "Unexpected offset opcode 0x" +
                opcode.toString(16)
            );
        }

        const oi = readULEB(q);
        q = oi.next;

        const endOpcode = buf[q++];

        offsetExpr = {
            value: oi.value,
            endOpcode
        };

        console.log("OFFSET VALUE :", offsetExpr.value);

        elemKind = buf[q++];

        console.log(
            "ELEM KIND : 0x" +
            elemKind.toString(16)
        );

    } else {
        console.log(
            "UNHANDLED FLAGS:",
            flags,
            "0x" + flags.toString(16)
        );

        break;
    }

    const vecInfo = readULEB(q);
    const funcCount = vecInfo.value;
    q = vecInfo.next;

    console.log("FUNCTION COUNT :", funcCount);
    console.log(
        "FUNCTION VECTOR START : 0x" +
        q.toString(16)
    );

    const interestingStart = Math.max(0, TARGET_POS - 8);
    const interestingEnd = Math.min(
        funcCount - 1,
        TARGET_POS + 8
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log(
        "VECTOR ENTRIES AROUND POSITION " + TARGET_POS
    );
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    let targetFound = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < funcCount; i++) {

        const fi = readULEB(q);
        const funcIdx = fi.value;
        q = fi.next;

        if (i >= interestingStart && i <= interestingEnd) {

            const tableIndexActual =
                (offsetExpr ? offsetExpr.value : 0) + i;

            console.log(
                String(i).padStart(6),
                "TABLE[" +
                String(tableIndexActual).padStart(5) +
                "]",
                "FUNC",
                String(funcIdx).padStart(5),
                "OFFSET",
                "0x" + (fi.next - 1).toString(16)
            );
        }

        if (i === TARGET_POS) {

            targetFound = true;

            console.log("");
            console.log(">>> TARGET VECTOR POSITION HIT");
            console.log("VECTOR POSITION :", i);

            console.log(
                "CALCULATED TABLE INDEX :",
                (offsetExpr ? offsetExpr.value : 0) + i
            );

            console.log("FUNCTION INDEX :", funcIdx);

            if (funcIdx === TARGET_FUNC) {
                console.log("STATUS : *** EXACT MATCH ***");
            } else {
                console.log(
                    "STATUS : MISMATCH - expected",
                    TARGET_FUNC,
                    "got",
                    funcIdx
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("SEGMENT END : 0x" + q.toString(16));

    if (!targetFound) {
        console.log(
            "TARGET POSITION",
            TARGET_POS,
            "IS OUTSIDE VECTOR"
        );
    }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL VERIFICATION");

FILE: scripts\decodeElement5079V44.ts

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGET = 5079;

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { v, p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

let p = 8;

let elementStart = -1;
let elementEnd = -1;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];

  const z = uleb(p);
  p = z.p;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + z.v;

  if (id === 9) {
    elementStart = start;
    elementEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (elementStart < 0)
  throw new Error("Element section not found");

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("ELEMENT SEGMENT DECODER FOR FUNCTION 5079 v44");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`Element section : ${hex(elementStart)} .. ${hex(elementEnd)}`);
console.log(`Target function : ${TARGET}`);
console.log("");

let q = elementStart;

const segmentCount = uleb(q);
q = segmentCount.p;

console.log(`Element segments : ${segmentCount.v}`);
console.log("");

let found = 0;

for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount.v; seg++) {

  const segStart = q;

  const flagsR = uleb(q);
  const flags = flagsR.v;
  q = flagsR.p;

  console.log(`SEGMENT #${seg}`);
  console.log(`  start : ${hex(segStart)}`);
  console.log(`  flags : ${flags}`);

  /*
     Handle common active function-table forms.

     flags 0:
       offset expr + vec(funcidx)

     flags 2:
       table index + offset expr + vec(funcidx)

     Other forms are reported but not decoded as function-index vectors.
  */

  if (flags === 0 || flags === 2) {

    if (flags === 2) {
      const tableR = uleb(q);
      q = tableR.p;
      console.log(`  table : ${tableR.v}`);
    }

    // offset expression
    const opcode = b[q++];

    console.log(
      `  offset expr opcode : ${hex(opcode)}`
    );

    // i32.const
    if (opcode === 0x41) {
      const off = uleb(q);
      q = off.p;
      console.log(`  offset : ${off.v}`);
    } else {
      console.log("  offset : non-i32.const expression");
    }

    // end
    if (b[q] === 0x0b)
      q++;

    const nR = uleb(q);
    const n = nR.v;
    q = nR.p;

    console.log(`  function count : ${n}`);

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

      const pos = q;

      const fR = uleb(q);
      const f = fR.v;
      q = fR.p;

      if (f === TARGET) {

        found++;

        console.log("");
        console.log("  >>> TARGET FOUND <<<");
        console.log(`  function index : ${f}`);
        console.log(`  element index  : ${i}`);
        console.log(`  byte offset    : ${hex(pos)}`);
        console.log(`  segment        : ${seg}`);
        console.log(
          `  table slot     : ${i}`
        );
        console.log("");
      }
    }

  } else {

    console.log(
      "  unsupported element encoding; skipping segment payload"
    );

    /*
       For unsupported encodings we cannot safely advance without
       implementing that exact encoding, so stop rather than guess.
    */

    break;
  }

  console.log("");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TOTAL TARGET OCCURRENCES : ${found}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("END V44");
console.log("============================================================");

const fs = require("fs");

console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log("TARGET    :", TARGET);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte;

    while (true) {
        byte = buf[pos++];

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (!(byte & 0x80)) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos
    };
}

function hex(v) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Locate Element Section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let pos = 8;

let elementStart = -1;
let elementPayload = -1;
let elementSize = -1;

while (pos < buf.length) {

    const sectionStart = pos;

    const sectionType = buf[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadStart = pos;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + size;

    if (sectionType === 9) {
        elementStart = sectionStart;
        elementPayload = payloadStart;
        elementSize = size;
        break;
    }

    pos = payloadEnd;
}

if (elementStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("ELEMENT SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

console.log("ELEMENT SECTION START :", hex(elementStart));
console.log("PAYLOAD START         :", hex(elementPayload));
console.log("SIZE                  :", elementSize);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

pos = elementPayload;

// segment count
let r = readULEB(pos);
const segmentCount = r.value;
pos = r.next;

console.log("SEGMENT COUNT :", segmentCount);
console.log();

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Decode segments
// ------------------------------------------------------------

for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount; seg++) {

    const segStart = pos;

    r = readULEB(pos);
    const flags = r.value;
    pos = r.next;

    console.log(
        `SEGMENT ${seg} START ${hex(segStart)} FLAGS ${flags}`
    );

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // flags = 0
    //
    // active segment
    // implicit table 0
    // offset expression
    // vector of function indices
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (flags === 0) {

        console.log("  MODE : active / table 0");

        // offset expression
        const opcode = buf[pos++];

        console.log(
            "  OFFSET OPCODE :",
            "0x" + opcode.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
        );

        let offsetValue = null;

        if (opcode === 0x41) {
            r = readSLEB(pos);
            offsetValue = r.value;
            pos = r.next;

            console.log("  OFFSET VALUE  :", offsetValue);
        }
        else if (opcode === 0x42) {
            // i64.const
            r = readSLEB(pos);
            offsetValue = r.value;
            pos = r.next;

            console.log("  OFFSET VALUE  :", offsetValue);
        }
        else if (opcode === 0x23) {
            // global.get
            r = readULEB(pos);
            const globalIndex = r.value;
            pos = r.next;

            console.log("  OFFSET GLOBAL :", globalIndex);
        }
        else {
            console.log(
                "  UNKNOWN OFFSET OPCODE"
            );
        }

        // end opcode
        if (buf[pos] === 0x0b) {
            pos++;
        }

        // vector count
        r = readULEB(pos);
        const count = r.value;
        pos = r.next;

        console.log("  FUNCTION COUNT :", count);
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        let hits = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

            const funcPos = pos;

            r = readULEB(pos);
            const funcIndex = r.value;
            pos = r.next;

            if (funcIndex === TARGET) {

                hits++;

                console.log("******** EXACT TARGET HIT ********");
                console.log("SEGMENT       :", seg);
                console.log("ELEMENT INDEX :", i);
                console.log("TABLE SLOT    :", offsetValue + i);
                console.log("FUNC INDEX    :", funcIndex);
                console.log("BYTE OFFSET   :", hex(funcPos));

                const a = Math.max(elementPayload, funcPos - 16);
                const b = Math.min(pos + 16, elementPayload + elementSize);

                console.log(
                    "CONTEXT BYTES :",
                    [...buf.subarray(a, b)]
                        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
                        .join(" ")
                );

                console.log("**********************************");
                console.log();
            }
        }

        console.log(
            "SEGMENT DECODE END :",
            hex(pos)
        );

        console.log(
            "TARGET HITS        :",
            hits
        );

    } else {

        console.log(

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readULEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
        }
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {
    const sections: any[] = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const size = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = size.next;

        const payloadStart = p;
        const payloadEnd = p + size.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            payloadStart,
            payloadEnd,
            size: size.value
        });

        p = payloadEnd;
    }

    return sections;
}

export async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" ELEMENT → FUNCTION TABLE DECODER");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    const sections = parseSections(buf);

    const sec = sections.find((x) => x.id === 9);

    if (!sec) {
        throw new Error("Element section not found");
    }

    let p = sec.payloadStart;

    const segmentCount = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = segmentCount.next;

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "Element segments :",
        segmentCount.value
    );

    const flags = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = flags.next;

    console.log(
        "Flags            :",
        flags.value
    );

    if (flags.value !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected flags=0, got ${flags.value}`
        );
    }

    /*
     * offset expression
     */

    const opcode = buf[p++];

    console.log(
        "Offset opcode    :",
        hex(opcode)
    );

    if (opcode !== 0x41) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected i32.const, got ${hex(opcode)}`
        );
    }

    const offsetInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = offsetInfo.next;

    const endOpcode = buf[p++];

    if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected end opcode, got ${hex(endOpcode)}`
        );
    }

    const tableOffset = offsetInfo.value;

    console.log(
        "Table offset     :",
        tableOffset
    );

    /*
     * IMPORTANT:
     *
     * flags=0 modern encoding:
     *
     *   offset expression
     *   vec(funcidx)
     *
     * There is NO elemkind byte here.
     */

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const count = countInfo.value;

    console.log(
        "Function count   :",
        count
    );

    const table = new Map<number, number>();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const fnInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = fnInfo.next;

        const tableIndex = tableOffset + i;

        table.set(tableIndex, fnInfo.value);
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("Final element cursor :", hex(p));
    console.log("Expected section end :", hex(sec.payloadEnd));

    if (p !== sec.payloadEnd) {
        console.log(
            "WARNING: cursor != section end, remaining =",
            sec.payloadEnd - p
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" TARGET TABLE LOOKUP");
    console.log("============================================================");

   const targets = [
    0x0A6E,
    0x0CDD,
    0x2163,
    0x21D2,
    0x12B4, // 4788
    0x12B6  // 4790
];

    for (const idx of targets) {
        const fn = table.get(idx);

        if (fn === undefined) {
            console.log(
                `table[${hex(idx)}] -> NOT PRESENT`
            );
        } else {
            console.log(
                `table[${hex(idx)}] -> function ${fn}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SEGMENT 413 CANDIDATE RANGE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    let hits = 0;

    for (let idx = 0; idx < count; idx++) {
        const tableIndex = tableOffset + idx;
        const fn = table.get(tableIndex)!;

        if (fn >= 4057 && fn <= 4188) {
            console.log(
                `table[${hex(tableIndex)}] -> function ${fn}`
            );

            hits++;
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "Candidate function mappings :",
        hits
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" TABLE WINDOW 0x80..0xA0");
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (
        let idx = 0x80;
        idx <= 0xa0;
        idx++
    ) {
        const fn = table.get(idx);

        if (fn === undefined) {
            console.log(
                `table[${hex(idx)}] -> undefined`
            );
        } else {
            console.log(
                `table[${hex(idx)}] -> function ${fn}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" TABLE WINDOW 0xFC0..0xFDF");
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (
        let idx = 0xfc0;
        idx <= 0xfdf;
        idx++
    ) {
        const fn = table.get(idx);

        if (fn === undefined) {
            console.log(
                `table[${hex(idx)}] -> undefined`
            );
        } else {
            console.log(
                `table[${hex(idx)}] -> function ${fn}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" END");
    console.log("============================================================");
}
run().catch((error) => {
    console.error(error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
});

import { Address, Cell, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';

    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000009n;

const PROVIDE_LP = 0x37c096df;
const ADD_LIQUIDITY = 0x50c6a654;
const JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER = 0x178d4519;

function opHex(op: number): string {
    return '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function fmt(value: bigint): string {
    return value.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
}

function rooster(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;
    const fraction = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction
        ? `${whole.toLocaleString()}.${fraction}`
        : whole.toLocaleString();
}

function ton(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;
    const fraction = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction
        ? `${whole.toLocaleString()}.${fraction}`
        : whole.toLocaleString();
}

function opcode(cell: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function printAddress(label: string, address: Address | null | undefined) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`${label}:`);

    if (!address) {
        console.log('NULL');
    } else {
        console.log(address.toString());
    }
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';

const RPC = 'https://104.26.1.179/api/v2/jsonRPC';

const POOL =
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf';

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000009;

async function rpc(method: string, params: any) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 15000);

    try {
        const response = await fetch(RPC, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'Host': 'testnet.toncenter.com',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                jsonrpc: '2.0',
                id: 1,
                method,
                params,
            }),
            signal: controller.signal,
        });

        const text = await response.text();

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `HTTP ${response.status}: ${text}`
            );
        }

        const json = JSON.parse(text);

        if (json.error) {
            throw new Error(
                `RPC ERROR: ${JSON.stringify(json.error)}`
            );
        }

        return json.result;
    } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer);
    }
}

function addr(msg: any): string {
    return (
        msg?.address ||
        msg?.destination ||
        msg?.source ||
        '<none>'
    );
}

function decodeBody(body?: string) {
    if (!body) {
        console.log('BODY: NONE');
        return;
    }

    console.log('BODY BOC:');
    console.log(body);

    try {
        const cell = Cell.fromBase64(body);
        const slice = cell.beginParse();

        console.log(
            `BODY ROOT: bits=${cell.bits.length} refs=${cell.refs.length}`
        );

        if (slice.remainingBits >= 32) {
            const opcode = slice.loadUint(32);

            console.log(
                `OPCODE: 0x${opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`
            );

            console.log(
                `OPCODE DECIMAL: ${opcode}`
            );
        }

        console.log(
            `ROOT REMAINING BITS: ${slice.remainingBits}`
        );
        console.log(
            `ROOT REMAINING REFS: ${slice.remainingRefs}`
        );
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'BODY DECODE ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : e
        );
    }
}

async function main() {
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi v2.2 EXACT POOL TRANSACTION DECODER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL:');
    console.log(POOL);
    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET LT:');
    console.log(TARGET_LT);
    console.log('');
    console.log('RPC:');
    console.log(RPC);
    console.log('');

    const result = await rpc('getTransactions', {
        address: POOL,
        limit: 1,
        lt: String(TARGET_LT),
    });

    console.log('TRANSACTION RESULT RECEIVED');
    console.log('');

    if (!result || result.length === 0) {
        console.log('NO TRANSACTION FOUND');
        return;
    }

    const tx = result[0];

    console.log('===== TRANSACTION =====');

    console.log('LT:', tx.lt);
    console.log('HASH:', tx.hash);
    console.log('UTIME:', tx.utime);

    if (tx.utime) {
        console.log(
            'DATE:',
            new Date(Number(tx.utime) * 1000).toISOString()
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== IN MESSAGE =====');

    const inMsg = tx.in_msg;

    if (!inMsg) {
        console.log('NO IN MESSAGE');
    } else {
        console.log('SOURCE:', inMsg.source);
        console.log('DESTINATION:', inMsg.destination);
        console.log('VALUE:', inMsg.value);
        console.log(
            'VALUE TON:',
            Number(inMsg.value || 0) / 1e9
        );

        decodeBody(inMsg.message_content?.body);
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== OUT MESSAGES =====');

    const outMsgs = tx.out_msgs || [];

    console.log('COUNT:', outMsgs.length);

    for (let i = 0; i < outMsgs.length; i++) {
        const msg = outMsgs[i];

        console.log('');
        console.log(`--- OUT MESSAGE ${i + 1} ---`);

        console.log('SOURCE:', msg.source);
        console.log('DESTINATION:', msg.destination);
        console.log('VALUE:', msg.value);
        console.log(
            'VALUE TON:',
            Number(msg.value || 0) / 1e9
        );

        decodeBody(msg.message_content?.body);
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' END - READ ONLY');
    console.log('================================================');
}

main().catch((e) => {
    console.log('');
    console.log('ERROR:');

    if (e instanceof Error) {
        console.log(e.stack || e.message);
    } else {
        console.log(e);
    }
});

import { Address, Cell } from "@ton/core";
import * as fs from "fs";

const BOC_FILE = "./sdk_generated_v22_rooster_liquidity.boc";

function printCell(label: string, cell: Cell) {
  console.log(`\n===== ${label} =====`);
  console.log("bits:", cell.bits.length);
  console.log("refs:", cell.refs.length);
  console.log("hash:", cell.hash().toString("hex"));
}

function formatAddress(address: Address | null) {
  return address ? address.toString() : "null";
}

export async function run() {
  console.log("=================================================");
  console.log(" STON.fi v2.2 EXACT SDK BODY DECODER");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT");
  console.log("=================================================");

  if (!fs.existsSync(BOC_FILE)) {
    throw new Error(`BOC file not found: ${BOC_FILE}`);
  }

  const base64 = fs.readFileSync(BOC_FILE, "utf8").trim();

  const body = Cell.fromBoc(
    Buffer.from(base64, "base64")
  )[0];

  printCell("ROOT BODY", body);

  const root = body.beginParse();

  console.log("\n===== JETTON TRANSFER =====");

  const opcode = root.loadUint(32);
  const queryId = root.loadUintBig(64);
  const amount = root.loadCoins();

  const destination = root.loadAddress();
  const responseDestination = root.loadAddress();

  const hasCustomPayload = root.loadBit();

  let customPayload: Cell | null = null;

  if (hasCustomPayload) {
    customPayload = root.loadRef();
  }

  const forwardTonAmount = root.loadCoins();

  const hasForwardPayload = root.loadBit();

  let forwardPayload: Cell | null = null;

  if (hasForwardPayload) {
    forwardPayload = root.loadRef();
  } else {
    throw new Error("SDK body has no forward payload.");
  }

  console.log("opcode:", "0x" + opcode.toString(16));
  console.log("queryId:", queryId.toString());
  console.log("amount:", amount.toString());

  console.log(
    "destination:",
    formatAddress(destination)
  );

  console.log(
    "responseDestination:",
    formatAddress(responseDestination)
  );

  console.log(
    "customPayload:",
    customPayload ? "REFERENCE" : "none"
  );

  console.log(
    "forwardTonAmount:",
    forwardTonAmount.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "forwardPayload:",
    "REFERENCE"
  );

  console.log("\n===== FORWARD PAYLOAD =====");

  printCell("PROVIDE_LP ROOT", forwardPayload);

  const provide = forwardPayload.beginParse();

  const provideOpcode = provide.loadUint(32);

  console.log(
    "PROVIDE_LP opcode:",
    "0x" + provideOpcode.toString(16)
  );

  const routerWallet = provide.loadAddress();
  const refundAddress = provide.loadAddress();
  const excessesAddress = provide.loadAddress();

  const deadline = provide.loadUintBig(64);

  console.log(
    "routerWalletAddress:",
    formatAddress(routerWallet)
  );

  console.log(
    "refundAddress:",
    formatAddress(refundAddress)
  );

  console.log(
    "excessesAddress:",
    formatAddress(excessesAddress)
  );

  console.log(
    "deadline:",
    deadline.toString()
  );

  const nested = provide.loadRef();

  printCell("NESTED PROVIDE_LP PARAMETERS", nested);

  const nestedSlice = nested.beginParse();

  const minLpOut = nestedSlice.loadCoins();
  const receiverAddress = nestedSlice.loadAddress();
  const bothPositive = nestedSlice.loadUint(1);

  const dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount =
    nestedSlice.loadCoins();

  const hasDexCustomPayload =
    nestedSlice.loadBit();

  let dexCustomPayload: Cell | null = null;

  if (hasDexCustomPayload) {
    dexCustomPayload = nestedSlice.loadRef();
  }

  console.log("\n===== PROVIDE_LP PARAMETERS =====");

  console.log(
    "minLpOut:",
    minLpOut.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "receiverAddress:",
    formatAddress(receiverAddress)
  );

  console.log(
    "bothPositive:",
    bothPositive
  );

  console.log(
    "dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount:",
    dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "dexCustomPayload:",
    dexCustomPayload ? "REFERENCE" : "none"
  );

  console.log("\n===== REMAINING BITS / REFS =====");

  console.log(
    "forward payload remaining bits:",
    provide.remainingBits
  );

  console.log(
    "forward payload remaining refs:",
    provide.remainingRefs
  );

  console.log(
    "nested remaining bits:",
    nestedSlice.remainingBits
  );

  console.log(
    "nested remaining refs:",
    nestedSlice.remainingRefs
  );

  
  console.log("\n===== FINAL SDK VALUES =====");

  console.log(
    "ROOSTER amount:",
    amount.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "minLpOut:",
    minLpOut.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "routerWalletAddress:",
    routerWallet.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "refundAddress:",
    refundAddress.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "excessesAddress:",
    excessesAddress.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "receiverAddress:",
    receiverAddress.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "deadline:",
    deadline.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "forwardTonAmount:",
    forwardTonAmount.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "bothPositive:",
    bothPositive
  );

  console.log(
    "dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount:",
    dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "dexCustomPayload:",
    dexCustomPayload ? "REFERENCE" : "none"
  );

import { Cell, Address } from "@ton/core";
import * as fs from "fs";
import * as path from "path";

// ============================================================
// CONFIGURATION
// ============================================================
//
// IMPORTANT:
// rebuildFreshV22 saves rooster_v22_generated.boc as RAW binary
// BOC, NOT as Base64 text.
//
// This decoder is specifically aligned with the STON.fi v2.2
// SDK structure found in @ston-fi/sdk 2.7.0.
//
// READ ONLY
// NO TRANSACTION
// NO SIGNATURE
//

const BOC_PATH = path.resolve(
  process.cwd(),
  "rooster_v22_generated.boc"
);

// ============================================================
// EXPECTED VALUES
// ============================================================

const EXPECTED = {
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Jetton Transfer
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  jettonTransferOpcode: 0x0f8a7ea5,

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // STON.fi v2.2 PROVIDE_LP
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  provideLpOpcode: 0x37c096df,

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Fresh build
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  roosterAmount: 100000000000n,

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Actual STON.fi v2.2 Router
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  routerAddress:
    "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3",

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Connected wallet / response / refund / excesses
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  userAddress:
    "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix",

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // pTON jetton wallet owned by STON.fi Router
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  routerPtonWallet:
    "EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3",

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Fresh build
  // 95% minimum LP
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  minLpOut: 150109265n,

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // STON.fi v2.2 SDK 2.7.0:
  //
  // provideLpJetton.forwardGasAmount = 0.235 TON
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  forwardTonAmount: 235000000n,

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Fresh build deadline
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  deadline: 1790697420n,

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // v2.2 flags
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  bothPositive: true,

  // No custom DEX payload in fresh build
  dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount: 0n,

  hasDexCustomPayload: false,
};

// ============================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================

function check(
  label: string,
  actual: unknown,
  expected: unknown
): boolean {
  if (actual === expected) {
    console.log(
      `PASS | ${label} | actual=${String(actual)} | expected=${String(expected)}`
    );

    return true;
  }

  console.log(
    `FAIL | ${label} | actual=${String(actual)} | expected=${String(expected)}`
  );

  return false;
}

// ============================================================
// ADDRESS HELPERS
// ============================================================

function addressString(
  address: Address | null
): string {
  if (!address) {
    return "null";
  }

  return address.toString({
    bounceable: true,
    urlSafe: true,
  });
}

function checkAddress(
  label: string,
  actual: Address | null,
  expected: string
): boolean {
  console.log(label);

  if (!actual) {
    console.log(
      `       actual:   null`
    );

    console.log(
      `       expected: ${expected}`
    );

    console.log(
      `FAIL | ${label}`
    );

    return false;
  }

  const actualString =
    addressString(actual);

  console.log(
    `       actual:   ${actualString}`
  );

  console.log(
    `       expected: ${expected}`
  );

  const actualRaw =
    actual.toRawString();

  const expectedRaw =
    Address.parse(expected).toRawString();

  if (actualRaw === expectedRaw) {
    console.log(
      `PASS | ${label}`
    );

    return true;
  }

  console.log(
    `       actual RAW:   ${actualRaw}`
  );

  console.log(
    `       expected RAW: ${expectedRaw}`
  );

  console.log(
    `FAIL | ${label}`
  );

  return false;
}

// ============================================================
// INNER PROVIDE_LP DATA DECODER
// ============================================================
//
// STON.fi v2.2 SDK:
//
// storeRef(
//   beginCell()
//     .storeCoins(minLpOut)
//     .storeAddress(receiverAddress)
//     .storeUint(bothPositive ? 1 : 0, 1)
//     .storeCoins(dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount ?? 0)
//     .storeMaybeRef(dexCustomPayload)
//     .endCell()
// )
//
// ============================================================

function decodeProvideLpInnerCell(
  cell: Cell
): boolean {
  console.log("");
  console.log(
    "===== PROVIDE_LP INNER REF ====="
  );

  console.log(
    `Inner bits: ${cell.bits.length}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Inner refs: ${cell.refs.length}`
  );

  const s =
    cell.beginParse();

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // minLpOut
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const minLpOut =
    s.loadCoins();

  const minLpOk =
    check(
      "PROVIDE_LP minLpOut",
      minLpOut.toString(),
      EXPECTED.minLpOut.toString()
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // receiverAddress
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const receiverAddress =
    s.loadAddress();

  const receiverOk =
    checkAddress(
      "PROVIDE_LP receiver address",
      receiverAddress,
      EXPECTED.userAddress
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // bothPositive
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const bothPositive =
    s.loadBit();

  const bothPositiveOk =
    check(
      "PROVIDE_LP bothPositive",
      bothPositive,
      EXPECTED.bothPositive
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // DEX custom payload forward gas
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount =
    s.loadCoins();

  const dexGasOk =
    check(
      "DEX custom payload forward gas",
      dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount.toString(),
      EXPECTED.dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount.toString()
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Optional custom payload
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const hasDexCustomPayload =
    s.loadBit();

  const customPayloadFlagOk =
    check(
      "DEX custom payload flag",
      hasDexCustomPayload,
      EXPECTED.hasDexCustomPayload
    );

  if (hasDexCustomPayload) {
    console.log(
      "WARNING | Unexpected DEX custom payload reference"
    );

    if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
      s.loadRef();
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Remaining
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const remainingBits =
    s.remainingBits;

  const remainingRefs =
    s.remainingRefs;

  console.log(
    `Inner remaining bits: ${remainingBits}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Inner remaining refs: ${remainingRefs}`
  );

  const fullyConsumed =
    remainingBits === 0 &&
    remainingRefs === 0;

  if (fullyConsumed) {
    console.log(
      "PASS | PROVIDE_LP inner cell fully consumed"
    );
  } else {
    console.log(
      `FAIL | PROVIDE_LP inner cell trailing data | bits=${remainingBits}, refs=${remainingRefs}`
    );
  }

  return (
    minLpOk &&
    receiverOk &&
    bothPositiveOk &&
    dexGasOk &&
    customPayloadFlagOk &&
    fullyConsumed
  );
}

// ============================================================
// OUTER PROVIDE_LP DECODER
// ============================================================
//
// STON.fi v2.2:
//
//   uint32  PROVIDE_LP
//   address routerWalletAddress
//   address refundAddress
//   address excessesAddress
//   uint64  deadline
//   ref     inner payload
//
// ============================================================

function decodeProvideLpPayload(
  cell: Cell
): boolean {
  console.log("");
  console.log(
    "===== PROVIDE_LP PAYLOAD ====="
  );

  console.log(
    `Outer PROVIDE_LP bits: ${cell.bits.length}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Outer PROVIDE_LP refs: ${cell.refs.length}`
  );

  const s =
    cell.beginParse();

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Opcode
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const opcode =
    s.loadUint(32);

  const opcodeOk =
    check(
      "PROVIDE_LP opcode",
      opcode,
      EXPECTED.provideLpOpcode
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Router pTON wallet
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const routerWalletAddress =
    s.loadAddress();

  const routerWalletOk =
    checkAddress(
      "PROVIDE_LP router wallet",
      routerWalletAddress,
      EXPECTED.routerPtonWallet
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Refund address
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const refundAddress =
    s.loadAddress();

  const refundOk =
    checkAddress(
      "PROVIDE_LP refund address",
      refundAddress,
      EXPECTED.userAddress
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Excesses address
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const excessesAddress =
    s.loadAddress();

  const excessesOk =
    checkAddress(
      "PROVIDE_LP excesses address",
      excessesAddress,
      EXPECTED.userAddress
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Deadline
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const deadline =
    s.loadUintBig(64);

  const deadlineOk =
    check(
      "PROVIDE_LP deadline",
      deadline.toString(),
      EXPECTED.deadline.toString()
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Inner reference
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  let innerCell: Cell | null = null;

  if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
    innerCell =
      s.loadRef();

    console.log(
      "PASS | PROVIDE_LP inner payload reference present"
    );
  } else {
    console.log(
      "FAIL | PROVIDE_LP inner payload reference missing"
    );
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Outer cell remaining
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const remainingBits =
    s.remainingBits;

  const remainingRefs =
    s.remainingRefs;

  console.log(
    `PROVIDE_LP outer remaining bits: ${remainingBits}`
  );

  console.log(
    `PROVIDE_LP outer remaining refs: ${remainingRefs}`
  );

  const outerFullyConsumed =
    remainingBits === 0 &&
    remainingRefs === 0;

  if (outerFullyConsumed) {
    console.log(
      "PASS | PROVIDE_LP outer cell fully consumed"
    );
  } else {
    console.log(
      `FAIL | PROVIDE_LP outer cell trailing data | bits=${remainingBits}, refs=${remainingRefs}`
    );
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Decode inner reference
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  let innerOk = false;

  if (innerCell) {
    innerOk =
      decodeProvideLpInnerCell(
        innerCell
      );
  }

  return (
    opcodeOk &&
    routerWalletOk &&
    refundOk &&
    excessesOk &&
    deadlineOk &&
    outerFullyConsumed &&
    innerOk
  );
}

// ============================================================
// JETTON TRANSFER DECODER
// ============================================================

function decodeJettonTransfer(
  root: Cell
): boolean {
  console.log("");
  console.log(
    "===== JETTON TRANSFER ====="
  );

  const s =
    root.beginParse();

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Jetton Transfer opcode
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const opcode =
    s.loadUint(32);

  const opcodeOk =
    check(
      "Jetton Transfer opcode",
      opcode,
      EXPECTED.jettonTransferOpcode
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Query ID
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const queryId =
    s.loadUintBig(64);

  console.log(
    `query_id: ${queryId.toString()}`
  );

  const queryIdOk =
    check(
      "query_id",
      queryId.toString(),
      "0"
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Jetton amount
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const amount =
    s.loadCoins();

  const amountOk =
    check(
      "Jetton transfer amount",
      amount.toString(),
      EXPECTED.roosterAmount.toString()
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Destination
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const destination =
    s.loadAddress();

  const destinationOk =
    checkAddress(
      "Jetton transfer destination",
      destination,
      EXPECTED.routerAddress
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Response destination
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const responseDestination =
    s.loadAddress();

  const responseOk =
    checkAddress(
      "Jetton response destination",
      responseDestination,
      EXPECTED.userAddress
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Custom payload
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const hasCustomPayload =
    s.loadBit();

  const customPayloadOk =
    check(
      "custom payload flag",
      hasCustomPayload,
      false
    );

  if (hasCustomPayload) {
    console.log(
      "WARNING | Unexpected custom payload reference"
    );

    s.loadRef();
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Forward TON amount
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const forwardTonAmount =
    s.loadCoins();

  const forwardTonOk =
    check(
      "forward TON amount",
      forwardTonAmount.toString(),
      EXPECTED.forwardTonAmount.toString()
    );

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Forward payload
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const forwardPayloadIsRef =
    s.loadBit();

  const forwardPayloadFlagOk =
    check(
      "forward payload reference flag",
      forwardPayloadIsRef,
      true
    );

  let provideLpCell: Cell | null = null;

  if (forwardPayloadIsRef) {
    provideLpCell =
      s.loadRef();

    console.log(
      "PASS | Forward payload stored as reference"
    );
  } else {
    console.log(
      "FAIL | Forward payload is not a reference"
    );
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Forward payload information
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (provideLpCell) {
    console.log("");
    console.log(
      "===== FORWARD PAYLOAD ====="
    );

    console.log(
      `Forward payload bits: ${provideLpCell.bits.length}`
    );

    console.log(
      `Forward payload refs: ${provideLpCell.refs.length}`
    );
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Decode PROVIDE_LP
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  let provideLpOk = false;

  if (provideLpCell) {
    provideLpOk =
      decodeProvideLpPayload(
        provideLpCell
      );
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Root remaining data
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  const remainingBits =
    s.remainingBits;

  const remainingRefs =
    s.remainingRefs;

  console.log("");
  console.log(
    "===== OUTER CELL CHECK ====="
  );

  console.log(
    `Remaining root bits: ${remainingBits}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Remaining root refs: ${remainingRefs}`
  );

  const outerFullyConsumed =
    remainingBits === 0 &&
    remainingRefs === 0;

  if (outerFullyConsumed) {
    console.log(
      "PASS | Jetton Transfer payload fully consumed"
    );
  } else {
    console.log(
      `FAIL | Jetton Transfer contains unexpected trailing data | bits=${remainingBits}, refs=${remainingRefs}`
    );
  }

  return (
    opcodeOk &&
    queryIdOk &&
    amountOk &&
    destinationOk &&
    responseOk &&
    customPayloadOk &&
    forwardTonOk &&
    forwardPayloadFlagOk &&
    provideLpOk &&
    outerFullyConsumed
  );
}

function loadBocFile(): Buffer {
  const boc =
    fs.readFileSync(
      BOC_PATH
    );

  if (boc.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(
      "BOC file is empty."
    );
  }

  console.log(
    `Raw BOC bytes: ${boc.length}`
  );

  return boc;
}
