import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';

const ROOSTER_BOC = './rooster_v22_current_ratio.boc';
const PTON_BOC = './pton_v22_current_ratio.boc';

function printAddress(slice: any, name: string) {
    try {
        const address = slice.loadAddress();

        console.log(`${name}: ${address ? address.toString() : 'null'}`);

        return address;
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(`${name}: ERROR`);
        console.log(String(e));
        return null;
    }
}

function decodeProvideLpPayload(cell: Cell, label: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(` ${label}`);
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    console.log(`BITS: ${s.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`REFS: ${s.remainingRefs}`);

    const op = s.loadUint(32);

    console.log(
        `OPCODE: 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`
    );

    if (op !== 0x37c096df) {
        console.log('ERROR: not provide_lp');
        return;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('--- PROVIDE_LP HEADER ---');

    printAddress(s, 'OTHER_TOKEN_WALLET');
    printAddress(s, 'REFUND_ADDRESS');
    printAddress(s, 'EXCESSES_ADDRESS');

    if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
        const deadline = s.loadUintBig(64);

        console.log(`DEADLINE: ${deadline}`);

        const deadlineNumber = Number(deadline);

        if (
            Number.isSafeInteger(deadlineNumber) &&
            deadlineNumber > 1000000000 &&
            deadlineNumber < 5000000000
        ) {
            console.log(
                `DEADLINE DATE: ${new Date(
                    deadlineNumber * 1000
                ).toISOString()}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('--- PROVIDE_LP ADDITIONAL_DATA ---');

    if (s.remainingRefs < 1) {
        console.log('ERROR: missing additional_data reference');
        return;
    }

    const additional = s.loadRef();
    const a = additional.beginParse();

    console.log(`ADDITIONAL BITS: ${a.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`ADDITIONAL REFS: ${a.remainingRefs}`);

    const minLpOut = a.loadCoins();

    console.log(`MIN_LP_OUT: ${minLpOut}`);

    printAddress(a, 'RECEIVER_ADDRESS');

    if (a.remainingBits >= 1) {
        const bothPositive = a.loadBit();

        console.log(`BOTH_POSITIVE: ${bothPositive}`);
    }

    if (a.remainingBits > 0) {
        const fwdAmount = a.loadCoins();

        console.log(`FWD_AMOUNT: ${fwdAmount}`);
        console.log(
            `FWD_AMOUNT TON: ${Number(fwdAmount) / 1e9}`
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('--- CUSTOM_PAYLOAD ---');

    if (a.remainingBits >= 1) {
        const hasPayload = a.loadBit();

        console.log(`CUSTOM_PAYLOAD PRESENT: ${hasPayload}`);

        if (hasPayload && a.remainingRefs > 0) {
            const customPayload = a.loadRef();

            console.log(
                `CUSTOM_PAYLOAD BITS: ${customPayload.bits.length}`
            );

            console.log(
                `CUSTOM_PAYLOAD REFS: ${customPayload.refs.length}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(`ADDITIONAL REMAINING BITS: ${a.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`ADDITIONAL REMAINING REFS: ${a.remainingRefs}`);

    console.log('');
    console.log(`PAYLOAD REMAINING BITS: ${s.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`PAYLOAD REMAINING REFS: ${s.remainingRefs}`);
}

function decodeRoosterTransfer(root: Cell) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' ROOSTER JETTON TRANSFER');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const s = root.beginParse();

    const op = s.loadUint(32);

    console.log(
        `OPCODE: 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`
    );

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    console.log(`QUERY_ID: ${queryId}`);

    const amount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log(`JETTON_AMOUNT: ${amount}`);
    console.log(
        `JETTON_AMOUNT ROOSTER: ${Number(amount) / 1e9}`
    );

    printAddress(s, 'DESTINATION');
    printAddress(s, 'RESPONSE_DESTINATION');

    console.log('');
    console.log('--- CUSTOM PAYLOAD ---');

    const customPresent = s.loadBit();

    console.log(`CUSTOM_PAYLOAD PRESENT: ${customPresent}`);

    if (customPresent && s.remainingRefs > 0) {
        s.loadRef();
    }

    const forwardAmount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log(`FORWARD_TON_AMOUNT: ${forwardAmount}`);
    console.log(
        `FORWARD_TON_AMOUNT TON: ${Number(forwardAmount) / 1e9}`
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('--- FORWARD PAYLOAD ---');

    const isRef = s.loadBit();

    console.log(`FORWARD_PAYLOAD IS REF: ${isRef}`);

    let payload: Cell | null = null;

    if (isRef && s.remainingRefs > 0) {
        payload = s.loadRef();
    }

    if (payload) {
        decodeProvideLpPayload(
            payload,
            'ROOSTER -> ROUTER PROVIDE_LP'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(`ROOT REMAINING BITS: ${s.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`ROOT REMAINING REFS: ${s.remainingRefs}`);
}

function decodePtonRaw(root: Cell) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' pTON ROOT STRUCTURE');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const s = root.beginParse();

    const op = s.loadUint(32);

    console.log(
        `OPCODE: 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`
    );

    console.log(`REMAINING BITS: ${s.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`REMAINING REFS: ${s.remainingRefs}`);

    for (let i = 0; i < s.remainingRefs; i++) {
        const ref = s.loadRef();

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            `pTON REF ${i}: bits=${ref.bits.length}, refs=${ref.refs.length}`
        );

        const rs = ref.beginParse();

        if (rs.remainingBits >= 32) {
            const refOp = rs.loadUint(32);

            console.log(
                `pTON REF ${i} OPCODE: 0x${refOp
                    .toString(16)
                    .padStart(8, '0')}`
            );

            if (refOp === 0x37c096df) {
                decodeProvideLpPayload(
                    ref,
                    `pTON -> PROVIDE_LP REF ${i}`
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x0000d339;
const END   = 0x0000d49e;

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb32(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let x;

  do {
    x = b[pos++];
    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value, next: pos };
}

function readInstruction(p) {
  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let text = `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}  `;

  switch (op) {

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(p);
      p = t.next;
      const tab = uleb(p);
      p = tab.next;
      text += `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      text += `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      text += `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb32(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `I32.CONST ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x6a:
      text += "I32.ADD";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      text += "I32.SUB";
      break;

    case 0x45:
      text += "I32.EQZ";
      break;

    case 0x47:
      text += "I32.NE";
      break;

    case 0x04:
      text += `IF type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    case 0x02:
      text += `BLOCK type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    case 0x03:
      text += `LOOP type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      text += "END";
      break;

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `BR ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `BR_IF ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x1a:
      text += "DROP";
      break;

    case 0x0f:
      text += "RETURN";
      break;

    case 0x41:
      break;

    default:
      text += `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      break;
  }

  return { next: p, text };
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function leb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];
  const r = leb(p);
  p = r.next;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = p;
    break;
  }

  p += r.value;
}

let q = codeStart;
const count = leb(q);
q = count.next;

for (let func = 0; func <= 122; func++) {
  const br = leb(q);
  const bodySize = br.value;
  q = br.next;

  const bodyStart = q;
  const bodyEnd = q + bodySize;

  if (func !== 122) {
    q = bodyEnd;
    continue;
  }

  const localCount = leb(q);
  q = localCount.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {
    const n = leb(q);
    q = n.next;
    q += 1;
  }

  const start = q;
  const end = bodyEnd - 1;

  console.log("FUNC 122 CALL 87 STACK TRACE");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");

  for (let x = start; x < end; x++) {
    if (wasm[x] !== 0x10) continue;

    const c = leb(x + 1);
    if (c.value !== 87) continue;

    console.log("");
    console.log(`CALL 87 @ 0x${x.toString(16).padStart(6, "0")}`);

    const from = Math.max(start, x - 32);

    let i = from;

    while (i < x) {
      const op = wasm[i];

      if (op === 0x20) {
        const r = leb(i + 1);
        console.log(`  local.get ${r.value}`);
        i = r.next;
        continue;
      }

      if (op === 0x22) {
        const r = leb(i + 1);
        console.log(`  local.tee ${r.value}`);
        i = r.next;
        continue;
      }

      if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = leb(i + 1);
        console.log(`  i32.const ${r.value} (0x${r.value.toString(16)})`);
        i = r.next;
        continue;
      }

      if (op === 0x42) {
        const r = leb(i + 1);
        console.log(`  i64.const ${r.value} (0x${r.value.toString(16)})`);
        i = r.next;
        continue;
      }

      if (op === 0x29) {
        const align = wasm[i + 1];
        const off = leb(i + 2);
        console.log(`  i64.load align=${align} offset=${off.value}`);
        i = off.next;
        continue;
      }

      if (op === 0x6a) {
        console.log("  i32.add");
        i++;
        continue;
      }

      if (op === 0x86) {
        console.log("  i64.extend_i32_u");
        i++;
        continue;
      }

      if (op === 0x10) {
        const r = leb(i + 1);
        console.log(`  call ${r.value}`);
        i = r.next;
        continue;
      }

      console.log(`  opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`);
      i++;
    }
  }

  console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x0000eec5;
const END   = 0x0000ef44;

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: v, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function sleb(pos) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
                v |= (~0 << shift);

            return { value: v | 0, next: pos };
        }
    }
}

function hex(v, n = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("FUNC 122 CONTROL-FLOW DECODE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log();

let p = START;
let depth = 0;

function indent() {
    return "  ".repeat(depth);
}

while (p < END) {

    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    switch (op) {

        case 0x02: { // block
            const x = wasm[p++];
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}BLOCK type=${hex(x,2)}`
            );
            depth++;
            break;
        }

        case 0x03: { // loop
            const x = wasm[p++];
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}LOOP type=${hex(x,2)}`
            );
            depth++;
            break;
        }

        case 0x04: { // if
            const x = wasm[p++];
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}IF type=${hex(x,2)}`
            );
            depth++;
            break;
        }

        case 0x05: // else
            depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
            console.log(`${hex(at)} ${indent()}ELSE`);
            depth++;
            break;

        case 0x0b: // end
            depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
            console.log(`${hex(at)} ${indent()}END`);
            break;

        case 0x0c: { // br
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}BR depth=${x.value}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x0d: { // br_if
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}BR_IF depth=${x.value}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x0f:
            console.log(`${hex(at)} ${indent()}RETURN`);
            break;

        case 0x20: { // local.get
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}local.get ${x.value}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: { // local.set
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}local.set ${x.value}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x22: { // local.tee
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}local.tee ${x.value}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: { // i32.const
            const x = sleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}i32.const ${x.value} (${hex(x.value >>> 0)})`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x28: { // i32.load
            const align = uleb(p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = uleb(p);
            p = offset.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}i32.load align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x36: { // i32.store
            const align = uleb(p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = uleb(p);
            p = offset.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}i32.store align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x45:
            console.log(`${hex(at)} ${indent()}i32.eqz`);
            break;

        case 0x46:
            console.log(`${hex(at)} ${indent()}i32.eq`);
            break;

        case 0x10: { // call
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}CALL FUNC ${x.value}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
            const t = uleb(p);
            p = t.next;

            const table = uleb(p);
            p = table.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`
            );
            break;
        }

        default:
            // Keep unknown opcodes visible, but don't stop.
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} ${indent()}OPCODE ${hex(op,2)}`
            );
            break;
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const BODY_START = 0; // auto-find below
const FUNC = 1533;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return [v >>> 0, pos];
    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  let code = null;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const [size, q] = uleb(p);
    p = q;

    const end = p + size;

    if (id === 10) {
      const [count, q2] = uleb(p);
      let x = q2;

      const bodies = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const [bodySize, q3] = uleb(x);
        x = q3;

        const start = x;
        const stop = x + bodySize;

        bodies.push({ start, stop });
        x = stop;
      }

      code = bodies;
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return code;
}

  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22 ||
      op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {

    const [idx, q1] = uleb(p);
    p = q1;
    s += ` L${idx}`;

  } else if (op === 0x41) {

    const [v, q1] = uleb(p);
    p = q1;
    s += ` ${v} (${hex(v)})`;

  } else if (op === 0x10) {

    const [idx, q1] = uleb(p);
    p = q1;
    s += ` FUNC ${idx}`;

  } else if (op === 0x11) {

    const [type, q1] = uleb(p);
    p = q1;
    const table = b[p++];
    s += ` TYPE ${type} TABLE ${table}`;

  } else if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x2d || op === 0x36 || op === 0x3a) {

    const m = readMemArg();
    s += ` align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;

  } else if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

    const [depth, q1] = uleb(p);
    p = q1;
    s += ` ${depth}`;

  } else if (op === 0xfc) {

    const sub = b[p++];
    s += ` SUBOP=0x${sub.toString(16)}`;

    // Preserve raw bytes for bulk-memory/table instructions
    while (p < f.stop && (b[p] & 0x80)) p++;
    if (p < f.stop) p++;
  }

  console.log(s);
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const targetFunc = 1416;

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);
let p = 8;

function u8() {
  return b[p++];
}

function readULEB() {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = u8();
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return v;
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB() {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let x;

  while (true) {
    x = u8();
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
    v -= 2 ** s;
  }

  return v;
}

function hex(v, n = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

// ============================================================
// PARSE WASM SECTIONS
// ============================================================

let types = [];
let importedFunctions = 0;
let funcTypeIndices = [];
let codeBodies = [];

while (p < b.length) {
  const sectionId = u8();
  const sectionSize = readULEB();
  const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // TYPE SECTION
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (sectionId === 1) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const form = u8();

      if (form !== 0x60) {
        throw new Error(
          `Unexpected type form 0x${form.toString(16)}`
        );
      }

      const paramCount = readULEB();
      const params = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
        params.push(u8());
      }

      const resultCount = readULEB();
      const results = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
        results.push(u8());
      }

      types.push({
        params,
        results
      });
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // IMPORT SECTION
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 2) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      readULEB(); // module string length + bytes
      readULEB(); // field string length + bytes

      const kind = u8();

      if (kind === 0) {
        readULEB(); // type index
        importedFunctions++;
      }

      else if (kind === 1) {
        u8(); // element type

        const flags = readULEB();
        readULEB(); // min

        if (flags & 1) {
          readULEB(); // max
        }
      }

      else if (kind === 2) {
        const flags = readULEB();
        readULEB();

        if (flags & 1) {
          readULEB();
        }
      }

      else if (kind === 3) {
        u8();
        u8();
      }
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // FUNCTION SECTION
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 3) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      funcTypeIndices.push(readULEB());
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // CODE SECTION
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  else if (sectionId === 10) {
    const count = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const bodySize = readULEB();

      const bodyStart = p;
      const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

      codeBodies.push({
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
        bodySize
      });

      p = bodyEnd;
    }
  }

  p = sectionEnd;
}

if (
  definedIndex < 0 ||
  definedIndex >= codeBodies.length

    `FUNC ${targetFunc} not found`
  );
}

const body = codeBodies[definedIndex];

function blockType() {
  const x = u8();

  if (x === 0x40) return "0x40";
  if (x === 0x7f) return "i32";
  if (x === 0x7e) return "i64";
  if (x === 0x7d) return "f32";
  if (x === 0x7c) return "f64";

  return hex(x, 2);
}

function memArg() {
  const align = readULEB();
  const offset = readULEB();

  return {
    align,
    offset
  };
}

while (p < body.bodyEnd) {
  const at = p;
  const op = u8();

  let line =
    names[op] ||
    `opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

  switch (op) {

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // BLOCK / LOOP / IF
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x02:
    case 0x03:
    case 0x04: {
      line += ` blocktype=${blockType()}`;
      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // BR / BR_IF
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x0c:
    case 0x0d: {
      const depth = readULEB();
      line += ` ${depth}`;
      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // BR_TABLE
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x0e: {
      const count = readULEB();
      const labels = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        labels.push(readULEB());
      }

      const def = readULEB();

      line +=
        ` labels=[${labels.join(",")}]` +
        ` default=${def}`;

      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CALL
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x10: {
      const func = readULEB();
      line += ` FUNC ${func}`;
      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CALL INDIRECT
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x11: {
      const typeIndex = readULEB();
      const tableIndex = readULEB();

      line +=
        ` TYPE ${typeIndex}` +
        ` TABLE ${tableIndex}`;

      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // LOCAL
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x20:
    case 0x21:
    case 0x22: {
      const local = readULEB();
      line += ` L${local}`;
      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // GLOBAL
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x23:
    case 0x24: {
      const global = readULEB();
      line += ` G${global}`;
      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // MEMORY
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x28:
    case 0x29:
    case 0x2d:
    case 0x2f:
    case 0x36:
    case 0x37:
    case 0x3a:
    case 0x3b: {
      const m = memArg();

      line +=
        ` align=${m.align}` +
        ` offset=${m.offset}`;

      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // I32 CONST
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x41: {
      const v = readSLEB();

      line +=
        ` ${v}` +
        ` (${hex(v)})`;

      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // I64 CONST
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0x42: {
      const v = readSLEB();

      line += ` ${v}`;

      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // FC PREFIX
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0xfc: {
      const sub = readULEB();

      line +=
        ` subopcode=0x${sub.toString(16)}`;

      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // FE PREFIX
    // --------------------------------------------------------
    case 0xfe: {
      const sub = readULEB();

      line +=
        ` subopcode=0x${sub.toString(16)}`;

      break;
    }

    default:
      break;
  }

  console.log(
    `${hex(at)}  ${line}`
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, end: pos };
    s += 7;
  }
  return null;
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function findBodies() {
  let p = 8;
  let bodies = null;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const r = uleb(p);
    if (!r) break;

    p = r.end;
    const end = p + r.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      const c = uleb(p);
      let q = c.end;

      bodies = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const z = uleb(q);
        q = z.end;

        bodies.push({
          start: q,
          end: q + z.value
        });

        q += z.value;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

    p = r.end;
    s += ` L${r.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x41) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;
    s += ` ${r.value} (${hex(r.value)})`;

  } else if (op === 0x10) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;
    s += ` FUNC ${r.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x11) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;

    const table = b[p++];

    s += ` TYPE ${r.value} TABLE ${table}`;

  } else if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x2d ||
    op === 0x36 ||
    op === 0x3a
  ) {

    const m = memarg();

    s +=
      ` align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}` +
      ` [abs=0x${m.offset.toString(16)}]`;

  } else if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;

    s += ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  console.log(s);
}

console.log("DONE");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 0x093e16;
const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function s32(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40)) v -= 2 ** (s + 7);
      return { value: v, next: p };
    }
    s += 7;
  }
}

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x00095afd;
const END   = 0x00095b83;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function ins(p) {
  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let text = `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}  `;

  switch (op) {

    case 0x01:
      text += "NOP";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      text += "END";
      break;

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text += `BR_IF ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text += `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(p); p = t.next;
      const tab = uleb(p); p = tab.next;
      text += `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x1a:
      text += "DROP";
      break;

    case 0x1b:
      text += "SELECT";
      break;

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text += `GLOBAL.GET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = uleb(p); p = x.next;
      text += `GLOBAL.SET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p); p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p); p = o.next;
      text += `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p); p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p); p = o.next;
      text += `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb(p); p = x.next;
      text += `I32.CONST ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x45:
      text += "I32.EQZ";
      break;

    case 0x46:
      text += "I32.EQ";
      break;

    case 0x47:
      text += "I32.NE";
      break;

    case 0x6a:
      text += "I32.ADD";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      text += "I32.SUB";
      break;

    case 0x71:
      text += "I32.AND";
      break;

    case 0x72:
      text += "I32.OR";
      break;

    case 0x04:
      text += `IF type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    case 0x05:
      text += "ELSE";
      break;

    case 0x02:
      text += `BLOCK type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    case 0x03:
      text += `LOOP type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    default:
      text += `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      break;
  }

  return { next:p, text };
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

let p = 8;

// ---------- helpers ----------
function u32() {
  const v = b.readUInt32LE(p);
  p += 4;
  return v;
}

function u8() {
  return b[p++];
}

function readULEB() {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = u8();
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return v >>> 0;
    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB() {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  while (true) {
    x = u8();
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << s);
  return v | 0;
}

function skipLimits() {
  const flags = readULEB();
  readULEB();
  if (flags & 1) readULEB();
}

function skipType() {
  const form = u8();
  if (form === 0x60) {
    const n = readULEB();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) u8();
    const r = readULEB();
    for (let i = 0; i < r; i++) u8();
  }
}

function skipSectionPayload(size) {
  p += size;
}

let types = [];

  const id = u8();
  const size = readULEB();
  const end = p + size;

  if (id === 1) {
    const n = readULEB();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const form = u8();
      if (form !== 0x60) {
        throw new Error("Unexpected type form");
      }

      const np = readULEB();
      const params = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < np; j++) params.push(u8());

      const nr = readULEB();
      const results = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < nr; j++) results.push(u8());

      types.push({ params, results });
    }
  } else if (id === 2) {
    const n = readULEB();

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      readULEB(); // module name
      readULEB(); // field name

      const kind = u8();

      if (kind === 0) {
        const typeIndex = readULEB();
        imports.push(typeIndex);
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        u8(); // table type
        skipLimits();
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        skipLimits();
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        u8();
        u8();
      }
    }
  } else if (id === 3) {
    const n = readULEB();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const START = 0x2cc1f;
const END   = 0x2ccc3;

function hex(v, n = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

function decodeSLEB32(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let bytes = [];

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    bytes.push(x);

    result |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      shift += 7;

      if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1 << shift);
      }

      return {
        signed: result | 0,
        unsigned: result >>> 0,
        bytes
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const FUNC = 6826;
const IMPORTS = 83;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, end: pos };
    s += 7;
  }
  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v -= 2 ** s;
      return { value: v | 0, end: pos };
    }
  }
  throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function findBodies() {
  let p = 8;
  const bodies = [];

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;

    const end = p + r.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      const c = uleb(p);
      let q = c.end;

      for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const z = uleb(q);
        q = z.end;

        bodies.push({
          start: q,
          end: q + z.value
        });

        q += z.value;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

  let s =
    `${hex(at)}  ${names[op] ?? "opcode=0x" + op.toString(16)}`;

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24
  ) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;
    s += ` L${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = sleb(p);
    p = r.end;
    s += ` ${r.value} (${hex(r.value)})`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;
    s += ` FUNC ${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x11) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;
    const table = b[p++];
    s += ` TYPE ${r.value} TABLE ${table}`;
  }

  else if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x2d ||
    op === 0x36 ||
    op === 0x3a
  ) {
    const m = memarg();

    s +=
      ` align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}` +
      ` [abs=0x${m.offset.toString(16)}]`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;
    s += ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  console.log(s);
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        value |= (-1 << shift);
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 91 SYMBOLIC STACK DECODE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Locate code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {

    const sectionId = wasm[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const payload = pos;
    const end = payload + size;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = payload;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Locate FUNC 91
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const targetGlobal = 91;
const targetOrdinal = targetGlobal - 83;

let p = codeStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const codeCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

let bodyStart = -1;
let bodyEnd = -1;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < codeCount; ordinal++) {

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + bodySize;

    if (ordinal === targetOrdinal) {
        bodyStart = start;
        bodyEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

if (bodyStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("FUNC 91 NOT FOUND");
}

console.log(`CODE SECTION = ${hex(codeStart)} .. ${hex(codeEnd)}`);
console.log(`FUNC 91 BODY  = ${hex(bodyStart)} .. ${hex(bodyEnd)}`);
console.log(`BODY SIZE     = ${bodyEnd - bodyStart}`);

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Stack representation
// ------------------------------------------------------------

type Value = {
    name: string;
    origin: string;
};

const stack: Value[] = [];

function push(name: string, origin: string) {
    stack.push({ name, origin });
}

function pop(): Value {
    if (stack.length === 0) {
        return {
            name: "<UNKNOWN>",
            origin: "stack underflow"
        };
    }

    return stack.pop()!;
}

function showStack() {

    if (stack.length === 0) {
        console.log("    STACK = [ empty ]");
        return;
    }

    console.log(
        "    STACK = [ " +
        stack.map(v => `${v.name}{${v.origin}}`).join(" , ") +
        " ]"
    );
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Decode
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let x = bodyStart;

// locals
const localInfo = readULEB(x);
const localGroups = localInfo.value;
x = localInfo.next;

let localCount = 3; // parameters 0,1,2

console.log(`PARAMETERS = local0, local1, local2`);

for (let i = 0; i < localGroups; i++) {

    const c = readULEB(x);
    const count = c.value;
    x = c.next;

    const type = wasm[x++];

    console.log(
        `LOCAL GROUP ${i}: count=${count} type=0x${type.toString(16)}`
    );

    localCount += count;
}

console.log(`TOTAL LOCALS = ${localCount}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("INSTRUCTION TRACE");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

while (x < bodyEnd) {

    const offset = x;
    const op = wasm[x++];

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // block
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x02) {

        const blockType = wasm[x++];

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  block type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // loop
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x03) {

        const blockType = wasm[x++];

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  loop type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // if
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x04) {

        const blockType = wasm[x++];

        const cond = pop();

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  if type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}` +
            ` cond=${cond.name}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // end
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x0b) {

        console.log(`${hex(offset)}  end`);

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // br
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x0c) {

        const r = readULEB(x);
        x = r.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  br depth=${r.value}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // br_if
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x0d) {

        const r = readULEB(x);
        x = r.next;

        const cond = pop();

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  br_if depth=${r.value}` +
            ` cond=${cond.name}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // return
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x0f) {

        console.log(`${hex(offset)}  return`);
        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // local.get
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x20) {

        const r = readULEB(x);
        x = r.next;

        push(`local${r.value}`, `local.get ${r.value}`);

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  local.get ${r.value}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // local.set
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x21) {

        const r = readULEB(x);
        x = r.next;

        const value = pop();

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  local.set ${r.value} <- ${value.name}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // local.tee
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x22) {

        const r = readULEB(x);
        x = r.next;

        const value = pop();

        push(
            value.name,
            `local.tee ${r.value}`
        );

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  local.tee ${r.value} <- ${value.name}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.const
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x41) {

        const r = readSLEB32(x);
        x = r.next;

        push(
            `i32.const(${r.value})`,
            `constant ${r.value}`
        );

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  i32.const ${r.value}` +
            ` (${hex(r.value >>> 0)})`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.load
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x28) {

        const align = readULEB(x);
        x = align.next;

        const memOffset = readULEB(x);
        x = memOffset.next;

        const address = pop();

        push(
            `load32(${address.name}+${hex(memOffset.value)})`,
            `i32.load`
        );

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  i32.load` +
            ` align=${align.value}` +
            ` offset=${memOffset.value}` +
            ` addr=${address.name}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.add
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x6a) {

        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(
            `(${a.name}+${b.name})`,
            "i32.add"
        );

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  i32.add` +
            ` ${a.name} + ${b.name}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.eqz
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x45) {

        const a = pop();

        push(
            `eqz(${a.name})`,
            "i32.eqz"
        );

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  i32.eqz ${a.name}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.eq
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x46) {

        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(
            `(${a.name}==${b.name})`,
            "i32.eq"
        );

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  i32.eq`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.ne
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x47) {

        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(
            `(${a.name}!=${b.name})`,
            "i32.ne"
        );

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  i32.ne`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // call_indirect
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x11) {

        const typeInfo = readULEB(x);
        x = typeInfo.next;

        const reserved = wasm[x++];

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  CALL_INDIRECT` +
            ` type=${typeInfo.value}` +
            ` reserved=${reserved}`

        console.log(

        // WebAssembly call_indirect consumes:
        //   arguments + table index
        //
        // Stack top is table index.

        const arg2 = pop();
        const arg1 = pop();
        const arg0 = pop();

        console.log(
            `    ARG0 = ${arg0.name}`
        );

        console.log(
            `    ARG1 = ${arg1.name}`
        );

        console.log(
            `    ARG2 = ${arg2.name}`
        );

        console.log(
            `    TARGET TYPE = ${typeInfo.value}`
        );

        console.log(
            `    EXPECTED TYPE = (i32,i32,i32)->void`
        );

        showStack();

        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // direct call
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x10) {

        const target = readULEB(x);
        x = target.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  CALL FUNC ${target.value}`
        );

        if (target.value === 83) {

            const arg = pop();

            console.log(
                `    FUNC 83 ARG0 = ${arg.name}`
            );
        }

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // misc integer operations
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        op === 0x47 ||
        op === 0x48 ||
        op === 0x49 ||
        op === 0x4a ||
        op === 0x4b ||
        op === 0x4c ||
        op === 0x4d ||
        op === 0x4e ||
        op === 0x4f
    ) {

        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(
            `cmp(${a.name},${b.name})`,
            `compare opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
        );

        console.log(
            `${hex(offset)}  compare opcode=0x${op.toString(16)}`
        );

        showStack();
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Unknown opcode
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    console.log(
        `${hex(offset)}  UNKNOWN OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16)}`
    );

    console.log(
        "    Decoder stopped to avoid desynchronization."
    );

    break;

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function sleb32(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = wasm[pos++];
    result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    result |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

function sleb64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
  let result = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = wasm[pos++];
    result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7n;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
    result |= (-1n) << shift;
  }

  return { value: BigInt.asIntN(64, result), next: pos };
}

function hex(v: number): string {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readName(pos: number): { name: string; next: number } {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  pos = n.next;

  const end = pos + n.value;
  return {
    name: Buffer.from(wasm.subarray(pos, end)).toString("utf8"),
    next: end,
  };
}

function readBlockType(pos: number): {
  text: string;
  next: number;
} {
  const b = wasm[pos++];

  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x40: "empty",
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64",
  };

  if (names[b] !== undefined) {
    return { text: names[b], next: pos };
  }

  return {
    text: `typeidx/raw ${hex(b)}`,
    next: pos,
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { v: v >>> 0, p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (-1 << s);
  return { v: v | 0, p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x126fa;
const END   = 0x1295b;

console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`WASM size : ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        byte = buf[pos++];

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if ((byte & 0x40) !== 0 && shift < 63n) {
                result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return { value: result, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error("SLEB64 overflow");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("SLEB64 overflow");
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function localName(i: number): string {
    return `L${i}`;
}

function fmtI64(v: bigint): string {
    return v.toString();
}

type Value = string;

const stack: Value[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, Value>();

let teeCounter = 0;

function pop(): Value {
    if (stack.length === 0) {
        return "STACK_UNDERFLOW";
    }

    return stack.pop()!;
}

function push(v: Value) {
    stack.push(v);
}

function setLocal(i: number, v: Value) {
    locals.set(i, v);
}

function getLocal(i: number): Value {
    return locals.get(i) ?? localName(i);
}

function binary(op: string) {
    const b = pop();
    const a = pop();

    push(`(${a} ${op} ${b})`);
}

function printStack() {
    console.log(
        "    STACK = [" +
        stack.map((x, i) => `${i}:${x}`).join(", ") +
        "]"
    );
}

let p = START;

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log(" DECODING");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

while (p < END) {
    const at = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    try {
        switch (op) {

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // Control
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x05:
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  else`);
                break;

            case 0x0b:
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  end`);
                break;

            case 0x0f:
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  return`);
                break;

            case 0x1a: {
                const v = pop();
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  drop   ${v}`);
                break;
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // locals
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x20: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                const v = getLocal(r.value);

                push(v);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  local.get ${r.value}   => ${v}`
                );

                break;
            }

            case 0x21: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                const v = pop();
                setLocal(r.value, v);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  local.set ${r.value} = ${v}`
                );

                break;
            }

            case 0x22: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                const v = pop();

                setLocal(r.value, v);
                push(v);

                teeCounter++;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  local.tee ${r.value} = ${v}`
                );

                break;
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // i32 constants
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x41: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                push(`i32.const(${r.value})`);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i32.const ${r.value}`
                );

                break;
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // i64 constants
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x42: {
                const r = readSLEB64(p);
                p = r.next;

                push(`i64.const(${fmtI64(r.value)})`);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i64.const ${fmtI64(r.value)}`
                );

                break;
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // i32 arithmetic
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x6a:
                binary("i32.add");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.add`);
                break;

            case 0x6b:
                binary("i32.sub");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.sub`);
                break;

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // i64 arithmetic
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x7c:
                binary("+");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.add`);
                break;

            case 0x7d:
                binary("-");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.sub`);
                break;

            case 0x7e:
                binary("*");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.mul`);
                break;

            case 0x7f:
                binary("div_s");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.div_s`);
                break;

            case 0x80:
                binary("div_u");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.div_u`);
                break;

            case 0x81:
                binary("rem_s");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.rem_s`);
                break;

                binary("rem_u");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.rem_u`);
                break;

            case 0x8a:

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // comparisons
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x54:
                binary("<u");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.lt_u`);
                break;

            case 0x55:
                binary("<s");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.lt_s`);
                break;

            case 0x56:
                binary(">u");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.gt_u`);
                break;

            case 0x57:
                binary(">s");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.gt_s`);
                break;

            case 0x58:
                binary("<=u");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.le_u`);
                break;

            case 0x59:
                binary("<=s");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.le_s`);

            case 0x5a:

                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.ge_u`);
                break;

            case 0x5b:
                binary(">=s");
                console.log(`${hex(at)}  i64.ge_s`);
                break;

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // conversions
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0xa7: {
                const v = pop();
                push(`i32.wrap_i64(${v})`);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i32.wrap_i64(${v})`
                );

                break;
            }

            case 0xac: {
                const v = pop();
                push(`i64.extend8_s(${v})`);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i64.extend8_s(${v})`
                );

                break;
            }

            case 0xad: {
                const v = pop();
                push(`i64.extend32_s(${v})`);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i64.extend32_s(${v})`
                );

                break;
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // memory loads
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x29: {
                const align = buf[p++];

                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                const addr = pop();

                const expr =
                    `MEM64[${addr} + ${r.value}]`;

                push(expr);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i64.load align=${align} offset=${r.value}   => ${expr}`
                );

                break;
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // memory stores
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x37: {
                const align = buf[p++];

                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                const value = pop();
                const addr = pop();

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i64.store align=${align} offset=${r.value}` +
                    `   MEM64[${addr} + ${r.value}] = ${value}`
                );

                break;
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // calls
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x10: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                /*
                 * Function 87 has already been proven to consume:
                 *
                 *   destination
                 *   A
                 *   zero
                 *   B
                 *   zero
                 *
                 * and write LOW/HIGH to destination.
                 *
                 * For this arithmetic pass we do not emulate
                 * CALL 87 on the stack. Instead annotate it.
                 */

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  call ${r.value}`
                );

                if (r.value === 87) {
                    console.log(
                        `          [CALL87: writes 128-bit result to destination]`
                    );
                }

                break;
            }

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // select
            // ------------------------------------------------

            case 0x1b: {
                const falseValue = pop();
                const trueValue = pop();
                const cond = pop();

                const expr =
                    `(if ${cond} then ${trueValue} else ${falseValue})`;

                push(expr);

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  select => ${expr}`
                );

                break;
            }

            default:
                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
                );
                break;
        }

        /*
         * Do not print the entire stack after every instruction.
         * Only show it around important dataflow operations.
         */
        if (
            op === 0x22 ||
            op === 0x7c ||
            op === 0x7d ||
            op === 0x83 ||
            op === 0x84 ||
            op === 0x54 ||
            op === 0x56 ||
            op === 0xad ||
            op === 0x37
        ) {
            printStack();
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.log();
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(" DECODE ERROR");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(`Offset : ${hex(at)}`);
        console.log(`Opcode : 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`);
        console.log(`Error  : ${String(e)}`);
        console.log();

        break;
    }
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`teeCounter : ${teeCounter}`);
console.log(`Final PC    : ${hex(p)}`);
console.log(`End target  : ${hex(END)}`);
console.log();

console.log("FINAL LOCAL VALUES:");
for (const [k, v] of [...locals.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])) {
    console.log(`  L${k} = ${v}`);

function hx(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function sleb64(pos: number) {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];

        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if ((b & 0x40) !== 0 && shift < 63n) {
                result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return { value: result, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function pop(): Val {
    return stack.length
        ? stack.pop()!
        : "STACK_UNDERFLOW";
}

function push(v: Val) {
    stack.push(v);
}

function getLocal(n: number): Val {
    return locals.get(n) ?? `L${n}`;
}

function setLocal(n: number, v: Val) {
    locals.set(n, v);
}

function binary(symbol: string) {
    const b = pop();
    const a = pop();

    push(`(${a} ${symbol} ${b})`);
}

function emit(line: string, isImportant = false) {
    output.push(line);

    if (isImportant) {
        important.push(line);
    }
}

function stackShort() {
    if (stack.length === 0) return "[]";

    const start = Math.max(0, stack.length - 6);

    return "[" +
        stack
            .slice(start)
            .map((x, i) => `${start + i}:${x}`)
            .join(", ") +
        "]";
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number; bytes: string } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    const raw: number[] = [];

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        raw.push(b);

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value,
                next: p,
                bytes: raw.map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ")
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB too long at 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }

    throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF in ULEB at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
}

function sleb(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let p = pos;
    let byte = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        byte = wasm[p++];

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if ((byte & 0x40) !== 0 && shift < 64n) {
                result |= (-1n) << shift;
            }

            return { value: result, next: p };
        }

        if (shift >= 70n) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB too long at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }

    throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF in SLEB at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
    return n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readU32(pos: number) {
    return uleb(pos);
}

function memarg(pos: number): { align: number; offset: number; next: number } {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    const o = uleb(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: o.value,
        next: o.next
    };
}

function decodeAt(pos: number): { next: number; text: string } {
    const op = wasm[pos];

    if (op === undefined) {
        throw new Error(`EOF at 0x${hex(pos)}`);
    }

    const name = names[op];

    if (!name) {
        if (op === 0xfc) {
            const sub = uleb(pos + 1);
            return {
                next: sub.next,
                text: `0xfc <bulk-memory subopcode ${sub.value}>`
            };
        }

        if (op === 0xfd) {
            const sub = uleb(pos + 1);
            return {
                next: sub.next,
                text: `0xfd <SIMD subopcode ${sub.value}>`
            };
        }

        if (op === 0xfe) {
            const sub = uleb(pos + 1);
            return {
                next: sub.next,
                text: `0xfe <atomic subopcode ${sub.value}>`
            };
        }

        throw new Error(
            `UNKNOWN OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} at 0x${hex(pos)}`
        );
    }

    let p = pos + 1;
    let text = name;

    switch (op) {
        case 0x02:
        case 0x03:
        case 0x04: {
            const bt = wasm[p++];
            text += ` blocktype=0x${bt.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x0c:
        case 0x0d: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            text += ` ${x.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x0e: {
            const n = uleb(p);
            p = n.next;

            const labels: number[] = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                labels.push(x.value);
            }

            const def = uleb(p);
            p = def.next;

            text += ` [${labels.join(", ")}] default=${def.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            text += ` ${x.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            const table = uleb(p);
            p = table.next;
            text += ` type=${x.value} table=${table.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x20:
        case 0x21:
        case 0x22:
        case 0x23:
        case 0x24:
        case 0x25:
        case 0x26: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            text += ` ${x.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x28:
        case 0x29:
        case 0x2a:
        case 0x2b:
        case 0x2c:
        case 0x2d:
        case 0x2e:
        case 0x2f:
        case 0x30:
        case 0x31:
        case 0x32:
        case 0x33:
        case 0x34:
        case 0x35:
        case 0x36:
        case 0x37:
        case 0x38:
        case 0x39:
        case 0x3a:
        case 0x3b:
        case 0x3c:
        case 0x3d:
        case 0x3e: {
            const m = memarg(p);
            p = m.next;
            text += ` align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x3f:
        case 0x40: {
            const mem = uleb(p);
            p = mem.next;
            text += ` memory=${mem.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = sleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            text += ` ${x.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x42: {
            const x = sleb(p);
            p = x.next;
            text += ` ${x.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x43:
            p += 4;
            text += ` f32-bytes`;
            break;

        case 0x44:
            p += 8;
            text += ` f64-bytes`;
            break;
    }

    return { next: p, text };
}

        const d = decodeAt(pos);

        let raw = "";

            raw += wasm[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0") + " ";
        }

        console.log(
            `${count.toString().padStart(4)}  0x${hex(old)}  ` +

        console.log(String(e));
        console.log("!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!");

        for (let p = Math.max(START, pos - 16); p < Math.min(END, pos + 32); p += 16) {
            let raw = "";

            for (let q = p; q < Math.min(END, p + 16); q++) {
                raw += wasm[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0") + " ";
            }

            console.log(`0x${hex(p)}  ${raw}`);
        }

        process.exit(1);
    }
