import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x1226d;
const END = 0x1295b;

function hx(x: number): string {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        if (p >= wasm.length) {
            throw new Error(`EOF ULEB @ ${hx(pos)}`);
        }

        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error(`ULEB overflow @ ${hx(pos)}`);
}

function readSLEB(pos: number, bits: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let byte = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        if (p >= wasm.length) {
            throw new Error(`EOF SLEB @ ${hx(pos)}`);
        }

        byte = wasm[p++];

        value += (byte & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < bits && (byte & 0x40)) {
                value -= Math.pow(2, shift);
            }

            return { value, next: p };
        }
    }

    throw new Error(`SLEB overflow @ ${hx(pos)}`);
}

function readF32(pos: number): number {
    return pos + 4;
}

function readF64(pos: number): number {
    return pos + 8;
}

function readMemArg(pos: number): {
    align: number;
    offset: number;
    next: number;
} {
    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: o.value,
        next: o.next,
    };
}

        0xb1: "i64.trunc_f64_u",

        0xb2: "f32.convert_i32_s",
        0xb3: "f32.convert_i32_u",
        0xb4: "f32.convert_i64_s",
        0xb5: "f32.convert_i64_u",
        0xb6: "f32.demote_f64",

        0xb7: "f64.convert_i32_s",
        0xb8: "f64.convert_i32_u",
        0xb9: "f64.convert_i64_s",
        0xba: "f64.convert_i64_u",
        0xbb: "f64.promote_f32",

        0xbc: "i32.reinterpret_f32",
        0xbd: "i64.reinterpret_f64",
        0xbe: "f32.reinterpret_i32",
        0xbf: "f64.reinterpret_i64",

        0xc0: "i32.extend8_s",
        0xc1: "i32.extend16_s",
        0xc2: "i64.extend8_s",
        0xc3: "i64.extend16_s",
        0xc4: "i64.extend32_s",
    };

    return n[op] ?? `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

interface Insn {
    pos: number;
    end: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    loadOffset?: number;
}

function decode(pos: number): Insn {
    const start = pos;
    const op = wasm[pos++];

    // Control instructions
    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
        const r = readSLEB(pos, 33);
        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `${name(op)} ${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
        const r = readULEB(pos);
        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `${name(op)} ${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x0e) {
        const count = readULEB(pos);
        let p = count.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        const def = readULEB(p);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: def.next,
            op,
            text: `${name(op)} count=${count.value}`,
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const r = readULEB(pos);
        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `call ${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const a = readULEB(pos);
        const b = readULEB(a.next);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: b.next,
            op,
            text: `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`,
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x1c) {
        const n = readULEB(pos);
        let p = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
            p++;
        }

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: p,
            op,
            text: `select_t ${n.value}`,
        };
    }

    // locals
    if (op >= 0x20 && op <= 0x22) {
        const r = readULEB(pos);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `${name(op)} ${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    // globals
    if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
        const r = readULEB(pos);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `${name(op)} ${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    // tables
    if (op === 0x25 || op === 0x26) {
        const r = readULEB(pos);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `${name(op)} ${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    // memory loads/stores
    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const m = readMemArg(pos);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: m.next,
            op,
            text: `${name(op)} align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`,
            loadOffset:
                op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35
                    ? m.offset
                    : undefined,
        };
    }

    // memory size/grow
    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
        const r = readULEB(pos);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `${name(op)} memory=${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    // constants
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = readSLEB(pos, 32);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `i32.const ${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const r = readSLEB(pos, 64);

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: r.next,
            op,
            text: `i64.const ${r.value}`,
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x43) {
        return {
            pos: start,
            end: readF32(pos),
            op,
            text: "f32.const",
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x44) {
        return {
            pos: start,
            end: readF64(pos),
            op,
            text: "f64.const",
        };
    }

    // FC prefix - consume subopcode and its known immediate shapes
    if (op === 0xfc) {
        const sub = readULEB(pos);
        let p = sub.next;

        // memory/table bulk operations with immediates
        if (sub.value === 8) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        } else if (sub.value === 9) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        } else if (sub.value === 10) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        } else if (sub.value === 11) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        } else if (sub.value === 12) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        } else if (sub.value === 13) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        } else if (sub.value === 14) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        } else if (sub.value === 15 || sub.value === 16 ||
                   sub.value === 17) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        return {
            pos: start,
            end: p,
            op,
            text: `0xfc.${sub.value}`,
        };
    }

    // Default: no immediate.
    return {
        pos: start,
        end: pos,
        op,
        text: name(op),
    };
}

while (p < END) {
    try {
        const x = decode(p);

        if (x.end <= p) {
            throw new Error(`decoder stall`);
        }

        if (x.end > END) {
            throw new Error(
                `instruction crosses function end: ${hx(x.end)}`
            );
        }

        insns.push(x);
        p = x.end;
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            `DECODE ERROR @ ${hx(p)} : ${String(e)}`
        );
        break;
    }
}

function showAround(target: number, before = 8, after = 20) {
    const idx = insns.findIndex(x => x.pos === target);

    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log(`TARGET ${hx(target)}`);

    if (idx < 0) {
        console.log("NOT FOUND");
        return;
    }

    const lo = Math.max(0, idx - before);
    const hi = Math.min(insns.length, idx + after + 1);

    for (let i = lo; i < hi; i++) {
        const x = insns[i];
        const mark = x.pos === target ? " <== TARGET" : "";

        console.log(
            `${hx(x.pos)}  ${x.text}${mark}`
        );
    }
}

    if (!x) {

        continue;
    }

    console.log(
        `${hx(t)} : VALID  ${x.text}  end=${hx(x.end)}`
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const START = 0x0001226d;
const END   = 0x0001295c;

function readULEB(pos: { value: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos.value++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB128 too large");
        }
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function memArg(pos: { value: number }) {
    const align = readULEB(pos);
    const offset = readULEB(pos);

    return { align, offset };
}

function blockType(pos: { value: number }): string {
    const b = wasm[pos.value++];

    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x40: "void",
        0x7f: "i32",
        0x7e: "i64",
        0x7d: "f32",
        0x7c: "f64",
    };

    return names[b] ?? `0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

                console.log(`${hex(at)} i64.shr_s`);
                break;

            case 0x88:
                console.log(`${hex(at)} i64.shr_u`);
                break;

            case 0x89:
                console.log(`${hex(at)} i64.rotl`);
                break;

            case 0x8a:
                console.log(`${hex(at)} i64.rotr`);
                break;

            case 0xfc: {
                const pos = { value: p };
                const sub = readULEB(pos);
                p = pos.value;

                if (sub === 0x0a) {
                    const dst = readULEB(pos);
                    const src = readULEB(pos);
                    p = pos.value;

                    console.log(
                        `${hex(at)} memory.copy dstMem=${dst} srcMem=${src}`
                    );
                } else if (sub === 0x0b) {
                    const mem = readULEB(pos);
                    p = pos.value;

                    console.log(
                        `${hex(at)} memory.fill memidx=${mem}`
                    );
                } else {
                    console.log(
                        `${hex(at)} 0xfc subopcode=${sub}`
                    );
                }

                break;
            }

            default:
                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)} UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
                );

                console.log();
                console.log(`Stopped at ${hex(at)}`);
                process.exit(0);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.log();
        console.log(`DECODER ERROR at ${hex(at)}`);
        console.log(e);
        process.exit(1);
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { v: v >>> 0, p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
    v |= (-1 << s);
  }

  return { v: v | 0, p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  let codeStart = 0;
  let codeEnd = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    const size = s.v;
    p = s.p;

    const payload = p;

    if (id === 10) {
      codeStart = payload;
      codeEnd = payload + size;
      break;
    }

    p += size;
  }

  return { codeStart, codeEnd };
}

function u8(p: number): number {
  if (p >= wasm.length) throw new Error(`EOF @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
  return wasm[p];
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(p++);
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error(`ULEB too large @ 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
    }
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number, bits = 32): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = u8(p++);
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > bits + 7) {
      throw new Error(`SLEB too large @ 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
    }
  }

  if (shift < bits && (b & 0x40)) {
    value -= 2 ** shift;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 0): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function hexBytes(start: number, end: number): string {
  return Array.from(wasm.slice(start, end))
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");
}

function readName(pos: number): { name: string; next: number } {
  const n = readULEB(pos);
  const start = n.next;
  const end = start + n.value;

  return {
    name: Buffer.from(wasm.slice(start, end)).toString("utf8"),
    next: end,
  };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
 * WASM section discovery
 * ------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface Section {
  id: number;
  start: number;
  payloadStart: number;
  payloadEnd: number;
  size: number;
}

function parseSections(): Section[] {
  const sections: Section[] = [];

  if (
    wasm[0] !== 0x00 ||
    wasm[1] !== 0x61 ||
    wasm[2] !== 0x73 ||
    wasm[3] !== 0x6d
  ) {
    throw new Error("Not a WASM binary");
  }

  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const start = p;
    const id = u8(p++);

    const sz = readULEB(p);
    p = sz.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + sz.value;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start,
      payloadStart,
      payloadEnd,
      size: sz.value,
    });

    p = payloadEnd;
  }

  return sections;
}

interface FuncType {
  params: number[];
  results: number[];
}

function valTypeName(t: number): string {
  switch (t) {
    case 0x7f: return "i32";
    case 0x7e: return "i64";
    case 0x7d: return "f32";
    case 0x7c: return "f64";
    case 0x7b: return "v128";
    case 0x70: return "funcref";
    case 0x6f: return "externref";
    default: return `type(0x${t.toString(16)})`;
  }
}

  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const form = u8(p++);

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      throw new Error(
        `Unsupported type form 0x${form.toString(16)} @ ${hex(p - 1)}`
      );
    }

    const pc = readULEB(p);
    p = pc.next;

    const params: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
      params.push(u8(p++));
    }

    const rc = readULEB(p);
    p = rc.next;

    const results: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
      results.push(u8(p++));
    }

    types.push({ params, results });
  }
}

function decodeMemArg(p: number): {
  text: string;
  next: number;
} {
  const align = readULEB(p);
  p = align.next;

  const offset = readULEB(p);
  p = offset.next;

  return {
    text:
      `align=${align.value}` +
      ` offset=${offset.value}` +
      ` (${hex(offset.value)})`,
    next: p,
  };
}

function decodeInstruction(pos: number): {
  next: number;
  text: string;
} {
  const opPos = pos;
  const op = u8(pos++);

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00: return { next: pos, text: "unreachable" };
    case 0x01: return { next: pos, text: "nop" };

    case 0x02: {
      const b = readSLEB(pos, 33);
      return { next: b.next, text: `block ${hex(b.value)}` };
    }

    case 0x03: {
      const b = readSLEB(pos, 33);
      return { next: b.next, text: `loop ${hex(b.value)}` };
    }

    case 0x04: {
      const b = readSLEB(pos, 33);
      return { next: b.next, text: `if ${hex(b.value)}` };
    }

    case 0x05:
      return { next: pos, text: "else" };

    case 0x0b:
      return { next: pos, text: "end" };

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `br ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `br_if ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x0e: {
      const n = readULEB(pos);
      pos = n.next;

      const labels: number[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const x = readULEB(pos);
        pos = x.next;
        labels.push(x.value);
      }

      const def = readULEB(pos);
      pos = def.next;

      return {
        next: pos,
        text: `br_table [${labels.join(", ")}] default=${def.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x0f:
      return { next: pos, text: "return" };

    case 0x10: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `call ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      pos = x.next;

      const table = readULEB(pos);
      pos = table.next;

      return {
        next: pos,
        text: `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${table.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x1a:
      return { next: pos, text: "drop" };

    case 0x1b:
      return { next: pos, text: "select" };

    case 0x20: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `local.get ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `local.set ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `local.tee ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `global.get ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `global.set ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i32.load ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x29: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.load ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x2a: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `f32.load ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x2b: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `f64.load ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x2c: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i32.load8_s ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x2d: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i32.load8_u ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x2e: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i32.load16_s ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x2f: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i32.load16_u ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x30: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.load8_s ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x31: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.load8_u ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x32: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.load16_s ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x33: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.load16_u ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x34: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.load32_s ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x35: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.load32_u ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i32.store ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x37: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.store ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x38: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `f32.store ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x39: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `f64.store ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x3a: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i32.store8 ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x3b: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i32.store16 ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x3c: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.store8 ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x3d: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.store16 ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x3e: {
      const m = decodeMemArg(pos);
      return { next: m.next, text: `i64.store32 ${m.text}` };
    }

    case 0x3f: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `memory.size ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x40: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `memory.grow ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos, 32);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `i32.const ${x.value} (${hex((x.value >>> 0))})`,
      };
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos, 64);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x43: {
      const bytes = hexBytes(pos, pos + 4);
      return { next: pos + 4, text: `f32.const ${bytes}` };
    }

    case 0x44: {
      const bytes = hexBytes(pos, pos + 8);
      return { next: pos + 8, text: `f64.const ${bytes}` };
    }

    /* i32 */
    case 0x45: return { next: pos, text: "i32.eqz" };
    case 0x46: return { next: pos, text: "i32.eq" };
    case 0x47: return { next: pos, text: "i32.ne" };
    case 0x48: return { next: pos, text: "i32.lt_s" };
    case 0x49: return { next: pos, text: "i32.lt_u" };
    case 0x4a: return { next: pos, text: "i32.gt_s" };
    case 0x4b: return { next: pos, text: "i32.gt_u" };
    case 0x4c: return { next: pos, text: "i32.le_s" };
    case 0x4d: return { next: pos, text: "i32.le_u" };
    case 0x4e: return { next: pos, text: "i32.ge_s" };
    case 0x4f: return { next: pos, text: "i32.ge_u" };

    case 0x50: return { next: pos, text: "i64.eqz" };
    case 0x51: return { next: pos, text: "i64.eq" };
    case 0x52: return { next: pos, text: "i64.ne" };
    case 0x53: return { next: pos, text: "i64.lt_s" };
    case 0x54: return { next: pos, text: "i64.lt_u" };
    case 0x55: return { next: pos, text: "i64.gt_s" };
    case 0x56: return { next: pos, text: "i64.gt_u" };
    case 0x57: return { next: pos, text: "i64.le_s" };
    case 0x58: return { next: pos, text: "i64.le_u" };
    case 0x59: return { next: pos, text: "i64.ge_s" };
    case 0x5a: return { next: pos, text: "i64.ge_u" };

    case 0x5b: return { next: pos, text: "f32.eq" };
    case 0x5c: return { next: pos, text: "f32.ne" };
    case 0x5d: return { next: pos, text: "f32.lt" };
    case 0x5e: return { next: pos, text: "f32.gt" };
    case 0x5f: return { next: pos, text: "f32.le" };
    case 0x60: return { next: pos, text: "f32.ge" };
    case 0x61: return { next: pos, text: "f64.eq" };
    case 0x62: return { next: pos, text: "f64.ne" };
    case 0x63: return { next: pos, text: "f64.lt" };
    case 0x64: return { next: pos, text: "f64.gt" };
    case 0x65: return { next: pos, text: "f64.le" };
    case 0x66: return { next: pos, text: "f64.ge" };

    case 0x67: return { next: pos, text: "i32.clz" };
    case 0x68: return { next: pos, text: "i32.ctz" };
    case 0x69: return { next: pos, text: "i32.popcnt" };
    case 0x6a: return { next: pos, text: "i32.add" };
    case 0x6b: return { next: pos, text: "i32.sub" };
    case 0x6c: return { next: pos, text: "i32.mul" };
    case 0x6d: return { next: pos, text: "i32.div_s" };
    case 0x6e: return { next: pos, text: "i32.div_u" };
    case 0x6f: return { next: pos, text: "i32.rem_s" };
    case 0x70: return { next: pos, text: "i32.rem_u" };
    case 0x71: return { next: pos, text: "i32.and" };
    case 0x72: return { next: pos, text: "i32.or" };
    case 0x73: return { next: pos, text: "i32.xor" };
    case 0x74: return { next: pos, text: "i32.shl" };
    case 0x75: return { next: pos, text: "i32.shr_s" };
    case 0x76: return { next: pos, text: "i32.shr_u" };
    case 0x77: return { next: pos, text: "i32.rotl" };
    case 0x78: return { next: pos, text: "i32.rotr" };

    /* i64 */
    case 0x79: return { next: pos, text: "i64.clz" };
    case 0x7a: return { next: pos, text: "i64.ctz" };
    case 0x7b: return { next: pos, text: "i64.popcnt" };
    case 0x7c: return { next: pos, text: "i64.add" };
    case 0x7d: return { next: pos, text: "i64.sub" };
    case 0x7e: return { next: pos, text: "i64.mul" };
    case 0x7f: return { next: pos, text: "i64.div_s" };
    case 0x80: return { next: pos, text: "i64.div_u" };
    case 0x81: return { next: pos, text: "i64.rem_s" };
    case 0x82: return { next: pos, text: "i64.rem_u" };
    case 0x83: return { next: pos, text: "i64.and" };
    case 0x84: return { next: pos, text: "i64.or" };
    case 0x85: return { next: pos, text: "i64.xor" };
    case 0x86: return { next: pos, text: "i64.shl" };
    case 0x87: return { next: pos, text: "i64.shr_s" };
    case 0x88: return { next: pos, text: "i64.shr_u" };
    case 0x89: return { next: pos, text: "i64.rotl" };
    case 0x8a: return { next: pos, text: "i64.rotr" };

    /* conversions */
    case 0xa7: return { next: pos, text: "i32.wrap_i64" };
    case 0xac: return { next: pos, text: "i64.extend_i32_s" };
    case 0xad: return { next: pos, text: "i64.extend_i32_u" };

    /* common float/conversion */
    case 0xaa: return { next: pos, text: "i64.trunc_f32_s" };
    case 0xab: return { next: pos, text: "i64.trunc_f32_u" };
    case 0xae: return { next: pos, text: "i64.extend32_s" };

    /* sign extension */
    case 0xc0: return { next: pos, text: "i32.extend8_s" };
    case 0xc1: return { next: pos, text: "i32.extend16_s" };
    case 0xc2: return { next: pos, text: "i64.extend8_s" };
    case 0xc3: return { next: pos, text: "i64.extend16_s" };
    case 0xc4: return { next: pos, text: "i64.extend32_s" };

    /* prefixes */
    case 0xfc: {
      const sub = readULEB(pos);
      return {
        next: sub.next,
        text: `0xfc subopcode=${sub.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0xfd: {
      const sub = readULEB(pos);
      return {
        next: sub.next,
        text: `0xfd subopcode=${sub.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0xfe: {
      const sub = readULEB(pos);
      return {
        next: sub.next,
        text: `0xfe subopcode=${sub.value}`,
      };
    }

    default:
      return {
        next: pos,
        text: `UNKNOWN op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      };
  }
}

let p = targetBody.bodyStart;

p = localDeclCount.next;

interface LocalDecl {
  count: number;
  type: number;
}

const localDecls: LocalDecl[] = [];

  p = n.next;

  const type = u8(p++);

  localDecls.push({
    count: n.value,
    type,
  });

  totalLocals += n.value;
}

console.log(` total local slots : ${totalLocalSlots}`);

for (const d of localDecls) {
  console.log(
    ` local ${localIndex}..${localIndex + d.count - 1}` +
    ` : ${d.count} x ${valTypeName(d.type)}`
  );

  localIndex += d.count;

  const start = p;

  let decoded;

  try {
    decoded = decodeInstruction(p);
  } catch (e) {
    console.log();
    console.log(
      `DECODE ERROR @ ${hex(start, 8)}: ${
        e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
      }`
    );
    console.log(
      `remaining bytes: ${hexBytes(start, targetBody.bodyEnd)}`
    );
    break;
  }

  const bytes = hexBytes(start, decoded.next);

  console.log(
    `${hex(start, 8)}  ` +
    `${bytes.padEnd(38)}  ` +
    `${decoded.text}`
  );

  if (decoded.text.startsWith("UNKNOWN")) {
    unknownCount++;
  }

  instructionCount++;
  p = decoded.next;
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = process.argv[2];

if (!wasmPath) {
    console.error("WASM path is required.");
    process.exit(1);
}

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x122dc;
const END = 0x12303;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (b & 0x40) {
                value -= 1n << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function opname(op: number): string {
    const n: Record<number, string> = {
        0x0b: "end",
        0x10: "call",
        0x1a: "drop",

        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",
        0x83: "i64.and",
        0x84: "i64.or",
        0x85: "i64.xor",
        0x86: "i64.shl",
        0x87: "i64.shr_s",
        0x88: "i64.shr_u",
    };

    return n[op] ?? `OP_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

const stack: string[] = [];

function pop(): string {
    return stack.length
        ? stack.pop()!
        : "<UNDERFLOW>";
}

function push(x: string) {
    stack.push(x);
}

function showStack(): string {
    return "[" + stack.join(", ") + "]";
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 205 LOCAL11 PRODUCER v2");
console.log(" EXACT STACK EXPRESSION");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

console.log(`WASM size : ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Range     : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log();

let p = START;

while (p < END) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    let desc = opname(op);

    switch (op) {

        case 0x20: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            desc += ` ${x.value}`;
            push(`L${x.value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            const v = pop();

            desc += ` ${x.value} <= ${v}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            const v = stack.length
                ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                : "<UNDERFLOW>";

            desc += ` ${x.value} <= ${v}`;

            if (x.value === 11) {
                console.log();
                console.log("******** LOCAL11 PRODUCER ********");
                console.log(`address : 0x${addr.toString(16)}`);
                console.log(`value   : ${v}`);
                console.log(`stack   : ${showStack()}`);
                console.log("**********************************");
                console.log();
            }

            break;
        }

        case 0x23: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            desc += ` ${x.value}`;
            push(`G${x.value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x24: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            const v = pop();

            desc += ` ${x.value} <= ${v}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            /*
             * i32.const is normally not needed for the i64 expression,
             * but parse its signed LEB correctly.
             */
            let value = 0;
            let shift = 0;
            let b = 0;

            while (true) {
                b = buf[p++];
                value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
                shift += 7;

                if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value -= 2 ** shift;
            }

            desc += ` ${value}`;
            push(`${value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x42: {
            const x = readSLEB64(p);
            p = x.next;

            desc += ` ${x.value}`;
            push(`${x.value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x29: {
            const a = readULEB(p);
            p = a.next;

            const o = readULEB(p);
            p = o.next;

            const base = pop();

            const expr = `MEM64[${base}+0x${o.value.toString(16)}]`;

            desc +=
                ` align=${a.value}` +
                ` offset=${o.value} => ${expr}`;

            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x6a: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} + ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x6b: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} - ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x7c: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} + ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x7d: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} - ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x7e: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} * ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x83: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} & ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x84: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} | ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x85: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} ^ ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x86: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} << ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x87: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} >>s ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x88: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            const expr = `(${a} >>u ${b})`;

            desc += ` => ${expr}`;
            push(expr);
            break;
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            /*
             * Function 87 has:
             *   (i32, i64, i64, i64, i64) -> ()
             *
             * We do not know stack boundaries automatically here,
             * so preserve the call marker instead of corrupting
             * the expression.
             */
            desc += ` ${x.value}`;

            if (x.value === 87) {
                desc += " [FUNCTION 87]";
            }

            break;
        }

        case 0x1a: {
            const v = pop();

            desc += ` drop ${v}`;
            break;
        }

        default:
            desc += " [UNHANDLED]";
            break;
    }

    console.log(
        `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ` +
        `${desc.padEnd(65)} STACK=${showStack()}`
    );
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = process.argv[2];

if (!wasmPath) {
    console.error("WASM path is required.");
    process.exit(1);
}

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x1226d;
const END = 0x12290;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value -= 2 ** shift;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if ((b & 0x40) !== 0) {
                value -= 1n << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function hx(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function opname(op: number): string {
    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x0b: "end",
        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",
        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",
        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2a: "f32.load",
        0x2b: "f64.load",
        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",
        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",
        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x10: "call",
        0x1a: "drop",
        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",
        0x48: "i32.lt_s",
        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
        0x50: "i64.eqz"
    };

    return names[op] ?? `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

    p = countInfo.next;

    const type = buf[p++];

    console.log(
        `  group ${g}: count=${countInfo.value} ` +
        `type=0x${type.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} ` +
        `locals=${totalLocals}..${totalLocals + countInfo.value - 1}`
    );

    totalLocals += countInfo.value;
}

const stack: string[] = [];

function push(x: string) {
    stack.push(x);
}

function pop(): string {
    return stack.length ? stack.pop()! : "<STACK_UNDERFLOW>";
}

function showStack() {
    if (stack.length === 0) {
        return "[]";
    }

    return "[" + stack.join(", ") + "]";
}

while (p < END) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    let text = opname(op);

    switch (op) {
        case 0x20: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            text += ` ${x.value}`;

            push(`L${x.value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            const v = pop();

            text += ` ${x.value}    <= ${v}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            const v = stack.length
                ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                : "<STACK_UNDERFLOW>";

            text += ` ${x.value}    <= ${v}`;

            /*
             * local.tee keeps the value on stack.
             */
            break;
        }

        case 0x23: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            text += ` ${x.value}`;

            push(`G${x.value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x24: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            const v = pop();

            text += ` ${x.value}    <= ${v}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = readSLEB32(p);
            p = x.next;

            text += ` ${x.value} (${hx(x.value >>> 0)})`;

            push(`${x.value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x42: {
            const x = readSLEB64(p);
            p = x.next;

            text += ` ${x.value}`;

            push(`${x.value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x6a: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            text += `    ${a} + ${b}`;

            push(`(${a}+${b})`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x6b: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            text += `    ${a} - ${b}`;

            push(`(${a}-${b})`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x28:
        case 0x29: {
            const align = readULEB(p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readULEB(p);
            p = offset.next;

            const a = pop();

            text +=
                ` align=${align.value}` +
                ` offset=${offset.value}` +
                `    mem[${a}+${offset.value}]`;

            push(`MEM[${a}+${offset.value}]`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x36:
        case 0x37: {
            const align = readULEB(p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readULEB(p);
            p = offset.next;

            const value = pop();
            const addrExpr = pop();

            text +=
                ` align=${align.value}` +
                ` offset=${offset.value}` +
                `    MEM[${addrExpr}+${offset.value}] = ${value}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;

            text += ` ${x.value}`;

            /*
             * We don't attempt signature-based argument popping here.
             * The goal of this first pass is the local2 producer.
             */
            break;
        }

        case 0x1a: {
            const v = pop();
            text += `    drop ${v}`;
            break;
        }

        default:
            /*
             * Stop rather than silently mis-decoding.
             */
            console.log(
                `${hx(addr)}  ${text}  [decoder stop]`
            );

            console.log();
            console.log("DECODER STOP");
            console.log(`offset : ${hx(addr)}`);
            console.log(`opcode : 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`);
            console.log(`stack  : ${showStack()}`);
            process.exit(0);
    }

    console.log(
        `${hx(addr)}  ${text.padEnd(55)} STACK=${showStack()}`
    );
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" END");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`final offset : ${hx(p)}`);
console.log(`stack        : ${showStack()}`);

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = process.argv[2];

if (!wasmPath) {
    console.error("WASM path is required.");
    process.exit(1);
}

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const WINDOWS = [
    { name: "LOCAL17", start: 0x12320, end: 0x12350 },
    { name: "LOCAL34", start: 0x12435, end: 0x12460 },
];

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (b & 0x40) {
                value -= 1n << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value -= 2 ** shift;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function name(op: number): string {
    const n: Record<number, string> = {
        0x03: "block",
        0x04: "if",
        0x05: "else",
        0x0b: "end",
        0x0c: "br",
        0x0d: "br_if",
        0x0f: "return",
        0x10: "call",

        0x1a: "drop",

        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",

        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",
        0x7f: "i64.div_s",
        0x80: "i64.div_u",
        0x81: "i64.rem_s",
        0x82: "i64.rem_u",
        0x83: "i64.and",
        0x84: "i64.or",
        0x85: "i64.xor",
        0x86: "i64.shl",
        0x87: "i64.shr_s",
        0x88: "i64.shr_u",
    };

    return n[op] ?? `OP_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function decodeWindow(
    label: string,
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(` ${label}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const addr = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        let extra = "";

        switch (op) {

            case 0x20:
            case 0x21:
            case 0x22:
            case 0x23:
            case 0x24: {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                extra = ` ${x.value}`;

                if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
                    extra += `   [local${x.value}]`;
                }

                break;
            }

            case 0x41: {
                const x = readSLEB32(p);
                p = x.next;

                extra =
                    ` ${x.value}` +
                    ` (0x${(x.value >>> 0).toString(16)})`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x42: {
                const x = readSLEB64(p);
                p = x.next;

                extra = ` ${x.value}`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x28:
            case 0x29:
            case 0x36:
            case 0x37: {
                const a = readULEB(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = readULEB(p);
                p = o.next;

                extra =
                    ` align=${a.value}` +
                    ` offset=${o.value}` +
                    ` (0x${o.value.toString(16)})`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x10: {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                extra = ` ${x.value}`;

                if (x.value === 87) {
                    extra += "   [FUNCTION 87]";
                }

                break;
            }

            case 0x03:
            case 0x04: {
                const type = buf[p++];
                extra =
                    ` type=0x${type.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0c:
            case 0x0d: {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                extra = ` ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            default:
                break;
        }

        console.log(
            `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ` +
            `${name(op).padEnd(16)}${extra}`
        );
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;
const CODE_START = 0x6e7d;
const CODE_END = 0x324ef5;
const TARGET_FUNC = 2094;

function readULEB(offset: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = offset;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        if (x === undefined) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB EOF at 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }

        value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB too long at 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB(offset: number): {
    value: bigint;
    next: number;
} {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let p = offset;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[p++];

        if (byte === undefined) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB EOF at 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if ((shift < 64n) && (byte & 0x40)) {
                result |= (-1n) << shift;
            }

            return {
                value: result,
                next: p,
            };
        }

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB too long at 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }
}

function hex(v: number): string {
    return `0x${v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`;
}

function i64hex(v: bigint): string {
    let x = v;

    if (x < 0n) {
        x = (1n << 64n) + x;
    }

    return `0x${x.toString(16).padStart(16, "0")}`;
}

function u32(offset: number): number {
    return (
        b[offset] |
        (b[offset + 1] << 8) |
        (b[offset + 2] << 16) |
        (b[offset + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

    sizeField: number;
    codeStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;

     * Constants
     */
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = readSLEB(pc);
        pc = x.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(start)}  i32.const        ${x.value.toString()}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = readSLEB(pc);
        pc = x.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(start)}  i64.const        ${x.value.toString()} ` +
            `[${i64hex(x.value)}]`
        );

        continue;
    }

    /*
     * Everything else in OPCODES is one byte.
     */
    console.log(
        `${hex(start)}  ${name}`
    );
}

console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`Final PC     : ${hex(pc)}`);
console.log(`Body end     : ${hex(target.bodyEnd)}`);

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;
const CODE_START = 0x6e7d;
const CODE_END = 0x324ef5;
const TARGET_FUNC = 2094;

function readULEB(offset: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = offset;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        if (x === undefined) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB EOF @ 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }

        value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB too long @ 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB(offset: number) {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let p = offset;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        if (x === undefined) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB EOF @ 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }

        result |= BigInt(x & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 64n && (x & 0x40)) {
                result |= (-1n) << shift;
            }

            return {
                value: result,
                next: p,
            };
        }

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB too long @ 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return `0x${v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`;
}

let p = CODE_START;

const functionCount = fc.value;

    bodyIndex: number;
    realIndex: number;
    sizeField: number;
    codeStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;
}[] = [];

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < functionCount; bodyIndex++) {
    const sizeField = p;

    const s = readULEB(p);
    const codeStart = s.next;
    const bodyEnd = codeStart + s.value;

    funcs.push({
        bodyIndex,
        realIndex: IMPORT_COUNT + bodyIndex,
        sizeField,
        codeStart,
        bodyEnd,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
}

if (p !== CODE_END) {
    throw new Error(
        `Function map mismatch: ${hex(p)} != ${hex(CODE_END)}`
    );
}

const target = funcs.find(f => f.realIndex === TARGET_FUNC);

if (!target) {
    throw new Error(`Function ${TARGET_FUNC} not found`);
}

console.log(`Function bodies : ${functionCount}`);
console.log(`Target Function : ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log(`Body #          : ${target.bodyIndex}`);
console.log(`Size field      : ${hex(target.sizeField)}`);
console.log(`Code start      : ${hex(target.codeStart)}`);
console.log(`Body end        : ${hex(target.bodyEnd)}`);
console.log(`Code bytes      : ${target.bodyEnd - target.codeStart}`);

while (pc < target.bodyEnd) {
    const start = pc;
    const op = b[pc++];

    if (op === undefined) {
        throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF @ ${hex(start)}`);
    }

    instructionCount++;

    const name = NAME[op];

    if (!name && op !== 0xfc) {
        console.log(
            `${hex(start)}  op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}  UNKNOWN`
        );

        console.log("");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log("TRACE STOP");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`Offset               : ${hex(start)}`);
        console.log(
            `Opcode               : 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
        );
        console.log(`Decoded instructions : ${instructionCount}`);
        console.log(`Expected body end    : ${hex(target.bodyEnd)}`);
        console.log("");
        console.log("Unknown opcode encountered.");
        console.log("No bytes after this opcode were guessed.");

        process.exit(0);
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * block / loop / if
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
        const bt = b[pc++];

        if (bt === undefined) {
            throw new Error(
                `Missing blocktype @ ${hex(start)}`
            );
        }

        console.log(
            `${hex(start)}  ${name.padEnd(17)} ` +
            `blocktype=0x${bt.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * else / end
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op === 0x05 || op === 0x0b) {
        console.log(`${hex(start)}  ${name}`);
        continue;
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * br / br_if
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

        pc = x.next;

        );

        continue;

     * br_table
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op === 0x0e) {

        pc = n.next;

            const x = readULEB(pc);
            pc = x.next;
            labels.push(x.value);
        }

     * call_indirect
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const type = readULEB(pc);
        pc = type.next;

        pc = table.next;

     * --------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Every memory opcode has:
     *
     *   align  : ULEB128
     *   offset : ULEB128
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const align = readULEB(pc);
        pc = align.next;

        const memOffset = readULEB(pc);
        pc = memOffset.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(start)}  ${name.padEnd(17)} ` +
            `align=${align.value} offset=${memOffset.value}`

        if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) {
            loads.push({
                offset: start,
                opcode: op,

                memOffset: memOffset.value,
            });

            stores.push({
                offset: start,
                opcode: op,
                name,
                align: align.value,
                memOffset: memOffset.value,
            });
        }

     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * i32.const
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = readSLEB(pc);
        pc = x.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(start)}  i32.const         ${x.value.toString()}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * i64.const
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = readSLEB(pc);
        pc = x.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(start)}  i64.const         ${x.value.toString()}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * 0xfc EXTENDED OPCODES
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * 0xfc is an extended-opcode prefix.
     *
     * The subopcode immediately following 0xfc is ULEB128.
     *
     * Known bulk-memory / table instructions:
     *
     *   0x08 memory.init
     *   0x09 data.drop
     *   0x0a memory.copy
     *   0x0b memory.fill
     *   0x0c table.init
     *   0x0d elem.drop
     *   0x0e table.copy
     *   0x0f table.grow
     *   0x10 table.size
     *   0x11 table.fill
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    if (op === 0xfc) {
        const sub = readULEB(pc);
        pc = sub.next;

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * memory.init
         *
         * immediates:
         *   data index : ULEB128
         *   memory     : ULEB128
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x08) {
            const dataIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = dataIndex.next;

            const memoryIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = memoryIndex.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  memory.init       ` +
                `data=${dataIndex.value} memory=${memoryIndex.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * data.drop
         *
         * immediate:
         *   data index : ULEB128
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x09) {
            const dataIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = dataIndex.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  data.drop         ` +
                `data=${dataIndex.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * memory.copy
         *
         * immediates:
         *   destination memory index : ULEB128
         *   source memory index      : ULEB128
         *
         * We deliberately decode BOTH values.
         * We do not assume they are zero.
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x0a) {
            const dstMemory = readULEB(pc);
            pc = dstMemory.next;

            const srcMemory = readULEB(pc);
            pc = srcMemory.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  memory.copy       ` +
                `dst=${dstMemory.value} src=${srcMemory.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * memory.fill
         *
         * immediate:
         *   memory index : ULEB128
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x0b) {
            const memoryIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = memoryIndex.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  memory.fill       ` +
                `memory=${memoryIndex.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * table.init
         *
         * immediates:
         *   element index : ULEB128
         *   table index    : ULEB128
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x0c) {
            const elemIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = elemIndex.next;

            const tableIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = tableIndex.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  table.init        ` +
                `elem=${elemIndex.value} table=${tableIndex.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * elem.drop
         *
         * immediate:
         *   element index : ULEB128
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x0d) {
            const elemIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = elemIndex.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  elem.drop         ` +
                `elem=${elemIndex.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * table.copy
         *
         * immediates:
         *   destination table : ULEB128
         *   source table      : ULEB128
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x0e) {
            const dstTable = readULEB(pc);
            pc = dstTable.next;

            const srcTable = readULEB(pc);
            pc = srcTable.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  table.copy        ` +
                `dst=${dstTable.value} src=${srcTable.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * table.grow
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x0f) {
            const tableIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = tableIndex.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  table.grow        ` +
                `table=${tableIndex.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * table.size
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x10) {
            const tableIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = tableIndex.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  table.size        ` +
                `table=${tableIndex.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * table.fill
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        if (sub.value === 0x11) {
            const tableIndex = readULEB(pc);
            pc = tableIndex.next;

            console.log(
                `${hex(start)}  table.fill        ` +
                `table=${tableIndex.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         * Unknown 0xfc subopcode
         * ----------------------------------------------------
         */

        console.log("");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log("TRACE STOP");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`Offset               : ${hex(start)}`);
        console.log(`Opcode               : 0xfc`);
        console.log(`Subopcode            : ${hex(sub.value)}`);
        console.log(`Decoded instructions : ${instructionCount}`);
        console.log(`Expected body end    : ${hex(target.bodyEnd)}`);
        console.log("");
        console.log("Unknown 0xfc subopcode.");
        console.log("No bytes after this opcode were guessed.");

        process.exit(0);
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * One-byte numeric opcode
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log(
        `${hex(start)}  ${name}`
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_GLOBAL = 2330;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= wasm.length)
            throw new Error("ULEB past EOF");

        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35)
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow at 0x" + pos.toString(16));
    }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            break;

        if (shift > 35)
            throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos
    };
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = 8;

let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (p < wasm.length) {

    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (id === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0)
    throw new Error("Code section not found");

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// ------------------------------------------------------------

const fc = uleb(codeStart);
const functionCount = fc.value;

let bodyPos = fc.next;

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x00018c42;
const END   = 0x00018c62;

function readULEB(pos: { value: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos.value++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 249 DECODER v1");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

let p = START;

/*
 * Function body begins with local declarations.
 *
 * First byte:
 *   01 = one local declaration group
 *
 * Then:
 *   02 7f
 *
 * means:
 *   two i32 locals
 */

const localGroups = wasm[p++];

console.log(
    `${hex(START)} local.decl.groups = ${localGroups}`
);

for (let i = 0; i < localGroups; i++) {
    const countPos = { value: p };
    const count = readULEB(countPos);
    p = countPos.value;

    const type = wasm[p++];

    const typeName =
        type === 0x7f ? "i32" :
        type === 0x7e ? "i64" :
        type === 0x7d ? "f32" :
        type === 0x7c ? "f64" :
        `0x${type.toString(16)}`;

    console.log(
        `  group ${i}: ${count} × ${typeName}`
    );
}

while (p < END) {
    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    switch (op) {

        case 0x20: {
            const tmp = { value: p };
            const local = readULEB(tmp);
            p = tmp.value;
            console.log(`${hex(at)} local.get ${local}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const tmp = { value: p };
            const local = readULEB(tmp);
            p = tmp.value;
            console.log(`${hex(at)} local.set ${local}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const tmp = { value: p };
            const local = readULEB(tmp);
            p = tmp.value;
            console.log(`${hex(at)} local.tee ${local}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const tmp = { value: p };
            const value = readULEB(tmp);
            p = tmp.value;
            console.log(`${hex(at)} i32.const ${value}`);
            break;
        }

        case 0x04: {
            const blockType = wasm[p++];

            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} if blockType=0x${blockType.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0x05:
            console.log(`${hex(at)} else`);
            break;

        case 0x0b:
            console.log(`${hex(at)} end`);
            break;

        case 0x10: {
            const tmp = { value: p };
            const funcIndex = readULEB(tmp);
            p = tmp.value;

            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} call ${funcIndex}`
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0xfc: {
            const tmp = { value: p };
            const subOpcode = readULEB(tmp);
            p = tmp.value;

            if (subOpcode === 0x0a) {
                const tmp1 = { value: p };
                const dstMem = readULEB(tmp1);
                p = tmp1.value;

                const tmp2 = { value: p };
                const srcMem = readULEB(tmp2);
                p = tmp2.value;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)} memory.copy dstMem=${dstMem} srcMem=${srcMem}`
                );
            } else {
                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)} 0xfc subopcode=${subOpcode}`
                );
            }

            break;
        }

        case 0x45:
            console.log(`${hex(at)} i32.eqz`);
            break;

        default:
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)} UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
            );

            console.log();
            console.log(`Stopped at ${hex(at)}`);

            process.exit(0);
    }
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" END");
console.log("============================================================");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function i32(n: number) {
    return n | 0;
}

function decode(pos: number) {
    const op = wasm[pos];

    switch (op) {
        case 0x20: {
            const r = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return [`local.get ${r.value}`, r.next];
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const r = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return [`local.set ${r.value}`, r.next];
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const r = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return [`local.tee ${r.value}`, r.next];
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const r = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return [`i32.const ${hex(r.value)}`, r.next];
        }

        case 0x42: {
            const r = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return [`i64.const ${r.value}`, r.next];
        }

        case 0x28: {
            const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
            const b = readULEB(a.next);
            return [`i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${hex(b.value)}`, b.next];
        }

        case 0x36: {
            const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
            const b = readULEB(a.next);
            return [`i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${hex(b.value)}`, b.next];
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
            const b = readULEB(a.next);
            return [`i64.store align=${a.value} offset=${hex(b.value)}`, b.next];
        }

        case 0x6a: return ["i32.add", pos + 1];
        case 0x6b: return ["i32.sub", pos + 1];
        case 0x68: return ["i32.mul", pos + 1];
        case 0x71: return ["i32.and", pos + 1];
        case 0x72: return ["i32.or", pos + 1];
        case 0x73: return ["i32.xor", pos + 1];
        case 0x74: return ["i32.shr_u", pos + 1];
        case 0x75: return ["i32.shr_s", pos + 1];
        case 0x76: return ["i32.rotl", pos + 1];
        case 0x77: return ["i32.rotr", pos + 1];

        case 0x45: return ["i32.eqz", pos + 1];
        case 0x46: return ["i32.eq", pos + 1];
        case 0x47: return ["i32.ne", pos + 1];

        case 0x0b: return ["end", pos + 1];
        case 0x0c: {
            const r = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return [`br ${r.value}`, r.next];
        }
        case 0x0d: {
            const r = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return [`br_if ${r.value}`, r.next];
        }

        case 0x04: return ["if", pos + 1];
        case 0x03: return ["loop", pos + 1];
        case 0x02: return ["block", pos + 1];

        case 0x1b: return ["select", pos + 1];

        default:
            return [`op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`, pos + 1];
    }
}

function uleb(offset: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = offset;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) break;
    }

    return null;
}

function hex(bytes: number[]) {
    return bytes
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}
