function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value -= Math.pow(2, shift);
            }

            return {
                value,
                next: p
            };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid SLEB128");
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number) {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40)) {
                value -= 1n << shift;
            }

            return {
                value,
                next: p
            };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid SLEB128 i64");
}

function hex8(x: number) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function raw(pos: number, n = 32) {
    return Array.from(
        wasm.subarray(pos, Math.min(pos + n, END))
    )
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

    addr: number,

        `align=${align.value} offset=${hex8(offset.value)}`
    );

    console.log(`             RAW: ${raw(addr)}`);

    return p;
}

function u32leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: result >>> 0,
                next: p,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        value: 0,
        next: pos + 1,
    };
}

function i32leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                result |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return {
                value: result | 0,
                next: p,
            };
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        value: 0,
        next: pos + 1,
    };
}

function hexByte(b: number): string {
    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
}

function hexBytes(a: number, b: number): string {
    return Array.from(wasm.slice(a, b))
        .map(hexByte)
        .join(" ");
}

function decodeAt(pos: number): {
    text: string;
    next: number;
} {
    const op = wasm[pos];

    switch (op) {
        case 0x00:
            return { text: "unreachable", next: pos + 1 };

        case 0x01:
            return { text: "nop", next: pos + 1 };

        case 0x02: {
            const bt = wasm[pos + 1];
            return {
                text: `blocktype 0x${hexByte(bt)}`,
                next: pos + 2,
            };
        }

        case 0x03: {
            const bt = wasm[pos + 1];
            return {
                text: `looptype 0x${hexByte(bt)}`,
                next: pos + 2,
            };
        }

        case 0x04: {
            const bt = wasm[pos + 1];
            return {
                text: `if type 0x${hexByte(bt)}`,
                next: pos + 2,
            };
        }

        case 0x05:
            return { text: "else", next: pos + 1 };

        case 0x0b:
            return { text: "end", next: pos + 1 };

        case 0x0c: {
            const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
            return {
                text: `br ${r.value}`,
                next: r.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
            return {
                text: `br_if ${r.value}`,
                next: r.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
            return {
                text: `call ${r.value}`,
                next: r.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x18: {
            const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
            return {
                text: `delegate/op_0x18 ${r.value}`,
                next: r.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x20: {
            const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
            return {
                text: `local.get ${r.value}`,
                next: r.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
            return {
                text: `local.set ${r.value}`,
                next: r.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
            return {
                text: `local.tee ${r.value}`,
                next: r.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x28: {
            const align = wasm[pos + 1];
            const off = u32leb(pos + 2);

            return {

function u32leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: result >>> 0,
                next: p,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        value: 0,
        next: pos + 1,
    };
}

function i32leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                result |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return {
                value: result | 0,
                next: p,
            };
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        value: 0,
        next: pos + 1,
    };
}

function hexByte(b: number): string {
    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
}

function hexBytes(a: number, b: number): string {
    return Array.from(wasm.slice(a, b))
        .map(hexByte)
        .join(" ");
}

            };
        }

            return {
                text: `if type 0x${hexByte(bt)}`,
                next: pos + 2,
            };
        }

        case 0x05:
            return { text: "else", next: pos + 1 };

        case 0x0b:
            return { text: "end", next: pos + 1 };

        case 0x0c: {

import fs from "fs";

const path =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x001245a1;
const END   = 0x0012460b;

const b = fs.readFileSync(path);

console.log(" FUNCTION 3550 IF-BODY DECODER v58");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${b.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Range     : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");

type T = "i32" | "i64";

interface V {
    type: T;
    expr: string;
}

const stack: V[] = [];

// The value surviving before IF in the real stack.
stack.push({
    type: "i32",
    expr: "local4"
});

function push(type: T, expr: string) {
    stack.push({ type, expr });
}

function pop(type?: T): V {
    const v = stack.pop();

    if (!v) {
        throw new Error("STACK UNDERFLOW");
    }

    if (type && v.type !== type) {
        throw new Error(
            `TYPE MISMATCH: expected ${type}, got ${v.type}: ${v.expr}`
        );
    }

    return v;
}

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[pos++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[pos++];

        result |=
            BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40))
        result |= (-1n) << shift;

    return { value: result, next: pos };
}

function binary(
    op: string,
    type: T
) {
    const rhs = pop(type);
    const lhs = pop(type);

    push(
        type,
        `(${lhs.expr} ${op} ${rhs.expr})`
    );
}

function showStack() {
    return stack.length
        ? stack.map(
            (v, i) =>
                `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
          ).join(" | ")
        : "[]";
}

                break;

    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readULEB(pos: { value: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos.value++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

type ValType = "i32" | "i64";

interface Value {
    type: ValType;
    expr: string;
}

const stack: Value[] = [];

function push(type: ValType, expr: string) {
    stack.push({ type, expr });
}

function pop(expected?: ValType): Value {
    const v = stack.pop();

    if (!v) {
        throw new Error("STACK UNDERFLOW");
    }

    if (expected && v.type !== expected) {
        throw new Error(
            `TYPE MISMATCH: expected ${expected}, got ${v.type}: ${v.expr}`
        );
    }

    return v;
}

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[pos++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function sleb(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[pos++];

        result |=
            BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1n) << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        next: pos
    };
}

function hex64(v: bigint): string {
    if (v < 0n) {
        return "-0x" + (-v).toString(16);
    }

    return "0x" + v.toString(16);
}

function showStack() {
    if (stack.length === 0) {
        return "[]";
    }

    return "[" +
        stack.map(
            (x, i) =>
                `${i}:${x.type}:${x.expr}`
        ).join(" | ") +
        "]";
}

function binary(
    op: string,
    type: ValType
) {
    const rhs = pop(type);
    const lhs = pop(type);

    push(
        type,
        `(${lhs.expr} ${op} ${rhs.expr})`
    );
}

    if (type && v.type !== type) {

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

        const x = b[pos++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }

function sleb(pos: number) {

    let shift = 0n;

        byte = b[pos++];

        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0)

    if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40))

import fs from "fs";

const path =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x00124566;
const END   = 0x0012460b;

const b = fs.readFileSync(path);

type T = "i32" | "i64";

interface V {
    type: T;
    expr: string;
}

interface Control {
    kind: "if";
    resultType: T | "void";
    height: number;
    condition: string;
}

const stack: V[] = [];
const controls: Control[] = [];

function push(type: T, expr: string) {
    stack.push({ type, expr });
}

function pop(type?: T): V {
    const v = stack.pop();

    if (!v)
        throw new Error("STACK UNDERFLOW");

    if (type && v.type !== type) {
        throw new Error(
            `TYPE MISMATCH: expected ${type}, got ${v.type}: ${v.expr}`
        );
    }

    return v;
}

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[pos++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[pos++];

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40))
        result |= (-1n) << shift;

    return { value: result, next: pos };
}

function bin(op: string, type: T) {
    const rhs = pop(type);
    const lhs = pop(type);

    push(type, `(${lhs.expr} ${op} ${rhs.expr})`);
}

function showStack() {
    return stack.length === 0
        ? "[]"
        : "[" +
          stack.map(
              (v, i) =>
                  `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
          ).join(" | ") +
          "]";
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x00124631;
const END   = 0x001246d6;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

type Val = {
    type: "i32" | "i64";
    expr: string;
};

type Ctrl = {
    kind: "if";
    resultType: "i32" | "i64" | "void";
    entryHeight: number;
    condition: string;
    thenResult?: Val;
};

let p = START;
const stack: Val[] = [];
const controls: Ctrl[] = [];

function u32(): number {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) return v >>> 0;
        s += 7;
    }
}

function i64leb(): bigint {
    let v = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            if (shift < 63n && (b & 0x40)) {
                v |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }
            return BigInt.asIntN(64, v);
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function hex64(v: bigint): string {
    const u = BigInt.asUintN(64, v);
    return "0x" + u.toString(16).padStart(16, "0");
}

function pop(type?: "i32" | "i64"): Val {
    const v = stack.pop();
    if (!v) throw new Error("STACK UNDERFLOW");
    if (type && v.type !== type) {
        throw new Error(
            `TYPE ERROR: expected ${type}, got ${v.type}: ${v.expr}`
        );
    }
    return v;
}

function push(type: "i32" | "i64", expr: string) {
    stack.push({ type, expr });
}

function localType(n: number): "i32" | "i64" {
    return n <= 5 ? "i32" : "i64";
}

function local(n: number): Val {
    return {
        type: localType(n),
        expr: `local${n}`
    };
}

function readBlockType(): "i32" | "i64" | "void" {
    const b = buf[p++];

    if (b === 0x7f) return "i32";
    if (b === 0x7e) return "i64";
    if (b === 0x40) return "void";

    throw new Error(
        `Unsupported block type 0x${b.toString(16)} @ 0x${(p - 1)
            .toString(16)}`
    );
}

            const a = pop("i64");

            push("i64", `(${a.expr} - ${b.expr})`);

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.sub`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x83: { // i64.and
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

            push("i64", `(${a.expr} & ${b.expr})`);

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.and`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x84: { // i64.or
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

            push("i64", `(${a.expr} | ${b.expr})`);

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.or`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x88: { // i64.shr_u
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

            push("i64", `(${a.expr} >>u ${b.expr})`);

            console.log(

            break;
        }

        case 0x52: { // i64.ne

            const a = pop("i64");

            const a = pop("i64");

            push(

            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.lt_u`
            );
            break;

            const resultType = readBlockType();
            const cond = pop("i32");

            const ctrl: Ctrl = {
                kind: "if",
                resultType,
                entryHeight: stack.length,
                condition: cond.expr
            };

            controls.push(ctrl);

            console.log();

                `0x${at.toString(16)} IF -> ${resultType}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  condition = ${cond.expr}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  entry stack = [` +
                stack.map(
                    (v, i) => `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                ).join(" | ") +
                `]`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x05: { // else
            const ctrl = controls[controls.length - 1];

            if (!ctrl || ctrl.kind !== "if") {
                throw new Error(
                    `ELSE without IF @ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
                );
            }

            if (ctrl.resultType !== "void") {
                const thenResult = pop(ctrl.resultType);
                ctrl.thenResult = thenResult;
            }

            stack.length = ctrl.entryHeight;

            console.log();
            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} ELSE`
            );
            console.log(
                `  restore height = ${ctrl.entryHeight}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  condition = ${ctrl.condition}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  stack = [` +
                stack.map(
                    (v, i) => `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                ).join(" | ") +
                `]`
            );
            break;
        }

        case 0x0b: { // end
            if (controls.length > 0) {
                const ctrl = controls.pop()!;

                if (ctrl.resultType !== "void") {
                    const elseResult = pop(ctrl.resultType);

                    if (!ctrl.thenResult) {
                        throw new Error(
                            `IF result missing THEN result @ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
                        );
                    }

                    const merged =
                        `IF(${ctrl.condition}) ? ` +
                        `${ctrl.thenResult.expr} : ` +
                        `${elseResult.expr}`;

                    stack.push({
                        type: ctrl.resultType,
                        expr: merged
                    });

                    console.log();
                    console.log(
                        `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                    );
                    console.log(
                        `  IF result = ${ctrl.resultType}`
                    );
                    console.log(
                        `  result = ${merged}`
                    );
                } else {
                    console.log(
                        `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                    );
                }

                console.log(
                    `  stack = [` +
                    stack.map(
                        (v, i) => `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                    ).join(" | ") +
                    `]`
                );
            } else {
                console.log(
                    `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                );
            }
            break;
        }

        case 0x37: { // i64.store
            const align = buf[p++];
            const offset = u32();

            const value = pop("i64");
            const address = pop("i32");

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.store offset=${offset}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  address = ${address.expr}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  value   = ${value.expr}`
            );
            break;
        }

        default:
            throw new Error(
                `UNKNOWN OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} ` +
                `@ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
            );
    }

import fs from "fs";

const END   = 0x001246d6;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

type Val = {
    type: "i32" | "i64";
    expr: string;
};

type Ctrl = {
    kind: "if";
    resultType: "i32" | "i64" | "void";
    entryHeight: number;
    condition: string;
    thenResult?: Val;
};

let p = START;
const stack: Val[] = [
    { type: "i32", expr: "local4" },
    { type: "i64", expr: "local15" },
    { type: "i64", expr: "16" },
];

const controls: Ctrl[] = [];
function u32(): number {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) return v >>> 0;
        s += 7;
    }
}

function i64leb(): bigint {
    let v = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            if (shift < 63n && (b & 0x40)) {
                v |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }
            return BigInt.asIntN(64, v);
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function hex64(v: bigint): string {
    const u = BigInt.asUintN(64, v);
    return "0x" + u.toString(16).padStart(16, "0");
}

function pop(type?: "i32" | "i64"): Val {
    const v = stack.pop();
    if (!v) throw new Error("STACK UNDERFLOW");
    if (type && v.type !== type) {
        throw new Error(
            `TYPE ERROR: expected ${type}, got ${v.type}: ${v.expr}`
        );
    }
    return v;
}

function push(type: "i32" | "i64", expr: string) {
    stack.push({ type, expr });
}

function localType(n: number): "i32" | "i64" {
    return n <= 5 ? "i32" : "i64";
}

function local(n: number): Val {
    return {
        type: localType(n),
        expr: `local${n}`
    };
}

function readBlockType(): "i32" | "i64" | "void" {
    const b = buf[p++];

    if (b === 0x7f) return "i32";
    if (b === 0x7e) return "i64";
    if (b === 0x40) return "void";

    throw new Error(
        `Unsupported block type 0x${b.toString(16)} @ 0x${(p - 1)
            .toString(16)}`
    );
}

        case 0x83: {
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

            push(
                "i64",
                `(${a.expr} & ${b.expr})`
            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.and`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i64.or
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x84: {
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

            push(
                "i64",
                `(${a.expr} | ${b.expr})`
            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.or`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i64.shr_u
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x88: {
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

            push(
                "i64",
                `(${a.expr} >>u ${b.expr})`
            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.shr_u`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i64.ne
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x52: {
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

            push(
                "i32",
                `(${a.expr} != ${b.expr})`
            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.ne`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i64.lt_u
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x54: {
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

            push(
                "i32",
                `(${a.expr} <u ${b.expr})`
            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.lt_u`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // IF
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x04: {

            const resultType =
                readBlockType();

            const cond =
                pop("i32");

            const ctrl: Ctrl = {
                kind: "if",
                resultType,
                entryHeight: stack.length,
                condition: cond.expr,
            };

            controls.push(ctrl);

            console.log();
            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} IF -> ${resultType}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  condition = ${cond.expr}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  entry stack = [` +
                stack.map(
                    (v, i) =>
                        `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                ).join(" | ") +
                `]`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // ELSE
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x05: {

            const ctrl =
                controls[controls.length - 1];

            if (!ctrl || ctrl.kind !== "if") {
                throw new Error(
                    `ELSE without IF @ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
                );
            }

            if (ctrl.resultType !== "void") {

                const thenResult =
                    pop(ctrl.resultType);

                ctrl.thenResult =
                    thenResult;
            }

            stack.length =
                ctrl.entryHeight;

            console.log();
            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} ELSE`
            );

            console.log(
                `  restore height = ` +
                `${ctrl.entryHeight}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  stack = [` +
                stack.map(
                    (v, i) =>
                        `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                ).join(" | ") +
                `]`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // END
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x0b: {

            if (controls.length === 0) {

                console.log(
                    `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                );

                break;
            }

            const ctrl =
                controls.pop()!;

            if (ctrl.resultType !== "void") {

                const elseResult =
                    pop(ctrl.resultType);

                if (!ctrl.thenResult) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `IF THEN result missing ` +
                        `@ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
                    );
                }

                const merged =
                    `IF(${ctrl.condition}) ? ` +
                    `${ctrl.thenResult.expr} : ` +
                    `${elseResult.expr}`;

                push(
                    ctrl.resultType,
                    merged
                );

                console.log();
                console.log(
                    `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  IF result = ${ctrl.resultType}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  result = ${merged}`
                );

            } else {

                console.log(
                    `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                );
            }

            console.log(
                `  stack = [` +
                stack.map(
                    (v, i) =>
                        `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                ).join(" | ") +
                `]`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i64.store
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x37: {

            const align =
                buf[p++];

            const offset =
                u32();

            const value =
                pop("i64");

            const address =
                pop("i32");

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} ` +
                `i64.store offset=${offset}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  address = ${address.expr}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  value   = ${value.expr}`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // UNKNOWN
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        default:

            throw new Error(
                `UNKNOWN OPCODE 0x` +
                op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0") +
                ` @ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
            );
    }

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x001246d6;
const END   = 0x00124729;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

type Val = {
    type: "i32" | "i64";
    expr: string;
};

type Ctrl = {
    kind: "if";
    resultType: "i32" | "i64" | "void";
    entryHeight: number;
    condition: string;
    thenResult?: Val;
};

let p = START;

const stack: Val[] = [
    { type: "i32", expr: "local4" },
    {
        type: "i64",
        expr:
            "IF(C2) ? local7 : (((local10 >>u 52) - 1) & 281474976710655)"
    }
];

const controls: Ctrl[] = [];

function u32(): number {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            return v >>> 0;

        s += 7;
    }
}

function i64leb(): bigint {
    let v = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            if (shift < 63n && (b & 0x40))
                v |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);

            return BigInt.asIntN(64, v);
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function hex64(v: bigint): string {
    return (
        "0x" +
        BigInt.asUintN(64, v)
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(16, "0")
    );
}

function localType(n: number): "i32" | "i64" {
    return n <= 5 ? "i32" : "i64";
}

function pop(type?: "i32" | "i64"): Val {
    const v = stack.pop();

    if (!v)
        throw new Error(
            `STACK UNDERFLOW @ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`
        );

    if (type && v.type !== type) {
        throw new Error(
            `TYPE ERROR @ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}: ` +
            `expected ${type}, got ${v.type}: ${v.expr}`
        );
    }

    return v;
}

function push(
    type: "i32" | "i64",
    expr: string
) {
    stack.push({ type, expr });
}

function readBlockType():
    "i32" | "i64" | "void"
{
    const b = buf[p++];

    if (b === 0x7f) return "i32";
    if (b === 0x7e) return "i64";
    if (b === 0x40) return "void";

    throw new Error(
        `UNKNOWN BLOCK TYPE 0x${b.toString(16)} ` +
        `@ 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`
    );
}

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} local.tee ${n} = ${v.expr}`
            );

            break;
        }

        // i32.const
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x41: {
            const v = u32();

            push(
                "i32",
                String(v)
            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i32.const ${v}`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i64.const
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x42: {
            const v = i64leb();

            push(
                "i64",
                v.toString()
            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i64.const ` +
                `${v} (${hex64(v)})`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i32.add
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x6a: {
            const b = pop("i32");
            const a = pop("i32");

            push(
                "i32",
                `(${a.expr} + ${b.expr})`
            );

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} i32.add`
            );

            break;
        }

        // i64.add
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x7c: {
            const b = pop("i64");
            const a = pop("i64");

                `(${a.expr} + ${b.expr})`
            );

            console.log(

            );

        // i64.sub

        case 0x7d: {

            const a = pop("i64");

            );

            );

            break;
        }

        // IF
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x04: {

            const resultType =
                readBlockType();

            const cond =
                pop("i32");

            const ctrl: Ctrl = {
                kind: "if",
                resultType,
                entryHeight: stack.length,
                condition: cond.expr,
            };

            controls.push(ctrl);

            console.log();
            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} IF -> ${resultType}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  condition = ${cond.expr}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  entry stack = [` +
                stack.map(
                    (v, i) =>
                        `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                ).join(" | ") +
                `]`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // ELSE
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x05: {

            const ctrl =
                controls[controls.length - 1];

            if (!ctrl || ctrl.kind !== "if") {
                throw new Error(
                    `ELSE without IF @ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
                );
            }

            if (ctrl.resultType !== "void") {

                const thenResult =
                    pop(ctrl.resultType);

                ctrl.thenResult =
                    thenResult;
            }

            stack.length =
                ctrl.entryHeight;

            console.log();
            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} ELSE`
            );

            console.log(
                `  restore height = ` +
                `${ctrl.entryHeight}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  stack = [` +
                stack.map(
                    (v, i) =>
                        `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                ).join(" | ") +
                `]`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // END
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x0b: {

            if (controls.length === 0) {

                console.log(
                    `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                );

                break;
            }

            const ctrl =
                controls.pop()!;

            if (ctrl.resultType !== "void") {

                const elseResult =
                    pop(ctrl.resultType);

                if (!ctrl.thenResult) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `IF THEN result missing ` +
                        `@ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
                    );
                }

                const merged =
                    `IF(${ctrl.condition}) ? ` +
                    `${ctrl.thenResult.expr} : ` +
                    `${elseResult.expr}`;

                push(
                    ctrl.resultType,
                    merged
                );

                console.log();
                console.log(
                    `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  IF result = ${ctrl.resultType}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  result = ${merged}`
                );

            } else {

                console.log(
                    `0x${at.toString(16)} END`
                );
            }

            console.log(
                `  stack = [` +
                stack.map(
                    (v, i) =>
                        `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
                ).join(" | ") +
                `]`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i64.store
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x37: {

            const align =
                buf[p++];

            const offset =
                u32();

            const value =
                pop("i64");

            const address =
                pop("i32");

            console.log(
                `0x${at.toString(16)} ` +
                `i64.store offset=${offset}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  address = ${address.expr}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  value   = ${value.expr}`
            );

            break;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // UNKNOWN
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        default:

            throw new Error(
                `UNKNOWN OPCODE 0x` +
                op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0") +
                ` @ 0x${at.toString(16)}`
            );
    }
}

console.log();
console.log(
    "============================================================"
);
console.log(
    " FINAL"
);
console.log(
    "============================================================"
);

console.log(

    stack.map(
        (v, i) =>
            `${i}:${v.type}:${v.expr}`
    ).join(" | ") +
    "]"
);

console.log(

    controls.length
);

console.log(

let p = START;

function hx(n: number, width = 8): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readULEB(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= END) {
            throw new Error(
                `ULEB past END @ ${hx(p)}`
            );
        }

        const b = wasm[p++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result;
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(
                `ULEB too large @ ${hx(p)}`
            );
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB32(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= END) {
            throw new Error(
                `SLEB32 past END @ ${hx(p)}`
            );
        }

        byte = wasm[p++];

        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(
                `SLEB32 too large @ ${hx(p)}`
            );
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1 << shift);
    }

    return result;
}

function readSLEB64(): bigint {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= END) {
            throw new Error(
                `SLEB64 past END @ ${hx(p)}`
            );
        }

        byte = wasm[p++];

        result |=
            BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error(
                `SLEB64 too large @ ${hx(p)}`
            );
        }
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1n) << shift;
    }

    return BigInt.asIntN(64, result);
}

function readMemarg() {
    const align = readULEB();
    const offset = readULEB();

    return {
        align,
        offset
    };
}

function print(at: number, text: string) {
    console.log(
        `${hx(at)}  ${text}`
    );
}

    throw new Error(`Unexpected WASM size: ${wasm.length}`);

let p = START;

function hx(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= END) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB past END @ ${hx(p)}`);
        }

        const b = wasm[p++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result;
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB too large @ ${hx(p)}`);
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB32(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= END) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB32 past END @ ${hx(p)}`);
        }

        byte = wasm[p++];

        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB32 too large @ ${hx(p)}`);
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1 << shift);
    }

    return result;
}

function readSLEB64(): bigint {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= END) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB64 past END @ ${hx(p)}`);
        }

        byte = wasm[p++];

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB64 too large @ ${hx(p)}`);
        }
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1n) << shift;
    }

    return BigInt.asIntN(64, result);
}

function readMemarg() {
    return {
        align: readULEB(),
        offset: readULEB()
    };
}

function readBlockType(): string {
    const b = wasm[p];

    if (b === 0x40) {
        p++;
        return "void";
    }

    if (
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c
    ) {
        p++;
        return `valtype=0x${b.toString(16)}`;
    }

    const v = readSLEB32();
    return `typeidx=${v}`;
}

function hx(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");

function uleb(): number {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
            return v;

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function sleb32(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[p++];
        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40))
        result |= (-1 << shift);

    return result;
}

function sleb64(): bigint {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[p++];

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40))
        result |= (-1n) << shift;

    return BigInt.asIntN(64, result);
}

            );

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x12422b;

function readULEB(pos: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
    bytes: number[];
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    const bytes: number[] = [];

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        bytes.push(b);

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value,
                next: p,
                bytes
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB too long at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }

    throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading ULEB at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
    bytes: number[];
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    const bytes: number[] = [];
    let b = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        bytes.push(b);

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value -= Math.pow(2, shift);
            }

            return {
                value,
                next: p,
                bytes
            };
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB32 too long at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }

    throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading SLEB32 at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number): {
    value: bigint;
    next: number;
    bytes: number[];
} {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let p = pos;
    const bytes: number[] = [];
    let b = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        bytes.push(b);

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (-1n) << shift;
            }

            return {
                value,
                next: p,
                bytes
            };
        }

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB64 too long at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }

    throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading SLEB64 at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8): string {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function printInstruction(
    addr: number,
    end: number,
    text: string
) {
    console.log(
        `${hex(addr)} .. ${hex(end - 1)}  ${text}`
    );
}

function readULEB(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= END) throw new Error("ULEB past function end");

        const b = wasm[p++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result;
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB64(): bigint {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= END) throw new Error("SLEB past function end");

        byte = wasm[p++];

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if ((shift < 64n) && (byte & 0x40)) {
                result |= (-1n) << shift;
            }

            return result;
        }

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error("SLEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function readMemarg() {
    const align = readULEB();
    const offset = readULEB();

    return { align, offset };
}

function line(at: number, text: string) {
    console.log(
        `0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${text}`
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readS32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (-1 << shift);
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function hex(pos: number, count: number): string {
    return Array.from(bytes.subarray(pos, pos + count))
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

function findSection(id: number) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const sectionId = bytes[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readU32Leb(p);
        const payloadSize = sizeInfo.value;
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const payloadStart = p;

        if (sectionId === id) {
            return {
                start: payloadStart,
                size: payloadSize,
            };
        }

        p += payloadSize;
    }

    throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
}

function opcodeName(op: number): string {
    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x00: "unreachable",

        0x1a: "drop",
        0x1b: "select",

        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",

        0x41: "i32.const",

        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if ((b & 0x40) !== 0)
                value -= Math.pow(2, shift);

            return { value, next: pos };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readString(v: number) {
    return hex(v);
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: result >>> 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function sleb32(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = wasm[pos++];

    result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    result |= ~0 << shift;
  }

  return {
    value: result | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function sleb64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
  let result = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = wasm[pos++];

    result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7n;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
    result |= (-1n) << shift;
  }

  return {
    value: BigInt.asIntN(64, result),
    next: pos,
  };
}

function hex(v: number): string {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 8620;
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

type Instr = {
    offset: number;
    opcode: number;
    text: string;
    target?: number;
};

function readU32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readS32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= ~0 << shift;
            }

            return {
                value: value | 0,
                next: pos,
            };
        }
    }
}

function readU64Leb(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value,
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function skipMemArg(pos: number): number {
    const a = readU32Leb(pos);
    return readU32Leb(a.next).next;
}

function decodeInstruction(pos: number): {
    instr: Instr;
    next: number;
} {
    const start = pos;
    const op = wasm[pos++];

    switch (op) {
        case 0x00:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "unreachable",
                },
                next: pos,
            };

        case 0x01:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "nop",
                },
                next: pos,
            };

        case 0x02:
        case 0x03:
        case 0x04: {
            const blockType = readS32Leb(pos);
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text:
                        op === 0x02
                            ? `block ${blockType.value}`
                            : op === 0x03
                              ? `loop ${blockType.value}`
                              : `if ${blockType.value}`,
                },
                next: blockType.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x05:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "else",
                },
                next: pos,
            };

        case 0x0b:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "end",
                },
                next: pos,
            };

        case 0x0c: {
            const x = readU32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `br ${x.value}`,
                    target: x.value,
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const x = readU32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `br_if ${x.value}`,
                    target: x.value,
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x0e: {
            const n = readU32Leb(pos);
            pos = n.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                pos = readU32Leb(pos).next;
            }

            pos = readU32Leb(pos).next;

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "br_table",
                },
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        case 0x0f:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "return",
                },
                next: pos,
            };

        case 0x10: {
            const x = readU32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `call ${x.value}`,
                    target: x.value,
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x11: {
            const type = readU32Leb(pos);
            pos = type.next;

            const table = readU32Leb(pos);
            pos = table.next;

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`,
                },
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        case 0x1a:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "drop",
                },
                next: pos,
            };

        case 0x1b:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "select",
                },
                next: pos,
            };

        case 0x20: {
            const x = readU32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = readU32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = readU32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x23: {
            const x = readU32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `global.get ${x.value}`,
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x24: {
            const x = readU32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `global.set ${x.value}`,
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x28:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "i32.load",
                },
                next: skipMemArg(pos),
            };

        case 0x29:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "i64.load",
                },
                next: skipMemArg(pos),
            };

        case 0x2a:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "f32.load",
                },
                next: skipMemArg(pos),
            };

        case 0x2b:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "f64.load",
                },
                next: skipMemArg(pos),
            };

        case 0x36:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "i32.store",
                },
                next: skipMemArg(pos),
            };

        case 0x37:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "i64.store",
                },
                next: skipMemArg(pos),
            };

        case 0x38:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "f32.store",
                },
                next: skipMemArg(pos),
            };

        case 0x39:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: "f64.store",
                },
                next: skipMemArg(pos),
            };

        case 0x41: {
            const x = readS32Leb(pos);

            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
                },
                next: x.next,

        }

        case 0x42: {
            const x = readU64Leb(pos);

            return {

                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x43:
            return {

                    text: "f32.const",
                },

            };

        case 0x44:
            return {

                    text: "f64.const",
                },
                next: pos + 8,
            };

        default:
            return {
                instr: {
                    offset: start,
                    opcode: op,
                    text: `op=0x${op
                        .toString(16)
                        .padStart(2, "0")}`,
                },
                next: pos,
            };
    }
}

function findCodeSection(): {
    start: number;
    size: number;
} {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const s = readU32Leb(p);
        p = s.next;

        if (id === 10) {
            return {
                start: p,
                size: s.value,
            };
        }

        p += s.value;
    }

    throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

function findTargetBody(): {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    bodyIndex: number;
} {
    const sec = findCodeSection();

    let p = sec.start;

    const count = readU32Leb(p);
    p = count.next;

    const targetBodyIndex =
        TARGET_FUNC - IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS;

    if (
        targetBodyIndex < 0 ||
        targetBodyIndex >= count.value
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            `Function ${TARGET_FUNC} is outside code section`,
        );
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const size = readU32Leb(p);
        p = size.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + size.value;

        if (i === targetBodyIndex) {
            return {
                start,
                end,
                bodyIndex: i,
            };
        }

        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error(
        `Body for Function ${TARGET_FUNC} not found`,
    );
}

function decodeBody(
    start: number,
    end: number,
): Instr[] {
    let p = start;

    const localDecls = readU32Leb(p);
    p = localDecls.next;

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < localDecls.value;
        i++
    ) {
        const n = readU32Leb(p);
        p = n.next;

        p++; // valtype
    }

    const result: Instr[] = [];

    while (p < end) {
        const d = decodeInstruction(p);

        if (d.next <= p) {
            throw new Error(
                `Decoder stalled at 0x${p.toString(16)}`,
            );
        }

        result.push(d.instr);
        p = d.next;
    }

    return result;
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return (
        "0x" +
        n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")
    );
}

function isInteresting(x: Instr): boolean {
    return (
        x.text.includes("1837608") ||
        x.text.includes("8620") ||
        x.text.includes("call_indirect") ||
        x.text.includes("i32.load") ||
        x.text.includes("i32.store") ||
        x.text.includes("local.")
    );
}

function u8(p: number): number {
  if (p >= wasm.length) {
    throw new Error(`OOB byte read @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
  }
  return wasm[p];
}

function readSLEB128(start: number): {
  value: bigint;
  next: number;
  bytes: number[];
} {
  let p = start;
  let result = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;
  const bytes: number[] = [];

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(p++);
    bytes.push(b);

    result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if ((b & 0x40) !== 0) {
        result -= 1n << (shift + 7n);
      }
      return { value: result, next: p, bytes };
    }

    shift += 7n;

    if (shift > 70n) {
      throw new Error(
        `SLEB128 too long @ 0x${start.toString(16)}`
      );
    }
  }
}

function hex8(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function fmtI64(v: bigint): string {
  return v.toString();
}

function opName(op: number): string {
  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",

    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x42: "i64.const",

    0x7c: "i64.add",
    0x7d: "i64.sub",
    0x7e: "i64.mul",
    0x7f: "i64.div_s",
    0x80: "i64.div_u",
    0x81: "i64.rem_s",
    0x82: "i64.rem_u",
    0x83: "i64.and",
    0x84: "i64.or",
    0x85: "i64.xor",
    0x86: "i64.shl",
    0x87: "i64.shr_s",
    0x88: "i64.shr_u",
    0x89: "i64.rotl",
    0x8a: "i64.rotr",

    0x37: "i64.store",

    0x0b: "end",
  };

  return names[op] ?? `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")})`;
}

type Expr = string;

interface LocalState {
  version: number;
  expr: Expr;
}

let locals: LocalState[] = Array.from(
  { length: 6 },
  (_, i) => ({
    version: 0,
    expr: `L${i}_0`,
  })
);

const stack: Expr[] = [];

const stores: {
  offset: number;
  align: number;
  value: Expr;
  address: Expr;
}[] = [];

let p = FUNC87_CODE_START;
let instructionCount = 0;

function pop(): Expr {
  if (stack.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(
      `STACK UNDERFLOW @ ${hex8(p)}`
    );
  }

  return stack.pop()!;
}

function push(x: Expr) {
  stack.push(x);
}

function bin(
  name: string
) {
  const rhs = pop();
  const lhs = pop();

  push(`(${lhs} ${name} ${rhs})`);
}

function newLocalVersion(
  localIndex: number,
  expr: Expr
): string {
  locals[localIndex].version++;

  const v =
    `L${localIndex}_${locals[localIndex].version}`;

  locals[localIndex].expr = expr;

  return v;
}

function parseLocalIndex(start: number): {
  value: number;
  next: number;
} {
  const r = readSLEB128(start);
  const n = Number(r.value);

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(n) || n < 0 || n > 100000) {
    throw new Error(
      `Invalid local index ${r.value} @ ${hex8(start)}`
    );
  }

  return {
    value: n,
    next: r.next,
  };
}

function parseMemArg(start: number): {
  align: number;
  offset: number;
  next: number;
} {
  const alignR = readSLEB128(start);
  const offsetR = readSLEB128(alignR.next);

  return {
    align: Number(alignR.value),
    offset: Number(offsetR.value),
    next: offsetR.next,
  };
}

function uleb(offset: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = offset;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb64(offset: number) {
  let value = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;
  let p = offset;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = b[p++];
    value |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7n;
  }

  if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function i64hex(v: bigint) {
  return "0x" + BigInt.asUintN(64, v).toString(16).padStart(16, "0");
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 8952;
const TARGET_TYPE = 4;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNCTION 8952 - FULL DISPATCH ANALYSIS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log("FUNCTION  :", TARGET_FUNC);
console.log("TARGET TYPE:", TARGET_TYPE);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");


/*
 * ============================================================
 * BASIC READERS
 * ============================================================
 */

function readULEB(pos) {

    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {

        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(
                "ULEB overflow at 0x" +
                pos.toString(16)
            );
        }
    }

    return {
        value,
        next: p
    };
}


function readSLEB(pos) {

    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b;

    while (true) {

        b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p
    };
}


function hex(v) {

    return "0x" +
        v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}


/*
 * ============================================================
 * SECTION MAP
 * ============================================================
 */

function readSectionHeader(pos) {

    const sectionStart = pos;

    const id = buf[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);

    const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + size;

    return {
        id,
        sectionStart,
        size,
        payloadStart,
        payloadEnd
    };
}


const sections = [];

let p = 8;

while (p < buf.length) {

    const section = readSectionHeader(p);

    sections.push(section);

    p = section.payloadEnd;
}


const typeSection =
    sections.find(s => s.id === 1);

const importSection =
    sections.find(s => s.id === 2);

const functionSection =
    sections.find(s => s.id === 3);

const codeSection =
    sections.find(s => s.id === 10);


if (!typeSection) {
    throw new Error("TYPE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

if (!functionSection) {
    throw new Error("FUNCTION SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

if (!codeSection) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

    hex(typeSection.payloadStart),

 * ============================================================
 * FUNCTION SECTION
 * ============================================================

const functionCountInfo = readULEB(fp);

    functionCountInfo.value;

 * ============================================================
 * IMPORT SECTION
 * ============================================================
 */

let importedFunctionCount = 0;

if (importSection) {

    let ip = importSection.payloadStart;

    const importCountInfo = readULEB(ip);

    const importCount =
        importCountInfo.value;

    ip = importCountInfo.next;

    console.log(
        "IMPORT COUNT :",
        importCount
    );

    for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {

        const moduleInfo = readULEB(ip);

        ip = moduleInfo.next + moduleInfo.value;


        const nameInfo = readULEB(ip);

        ip = nameInfo.next + nameInfo.value;


        const kind = buf[ip++];


        /*
         * Function import
         */

        if (kind === 0) {

            importedFunctionCount++;

            const typeInfo = readULEB(ip);

            ip = typeInfo.next;
        }


        /*
         * Table import
         */

        else if (kind === 1) {

            /*
             * elemtype + limits
             */

            ip++;

            const flags = buf[ip++];

            ip = readULEB(ip).next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                ip = readULEB(ip).next;
            }
        }


        /*
         * Memory import
         */

        else if (kind === 2) {

            const flags = buf[ip++];

            ip = readULEB(ip).next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                ip = readULEB(ip).next;
            }
        }


        /*
         * Global import
         */

        else if (kind === 3) {

            /*
             * valtype + mutability
             */

            ip += 2;
        }


        else {

            throw new Error(
                "Unknown import kind " +
                kind
            );
        }
    }
}


console.log(
    "IMPORTED FUNCTIONS :",
    importedFunctionCount
);


const definedIndex =
    TARGET_FUNC -
    importedFunctionCount;


console.log(
    "DEFINED INDEX FOR TARGET :",
    definedIndex
);


if (
    definedIndex < 0 ||
    definedIndex >= definedFunctionCount
) {

    throw new Error(
        "Target function outside defined range"
    );
}

    const bodyStart = cp;

    const bodySize =
        bodySizeInfo.value;

    cp = bodySizeInfo.next;

    const bodyEnd =

            bodyIndex: i,

            bodyStart,

            bodyPayloadStart:
                payloadStart,

            bodyEnd,

            bodySize
        };

        break;
    }


    cp = bodyEnd;
}

    throw new Error(

    );
