/*
 * ============================================================
 * INSTRUCTION DECODER
 * ============================================================
 */

function decodeInstruction(pos) {

    const start = pos;

    const op =
        buf[pos++];

    const name =
        names[op] ||
        ("opcode_0x" +
         op.toString(16));


    const operands = [];


    /*
     * local / global
     */

    if (
        op === 0x20 ||
        op === 0x21 ||
        op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 ||
        op === 0x24
    ) {

        const r =
            readULEB(pos);

        operands.push(
            r.value
        );

        pos = r.next;
    }


    /*
     * direct call
     */

    else if (op === 0x10) {

        const r =
            readULEB(pos);

        operands.push(
            r.value
        );

        pos = r.next;
    }


    /*
     * call_indirect
     *
     * typeidx
     * tableidx
     */

    else if (op === 0x11) {

        const type =
            readULEB(pos);

        pos = type.next;


        const table =
            readULEB(pos);

        pos = table.next;


        operands.push(
            "type=" +
            type.value,

            "table=" +
            table.value
        );
    }


    /*
     * Memory loads/stores
     *
     * memarg:
     *   align
     *   offset
     */

    else if (
        op >= 0x28 &&
        op <= 0x3e
    ) {

        const align =
            readULEB(pos);

        pos = align.next;


        const offset =
            readULEB(pos);

        pos = offset.next;


        operands.push(
            "align=" +
            align.value,

            "offset=" +
            offset.value
        );
    }


    /*
     * i32.const
     */

    else if (op === 0x41) {

        const r =
            readSLEB(pos);

        operands.push(
            r.value
        );

        pos = r.next;
    }


    /*
     * i64.const
     */

    else if (op === 0x42) {

        const r =
            readULEB(pos);

        operands.push(
            r.value
        );

        pos = r.next;
    }


    /*
     * block / loop / if
     */

    else if (
        op === 0x02 ||
        op === 0x03 ||
        op === 0x04
    ) {

        const blockType =
            buf[pos++];

        operands.push(
            "blocktype=0x" +
            blockType.toString(16)
        );
    }


    /*
     * branch
     */

    else if (
        op === 0x0c ||
        op === 0x0d
    ) {

        const r =
            readULEB(pos);

        operands.push(
            r.value
        );

        pos = r.next;
    }


    return {

        start,

        end: pos,

        op,

        name,

        operands
    };
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x00008152;
const END   = 0x00008174;

function uleb(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[p++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value, next: p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

      return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p
      };
    }
  }
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function decode() {

  let p = START;

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("FUNCTION 96 FC OPCODE TRACE");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`RANGE : ${hex(START)} .. ${hex(END)}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  while (p < END) {

    const at = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  local.get ${x.value}`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  local.set ${x.value}`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  local.tee ${x.value}`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = sleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.const ${x.value}`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x6a) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.add`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x71) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.and`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x45) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.eqz`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x47) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.ne`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x0f) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  return`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x0b) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  end`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x00) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  unreachable`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x04) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  if`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x02) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  block`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x0d) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  br_if ${x.value}`);
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  call ${x.value}`);
    }

    else if (op === 0xfc) {

      const sub = uleb(p);
      p = sub.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  0xfc subopcode=${sub.value} (0x${sub.value.toString(16)})`
      );

      // Decode common bulk-memory/table instructions.
      if (
        sub.value === 8 ||
        sub.value === 9 ||
        sub.value === 11 ||
        sub.value === 13
      ) {

        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        console.log(
          `           immediate=${x.value}`
        );
      }

      else if (
        sub.value === 10 ||
        sub.value === 12 ||
        sub.value === 14
      ) {

        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        const y = uleb(p);
        p = y.next;

        console.log(
          `           immediate=${x.value}, ${y.value}`
        );
      }

      else {

        console.log(
          "           UNKNOWN 0xfc SUBOPCODE"
        );

        console.log(
          `           RAW : ${bytes.subarray(at, Math.min(END, at + 8)).toString("hex")}`
        );
      }
    }

    else {
      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      );
    }
  }

  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log("END");
  console.log("============================================================");
}

decode();

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const IMPORTED = 83;

const targets = [9129, 9130, 9132, 9133];

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findSection(id) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const sid = buf[p++];

    const s = readULEB(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n, w = 8) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

const code = findSection(10);

if (!code) {
  throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

let p = code.start;

const count = readULEB(p);
p = count.next;

const bodies = new Map();

for (let codeIndex = 0; codeIndex < count.value; codeIndex++) {

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

  const globalIndex = IMPORTED + codeIndex;

  if (targets.includes(globalIndex)) {
    bodies.set(globalIndex, {
      codeIndex,
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd
    });
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

function opcodeName(op) {
  const names = {
    0x00: "unreachable",
    0x01: "nop",
    0x02: "block",
    0x03: "loop",
    0x04: "if",
    0x05: "else",
    0x0b: "end",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
    0x0e: "br_table",
    0x0f: "return",

    0x10: "call",
    0x11: "call_indirect",

    0x1a: "drop",
    0x1b: "select",

    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",

    0x23: "global.get",
    0x24: "global.set",

    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x29: "i64.load",
    0x2a: "f32.load",
    0x2b: "f64.load",

    0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
    0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
    0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
    0x2f: "i32.load16_u",

    0x30: "i64.load8_s",
    0x31: "i64.load8_u",
    0x32: "i64.load16_s",
    0x33: "i64.load16_u",
    0x34: "i64.load32_s",
    0x35: "i64.load32_u",

    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x37: "i64.store",
    0x38: "f32.store",
    0x39: "f64.store",

    0x3a: "i32.store8",
    0x3b: "i32.store16",
    0x3c: "i64.store8",
    0x3d: "i64.store16",
    0x3e: "i64.store32",

    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x42: "i64.const",

    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x48: "i32.lt_s",
    0x49: "i32.lt_u",
    0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
    0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
    0x4c: "i32.le_s",
    0x4d: "i32.le_u",
    0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
    0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

    0x50: "i64.eqz",
    0x51: "i64.eq",
    0x52: "i64.ne",

    0x6a: "i32.add",

    0x6c: "i32.mul",
    0x6d: "i32.div_s",
    0x6e: "i32.div_u",
    0x6f: "i32.rem_s",
    0x70: "i32.rem_u",

    0x71: "i32.and",
    0x72: "i32.or",
    0x73: "i32.xor",

    0xd2: "ref.func"
  };

  return names[op] || null;

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte;

  while (true) {
    byte = buf[pos++];

    value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(byte & 0x80)) break;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("SLEB too long at " + hex(pos));
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value,
    next: pos
  };
}

function readInstruction(pos, end) {

  const start = pos;
  const op = buf[pos++];

  const name = opcodeName(op);

  if (!name) {
    return {
      start,
      end: pos,
      text: `UNKNOWN opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    };
  }

  let text = name;

  try {

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      text += " " + x.value;
    }

    else if (op === 0x42) {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      text += " " + x.value;
    }

    else if (op === 0x20 ||
             op === 0x21 ||
             op === 0x22 ||
             op === 0x23 ||
             op === 0x24) {

      const x = readULEB(pos);
      pos = x.next;

      text += " " + x.value;
    }

    else if (
      op >= 0x28 &&
      op <= 0x3e
    ) {
      const align = readULEB(pos);
      pos = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(pos);
      pos = offset.next;

      text +=
        ` align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      pos = x.next;

      text += " " + x.value;
    }

    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const type = readULEB(pos);
      pos = type.next;

      const table = readULEB(pos);
      pos = table.next;

      text +=
        ` type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d
    ) {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      pos = x.next;

      text += " " + x.value;
    }

    else if (op === 0x0e) {
      const n = readULEB(pos);
      pos = n.next;

      const labels = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
        const x = readULEB(pos);
        pos = x.next;
        labels.push(x.value);
      }

      text +=
        " " + labels.join(",");
    }

    else if (op === 0x02 ||
             op === 0x03 ||
             op === 0x04) {

      // block type
      const bt = buf[pos++];

      text +=
        ` type=0x${bt.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0xd0) {
      const x = buf[pos++];
      text +=
        ` type=0x${x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }

    return {
      start,
      end: pos,
      text
    };

  } catch (e) {

    return {
      start,
      end: Math.min(pos + 1, end),
      text: "DECODE ERROR: " + e.message
    };
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNCTIONS 9129 / 9130 / 9132 / 9133");

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

for (const fn of targets) {

  const b = bodies.get(fn);

  if (!b) {
    console.log(`FUNCTION ${fn} NOT FOUND`);
    continue;
  }

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`FUNCTION ${fn}`);
  console.log(`CODE INDEX : ${b.codeIndex}`);
  console.log(
    `BODY       : ${hex(b.bodyStart)} .. ${hex(b.bodyEnd)}`
  );
  console.log(
    `SIZE       : ${b.bodyEnd - b.bodyStart} bytes`
  );
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  let p = b.bodyStart;

  // Function body begins with local declarations.
  const localCountInfo = readULEB(p);
  p = localCountInfo.next;

  console.log(
    `LOCAL DECL GROUPS : ${localCountInfo.value}`
  );

  for (let i = 0; i < localCountInfo.value; i++) {

    const n = readULEB(p);
    p = n.next;

    const type = buf[p++];

    console.log(
      `  locals[${i}] count=${n.value} type=0x${type
        .toString(16)
        .padStart(2, "0")}`
    );
  }

  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  let instructions = 0;

  while (p < b.bodyEnd) {

    const ins = readInstruction(p, b.bodyEnd);

    console.log(
      hex(ins.start),
      ins.text
    );

    p = ins.end;
    instructions++;

    if (instructions > 10000) {
      console.log("SAFETY STOP");
      break;
    }
  }

  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`FINAL : ${hex(p)}`);
  console.log(
    `EXPECTED : ${hex(b.bodyEnd)}`
  );
  console.log("");
}

import fs from "fs";

const START = 0x96600;

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function sleb32(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let x = 0;

  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= ~0 << s;

  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function memarg(p: number) {
  const a = uleb(p);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const END   = 0x00096853;

  0x00096653,
  0x0009670d,
  0x000967c8
]);

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);
  return { v, p };
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= ~0 << s;
  return { v, p };
}

function hx(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function memarg(p: number) {
  const a = uleb(p);
  const o = uleb(a.p);
  return { align: a.v, off: o.v, p: o.p };
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGETS = [0x95a47, 0x95d4f];

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { v: v >>> 0, p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (-1 << s);
  return { v: v | 0, p };
}

function decodeFrom(start: number, end: number) {
  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      const names: Record<number,string> = {
        0x20:"local.get",
        0x21:"local.set",
        0x22:"local.tee",
        0x23:"global.get",
        0x24:"global.set"
      };

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} ${names[op]} ${r.v}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} i32.const ${r.v}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
      const r = sleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} i64.const ${r.v}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} call ${r.v}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.p;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.p;

      const kind =
        op >= 0x36 ? "STORE" : "LOAD";

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} ${kind} op=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
        `align=${a.v} offset=${o.v}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0xfc) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} 0xfc subop=${r.v}`
      );

      if (r.v === 8 || r.v === 10) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.p;

        const c = uleb(p);
        p = c.p;
      }

      continue;
    }

    // common arithmetic/control
    if (
      op === 0x0b ||
      op === 0x05 ||
      op === 0x1a ||
      op === 0x6a ||
      op === 0x6b ||
      op === 0x71 ||
      op === 0x72 ||
      op === 0x73 ||
      op === 0x74 ||
      op === 0x75 ||
      op === 0x76 ||
      op === 0x7c ||
      op === 0x7d ||
      op === 0x7e ||
      op === 0x7f ||
      op === 0x80 ||
      op === 0x81 ||
      op === 0x82 ||
      op === 0x83 ||
      op === 0x84 ||
      op === 0x85 ||
      op === 0x86 ||
      op === 0x87 ||
      op === 0x88
    ) {
      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      if (b[p] === 0x40) {
        p++;
        console.log(`${hex(at)} block/loop/if blocktype=0x40`);
      } else {
        const r = sleb(p);
        p = r.p;
        console.log(
          `${hex(at)} block/loop/if blocktype=${r.v}`
        );
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} ${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"} ${r.v}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
    );
  }
}

for (const target of TARGETS) {
  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`TARGET STORE @ ${hex(target)}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  // Show 100 bytes before and 20 after.
  decodeFrom(target - 100, target + 20);
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" END V25");
console.log("============================================================");

const BODY_BOC =
    'te6cckEBAQEAVwAAqReNRRkAAAAAAAAAAFIiSmPsCAHjPyYW2Lkr1x78cDfEhWZTyVUtGMOargKZ0Mm80XL4bwA8Z+TC2xcleuPfjgb4kKzKeSqloxhzVcBTOhk3mi5fDcFbeW8f';

function hex32(value: bigint | number): string {
    return '0x' + BigInt(value).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function printRemaining(slice: Slice) {
    console.log('\nRemaining bits:', slice.remainingBits);
    console.log('Remaining refs:', slice.remainingRefs);

    if (slice.remainingBits > 0) {
        try {
            const raw = slice.loadUintBig(slice.remainingBits);
            console.log(
                'Remaining bits as hex:',
                '0x' + raw.toString(16)
            );
        } catch (e) {
            console.log(
                'Could not read remaining bits as uint'
            );
        }
    }
}

function decode(cell: Cell) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 INTERNAL_TRANSFER 0x178d4519');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    console.log('\nCell bits:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('Cell refs:', cell.refs.length);
    console.log('Cell hash:', cell.hash().toString('hex'));

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // OP
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const op = s.loadUint(32);

    console.log('\n1. OP');
    console.log('   hex:', hex32(op));
    console.log('   decimal:', op);

    if (op === 0x178d4519) {
        console.log('   OK: INTERNAL_TRANSFER');
    } else {
        console.log('   WARNING: unexpected opcode');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // QUERY ID
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    console.log('\n2. QUERY_ID');
    console.log('   value:', queryId.toString());

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // AMOUNT
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const amount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log('\n3. AMOUNT');
    console.log('   nano LP:', amount.toString());

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // FROM ADDRESS
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const fromAddress = s.loadAddress();

    console.log('\n4. FROM_ADDRESS');
    console.log(
        '   address:',
        fromAddress?.toString() ?? 'null'
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // RESPONSE ADDRESS
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const responseAddress = s.loadAddress();

    console.log('\n5. RESPONSE_ADDRESS');
    console.log(
        '   address:',
        responseAddress?.toString() ?? 'null'
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // FORWARD TON AMOUNT
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log('\n6. FORWARD_TON_AMOUNT');
    console.log('   nanoTON:', forwardTonAmount.toString());

    console.log(
        '   TON:',
        Number(forwardTonAmount) / 1_000_000_000
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // FORWARD PAYLOAD
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('\n7. FORWARD_PAYLOAD');

    const payloadBit = s.loadBit();

    console.log(
        '   Either flag:',
        payloadBit ? 'reference (^Cell)' : 'inline (Cell)'
    );

    if (payloadBit) {
        console.log(
            '   refs remaining:',
            s.remainingRefs
        );

        if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
            const payload = s.loadRef();

            console.log(
                '   payload bits:',
                payload.bits.length
            );

            console.log(
                '   payload refs:',
                payload.refs.length
            );

            console.log(
                '   payload BOC:',
                payload
                    .toBoc({ idx: false })
                    .toString('base64')
            );
        }
    } else {
        console.log(
            '   inline payload bits:',
            s.remainingBits
        );

        if (s.remainingBits > 0) {
            const payload = s.loadBits(s.remainingBits);

            console.log(
                '   inline payload:',
                payload.toString()
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('\nRemaining after decode:');
    console.log('   bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('   refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    printRemaining(s);

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('DONE');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

import fs from 'fs';

const WASM =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const TARGETS = [107, 116, 122];

const bytes = new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(WASM));

function readU32(pos: { v: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos.v++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readS32(pos: { v: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[pos.v++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << (shift + 7));
    }

    return result | 0;
}

function readU64(pos: { v: number }): bigint {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos.v++];

        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result;
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function readBytes(pos: { v: number }, n: number): Uint8Array {
    const out = bytes.slice(pos.v, pos.v + n);
    pos.v += n;
    return out;
}

function skipLimits(pos: { v: number }) {
    const flags = bytes[pos.v++];

    readU32(pos);

    if (flags & 0x01) {
        readU32(pos);
    }
}

function readName(pos: { v: number }): string {
    const n = readU32(pos);

    const data = readBytes(pos, n);

    return new TextDecoder().decode(data);
}

interface FnBody {
    index: number;
    offset: number;
    size: number;
    body: Uint8Array;
}

const IMPORTS = 83;

const functions = new Map<number, FnBody>();

interface IndirectCall {
    functionIndex: number;
    offsetInBody: number;
    typeIndex: number;
}

const indirectCalls: IndirectCall[] = [];

function decodeCallIndirect(body: Uint8Array): {
    offset: number;
    typeIndex: number;
}[] {
    const result: {
        offset: number;
        typeIndex: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
        if (body[i] !== 0x11) {
            continue;
        }

        let p = i + 1;

        let typeIndex = 0;
        let shift = 0;

        while (p < body.length) {
            const b = body[p++];

            typeIndex |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

            if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
                break;
            }

            shift += 7;
        }

        // call_indirect has an immediate table index.
        // In the current MVP encoding this is normally 0.
        const tableIndex = body[p];

        result.push({
            offset: i,
            typeIndex: typeIndex >>> 0,
        });

        void tableIndex;
    }

    return result;
}

function parseSections() {
    const pos = { v: 8 };

    while (pos.v < bytes.length) {
        const sectionId = bytes[pos.v++];

        const sectionSize = readU32(pos);

        const payloadStart = pos.v;
        const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

        console.log(
            `section ${sectionId} offset=${payloadStart} size=${sectionSize}`
        );

        // Import section
        if (sectionId === 2) {
            const count = readU32(pos);

            console.log(`  imports=${count}`);

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const module = readName(pos);
                const name = readName(pos);
                const kind = bytes[pos.v++];

                if (kind === 0) {
                    readU32(pos);
                } else if (kind === 1) {
                    const elementType = bytes[pos.v++];

                    void elementType;

                    skipLimits(pos);
                } else if (kind === 2) {
                    skipLimits(pos);
                } else if (kind === 3) {
                    pos.v += 2;
                } else {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Unknown import kind ${kind} at import ${i}`
                    );
                }

                if (i < 90) {
                    console.log(
                        `    #${i} ${module}.${name} kind=${kind}`
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        // Table section
        if (sectionId === 4) {
            const count = readU32(pos);

            console.log('');
            console.log('  ================= TABLE SECTION =================');

            console.log(`  table count=${count}`);

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const elementType = bytes[pos.v++];

                const before = pos.v;

                const flags = bytes[pos.v++];

                const minimum = readU32(pos);

                let maximum: number | undefined;

                if (flags & 0x01) {
                    maximum = readU32(pos);
                }

                console.log(
                    `  table[${i}] ` +
                    `elementType=0x${elementType.toString(16)} ` +
                    `flags=${flags} ` +
                    `min=${minimum}` +
                    (maximum !== undefined
                        ? ` max=${maximum}`
                        : '')
                );

                console.log(
                    `    descriptorBytes=${pos.v - before}`
                );
            }
        }

        // Element section
        if (sectionId === 9) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('  ================= ELEMENT SECTION =================');

            const count = readU32(pos);

            console.log(`  element segments=${count}`);

            for (let segment = 0; segment < count; segment++) {
                const segmentStart = pos.v;

                const flags = readU32(pos);

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    `  segment[${segment}] ` +
                    `flags=${flags} ` +
                    `offset=${segmentStart}`
                );

                /*
                 * We handle the common active-table forms:
                 *
                 * flags 0:
                 *   table 0
                 *   offset expr
                 *   vec(funcidx)
                 *
                 * flags 2:
                 *   tableidx
                 *   offset expr
                 *   elemkind
                 *   vec(funcidx)
                 *
                 * Other forms are reported but not guessed.
                 */

                if (flags === 0) {
                    console.log('    table=0');

                    const opcode = bytes[pos.v++];

                    console.log(
                        `    offset expr first opcode=0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
                    );

                    // Common i32.const expression
                    if (opcode === 0x41) {
                        const value = readS32(pos);

                        console.log(`    offset=${value}`);
                    } else {
                        console.log(
                            '    non-i32.const offset expression'
                        );

                        // We cannot safely skip arbitrary expressions here.
                        // Stop parsing this segment.
                        pos.v = payloadEnd;
                        break;
                    }

                    const endOpcode = bytes[pos.v++];

                    if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
                        console.log(
                            `    unexpected offset end=0x${endOpcode.toString(16)}`
                        );
                    }

                    const n = readU32(pos);

                    console.log(`    function count=${n}`);

                    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        const fn = readU32(pos);

                        console.log(
                            `      table[${j}] = function ${fn}`
                        );
                    }
                } else if (flags === 2) {
                    const tableIndex = readU32(pos);

                    console.log(
                        `    tableIndex=${tableIndex}`
                    );

                    const opcode = bytes[pos.v++];

                    console.log(
                        `    offset expr first opcode=0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
                    );

                    if (opcode === 0x41) {
                        const value = readS32(pos);

                        console.log(`    offset=${value}`);
                    } else {
                        console.log(
                            '    non-i32.const offset expression'
                        );

                        pos.v = payloadEnd;
                        break;
                    }

                    const endOpcode = bytes[pos.v++];

                    if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
                        console.log(
                            `    unexpected offset end=0x${endOpcode.toString(16)}`
                        );
                    }

                    const elemKind = bytes[pos.v++];

                    console.log(
                        `    elemkind=0x${elemKind.toString(16)}`
                    );

                    const n = readU32(pos);

                    console.log(`    function count=${n}`);

                    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                        const fn = readU32(pos);

                        console.log(
                            `      table[${j}] = function ${fn}`
                        );
                    }
                } else {
                    console.log(
                        `    unsupported element flags=${flags}`
                    );

                    pos.v = payloadEnd;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        // Code section
        if (sectionId === 10) {
            const count = readU32(pos);

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `  code functions=${count}`
            );

            for (let defined = 0; defined < count; defined++) {
                const size = readU32(pos);

                const offset = pos.v;

                const body = readBytes(pos, size);

                const index = IMPORTS + defined;

                functions.set(index, {
                    index,
                    offset,
                    size,
                    body,
                });

                if (TARGETS.includes(index)) {
                    const calls = decodeCallIndirect(body);

                    for (const c of calls) {
                        indirectCalls.push({
                            functionIndex: index,
                            offsetInBody: c.offset,
                            typeIndex: c.typeIndex,
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        pos.v = payloadEnd;
    }
}

function main() {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' WASM TABLE + ELEMENT + CALL_INDIRECT INSPECTOR v22');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - OFFLINE');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log(`WASM: ${WASM}`);
    console.log(`size: ${bytes.length.toLocaleString()}`);
    console.log('');

    parseSections();

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' TARGET CALL_INDIRECT');
    console.log('============================================================');

    for (const c of indirectCalls) {
        const fn = functions.get(c.functionIndex);

        console.log(
            `F#${c.functionIndex} ` +
            `offset=${fn?.offset ?? '?'} ` +
            `bodyOffset=${c.offsetInBody} ` +
            `typeIndex=${c.typeIndex}`
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' DONE');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

main();

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';

const ROOSTER_BODY =
    '';

const PTON_BODY =
    '';

function hex(value: number | bigint, bytes = 4) {
    return '0x' + value.toString(16).padStart(bytes * 2, '0');
}

function printCell(cell: Cell, name: string) {
    console.log(`\n===== ${name} =====`);

    console.log('Bits:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', cell.refs.length);

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    if (s.remainingBits >= 32) {
        const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

        console.log('Opcode:', hex(opcode));
        console.log('Opcode decimal:', opcode.toString());
    }

    console.log('\n===== CELL TREE =====');

    function walk(c: Cell, level: number, path: string) {
        const indent = '  '.repeat(level);

        console.log(
            `${indent}${path}: bits=${c.bits.length}, refs=${c.refs.length}`
        );

        if (c.bits.length >= 32) {
            try {
                const ss = c.beginParse();
                const op = ss.loadUint(32);

                console.log(
                    `${indent}  first_uint32=${hex(op)} (${op.toString()})`
                );
            } catch {
                // ignore
            }
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < c.refs.length; i++) {
            walk(c.refs[i], level + 1, `${path}.ref[${i}]`);
        }
    }

    walk(cell, 0, 'root');
}

function decodeRooster(cell: Cell) {
    console.log('\n===== ROOSTER TRANSACTION FIELDS =====');

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
    const amount = s.loadCoins();
    const destination = s.loadAddress();
    const responseDestination = s.loadAddress();

    console.log('Opcode:', hex(opcode));
    console.log('Query ID:', queryId.toString());
    console.log('Amount nano:', amount.toString());
    console.log('Amount ROOSTER:', Number(amount) / 1e9);
    console.log('Destination:', destination?.toString());
    console.log('Response destination:', responseDestination?.toString());

    console.log('Remaining bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Remaining refs:', s.remainingRefs);
}

export async function run() {
    const rooster = Cell.fromBase64(ROOSTER_BODY);
    const pton = Cell.fromBase64(PTON_BODY);

    printCell(rooster, 'ROOSTER BODY');
    printCell(pton, 'PTON BODY');

    decodeRooster(rooster);

    console.log('\n===== DONE =====');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';

const ROOSTER_BOC =
    '';

const PTON_BOC =
    '';

function inspectCell(
    name: string,
    cell: Cell
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(name);
    console.log('================================================');

    console.log(
        'Bits:',
        cell.bits.length
    );

    console.log(
        'Refs:',
        cell.refs.length
    );

    const slice = cell.beginParse();

    if (slice.remainingBits >= 32) {
        const opcode = slice.loadUint(32);

        console.log(
            'Opcode:',
            '0x' +
            opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'Hash:',
        cell.hash().toString('hex')
    );

    console.log('');

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < cell.refs.length;
        i++
    ) {
        const ref = cell.refs[i];

        console.log(
            `REF ${i + 1}:`
        );

        console.log(
            '  Bits:',
            ref.bits.length
        );

        console.log(
            '  Refs:',
            ref.refs.length
        );

        const refSlice =
            ref.beginParse();

        if (
            refSlice.remainingBits >= 32
        ) {
            const opcode =
                refSlice.loadUint(32);

            console.log(
                '  Opcode:',
                '0x' +
                opcode
                    .toString(16)
                    .padStart(8, '0')
            );
        }

        console.log(
            '  Hash:',
            ref.hash().toString('hex')
        );

        console.log('');

        for (
            let j = 0;
            j < ref.refs.length;
            j++
        ) {
            const child =
                ref.refs[j];

            console.log(
                `  REF ${i + 1}.${j + 1}:`
            );

            console.log(
                '    Bits:',
                child.bits.length
            );

            console.log(
                '    Refs:',
                child.refs.length
            );

            const childSlice =
                child.beginParse();

            if (
                childSlice.remainingBits >= 32
            ) {
                const opcode =
                    childSlice.loadUint(32);

                console.log(
                    '    Opcode:',
                    '0x' +
                    opcode
                        .toString(16)
                        .padStart(8, '0')
                );
            }

            console.log(
                '    Hash:',
                child.hash().toString('hex')
            );
        }
    }
}

import { Address, TonClient, Cell, Slice } from '@ton/ton';

const USER_WALLET =
    '0QDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N6R-';

const ROOSTER_WALLET =
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh';

const TARGET_LT = '99809465000001';

const client = new TonClient({
    endpoint:
        'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
});

function addr(slice: Slice): string {
    try {
        return slice.loadAddress().toString();
    } catch {
        return 'ADDRESS_ERROR';
    }
}

function coins(slice: Slice): bigint {
    try {
        return slice.loadCoins();
    } catch {
        return 0n;
    }
}

function readOpcode(cell: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);

    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function opcodeText(op: number | null): string {

    if (op === null) {
        return 'NONE';
    }

    const hex =
        '0x' +
        op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');

    let name = 'UNKNOWN';

    switch (hex) {

        case '0x0f8a7ea5':
            name = 'Jetton transfer';
            break;

        case '0x178d4519':
            name = 'Jetton internal_transfer';
            break;

        case '0x37c096df':
            name = 'STON.Fi provide_lp';
            break;

        case '0x01f3835d':
            name = 'pTON operation';
            break;

        case '0x7369676e':
            name = 'Wallet signature';
            break;
    }

    return `${hex}  (${name})`;
}

function dumpCell(
    title: string,
    cell: Cell,
    depth = 0
) {

    const indent =
        '  '.repeat(depth);

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `${indent}${title}`
    );

    console.log(
        `${indent}--------------------------------`
    );

    console.log(
        `${indent}bits : ${cell.bits.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `${indent}refs : ${cell.refs.length}`
    );

    const op =
        readOpcode(cell);

    console.log(
        `${indent}opcode: ${opcodeText(op)}`
    );

    try {

        console.log(
            `${indent}BOC: ${cell
                .toBoc()
                .toString('base64')}`
        );

    } catch {
        console.log(
            `${indent}BOC: ERROR`
        );
    }

    if (depth >= 4) {
        return;
    }

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < cell.refs.length;
        i++
    ) {

        dumpCell(
            `REF ${i + 1}`,
            cell.refs[i],
            depth + 1
        );
    }
}

function decodeJettonTransfer(
    body: Cell
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        'JETTON TRANSFER DECODE'
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    const s =
        body.beginParse();

    const op =
        s.loadUint(32);

    console.log(
        `opcode       : ${opcodeText(op)}`
    );

    const queryId =
        s.loadUintBig(64);

    console.log(
        `query_id     : ${queryId.toString()}`
    );

    const amount =
        coins(s);

    console.log(
        `jetton amount: ${amount.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `display      : ${Number(amount) / 1e9} ROOSTER`
    );

    const destination =
        addr(s);

    console.log(
        `destination  : ${destination}`
    );

    const responseDestination =
        addr(s);

    console.log(
        `response dest: ${responseDestination}`
    );

    /*
     * custom_payload:
     *
     * Maybe (Either Cell ^Cell)
     */

    const hasCustomPayload =
        s.loadBit();

    console.log(
        `custom payload present: ${hasCustomPayload}`
    );

    if (hasCustomPayload) {

        const customIsRef =
            s.loadBit();

        console.log(
            `custom payload is ref: ${customIsRef}`
        );

        if (customIsRef) {

            const custom =
                s.loadRef();

            dumpCell(
                'CUSTOM PAYLOAD',
                custom
            );

        } else {

            const custom =
                s.asCell();

            dumpCell(
                'CUSTOM PAYLOAD INLINE',
                custom
            );
        }
    }

    const forwardTonAmount =
        coins(s);

    console.log(
        `forward TON  : ${forwardTonAmount.toString()} nanotons`
    );

    console.log(
        `forward TON  : ${Number(forwardTonAmount) / 1e9} TON`
    );

    /*
     * forward_payload:
     *
     * Either Cell ^Cell
     */

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'FORWARD PAYLOAD'
    );

    const forwardIsRef =
        s.loadBit();

    console.log(
        `forward payload is ref: ${forwardIsRef}`
    );

    let forwardPayload: Cell;

    if (forwardIsRef) {

        forwardPayload =
            s.loadRef();

    } else {

        forwardPayload =
            s.asCell();
    }

    dumpCell(
        'FORWARD PAYLOAD ROOT',
        forwardPayload
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        'END JETTON TRANSFER DECODE'
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
}

function decodePtonMessage(
    body: Cell
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        'PTON MESSAGE RAW DECODE'
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    dumpCell(
        'PTON ROOT',
        body
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'The complete pTON body is preserved above.'
    );
}

export async function run() {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        '       STON.FI V2.2 LIQUIDITY PAYLOAD DECODER'
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        'READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT'
    );

    console.log(
        `TARGET LT: ${TARGET_LT}`
    );

    console.log('');

    const user =
        Address.parse(USER_WALLET);

    console.log(
        `Reading: ${user.toString()}`
    );

    const transactions =
        await client.getTransactions(
            user,
            {
                limit: 10,
            }
        );

    console.log(
        `Transactions returned: ${transactions.length}`
    );

    const tx: any =
        transactions.find(
            (x: any) =>
                String(x.lt) === TARGET_LT
        );

    if (!tx) {

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'TARGET TRANSACTION NOT FOUND'
        );

        return;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'TARGET TRANSACTION FOUND'
    );

    console.log(
        `LT: ${tx.lt}`
    );

    console.log(
        `HASH: ${Buffer.from(
            tx.hash()
        ).toString('base64')}`
    );

    if (!tx.outMessages) {

        console.log(
            'No outgoing messages.'
        );

        return;
    }

    let index = 1;

    for (
        const message
        of tx.outMessages.values()
    ) {

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            `OUTGOING MESSAGE ${index}`
        );

        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );

        try {

            const info =
                message.info;

            const destination =
                info.dest?.toString() ??
                'unknown';

            const value =
                info.value?.coins ??
                0n;

            console.log(
                `destination: ${destination}`
            );

            console.log(
                `value      : ${value.toString()} nanotons`
            );

        } catch {
            // ignore
        }

        if (!message.body) {

            console.log(
                'No body.'
            );

            index++;
            continue;
        }

        const op =
            readOpcode(message.body);

        console.log(
            `opcode     : ${opcodeText(op)}`
        );

        if (
            op === 0x0f8a7ea5
        ) {

            decodeJettonTransfer(
                message.body
            );

        } else if (
            op === 0x01f3835d
        ) {

            decodePtonMessage(
                message.body
            );

        } else {

            dumpCell(
                'MESSAGE BODY',
                message.body
            );
        }

        index++;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        'TRACE COMPLETE'
    );

    console.log(
        'NO TRANSACTION SENT'
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';

export async function run() {
    const boc =
        'te6cckEBAwEAzwABZAHzg10AAAAAAAAAAEBfXhAIAeM/JhbYuSvXHvxwN8SFZlPJVS0Yw5quApnQybzRcvhvAQHhN8CW34AEx3gN5WPFrXscgQQeOvvatValdjQXGwd/WUIYGRWYtNADxn5MLbFyV649+OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N4AeM/JhbYuSvXHvxwN8SFZlPJVS0Yw5quApnQybzRcvhuAAAAANVpZ2MACAEcQGAHjPyYW2Lkr1x78cDfEhWZTyVUtGMOargKZ0Mm80XL4bwQFVxRf';

    const root = Cell.fromBoc(
        Buffer.from(boc, 'base64')
    )[0];

    function decode(cell: Cell, level: number) {
        const prefix = '  '.repeat(level);

        console.log(`${prefix}===== CELL ${level} =====`);
        console.log(`${prefix}Hash: ${cell.hash().toString('hex')}`);
        console.log(`${prefix}Bits: ${cell.bits.length}`);
        console.log(`${prefix}Refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);

        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits >= 32) {
            try {
                console.log(
                    `${prefix}First uint32: 0x${s.loadUint(32).toString(16)}`
                );
            } catch {}
        }

        if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
            try {
                console.log(
                    `${prefix}Next uint64: ${s.loadUintBig(64).toString()}`
                );
            } catch {}
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
            decode(cell.refs[i], level + 1);
        }
    }

    console.log('===== FULL LIQUIDITY TX DECODER =====');

    decode(root, 0);
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {

    console.log('\nQUERY ID:');

        s.loadUintBig(64).toString()
    );

    console.log('\nAMOUNT (loadCoins):');
    const amount = s.loadCoins();
    console.log(amount.toString());

    console.log('\nAMOUNT / 1e9:');
    console.log(
        (Number(amount) / 1e9).toFixed(9)
    );

    console.log('\nREMAINING BITS AFTER AMOUNT:');
    console.log(s.remainingBits);

    console.log('\nREMAINING REFS AFTER AMOUNT:');
    console.log(s.remainingRefs);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Try next field as address
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    try {

        const address1 = s.loadAddress();

        console.log('\nFIELD #1 AFTER AMOUNT: ADDRESS');
        console.log(address1?.toString() ?? 'null');

    } catch (e: any) {

        console.log('\nFIELD #1 AFTER AMOUNT: NOT ADDRESS');
        console.log(e?.message || String(e));
    }

    console.log('\nREMAINING BITS:');
    console.log(s.remainingBits);

    console.log('\nREMAINING REFS:');
    console.log(s.remainingRefs);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Try next field as address
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    try {

        const address2 = s.loadAddress();

        console.log('\nFIELD #2 AFTER AMOUNT: ADDRESS');
        console.log(address2?.toString() ?? 'null');

    } catch (e: any) {

        console.log('\nFIELD #2 AFTER AMOUNT: NOT ADDRESS');
        console.log(e?.message || String(e));
    }

    console.log('\nREMAINING BITS:');
    console.log(s.remainingBits);

    console.log('\nREMAINING REFS:');
    console.log(s.remainingRefs);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Try remaining data as coins
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    try {

        const value = s.loadCoins();

        console.log('\nNEXT FIELD AS COINS:');
        console.log(value.toString());

    } catch (e: any) {

        console.log('\nNEXT FIELD IS NOT COINS');
        console.log(e?.message || String(e));
    }

    console.log('\nFINAL REMAINING BITS:');
    console.log(s.remainingBits);

    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {

        endpoint: RPC,
    });

        LP_WALLET,

    if (!tx) {

        console.log('\nNO INCOMING MESSAGE');
        return;
    }

    console.log('\nHASH:');

    console.log('\nDESTINATION:');
    console.log(msg.info.dest.toString());

    console.log('\nTON VALUE:');
    console.log(msg.info.value.coins.toString());

    const body = msg.body;

    console.log('\nBODY BITS:');
    console.log(body.bits.length);

    console.log('\nBODY REFS:');
    console.log(body.refs.length);

    console.log('\nBODY BOC HEX FROM LIVE TRANSACTION:');
    console.log(body.toBoc().toString('hex'));

    const s = body.beginParse();

    console.log('\n' + '-'.repeat(70));
    console.log('DECODE');
    console.log('-'.repeat(70));

    console.log('\nOPCODE:');
    console.log(
        '0x' +
        s.loadUint(32)
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, '0')
    );

    console.log('\nQUERY ID:');
    console.log(
        s.loadUintBig(64).toString()
    );

    console.log('\nNEXT 128 BITS:');
    console.log(
        s.loadUintBig(128).toString()
    );

    console.log('\nREMAINING BITS:');
    console.log(s.remainingBits);

    console.log('\nREMAINING REFS:');
    console.log(s.remainingRefs);

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(70));
    console.log('LIVE DECODING COMPLETE');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

function printCell(name: string, cell: Cell, level = 0) {

    const pad = ' '.repeat(level * 2);

    console.log('');
    console.log(`${pad}===== ${name} =====`);
    console.log(`${pad}bits: ${cell.bits.length}`);
    console.log(`${pad}refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);
    console.log(`${pad}exotic: ${cell.isExotic}`);
    console.log(`${pad}type: ${cell.type}`);
    console.log(`${pad}hash: ${cell.hash().toString('hex')}`);

    console.log(
        `${pad}boc: ${cell.toBoc({ idx: false }).toString('base64')}`
    );

    try {
        console.log(
            `${pad}bits-string: ${cell.bits.toString()}`
        );
    } catch (e: any) {
        console.log(
            `${pad}bits-string: <unavailable>`
        );
    }

    cell.refs.forEach((ref, i) => {
        printCell(`${name}.ref[${i}]`, ref, level + 1);
    });
}

export async function run(provider: any) {

    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('      LIVE ROUTER LIBRARY INSPECTION');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Router:', ROUTER.toString());
    console.log('');

    const result = await provider.provider(ROUTER).getState();

    if (result.state.type !== 'active') {
        console.log('Router is not active.');
        return;
    }

    const data = Cell.fromBoc(result.state.data)[0];

    console.log('===== LIVE ROOT DATA =====');
    console.log('bits:', data.bits.length);
    console.log('refs:', data.refs.length);
    console.log('hash:', data.hash().toString('hex'));

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== LIVE DATA TREE =====');

    printCell('ROOT', data);

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' LIBRARY CONTAINER CHECK');
    console.log('========================================');

    if (data.refs.length < 2) {
        console.log('ERROR: Router data has fewer than 2 refs.');
        return;
    }

    const container = data.refs[1];

    console.log('Container bits:', container.bits.length);
    console.log('Container refs:', container.refs.length);

    for (let i = 0; i < container.refs.length; i++) {

        const lib = container.refs[i];

        console.log('');
        console.log(`===== LIVE LIBRARY ${i + 1} =====`);
        console.log('Cell hash:', lib.hash().toString('hex'));
        console.log('bits:', lib.bits.length);
        console.log('refs:', lib.refs.length);
        console.log('exotic:', lib.isExotic);
        console.log('type:', lib.type);

        console.log(
            'BOC:',
            lib.toBoc({ idx: false }).toString('base64')
        );

        try {
            console.log(
                'BITS:',
                lib.bits.toString()
            );
        } catch {
            console.log(
                'BITS: <unavailable>'
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY CHECK COMPLETE');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('========================================');
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x9652b;
const END   = 0x96566;

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      break;

    s += 7;
  }

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function sleb32(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let x = 0;

  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= ~0 << s;

  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function sleb64(p: number) {
  let v = 0n;
  let s = 0n;
  let x = 0;

  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= BigInt(x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7n;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 64n && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (-1n) << s;

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function memarg(p: number) {
  const a = uleb(p);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next
  };
}

function blocktype(p: number) {
  const x = b[p];

  if (x === 0x40)
    return { text: "void", next: p + 1 };

  const r = sleb32(p);

  return {
    text: String(r.value),
    next: r.next
  };
}

const names: Record<number,string> = {

  0x20: "local.get",
  0x21: "local.set",
  0x22: "local.tee",

  0x41: "i32.const",
  0x42: "i64.const",

  0x28: "i32.load",
  0x29: "i64.load",

  0x2d: "i32.load8_u",

  0x46: "i32.eq",
  0x47: "i32.ne",

  0x49: "i32.lt_u",

  0x1b: "select",

  0x6a: "i32.add",
  0x6b: "i32.sub",

  0x71: "i32.and",
  0x72: "i32.or",
  0x73: "i32.xor",

  0x74: "i32.shl",
  0x75: "i32.shr_s",
  0x76: "i32.shr_u",
  0x77: "i32.rotl",
  0x78: "i32.rotr",

  0x7c: "i64.add",
  0x7d: "i64.sub",
  0x7e: "i64.mul",

  0x83: "i64.and",
  0x85: "i64.xor",

  0xac: "i64.extend_i32_s",
  0xad: "i64.extend_i32_u"
};

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" LOCAL13 EXACT PRODUCER V15");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

console.log(`Range: ${hx(START)} .. ${hx(END)}`);
console.log();

let p = START;

while (p < END) {

  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let name =
    names[op] ??
    `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")})`;

  let extra = "";

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22
  ) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.next;
    extra = ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = sleb32(p);
    p = r.next;
    extra = ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x42) {
    const r = sleb64(p);
    p = r.next;
    extra = ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2d
  ) {
    const m = memarg(p);
    p = m.next;
    extra =
      ` align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x03) {
    const r = blocktype(p);
    p = r.next;
    extra = ` blocktype=${r.text}`;
  }

  else if (op === 0xfc) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.next;

    const sub = r.value;

    if (sub === 10) {

      const dst = uleb(p);
      p = dst.next;

      const src = uleb(p);
      p = src.next;

      extra =
        ` memory.copy dst=${dst.value} src=${src.value}`;

      name = "memory.copy";
    }
    else {
      name += ` sub=${sub}`;
    }
  }

  console.log(
    `${hx(at)}  ${name}${extra}`
  );
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" RAW BYTES");
console.log("============================================================");

for (let i = START; i < END; i += 16) {

  const e = Math.min(i + 16, END);

  const bytes: string[] = [];

  for (let j = i; j < e; j++)
    bytes.push(
      b[j].toString(16).padStart(2,"0")
    );

  console.log(`${hx(i)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`);
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" TARGET");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log();
console.log("Producer:");
console.log("  local13 = value generated immediately before");
console.log("  0x96565 local.set 13");
console.log();

console.log("Consumer:");
console.log("  0x965fa -> MEM[G-8] = local13");
console.log();

console.log("Then:");
console.log("  G208[i] =");
console.log("    (old_G208[i] XOR local13)");
console.log("    XOR");
console.log("    (G336[i] AND");
console.log("      (old_G208[i] XOR local13))");
console.log();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" END V15");
console.log("============================================================");

while (p < END) {

  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  const name =
    names[op] ??
    `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")})`;

  let extra = "";

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24
  ) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.next;

    extra = ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x41) {

    const r = sleb32(p);
    p = r.next;

    extra = ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (op === 0x42) {

    const r = sleb64(p);
    p = r.next;

    extra = ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (
    op >= 0x28 &&
    op <= 0x35
  ) {

    const m = memarg(p);
    p = m.next;

    extra =
      ` align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;
  }

  else if (
    op >= 0x36 &&
    op <= 0x3e
  ) {

    const m = memarg(p);
    p = m.next;

    extra =
      ` align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;
  }

  else if (
    op === 0x10 ||
    op === 0x0c ||
    op === 0x0d
  ) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.next;

    extra = ` ${r.value}`;
  }

  else if (
    op === 0x03 ||
    op === 0x04
  ) {

    const r = sleb32(p);
    p = r.next;

    extra = ` blocktype=${r.value}`;
  }

  console.log(
    `${hx(at)}  ${name}${extra}`
  );
}

  const end = Math.min(i + 16, 0x963f8);

  const s: string[] = [];

  for (let j = i; j < end; j++)
    s.push(b[j].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));

  console.log(`${hx(i)}  ${s.join(" ")}`);

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LP_ACCOUNT = Address.parse(
    'EQCEwfJtb6ZmPJdNw387eJwed2N51K6dFFbH82jTxe_cf31e'
);

const OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY = 0x50c6a654;

function formatInteger(value: bigint): string {
    return value
        .toString()
        .replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
}

function formatToken9(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    if (fraction.length === 0) {
        return whole.toLocaleString();
    }

    return `${whole.toLocaleString()}.${fraction}`;
}

function getOpcode(body: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function decodeAddLiquidity(
    body: Cell,
    txLt: string
) {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

        if (opcode !== OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
            return false;
        }

        /*
         * STON.fi v2.2 LP Account add_liquidity body:
         *
         * opcode
         * query_id
         * new_amount0
         * new_amount1
         * min_lp_out
         * fwd_amount
         * both_positive
         * to_user
         * custom_payload
         * additional_fields:
         *   refund_address
         *   excess_address
         */

        const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

        const newAmount0 = s.loadCoins();

        const newAmount1 = s.loadCoins();

        const minLpOut = s.loadCoins();

        const fwdAmount = s.loadCoins();

        const bothPositive = s.loadBit();

        const toUser = s.loadAddress();

        const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

        if (hasCustomPayload) {
            s.loadRef();
        }

        const additionalFields = s.loadRef();

        const a = additionalFields.beginParse();

        const refundAddress = a.loadAddress();

        const excessAddress = a.loadAddress();

        console.log('');
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );
        console.log(
            ` ADD_LIQUIDITY DECODE — LT ${txLt}`
        );
        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('OPCODE:');
        console.log(
            '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('QUERY ID:');
        console.log(queryId.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('NEW AMOUNT0 RAW:');
        console.log(formatInteger(newAmount0));

        console.log('');
        console.log('NEW AMOUNT0 TOKEN:');
        console.log(formatToken9(newAmount0));

        console.log('');
        console.log('NEW AMOUNT1 RAW:');
        console.log(formatInteger(newAmount1));

        console.log('');
        console.log('NEW AMOUNT1 TOKEN:');
        console.log(formatToken9(newAmount1));

        console.log('');
        console.log('MIN LP OUT:');
        console.log(formatInteger(minLpOut));

        console.log('');
        console.log('FWD AMOUNT:');
        console.log(formatInteger(fwdAmount));

        console.log('');
        console.log('BOTH POSITIVE:');
        console.log(
            bothPositive ? 'YES' : 'NO'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('TO USER:');
        console.log(
            toUser
                ? toUser.toString()
                : 'NULL'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('CUSTOM PAYLOAD:');
        console.log(
            hasCustomPayload ? 'YES' : 'NO'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('REFUND ADDRESS:');
        console.log(
            refundAddress
                ? refundAddress.toString()
                : 'NULL'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('EXCESS ADDRESS:');
        console.log(
            excessAddress
                ? excessAddress.toString()
                : 'NULL'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('REMAINING ROOT BITS:');
        console.log(s.remainingBits);

        console.log('');
        console.log('REMAINING ROOT REFS:');
        console.log(s.remainingRefs);

        console.log('');
        console.log('============================================================');

        return {
            newAmount0,
            newAmount1,
            minLpOut,
        };

    } catch (error) {

        console.log('');
        console.log('ADD_LIQUIDITY DECODE FAILED');

        console.log(
            error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : String(error)
        );

        return false;
    }
}

export async function run(
    _provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STON.fi v2.2 LP ACCOUNT ADD_LIQUIDITY DECODER'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        'READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('LP ACCOUNT:');
    console.log(LP_ACCOUNT.toString());

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint:
            'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('Fetching LP Account transactions...');

    const transactions =
        await client.getTransactions(
            LP_ACCOUNT,
            {
                limit: 100,
            }
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log('TRANSACTIONS FETCHED:');
    console.log(transactions.length);

    let found = 0;

    for (const tx of transactions) {

        if (!tx.inMessage) {
            continue;
        }

        if (
            tx.inMessage.info.type !==
            'internal'
        ) {
            continue;
        }

        const body =
            tx.inMessage.body;

        const opcode =
            getOpcode(body);

        if (opcode !== OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
            continue;
        }

        found++;

        decodeAddLiquidity(
            body,
            tx.lt.toString()
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log('ADD_LIQUIDITY MESSAGES FOUND:');
    console.log(found);

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'DECODER COMPLETE'
    );

    console.log(
        'READ ONLY'
    );

    console.log(
        'NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT'
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
}

import { Address, Cell, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';

const LP_ACCOUNT = Address.parse(
    'EQCEwfJtb6ZmPJdNw387eJwed2N51K6dFFbH82jTxe_cf31e'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000011n;

function opcodeHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';

    return (
        '0x' +
        op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
    );
}

function getOpcode(cell: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function formatNano(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction = (
        value % 1_000_000_000n
    )
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : whole.toString();
}

function sameAddress(a: Address | null, b: Address): boolean {
    return !!a && a.equals(b);
}

async function main() {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    console.log('refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    console.log();

    console.log('FIELD 1: ADDRESS');
    console.log('============================================================');

    const field1Start = 0;

    console.log('start bit:', field1Start);

    console.log('address:', field1?.toString());

    if (sameAddress(field1, EXPECTED_OWNER)) {
        console.log('*** MATCH: KNOWN OWNER ***');
    } else {
        console.log('*** NOT THE EXPECTED OWNER ***');
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
