    console.log('end bit:', 534);
    console.log('address:', field2?.toString());

    if (sameAddress(field2, EXPECTED_POOL)) {
        console.log('*** MATCH: KNOWN POOL ***');
    } else {
        console.log('*** NOT THE EXPECTED POOL ***');
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // FIELD 3
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    console.log();
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('FIELD 3: REMAINING 48 BITS');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('bits before field 3:', s.remainingBits);

    if (s.remainingBits !== 48) {
        console.log(
            `WARNING: expected 48 remaining bits, got ${s.remainingBits}`
        );
    }

    const field3 = s.loadUintBig(s.remainingBits);

    console.log('field3 decimal:', field3.toString());
    console.log('field3 hex:', '0x' + field3.toString(16));

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Interpret field 3 as possible amounts
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    console.log();
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('FIELD 3 INTERPRETATION');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log(
        'as nano ROOSTER:',
        field3.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'as ROOSTER:',
        Number(field3) / 1_000_000_000
    );

    console.log(
        'target 7.219004800 nano:',
        7219004800n.toString()
    );

    if (field3 === 7219004800n) {
        console.log(
            '*** EXACT MATCH: 7.219004800 ROOSTER ***'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            'field3 is NOT 7.219004800 ROOSTER'
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('FINAL STRUCTURE');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log(
        'FIELD 1 [0..266]   =',
        field1?.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'FIELD 2 [267..533] =',
        field2?.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'FIELD 3 [534..581] =',
        field3.toString()
    );

    console.log();
    console.log('remaining bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('remaining refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    if (s.remainingBits === 0 && s.remainingRefs === 0) {
        console.log();
        console.log(
            '*** COMPLETE CELL CONSUMED EXACTLY ***'
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log('END');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
}

    await main();
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const BOC =
    'b5ee9c724101010100570000a9178d4519000000000000000052224a63ec0801e33f2616d8b92bd71efc7037c4856653c9552d18c39aae0299d0c9bcd172f86f003c67e4c2db17257ae3df8e06f890acca792aa5a3187355c0533a19379a2e5f0dc15b796f1f';

function formatAmount(value: bigint, decimals = 9): string {
    const base = 10n ** BigInt(decimals);
    const whole = value / base;
    const fraction = (value % base)
        .toString()
        .padStart(decimals, '0');

    return `${whole}.${fraction}`;
}

function formatAddress(address: Address | null): string {
    if (!address) return 'null';

    return address.toString({
        urlSafe: true,
        bounceable: true,
        testOnly: true,
    });
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP WALLET INTERNAL TRANSFER DECODER');
    console.log(' opcode: 0x178d4519');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - OFFLINE BOC DECODING');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    // IMPORTANT:
    // The supplied BOC is HEX, not Base64.
    const bocBytes = Buffer.from(BOC, 'hex');

    console.log('\nBOC HEX LENGTH:', BOC.length);
    console.log('BOC BYTE LENGTH:', bocBytes.length);
    console.log('BOC MAGIC:', bocBytes.subarray(0, 4).toString('hex'));

    const roots = Cell.fromBoc(bocBytes);

    console.log('BOC ROOT COUNT:', roots.length);

    const cell = roots[0];
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // HEADER
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    console.log('\nHEADER');
    console.log('Opcode :', '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0'));
    console.log('Query ID:', queryId.toString());

    if (opcode !== 0x178d4519) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected opcode: 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // amount
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const amount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log('\nLP AMOUNT');
    console.log('Raw:', amount.toString());
    console.log('LP :', formatAmount(amount));

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // from_address
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const fromAddress = s.loadAddress();

    console.log('\nFROM ADDRESS');
    console.log(formatAddress(fromAddress));

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // response_address
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const responseAddress = s.loadAddress();

    console.log('\nRESPONSE ADDRESS');
    console.log(formatAddress(responseAddress));

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // forward_ton_amount
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log('\nFORWARD TON AMOUNT');
    console.log('Raw:', forwardTonAmount.toString());
    console.log('TON:', formatAmount(forwardTonAmount));

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // remaining payload
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('\nFORWARD PAYLOAD');
    console.log('Remaining bits :', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Remaining refs :', s.remainingRefs);

    if (s.remainingBits > 0) {
        const bits = s.loadBits(s.remainingBits);

        console.log('Payload bits length:', bits.length);
        console.log('Payload bits:', bits.toString());
    }

    if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
        let index = 0;

        while (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
            const ref = s.loadRef();

            console.log(`Payload ref [${index}] BOC:`);
            console.log(ref.toBoc().toString('base64'));

        }

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const CONTENT_BOC =
    'te6cckEBAQEAZQAAxgFodHRwczovL21ldGEuc3Rvbi5maS9scC92MS8wOkY5MDBCNjgyQjg0QTg5RUNDOEJEQUE1NUNFMDNCMDQ3MzJCNEVBRjFFRDlGNjc5MDdGQjVFNThERDdCMzE5QUIuanNvblMBP1g=';

function readSnakeString(cell: Cell): string {
    let current = cell;
    let result = '';

    while (true) {
        const slice = current.beginParse();

        while (slice.remainingBits >= 8) {
            result += String.fromCharCode(slice.loadUint(8));
        }

        if (slice.remainingRefs === 0) {
            break;
        }

        current = slice.loadRef();
    }

    return result;
}

function decodeAddress(boc: string): string {
    const cell = Cell.fromBase64(boc);
    const slice = cell.beginParse();

    const address = slice.loadAddress();

    if (address === null) {
        throw new Error('Address is null');
    }

    return address.toString({
        urlSafe: true,
        bounceable: true,
        testOnly: true,
    });
}

FILE: scripts\decodeLpWalletMessageV22.ts

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const BODY_BOC =
    'te6cckEBAQEAVwAAqReNRRkAAAAAAAAAAFIiSmPsCAHjPyYW2Lkr1x78cDfEhWZTyVUtGMOargKZ0Mm80XL4bwA8Z+TC2xcleuPfjgb4kKzKeSqloxhzVcBTOhk3mi5fDcFbeW8f';

function scanCell(cell: Cell, path: string) {
    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log(`CELL ${path}`);
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    console.log('bits:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('refs:', cell.refs.length);
    console.log('hash:', cell.hash().toString('hex'));

    const slice = cell.beginParse();

    if (cell.bits.length >= 32) {
        const opcode = slice.loadUint(32);

        console.log(
            '\nFIRST 32-BIT VALUE:',
            `0x${opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`,
            `(${opcode})`
        );

        if (opcode === 0x178d4519) {
            console.log('\n*** FOUND TARGET OPCODE 0x178d4519 ***');
        }

        if (cell.bits.length >= 96) {
            const queryId = slice.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log(
                'NEXT 64-BIT VALUE:',
                queryId.toString()
            );
        }
    }

    // Scan every possible 32-bit offset.
    // We reconstruct the bitstream using loadUint(1), avoiding
    // assumptions about byte alignment.

    const reader = cell.beginParse();
    const bits: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.bits.length; i++) {
        bits.push(reader.loadUint(1));
    }

    const target = 0x178d4519;

    let found = false;

    for (let offset = 0; offset <= bits.length - 32; offset++) {
        let value = 0;

        for (let j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
            value = value * 2 + bits[offset + j];
        }

        if (value === target) {
            console.log(
                `FOUND 0x178d4519 at bit offset ${offset}`
            );
            found = true;
        }
    }

    if (!found) {
        console.log('0x178d4519 not found in this cell.');
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
        scanCell(cell.refs[i], `${path}.ref${i}`);
    }
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP WALLET MESSAGE DECODER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - OFFLINE BOC ANALYSIS');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const cells = Cell.fromBoc(
        Buffer.from(BODY_BOC, 'base64')
    );

    console.log('\nBOC root cells:', cells.length);

    scanCell(cells[0], 'root');

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('DONE');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const BOC =
    'te6cckEBAQEADgAAGNUydtsAAAAAAAAAAPfBmNw=';

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP WALLET OUTGOING MESSAGE DECODER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - OFFLINE BOC');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const cell = Cell.fromBase64(BOC);
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    console.log('\nCell bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Cell refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    console.log('\nOPCODE');
    console.log('hex:', '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0'));
    console.log('decimal:', opcode);

    if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
        const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

        console.log('\nQUERY_ID');
        console.log('value:', queryId.toString());
    }

    console.log('\nREMAINING');
    console.log('bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    if (s.remainingBits > 0) {
        console.log('\nRemaining bits as hex:');

        let value = 0n;
        const count = Math.min(s.remainingBits, 256);

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            value = (value << 1n) | BigInt(s.loadBit() ? 1 : 0);
        }

        console.log(
            value.toString(16).padStart(Math.ceil(count / 4), '0')
        );
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('DONE');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

    console.log('\nINCOMING MESSAGE');

    const incoming =
        tx.in_msg;

    if (!incoming) {
        console.log('No incoming message.');
    } else {

        console.log('Opcode:', incoming.opcode);
        console.log('Decoded:', incoming.decoded);

        console.log('\nFULL INCOMING MESSAGE JSON:');
        console.log(
            JSON.stringify(incoming, null, 2)
        );
    }

    console.log('\nOUTGOING MESSAGES');

    const outgoing =
        tx.out_msgs ?? [];

    console.log(
        'Count:',
        outgoing.length
    );

    for (let i = 0; i < outgoing.length; i++) {
        const msg = outgoing[i];

        console.log('\n' + '-'.repeat(80));
        console.log(`MESSAGE #${i + 1}`);
        console.log('-'.repeat(80));

        console.log('Source:', msg.source);
        console.log('Destination:', msg.destination);
        console.log('Value:', msg.value);
        console.log('Created LT:', msg.created_lt);
        console.log('Opcode:', msg.opcode);
        console.log('Decoded:', msg.decoded);

        console.log('\nFULL MESSAGE JSON:');
        console.log(
            JSON.stringify(msg, null, 2)
        );
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('END');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

function decodeAddress(label: string, boc: string) {

    const cell = Cell.fromBase64(boc);

    console.log(label);
    console.log('bits:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('refs:', cell.refs.length);

    try {

        const slice = cell.beginParse();
        const address = slice.loadAddress();

        if (address) {
            console.log('Address:', address.toString());
        } else {
            console.log('Address: null');
        }

    } catch (error: any) {

        console.log(
            'Decode failed:',
            error?.message ?? error
        );
    }

    console.log('');
}

        'te6cckEBAQEAJAAAQ4ASRBgwNNn9WaI29x7EJxvjdzmQVt2kzDpev13ECWffZBDChq0g'
    );
}

function nanoToTon(value: bigint): string {
    return (Number(value) / 1e9).toFixed(9);
}

        },
    );

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const BOC =
    '';

function amount9(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;
    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0');

    return `${whole}.${frac}`;
}

function addr(a: Address | null): string {
    if (!a) return 'null';

    return a.toString({
        urlSafe: true,
        bounceable: true,
        testOnly: true,
    });
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 POOL cb_add_liquidity DECODER');
    console.log(' opcode: 0x06ecd527');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - OFFLINE BOC DECODING');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const bytes = Buffer.from(BOC, 'hex');

    console.log('\nBOC MAGIC:', bytes.subarray(0, 4).toString('hex'));

    const cell = Cell.fromBoc(bytes)[0];
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    console.log('\nHEADER');
    console.log('Opcode :', '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0'));
    console.log('Query ID:', queryId.toString());

    if (opcode !== 0x06ecd527) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected opcode: 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    // excess_address
    const excessAddress = s.loadAddress();

    console.log('\nEXCESS ADDRESS');
    console.log(addr(excessAddress));

    // The callback contains the liquidity amounts
    // in the referenced payload structure.
    console.log('\nREMAINING CELL');
    console.log('Bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    while (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
        const ref = s.loadRef();

        console.log('\nREFERENCE BOC:');
        console.log(ref.toBoc().toString('base64'));

        console.log('Reference bits:', ref.bits.length);
        console.log('Reference refs:', ref.refs.length);
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' DECODER COMPLETE');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const BOC_HEX =
    '';

const EXPECTED_OPCODE = 0x06ecd527;

function readCoins(slice: any): bigint {
    return slice.loadCoins();
}

function readMaybeRef(slice: any): any | null {
    const exists = slice.loadBit();
    return exists ? slice.loadRef() : null;
}

function readAddress(slice: any): Address {
    return slice.loadAddress();
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {

        Buffer.from(BOC_HEX, 'hex')
    )[0];

    console.log(`Refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);

    console.log('--------------------------------------');

    console.log('opcode:');
    console.log('0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0'));

    if (opcode !== EXPECTED_OPCODE) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected opcode: 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    console.log('query_id:');
    console.log(queryId.toString());

    const amount0 = readCoins(s);

    console.log('amount0:');
    console.log(amount0.toString());

    const amount1 = readCoins(s);

    console.log('amount1:');
    console.log(amount1.toString());

    const userAddress = readAddress(s);

    console.log('user_address:');
    console.log(userAddress.toString());

    const minLpOut = readCoins(s);

    console.log('min_lp_out:');
    console.log(minLpOut.toString());

    const fwdAmount = readCoins(s);

    console.log('fwd_amount:');
    console.log(fwdAmount.toString());

    const customPayload = readMaybeRef(s);

    console.log('custom_payload:');
    console.log(customPayload ? 'present' : 'absent');

    console.log('');
    console.log('--------------------------------------');
    console.log('ADDITIONAL DATA REF');
    console.log('--------------------------------------');

    console.log(`Remaining refs: ${s.remainingRefs}`);

    console.log('NO TRANSACTION SENT');

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_LT = '99809465000012';

const OP_INTERNAL_TRANSFER = 0x178d4519;

function fmt(value: bigint): string {
    return value
        .toString()
        .replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
}

function getOpcode(body: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function decodeInternalTransfer(body: Cell) {
    const s = body.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    if (opcode !== OP_INTERNAL_TRANSFER) {
        return;
    }

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const amount = s.loadCoins();

    const fromAddress = s.loadAddress();

    const responseAddress = s.loadAddress();

    const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    let forwardPayload = 'NONE';

    if (s.remainingBits > 0) {
        const isRef = s.loadBit();

        if (isRef) {
            if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
                const ref = s.loadRef();

                forwardPayload =
                    `REF: ${ref.bits.length} bits / ${ref.refs.length} refs`;
            }
        } else {
            forwardPayload = 'INLINE';
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' JETTON INTERNAL_TRANSFER DECODE');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('OPCODE:');
    console.log(
        '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('QUERY ID:');
    console.log(queryId.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('LP AMOUNT RAW:');
    console.log(fmt(amount));

    console.log('');
    console.log('LP AMOUNT:');
    console.log(
        fmt(amount)
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('FROM:');
    console.log(
        fromAddress
            ? fromAddress.toString()
            : 'NULL'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('RESPONSE ADDRESS:');
    console.log(
        responseAddress
            ? responseAddress.toString()
            : 'NULL'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('FORWARD TON AMOUNT:');
    console.log(
        fmt(forwardTonAmount)
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('FORWARD PAYLOAD:');
    console.log(forwardPayload);

    console.log('');
    console.log('REMAINING BITS:');
    console.log(s.remainingBits);

    console.log('');
    console.log('REMAINING REFS:');
    console.log(s.remainingRefs);

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

export async function run(
    _provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi v2.2 POOL LP MINT DECODER');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL:');
    console.log(POOL.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET LT:');
    console.log(TARGET_LT);

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint:
            'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('Fetching Pool transactions...');

    const transactions =
        await client.getTransactions(
            POOL,
            {
                limit: 30,
            }
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log('TRANSACTIONS FETCHED:');
    console.log(transactions.length);

    for (const tx of transactions) {

        if (
            tx.lt.toString() !==
            TARGET_LT
        ) {
            continue;
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('TARGET TRANSACTION FOUND');

        console.log('');
        console.log('LT:');
        console.log(tx.lt.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('HASH:');
        console.log(
            tx.hash().toString('base64')
        );

        let index = 0;

        for (
            const outMessage
            of tx.outMessages.values()
        ) {

            index++;

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `OUTGOING MESSAGE #${index}`
            );

            if (
                outMessage.info.type ===
                'internal'
            ) {
                console.log('');
                console.log('DESTINATION:');
                console.log(
                    outMessage.info.dest.toString()
                );
            }

            const opcode =
                getOpcode(
                    outMessage.body
                );

            console.log('');
            console.log('OPCODE:');
            console.log(
                opcode === null
                    ? 'UNKNOWN'
                    : '0x' +
                      opcode
                        .toString(16)
                        .padStart(8, '0')
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('BODY:');
            console.log(
                `${outMessage.body.bits.length} bits / ${outMessage.body.refs.length} refs`
            );

            if (
                opcode ===
                OP_INTERNAL_TRANSFER
            ) {
                decodeInternalTransfer(
                    outMessage.body
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('DECODER COMPLETE');
    console.log('READ ONLY');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

FILE: scripts\decodePoolMessageSchemaV22.ts

import { Address, Cell, Slice } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/getTransactions';

function hex(n: bigint, bits: number): string {
    const width = Math.ceil(bits / 4);
    return n.toString(16).padStart(width, '0');
}

function inspectSlice(
    cell: Cell,
    path: string,
    depth = 0
) {
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    console.log('');
    console.log('-'.repeat(78));
    console.log(`CELL ${path}`);
    console.log(`Depth: ${depth}`);
    console.log(`Bits: ${s.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`Refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);
    console.log('-'.repeat(78));

    /*
     * First 32 bits:
     * Almost all TON message bodies start with
     * an opcode / constructor identifier.
     */
    if (s.remainingBits >= 32) {
        const op = s.loadUint(32);

        console.log(
            `opcode uint32 : ${op}`
        );

        console.log(
            `opcode hex    : 0x${hex(BigInt(op), 32)}`
        );

        console.log(
            `opcode signed : ${
                op > 0x7fffffff
                    ? op - 0x100000000
                    : op
            }`
        );
    }

    /*
     * Show the next standard-sized fields.
     *
     * We use independent slices so this diagnostic
     * never mutates the slice used by another test.
     */

    const tests = [
        { bits: 32, name: 'uint32' },
        { bits: 64, name: 'uint64' },
        { bits: 128, name: 'uint128' },
        { bits: 256, name: 'uint256' }
    ];

    for (const test of tests) {
        if (s.remainingBits < test.bits) {
            continue;
        }

        try {
            const x = cell.beginParse();

            /*
             * Skip opcode.
             */
            x.skip(32);

            if (x.remainingBits >= test.bits) {
                const value =
                    x.loadUintBig(test.bits);

                console.log(
                    `after opcode ${test.name}: ${value.toString()}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `after opcode ${test.name} hex: 0x${hex(
                        value,
                        test.bits
                    )}`
                );
            }
        } catch {
            // Diagnostic only.
        }
    }

    /*
     * Print byte-aligned windows after the opcode.
     * This is useful when fields are not the type
     * we initially assumed.
     */
    const offsets = [
        32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 72,
        80, 88, 96, 104, 112, 120,
        128, 136, 144, 152, 160,
        168, 176, 184, 192, 200, 208,
        216, 224, 232, 240, 248, 256,
        264, 272, 280, 288, 296,
        304, 312, 320
    ];

    console.log('');
    console.log('64-bit windows:');

    for (const offset of offsets) {
        if (offset + 64 > cell.bits.length) {
            continue;
        }

        try {
            const x = cell.beginParse();
            x.skip(offset);

            const value =
                x.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log(
                `  @${offset}: ${value.toString()} ` +
                `(0x${hex(value, 64)})`
            );
        } catch {
            // Ignore invalid window.
        }
    }

    /*
     * Recursive refs.
     */
    for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
        inspectSlice(
            cell.refs[i],
            `${path}.ref[${i}]`,
            depth + 1
        );
    }
}

function tryCommonSchemas(
    cell: Cell,
    path: string
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `SCHEMA TESTS FOR ${path}`
    );

    /*
     * Schema A:
     *
     * opcode:uint32
     * query_id:uint64
     */
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits >= 96) {
            const op = s.loadUint(32);
            const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'Schema A: opcode:uint32 + query_id:uint64'
            );
            console.log(
                `  opcode   = 0x${hex(BigInt(op), 32)}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  query_id = ${queryId.toString()}`
            );
        }
    } catch {
        // Ignore.
    }

    /*
     * Schema B:
     *
     * opcode:uint32
     * query_id:uint64
     * amount:uint64
     */
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits >= 160) {
            const op = s.loadUint(32);
            const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
            const amount = s.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'Schema B: opcode:uint32 + query_id:uint64 + amount:uint64'
            );
            console.log(
                `  opcode   = 0x${hex(BigInt(op), 32)}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  query_id = ${queryId.toString()}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  amount   = ${amount.toString()}`
            );
        }
    } catch {
        // Ignore.
    }

    /*
     * Schema C:
     *
     * opcode:uint32
     * query_id:uint64
     * amount:uint128
     */
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits >= 224) {
            const op = s.loadUint(32);
            const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
            const amount = s.loadUintBig(128);

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'Schema C: opcode:uint32 + query_id:uint64 + amount:uint128'
            );
            console.log(
                `  opcode   = 0x${hex(BigInt(op), 32)}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  query_id = ${queryId.toString()}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  amount   = ${amount.toString()}`
            );
        }
    } catch {
        // Ignore.
    }
}

async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(
        ' STON.FI v2.2 POOL MESSAGE SCHEMA DECODER'
    );
    console.log(
        ' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION'
    );
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    console.log('');
    console.log('Pool:', POOL.toString());

    const url =
        `${TONCENTER}` +
        `?address=${encodeURIComponent(POOL.toString())}` +
        `&limit=20`;

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Requesting Pool transactions...'
    );

    const response = await fetch(url);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Toncenter HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`
        );
    }

    const json: any = await response.json();

    if (!json.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Toncenter API error: ${JSON.stringify(json)}`
        );
    }

    const transactions = json.result ?? [];

    console.log(
        'Transactions returned:',
        transactions.length
    );

    /*
     * Only inspect a manageable number.
     *
     * The purpose here is schema identification,
     * not exhaustive historical scanning.
     */
    for (let i = 0; i < transactions.length; i++) {
        const tx = transactions[i];

        console.log('');
        console.log('='.repeat(78));
        console.log(
            `TRANSACTION #${i + 1}`
        );
        console.log(
            'Hash:',
            tx.transaction_id?.hash
        );
        console.log(
            'UTIME:',
            tx.utime
        );
        console.log('='.repeat(78));

        const inBody =
            tx.in_msg?.msg_data?.body;

        if (inBody) {
            try {
                const cell =
                    Cell.fromBase64(inBody);

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    '--- IN MESSAGE ---'
                );

                inspectSlice(
                    cell,
                    `tx${i + 1}.in`
                );

                tryCommonSchemas(
                    cell,
                    `tx${i + 1}.in`
                );
            } catch (e) {
                console.log(
                    'IN decode error:',
                    String(e)
                );
            }
        }

        const outMsgs =
            tx.out_msgs ?? [];

        for (
            let j = 0;
            j < outMsgs.length;
            j++
        ) {
            const body =
                outMsgs[j]?.msg_data?.body;

            if (!body) {
                continue;
            }

            try {
                const cell =
                    Cell.fromBase64(body);

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    `--- OUT MESSAGE #${j + 1} ---`
                );

                inspectSlice(
                    cell,
                    `tx${i + 1}.out${j + 1}`
                );

                tryCommonSchemas(
                    cell,
                    `tx${i + 1}.out${j + 1}`
                );
            } catch (e) {
                console.log(
                    'OUT decode error:',
                    String(e)
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(
        'SCHEMA DECODING FINISHED'
    );
    console.log(
        'READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT'
    );
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

export { run };

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const POOL_TX_LT = 99809465000010n;
const TARGET_MESSAGE_LT = 99809465000011n;

const TONCENTER = 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

function hex(n: bigint, bytes = 4) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(bytes * 2, '0');
}

function addr(a: any): string {
    try {
        return a?.toString?.() ?? String(a);
    } catch {
        return String(a);
    }
}

function dumpCell(cell: any, name: string, depth = 0) {
    const pad = ' '.repeat(depth * 2);

    console.log(`${pad}${name}`);

    try {
        console.log(`${pad}bits: ${cell.bits.length}`);
    } catch {}

    try {
        console.log(`${pad}refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);
    } catch {}

    try {
        const boc = cell.toBoc().toString('base64');
        console.log(`${pad}BOC(base64):`);
        console.log(`${pad}${boc}`);
    } catch {}

    try {
        const slice = cell.beginParse();

        console.log(
            `${pad}remainingBits: ${slice.remainingBits}`
        );

        console.log(
            `${pad}remainingRefs: ${slice.remainingRefs}`
        );

        if (slice.remainingBits >= 32) {
            const op = slice.loadUint(32);

            console.log(
                `${pad}uint32 opcode: ${hex(BigInt(op), 4)}`
            );

            if (slice.remainingBits >= 64) {
                const qid = slice.loadUintBig(64);

                console.log(
                    `${pad}uint64/query_id: ${qid}`
                );
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            `${pad}slice decode error: ${e}`
        );
    }

    try {
        for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
            dumpCell(
                cell.refs[i],
                `ref[${i}]`,
                depth + 1
            );
        }
    } catch {}
}

async function main(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 POOL OUTGOING MESSAGE DECODER');
    console.log(' POOL TX LT: 99809465000010');
    console.log(' TARGET MESSAGE LT: 99809465000011');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: TONCENTER,
    });

    console.log(`Pool: ${POOL.toString()}`);
    console.log(`Pool transaction LT: ${POOL_TX_LT}`);
    console.log(`Target message LT: ${TARGET_MESSAGE_LT}`);
    console.log('');

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(POOL, {
        limit: 20,
    });

    const tx = txs.find((t: any) => {
        try {
            return BigInt(t.lt) === POOL_TX_LT;
        } catch {
            return false;
        }
    });

    if (!tx) {
        console.log('POOL TRANSACTION NOT FOUND');
        return;
    }

    console.log('POOL TRANSACTION FOUND');

    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log('POOL TRANSACTION');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');

    console.log(`LT: ${tx.lt}`);

    try {
        console.log(
            `hash: ${Buffer.from(tx.hash()).toString('base64')}`
        );
    } catch {}

    console.log('');

    const outgoing = tx.outMessages;

    if (!outgoing || outgoing.size === 0) {
        console.log('No outgoing messages.');
        return;
    }

    console.log(
        `Outgoing message count: ${outgoing.size}`
    );

    let index = 0;
    let found = false;

    for (const [, message] of outgoing) {
        const info: any = message.info;

        let createdLt: bigint | null = null;

        try {
            createdLt = BigInt(info.createdLt);
        } catch {}

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            `OUTGOING MESSAGE #${index}`
        );

        console.log(
            `createdLt: ${createdLt ?? '<unavailable>'}`
        );

        if (createdLt !== TARGET_MESSAGE_LT) {
            console.log('Not target message.');
            index++;
            continue;
        }

        found = true;

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );
        console.log(
            'TARGET OUTGOING MESSAGE FOUND'
        );
        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );

        try {
            console.log(`src: ${addr(info.src)}`);
        } catch {}

        try {
            console.log(`dest: ${addr(info.dest)}`);
        } catch {}

        try {
            console.log(
                `value: ${info.value.coins} nanoTON`
            );

            console.log(
                `value: ${(Number(info.value.coins) / 1e9).toFixed(9)} TON`
            );
        } catch {}

        try {
            console.log(
                `createdLt: ${info.createdLt}`
            );
        } catch {}

        try {
            console.log(
                `createdAt: ${info.createdAt}`
            );
        } catch {}

        console.log('');

        if (message.body) {
            dumpCell(
                message.body,
                'BODY'
            );
        } else {
            console.log('BODY: empty');
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );

        break;
    }

    if (!found) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'TARGET MESSAGE LT NOT FOUND INSIDE POOL TRANSACTION.'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(' DECODING COMPLETE');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log('');
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    await main(provider);
}

export async function run(
    _provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    console.log('================================================');

    console.log('ROOT BITS:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('ROOT REFS:', cell.refs.length);

    console.log('');

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
        throw new Error(
            'Not enough bits for opcode'
        );
    }

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    console.log(
        'OPCODE:',
        '0x' +
            opcode
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, '0')
    );

    console.log(
        'OPCODE DECIMAL:',

    if (opcode !== ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'WARNING: Opcode is not expected ADD_LIQUIDITY'
        );
        console.log(
            'EXPECTED:',
            '0x50c6a654'
        );
    } else {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'MESSAGE TYPE: STON.fi ADD_LIQUIDITY'
        );
    }

    if (s.remainingBits < 64) {
        throw new Error(
            'Not enough bits for query_id'
        );
    }

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'QUERY ID:',
        queryId.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('========== ROOT PAYLOAD ==========');

    /*
     * Based on the v2.2 ADD_LIQUIDITY layout:
     *
     * opcode
     * query_id
     * amount0
     * amount1
     * min_lp_out
     * fwd_amount
     * both_positive
     * to_address
     * custom_payload
     *
     * Additional fields are stored in a reference.
     */

    const amount0 = s.loadCoins();
    const amount1 = s.loadCoins();
    const minLpOut = s.loadCoins();
    const fwdAmount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log('');

        'AMOUNT0 RAW:',
        amount0.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'AMOUNT0:',
        formatNano(amount0),

    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'AMOUNT1 RAW:',
        amount1.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'AMOUNT1:',
        formatNano(amount1),
        'pTON'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'MIN LP OUT RAW:',
        minLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log(

    console.log(

    if (s.remainingBits < 1) {
        throw new Error(

        );
    }

    const bothPositive = s.loadBit();

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'BOTH POSITIVE:',
        bothPositive
    );

    const toAddress = s.loadAddress();

    console.log('');
    printAddress(
        'TO ADDRESS',
        toAddress
    );

    if (s.remainingBits < 1) {
        throw new Error(
            'Missing custom_payload flag'
        );
    }

    const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'CUSTOM PAYLOAD PRESENT:',
        hasCustomPayload
    );

    if (hasCustomPayload) {
        console.log(
            'CUSTOM PAYLOAD:',
            'PRESENT'
        );

        if (s.remainingRefs < 1) {
            throw new Error(
                'Custom payload flag is true but reference is missing'
            );
        }

        const customPayload = s.loadRef();

        console.log(
            'CUSTOM PAYLOAD BITS:',

        );

        console.log(

            customPayload.refs.length

    } else {
        console.log(

            'NONE'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'ROOT REMAINING BITS:',
        s.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOT REMAINING REFS:',
        s.remainingRefs
    );

    /*
     * Additional fields
     */

    if (s.remainingRefs < 1) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'WARNING: additional_fields reference is missing'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('================================================');
        console.log(' END - READ ONLY');
        console.log('================================================');

        return;
    }

    const additional = s.loadRef();

    console.log('');
    console.log('========== ADDITIONAL FIELDS ==========');

    console.log(
        'REF BITS:',
        additional.bits.length
    );

    console.log(
        'REF REFS:',
        additional.refs.length
    );

    const a = additional.beginParse();

    if (a.remainingBits < 267) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(

    }

    let refundAddress: Address | null = null;
    let excessAddress: Address | null = null;

    try {

    try {
        excessAddress = a.loadAddress();
    } catch {
        console.log(

    console.log('');
    printAddress(
        'REFUND ADDRESS',
        refundAddress
    );

    printAddress(
        'EXCESS ADDRESS',
        excessAddress
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'REF REMAINING BITS:',
        a.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'REF REMAINING REFS:',
        a.remainingRefs
    );

    /*
     * Root reference inspection
     *
     * This is useful because the currently supplied BOC

    console.log('');

    console.log(

        cell.refs.length

    for (

        const rs = ref.beginParse();

        if (rs.remainingBits >= 32) {

            console.log(

        if (rs.remainingBits >= 64) {
            const refQueryId =
                rs.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log(
                'NEXT 64 BITS:',
                refQueryId.toString()
            );
        }

        console.log(

            rs.remainingBits
        );

        console.log(
            'REMAINING REFS:',
            rs.remainingRefs
        );

        for (
            let j = 0;
            j < ref.refs.length;

            const child = ref.refs[j];

            console.log('');

            );

            console.log(

            );

            console.log(

            console.log(

                cs.remainingBits

            console.log(

            );

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET = 7219004800n;
const TARGET_HEX = '00000001ae494580';

const OPS: Record<number, string> = {
    0x37c096df: 'PROVIDE_LP',
    0x50c6a654: 'ADD_LIQUIDITY',
    0x178d4519: 'LP/CALLBACK',
    0x0801e33f: 'ADDRESS/DATA',
    0x801e33f2: 'ADDRESS/DATA'
};

function indent(depth: number): string {
    return '  '.repeat(depth);
}

function toHex(value: bigint, bits: number): string {
    const digits = Math.ceil(bits / 4);
    return value.toString(16).padStart(digits, '0');
}

function scanLogicalFields(
    cell: Cell,
    path: string,
    depth: number
) {
    const p = indent(depth);

    console.log(`${p}CELL ${path}`);
    console.log(
        `${p}bits=${cell.bits.length} refs=${cell.refs.length}`
    );

    /*
     * Root opcode
     */
    if (cell.bits.length >= 32) {
        const opcode = cell.beginParse().preloadUint(32);
        const opHex = opcode
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, '0');

        console.log(
            `${p}opcode=0x${opHex} ${
                OPS[opcode] ?? 'UNKNOWN'
            }`
        );
    }

    /*
     * Scan only byte-aligned positions.
     *
     * Important:
     * loadUintBig() is used here because TARGET is bigint.
     */
    const widths = [32, 64, 128, 256];

    for (const width of widths) {
        if (cell.bits.length < width) {
            continue;
        }

        for (
            let offset = 0;
            offset + width <= cell.bits.length;
            offset += 8
        ) {
            const s = cell.beginParse();

            if (offset > 0) {
                s.skip(offset);
            }

            const value = s.loadUintBig(width);

            /*
             * Exact target
             */
            if (value === TARGET) {
                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    `${p}*** TARGET FOUND ***`
                );
                console.log(
                    `${p}path   = ${path}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `${p}offset = ${offset} bits`
                );
                console.log(
                    `${p}width  = ${width}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `${p}decimal= ${value}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `${p}hex    = 0x${toHex(value, width)}`
                );
            }

            /*
             * Target bytes inside larger fields
             */
            if (width > 64) {
                const valueHex = toHex(
                    value,
                    width
                );

                if (
                    valueHex.includes(TARGET_HEX)
                ) {
                    console.log('');
                    console.log(
                        `${p}*** TARGET BYTES INSIDE FIELD ***`
                    );
                    console.log(
                        `${p}path   = ${path}`
                    );
                    console.log(
                        `${p}offset = ${offset} bits`
                    );
                    console.log(
                        `${p}width  = ${width}`
                    );
                    console.log(
                        `${p}value  = 0x${valueHex}`
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /*
     * Follow every reference recursively.
     */
    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < cell.refs.length;
        i++
    ) {
        scanLogicalFields(
            cell.refs[i],
            `${path}.ref[${i}]`,
            depth + 1
        );
    }
}

function decodeKnownRoot(
    cell: Cell,
    label: string
) {
    if (cell.bits.length < 32) {
        return;
    }

    const s = cell.beginParse();
    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    const opHex = opcode
        .toString(16)
        .padStart(8, '0');

    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));
    console.log(label);
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    console.log(`opcode: 0x${opHex}`);
    console.log(
        `name  : ${OPS[opcode] ?? 'UNKNOWN'}`
    );
    console.log(
        `bits  : ${cell.bits.length}`
    );
    console.log(
        `refs  : ${cell.refs.length}`
    );

    /*
     * We are NOT assigning semantic names to these fields yet.
     * They are only positional observations.
     */
    if (opcode === 0x50c6a654) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'ADD_LIQUIDITY ROOT'
        );

        console.log(
            `remaining bits after opcode: ${s.remainingBits}`
        );

        if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
            const field0 = s.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log(
                `field[0] uint64 = ${field0}`
            );

            console.log(
                `field[0] hex     = 0x${toHex(
                    field0,
                    64
                )}`
            );
        }

        if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
            const field1 = s.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log(
                `field[1] uint64 = ${field1}`
            );

            console.log(
                `field[1] hex     = 0x${toHex(
                    field1,
                    64
                )}`
            );
        }

        console.log(
            `refs remaining: ${s.remainingRefs}`
        );
    }

    if (opcode === 0x37c096df) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'PROVIDE_LP ROOT'
        );

        console.log(
            `remaining bits after opcode: ${s.remainingBits}`
        );

        if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
            const field0 = s.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log(
                `field[0] uint64 = ${field0}`
            );

            console.log(
                `field[0] hex     = 0x${toHex(
                    field0,
                    64
                )}`
            );
        }

        console.log(
            `refs remaining: ${s.remainingRefs}`
        );
    }
}

async function getTransactions(
    address: string,
    limit = 20
) {
    const url =
        'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/getTransactions' +
        `?address=${encodeURIComponent(address)}` +
        `&limit=${limit}`;

    const response = await fetch(url);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Toncenter HTTP ${response.status}`
        );
    }

    const json = await response.json();

    if (
        !json.ok ||
        !Array.isArray(json.result)
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'Invalid Toncenter response'
        );
    }

    return json.result;
}

function bodyToCell(
    body: any
): Cell | null {
    if (!body) {
        return null;
    }

    try {
        if (
            body['@type'] === 'tvm.cell'
        ) {
            return Cell.fromBoc(
                Buffer.from(
                    body.bytes,
                    'base64'
                )
            )[0];
        }

        if (
            typeof body === 'string'
        ) {
            return Cell.fromBoc(
                Buffer.from(
                    body,
                    'base64'
                )
            )[0];
        }
    } catch {
        return null;
    }

    return null;
}

export async function run(
    provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));
    console.log(
        ' STON.FI v2.2 POOL SCHEMA TREE DECODER'
    );
    console.log(
        ' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION'
    );
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `Pool   : ${POOL.toString()}`
    );
    console.log(
        `Target : ${TARGET}`
    );
    console.log(
        `Hex    : 0x${TARGET_HEX}`
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Fetching Pool transactions from TON Center testnet...'
    );

    const txs = await getTransactions(
        POOL.toString(),
        20
    );

    console.log(
        `Transactions: ${txs.length}`
    );

    let interesting = 0;

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < txs.length;
        i++
    ) {
        const tx = txs[i];

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            '#'.repeat(80)
        );

        console.log(
            `TRANSACTION ${i + 1}/${txs.length}`
        );

        console.log(
            '#'.repeat(80)
        );

        console.log(
            `hash : ${
                tx.transaction_id?.hash ?? '?'
            }`
        );

        console.log(
            `lt   : ${
                tx.transaction_id?.lt ?? '?'
            }`
        );

        console.log(
            `utime: ${tx.utime ?? '?'}`
        );

        /*
         * IN MESSAGE
         */
        const inMsg = tx.in_msg;

        if (
            inMsg &&
            inMsg.body
        ) {
            const cell =
                bodyToCell(inMsg.body);

            if (cell) {
                const s =
                    cell.beginParse();

                if (
                    cell.bits.length >= 32
                ) {
                    const op =
                        s.preloadUint(32);

                    if (OPS[op]) {
                        interesting++;

                        decodeKnownRoot(
                            cell,
                            'IN MESSAGE'
                        );

                        console.log('');
                        console.log(
                            'REF TREE'
                        );

                        scanLogicalFields(
                            cell,
                            'in',
                            0
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        /*
         * OUT MESSAGES
         */
        const outMsgs =
            tx.out_msgs || [];

        for (
            let j = 0;
            j < outMsgs.length;
            j++
        ) {
            const msg =
                outMsgs[j];

            if (!msg?.body) {
                continue;
            }

            const cell =
                bodyToCell(msg.body);

            if (!cell) {
                continue;
            }

            const s =
                cell.beginParse();

            if (
                cell.bits.length < 32
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            const op =
                s.preloadUint(32);

            if (!OPS[op]) {
                continue;
            }

            interesting++;

            decodeKnownRoot(
                cell,
                `OUT MESSAGE #${j + 1}`
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'REF TREE'
            );

            scanLogicalFields(
                cell,
                `out[${j + 1}]`,
                0
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '='.repeat(80)
    );

    console.log(
        'FINISHED'
    );

    console.log(
        '='.repeat(80)
    );

    console.log(
        `Interesting messages: ${interesting}`
    );

    console.log(

function printBits(cell: Cell) {
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    console.log('Bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    if (s.remainingBits > 0) {
        const bits = s.loadBits(s.remainingBits);
        console.log('BITS HEX:');
        console.log(bits.toString());
    }
}

function scanUint(
    cell: Cell,
    maxBits: number
) {
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('UINT SCAN');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    for (
        let bits = 8;
        bits <= maxBits && bits <= s.remainingBits;
        bits += 8
    ) {
        try {
            const x = cell.beginParse().loadUintBig(bits);

            if (x === TARGET) {
                console.log(
                    `FOUND TARGET at ${bits} bits:`,
                    x.toString()
                );
            }

            if (
                x > 0n &&
                x < 10_000_000_000_000_000n
            ) {
                console.log(
                    `${bits} bits -> ${x.toString()}`
                );
            }
        } catch {
            // ignore
        }
    }
}

function walk(
    cell: Cell,
    path: string
) {
    console.log('\n' + '-'.repeat(80));
    console.log('CELL:', path);
    console.log('-'.repeat(80));

    console.log('Bits:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', cell.refs.length);
    console.log('Hash:', cell.hash().toString('hex'));

    printBits(cell);

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
        walk(
            cell.refs[i],
            `${path}.ref[${i}]`
        );
    }
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET = 7219004800n;
const TARGET_HEX = '00000001ae494580';

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/getTransactions';

function hexFromBytes(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    return Array.from(bytes)
        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join('');
}

function scanCell(
    cell: Cell,
    path: string,
    hits: string[],
    depth = 0
) {
    const slice = cell.beginParse();

    console.log('');
    console.log(`CELL ${path}`);
    console.log(`Depth: ${depth}`);
    console.log(`Bits remaining: ${slice.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`Refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);

    /*
     * The important correction:
     * do NOT use BitString.toString().
     *
     * Instead, inspect every possible 64-bit window
     * directly through a fresh Slice.
     */

    const totalBits = slice.remainingBits;

    for (
        let offset = 0;
        offset + 64 <= totalBits;
        offset++
    ) {
        try {
            const s = cell.beginParse();

            if (offset > 0) {
                s.skip(offset);
            }

            const value = s.loadUintBig(64);

            if (value === TARGET) {
                const msg =
                    `FOUND TARGET uint64: ${path}, ` +
                    `bit offset=${offset}`;

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    '!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!'
                );
                console.log(msg);
                console.log(
                    `Value: ${value.toString()}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `Hex: 0x${TARGET_HEX}`
                );
                console.log(
                    '!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!'
                );

                hits.push(msg);
            }
        } catch {
            break;
        }
    }

    /*
     * Also inspect common aligned integer fields.
     */
    const alignedOffsets = [
        0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56,
        64, 72, 80, 88, 96, 104, 112,
        120, 128, 136, 144, 152, 160
    ];

    for (const offset of alignedOffsets) {
        if (offset + 64 > totalBits) {
            continue;
        }

        try {
            const s = cell.beginParse();
            s.skip(offset);

            const value = s.loadUintBig(64);

            console.log(
                `  uint64 @ ${offset}: ${value.toString()}`
            );

            if (value === TARGET) {
                const msg =
                    `ALIGNED TARGET: ${path}, ` +
                    `bit offset=${offset}`;

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    '!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!'
                );
                console.log(msg);
                console.log(
                    `Value: ${value.toString()}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `Hex: 0x${TARGET_HEX}`
                );
                console.log(
                    '!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!'
                );

                hits.push(msg);
            }
        } catch {
            // Not enough bits.
        }
    }

    /*
     * Recursively inspect every reference.
     */
    for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
        scanCell(
            cell.refs[i],
            `${path}.ref[${i}]`,
            hits,
            depth + 1
        );
    }
}

    if (!response.ok) {

        );
    }

    const json: any = await response.json();

    if (!json.ok) {
        throw new Error(

        );
    }

    const transactions = json.result ?? [];

    console.log(
        'Transactions returned:',
        transactions.length
    );

    const hits: string[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < transactions.length; i++) {

        );

            'Hash:',
            tx.transaction_id?.hash
        );
        console.log(
            'UTIME:',
            tx.utime
        );
        console.log('='.repeat(78));

        /*
         * IN BODY
         */

            tx.in_msg?.msg_data?.body;

        if (inBody) {
            console.log('');
            console.log(
                '--- IN MESSAGE BODY ---'
            );

            try {
                const cell =
                    Cell.fromBase64(inBody);

                scanCell(
                    cell,
                    `tx${i + 1}.in`,
                    hits
                );
            } catch (e) {
                console.log(
                    'IN decode error:',
                    String(e)
                );
            }
        }

        /*
         * OUT BODIES
         */
        const outMsgs =
            tx.out_msgs ?? [];

        for (
            let j = 0;
            j < outMsgs.length;
            j++
        ) {
            const body =
                outMsgs[j]?.msg_data?.body;

            if (!body) {
                continue;
            }

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `--- OUT MESSAGE #${j + 1} BODY ---`
            );

            try {
                const cell =
                    Cell.fromBase64(body);

                scanCell(
                    cell,
                    `tx${i + 1}.out${j + 1}`,
                    hits
                );
            } catch (e) {
                console.log(
                    'OUT decode error:',
                    String(e)
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(
        'FINAL SEARCH RESULT'
    );
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    console.log(
        `Target: ${TARGET.toString()}`
    );
    console.log(
        `Target hex: 0x${TARGET_HEX}`
    );

    if (hits.length === 0) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'No uint64 target found.'
        );
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'Next step: decode the actual STON.fi'
        );
        console.log(
            'v2.2 message schemas and their refs.'
        );
    } else {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            `TARGET HITS: ${hits.length}`
        );

        for (const hit of hits) {
            console.log(hit);
        }
    }
}

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const LP_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCNnXhynq5G7RZ8glhXSNg6eXby1kzqD-p8HNxu6PN5SIgd'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99809465000012n;

const INTERNAL_TRANSFER_OPCODE = 0x178d4519;

function nanoToTon(value: bigint): string {
    return (Number(value) / 1e9).toFixed(9);
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {

    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 POOL -> LP WALLET TRANSFER DECODER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('Fetching Pool transactions...');

    const transactions = await client.getTransactions(
        POOL,
        {
            limit: 20,
            archival: true,
        },
    );

    for (const tx of transactions) {

        const lt = BigInt(tx.lt);

        if (lt !== TARGET_LT) {
            continue;
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('TARGET TRANSACTION');
        console.log('LT:', lt.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('HASH:');
        console.log(tx.hash().toString('hex'));

        const outMessages: any = tx.outMessages;

        if (!outMessages || outMessages.size === 0) {
            console.log('No outgoing messages.');
            return;
        }

        let found = false;

        for (const [key, msg] of outMessages) {

            const destination =
                msg?.info?.dest?.toString?.() ?? 'NONE';

            const body = msg.body;

            const slice = body.beginParse();

            let opcode = 0;

            try {
                if (slice.remainingBits >= 32) {
                    opcode = slice.loadUint(32);
                }
            } catch {
                opcode = 0;
            }

            const opcodeHex =
                '0x' +
                opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');

            if (
                destination !== LP_WALLET.toString() &&
                opcode !== INTERNAL_TRANSFER_OPCODE
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            found = true;

            console.log('');
            console.log('='.repeat(78));
            console.log('POOL -> LP WALLET MESSAGE');
            console.log('='.repeat(78));

            console.log('');
            console.log('Dictionary key:');
            console.log(key);

            console.log('');
            console.log('Source:');
            console.log(
                msg.info?.src?.toString?.() ?? 'NONE'
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('Destination:');
            console.log(destination);

            console.log('');
            console.log('TON value:');
            console.log(
                nanoToTon(
                    BigInt(msg.info?.value?.coins ?? 0)
                )
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('Opcode:');
            console.log(opcodeHex);

            console.log('');
            console.log('BODY BOC HEX:');
            console.log(
                body.toBoc().toString('hex')
            );

            // ========================================================
            // DECODE INTERNAL TRANSFER
            // ========================================================

            const s = body.beginParse();

            const op = s.loadUint(32);
            const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
            const amount = s.loadCoins();
            const from = s.loadAddress();
            const response = s.loadAddress();
            const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

            console.log('');
            console.log('-'.repeat(78));
            console.log('DECODED INTERNAL TRANSFER');
            console.log('-'.repeat(78));

            console.log('');
            console.log('1. OPCODE:');
            console.log(
                '0x' +
                op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('2. QUERY ID:');
            console.log(queryId.toString());

            console.log('');
            console.log('3. AMOUNT RAW:');
            console.log(amount.toString());

            console.log('');
            console.log('4. AMOUNT / 1e9:');
            console.log(
                (Number(amount) / 1e9).toFixed(9)
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('5. FROM:');
            console.log(
                from?.toString?.() ?? 'NONE'
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('6. RESPONSE ADDRESS:');
            console.log(
                response?.toString?.() ?? 'NONE'
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('7. FORWARD TON AMOUNT:');
            console.log(forwardTonAmount.toString());

            console.log('');
            console.log('8. FORWARD TON:');
            console.log(
                nanoToTon(forwardTonAmount)
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('REMAINING BITS:');
            console.log(s.remainingBits);

            console.log('');
            console.log('REMAINING REFS:');
            console.log(s.remainingRefs);

            // ========================================================
            // VERIFY DESTINATION
            // ========================================================

            console.log('');
            console.log('-'.repeat(78));
            console.log('ADDRESS CHECK');
            console.log('-'.repeat(78));

            console.log('');
            console.log('Expected LP Wallet:');
            console.log(LP_WALLET.toString());

            console.log('');
            console.log('Actual destination:');
            console.log(destination);

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'Destination matches LP Wallet:',
                destination === LP_WALLET.toString()
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('='.repeat(78));
            console.log('DECODE COMPLETE');
            console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
            console.log('='.repeat(78));

            return;
        }

        if (!found) {
            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'No Pool -> LP Wallet internal_transfer found.'
            );
        }

        return;
    }

    console.log(
        'Target LT not found:',
        TARGET_LT.toString()
    );
