// DECODE STON.fi PROVIDE_LP PAYLOAD
// ============================================================

function decodeProvideLpPayload(
    payload: Cell
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' PROVIDE_LP PAYLOAD');
    console.log('============================================================');

    const s =
        payload.beginParse();


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // opcode
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const op =
        loadUintSafe(s, 32);

    console.log('');
    console.log('op:');

    if (op === null) {

        console.log(
            'DECODE FAILED'
        );

    } else {

        console.log(
            op.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'hex:',
            hex(op)
        );

        console.log(
            'Expected PROVIDE_LP:',
            hex(PROVIDE_LP_OP)
        );

        console.log(
            'MATCH:',
            op === BigInt(PROVIDE_LP_OP)
        );
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // router wallet address
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const routerWallet =
        loadAddressSafe(s);

    showAddress(
        'routerWalletAddress',
        routerWallet
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // refund address
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const refundAddress =
        loadAddressSafe(s);

    showAddress(
        'refundAddress',
        refundAddress,
        USER_ADDRESS
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // excesses address
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const excessesAddress =
        loadAddressSafe(s);

    showAddress(
        'excessesAddress',
        excessesAddress,
        USER_ADDRESS
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // deadline
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const deadline =
        loadUintSafe(s, 64);

    console.log('');
    console.log('deadline:');

    if (deadline === null) {

        console.log(
            'DECODE FAILED'
        );

    } else {

        console.log(
            deadline.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'deadline hex:',
            hex(deadline)
        );

        try {

            console.log(
                'deadline date:',
                new Date(
                    Number(deadline) * 1000
                ).toISOString()
            );

        } catch {

            console.log(
                'deadline date: INVALID'
            );
        }
    }


    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Remaining bits before additional_data:',
        s.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'Remaining refs:',
        s.remainingRefs
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // additional_data reference
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (s.remainingRefs < 1) {

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'ERROR: additional_data reference missing'
        );

        return;
    }


    const additionalData =
        s.loadRef();


    console.log('');
    console.log('additional_data:');

    console.log(
        'bits:',
        additionalData.bits.length
    );

    console.log(
        'refs:',
        additionalData.refs.length
    );


    const a =
        additionalData.beginParse();


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // min_lp_out
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const minLpOut =
        loadCoinsSafe(a);

    printAmount(
        'minLpOut',
        minLpOut,
        0
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // receiver address
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const receiverAddress =
        loadAddressSafe(a);

    showAddress(
        'receiverAddress',
        receiverAddress,
        USER_ADDRESS
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // both_positive
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const bothPositive =
        loadUintSafe(a, 1);

    console.log('');
    console.log('bothPositive:');

    if (bothPositive === null) {

        console.log(
            'DECODE FAILED'
        );

    } else {

        console.log(
            bothPositive.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'Interpretation:',
            bothPositive === 1n
                ? 'BOTH TOKENS POSITIVE'
                : 'SINGLE SIDE'
        );
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // DEX custom payload forward gas
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const customPayloadForwardGas =
        loadCoinsSafe(a);

    printAmount(
        'dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount',
        customPayloadForwardGas,
        9
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // optional custom payload
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'additional_data remaining bits:',
        a.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'additional_data remaining refs:',
        a.remainingRefs
    );


    if (a.remainingRefs > 0) {

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'dexCustomPayload: PRESENT'
        );

    } else {

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'dexCustomPayload: NONE'
        );
    }
}


// ============================================================
// DECODE ROOSTER JETTON TRANSFER
// ============================================================

function decodeRooster() {

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' ROOSTER JETTON TRANSFER');
    console.log('============================================================');


    const cell =
        Cell.fromBase64(ROOSTER_BOC);


    console.log('');
    console.log('BOC hash:');

    console.log(
        cell.hash().toString('hex')
    );


    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Root bits:',
        cell.bits.length
    );

    console.log(
        'Root refs:',
        cell.refs.length
    );


    const s =
        cell.beginParse();


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // opcode
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const op =
        loadUintSafe(s, 32);


    console.log('');
    console.log('opcode:');


    if (op === null) {

        console.log(
            'DECODE FAILED'
        );

        return;
    }


    console.log(
        op.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'hex:',
        hex(op)
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected Jetton Transfer:',
        hex(JETTON_TRANSFER_OP)
    );

    console.log(
        'MATCH:',
        op === BigInt(JETTON_TRANSFER_OP)
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // query id
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const queryId =
        loadUintSafe(s, 64);

    console.log('');
    console.log('queryId:');

    console.log(
        queryId?.toString() ??
        'DECODE FAILED'
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // amount
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const amount =
        loadCoinsSafe(s);

    printAmount(
        'ROOSTER amount',
        amount,
        9
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // destination
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const destination =
        loadAddressSafe(s);

    showAddress(
        'destination',
        destination,
        ROUTER_ADDRESS
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // response destination
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const responseDestination =
        loadAddressSafe(s);

    showAddress(
        'responseDestination',
        responseDestination,
        USER_ADDRESS
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // custom payload
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('');
    console.log('custom_payload:');


    try {

        const customPayloadBit =
            s.loadBit();


        console.log(
            'presence bit:',
            customPayloadBit
        );


        // loadBit() returns boolean.
        // false = no payload
        // true  = payload exists

        if (customPayloadBit === false) {

            console.log(
                'custom_payload: NONE'
            );

        } else {

            console.log(
                'custom_payload: PRESENT'
            );


            const cp =
                s.loadRef();


            console.log(
                'custom payload bits:',
                cp.bits.length
            );

            console.log(
                'custom payload refs:',
                cp.refs.length
            );
        }

    } catch (error) {

        console.log(
            'Unable to decode custom_payload'
        );

        console.log(
            String(error)
        );
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // forward TON amount
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const forwardTonAmount =
        loadCoinsSafe(s);

    printAmount(
        'forwardTonAmount',
        forwardTonAmount,
        9
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // forward payload
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('');
    console.log('forward_payload:');


    try {

        const either =
            s.loadBit();


        console.log(
            'Either bit:',
            either
        );


        let forwardPayload: Cell;


        // loadBit() returns boolean.
        // false = inline
        // true  = reference

        if (either === false) {

            console.log(
                'Payload stored inline'
            );

            forwardPayload =
                s.asCell();

        } else {

            console.log(
                'Payload stored as reference'
            );

            forwardPayload =
                s.loadRef();
        }


        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'forward payload bits:',
            forwardPayload.bits.length
        );

        console.log(
            'forward payload refs:',
            forwardPayload.refs.length
        );


        decodeProvideLpPayload(
            forwardPayload
        );


    } catch (error) {

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'Unable to decode forward_payload'
        );

        console.log(
            String(error)
        );
    }


    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Remaining root bits:',
        s.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'Remaining root refs:',
        s.remainingRefs
    );
}

function decodePton() {

    console.log('');

        Cell.fromBase64(PTON_BOC);


    console.log('');

        cell.hash().toString('hex')
    );


    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Root bits:',
        cell.bits.length
    );

    console.log(

    const s =

        console.log(
            'Expected TON_TRANSFER:',
            hex(PTON_TON_TRANSFER_OP)
        );

        console.log(
            'MATCH:',
            op === BigInt(PTON_TON_TRANSFER_OP)
        );
    }


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // query id
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const queryId =
        loadUintSafe(s, 64);


    console.log('');
    console.log('queryId:');

    console.log(
        queryId?.toString() ??
        'DECODE FAILED'
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // TON amount
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const amount =
        loadCoinsSafe(s);

    printAmount(
        'TON amount',
        amount,
        9
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // destination
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const destination =
        loadAddressSafe(s);

    showAddress(
        'destination',
        destination
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // remaining
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Remaining bits before payload:',
        s.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'Remaining refs before payload:',
        s.remainingRefs
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // forward payload
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    try {

        const either =
            s.loadBit();


        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'forwardPayload Either bit:',
            either
        );


        let payload: Cell;


        if (either === false) {

            console.log(
                'forwardPayload is inline'
            );

            payload =
                s.asCell();

        } else {

            console.log(
                'forwardPayload is reference'
            );

            payload =
                s.loadRef();
        }


        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'pTON forward payload bits:',
            payload.bits.length
        );

        console.log(
            'pTON forward payload refs:',
            payload.refs.length
        );


        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // Inspect first opcode
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (payload.bits.length >= 32) {

            const ps =
                payload.beginParse();


            const payloadOp =
                loadUintSafe(ps, 32);


            console.log('');

            console.log(
                'pTON forward payload opcode:'
            );

            console.log(
                payloadOp?.toString() ??
                'DECODE FAILED'
            );


            if (payloadOp !== null) {

                console.log(
                    'hex:',
                    hex(payloadOp)
                );


                console.log(
                    'Expected PROVIDE_LP:',
                    hex(PROVIDE_LP_OP)
                );


                console.log(
                    'MATCH PROVIDE_LP:',
                    payloadOp ===
                    BigInt(PROVIDE_LP_OP)
                );
            }
        }


        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // If the payload itself is PROVIDE_LP,
        // decode it completely.
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (payload.bits.length >= 32) {

            const ps =
                payload.beginParse();


            const payloadOp =
                loadUintSafe(ps, 32);


            if (
                payloadOp ===
                BigInt(PROVIDE_LP_OP)
            ) {

                decodeProvideLpPayload(
                    payload
                );
            }
        }


    } catch (error) {

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'Unable to decode pTON forward payload'
        );

        console.log(
            String(error)
        );
    }


    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Remaining pTON root bits:',
        s.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'Remaining pTON root refs:',
        s.remainingRefs
    );
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';

const EXPECTED = {
    jettonTransferOpcode: 0x0f8a7ea5,
    provideLpOpcode: 0x37c096df,

    roosterAmount: 266742370687260n,

    routerAddress:
        'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3',

    userAddress:
        'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix',

    routerPtonWallet:
        'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3',

    minLpOut: 346725530921n,

    forwardTonAmount: 235000000n,

    bothPositive: true,

    dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount: 0n,

    hasDexCustomPayload: false,

    queryId: 0,
};

function check(
    name: string,
    actual: unknown,
    expected: unknown
) {
    const pass = actual === expected;

    console.log(
        `${pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | ${name} | actual=${String(actual)} | expected=${String(expected)}`
    );

    if (!pass) {
        throw new Error(
            `${name} mismatch`
        );
    }
}

function addressString(address: Address | null): string {
    if (!address) {
        return 'null';
    }

    return address.toString();
}

function checkAddress(
    name: string,
    actual: Address | null,
    expected: string
) {
    const actualString = addressString(actual);

    check(
        name,
        actualString,
        expected
    );
}

function decodeProvideLpInnerCell(
    cell: Cell
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('----- PROVIDE_LP INNER CELL -----');

    const slice = cell.beginParse();

    const minLpOut = slice.loadCoins();

    const receiverAddress = slice.loadAddress();

    const bothPositive = slice.loadBit() === true;

    const dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount =
        slice.loadCoins();

    const hasDexCustomPayload =
        slice.loadBit();

    let dexCustomPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (hasDexCustomPayload) {
        dexCustomPayload = slice.loadRef();
    }

    console.log(
        'minLpOut:',
        minLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'receiverAddress:',
        addressString(receiverAddress)
    );

    console.log(
        'bothPositive:',
        bothPositive
    );

    console.log(
        'dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount:',
        dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'hasDexCustomPayload:',
        hasDexCustomPayload
    );

    check(
        'minLpOut',
        minLpOut,
        EXPECTED.minLpOut
    );

    checkAddress(
        'receiverAddress',
        receiverAddress,
        EXPECTED.userAddress
    );

    check(
        'bothPositive',
        bothPositive,
        EXPECTED.bothPositive
    );

    check(
        'dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount',
        dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount,
        EXPECTED.dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount
    );

    check(
        'hasDexCustomPayload',
        hasDexCustomPayload,
        EXPECTED.hasDexCustomPayload
    );

    if (slice.remainingBits !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `Inner cell has ${slice.remainingBits} remaining bits`
        );
    }

    if (slice.remainingRefs !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `Inner cell has ${slice.remainingRefs} remaining refs`
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'INNER CELL STRUCTURE: PASS'
    );

    return {
        minLpOut,
        receiverAddress,
        bothPositive,
        dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount,
        dexCustomPayload,
    };
}

function decodeProvideLpPayload(
    cell: Cell
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('----- PROVIDE_LP PAYLOAD -----');

    const slice = cell.beginParse();

    const opcode = slice.loadUint(32);

    const routerWalletAddress =
        slice.loadAddress();

    const refundAddress =
        slice.loadAddress();

    const excessesAddress =
        slice.loadAddress();

    const deadline =
        slice.loadUint(64);

    const innerCell =
        slice.loadRef();

    console.log(
        'opcode:',
        '0x' + opcode.toString(16)
    );

    console.log(
        'routerWalletAddress:',
        addressString(routerWalletAddress)
    );

    console.log(
        'refundAddress:',
        addressString(refundAddress)
    );

    console.log(
        'excessesAddress:',
        addressString(excessesAddress)
    );

    console.log(
        'deadline:',
        deadline.toString()
    );

    check(
        'provideLpOpcode',
        opcode,
        EXPECTED.provideLpOpcode
    );

    checkAddress(
        'routerWalletAddress',
        routerWalletAddress,
        EXPECTED.routerPtonWallet
    );

    checkAddress(
        'refundAddress',
        refundAddress,
        EXPECTED.userAddress
    );

    checkAddress(
        'excessesAddress',
        excessesAddress,
        EXPECTED.userAddress
    );

    if (deadline <= 0) {
        throw new Error(
            'Invalid deadline'
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'deadline validity: PASS'
    );

    if (slice.remainingBits !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `Provide LP payload has ${slice.remainingBits} remaining bits`
        );
    }

    if (slice.remainingRefs !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `Provide LP payload has ${slice.remainingRefs} remaining refs`
        );
    }

    const inner =
        decodeProvideLpInnerCell(innerCell);

    return {
        opcode,
        routerWalletAddress,
        refundAddress,
        excessesAddress,
        deadline,
        inner,
    };
}

function decodeJettonTransfer(
    cell: Cell
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('----- JETTON TRANSFER -----');

    const slice = cell.beginParse();

    const opcode =
        slice.loadUint(32);

    const queryId =
        slice.loadUint(64);

    const amount =
        slice.loadCoins();

    const destination =
        slice.loadAddress();

    const responseDestination =
        slice.loadAddress();

    const hasCustomPayload =
        slice.loadBit();

    let customPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (hasCustomPayload) {
        customPayload = slice.loadRef();
    }

    const forwardTonAmount =
        slice.loadCoins();

    const hasForwardPayload =
        slice.loadBit();

    let forwardPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (hasForwardPayload) {
        forwardPayload = slice.loadRef();
    }

    console.log(
        'opcode:',
        '0x' + opcode.toString(16)
    );

    console.log(
        'queryId:',
        queryId.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'amount:',
        amount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'destination:',
        addressString(destination)
    );

    console.log(
        'responseDestination:',
        addressString(responseDestination)
    );

    console.log(
        'hasCustomPayload:',
        hasCustomPayload
    );

    console.log(
        'forwardTonAmount:',
        forwardTonAmount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'hasForwardPayload:',
        hasForwardPayload
    );

    check(
        'jettonTransferOpcode',
        opcode,
        EXPECTED.jettonTransferOpcode
    );

    check(
        'queryId',
        queryId,
        EXPECTED.queryId
    );

    check(
        'roosterAmount',
        amount,
        EXPECTED.roosterAmount
    );

    checkAddress(
        'destination',
        destination,
        EXPECTED.routerAddress
    );

    check(
        'forwardTonAmount',
        forwardTonAmount,
        EXPECTED.forwardTonAmount
    );

    check(
        'hasCustomPayload',
        hasCustomPayload,
        false
    );

    check(
        'hasForwardPayload',
        hasForwardPayload,
        true
    );

    if (!forwardPayload) {
        throw new Error(
            'Forward payload is missing'
        );
    }

    const provideLp =
        decodeProvideLpPayload(

    if (slice.remainingBits !== 0) {
        throw new Error(

        );
    }

    if (slice.remainingRefs !== 0) {
        throw new Error(

        );
    }

    console.log(

    return {

        amount,
        destination,
        responseDestination,
        customPayload,

function loadBocFile(): Cell {
    const bocPath =
        path.resolve(
            process.cwd(),
            'rooster_v22_generated.boc'
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'BOC FILE:',
        bocPath
    );

    if (!fs.existsSync(bocPath)) {
        throw new Error(
            `BOC file not found: ${bocPath}`
        );
    }
let boc =
    fs.readFileSync(bocPath);

    console.log(
        'BOC SIZE:',
        boc.length,
        'bytes'
    );

    if (boc.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(
            'BOC file is empty'
        );
    }

   let rawMagic =
    boc.subarray(0, 4).toString('hex');

if (rawMagic !== 'b5ee9c72') {
    const base64Text =
        boc.toString('utf8').trim();

    try {
        boc = Buffer.from(
            base64Text,
            'base64'
        );
    } catch {
        throw new Error(
            'INVALID BOC FILE: not raw BOC and not valid Base64'
        );
    }
}

const magic =
    boc.subarray(0, 4).toString('hex');

console.log(
    'BOC MAGIC:',
    magic
);

check(
    'BOC magic',
    magic,
    'b5ee9c72'
);

    const cells =
        Cell.fromBoc(boc);

    if (cells.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected 1 root cell, found ${cells.length}`
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'ROOT CELLS:',
        cells.length
    );

    return cells[0];
}

import { Address, Cell, Slice } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ENDPOINT = 'https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com';

const ROUTER_ADDRESS =
    'EQBQ_UBQvR9ryUjKDwijtoiyyga2Wl-yJm6Y8gl0k-HDh_5x';

function printCellInfo(label: string, cell: Cell): void {
    console.log('');
    console.log(label);
    console.log('----------------------------------------');
    console.log(`cell type : ${cell.type}`);
    console.log(`bits      : ${cell.bits.length}`);
    console.log(`refs      : ${cell.refs.length}`);
    console.log(`hash      : ${cell.hash().toString('hex')}`);

    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        console.log(`remaining : ${s.remainingBits} bits`);

        if (s.remainingBits >= 8) {
            const count = Math.min(
                Math.floor(s.remainingBits / 8),
                32,
            );

            const bytes: number[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                bytes.push(s.loadUint(8));
            }

            const ascii = bytes
                .map((b) =>
                    b >= 32 && b <= 126
                        ? String.fromCharCode(b)
                        : '.',
                )
                .join('');

            const hex = bytes
                .map((b) =>
                    b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'),
                )
                .join(' ');

            console.log(`ASCII     : ${ascii}`);
            console.log(`HEX       : ${hex}`);
        }
    } catch {
        console.log('preview   : unavailable');
    }
}

function printSlice(label: string, slice: Slice): void {
    console.log('');
    console.log(label);
    console.log('----------------------------------------');
    console.log(`remaining bits : ${slice.remainingBits}`);
    console.log(`remaining refs : ${slice.remainingRefs}`);

    // Clone the slice so the original reader position is not changed.
    const s = slice.clone();

    try {
        if (s.remainingBits >= 267) {
            const address = s.loadAddress();

            if (address) {
                console.log(`ADDRESS       : ${address.toString()}`);
                return;
            }
        }
    } catch {
        // Not an address slice.
    }

    // Try to interpret the slice as a byte string.
    try {
        const byteCount = Math.floor(s.remainingBits / 8);

        if (byteCount > 0) {
            const count = Math.min(byteCount, 64);
            const bytes: number[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                bytes.push(s.loadUint(8));
            }

            const ascii = bytes
                .map((b) =>
                    b >= 32 && b <= 126
                        ? String.fromCharCode(b)
                        : '.',
                )
                .join('');

            const hex = bytes
                .map((b) =>
                    b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'),
                )
                .join(' ');

            console.log(`ASCII         : ${ascii}`);
            console.log(`HEX           : ${hex}`);
        }
    } catch {
        console.log('slice preview : unavailable');
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI ROUTER DATA STRUCTURE DECODER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log(`ROUTER: ${ROUTER_ADDRESS}`);
    console.log(`ENDPOINT: ${ENDPOINT}`);
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: ENDPOINT,
    });

    const router = Address.parse(ROUTER_ADDRESS);

    const latest = await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log(`MASTERCHAIN SEQNO: ${latest.last.seqno}`);
    console.log('');

    const result = await client.runMethod(
        latest.last.seqno,
        router,
        'get_router_data',
    );

    console.log(`EXIT CODE: ${result.exitCode}`);
    console.log('');

    if (result.exitCode !== 0) {
        console.log('GETTER FAILED');
        console.log('RESULT RAW:');
        console.log(result.resultRaw);
        return;
    }

    const reader = result.reader;

    console.log('================ ROUTER FIELDS =================');
    console.log('');

    // FIELD 0
    const routerId = reader.readBigNumber();

    console.log('FIELD [0]');
    console.log('----------------------------------------');
    console.log('type  : int');
    console.log(`value : ${routerId}`);

    // FIELD 1
    const dexType = reader.readString();

console.log('');
console.log('FIELD [1] - DEX TYPE');
console.log('----------------------------------------');
console.log(`value : ${dexType}`);

    // FIELD 2
    const locked = reader.readBigNumber();

    console.log('');
    console.log('FIELD [2]');
    console.log('----------------------------------------');
    console.log('type  : int');
    console.log(`value : ${locked}`);

    console.log(
        `status: ${locked === 0n ? 'UNLOCKED' : 'LOCKED'}`,
    );

    // FIELD 3
  const adminAddress = reader.readAddress();

console.log('');
console.log('FIELD [3] - ADMIN / ADDRESS');
console.log('----------------------------------------');
console.log(`ADDRESS : ${adminAddress.toString()}`);

    // FIELD 4
    const field4 = reader.readCell();

    printCellInfo(
        'FIELD [4] - CELL',
        field4,
    );

    // FIELD 5
    const field5 = reader.readCell();

    printCellInfo(
        'FIELD [5] - CELL',
        field5,
    );

    // FIELD 6
    const field6 = reader.readCell();

    printCellInfo(
        'FIELD [6] - CELL',
        field6,
    );

    // FIELD 7
    const field7 = reader.readCell();

    printCellInfo(
        'FIELD [7] - CELL',
        field7,
    );

    // FIELD 8
    const field8 = reader.readCell();

    printCellInfo(
        'FIELD [8] - CELL',
        field8,
    );

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ENDPOINT = 'https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com';

const ROUTER_ADDRESS =
    'EQBQ_UBQvR9ryUjKDwijtoiyyga2Wl-yJm6Y8gl0k-HDh_5x';

function dumpRef(
    index: number,
    cell: any,
): void {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`REF [${index}]`);
    console.log('----------------------------------------');

    console.log(`type : ${cell.type}`);
    console.log(`bits : ${cell.bits.length}`);
    console.log(`refs : ${cell.refs.length}`);

    console.log(
        `hash : ${cell.hash().toString('hex')}`,
    );

    try {
        console.log(
            `BOC  : ${cell.toBoc({
                idx: false,
            }).toString('base64')}`,
        );
    } catch {
        console.log('BOC  : unavailable');
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER FIELD [4] DECODER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: ENDPOINT,
    });

    const router = Address.parse(
        ROUTER_ADDRESS,
    );

    const latest = await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log(
        `MASTERCHAIN SEQNO: ${latest.last.seqno}`,
    );

    console.log('');

    const result = await client.runMethod(
        latest.last.seqno,
        router,
        'get_router_data',
    );

    console.log(
        `EXIT CODE: ${result.exitCode}`,
    );

    if (result.exitCode !== 0) {
        console.log('GETTER FAILED');
        console.log(result.resultRaw);
        return;
    }

    const reader = result.reader;

    // [0]
    reader.readBigNumber();

    // [1]
    reader.readString();

    // [2]
    reader.readBigNumber();

    // [3]
    reader.readAddress();

    // [4]
    const field4 = reader.readCell();

    console.log('');
    console.log('FIELD [4]');
    console.log('----------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        `type : ${field4.type}`,
    );

    console.log(
        `bits : ${field4.bits.length}`,
    );

    console.log(
        `refs : ${field4.refs.length}`,
    );

    console.log(
        `hash : ${field4.hash().toString('hex')}`,
    );

    console.log('');

    try {
        console.log(
            'BOC:',
        );

        console.log(
            field4
                .toBoc({
                    idx: false,
                })
                .toString('base64'),
        );
    } catch {
        console.log(
            'BOC: unavailable',
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('FIELD [4] BIT DATA');
    console.log('----------------------------------------');

    try {
        const s = field4.beginParse();

        console.log(
            `remaining bits : ${s.remainingBits}`,
        );

        console.log(
            `remaining refs : ${s.remainingRefs}`,
        );

        const fullBytes =
            Math.floor(
                s.remainingBits / 8,
            );

        const bytes: number[] = [];

        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < fullBytes;
            i++
        ) {
            bytes.push(
                s.loadUint(8),
            );
        }

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'HEX:',
        );

        console.log(
            bytes
                .map((b) =>
                    b
                        .toString(16)
                        .padStart(2, '0'),
                )
                .join(' '),
        );

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'DECIMAL:',
        );

        console.log(
            bytes.join(', '),
        );
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'Bit decode failed:',
            e instanceof Error
                ? e.message
                : String(e),
        );
    }

    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'FIELD [4] REFERENCES',
    );

    console.log(
        '----------------------------------------',
    );

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < field4.refs.length;
        i++
    ) {
        dumpRef(
            i,
            field4.refs[i],
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' FINISHED - READ ONLY');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';

export async function run(provider: any) {
    const router = Address.parse(
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
    );

    console.log('===== DECODE ROUTER LIBRARY REFERENCE =====');
    console.log('Router:', router.toString());

    const state = await provider.provider(router).getState();

    if (state.state.type !== 'active') {
        console.log('Router is not active.');
        return;
    }

    const code = state.state.code;

    if (!code) {
        console.log('Router code is missing.');
        return;
    }

    console.log('\nCode bytes:', code.length);
    console.log('Code HEX:');
    console.log(code.toString('hex'));

    console.log('\nCode Base64 BOC:');
    console.log(code.toString('base64'));

    console.log('\n===== RAW BYTES =====');

    for (let i = 0; i < code.length; i++) {
        console.log(
            `${i.toString().padStart(2, '0')}: 0x${code[i]
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(2, '0')}`
        );
    }

    console.log('\n===== POSSIBLE LIBRARY HASH REGION =====');

    if (code.length >= 34) {
        console.log(
            'Bytes 2..33:',
            code.subarray(2, 34).toString('hex')
        );
    }

    if (code.length >= 35) {
        console.log(
            'Bytes 3..34:',
            code.subarray(3, 35).toString('hex')
        );
    }
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

export async function run(provider: any) {

    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('   EXTRACT ROUTER LIBRARY HASHES');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');

    const state =
        await provider.provider(ROUTER).getState();

    if (state.state.type !== 'active') {
        console.log('Router is not active.');
        return;
    }

    const data =
        Cell.fromBoc(state.state.data)[0];

    const libraryContainer = data.refs[1];

    console.log('Router:', ROUTER.toString());
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Library container refs:',
        libraryContainer.refs.length
    );

    for (let i = 0; i < libraryContainer.refs.length; i++) {

        const lib = libraryContainer.refs[i];

        console.log('');
        console.log(`===== LIBRARY REF [${i}] =====`);

        console.log('Cell bits:', lib.bits.length);
        console.log('Cell refs:', lib.refs.length);
        console.log('Exotic:', lib.isExotic);
        console.log('Cell type:', lib.type);

        /*
         * Library reference is an exotic cell and cannot
         * be parsed with beginParse().
         *
         * Its payload is:
         *
         *   8 bits  = type 2
         *   256 bits = library hash
         *
         * We therefore read the raw bitstring.
         */

        const bits = lib.bits.toString();

        console.log('');
        console.log('RAW BITS:');
        console.log(bits);

        const tagBits = bits.substring(0, 8);
        const hashBits = bits.substring(8, 264);

        console.log('');
        console.log('TAG BITS:');
        console.log(tagBits);

        console.log('');
        console.log('HASH BITS:');
        console.log(hashBits);

        const tag = parseInt(tagBits, 2);

        let hashHex = '';

        for (let j = 0; j < hashBits.length; j += 8) {
            const byte = parseInt(
                hashBits.substring(j, j + 8),
                2
            );

            hashHex += byte
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(2, '0');
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('TAG:', tag);
        console.log('INTERNAL LIBRARY HASH:');
        console.log(hashHex);
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('              COMPLETE');
    console.log('              NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================');
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROUTER =
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3';

const POOL =
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf';

const ROUTER_LT = '99809465000006';
const POOL_LT = '99809465000008';

const PROVIDE_LP = 0x37c096df;

const ENDPOINT =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/getTransactions';

function findBody(msg: any): string | null {
    const candidates = [
        msg?.msg_data?.body,
        msg?.message_content?.body,
        msg?.body,
    ];

    for (const x of candidates) {
        if (typeof x === 'string' && x.length > 20) {
            return x;
        }
    }

    return null;
}

function decodeProvideLp(boc: string) {
    const root = Cell.fromBase64(boc);
    const s = root.beginParse();

    const op = s.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const fromUser = s.loadAddress();
    const leftAmount = s.loadCoins();
    const rightAmount = s.loadCoins();

    const dexPayload = s.loadRef();
    const d = dexPayload.beginParse();

    const transferredOp = d.loadUint(32);
    const tokenWallet1 = d.loadAddress();
    const refundAddress = d.loadAddress();
    const excessesAddress = d.loadAddress();
    const deadline = d.loadUintBig(64);

    const provideBody = d.loadRef();
    const p = provideBody.beginParse();

    const minLpOut = p.loadCoins();
    const toAddress = p.loadAddress();
    const bothPositive = p.loadBit();
    const fwdAmount = p.loadCoins();

    let customPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (p.loadBit()) {
        customPayload = p.loadRef();
    }

    return {
        op: `0x${op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`,
        queryId,

        fromUser,
        leftAmount,
        rightAmount,

        transferredOp:
            `0x${transferredOp.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`,

        tokenWallet1,
        refundAddress,
        excessesAddress,

        deadline,
        minLpOut,
        toAddress,
        bothPositive,
        fwdAmount,

        customPayload,
    };
}

async function getTx(address: string, lt: string) {
    const url =
        `${ENDPOINT}?address=${encodeURIComponent(address)}&limit=20`;

    const response = await fetch(url);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`
        );
    }

    const json: any = await response.json();

    if (!json.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Toncenter error: ${JSON.stringify(json)}`
        );
    }

    const tx = (json.result ?? []).find(
        (x: any) =>
            String(x?.transaction_id?.lt) === lt
    );

    if (!tx) {
        throw new Error(
            `Transaction LT ${lt} not found for ${address}`
        );
    }

    return tx;
}

function getProvideMessage(tx: any, direction: 'in' | 'out') {
    if (direction === 'in') {
        return tx.in_msg;
    }

    const outs = tx.out_msgs ?? [];

    return outs.find((msg: any) => {
        const body = findBody(msg);

        if (!body) return false;

        try {
            const cell = Cell.fromBase64(body);
            return cell.beginParse().loadUint(32) === PROVIDE_LP;
        } catch {
            return false;
        }
    });
}

async function main() {
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteRoundRobinEngine, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { Functions } from 'ton-lite-client/dist/schema';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

const LIBRARY_CODE_HASH =
    'ca4c3052a1396aef50ca358ac355e2a99be4e1683eb87a2c11fbd452bb4acec5';

function printCell(label: string, cell: Cell) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`===== ${label} =====`);
    console.log('Type:', cell.type);
    console.log('Bits:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', cell.refs.length);
    console.log('Hash:', cell.hash().toString('hex'));
    console.log('BOC:', cell.toBoc().toString('base64'));
}

function printBits(label: string, cell: Cell) {
    if (cell.type !== -1) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(`----- ${label} RAW BITS -----`);
        console.log('SKIPPED: exotic cell');
        console.log('Type:', cell.type);
        console.log('Bit count:', cell.bits.length);
        return;
    }

    const slice = cell.beginParse();

    let bits = '';

    while (slice.remainingBits > 0) {
        bits += slice.loadBit() ? '1' : '0';
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(`----- ${label} RAW BITS -----`);
    console.log(bits);
    console.log('Bit count:', bits.length);
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROUTER =
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3';

const TARGET_LT = '99809465000006';

const ENDPOINT =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/getTransactions';

function firstOpcode(body: string): string {
    try {
        const cell = Cell.fromBase64(body);
        const s = cell.beginParse();
        return '0x' + s.loadUint(32).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    } catch {
        return 'INVALID_BOC';
    }
}

function findBody(msg: any): string | null {
    const candidates = [
        msg?.msg_data?.body,
        msg?.message_content?.body,
        msg?.body,
        msg?.message_content?.data,
        msg?.msg_data?.data,
    ];

    for (const x of candidates) {
        if (typeof x === 'string' && x.length > 20) {
            return x;
        }
    }

    return null;
}

function printMessage(
    title: string,
    msg: any,
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log(title);
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');

    console.log('source      :', msg?.source);
    console.log('destination :', msg?.destination);
    console.log('value       :', msg?.value);
    console.log('created_lt  :', msg?.created_lt);

    console.log('');
    console.log('MESSAGE KEYS:');

    if (msg && typeof msg === 'object') {
        console.log(Object.keys(msg).join(', '));
    }

    const body = findBody(msg);

    if (!body) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('BODY: NOT FOUND');
        return;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('BODY FOUND');
    console.log('BOC length:', body.length);
    console.log('BOC:', body);

    const op = firstOpcode(body);

    console.log('');
    console.log('OPCODE:', op);

    if (op === '0x37c096df') {
        console.log('');
        console.log('>>> STON.FI v2.2 PROVIDE_LP MESSAGE');
    } else if (op === '0x7362d09c') {
        console.log('');
        console.log('>>> JETTON_NOTIFY');
    } else if (op === '0x50c6a654') {
        console.log('');
        console.log('>>> ADD_LIQUIDITY_V2');
    } else {
        console.log('');
        console.log('>>> UNKNOWN OPCODE');
    }
}

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000007n;

function getOpcode(body: any): number | null {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function opcodeHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';

    return '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function ton(value: bigint): string {
    return (
        Number(value) / 1e9
    ).toFixed(9);
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

function cellToAddress(cell: Cell): string {
    try {
        const slice = cell.beginParse();
        return slice.loadAddress()?.toString() ?? 'null';
    } catch {
        return 'DECODE_FAILED';
    }
}

function cellToString(cell: Cell): string {
    try {
        const slice = cell.beginParse();

        if (slice.remainingBits < 8) {
            return 'EMPTY';
        }

        return slice.loadStringTail();
    } catch {
        return 'DECODE_FAILED';
    }
}

import { Address, Cell } from "@ton/core";
import { DEX } from "@ston-fi/sdk";

const ROOSTER_MASTER =
  "EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx";

const PTON_MASTER =
  "EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S";

const ROUTER =
  "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3";

const USER =
  "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix";

const EXPECTED_PTON_WALLET =
  "EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3";

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 200073535827652n;
const MIN_LP_OUT = 300329052918n;

const GAS_AMOUNT = 300000000n;
const FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT = 240000000n;

function showAddress(
  label: string,
  address: Address | null,
) {
  console.log(
    `${label}:`,
    address ? address.toString() : "null",
  );
}

function inspectCellTree(
  name: string,
  cell: Cell,
  depth = 0,
) {
  const p = "  ".repeat(depth);

  console.log(`${p}${name}`);
  console.log(`${p}bits: ${cell.bits.length}`);
  console.log(`${p}refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);
  console.log(
    `${p}hash: ${cell.hash().toString("hex")}`,
  );

  for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
    inspectCellTree(
      `ref[${i}]`,
      cell.refs[i],
      depth + 1,
    );
  }
}

function decodeProvideLpCell(
  cell: Cell,
) {
  console.log();
  console.log("===== PROVIDE_LP CELL =====");

  const s = cell.beginParse();

  console.log(
    "Initial bits:",
    s.remainingBits,
  );

  console.log(
    "Initial refs:",
    s.remainingRefs,
  );

  if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
    console.log("Not enough bits for opcode.");
    return;
  }

  const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

  console.log(
    "Opcode:",
    "0x" +
      opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, "0"),
  );

  if (opcode !== 0x37c096df) {
    console.log(
      "WARNING: opcode is not PROVIDE_LP",
    );
  } else {
    console.log("Opcode check: PASS");
  }

  if (s.remainingBits >= 267) {
    const routerWallet =
      s.loadAddress();

    showAddress(
      "routerWalletAddress",
      routerWallet,
    );
  } else {
    console.log(
      "Not enough bits for routerWalletAddress",
    );
    return;
  }

  if (s.remainingBits >= 1) {
    const minLpOut =
      s.loadCoins();

    console.log(
      "minLpOut:",
      minLpOut.toString(),
    );

    console.log(
      "Expected minLpOut:",
      MIN_LP_OUT.toString(),
    );

    console.log(
      "minLpOut check:",
      minLpOut === MIN_LP_OUT
        ? "PASS"
        : "FAIL",
    );
  }

  console.log(
    "Trailing bits:",
    s.remainingBits,
  );

  console.log(
    "Trailing refs:",
    s.remainingRefs,
  );
}

function decodeJettonTransfer(
  cell: Cell,
) {
  console.log();
  console.log("==============================================");
  console.log(" JETTON TRANSFER EXACT DECODE");
  console.log("==============================================");

  const s = cell.beginParse();

  console.log();
  console.log("===== INITIAL =====");
  console.log("bits:", s.remainingBits);
  console.log("refs:", s.remainingRefs);

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // opcode
  // ------------------------------------------------

  if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
    throw new Error("Missing Jetton Transfer opcode");
  }

  const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 1. OPCODE =====");
  console.log(
    "Opcode:",
    "0x" +
      opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, "0"),
  );

  console.log(
    "Expected:",
    "0x0f8a7ea5",
  );

  console.log(
    "Check:",
    opcode === 0x0f8a7ea5
      ? "PASS"
      : "FAIL",
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // query_id
  // ------------------------------------------------

  const queryId =
    s.loadUintBig(64);

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 2. QUERY ID =====");
  console.log(
    "query_id:",
    queryId.toString(),
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // amount
  // ------------------------------------------------

  const amount =
    s.loadCoins();

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 3. AMOUNT =====");
  console.log(
    "amount:",
    amount.toString(),
  );

  console.log(
    "Expected:",
    ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString(),
  );

  console.log(
    "Check:",
    amount === ROOSTER_AMOUNT
      ? "PASS"
      : "FAIL",
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // destination
  // ------------------------------------------------

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 4. DESTINATION =====");

  const destination =
    s.loadAddress();

  showAddress(
    "destination",
    destination,
  );

  console.log(
    "Expected Router:",
    ROUTER,
  );

  console.log(
    "Check:",
    destination?.toString() === ROUTER
      ? "PASS"
      : "FAIL",
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // response destination
  // ------------------------------------------------

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 5. RESPONSE DESTINATION =====");

  const responseDestination =
    s.loadAddress();

  showAddress(
    "response_destination",
    responseDestination,
  );

  console.log(
    "Expected User:",
    USER,
  );

  console.log(
    "Check:",
    responseDestination?.toString() === USER
      ? "PASS"
      : "FAIL",
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // custom payload
  // ------------------------------------------------

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 6. CUSTOM PAYLOAD =====");

  const customPayloadBit =
    s.loadBit();

  console.log(
    "custom_payload:",
    customPayloadBit
      ? "present"
      : "none",
  );

  if (customPayloadBit) {
    if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
      const customPayload =
        s.loadRef();

      console.log(
        "Custom payload reference: present",
      );

      inspectCellTree(
        "customPayload",
        customPayload,
      );
    } else {
      console.log(
        "WARNING: custom payload bit set but no ref",
      );
    }
  } else {
    console.log(
      "Custom payload check: PASS (none)",
    );
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // forward TON amount
  // ------------------------------------------------

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 7. FORWARD TON AMOUNT =====");

  const forwardTonAmount =
    s.loadCoins();

  console.log(
    "forward_ton_amount:",
    forwardTonAmount.toString(),
  );

  console.log(
    "Expected:",
    FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT.toString(),
  );

  console.log(
    "Check:",
    forwardTonAmount === FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT
      ? "PASS"
      : "FAIL",
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // forward payload
  // ------------------------------------------------

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 8. FORWARD PAYLOAD =====");

  if (s.remainingBits < 1) {
    throw new Error(
      "Missing forward_payload selector",
    );
  }

  const forwardPayloadIsRef =
    s.loadBit();

  console.log(
    "forward_payload mode:",
    forwardPayloadIsRef
      ? "REFERENCE"
      : "INLINE",
  );

  let forwardPayload: Cell | null = null;

  if (forwardPayloadIsRef) {
    if (s.remainingRefs < 1) {
      throw new Error(
        "Forward payload says REFERENCE but no ref exists",
      );
    }

    forwardPayload =
      s.loadRef();

    console.log(
      "Forward payload reference: PASS",
    );
  } else {
    console.log(
      "Forward payload is inline.",
    );

    /*
     * If inline, the remaining slice itself is
     * the forward payload.
     *
     * We preserve it as a Cell for inspection.
     */
    forwardPayload =
      s.asCell();
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // root trailing
  // ------------------------------------------------

  console.log();
  console.log("===== 9. ROOT AFTER PARSE =====");

  console.log(
    "Remaining bits:",
    s.remainingBits,
  );

  console.log(
    "Remaining refs:",
    s.remainingRefs,
  );

  // ------------------------------------------------
  // forward payload decode
  // ------------------------------------------------

  if (forwardPayload) {
    inspectCellTree(
      "forwardPayload",
      forwardPayload,
    );

    decodeProvideLpCell(
      forwardPayload,
    );
  }
}

export async function run(provider: any) {
  console.log("==============================================");
  console.log(" STON.fi v2.2 SDK JETTON TRANSFER DECODE");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT");
  console.log("==============================================");

  console.log();
  console.log("===== BUILD SDK BODY =====");

  const routerAddress =
    Address.parse(ROUTER);

  const userAddress =
    Address.parse(USER);

  const roosterMaster =
    Address.parse(ROOSTER_MASTER);

  const ptonMaster =
    Address.parse(PTON_MASTER);

  const routerContract =
    DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(
      routerAddress,
    );

  const params =
    await routerContract
      .getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
        provider.provider(routerAddress),
        {
          userWalletAddress: userAddress,
          sendTokenAddress: roosterMaster,
          otherTokenAddress: ptonMaster,
          sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
          minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
          gasAmount: GAS_AMOUNT,
          forwardGasAmount:
            FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT,
          transferExcessAddress:
            userAddress,
        },
      );

  if (!params.body) {
    throw new Error(
      "SDK returned empty body",
    );
  }

  console.log(
    "SDK body: PASS",
  );

  console.log(
    "TX to:",
    params.to.toString(),
  );

  console.log(
    "TX value:",
    params.value.toString(),
  );

  console.log();
  console.log("===== COMPLETE SDK BODY TREE =====");

  inspectCellTree(
    "SDK BODY",
    params.body,
  );

  decodeJettonTransfer(
    params.body,
  );

  console.log();
  console.log("==============================================");
  console.log(" DECODE COMPLETE");
  console.log(" NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT");
  console.log("==============================================");
}

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const SEG412_START = 0x0018744c;
const SEG412_END   = 0x0018ab8c;

const SEG413_START = 0x0018ab98;
const SEG413_END   = 0x0018f511;

const TARGETS = [
    { name: "2053", addr: 0x00189dec },
    { name: "2101", addr: 0x00189f9c },
    { name: "2612", addr: 0x0018a8b0 },
];

function u32(fileOffset: number): number {
    return wasm.readUInt32LE(fileOffset);
}

function hex(v: number): string {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function runtimeToFile(addr: number): number | null {
    // Segment 412
    if (addr >= SEG412_START && addr <= SEG412_END) {
        return 0x004a6695 + (addr - SEG412_START);
    }

    // Segment 413
    if (addr >= SEG413_START && addr <= SEG413_END) {
        return 0x004a9de0 + (addr - SEG413_START);
    }

    return null;
}

function classify(v: number): string {
    if (v === 0) return "ZERO";

    if (v >= SEG412_START && v <= SEG412_END)
        return "SEG412_PTR";

    if (v >= SEG413_START && v <= SEG413_END)
        return "SEG413_PTR";

    // Function indexes are generally much smaller than runtime pointers.
    if (v < 10000)
        return "SMALL_INDEX";

    return "VALUE";
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SEGMENT 412 TARGET DECODER");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);

for (const target of TARGETS) {
    const targetFile = runtimeToFile(target.addr);

    if (targetFile === null) {
        console.log(`\nTARGET ${target.name}: FILE OFFSET ERROR`);
        continue;
    }

    console.log("\n============================================================");
    console.log(`TARGET ${target.name}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(`runtime : ${hex(target.addr)}`);
    console.log(`file    : ${hex(targetFile)}`);
    console.log(`index   : ${hex(u32(targetFile))}`);

    // Search backwards for the probable record start:
    // a record usually begins with 3 consecutive small indices.
    let recordStart = targetFile;

    for (let p = targetFile; p >= targetFile - 256; p -= 4) {
        if (p < 0 || p + 12 > wasm.length) continue;

        const a = u32(p);
        const b = u32(p + 4);
        const c = u32(p + 8);

        if (
            a < 10000 &&
            b < 10000 &&
            c < 10000 &&
            b === a + 1 &&
            c === b + 1
        ) {
            recordStart = p;
            break;
        }
    }

    const recordRuntime =
        SEG412_START + (recordStart - 0x004a6695);

    console.log(`record runtime : ${hex(recordRuntime)}`);
    console.log(`record file    : ${hex(recordStart)}`);
    console.log("");

    console.log("RECORD WORDS");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    const MAX_WORDS = 48;

    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_WORDS; i++) {
        const p = recordStart + i * 4;
        if (p + 4 > wasm.length) break;

        const v = u32(p);

        const runtime =
            SEG412_START + (p - 0x004a6695);

        let marker = "";

        if (runtime === target.addr)
            marker = " <<< TARGET";

        console.log(
            `+${String(i * 4).padStart(3, " ")} ` +
            `${hex(runtime)} ` +
            `file=${hex(p)} ` +
            `${hex(v)} ` +
            `${classify(v)}${marker}`
        );
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------
    // Extract pointer targets and inspect pointed structures
    // ---------------------------------------------------------

    console.log("");
    console.log("POINTER DESTINATIONS");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    const seen = new Set<number>();

    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_WORDS; i++) {
        const p = recordStart + i * 4;
        if (p + 4 > wasm.length) break;

        const v = u32(p);

        if (
            (v >= SEG412_START && v <= SEG412_END) ||
            (v >= SEG413_START && v <= SEG413_END)
        ) {
            if (seen.has(v)) continue;
            seen.add(v);

            const destFile = runtimeToFile(v);

            console.log(
                `field +${String(i * 4).padStart(3, " ")} ` +
                `${hex(v)} ` +
                `${v >= SEG413_START ? "SEG413" : "SEG412"} ` +
                `file=${destFile !== null ? hex(destFile) : "n/a"}`
            );

            if (destFile === null) continue;

            console.log("  first 16 words:");

            for (let j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
                const q = destFile + j * 4;

                if (q + 4 > wasm.length) break;

                const x = u32(q);

                console.log(
                    `    +${String(j * 4).padStart(2, " ")} ` +
                    `${hex(x)} ${classify(x)}`
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

console.log("\n============================================================");
console.log("END");
console.log("============================================================");
