import fs from "fs";

// ============================================================
// SEGMENT 669 FUNCTION INDEX DECODER v24
// READ ONLY - OFFLINE
//
// Goal:
//   1. Decode Import Section
//   2. Decode Function Section
//   3. Map Code Body Index -> REAL WASM Function Index
//   4. Inspect functions containing Segment 669 consumers
//   5. Decode Export / Name information when available
//
// NO TON
// NO RPC
// NO WALLET
// NO TRANSACTION
// NO SIGNING
// ============================================================

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_BODIES = [8, 36, 39, 573];

function readULEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    off: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 8 && off < buf.length; i++) {
        const b = buf[off++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: off };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: -1, next: off };
}

function readName(
    buf: Buffer,
    off: number
): { value: string; next: number } {
    const n = readULEB(buf, off);
    const end = n.next + n.value;

    if (n.value < 0 || end > buf.length) {
        return { value: "", next: buf.length };
    }

    return {
        value: buf.subarray(n.next, end).toString("utf8"),
        next: end,
    };
}

function u32(buf: Buffer, off: number): number {
    return (
        (buf[off] ?? 0) |
        ((buf[off + 1] ?? 0) << 8) |
        ((buf[off + 2] ?? 0) << 16) |
        ((buf[off + 3] ?? 0) << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function hex(buf: Buffer, start: number, end: number): string {
    return Array.from(buf.subarray(start, end))
        .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {
    if (
        buf.length < 8 ||
        buf[0] !== 0x00 ||
        buf[1] !== 0x61 ||
        buf[2] !== 0x73 ||
        buf[3] !== 0x6d
    ) {
        throw new Error("Invalid WASM magic");
    }

    let off = 8;

    const sections: {
        id: number;
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
        size: number;
    }[] = [];

    while (off < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[off++];

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, off);

        if (sizeInfo.value < 0) {
            break;
        }

        off = sizeInfo.next;

        const payloadStart = off;
        const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sizeInfo.value;

        if (payloadEnd > buf.length) {
            throw new Error(
                `Section exceeds WASM size: id=${id}`
            );
        }

        sections.push({
            id,
            payloadStart,
            payloadEnd,
            size: sizeInfo.value,
        });

        off = payloadEnd;
    }

    return sections;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORT SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function parseImportSection(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }
) {
    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    off = countInfo.next;

    const imports: {
        index: number;
        module: string;
        name: string;
        kind: number;
        typeIndex?: number;
    }[] = [];

    let importedFunctions = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const moduleInfo = readName(buf, off);
        const module = moduleInfo.value;
        off = moduleInfo.next;

        const nameInfo = readName(buf, off);
        const name = nameInfo.value;
        off = nameInfo.next;

        const kind = buf[off++];

        let typeIndex: number | undefined;

        switch (kind) {
            // Function
            case 0x00: {
                const typeInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
                typeIndex = typeInfo.value;
                off = typeInfo.next;

                imports.push({
                    index: importedFunctions,
                    module,
                    name,
                    kind,
                    typeIndex,
                });

                importedFunctions++;
                break;
            }

            // Table
            case 0x01: {
                // elemtype
                off += 1;

                // limits
                const flags = buf[off++];
                const min = readULEB(buf, off);
                off = min.next;

                if (flags & 0x01) {
                    const max = readULEB(buf, off);
                    off = max.next;
                }

                break;
            }

            // Memory
            case 0x02: {
                const flags = buf[off++];
                const min = readULEB(buf, off);
                off = min.next;

                if (flags & 0x01) {
                    const max = readULEB(buf, off);
                    off = max.next;
                }

                break;
            }

            // Global
            case 0x03: {
                // valtype
                off += 1;

                // mutability
                off += 1;

                break;
            }

            default:
                throw new Error(
                    `Unknown import kind 0x${kind.toString(16)}`
                );
        }
    }

    return {
        imports,
        importedFunctions,
        count,
    };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function parseFunctionSection(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }
) {
    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    off = countInfo.next;

    const typeIndices: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const typeInfo = readULEB(buf, off);

        typeIndices.push(typeInfo.value);

        off = typeInfo.next;
    }

    return typeIndices;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function parseCodeSection(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }
) {
    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    off = countInfo.next;

    const bodies: {
        bodyIndex: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
        bodySize: number;
        codeStart: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, off);

        const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
        off = sizeInfo.next;

        const bodyStart = off;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

        if (bodyEnd > section.payloadEnd) {
            throw new Error(
                `Invalid code body ${i}`
            );
        }

        let p = bodyStart;

        const localsInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        const localCount = localsInfo.value;
        p = localsInfo.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localCount; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = n.next;

            // value type
            p += 1;
        }

        bodies.push({
            bodyIndex: i,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            bodySize,
            codeStart: p,
        });

        off = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// EXPORT SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function parseExportSection(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }
) {
    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    off = countInfo.next;

    const exports: {
        name: string;
        kind: number;
        index: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const nameInfo = readName(buf, off);
        const name = nameInfo.value;
        off = nameInfo.next;

        const kind = buf[off++];

        const indexInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
        const index = indexInfo.value;
        off = indexInfo.next;

        exports.push({
            name,
            kind,
            index,
        });
    }

    return exports;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CUSTOM NAME SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function parseNameCustomSection(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }
) {
    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const nameInfo = readName(buf, off);
    const customName = nameInfo.value;
    off = nameInfo.next;

    const result: {
        customName: string;
        functionNames: Map<number, string>;
    } = {
        customName,
        functionNames: new Map(),
    };

    if (customName !== "name") {
        return result;
    }

    while (off < section.payloadEnd) {
        const subsectionId = buf[off++];

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
        const size = sizeInfo.value;
        off = sizeInfo.next;

        const subEnd = off + size;

        if (subEnd > section.payloadEnd) {
            break;
        }

        // Function names subsection
        if (subsectionId === 1) {
            const countInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
            const count = countInfo.value;
            off = countInfo.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const indexInfo = readULEB(buf, off);
                const index = indexInfo.value;
                off = indexInfo.next;

                const nameInfo2 = readName(buf, off);
                off = nameInfo2.next;

                result.functionNames.set(
                    index,
                    nameInfo2.value
                );
            }
        }

        off = subEnd;
    }

    return result;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SIMPLE CALL SCAN
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function scanCalls(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    const calls: {
        offset: number;
        functionIndex: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let p = start; p < end; p++) {
        // WASM call opcode = 0x10
        if (buf[p] !== 0x10) {
            continue;
        }

        const info = readULEB(buf, p + 1);

        if (
            info.value >= 0 &&
            info.next <= end
        ) {
            calls.push({
                offset: p,
                functionIndex: info.value,
            });
        }
    }

    return calls;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// TARGET BODY REPORT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function reportTarget(
    wasm: Buffer,
    body: ReturnType<typeof parseCodeSection>[number],
    importedFunctions: number,
    typeIndices: number[],
    functionNames: Map<number, string>,
    exports: ReturnType<typeof parseExportSection>
) {
    const realFunctionIndex =
        importedFunctions + body.bodyIndex;

    console.log("");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log(
        `BODY ${body.bodyIndex} @ ` +
        `0x${body.bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
    );
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    console.log(
        `body index          : ${body.bodyIndex}`
    );

    console.log(
        `REAL function index  : ${realFunctionIndex}`
    );

    const typeIndex =
        typeIndices[body.bodyIndex];

    console.log(
        `type index           : ${
            typeIndex === undefined
                ? "UNKNOWN"
                : typeIndex
        }`
    );

    const name =
        functionNames.get(realFunctionIndex);

    console.log(
        `function name        : ${
            name ?? "(no name subsection entry)"
        }`
    );

    const matchingExports =
        exports.filter(
            (e) =>
                e.kind === 0x00 &&
                e.index === realFunctionIndex
        );

    if (matchingExports.length) {
        console.log(
            `exports              : ${
                matchingExports
                    .map((e) => e.name)
                    .join(", ")
            }`
        );
    } else {
        console.log("exports              : none");
    }

    console.log(
        `body start           : 0x${body.bodyStart
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log(
        `body end             : 0x${body.bodyEnd
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log(
        `code start           : 0x${body.codeStart
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log(
        `body size            : ${body.bodySize}`
    );

    const calls = scanCalls(
        wasm,
        body.codeStart,
        body.bodyEnd
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("CALLS");

    if (!calls.length) {
        console.log("  none found");
    }

    for (const c of calls) {
        const targetName =
            functionNames.get(c.functionIndex);

        console.log(
            `  @0x${c.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}` +
            ` → function ${c.functionIndex}` +
            `${targetName ? ` (${targetName})` : ""}`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("BODY HEX");

    console.log(
        hex(
            wasm,
            body.bodyStart,
            body.bodyEnd
        )
    );
}

export async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SEGMENT 669 FUNCTION INDEX DECODER v24");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    if (!fs.existsSync(WASM_PATH)) {
        throw new Error(
            `WASM not found:\n${WASM_PATH}`
        );
    }

    const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

    console.log(
        `WASM path : ${WASM_PATH}`
    );

    console.log(
        `WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`
    );

    const sections = parseSections(wasm);

    const importSection =
        sections.find((s) => s.id === 2);

    const functionSection =
        sections.find((s) => s.id === 3);

    const exportSection =
        sections.find((s) => s.id === 7);

    const codeSection =
        sections.find((s) => s.id === 10);

    if (!importSection) {
        throw new Error(
            "Import Section not found"
        );
    }

    if (!functionSection) {
        throw new Error(
            "Function Section not found"
        );
    }

    if (!codeSection) {
        throw new Error(
            "Code Section not found"
        );
    }

    const imports =
        parseImportSection(
            wasm,
            importSection
        );

    const typeIndices =
        parseFunctionSection(
            wasm,
            functionSection
        );

    const bodies =
        parseCodeSection(
            wasm,
            codeSection
        );

    const exports =
        exportSection
            ? parseExportSection(
                  wasm,
                  exportSection
              )
            : [];

    const nameSections = sections.filter(
        (s) => s.id === 0
    );

    const functionNames =
        new Map<number, string>();

    let foundNameSection = false;

    for (const s of nameSections) {
        const parsed =
            parseNameCustomSection(
                wasm,
                s
            );

        if (parsed.customName === "name") {
            foundNameSection = true;

            for (const [
                index,
                name,
            ] of parsed.functionNames) {
                functionNames.set(
                    index,
                    name
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" MODULE SUMMARY");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(
        `imports total       : ${imports.count}`
    );

    console.log(
        `imported functions  : ${imports.importedFunctions}`
    );

    console.log(
        `defined functions   : ${typeIndices.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `code bodies         : ${bodies.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `exports             : ${exports.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `name section        : ${
            foundNameSection ? "YES" : "NO"
        }`
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" IMPORTED FUNCTIONS");
    console.log("============================================================");

    if (!imports.imports.length) {
        console.log("none");
    }

    for (const imp of imports.imports) {
        console.log(
            `${imp.index}` +
            ` : ${imp.module}` +
            `.${imp.name}` +
            ` type=${imp.typeIndex}`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" TARGET BODY → REAL FUNCTION INDEX");
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (const bodyIndex of TARGET_BODIES) {
        const body =
            bodies[bodyIndex];

        if (!body) {
            console.log(
                `BODY ${bodyIndex}: NOT FOUND`
            );
            continue;
        }

        reportTarget(
            wasm,
            body,
            imports.importedFunctions,
            typeIndices,
            functionNames,
            exports
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" TARGET CONSUMER OFFSETS");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const consumerOffsets = [
        0x00007c43,
        0x0000eed8,
        0x0000ece4,
        0x0002cc30,
        0x0002cc6b,
    ];

    for (const offset of consumerOffsets) {
        const body =
            bodies.find(
                (b) =>
                    offset >= b.bodyStart &&
                    offset < b.bodyEnd
            );

        console.log(
            `0x${offset
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, "0")} → ` +
            `${
                body
                    ? `body ${body.bodyIndex}, real function ${
                          imports.importedFunctions +
                          body.bodyIndex
                      }`
                    : "NO BODY"
            }`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" DONE");
    console.log(" READ ONLY: no TON");
    console.log(" READ ONLY: no RPC");
    console.log(" READ ONLY: no wallet");
    console.log(" READ ONLY: no transaction");
    console.log(" READ ONLY: no signing");
    console.log("============================================================");
}

// Blueprint-compatible entry point.
if (require.main === module) {
    run().catch((err) => {
        console.error(err);
        process.exitCode = 1;
    });
}

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

function u32(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    return buf.readUInt32LE(p);
}

function hx(n: number, w = 8): string {
    return n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function dumpWords(buf: Buffer, start: number, end: number) {
    console.log(
        `\nRange 0x${hx(start)} .. 0x${hx(end)}`
    );

    for (let p = start; p + 4 <= end; p += 4) {
        const v = u32(buf, p);

        console.log(
            `0x${hx(p)}  u32=${v.toString().padStart(10)}  hex=0x${hx(v)}`
        );
    }
}

async function main() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SEGMENT 669 TABLE DECODER v22");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const wasmPath =
        "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

    const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

    console.log(`WASM size: ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);

    const anchor = 0x004b3f11;

    console.log("\n============================================================");
    console.log(" SEGMENT 669 EXACT RECORD");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(`file offset = 0x${hx(anchor)} (${anchor})`);

    const record = wasm.subarray(anchor, anchor + 29);

    console.log(

import { Address, Cell, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_OPCODE = 0x06ecd527;

function getOpcode(cell: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function opcodeHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) {
        return 'UNKNOWN';
    }

    return (
        '0x' +
        op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
    );
}

function formatTon(value: bigint): string {
    const whole =
        value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction =
        (value % 1_000_000_000n)
            .toString()
            .padStart(9, '0')
            .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : whole.toString();
}

const START = 0x004db180;
const END   = 0x004db210;
const TARGET = 0x0019534c;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DECODE SELECTOR TABLE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`RANGE  : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log(`TARGET : 0x${TARGET.toString(16)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let p = START; p + 8 <= END; p += 8) {
  const tag =
    wasm[p] |
    (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
    (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
    (wasm[p + 3] << 24);

  const value =
    wasm[p + 4] |
    (wasm[p + 5] << 8) |
    (wasm[p + 6] << 16) |
    (wasm[p + 7] << 24);

  const uTag = tag >>> 0;
  const uValue = value >>> 0;

  console.log(
    `0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ` +
    `TAG=0x${uTag.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ` +
    `VALUE=0x${uValue.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ` +
    `DEC=${uValue}`
  );

  if (uValue === TARGET || uTag === TARGET) {
    console.log("  >>> TARGET MATCH <<<");
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = {
  3336: [0x102200, 0x102250],
  6991: [0x23c4c0, 0x23c550],
  7006: [0x23d720, 0x23d7a0]
};

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);
  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function readLocal(p) {
  const x = uleb(p + 1);
  return `L${x.value}`;
}

function memName(op) {
  return {
    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x29: "i64.load",
    0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
    0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
    0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
    0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x37: "i64.store",
    0x3a: "i32.store8",
    0x3b: "i32.store16"
  }[op];
}

function dump(start, end) {

  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {

    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    let s = `0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}  `;

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = sleb(p);
      s += `i32.const ${x.value} (0x${(x.value >>> 0).toString(16)})`;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      s += `local.get L${x.value}`;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      s += `local.set L${x.value}`;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      s += `local.tee L${x.value}`;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      s += `CALL ${x.value}`;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      const y = uleb(p);
      p = y.next;

      s += `CALL_INDIRECT type=${x.value} table=${y.value}`;
    }

    else if (memName(op)) {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      s += `${memName(op)} align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
    }

    else {
      const names = {
        0x0b:"END",
        0x0f:"RETURN",
        0x1a:"drop",
        0x40:"block",
        0x41:"i32.const",
        0x45:"i32.eqz",
        0x46:"i32.eq",
        0x47:"i32.ne",
        0x48:"i32.lt_s",
        0x49:"i32.lt_u",
        0x4a:"i32.gt_s",
        0x4b:"i32.gt_u",
        0x4c:"i32.le_s",
        0x4d:"i32.le_u",
        0x4e:"i32.ge_s",
        0x4f:"i32.ge_u",
        0x6a:"i32.add",
        0x6b:"i32.sub",
        0x6c:"i32.mul",
        0x72:"i32.xor",
        0x7a:"i32.rotl",
        0x0c:"br",
        0x0d:"br_if",
        0x04:"if",
        0x05:"else"
      };

      s += names[op] ?? `opcode=0x${op.toString(16)}`;
    }

    console.log(s);
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("STATE WRITERS EXACT DECODE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const [fn, range] of Object.entries(TARGETS)) {

  console.log("");
  console.log("############################################################");
  console.log(`FUNC ${fn}`);
  console.log(
    `RANGE 0x${range[0].toString(16)} .. 0x${range[1].toString(16)}`
  );
  console.log("############################################################");

  dump(range[0], range[1]);
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LIBRARY_HASH_HEX =
    'C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const TARGET_CELL_HASH_HEX =
    'DB8B6488B1D9B9051532EE339C86B249DF8F923B6E29975E8E474009157F601A';

const LITESERVER_HOST =
    'tcp://49.12.147.32:27842';

const LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY =
    'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM=';

const TARGETS = [
    ['ADD_LIQUIDITY', '50c6a654'],
    ['PROVIDE_LP', '37c096df'],
    ['LP_TRANSFER', '178d4519'],
    ['PTON_TRANSFER', '01f3835d'],
    ['ROOSTER_PATH', '0f8a7ea5'],
] as const;

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

function cellBits(cell: Cell): string {
    let result = '';

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.bits.length; i++) {
        result += cell.bits.at(i) ? '1' : '0';
    }

    return result;
}

function bitsToHex(bits: string): string {
    let result = '';

    for (let i = 0; i + 4 <= bits.length; i += 4) {
        result += parseInt(bits.slice(i, i + 4), 2)
            .toString(16);
    }

    return result.toUpperCase();
}

function hexToBits(hex: string): string {
    let result = '';

    for (const c of hex) {
        result += parseInt(c, 16)
            .toString(2)
            .padStart(4, '0');
    }

    return result;
}

function findBitOccurrences(
    bits: string,
    pattern: string
): number[] {
    const positions: number[] = [];

    let pos = bits.indexOf(pattern);

    while (pos !== -1) {
        positions.push(pos);
        pos = bits.indexOf(pattern, pos + 1);
    }

    return positions;
}

function printWindow(
    bits: string,
    offset: number,
    radius: number = 64
) {
    const start = Math.max(0, offset - radius);
    const end = Math.min(bits.length, offset + 32 + radius);

    const window = bits.slice(start, end);

    console.log(`  Window bits [${start}..${end - 1}]`);
    console.log(`  ${window}`);

    console.log(
        `  Target starts at relative bit ${offset - start}`
    );

    console.log(
        `  Window hex: ${bitsToHex(window)}`
    );
}

function inspectCell(
    cell: Cell,
    name: string,
    path: string
) {
    const hash =
        cell.hash()
            .toString('hex')
            .toUpperCase();

    const bits = cellBits(cell);

    console.log();
    console.log('----------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log(`${name}  ${path}`);
    console.log('----------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log(`Hash: ${hash}`);
    console.log(`Bits: ${bits.length}`);
    console.log(`Refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);
    console.log(`Full hex: ${bitsToHex(bits)}`);

    for (const [opcodeName, opcodeHex] of TARGETS) {
        const pattern = hexToBits(opcodeHex);
        const positions = findBitOccurrences(bits, pattern);

        if (positions.length === 0) {
            continue;
        }

        console.log();
        console.log(
            `*** ${opcodeName} (${opcodeHex.toUpperCase()}) ***`
        );

        for (const position of positions) {
            console.log(`Bit offset: ${position}`);
            console.log(`Byte offset: ${position / 8}`);

            if (position % 8 !== 0) {
                console.log(
                    'WARNING: opcode is not byte-aligned'
                );
            }

            printWindow(bits, position);
        }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
        inspectCell(
            cell.refs[i],
            `${name}.ref${i}`,
            `${path}.ref${i}`
        );
    }
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log(' TARGET STON.FI v2.2 LIBRARY CELL DECODER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log();

    console.log(`Library: ${LIBRARY_HASH_HEX}`);
    console.log(`Target:  ${TARGET_CELL_HASH_HEX}`);
    console.log(`Server:  ${LITESERVER_HOST}`);
    console.log();

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host: LITESERVER_HOST,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(
            LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY,
            'base64'
        ),
    });

    try {
        console.log('Waiting for ADNL READY...');

        const started = Date.now();

        while (!engine.isReady()) {
            if (Date.now() - started > 15000) {
                throw new Error(
                    'LiteServer did not become ready within 15 seconds'
                );
            }

            await sleep(250);
        }

        console.log('ADNL READY');
        console.log();

        const client = new LiteClient({
            engine,
        });

        const libraryHash =
            Buffer.from(LIBRARY_HASH_HEX, 'hex');

        console.log('Calling getLibraries()...');

        const result =
            await client.getLibraries([libraryHash]);

        const entry = result.result.find(
            item =>
                Buffer.from(item.hash)
                    .toString('hex')
                    .toUpperCase() === LIBRARY_HASH_HEX
        );

        if (!entry) {
            throw new Error(
                'Library entry not found'
            );
        }

        const root =
            Cell.fromBoc(Buffer.from(entry.data))[0];

        console.log(
            `Root hash: ${root.hash()
                .toString('hex')
                .toUpperCase()}`
        );

        const targetPath: Cell[] = [];

        function findTarget(
            cell: Cell,
            path: string
        ): boolean {
            const hash =
                cell.hash()
                    .toString('hex')
                    .toUpperCase();

            if (hash === TARGET_CELL_HASH_HEX) {
                targetPath.push(cell);

                console.log();
                console.log(
                    'TARGET CELL FOUND'
                );
                console.log(
                    `Path: ${path}`
                );

                return true;
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
                if (
                    findTarget(
                        cell.refs[i],
                        `${path}.ref${i}`
                    )
                ) {
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        findTarget(root, 'root');

        if (targetPath.length === 0) {
            throw new Error(
                'Target Cell was not found'
            );
        }

        const target =
            targetPath[targetPath.length - 1];

        console.log();
        console.log('========================================================================');
        console.log(' TARGET CELL');
        console.log('========================================================================');

        inspectCell(
            target,
            'TARGET',
            'root.ref0.ref0.ref0.ref0'
        );

        console.log();
        console.log('========================================================================');
        console.log(' DECODER COMPLETE');
        console.log('========================================================================');
        console.log('No blockchain transaction was sent.');
    } finally {
        engine.close();
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_TYPE = 23;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8;
let found = false;

while (p < b.length) {

  const id = b[p++];

  const s = uleb(p);
  p = s.next;

  const end = p + s.value;

  if (id === 1) {

    const count = uleb(p);
    p = count.next;

    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");

    console.log(`TYPE COUNT : ${count.value}`);
    console.log(`TARGET     : ${TARGET_TYPE}`);

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

      if (form !== 0x60)
        throw new Error(`Unexpected type form at ${i}`);

      const pc = uleb(p);

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

const TYPE_NAMES: Record<number, string> = {
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64",
    0x7b: "v128",
    0x70: "funcref",
    0x6f: "externref",
};

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" WASM TYPE #2 DECODER v37");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

console.log(`WASM size: ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log();

let pos = 8;

while (pos < buf.length) {
    const sectionId = buf[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, pos);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadStart = pos;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId !== 1) {
        pos = payloadEnd;
        continue;
    }

    console.log(
        `Type section: offset=0x${payloadStart.toString(16)} size=${sectionSize}`
    );
    console.log();

    let p = payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    const typeCount = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    console.log(`Type count: ${typeCount}`);
    console.log();

    for (let typeIndex = 0; typeIndex < typeCount; typeIndex++) {
        const form = buf[p++];

        const params: string[] = [];
        const results: string[] = [];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            console.log(
                `type #${typeIndex}: form=0x${form.toString(16)}`
            );
            continue;
        }

        const paramCountInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        const paramCount = paramCountInfo.value;
        p = paramCountInfo.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
            const vt = buf[p++];
            params.push(
                TYPE_NAMES[vt] ??
                `unknown(0x${vt.toString(16)})`
            );
        }

        const resultCountInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        const resultCount = resultCountInfo.value;
        p = resultCountInfo.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
            const vt = buf[p++];
            results.push(
                TYPE_NAMES[vt] ??
                `unknown(0x${vt.toString(16)})`
            );
        }

        if (
            typeIndex === 2 ||
            typeIndex === 1 ||
            typeIndex === 3
        ) {
            console.log(
                `type #${typeIndex}:`
            );

            console.log(
                `  params  = (${params.join(", ")})`
            );

            console.log(
                `  results = (${results.join(", ")})`
            );

            console.log();
        }
    }

    break;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_TYPE = 31;

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(
  buf: Buffer,
  pos: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB128 too large");
    }
  }
}

function findSection(
  wasm: Buffer,
  wantedId: number
): { start: number; end: number } | null {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sizeInfo.value;

    if (id === wantedId) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

function typeName(v: number): string {
  switch (v) {
    case 0x7f:
      return "i32";
    case 0x7e:
      return "i64";
    case 0x7d:
      return "f32";
    case 0x7c:
      return "f64";
    case 0x7b:
      return "v128";
    case 0x70:
      return "funcref";
    case 0x6f:
      return "externref";
    default:
      return `UNKNOWN(${hex(v)})`;
  }
}

  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findTypeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    if (id === 1) {
      return {
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
      };
    }

    p += s.value;
  }

  throw new Error("TYPE section not found");
}

const TARGET_TYPES = [15, 29];

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(
  buf: Buffer,
  pos: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB128 too large");
    }
  }
}

function findSection(
  wasm: Buffer,
  wantedId: number
): { start: number; end: number } | null {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size;

    if (id === wantedId) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

function readVec(buf: Buffer, pos: number): {
  count: number;
  next: number;
} {
  const r = readULEB(buf, pos);

  return {
    count: r.value,
    next: r.next,
  };
}

  }

const fs = require("fs");

const file =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(file);

const IMPORTED = 83;
const TARGETS = [3317, 6993, 6995];

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// ULEB128
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// WASM value types
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function typeName(b) {
    switch (b) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        case 0x7b: return "v128";
        case 0x70: return "funcref";
        case 0x6f: return "externref";
        case 0x6b: return "exnref";
        default:
            return "0x" + b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find sections
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let pos = 8;

let typeSection = null;
let functionSection = null;

while (pos < buf.length) {

    const sectionId = buf[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadStart = pos;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 1) {
        typeSection = {
            start: payloadStart,
            end: payloadEnd
        };
    }

    if (sectionId === 3) {
        functionSection = {
            start: payloadStart,
            end: payloadEnd
        };
    }

    pos = payloadEnd;
}

if (!typeSection)
    throw new Error("Type section not found");

if (!functionSection)
    throw new Error("Function section not found");

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse type section
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let p = typeSection.start;

const typeCountInfo = readULEB(p);
const typeCount = typeCountInfo.value;
p = typeCountInfo.next;

const types = [];

for (let i = 0; i < typeCount; i++) {

    const form = buf[p++];

    // Standard function type
    if (form !== 0x60) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected type form ${hex(form, 2)} at type ${i}`
        );
    }

    const paramCountInfo = readULEB(p);
    const paramCount = paramCountInfo.value;
    p = paramCountInfo.next;

    const params = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
        params.push(typeName(buf[p++]));
    }

    const resultCountInfo = readULEB(p);
    const resultCount = resultCountInfo.value;
    p = resultCountInfo.next;

    const results = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
        results.push(typeName(buf[p++]));
    }

    types.push({
        index: i,
        params,
        results
    });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse function section
//
// Function section contains type index for each defined body.
// Global function index = IMPORTED + body index
// ------------------------------------------------------------
p = functionSection.start;

const functionCountInfo = readULEB(p);
const functionCount = functionCountInfo.value;
p = functionCountInfo.next;

const functionTypeIndex = new Map();

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < functionCount; bodyIndex++) {

    const typeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const typeIndex = typeInfo.value;
    p = typeInfo.next;

    const funcIndex = IMPORTED + bodyIndex;

    functionTypeIndex.set(funcIndex, typeIndex);
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 114;

function uleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 128))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }

  throw Error("ULEB");
}

function sleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 127) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 128))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 64))
    v |= -1 << s;

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function skipName(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  return n.next + n.value;
}

function sections(b: Buffer): any {
  let p = 8;
  const r: any = {};

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    r[id] = {
      start: p,
      size: s.value
    };

    p += s.value;
  }

  return r;
}

function importedFuncs(b: Buffer, sec: any) {
  let p = sec.start;

  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  let count = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    p = skipName(b, p);
    p = skipName(b, p);

    const kind = b[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      p = uleb(b, p).next;
      count++;
    }
    else if (kind === 1 || kind === 2) {
      const f = uleb(b, p);
      p = f.next;
      p = uleb(b, p).next;

      if (f.value & 1)
        p = uleb(b, p).next;
    }
    else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return count;
}

function getBodies(
  b: Buffer,
  sec: any,
  imported: number
) {
  let p = sec.start;

  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  const out: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    out.push({
      func: imported + i,
      start: p,
      end: p + s.value,
      bytes: b.subarray(p, p + s.value)
    });

    p += s.value;
  }

  return out;
}

type I = {
  off: number;
  op: number;
  imm: number[];
  text: string;
};

function decode(b: Buffer, base: number): I[] {
  const a: I[] = [];

  let p = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const off = base + p;
    const op = b[p++];

    const imm: number[] = [];
    let text = `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`;

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22
    ) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x20
          ? `local.get ${r.value}`
          : op === 0x21
          ? `local.set ${r.value}`
          : `local.tee ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x23
          ? `global.get ${r.value}`
          : `global.set ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `call ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = uleb(b, p);
      p = t.next;

      const tab = uleb(b, p);
      p = tab.next;

      imm.push(t.value, tab.value);

      text =
        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
    }

    else if (
      op >= 0x28 &&
      op <= 0x3e
    ) {
      const al = uleb(b, p);
      p = al.next;

      const of = uleb(b, p);
      p = of.next;

      imm.push(al.value, of.value);

      text = `load offset=${of.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x6a)
      text = "i32.add";

    else if (op === 0x6b)
      text = "i32.sub";

    else if (op === 0x6c)
      text = "i32.mul";

    else if (op === 0x1a)
      text = "drop";

    else if (op === 0x0f)
      text = "return";

    else if (op === 0x0b)
      text = "end";

    else if (op === 0x05)
      text = "else";

    else if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04
    ) {
      if (p < b.length)
        p++;

      text =
        op === 0x02
          ? "block"
          : op === 0x03
          ? "loop"
          : "if";
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d
    ) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x0c
          ? `br ${r.value}`
          : `br_if ${r.value}`;
    }

    a.push({
      off,
      op,
      imm,
      text
    });
  }

  return a;
}

function window(
  a: I[],
  pos: number,
  n = 12
) {
  for (
    let j = Math.max(0, pos - n);
    j <= Math.min(a.length - 1, pos + 2);
    j++
  ) {
    console.log(
      `${j === pos ? " >>>" : "    "} ` +
      `0x${a[j].off.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
      a[j].text
    );
  }
}

export async function run() {
  const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
  const sec = sections(wasm);

  const imported = importedFuncs(
    wasm,
    sec[2]
  );

  const bodies = getBodies(
    wasm,
    sec[10],
    imported
  );

  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );
  console.log(
    " DEEP BACKTRACE INDEX 114"
  );
  console.log(
    " READ ONLY - OFFLINE"
  );
  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );

  console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length}`);
  console.log(`Target    : ${TARGET}`);
  console.log();

  let found = 0;
  let printed = 0;

  for (const body of bodies) {
    let a: I[];

    try {
      a = decode(body.bytes, body.start);
    }
    catch {
      continue;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      const c = a[i];

      if (
        c.op !== 0x11 ||
        c.imm[0] !== 0 ||
        c.imm[1] !== 0
      )
        continue;

      /*
       * We only care about the 66 known local-base
       * patterns:
       *
       * local.get
       * load
       * load
       * call_indirect
       */

      if (i < 3)
        continue;

      const outer = a[i - 1];
      const inner = a[i - 2];
      const base = a[i - 3];

      if (
        outer.op < 0x28 ||
        outer.op > 0x3e ||
        inner.op < 0x28 ||
        inner.op > 0x3e ||
        base.op !== 0x20
      )
        continue;

      const localId = base.imm[0];

      /*
       * Find ALL earlier definitions of this local.
       * We inspect up to 8 definitions, because a local
       * may be reassigned in different branches.
       */

      let defs = 0;

      for (
        let j = i - 4;
        j >= 0 && defs < 8;
        j--
      ) {
        if (
          (a[j].op === 0x21 ||
           a[j].op === 0x22) &&
          a[j].imm[0] === localId
        ) {
          defs++;

          const src = j - 1;

          if (src < 0)
            continue;

          const s = a[src];

          /*
           * Direct 114
           */
          if (
            s.op === 0x41 &&
            s.imm[0] === TARGET
          ) {
            found++;

            console.log(
              `FOUND 114: func=${body.func} ` +
              `local=${localId} ` +
              `def=0x${a[j].off.toString(16)} ` +
              `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
            );

            window(a, j);
            continue;
          }

          /*
           * LOAD source
           */
          if (
            s.op >= 0x28 &&
            s.op <= 0x3e
          ) {
            if (printed < 120) {
              console.log(
                `DEEP LOAD: func=${body.func} ` +
                `local=${localId} ` +
                `load=0x${s.off.toString(16)} ` +
                `offset=${s.imm[1]} ` +
                `def=0x${a[j].off.toString(16)} ` +
                `indirect=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
              );

              window(a, j, 8);
              printed++;
            }

            continue;
          }

          /*
           * CALL source
           */
          if (s.op === 0x10) {
            if (printed < 120) {
              console.log(
                `DEEP CALL: func=${body.func} ` +
                `local=${localId} ` +
                `returns=${s.imm[0]} ` +
                `def=0x${a[j].off.toString(16)} ` +
                `indirect=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
              );

              window(a, j, 8);
              printed++;
            }

            continue;
          }

          /*
           * Another local
           */
          if (s.op === 0x20) {
            if (printed < 120) {
              console.log(
                `DEEP LOCAL: func=${body.func} ` +
                `local=${localId} ` +
                `from=${s.imm[0]} ` +
                `def=0x${a[j].off.toString(16)}`
              );

              window(a, j, 8);
              printed++;
            }

            continue;
          }

          /*
           * Arithmetic / other source
           */
          if (
            s.op === 0x6a ||
            s.op === 0x6b ||
            s.op === 0x6c
          ) {
            if (printed < 120) {
              console.log(
                `DEEP ARITH: func=${body.func} ` +
                `local=${localId} ` +
                `${s.text} ` +
                `def=0x${a[j].off.toString(16)}`
              );

              window(a, j, 8);
              printed++;
            }

            continue;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  console.log();

  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );
  console.log("SUMMARY");
  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );

  console.log(
    `Confirmed CONST(114) : ${found}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Deep traces printed  : ${printed}`
  );

  console.log();
  console.log(
    "NEXT: resolve the deepest LOAD/CALL producer."
  );
}

====================================================================================================
