import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 4154;
const TARGET_SLOT = 114;
const TARGET_TYPE = 0;
const TARGET_TABLE = 0;

type Instr = {
    off: number;
    op: number;
    imm: number[];
    size: number;
    text: string;
};

type Source =
    | { kind: "const"; value: number; origin: string }
    | { kind: "local"; index: number; origin: string }
    | { kind: "call"; func: number; origin: string }
    | { kind: "load"; origin: string }
    | { kind: "unknown"; origin: string };

type Body = {
    func: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    bytes: Buffer;
};

function uleb(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= -1 << shift;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function readVec(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { count: number; next: number } {
    const r = uleb(buf, p);

    return {
        count: r.value,
        next: r.next,
    };
}

function readName(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { name: string; next: number } {
    const n = uleb(buf, p);
    const end = n.next + n.value;

    return {
        name: buf.subarray(n.next, end).toString("utf8"),
        next: end,
    };
}

function parseSections(wasm: Buffer) {
    let p = 8;

    let typeSec:
        | { start: number; size: number }
        | undefined;

    let importSec:
        | { start: number; size: number }
        | undefined;

    let funcSec:
        | { start: number; size: number }
        | undefined;

    let codeSec:
        | { start: number; size: number }
        | undefined;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const s = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const size = s.value;

        if (id === 1) {
            typeSec = { start, size };
        }

        if (id === 2) {
            importSec = { start, size };
        }

        if (id === 3) {
            funcSec = { start, size };
        }

        if (id === 10) {
            codeSec = { start, size };
        }

        p += size;
    }

    return {
        typeSec,
        importSec,
        funcSec,
        codeSec,
    };
}

function parseTypes(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number }
) {
    let p = sec.start;
    const end = p + sec.size;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);
    p = v.next;

    const types: {
        params: number[];
        results: number[];
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < v.count; i++) {
        const form = wasm[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unsupported type form ${form}`
            );
        }

        const pc = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = pc.next;

        const params = Array.from(
            wasm.subarray(p, p + pc.value)
        );

        p += pc.value;

        const rc = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = rc.next;

        const results = Array.from(
            wasm.subarray(p, p + rc.value)
        );

        p += rc.value;

        types.push({
            params,
            results,
        });
    }

    if (p !== end) {
        throw new Error(
            `Type section mismatch ${p} != ${end}`
        );
    }

    return types;
}

function parseImports(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number }
) {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);
    p = v.next;

    let importedFuncs = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < v.count; i++) {
        const mod = readName(wasm, p);
        p = mod.next;

        const name = readName(wasm, p);
        p = name.next;

        const kind = wasm[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;

            importedFuncs++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
            /*
             * table type:
             * elemtype + limits
             */
            p++;

            const flags = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = flags.next;

            const min = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = min.next;

            if (flags.value & 1) {
                const max = uleb(wasm, p);
                p = max.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 2) {
            /*
             * memory
             */
            const flags = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = flags.next;

            const min = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = min.next;

            if (flags.value & 1) {
                const max = uleb(wasm, p);
                p = max.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
            /*
             * global
             */
            p += 2;
        } else {
            throw new Error(
                `Unknown import kind ${kind}`
            );
        }
    }

    return importedFuncs;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number }
) {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);
    p = v.next;

    const result: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < v.count; i++) {
        const r = uleb(wasm, p);

        result.push(r.value);

        p = r.next;
    }

    return result;
}

function parseBodies(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number },
    importedFuncs: number
): Body[] {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);
    p = v.next;

    const bodies: Body[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < v.count; i++) {
        const s = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        bodies.push({
            func: importedFuncs + i,
            start,
            end,
            bytes: wasm.subarray(start, end),
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function decode(
    bytes: Buffer,
    base: number
): Instr[] {
    const out: Instr[] = [];

    let p = 0;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const start = p;
        const off = base + p;
        const op = bytes[p++];

        const imm: number[] = [];
        let text = `op=0x${op
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(2, "0")}`;

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = sleb(bytes, p);
            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x42) {
            const r = sleb(bytes, p);
            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
        } else if (
            op === 0x20 ||
            op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22
        ) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            if (op === 0x20) {
                text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
            } else if (op === 0x21) {
                text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
            } else {
                text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
            }
        } else if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `call ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x11) {
            const a = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = a.next;

            const b = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = b.next;

            imm.push(a.value, b.value);

            text =
                `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text =
                op === 0x23
                    ? `global.get ${r.value}`
                    : `global.set ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x25 || op === 0x26) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text =
                op === 0x25
                    ? `table.get ${r.value}`
                    : `table.set ${r.value}`;
        } else if (
            op >= 0x28 &&
            op <= 0x40
        ) {
            const a = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = a.next;

            const b = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = b.next;

            imm.push(a.value, b.value);

            text =
                `memory op 0x${op
                    .toString(16)
                    .padStart(2, "0")}`;
        } else if (
            op === 0x02 ||
            op === 0x03 ||
            op === 0x04
        ) {
            if (p >= bytes.length) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Missing blocktype"
                );
            }

            const first = bytes[p++];

            if (first !== 0x40 && first < 0x80) {
                let b = first;
                let value = first & 0x7f;
                let shift = 7;

                while (b & 0x80) {
                    if (p >= bytes.length) {
                        throw new Error(
                            "Blocktype overflow"
                        );
                    }

                    b = bytes[p++];

                    value |=
                        (b & 0x7f) << shift;

                    shift += 7;
                }

                imm.push(value);
            } else {
                imm.push(first);
            }

            text =
                op === 0x02
                    ? "block"
                    : op === 0x03
                    ? "loop"
                    : "if";
        } else if (op === 0x05) {
            text = "else";
        } else if (op === 0x0b) {
            text = "end";
        } else if (op === 0x0f) {
            text = "return";
        } else if (
            op === 0x0c ||
            op === 0x0d
        ) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text =
                op === 0x0c
                    ? `br ${r.value}`
                    : `br_if ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x1a) {
            text = "drop";
        } else if (
            op >= 0x45 &&
            op <= 0x4f
        ) {
            text =
                `i32 compare 0x${op
                    .toString(16)}`;
        } else if (
            op >= 0x6a &&
            op <= 0x78
        ) {
            text =
                `i32 arithmetic 0x${op
                    .toString(16)}`;
        } else if (op === 0x0e) {
            const n = uleb(bytes, p);
            p = n.next;

            for (
                let i = 0;
                i < n.value + 1;
                i++
            ) {
                const r = uleb(bytes, p);
                p = r.next;

                imm.push(r.value);
            }

            text = "br_table";
        }

        if (p <= start) {
            throw new Error(
                `Decoder stalled @ 0x${off.toString(16)}`
            );
        }

        out.push({
            off,
            op,
            imm,
            size: p - start,
            text,
        });
    }

    return out;
}

function findPreviousLocalWrite(
    instrs: Instr[],
    from: number,
    local: number
): number {
    for (
        let i = from - 1;
        i >= 0;
        i--
    ) {
        const ins = instrs[i];

        if (
            (ins.op === 0x21 ||
                ins.op === 0x22) &&
            ins.imm[0] === local
        ) {
            return i;
        }
    }

    return -1;
}

function traceLocal(
    instrs: Instr[],
    local: number,
    from: number,
    depth: number,
    visited: Set<string>
): Source {
    if (depth > 20) {
        return {
            kind: "unknown",
            origin: `depth-limit local ${local}`,
        };
    }

    const key = `${local}:${from}:${depth}`;

    if (visited.has(key)) {
        return {
            kind: "unknown",
            origin: `cycle local ${local}`,
        };
    }

    visited.add(key);

    const write = findPreviousLocalWrite(
        instrs,
        from,
        local
    );

    if (write < 0) {
        return {
            kind: "unknown",
            origin: `no-write local ${local}`,
        };
    }

    const ins = instrs[write];

    /*
     * local.set/tee consumes the value immediately
     * before itself.
     *
     * Walk backward from that stack-producing value.
     */
    for (
        let i = write - 1;
        i >= 0 && i >= write - 100;
        i--
    ) {
        const x = instrs[i];

        if (x.op === 0x41) {
            return {
                kind: "const",
                value: x.imm[0],
                origin:
                    `i32.const @ 0x${x.off.toString(16)}`,
            };
        }

        if (x.op === 0x20) {
            return traceLocal(
                instrs,
                x.imm[0],
                i,
                depth + 1,
                visited
            );
        }

        if (x.op === 0x10) {
            return {
                kind: "call",
                func: x.imm[0],
                origin:
                    `call ${x.imm[0]} @ 0x${x.off.toString(16)}`,
            };
        }

        if (
            x.op === 0x28 ||
            x.op === 0x29 ||
            x.op === 0x2a ||
            x.op === 0x2b ||
            x.op === 0x2c ||
            x.op === 0x2d ||
            x.op === 0x2e ||
            x.op === 0x2f
        ) {
            return {
                kind: "load",
                origin:
                    `${x.text} @ 0x${x.off.toString(16)}`,
            };
        }

        /*
         * Stop at another control-flow-producing
         * or indirect-call boundary.
         */
        if (
            x.op === 0x11 ||
            x.op === 0x0f ||
            x.op === 0x0e
        ) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        kind: "unknown",
        origin:
            `unresolved write local ${local}`,
    };
}

export async function run() {
    const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        " DEEP BACKWARD TRACE -> FUNCTION 4154"
    );
    console.log(
        " READ ONLY - OFFLINE"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log();

    console.log(`WASM size       : ${wasm.length}`);
    console.log(`Target function : ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
    console.log(
        `Target slot     : 0x${TARGET_SLOT
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")} = ${TARGET_SLOT}`
    );
    console.log(`Target type     : ${TARGET_TYPE}`);
    console.log(`Target table    : ${TARGET_TABLE}`);
    console.log();

    const sections = parseSections(wasm);

    if (
        !sections.typeSec ||
        !sections.importSec ||
        !sections.funcSec ||
        !sections.codeSec
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            "Required WASM sections missing"
        );
    }

    const types = parseTypes(
        wasm,
        sections.typeSec
    );

    const importedFuncs = parseImports(
        wasm,
        sections.importSec
    );

    const funcTypes = parseFunctionTypes(
        wasm,
        sections.funcSec
    );

    const bodies = parseBodies(
        wasm,
        sections.codeSec,
        importedFuncs
    );

    console.log(`Types          : ${types.length}`);
    console.log(
        `Imported funcs : ${importedFuncs}`
    );
    console.log(
        `Defined funcs  : ${funcTypes.length}`
    );
    console.log(
        `Code bodies    : ${bodies.length}`
    );
    console.log();

    const decoded: {
        body: Body;
        instrs: Instr[];
    }[] = [];

    let decodeErrors = 0;

    for (const body of bodies) {
        try {
            const instrs = decode(
                body.bytes,
                body.start
            );

            decoded.push({
                body,
                instrs,
            });
        } catch {
            decodeErrors++;
        }
    }

    console.log(
        `Decoded bodies : ${decoded.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Decode errors  : ${decodeErrors}`
    );

    console.log();

    let sites = 0;
    let localDependent = 0;
    let exact = 0;
    let loadDependent = 0;
    let callDependent = 0;
    let unresolved = 0;

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        "DEEP BACKWARD RESULTS"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    for (const item of decoded) {
        const instrs = item.instrs;

        for (let i = 0; i < instrs.length; i++) {
            const ci = instrs[i];

            if (
                ci.op !== 0x11 ||
                ci.imm[0] !== TARGET_TYPE ||
                ci.imm[1] !== TARGET_TABLE
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            sites++;

            /*
             * Search the immediately preceding stack producer.
             */
            let source: Source = {
                kind: "unknown",
                origin: "no-source",
            };

            for (
                let j = i - 1;
                j >= 0 && j >= i - 100;
                j--
            ) {
                const x = instrs[j];

                if (x.op === 0x41) {
                    source = {
                        kind: "const",
                        value: x.imm[0],
                        origin:
                            `i32.const @ 0x${x.off.toString(16)}`,
                    };

                    break;
                }

                if (x.op === 0x20) {
                    source = traceLocal(
                        instrs,
                        x.imm[0],
                        j,
                        0,
                        new Set<string>()
                    );

                    break;
                }

                if (x.op === 0x10) {
                    source = {
                        kind: "call",
                        func: x.imm[0],
                        origin:
                            `call ${x.imm[0]} @ 0x${x.off.toString(16)}`,
                    };

                    break;
                }

                if (
                    x.op >= 0x28 &&
                    x.op <= 0x2f
                ) {
                    source = {
                        kind: "load",
                        origin:
                            `${x.text} @ 0x${x.off.toString(16)}`,
                    };

                    break;
                }

                /*
                 * Do not cross another indirect call.
                 */
                if (x.op === 0x11) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (source.kind === "const") {
                if (source.value === TARGET_SLOT) {
                    exact++;

                    console.log();
                    console.log(
                        "************************************************************"
                    );
                    console.log(
                        "*** DEFINITIVE CONST(114) BACKWARD CANDIDATE ***"
                    );
                    console.log(
                        "************************************************************"
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `Caller function : ${item.body.func}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `call_indirect   : 0x${ci.off.toString(16)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `Source          : CONST(${source.value})`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `Origin          : ${source.origin}`
                    );
                }
            } else if (
                source.kind === "local"
            ) {
                localDependent++;
            } else if (
                source.kind === "load"
            ) {
                loadDependent++;
            } else if (
                source.kind === "call"
            ) {
                callDependent++;
            } else {
                unresolved++;
            }
        }
    }

    console.log();
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        "SUMMARY"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    console.log(
        `Decoded bodies          : ${decoded.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Decode errors           : ${decodeErrors}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Type-0/table-0 sites    : ${sites}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Exact CONST(114) paths  : ${exact}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Local-dependent paths   : ${localDependent}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Memory-load paths       : ${loadDependent}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Call-return paths       : ${callDependent}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Unresolved paths        : ${unresolved}`
    );

    console.log();

    if (exact > 0) {
        console.log(
            "TARGET 4154: EXACT CONST(114) BACKWARD PATH FOUND."
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            "TARGET 4154: NO EXACT CONST(114) PATH YET."

        console.log(
            "Local, memory and interprocedural paths remain."
        );
    }

    console.log();

        "============================================================"

        "============================================================"

    console.log(
        "No transaction sent."
    );

    console.log(
        "Read-only / offline."
    );
}

function shortAddress(value: string): string {
    if (value.length <= 32) return value;

    return (
        value.slice(0, 14) +
        '...' +
        value.slice(-12)
    );
}

function getOpcode(body: Cell | null | undefined): string {
    if (!body) return 'NO BODY';

    try {
        const slice = body.beginParse();

        if (slice.remainingBits < 32) {
            return 'LESS THAN 32 BITS';
        }

        const op = slice.loadUint(32);

        return (
            '0x' +
            op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );

    } catch {
        return 'OPCODE ERROR';
    }
}

function opcodeName(op: string): string {

    switch (op.toLowerCase()) {

        case '0x37c096df':
            return 'provide_lp';

        case '0x0f8a7ea5':
            return 'STON.FI / LP message';

        case '0x178d4519':
            return 'Jetton transfer';

        case '0x01f3835d':
            return 'pTON operation';

        case '0x7369676e':
            return 'wallet signed external message';

        default:
            return 'UNKNOWN';
    }
}

function getAddress(
    info: any,
    field: 'src' | 'dest'
): string {

    try {

        const value = info?.[field];

        if (value) {
            return value.toString();
        }

    } catch {
        // ignore
    }

    return 'unknown';
}

function getValue(info: any): bigint {

    try {

        if (
            info?.type === 'internal' &&
            info.value?.coins !== undefined
        ) {
            return BigInt(
                info.value.coins
            );
        }

    } catch {
        // ignore
    }

    return 0n;
}

function printMessage(
    title: string,
    message: any
) {

    if (!message) {
        console.log(
            `${title}: NONE`
        );

        return;
    }

    const info =
        message.info;

    const src =
        getAddress(info, 'src');

    const dst =
        getAddress(info, 'dest');

    const value =
        getValue(info);

    const opcode =
        getOpcode(message.body);

    console.log('');
    console.log(title);
    console.log('----------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        `SOURCE      : ${src}`
    );

    console.log(
        `DESTINATION : ${dst}`
    );

    console.log(
        `VALUE       : ${value.toString()} nanotons`
    );

    console.log(
        `TON         : ${Number(value) / 1e9}`
    );

    console.log(
        `OPCODE      : ${opcode}`
    );

    console.log(
        `MEANING     : ${opcodeName(opcode)}`
    );

    if (message.body) {

        try {

            const boc =
                message.body
                    .toBoc()
                    .toString('base64');

            console.log(
                `BODY BOC    : ${boc}`
            );

        } catch {
            console.log(
                'BODY BOC    : ERROR'
            );
        }
    }
}

async function readAddress(
    label: string,
    addressText: string
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '================================================'
    );

    console.log(label);

    console.log(
        '================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        `ADDRESS: ${addressText}`
    );

    let address: Address;

    try {

        address =
            Address.parse(addressText);

    } catch (error) {

        console.log(
            'INVALID ADDRESS:'
        );

        console.log(
            error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : String(error)
        );

        return;
    }

    try {

        const transactions =
            await client.getTransactions(
                address,
                {
                    limit: 10,
                }
            );

        console.log(
            `TRANSACTIONS: ${transactions.length}`
        );

        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < transactions.length;
            i++
        ) {

            const tx: any =
                transactions[i];

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `TX ${i + 1}`
            );

            console.log(
                `LT: ${tx.lt}`
            );

            if (
                String(tx.lt) !==
                TARGET_LT
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            console.log(
                '*** TARGET TRANSACTION FOUND ***'
            );

            console.log(
                `HASH: ${Buffer.from(
                    tx.hash()
                ).toString('base64')}`
            );

            printMessage(
                'INCOMING MESSAGE',
                tx.inMessage
            );

            if (tx.outMessages) {

                let index = 1;

                for (
                    const msg
                    of tx.outMessages.values()
                ) {

                    printMessage(
                        `OUTGOING MESSAGE ${index}`,
                        msg
                    );

                    index++;
                }
            }
        }

    } catch (error) {

        console.log(
            'READ ERROR:'
        );

        console.log(
            error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : String(error)
        );
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const owner = provider.sender().address;

    if (!owner) {
        throw new Error('Tonkeeper wallet address not available');
    }

    const pton = DEX.v2_2.pTON.create(
        Address.parse(
            'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
        )
    );

    console.log('pTON Master:', pton.address.toString());
    console.log('Owner:', owner.toString());
    console.log('Deploy Wallet: 0.1 TON');

    await pton.sendDeployWallet(
        provider.provider(pton.address),
        provider.sender(),
        {
            ownerAddress: owner,
            excessAddress: owner,
        }
    );

    console.log('Deploy transaction sent.');
}

import { beginCell, toNano } from '@ton/core';
import { RoosterCoin } from '../wrappers/RoosterCoin';
import { compile, NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    // فقط Testnet
    if (provider.network() !== 'testnet') {
        throw new Error('STOP: This script is only for TON Testnet.');
    }

    // Admin = همان کیف پولی که با Tonkeeper به Blueprint متصل شده
    const adminAddress = provider.sender().address;

    if (!adminAddress) {
        throw new Error('STOP: Connected wallet address is not available.');
    }

    console.log('Network:', provider.network());
    console.log('Connected wallet:', adminAddress.toString());
    console.log('Admin address:', adminAddress.toString());

    const content = beginCell()
    .storeUint(2, 32)
    .endCell();

    const jettonWalletCode = await compile('JettonWallet');
    const minterCode = await compile('RoosterCoin');

    const roosterCoin = provider.open(
        RoosterCoin.createFromConfig(
            {
                adminAddress,
                content,
                jettonWalletCode,
            },
            minterCode
        )
    );

    console.log('Rooster Coin address:', roosterCoin.address.toString());

    const alreadyDeployed =
        await provider.isContractDeployed(roosterCoin.address);

    if (alreadyDeployed) {
        console.log('Rooster Coin is already deployed.');
        return;
    }

    console.log('Sending deployment transaction...');
    console.log('IMPORTANT: Approve ONLY if your wallet shows TESTNET.');

    await roosterCoin.sendDeploy(
        provider.sender(),
        toNano('0.1')
    );

    console.log('Transaction sent. Waiting for Testnet confirmation...');

    await provider.waitForDeploy(
        roosterCoin.address,
        60,
        3000
    );

    console.log('Rooster Coin deployed successfully!');
    console.log('Address:', roosterCoin.address.toString());
}

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from "ton-lite-client";

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    "EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval"

// همان LiteServer که قبلاً با موفقیت به آن وصل شدیم
const HOST = "tcp://168.119.95.207:27787";

export async function run() {
    console.log("========================================");

    try {

    }

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';

const ROUTER =
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval';

const SERVER =
    'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088';

const PUBLIC_KEY = Buffer.from(
    'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
    'base64'
);

async function waitForReady(
    engine: LiteSingleEngine,
    timeoutMs = 15000
) {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {

        if (engine.isReady()) {
            resolve();
            return;
        }

        const timer = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error(
                'Timeout waiting for LiteServer ready.'
            ));
        }, timeoutMs);

        engine.once('ready', () => {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            resolve();
        });

        engine.once('error', (err) => {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            reject(err);
        });

        engine.once('close', () => {
            clearTimeout(timer);

            if (!engine.isReady()) {
                reject(new Error(
                    'LiteServer connection closed before ready.'
                ));
            }
        });
    });
}

async function main() {

    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' DIRECT ROUTER GETTER TEST');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('NO WALLET CONNECTION REQUIRED.');
    console.log('');

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host: SERVER,
        publicKey: PUBLIC_KEY,
        client: 'tcp',
    });

    engine.on('connect', () => {
        console.log('[EVENT] Engine connected');
    });

    engine.on('ready', () => {
        console.log('[EVENT] Engine ready');
    });

    engine.on('close', () => {
        console.log('[EVENT] Engine closed');
    });

    engine.on('error', (err: any) => {
        console.log('[EVENT] Engine error:', err);
    });

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine,
        batchSize: 1,
    });

    console.log('===== WAIT FOR CONNECTION =====');

    await waitForReady(engine);

    console.log('');
    console.log('Engine closed:', engine.isClosed());
    console.log('Engine ready:', engine.isReady());

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== MASTERCHAIN =====');

    const master = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

    console.log('Seqno:', master.seqno);
    console.log(
        'Root hash:',
        master.rootHash.toString('hex')
    );
    console.log(
        'File hash:',
        master.fileHash.toString('hex')
    );

    const router = Address.parse(ROUTER);

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== GET ROUTER VERSION =====');

    const version = await client.runMethod(
        router,
        'get_router_version',
        Buffer.alloc(0),
        master
    );

    console.log(JSON.stringify({
        exitCode: version.exitCode,
        result: version.result,
        block: version.block,
    }, null, 2));

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== GET ROUTER DATA =====');

    const data = await client.runMethod(
        router,
        'get_router_data',
        Buffer.alloc(0),
        master
    );

    console.log(JSON.stringify({
        exitCode: data.exitCode,
        result: data.result,
        block: data.block,
    }, null, 2));

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== FINISHED =====');

    engine.close();
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteRoundRobinEngine, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { Functions } from 'ton-lite-client/dist/schema';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

const EXPECTED_CODE_HASH =
    'ca4c3052a1396aef50ca358ac355e2a99be4e1683eb87a2c11fbd452bb4acec5';

const EXPECTED_LIBRARY_HASH =
    '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86';

const METHOD_ID = '128085'; // get_router_data = 0x1F455

function hex(buf: Buffer): string {
    return Buffer.from(buf).toString('hex');
}

async function main() {
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER LIBRARY EXECUTION DIAGNOSTIC');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================');

    const engines = [
        new LiteSingleEngine({
            host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
            publicKey: Buffer.from(
                'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
                'base64'
            ),
        }),
        new LiteSingleEngine({
            host: 'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088',
            publicKey: Buffer.from(
                'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
                'base64'
            ),
        }),
    ];

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine: new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines),
    });

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // 1. MASTERCHAIN
    // ------------------------------------------------
    const master = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

    console.log('\nMASTERCHAIN');
    console.log('seqno:', master.last.seqno);
    console.log('shard:', master.last.shard);
    console.log('workchain:', master.last.workchain);

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // 2. GET ROUTER STATE DIRECTLY
    // ------------------------------------------------
    const stateRequest = {
        kind: 'liteServer.getAccountState' as const,

        id: {
            kind: 'tonNode.blockIdExt' as const,
            seqno: master.last.seqno,
            shard: master.last.shard,
            workchain: master.last.workchain,
            fileHash: master.last.fileHash,
            rootHash: master.last.rootHash,
        },

        account: {
            kind: 'liteServer.accountId' as const,
            workchain: ROUTER.workChain,
            id: Buffer.from(ROUTER.hash),
        },
    };

    const stateResult = await client.engine.query(
        Functions.liteServer_getAccountState,
        stateRequest
    );

    console.log('\nSTATE RESULT');
    console.log('kind:', stateResult.kind);
    console.log('state bytes:', stateResult.state.length);

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // 3. DECODE STATE BOC
    // ------------------------------------------------
    const { Cell } = await import('@ton/core');

    const stateCells = Cell.fromBoc(Buffer.from(stateResult.state));

    if (stateCells.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(`Unexpected state root count: ${stateCells.length}`);
    }

    const stateRoot = stateCells[0];

    console.log('\nSTATE ROOT');
    console.log('type:', stateRoot.type);
    console.log('bits:', stateRoot.bits.length);
    console.log('refs:', stateRoot.refs.length);
    console.log('hash:', stateRoot.hash().toString('hex'));

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // 4. ROUTER CODE REFERENCE
    // ------------------------------------------------
    if (stateRoot.refs.length < 1) {
        throw new Error('Router state has no code reference');
    }

    const codeRef = stateRoot.refs[0];

    console.log('\nROUTER CODE REFERENCE');
    console.log('type:', codeRef.type);
    console.log('bits:', codeRef.bits.length);
    console.log('refs:', codeRef.refs.length);

    const actualCodeHash = codeRef.hash().toString('hex');

    console.log('code cell hash:', actualCodeHash);
    console.log(
        'expected code hash:',
        EXPECTED_CODE_HASH
    );

    console.log(
        'CODE HASH MATCH:',
        actualCodeHash === EXPECTED_CODE_HASH ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    console.log(
        'is exotic:',
        codeRef.isExotic ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // 5. SHOW RAW LIBRARY REFERENCE BOC
    // ------------------------------------------------
    const codeBoc = codeRef.toBoc().toString('base64');

    console.log('\nCODE REFERENCE BOC');
    console.log(codeBoc);

    // The first byte of the exotic library-reference payload
    // is 0x02, followed by the 256-bit library hash.
    //
    // We already verified this exact BOC previously.
    console.log('\nEXPECTED LIBRARY HASH');
    console.log(EXPECTED_LIBRARY_HASH);

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // 6. RUN get_router_data MODE 4
    // ------------------------------------------------
    const runRequest4 = {
        kind: 'liteServer.runSmcMethod' as const,

        mode: 4,

        id: {
            kind: 'tonNode.blockIdExt' as const,
            seqno: master.last.seqno,
            shard: master.last.shard,
            workchain: master.last.workchain,
            fileHash: master.last.fileHash,
            rootHash: master.last.rootHash,
        },

        account: {
            kind: 'liteServer.accountId' as const,
            workchain: ROUTER.workChain,
            id: Buffer.from(ROUTER.hash),
        },

        methodId: METHOD_ID,

        params: Buffer.alloc(0),
    };

    console.log('\n========================================');
    console.log('RUN METHOD');
    console.log('========================================');

    console.log('method:', 'get_router_data');
    console.log('method id:', METHOD_ID);
    console.log('mode:', 4);

    const result4 = await client.engine.query(
        Functions.liteServer_runSmcMethod,
        runRequest4
    );

    console.log('\nMODE 4 RESULT');
    console.dir(result4, { depth: 5 });

    console.log(
        'exit code:',
        result4.exitCode
    );

    if (result4.result) {
        console.log(
            'result bytes:',
            result4.result.length
        );

        console.log(
            'result BOC:',
            Buffer.from(result4.result).toString('base64')
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // 7. RUN get_router_data MODE 20
    // ------------------------------------------------
    const runRequest20 = {
        ...runRequest4,
        mode: 20,
    };

    console.log('\n========================================');
    console.log('RUN METHOD WITH LIB EXTRAS');
    console.log('========================================');

    console.log('mode:', 20);
    console.log('mode bits: 4 + 16');
    console.log('expected: result + lib_extras');

    const result20 = await client.engine.query(
        Functions.liteServer_runSmcMethod,
        runRequest20
    );

    console.log('\nMODE 20 RESULT');
    console.dir(result20, { depth: 5 });

    console.log(
        'exit code:',
        result20.exitCode
    );

    console.log(
        'result bytes:',
        result20.result
            ? result20.result.length
            : 0
    );

    console.log(
        'libExtras bytes:',
        result20.libExtras
            ? result20.libExtras.length
            : 0
    );

    if (result20.result) {
        console.log(
            'result BOC:',
            Buffer.from(result20.result).toString('base64')
        );
    }

    if (result20.libExtras) {
        console.log(
            'libExtras BOC:',
            Buffer.from(result20.libExtras).toString('base64')
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // 8. FINAL DIAGNOSIS
    // ------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n========================================');
    console.log('DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY');
    console.log('========================================');

    console.log(
        'Router code hash correct:',
        actualCodeHash === EXPECTED_CODE_HASH
    );

    console.log(
        'MODE 4 exit code:',
        result4.exitCode
    );

    console.log(
        'MODE 20 exit code:',
        result20.exitCode
    );

    console.log(
        'MODE 20 libExtras:',
        result20.libExtras
            ? result20.libExtras.length
            : 0
    );

    console.log('\nNO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
}

main().catch((error) => {
    console.error('\nFATAL ERROR');
    console.error(error);
    process.exit(1);
});

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function run() {
    console.log("========================================");
    console.log(" ROUTER LITESERVER GETTER DIAGNOSTIC");
    console.log("========================================");
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.");
    console.log("NO WALLET CONNECTION REQUIRED.");

    console.log("Server:", HOST);

        host: HOST,
        publicKey: PUBLIC_KEY,
    });

    console.log("Engine closed:", engine.isClosed());
    console.log("Engine ready:", engine.isReady());

    try {
        console.log("\n===== CONNECT =====");

        await engine.connect();

        console.log("Connect finished.");
        console.log("Engine closed:", engine.isClosed());
        console.log("Engine ready:", engine.isReady());

        // Give ADNL a moment to finish initialization.
        await sleep(1000);

        console.log("\n===== ENGINE STATUS =====");
        console.log("Engine closed:", engine.isClosed());
        console.log("Engine ready:", engine.isReady());

        if (engine.isClosed()) {
            throw new Error(
                "Engine closed immediately after connect()."
            );
        }

        if (!engine.isReady()) {
            throw new Error(
                "Engine did not become ready after connect()."
            );
        }

        const client = new LiteClient({
            engine,
        });

        console.log("\n===== MASTERCHAIN =====");

        const master =
            await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log(
            "Masterchain seqno:",
            master.last.seqno
        );

        console.log(
            "Shard:",
            master.last.shard.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            "Root hash:",
            Buffer.from(
                master.last.rootHash
            ).toString("hex")
        );

        console.log(
            "File hash:",
            Buffer.from(
                master.last.fileHash
            ).toString("hex")
        );

        console.log("\n===== RUN get_router_data =====");

        const result = await client.runMethod(
            ROUTER,
            "get_router_data",
            Buffer.alloc(0),
            master.last
        );

        console.log("\n===== RESULT =====");

        console.dir(result, {
            depth: 20,
        });

    } catch (e: any) {
        console.log("\n===== ERROR =====");

        console.log(
            "Message:",
            e?.message ?? e
        );

        console.log("\nError object:");

        console.dir(e, {
            depth: 20,
        });

        if (e?.stack) {
            console.log("\nSTACK TRACE:");
            console.log(e.stack);
        }

    } finally {
        console.log("\n===== CLOSE ENGINE =====");

        try {
            engine.close();
            console.log("Engine closed.");
        } catch (e) {
            console.log(
                "Close error:",
                e
            );
        }
    }

    console.log("\n========================================");
    console.log("DIAGNOSTIC FINISHED");
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION");
    console.log("========================================");
}

run().catch((e) => {

export async function run() {
    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    const roosterMasterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'

    const ptonMasterAddress = Address.parse(
        'kQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT-Px'
    );

    const router = client.open(
        DEX.v2_1.Router.CPI.create(routerAddress)
    );

    const roosterMaster = client.open(
        JettonMaster.create(roosterMasterAddress)
    );

    const ptonMaster = client.open(
        JettonMaster.create(ptonMasterAddress)
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== TESTNET POOL DIAGNOSTIC =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Router:');
    console.log(routerAddress.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER Master:');
    console.log(roosterMasterAddress.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON Master:');
    console.log(ptonMasterAddress.toString());

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Get Router Jetton Wallets
    // --------------------------------------------------

    let roosterRouterWallet: Address;
    let ptonRouterWallet: Address;

    try {
        roosterRouterWallet =
            await roosterMaster.getWalletAddress(routerAddress);

        console.log('');
        console.log('ROOSTER Router Wallet:');
        console.log(roosterRouterWallet.toString());
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('ROOSTER Router Wallet ERROR:');
        console.log(String(error));
        return;
    }

    try {
        ptonRouterWallet =
            await ptonMaster.getWalletAddress(routerAddress);

        console.log('');
        console.log('pTON Router Wallet:');
        console.log(ptonRouterWallet.toString());
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('pTON Router Wallet ERROR:');
        console.log(String(error));
        return;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 2. Ask Router for Pool Address
    // --------------------------------------------------

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== ROUTER get_pool_address =====');

    try {
        const poolAddress = await router.getPoolAddress({
            token0: roosterRouterWallet,
            token1: ptonRouterWallet,
        });

        console.log('');
        console.log('SUCCESS');
        console.log('Pool Address:');
        console.log(poolAddress.toString());
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('FAILED');
        console.log(String(error));
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Reverse token order
    // --------------------------------------------------

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== REVERSE TOKEN ORDER =====');

    try {
        const poolAddressReverse = await router.getPoolAddress({
            token0: ptonRouterWallet,
            token1: roosterRouterWallet,
        });

        console.log('');
        console.log('SUCCESS');

    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');

        console.log(String(error));
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('================================');
}

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

const HASH = Buffer.from(
    '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86',
    'hex'
);

const servers = [
    {
        name: 'SERVER 1',
        host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
        key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
    },
    {
        name: 'SERVER 2',
        host: 'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088',
        key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
    },
];

async function main() {
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' DIRECT LIBRARY QUERY');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('READ ONLY');
    console.log('HASH:', HASH.toString('hex'));
    console.log('');

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const router = Address.parse(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    const roosterWallet = Address.parse(
        'EQAmO8BvKx4ta9jkCCDx197VqrUrsaC42Dv6yhDAyKzFpi2S'
    );

    const ptonMaster = Address.parse(
        'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
    );

    console.log('===== DIRECT get_pool_address =====');
    console.log('Router:', router.toString());
    console.log('ROOSTER router wallet:', roosterWallet.toString());
    console.log('pTON master:', ptonMaster.toString());

    const routerProvider = provider.provider(router);

    const ptonWalletResult = await provider.provider(ptonMaster).get(
        'get_wallet_address',
        [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(router)
                    .endCell()
            }
        ]
    );

    const ptonRouterWallet = ptonWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log(
        'pTON router wallet:',
        ptonRouterWallet.toString()
    );

    try {
        const result = await routerProvider.get(
            'get_pool_address',
            [
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: beginCell()
                        .storeAddress(roosterWallet)
                        .endCell()
                },
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: beginCell()
                        .storeAddress(ptonRouterWallet)
                        .endCell()
                }
            ]
        );

        console.log('POOL:', result.stack.readAddress().toString());
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('GET_POOL_ADDRESS ERROR:', e);
    }
}

import fs from 'node:fs';

const file =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos, limit = wasm.length) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= limit) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading ULEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }

        const byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid ULEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }
    }
}

function sleb(pos, bits = 32, limit = wasm.length) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= limit) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading SLEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }

        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

        if (shift > bits + 7) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid SLEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }
    }

    if (shift < 53 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        value -= 2 ** shift;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function slebBigInt(pos, bits = 64, limit = wasm.length) {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= limit) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading SLEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }

        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

        if (shift > BigInt(bits + 7)) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid SLEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }
    }

    if ((byte & 0x40) !== 0) {
        value -= 1n << shift;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function signedHex(n) {
    return n < 0
        ? `-0x${(-n).toString(16)}`
        : `0x${n.toString(16)}`;
}

function needBytes(p, n, end, context) {
    if (p + n > end) {
        throw new Error(
            `Truncated ${context} at ${hex(p)}; need ${n} byte(s)`
        );
    }
}

function readU(p, end, context = 'ULEB') {
    const result = uleb(p, end);
    return { value: result.value, next: result.next, text: String(result.value) };
}

function readS(p, end, context = 'SLEB') {
    const result = sleb(p, 32, end);
    return { value: result.value, next: result.next, text: String(result.value) };
}

function readMemArg(p, end) {
    const align = readU(p, end, 'memarg align');
    const offset = readU(align.next, end, 'memarg offset');

    return {
        next: offset.next,
        text: `align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`,
    };
}

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];
    const size = uleb(pos);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (end > wasm.length) {
        throw new Error('Invalid WASM section size');
    }

    if (id === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error('Code section not found');
}

const count = uleb(codeStart, codeEnd);
pos = count.next;

const bodies = new Map();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const size = uleb(pos, codeEnd);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (end > codeEnd) {
        throw new Error(`Function body ${ordinal} exceeds code section`);
    }

    bodies.set(83 + ordinal, { start, end });
    pos = end;
}

function readBytes(start, end) {
    return [...wasm.subarray(start, end)]
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join(' ');
}

function decodeFunction(func) {
    const body = bodies.get(func);

    if (!body) {
        throw new Error(`Function ${func} not found`);
    }

    let p = body.start;

    const localGroups = uleb(p, body.end);
    p = localGroups.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(p, body.end);
        p = n.next;

        needBytes(p, 1, body.end, 'local type');
        p++;
    }

    const instructions = [];

    while (p < body.end) {
        const start = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text = names[op];

        if (!text && op !== 0xfc) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unknown opcode 0x${op.toString(16)} in function ${func} at ${hex(start)}`
            );
        }

        if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
            needBytes(p, 1, body.end, 'block type');
            const blockType = wasm[p++];

            text += blockType === 0x40
                ? ' void'
                : ` blocktype=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`;
        } else if (
            op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d ||
            op === 0x10 ||
            op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22 || op === 0x23 || op === 0x24
        ) {
            const imm = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = imm.next;
            text += ` ${imm.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x0e) {
            const count = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = count.next;

            const labels = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
                const label = uleb(p, body.end);
                p = label.next;
                labels.push(label.value);
            }

            const fallback = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = fallback.next;

            text += ` labels=[${labels.join(',')}] default=${fallback.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x11) {
            const typeIndex = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = typeIndex.next;

            const tableIndex = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = tableIndex.next;

            text += ` type=${typeIndex.value} table=${tableIndex.value}`;
        } else if (memoryOps.has(op)) {
            const memarg = readMemArg(p, body.end);
            p = memarg.next;
            text += ` ${memarg.text}`;
        } else if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
            const mem = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = mem.next;
            text += ` memory=${mem.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x41) {
            const imm = sleb(p, 32, body.end);
            p = imm.next;
            text += ` ${imm.value} (${signedHex(imm.value)})`;
        } else if (op === 0x42) {
            const imm = slebBigInt(p, 64, body.end);
            p = imm.next;

            const valueHex = imm.value < 0n
                ? `-0x${(-imm.value).toString(16)}`
                : `0x${imm.value.toString(16)}`;

            text += ` ${imm.value.toString()} (${valueHex})`;
        } else if (op === 0x43) {
            needBytes(p, 4, body.end, 'f32.const');
            text += ` bytes=${readBytes(p, p + 4)}`;
            p += 4;
        } else if (op === 0x44) {
            needBytes(p, 8, body.end, 'f64.const');
            text += ` bytes=${readBytes(p, p + 8)}`;
            p += 8;
        } else if (op === 0xfc) {
            const sub = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = sub.next;

            const name = fcNames[sub.value];

            if (!name) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unknown 0xfc subopcode ${sub.value} in function ${func} at ${hex(start)}`
                );
            }

            text = `0xfc.${sub.value} ${name}`;

            const imm1 = () => {
                const v = uleb(p, body.end);
                p = v.next;
                return v.value;
            };

            if (sub.value === 8) {
                const dataIndex = imm1();
                const memoryIndex = imm1();
                text += ` data=${dataIndex} memory=${memoryIndex}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 9) {
                text += ` data=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 10) {
                const dstMemory = imm1();
                const srcMemory = imm1();
                text += ` dst_memory=${dstMemory} src_memory=${srcMemory}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 11) {
                text += ` memory=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 12) {
                const elemIndex = imm1();
                const tableIndex = imm1();
                text += ` elem=${elemIndex} table=${tableIndex}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 13) {
                text += ` elem=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 14) {
                const dstTable = imm1();
                const srcTable = imm1();
                text += ` dst_table=${dstTable} src_table=${srcTable}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 15) {
                text += ` table=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 16) {
                text += ` table=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 17) {
                text += ` table=${imm1()}`;
            }
        }

        if (p > body.end) {
            throw new Error(
                `Instruction overran function ${func} at ${hex(start)}`
            );
        }

        instructions.push({
            start,
            end: p,
            text,
            raw: readBytes(start, p),
        });

        if (op === 0x0b && p === body.end) break;
    }

    return { body, instructions };
}

import fs from 'node:fs';

const file =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos, limit = wasm.length) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= limit) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading ULEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }

        const byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid ULEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }
    }
}

function sleb(pos, bits = 32, limit = wasm.length) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= limit) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading SLEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }

        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

        if (shift > bits + 7) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid SLEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }
    }

    if (shift < 53 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        value -= 2 ** shift;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function slebBigInt(pos, bits = 64, limit = wasm.length) {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= limit) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF reading SLEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }

        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

        if (shift > BigInt(bits + 7)) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid SLEB at ${hex(pos)}`);
        }
    }

    if ((byte & 0x40) !== 0) {
        value -= 1n << shift;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function signedHex(n) {
    return n < 0
        ? `-0x${(-n).toString(16)}`
        : `0x${n.toString(16)}`;
}

function needBytes(p, n, end, context) {
    if (p + n > end) {
        throw new Error(
            `Truncated ${context} at ${hex(p)}; need ${n} byte(s)`
        );
    }
}

function readU(p, end, context = 'ULEB') {
    const result = uleb(p, end);
    return { value: result.value, next: result.next, text: String(result.value) };
}

function readS(p, end, context = 'SLEB') {
    const result = sleb(p, 32, end);
    return { value: result.value, next: result.next, text: String(result.value) };
}

function readMemArg(p, end) {
    const align = readU(p, end, 'memarg align');
    const offset = readU(align.next, end, 'memarg offset');

    return {
        next: offset.next,
        text: `align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`,
    };
}

let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];
    const size = uleb(pos);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (end > wasm.length) {
        throw new Error('Invalid WASM section size');
    }

    if (id === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error('Code section not found');
}

pos = count.next;

const bodies = new Map();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const size = uleb(pos, codeEnd);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (end > codeEnd) {
        throw new Error(`Function body ${ordinal} exceeds code section`);
    }

    bodies.set(83 + ordinal, { start, end });
    pos = end;
}

function decodeFunction(func) {
    const body = bodies.get(func);

    if (!body) {
        throw new Error(`Function ${func} not found`);
    }

    let p = body.start;

    const localGroups = uleb(p, body.end);
    p = localGroups.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(p, body.end);
        p = n.next;

        needBytes(p, 1, body.end, 'local type');
        p++;
    }

    const instructions = [];

    while (p < body.end) {
        const start = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text = names[op];

        if (!text && op !== 0xfc) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unknown opcode 0x${op.toString(16)} in function ${func} at ${hex(start)}`
            );
        }

        if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
            needBytes(p, 1, body.end, 'block type');
            const blockType = wasm[p++];

            text += blockType === 0x40
                ? ' void'
                : ` blocktype=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`;
        } else if (
            op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d ||
            op === 0x10 ||
            op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22 || op === 0x23 || op === 0x24
        ) {
            const imm = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = imm.next;
            text += ` ${imm.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x0e) {
            const count = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = count.next;

            const labels = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
                const label = uleb(p, body.end);
                p = label.next;
                labels.push(label.value);
            }

            const fallback = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = fallback.next;

            text += ` labels=[${labels.join(',')}] default=${fallback.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x11) {
            const typeIndex = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = typeIndex.next;

            const tableIndex = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = tableIndex.next;

            text += ` type=${typeIndex.value} table=${tableIndex.value}`;
        } else if (memoryOps.has(op)) {
            const memarg = readMemArg(p, body.end);
            p = memarg.next;
            text += ` ${memarg.text}`;
        } else if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
            const mem = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = mem.next;
            text += ` memory=${mem.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x41) {
            const imm = sleb(p, 32, body.end);
            p = imm.next;
            text += ` ${imm.value} (${signedHex(imm.value)})`;
        } else if (op === 0x42) {
            const imm = slebBigInt(p, 64, body.end);
            p = imm.next;

            const valueHex = imm.value < 0n
                ? `-0x${(-imm.value).toString(16)}`
                : `0x${imm.value.toString(16)}`;

            text += ` ${imm.value.toString()} (${valueHex})`;
        } else if (op === 0x43) {
            needBytes(p, 4, body.end, 'f32.const');
            text += ` bytes=${readBytes(p, p + 4)}`;
            p += 4;
        } else if (op === 0x44) {
            needBytes(p, 8, body.end, 'f64.const');
            text += ` bytes=${readBytes(p, p + 8)}`;
            p += 8;
        } else if (op === 0xfc) {
            const sub = uleb(p, body.end);
            p = sub.next;

            const name = fcNames[sub.value];

            if (!name) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unknown 0xfc subopcode ${sub.value} in function ${func} at ${hex(start)}`
                );
            }

            text = `0xfc.${sub.value} ${name}`;

            const imm1 = () => {
                const v = uleb(p, body.end);
                p = v.next;
                return v.value;
            };

            if (sub.value === 8) {
                const dataIndex = imm1();
                const memoryIndex = imm1();
                text += ` data=${dataIndex} memory=${memoryIndex}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 9) {
                text += ` data=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 10) {
                const dstMemory = imm1();
                const srcMemory = imm1();
                text += ` dst_memory=${dstMemory} src_memory=${srcMemory}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 11) {
                text += ` memory=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 12) {
                const elemIndex = imm1();
                const tableIndex = imm1();
                text += ` elem=${elemIndex} table=${tableIndex}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 13) {
                text += ` elem=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 14) {
                const dstTable = imm1();
                const srcTable = imm1();
                text += ` dst_table=${dstTable} src_table=${srcTable}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 15) {
                text += ` table=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 16) {
                text += ` table=${imm1()}`;
            } else if (sub.value === 17) {
                text += ` table=${imm1()}`;
            }
        }

        if (p > body.end) {
            throw new Error(
                `Instruction overran function ${func} at ${hex(start)}`
            );
        }

        instructions.push({
            start,
            end: p,
            text,
            raw: readBytes(start, p),
        });

        if (op === 0x0b && p === body.end) break;
    }

    return { body, instructions };
}

console.log('READ ONLY - OFFLINE - NO WASM EXECUTION');

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const wasmPath = path.resolve('emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm');
const targets = [1001, 709, 4097];

function extractFunction(lines, target) {
    const marker = new RegExp(
        '^\\s*\\(func\\s+\\(;\\s*' + target + '\\s*;\\)'
    );

    const start = lines.findIndex(line => marker.test(line));

    if (start < 0) {
        return null;
    }

    let end = start + 1;

    while (end < lines.length) {
        if (/^  \((func|table|memory|global|export|start|elem|data|type|import|tag)\b/.test(lines[end])) {
            break;
        }
        end++;
    }

    return lines.slice(start, end).join('\n');
}

async function main() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(wasmPath)) {
        throw new Error(`WASM file not found: ${wasmPath}`);
    }

    const wabtFactory = require('wabt');
    const wabt = await wabtFactory();
    const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

    const module = wabt.readWasm(bytes, {
    readDebugNames: true,
    features: {
        threads: true,
        bulk_memory: true,
        exceptions: true,
        simd: true,
        multi_value: true,
        reference_types: true,
        tail_call: true,
        extended_const: true,
        memory64: true
    }
});

    module.generateNames();
    module.applyNames();

    const wat = module.toText({
        foldExprs: false,
        inlineExport: false
    });

    const lines = wat.split(/\r?\n/);

    console.log('WASM TARGET DISASSEMBLER');
    console.log('READ ONLY - OFFLINE');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(`WASM bytes : ${bytes.length}`);
    console.log(`WAT lines  : ${lines.length}`);
    console.log(`Targets    : ${targets.join(', ')}`);

    for (const target of targets) {
        console.log('\n\n================================================');
        console.log(`FUNCTION ${target}`);
        console.log('================================================');

        const result = extractFunction(lines, target);

        if (result === null) {
            console.log('Function marker not found in WAT output.');
            console.log('Nearby function declarations:');

            const candidates = lines.filter(
                line => /^\s*\(func\b/.test(line)
            );

            console.log(candidates.slice(0, 5).join('\n'));
            continue;
        }

        console.log(result);
    }

    module.destroy();
}

main().catch(error => {
    console.error('ERROR:', error.message);
    process.exitCode = 1;
});
