import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [0x195350, 0x195354];

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
        s += 7;
    }
    return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        s += 7;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    }

    if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        v |= ~0 << s;
    }

    return { value: v | 0, next: pos };
}

let p = 8;
let dataStart = 0;
let dataEnd = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const sz = uleb(p);
    p = sz.next;

    if (id === 11) {
        dataStart = p;
        dataEnd = p + sz.value;
        break;
    }

    p += sz.value;
}

if (!dataStart) {
    throw new Error("DATA SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

p = dataStart;

const count = uleb(p);
p = count.next;

console.log("EXTRACT 0x195350 / 0x195354");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`DATA SEGMENTS = ${count.value}`);
console.log("");

let found = 0;

for (let seg = 0; seg < count.value; seg++) {

    const flags = uleb(p);
    p = flags.next;

    if (flags.value !== 0 && flags.value !== 2) {
        if (flags.value === 1) {
            const n = uleb(p);
            p = n.next + n.value;
        } else {
            if (flags.value === 3) {
                const mi = uleb(p);
                p = mi.next;
            }
        }
        continue;
    }

    if (flags.value === 2) {
        const mi = uleb(p);
        p = mi.next;
    }

    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op !== 0x41) {
        throw new Error(`Unexpected offset opcode: 0x${op.toString(16)}`);
    }

    const off = sleb(p);
    p = off.next;

    const end = wasm[p++];

    if (end !== 0x0b) {
        throw new Error("Offset expression missing END");
    }

    const offset = off.value >>> 0;

    const sizeInfo = uleb(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const payload = p;
    const size = sizeInfo.value;

    for (const target of TARGETS) {

        const rel = target - offset;

        if (rel >= 0 && rel + 4 <= size) {

            const a = payload + rel;

            const bytes = [
                wasm[a],
                wasm[a + 1],
                wasm[a + 2],
                wasm[a + 3]
            ];

            const value =
                (bytes[0] |
                (bytes[1] << 8) |
                (bytes[2] << 16) |
                (bytes[3] << 24)) >>> 0;

            console.log(`SEGMENT       = ${seg}`);
            console.log(`SEGMENT OFFSET= 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
            console.log(`SEGMENT SIZE  = ${size}`);
            console.log(`TARGET        = 0x${target.toString(16)}`);
            console.log(`RELATIVE      = 0x${rel.toString(16)}`);
            console.log(
                `BYTES         = ${bytes.map(
                    x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
                ).join(" ")}`
            );
            console.log(`VALUE         = ${value}`);
            console.log(`VALUE HEX     = 0x${value.toString(16)}`);
            console.log("");

            found++;
        }

    p = payload + size;

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { Cell } from '@ton/core';

const buildDir =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\stonfi-dex-core-v2\\build';

const targets = [
    'Router.compiled.json',
    'Pool.compiled.json',
    'LPAccount.compiled.json',
    'LPWallet.compiled.json',
    'Vault.compiled.json',
    'PoolDummy.compiled.json',
];

const targetLibraryHash =
    '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80e9182c86';

function walk(value: any, pathName = 'root'): void {
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
        const s = value.trim();

        // BOC-looking Base64
        if (s.startsWith('te6')) {
            try {
                const cells = Cell.fromBoc(Buffer.from(s, 'base64'));

                for (const cell of cells) {
                    inspectCell(cell, pathName);
                }
            } catch {
                // Ignore unrelated strings
            }
        }

        // Direct hex-looking 32-byte hash
        if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(s)) {
            if (s.toLowerCase() === targetLibraryHash) {
                console.log(
                    `FOUND TARGET HASH at ${pathName}: ${s}`
                );
            }
        }

        return;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        value.forEach((item, i) =>
            walk(item, `${pathName}[${i}]`)
        );
        return;
    }

    if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
        for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
            walk(child, `${pathName}.${key}`);
        }
    }
}

function inspectCell(cell: Cell, pathName: string): void {
    console.log('');
    console.log('CELL:', pathName);
    console.log('Bits:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', cell.refs.length);
    console.log('Exotic:', cell.isExotic);
    console.log('Hash:', cell.hash().toString('hex'));

    if (cell.isExotic) {
        try {
            const slice = cell.beginParse(true);
            const type = slice.loadUint(8);

            console.log('Exotic type:', type);

            if (type === 2 && slice.remainingBits >= 256) {
                const libraryHash = slice
                    .loadBuffer(32)
                    .toString('hex');

                console.log(
                    'Library reference:',
                    libraryHash
                );

                if (
                    libraryHash.toLowerCase() ===
                    targetLibraryHash
                ) {
                    console.log(
                        '>>> TARGET ON-CHAIN LIBRARY HASH FOUND <<<'
                    );
                }
            }
        } catch {
            console.log('Could not parse exotic cell.');
        }
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
        inspectCell(
            cell.refs[i],
            `${pathName}.ref[${i}]`
        );
    }
}

console.log('===== STONFI ARTIFACT HASH EXTRACTION =====');
console.log('');

for (const file of targets) {
    const fullPath = path.join(buildDir, file);

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('FILE:', file);
    console.log('========================================');

    if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
        console.log('FILE NOT FOUND');
        continue;
    }

    try {
        const json = JSON.parse(
            fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8')
        );

        walk(json, file);
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('ERROR:', error);
    }
}

console.log('');
console.log('========================================');
console.log('TARGET LIBRARY');
console.log('========================================');
console.log(targetLibraryHash);
console.log('');
console.log('===== DONE =====');

FILE: scripts\extractCall205ArgsV2.ts

import * as fs from "fs";
import * as path from "path";

const WASM = path.resolve(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const TARGET_FUNC = 2094;
const TARGET_CALL = 205;

const CALL_SITES = [
  0x969de,
  0x96aa1,
  0x96aad,
  0x96ab4,
];

type Val = {
  id: number;
  expr: string;
};

type FuncType = {
  params: number[];
  results: number[];
};

type Instr = {
  pc: number;
  op: number;
  name: string;
  args?: number[];
};

function readULEB(
  b: Buffer,
  p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    result += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(
  b: Buffer,
  p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = b[p++];
    result += (byte & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(byte & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    result -= 2 ** shift;
  }

  return { value: result, next: p };
}

function readSLEB64(
  b: Buffer,
  p: number
): { value: bigint; next: number } {
  let result = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = b[p++];

    result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7n;

    if (!(byte & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
    result -= 1n << shift;
  }

  return { value: result, next: p };
}

function readVecValTypes(
  b: Buffer,
  p: number
): { values: number[]; next: number } {
  const n = readULEB(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  const values: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    values.push(b[p++]);
  }

  return { values, next: p };
}

function parseTypes(
  wasm: Buffer,
  sectionStart: number,
  sectionEnd: number
): FuncType[] {
  let p = sectionStart;

  const count = readULEB(wasm, p);
  p = count.next;

  const types: FuncType[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const form = wasm[p++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      throw new Error(
        `Unexpected function type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at ${p - 1}`
      );
    }

    const params = readVecValTypes(wasm, p);
    p = params.next;

    const results = readVecValTypes(wasm, p);
    p = results.next;

    types.push({
      params: params.values,
      results: results.values,
    });
  }

  if (p !== sectionEnd) {
    console.log(
      `WARNING: type parser ended at 0x${p.toString(16)}, expected 0x${sectionEnd.toString(16)}`
    );
  }

  return types;
}

function parseImports(
  wasm: Buffer,
  sectionStart: number,
  sectionEnd: number
): number {
  let p = sectionStart;

  const count = readULEB(wasm, p);
  p = count.next;

  let importedFunctions = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const moduleLen = readULEB(wasm, p);
    p = moduleLen.next + moduleLen.value;

    const nameLen = readULEB(wasm, p);
    p = nameLen.next + nameLen.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0x00) {
      const type = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = type.next;
      importedFunctions++;
    } else if (kind === 0x01) {
      p += 1;

      const elemType = wasm[p++];

      if (elemType === 0x70 || elemType === 0x6f) {
        const flags = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = flags.next;

        const min = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = min.next;

        if (flags.value & 1) {
          const max = readULEB(wasm, p);
          p = max.next;
        }
      }
    } else if (kind === 0x02) {
      const flags = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = flags.next;

      const min = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 0x03) {
      p += 2;
    } else {
      throw new Error(
        `Unknown import kind 0x${kind.toString(16)} at 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`
      );
    }
  }

  if (p !== sectionEnd) {
    console.log(
      `WARNING: import parser ended at 0x${p.toString(16)}, expected 0x${sectionEnd.toString(16)}`
    );
  }

  return importedFunctions;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(
  wasm: Buffer,
  sectionStart: number,
  sectionEnd: number
): number[] {
  let p = sectionStart;

  const count = readULEB(wasm, p);
  p = count.next;

  const types: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const t = readULEB(wasm, p);
    p = t.next;
    types.push(t.value);
  }

  if (p !== sectionEnd) {
    console.log(
      `WARNING: function section parser ended at 0x${p.toString(16)}, expected 0x${sectionEnd.toString(16)}`
    );
  }

  return types;
}

function getSections(wasm: Buffer) {
  let p = 8;

  const sections = new Map<
    number,
    { payloadStart: number; payloadEnd: number }
  >();

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const size = readULEB(wasm, p);
    p = size.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + size.value;

    sections.set(id, {
      payloadStart,
      payloadEnd,
    });

    p = payloadEnd;
  }

  return sections;
}

function decodeFunction(
  wasm: Buffer,
  bodyStart: number,
  bodyEnd: number
): Instr[] {
  let p = bodyStart;

  const localDeclCount = readULEB(wasm, p);
  p = localDeclCount.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount.value; i++) {
    const n = readULEB(wasm, p);
    p = n.next;

    p += 1;
  }

  const instrs: Instr[] = [];

  while (p < bodyEnd) {
    const pc = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op === 0x0b) {
      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "end",
      });

      if (p === bodyEnd) break;

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = x.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "local.get",
        args: [x.value],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = x.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "local.set",
        args: [x.value],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = x.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "local.tee",
        args: [x.value],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = readSLEB(wasm, p);
      p = x.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "i32.const",
        args: [x.value],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
      const x = readSLEB64(wasm, p);
      p = x.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "i64.const",
        args: [Number(x.value)],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = x.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "call",
        args: [x.value],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      const bt = wasm[p++];

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name:
          op === 0x02
            ? "block"
            : op === 0x03
            ? "loop"
            : "if",
        args: [bt],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x05) {
      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "else",
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const x = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = x.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if",
        args: [x.value],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (
      op === 0x6a ||
      op === 0x6b ||
      op === 0x6c ||
      op === 0x6d ||
      op === 0x6e ||
      op === 0x74 ||
      op === 0x7c ||
      op === 0x7d ||
      op === 0x7e ||
      op === 0x7f ||
      op === 0x83 ||
      op === 0x88
    ) {
      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: `op_0x${op.toString(16)}`,
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x29 || op === 0x31) {
      const align = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = offset.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: op === 0x29 ? "i64.load" : "i64.load8_u",
        args: [offset.value],
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x37) {
      const align = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(wasm, p);
      p = offset.next;

      instrs.push({
        pc,
        op,
        name: "i64.store",
        args: [offset.value],
      });

      continue;
    }

    // Unknown opcode: preserve it but do not guess its immediates.
    instrs.push({
      pc,
      op,
      name: `UNKNOWN_0x${op.toString(16)}`,
    });
  }

  return instrs;
}

function val(expr: string, id: number): Val {
  return { id, expr };
}

function localExpr(
  local: number,
  locals: Map<number, Val>
): string {
  const x = locals.get(local);

  if (x) return x.expr;

  return `L${local}`;
}

function simplify(expr: string): string {
  return expr
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\+\s+0\b/g, "")
    .replace(/\(\s*/g, "(")
    .replace(/\s*\)/g, ")")
    .trim();
}

function symbolicTrace(
  instrs: Instr[],
  callPc: number,
  funcTypes: FuncType[],
  functionTypes: number[],
  importedFunctions: number
): Val[] {
  const stack: Val[] = [];
  const locals = new Map<number, Val>();

  let nextId = 1;

  const fresh = (expr: string) =>
    val(simplify(expr), nextId++);

  function pop(n: number): Val[] {
    const out: Val[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if (stack.length === 0) {
        out.unshift(fresh(`STACK_UNDERFLOW_${i}`));
      } else {
        out.unshift(stack.pop()!);
      }
    }

    return out;
  }

  function push(expr: string) {
    stack.push(fresh(expr));
  }

  for (const ins of instrs) {
    if (ins.pc >= callPc) break;

    switch (ins.name) {
      case "local.get": {
        const n = ins.args![0];
        stack.push(fresh(localExpr(n, locals)));
        break;
      }

      case "local.set": {
        const n = ins.args![0];
        const x = pop(1)[0];
        locals.set(n, x);
        break;
      }

      case "local.tee": {
        const n = ins.args![0];
        const x = pop(1)[0];
        locals.set(n, x);
        stack.push(x);
        break;
      }

      case "i32.const": {
        push(String(ins.args![0]));
        break;
      }

      case "i64.const": {
        push(String(ins.args![0]));
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x6a": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}+${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x6b": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}-${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x6c": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}*${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x74": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}<<${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x7c": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}+${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x7d": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}-${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x7e": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}*${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x7f": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}<<${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x83": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}&${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "op_0x88": {
        const [a, b] = pop(2);
        push(`(${a.expr}==${b.expr})`);
        break;
      }

      case "i64.load": {
        const [addr] = pop(1);
        const off = ins.args![0];

        push(`MEM64[${addr.expr}${off ? `+${off}` : ""}]`);
        break;
      }

      case "i64.load8_u": {
        const [addr] = pop(1);
        const off = ins.args![0];

        push(`MEM8[${addr.expr}${off ? `+${off}` : ""}]`);
        break;
      }

      case "i64.store": {
        const [addr, value] = pop(2);
        void addr;
        void value;
        break;
      }

      case "call": {
        const target = ins.args![0];

        if (target >= importedFunctions) {
          const typeIndex =
            functionTypes[target - importedFunctions];

          const ft = funcTypes[typeIndex];

          if (!ft) {
            throw new Error(
              `Missing type for function ${target}, type index ${typeIndex}`
            );
          }

          const args = pop(ft.params.length);

          for (let i = 0; i < ft.results.length; i++) {
            push(`RET${target}[${i}]`);
          }
        } else {
          // Imported call: type information may still be available.
          const typeIndex = -1;

          if (typeIndex === -1) {
            // We intentionally do not guess imported signatures.
            stack.length = 0;
          }
        }

        break;
      }

      case "br_if": {
        pop(1);
        break;
      }

      case "br":
      case "block":
      case "loop":
      case "if":
      case "else":
      case "end":
        break;

      default:
        // For unknown arithmetic/control instructions, preserve stack
        // rather than inventing semantics.
        break;
    }
  }

  return stack;
}

function findFunctionBody(
  wasm: Buffer,
  codeStart: number,
  codeEnd: number,
  importedFunctions: number,
  targetFunc: number
) {
  let p = codeStart;

  const count = readULEB(wasm, p);
  p = count.next;

  const bodyIndex = targetFunc - importedFunctions;

  if (bodyIndex < 0 || bodyIndex >= count.value) {
    throw new Error(
      `Function ${targetFunc} is outside defined-function range`
    );
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const sizeField = p;
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

    if (i === bodyIndex) {
      return {
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
        sizeField,
      };
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  throw new Error(`Function ${targetFunc} body not found`);
}

export async function run() {
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" FUNCTION 2094 CALL 205 ARG EXTRACTION v2");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log();

  const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

  console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);

  const sections = getSections(wasm);

  const typeSec = sections.get(1);
  const importSec = sections.get(2);
  const funcSec = sections.get(3);
  const codeSec = sections.get(10);

  if (!typeSec || !funcSec || !codeSec) {
    throw new Error("Required WASM sections are missing");
  }

  const types = parseTypes(
    wasm,
    typeSec.payloadStart,
    typeSec.payloadEnd
  );

  const importedFunctions = importSec
    ? parseImports(
        wasm,
        importSec.payloadStart,
        importSec.payloadEnd
      )
    : 0;

  const functionTypes = parseFunctionTypes(
    wasm,
    funcSec.payloadStart,
    funcSec.payloadEnd
  );

  const body = findFunctionBody(
    wasm,
    codeSec.payloadStart,
    codeSec.payloadEnd,
    importedFunctions,
    TARGET_FUNC
  );

  console.log(
    `Function  : ${TARGET_FUNC}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Body      : 0x${body.bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${body.bodyEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
  );

  const instrs = decodeFunction(
    wasm,
    body.bodyStart,
    body.bodyEnd
  );

  console.log(`Decoded   : ${instrs.length}`);
  console.log(`Imports   : ${importedFunctions}`);
  console.log(`Types     : ${types.length}`);
  console.log();

  const call205TypeIndex =
    TARGET_CALL < importedFunctions
      ? null
      : functionTypes[TARGET_CALL - importedFunctions];

  if (call205TypeIndex == null) {
    throw new Error("Could not resolve Function 205 type");
  }

  const call205Type = types[call205TypeIndex];

  if (!call205Type) {
    throw new Error(
      `Could not resolve type ${call205TypeIndex} for Function 205`
    );
  }

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" FUNCTION 205 SIGNATURE");
  console.log("============================================================");

  console.log(`Function 205 type index : ${call205TypeIndex}`);
  console.log(`Parameter count         : ${call205Type.params.length}`);
  console.log(`Result count             : ${call205Type.results.length}`);

  console.log(
    `Parameters               : ${call205Type.params
      .map((x) => `0x${x.toString(16)}`)
      .join(", ")}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Results                  : ${call205Type.results
      .map((x) => `0x${x.toString(16)}`)
      .join(", ")}`
  );

  console.log();

  for (let siteNo = 0; siteNo < CALL_SITES.length; siteNo++) {
    const pc = CALL_SITES[siteNo];

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(
      `CALL #${siteNo + 1} @ 0x${pc.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
    );
    console.log("============================================================");

    const index = instrs.findIndex((x) => x.pc === pc);

    if (index < 0) {
      console.log("ERROR: call site not found");
      console.log();
      continue;
    }

    const ins = instrs[index];

    if (ins.name !== "call" || ins.args![0] !== TARGET_CALL) {
      console.log(
        `ERROR: expected call ${TARGET_CALL}, found ${ins.name} ${
          ins.args?.join(",") ?? ""
        }`
      );
      console.log();
      continue;
    }

    console.log("Confirmed instruction: call 205");
    console.log();

    console.log("LAST 20 DECODED INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE CALL:");

    const start = Math.max(0, index - 20);

    for (let j = start; j < index; j++) {
      const x = instrs[j];

      let suffix = "";

      if (x.args?.length) {
        suffix = " " + x.args.join(", ");
      }

      console.log(
        `0x${x.pc.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${x.name}${suffix}`
      );
    }

    console.log();

    const stack = symbolicTrace(
      instrs,
      pc,
      types,
      functionTypes,
      importedFunctions
    );

    console.log("SYMBOLIC STACK BEFORE CALL:");
    console.log();

    if (stack.length === 0) {
      console.log("  <empty>");
    } else {
      stack.forEach((x, i) => {
        console.log(`  STACK[${i}] = ${x.expr}`);
      });
    }

    console.log();

    const n = call205Type.params.length;

    if (stack.length >= n) {
      const args = stack.slice(stack.length - n);

      console.log(`EXTRACTED ${n} CALL ARGUMENTS:`);

      args.forEach((x, i) => {
        console.log(`  arg${i} = ${x.expr}`);
      });
    } else {
      console.log(
        `WARNING: stack has ${stack.length} values, Function 205 requires ${n}`
      );

      console.log(
        "The missing values are therefore coming from an earlier stack-producing path."
      );
    }

    console.log();
  }

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("END CALL 205 ARG EXTRACTION v2");
  console.log("============================================================");
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 2094;
const TARGET_CALL = 205;

const CALL_SITES = [
    0x969de,
    0x96aa1,
    0x96aad,
    0x96ab4,
];

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 2094 CALL 205 DIRECT ARGUMENT VERIFIER V3");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

const bytes = new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(WASM));

console.log(`WASM size : ${bytes.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Function  : ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log(`Target    : call ${TARGET_CALL}`);
console.log();

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; end: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, end: p };
}

function sleb32(pos: number): { value: number; end: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: result, end: p };
}

function readSections() {
    let p = 8;

    let functionSectionStart = 0;
    let functionSectionEnd = 0;

    let codeSectionStart = 0;
    let codeSectionEnd = 0;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];

        const sz = uleb(p);
        p = sz.end;

        const payload = p;
        const end = p + sz.value;

        if (id === 3) {
            functionSectionStart = payload;
            functionSectionEnd = end;
        }

        if (id === 10) {
            codeSectionStart = payload;
            codeSectionEnd = end;
        }

        p = end;
    }

    return {
        functionSectionStart,
        functionSectionEnd,
        codeSectionStart,
        codeSectionEnd,
    };
}

function getImportedFunctionCount(): number {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];

        const sz = uleb(p);
        p = sz.end;

        const end = p + sz.value;

        if (id === 2) {
            let q = p;

            const count = uleb(q);
            q = count.end;

            let importedFunctions = 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
                const moduleLen = uleb(q);
                q = moduleLen.end + moduleLen.value;

                const nameLen = uleb(q);
                q = nameLen.end + nameLen.value;

                const kind = bytes[q++];

                if (kind === 0) {
                    uleb(q);
                    q = uleb(q).end;
                    importedFunctions++;
                } else if (kind === 1) {
                    q += 4;
                } else if (kind === 2) {
                    q += 1;
                } else if (kind === 3) {
                    q += 2;
                }
            }

            return importedFunctions;
        }

        p = end;
    }

    return 0;
}

function getFunctionBody(target: number) {
    const sections = readSections();
    const imported = getImportedFunctionCount();

    const functionIndex = target - imported;

    let p = sections.codeSectionStart;

    const bodyCount = uleb(p);
    p = bodyCount.end;

    for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount.value; i++) {
        const sizeInfo = uleb(p);
        const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
        const sizeEnd = sizeInfo.end;

        const bodyStart = sizeEnd;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

        if (i === functionIndex) {
            return {
                imported,
                functionIndex,
                bodyStart,
                bodyEnd,
            };
        }

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    throw new Error("Function body not found");
}

function decodeInstruction(pc: number): {
    text: string;
    end: number;
} {
    const b = bytes[pc];
    let p = pc + 1;

    switch (b) {
        case 0x20: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = sleb32(p);
            return {
                text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x42: {
            let q = p;
            while (bytes[q++] & 0x80) {}
            return {
                text: "i64.const",
                end: q,
            };
        }

        case 0x6a:
            return { text: "i32.add", end: p };

        case 0x6b:
            return { text: "i32.sub", end: p };

        case 0x10: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `call ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x28: {
            const align = uleb(p);
            const off = uleb(align.end);

            return {
                text: `i32.load offset=${off.value}`,
                end: off.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x29: {
            const align = uleb(p);
            const off = uleb(align.end);

            return {
                text: `i64.load offset=${off.value}`,
                end: off.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const align = uleb(p);
            const off = uleb(align.end);

            return {
                text: `i64.store offset=${off.value}`,
                end: off.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x0b:
            return { text: "end", end: p };

        case 0x0c: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `br ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `br_if ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x02:
        case 0x03:
        case 0x04: {
            const bt = bytes[p++];

            const name =
                b === 0x02 ? "block" :
                b === 0x03 ? "loop" :
                "if";

            return {
                text: `${name} blocktype=0x${bt.toString(16)}`,
                end: p,
            };
        }

        default:
            return {
                text: `op_0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
                end: p,
            };
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

let p = 0x2b0d;

const segments = uleb(p);
p = segments.next;

const flag = uleb(p);
p = flag.next;

if (flag.value !== 0)
  throw new Error(`Unexpected flag ${flag.value}`);

// offset expression
if (b[p++] !== 0x41)
  throw new Error("Expected i32.const");

const offset = uleb(p);
p = offset.next;

if (b[p++] !== 0x0b)
  throw new Error("Expected END");

p = count.next;

  if (position < 0 || position >= count.value) {

  );

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x0000d339;
const END   = 0x0000d49e;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 107 REAL CALL EXTRACTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(
  `BODY : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`
);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let p = START;

while (p < END) {

  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  // CALL
  if (op === 0x10) {

    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    console.log(
      `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  CALL FUNC ${x.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // CALL INDIRECT
  if (op === 0x11) {

    const type = uleb(p);
    p = type.next;

    const table = uleb(p);
    p = table.next;

    console.log(
      `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  CALL_INDIRECT type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // local.get / set / tee
  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    p = uleb(p).next;
    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    p = uleb(p).next;
    continue;
  }

  // i64.const
  if (op === 0x42) {
    p = uleb(p).next;
    continue;
  }

  // memory loads
  if (
    op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2a || op === 0x2b ||
    op === 0x2c || op === 0x2d ||
    op === 0x2e || op === 0x2f ||
    op === 0x30 || op === 0x31
  ) {
    p = uleb(p).next;
    p = uleb(p).next;
    continue;
  }

  // memory stores
  if (
    op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 ||
    op === 0x38 || op === 0x39 ||
    op === 0x3a || op === 0x3b
  ) {
    p = uleb(p).next;
    p = uleb(p).next;
    continue;
  }

  // memory.size / grow
  if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
    p++;
    continue;
  }

  // block / loop / if
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    p++;
    continue;
  }

  // br / br_if
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    p = uleb(p).next;
    continue;
  }

  // select / drop / return
  if (op === 0x1b || op === 0x1a || op === 0x0f) {
    continue;
  }

  // numeric opcodes with no immediates
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const targetFunc = 91;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(data: Buffer, pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = data[pos++];

        if (b === undefined) {
            throw new Error("Unexpected EOF while reading ULEB");
        }

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function bytesToHex(data: Buffer, start: number, end: number): string {
    const out: string[] = [];

    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
        out.push(data[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
    }

    return out.join(" ");
}

console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET FUNCTION = ${targetFunc}`);
console.log();

let p = 8;

let codeSectionStart = -1;
let codeSectionEnd = -1;

while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeSectionStart = payloadStart;
        codeSectionEnd = payloadEnd;

    p = payloadEnd;
}

if (codeSectionStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

console.log(

const countInfo = readULEB(wasm, q);
const funcCount = countInfo.value;
q = countInfo.next;

console.log(`CODE BODY COUNT = ${funcCount}`);

let bodyStart = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < funcCount; i++) {

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LIBRARY_HASH_HEX =
    'C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const TESTNET_CONFIG_URL =
    'https://ton-blockchain.github.io/testnet-global.config.json';

function intToIP(ip: number): string {
    const n = ip >>> 0;

    return [
        (n >>> 24) & 255,
        (n >>> 16) & 255,
        (n >>> 8) & 255,
        n & 255,
    ].join('.');
}

async function getTestnetConfig(): Promise<any> {
    const response = await fetch(TESTNET_CONFIG_URL);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Cannot download Testnet config: HTTP ${response.status}`
        );
    }

    return await response.json();
}

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function waitForEngine(
    engine: LiteSingleEngine,
    timeoutMs: number
): Promise<void> {
    const started = Date.now();

    while (Date.now() - started < timeoutMs) {
        if (engine.isReady()) {
            return;
        }

        if (engine.isClosed()) {
            await sleep(250);
            continue;
        }

        await sleep(250);
    }

    throw new Error(
        `LiteSingleEngine did not become ready within ${timeoutMs} ms`
    );
}

function collectCells(
    root: Cell
): Cell[] {
    const result: Cell[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();

    function visit(cell: Cell) {
        const hash = cell.hash().toString('hex');

        if (seen.has(hash)) {
            return;
        }

        seen.add(hash);
        result.push(cell);

        for (const ref of cell.refs) {
            visit(ref);
        }
    }

    visit(root);

    return result;
}

function getCellBitsHex(cell: Cell): string {
    const bits = cell.bits;

    if (bits.length === 0) {
        return '';
    }

    const byteLength = Math.floor(bits.length / 8);

    if (byteLength === 0) {
        return '';
    }

    try {
        const slice = cell.beginParse();

        return slice
            .loadBuffer(byteLength)
            .toString('hex');
    } catch {
        return '(not byte-readable)';
    }
}

function scoreCell(cell: Cell): number {
    let score = 0;

    /*
     * Large cells are more likely to contain TVM code/data.
     */
    if (cell.bits.length >= 256) {
        score += 1;
    }

    if (cell.bits.length >= 512) {
        score += 1;
    }

    if (cell.bits.length >= 900) {
        score += 1;
    }

    /*
     * A Cell with references can represent a continuation
     * of TVM code/data.
     */
    if (cell.refs.length > 0) {
        score += 1;
    }

    /*
     * Byte-aligned cells are easier to inspect.
     */
    if (cell.bits.length % 8 === 0) {
        score += 1;
    }

    return score;
}

async function resolveLibrary(): Promise<Cell> {
    const config = await getTestnetConfig();

    if (
        !config.liteservers ||
        config.liteservers.length === 0
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'No Testnet LiteServers found'
        );
    }

    const libraryHash = Buffer.from(
        LIBRARY_HASH_HEX,
        'hex'
    );

    let lastError: unknown = null;

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < config.liteservers.length;
        i++
    ) {
        const server = config.liteservers[i];

        const ip = intToIP(server.ip);
        const port = server.port;

        const publicKey = Buffer.from(
            server.id.key,
            'base64'
        );

        console.log(
            `Trying LiteServer ${i + 1}/${config.liteservers.length}: ${ip}:${port}`
        );

        let engine: LiteSingleEngine | null = null;

        try {
            engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
                host: `tcp://${ip}:${port}`,
                publicKey,
                reconnectTimeout: 3000,
            });

            await waitForEngine(
                engine,
                15000
            );

            const client = new LiteClient({
                engine,
            });

            const master =
                await client.getMasterchainInfo({
                    timeout: 10000,
                });

            console.log(
                `Masterchain seqno: ${master.last.seqno}`
            );

            const result =
                await client.getLibraries(
                    [libraryHash],
                    {
                        timeout: 15000,
                    }
                );

            if (result.result.length === 0) {
                engine.close();
                continue;
            }

            const entry = result.result[0];

            const data =
                Buffer.from(entry.data);

            console.log(
                `Library bytes: ${data.length}`
            );

            const cells =
                Cell.fromBoc(data);

            if (cells.length === 0) {
                engine.close();

                throw new Error(
                    'Library BOC returned zero root cells'
                );
            }

            const root = cells[0];

            const actualHash =
                root.hash().toString('hex');

            console.log(
                `Library hash: ${actualHash}`
            );

            if (
                actualHash.toLowerCase() !==
                LIBRARY_HASH_HEX.toLowerCase()
            ) {
                engine.close();

                throw new Error(
                    'Library hash mismatch'
                );
            }

            engine.close();

            return root;
        } catch (e) {
            lastError = e;

            console.log(
                `LiteServer failed: ${String(e)}`
            );

            if (engine) {
                try {
                    engine.close();
                } catch {
                    // ignore
                }
            }
        }
    }

    throw new Error(
        `All LiteServers failed. Last error: ${String(lastError)}`
    );
}

export async function run(
    _provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LIBRARY CODE EXTRACTOR');
    console.log(' ON-CHAIN GET_LIBRARIES');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    console.log('');

    const root =
        await resolveLibrary();

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Library resolved successfully.'
    );

    console.log(
        `Root hash: ${root.hash().toString('hex')}`
    );

    const cells =
        collectCells(root);

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `Unique cells in Library tree: ${cells.length}`
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' CELL INVENTORY');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    const ranked = cells
        .map((cell, index) => ({
            cell,
            index,
            score: scoreCell(cell),
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => {
            if (b.score !== a.score) {
                return b.score - a.score;
            }

            return (
                b.cell.bits.length -
                a.cell.bits.length
            );
        });

    for (const item of ranked) {
        const cell = item.cell;

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            `Cell #${item.index}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  hash  : ${cell.hash().toString('hex')}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  bits  : ${cell.bits.length}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  refs  : ${cell.refs.length}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  exotic: ${cell.isExotic}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  score : ${item.score}`
        );

        const hex =
            getCellBitsHex(cell);

        if (hex.length > 0) {
            console.log(
                `  bits hex: ${hex.slice(0, 160)}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' LARGE / CODE-LIKE CELLS');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    for (const item of ranked) {
        const cell = item.cell;

        if (
            cell.bits.length >= 900 ||
            (
                cell.bits.length >= 256 &&
                cell.refs.length > 0
            )
        ) {
            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `Candidate Cell #${item.index}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  hash  : ${cell.hash().toString('hex')}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  bits  : ${cell.bits.length}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  refs  : ${cell.refs.length}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  exotic: ${cell.isExotic}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  bits hex: ${getCellBitsHex(cell)}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' RESULT');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    console.log(
        'ON-CHAIN LIBRARY RESOLVED: TRUE'
    );

    console.log(
        `UNIQUE CELLS: ${cells.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        'NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT'
    );
}

const BOC =
    'te6cckEBAQEAIwAIQgLJWi7SKrUW93+dSJjcRXjnLxiiRI6PaDIzSwtL9QG8eU64SPQ=';

console.log('==============================================');

console.log('refs =', cell.refs.length);
console.log('exotic =', cell.isExotic);

// Exotic Library Reference layout:
// 8 bits  = exotic type
// 256 bits = library hash

const raw = cell.bits;

console.log('raw bits object:', raw.constructor.name);

// Convert individual bits into bytes.
function readBitsAsBuffer(bits: any, offset: number, length: number): Buffer {
    const out = Buffer.alloc(Math.ceil(length / 8));

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        const bit = bits.at(offset + i);

        if (bit) {
            out[Math.floor(i / 8)] |= 1 << (7 - (i % 8));
        }
    }

    return out;
}

const type = readBitsAsBuffer(raw, 0, 8);
const hash = readBitsAsBuffer(raw, 8, 256);

console.log('');
console.log('EXOTIC TYPE =', type.toString('hex').toUpperCase());
console.log('HASH        =', hash.toString('hex').toUpperCase());
console.log('HASH CHARS  =', hash.toString('hex').length);
console.log('HASH BYTES  =', hash.length);
console.log('');
console.log('remaining bits =', raw.length - 264);
console.log('remaining refs =', cell.refs.length);

if (hash.length !== 32) {
    throw new Error(`INVALID HASH LENGTH: ${hash.length} bytes`);
}

console.log('');
console.log('VALID 256-BIT HASH = true');

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99809465000012n;

const CALLBACK_OPCODE = 0x06ecd527;

function getOpcode(body: any): string {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return 'NO_OPCODE';
        }

        return (
            '0x' +
            s.loadUint(32).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );
    } catch {
        return 'DECODE_ERROR';
    }
}

function getBodyHex(body: any): string {
    try {
        return body.toBoc().toString('hex');
    } catch {
        return 'BOC_ERROR';
    }
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL =
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf';

const TARGET_LT = '99809465000012';

const ENDPOINT =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

async function rpc(method: string, params: any) {
    const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            jsonrpc: '2.0',
            id: 1,
            method,
            params,
        }),
    });

    return await response.json();
}

function formatAddress(address: Address | null): string {
    if (!address) return 'null';

    return address.toString({
        urlSafe: true,
        bounceable: true,
        testOnly: true,
    });
}

function formatAmount(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;
    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0');

    return `${whole}.${frac}`;
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

        console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

    }

    console.log('\nTARGET TRANSACTION FOUND');

    console.log('HASH:', tx.transaction_id.hash);

    const inMsg = tx.in_msg;

    console.log('\nINCOMING MESSAGE');
    console.log('Source:', inMsg.source);
    console.log('Destination:', inMsg.destination);
    console.log('Value:', inMsg.value);
    console.log('Message type:', inMsg.message_content?.type);

    const body = inMsg.message_content?.body;

    if (!body) {
        console.log('\nNO BODY FOUND IN in_msg');
        console.log(JSON.stringify(inMsg, null, 2));
        return;
    }

    console.log('\nREAL BODY FROM TONCENTER');
    console.log(body);

    console.log('\nBODY LENGTH');
    console.log('Characters:', body.length);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Detect encoding
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    let bytes: Buffer;

    const first8 = body.substring(0, 8).toLowerCase();

    console.log('\nBODY PREFIX:', first8);

    if (first8 === 'b5ee9c72') {
        console.log('Detected: HEX BOC');
        bytes = Buffer.from(body, 'hex');
    } else {
        console.log('Detected: BASE64 BOC');
        bytes = Buffer.from(body, 'base64');
    }

    console.log('Decoded bytes:', bytes.length);
    console.log(
        'Magic:',
        bytes.subarray(0, 4).toString('hex')
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Decode the REAL BOC
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const roots = Cell.fromBoc(bytes);

    console.log('\nBOC ROOT COUNT:', roots.length);

    const cell = roots[0];
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    console.log('\nHEADER');
    console.log(
        'Opcode:',
        '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
    );
    console.log('Query ID:', queryId.toString());

    if (opcode !== 0x06ecd527) {
        console.log(
            '\nWARNING: Expected 0x06ecd527 but got',
            '0x' + opcode.toString(16)
        );
    }

    console.log('\nREMAINING ROOT CELL');
    console.log('Bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Print raw structure safely
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    if (s.remainingBits > 0) {
        console.log('\nRemaining bits exist.');
    }

    if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
        console.log('\nREFERENCES:');

        let i = 0;

        while (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
            const ref = s.loadRef();

            console.log(`\nREF [${i}]`);
            console.log('Bits:', ref.bits.length);
            console.log('Refs:', ref.refs.length);
            console.log(
                'BOC:',
                ref.toBoc().toString('base64')
            );

            i++;
        }
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' FETCH + DECODE COMPLETE');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const pattern = [
  0x41, 0x18,
  0x10, 0x60,
  0x22, 0x00
];

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FILTER CALL 96 — VERIFIED PATTERN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("PATTERN : 41 18 10 60 22 00");
console.log("MEANING : i32.const 24 / call 96 / local.tee 0");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let hits = 0;

for (let i = 0; i <= buf.length - pattern.length; i++) {
  let ok = true;

  for (let j = 0; j < pattern.length; j++) {
    if (buf[i + j] !== pattern[j]) {
      ok = false;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!ok) continue;

  hits++;

  console.log(
    `HIT #${hits} : 0x${i.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
  );
}

console.log("");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("TOTAL VERIFIED PATTERN HITS :", hits);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

// ============================================================

function format9(value: bigint): string {

    const whole =
        value / 1000000000n;

    const fraction =
        (value % 1000000000n)
            .toString()
            .padStart(9, '0')
            .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction.length > 0
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : `${whole}`;
}


function pass(label: string, value: boolean) {

    console.log(

    );
}

    console.log(
        `WARN  ${label}`
    );
}

    );
}

  "./exact_sdk_matched_v22_rooster_liquidity.boc";

const EXPECTED_SDK_HASH =

function hashCell(cell: Cell): string {
  return cell.hash().toString("hex");
}

function loadBocFile(path: string): Cell {
  if (!fs.existsSync(path)) {
    throw new Error(`BOC file not found: ${path}`);
  }

  const base64 =
    fs.readFileSync(path, "utf8").trim();

  return Cell.fromBoc(
    Buffer.from(base64, "base64")
  )[0];
}

export async function run(provider: any) {
  console.log("=================================================");
  console.log(" STON.fi v2.2 FINAL EXACT SDK PREFLIGHT");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT");
  console.log("=================================================");

  const master =
    Address.parse(ROOSTER_MASTER);

  const user =
    Address.parse(USER_WALLET);

  const router =
    Address.parse(ROUTER);

  const ptonMaster =
    Address.parse(PTON_MASTER);

  const routerPtonWallet =
    Address.parse(ROUTER_PTON_WALLET);

  let allPass = true;

  // =================================================
  // 1. USER ROOSTER WALLET
  // =================================================

  console.log("\n===== 1. ROOSTER WALLET =====");

  const masterProvider =
    provider.provider(master);

  const walletResult =
    await masterProvider.get(
      "get_wallet_address",
      [
        {
          type: "slice",
          cell: beginCell()
            .storeAddress(user)
            .endCell(),
        },
      ]
    );

  const userJettonWallet =
    walletResult.stack.readAddress();

  console.log(
    "Derived user ROOSTER wallet:"
  );
  console.log(
    userJettonWallet.toString()
  );

  const expectedUserJettonWallet =
    "EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh";

  const userWalletPass =
    userJettonWallet.toString() ===
    expectedUserJettonWallet;

  console.log(
    "User ROOSTER wallet:",
    userWalletPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= userWalletPass;

  // =================================================
  // 2. pTON MASTER -> ROUTER WALLET
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 2. pTON ROUTER WALLET ====="
  );

  const ptonProvider =
    provider.provider(ptonMaster);

  const ptonResult =
    await ptonProvider.get(
      "get_wallet_address",
      [
        {
          type: "slice",
          cell: beginCell()
            .storeAddress(router)
            .endCell(),
        },
      ]
    );

  const derivedRouterPtonWallet =
    ptonResult.stack.readAddress();

  console.log(
    "Derived router pTON wallet:"
  );
  console.log(
    derivedRouterPtonWallet.toString()
  );

  const ptonPass =
    derivedRouterPtonWallet.toString() ===
    routerPtonWallet.toString();

  console.log(
    "pTON router wallet:",
    ptonPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= ptonPass;

  // =================================================
  // 3. SDK TX PARAMETERS
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 3. SDK TX PARAMETERS ====="
  );

  const routerContract =
    DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(router);

  const routerProvider =
    provider.provider(router);

  const txParams =
    await routerContract
      .getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
        routerProvider,
        {
          userWalletAddress: user,
          sendTokenAddress: master,
          otherTokenAddress: ptonMaster,
         sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
deadline: EXPECTED_DEADLINE,
gasAmount: EXPECTED_GAS,
          forwardGasAmount:
            EXPECTED_FORWARD_GAS,
          transferExcessAddress: user,
        }
      );

  console.log(
    "SDK TX generated: PASS"
  );

  // =================================================
  // 4. TX DESTINATION
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 4. TX DESTINATION ====="
  );

  console.log("Expected:");
  console.log(
    userJettonWallet.toString()
  );

  console.log("Actual:");
  console.log(
    txParams.to.toString()
  );

  const destinationPass =
    txParams.to.toString() ===
    userJettonWallet.toString();

  console.log(
    "Destination:",
    destinationPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= destinationPass;

  // =================================================
  // 5. GAS
  // =================================================

  console.log("\n===== 5. GAS =====");

  const gasPass =
    BigInt(txParams.value.toString()) ===
    EXPECTED_GAS;

  console.log(
    "Expected:",
    EXPECTED_GAS.toString()

  console.log(
    "Actual:",
    txParams.value.toString()
  );

  console.log(

  // =================================================
  // 6. SDK BODY

  console.log(

  );

  if (!txParams.body) {
    throw new Error(
      "SDK transaction body is empty."
    );
  }

  const sdkBody =
    Cell.fromBoc(
      txParams.body.toBoc()
    )[0];

  const sdkHash =
    hashCell(sdkBody);

  const sdkBoc =
    sdkBody.toBoc();

  console.log(
    "SDK hash:"
  );
  console.log(sdkHash);

  console.log(
    "SDK bits:",
    sdkBody.bits.length
  );

  console.log(
    "SDK refs:",
    sdkBody.refs.length
  );

  console.log(
    "SDK bytes:",
    sdkBoc.length
  );

  console.log(
    "SDK chars:",
    sdkBoc.toString("base64").length
  );

  const sdkHashPass =
    sdkHash === EXPECTED_SDK_HASH;

  console.log(
    "SDK hash:",
    sdkHashPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= sdkHashPass;

  // =================================================
  // 7. SAVED SDK BOC
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 7. SAVED SDK BOC ====="
  );

  const savedSdkBody =
    loadBocFile(SDK_BOC_FILE);

  const savedSdkHash =
    hashCell(savedSdkBody);

  const savedSdkBytes =
    savedSdkBody.toBoc();

  const savedSdkPass =
    savedSdkHash === sdkHash;

  console.log(
    "Saved SDK hash:"
  );
  console.log(savedSdkHash);

  console.log(
    "SDK generated hash:"
  );
  console.log(sdkHash);

  console.log(
    "Saved SDK BOC:",
    savedSdkPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= savedSdkPass;

  // =================================================
  // 8. EXACT MANUAL BOC
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 8. EXACT MANUAL BOC ====="
  );

  const exactBody =
    loadBocFile(EXACT_BOC_FILE);

  const exactHash =
    hashCell(exactBody);

  const exactBoc =
    exactBody.toBoc();

  console.log(
    "Exact BOC hash:"
  );
  console.log(exactHash);

  console.log(
    "Exact BOC bits:",
    exactBody.bits.length
  );

  console.log(
    "Exact BOC refs:",
    exactBody.refs.length
  );

  console.log(
    "Exact BOC bytes:",
    exactBoc.length
  );

  console.log(
    "Exact BOC chars:",
    exactBoc.toString("base64").length
  );

  const exactHashPass =
    exactHash === sdkHash;

  console.log(
    "Exact BOC == SDK:",
    exactHashPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= exactHashPass;

  // =================================================
  // 9. BYTE-FOR-BYTE COMPARISON
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 9. BYTE-FOR-BYTE ====="
  );

  const sdkBase64 =
    sdkBoc.toString("base64");

  const exactBase64 =
    exactBoc.toString("base64");

  const byteForBytePass =
    sdkBase64 === exactBase64;

  console.log(
    "SDK BOC == exact BOC:",
    byteForBytePass
      ? "PASS"
      : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= byteForBytePass;

  // =================================================
  // 10. FINAL VALUES
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 10. FINAL VALUES ====="
  );

  console.log(
    "ROOSTER amount:",
    ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "minLpOut:",
    MIN_LP_OUT.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "Gas:",
    EXPECTED_GAS.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "Forward gas:",
    EXPECTED_FORWARD_GAS.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "Deadline:",
    EXPECTED_DEADLINE.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "Router pTON wallet:",
    routerPtonWallet.toString()
  );

  console.log(
    "User:",
    user.toString()
  );

  // =================================================
  // FINAL
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n================================================="
  );
  console.log(
    " FINAL PREFLIGHT RESULT"
  );
  console.log(
    "================================================="
  );

  if (allPass) {
    console.log("");
    console.log(
      "STATUS: ALL CHECKS PASSED"
    );
    console.log("");
    console.log(
      "ROOSTER wallet: PASS"
    );
    console.log(
      "pTON router wallet: PASS"
    );
    console.log(
      "TX destination: PASS"
    );
    console.log(
      "Gas = 0.30 TON: PASS"
    );
    console.log(
      "SDK body hash: PASS"
    );
    console.log(
      "Saved SDK BOC: PASS"
    );
    console.log(
      "Exact manual BOC: PASS"
    );
    console.log(
      "Byte-for-byte equality: PASS"
    );
    console.log("");
    console.log(
      "SDK BOC and exact manual BOC are identical."
    );
    console.log("");
    console.log(
      "NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT."
    );
  } else {
    console.log("");
    console.log(
      "STATUS: FAIL"
    );
    console.log("");
    console.log(
      "NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT."
    );
  }

  console.log(
    "================================================="
  );
}

// ============================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================

function pass(label: string, condition: boolean) {

    console.log(
        `${condition ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${label}`
    );

    return condition;
}


function section(title: string) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        ` ${title}`
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
}


function format9(value: bigint): string {

    const whole =
        value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction =
        (value % 1_000_000_000n)
            .toString()
            .padStart(9, '0')
            .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction.length > 0
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : `${whole}`;
}


function sameAddress(
    a: Address,
    b: Address
): boolean {

    return a.equals(b);
}

        innerSlice.loadAddress();

    const bothPositive =
        innerSlice.loadUint(1);

    const customForwardGas =
        innerSlice.loadCoins();

    const customPayload =
        innerSlice.loadMaybeRef();


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER transfer opcode',
            roosterTransferOpcode === 0x0f8a7ea5
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER amount = 100',
            roosterAmount === ROOSTER_AMOUNT
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER destination = Router',
            sameAddress(
                roosterDestination,
                ROUTER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER response = USER',
            sameAddress(
                roosterResponse,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER custom payload absent',
            roosterCustom === null
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER forward TON = 0.235',
            roosterForwardTon === ROOSTER_FORWARD_TON
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER forward payload present',
            roosterForwardPresent === true
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'PROVIDE_LP opcode',
            provideOpcode === 0x37c096df
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER leg router pTON wallet',
            sameAddress(
                provideRouterWallet,
                EXPECTED_ROUTER_PTON_WALLET
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER refund = USER',
            sameAddress(
                provideRefund,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER excesses = USER',
            sameAddress(
                provideExcesses,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;

            minLpOut === MIN_LP_OUT
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(

            sameAddress(
                receiver,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(

            bothPositive === 1
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(

            customForwardGas === 0n
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER custom payload absent',
            customPayload === null
        ) && allPass;

    // 12. FRESH pTON BOC VALIDATION
    // ========================================================

    section('12. FRESH pTON BOC');


    if (!ptonTx.body) {

        throw new Error(
            'pTON SDK body is empty.'
        );
    }


    const ptonBody =
        Cell.fromBoc(
            ptonTx.body.toBoc()
        )[0];


    const ptonSlice =
        ptonBody.beginParse();


    const ptonOpcode =
        ptonSlice.loadUint(32);

    const ptonQueryId =
        ptonSlice.loadUintBig(64);

    const ptonAmount =
        ptonSlice.loadCoins();

    const ptonRefund =
        ptonSlice.loadAddress();

    const ptonForwardPresent =
        ptonSlice.loadBit();

    const ptonForwardPayload =
        ptonSlice.loadRef();

        pass(
            'pTON TON_TRANSFER opcode',
            ptonOpcode === 0x01f3835d
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON query ID = 0',
            ptonQueryId === 0n
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON amount',
            ptonAmount === PTON_AMOUNT
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON refund = USER',
            sameAddress(
                ptonRefund,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON forward payload present',
            ptonForwardPresent === true
        ) && allPass;


    const ptonProvideSlice =
        ptonForwardPayload.beginParse();


    const ptonProvideOpcode =
        ptonProvideSlice.loadUint(32);

    const ptonOtherTokenWallet =
    ptonProvideSlice.loadAddress();

    const ptonProvideRefund =
        ptonProvideSlice.loadAddress();

    const ptonProvideExcesses =
        ptonProvideSlice.loadAddress();

    const ptonDeadline =
        ptonProvideSlice.loadUintBig(64);

    const ptonInner =

    const ptonReceiver =
        ptonInnerSlice.loadAddress();

    const ptonBothPositive =
        ptonInnerSlice.loadUint(1);

    const ptonCustomForwardGas =
        ptonInnerSlice.loadCoins();

    const ptonCustomPayload =
        ptonInnerSlice.loadMaybeRef();


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON PROVIDE_LP opcode',
            ptonProvideOpcode === 0x37c096df
        ) && allPass;


    // On the pTON leg, the SDK places the
    // ROOSTER wallet as the other-token wallet.

allPass =
    pass(
        'pTON leg Pool ROOSTER wallet',
        sameAddress(
            ptonOtherTokenWallet,
            EXPECTED_POOL_ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    ) && allPass;
   


    allPass =

                ptonProvideRefund,

            )

            )

        ) && allPass;


    allPass =

            sameAddress(
                ptonReceiver,

            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(

            ptonBothPositive === 1
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(

            ptonCustomForwardGas === 0n
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(

            ptonCustomPayload === null
        ) && allPass;

    // ========================================================

    section('13. CROSS-CHECKS');

        ) &&

            EXPECTED_POOL_ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    ) && allPass;
   

    // ========================================================
    // 14. FINAL
    // ========================================================

    section('14. FINAL READ-ONLY RESULT');


    console.log('');

    if (allPass) {

        console.log(
            'STATUS: READY FOR FINAL SEND REVIEW'
        );

    } else {

        console.log(

        );

    console.log('');
