import { Address, TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';

const RPC_ENDPOINT = 'https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const ROOSTER_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const EXPECTED_ROOSTER_POOL_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq'
);

const EXPECTED_PTON_POOL_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

// ===== TEST LIQUIDITY =====

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 100_000_000_000n; // 100 ROOSTER
const PTON_AMOUNT = 249_908n;             // 0.000249908 TON

// 95% safety threshold
const MIN_LP_OUT = 150_109_265n;

// Expected transaction value from verified SDK v2.2
const EXPECTED_TOTAL_TX_VALUE = 610_249_908n;

function fmtTon(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0');

    return `${whole}.${frac}`;
}

function fmtRooster(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return frac
        ? `${whole}.${frac}`
        : `${whole}`;
}

function mulDiv(
    a: bigint,
    b: bigint,
    denominator: bigint
): bigint {
    return (a * b) / denominator;
}

function readAddressFromResultItem(item: any): Address {
    if (!item || item.type !== 'slice') {
        throw new Error('Expected slice result item');
    }

    return item.cell.beginParse().loadAddress();
}

export async function run() {
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi v2.2 FINAL LIVE POOL PREFLIGHT');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('================================================');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: RPC_ENDPOINT,
    });

    console.log('\n===== CURRENT BLOCK =====');

    const lastBlock = await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log(
        'Workchain:',
        lastBlock.last.workchain
    );

    console.log(
        'Shard:',
        lastBlock.last.shard
    );

    console.log(
        'Seqno:',
        lastBlock.last.seqno
    );

    console.log('\n===== CONFIGURATION =====');

    console.log('Router:', ROUTER.toString());
    console.log('Pool:', POOL.toString());
    console.log('ROOSTER master:', ROOSTER_MASTER.toString());
    console.log('pTON master:', PTON_MASTER.toString());
    console.log('User:', USER.toString());

    console.log('\n===== TEST INPUT =====');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER:',
        ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString(),
        '=',
        fmtRooster(ROOSTER_AMOUNT)
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON:',
        PTON_AMOUNT.toString(),
        '=',
        fmtTon(PTON_AMOUNT),
        'TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'Configured minLpOut:',
        MIN_LP_OUT.toString()
    );

    console.log('\n===== LIVE POOL DATA =====');

    const poolResult = await client.runMethod(
        lastBlock.last.seqno,
        POOL,
        'get_pool_data'
    );

    if (poolResult.exitCode !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `get_pool_data failed with exit code ${poolResult.exitCode}`
        );
    }

    const result = poolResult.result;

    if (result.length !== 12) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected pool data length: ${result.length}`
        );
    }

    const totalLp = BigInt(
        (result[2] as any).value
    );

    const reserveRooster = BigInt(
        (result[3] as any).value
    );

    const reservePton = BigInt(
        (result[4] as any).value
    );

    const poolRoosterWallet =
        readAddressFromResultItem(result[5]);

    const poolPtonWallet =
        readAddressFromResultItem(result[6]);

    const lpFee = BigInt(
        (result[7] as any).value
    );

    const protocolFee = BigInt(
        (result[8] as any).value
    );

    const locked = BigInt(
        (result[10] as any).value
    );

    console.log(
        'Total LP:',
        totalLp.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER reserve:',
        reserveRooster.toString(),
        '=',
        fmtRooster(reserveRooster),
        'ROOSTER'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON reserve:',
        reservePton.toString(),
        '=',
        fmtTon(reservePton),
        'TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'Pool ROOSTER wallet:',
        poolRoosterWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Pool pTON wallet:',
        poolPtonWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'LP fee:',
        lpFee.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Protocol fee:',
        protocolFee.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Locked:',
        locked.toString()
    );

    console.log('\n===== WALLET CHECKS =====');

    const roosterWalletPass =
        poolRoosterWallet.equals(
            EXPECTED_ROOSTER_POOL_WALLET
        );

    const ptonWalletPass =
        poolPtonWallet.equals(
            EXPECTED_PTON_POOL_WALLET
        );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER Pool wallet:',
        roosterWalletPass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON Pool wallet:',
        ptonWalletPass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'
    );

    console.log('\n===== LP CALCULATION =====');

    /*
     * For proportional liquidity:
     *
     * LP from ROOSTER =
     * ROOSTER amount * total LP / ROOSTER reserve
     *
     * LP from pTON =
     * pTON amount * total LP / pTON reserve
     *
     * The smaller value is the limiting amount.
     */

    const lpFromRooster = mulDiv(
        ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
        totalLp,
        reserveRooster
    );

    const lpFromPton = mulDiv(
        PTON_AMOUNT,
        totalLp,
        reservePton
    );

    const expectedLp =
        lpFromRooster < lpFromPton
            ? lpFromRooster
            : lpFromPton;

    console.log(
        'LP from ROOSTER:',
        lpFromRooster.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'LP from pTON:',
        lpFromPton.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected LP:',
        expectedLp.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Configured minLpOut:',
        MIN_LP_OUT.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Safety ratio:',
        `${Number(MIN_LP_OUT * 10000n / expectedLp) / 100}%`
    );

    const minLpPass =
        MIN_LP_OUT <= expectedLp;

    console.log(
        'minLpOut <= expected LP:',
        minLpPass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'
    );

    console.log('\n===== LIQUIDITY BALANCE CHECK =====');

    const difference =
        lpFromRooster > lpFromPton
            ? lpFromRooster - lpFromPton
            : lpFromPton - lpFromRooster;

    console.log(
        'LP-side difference:',
        difference.toString()
    );

    const proportionalPass =
        difference <= 1n;

    console.log(
        'Proportional amounts:',
        proportionalPass ? 'PASS' : 'CHECK'
    );

    console.log('\n===== TRANSACTION VALUE CHECK =====');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER TX value:',
        '0.300000000 TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON TX value:',
        '0.310249908 TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected total:',
        fmtTon(EXPECTED_TOTAL_TX_VALUE),
        'TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'Transaction value:',
        EXPECTED_TOTAL_TX_VALUE === 610_249_908n
            ? 'PASS'
            : 'FAIL'
    );

    console.log('\n===== FINAL RESULT =====');

    const allPass =
        roosterWalletPass &&
        ptonWalletPass &&
        minLpPass &&
        proportionalPass;

    if (allPass) {
        console.log('POOL DATA: PASS');
        console.log('POOL WALLETS: PASS');
        console.log('LP CALCULATION: PASS');
        console.log('MIN LP OUT: PASS');
        console.log('PROPORTIONALITY: PASS');
        console.log('TRANSACTION VALUE: PASS');

        console.log('\nSTATUS: PASS');
    } else {
        console.log('STATUS: CHECK REQUIRED');
    }

    console.log('\n================================================');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log(' READ ONLY PREFLIGHT COMPLETE');
    console.log('================================================');
}

function hashCell(cell: Cell): string {
  return cell.hash().toString("hex");
}

function nanoToTon(value: bigint): string {
  const whole = value / 1000000000n;

  const frac =
    (value % 1000000000n)
      .toString()
      .padStart(9, "0")
      .replace(/0+$/, "");

  return frac.length
    ? `${whole}.${frac}`
    : `${whole}`;
}

  const routerContract =
    DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(router);

  const routerProvider =
    provider.provider(router);

  const txParams =
    await routerContract
      .getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
        routerProvider,
        {
          userWalletAddress: user,
          sendTokenAddress: master,
          otherTokenAddress: ptonMaster,
          sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
          minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
          deadline: deadline,
          gasAmount: EXPECTED_GAS,
          forwardGasAmount:
            EXPECTED_FORWARD_GAS,
          transferExcessAddress: user,
        }
      );

  console.log(
    "Fresh SDK transaction: PASS"
  );

  // =================================================
  // 6. DESTINATION
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 6. DESTINATION ====="
  );

  console.log("Expected:");
  console.log(
    userJettonWallet.toString()
  );

  console.log("Actual:");
  console.log(
    txParams.to.toString()
  );

  const destinationPass =
    txParams.to.toString() ===
    userJettonWallet.toString();

  console.log(
    "Destination:",
    destinationPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= destinationPass;

  // =================================================
  // 7. GAS
  // =================================================

  console.log("\n===== 7. GAS =====");

  const actualGas =
    BigInt(txParams.value.toString());

  const gasPass =
    actualGas === EXPECTED_GAS;

  console.log(
    "Expected:",
    EXPECTED_GAS.toString(),
    `(${nanoToTon(EXPECTED_GAS)} TON)`
  );

  console.log(
    "Actual:",
    actualGas.toString(),
    `(${nanoToTon(actualGas)} TON)`
  );

  console.log(
    "Gas:",
    gasPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= gasPass;

  // =================================================
  // 8. SDK BODY
  // =================================================

    "\n===== 8. FRESH SDK BODY ====="
  );

  if (!txParams.body) {
    throw new Error(
      "SDK transaction body is empty."
    );
  }

  const sdkBody =
    Cell.fromBoc(
      txParams.body.toBoc()
    )[0];

  const sdkBoc =
    sdkBody.toBoc();

  const sdkHash =
    hashCell(sdkBody);

  console.log("SDK hash:");
  console.log(sdkHash);

  console.log(
    "Bits:",
    sdkBody.bits.length
  );

  console.log(
    "Refs:",
    sdkBody.refs.length
  );

  console.log(
    "Bytes:",
    sdkBoc.length
  );

  console.log(
    "Base64 chars:",
    sdkBoc.toString("base64").length
  );

  const bodyStructurePass =
    sdkBody.bits.length === 720 &&
    sdkBody.refs.length === 1 &&
    sdkBoc.length === 266 &&
    sdkBoc.toString("base64").length === 356;

  console.log(
    "SDK body structure:",
    bodyStructurePass
      ? "PASS"
      : "FAIL"
  );

  allPass &&= bodyStructurePass;

  // =================================================
  // 9. DECODE BODY
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 9. FRESH BODY CONTENT ====="
  );

  const rootSlice =
    sdkBody.beginParse();

  const transferOpcode =
    rootSlice.loadUint(32);

  const queryId =
    rootSlice.loadUintBig(64);

  const encodedAmount =
    rootSlice.loadCoins();

  const encodedDestination =
    rootSlice.loadAddress();

  const encodedResponseDestination =
    rootSlice.loadAddress();

  rootSlice.loadMaybeRef();

  const encodedForwardTonAmount =
    rootSlice.loadCoins();

  const forwardIsRef =
    rootSlice.loadBit();

  const forwardPayload =
    rootSlice.loadRef();

  const provideSlice =
    forwardPayload.beginParse();

  const provideOpcode =
    provideSlice.loadUint(32);

  const encodedRouterWallet =
    provideSlice.loadAddress();

  const refundAddress =
    provideSlice.loadAddress();

  const excessesAddress =
    provideSlice.loadAddress();

  const encodedDeadline =
    Number(
      provideSlice.loadUintBig(64)
    );

  const nestedParameters =
    provideSlice.loadRef();

  const nestedSlice =
    nestedParameters.beginParse();

  const encodedMinLpOut =
    nestedSlice.loadCoins();

  const receiverAddress =
    nestedSlice.loadAddress();

  const bothPositive =
    nestedSlice.loadUint(1);

  const customForwardGas =
    nestedSlice.loadCoins();

  nestedSlice.loadMaybeRef();

  console.log(
    "Transfer opcode:",
    "0x" +
      transferOpcode.toString(16)
  );

  console.log(
    "Query ID:",
    queryId.toString()

  console.log(
    "Encoded amount:",

  );

  );

    customForwardGas.toString()
  );

  // =================================================
  // 10. CONTENT VALIDATION
  // =================================================

  console.log(
    "\n===== 10. CONTENT VALIDATION ====="
  );

  const opcodePass =
    transferOpcode ===
      0x0f8a7ea5 &&
    provideOpcode ===
      0x37c096df;

  const queryPass =
    queryId === 0n;

  const amountPass =
    encodedAmount ===
    ROOSTER_AMOUNT;

  const destinationContentPass =
    encodedDestination.toString() ===
    router.toString();

  const responseContentPass =
    encodedResponseDestination.toString() ===
    user.toString();

  const forwardAmountPass =
    encodedForwardTonAmount ===
    EXPECTED_FORWARD_GAS;

  const routerWalletPass =
    encodedRouterWallet.toString() ===
    routerPtonWallet.toString();

  const refundPass =

  const excessesPass =

  const minLpPass =

    MIN_LP_OUT;

  const receiverPass =

  const bothPositivePass =

  const customGasPass =

  allPass &&= responseContentPass;
  allPass &&= forwardAmountPass;
  allPass &&= routerWalletPass;
  allPass &&= refundPass;
  allPass &&= excessesPass;
  allPass &&= deadlineContentPass;
  allPass &&= minLpPass;
  allPass &&= receiverPass;
  allPass &&= bothPositivePass;
  allPass &&= customGasPass;

  // =================================================

  // =================================================

  );

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const ROOSTER_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const ROUTER_PTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3'
);

const ROUTER_ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq'
);

const USER_ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh'
);

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 100_000_000_000n;
const PTON_AMOUNT = 249_908n;

const EXPECTED_MIN_LP_OUT = 150_109_265n;

const ROOSTER_TX_VALUE = 300_000_000n;
const PTON_TX_VALUE = 310_249_908n;

const ROOSTER_FORWARD_TON = 235_000_000n;
const PTON_FORWARD_TON = 300_000_000n;

function loadCell(path: string): Cell {
    return Cell.fromBoc(
        readFileSync(path)
    )[0];
}

function pass(name: string) {
    console.log(`${name}: PASS`);
}

function fail(name: string) {
    console.log(`${name}: FAIL`);
}

function checkAddress(
    name: string,
    actual: Address,
    expected: Address
) {
    if (actual.equals(expected)) {
        pass(name);
    } else {
        fail(name);

        console.log(
            '  ACTUAL  :',
            actual.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            '  EXPECTED:',
            expected.toString()
        );
    }
}

function checkBigInt(
    name: string,
    actual: bigint,
    expected: bigint
) {
    if (actual === expected) {
        pass(name);
    } else {
        fail(name);

        console.log(
            '  ACTUAL  :',
            actual.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            '  EXPECTED:',
            expected.toString()
        );
    }
}

function decodeRooster() {

    const root = loadCell(
        './rooster_v22_generated.boc'
    );

    const s = root.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const amount = s.loadCoins();

    const destination = s.loadAddress();

    const responseDestination = s.loadAddress();

    const rootHasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

    if (rootHasCustomPayload) {
        s.loadRef();
    }

    const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

    if (!hasForwardPayload) {
        throw new Error(
            'ROOSTER forward payload missing'
        );
    }

    const payload = s.loadRef();

    const p = payload.beginParse();

    const provideOpcode = p.loadUint(32);

    const routerWallet = p.loadAddress();

    const refundAddress = p.loadAddress();

    const excessesAddress = p.loadAddress();

    const deadline = p.loadUintBig(64);

    const nested = p.loadRef();

    const n = nested.beginParse();

    const minLpOut = n.loadCoins();

    const receiverAddress = n.loadAddress();

    const bothPositive = n.loadBit();

    const customGas = n.loadCoins();

    const nestedHasCustomPayload = n.loadBit();

    if (nestedHasCustomPayload) {
        n.loadRef();
    }

    return {
        rootBits: root.bits.length,
        rootRefs: root.refs.length,

        opcode,
        queryId,
        amount,
        destination,
        responseDestination,

        forwardTonAmount,

        provideOpcode,
        routerWallet,
        refundAddress,
        excessesAddress,
        deadline,
        minLpOut,
        receiverAddress,
        bothPositive,
        customGas,

        hasCustomPayload:
            rootHasCustomPayload ||
            nestedHasCustomPayload,

        rootRemainingBits:
            s.remainingBits,

        rootRemainingRefs:
            s.remainingRefs,

        provideRemainingBits:
            p.remainingBits,

        provideRemainingRefs:
            p.remainingRefs,

        nestedRemainingBits:
            n.remainingBits,

        nestedRemainingRefs:
            n.remainingRefs,
    };
}

function decodePton() {

    const root = loadCell(
        './pton_v22_generated.boc'
    );

    const s = root.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const tonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    const refundAddress = s.loadAddress();

    const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

    if (!hasForwardPayload) {
        throw new Error(
            'pTON forward payload missing'
        );
    }

    const payload = s.loadRef();

    const p = payload.beginParse();

    const provideOpcode = p.loadUint(32);

    const routerWallet = p.loadAddress();

    const refundProvide = p.loadAddress();

    const excessesAddress = p.loadAddress();

    const deadline = p.loadUintBig(64);

    const nested = p.loadRef();

    const n = nested.beginParse();

    const minLpOut = n.loadCoins();

    const receiverAddress = n.loadAddress();

    const bothPositive = n.loadBit();

    const customGas = n.loadCoins();

    const nestedHasCustomPayload = n.loadBit();

    if (nestedHasCustomPayload) {
        n.loadRef();
    }

    return {
        rootBits: root.bits.length,
        rootRefs: root.refs.length,

        opcode,
        queryId,
        tonAmount,
        refundAddress,

        provideOpcode,
        routerWallet,
        refundProvide,
        excessesAddress,
        deadline,
        minLpOut,
        receiverAddress,
        bothPositive,
        customGas,

        hasCustomPayload:
            nestedHasCustomPayload,

        rootRemainingBits:
            s.remainingBits,

        rootRemainingRefs:
            s.remainingRefs,

        provideRemainingBits:
            p.remainingBits,

        provideRemainingRefs:
            p.remainingRefs,

        nestedRemainingBits:
            n.remainingBits,

        nestedRemainingRefs:
            n.remainingRefs,
    };
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    // ================================================================

    );

        POOL.toString()

    const poolContract =
        DEX.v2_2.Pool.CPI.create(POOL);

    const poolProvider =

        );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'POOL:',

    );

    console.log(

    );

        poolData.reserve1.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'TOKEN 0 WALLET:',

    );

    console.log(
        'TOKEN 1 WALLET:',

    );

    // ================================================================
    // 3. LIVE POOL ADDRESS CHECKS
    // ================================================================

    console.log('');

    console.log('3. LIVE POOL CHECKS');

    checkAddress(

    checkAddress(

        poolData.token1WalletAddress,

    );

    // ================================================================
    // 4. RESERVES
    // ================================================================

    const reserve0 =
        poolData.reserve0;

    const reserve1 =
        poolData.reserve1;

    const totalLp =
        poolData.totalSupplyLP;

    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log('4. RESERVE VALUES');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER RESERVE:',
        reserve0.toString()
    );

    console.log(

        Number(reserve0) / 1_000_000_000,

    );

    console.log(
        'pTON RESERVE:',
        reserve1.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON RESERVE DISPLAY:',

    console.log(

        totalLp.toString()
    );

    // ================================================================
    // 5. LP CALCULATION
    // ================================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log('5. LP CALCULATION');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------------');

    const lpFromRooster =
        (
            ROOSTER_AMOUNT *
            totalLp
        ) /
        reserve0;

    const lpFromPton =
        (
            PTON_AMOUNT *
            totalLp
        ) /
        reserve1;

    const expectedLp =

    const calculatedMinLpOut =

            : 'pTON'

        expectedLp.toString()
    );

    );

        'ROOSTER RESPONSE',
        rooster.responseDestination,
        USER
    );

    checkBigInt(
        'ROOSTER FORWARD TON',
        rooster.forwardTonAmount,
        ROOSTER_FORWARD_TON
    );

    checkAddress(
        'ROOSTER ROUTER pTON WALLET',
        rooster.routerWallet,
        ROUTER_PTON_WALLET
    );

    checkAddress(
        'ROOSTER RECEIVER',
        rooster.receiverAddress,
        USER
    );

    checkAddress(
        'ROOSTER REFUND',
        rooster.refundAddress,
        USER
    );

    checkAddress(
        'ROOSTER EXCESSES',
        rooster.excessesAddress,
        USER
    );

    checkBigInt(
        'ROOSTER MIN LP',

            0 &&

        rooster.provideRemainingBits ===
            0 &&

        rooster.provideRemainingRefs ===
            0 &&

        rooster.nestedRemainingBits ===
            0 &&

        rooster.nestedRemainingRefs ===
            0;

    const ptonOk =
        pton.opcode ===
            0x01f3835d &&

        pton.provideOpcode ===
            0x37c096df &&

        pton.tonAmount ===
            PTON_AMOUNT &&

        pton.refundAddress.equals(
            USER

        pton.routerWallet.equals(
            ROUTER_ROOSTER_WALLET
        ) &&

        pton.receiverAddress.equals(
            USER

            USER

        pton.excessesAddress.equals(
            USER
        ) &&

        pton.minLpOut ===
            EXPECTED_MIN_LP_OUT &&

        pton.bothPositive &&

const MIN_LP_OUT = 150109265n;


// ============================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================

function format9(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1000000000n;
    const fraction = (value % 1000000000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction.length > 0
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : `${whole}`;
}


function percentNumerator(
    numerator: bigint,
    denominator: bigint
): string {

    if (denominator === 0n) {
        return 'N/A';
    }

    const scaled =
        numerator * 10000n / denominator;

    const whole =
        scaled / 100n;

    const fraction =
        (scaled % 100n)
            .toString()
            .padStart(2, '0');

    return `${whole}.${fraction}%`;
}


function printCheck(
    label: string,
    result: boolean
) {
    console.log(
        `${result ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${label}`
    );
}

    );

    printCheck(
        'pTON amount = 0.000249908',
        PTON_AMOUNT === 249908n
    );

    printCheck(
        'Expected LP is positive',
        calculatedExpectedLp > 0n
    );

    printCheck(
        'minLpOut is below expected LP',
        MIN_LP_OUT <= calculatedExpectedLp
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 13. FINAL DECISION DATA
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' IMPORTANT VALUES');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Current ROOSTER reserve:');
    console.log(
        format9(poolData.reserve0)
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Current pTON reserve:');
    console.log(
        format9(poolData.reserve1)
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Current LP supply:');
    console.log(
        poolData.totalSupplyLP.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Calculated expected LP:');
    console.log(
        calculatedExpectedLp.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Configured minLpOut:');
    console.log(
        MIN_LP_OUT.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER input:');
    console.log(
        format9(ROOSTER_AMOUNT)
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON input:');
    console.log(
        format9(PTON_AMOUNT)
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 14. SAFETY STATUS
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' TRANSACTION SAFETY STATUS');
    console.log('============================================================');

import { Address, Cell, beginCell } from "@ton/core";
import { DEX } from "@ston-fi/sdk";
import * as fs from "fs";

const ROOSTER_MASTER =
  "EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx";

const USER_WALLET =
  "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix";

const ROUTER =
  "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3";

const PTON_MASTER =
  "EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S";

const ROUTER_PTON_WALLET =
  "EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3";

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 200073535827652n;
const MIN_LP_OUT = 300329052918n;

const EXPECTED_GAS = 300000000n;
const EXPECTED_FORWARD_GAS = 240000000n;

const BOC_FILE = "./final_v22_rooster_liquidity.boc";

function hashCell(cell: Cell): string {
  return cell.hash().toString("hex");
}

export async function run(provider: any) {
  console.log("==============================================");
  console.log(" STON.fi v2.2 SDK TX PARAMETER PREFLIGHT");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT");
  console.log("==============================================");

  const master = Address.parse(ROOSTER_MASTER);
  const user = Address.parse(USER_WALLET);
  const router = Address.parse(ROUTER);
  const ptonMaster = Address.parse(PTON_MASTER);
  const routerPtonWallet = Address.parse(ROUTER_PTON_WALLET);

  console.log("\n===== 1. DERIVE USER ROOSTER JETTON WALLET =====");

  const masterProvider = provider.provider(master);

  const result = await masterProvider.get("get_wallet_address", [
    {
      type: "slice",
      cell: beginCell()
        .storeAddress(user)
        .endCell(),
    },
  ]);

  const userJettonWallet = result.stack.readAddress();

  console.log("ROOSTER master:");
  console.log(master.toString());

  console.log("User wallet:");
  console.log(user.toString());

  console.log("Derived user ROOSTER Jetton Wallet:");
  console.log(userJettonWallet.toString());

  console.log("\n===== 2. VERIFY pTON MASTER -> ROUTER WALLET =====");

  const ptonMasterProvider = provider.provider(ptonMaster);

  const ptonResult = await ptonMasterProvider.get(
    "get_wallet_address",
    [
      {
        type: "slice",
        cell: beginCell()
          .storeAddress(router)
          .endCell(),
      },
    ]
  );

  const derivedRouterPtonWallet =
    ptonResult.stack.readAddress();

  console.log("pTON master:");
  console.log(ptonMaster.toString());

  console.log("Expected router pTON wallet:");
  console.log(routerPtonWallet.toString());

  console.log("Derived router pTON wallet:");
  console.log(derivedRouterPtonWallet.toString());

  const ptonWalletPass =
    derivedRouterPtonWallet.toString() ===
    routerPtonWallet.toString();

  console.log(
    "pTON router wallet:",
    ptonWalletPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  if (!ptonWalletPass) {
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.");
    return;
  }

  console.log("\n===== 3. SDK ROUTER =====");

  const routerContract =
    DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(router);

  console.log("Router:");
  console.log(routerContract.address.toString());

  console.log("\n===== 4. SDK getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams =====");

  const routerProvider = provider.provider(router);

  const txParams =
    await routerContract.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
      routerProvider,
      {
        userWalletAddress: user,
        sendTokenAddress: master,
        otherTokenAddress: ptonMaster,
        sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
        minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
        gasAmount: EXPECTED_GAS,
        forwardGasAmount: EXPECTED_FORWARD_GAS,
        transferExcessAddress: user,
      }
    );

  console.log("SDK transaction parameters generated.");

  console.log("\n----- SDK TX TO -----");
  console.log(txParams.to.toString());

  console.log("\n----- SDK TX VALUE -----");
  console.log(txParams.value.toString());

  console.log("\n===== 5. VERIFY TX DESTINATION =====");

  const destinationPass =
    txParams.to.toString() ===
    userJettonWallet.toString();

  console.log("Expected TX to:");
  console.log(userJettonWallet.toString());

  console.log("Actual SDK TX to:");
  console.log(txParams.to.toString());

  console.log(
    "TX destination:",
    destinationPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  console.log("\n===== 6. VERIFY GAS VALUE =====");

  const gasPass =
    BigInt(txParams.value.toString()) ===
    EXPECTED_GAS;

  console.log("Expected:", EXPECTED_GAS.toString());
  console.log("Actual:", txParams.value.toString());

  console.log(
    "Gas value:",
    gasPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  if (!txParams.body) {
    throw new Error(
      "SDK returned empty transaction body."
    );
  }

  const sdkBodyCell =
    Cell.fromBoc(txParams.body.toBoc())[0];

const sdkBodyBase64 =
  sdkBodyCell.toBoc().toString("base64");

const SDK_BOC_FILE =
  "./sdk_generated_v22_rooster_liquidity.boc";

fs.writeFileSync(
  SDK_BOC_FILE,
  sdkBodyBase64,
  "utf8"
);

console.log("\nSDK BOC saved:");
console.log(SDK_BOC_FILE);

console.log("SDK BOC base64:");
console.log(sdkBodyBase64);

  console.log("\n===== 7. SDK BODY =====");

  console.log("SDK body SHA256:");
  console.log(hashCell(sdkBodyCell));

  console.log("SDK body BOC chars:");
  console.log(
    sdkBodyCell.toBoc().toString("base64").length
  );

  console.log("SDK body BOC bytes:");
  console.log(
    sdkBodyCell.toBoc().length
  );

  console.log("\n===== 8. COMPARE PREPARED BOC =====");

  if (!fs.existsSync(BOC_FILE)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Prepared BOC not found: ${BOC_FILE}`
    );
  }

  const preparedBase64 =
    fs.readFileSync(BOC_FILE, "utf8").trim();

  const preparedBodyCell =
    Cell.fromBoc(
      Buffer.from(preparedBase64, "base64")
    )[0];

  const preparedHash =
    hashCell(preparedBodyCell);

  const sdkHash =
    hashCell(sdkBodyCell);

  console.log("Prepared BOC SHA256:");
  console.log(preparedHash);

  console.log("SDK body SHA256:");
  console.log(sdkHash);

  const bodyPass =
    preparedHash === sdkHash;

  console.log(
    "SDK body == prepared BOC:",
    bodyPass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"
  );

  console.log("\n===== 9. FINAL RESULT =====");

  const allPass =
    ptonWalletPass &&
    destinationPass &&
    gasPass &&
    bodyPass;

  if (!allPass) {
    console.log("STATUS: FAIL");
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.");
    return;
  }

  console.log("STATUS: PASS");
  console.log("");
  console.log(
    "pTON master -> router pTON wallet: PASS"
  );
  console.log(
    "TX destination = user ROOSTER Jetton Wallet: PASS"
  );
  console.log(
    "Gas value = 0.30 TON: PASS"
  );
  console.log(
    "SDK body = prepared BOC: PASS"
  );
  console.log("");
  console.log(
    "ALL READ-ONLY SDK PREFLIGHT CHECKS PASSED."
  );
  console.log("NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.");
}

function sameAddress(
    a: Address,
    b: Address
): boolean {
    return a.equals(b);
}


function pass(
    label: string,
    condition: boolean
): boolean {

    console.log(
        `${condition ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${label}`
    );

    return condition;
}


function nanoToTon(
    value: bigint
): number {

    return Number(value) / 1e9;
}


function sha256Hex(
    data: Buffer
): string {

    return createHash('sha256')
        .update(data)
        .digest('hex');
}


function shortHash(
    hash: string
): string {

    return (
        hash.slice(0, 16) +
        '...' +
        hash.slice(-16)
    );
}

        rLp.loadCoins();

        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER receiver = USER',
            sameAddress(
                rReceiver,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER bothPositive = true',
            rBothPositive === true
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER custom gas = 0',
            rCustomGas === 0n
        ) && allPass;


    // ========================================================
    // 8. BUILD pTON LEG
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        '8. BUILD FRESH pTON LEG'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );


    const ptonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams({

            userWalletAddress:
                USER,

            proxyTon:
                DEX.v2_2.pTON.create(
                    PTON_MASTER
                ),

            otherTokenAddress:
                ROOSTER_MASTER,

            sendAmount:
                PTON_AMOUNT,

            minLpOut:
                MIN_LP_OUT,

            receiverAddress:
                USER,

            refundAddress:
                USER,

            excessesAddress:
                USER,

            deadline,

        });


    console.log('TO:');

    console.log(
        ptonTx.to.toString()
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log('VALUE:');

    console.log(
        nanoToTon(
            BigInt(ptonTx.value)
        ),
        'TON'
    );


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON destination = pTON Pool wallet',
            sameAddress(
                ptonTx.to,
                POOL_PTON_WALLET
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON value correct',
            BigInt(ptonTx.value) ===
                PTON_TX_VALUE
        ) && allPass;


    if (!ptonTx.body) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: pTON body unavailable'
        );

    }


    // ========================================================
    // 9. pTON BOC
    // ========================================================

    const ptonBoc =
        ptonTx.body.toBoc();


    const ptonHash =
        sha256Hex(
            ptonBoc
        );


    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON BOC bytes:');

    console.log(
        ptonBoc.length
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON BOC SHA-256:');

    console.log(
        ptonHash
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON BOC hash short:');

    console.log(
        shortHash(
            ptonHash
        )
    );


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON BOC exists',
            ptonBoc.length > 0
        ) && allPass;


    // ========================================================
    // 10. DECODE pTON BOC
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        '10. pTON BOC DECODE'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );


    const p =
        ptonTx.body.beginParse();


    const pOpcode =
        p.loadUint(32);


    const pQuery =
        p.loadUint(64);


    const pAmount =
        p.loadCoins();


    const pRefund =
        p.loadAddress();


    const pForward =
        p.loadBit();


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON TON_TRANSFER opcode',
            pOpcode ===
                TON_TRANSFER_OPCODE
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON query ID = 0',
            pQuery === 0
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON amount',
            pAmount ===
                PTON_AMOUNT
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON refund = USER',
            sameAddress(
                pRefund,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON forward payload present',
            pForward === true
        ) && allPass;


    const pProvideRef =
        p.loadRef();


    const pProvide =
        pProvideRef.beginParse();


    const pProvideOpcode =
        pProvide.loadUint(32);


    const pOtherWallet =
        pProvide.loadAddress();


    const pRefundNested =
        pProvide.loadAddress();


    const pExcesses =
        pProvide.loadAddress();


    const pDeadline =
        pProvide.loadUint(64);


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON PROVIDE_LP opcode',
            pProvideOpcode ===
                PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON other wallet = ROOSTER Pool wallet',
            sameAddress(
                pOtherWallet,
                POOL_ROOSTER_WALLET
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON refund = USER',
            sameAddress(
                pRefundNested,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON excesses = USER',
            sameAddress(
                pExcesses,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON deadline',
            pDeadline ===
                deadline
        ) && allPass;


    const pLpRef =
        pProvide.loadRef();


    const pLp =
        pLpRef.beginParse();


    const pMinLp =
        pLp.loadCoins();


    const pReceiver =
        pLp.loadAddress();


    const pBothPositive =
        pLp.loadBit();


    const pCustomGas =
        pLp.loadCoins();


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON minLpOut',
            pMinLp ===
                MIN_LP_OUT
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON receiver = USER',
            sameAddress(
                pReceiver,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON bothPositive = true',
            pBothPositive === true
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON custom gas = 0',
            pCustomGas === 0n
        ) && allPass;


    // ========================================================
    // 11. FINAL CROSS CHECK
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        '11. FINAL CROSS-CHECK'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );


    allPass =
        pass(
            'Same USER receiver',
            sameAddress(
                rReceiver,
                pReceiver
            ) &&
            sameAddress(
                rReceiver,
                USER
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'Same minLpOut',
            rMinLp ===
                pMinLp &&
            rMinLp ===
                MIN_LP_OUT
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'Same deadline',
            rDeadline ===
                pDeadline &&
            rDeadline ===
                deadline
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER → pTON Pool wallet',
            sameAddress(
                rOtherWallet,
                POOL_PTON_WALLET
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON → ROOSTER Pool wallet',
            sameAddress(
                pOtherWallet,
                POOL_ROOSTER_WALLET
            )
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER TX value correct',
            BigInt(roosterTx.value) ===
                ROOSTER_TX_VALUE
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'pTON TX value correct',
            BigInt(ptonTx.value) ===
                PTON_TX_VALUE
        ) && allPass;


    allPass =
        pass(
            'Total TX value correct',
            BigInt(roosterTx.value) +
                BigInt(ptonTx.value) ===
                TOTAL_TX_VALUE
        ) && allPass;


    // ========================================================
    // 12. BALANCE SAFETY
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        '12. BALANCE SAFETY'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );


    const userState =
        await provider
            .provider(USER)
            .getState();


    const tonBalance =
        userState.balance;


    const remaining =
        tonBalance -
        TOTAL_TX_VALUE;


    console.log('Current TON:');

    console.log(
        nanoToTon(
            tonBalance
        )
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log('Total TX values:');

    console.log(
        nanoToTon(
            TOTAL_TX_VALUE
        )
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log('Remaining:');

    console.log(
        nanoToTon(
            remaining
        )
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log('Safety reserve:');

    console.log(
        nanoToTon(
            SAFETY_RESERVE
        )
    );


    allPass =
        pass(
            'Safety reserve remains >= 0.1 TON',
            remaining >=
                SAFETY_RESERVE
        ) && allPass;


    // ========================================================
    // 13. FINAL PAYLOAD SUMMARY
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        '13. FINAL PAYLOAD SUMMARY'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'ROOSTER LEG'
    );

    console.log(
        'TO:',
        roosterTx.to.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'VALUE:',
        nanoToTon(
            BigInt(roosterTx.value)
        ),
        'TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'BOC BYTES:',
        roosterBoc.length
    );

    console.log(
        'BOC SHA256:',
        roosterHash
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'pTON LEG'
    );

    console.log(
        'TO:',
        ptonTx.to.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'VALUE:',
        nanoToTon(
            BigInt(ptonTx.value)
        ),
        'TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'BOC BYTES:',
        ptonBoc.length
    );

    console.log(
        'BOC SHA256:',
        ptonHash
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 14. FINAL RESULT
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        '14. FINAL RESULT'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );


    if (allPass) {

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'STATUS: FINAL PAYLOADS VERIFIED'
        );

    } else {

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'STATUS: PAYLOAD REVIEW FAILED'
        );

    }


    // ========================================================
    // 15. ABSOLUTE SAFETY CONFIRMATION
    // ========================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        '15. SAFETY CONFIRMATION'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );


    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'send(): NOT CALLED'
    );

    console.log(
        'sender.send(): NOT CALLED'
    );

    console.log(
        'Tonkeeper approval: NOT REQUESTED'

    console.log(

    );

    console.log(

// ============================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================

function format9(value: bigint): string {

    const whole =
        value / 1000000000n;

    const fraction =
        (value % 1000000000n)
            .toString()
            .padStart(9, '0')
            .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction.length > 0
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : `${whole}`;
}


function pass(
    label: string,
    condition: boolean
): boolean {

    console.log(
        `${condition ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${label}`
    );

    return condition;
}


function section(
    title: string
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        ` ${title}`
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
}


function addressEqual(
    a: Address,
    b: Address
): boolean {

    return a.equals(b);
}


function bodyHash(
    body: Cell
): string {

    return crypto
        .createHash('sha256')
        .update(
            body.toBoc({
                idx: false
            })
        )
        .digest('hex');
}


function unixNow(): bigint {

    return BigInt(
        Math.floor(
            Date.now() / 1000
        )
    );
}


function iso(
    timestamp: bigint
): string {

    return new Date(
        Number(timestamp) * 1000
    ).toISOString();
}

const ptonBody =

        ) && allPass;

        format9(
            tonBalance - totalValue
        ),
        'TON'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 14. TRANSACTION DESTINATION CHECK
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '14. TRANSACTION DESTINATION CHECK'
    );


    allPass =
        pass(
            'ROOSTER TX goes to USER ROOSTER wallet',
            addressEqual(

    console.log(

        ptonTx.to.toString()

    console.log(

        poolData.token1WalletAddress.toString()
    );


    allPass =

            addressEqual(
                ptonTx.to,
                poolData.token1WalletAddress
            )
        ) && allPass;


    // ========================================================
    // 15. FINAL INPUT SUMMARY

        '15. FINAL INPUT SUMMARY'
    );

        'ROOSTER input:',

    );

    console.log(
        'pTON input:',
        format9(PTON_AMOUNT)
    );

    console.log(
        'minLpOut:',
        MIN_LP_OUT.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected LP:',
        expectedLp.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER TX value:',
        format9(roosterValue),
        'TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON TX value:',
        format9(ptonValue),
        'TON'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 16. FINAL STATUS
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '16. FINAL STATUS'
    );


    console.log('');


    if (allPass) {

        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );

        console.log(
            ' STATUS: READY TO SEND'
        );

        console.log(

        );

    } else {

        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );

        console.log(
            ' STATUS: NOT READY'
        );

        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );
    }


    // ========================================================
    // 17. ABSOLUTE SAFETY
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '17. SAFETY CONFIRMATION'
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'send(): NOT CALLED'
    );

    console.log(
        'wallet.send(): NOT CALLED'
    );

    );

    console.log(
        'Broadcast: NO'
    );

    console.log(
        'Wallet state change: NO'
    );

    console.log(
        'Pool state change: NO'
    );

    console.log('');

        'FINAL SEND PREFLIGHT FINISHED'

//
// PURPOSE:
// Build BOTH fresh SDK transactions and independently validate
// destinations, values, BOC bodies and cross-consistency.
// ============================================================

// ============================================================

);

// ============================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================

function sameAddress(
    a: Address,
    b: Address
): boolean {
    return a.equals(b);
}


function pass(
    label: string,
    condition: boolean
): boolean {

    console.log(
        `${condition ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${label}`
    );

    return condition;
}


function nanoToTon(
    value: bigint
): number {

    return Number(value) / 1e9;
}

// MAIN
// ============================================================

export async function run(

) {

    let allPass = true;

    );
