function section(title: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(64));
    console.log(title);
    console.log('='.repeat(64));
}

function pass(label: string) {
    console.log(`${label}: PASS`);
}

function fail(label: string, reason: string): never {
    console.log(`${label}: FAIL`);
    throw new Error(`FINAL GATE STOP: ${reason}`);
}

function sameAddress(
    a: Address,
    b: Address
): boolean {
    return a.toRawString() === b.toRawString();
}

function fmtTon(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1000000000n;
    const fraction = (value % 1000000000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0');

    return `${whole}.${fraction} TON`;
}

function sha256(buffer: Buffer): string {
    return crypto
        .createHash('sha256')
        .update(buffer)
        .digest('hex');
}

function createStorage() {
    return {
        async setItem(
            key: string,
            value: string
        ): Promise<void> {
            const dir = path.dirname(STORAGE_PATH);

            if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
                fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
            }

            let data: Record<string, string> = {};

            if (fs.existsSync(STORAGE_PATH)) {
                try {
                    data = JSON.parse(
                        fs.readFileSync(
                            STORAGE_PATH,
                            'utf8'
                        )
                    );
                } catch {
                    data = {};
                }
            }

            data[key] = value;

            fs.writeFileSync(
                STORAGE_PATH,
                JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)
            );
        },

        async getItem(
            key: string
        ): Promise<string | null> {
            if (!fs.existsSync(STORAGE_PATH)) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                const data: Record<string, string> =
                    JSON.parse(
                        fs.readFileSync(
                            STORAGE_PATH,
                            'utf8'
                        )
                    );

                return data[key] ?? null;
            } catch {
                return null;
            }
        },

        async removeItem(
            _key: string
        ): Promise<void> {
            /*
             * This gate never intentionally modifies
             * the TonConnect connection.
             */
        },
    };
}

function decodeJettonTransfer(body: Cell) {
    const s = body.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
    const amount = s.loadCoins();
    const destination = s.loadAddress();
    const responseDestination = s.loadAddress();

    const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

    if (hasCustomPayload) {
        s.loadRef();
    }

    const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();
    const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

    let forwardPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (hasForwardPayload) {
        forwardPayload = s.loadRef();
    }

    return {
        opcode,
        queryId,
        amount,
        destination,
        responseDestination,
        hasCustomPayload,
        forwardTonAmount,
        hasForwardPayload,
        forwardPayload,
    };
}

function decodeTonTransfer(body: Cell) {
    const s = body.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
    const amount = s.loadCoins();
    const refundAddress = s.loadAddress();

    const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

    let forwardPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (hasForwardPayload) {
        forwardPayload = s.loadRef();
    }

    return {
        opcode,
        queryId,
        amount,
        refundAddress,
        hasForwardPayload,
        forwardPayload,
    };
}
function decodeProvideLp(payload: Cell) {
    const s = payload.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    const routerWallet = s.loadAddress();
    const refundAddress = s.loadAddress();
    const excessesAddress = s.loadAddress();
    const deadline = s.loadUintBig(64);

    const nested = s.loadRef().beginParse();

    const minLpOut = nested.loadCoins();
    const receiverAddress = nested.loadAddress();
    const bothPositive = nested.loadBit();

    const customGas = nested.loadCoins();

    const hasCustomPayload = nested.loadBit();

    if (hasCustomPayload) {
        nested.loadRef();
    }

    return {
        opcode,
        routerWallet,
        refundAddress,
        excessesAddress,
        deadline,
        minLpOut,
        receiverAddress,
        bothPositive,
        customGas,
        hasCustomPayload,
    };
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        'STON.fi v2.2 FINAL TWO-MESSAGE READ-ONLY GATE'
    );
    console.log(
        '================================================================'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('MODE: FINAL READ ONLY');
    console.log('NETWORK: TESTNET');
    console.log('SEND: NO');
    console.log('APPROVAL: NO');
    console.log('BROADCAST: NO');
    console.log('STATE CHANGE: NO');

    section('1. TONCONNECT WALLET CAPABILITY');

    if (!fs.existsSync(STORAGE_PATH)) {
        fail(
            'TonConnect storage',
            'Storage file not found.'
        );
    }

    const connector = new TonConnect({
        storage: createStorage(),
        manifestUrl: MANIFEST_URL,
    });

    await connector.restoreConnection();

    if (!connector.wallet) {
        fail(
            'TonConnect connection',
            'No restored wallet.'
        );
    }

    const wallet = connector.wallet as any;

    const connectedAddress =
        wallet.account?.address;

    if (!connectedAddress) {
        fail(
            'Wallet address',
            'Wallet did not report an account address.'
        );
    }

    const connectedUser =
        Address.parse(connectedAddress);

    console.log(
        `Connected wallet: ${connectedUser.toString({
            bounceable: true,
            testOnly: true,
        })}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Expected wallet: ${USER.toString({
            bounceable: true,
            testOnly: true,
        })}`
    );

    if (!sameAddress(connectedUser, USER)) {
        fail(
            'Wallet identity',
            'Connected wallet does not match USER.'
        );
    }

    pass('Wallet identity');

    if (
        wallet.account?.chain !==
        CHAIN.TESTNET
    ) {
        fail(
            'TESTNET',
            `Wallet chain is ${wallet.account?.chain}, expected ${CHAIN.TESTNET}.`
        );
    }

    pass('TESTNET');

    const features =
        wallet.device?.features;

    if (!Array.isArray(features)) {
        fail(
            'Wallet features',
            'device.features is unavailable.'
        );
    }

    const sendFeature =
        features.find(
            (feature: any) =>
                feature?.name ===
                'SendTransaction'
        );

    if (!sendFeature) {
        fail(
            'SendTransaction capability',
            'Wallet does not advertise SendTransaction.'
        );
    }

    const maxMessages =
        Number(sendFeature.maxMessages);

    console.log(
        `Wallet maxMessages: ${maxMessages}`
    );

    if (
        !Number.isFinite(maxMessages) ||
        maxMessages < 2
    ) {
        fail(
            'Two-message capability',
            'Wallet does not advertise support for 2 messages.'
        );
    }

    pass('Two-message capability');

    section('2. STON.fi v2.2 ROUTER');

    const router =
        provider.open(
            DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(
                ROUTER_ADDRESS
            )
        );

    const routerData =
        await router.getRouterData();

    const routerVersion =
        await router.getRouterVersion();

    console.log(
        `Router: ${ROUTER_ADDRESS.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Router ID: ${routerData.routerId}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Version: ${JSON.stringify(routerVersion)}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Locked: ${routerData.isLocked}`
    );

    if (
        routerVersion.major !== 2 ||
        routerVersion.minor !== 2
    ) {
        fail(
            'Router version',
            'Router is not v2.2.'
        );
    }

    pass('Router v2.2');

    if (routerData.isLocked) {
        fail(
            'Router unlocked',
            'Router is locked.'
        );
    }

    pass('Router unlocked');

    section('3. LIVE POOL');

    const pool =
        await router.getPool({
            token0: ROOSTER_MASTER,
            token1: PTON_MASTER,
        });

    console.log(
        `Resolved pool: ${pool.address.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Expected pool: ${EXPECTED_POOL.toString()}`
    );

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            pool.address,
            EXPECTED_POOL
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'Pool identity',
            'Resolved pool does not match expected pool.'
        );
    }

    pass('Pool identity');

    /*
     * IMPORTANT:
     * router.getPool() returns a CPIPoolV2_2 contract object,
     * not a bare Address.
     */
    const poolContract =
        provider.open(pool);

    const poolData =
        await poolContract.getPoolData();

    console.log(
        `Pool router: ${poolData.routerAddress.toString()}`
    );

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            poolData.routerAddress,
            ROUTER_ADDRESS
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'Pool router',
            'Pool router does not match v2.2 router.'
        );
    }

    pass('Pool router');

    console.log(
        `Pool locked: ${poolData.isLocked}`
    );

    if (poolData.isLocked) {
        fail(
            'Pool unlocked',
            'Pool is locked.'
        );
    }

    pass('Pool unlocked');

    section('4. POOL TOKEN WALLET CONSISTENCY');

    const poolToken0 =
        poolData.token0WalletAddress;

    const poolToken1 =
        poolData.token1WalletAddress;

    console.log(
        `Pool token0 wallet: ${poolToken0.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Expected ROOSTER pool wallet: ${EXPECTED_POOL_ROOSTER_WALLET.toString()}`
    );

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            poolToken0,
            EXPECTED_POOL_ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER pool wallet',
            'Pool token0 wallet mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER pool wallet');

    console.log(
        `Pool token1 wallet: ${poolToken1.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Expected pTON pool wallet: ${EXPECTED_POOL_PTON_WALLET.toString()}`
    );

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            poolToken1,
            EXPECTED_POOL_PTON_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON pool wallet',
            'Pool token1 wallet mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON pool wallet');

    section('5. LIVE RESERVES AND LP CALCULATION');

    console.log(
        `ROOSTER reserve: ${poolData.reserve0}`
    );

    console.log(
        `pTON reserve: ${poolData.reserve1}`
    );

    console.log(
        `LP total supply: ${poolData.totalSupplyLP}`
    );

    const currentLpFromRooster =
        (
            ROOSTER_AMOUNT *
            poolData.totalSupplyLP
        ) /
        poolData.reserve0;

    const currentLpFromPton =
        (
            PTON_AMOUNT *
            poolData.totalSupplyLP
        ) /
        poolData.reserve1;

    const expectedLp =
        currentLpFromRooster <
        currentLpFromPton
            ? currentLpFromRooster
            : currentLpFromPton;

    console.log(
        `ROOSTER-side expected LP: ${currentLpFromRooster}`
    );

    console.log(
        `pTON-side expected LP: ${currentLpFromPton}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Limiting expected LP: ${expectedLp}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Configured minLpOut: ${MIN_LP_OUT}`
    );

    if (
        MIN_LP_OUT > expectedLp
    ) {
        fail(
            'minLpOut safety',
            'Configured minLpOut exceeds current expected LP.'
        );
    }

    pass('minLpOut safety');

    section('6. LIVE USER BALANCES');

    const roosterMaster =
        provider.open(
            JettonMaster.create(
                ROOSTER_MASTER
            )
        );

    const userRoosterWallet =
        await roosterMaster.getWalletAddress(
            USER
        );

    console.log(
        `Resolved user ROOSTER wallet: ${userRoosterWallet.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Expected user ROOSTER wallet: ${EXPECTED_USER_ROOSTER_WALLET.toString()}`
    );

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            userRoosterWallet,
            EXPECTED_USER_ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'User ROOSTER wallet',
            'Resolved wallet mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('User ROOSTER wallet');

    /*
     * IMPORTANT:
     * userRoosterWallet is an Address.
     * provider.open() requires a Contract.
     */
    const userRoosterContract =
    provider.open(
        JettonWallet.create(
            userRoosterWallet
        )
    );

const roosterBalance =
    await userRoosterContract.getBalance();

console.log(
    `User ROOSTER balance: ${roosterBalance}`
);

if (
    roosterBalance <
    ROOSTER_AMOUNT
) {
    fail(
        'ROOSTER balance',
        'Insufficient ROOSTER.'
    );
}

pass('ROOSTER balance');

    const userState =
        await provider.provider(
            USER
        ).getState();

    const tonBalance =
        userState.balance;

    console.log(
        `User TON balance: ${fmtTon(tonBalance)}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Required TX total: ${fmtTon(EXPECTED_TOTAL_TX_VALUE)}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Extra reserve: ${fmtTon(EXTRA_TON_RESERVE)}`
    );

    const minimumRequired =
        EXPECTED_TOTAL_TX_VALUE +
        EXTRA_TON_RESERVE;

    console.log(
        `Minimum recommended balance: ${fmtTon(minimumRequired)}`
    );

    if (
        tonBalance <
        minimumRequired
    ) {
        fail(
            'TON balance',
            'TON balance does not cover both transactions plus reserve.'
        );
    }

    pass('TON balance');

    section('7. FRESH DEADLINE');

    const now =
        Math.floor(
            Date.now() / 1000
        );

    const deadline =
        now + 600;

    console.log(
        `Current Unix: ${now}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Fresh deadline: ${deadline}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Validity: ${deadline - now} seconds`
    );

    if (
        deadline <= now
    ) {
        fail(
            'Deadline',
            'Deadline is not in the future.'
        );
    }

    pass('Deadline');

    section('8. BUILD FRESH ROOSTER LEG');

    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams({
            userWalletAddress: USER,
            sendTokenAddress: ROOSTER_MASTER,
            otherTokenAddress: PTON_MASTER,
            sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
            minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
            receiverAddress: USER,
            refundAddress: USER,
            excessesAddress: USER,
            deadline,
        });

    console.log(
        `ROOSTER TO: ${roosterTx.to.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `ROOSTER VALUE: ${fmtTon(roosterTx.value)}`
    );

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterTx.to,
            EXPECTED_USER_ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER destination',
            'ROOSTER outer destination mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER destination');

    if (
        BigInt(roosterTx.value) !==
        EXPECTED_ROOSTER_TX_VALUE
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER value',
            'ROOSTER transaction value mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER value');

    section('9. BUILD FRESH pTON LEG');

    const proxyTon =
        pTON.v2_1.create(
            PTON_MASTER
        );

    const ptonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams({
            userWalletAddress: USER,
            otherTokenAddress: ROOSTER_MASTER,
            sendAmount: PTON_AMOUNT,
            minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
            receiverAddress: USER,
            refundAddress: USER,
            excessesAddress: USER,
            deadline,
            proxyTon,
        });

    console.log(
        `pTON TO: ${ptonTx.to.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `pTON VALUE: ${fmtTon(ptonTx.value)}`
    );

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            ptonTx.to,
            EXPECTED_POOL_PTON_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON destination',
            'pTON outer destination mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON destination');

    if (
        BigInt(ptonTx.value) !==
        EXPECTED_PTON_TX_VALUE
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON value',
            'pTON transaction value mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON value');

    section('10. SERIALIZE FRESH BOCS');

    if (!roosterTx.body) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER body',
            'SDK returned no ROOSTER payload body.'
        );
    }

    if (!ptonTx.body) {
        fail(
            'pTON body',
            'SDK returned no pTON payload body.'
        );
    }

    const roosterBody =
        roosterTx.body;

    const ptonBody =
        ptonTx.body;

    const roosterBoc =
        roosterBody.toBoc();

    const ptonBoc =
        ptonBody.toBoc();

    console.log(
        `ROOSTER BOC bytes: ${roosterBoc.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `ROOSTER SHA256: ${sha256(roosterBoc)}`
    );

    console.log(
        `pTON BOC bytes: ${ptonBoc.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `pTON SHA256: ${sha256(ptonBoc)}`
    );

    if (
        roosterBoc.length !== 264
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER BOC size',
            'Unexpected ROOSTER BOC size.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER BOC size');

    if (
        ptonBoc.length !== 224
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON BOC size',
            'Unexpected pTON BOC size.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON BOC size');

    section('11. DECODE ROOSTER BOC');

    const roosterTransfer =
        decodeJettonTransfer(
            roosterBody
        );

    console.log(
        `Opcode: 0x${roosterTransfer.opcode.toString(16)}`
    );

    if (
        roosterTransfer.opcode !==
        JETTON_TRANSFER_OPCODE
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER transfer opcode',
            'Unexpected opcode.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER transfer opcode');

    if (
        roosterTransfer.amount !==
        ROOSTER_AMOUNT
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER amount',
            'Unexpected ROOSTER amount.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER amount');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterTransfer.destination,
            ROUTER_ADDRESS
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER nested destination',
            'ROOSTER transfer does not point to router.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER nested destination');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterTransfer.responseDestination,
            USER
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER response address',
            'ROOSTER response destination mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER response address');

    if (
        roosterTransfer.hasCustomPayload
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER custom payload',
            'Unexpected custom payload.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER custom payload');

    if (
        roosterTransfer.forwardTonAmount !==
        235000000n
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER forward TON',
            'Unexpected forward TON amount.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER forward TON');

    if (
        !roosterTransfer.hasForwardPayload ||
        !roosterTransfer.forwardPayload
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER forward payload',
            'Forward payload is missing.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER forward payload');

    const roosterProvide =
        decodeProvideLp(
            roosterTransfer.forwardPayload
        );

    if (
        roosterProvide.opcode !==
        PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER PROVIDE_LP opcode',
            'Unexpected PROVIDE_LP opcode.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER PROVIDE_LP opcode');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterProvide.routerWallet,
            EXPECTED_POOL_PTON_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER router wallet',
            'ROOSTER leg does not point to pTON pool wallet.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER router wallet');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterProvide.refundAddress,
            USER
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER refund',
            'Refund address mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER refund');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterProvide.excessesAddress,
            USER
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER excesses',
            'Excesses address mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER excesses');

    if (
        roosterProvide.deadline !==
        BigInt(deadline)
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER deadline',
            'Deadline mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER deadline');

    if (
        roosterProvide.minLpOut !==
        MIN_LP_OUT
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER minLpOut',
            'minLpOut mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER minLpOut');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterProvide.receiverAddress,
            USER
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER receiver',
            'Receiver mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER receiver');

    if (
        !roosterProvide.bothPositive
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER bothPositive',
            'bothPositive is not true.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER bothPositive');

    if (
        roosterProvide.customGas !==
        0n
    ) {
        fail(
            'ROOSTER custom gas',
            'Unexpected custom gas.'
        );
    }

    pass('ROOSTER custom gas');

    section('12. DECODE pTON BOC');

    const ptonTransfer =
        decodeTonTransfer(
            ptonBody
        );

    console.log(
        `Opcode: 0x${ptonTransfer.opcode.toString(16)}`
    );

    if (
        ptonTransfer.opcode !==
        TON_TRANSFER_OPCODE
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON TON_TRANSFER opcode',
            'Unexpected opcode.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON TON_TRANSFER opcode');

    if (
        ptonTransfer.queryId !==
        0n
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON queryId',
            'Expected queryId 0.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON queryId');

    if (
        ptonTransfer.amount !==
        PTON_AMOUNT
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON amount',
            'Unexpected pTON amount.'
        );
    }

      pass('pTON amount');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            ptonTransfer.refundAddress,
            USER
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON refund address',
            'pTON refund address mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON refund address');

if (
    !ptonTransfer.hasForwardPayload ||
    !ptonTransfer.forwardPayload
) {
    fail(
        'pTON forward payload',
        'Forward payload is missing.'
    );
}
    

    pass('pTON forward payload');

    const ptonProvide =
        decodeProvideLp(
            ptonTransfer.forwardPayload
        );

    if (
        ptonProvide.opcode !==
        PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON PROVIDE_LP opcode',
            'Unexpected PROVIDE_LP opcode.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON PROVIDE_LP opcode');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            ptonProvide.routerWallet,
            EXPECTED_POOL_ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON router wallet',
            'pTON leg does not point to ROOSTER pool wallet.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON router wallet');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            ptonProvide.refundAddress,
            USER
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON refund',
            'Refund address mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON refund');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            ptonProvide.excessesAddress,
            USER
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON excesses',
            'Excesses address mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON excesses');

    if (
        ptonProvide.deadline !==
        BigInt(deadline)
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON deadline',
            'Deadline mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON deadline');

    if (
        ptonProvide.minLpOut !==
        MIN_LP_OUT
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON minLpOut',
            'minLpOut mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON minLpOut');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            ptonProvide.receiverAddress,
            USER
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON receiver',
            'Receiver mismatch.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON receiver');

    if (
        !ptonProvide.bothPositive
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON bothPositive',
            'bothPositive is not true.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON bothPositive');

    if (
        ptonProvide.customGas !==
        0n
    ) {
        fail(
            'pTON custom gas',
            'Unexpected custom gas.'
        );
    }

    pass('pTON custom gas');

    section('13. CROSS-LEG CONSISTENCY');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterProvide.refundAddress,
            ptonProvide.refundAddress
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'Same refund address',
            'Refund addresses differ.'
        );
    }

    pass('Same refund address');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterProvide.excessesAddress,
            ptonProvide.excessesAddress
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'Same excesses address',
            'Excesses addresses differ.'
        );
    }

    pass('Same excesses address');

    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterProvide.receiverAddress,
            ptonProvide.receiverAddress
        )
    ) {
        fail(
            'Same receiver',
            'Receiver addresses differ.'
        );
    }

    pass('Same receiver');

    if (

function addressEqual(a: Address | null, b: Address): boolean {
    return a !== null && a.equals(b);
}

function pass(label: string, ok: boolean, detail = '') {
    console.log(
        `${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | ${label}${detail ? ` | ${detail}` : ''}`,
    );
}

function showAddress(label: string, actual: Address | null) {
    console.log(`${label}: ${actual?.toString() ?? 'null'}`);
}

function loadBoc(file: string): Cell {
    if (!fs.existsSync(file)) {
        throw new Error(`Missing BOC: ${file}`);
    }

    const data = fs.readFileSync(file);

    const magic = data.readUInt32BE(0);

    pass(
        `${path.basename(file)} BOC magic`,
        magic === 0xb5ee9c72,
    );

    const cells = Cell.fromBoc(data);

    if (cells.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(
            `${path.basename(file)}: expected one root cell, got ${cells.length}`,
        );
    }

    return cells[0];
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 0x093e6b;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readS32(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value -= 2 ** (shift + 7);

      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 122;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findBodies() {
  let p = 8;
  let imported = 0;
  const bodies: { start: number; end: number }[] = [];

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const section = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    const start = s.next;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (section === 2) {
      let q = start;
      const n = uleb(q);
      q = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const ml = uleb(q);
        q = ml.next + ml.value;

        const nl = uleb(q);
        q = nl.next + nl.value;

        const kind = wasm[q++];

        if (kind === 0) {
          imported++;
          const t = uleb(q);
          q = t.next;
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (section === 10) {
      let q = start;
      const n = uleb(q);
      q = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const bs = uleb(q);
        const bodyStart = bs.next;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bs.value;

        bodies.push({
          start: bodyStart,
          end: bodyEnd,
        });

        q = bodyEnd;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return { imported, bodies };
}

const { imported, bodies } = findBodies();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 122 — CONSTANT ARGUMENT PAIRS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let hits = 0;

for (let bi = 0; bi < bodies.length; bi++) {

  const { start, end } = bodies[bi];
  const func = imported + bi;

  for (let p = start; p < end - 1; p++) {

    if (wasm[p] !== 0x41)
      continue;

    const a = uleb(p + 1);

    if (wasm[a.next] !== 0x41)
      continue;

    const b = uleb(a.next + 1);

    if (wasm[b.next] !== 0x10)
      continue;

    const c = uleb(b.next + 1);

    if (c.value !== TARGET)
      continue;

    hits++;

    console.log(
      `FUNC ${func}  @ 0x${p.toString(16)}  ` +
      `CONST1=${a.value}  CONST2=${b.value}  CALL=122`
    );
  }
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log(`TOTAL : ${hits}`);
console.log("============================================================");

function u32LE(pos) {
  if (pos + 4 > buf.length) return null;

  return (
    (buf[pos]) |
    (buf[pos + 1] << 8) |
    (buf[pos + 2] << 16) |
    (buf[pos + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/*
 * Search raw little-endian addresses in the entire WASM.
 *
 * This catches:
 *
 *   1C 01 19 00  -> 0x19011C
 *   EC 01 19 00  -> 0x1901EC
 *
 * for direct embedded addresses.
 */

console.log("");
console.log("RAW ADDRESS REFERENCES");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let rawCount = 0;

for (let addr = BASE; addr <= END; addr += 4) {

  const pattern = Buffer.alloc(4);

  pattern.writeUInt32LE(addr, 0);

  for (let p = 0; p <= buf.length - 4; p++) {

    if (
      buf[p] === pattern[0] &&
      buf[p + 1] === pattern[1] &&
      buf[p + 2] === pattern[2] &&
      buf[p + 3] === pattern[3]
    ) {

      rawCount++;

      console.log(

        hex(addr),
        "FOUND AT FILE",
        hex(p),
        addr === TARGET ? " <-- TARGET 4275" : ""
      );
    }
  }
}

/*
 * Search WASM code for i32.const values corresponding
 * to the table memory addresses.
 *
 * We scan for:
 *
 *   41 <signed LEB32>
 *
 * This avoids assuming a fixed byte representation.
 */

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readSLEB(pos) {

  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {

    const b = buf[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {

      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << (shift + 7));
      }

      return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const BASE = 0x195348;
const END  = 0x19535c;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    n++;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };

    s += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0, x;

  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    n++;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v | 0, len: n };
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function targetName(v) {
  const x = v >>> 0;

  if (x === 0x195348) return "BASE";
  if (x === 0x19534c) return "TARGET_19534C";
  if (x === 0x195350) return "195350";
  if (x === 0x195354) return "195354";
  if (x === 0x195358) return "195358";

  return null;
}

 * then inspect nearby store instructions.

  const limit = Math.min(b.length, p + 96);

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x0019534c;

// Known target-derived offsets.
// We are interested in patterns such as:
//   i32.const TARGET
//   ... local.set/tee
//   local.get
//   i32.const offset
//   i32.add
//   i32.store
//
// and:
//   local.get X
//   i32.const delta
//   i32.add
//   i32.store

const MAX_BACK = 96;

function readULEB(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let n = 0;

  while (p + n < b.length) {
    const x = b[p + n++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("INDIRECT WRITERS FOR 0x19534C");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(`TARGET : ${hex(TARGET)}`);

let candidates = 0;

for (let p = 0; p < b.length; p++) {

  // Look for i32.store / store16 / store8.
  // 0x36 = i32.store
  // 0x3b = i32.store8/16 family
  if (b[p] !== 0x36 && b[p] !== 0x3a && b[p] !== 0x3b)
    continue;

  const op = b[p];

  const align = b[p + 1];
  const r = readULEB(p + 2);
  if (!r) continue;

  const offset = r.value;

  // Inspect preceding MAX_BACK bytes for TARGET constant.
  const start = Math.max(0, p - MAX_BACK);

  let targetPos = -1;

  for (let q = start; q < p; q++) {
    if (b[q] !== 0x41) continue;

    const x = readULEB(q + 1);

    if (x && x.value === TARGET) {
      targetPos = q;
    }
  }

  if (targetPos < 0) continue;

  // Confirm that target constant is reasonably close.
  candidates++;

  console.log(
    `\nCANDIDATE ${candidates}`
  );
  console.log(
    `STORE @ ${hex(p)} opcode=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
    `align=${align} offset=${offset}`
  );
  console.log(
    `TARGET CONST @ ${hex(targetPos)}`
  );

  const s = Math.max(0, targetPos - 8);
  const e = Math.min(b.length, p + 12);

  console.log(
    Array.from(b.slice(s, e))
      .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join(" ")
  );
}

console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(72));
console.log(`CANDIDATES : ${candidates}`);
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("DONE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0;
  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    n++;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };
    s += 7;
  }
  return null;
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    n++;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v | 0, len: n };
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readName(op) {
  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    const r = uleb(pos);
    if (!r) return null;
    pos += r.len;
    return r.value;
  }
  return null;
}

/*
 * This scanner deliberately starts from the two already-proven
 * references to TARGET:
 *
 * FUNC 122  @ 0x0000eece
 * FUNC 2057 @ 0x00093e6b
 *
 * Then follows the local stack backwards toward the store.
 */

const refs = [
  { func: 122, ref: 0x0000eece, end: 0x0000ef40 },
  { func: 2057, ref: 0x00093e6b, end: 0x00093ec0 }
];

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("0x19534C STORE DATA-FLOW");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(`TARGET : ${hx(TARGET)}`);
console.log("");

for (const R of refs) {

  console.log("-".repeat(72));
  console.log(`FUNC ${R.func}`);
  console.log(`TARGET CONST : ${hx(R.ref)}`);
  console.log(`SCAN         : ${hx(R.ref)} .. ${hx(R.end)}`);
  console.log("-".repeat(72));

  let p = R.ref;

  while (p < R.end) {

    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    let text = `${hx(at)}  ${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;

      text += `  i32.const ${r.value} (${hx(r.value)})`;

      if ((r.value >>> 0) === TARGET)
        text += "  <<< TARGET";

    } else if (op === 0x20) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      text += `  local.get ${r.value}`;

    } else if (op === 0x21) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      text += `  local.set ${r.value}`;

    } else if (op === 0x22) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      text += `  local.tee ${r.value}`;

    } else if (op === 0x28) {
      const a = b[p++];
      const r = uleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      text += `  i32.load align=${a} offset=${r.value}`;

    } else if (op === 0x36) {
      const a = b[p++];
      const r = uleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;

      text += `  i32.store align=${a} offset=${r.value}`;

      console.log(text);

      /*
       * Print a larger backward window around every store.
       * This lets us see whether TARGET is actually the address
       * consumed by this store.
       */
      const lo = Math.max(R.ref, at - 28);

      console.log("  BACKTRACE WINDOW:");

      let q = lo;

      while (q < at) {

        const qa = q;
        const qo = b[q++];

        let qs =
          `    ${hx(qa)}  ${qo.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;

        if (qo === 0x41) {
          const z = sleb(q);
          if (!z) break;
          q += z.len;
          qs += `  i32.const ${z.value} (${hx(z.value)})`;

          if ((z.value >>> 0) === TARGET)
            qs += "  <<< TARGET";

        } else if (qo === 0x20) {
          const z = uleb(q);
          if (!z) break;
          q += z.len;
          qs += `  local.get ${z.value}`;

        } else if (qo === 0x21) {
          const z = uleb(q);
          if (!z) break;
          q += z.len;
          qs += `  local.set ${z.value}`;

        } else if (qo === 0x22) {
          const z = uleb(q);
          if (!z) break;
          q += z.len;
          qs += `  local.tee ${z.value}`;

        } else if (qo === 0x28 || qo === 0x36) {
          const al = b[q++];
          const z = uleb(q);
          if (!z) break;
          q += z.len;

          qs +=
            `  ${qo === 0x28 ? "i32.load" : "i32.store"}` +
            ` align=${al} offset=${z.value}`;

        } else if (qo === 0x6a) {
          qs += "  i32.add";

        } else if (qo === 0x6b) {
          qs += "  i32.sub";

        } else {
          qs += "  opcode";
        }

        console.log(qs);
      }

      console.log("");
      continue;

    } else if (op === 0x6a) {
      text += "  i32.add";

    } else if (op === 0x6b) {
      text += "  i32.sub";

    } else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      text += `  call ${r.value}`;

    } else if (op === 0x0d) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      text += `  br_if ${r.value}`;

    } else if (op === 0x0c) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      text += `  br ${r.value}`;

    } else if (op === 0x0b) {
      text += "  end";
    }

    console.log(text);
  }

  console.log("");
}

console.log("IMPORTANT");
console.log("A store is a TRUE DIRECT TARGET WRITER only when");
console.log("the address operand reaching i32.store is proven to be");

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8, code = null;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const [n, q] = u(p);
  p = q;
  if (id === 10) code = [p, p + n];
  p += n;
}

p = code[0];
const [count, q0] = u(p);
p = q0;

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  const [size, q] = u(p);
  p = q;

  const func = 83 + i;
  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  for (let x = start; x < end; x++) {
    if (b[x] !== 0x36) continue; // i32.store

    // Search backward only for an exact i32.const TARGET
    let found = false;

    for (let z = x - 1; z >= Math.max(start, x - 50); z--) {
      if (b[z] !== 0x41) continue;

      const [v, qv] = u(z + 1);

      if (v === TARGET) {
        console.log(`FUNC ${func} STORE @ 0x${x.toString(16)}`);
        console.log(`TARGET CONST @ 0x${z.toString(16)}`);

        console.log(
          [...b.subarray(Math.max(start, z - 20), Math.min(end, x + 12))]
            .map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
            .join(" ")
        );

        console.log("--------------------------------------------");
        found = true;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

while (p < b.length) {

        found = true;
        break;

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sections() {
  let p = 8, code = null;
  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const [n, q] = uleb(p);
    p = q;
    if (id === 10) code = [p, p + n];
    p += n;
  }
  return code;
}

const code = sections();
let p = code[0];
const [count, q0] = uleb(p);
p = q0;

const TARGET = 0x195354;
let total = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  const [size, q] = uleb(p);
  p = q;

  const func = 83 + i;
  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  for (let x = start; x < end; x++) {
    if (b[x] !== 0x41) continue;

    const [value, qv] = uleb(x + 1);

    if (value !== TARGET) continue;

    for (let y = qv; y < Math.min(end, qv + 40); y++) {
      if (b[y] === 0x36 || b[y] === 0x37 || b[y] === 0x38 || b[y] === 0x39) {
        console.log(
          `FUNC ${func} CONST @ 0x${x.toString(16)} ` +
          `STORE @ 0x${y.toString(16)} ` +
          `OP=0x${b[y].toString(16)}`
        );

        const from = Math.max(start, x - 8);
        const to = Math.min(end, y + 8);

        console.log(
          [...b.subarray(from, to)]
            .map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
            .join(" ")
        );
        console.log("--------------------------------------------");

        total++;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

console.log("TOTAL :", total);

FILE: scripts\find1953Writes.ts

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [0x195350, 0x195354];

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function findSection(id: number) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const sid = wasm[p++];
        const s = readULEB(p);
        p = s.next;

        if (sid === id) {
            return { start: p, end: p + s.value };
        }

        p += s.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

function parseCode() {
    const sec = findSection(10);
    let p = sec.start;

    const c = readULEB(p);
    p = c.next;

    const bodies: any[] = [];

    for (let ord = 0; ord < c.value; ord++) {
        const size = readULEB(p);
        p = size.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

        const locals = readULEB(p);
        p = locals.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {
            const n = readULEB(p);
            p = n.next;
            p++;
        }

        const codeStart = p;

        bodies.push({
            ord,
            globalFunc: ord + 83,
            bodyStart,
            codeStart,
            bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

const bodies = parseCode();

console.log("FIND WRITES TO 0x195350 / 0x195354");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const target of TARGETS) {
    console.log("");
    console.log(`TARGET = 0x${target.toString(16)} (${target})`);
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    let found = 0;

    for (const body of bodies) {
        let p = body.codeStart;

        while (p < body.bodyEnd) {
            const at = p;
            const op = wasm[p++];

            /*
             * i32.const target
             */
            if (op === 0x41) {
                const x = readSLEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                if ((x.value >>> 0) === target) {
                    const from = Math.max(body.codeStart, at - 8);
                    const to = Math.min(body.bodyEnd, p + 16);

                    console.log(
                        `CONST TARGET in FUNC ${body.globalFunc}` +
                        ` @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `  context 0x${from.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}` +
                        ` .. 0x${to.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
                    );

                    found++;
                }

                continue;
            }

            /*
             * Skip immediates
             */
            switch (op) {
                case 0x10: { // call
                    const x = readULEB(p);
                    p = x.next;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x11: { // call_indirect
                    const t = readULEB(p);
                    p = t.next;

                    const table = readULEB(p);
                    p = table.next;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x20:
                case 0x21:
                case 0x22: {
                    const x = readULEB(p);
                    p = x.next;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x28:
                case 0x29:
                case 0x2a:
                case 0x2b:
                case 0x2c:
                case 0x2d:
                case 0x2e:
                case 0x2f:
                case 0x36:
                case 0x37:
                case 0x38:
                case 0x39: {
                    const a = readULEB(p);
                    p = a.next;

                    const o = readULEB(p);
                    p = o.next;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x41: {
                    const x = readSLEB(p);
                    p = x.next;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x42: {
                    const x = readSLEB(p);
                    p = x.next;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x43:
                    p += 4;
                    break;

                case 0x44:
                    p += 8;
                    break;

                case 0x02:
                case 0x03:
                case 0x04: {
                    p++;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0c:
                case 0x0d: {
                    const x = readULEB(p);
                    p = x.next;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0e: {
                    const n = readULEB(p);
                    p = n.next;

                    for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
                        const x = readULEB(p);
                        p = x.next;
                    }
                    break;
                }

                case 0x3f:
                case 0x40:
                    p++;
                    break;

                default:
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    console.log(`TOTAL DIRECT CONST REFERENCES = ${found}`);
}

console.log("");
console.log("IMPORTANT");
console.log("This scan identifies constant references.");
console.log("Next step is to identify STORE instructions whose effective address");
console.log("is 0x195350 or 0x195354.");
console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("READ ONLY - NO EXECUTION - NO TRANSACTION");

import fs from "fs";

const file = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 0x25100c;

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

function u32(p: number) {
  return (
    (b[p] |
      (b[p + 1] << 8) |
      (b[p + 2] << 16) |
      (b[p + 3] << 24)) >>>
    0
  );
}

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    n++;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

// Find raw little-endian i32.const TARGET:
// 41 <ULEB 25100c>
function isTargetConst(p: number) {
  if (b[p] !== 0x41) return false;
  const r = readULEB(p + 1);
  return r.value === TARGET;
}

// Find exact byte pattern for i32.store with offset=0,
// where the address is expected to be TARGET.
// This is a raw scan; symbolic address resolution comes next.
console.log("FUNC / BODY RAW SCAN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET : 0x25100C");
console.log("============================================================");

let hits: number[] = [];

for (let p = 0; p < b.length; p++) {
  if (isTargetConst(p)) hits.push(p);
}

console.log(`CONST HITS : ${hits.length}`);

for (const p of hits) {
  const end = Math.min(b.length, p + 24);
  const bytes = Array.from(b.subarray(p, end))
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");

  console.log(`\n0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${bytes}`);
}

// Also search for direct raw 32-bit occurrences of TARGET.
console.log("\n============================================================");
console.log("RAW 32-BIT TARGET OCCURRENCES");
console.log("============================================================");

let raw = 0;

for (let p = 0; p + 4 <= b.length; p++) {
  if (u32(p) === TARGET) {
    raw++;
    console.log(`0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  0c 10 25 00`);
  }
}

console.log(`\nRAW OCCURRENCES : ${raw}`);
console.log("\nDONE");

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const TARGET = 3317;
const IMPORTS = 83;

function u8(p) {
  return buf[p];
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(p++);
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function dump(pos, radius = 20) {
  const s = Math.max(0, pos - radius);
  const e = Math.min(buf.length, pos + radius + 16);

  let a = [];

  for (let i = s; i < e; i++) {
    a.push(buf[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
  }

  return a.join(" ");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Locate CODE section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;

while (p < buf.length) {
  const id = u8(p++);
  const sz = readULEB(p);

  p = sz.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (!codeStart) {
  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse bodies
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let q = codeStart;

const count = readULEB(q);
q = count.next;

const bodies = [];

for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
  const sz = readULEB(q);
  q = sz.next;

  const start = q;
  const end = q + sz.value;

  bodies.push({
    func: IMPORTS + i,
    start,
    end
  });

  q = end;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND ALL REFERENCES TO FUNC 3317");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET :", TARGET);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. Direct call 3317
//
// opcode 10 + function index ULEB
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DIRECT CALLS TO 3317");
console.log("============================================================");

let direct = 0;

for (const fn of bodies) {

  for (let x = fn.start; x < fn.end; x++) {

    if (u8(x) !== 0x10) continue;

    const r = readULEB(x + 1);

    if (r.value === TARGET) {

      direct++;

      console.log("");
      console.log(
        "CALL 3317 FROM FUNC",
        fn.func,
        "@",
        hex(x)
      );

      console.log(dump(x));
    }
  }
}

console.log("");

//
// 0xd2 + function index ULEB

console.log("============================================================");

for (const fn of bodies) {

  for (let x = fn.start; x < fn.end; x++) {

// ------------------------------------------------------------

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8, code = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const [n, q] = u(p);
  p = q;
  if (id === 10) {
    code = p;
    break;
  }
  p += n;
}

p = code;
const [count, q0] = u(p);
p = q0;

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  const [size, q] = u(p);
  p = q;

  const func = 83 + i;
  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  for (let x = start; x < end; x++) {
    if (b[x] !== 0x10) continue;

    const [callee] = u(x + 1);

    if (callee !== 3336) continue;

    console.log(
      `FUNC ${func} CALL3336 @ 0x${x.toString(16)}`
    );

    console.log(
      [...b.subarray(Math.max(start, x - 80), Math.min(end, x + 8))]
        .map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ")
    );

    console.log("--------------------------------------------");
  }

  p = end;
}

FILE: scripts\find4275BaseCandidates.js
====================================================================================================
const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TABLE_BASE = 0x1901dc;
const TABLE_END  = 0x1901fc;

const LOW_START = 0x1dc;
const LOW_END   = 0x1fc;

const HIGH_START = 0x18f000;
const HIGH_END   = 0x191000;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND 4275 BASE CANDIDATES");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TABLE BASE :", "0x" + TABLE_BASE.toString(16));
console.log("TABLE END  :", "0x" + TABLE_END.toString(16));
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {

      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << (shift + 7));
      }

      return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/*
 * Locate CODE section.
 */
let p = 8;
let codeStart = null;
let codeEnd = null;

while (p < buf.length) {

  const id = buf[p++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  if (!sizeInfo) break;

  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const payloadStart = p;
  const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sizeInfo.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = payloadStart;
    codeEnd = payloadEnd;
    break;
  }

  p = payloadEnd;
}

if (codeStart === null) {
  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

let q = codeStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(q);
q = countInfo.next;

const functionCount = countInfo.value;

let candidateCount = 0;

for (let func = 0; func < functionCount; func++) {

  const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(q);
  q = bodySizeInfo.next;

  const bodyStart = q;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySizeInfo.value;

  /*
   * Decode locals.
   */
  let x = bodyStart;

  const localGroupsInfo = readULEB(x);
  if (!localGroupsInfo) break;

  x = localGroupsInfo.next;

  for (let g = 0; g < localGroupsInfo.value; g++) {

    const n = readULEB(x);
    if (!n) break;

    x = n.next;

    // valtype
    x++;
  }

  const constants = [];
  const offsets = [];

  /*
   * First pass: collect i32.const values.
   */
  while (x < bodyEnd) {

    const opPos = x;
    const opcode = buf[x++];

    if (opcode === 0x41) {

      const r = readSLEB(x);
      if (!r) break;

      const value = r.value >>> 0;
      x = r.next;

      if (
        (value >= LOW_START && value <= LOW_END) ||
        (value >= HIGH_START && value <= HIGH_END)
      ) {

        constants.push({
          pos: opPos,
          value
        });

        if (
          value >= LOW_START &&
          value <= LOW_END
        ) {
          offsets.push({
            pos: opPos,
            value
          });
        }
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * local get/set/tee
     */
    if (
      opcode === 0x20 ||
      opcode === 0x21 ||
      opcode === 0x22
    ) {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;
      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * call
     */
    if (opcode === 0x10) {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;
      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * call_indirect
     */
    if (opcode === 0x11) {

      const a = readULEB(x);
      if (!a) break;

      x = a.next;

      const b = readULEB(x);
      if (!b) break;

      x = b.next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * branches
     */
    if (
      opcode === 0x0c ||
      opcode === 0x0d
    ) {

      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;

      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (opcode === 0x0e) {

      const n = readULEB(x);
      if (!n) break;

      x = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const r = readULEB(x);
        if (!r) break;
        x = r.next;
      }

      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;

      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * block / loop / if
     */
    if (
      opcode === 0x02 ||
      opcode === 0x03 ||
      opcode === 0x04
    ) {
      x++;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * memory instructions.
     */
    if (
      opcode >= 0x28 &&
      opcode <= 0x3e
    ) {

      const a = readULEB(x);
      if (!a) break;

      x = a.next;

      const b = readULEB(x);
      if (!b) break;

      x = b.next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * memory.size/grow
     */
    if (
      opcode === 0x3f ||
      opcode === 0x40
    ) {

      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;

      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * globals
     */
    if (
      opcode === 0x23 ||
      opcode === 0x24
    ) {

      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;

      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }
  }

  /*
   * Look for functions that contain BOTH:
   *
   *   table offset
   *   AND
   *   address near 0x190000
   */
  const highConstants =
    constants.filter(c =>
      c.value >= HIGH_START &&
      c.value <= HIGH_END
    );

  if (
    offsets.length > 0 &&
    highConstants.length > 0
  ) {

    candidateCount++;

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("CANDIDATE FUNCTION :", func);
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log("TABLE-LIKE OFFSETS:");

    for (const o of offsets) {
      console.log(
        "  CODE",
        hex(o.pos),
        "VALUE",
        hex(o.value)
      );
    }

    console.log("NEAR-BASE CONSTANTS:");

    for (const h of highConstants) {
      console.log(
        "  CODE",
        hex(h.pos),
        "VALUE",
        hex(h.value)
      );
    }

    /*
     * Print compact byte context around every offset.
     */
    console.log("CONTEXT:");

    for (const o of offsets) {

      const from = Math.max(bodyStart, o.pos - 16);
      const to = Math.min(bodyEnd, o.pos + 48);

      console.log(
        "  OFFSET",
        hex(o.value),
        "AT",
        hex(o.pos)
      );

      for (let z = from; z < to; z += 16) {

        const rowEnd = Math.min(to, z + 16);
        const bytes = [];

        for (let k = z; k < rowEnd; k++) {
          bytes.push(
            buf[k].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
          );
        }

        console.log(
          "    " +
          hex(z) +
          " : " +
          bytes.join(" ")
        );
      }
    }
  }

  q = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("BASE + OFFSET CANDIDATES :", candidateCount);
console.log("============================================================");

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 4275;
const TARGET_HEX = 0x10b3;

const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;

function readULEB(pos) {

  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {

    const b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {

  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b;

  do {

    b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    shift += 7;

  } while (b & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/*
 * ============================================================
 * LOCATE CODE SECTION
 * ============================================================
 */

let codeEnd = 0;

  const id = wasm[p++];

  const size = readULEB(p);

  const start = size.next;
  const end = start + size.value;

  if (id === 10) {

    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;

    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (!codeStart)
  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

 * ============================================================

p = bodyCount.next;

for (

  bodyIndex < bodyCount.value;
  bodyIndex++

  const start = size.next;
  const end = start + size.value;

  bodies.push({
    bodyIndex,
    funcIndex: IMPORT_COUNT + bodyIndex,
    start,
    end
  });

  p = end;
}

  for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {

  }

  /*

   */

  const history = [];

  while (q < body.end) {

        case 0x22: {

          q = x.next;

          text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;

          break;

        case 0x41: {

          const x = readSLEB(q);
          q = x.next;

          immediate = x.value;

          text = `i32.const ${x.value}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0x36: {

          const align = readULEB(q);
          q = align.next;

          const offset = readULEB(q);
          q = offset.next;

          text =
            `i32.store align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;

           * i32.store offset=4
           */

             * Search recent history for TARGET constant.
             */

                x.immediate === TARGET

              candidates++;

              console.log(
                "CANDIDATE",
                candidates
              );

              console.log(
                "FUNC :",
                body.funcIndex
              );

              console.log(
                "STORE :",
                hex(off)
              );

              console.log(
                "STORE OFFSET : 4"
              );

              console.log(
                "------------------------------------------------------------"
              );

              for (const h of history.slice(-12)) {

                console.log(
                  hex(h.off),
                  h.text
                );
              }

              console.log(
                hex(off),
                text
              );

              console.log(
                "TARGET 4275 SEEN IN RECENT DATAFLOW"
              );
            }
          }

          break;
        }

        case 0x10: {

          const x = readULEB(q);
          q = x.next;

          text = `call ${x.value}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0x11: {

          const type = readULEB(q);
          q = type.next;

          const table = readULEB(q);
          q = table.next;

          text =
            `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0x28: {

          const align = readULEB(q);
          q = align.next;

          const offset = readULEB(q);
          q = offset.next;

          text =
            `i32.load align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0x2d: {

          const align = readULEB(q);
          q = align.next;

          const offset = readULEB(q);
          q = offset.next;

          text =
            `i32.load8_u align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0x6a:
          text = "i32.add";
          break;

        case 0x6b:
          text = "i32.sub";
          break;

        case 0x6c:
          text = "i32.mul";
          break;

        case 0x45:
          text = "i32.eqz";
          break;

        case 0x46:
          text = "i32.eq";
          break;

        case 0x47:
          text = "i32.ne";
          break;

        default:

          /*
           * Unknown opcode.
           *
           * Do not attempt dangerous decoding.
           * Reset history because instruction boundaries
           * are no longer guaranteed.
           */

          history.length = 0;

          text = `UNKNOWN ${hex(op)}`;

          break;
      }

    } catch {

      break;
    }

    history.push({
      off,
      opcode: op,
      immediate,
      text
    });

    if (history.length > 20)
      history.shift();

    if (op === 0x0b)
      break;
  }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const path =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(path);

const IMPORTED = 83;

function u32(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(x & 0x80))
            return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

        s += 7;
    }
}

function s32(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(x & 0x80)) {
            if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
                v |= (~0 << (s + 7));

            return { value: v | 0, next: p };
        }

        s += 7;
    }
}

function skipBlockType(p) {
    const x = b[p];

    if (
        x === 0x40 ||
        x === 0x7f ||
        x === 0x7e ||
        x === 0x7d ||
        x === 0x7c
    )
        return p + 1;

    return s32(p).next;
}

function skip(p) {

    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04)
        return skipBlockType(p);

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d)
        return u32(p).next;

    if (op === 0x0e) {
        const n = u32(p);
        p = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
            p = u32(p).next;

        return u32(p).next;
    }

    if (op === 0x10)
        return u32(p).next;

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const a = u32(p);
        const c = u32(a.next);
        return c.next;
    }

    if (op >= 0x20 && op <= 0x24)
        return u32(p).next;

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const a = u32(p);
        const c = u32(a.next);
        return c.next;
    }

    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40)
        return p + 1;

    if (op === 0x41)
        return s32(p).next;

    if (op === 0x42) {
        while (true) {
            const x = b[p++];

            if (!(x & 0x80))
                return p;
        }
    }

    if (op === 0x43)
        return p + 4;

    if (op === 0x44)
        return p + 8;

    return p;
}

        }
    }

}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    v += (b & 127) * Math.pow(2, s);

    if (!(b & 128))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];

    v |= (b & 127) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(b & 128)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 64))
        v |= (~0 << s);

      return {
        value: v | 0,
        next: p
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function decode(p, end) {

  if (p >= end)
    return null;

  const start = p;
  const op = buf[p++];

  const r = {
    start,
    end: p,
    op,
    text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
  };

  if (op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    r.end = a.next;
    r.local = a.value;

    r.text =
      op === 0x20
        ? `local.get local=${a.value}`
        : op === 0x21
          ? `local.set local=${a.value}`
          : `local.tee local=${a.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    r.end = a.next;
    r.callTarget = a.value;
    r.text = `call ${a.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    r.end = b.next;

    r.text =
      `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2a ||
    op === 0x2d
  ) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    r.end = b.next;
    r.offset = b.value;
    r.isLoad = true;

    if (op === 0x28)
      r.text = `i32.load offset=${b.value}`;
    else if (op === 0x29)
      r.text = `i64.load offset=${b.value}`;
    else if (op === 0x2a)
      r.text = `f32.load offset=${b.value}`;
    else
      r.text = `i32.load8_u offset=${b.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x36) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    r.end = b.next;
    r.offset = b.value;
    r.isStore = true;

    r.text = `i32.store offset=${b.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {

    const a = sleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    r.end = a.next;
    r.value = a.value;
    r.text = `i32.const ${a.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x6a) {
    r.text = "i32.add";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x6b) {
    r.text = "i32.sub";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x45) {
    r.text = "i32.eqz";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x46) {
    r.text = "i32.eq";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x47) {
    r.text = "i32.ne";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x04) {

    if (p >= end)
      return null;

    p++;

    r.end = p;
    r.text = "if";

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x02) {

    if (p >= end)
      return null;

    p++;

    r.end = p;
    r.text = "block";

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x03) {

    if (p >= end)
      return null;

    p++;

    r.end = p;
    r.text = "loop";

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x05) {
    r.text = "else";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    r.text = "end";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    r.end = a.next;

    r.text =
      op === 0x0c
        ? `br ${a.value}`
        : `br_if ${a.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  return r;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

function u32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function i32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << s);
      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }
  }
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find CODE section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let codeStart = 0;

  p = s.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + s.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

// local declarations

  const type = wasm[p++];
  for (let j = 0; j < n.value; j++)
    locals.push(type);
