const stack = [];
const localExpr = new Map();

function push(x) {
  stack.push(x);
}

function pop() {
  return stack.pop() ?? "<?>"; 
}

function setLocal(n, x) {
  localExpr.set(n, x);
}

function getLocal(n) {
  return localExpr.get(n) ?? `local${n}`;
}

function dumpStack() {
  return stack.map((x, i) => `  [${i}] ${x}`).join("\n");
}

while (p < body446.end) {

  const off = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  // END
  if (op === 0x0b) {
    console.log(`${hx(off)} end`);
    continue;
  }

  // BLOCK
  if (op === 0x02) {
    const bt = wasm[p++];
    console.log(`${hx(off)} block type=0x${bt.toString(16)}`);
    continue;
  }

  // IF
  if (op === 0x04) {
    const bt = wasm[p++];
    const cond = pop();
    console.log(`${hx(off)} if (${cond})`);
    continue;
  }

  // BR_IF
  if (op === 0x0d) {
    const d = u32(p);
    p = d.next;

    const cond = pop();

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} br_if ${d.value}  [condition=${cond}]`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // RETURN
  if (op === 0x0f) {
    console.log(`${hx(off)} return`);
    continue;
  }

  // LOCAL.GET
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = getLocal(x.value);
    push(e);

    console.log(`${hx(off)} local.get ${x.value} -> ${e}`);
    continue;
  }

  // LOCAL.SET
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = pop();
    setLocal(x.value, e);

    console.log(`${hx(off)} local.set ${x.value} = ${e}`);
    continue;
  }

  // LOCAL.TEE
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = pop();
    setLocal(x.value, e);
    push(e);

    console.log(`${hx(off)} local.tee ${x.value} = ${e}`);
    continue;
  }

  // I32.CONST
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = i32(p);
    p = x.next;

    push(String(x.value));

    console.log(`${hx(off)} i32.const ${x.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // I32.LOAD
  if (op === 0x28) {
    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    const addr = pop();

    const expr =
      o.value === 0
        ? `MEM[${addr}]`
        : `MEM[${addr}+${o.value}]`;

    push(expr);

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} i32.load offset=${o.value} : ${addr} -> ${expr}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // I64.LOAD
  if (op === 0x29) {
    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    const addr = pop();

    const expr =
      o.value === 0
        ? `MEM64[${addr}]`
        : `MEM64[${addr}+${o.value}]`;

    push(expr);

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} i64.load offset=${o.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // I32.STORE
  if (op === 0x36) {
    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    const value = pop();
    const addr = pop();

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} i32.store offset=${o.value} : MEM[${addr}+${o.value}] = ${value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // CALL
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} CALL ${x.value}`
    );

    // Important for FUNC 446:
    // CALL 500 consumes one i32 and returns one i32.
    // CALL 122 returns one i32.
    if (x.value === 122) {
      pop();
      pop();
      pop();

      push("RET[122]");
    }
    else if (x.value === 500) {
      const arg = pop();
      push(`RET[500](${arg})`);
    }
    else if (x.value === 85 ||
             x.value === 84 ||
             x.value === 86 ||
             x.value === 91 ||
             x.value === 280) {
      // Most are void in the observed path.
    }

    continue;
  }

  // CALL INDIRECT
  if (op === 0x11) {

    const t = u32(p);
    p = t.next;

    const tab = u32(p);
    p = tab.next;

    console.log("");
    console.log("************************************************************");
    console.log(`CALL_INDIRECT TYPE=${t.value} TABLE=${tab.value}`);
    console.log(`AT ${hx(off)}`);
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    console.log("STACK BEFORE INDIRECT CALL:");
    console.log(
      dumpStack() || "  <empty>"
    );

    // For FUNC 446, the final stack item is the dispatch index.
    const indexExpr = pop();

    console.log("");
    console.log("DISPATCH INDEX EXPRESSION:");
    console.log(`  ${indexExpr}`);

    console.log("");
    console.log("Remaining stack:");
    console.log(
      dumpStack() || "  <empty>"
    );

    console.log("************************************************************");
    console.log("");

    // TYPE-2 returns i32.
    push(`RET[TYPE2:${indexExpr}]`);

    continue;
  }

  // I32.EQZ
  if (op === 0x45) {
    const a = pop();
    push(`(${a}==0)`);

    console.log(`${hx(off)} i32.eqz ${a}`);
    continue;
  }

  // I32.WRAP_I64
  if (op === 0xa7) {
    const a = pop();
    push(`wrap_i32(${a})`);

    console.log(`${hx(off)} i32.wrap_i64`);
    continue;
  }

  // Unknown opcode
  console.log(
    `${hx(off)} UNKNOWN opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
  );
}

console.log("");

for (const [k, v] of localExpr.entries()) {
  console.log(`local${k} = ${v}`);

function u(p) {

  }
}

    if(b[x]!==0x41) continue;

    const [v,qv]=u(x+1);

    // Search until control-flow boundary / max 80 bytes
    let y=qv;

    for(let n=0;n<80 && y<end;n++,y++){

      // call_indirect
      if(b[y]===0x11){

        const [table]=u(q1);

        console.log(
          `FUNC ${func} CONST4788 @ 0x${x.toString(16)} `+
          `CALL_INDIRECT @ 0x${y.toString(16)} `+
          `TYPE=${type} TABLE=${table}`
        );

        console.log(
          [...b.subarray(
            Math.max(start,x-20),
            Math.min(end,y+10)
          )]
          .map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join(" ")
        );

        console.log("--------------------------------------------");
        break;
      }

      // stop at return / branch / end
      if(
        b[y]===0x0b ||
        b[y]===0x0c ||
        b[y]===0x0d ||
        b[y]===0x0f
      ) break;
    }
  }

  p=end;
}

import { readFileSync } from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 4815;

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        next: p,
    };
}

function readElementSection(buf: Buffer) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const s = readULEB(buf, p);
        const size = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const payloadStart = p;
        const payloadEnd = p + size;

        if (id === 9) {
            return {
                start: payloadStart,
                end: payloadEnd,
            };
        }

        p = payloadEnd;
    }

    throw new Error("Element section not found.");
}

export async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" FIND FUNCTION 4815 IN ELEMENT TABLE");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("");

    const wasm = readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

    console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length}`);
    console.log(`Target    : Function ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
    console.log("");

    const sec = readElementSection(wasm);

    console.log(
        `Element section : 0x${sec.start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${sec.end.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    let p = sec.start;

    const segmentInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const segmentCount = segmentInfo.value;
    p = segmentInfo.next;

    console.log(`Segments        : ${segmentCount}`);
    console.log("");

    let totalFound = 0;

    for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount; seg++) {
        const flagsInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
        const flags = flagsInfo.value;
        p = flagsInfo.next;

        console.log(`Segment ${seg}: flags=${flags}`);

        if (flags !== 0) {
            console.log(
                `Unsupported flags=${flags}; stopping safely.`
            );
            break;
        }

        /*
         * flags = 0:
         *
         *   offset expression
         *   end
         *   vec(funcidx)
         *
         * There is NO elemkind byte here.
         */

        console.log(
            `  Offset expression starts at 0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
        );

        let offsetValue: number | null = null;

        const offsetOp = wasm[p++];

        if (offsetOp === 0x41) {
            const r = readULEB(wasm, p);
            offsetValue = r.value;
            p = r.next;

            console.log(`  Offset opcode : i32.const`);
            console.log(`  Table offset  : ${offsetValue}`);

import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL =
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf';

const TARGET_LT = '99809465000010';
const TARGET_RAW = '7219004800';

const URL =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v3/transactions';

function walk(
    value: any,
    path: string,
    target: string,
    results: string[]
) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
        return;
    }

    if (
        typeof value === 'string' ||
        typeof value === 'number'
    ) {
        if (String(value) === target) {
            results.push(path);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
            walk(
                value[i],
                `${path}[${i}]`,
                target,
                results
            );
        }
        return;
    }

    if (typeof value === 'object') {
        for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
            walk(
                child,
                `${path}.${key}`,
                target,
                results
            );
        }
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCTION_INDEX = 87;

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(
  buf: Buffer,
  pos: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB128 too large");
    }
  }
}

function findSection(
  wasm: Buffer,
  wantedId: number
): { start: number; end: number } | null {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sizeInfo.value;

    if (id === wantedId) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

  ip = nameLen.next + nameLen.value;

  if (kind === 0x00) {
    const typeInfo = readULEB(wasm, ip);
    ip = typeInfo.next;

  } else if (kind === 0x01) {
    ip += 1;

    const flags = wasm[ip++];

    const min = readULEB(wasm, ip);
    ip = min.next;

    if (flags & 1) {

      ip = max.next;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

function findCode() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const [size, q] = uleb(p);
    p = q;

    if (id === 10)
      return [p, p + size];

    p += size;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

const [secStart, secEnd] = findCode();

        );

      }
    }
  }

  p = end;

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let n = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    n++;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }
  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;
const CODE_START = 0x6e7d;

function readULEB(offset: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = offset;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

type FuncRange = {
    bodyIndex: number;
    realIndex: number;
    sizeField: number;
    codeStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;
};

    const bodyEnd = codeStart + sizeInfo.value;

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 2094;

const TARGETS = [
    { name: "G-528", offset: -528 },
    { name: "G-336", offset: -336 },
    { name: "G-272", offset: -272 },
    { name: "G-208", offset: -208 },
];

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 2094 CALL 205 PRODUCER SCAN V1");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

const bytes = new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(WASM));

console.log(`WASM size : ${bytes.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Function  : ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log();

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; end: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, end: p };
}

function sleb32(pos: number): { value: number; end: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        end: p,
    };
}

function readSections() {
    let p = 8;

    let codeStart = 0;
    let codeEnd = 0;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];

        const size = uleb(p);
        p = size.end;

        const payload = p;
        const end = p + size.value;

        if (id === 10) {
            codeStart = payload;
            codeEnd = end;
        }

        p = end;
    }

    return {
        codeStart,
        codeEnd,
    };
}

function getImportedFunctionCount(): number {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];

        const size = uleb(p);
        p = size.end;

        const end = p + size.value;

        if (id !== 2) {
            p = end;
            continue;
        }

        let q = p;

        const count = uleb(q);
        q = count.end;

        let importedFunctions = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

            const moduleLen = uleb(q);
            q = moduleLen.end + moduleLen.value;

            const nameLen = uleb(q);
            q = nameLen.end + nameLen.value;

            const kind = bytes[q++];

            if (kind === 0) {
                const type = uleb(q);
                q = type.end;

                importedFunctions++;
            }
            else if (kind === 1) {
                q += 4;
            }
            else if (kind === 2) {
                q += 1;
            }
            else if (kind === 3) {
                q += 2;
            }
        }

        return importedFunctions;
    }

    return 0;
}

function getFunctionBody(target: number) {

    const sections = readSections();

    const imported = getImportedFunctionCount();

    const functionIndex = target - imported;

    let p = sections.codeStart;

    const count = uleb(p);
    p = count.end;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

        const size = uleb(p);

        const bodySize = size.value;

        const bodyStart = size.end;

        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

        if (i === functionIndex) {

            return {
                imported,
                functionIndex,
                bodyStart,
                bodyEnd,
            };
        }

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    throw new Error("Function body not found");
}

function readOpcode(pc: number): {
    opcode: number;
    end: number;
} {

    const opcode = bytes[pc];

    let p = pc + 1;

    switch (opcode) {

        case 0x20:
        case 0x21:
        case 0x22: {
            const x = uleb(p);

            return {
                opcode,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = sleb32(p);

            return {
                opcode,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x42: {

            while (bytes[p++] & 0x80) {}

            return {
                opcode,
                end: p,
            };
        }

        case 0x28:
        case 0x29:
        case 0x2a:
        case 0x2b:
        case 0x36:
        case 0x37:
        case 0x38:
        case 0x39: {

            const align = uleb(p);

            const off = uleb(align.end);

            return {
                opcode,
                end: off.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x10: {

            const x = uleb(p);

            return {
                opcode,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x02:
        case 0x03:
        case 0x04: {

            p++;

            return {
                opcode,
                end: p,
            };
        }

        case 0x0c:
        case 0x0d: {

            const x = uleb(p);

            return {
                opcode,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        default:
            return {
                opcode,
                end: p,
            };
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { v: v >>> 0, p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

// Code section
let p = 0x6e7d;

const count = uleb(p);
p = count.p;

for (let fn = 0; fn < count.v; fn++) {

  const s = uleb(p);
  const size = s.v;
  p = s.p;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + size;

  const locals = uleb(p);
  p = locals.p;

  for (let i = 0; i < locals.v; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.p;
    p++;
  }

  const codeStart = p;

  while (p < bodyEnd) {

    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      if (r.v === 2094) {

        console.log();
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log("CALL 2094 FOUND");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`Caller function : ${fn}`);
        console.log(`CALL address    : ${hex(at)}`);
        console.log(`Body start      : ${hex(bodyStart)}`);
        console.log(`Code start      : ${hex(codeStart)}`);
        console.log(`Body end        : ${hex(bodyEnd)}`);
        console.log("============================================================");

      }

      continue;
    }

    // Skip immediates

    if (op >= 0x20 && op <= 0x24) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41 || op === 0x42) {
      let v = 0, shift = 0;

      while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (!(x & 0x80))
          break;
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
      let r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0xfc) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      if (r.v === 8 || r.v === 10) {
        let x = uleb(p);
        p = x.p;

        x = uleb(p);
        p = x.p;
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      if (b[p] === 0x40) {
        p++;
      } else {
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.p;
      }

      continue;
    }
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x012200;
const END   = 0x01295b;
const CALL26 = 0x0126b4;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(pos: number, bits: number) {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (
                shift + 7n < BigInt(bits) &&
                (b & 0x40)
            ) {
                value |=
                    (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }

    throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    const b = uleb(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: b.value,
        next: b.next
    };
}

interface Ins {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    kind: string;
    local?: number;
    value?: number | bigint;
    offset?: number;
    global?: number;
}

function decode(pos: number): Ins {
    const start = pos;
    const op = buf[pos++];

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.get",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.set",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.tee",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * global.get
     */
    if (op === 0x23) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `global.get ${x.value}`,
            kind: "global.get",
            global: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * global.set
     */
    if (op === 0x24) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `global.set ${x.value}`,
            kind: "global.set",
            global: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = sleb(pos, 32);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
            kind: "i32.const",
            value: Number(x.value)
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = sleb(pos, 64);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
            kind: "i64.const",
            value: x.value
        };
    }

    if (
        op === 0x28 ||
        op === 0x29 ||
        op === 0x2a ||
        op === 0x2b ||
        op === 0x36 ||
        op === 0x37 ||
        op === 0x38 ||
        op === 0x39
    ) {
        const m = memarg(pos);

        let name = `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`;

        if (op === 0x28) name = "i32.load";
        if (op === 0x29) name = "i64.load";
        if (op === 0x2a) name = "f32.load";
        if (op === 0x2b) name = "f64.load";
        if (op === 0x36) name = "i32.store";
        if (op === 0x37) name = "i64.store";
        if (op === 0x38) name = "f32.store";
        if (op === 0x39) name = "f64.store";

        return {
            start,
            end: m.next,
            op,
            text: `${name} offset=${m.offset}`,
            kind: name,
            offset: m.offset
        };
    }

    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",

        0x10: "call",
        0x0b: "end"
    };

    return {
        start,
        end: pos,
        op,
        text:
            names[op] ??
            `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        kind: "other"
    };
}

function H(n: number) {
    return "0x" +
        n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const ins: Ins[] = [];

while (p < END) {
    const x = decode(p);
    ins.push(x);
    p = x.end;
}

if (p !== END) {
    throw new Error(
        `Decode mismatch: ${H(p)} != ${H(END)}`
    );
}

    for (let j = from; j < i; j++) {

        if (
            y.kind === "global.get" &&
            y.global === 0

            if (n === -568)

            if (n === -576)
                hasMinus576 = true;

            if (n === 512)

        }

        hasGlobal0 ||

        hasMinus64 ||
        hasMinus568 ||
        hasMinus576
    ) {

        );

            x.text

            `local2=${hasLocal2} ` +
            `-64=${hasMinus64} ` +
            `-568=${hasMinus568} ` +
            `-576=${hasMinus576}`
        );

        );

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { v: v >>> 0, p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

let p = 0x6e7d;

const count = uleb(p);
p = count.p;

for (let fn = 0; fn < count.v; fn++) {

  const s = uleb(p);
  const size = s.v;
  p = s.p;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + size;

  const locals = uleb(p);
  p = locals.p;

  for (let i = 0; i < locals.v; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.p;
    p++;
  }

  const codeStart = p;

  while (p < bodyEnd) {

    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === 0x10) {

      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      if (r.v === 2827) {
        console.log();
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log("CALL 2827 FOUND");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`Caller function : ${fn}`);
        console.log(`CALL address    : ${hex(at)}`);
        console.log(`Body start      : ${hex(bodyStart)}`);
        console.log(`Code start      : ${hex(codeStart)}`);
        console.log(`Body end        : ${hex(bodyEnd)}`);
        console.log("============================================================");
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op >= 0x20 && op <= 0x24) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41 || op === 0x42) {
      let x;
      do {
        x = b[p++];
      } while (x & 0x80);
      continue;
    }

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
      let r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0xfc) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      if (r.v === 8 || r.v === 10) {
        let x = uleb(p);
        p = x.p;
        x = uleb(p);
        p = x.p;
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      if (b[p] === 0x40) {
        p++;
      } else {
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.p;
      }
      continue;
    }
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("END V33");
console.log("============================================================");

FILE: scripts\findCall446Contexts.js

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const TARGET_CALL = 446;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: result >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Locate CODE section only
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = null;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
  const sectionStart = pos;
  const id = wasm[pos++];

  const sz = readULEB(pos);
  const sectionSize = sz.value;
  pos = sz.next;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = pos;
    break;
  }

  pos = sectionStart + 1 + (sz.next - (sectionStart + 1)) + sectionSize;
}

if (codeStart === null) {
  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

let p = codeStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const bodyCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Decode enough instructions to identify exact call 446
// and maintain instruction boundaries.
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function decodeBody(start, end) {
  let p = start;

  const decl = readULEB(p);
  const localDeclCount = decl.value;
  p = decl.next;

  // Skip local declarations.
  for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
    const n = readULEB(p);
    p = n.next;

    // valtype
    p++;
  }

  const ins = [];

  while (p < end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    // end
    if (op === 0x0b) {
      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: "end"
      });
      break;
    }

    // local.get/set/tee
    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      const name =
        op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
        op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
        "local.tee";

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `${name} local${x.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // i32.const
    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `i32.const ${x.value | 0}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // call
    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        target: x.value,
        text: `call ${x.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // call_indirect
    if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = readULEB(p);
      p = t.next;

      const table = readULEB(p);
      p = table.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // i32.load
    if (op === 0x28) {
      const a = readULEB(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = readULEB(p);
      p = o.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // i32.load8_u
    if (op === 0x2d) {
      const a = readULEB(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = readULEB(p);
      p = o.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // i32.store
    if (op === 0x36) {
      const a = readULEB(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = readULEB(p);
      p = o.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // i64.load
    if (op === 0x29) {
      const a = readULEB(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = readULEB(p);
      p = o.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `i64.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // block / loop / if
    if (op === 0x02) {
      p++;
      ins.push({ at, op, text: "block" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x03) {
      p++;
      ins.push({ at, op, text: "loop" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x04) {
      p++;
      ins.push({ at, op, text: "if" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x05) {
      ins.push({ at, op, text: "else" });
      continue;
    }

    // br / br_if
    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"} ${x.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // numeric one-byte instructions
    const names = {
      0x45: "i32.eqz",
      0x49: "i32.lt_u",
      0x4d: "i32.ge_u",
      0x4f: "i32.gt_u",
      0x51: "i64.eqz",
      0x67: "i32.clz",
      0x6a: "i32.add",
      0x6b: "i32.sub",
      0x6c: "i32.mul",
      0x71: "i32.and",
      0x72: "i32.or",
      0x73: "i32.xor",
      0x74: "i32.shl",
      0x75: "i32.shr_s",
      0x76: "i32.shr_u",
      0x79: "i64.shl",
      0x7d: "i64.extend_i32_u",
      0x83: "i64.and",
      0x84: "i64.or",
      0x85: "i64.xor",
      0x86: "i64.shr_u",
      0x88: "i64.shr_s",
      0xa7: "i32.wrap_i64",
      0xad: "i64.extend_i32_s"
    };

    ins.push({
      at,
      op,
      text: names[op] || `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    });
  }

  return ins;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Scan every code body
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const matches = [];

p = codeStart + 1;

// Re-read count correctly
const c = readULEB(codeStart);
p = c.next;

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < bodyCount; bodyIndex++) {

  const size = readULEB(p);
  const bodySize = size.value;
  p = size.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

  let ins;

  try {
    ins = decodeBody(bodyStart, bodyEnd);
  } catch {
    p = bodyEnd;
    continue;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
    const x = ins[i];

    if (x.op === 0x10 && x.target === TARGET_CALL) {
      matches.push({
        bodyIndex,
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
        ins,
        index: i
      });
    }
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

function u(p: number) {
    let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;

        v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
        s += 7;
    } while (x & 0x80);
    return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

function opcodeHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';
    return '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function getOpcode(cell: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function cellInfo(cell: Cell): string {
    return `${cell.bits.length} bits / ${cell.refs.length} refs`;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = new Set([
  8950,
  8951,
  8952,
  8953,
  8954
]);

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u8(p) {
  return buf[p];
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(pos++);
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function skipInitExpr(pos) {
  while (true) {
    const op = u8(pos++);

    if (op === 0x0b) {
      return pos;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      pos = readULEB(pos).next;
    } else if (op === 0x42) {
      pos = readULEB(pos).next;
    } else if (op === 0x43) {
      pos += 4;
    } else if (op === 0x44) {
      pos += 8;
    } else if (op === 0x23 || op === 0xd2) {
      pos = readULEB(pos).next;
    }
  }
}

let p = 8;

const elementSegments = [];

while (p < buf.length) {
  const sectionId = u8(p++);

  const s = readULEB(p);
  const sectionSize = s.value;
  p = s.next;

  const end = p + sectionSize;

  if (sectionId === 9) {
    const n = readULEB(p);
    p = n.next;

    console.log("ELEMENT SEGMENTS :", n.value);

    for (let seg = 0; seg < n.value; seg++) {

      const flags = readULEB(p);
      p = flags.next;

      let tableIndex = 0;
      let offset = null;

      if (flags.value === 0) {
        offset = skipInitExpr(p);
        p = offset;

      } else if (flags.value === 1) {
        const elemKind = u8(p++);
        const count = readULEB(p);
        p = count.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
          p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        continue;

      } else if (flags.value === 2) {
        const ti = readULEB(p);
        tableIndex = ti.value;
        p = ti.next;

        p = skipInitExpr(p);

      } else if (flags.value === 3) {
        const elemKind = u8(p++);
        const count = readULEB(p);
        p = count.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
          p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        continue;

      } else if (flags.value === 4) {
        offset = skipInitExpr(p);
        p = offset;

      } else if (flags.value === 6) {
        const ti = readULEB(p);
        tableIndex = ti.value;
        p = ti.next;

        p = skipInitExpr(p);
      }

      const elemType = u8(p++);

      const count = readULEB(p);
      p = count.next;

      const funcs = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const f = readULEB(p);
        p = f.next;
        funcs.push(f.value);
      }

      let base = null;

      // Re-read the offset expression is unnecessary for active
      // segments in this WASM because the known table is table 0.
      // We recover the base from the init expression bytes separately
      // only for flags 0/2/4/6 below.

      elementSegments.push({
        seg,
        flags: flags.value,
        tableIndex,
        count: funcs.length,
        funcs
      });
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos:number) {
  let v=0, shift=0, p=pos;
  while(p<wasm.length) {
    const b=wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if(!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return {value:v>>>0,next:p};
}

        q+=2;

  p=end;

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 248;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    result |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

function readName(pos) {
  const n = readULEB(pos);
  const len = n.value;
  const start = n.next;
  return {
    value: wasm.toString("utf8", start, start + len),
    next: start + len
  };
}

function skipLimits(pos) {
  const flags = wasm[pos++];
  const min = readULEB(pos);
  pos = min.next;

  if (flags & 1) {
    const max = readULEB(pos);
    pos = max.next;
  }

  return pos;
}

function skipBlockType(pos) {
  const b = wasm[pos];

  if (
    b === 0x40 ||
    b === 0x7f ||
    b === 0x7e ||
    b === 0x7d ||
    b === 0x7c ||
    b === 0x7b ||
    b === 0x70 ||
    b === 0x6f
  ) {
    return pos + 1;
  }

  return readSLEB(pos).next;
}

function skipMemArg(pos) {
  const align = readULEB(pos);
  const offset = readULEB(align.next);

  return {
    next: offset.next,
    align: align.value,
    offset: offset.value
  };
}

function decodeFunction(start, end) {
  const calls = [];

  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const opPos = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    try {
      switch (op) {
        case 0x00: // unreachable
        case 0x01: // nop
        case 0x05: // else
        case 0x0b: // end
        case 0x0f: // return
          break;

        case 0x02: // block
        case 0x03: // loop
        case 0x04: // if
          p = skipBlockType(p);
          break;

        case 0x0c: // br
        case 0x0d: // br_if
          p = readULEB(p).next;
          break;

        case 0x0e: { // br_table
          const n = readULEB(p);
          p = n.next;

          for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
          }

          p = readULEB(p).next;
          break;
        }

        case 0x10: { // call
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          if (r.value === TARGET) {
            calls.push(opPos);
          }
          break;
        }

        case 0x11: { // call_indirect
          p = readULEB(p).next;
          p = readULEB(p).next;
          break;
        }

        case 0x20: // local.get
        case 0x21: // local.set
        case 0x22: // local.tee
        case 0x23: // global.get
        case 0x24: // global.set
          p = readULEB(p).next;
          break;

        case 0x25: // table.get
        case 0x26: // table.set
          p = readULEB(p).next;
          break;

        case 0x28: // i32.load
        case 0x29: // i64.load
        case 0x2a: // f32.load
        case 0x2b: // f64.load
        case 0x2c: // i32.load8_s
        case 0x2d: // i32.load8_u
        case 0x2e: // i32.load16_s
        case 0x2f: // i32.load16_u
        case 0x30: // i64.load8_s
        case 0x31: // i64.load8_u
        case 0x32: // i64.load16_s
        case 0x33: // i64.load16_u
        case 0x34: // i64.load32_s
        case 0x35: // i64.load32_u
        case 0x36: // i32.store
        case 0x37: // i64.store
        case 0x38: // f32.store
        case 0x39: // f64.store
        case 0x3a: // i32.store8
        case 0x3b: // i32.store16
        case 0x3c: // i64.store8
        case 0x3d: // i64.store16
        case 0x3e: // i64.store32
        {
          p = skipMemArg(p).next;
          break;
        }

        case 0x3f: // memory.size
        case 0x40: // memory.grow
          p = readULEB(p).next;
          break;

        case 0x41: // i32.const
          p = readSLEB(p).next;
          break;

        case 0x42: // i64.const
          p = readSLEB(p).next;
          break;

        case 0x43:
          p += 4;
          break;

        case 0x44:
          p += 8;
          break;

        case 0x45:
        case 0x46:
        case 0x47:
        case 0x48:
        case 0x49:
        case 0x4a:
        case 0x4b:
        case 0x4c:
        case 0x4d:
        case 0x4e:
        case 0x4f:
        case 0x50:
        case 0x51:
        case 0x52:
        case 0x53:
        case 0x54:
        case 0x55:
        case 0x56:
        case 0x57:
        case 0x58:
        case 0x59:
        case 0x5a:
        case 0x5b:
        case 0x5c:
        case 0x5d:
        case 0x5e:
        case 0x5f:
        case 0x60:
        case 0x61:
        case 0x62:
        case 0x63:
        case 0x64:
        case 0x65:
        case 0x66:
        case 0x67:
        case 0x68:
        case 0x69:
        case 0x6a:
        case 0x6b:
        case 0x6c:
        case 0x6d:
        case 0x6e:
        case 0x6f:
        case 0x70:
        case 0x71:

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 656;
const IMPORTS = 83;

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v: number) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function section(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];
    const z = uleb(p);
    p = z.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + z.value;

    if (sid === id) return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
}

const fsx = section(3);
let p = fsx.start;

const fc = uleb(p);
p = fc.next;

const funcTypes: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
  const x = uleb(p);
  funcTypes.push(x.value);
  p = x.next;
}

const cs = section(10);
p = cs.start;

const cc = uleb(p);
p = cc.next;

console.log("FIND CALLERS OF FUNC 656");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
  const sz = uleb(p);
  p = sz.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + sz.value;
  const func = IMPORTS + i;

  for (let q = start; q < end;) {
    const pos = q;
    const op = wasm[q++];

    /*
     * Direct call
     */
    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;

      if (x.value === TARGET) {
        console.log();
        console.log(`CALL 656`);
        console.log(`CALLER FUNC = ${func}`);
        console.log(`ADDRESS      = ${hex(pos)}`);
        console.log(`BODY         = ${hex(start)} .. ${hex(end - 1)}`);

        const from = Math.max(start, pos - 20);

        console.log("CONTEXT:");

        for (let z = from; z < Math.min(end, pos + 12); z++) {
          console.log(
            `${hex(z)}  ${wasm[z].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
          );
        }
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * call_indirect:
     * immediate operands are type index + table index.
     */
    if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = uleb(q);
      q = t.next;

      const table = uleb(q);
      q = table.next;

      /*
       * We cannot know statically which table entry maps
       * to FUNC 656 yet. Record all indirect calls whose
       * type is compatible with FUNC 656.
       */
      if (t.value === funcTypes[TARGET - IMPORTS]) {
        console.log();
        console.log(`POSSIBLE INDIRECT CALL`);
        console.log(`CALLER FUNC = ${func}`);
        console.log(`ADDRESS      = ${hex(pos)}`);
        console.log(`TYPE INDEX   = ${t.value}`);
        console.log(`TABLE        = ${table.value}`);
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Skip immediates for common instructions.
     */
    if (
      op === 0x20 || // local.get
      op === 0x21 || // local.set
      op === 0x22    // local.tee
    ) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) { // i32.const
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28) { // i32.load
      const a = uleb(q);
      q = a.next;

      const o = uleb(q);
      q = o.next;

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;
      continue;
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

    const x=b[p++];
    v |= (x&0x7f)<<s;
    if(!(x&0x80)) return {v:v>>>0,p};

  }

  const x=uleb(p);

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const fs = require("fs");

const FILE = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 8927;

const b = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function readU32Leb(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let start = pos;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[pos++];
        result |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
        if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos, start };
}

function readVec(pos) {
    return readU32Leb(pos);
}

function skipLimits(pos) {
    const flags = b[pos++];
    let r = readU32Leb(pos);
    pos = r.next;

    if (flags & 1) {
        r = readU32Leb(pos);
        pos = r.next;
    }
    return pos;
}

function skipType(pos) {
    const t = b[pos++];

    if (t === 0x60) {
        let r = readU32Leb(pos);
        pos = r.next;
        for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
            pos++;
        }

        r = readU32Leb(pos);
        pos = r.next;
        for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
            pos++;
        }
        return pos;
    }

    if (t === 0x5f || t === 0x5e || t === 0x5d || t === 0x5c) {
        return pos;
    }

    return pos;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find CODE section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeSize = 0;

while (pos < b.length) {
    const sectionId = b[pos++];

    const sr = readU32Leb(pos);
    const sectionSize = sr.value;
    pos = sr.next;

    const payloadStart = pos;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = payloadStart;
        codeSize = sectionSize;
        break;
    }

    pos += sectionSize;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

let p = codeStart;

const countR = readVec(p);
const functionCount = countR.value;
p = countR.next;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DIRECT CALLERS OF FUNC 8927");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE       :", b.length);
console.log("CODE START      :", "0x" + codeStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0"));
console.log("FUNCTION BODIES :", functionCount);
console.log("TARGET FUNC     :", TARGET);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

const callers = [];

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < functionCount; bodyIndex++) {

    const sizeR = readU32Leb(p);
    const bodySize = sizeR.value;
    p = sizeR.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

    let q = bodyStart;

    const localR = readU32Leb(q);
    const localCount = localR.value;
    q = localR.next;

    // Skip locals
    for (let i = 0; i < localCount; i++) {
        const n = readU32Leb(q);
        q = n.next;
        q++; // valtype
    }

    while (q < bodyEnd) {

        const op = b[q];
        const at = q;
        q++;

        // call
        if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;

            if (r.value === TARGET) {
                callers.push({
                    bodyIndex,
                    funcIndex: bodyIndex + 83,
                    bodyStart,
                    bodyEnd,
                    callAt: at
                });
            }

            continue;
        }

        // call_indirect
        if (op === 0x11) {
            const r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;

            const tableIndex = b[q++];
            continue;
        }

        // Simple immediates
        if (op === 0x41 || op === 0x42) {
            const r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // local/global index
        if (
            op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22 ||
            op === 0x23 || op === 0x24
        ) {
            const r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // load/store memory immediate
        if (
            (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e)
        ) {
            let r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;

            r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;

            continue;
        }

        // memory.size / memory.grow
        if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
            q++;
            continue;
        }

        // br / br_if / br_table / block / loop / if
        if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
            q++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
            const r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0e) {
            const r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
                const x = readU32Leb(q);
                q = x.next;
            }

            const x = readU32Leb(q);
            q = x.next;
            continue;
        }

        // br_table etc. / end / return / drop / select
        if (
            op === 0x0b ||
            op === 0x0f ||
            op === 0x1a ||
            op === 0x1b
        ) {
            continue;
        }

        // ref.null / ref.func
        if (op === 0xd0) {
            q++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0xd2) {
            const r = readU32Leb(q);
            q = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // bulk-memory / misc prefix
        if (op === 0xfc) {
            const sub = readU32Leb(q);
            q = sub.next;

            if (
                sub.value === 8 ||
                sub.value === 9 ||
                sub.value === 10 ||
                sub.value === 11
            ) {
                const a = readU32Leb(q);
                q = a.next;

                if (sub.value === 8 || sub.value === 10) {
                    const c = readU32Leb(q);
                    q = c.next;
                }
            }

            continue;
        }

        // SIMD prefix
        if (op === 0xfd) {
            const sub = readU32Leb(q);
            q = sub.next;

            // Most SIMD instructions have fixed/variable immediates.
            // We don't need to decode them here unless encountered.
            continue;
        }

        // Default: opcode has no immediate
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

    );

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =

let p = 8;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// LEB
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function u8() {
    return buf[p++];
}

function u32() {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return result >>> 0;

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function i32() {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        result |= (~0 << shift);

    return result | 0;
}

function bytes(n) {
    const s = p;
    p += n;
    return buf.subarray(s, p);
}

function readName() {
    const n = u32();
    return Buffer.from(bytes(n)).toString("utf8");
}

function hex(x, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTION MAP
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const sections = [];

p = 8;

while (p < buf.length) {

    const sectionStart = p;
    const id = u8();
    const size = u32();

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + size;

    sections.push({
        id,
        sectionStart,
        payloadStart,
        payloadEnd,
        size
    });

    p = payloadEnd;
}

    throw new Error("FUNCTION SECTION NOT FOUND");

if (importSection) {

    p = importSection.payloadStart;

    const count = u32();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

        const module = readName();
        const name = readName();
        const kind = u8();

        let typeIndex = null;

        if (kind === 0x00) {

            typeIndex = u32();
            importedFunctions++;
        }

        else if (kind === 0x01) {

            u8();

            const flags = u8();
            u32();

            if (flags & 1)
                u32();
        }

        else if (kind === 0x02) {

            const flags = u8();
            u32();

            if (flags & 1)
                u32();
        }

        else if (kind === 0x03) {

            u8();
            u8();
        }

        else {
            throw new Error(
                `Unknown import kind ${kind}`
            );
        }

        imports.push({
            module,
            name,
            kind,
            typeIndex
        });
    }
}

function getType(functionIndex) {

    if (functionIndex < importedFunctions) {

        return imports[functionIndex]?.typeIndex ?? null;
    }

    return functionTypes[functionIndex - importedFunctions] ?? null;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------

function skipBlockType() {

    const b = buf[p];

    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c ||
        b === 0x7b
    ) {
        p++;
        return;
    }

    i32();
}

function skipMemArg() {
    u32();
    u32();
}

function decodeInstruction(start) {

    const op = u8();

    const ins = {
        start,
        op,
        name: `op_0x${op.toString(16)}`
    };

    switch (op) {

        case 0x00:
            ins.name = "unreachable";
            break;

        case 0x01:
            ins.name = "nop";
            break;

        case 0x02:
            ins.name = "block";
            skipBlockType();
            break;

        case 0x03:
            ins.name = "loop";
            skipBlockType();
            break;

        case 0x04:
            ins.name = "if";
            skipBlockType();
            break;

        case 0x05:
            ins.name = "else";
            break;

        case 0x0b:
            ins.name = "end";
            break;

        case 0x0c:
            ins.name = "br";
            ins.depth = u32();
            break;

        case 0x0d:
            ins.name = "br_if";
            ins.depth = u32();
            break;

        case 0x0e: {

            ins.name = "br_table";

            const n = u32();

            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
                u32();

            u32();

            break;
        }

        case 0x0f:
            ins.name = "return";
            break;

        case 0x10:

            ins.name = "call";
            ins.functionIndex = u32();

            break;

        case 0x11:

            ins.name = "call_indirect";
            ins.typeIndex = u32();
            ins.tableIndex = u32();

            break;

        case 0x1a:
            ins.name = "drop";
            break;

        case 0x1b:
            ins.name = "select";
            break;

        case 0x20:
            ins.name = "local.get";
            ins.local = u32();
            break;

        case 0x21:
            ins.name = "local.set";
            ins.local = u32();
            break;

        case 0x22:
            ins.name = "local.tee";
            ins.local = u32();
            break;

        case 0x23:
            ins.name = "global.get";
            ins.global = u32();
            break;

        case 0x24:
            ins.name = "global.set";
            ins.global = u32();
            break;

        // loads
        case 0x28:
            ins.name = "i32.load";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x29:
            ins.name = "i64.load";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x2a:
            ins.name = "f32.load";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x2b:
            ins.name = "f64.load";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x2c:
            ins.name = "i32.load8_s";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x2d:
            ins.name = "i32.load8_u";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x2e:
            ins.name = "i32.load16_s";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x2f:
            ins.name = "i32.load16_u";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x30:
            ins.name = "i64.load8_s";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x31:
            ins.name = "i64.load8_u";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x32:
            ins.name = "i64.load16_s";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x33:
            ins.name = "i64.load16_u";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x34:
            ins.name = "i64.load32_s";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x35:
            ins.name = "i64.load32_u";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        // stores
        case 0x36:
            ins.name = "i32.store";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x37:
            ins.name = "i64.store";
            skipMemArg();
            break;

        case 0x38:
            ins.name = "f32.store";

if (bodyCount !== definedCount)
    throw new Error(
        `BODY COUNT ${bodyCount} != DEFINED COUNT ${definedCount}`
    );

const directCalls = [];
const targetContexts = [];

let decoderFailures = 0;

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < bodyCount; bodyIndex++) {

    const bodySize = u32();

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    const functionIndex =
        importedFunctions + bodyIndex;

    const localGroups = u32();

    let declaredLocals = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < localGroups; i++) {

        declaredLocals += u32();
        u8();
    }

    const instructions = [];

    while (p < bodyEnd) {

        const insStart = p;

        const ins = decodeInstruction(insStart);

        if (ins.unknown) {

            decoderFailures++;

            p = bodyEnd;
            break;
        }

        instructions.push(ins);

        if (
            ins.op === 0x10 &&
            ins.functionIndex === TARGET
        ) {

            directCalls.push({
                caller: functionIndex,
                bodyIndex,
                address: ins.start,
                instructions: instructions.slice(
                    Math.max(0, instructions.length - 13),
                    instructions.length
                )
            });
        }

        if (
            ins.op === 0x0b &&
            p === bodyEnd
        ) {
            break;
        }
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

const fs = require("fs");
const wabtFactory = require("wabt");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 96;

async function main() {

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("CALLERS OF FUNCTION 96");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");

  const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

  console.log(
    `WASM SIZE : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`
  );

  console.log(
    `TARGET    : call ${TARGET}`
  );

  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  const wabt = await wabtFactory();

  const module = wabt.readWasm(
    wasm,
    {
      readDebugNames: true
    }
  );

  module.generateNames();
  module.applyNames();

  const wat = module.toText({
    foldExprs: false,
    inlineExport: false,
    inlineImports: false,
    showLabels: true
  });

  const lines = wat.split(/\r?\n/);

  let currentFunc = null;
  let total = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {

    const line = lines[i].trim();

    const funcMatch =
      line.match(/^\(func\s+(\$[^\s]+)?/);

    if (funcMatch) {
      currentFunc = funcMatch[1] || "<unnamed>";
    }

    const callMatch =
      line.match(/\bcall\s+(\$?)(\d+)\b/);

    if (callMatch) {

      const target =
        Number(callMatch[2]);

      if (target === TARGET) {

        total++;

        console.log("");
        console.log(`HIT #${total}`);
        console.log(`CALLER : ${currentFunc}`);
        console.log(`WAT    : ${line}`);
      }
    }
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`TOTAL CALLS TO 96 : ${total}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  module.destroy();
}

main().catch(err => {

  console.error("");
  console.error("ERROR:");
  console.error(err.message);

  process.exit(1);
});

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 96;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(buf, p) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function readSLEB(buf, p) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    b = buf[p++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
      }
      return { value: result | 0, next: p };
    }

    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function skipMemarg(buf, p) {
  let r = readULEB(buf, p);
  if (!r) return null;

  r = readULEB(buf, r.next);
  if (!r) return null;

  return r.next;
}

function skipInstruction(buf, p) {
  const op = buf[p++];

  if (op === undefined) return null;

  // control
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    if (p >= buf.length) return null;
    p++; // blocktype
    return p;
  }

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    return readULEB(buf, p)?.next ?? null;
  }

  if (op === 0x0e) {
    let r = readULEB(buf, p);
    if (!r) return null;

    p = r.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
      r = readULEB(buf, p);
      if (!r) return null;
      p = r.next;
    }

    r = readULEB(buf, p);
    return r ? r.next : null;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = readULEB(buf, p);
    if (!r) return null;

    if (r.value === TARGET) {
      return { next: r.next, call96: true };
    }

    return r.next;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    let r = readULEB(buf, p);
    if (!r) return null;

    r = readULEB(buf, r.next);
    return r ? r.next : null;
  }

  // br_table
  if (op === 0x0e) {
    return null;
  }

  // constants
  if (op === 0x41) return readSLEB(buf, p)?.next ?? null;
  if (op === 0x42) {
    let r = readSLEB(buf, p);
    if (!r) return null;

    while (r.next < buf.length) {
      // i64.const can require up to 10 bytes;
      // use generic continuation handling
      if ((buf[r.next - 1] & 0x80) === 0) break;
      r = readSLEB(buf, r.next);
      if (!r) return null;
    }

    return r.next;
  }

  if (op === 0x43) return Math.min(p + 4, buf.length);
  if (op === 0x44) return Math.min(p + 8, buf.length);

  // local/global/table
  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24 ||
    op === 0xd2
  ) {
    return readULEB(buf, p)?.next ?? null;
  }

  // memory load/store
  if (
    (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e)
  ) {
    return skipMemarg(buf, p);
  }

  // memory.size / memory.grow
  if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
    return readULEB(buf, p)?.next ?? null;
  }

  // reference instructions
  if (op === 0xd0) {
    if (p >= buf.length) return null;
    return p + 1;
  }

  if (op === 0xd1) return p;

  // 0xfc prefix: bulk memory / saturating conversions
  if (op === 0xfc) {
    const r = readULEB(buf, p);
    if (!r) return null;

    const sub = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    // memory.init
    if (sub === 8) {
      let x = readULEB(buf, p);
      if (!x) return null;
      x = readULEB(buf, x.next);
      return x ? x.next : null;
    }

    // data.drop
    if (sub === 9) {
      return readULEB(buf, p)?.next ?? null;
    }

    // memory.copy
    if (sub === 10) {
      let x = readULEB(buf, p);
      if (!x) return null;
      x = readULEB(buf, x.next);
      return x ? x.next : null;
    }

    // memory.fill
    if (sub === 11) {
      return readULEB(buf, p)?.next ?? null;
    }

    // table.init
    if (sub === 12) {
      let x = readULEB(buf, p);
      if (!x) return null;
      x = readULEB(buf, x.next);
      return x ? x.next : null;
    }

    // elem.drop
    if (sub === 13) {
      return readULEB(buf, p)?.next ?? null;
    }

    // table.copy
    if (sub === 14) {
      let x = readULEB(buf, p);
      if (!x) return null;
      x = readULEB(buf, x.next);
      return x ? x.next : null;
    }

    // table.grow/fill/size
    if (sub === 15 || sub === 16 || sub === 17) {
      return readULEB(buf, p)?.next ?? null;
    }

    return p;
  }

  // 0xfd prefix: SIMD
  if (op === 0xfd) {
    const r = readULEB(buf, p);
    if (!r) return null;

    p = r.next;

    // Most SIMD instructions have immediate widths.
    // For call scanning, skip conservatively.
    const sub = r.value;

    if (
      (sub >= 0 && sub <= 11) ||
      sub === 92 ||
      sub === 93 ||
      sub === 94 ||
      sub === 95 ||
      sub === 96 ||
      sub === 97 ||
      sub === 98 ||

      sub === 245 ||

      sub === 247 ||
      sub === 248 ||
      sub === 249 ||
      sub === 250 ||
      sub === 251 ||
      sub === 252 ||
      sub === 253 ||
      sub === 254 ||
      sub === 255
    ) {
      // Conservative fallback: SIMD immediates are not calls.
      // Advance minimally; function boundaries prevent false call matches.
      return p;
    }

    return p;
  }

  // 0xfe prefix: atomics / threads
  if (op === 0xfe) {
    const r = readULEB(buf, p);
    if (!r) return null;

    p = r.next;

    // Most 0xfe instructions use memarg.
    // All are non-call instructions.
    return skipMemarg(buf, p);
  }

  // 0x1c select_t
  if (op === 0x1c) {
    const r = readULEB(buf, p);
    if (!r) return null;

    p = r.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
      if (p >= buf.length) return null;
      p++;
    }

    return p;
  }

  // Everything else with no immediate.
  return p;
}

function parseCodeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[p++];

    const sr = readULEB(wasm, p);
    if (!sr) throw new Error("bad section size");

    const sectionSize = sr.value;
    p = sr.next;

    const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
      const countR = readULEB(wasm, p);
      if (!countR) throw new Error("bad code count");

      const count = countR.value;
      p = countR.next;

      const hits = [];

      for (let fi = 0; fi < count; fi++) {
        const bodySizeR = readULEB(wasm, p);
        if (!bodySizeR) throw new Error("bad body size");

        const bodySize = bodySizeR.value;
        p = bodySizeR.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

        const localR = readULEB(wasm, p);
        if (!localR) throw new Error("bad locals");

        const localCount = localR.value;
        p = localR.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < localCount; i++) {
          const n = readULEB(wasm, p);
          if (!n) throw new Error("bad local count");

          p = n.next + 1;
        }

        while (p < bodyEnd) {
          const r = skipInstruction(wasm, p);

          if (!r) {
            // stop this body rather than inventing instructions
            break;
          }

          if (typeof r === "object" && r.call96) {
            hits.push({
              functionIndex: fi,
              offset: p,
              bodyStart,
              bodyEnd
            });

            p = r.next;
          } else {
            p = r;
          }
        }

        p = bodyEnd;
      }

      return hits;
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
  }

  throw new Error("Code section not found");
}
