import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x95e67;
const TARGET = 0x9652b;

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      break;

    s += 7;
  }

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

const hits: {
  offset: number;
  kind: string;
}[] = [];

let p = START;

while (p < TARGET) {

  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  if (
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x20
  ) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.next;

    if (r.value === 13) {

      hits.push({
        offset: at,
        kind:
          op === 0x20
            ? "local.get 13"
            : op === 0x21
              ? "local.set 13"
              : "local.tee 13"
      });
    }

    continue;
  }

  // Skip immediates of common instructions.
  if (op === 0x41) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x42) {

    // signed LEB64
    while (true) {
      const x = b[p++];
      if (!(x & 0x80))
        break;
    }

    continue;
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2a ||
    op === 0x2b ||
    op === 0x2c ||
    op === 0x2d ||
    op === 0x2e ||
    op === 0x2f ||
    op === 0x30 ||
    op === 0x31 ||
    op === 0x32 ||
    op === 0x33 ||
    op === 0x34 ||
    op === 0x35 ||
    op === 0x36 ||
    op === 0x37 ||
    op === 0x38 ||
    op === 0x39 ||
    op === 0x3a ||
    op === 0x3b ||
    op === 0x3c ||
    op === 0x3d ||
    op === 0x3e
  ) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    const o = uleb(a.next);

    p = o.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0xfc) {

    const sub = uleb(p);
    p = sub.next;

    // memory.copy / memory.fill
    if (sub.value === 10) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      const c = uleb(a.next);

      p = c.next;

    } else if (sub.value === 11) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
    }

    continue;
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" LAST LOCAL13 PRODUCER V17");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

console.log("Function range:");
console.log(`  ${hx(START)} .. ${hx(TARGET)}`);

console.log();
console.log("ALL local13 REFERENCES BEFORE TARGET:");
console.log();

for (const h of hits) {
  console.log(`${hx(h.offset)}  ${h.kind}`);
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");

const producers = hits.filter(
  x =>
    x.kind === "local.set 13" ||
    x.kind === "local.tee 13"
);

console.log();

if (producers.length === 0) {

  console.log("NO local.set/tee 13 FOUND.");

} else {

  const last = producers[producers.length - 1];

  console.log("LAST PRODUCER:");
  console.log(`  ${hx(last.offset)}  ${last.kind}`);

  console.log();
  console.log("INITIAL local13 USED AT:");
  console.log(`  ${hx(TARGET)}  local.get 13`);

  console.log();
  console.log("DISTANCE:");
  console.log(
    `  ${TARGET - last.offset} bytes`
  );
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" END V17");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROOT = 'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin';

const SEARCH_DIRS = [
    path.join(ROOT, 'node_modules', '@ston-fi'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'node_modules', '@ton'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'contracts'),
    path.join(ROOT, 'wrappers'),
];

const TARGET =
    '02C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const TEXT_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
    '.ts',
    '.js',
    '.mjs',
    '.cjs',
    '.json',
    '.map',
    '.md',
    '.tolk',
    '.func',
    '.fc',
    '.txt',
]);

let filesScanned = 0;
let matches = 0;

function scanFile(file: string) {
    const ext = path.extname(file).toLowerCase();

    if (!TEXT_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
        return;
    }

    filesScanned++;

    let text: string;

    try {
        text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    } catch {
        return;
    }

    const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    const target = TARGET.toLowerCase();

    let offset = lower.indexOf(target);

    while (offset !== -1) {
        matches++;

        console.log();
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log('*** REAL LIBRARY HASH MATCH ***');
        console.log('============================================================');

        console.log('FILE:');
        console.log(file);

        console.log();
        console.log('OFFSET:');
        console.log(offset);

        console.log();
        console.log('CONTEXT:');

        const start = Math.max(0, offset - 500);
        const end = Math.min(
            text.length,
            offset + TARGET.length + 500
        );

        console.log(text.slice(start, end));

        offset = lower.indexOf(
            target,
            offset + TARGET.length
        );
    }
}

function scanDirectory(dir: string) {
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
        console.log('SKIP - directory not found:');
        console.log(dir);
        return;
    }

    let entries: fs.Dirent[];

    try {
        entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, {
            withFileTypes: true,
        });
    } catch {
        return;
    }

    for (const entry of entries) {
        const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);

        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
            scanDirectory(full);
        } else if (entry.isFile()) {
            scanFile(full);
        }
    }
}

async function main() {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LIBRARY HASH SEARCH - REAL');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - LOCAL SDK/PROJECT FILES');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    console.log();
    console.log('TARGET:');
    console.log(TARGET);

    console.log();

    for (const dir of SEARCH_DIRS) {
        console.log('Scanning:');
        console.log(dir);
        scanDirectory(dir);
        console.log();
    }

    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('SUMMARY');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('files scanned:', filesScanned);
    console.log('real matches:', matches);

    if (matches === 0) {
        console.log();
        console.log('NO REAL LOCAL MATCH FOUND.');
        console.log();
        console.log(
            'The Library hash is not present in the local SDK/project sources.'
        );
        console.log();
        console.log(
            'Next step: identify the Library on-chain.'
        );
    } else {
        console.log();
        console.log(
            'REAL LIBRARY SOURCE MATCH FOUND.'
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('No transaction was sent.');
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    await main();
}

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROOT = path.join(
    process.cwd(),
    'node_modules',
    '@ston-fi',
    'sdk',
    'dist'
);

const TARGETS = [
    'LpAccountV2_2',
    'LpAccountV2_1',
    '0x178d4519',
    '178d4519',
    'LP_ACCOUNT',
    'createTransfer',
    'createMint',
    'createBurn',
    'transfer',
    'mint',
    'burn',
];

const FILE_PRIORITY = [
    'chunk-G66DMSME.cjs',
    'chunk-G66DMSME.cjs.map',
];

function allFiles(dir: string): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];

    for (const name of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
        const full = path.join(dir, name);

        let st;
        try {
            st = fs.statSync(full);
        } catch {
            continue;
        }

        if (st.isDirectory()) {
            out.push(...allFiles(full));
        } else {
            out.push(full);
        }
    }

    return out;
}

function printContext(
    file: string,
    content: string,
    index: number,
    term: string,
) {
    const start = Math.max(0, index - 1000);
    const end = Math.min(content.length, index + term.length + 2500);

    console.log('\n------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log(`MATCH: ${term}`);
    console.log(`FILE : ${path.relative(ROOT, file)}`);
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log(content.slice(start, end));
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP ACCOUNT SCHEMA SEARCH');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - LOCAL SDK FILES ONLY');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(`SDK root: ${ROOT}`);

    if (!fs.existsSync(ROOT)) {
        console.log('\nERROR: SDK dist directory not found.');
        return;
    }

    const files = allFiles(ROOT).filter((f) =>
        /\.(cjs|js|map|d\.ts)$/.test(f)
    );

    console.log(`Files scanned: ${files.length}`);

    const priority = new Set(
        FILE_PRIORITY.map((x) => path.normalize(path.join(ROOT, x)))
    );

    const ordered = [
        ...files.filter((f) => priority.has(path.normalize(f))),
        ...files.filter((f) => !priority.has(path.normalize(f))),
    ];

    const shown = new Set<string>();
    let total = 0;

    for (const file of ordered) {
        let content: string;

        try {
            content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
        } catch {
            continue;
        }

        for (const term of TARGETS) {
            let pos = 0;

            while (true) {
                const index = content.indexOf(term, pos);

                if (index === -1) break;

                total++;

                const key = `${file}|${term}|${index}`;

                if (!shown.has(key)) {
                    shown.add(key);

                    printContext(
                        file,
                        content,
                        index,
                        term,
                    );
                }

                pos = index + term.length;

                // Prevent enormous duplicate output.
                if (shown.size >= 80) {
                    console.log('\n[OUTPUT LIMIT REACHED]');
                    console.log('Stopping after 80 matches.');
                    console.log('============================================================');
                    console.log(`Total displayed matches: ${shown.size}`);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('\n============================================================');
    console.log(' INSPECTION COMPLETE');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(`Total displayed matches: ${shown.size}`);
}

import { Address, TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL =
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf';

const TARGET_AMOUNT = 1001n;

function shortAddress(address: any): string {
    try {
        return address.toString();
    } catch {
        return String(address);
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP DUST / SUPPLY DIFFERENCE INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('==============================================================');
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet-v4.tonhubapi.com',
    });

    const poolAddress = Address.parse(POOL);

    const latest = await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log('MASTERCHAIN SEQNO:', latest.last.seqno);
    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL:');
    console.log(POOL);
    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET DIFFERENCE:');
    console.log('1001 base LP units');
    console.log('0.000001001 LP');
    console.log('');

    const transactions = await client.getAccountTransactions(
        poolAddress,
        0n,
        Buffer.alloc(32)
    );

    console.log('TRANSACTIONS RETURNED:', transactions.length);
    console.log('');

    let found = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < transactions.length; i++) {
        const tx: any = transactions[i].tx;

        const txHash =
            typeof tx.hash === 'function'
                ? tx.hash().toString('base64')
                : tx.hash
                    ? Buffer.from(tx.hash).toString('base64')
                    : 'N/A';

        const lt = tx.lt?.toString() ?? 'N/A';

        const outMessages: any = tx.outMessages;

        if (!outMessages?._map) {
            continue;
        }

        const internalMap: Map<any, any> = outMessages._map;

        for (const [key, message] of internalMap.entries()) {
            try {
                if (!message?.body) {
                    continue;
                }

                const slice = message.body.beginParse();

                if (slice.remainingBits < 32) {
                    continue;
                }

                const op = slice.loadUint(32);

                if (op !== 0x178d4519) {
                    continue;
                }

                const queryId = slice.loadUintBig(64);
                const amount = slice.loadCoins();

                const from = slice.loadAddress();

                let responseAddress: any = null;
                let forwardTonAmount = 0n;

                try {
                    responseAddress = slice.loadAddress();
                    forwardTonAmount = slice.loadCoins();
                } catch {
                    // Ignore optional parsing differences.
                }

                const destination =
                    message.info?.dest ??
                    message.destination ??
                    key;

                console.log('----------------------------------------');
                console.log('TX LT:', lt);
                console.log('TX HASH:', txHash);
                console.log('DESTINATION:', shortAddress(destination));
                console.log('OPCODE: 0x178d4519');
                console.log('QUERY ID:', queryId.toString());
                console.log('LP AMOUNT:', amount.toString());
                console.log(
                    'LP AMOUNT DISPLAY:',
                    Number(amount) / 1e9
                );
                console.log('FROM:', shortAddress(from));

                if (responseAddress) {
                    console.log(
                        'RESPONSE:',
                        shortAddress(responseAddress)
                    );
                }

                console.log(
                    'FORWARD TON:',
                    forwardTonAmount.toString()
                );

                if (amount === TARGET_AMOUNT) {
                    console.log('');
                    console.log('******** TARGET MATCH ********');
                    console.log('FOUND EXACT 1001 LP BASE UNITS');
                    console.log('*******************************');
                    found++;
                }
            } catch {
                // Ignore messages that are not parseable.
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================================');
    console.log('SEARCH RESULT');
    console.log('==============================================================');
    console.log('');

    if (found > 0) {
        console.log('EXACT 1001-UNIT LP TRANSFER FOUND:', found);
    } else {
        console.log('NO EXACT 1001-UNIT LP TRANSFER FOUND');
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'This does NOT mean the 1001 units are missing.'
        );
        console.log(
            'They may originate from mint/burn/accounting state rather than'
        );
        console.log(
            'a direct 1001-unit internal_transfer message.'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('READ ONLY: YES');
    console.log('TRANSACTION SENT: NO');
    console.log('==============================================================');
}

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(pos: number) {
    let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
    do {
        x = b[pos++];
        v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
        s += 7;
    } while (x & 0x80);
    return { value: v, next: pos };
}

function hex(x: number) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");

import fs from 'fs';

const WASM_PATH =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

const TARGET = 1659724; // 0x19534C

function readU32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readI32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }
    }
}

function readString(pos: number) {
    const n = readU32(pos);
    const start = n.next;
    const end = start + n.value;

    return {
        value: wasm.subarray(start, end).toString('utf8'),
        next: end,
    };
}

function readInitExpr(pos: number) {
    const op = wasm[pos++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = readI32(pos);

        pos = x.next;

        if (wasm[pos] !== 0x0b) {
            throw new Error(
                `Expected end of init expr at ${pos}`
            );
        }

        pos++;

        return {
            offset: x.value,
            next: pos,
        };
    }

    throw new Error(
        `Unsupported data offset expression opcode 0x${op
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(2, '0')} at ${pos - 1}`
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return [v >>> 0, p];
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 127) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << s);
  return [v | 0, p];
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

// Find code section
let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  let size;
  [size, p] = u(p);

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = p;
    break;
  }

  p += size;
}

let q = codeStart;
let bodyCount;
[bodyCount, q] = u(q);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC OBJECT +80 / +84 CONSUMERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("BODY COUNT :", bodyCount);
console.log("");

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {
  let bodySize;
  [bodySize, q] = u(q);

  const bodyStart = q;
  const bodyEnd = q + bodySize;
  const func = i + 91;

  let p2 = bodyStart;

  // locals
  let groups;
  [groups, p2] = u(p2);

  for (let g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
    let n;
    [n, p2] = u(p2);
    p2++; // valtype
  }

  const hits = [];

  while (p2 < bodyEnd) {
    const opPos = p2;
    const op = b[p2++];

    // i32.load / i32.store
    if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x36) {
      let align, offset;
      [align, p2] = u(p2);
      [offset, p2] = u(p2);

      if (offset === 80 || offset === 84) {
        hits.push({
          pos: opPos,
          op,
          offset
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    // Skip immediates for common instructions
    if (
      op === 0x20 || // local.get
      op === 0x21 || // local.set
      op === 0x22 || // local.tee
      op === 0x10 || // call
      op === 0x0c || // br
      op === 0x0d || // br_if
      op === 0x41 || // i32.const
      op === 0x42 || // i64.const
      op === 0x43 || // f32.const
      op === 0x44    // f64.const
    ) {
      if (op === 0x43) p2 += 4;
      else if (op === 0x44) p2 += 8;
      else {
        let dummy;
        [dummy, p2] = u(p2);
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      let typeidx;
      [typeidx, p2] = u(p2);
      p2++; // table index
      continue;
    }

    // block / loop / if
    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      p2++;
      continue;
    }

    // memory.size / memory.grow
    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
      p2++;
      continue;
    }

    // br_table
    if (op === 0x0e) {
      let n;
      [n, p2] = u(p2);
      for (let z = 0; z < n + 1; z++) {
        let dummy;
        [dummy, p2] = u(p2);
      }
      continue;
    }

    // ref.func
    if (op === 0xd2) {
      let dummy;
      [dummy, p2] = u(p2);
      continue;
    }

    // table.get / table.set
    if (op === 0x25 || op === 0x26) {
      let dummy;
      [dummy, p2] = u(p2);
      continue;
    }

    // otherwise no immediate
  }

  if (hits.length) {
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log("FUNC", func);
    console.log("BODY", hex(bodyStart), "..", hex(bodyEnd));

    for (const h of hits) {
      console.log(
        hex(h.pos),
        h.op === 0x28 ? "i32.load" : "i32.store",
        "offset=" + h.offset
      );

      const from = Math.max(bodyStart, h.pos - 10);
      const to = Math.min(bodyEnd, h.pos + 12);

      console.log(
        "  RAW:",
        [...b.slice(from, to)]
          .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
          .join(" ")
      );
    }
  }

  q = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_OFFSET = 128;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: result >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  do {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (b & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    result |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: result | 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readName(pos) {
  const x = readULEB(pos);
  const start = x.next;
  const end = start + x.value;

  return {
    next: end
  };
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Locate sections
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

let p = 8;

let importSection = null;
let functionSection = null;
let codeSection = null;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const sectionId = wasm[p++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  const size = sizeInfo.value;

  const start = sizeInfo.next;
  const end = start + size;

  if (sectionId === 2)
    importSection = { start, end };

  if (sectionId === 3)
    functionSection = { start, end };

  if (sectionId === 10)
    codeSection = { start, end };

  p = end;
}

if (!importSection || !functionSection || !codeSection) {
  throw new Error("Required WASM sections not found");
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Count imported functions
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

p = importSection.start;

let x = readULEB(p);
let importCount = x.value;
p = x.next;

let importedFunctions = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {

  p = readName(p).next;
  p = readName(p).next;

  const kind = wasm[p++];

  if (kind === 0) {
    p = readULEB(p).next;
    importedFunctions++;
  }

  else if (kind === 1) {
    p++; // elemtype

    const flags = wasm[p++];

    p = readULEB(p).next;

    if (flags & 1)
      p = readULEB(p).next;
  }

  else if (kind === 2) {
    const flags = readULEB(p);
    p = flags.next;

    p = readULEB(p).next;

    if (flags.value & 1)
      p = readULEB(p).next;
  }

  else if (kind === 3) {
    p++;
    p++;
  }
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Function section
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

p = functionSection.start;

const fc = readULEB(p);
const definedCount = fc.value;
p = fc.next;

const functionTypes = [];

for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++) {
  const t = readULEB(p);
  p = t.next;

  functionTypes.push(t.value);
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Code bodies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

p = codeSection.start;

const bc = readULEB(p);
const bodyCount = bc.value;
p = bc.next;

const bodies = [];

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {

  const bs = readULEB(p);

  const bodySize = bs.value;
  const bodyStart = bs.next;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

  bodies.push({
    func: importedFunctions + i,
    start: bodyStart,
    end: bodyEnd
  });

  p = bodyEnd;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Raw instruction scanner
 *
 * We only need to reliably recognize:
 *
 *   0x36 i32.store
 *   0x37 i64.store
 *   0x38 f32.store
 *   0x39 f64.store
 *
 * and memory offset immediates.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function scanStoreInstructions(body) {

  let p = body.start;

  /*
   * local declarations
   */
  const locals = readULEB(p);
  p = locals.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {

    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    p++; // value type
  }

  const results = [];

  while (p < body.end) {

    const start = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    /*
     * i32.store
     */
    if (op === 0x36) {

      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      if (off.value === TARGET_OFFSET) {
        results.push({
          func: body.func,
          addr: start,
          opcode: "i32.store",
          align: align.value,
          offset: off.value
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * i64.store
     */
    if (op === 0x37) {

      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      if (off.value === TARGET_OFFSET) {
        results.push({
          func: body.func,
          addr: start,
          opcode: "i64.store",
          align: align.value,
          offset: off.value
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * f32.store
     */
    if (op === 0x38) {

      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      if (off.value === TARGET_OFFSET) {
        results.push({
          func: body.func,
          addr: start,
          opcode: "f32.store",
          align: align.value,
          offset: off.value
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * f64.store
     */
    if (op === 0x39) {

      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      if (off.value === TARGET_OFFSET) {
        results.push({
          func: body.func,
          addr: start,
          opcode: "f64.store",
          align: align.value,
          offset: off.value
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * immediates for common instructions
     */
    if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22 ||
      op === 0x10 ||
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d
    ) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      p = readSLEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Loads.
     */
    if (
      op === 0x28 ||
      op === 0x29 ||
      op === 0x2a ||
      op === 0x2b ||
      op === 0x2c ||
      op === 0x2d
    ) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * call_indirect
     */
    if (op === 0x11) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * br_table
     */
    if (op === 0x0e) {
      const n = readULEB(p);
      p = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
        p = readULEB(p).next;

      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Memory.size / memory.grow
     */
    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
      p++;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Other opcodes are one byte.
     */
  }

  return results;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"

function u32(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readLeb(p) {
  return u32(p);
}

  const start = p;
  const end = p + s.value;

  if (sectionId === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(buf, pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readName(buf, pos) {
  const n = readULEB(buf, pos);
  const end = n.next + n.value;

  return {
    next: end
  };
}

function skipLimits(buf, pos) {
  const flags = buf[pos++];

  const min = readULEB(buf, pos);
  pos = min.next;

  if (flags & 1) {
    const max = readULEB(buf, pos);
    pos = max.next;
  }

  return pos;
}

function countImports(buf, sec) {
  let pos = sec.start;

  const n = readULEB(buf, pos);
  pos = n.next;

  let funcs = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    pos = readName(buf, pos).next;
    pos = readName(buf, pos).next;

    const kind = buf[pos++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const x = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = x.next;
      funcs++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      pos++; // elemtype
      pos = skipLimits(buf, pos);
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      pos = skipLimits(buf, pos);
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      pos += 2;
    } else if (kind === 4) {
      const x = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = x.next;
    } else {
      throw new Error("Unknown import kind " + kind);
    }
  }

  return funcs;
}

function sections(buf) {
  let pos = 8;
  const out = [];

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[pos++];

    const s = readULEB(buf, pos);
    pos = s.next;

    out.push({
      id,
      start: pos,
      end: pos + s.value
    });

    pos += s.value;
  }

  return out;
}

function skipOpcode(buf, pos, op) {
  let x;

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24 ||
    op === 0x10 ||
    op === 0x0c ||
    op === 0x0d ||
    op === 0x25 ||
    op === 0x26
  ) {
    x = readULEB(buf, pos);
    return x.next;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    x = readULEB(buf, pos);
    x = readULEB(buf, x.next);
    return x.next;
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2a ||
    op === 0x2b ||
    op === 0x2c ||
    op === 0x2d ||
    op === 0x2e ||
    op === 0x2f ||
    op === 0x30 ||
    op === 0x31 ||
    op === 0x32 ||
    op === 0x33 ||
    op === 0x34 ||
    op === 0x35 ||
    op === 0x36 ||
    op === 0x37 ||
    op === 0x38 ||
    op === 0x39 ||
    op === 0x3a ||
    op === 0x3b
  ) {
    x = readULEB(buf, pos);
    x = readULEB(buf, x.next);
    return x.next;
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {
    x = readULEB(buf, pos);
    return x.next;
  }

  if (op === 0x42) {
    x = readULEB(buf, pos);
    return x.next;
  }

  if (op === 0x43) return pos + 4;
  if (op === 0x44) return pos + 8;

  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    return pos + 1;
  }

  if (op === 0x0e) {
    const n = readULEB(buf, pos);
    pos = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const y = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = y.next;
    }

    const d = readULEB(buf, pos);
    return d.next;
  }

  return pos;
}

const sec = sections(wasm);

const importSec = sec.find(x => x.id === 2);
const functionSec = sec.find(x => x.id === 3);
const codeSec = sec.find(x => x.id === 10);

const importedFunctions =
  countImports(wasm, importSec);

let fp = functionSec.start;

const fnCount = readULEB(wasm, fp);
fp = fnCount.next;

const typeIndices = [];

for (let i = 0; i < fnCount.value; i++) {
  const x = readULEB(wasm, fp);
  fp = x.next;
  typeIndices.push(x.value);
}

let cp = codeSec.start;

const bodyCount = readULEB(wasm, cp);
cp = bodyCount.next;

const results = [];

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < bodyCount.value; bodyIndex++) {
  const bodySize = readULEB(wasm, cp);
  cp = bodySize.next;

  const bodyStart = cp;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize.value;

  const funcIndex = importedFunctions + bodyIndex;

  let pos = bodyStart;

  // locals
  const localCount = readULEB(wasm, pos);
  pos = localCount.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {
    const n = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    pos = n.next;
    pos++;
  }

  while (pos < bodyEnd) {
    const addr = pos;
    const op = wasm[pos++];

    if (
      op === 0x36 ||
      op === 0x37 ||
      op === 0x3a ||
      op === 0x3b
    ) {
      const a = readULEB(wasm, pos);
      const o = readULEB(wasm, a.next);

      if (o.value === 4) {
        results.push({
          func: funcIndex,
          addr,
          op,
          align: a.value
        });
      }

      pos = o.next;
      continue;
    }

    pos = skipOpcode(wasm, pos, op);

    if (pos > bodyEnd)
      break;
  }

  cp = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("DEFINED FUNCTIONS :", bodyCount.value);
console.log("OFFSET TARGET : 4");
console.log("HITS :", results.length);

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("RESULTS");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const r of results) {
  const name =
    r.op === 0x36 ? "i32.store" :
    r.op === 0x37 ? "i64.store" :
    r.op === 0x3a ? "i32.store8" :
    "i32.store16";

  console.log(
    "FUNC " + r.func +
    "  @ 0x" +
    r.addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0") +

  );
}

import * as fs from 'fs';

function walk(dir: string): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];

    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return out;

    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);

        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
            out.push(...walk(full));
        } else {
            out.push(full);
        }
    }

    return out;
}

function isTextFile(file: string): boolean {
    const ext = path.extname(file).toLowerCase();

    return [
        '.js',
        '.cjs',
        '.mjs',
        '.ts',
        '.mts',
        '.d.ts',
        '.map',
        '.json'
    ].includes(ext);
}

function context(text: string, index: number): string {
    const start = Math.max(0, index - 220);
    const end = Math.min(text.length, index + 420);

    return text
        .slice(start, end)
        .replace(/\r?\n/g, ' ')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}

                continue;
            }

            let pos = 0;

            while (true) {
                const index = text.indexOf(target, pos);

                const relative = path.relative(ROOT, file);

                console.log('');
                console.log(`FILE: ${relative}`);
                console.log(`OFFSET: ${index}`);
                console.log(`CONTEXT: ${context(text, index)}`);

                pos = index + Math.max(target.length, 1);

function scanFile(file: string) {
    console.log();
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(`FILE: ${file}`);
    console.log('============================================================');

    if (!fs.existsSync(file)) {
        console.log('[MISSING]');
        return;
    }

    const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);

    const patterns = [
        'decodeInstruction',
        'Bad operand',
        'PUSHCONT',
        'operand.type',
        'operand',
        'parseInstructions',
    ];

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
        console.log();
        console.log(`PATTERN: ${pattern}`);

        let matches = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            if (lines[i].toLowerCase().includes(pattern.toLowerCase())) {
                matches++;

                const start = Math.max(0, i - 8);
                const end = Math.min(lines.length, i + 20);

                console.log();
                console.log(`--- lines ${start + 1}-${end} ---`);

                for (let j = start; j < end; j++) {
                    console.log(
                        `${String(j + 1).padStart(4, ' ')} | ${lines[j]}`
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        console.log(`Matches: ${matches}`);
    }
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
        }
    }
}

function sectionName(id: number): string {
    switch (id) {
        case 0: return "custom";
        case 1: return "type";
        case 2: return "import";
        case 3: return "function";
        case 4: return "table";
        case 5: return "memory";
        case 6: return "global";
        case 7: return "export";
        case 8: return "start";
        case 9: return "element";
        case 10: return "code";
        case 11: return "data";
        default: return `section-${id}`;
    }
}

import { StonApiClient } from '@ston-fi/api';
import { dexFactory } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run() {
    console.log('===== FIND POOL-CREATION ROUTERS =====');

    const api = new StonApiClient({
        baseUrl: 'https://api.ston.fi',
    });

    try {
        const routers = await api.getRouters({
            dexV2: true,
        });

        const candidates = routers.filter((r: any) =>
            r.majorVersion === 2 &&
            r.minorVersion === 2 &&
            r.routerType === 'ConstantProduct' &&
            r.poolCreationEnabled === true
        );

        console.log('TOTAL ROUTERS:', routers.length);
        console.log('CANDIDATES:', candidates.length);

        for (const r of candidates) {
            console.log('\n===== CANDIDATE =====');

            console.log('Address:', r.address);
            console.log('Version:', `${r.majorVersion}.${r.minorVersion}`);
            console.log('Type:', r.routerType);
            console.log('Pool creation:', r.poolCreationEnabled);
            console.log('pTON version:', r.ptonVersion);
            console.log('pTON master:', r.ptonMasterAddress);
            console.log('pTON wallet:', r.ptonWalletAddress);

            try {
                const dex = dexFactory(r);

                console.log('SDK Router:', dex.Router.name);
                console.log('SDK Pool:', dex.Pool.name);
                console.log('SDK pTON:', dex.pTON.name);
            } catch (e) {
                console.log(
                    'dexFactory ERROR:',
                    e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
                );
            }
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'API ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    }
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x96400;
const END   = 0x96a00;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" PRE-CALL205 PRODUCER SCAN v2");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Window    : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");
console.log("TARGETS:");
console.log("  G-528 = L7 - 64");
console.log("  G-272 = L7 + 192");
console.log("============================================================");

function u32(p: number): number {
  return (
    (wasm[p] |
      (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
      (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
      (wasm[p + 3] << 24)) >>> 0
  );
}

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function localName(n: number): string {
  return `L${n}`;
}

/*
 * We decode enough opcodes to recognize:
 *
 * local.get
 * local.set
 * local.tee
 * i32.const
 * i32.add
 * i32.sub
 * i64.store
 *
 * Everything else is printed as raw opcode.
 */

let p = START;

const recent: string[] = [];

while (p < END) {
  const at = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  let text = `${hex(at)} `;

  switch (op) {

    case 0x20: { // local.get
      const r = readUleb(p);
      p = r.next;
      text += `local.get ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: { // local.set
      const r = readUleb(p);
      p = r.next;
      text += `local.set ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: { // local.tee
      const r = readUleb(p);
      p = r.next;
      text += `local.tee ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: { // i32.const
      const r = readSleb(p);
      p = r.next;
      text += `i32.const ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x42: { // i64.const
      const r = readSleb(p);
      p = r.next;
      text += `i64.const ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x6a:
      text += "i32.add";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      text += "i32.sub";
      break;

    case 0x37: { // i64.store
      const align = readUleb(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readUleb(p);
      p = off.next;

      text += `i64.store align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x29: { // i64.load
      const align = readUleb(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readUleb(p);
      p = off.next;

      text += `i64.load align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x10: { // call
      const r = readUleb(p);
      p = r.next;
      text += `call ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    default:
      text += `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      break;
  }

  recent.push(text);
  if (recent.length > 10)
    recent.shift();

  /*
   * Highlight every i64.store.
   * We inspect its preceding stack-building instructions manually.
   */
  if (op === 0x37) {
    console.log("");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log(`STORE @ ${hex(at)}`);
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    for (const x of recent)
      console.log(x);

    console.log("");
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" END OF PRE-CALL SCAN");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("No transaction / network access performed.");
console.log("");
console.log("NOTE:");
console.log("Blueprint may append 'Error: Function run is missing!'");
console.log("after the offline script output. That is unrelated.");

import fs from "fs";

  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const IMPORTED = 83;
const TARGET_FUNC = 2088;
const TARGET_CALL = 106;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findCode() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    if (id === 10) {
      return {
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
      };
    }

    p += s.value;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

function getFunction(index) {
  const code = findCode();

  let p = code.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    const funcIndex = IMPORTED + i;

    if (funcIndex === index) {
      return {
        index: funcIndex,
        start,
        end,
        size: size.value
      };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`FUNC ${index} not found`);
}

import fs from "node:fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

function readU32(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const byte = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
    }
}

function findCodeSection() {
    let pos = 8;

    while (pos < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[pos++];
        const sizeInfo = readU32(pos);
        const sectionStart = sizeInfo.next;
        const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sizeInfo.value;

        if (id === 10) {
            return { start: sectionStart, end: sectionEnd };
        }

        pos = sectionEnd;
    }

    throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

const targets = [
    { name: "call_2530", bytes: [0x10, 0xe2, 0x13] },
    { name: "call_1746", bytes: [0x10, 0xd2, 0x0d] },
];

let pos = code.start;

pos = countInfo.next;

console.log();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < bodyCount; ordinal++) {
    const sizeInfo = readU32(pos);
    const bodyStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

    for (const target of targets) {
        for (
            let i = bodyStart;
            i <= bodyEnd - target.bytes.length;
            i++
        ) {
            let match = true;

            for (let j = 0; j < target.bytes.length; j++) {

                    break;

                );

FILE: scripts\findRealField4Writers.js

const fs = require("fs");

const FILE = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const IMPORTS = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function uleb(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
        s += 7;
    }
    return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0, b;
    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        s += 7;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    }
    if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);
    return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function section(type) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const t = wasm[p++];

        const z = uleb(p);
        p = z.next;

        if (t === type)
            return { start: p, end: p + z.value };

        p += z.value;
    }

    return null;
}

function decodeBody(start, end) {
    let p = start;

    const lg = uleb(p);
    p = lg.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < lg.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;
        p++;
    }

    const out = [];

    while (p < end) {
        const addr = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text = `opcode_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

        switch (op) {

            case 0x20: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x21: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x22: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x41: {
                const x = sleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `i32.const ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x28: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text = `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x29: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text = `i64.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x2d: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text = `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x36: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text = `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x37: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text = `i64.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x10: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `call ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x11: {
                const t = uleb(p);
                p = t.next;

                const tab = uleb(p);
                p = tab.next;

                text = `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x1a:
                text = "drop";
                break;

            case 0x45:
                text = "i32.eqz";
                break;

            case 0x46:
                text = "i32.eq";
                break;

            case 0x47:
                text = "i32.ne";
                break;

            case 0x6a:
                text = "i32.add";
                break;

            case 0x6b:
                text = "i32.sub";
                break;

            case 0x71:
                text = "i32.and";
                break;

            case 0x72:
                text = "i32.or";
                break;

            case 0x73:
                text = "i32.xor";
                break;

            case 0x0b:
                text = "end";
                break;

            case 0x0c: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `br ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0d: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `br_if ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x04:
                text = "if";
                break;

            case 0x05:
                text = "else";
                break;

            case 0x02:
            case 0x03:
                text = `${op === 2 ? "block" : "loop"} type=0x${wasm[p++].toString(16)}`;
                break;

            case 0x23: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `global.get ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x24: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `global.set ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }
        }

        out.push({ addr, text });
    }

    return out;
}

function getBodies() {
    const sec = section(10);
    if (!sec) throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

    let p = sec.start;

    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;

    const bodies = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const z = uleb(p);
        p = z.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + z.value;

        bodies.push({
            body: i,
            func: IMPORTS + i,
            start,
            end
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function hx(x) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const bodies = getBodies();

        const prev1 = ins[i - 1]?.text || "";
        const prev2 = ins[i - 2]?.text || "";

import fs from 'fs';

    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const IMPORTS = 83;

    { fn: 107, offset: 54073, size: 357 },
    { fn: 116, offset: 55544, size: 1181 },
    { fn: 122, offset: 61125, size: 127 },

function readU32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readI32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }
    }
}

function skipBlockType(pos: number) {
    const b = wasm[pos];

    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c ||
        b === 0x7b ||
        b === 0x70 ||
        b === 0x6f
    ) {
        return pos + 1;
    }

    return readI32(pos).next;
}

function skipLocals(pos: number) {
    const groups = readU32(pos);
    pos = groups.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < groups.value; i++) {
        pos = readU32(pos).next;
        pos++;
    }

    return pos;
}

FILE: scripts\findRefcountCallSites.mjs
====================================================================================================

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const WASM_PATH = path.resolve(
    process.cwd(),
    "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;
const TARGETS = [871, 1393, 2527];

function readULEB(buf, state) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (state.pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[state.pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) return value;

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 49) throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF while reading ULEB128");
}

function encodeULEB(value) {
    const bytes = [];

    do {
        let b = value & 0x7f;
        value = Math.floor(value / 128);

        if (value !== 0) b |= 0x80;
        bytes.push(b);
    } while (value !== 0);

    return bytes;
}

function getSections(buf) {
    const state = { pos: 8 };
    const sections = new Map();

    if (
        buf[0] !== 0 ||
        buf[1] !== 0x61 ||
        buf[2] !== 0x73 ||
        buf[3] !== 0x6d
    ) {
        throw new Error("Not a WASM file");
    }

    while (state.pos < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[state.pos++];
        const size = readULEB(buf, state);
        const start = state.pos;
        const end = start + size;

        if (end > buf.length) {
            throw new Error(`Section ${id} exceeds file bounds`);
        }

        if (!sections.has(id)) {
            sections.set(id, { start, end });
        }

        state.pos = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function getFunctionBodies(buf, section) {
    const state = { pos: section.start };
    const count = readULEB(buf, state);
    const bodies = [];

    for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count; ordinal++) {
        const bodySize = readULEB(buf, state);
        const bodyStart = state.pos;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

        if (bodyEnd > section.end) {
            throw new Error(
                `Function body ${ordinal} exceeds code section`
            );
        }

        bodies.push({
            ordinal,
            globalFunction: IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + ordinal,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
        });

        state.pos = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function findPattern(buf, start, end, pattern) {
    const matches = [];

    for (let i = start; i <= end - pattern.length; i++) {
        let equal = true;

        for (let j = 0; j < pattern.length; j++) {
            if (buf[i + j] !== pattern[j]) {
                equal = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (equal) matches.push(i);
    }

    return matches;
}

function hex(value) {
    return `0x${value.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`;
}

function main() {
    console.log("REFCOUNT CALL-SITE SCAN");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);
    const sections = getSections(buf);
    const codeSection = sections.get(10);

    if (!codeSection) {
        throw new Error("WASM code section (section 10) not found");
    }

    const bodies = getFunctionBodies(buf, codeSection);

    console.log(`FILE SIZE       = ${buf.length}`);
    console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCS  = ${IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS}`);
    console.log(`DEFINED FUNCS   = ${bodies.length}`);
    console.log(`CODE SECTION    = ${hex(codeSection.start)} .. ${hex(codeSection.end)}`);

    for (const target of TARGETS) {
        const ordinal = target - IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS;

        console.log("");
        console.log(`TARGET GLOBAL FUNCTION ${target}`);
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        if (ordinal < 0 || ordinal >= bodies.length) {
            console.log("Target is outside the defined-function range.");
            continue;
        }

        const pattern = [0x10, ...encodeULEB(target)];
        console.log(
            `RAW CALL PATTERN = ${pattern.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ")}`
        );

        let total = 0;

        for (const body of bodies) {
            const matches = findPattern(
                buf,
                body.bodyStart,
                body.bodyEnd,
                pattern
            );

            for (const offset of matches) {
                console.log(
                    `OWNER GLOBAL ${body.globalFunction}` +
                    ` | ORDINAL ${body.ordinal}` +
                    ` | BODY ${hex(body.bodyStart)}..${hex(body.bodyEnd)}` +
                    ` | MATCH ${hex(offset)}`
                );

                total++;
            }
        }

        console.log(`RAW MATCH COUNT = ${total}`);
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("SCAN COMPLETE");
    console.log("NOTE: Raw byte matches are candidates, not decoded instructions.");
}

try {
    main();
} catch (error) {
    console.error("SCAN FAILED");
    console.error(error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const BASE = 0x195348;
const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, end: p };

    s += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v -= 2 ** s;

      return { value: v | 0, end: p };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function dump(start, end) {
  for (let p = start; p < end; p++) {
    console.log(
      "  " + hex(p),
      b[p].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
    );
  }
}

console.log("S1 ADDRESS ARITHMETIC SCAN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("BASE   :", hex(BASE));
console.log("TARGET :", hex(TARGET));
console.log();

let baseHits = [];

//
// Find every literal 0x195348
//
for (let p = 0; p < b.length - 5; p++) {

  if (b[p] !== 0x41)
    continue;

  const r = sleb(p + 1);

  if (!r)
    continue;

  if ((r.value >>> 0) === BASE) {
    baseHits.push({
      pos: p,
      end: r.end
    });
  }
}

console.log("BASE CONST HITS :", baseHits.length);
console.log();

let candidates = [];

for (const h of baseHits) {

  let foundAdd4 = false;
  let foundTarget = false;
  let storePos = null;

  const end = Math.min(b.length, h.end + 96);

  for (let p = h.end; p < end; p++) {

    //
    // i32.const
    //
    if (b[p] === 0x41) {

      const r = sleb(p + 1);

      if (r) {
        const v = r.value | 0;

        if (v === 4)
          foundAdd4 = true;

        if ((v >>> 0) === TARGET)
          foundTarget = true;
      }
    }

    //
    // i32.add
    //
    if (b[p] === 0x6a && foundAdd4) {
      candidates.push({
        base: h.pos,
        add: p,
        store: null,
        type: "BASE + 4 + ADD"
      });
    }

    //
    // i32.store
    //
    if (b[p] === 0x36) {

      const a = uleb(p + 1);
      if (!a) continue;

      const o = uleb(a.end);
      if (!o) continue;

      if (foundAdd4) {
        storePos = p;

        candidates.push({
          base: h.pos,
          add: null,
          store: storePos,
          offset: o.value,
          type: "BASE + 4 -> STORE"
        });
      }
    }

    //
    // Direct literal TARGET
    //
    if (foundTarget && b[p] === 0x36) {

      const a = uleb(p + 1);
      if (!a) continue;

      const o = uleb(a.end);
      if (!o) continue;

      candidates.push({
        base: h.pos,
        add: null,
        store: p,
        offset: o.value,
        type: "TARGET LITERAL -> STORE"
      });
    }
  }
}

console.log("ARITHMETIC CANDIDATES :", candidates.length);
console.log();

for (const c of candidates) {

  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log("TYPE  :", c.type);
  console.log("BASE  :", hex(c.base));

  if (c.add !== null)
    console.log("ADD   :", hex(c.add));

  if (c.store !== null)
    console.log("STORE :", hex(c.store));

  if (c.offset !== undefined)
    console.log("OFFSET:", c.offset);

  const focus = c.store ?? c.add ?? c.base;

  console.log("BYTES:");

  const start = Math.max(0, focus - 40);
  const end = Math.min(b.length, focus + 40);

  dump(start, end);

  console.log();
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v=0,s=0;
  while(true){
    const x=b[p++];
    v+=(x&127)*2**s;
    if(!(x&128)) return [v>>>0,p];
    s+=7;
  }
}

let p=8, code=0;

while(p<b.length){
  const id=b[p++];
  const [n,q]=u(p); p=q;
  if(id===10){ code=p; break; }
  p+=n;
}

p=code;
const [count,q0]=u(p); p=q0;

for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  const [size,q]=u(p); p=q;

  const func=83+i, start=p, end=p+size;

  for(let x=start;x<end;x++){

    // memory.copy = fc 0a
    // memory.fill = fc 0b
    if(b[x]!==0xfc) continue;

    const [sub,qx]=u(x+1);

    if(sub!==0x0a && sub!==0x0b) continue;

    const from=Math.max(start,x-80);
    const to=Math.min(end,x+40);

    const hex=[...b.subarray(from,to)]
      .map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join(" ");

    if(hex.includes("cc a6 e5 00")){
      console.log(
        `FUNC ${func} BULK @ 0x${x.toString(16)} `+
        `SUB=0x${sub.toString(16)}`
      );
      console.log(hex);
      console.log("--------------------------------------------");
    }
  }

  p=end;
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v=0,s=0;
  while(true){
    const x=b[p++];
    v+=(x&127)*2**s;
    if(!(x&128)) return [v>>>0,p];
    s+=7;
  }
}

let p=8, code=0;

while(p<b.length){
  const id=b[p++];
  const [n,q]=u(p); p=q;
  if(id===10){ code=p; break; }
  p+=n;
}

p=code;
const [count,q0]=u(p); p=q0;

for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  const [size,q]=u(p); p=q;

  const func=83+i;
  const start=p, end=p+size;

  // Look for:
  // i32.const 0x19534c
  // local.set / local.tee
  // ...
  // local.get SAME
  // i32.store

  for(let x=start;x<end;x++){

    if(b[x]!==0x41) continue;

    const [v,qv]=u(x+1);
    if(v!==0x19534c) continue;

    let z=qv;

    // Find local.set / tee shortly after target constant
    let local=null;

    for(let k=0;k<16 && z<end;k++){
      if(b[z]===0x21 || b[z]===0x22){
        const [l,qz]=u(z+1);
        local=l;
        z=qz;
        break;
      }
      z++;
    }

    if(local===null) continue;

    // Search entire remainder of function for local.get + store
    for(let y=z;y<end;y++){

      if(b[y]!==0x20) continue;

      const [l,qy]=u(y+1);
      if(l!==local) continue;

      let w=qy;

      // allow small address arithmetic
      for(let k=0;k<8 && w<end;k++){

        if(b[w]===0x36 || b[w]===0x37 || b[w]===0x38){

          const [,qa]=u(w+1);
          const [off]=u(qa);

          console.log(
            `FUNC ${func} S1 ALIAS L${local} `+
            `CONST @ 0x${x.toString(16)} `+
            `STORE @ 0x${y.toString(16)} `+
            `OFFSET=${off}`
          );

          console.log(
            [...b.subarray(
              Math.max(start,x-16),
              Math.min(end,w+12)
            )]
            .map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join(" ")
          );

          console.log("--------------------------------------------");
          break;
        }

        // stop at control flow
        if(b[w]===0x0b || b[w]===0x0c || b[w]===0x0d)
          break;

        w++;
      }
    }
  }

  p=end;
}

FILE: scripts\findS1StoreDataflow.mjs

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const IMPORTS = 83;
const TARGET = 0x19534c;
const BASE   = 0x195348;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, end: pos };
    s += 7;
  }
  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  while (pos < b.length) {
    x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v -= 2 ** s;
      return { value: v | 0, end: pos };
    }
  }
  throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function findBodies() {
  let p = 8;
  let bodies = [];

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;

    const end = p + r.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      const c = uleb(p);
      let q = c.end;

      for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const z = uleb(q);
        q = z.end;

        bodies.push({
          start: q,
          end: q + z.value
        });

        q += z.value;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = findBodies();

const names = {
  0x1a:"DROP",
  0x20:"LOCAL.GET",
  0x21:"LOCAL.SET",
  0x22:"LOCAL.TEE",
  0x23:"GLOBAL.GET",
  0x24:"GLOBAL.SET",

  0x28:"I32.LOAD",
  0x2d:"I32.LOAD8_U",
  0x36:"I32.STORE",
  0x3a:"I32.STORE8",

  0x41:"I32.CONST",
  0x45:"I32.EQZ",
  0x46:"I32.EQ",
  0x47:"I32.NE",

  0x6a:"I32.ADD",
  0x6b:"I32.SUB",
  0x6c:"I32.MUL",

  0x71:"I32.AND",
  0x72:"I32.OR",
  0x73:"I32.XOR",
  0x74:"I32.SHL",
  0x75:"I32.SHR_S",
  0x76:"I32.SHR_U"
};

const arithmetic = new Set([
  0x6a,0x6b,0x6c,0x71,0x72,0x73,0x74,0x75,0x76
]);

const results = [];

for (let fi = 0; fi < bodies.length; fi++) {

  const func = IMPORTS + fi;
  const body = bodies[fi];

  let p = body.start;

  const groups = uleb(p);
  p = groups.end;

  let localCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < groups.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.end;
    p++;
    localCount += n.value;
  }

  const stack = [];
  const locals = new Map();

  function push(v) {
    stack.push(v);
  }

  function pop() {
    return stack.length ? stack.pop() : { kind:"unknown" };
  }

  function setLocal(id, value) {
    locals.set(id, value);
  }

  function getLocal(id) {
    return locals.get(id) || { kind:"local", id };
  }

  function valueConst(v, at) {
    return {
      kind:"const",
      value:v | 0,
      at
    };
  }

  function valueAdd(a, b, at) {
    if (a.kind === "const" && b.kind === "const")
      return valueConst((a.value + b.value) | 0, at);

    if (a.kind === "const" && b.kind === "target")
      return { kind:"target", offset:a.offset + b.offset, at };

    if (a.kind === "target" && b.kind === "const")
      return { kind:"target", offset:a.offset + b.value, at };

    if (a.kind === "const" && b.kind === "base")
      return { kind:"base", offset:a.offset + b.value, at };

    if (a.kind === "base" && b.kind === "const")
      return { kind:"base", offset:a.offset + b.value, at };

    return { kind:"expr", op:"add", a, b, at };
  }

  while (p < body.end) {

    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      if ((r.value >>> 0) === TARGET)
        push({ kind:"target", offset:0, at });
      else if ((r.value >>> 0) === BASE)
        push({ kind:"base", offset:0, at });
      else
        push(valueConst(r.value, at));

    }

    else if (op === 0x20) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;
      push(getLocal(r.value));
    }

    else if (op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      const v = pop();

      setLocal(r.value, v);

      if (op === 0x22)
        push(v);
    }

    else if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      if (op === 0x23)
        push({ kind:"global", id:r.value });
      else
        pop();
    }

    else if (op === 0x6a) {
      const b2 = pop();
      const a = pop();
      push(valueAdd(a, b2, at));
    }

    else if (arithmetic.has(op)) {

      const b2 = pop();
      const a = pop();

      if (
        (a.kind === "target" || a.kind === "base") ||
        (b2.kind === "target" || b2.kind === "base")
      ) {
        push({
          kind:"expr",
          op:names[op] || `0x${op.toString(16)}`,
          a,
          b:b2,
          at
        });
      } else {
        push({ kind:"unknown" });
      }
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x28 ||
      op === 0x2d
    ) {
      const align = uleb(p);
      p = align.end;

      const off = uleb(p);
      p = off.end;

      const addr = pop();

      if (
        addr.kind === "target" ||
        addr.kind === "base" ||
        addr.kind === "expr"
      ) {
        push({
          kind:"load",
          addr,
          offset:off.value,
          at
        });
      } else {
        push({ kind:"unknown" });
      }
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x36 ||
      op === 0x3a
    ) {
      const align = uleb(p);
      p = align.end;

      const off = uleb(p);
      p = off.end;

      const value = pop();
      const addr = pop();

      let hit = false;
      let type = "";

      if (addr.kind === "target" && addr.offset + off.value === 0) {
        hit = true;
        type = "DIRECT S1 STORE";
      }

      if (addr.kind === "base" && addr.offset + off.value === 4) {
        hit = true;
        type = "BASE+4 = S1 STORE";
      }

      if (addr.kind === "expr") {
        type = "DERIVED ADDRESS";
      }

      if (hit || type === "DERIVED ADDRESS") {
        results.push({
          func,
          at,
          op,
          type,
          addr,
          value
        });
      }
    }

    else if (op === 0x1a) {
      pop();
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      // Unknown stack effect: preserve analysis conservatively.
      push({ kind:"call_result", func:r.value });
    }

    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      p++;

      push({ kind:"indirect_result", type:r.value });
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x45 ||
      op === 0x46 ||
      op === 0x47
    ) {
      pop();
      if (op !== 0x45)
        pop();
      push({ kind:"unknown" });
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x0b ||
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04 ||
      op === 0x05 ||
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d ||
      op === 0x0f
    ) {
      // Control flow is intentionally not followed here.
      // This scan is candidate generation only.
    }

    else {
      // Skip immediate operands for common instructions.
      if (op === 0xfc) {
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.end;
      }
    }
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("S1 STORE DATAFLOW SCAN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET :", hex(TARGET));
console.log("BASE   :", hex(BASE));
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

if (!results.length) {
  console.log("NO S1 DATAFLOW STORE CANDIDATES");
} else {

  for (const r of results) {

    console.log("");
    console.log(`FUNC ${r.func}`);
    console.log(`STORE @ ${hex(r.at)}`);
    console.log(`TYPE : ${r.type}`);

    console.log(
      "ADDR :",
      JSON.stringify(r.addr)
    );

    console.log(
      "VALUE:",
      JSON.stringify(r.value)
    );
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;
const BASE   = 0x195348;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, end: pos };
    s += 7;
  }
  return null;
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v |= (-1 << s);
      return { value: v | 0, end: pos };
    }
  }
  return null;
}
