  // i32.const
  if (b[p] === 0x41) {
    const r = readSLEB(p + 1);
    if (!r) continue;

    const v = r.value >>> 0;

    if (v === TARGET) {
      exactConst.push({
        pos: p,
        end: r.end
      });
    }

    if (v === BASE) {
      baseConst.push({
        pos: p,
        end: r.end
      });
    }
  }

  // i32.store / i32.store8
  if (b[p] === 0x36 || b[p] === 0x3a) {
    const r = uleb(p + 1);
    if (!r) continue;

    const r2 = uleb(r.end);
    if (!r2) continue;

    stores.push({
      pos: p,
      op: b[p],
      end: r2.end,
      align: r.value,
      offset: r2.value
    });
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function u32(p) {
  return (b[p] | (b[p+1] << 8) | (b[p+2] << 16) | (b[p+3] << 24)) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, q = p;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[q++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: q };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, q = p, x;
  while (true) {
    x = b[q++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << s);
  return { value: v | 0, next: q };
}

function getSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const out = [];

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const z = readULEB(p);
    p = z.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + z.value;

    out.push({ id, start, end });
    p = end;
  }

  return out;
}

const sections = getSections();

function findCodeSection() {
  return sections.find(x => x.id === 10);
}

const codeSec = findCodeSection();

if (!codeSec) {
  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

let p = codeSec.start;
const fc = readULEB(p);
p = fc.next;

const bodies = [];

for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
  const sz = readULEB(p);
  p = sz.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + sz.value;

  bodies.push({
    func: i + 83,
    start: bodyStart,
    end: bodyEnd
  });

  p = bodyEnd;
}

function matchTargetConst(pos) {
  if (b[pos] !== 0x41) return false;
  const x = readSLEB(pos + 1);
  return (x.value >>> 0) === TARGET;
}

function decodeMemStore(pos) {
  // i32.store = 0x36
  // followed by alignment + offset ULEB
  if (b[pos] !== 0x36) return null;

  const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    end: o.next,
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value
  };
}

          );

          `TARGET CONST @ 0x${h.constPos.toString(16)} ` +
          `OFFSET=${h.offset}`
        );
      }
    }
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x195350;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: pos };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, x;
  while (true) {
    x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v -= 2 ** shift;
  return { value: v | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex32(v) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;
let codeEnd = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p];
  const s = uleb(p + 1);
  const payload = s.next;
  const end = payload + s.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = payload;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

let q = codeStart;
const count = uleb(q);
q = count.next;

console.log("S2 WRITER SEARCH");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET ADDRESS : ${hex32(TARGET)}`);
console.log(`TARGET VALUE   : ${TARGET}`);
console.log(`CODE SECTION   : ${hex32(codeStart)} .. ${hex32(codeEnd)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let hits = 0;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Scan every defined function
// ------------------------------------------------------------
for (let func = 0; func < count.value; func++) {

  const sz = uleb(q);
  const start = sz.next;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  for (let pos = start; pos < end;) {

    const opPos = pos;
    const op = b[pos++];

    // i32.const
    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(pos);

      if ((r.value >>> 0) === TARGET) {

        hits++;

        console.log(`\n############################################################`);
        console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
        console.log(`CONST @ ${hex32(opPos)}`);
        console.log(`VALUE  : ${r.value}`);
        console.log(`HEX    : ${hex32(r.value)}`);

        // Show nearby raw bytes
        const a = Math.max(start, opPos - 12);
        const z = Math.min(end, r.next + 20);

        console.log("CONTEXT:");
        for (let x = a; x < z; x += 16) {
          const e = Math.min(x + 15, z - 1);
          console.log(
            hex32(x) + "  " +
            [...b.slice(x, e + 1)]
              .map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
              .join(" ")
          );
        }

        // Look forward for memory stores
        let scan = r.next;
        const limit = Math.min(end, scan + 40);

        while (scan < limit) {
          const sop = b[scan++];

          if (
            sop === 0x36 ||
            sop === 0x37 ||
            sop === 0x3a ||
            sop === 0x3b ||
            sop === 0x3c ||
            sop === 0x3e ||
            sop === 0x3f
          ) {
            const al = uleb(scan);
            const off = uleb(al.next);

            console.log(
              `POSSIBLE STORE @ ${hex32(scan - 1)} ` +
              `opcode=0x${sop.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")} ` +
              `offset=${off.value}`
            );

            scan = off.next;
            continue;
          }

          if (sop === 0x41) {
            scan = sleb(scan).next;
            continue;
          }

          if (sop === 0x20 || sop === 0x21 || sop === 0x22) {
            scan = uleb(scan).next;
            continue;
          }

          if (sop === 0x10) {
            scan = uleb(scan).next;
            continue;
          }

          if (sop === 0x11) {
            const a1 = uleb(scan);
            const a2 = uleb(a1.next);
            scan = a2.next;
            continue;
          }
        }
      }

      pos = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    // Skip common immediates
    if (op === 0x10) {
      pos = uleb(pos).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      const a1 = uleb(pos);
      const a2 = uleb(a1.next);
      pos = a2.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
      pos = uleb(pos).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (
      op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 ||
      op === 0x2a || op === 0x2b ||
      op === 0x2c || op === 0x2d ||
      op === 0x2e || op === 0x2f ||
      op === 0x30 || op === 0x31 ||
      op === 0x32 || op === 0x33 ||
      op === 0x34 || op === 0x35 ||
      op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 ||
      op === 0x38 || op === 0x39 ||
      op === 0x3a || op === 0x3b ||
      op === 0x3c || op === 0x3d ||
      op === 0x3e || op === 0x3f
    ) {
      const al = uleb(pos);
      const off = uleb(al.next);
      pos = off.next;
      continue;
    }
  }

  q = end;
}

console.log("\n============================================================");
console.log(`TOTAL DIRECT S2 ADDRESS HITS : ${hits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_MIN = 4057;
const TARGET_MAX = 4188;

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;

function readULEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {

    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {

        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
        }
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readU32LE(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): number {

    return (
        buf[p] |
        (buf[p + 1] << 8) |
        (buf[p + 2] << 16) |
        (buf[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {

    const sections: {
        id: number;
        start: number;
        end: number;
        size: number;
    }[] = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {

        const id = buf[p++];

        const s = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start,
            end,
            size: s.value
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * FUNCTION SECTION
 *
 * Defined function N has a type index.
 * Function index = imported_count + defined_index.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function parseFunctionTypes(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        start: number;
        end: number;
    },
    importedFunctions: number
) {

    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const result = new Map<number, number>();

    for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {

        const typeInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = typeInfo.next;

        const functionIndex =
            importedFunctions + i;

        result.set(
            functionIndex,
            typeInfo.value
        );
    }

    return result;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * IMPORT SECTION
 *
 * Count imported functions.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function countImportedFunctions(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        start: number;
        end: number;
    }
) {

    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    let functionCount = 0;

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < countInfo.value;
        i++
    ) {

        /*
         * module name
         */
        const moduleLen = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = moduleLen.next + moduleLen.value;

        /*
         * field/name
         */
        const fieldLen = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = fieldLen.next + fieldLen.value;

        /*
         * import kind
         */
        const kind = buf[p++];

        if (kind === 0x00) {

            /*
             * func type index
             */
            const type = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = type.next;

            functionCount++;

        } else if (kind === 0x01) {

            /*
             * table
             */
            p++;

            const flags = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = flags.next;

            const min = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = min.next;

            if (flags.value & 1) {
                const max = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = max.next;
            }

        } else if (kind === 0x02) {

            /*
             * memory
             */
            const flags = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = flags.next;

            const min = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = min.next;

            if (flags.value & 1) {
                const max = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = max.next;
            }

        } else if (kind === 0x03) {

            /*
             * global
             */
            p += 2;

        } else {

            throw new Error(
                `Unknown import kind ${kind}`
            );
        }
    }

    return functionCount;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * ELEMENT TABLE
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function parseElementTable(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        start: number;
        end: number;
    }
) {

    let p = section.start;

    const segmentCount = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = segmentCount.next;

    if (segmentCount.value !== 1) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected 1 element segment, got ${segmentCount.value}`
        );
    }

    const flags = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = flags.next;

    if (flags.value !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected active table segment flags=0, got ${flags.value}`
        );
    }

    const offsetOpcode = buf[p++];

    if (offsetOpcode !== 0x41) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected i32.const, got ${hex(offsetOpcode)}`
        );
    }

    const offset = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = offset.next;

    const endOpcode = buf[p++];

    if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected end, got ${hex(endOpcode)}`
        );
    }

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const tableToFunction =
        new Map<number, number>();

    const functionToTable =
        new Map<number, number>();

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < countInfo.value;
        i++
    ) {

        const fnInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = fnInfo.next;

        const tableIndex =
            offset.value + i;

        tableToFunction.set(
            tableIndex,
            fnInfo.value
        );

        if (!functionToTable.has(fnInfo.value)) {
            functionToTable.set(
                fnInfo.value,
                tableIndex
            );
        }
    }

    return {
        count: countInfo.value,
        cursor: p,
        tableToFunction,
        functionToTable
    };
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * CODE SECTION
 *
 * Build exact function-body ranges.
 * We don't decode instructions.
 *
 * We only need to determine which function body contains
 * each byte-pattern candidate.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function parseCodeBodies(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        start: number;
        end: number;
    }
) {

    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const bodies: {
        functionIndex: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
        bodySize: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < countInfo.value;
        i++
    ) {

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd =
            bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

        bodies.push({
            functionIndex: 83 + i,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            bodySize: sizeInfo.value
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return {
        count: countInfo.value,
        cursor: p,
        bodies
    };
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * LEB ENCODER
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function encodeULEB(
    value: number
): number[] {

    const out: number[] = [];

    do {

        let byte =
            value & 0x7f;

        value =
            Math.floor(value / 128);

        if (value !== 0) {
            byte |= 0x80;
        }

        out.push(byte);

    } while (value !== 0);

    return out;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * MAIN
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

export async function run() {

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SEGMENT 413 INDIRECT CONSUMER SEARCH");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const buf =
        fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log("");
    console.log("WASM size :", buf.length);

    const sections =
        parseSections(buf);

    const importSection =
        sections.find(x => x.id === 2);

    const functionSection =
        sections.find(x => x.id === 3);

    const elementSection =
        sections.find(x => x.id === 9);

    const codeSection =
        sections.find(x => x.id === 10);

    if (
        !importSection ||
        !functionSection ||
        !elementSection ||
        !codeSection
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            "Required section missing"
        );
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * IMPORTS
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    const importedFunctions =
        countImportedFunctions(
            buf,
            importSection
        );

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "Imported functions :",
        importedFunctions
    );

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * FUNCTION TYPES
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    const functionTypes =
        parseFunctionTypes(
            buf,
            functionSection,
            importedFunctions
        );

    console.log(
        "Function type entries :",
        functionTypes.size
    );

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * ELEMENT TABLE
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    const element =
        parseElementTable(
            buf,
            elementSection
        );

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "Element segments : 1"
    );

    console.log(
        "Table offset     : 1"
    );

    console.log(
        "Function count   :",
        element.count
    );

    console.log(
        "Element cursor   :",
        hex(element.cursor)
    );

    console.log(
        "Expected cursor  :",
        hex(elementSection.end)
    );

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * TARGET MAP
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    type Target = {
        fn: number;
        type: number;
        table: number;
        pattern: number[];
    };

    const targets: Target[] = [];

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" TARGET DISPATCH MAP");
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (
        let fn = TARGET_MIN;
        fn <= TARGET_MAX;
        fn++
    ) {

        const type =
            functionTypes.get(fn);

        const table =
            element.functionToTable.get(fn);

        if (
            type === undefined ||
            table === undefined
        ) {
            console.log(
                `function ${fn}: MISSING TYPE OR TABLE`
            );
            continue;
        }

        /*
         * call_indirect encoding:
         *
         * 0x11
         * typeidx
         * tableidx
         *
         * We search exact ULEB sequences.
         */

        const typeBytes =
            encodeULEB(type);

        const tableBytes =
            encodeULEB(table);

        const pattern = [
            0x11,
            ...typeBytes,
            ...tableBytes
        ];

        targets.push({
            fn,
            type,
            table,
            pattern
        });
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * CODE BODY INDEX
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    const code =
        parseCodeBodies(
            buf,
            codeSection
        );

    console.log("");
    console.log("Code bodies :", code.count);

    console.log(
        "Code cursor :",
        hex(code.cursor)
    );

    console.log(
        "Expected    :",
        hex(codeSection.end)
    );

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * SEARCH
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SEARCHING CODE SECTION");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const matches: {
        targetFunction: number;
        type: number;
        table: number;
        codeOffset: number;
        caller: number;
    }[] = [];

    /*
     * Binary-search body containing an offset.
     */

    function findBody(
        offset: number
    ) {

        let lo = 0;
        let hi = code.bodies.length - 1;

        while (lo <= hi) {

            const mid =
                (lo + hi) >> 1;

            const body =
                code.bodies[mid];

            if (
                offset >= body.bodyStart &&
                offset < body.bodyEnd
            ) {
                return body;
            }

            if (offset < body.bodyStart) {
                hi = mid - 1;
            } else {
                lo = mid + 1;
            }
        }

        return undefined;
    }

    for (const target of targets) {

        const pat =
            target.pattern;

        for (
            let p = CODE_START;
            p + pat.length <= CODE_END;
            p++
        ) {

            let ok = true;

            for (
                let j = 0;
                j < pat.length;
                j++
            ) {

                if (buf[p + j] !== pat[j]) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!ok) {
                continue;
            }

            const body =
                findBody(p);

            if (!body) {
                continue;
            }

            matches.push({
                targetFunction: target.fn,
                type: target.type,
                table: target.table,
                codeOffset: p,
                caller: body.functionIndex
            });
        }
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * OUTPUT
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" INDIRECT CONSUMER MATCHES");
    console.log("============================================================");

    if (matches.length === 0) {

        console.log(
            "No exact call_indirect(type,table) byte-pattern matches."
        );

    } else {

        for (const m of matches) {

            console.log(
                `target function ${m.targetFunction}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  type  = ${m.type}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  table = ${hex(m.table)}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  call_indirect @ ${hex(m.codeOffset)}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  caller = function ${m.caller}`
            );

            console.log("");
        }
    }

    /*
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     * SUMMARY BY TARGET
     * --------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SUMMARY BY TARGET");
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (const target of targets) {

        const found =
            matches.filter(
                x =>
                    x.targetFunction === target.fn
            );

        console.log(
            `function ${target.fn}` +
            `  table=${hex(target.table)}` +
            `  type=${target.type}` +
            `  matches=${found.length}`
        );

        for (const x of found) {

            console.log(
                `    caller=${x.caller}` +
                ` @ ${hex(x.codeOffset)}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" END");
    console.log("============================================================");
}

import fs from "fs";

function hx(n: number, w = 8): string {
    return n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function uleb(n: number): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];

    while (n >= 0x80) {
        out.push((n & 0x7f) | 0x80);
        n >>>= 7;
    }

    out.push(n);
    return out;
}

function findAll(buf: Buffer, pattern: Buffer): number[] {
    const hits: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i <= buf.length - pattern.length; i++) {
        let ok = true;

        for (let j = 0; j < pattern.length; j++) {
            if (buf[i + j] !== pattern[j]) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (ok) hits.push(i);
    }

    return hits;
}

function dump(buf: Buffer, pos: number, radius = 48) {
    const start = Math.max(0, pos - radius);
    const end = Math.min(buf.length, pos + radius + 16);

    console.log(
        `\n--- file offset 0x${hx(pos)} (${pos}) ---`
    );

    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < 16 && p + j < end; j++) {
            bytes.push(
                buf[p + j].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
            );
        }

        console.log(
            `0x${hx(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
        );
    }
}

function readLeb(buf: Buffer, pos: number): {
    value: number;
    length: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 5 && pos + i < buf.length; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos + i];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                length: i + 1,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: 0,
        length: 0,
    };
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, off: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 10 && off + i < buf.length; i++) {
    const b = buf[off + i];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value,
        bytes: i + 1,
        hex: buf.subarray(off, off + i + 1).toString("hex"),
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

    wasm[off] |
    (wasm[off + 1] << 8) |

    (wasm[off + 3] << 24);

  if ((v >>> 0) !== TARGET) continue;

  hits++;

  console.log("");

  const start = Math.max(0, off - 32);
  const end = Math.min(wasm.length, off + 40);

  console.log(`RANGE      : 0x${start.toString(16)} .. 0x${end.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`RAW        : ${wasm.subarray(start, end).toString("hex")}`);

  console.log("ULEB CANDIDATES:");

    const u = readULEB(wasm, p);

    if (u && u.value === TARGET) {

      );
    }
  }

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) break;
  }

  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function section(idWanted: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === idWanted) return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

const code = section(10);

if (!code) throw new Error("CODE section not found");

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SELECTOR CONSTANT SEARCH");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET DEC : ${TARGET}`);
console.log(`TARGET HEX : 0x${TARGET.toString(16)}`);
console.log(`CODE       : 0x${code.start.toString(16)} .. 0x${code.end.toString(16)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let p = code.start;

const bodyCount = uleb(p);
p = bodyCount.next;

let hits = 0;

for (let f = 0; f < bodyCount.value; f++) {

  const bs = uleb(p);
  p = bs.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bs.value;

  let q = bodyStart;

  // locals
  const groups = uleb(q);
  q = groups.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < groups.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(q);
    q = n.next;
    q++;
  }

  // Scan instructions.
  while (q < bodyEnd) {

    const opPos = q;
    const op = wasm[q++];

    // i32.const
    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;

      if (x.value === TARGET) {
        hits++;

        console.log("");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(`BODY INDEX : ${f}`);
        console.log(`DEFINED    : ${f + 83}`);
        console.log(`OFFSET     : 0x${opPos.toString(16)}`);
        console.log(`i32.const  : 0x${TARGET.toString(16)}`);
      }

      continue;
    }

    // i64.const
    if (op === 0x42) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;
      continue;
    }

    // local.get/set/tee
    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;
      continue;
    }

    // call
    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;
      continue;
    }

    // br / br_if
    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;
      continue;
    }

    // memory load/store immediates
    if (
      (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e)
    ) {
      const align = uleb(q);
      q = align.next;

      const offset = uleb(q);
      q = offset.next;

      continue;
    }

    // block / loop / if
    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      q++;
      continue;
    }

    // memory.size / memory.grow
    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
      q++;
      continue;
    }
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log(`TOTAL EXACT i32.const HITS : ${hits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);

function hx(x) {

function readU32(p) {
  return (
    b[p] |
    (b[p + 1] << 8) |
    (b[p + 2] << 16) |
    (b[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

  segments.push({

  });

  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("SOURCE SEGMENT :", source);
  console.log("RUNTIME        :", hx(s.memStart));
  console.log("PAIRS          :", sig.length);

  for (const [key, selector] of sig) {
    console.log(
      "  KEY", key,
      "SELECTOR", selector
    );
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("MATCHING SEGMENTS:");

  let matches = 0;

  for (const t of segments) {
    const len = t.end - t.start;

    if (len !== s.end - s.start) continue;

    let same = true;

    for (let off = 0; off < len; off += 4) {
      if (readU32(s.start + off) !== readU32(t.start + off)) {
        same = false;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (same) {
      console.log(
        "  SEG", t.seg,
        "RUNTIME", hx(t.memStart),
        "SIZE", len
      );
      matches++;
    }
  }

  console.log("MATCH COUNT :", matches);
}

function u32le(p) {
  return (
    b[p] |
    (b[p + 1] << 8) |
    (b[p + 2] << 16) |
    (b[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function leb32(v) {
  const out = [];
  do {
    let x = v & 0x7f;
    v >>>= 7;
    if (v) x |= 0x80;
    out.push(x);
  } while (v);
  return out;
}

function encodeULEB(v: number): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  do {
    let b = v & 0x7f;
    v = Math.floor(v / 128);
    if (v !== 0) b |= 0x80;
    out.push(b);
  } while (v !== 0);
  return out;
}

const target = Buffer.from(encodeULEB(TARGET));

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 0x00255880;

function readULEB(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[p++];

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function readSections(b: Buffer) {
    const sections: any[] = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < b.length) {
        const id = b[p++];

        const s = readULEB(b, p);
        p = s.next;

        sections.push({
            id,
            payload: p,
            size: s.value,
            end: p + s.value,
        });

        p += s.value;
    }

    return sections;
}

function getSection(sections: any[], id: number) {
    const s = sections.find(x => x.id === id);

    if (!s) {
        throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
    }

    return s;
}

function importedFunctions(
    b: Buffer,
    s: any
) {
    let p = s.payload;

    const n = readULEB(b, p);
    p = n.next;

    let count = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

        const ml = readULEB(b, p);
        p = ml.next + ml.value;

        const nl = readULEB(b, p);
        p = nl.next + nl.value;

        const kind = b[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const x = readULEB(b, p);
            p = x.next;
            count++;
        } else {
            throw new Error(
                `unexpected import kind ${kind}`
            );
        }
    }

    return count;
}

function getBodies(
    b: Buffer,
    s: any
) {
    let p = s.payload;

    const n = readULEB(b, p);
    p = n.next;

    const result: any[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

        const size = readULEB(b, p);
        p = size.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

        const locals = readULEB(b, p);
        p = locals.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < locals.value; j++) {
            const count = readULEB(b, p);
            p = count.next;
            p++;
        }

        result.push({
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            codeStart: p,
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return result;
}

function hex8(x: number) {
    return (
        "0x" +
        (x >>> 0)
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")
    );
}

function decodeForSearch(
    b: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    const ins: any[] = [];

    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {

        const abs = p;
        const op = b[p++];

        try {

            if (
                op === 0x20 ||
                op === 0x21 ||
                op === 0x22 ||
                op === 0x23 ||
                op === 0x24
            ) {
                const x = readULEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

            } else if (op === 0x41) {

                const x = readSLEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

                ins.push({
                    abs,
                    op,
                    imm: x.value >>> 0,
                });

                continue;

            } else if (op === 0x42) {

                const x = readSLEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

            } else if (
                op >= 0x28 &&
                op <= 0x3e
            ) {

                const a = readULEB(b, p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = readULEB(b, p);
                p = o.next;

                ins.push({
                    abs,
                    op,
                    offset: o.value >>> 0,
                });

                continue;

            } else if (op === 0x10) {

                const x = readULEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

            } else if (
                op === 0x0c ||
                op === 0x0d
            ) {

                const x = readULEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

            } else if (
                op === 0x02 ||
                op === 0x03 ||
                op === 0x04
            ) {

                // block / loop / if
                p++;

            } else if (op === 0x05) {

                // else

            } else if (op === 0x0e) {

                // br_table
                const n = readULEB(b, p);
                p = n.next;

                for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
                    const x = readULEB(b, p);
                    p = x.next;
                }

            }

            ins.push({
                abs,
                op,
            });

        } catch {
            break;
        }
    }

    return ins;
}

function printWindow(
    b: Buffer,
    center: number,
    radius = 35
) {
    const start =
        Math.max(0, center - radius);

    const end =
        Math.min(b.length, center + radius);

    console.log(
        `\n--- WINDOW ${hex8(center)} ---`
    );

    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {

        const pos = p;
        const op = b[p++];

        let text =
            `byte=${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

        try {

            if (op === 0x41) {

                const x = readSLEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

                text =
                    `i32.const ${x.value} (${hex8(x.value)})`;

            } else if (op === 0x20) {

                const x = readULEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

                text = `local.get ${x.value}`;

            } else if (op === 0x21) {

                const x = readULEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

                text = `local.set ${x.value}`;

            } else if (op === 0x22) {

                const x = readULEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

                text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;

            } else if (
                op >= 0x28 &&
                op <= 0x3e
            ) {

                const a = readULEB(b, p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = readULEB(b, p);
                p = o.next;

                text =
                    `memory-op 0x${op
                        .toString(16)
                        .padStart(2, "0")}` +
                    ` align=${a.value}` +
                    ` offset=${hex8(o.value)}`;

            } else if (op === 0x10) {

                const x = readULEB(b, p);
                p = x.next;

                text = `call ${x.value}`;

            } else if (op === 0x6a) {

                text = "i32.add";

            } else if (op === 0x6b) {

                text = "i32.sub";

            } else if (op === 0x71) {

                text = "i32.and";

            } else if (op === 0x72) {

                text = "i32.or";

            } else if (op === 0x73) {

                text = "i32.xor";

            } else if (op === 0x74) {

                text = "i32.shl";

            } else if (op === 0x75) {

                text = "i32.shr_s";

            } else if (op === 0x76) {

                text = "i32.shr_u";

            } else if (op === 0x68) {

                text = "i32.ctz";

            } else if (op === 0x36) {

                text = "i32.store";

            } else if (op === 0x28) {

                text = "i32.load";

            }

        } catch {
            text = "decode-error";
        }

        const marker =
            pos === center
                ? " >>> "
                : "     ";

        console.log(
            `${marker}${hex8(pos)}  ${text}`
        );
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x0019534c;
const BASE   = 0x00195348;
const IMPORTS = 83;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, end: pos };

    s += 7;
  }

  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v -= 2 ** s;

      return { value: v | 0, end: pos };
    }
  }

  throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function findBodies() {

  let p = 8;
  const bodies = [];

  while (p < b.length) {

    const id = b[p++];

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;

    const end = p + r.value;

    if (id === 10) {

      const c = uleb(p);
      let q = c.end;

      for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {

        const z = uleb(q);
        q = z.end;

        bodies.push({
          start: q,
          end: q + z.value
        });

        q += z.value;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = findBodies();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("STATE POINTER WRITER SCAN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET :", hex(TARGET));
console.log("BASE   :", hex(BASE));
console.log("============================================================");

let totalStores = 0;
let candidates = 0;

for (let fi = 0; fi < bodies.length; fi++) {

  const func = fi + IMPORTS;
  const body = bodies[fi];

  let p = body.start;

  const groups = uleb(p);
  p = groups.end;

  let localCount = groups.value;

  for (let i = 0; i < groups.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.end;

    p++;
    localCount += n.value;
  }

  const locals = new Map();

  let stack = [];

  function push(x) {
    stack.push(x);
  }

  function pop() {
    return stack.length
      ? stack.pop()
      : { type: "UNKNOWN" };
  }

  function addrKnown(x) {

    if (!x)
      return false;

    if (x.type === "CONST")
      return (
        x.value === TARGET ||
        x.value === BASE
      );

    if (x.type === "ADD") {

      if (
        x.base &&
        x.offset !== undefined &&
        x.base.type === "CONST"
      ) {

        const v =
          (x.base.value + x.offset) >>> 0;

        return (
          v === TARGET ||
          v === BASE
        );
      }
    }

    if (x.type === "LOCAL")
      return false;

    return false;
  }

  let localState = new Map();

  function describe(x) {

    if (!x)
      return "UNKNOWN";

    if (x.type === "CONST")
      return `CONST ${hex(x.value)}`;

    if (x.type === "LOCAL")
      return `L${x.id}`;

    if (x.type === "ADD")
      return `ADD(${describe(x.base)}, ${x.offset})`;

    if (x.type === "LOAD")
      return `LOAD(${describe(x.addr)})`;

    return x.type || "UNKNOWN";
  }

  let found = [];

  while (p < body.end) {

    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // LOCAL.GET
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x20) {

      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      const id = r.value;

      const v =
        localState.get(id) ||
        { type: "LOCAL", id };

      push(v);
      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // LOCAL.SET
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x21) {

      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      const id = r.value;

      const v = pop();

      localState.set(id, v);

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // LOCAL.TEE
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x22) {

      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      const id = r.value;

      const v = stack.length
        ? stack[stack.length - 1]
        : { type: "UNKNOWN" };

      localState.set(id, v);

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // I32.CONST
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x41) {

      const r = sleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      push({
        type: "CONST",
        value: r.value >>> 0
      });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // I32.ADD
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x6a) {

      const rhs = pop();
      const lhs = pop();

      if (
        lhs?.type === "CONST" &&
        rhs?.type === "CONST"
      ) {

        push({
          type: "CONST",
          value: (lhs.value + rhs.value) >>> 0
        });

      } else if (
        lhs?.type === "CONST" &&
        rhs?.type === "UNKNOWN"
      ) {

        push({
          type: "ADD",
          base: lhs,
          offset: undefined
        });

      } else {

        push({
          type: "ADD",
          base: lhs,
          offset:
            rhs?.type === "CONST"
              ? rhs.value
              : undefined
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // I32.LOAD
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x28) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.end;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.end;

      const addr = pop();

      push({
        type: "LOAD",
        addr,
        offset: o.value
      });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // I32.STORE
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x36) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.end;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.end;

      const value = pop();
      const addr  = pop();

      totalStores++;

      let hit = false;
      let resolved = "";

      // Direct constant address
      if (addr?.type === "CONST") {

        const absolute =
          (addr.value + o.value) >>> 0;

        if (
          absolute === TARGET ||
          absolute === BASE
        ) {

          hit = true;
          resolved =
            `ABSOLUTE ${hex(absolute)}`;
        }
      }

      // ADD-derived address
      if (!hit && addr?.type === "ADD") {

        if (
          addr.base?.type === "CONST" &&
          addr.offset !== undefined
        ) {

          const absolute =
            (
              addr.base.value +
              addr.offset +
              o.value
            ) >>> 0;

          if (
            absolute === TARGET ||
            absolute === BASE
          ) {

            hit = true;
            resolved =
              `ARITHMETIC ${hex(absolute)}`;
          }
        }
      }

      if (hit) {

        candidates++;

        found.push({
          func,
          at,
          addr: describe(addr),
          offset: o.value,
          value: describe(value),
          resolved
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // I32.STORE8
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x3a) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.end;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.end;

      pop();
      const addr = pop();

      if (addr?.type === "CONST") {

        const absolute =
          (addr.value + o.value) >>> 0;

        if (
          absolute === TARGET ||
          absolute === BASE
        ) {

          candidates++;

          found.push({
            func,
            at,
            addr: describe(addr),
            offset: o.value,
            value: "STORE8",
            resolved:
              `ABSOLUTE ${hex(absolute)}`
          });
        }
      }

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CALL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x10) {

      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      // Unknown call result.
      // Clear stack because argument provenance
      // cannot safely be propagated through arbitrary calls.
      stack = [];

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CALL_INDIRECT
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x11) {

      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      p++;

      stack = [];

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // DROP
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x1a) {

      pop();
      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Memory opcodes with memarg
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      op === 0x29 ||
      op === 0x2a ||
      op === 0x2b ||
      op === 0x2c ||
      op === 0x2d ||
      op === 0x2e ||
      op === 0x2f ||
      op === 0x30 ||
      op === 0x31 ||
      op === 0x32 ||
      op === 0x33 ||
      op === 0x34 ||
      op === 0x35
    ) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.end;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.end;

      pop();

      push({
        type: "LOAD",
        addr: { type: "UNKNOWN" },
        offset: o.value
      });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Generic arithmetic / comparison:
    // consume operands, produce unknown.
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      op === 0x45 ||
      op === 0x46 ||
      op === 0x47 ||
      op === 0x48 ||
      op === 0x49 ||
      op === 0x4a ||
      op === 0x4b ||
      op === 0x4c ||
      op === 0x4d ||
      op === 0x4e ||
      op === 0x4f ||
      op === 0x50
    ) {

      pop();
      pop();
      push({ type: "UNKNOWN" });

      continue;
    }

    if (
      op === 0x6b ||
      op === 0x6c ||
      op === 0x6d ||
      op === 0x6e ||
      op === 0x6f ||
      op === 0x70 ||
      op === 0x71 ||
      op === 0x72 ||
      op === 0x73 ||
      op === 0x74 ||
      op === 0x75 ||
      op === 0x76 ||
      op === 0x77 ||
      op === 0x78 ||
      op === 0x79 ||
      op === 0x7a
    ) {

      pop();
      pop();
      push({ type: "UNKNOWN" });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Control flow
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04
    ) {

      // block / loop / if blocktype
      if (p < body.end) {

        const bt = b[p++];

        if (bt === 0x40)
          continue;

        if (
          bt === 0x7f ||
          bt === 0x7e ||
          bt === 0x7d ||
          bt === 0x7c
        )
          continue;
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x05 || op === 0x0b)
      continue;

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.end;

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0f)
      continue;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Unknown opcode:
    // keep parser synchronized only when possible.
    // --------------------------------------------------------

  }

  if (found.length) {

    console.log("");
    console.log("############################################################");
    console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
    console.log("############################################################");

    for (const x of found) {

      console.log(
        `STORE @ ${hex(x.at)}` +
        `  ${x.resolved}`
      );

      console.log(
        `  ADDRESS : ${x.addr}` +
        ` + offset ${x.offset}`
      );

      console.log(
        `  VALUE   : ${x.value}`
      );
    }
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TOTAL I32.STORE SCANNED :", totalStores);
console.log("POINTER/ADDRESS CANDIDATES:", candidates);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("============================================================");

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

const ROOT = path.resolve(
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\node_modules'
);

const SEARCHES = [
    '0x37c096df',
    '37c096df',
    '935368415',

    '0x50c6a654',
    '50c6a654',
    '1355195988',

    '0x178d4519',
    '178d4519',
    '395134233',

    '0x06ecd527',
    '06ecd527',
    '115137831',
];

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

const SKIP_DIRS = new Set([
    '.cache',
    '.git',
    'dist',
    'coverage',
]);

const TEXT_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
    '.ts',
    '.tsx',
    '.js',
    '.mjs',
    '.cjs',
    '.json',
    '.d.ts',
    '.map',
]);

let filesScanned = 0;
let matches = 0;

function shouldSkipDirectory(
    name: string
): boolean {
    return (
        SKIP_DIRS.has(name) ||
        name.startsWith('.')
    );
}

function scanFile(
    filePath: string
) {
    try {
        const stat =
            fs.statSync(filePath);

        if (
            !stat.isFile() ||
            stat.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE
        ) {
            return;
        }

        const ext =
            path.extname(filePath);

        if (
            !TEXT_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)
        ) {
            return;
        }

        const text =
            fs.readFileSync(
                filePath,
                'utf8'
            );

        filesScanned++;

        const lower =
            text.toLowerCase();

        for (
            const search of SEARCHES
        ) {
            const needle =
                search.toLowerCase();

            let position =
                lower.indexOf(needle);

            while (
                position !== -1
            ) {
                matches++;

                const start =
                    Math.max(
                        0,
                        position - 300
                    );

                const end =
                    Math.min(
                        text.length,
                        position + 500
                    );

                const context =
                    text.slice(
                        start,
                        end
                    );

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    '============================================================'
                );

                console.log(
                    `MATCH: ${search}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `FILE : ${filePath}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `POS  : ${position}`
                );

                console.log(
                    '------------------------------------------------------------'
                );

                console.log(context);

                console.log(
                    '============================================================'
                );

                position =
                    lower.indexOf(
                        needle,
                        position + needle.length
                    );
            }
        }
    } catch {
        // Ignore unreadable/binary files.
    }
}

function walk(
    dir: string
) {
    let entries:
        fs.Dirent[];

    try {
        entries =
            fs.readdirSync(
                dir,
                {
                    withFileTypes: true,
                }
            );
    } catch {
        return;
    }

    for (
        const entry of entries
    ) {
        if (
            entry.isDirectory()
        ) {
            if (
                shouldSkipDirectory(
                    entry.name
                )
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            walk(
                path.join(
                    dir,
                    entry.name
                )
            );

            continue;
        }

        if (
            entry.isFile()
        ) {
            scanFile(
                path.join(
                    dir,
                    entry.name
                )
            );
        }
    }
}

export async function run() {
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        ' STON.FI v2.2 SDK SCHEMA SEARCH'
    );

    console.log(
        ' READ ONLY - LOCAL node_modules ONLY'
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `Search root: ${ROOT}`
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Searching for known STON.fi opcodes...'
    );

    walk(ROOT);

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        'SEARCH FINISHED'
    );

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        `Files scanned : ${filesScanned}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Matches       : ${matches}`
    );

    console.log('');

    if (matches === 0) {
        console.log(
            'No opcode text found in node_modules.'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            'Review the matching files above.'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT'
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [0x195350, 0x195354];

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function findSection(id: number) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const sid = wasm[p++];
        const s = readULEB(p);
        p = s.next;

        if (sid === id) {
            return { start: p, end: p + s.value };
        }

        p += s.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

function parseCode() {
    const sec = findSection(10);
    let p = sec.start;

    const c = readULEB(p);
    p = c.next;

    const bodies: any[] = [];

    for (let ord = 0; ord < c.value; ord++) {
        const size = readULEB(p);
        p = size.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

        const localDecl = readULEB(p);
        p = localDecl.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < localDecl.value; i++) {
            const n = readULEB(p);
            p = n.next;
            p++;
        }

        bodies.push({
            globalFunc: ord + 83,
            codeStart: p,
            bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

const bodies = parseCode();

console.log("FIND STORE PATTERNS FOR 0x195350 / 0x195354");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let total = 0;

for (const body of bodies) {
    let p = body.codeStart;

    while (p < body.bodyEnd) {
        const at = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        /*
         * Memory stores:
         *
         * 0x36 i32.store
         * 0x37 i64.store
         * 0x38 f32.store
         * 0x39 f64.store
         * 0x3a i32.store8
         * 0x3b i32.store16
         * 0x3c i64.store8
         * 0x3d i64.store16
         * 0x3e i64.store32
         */

        if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {
            const align = readULEB(p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readULEB(p);
            p = offset.next;

            /*
             * A direct constant-address store has:
             *
             * i32.const TARGET
             * store
             *
             * The CONST itself is immediately before the store.
             */

            const windowStart = Math.max(body.codeStart, at - 12);

            let foundTarget = false;

            for (let q = windowStart; q < at; q++) {
                if (wasm[q] !== 0x41) continue;

                let r = q + 1;
                let value = 0;
                let shift = 0;

                while (r < at) {
                    const b = wasm[r++];
                    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

                    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
                    shift += 7;
                }

                if (TARGETS.includes(value >>> 0)) {
                    foundTarget = true;

                    console.log("");
                    console.log(
                        `FUNC ${body.globalFunc} STORE @ ` +
                        `0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `  TARGET CONST = 0x${(value >>> 0).toString(16)} ` +
                        `(${value >>> 0})`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `  ALIGN=${align.value} OFFSET=${offset.value}`
                    );

                    console.log("  BYTES:");

                    const from = Math.max(body.codeStart, q - 8);
                    const to = Math.min(body.bodyEnd, p + 8);

                    let hex = "";

                    for (let x = from; x < to; x++) {
                        hex += wasm[x].toString(16).padStart(2, "0") + " ";
                    }

                    console.log(
                        `  0x${from.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. ` +
                        `0x${to.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
                    );
                    console.log(`  ${hex}`);

                    total++;
                }
            }

            if (foundTarget) continue;
        }

        switch (op) {
            case 0x10: {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;
                break;
            }

            case 0x11: {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                const y = readULEB(p);
                p = y.next;
                break;
            }

            case 0x20:
            case 0x21:
            case 0x22: {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;
                break;
            }

            case 0x41:
            case 0x42: {
                let shift = 0;

                while (p < body.bodyEnd) {
                    const b = wasm[p++];
                    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
                    shift += 7;
                    if (shift > 35) break;
                }

                break;
            }

            case 0x43:
                p += 4;
                break;

            case 0x44:
                p += 8;
                break;

            case 0x28:
            case 0x29:
            case 0x2a:
            case 0x2b:
            case 0x2c:
            case 0x2d:
            case 0x2e:
            case 0x2f:
            case 0x36:
            case 0x37:
            case 0x38:
            case 0x39:
            case 0x3a:
            case 0x3b:
            case 0x3c:
            case 0x3d:
            case 0x3e: {
                const a = readULEB(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = readULEB(p);
                p = o.next;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0c:
            case 0x0d: {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0e: {
                const n = readULEB(p);
                p = n.next;

                for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
                    const x = readULEB(p);
                    p = x.next;
                }
                break;
            }

            case 0x02:
            case 0x03:
            case 0x04:
                p++;
                break;

            case 0x3f:
            case 0x40:
                p++;
                break;
        }
    }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const file =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(file);

const IMPORTED = 83;

const TARGET = 0x250fa0;
const RANGE = 0x40;

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 0;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos
    };
}

function hex(n, w = 8) {
    return "0x" +
        (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let pos = 8;
let codeStart = 0;

while (pos < buf.length) {

    const id = buf[pos++];

    const s = readULEB(pos);
    const size = s.value;
    pos = s.next;

    const start = pos;
    const end = start + size;

    if (id === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (!codeStart)
    throw new Error("Code section not found");

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Bodies
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let p = codeStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const count = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

const bodies = [];

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    bodies.push({
        func: IMPORTED + i,
        start: p,
        end: p + size
    });

    p += size;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Decode store instructions
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function storeInfo(op, p) {

    if (
        op === 0x36 || // i32.store
        op === 0x3a || // i32.store8
        op === 0x3b    // i32.store16
    ) {

        const a = readULEB(p + 1);
        const o = readULEB(a.next);

        return {
            name:
                op === 0x36 ? "i32.store" :
                op === 0x3a ? "i32.store8" :
                               "i32.store16",
            align: a.value,
            offset: o.value,
            next: o.next
        };
    }

    return null;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Search backward for nearby i32.const
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function findBase(body, storePos) {

    const start = Math.max(body.start, storePos - 40);

    let candidates = [];

    for (let p = start; p < storePos; p++) {

        if (buf[p] !== 0x41)
            continue;

        const r = readSLEB(p + 1);
        const value = r.value >>> 0;

        if (
            value >= TARGET - RANGE &&
            value <= TARGET + RANGE
        ) {
            candidates.push({
                addr: p,
                value
            });
        }
    }

    return candidates;
}

function uleb(): number {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return v >>> 0;
}

let table0: number[] = [];

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const size = uleb();
  const end = p + size;

  if (id === 9) {
    const n = uleb();

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const flags = uleb();

      if (flags === 0) {
        if (b[p++] !== 0x41) throw new Error("bad offset expr");
        uleb();
        if (b[p++] !== 0x0b) throw new Error("bad offset end");
      } else if (flags === 2) {
        uleb();
        if (b[p++] !== 0x41) throw new Error("bad offset expr");
        uleb();
        if (b[p++] !== 0x0b) throw new Error("bad offset end");
      } else {
        throw new Error("unsupported element flags " + flags);
      }

      const count = uleb();

      for (let j = 0; j < count; j++) {
        const fn = uleb();
        table0.push(fn);
      }
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function parseSections() {
    let pos = 8;

    const sections: Record<
        number,
        { start: number; end: number }
    > = {};

    while (pos < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[pos++];

        const s = u32leb(pos);
        pos = s.next;

        const start = pos;
        const end = pos + s.value;

        sections[id] = { start, end };

        pos = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseCodeBodies(section: {
    start: number;
    end: number;
}) {
    let pos = section.start;

    const count = u32leb(pos);
    pos = count.next;

    const bodies: {
        func: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
        instrStart: number;
    }[] = [];

    const imported = 83;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const size = u32leb(pos);
        pos = size.next;

        const bodyStart = pos;
        const bodyEnd = pos + size.value;

        /*
         * locals vector
         */
        const localCount = u32leb(pos);
        pos = localCount.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localCount.value; j++) {
            const n = u32leb(pos);
            pos = n.next;

            pos += 1; // valtype
        }

        const instrStart = pos;

        bodies.push({
            func: imported + i,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            instrStart,
        });

        pos = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function isInside(
    p: number,
    body: {
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
    }
) {
    return p >= body.bodyStart && p < body.bodyEnd;
}

async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" TABLE SLOT 0x72 PRODUCER SEARCH");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log("");
    console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length}`);
    console.log("Target function : 4154");
    console.log("Target table slot: 0x72 = 114");
    console.log("i32.const 114 encoding: 41 f2 00");
    console.log("");

    const sections = parseSections();

    const code = sections[10];

    if (!code) {
        throw new Error("Code section not found");
    }

    const bodies = parseCodeBodies(code);

    console.log(`Code bodies : ${bodies.length}`);
    console.log("");

    const hits: {
        offset: number;
        func: number;
    }[] = [];

    /*
     * Search only for the exact instruction byte sequence:
     *
     *   41 f2 00
     *
     * This is NOT a raw 0xf2 search.
     */
    for (const body of bodies) {
        for (
            let p = body.instrStart;
            p + 3 <= body.bodyEnd;
            p++
        ) {
            if (
                wasm[p] === 0x41 &&
                wasm[p + 1] === 0xf2 &&
                wasm[p + 2] === 0x00
            ) {
                hits.push({
                    offset: p,
                    func: body.func,
                });
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" EXACT i32.const 114 HITS");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(`Hits : ${hits.length}`);
    console.log("");

    for (const h of hits) {
        console.log(
            `Function ${h.func} @ 0x${h.offset
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, "0")}`
        );

        const start = Math.max(h.offset - 16, 0);
        const end = Math.min(h.offset + 24, wasm.length);

        const hex = Array.from(
            wasm.subarray(start, end)
        )
            .map(
                b =>
                    b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
            )
            .join(" ");

        console.log(`  ${hex}`);
        console.log("");
    }

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" IMPORTANT");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log("");
    console.log("These are only PRODUCERS of numeric value 114.");
    console.log("They are NOT yet proven call_indirect callers.");
    console.log("");

    console.log("Next step:");
    console.log("  decode each hit forward to the next real");
    console.log("  call_indirect and perform stack tracking.");
    console.log("");

    console.log("No transaction sent.");
    console.log("No WASM modification.");
    console.log("Read-only / offline.");
}

function readULEB(pos) {

  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {

    const b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {

  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b;

  do {

    b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    shift += 7;

  } while (b & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const fs = require("fs");

const FILE = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 8927;

const b = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function leb(pos) {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[pos++];
        v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(x & 0x80)) {
            return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        s += 7;
    }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TABLE REGISTRATION FOR FUNC 8927");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");

console.log("WASM SIZE :", b.length);

let found = false;
