    const sectionId = b[pos++];

    const sr = leb(pos);
    const sectionSize = sr.value;
    pos = sr.next;

    const payloadStart = pos;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

    // Element section
    if (sectionId === 9) {

        console.log(
            "ELEMENT SECTION :",
            "0x" + payloadStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0"),
            "..",
            "0x" + payloadEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")
        );

        let p = payloadStart;

        const countR = leb(p);
        const segmentCount = countR.value;
        p = countR.next;

        console.log("SEGMENTS :", segmentCount);
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount; seg++) {

            const flagsR = leb(p);
            const flags = flagsR.value;
            p = flagsR.next;

            let tableIndex = 0;

            // flags 0: active, table 0, offset expression
            // flags 2: active, explicit table index
            if (flags === 2) {
                const tr = leb(p);
                tableIndex = tr.value;
                p = tr.next;
            }

            // Skip/read offset expression.
            // Typical: i32.const <offset> end
            const opcode = b[p++];

            let offset = 0;

            if (opcode === 0x41) {
                const r = leb(p);
                offset = r.value;
                p = r.next;
            } else {
                throw new Error(
                    "Unexpected element offset opcode 0x" +
                    opcode.toString(16)
                );
            }

            if (b[p++] !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error("Missing end of offset expression");
            }

            // element kind / expressions
            if (flags === 0 || flags === 1 || flags === 2 || flags === 3) {

                // For function-index segments:
                // flags 0/2 = elemkind byte
                if (flags === 0 || flags === 2) {
                    const elemkind = b[p++];

                    const countR2 = leb(p);
                    const count = countR2.value;
                    p = countR2.next;

                    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

                                TARGET,
                                "SEGMENT",
                                seg,
                                "TABLE",
                                tableIndex,
                                "ELEMENT INDEX",
                                i
                            );

                            found = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        break;
    }

    pos = payloadEnd;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 8952;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    if (pos + i >= buf.length)
      throw new Error("ULEB out of bounds");

    const b = buf[pos + i];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value,
        next: pos + i + 1
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  throw new Error("ULEB too long");
}

function sectionName(id) {
  switch (id) {
    case 0: return "CUSTOM";
    case 1: return "TYPE";
    case 2: return "IMPORT";
    case 3: return "FUNCTION";
    case 4: return "TABLE";
    case 5: return "MEMORY";
    case 6: return "GLOBAL";
    case 7: return "EXPORT";
    case 8: return "START";
    case 9: return "ELEMENT";
    case 10: return "CODE";
    case 11: return "DATA";
    default: return "UNKNOWN";
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND FUNCTION 8952 IN ELEMENT SECTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log("TARGET    :", TARGET);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let pos = 8;
let found = 0;

while (pos < buf.length) {

  const sectionStart = pos;

  const id = buf[pos++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
  const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
  pos = sizeInfo.next;

  const payloadStart = pos;
  const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

  if (payloadEnd > buf.length)
    throw new Error("Section exceeds WASM");

  console.log(
    "SECTION",
    id,
    sectionName(id),
    "START 0x" + sectionStart.toString(16),
    "SIZE",
    sectionSize
  );

  if (id === 9) {

    console.log("");
    console.log(">>> ELEMENT SECTION FOUND");
    console.log("PAYLOAD : 0x" +
      payloadStart.toString(16) +
      " .. 0x" +
      payloadEnd.toString(16));

    let p = payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    console.log("ELEMENT COUNT :", count);

    for (let e = 0; e < count; e++) {

      const entryStart = p;

      const flagsInfo = readULEB(p);
      const flags = flagsInfo.value;
      p = flagsInfo.next;

      let mode = flags & 3;

      // MVP active/passive/declarative handling
      if (flags === 0) {
        // table index 0 implied
        // offset expression: i32.const + end
        const opcode = buf[p++];

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
          console.log(
            "ELEMENT", e,
            "unexpected offset opcode 0x" +
            opcode.toString(16)
          );
        }

        const offInfo = readULEB(p);
        p = offInfo.next;

        if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
          console.log("ELEMENT", e, "missing end");
        }

        const nInfo = readULEB(p);
        const n = nInfo.value;
        p = nInfo.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const fi = readULEB(p);
          const functionIndex = fi.value;
          p = fi.next;

          if (functionIndex === TARGET) {
            found++;

            console.log("");
            console.log("============================================================");
            console.log("FOUND FUNCTION 8952");
            console.log("ELEMENT       :", e);
            console.log("TABLE INDEX   :", i);
            console.log("ENTRY OFFSET  : 0x" +
              entryStart.toString(16));
            console.log("FUNCTION IDX  :", functionIndex);
            console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
          }
        }

      } else {
        /*
         * For non-MVP element forms we cannot safely skip
         * without decoding the complete element encoding.
         * Stop rather than guessing.
         */
        console.log("");

        console.log("FLAGS :", flags);
        console.log(
          "NON-MVP ELEMENT FORM — STOPPING SAFE SCAN"
        );
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  pos = payloadEnd;
}

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const FILE = path.resolve(
    process.cwd(),
    "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const IMPORTS = 83;
const TARGET_INDEX = 8689;

function readULEB(buf, s) {
    let n = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (s.pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[s.pos++];
        n += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) return n;

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 49) throw new Error("Invalid ULEB");
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function encodeULEB(n) {
    const out = [];

    do {
        let b = n % 128;
        n = Math.floor(n / 128);
        if (n) b |= 128;
        out.push(b);
    } while (n);

    return out;
}

function hex(n) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function getBodies(buf) {
    const s = { pos: 8 };

    while (s.pos < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[s.pos++];
        const size = readULEB(buf, s);
        const start = s.pos;
        const end = start + size;

        if (id === 10) {
            const cs = { pos: start };
            const count = readULEB(buf, cs);
            const bodies = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const bodySize = readULEB(buf, cs);
                const bodyStart = cs.pos;
                const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

                bodies.push({
                    fn: IMPORTS + i,
                    start: bodyStart,
                    end: bodyEnd
                });

                cs.pos = bodyEnd;
            }

            return bodies;
        }

        s.pos = end;
    }

    throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

function dump(buf, start, end) {
    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const q = Math.min(p + 16, end);
        const bytes = [];

        for (let i = p; i < q; i++) {
            bytes.push(buf[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
        }

        console.log(`${hex(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`);
    }
}

function findPattern(buf, start, end, pattern) {
    const hits = [];

    for (let p = start; p + pattern.length <= end; p++) {
        let ok = true;

        for (let i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
            if (buf[p + i] !== pattern[i]) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (ok) hits.push(p);
    }

    return hits;
}

function main() {
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(FILE);
    const bodies = getBodies(buf);

    const enc = encodeULEB(TARGET_INDEX);
    const patterns = [
        {
            name: "i32.const 8689",
            bytes: [0x41, ...enc]
        },
        {
            name: "call_indirect type 0 table 0",
            bytes: [0x11, 0x00, 0x00]
        }
    ];

    console.log("TABLE INDEX 8689 INVESTIGATION");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`TARGET TABLE INDEX = ${TARGET_INDEX}`);
    console.log(`ULEB = ${enc.map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ")}`);
    console.log(`GLOBAL FUNCTION = 4098`);
    console.log("");

    for (const pattern of patterns) {
        console.log(`PATTERN: ${pattern.name}`);
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        let total = 0;

        for (const body of bodies) {
            const hits = findPattern(
                buf,
                body.start,
                body.end,
                pattern.bytes
            );

            for (const hit of hits) {
                total++;
                console.log(
                    `FUNC ${body.fn} | BODY ${hex(body.start)}..${hex(body.end)}` +
                    ` | HIT ${hex(hit)}`
                );

                const start = Math.max(body.start, hit - 24);
                const end = Math.min(body.end, hit + 40);
                dump(buf, start, end);
                console.log("");
            }
        }

        console.log(`RAW MATCH COUNT = ${total}`);
        console.log("");
    }

    console.log("DONE - NO WASM EXECUTION");
    console.log("Matches are byte-level candidates, not confirmed instruction paths.");
}

try {
    main();
} catch (err) {
    console.error("FAILED:", err);
    process.exitCode = 1;
}

function uleb(p:number){
  let v=0,s=0;
  while(true){
    const x=b[p++];
    v |= (x&0x7f)<<s;
    if(!(x&0x80)) return {v:v>>>0,p};
    s+=7;

function skipBlockType(p:number){
  const x=b[p];
  if(x===0x40 || x===0x7f || x===0x7e || x===0x7d || x===0x7c ||
     x===0x70 || x===0x6f) return p+1;
  return uleb(p).p;
}

function str(p:number){
  const x=uleb(p);
  return x.p+x.v;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [3901, 6521, 8952];
const NEIGHBOR = 20;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND TABLE INDICES FOR TYPE 7 WRAPPERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

console.log("WASM SIZE :", wasm.length);
console.log("TARGETS   :", TARGETS.join(", "));
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readU32LEB(buf, p) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    const start = p;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: result >>> 0,
                next: p,
                bytes: p - start
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("Invalid U32 LEB128");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function readSections(buf) {
    let p = 8;
    const result = [];

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + sizeInfo.value;

        result.push({
            id,
            start,
            end,
            size: sizeInfo.value
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return result;
}

function decodeElementSection(buf, section) {
    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
    const segmentCount = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const segments = [];

    for (let s = 0; s < segmentCount; s++) {

        const segmentStart = p;

        const flagsInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        const flags = flagsInfo.value;
        p = flagsInfo.next;

        /*
         * We expect the classic active element segment:
         *
         * flags = 0
         * table index = 0
         * offset expression = i32.const ...
         * end
         * vec(funcidx)
         *
         * We nevertheless parse the flags explicitly.
         */

        let tableIndex = null;
        let offset = null;

        if (flags === 0) {

            tableIndex = 0;

            const opcode = buf[p++];

            if (opcode !== 0x41) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Unexpected element offset opcode 0x" +
                    opcode.toString(16)
                );
            }

            const offsetInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            offset = offsetInfo.value;
            p = offsetInfo.next;

            const endOpcode = buf[p++];

            if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Unexpected element offset end opcode 0x" +
                    endOpcode.toString(16)
                );
            }
        }

        else if (flags === 2) {

            const tableInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            tableIndex = tableInfo.value;
            p = tableInfo.next;

            const opcode = buf[p++];

            if (opcode !== 0x41) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Unexpected table offset opcode"
                );
            }

            const offsetInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            offset = offsetInfo.value;
            p = offsetInfo.next;

            const endOpcode = buf[p++];

            if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Unexpected table offset end opcode"
                );
            }
        }

        else {
            throw new Error(
                "Unsupported element flags " + flags
            );
        }

        /*
         * For flags 0 and 2 the next field is the function-index vector.
         */

        const vecInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        const functionCount = vecInfo.value;
        p = vecInfo.next;

        const vectorStart = p;

        const entries = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < functionCount; i++) {

            const entryOffset = p;

            const funcInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = funcInfo.next;

            entries.push({
                position: i,
                tableIndex: offset + i,
                function: funcInfo.value,
                rawOffset: entryOffset,
                rawBytes: funcInfo.bytes
            });
        }

        segments.push({
            segment: s,
            segmentStart,
            flags,
            tableIndex,
            offset,
            functionCount,
            vectorStart,
            entries
        });
    }

    return segments;
}

const sections = readSections(wasm);

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;

const TARGETS = [
  2053,
  2101,
  2612
];

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {

    if (pos + i >= b.length)
      return null;

    const x = b[pos + i];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value,
        end: pos + i + 1
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function getBodies() {

  let p = CODE_START;

  const count = readULEB(p)!;
  p = count.end;

  const bodies: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = readULEB(p)!;
    p = size.end;

    bodies.push({
      ordinal: i,
      global: i + 83,
      start: p,
      end: p + size.value
    });

    p += size.value;
  }

  if (p !== CODE_END)
    throw new Error(
      `CODE END MISMATCH ${hex(p)} != ${hex(CODE_END)}`
    );

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = getBodies();

const TARGET_TYPE = 3;
const IMPORTED = 83;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

type FuncType = {
  params: number[];
  results: number[];
};

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value, next: pos };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readName(pos: number) {
  const len = readULEB(pos);
  return { next: len.next + len.value };
}

function readLimits(pos: number): number {
  const flags = readULEB(pos);
  let q = flags.next;
  q = readULEB(q).next;
  if (flags.value & 1) q = readULEB(q).next;
  return q;
}

const sections = new Map<number, { start: number; end: number }>();

let p = 8;
while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const size = readULEB(p);
  const start = size.next;
  const end = start + size.value;
  sections.set(id, { start, end });
  p = end;
}

const typeSection = sections.get(1);
const importSection = sections.get(2);
const functionSection = sections.get(3);

if (!typeSection || !importSection || !functionSection) {
  throw new Error("Required WASM section not found");
}

// Read function signatures.
const types: FuncType[] = [];
p = typeSection.start;

const typeCount = readULEB(p);
p = typeCount.next;

for (let i = 0; i < typeCount.value; i++) {
  if (b[p++] !== 0x60) throw new Error("Unexpected function type form");

  const pc = readULEB(p);
  p = pc.next;
  const params = Array.from(b.subarray(p, p + pc.value));
  p += pc.value;

  const rc = readULEB(p);
  p = rc.next;
  const results = Array.from(b.subarray(p, p + rc.value));
  p += rc.value;

  types.push({ params, results });
}

// Count imported functions and preserve their type indices.
p = importSection.start;
const ic = readULEB(p);
p = ic.next;

const importedFunctionTypes: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < ic.value; i++) {
  p = readName(p).next; // module
  p = readName(p).next; // field/name

  const kind = b[p++];

  if (kind === 0) {
    const t = readULEB(p);
    importedFunctionTypes.push(t.value);
    p = t.next;
  } else if (kind === 1) {
    p++; // element type
    p = readLimits(p);
  } else if (kind === 2) {
    p = readLimits(p);
  } else if (kind === 3) {
    p += 2; // global value type and mutability
  } else if (kind === 4) {
    // Exception tag import: attribute + type index.
    p++; 
    p = readULEB(p).next;
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind}`);
  }
}

// Read type indices for defined functions.
p = functionSection.start;
const fc = readULEB(p);
p = fc.next;

const definedTypes: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
  const t = readULEB(p);
  definedTypes.push(t.value);
  p = t.next;
}

const TARGET = 6618;
const importedCount = importedFunctionTypes.length;
const ordinal = TARGET - importedCount;

if (TARGET < importedCount) {
  console.log(`Function ${TARGET} is imported.`);
  console.log("Its type index:", importedFunctionTypes[TARGET]);
  process.exit(0);
}

if (ordinal < 0 || ordinal >= definedTypes.length) {
  throw new Error("Target function index out of range");
}

const targetTypeIndex = definedTypes[ordinal];
const indirectTypeIndex = 2;

function fmt(t: FuncType) {
  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64",
    0x7b: "v128",
    0x70: "funcref",
    0x6f: "externref",
  };

  return `(${t.params.map(x => names[x] ?? `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(", ")}) -> (${t.results.map(x => names[x] ?? `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(", ")})`;
}

 targetTypeIndex);

}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [3901, 6521, 8952];

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND CALLERS OF TYPE 7 INDIRECT WRAPPERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

console.log("WASM SIZE :", wasm.length);
console.log("TARGETS   :", TARGETS.join(", "));
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readU32(buf, p) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: result >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("Invalid U32 LEB128");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function readI32(buf, p) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        b = buf[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                result |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return {
                value: result | 0,
                next: p
            };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function sections(buf) {
    let p = 8;
    const out = [];

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const s = readU32(buf, p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        out.push({
            id,
            start,
            end,
            size: s.value
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return out;
}

function parseImports(buf, section) {
    if (!section) {
        return {
            importedFunctionCount: 0,
            importedFunctionTypes: []
        };
    }

    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const importedFunctionTypes = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const moduleLen = readU32(buf, p);
        p = moduleLen.next;
        p += moduleLen.value;

        const nameLen = readU32(buf, p);
        p = nameLen.next;
        p += nameLen.value;

        const kind = buf[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const typeInfo = readU32(buf, p);
            p = typeInfo.next;

            importedFunctionTypes.push(typeInfo.value);
        }

        else if (kind === 1) {
            p += 1;

            const flags = buf[p++];

            const min = readU32(buf, p);
            p = min.next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                const max = readU32(buf, p);
                p = max.next;
            }
        }

        else if (kind === 2) {
            const flags = buf[p++];

            const min = readU32(buf, p);
            p = min.next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                const max = readU32(buf, p);
                p = max.next;
            }
        }

        else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;
        }

        else {
            throw new Error("Unknown import kind " + kind);
        }
    }

    return {
        importedFunctionCount: importedFunctionTypes.length,
        importedFunctionTypes
    };
}

function parseFunctionSection(buf, section) {
    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const types = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const x = readU32(buf, p);
        p = x.next;
        types.push(x.value);
    }

    return types;
}

/*
    Decode enough WASM instructions to identify:

    0x10 call
    0x11 call_indirect
    0xd2 ref.func

    Also decode common instructions so that byte positions remain exact.
*/

function decodeInstruction(buf, p, end) {
    const start = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    const ins = {
        start,
        end: p,
        op,
        mnemonic: "unknown",
        immediate: null
    };

    switch (op) {

        case 0x0b:
            ins.mnemonic = "end";
            break;

        case 0x10: {
            const x = readU32(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "call";
            ins.immediate = {
                func: x.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
            const t = readU32(buf, p);
            p = t.next;

            const table = readU32(buf, p);
            p = table.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "call_indirect";
            ins.immediate = {
                type: t.value,
                table: table.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0xd2: {
            const x = readU32(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "ref.func";
            ins.immediate = {
                func: x.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x20: {
            const x = readU32(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "local.get";
            ins.immediate = {
                local: x.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = readU32(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "local.set";
            ins.immediate = {
                local: x.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = readU32(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "local.tee";
            ins.immediate = {
                local: x.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = readI32(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i32.const";
            ins.immediate = {
                value: x.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x28: {
            const a = readU32(buf, p);
            p = a.next;

            const o = readU32(buf, p);
            p = o.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i32.load";
            ins.immediate = {
                align: a.value,
                offset: o.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x2d: {
            const a = readU32(buf, p);
            p = a.next;

            const o = readU32(buf, p);
            p = o.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i32.load8_u";
            ins.immediate = {
                align: a.value,
                offset: o.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x36: {
            const a = readU32(buf, p);
            p = a.next;

            const o = readU32(buf, p);
            p = o.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i32.store";
            ins.immediate = {
                align: a.value,
                offset: o.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const a = readU32(buf, p);
            p = a.next;

            const o = readU32(buf, p);
            p = o.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i64.store";
            ins.immediate = {
                align: a.value,
                offset: o.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x6a:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.add";
            break;

        case 0x6b:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.sub";
            break;

        case 0x46:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.eq";
            break;

        case 0x47:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.ne";
            break;

        case 0x48:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.lt_s";
            break;

        case 0x49:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.lt_u";
            break;

        case 0x4a:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.gt_s";
            break;

        case 0x4b:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.gt_u";
            break;

        case 0x4c:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.le_s";
            break;

        case 0x4d:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.le_u";
            break;

        case 0x4e:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.ge_s";
            break;

        case 0x4f:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.ge_u";
            break;

        case 0x1b:
            ins.mnemonic = "select";
            break;

        case 0x0f:
            ins.mnemonic = "return";
            break;

        case 0x02:
            ins.mnemonic = "block";

            if (p < end) {
                const blockType = buf[p++];

                if (blockType === 0x40) {
                    ins.immediate = {
                        blockType: "empty"
                    };
                } else {
                    ins.immediate = {
                        blockType
                    };
                }
            }

            break;

        case 0x03:
            ins.mnemonic = "loop";

            if (p < end) {
                const blockType = buf[p++];

                ins.immediate = {
                    blockType
                };
            }

            break;

        case 0x04:
            ins.mnemonic = "if";

            if (p < end) {
                const blockType = buf[p++];

                ins.immediate = {
                    blockType
                };
            }

            break;

        case 0x05:
            ins.mnemonic = "else";
            break;

        case 0x0c: {
            const x = readU32(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "br";
            ins.immediate = {
                depth: x.value
            };
            break;
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const x = readU32(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "br_if";
            ins.immediate = {
                depth: x.value
            };
            break;
        }

        default:
            return null;
    }

    ins.end = p;

    if (p > end) {
        return null;
    }

    return ins;
}

function decodeBody(buf, start, end) {
    let p = start;

    const sizeInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadEnd = p + sizeInfo.value;

    if (payloadEnd > end) {
        return null;
    }

    const localsInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    const localDeclCount = localsInfo.value;
    p = localsInfo.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
        const count = readU32(buf, p);
        p = count.next;

        p += 1;
    }

    const instructions = [];

    while (p < payloadEnd) {

        const ins = decodeInstruction(
            buf,
            p,
            payloadEnd
        );

        if (!ins) {
            return {
                instructions,
                failedAt: p,
                payloadEnd
            };
        }

        instructions.push(ins);
        p = ins.end;

        if (ins.mnemonic === "end" && p === payloadEnd) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        instructions,
        failedAt: null,
        payloadEnd
    };
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Parse sections
------------------------------------------------------------ */

const secs = sections(wasm);

const importSection = secs.find(x => x.id === 2);
const functionSection = secs.find(x => x.id === 3);
const codeSection = secs.find(x => x.id === 10);

if (!functionSection || !codeSection) {
    throw new Error("FUNCTION or CODE section not found");
}

const imports = parseImports(
    wasm,
    importSection
);

const definedTypes = parseFunctionSection(
    wasm,
    functionSection
);

const functionTypes = [
    ...imports.importedFunctionTypes,
    ...definedTypes
];

console.log(
    "IMPORTED FUNCTIONS :",
    imports.importedFunctionCount
);

console.log(
    "DEFINED FUNCTIONS  :",
    definedTypes.length
);

console.log(
    "TOTAL FUNCTIONS    :",
    functionTypes.length
);

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Scan every function body
------------------------------------------------------------ */

let p = codeSection.start;

const bodyCountInfo = readU32(buf = wasm, p);
const bodyCount = bodyCountInfo.value;
p = bodyCountInfo.next;

const results = [];

let decodeFailures = 0;

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < bodyCount; bodyIndex++) {

    const bodyStart = p;

    const sizeInfo = readU32(wasm, p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const bodyEnd = p + sizeInfo.value;

    const funcIndex =
        imports.importedFunctionCount +
        bodyIndex;

    const decoded =
        decodeBody(
            wasm,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd
        );

    if (!decoded) {
        decodeFailures++;
        p = bodyEnd;
        continue;
    }

    if (decoded.failedAt !== null) {
        decodeFailures++;
    }

    const hits = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < decoded.instructions.length; i++) {

        const ins = decoded.instructions[i];

        if (
            ins.mnemonic === "call" &&
            TARGETS.includes(ins.immediate.func)
        ) {
            hits.push({
                kind: "call",
                target: ins.immediate.func,
                instructionIndex: i,
                offset: ins.start
            });
        }

        if (
            ins.mnemonic === "ref.func" &&
            TARGETS.includes(ins.immediate.func)
        ) {
            hits.push({
                kind: "ref.func",
                target: ins.immediate.func,
                instructionIndex: i,
                offset: ins.start
            });
        }
    }

    if (hits.length > 0) {

        results.push({
            funcIndex,
            bodyIndex,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            typeIndex: functionTypes[funcIndex],
            instructions: decoded.instructions,
            hits
        });
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------

                    ` func=${ins.immediate.func}`;
            }

            else if (ins.mnemonic === "ref.func") {
                extra =

            }

            else if (ins.mnemonic === "local.get") {
                extra =
                    ` local=${ins.immediate.local}`;
            }

            else if (ins.mnemonic === "local.set") {
                extra =
                    ` local=${ins.immediate.local}`;
            }

            else if (ins.mnemonic === "local.tee") {
                extra =
                    ` local=${ins.immediate.local}`;
            }

            else if (ins.mnemonic === "i32.const") {
                extra =
                    ` value=${ins.immediate.value}`;
            }

            else if (
                ins.mnemonic === "i32.load" ||
                ins.mnemonic === "i32.load8_u" ||
                ins.mnemonic === "i32.store" ||
                ins.mnemonic === "i64.store"
            ) {
                extra =
                    ` align=${ins.immediate.align}` +
                    ` offset=${ins.immediate.offset}`;
            }

            else if (ins.mnemonic === "call_indirect") {
                extra =
                    ` type=${ins.immediate.type}` +
                    ` table=${ins.immediate.table}`;
            }

            const marker =
                i === hit.instructionIndex
                    ? " <<< TARGET"
                    : "";

            console.log(
                `      0x${ins.start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
                `${ins.mnemonic}${extra}${marker}`
            );
        }
    }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const IMPORTED = 83;
const TARGET_TYPE = 7;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Locate code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let pos = 8;
let codeSection = null;

while (pos < buf.length) {
  const id = buf[pos++];

  const s = readULEB(pos);
  pos = s.next;

  const start = pos;
  const end = start + s.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeSection = { start, end };
    break;
  }

  pos = end;
}

if (!codeSection) {
  throw new Error("Code section not found.");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Enumerate code bodies
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = codeSection.start;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const bodyCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

const bodies = [];

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {
  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = start + bodySize;

  bodies.push({ start, end });

  p = end;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Generic immediate skipper
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function skipImmediate(op, p) {
  // block / loop
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03) {
    return readULEB(p).next;
  }

  // if
  if (op === 0x04) {
    return readULEB(p).next;
  }

  // br / br_if
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    return readULEB(p).next;
  }

  // br_table
  if (op === 0x0e) {
    const n = readULEB(p);
    p = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
    }

    return readULEB(p).next;
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {
    return readULEB(p).next;
  }

  // call_indirect
  if (op === 0x11) {
    p = readULEB(p).next;
    p = readULEB(p).next;
    return p;
  }

  // local/global
  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24
  ) {
    return readULEB(p).next;
  }

  // memory load/store family
  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
    p = readULEB(p).next;
    p = readULEB(p).next;
    return p;
  }

  // memory.size / memory.grow
  if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
    return readULEB(p).next;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    while (true) {
      const b = buf[p++];
      if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }
    return p;
  }

  // i64.const
  if (op === 0x42) {
    while (true) {
      const b = buf[p++];
      if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }
    return p;
  }

  // f32.const
  if (op === 0x43) return p + 4;

  // f64.const
  if (op === 0x44) return p + 8;

  // ref.null
  if (op === 0xd0) {
    return p + 1;
  }

  // ref.func
  if (op === 0xd2) {
    return readULEB(p).next;
  }

  return p;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Scan
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const results = [];

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < bodies.length; bodyIndex++) {
  const body = bodies[bodyIndex];

  let p = body.start;

  // locals declaration
  const localInfo = readULEB(p);
  const localDeclCount = localInfo.value;
  p = localInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
    p = readULEB(p).next;
    p += 1;
  }

  while (p < body.end) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    if (op === 0x11) {
      const typeInfo = readULEB(p);
      p = typeInfo.next;

      const tableInfo = readULEB(p);
      p = tableInfo.next;

      if (typeInfo.value === TARGET_TYPE) {
        results.push({
          func: IMPORTED + bodyIndex,
          addr,
          table: tableInfo.value,
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    p = skipImmediate(op, p);
  }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 8952;
const TARGET_TYPE = 7;
const TARGET_INDIRECT_TYPE = 4;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TYPE 7 INDIRECT WRAPPER SCAN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

console.log("WASM SIZE :", wasm.length);
console.log("TARGET FUNC:", TARGET_FUNC);
console.log("TARGET TYPE:", TARGET_TYPE);
console.log("INDIRECT TYPE:", TARGET_INDIRECT_TYPE);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readU32LEB(buf, p) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let start = p;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: result >>> 0,
                next: p,
                bytes: p - start
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("Invalid u32 LEB128");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF in u32 LEB128");
}

function readI32LEB(buf, p) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        b = buf[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                result |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return {
                value: result | 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        if (shift >= 35) {
            throw new Error("Invalid signed LEB128");
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function readVecCount(buf, p) {
    return readU32LEB(buf, p);
}

function skipLimits(buf, p) {
    const flags = buf[p++];

    const min = readU32LEB(buf, p);
    p = min.next;

    if (flags & 0x01) {
        const max = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        p = max.next;
    }

    return p;
}

function readSectionBounds(buf) {
    let p = 8;
    const sections = [];

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        const size = sizeInfo.value;
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + size;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start,
            end,
            size
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseTypes(buf, section) {
    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const types = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const form = buf[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unsupported type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`
            );
        }

        const paramInfo = readVecCount(buf, p);
        const paramCount = paramInfo.value;
        p = paramInfo.next;

        const params = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
            params.push(buf[p++]);
        }

        const resultInfo = readVecCount(buf, p);
        const resultCount = resultInfo.value;
        p = resultInfo.next;

        const results = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
            results.push(buf[p++]);
        }

        types.push({
            params,
            results
        });
    }

    return types;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(buf, section) {
    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const typeIndices = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const x = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        p = x.next;
        typeIndices.push(x.value);
    }

    return typeIndices;
}

function parseImports(buf, section) {
    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const importedFuncTypes = [];
    const imports = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const moduleLen = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        p = moduleLen.next;

        p += moduleLen.value;

        const nameLen = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        p = nameLen.next;

        p += nameLen.value;

        const kind = buf[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const typeInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = typeInfo.next;

            importedFuncTypes.push(typeInfo.value);

            imports.push({
                kind: "func",
                typeIndex: typeInfo.value
            });
        } else if (kind === 1) {
            p += 1;
            p = skipLimits(buf, p);
        } else if (kind === 2) {
            p = skipLimits(buf, p);
        } else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;
        } else {
            throw new Error("Unknown import kind " + kind);
        }
    }

    return {
        importedFuncTypes,
        imports
    };
}

function decodeInstruction(buf, p, end) {
    const start = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    const ins = {
        start,
        end: p,
        op,
        mnemonic: "unknown",
        immediates: {}
    };

    switch (op) {
        case 0x0b:
            ins.mnemonic = "end";
            break;

        case 0x20: {
            const x = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;
            ins.mnemonic = "local.get";
            ins.immediates.local = x.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;
            ins.mnemonic = "local.set";
            ins.immediates.local = x.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;
            ins.mnemonic = "local.tee";
            ins.immediates.local = x.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = readI32LEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.const";
            ins.immediates.value = x.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x28: {
            const align = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = offset.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i32.load";
            ins.immediates.align = align.value;
            ins.immediates.offset = offset.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x2d: {
            const align = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = offset.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i32.load8_u";
            ins.immediates.align = align.value;
            ins.immediates.offset = offset.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x29: {
            const align = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = offset.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i64.load";
            ins.immediates.align = align.value;
            ins.immediates.offset = offset.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x36: {
            const align = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = offset.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i32.store";
            ins.immediates.align = align.value;
            ins.immediates.offset = offset.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const align = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = align.next;

            const offset = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = offset.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "i64.store";
            ins.immediates.align = align.value;
            ins.immediates.offset = offset.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const x = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;
            ins.mnemonic = "call";
            ins.immediates.func = x.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
            const typeInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = typeInfo.next;

            const tableInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = tableInfo.next;

            ins.mnemonic = "call_indirect";
            ins.immediates.type = typeInfo.value;
            ins.immediates.table = tableInfo.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x6a:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.add";
            break;

        case 0x6b:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.sub";
            break;

        case 0x46:
            ins.mnemonic = "i32.eq";
            break;

        case 0x1b:
            ins.mnemonic = "select";
            break;

        case 0x02:
            ins.mnemonic = "block";
            p += 1;
            break;

        case 0x03:
            ins.mnemonic = "loop";
            p += 1;
            break;

        case 0x04:
            ins.mnemonic = "if";
            p += 1;
            break;

        case 0x05:
            ins.mnemonic = "else";
            break;

        case 0x0c: {
            const x = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;
            ins.mnemonic = "br";
            ins.immediates.depth = x.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const x = readU32LEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;
            ins.mnemonic = "br_if";
            ins.immediates.depth = x.value;
            break;
        }

        case 0x0f:
            ins.mnemonic = "return";
            break;

        default:
            /*
             * Unknown opcode.
             *
             * We intentionally stop decoding this function rather than
             * pretending that the following bytes are instructions.
             */
            return null;
    }

    ins.end = p;

    if (p > end) {
        return null;
    }

    return ins;
}

function decodeBody(buf, bodyStart, bodyEnd) {
    let p = bodyStart;

    const sizeInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadEnd = p + sizeInfo.value;

    if (payloadEnd > bodyEnd) {
        return null;
    }

    const localDeclInfo = readU32LEB(buf, p);
    const localDeclCount = localDeclInfo.value;
    p = localDeclInfo.next;

    const locals = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
        const n = readU32LEB(buf, p);
        p = n.next;

        const type = buf[p++];

        locals.push({
            count: n.value,
            type
        });
    }

    const instructions = [];

    while (p < payloadEnd) {
        const ins = decodeInstruction(buf, p, payloadEnd);

        if (!ins) {
            return {
                instructions,
                failedAt: p,
                payloadEnd
            };
        }

        instructions.push(ins);
        p = ins.end;

        if (ins.mnemonic === "end" && p === payloadEnd) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        instructions,
        failedAt: null,
        payloadEnd
    };
}

function getOpcodeName(ins) {
    return ins.mnemonic;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Locate sections
------------------------------------------------------------ */

const sections = readSectionBounds(wasm);

const typeSection = sections.find(s => s.id === 1);
const importSection = sections.find(s => s.id === 2);
const functionSection = sections.find(s => s.id === 3);
const codeSection = sections.find(s => s.id === 10);

if (!typeSection || !functionSection || !codeSection) {
    throw new Error("Required WASM sections not found");
}

const types = parseTypes(wasm, typeSection);
const functionTypesDefined = parseFunctionTypes(wasm, functionSection);

let importedFunctionTypes = [];

if (importSection) {
    importedFunctionTypes =
        parseImports(wasm, importSection).importedFuncTypes;
}

const functionTypes = [
    ...importedFunctionTypes,
    ...functionTypesDefined
];

console.log("TYPE COUNT :", types.length);
console.log("FUNCTION TYPE ENTRIES :", functionTypes.length);
console.log("DEFINED FUNCTIONS :", functionTypesDefined.length);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Decode code section
------------------------------------------------------------ */

let p = codeSection.start;

const bodyCountInfo = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
const bodyCount = bodyCountInfo.value;
p = bodyCountInfo.next;

console.log("CODE BODY COUNT :", bodyCount);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

const matches = [];
let decodeFailures = 0;

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < bodyCount; bodyIndex++) {
    const bodyStart = p;

    const bodySizeInfo = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
    p = bodySizeInfo.next;

    const bodyEnd = p + bodySizeInfo.value;

    const funcIndex = importedFunctionTypes.length + bodyIndex;
    const typeIndex = functionTypes[funcIndex];

    if (typeIndex !== TARGET_TYPE) {
        p = bodyEnd;
        continue;
    }

    const decoded = decodeBody(wasm, bodyStart, bodyEnd);

    if (!decoded) {
        decodeFailures++;
        p = bodyEnd;
        continue;
    }

    if (decoded.failedAt !== null) {
        decodeFailures++;
    }

    const instructions = decoded.instructions;

    const indirect4 = instructions.filter(
        x =>
            x.mnemonic === "call_indirect" &&
            x.immediates.type === TARGET_INDIRECT_TYPE
    );

    if (indirect4.length === 0) {
        p = bodyEnd;
        continue;
    }

    matches.push({
        funcIndex,
        bodyIndex,
        typeIndex,
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
        instructions
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   Report
------------------------------------------------------------ */

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("RESULT");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log("TYPE 7 FUNCTIONS WITH TYPE 4 INDIRECT CALL :", matches.length);
console.log("DECODER FAILURES :", decodeFailures);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (const m of matches) {
    console.log();
    console.log(
        `FUNC ${m.funcIndex} TYPE=${m.typeIndex} BODY=${m.bodyIndex}`
    );

    console.log(
        `BODY : 0x${m.bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${m.bodyEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    let stack = [];

    for (const ins of m.instructions) {
        const off =
            "0x" +
            ins.start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");

        let detail = "";

        if (ins.mnemonic === "local.get") {
            detail = ` local=${ins.immediates.local}`;
            stack.push({
                kind: "local",
                value: ins.immediates.local
            });
        }

        else if (ins.mnemonic === "i32.load") {
            detail =
                ` align=${ins.immediates.align}` +
                ` offset=${ins.immediates.offset}`;

            const base = stack.length
                ? stack.pop()
                : null;

            stack.push({
                kind: "load",
                base,
                offset: ins.immediates.offset
            });
        }

        else if (ins.mnemonic === "i32.load8_u") {
            detail =
                ` align=${ins.immediates.align}` +
                ` offset=${ins.immediates.offset}`;

            const base = stack.length
                ? stack.pop()
                : null;

            stack.push({
                kind: "load8",
                base,
                offset: ins.immediates.offset
            });
        }

        else if (ins.mnemonic === "i32.const") {
            detail = ` value=${ins.immediates.value}`;

            stack.push({
                kind: "const",
                value: ins.immediates.value
            });
        }

        else if (ins.mnemonic === "i32.add") {
            const b = stack.pop();
            const a = stack.pop();

            stack.push({
                kind: "add",
                a,
                b
            });
        }

        else if (ins.mnemonic === "call_indirect") {
            detail =
                ` type=${ins.immediates.type}` +
                ` table=${ins.immediates.table}`;

            const tableIndex =
                stack.length
                    ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                    : null;

            console.log(
                `  ${off} ${ins.mnemonic}${detail}`
            );

            console.log(
                "    STACK-BEFORE:",
                JSON.stringify(stack)
            );

            console.log(
                "    TABLE-INDEX-CANDIDATE:",
                JSON.stringify(tableIndex)
            );

            continue;
        }

        console.log(
            `  ${off} ${ins.mnemonic}${detail}`
        );
    }
}

console.log();

console.log("TARGET FUNCTION CHECK");
console.log("============================================================");

if (!target) {

function uleb(p: number) {

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 4789; // 0x12b5

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        value -= 2 ** (shift + 7);

      return { value, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

  const end = start + s.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

  throw new Error("Code section not found");

  const bodyStart = sz.next;

  for (let i = bodyStart; i < bodyEnd; i++) {

    if (b[i] !== 0x41)

    console.log(`CONST           : ${hex(i)}`);
    console.log(`VALUE           : ${v.value}`);
    console.log(`BODY            : ${hex(bodyStart)} .. ${hex(bodyEnd - 1)}`);

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const ROOT = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin";

const EXT = new Set([
    ".js",
    ".mjs",
    ".cjs",
    ".ts",
    ".html",
]);

const SKIP = new Set([
    "node_modules",
    ".git",
    "dist",
    "build",
    "coverage",
    ".cache",
    "temp",
]);

const TARGETS = [
    "WebAssembly.instantiate",
    "WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming",
    "WebAssembly.Module",
    "WebAssembly.Instance",
    "imports",
    "a.ga",
    "ga:",
    '"ga"',
    "'ga'",
    "a:",
];

function walk(dir: string): string[] {
    const out: string[] = [];

    let entries: fs.Dirent[];
    try {
        entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
    } catch {
        return out;
    }

    for (const e of entries) {
        if (SKIP.has(e.name)) continue;

        const full = path.join(dir, e.name);

        if (e.isDirectory()) {
            out.push(...walk(full));
        } else if (e.isFile() && EXT.has(path.extname(e.name).toLowerCase())) {
            out.push(full);
        }
    }

    return out;
}

function printContext(lines: string[], hit: number) {
    const from = Math.max(0, hit - 5);
    const to = Math.min(lines.length, hit + 6);

    for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {
        console.log(
            `${String(i + 1).padStart(6)} | ${lines[i]}`
        );
    }
}

    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const line = lines[i];

        const matched = TARGETS.filter(t => line.includes(t));

        if (matched.length === 0) continue;

        hits++;

        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(file);
        console.log(`line ${i + 1}`);
        console.log(`MATCH: ${matched.join(", ")}`);
        printContext(lines, i);
    }
}

FILE: scripts\findWrapperCallers.mjs

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const FILE = path.resolve(
    process.cwd(),
    "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const IMPORTS = 83;
const TARGETS = [4098, 295, 83, 2528, 2529];

function readULEB(buf, s) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (s.pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[s.pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) return value;

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 49) throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function encodeULEB(value) {
    const bytes = [];

    do {
        let b = value % 128;
        value = Math.floor(value / 128);

        if (value !== 0) b |= 0x80;
        bytes.push(b);
    } while (value !== 0);

    return bytes;
}

function hex(value) {
    return "0x" + value.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readBodies(buf) {
    const s = { pos: 8 };

    while (s.pos < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[s.pos++];
        const size = readULEB(buf, s);
        const start = s.pos;
        const end = start + size;

        if (id === 10) {
            const cs = { pos: start };
            const count = readULEB(buf, cs);
            const bodies = [];

            for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count; ordinal++) {
                const bodySize = readULEB(buf, cs);
                const bodyStart = cs.pos;
                const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

                if (bodyEnd > end) {
                    throw new Error("Function body outside code section");
                }

                bodies.push({
                    fn: IMPORTS + ordinal,
                    start: bodyStart,
                    end: bodyEnd,
                    size: bodySize
                });

                cs.pos = bodyEnd;
            }

            return bodies;
        }

        s.pos = end;
    }

    throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

function findRaw(buf, start, end, pattern) {
    const hits = [];

    for (let p = start; p + pattern.length <= end; p++) {
        let matched = true;

        for (let i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
            if (buf[p + i] !== pattern[i]) {
                matched = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (matched) hits.push(p);
    }

    return hits;
}

function dump(buf, start, end) {
    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const lineEnd = Math.min(p + 16, end);
        const bytes = [];

        for (let i = p; i < lineEnd; i++) {
            bytes.push(buf[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
        }

        console.log(`${hex(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`);
    }
}

function main() {
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(FILE);
    const bodies = readBodies(buf);

    console.log("WRAPPER CALLER SEARCH");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`FILE SIZE = ${buf.length}`);
    console.log(`FUNCTION BODIES = ${bodies.length}`);

    for (const target of TARGETS) {
        const pattern = [0x10, ...encodeULEB(target)];

        console.log("");
        console.log(`TARGET GLOBAL FUNC ${target}`);
        console.log(`RAW PATTERN = ${pattern.map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ")}`);
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        let total = 0;

        for (const body of bodies) {
            const hits = findRaw(buf, body.start, body.end, pattern);

            for (const hit of hits) {
                total++;

                console.log(
                    `OWNER FUNC ${body.fn}` +
                    ` | BODY ${hex(body.start)}..${hex(body.end)}` +
                    ` | SIZE ${body.size}` +
                    ` | HIT ${hex(hit)}`
                );

                const start = Math.max(body.start, hit - 32);
                const end = Math.min(body.end, hit + 48);

                dump(buf, start, end);
                console.log("");
            }
        }

        console.log(`RAW HIT COUNT = ${total}`);
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("DONE - NO WASM EXECUTION");
    console.log("Raw matches are candidates; validate instruction boundaries.");
}

try {
    main();
} catch (err) {
    console.error("FAILED:", err);
    process.exitCode = 1;
}

FILE: scripts\findWrites19534c.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readConst(pos: number) {
  const x = uleb(pos);
  return x;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND WRITES TO 0x19534C");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let hits = 0;

// Search exact raw i32.const TARGET followed later by store.
// This intentionally keeps context small.
for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length - 10; p++) {

  if (wasm[p] !== 0x41) continue;

  const c = readConst(p + 1);

  if (c.value !== TARGET) continue;

  const from = p;
  const to = Math.min(wasm.length, p + 40);

  console.log("");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`CONST AT : 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`VALUE    : 0x${TARGET.toString(16)}`);

  let q = c.next;

  while (q < to) {

    const opPos = q;
    const op = wasm[q++];

    if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {
      console.log(
        `STORE    : 0x${opPos.toString(16)} opcode=0x${op.toString(16)}`
      );
      hits++;
      break;
    }

    // skip common immediates
    if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22 ||
      op === 0x10 ||
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d ||
      op === 0x41 ||
      op === 0x42

      q = uleb(q).next;

  }

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function decodeConst(pos: number) {
  if (wasm[pos] !== 0x41) return null;
  const x = uleb(pos + 1);
  return x.value === TARGET ? x.next : null;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND EXACT WRITE CANDIDATES FOR 0x19534C");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let hits = 0;

for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length - 10; p++) {

  if (wasm[p] !== 0x41) continue;

  const afterConst = decodeConst(p);
  if (afterConst === null) continue;

  /*
   * Only accept:
   *
   *   i32.const 0x19534C
   *   i32.store [offset=0]
   *
   * with only harmless stack/local operations between them.
   */

  let q = afterConst;
  let depth = 1;
  let steps = 0;

  while (q < wasm.length && steps < 12) {
    const pos = q;
    const op = wasm[q++];

    if (op === 0x36) {
      const a = uleb(q);
      q = a.next;

      const o = uleb(q);
      q = o.next;

      if (a.value === 2 && o.value === 0) {
        console.log("");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(`CONST : 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
        console.log(`STORE : 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
        console.log("PATTERN: i32.const TARGET -> i32.store offset=0");
        hits++;
      }

      break;
    }

    /*
     * Operations which consume/change the address.
     * Therefore this is NOT a direct write anymore.
     */
    if (
      op === 0x6a || // i32.add
      op === 0x6b || // i32.sub
      op === 0x6c || // mul
      op === 0x6d || // div
      op === 0x74 || // shl
      op === 0x75 || // shr_s
      op === 0x76 || // shr_u
      op === 0x77 || // rotl
      op === 0x78    // rotr
    ) {
      break;
    }

    /*
     * Another const means the target address may no longer
     * be the store address.
     */
    if (op === 0x41 || op === 0x42) break;

    steps++;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x00195354;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND WRITES TO 0x00195354");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {

    const sectionId = wasm[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const payload = pos;
    const end = payload + size;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = payload;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

console.log(`CODE SECTION = ${hex(codeStart)} .. ${hex(codeEnd)}`);

let p = codeStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const definedCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS = ${definedCount}`);
console.log(`GLOBAL RANGE = 83 .. ${83 + definedCount - 1}`);

console.log(`TARGET ADDRESS = ${hex(TARGET)}`);

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

type Hit = {
    func: number;
    ordinal: number;
    offset: number;
    opcode: number;
    memOffset: number;
    baseConstOffset: number | null;
};

const hits: Hit[] = [];

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < definedCount; ordinal++) {

    const globalFunc = 83 + ordinal;

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    let x = bodyStart;

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // local declarations
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const localInfo = readULEB(x);
    const localGroups = localInfo.value;
    x = localInfo.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localGroups; i++) {
        const c = readULEB(x);
        x = c.next;
        x++;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // Scan body
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    while (x < bodyEnd) {

        const opOffset = x;
        const op = wasm[x++];

        // local/global
        if (
            op === 0x20 ||
            op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22 ||
            op === 0x23 ||
            op === 0x24
        ) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // memory load/store
        if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {

            const align = readULEB(x);
            x = align.next;

            const offsetInfo = readULEB(x);
            const memOffset = offsetInfo.value;
            x = offsetInfo.next;

            // STORE operations:
            // 0x36 i32.store
            // 0x37 i64.store
            // 0x38 f32.store
            // 0x39 f64.store
            // 0x3a i32.store8
            // 0x3b i32.store16
            // 0x3c i64.store8
            // 0x3d i64.store16
            // 0x3e i64.store32

            if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {

                // We can directly identify absolute target
                // when the encoded memory offset itself is TARGET.

                if (memOffset === TARGET) {

                    hits.push({
                        func: globalFunc,
                        ordinal,
                        offset: opOffset,
                        opcode: op,
                        memOffset,
                        baseConstOffset: null
                    });
                }

                // Also detect the common pattern:
                //
                // i32.const TARGET
                // i32.store offset=0
                //
                // This requires looking backward, handled below
                // through a raw byte window.
            }

            continue;
        }

        // constants
        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x42) {
            while (true) {
                const b = wasm[x++];
                if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x43) {
            x += 4;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x44) {
            x += 8;
            continue;
        }

        // branch
        if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // br_table
        if (op === 0x0e) {

            const c = readULEB(x);
            const count = c.value;
            x = c.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const r = readULEB(x);
                x = r.next;
            }

            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            continue;
        }

        // call
        if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // call_indirect
        if (op === 0x11) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;
            x++;
            continue;
        }

        // prefixed instructions
        if (op === 0xfc) {

            const sub = readULEB(x);
            x = sub.next;

            if (
                sub.value === 8 ||
                sub.value === 9 ||
                sub.value === 10 ||
                sub.value === 11
            ) {
                const a = readULEB(x);
                x = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(x);
                x = b.next;
            }

            continue;
        }
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

for (const h of hits) {

    console.log(

    );

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p: number) {
    let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
    do {
        x = b[p++];
        v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
        s += 7;
    } while (x & 0x80);
    return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function hx(x: number) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}
