        break;

    p += r.value;

    const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

const fs = require("fs");

const path =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(path);

const IMPORTED = 83;
const TARGET = 446;

function u32(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        v |= (x & 127) << s;
        if (!(x & 128))
            return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
        s += 7;
    }
}

function s32(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        v |= (x & 127) << s;
        if (!(x & 128)) {
            if (s < 32 && (x & 64))
                v |= (~0 << (s + 7));
            return { value: v | 0, next: p };
        }
        s += 7;
    }
}

function skipBlockType(p) {
    const x = b[p];
    if (x === 0x40 || x === 0x7f ||
        x === 0x7e || x === 0x7d ||
        x === 0x7c)
        return p + 1;
    return s32(p).next;
}

function skip(p) {
    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04)
        return skipBlockType(p);

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d)
        return u32(p).next;

    if (op === 0x0e) {
        let n = u32(p);
        p = n.next;
        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
            p = u32(p).next;
        return u32(p).next;
    }

    if (op === 0x10)
        return u32(p).next;

    if (op === 0x11) {
        let a = u32(p);
        let c = u32(a.next);
        return c.next;
    }

    if (op >= 0x20 && op <= 0x24)
        return u32(p).next;

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
        let a = u32(p);
        return u32(a.next).next;
    }

    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40)
        return p + 1;

    if (op === 0x41)
        return s32(p).next;

    if (op === 0x42) {
        while (true) {
            const x = b[p++];
            if (!(x & 128))
                return p;
        }
    }

    if (op === 0x43)
        return p + 4;

    if (op === 0x44)
        return p + 8;

    return p;
}

function fmt(p) {
    const op = b[p];

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const r = u32(p + 1);
        return [`local.get ${r.value}`, r.next];
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const r = u32(p + 1);
        return [`local.set ${r.value}`, r.next];
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const r = u32(p + 1);
        return [`local.tee ${r.value}`, r.next];
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = s32(p + 1);
        return [`i32.const ${r.value}`, r.next];
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const r = u32(p + 1);
        return [`call ${r.value}`, r.next];
    }

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x36) {
        const a = u32(p + 1);
        const c = u32(a.next);
        return [
            `memop 0x${op.toString(16)} align=${a.value} offset=${c.value}`,
            c.next
        ];
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const a = u32(p + 1);
        const c = u32(a.next);
        return [
            `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${c.value}`,
            c.next
        ];
    }

    return [`opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`, p + 1];
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = 8;
const bodies = [];

while (p < b.length) {

    const section = b[p++];

    const z = u32(p);
    p = z.next;

    const end = p + z.value;

    if (section === 10) {

        const n = u32(p);
        p = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

            const bodyStart = p;

            const sz = u32(p);
            p = sz.next;

            const bodyEnd = p + sz.value;

            const locals = u32(p);
            p = locals.next;

            for (let j = 0; j < locals.value; j++) {
                const count = u32(p);
                p = count.next + 1;
            }

            bodies.push({
                func: IMPORTED + i,
                instr: p,
                end: bodyEnd
            });

            p = bodyEnd;
        }
    }

    p = end;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find CALL 446 and print focused context.
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FOCUSED FUNC 446 CALL SITES");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let hits = 0;

for (const f of bodies) {

    let q = f.instr;

    while (q < f.end) {

        const op = b[q];

        if (op === 0x10) {

            const r = u32(q + 1);

            if (r.value === TARGET) {

                hits++;

                console.log("");
                console.log(
                    `FUNC ${f.func}  CALL 446 @ 0x${q.toString(16)}`
                );
                console.log("--------------------------------------------");

                // Show ~12 instructions before and 5 after.
                const ins = [];

                let s = f.instr;

                while (s < q) {
                    const [text, next] = fmt(s);
                    ins.push({
                        pos: s,
                        text,
                        next
                    });
                    s = next;
                }

                const start = Math.max(0, ins.length - 12);

                for (let i = start; i < ins.length; i++) {
                    const x = ins[i];
                    console.log(
                        `0x${x.pos.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${x.text}`
                    );
                }

                console.log(
                    `0x${q.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  CALL 446`
                );

                let npos = r.next;

                for (let i = 0; i < 5 && npos < f.end; i++) {
                    const [text, next] = fmt(npos);
                    console.log(
                        `0x${npos.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${text}`
                    );
                    npos = next;
                }
            }

            q = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        q = skip(q);
    }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TOTAL CALL 446 SITES : ${hits}`);

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x00195d80;
const END   = 0x00195ef1;

function readULEB(buf, pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(buf, pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (b & 0x40)
    value -= 2 ** shift;

  return { value, next: pos };
}

function decodeAt(pos) {
  const addr = pos;
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  let x;

  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    x = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    return {
      next: x.next,
      text:
        (op === 0x20 ? "local.get " :
         op === 0x21 ? "local.set " :
         "local.tee ") + x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
    x = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    return {
      next: x.next,
      text:
        (op === 0x23 ? "global.get " : "global.set ") +
        x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {
    x = readSLEB(wasm, pos);
    return {
      next: x.next,
      text: "i32.const " + x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x42) {
    x = readSLEB(wasm, pos);
    return {
      next: x.next,
      text: "i64.const " + x.value
    };
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2d ||
    op === 0x36 ||
    op === 0x37 ||
    op === 0x3a ||
    op === 0x3b
  ) {
    const a = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    const o = readULEB(wasm, a.next);

    const names = {
      0x28: "i32.load",
      0x29: "i64.load",
      0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
      0x36: "i32.store",
      0x37: "i64.store",
      0x3a: "i32.store8",
      0x3b: "i32.store16"
    };

    return {
      next: o.next,
      text:
        names[op] +
        " align=" + a.value +
        " offset=" + o.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    x = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    return {
      next: x.next,
      text: "call " + x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    const table = readULEB(wasm, t.next);

    return {
      next: table.next,
      text:
        "call_indirect type=" +
        t.value +
        " table=" +
        table.value
    };
  }

  const simple = {
    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x1a: "drop",
    0x1b: "select",
    0x0b: "end",
    0x0f: "return"
  };

  if (simple[op]) {
    return {
      next: pos,
      text: simple[op]
    };
  }

  return {
    next: pos,
    text: "opcode=0x" + op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
  };
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const MIN_FUNC = 8950;
const TARGET_OFFSET = 128;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  do {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (b & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    result |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readName(pos) {
  const x = readULEB(pos);
  return { next: x.next + x.value };
}

    p = flags.next;

    p = readULEB(p).next;

      p = readULEB(p).next;

  } else if (kind === 3) {

    p++;
    p++;
  }
}

function decodeOne(pos) {

  const start = pos;
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  if (op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22) {

    const x = readULEB(pos);

    return {
      start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      local: x.value,
      text:
        op === 0x20
          ? `local.get ${x.value}`
          : op === 0x21
          ? `local.set ${x.value}`
          : `local.tee ${x.value}`
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {

    const x = readSLEB(pos);

    return {
      start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      value: x.value,
      text: `i32.const ${x.value}`
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {

    const x = readULEB(pos);

    return {
      start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      func: x.value,
      text: `call ${x.value}`
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {

    const t = readULEB(pos);
    const table = readULEB(t.next);

    return {
      start,
      end: table.next,
      op,
      type: t.value,
      text:
        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`
    };
  }

  /*
   * Loads
   */
  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) {

    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
      start,
      end: o.next,
      op,
      offset: o.value,
      text:
        `load opcode=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
        `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
    };
  }

  /*
   * Stores
   */
  if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {

    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
      start,
      end: o.next,
      op,
      offset: o.value,
      isStore: true,
      text:
        `store opcode=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
        `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
    };
  }

  /*
   * branches
   */
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

    const x = readULEB(pos);

    return {
      start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      text:
        (op === 0x0c ? "br " : "br_if ") + x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0e) {

    const n = readULEB(pos);
    pos = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
      pos = readULEB(pos).next;

    pos = readULEB(pos).next;

    return {
      start,
      end: pos,
      op,
      text: "br_table"
    };
  }

  return {
    start,
    end: pos,
    op,
    text:
      `opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
  };
}

function decodeFunction(body) {

  let p = body.start;

  const locals = readULEB(p);
  p = locals.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {

    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    p++;
  }

  const code = [];

  while (p < body.end) {

    const ins = decodeOne(p);

    code.push(ins);

    p = ins.end;

    if (ins.op === 0x0b)
      break;
  }

  return code;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function section(id: number) {

    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {

        const sid = wasm[p++];

        const size = uleb(p);
        p = size.next;

        if (sid === id) {
            return {
                start: p,
                end: p + size.value
            };
        }

        p += size.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

        p += 4;

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const IMPORTED = 83;
const TARGET_TYPE = 7;
const CONTEXT = 12;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    result |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

function decodeOne(op, p) {
  let text = `opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    return {
      text: `local.get ${r.value}`,
      next: r.next
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x21) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    return {
      text: `local.set ${r.value}`,
      next: r.next
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x22) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    return {
      text: `local.tee ${r.value}`,
      next: r.next
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x23) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    return {
      text: `global.get ${r.value}`,
      next: r.next
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x24) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    return {
      text: `global.set ${r.value}`,
      next: r.next
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    return {
      text: `call ${r.value}`,
      next: r.next
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = readULEB(p);
    p = t.next;

    const table = readULEB(p);
    p = table.next;

    return {
      text: `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`,
      next: p
    };
  }

  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
    const align = readULEB(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = readULEB(p);
    p = offset.next;

    let name = "memory";

    if (op === 0x28) name = "i32.load";
    else if (op === 0x29) name = "i64.load";
    else if (op === 0x2c) name = "i32.load8_s";
    else if (op === 0x2d) name = "i32.load8_u";
    else if (op === 0x36) name = "i32.store";
    else if (op === 0x37) name = "i64.store";
    else if (op === 0x3a) name = "i32.store8";

    return {
      text: `${name} align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`,
      next: p
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = readSLEB(p);

    return {
      text: `i32.const ${r.value}`,
      next: r.next
    };
  }

  const names = {
    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x48: "i32.lt_s",
    0x49: "i32.lt_u",
    0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
    0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x71: "i32.and",
    0x72: "i32.or",
    0x74: "i32.shl",
    0x75: "i32.shr_s",
    0x76: "i32.shr_u"
  };

  if (names[op]) {
    return {
      text: names[op],
      next: p
    };
  }

  return {
    text,
    next: p
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SCAN EACH FUNCTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const results = [];

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < bodies.length; bodyIndex++) {
  const body = bodies[bodyIndex];

  let p = body.start;

  // locals
  const localInfo = readULEB(p);
  const localDeclCount = localInfo.value;
  p = localInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
    p = readULEB(p).next;
    p++;
  }

  const decoded = [];

  while (p < body.end) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    const d = decodeOne(op, p);

    p = d.next;

    decoded.push({
      addr,
      text: d.text
    });
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < decoded.length; i++) {
    if (
      decoded[i].text ===
      "call_indirect type=7 table=0"
    ) {
      results.push({
        func: IMPORTED + bodyIndex,
        index: i,
        decoded
      });
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// OUTPUT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FOCUS TYPE 7 DISPATCH");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log("TYPE 7 DISPATCHES :", results.length);
console.log("CONTEXT :", CONTEXT);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (const r of results) {
  const start = Math.max(0, r.index - CONTEXT);
  const end = Math.min(
    r.decoded.length,
    r.index + 1
  );

  console.log("");

  );

      (i === r.index ? ">> " : "   ") +
      "0x" +
      x.addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0"),
      x.text
    );
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return [value >>> 0, pos];

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSections() {
  let pos = 8;
  let typeSection = null;
  let functionSection = null;
  let codeSection = null;

  while (pos < b.length) {
    const id = b[pos++];

    const [sectionSize, next] = uleb(pos);
    pos = next;

    const start = pos;
    const end = pos + sectionSize;

    if (id === 1)
      typeSection = [start, end];

    if (id === 3)
      functionSection = [start, end];

    if (id === 10)
      codeSection = [start, end];

    pos = end;
  }

  return { typeSection, functionSection, codeSection };
}

function readTypes(start, end) {
  let pos = start;

  const [count, next] = uleb(pos);
  pos = next;

  const types = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const form = b[pos++];

    const [paramCount, nextParam] = uleb(pos);
    pos = nextParam;

    const params = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++)
      params.push(b[pos++]);

    const [resultCount, nextResult] = uleb(pos);
    pos = nextResult;

    const results = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++)
      results.push(b[pos++]);

    types.push({
      form,
      params,
      results
    });
  }

  return types;
}

function getFunctionTypeIndex(functionSection, targetFunc) {
  let pos = functionSection[0];

  const [count, next] = uleb(pos);
  pos = next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const [typeIndex, nextType] = uleb(pos);
    pos = nextType;

    const func = 83 + i;

    if (func === targetFunc)
      return typeIndex;
  }

  return null;
}

function getFunctionBody(codeSection, targetFunc) {
  let pos = codeSection[0];

  const [count, next] = uleb(pos);
  pos = next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const [bodySize, nextSize] = uleb(pos);
    pos = nextSize;

    const func = 83 + i;

    if (func === targetFunc)
      return {
        start: pos,
        end: pos + bodySize,
        size: bodySize
      };

    pos += bodySize;
  }

  return null;
}

const sections = readSections();

const types = readTypes(...sections.typeSection);

const targetFunc = 119;

const typeIndex = getFunctionTypeIndex(
  sections.functionSection,
  targetFunc
);

const body = getFunctionBody(
  sections.codeSection,
  targetFunc
);

console.log("FUNC 119 SIGNATURE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TYPE INDEX :", typeIndex);

const type = types[typeIndex];

console.log(
  "PARAM COUNT:",
  type.params.length
);

console.log(
  "PARAMS     :",
  type.params.map(x => `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(", ")
);

console.log(
  "RESULT COUNT:",
  type.results.length
);

console.log(
  "RESULTS    :",
  type.results.map(x => `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(", ")
);

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

console.log(
  "BODY       : 0x" +
  body.start.toString(16) +
  " .. 0x" +
  body.end.toString(16)
);

console.log("SIZE       :", body.size);

console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function leb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8;
let typeStart = 0, typeSize = 0;
let importStart = 0, importSize = 0;
let funcStart = 0, funcSize = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];
  const r = leb(p);
  const size = r.value;
  p = r.next;

  if (id === 1) {
    typeStart = p;
    typeSize = size;
  }

  if (id === 2) {
    importStart = p;
    importSize = size;
  }

  if (id === 3) {
    funcStart = p;
    funcSize = size;
  }

  p += size;
}

console.log("FUNC 87 TYPE RESOLUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let q = funcStart;
const n = leb(q);
q = n.next;

let typeIndex87 = -1;

for (let i = 0; i <= 87; i++) {
  const r = leb(q);

  if (i === 87) {
    typeIndex87 = r.value;
    break;
  }

  q = r.next;
}

console.log(`FUNC 87 TYPE INDEX : ${typeIndex87}`);

console.log("");
console.log("TYPE SECTION");
console.log("============================================================");

q = typeStart;
const tc = leb(q);
q = tc.next;

for (let i = 0; i < tc.value; i++) {
  const form = wasm[q++];

  if (form !== 0x60) {
    console.log(`TYPE ${i}: form=0x${form.toString(16)}`);
    continue;
  }

  const pc = leb(q);
  q = pc.next;

  const params: number[] = [];

  for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
    params.push(wasm[q++]);
  }

  const rc = leb(q);
  q = rc.next;

  const results: number[] = [];

  for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
    results.push(wasm[q++]);
  }

  if (i === typeIndex87) {
    console.log(`TYPE ${i} <-- FUNC 87`);
    console.log(`PARAM COUNT  : ${params.length}`);
    console.log(
      `PARAM TYPES  : ${params.map(x => "0x" + x.toString(16)).join(", ")}`
    );
    console.log(`RESULT COUNT : ${results.length}`);
    console.log(
      `RESULT TYPES : ${results.map(x => "0x" + x.toString(16)).join(", ")}`
    );
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ENDPOINT =
    'https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com';

const ROUTER =
    'EQBQ_UBQvR9ryUjKDwijtoiyyga2Wl-yJm6Y8gl0k-HDh_5x';

const ROOSTER_ROUTER_WALLET =
    'EQA-oZKiTGR0Aes0yV7uck9-OLrLRJCwRMdwDnUgLU5EJYu0';

const PTON_ROUTER_WALLET =
    'EQBTYCx7TGgVgaIr3tuJ3r_91E6FUBBWLtT73lTYYmrIc5gb';

function addressSlice(address: Address) {
    return {
        type: 'slice' as const,
        cell: beginCell()
            .storeAddress(address)
            .endCell(),
    };
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI GET POOL ADDRESS');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: ENDPOINT,
    });

    const router =
        Address.parse(ROUTER);

    const token0 =
        Address.parse(ROOSTER_ROUTER_WALLET);

    const token1 =
        Address.parse(PTON_ROUTER_WALLET);

    const latest =
        await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log(
        `MASTERCHAIN SEQNO: ${latest.last.seqno}`,
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(`ROUTER : ${router.toString()}`);
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `TOKEN0 : ${token0.toString()}`,
    );
    console.log(
        `TOKEN1 : ${token1.toString()}`,
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Calling get_pool_address...');

    const result = await client.runMethod(
        latest.last.seqno,
        router,
        'get_pool_address',
        [
            addressSlice(token0),
            addressSlice(token1),
        ],
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(`EXIT CODE: ${result.exitCode}`);

    if (result.exitCode !== 0) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('GETTER FAILED');
        console.log('');
        console.log('RESULT RAW:');
        console.log(result.resultRaw);
        return;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('GETTER SUCCESS');

    try {
        const poolAddress =
            result.reader.readAddress();

        console.log('');
        console.log('POOL ADDRESS');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log(
            poolAddress.toString(),
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('POOL ADDRESS RAW');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log(
            poolAddress.toRawString(),
        );
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'Could not decode returned address:',
        );

        console.log(
            e instanceof Error
                ? e.message
                : String(e),
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('RESULT RAW:');
        console.log(result.resultRaw);
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' FINISHED - READ ONLY');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    const state = await provider.provider(routerAddress).getState();

    if (state.state.type !== 'active') {
        throw new Error('Router is not active');
    }

    if (!state.state.code) {
        throw new Error('Router code is missing');
    }

    const code = Cell.fromBoc(state.state.code)[0];

    console.log('');
    console.log('BOC hex:');
    console.log(code.toBoc().toString('hex'));
    console.log('============================');
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ENDPOINT =
    'https://sandbox-v4.tonhubapi.com';

const ROUTER =
    'EQBQ_UBQvR9ryUjKDwijtoiyyga2Wl-yJm6Y8gl0k-HDh_5x';

const ROOSTER_MASTER =
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx';

const PTON_MASTER =
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S';

async function getWallet(
    client: TonClient4,
    master: Address,
    router: Address,
    seqno: number,
): Promise<Address> {
    const result = await client.runMethod(
        seqno,
        master,
        'get_wallet_address',
        [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: (() => {
                    const { beginCell } = require('@ton/core');

                    return beginCell()
                        .storeAddress(router)
                        .endCell();
                })(),
            },
        ],
    );

    if (result.exitCode !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `get_wallet_address failed: ${result.exitCode}`,
        );
    }

    return result.reader.readAddress();
}

export async function run(
    provider: NetworkProvider,
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER JETTON WALLET DISCOVERY');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: ENDPOINT,
    });

    const router =
        Address.parse(ROUTER);

    const rooster =
        Address.parse(ROOSTER_MASTER);

    const pton =
        Address.parse(PTON_MASTER);

    const latest =
        await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log(
        `MASTERCHAIN SEQNO: ${latest.last.seqno}`,
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(`ROUTER: ${router.toString()}`);
    console.log('');

    const roosterWallet =
        await getWallet(
            client,
            rooster,
            router,
            latest.last.seqno,
        );

    console.log('ROOSTER ROUTER WALLET');
    console.log('----------------------------------------');
    console.log(
        roosterWallet.toString(),
    );

    console.log('');

    const ptonWallet =
        await getWallet(
            client,
            pton,
            router,
            latest.last.seqno,
        );

    console.log('PTON ROUTER WALLET');
    console.log('----------------------------------------');
    console.log(
        ptonWallet.toString(),
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' FINISHED - READ ONLY');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const roosterCoinAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const ownerAddress = provider.sender().address;

    if (!ownerAddress) {
        throw new Error('Wallet address not available.');
    }

    const contract = provider.provider(roosterCoinAddress);

    const result = await contract.get('get_wallet_address', [
        {
            type: 'slice',
            cell: beginCell()
                .storeAddress(ownerAddress)
                .endCell(),
        },
    ]);

    const jettonWalletAddress = result.stack.readAddress();

    console.log('');
    console.log('Rooster Coin Master:');
    console.log(roosterCoinAddress.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Owner Wallet:');
    console.log(ownerAddress.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER Jetton Wallet:');
    console.log(jettonWalletAddress.toString());
}

const ROOSTER_MASTER = Address.parse(

const USER = Address.parse(

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'

const EXPECTED_USER_JETTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh'

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 200073535827652n;
const MIN_LP_OUT = 300329052918n;

const GAS_AMOUNT = 300000000n;
const FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT = 240000000n;

const TRANSFER_OPCODE = 0x0f8a7ea5;
const PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE = 0x37c096df;

function assertEqual(
    label: string,
    actual: string,
    expected: string
) {
    if (actual !== expected) {
        throw new Error(
            `${label} FAILED\nExpected: ${expected}\nActual:   ${actual}`
        );
    }

    console.log(`${label}: PASS`);
}

function assertBigInt(
    label: string,
    actual: bigint,
    expected: bigint
) {
    if (actual !== expected) {
        throw new Error(
            `${label} FAILED\nExpected: ${expected}\nActual:   ${actual}`
        );
    }

    console.log(`${label}: PASS`);
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('=================================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi v2.2 GUARDED LIVE SEND');
    console.log(' REAL TRANSACTION POSSIBLE');
    console.log(' FINAL CONFIRMATION REQUIRED');
    console.log('=================================================');

    const sender = provider.sender();

    if (!sender.address) {
        throw new Error(
            'Connected wallet address is unavailable.'
        );
    }

    const senderAddress = sender.address;

    console.log('\n===== 1. WALLET =====');
    console.log('Connected wallet:');
    console.log(senderAddress.toString());

    assertEqual(
        'Connected wallet',
        senderAddress.toRawString(),
        USER.toRawString()
    );

    console.log('\n===== 2. USER ROOSTER WALLET =====');

    const userJettonWalletResult =
        await provider.provider(
            ROOSTER_MASTER
        ).get('get_wallet_address', [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(USER)
                    .endCell(),
            },
        ]);

    const derivedUserWallet =
        userJettonWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log(
        'Derived user ROOSTER wallet:',
        derivedUserWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected user ROOSTER wallet:',
        EXPECTED_USER_JETTON_WALLET.toString()
    );

    assertEqual(
        'ROOSTER wallet',
        derivedUserWallet.toRawString(),
        EXPECTED_USER_JETTON_WALLET.toRawString()
    );

    console.log('\n===== 3. ROUTER pTON WALLET =====');

    const routerPtonWalletResult =
        await provider.provider(
            PTON_MASTER
        ).get('get_wallet_address', [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(ROUTER)
                    .endCell(),
            },
        ]);

    const routerPtonWallet =
        routerPtonWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log(
        'Derived router pTON wallet:',
        routerPtonWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Expected router pTON wallet:',
        EXPECTED_ROUTER_PTON_WALLET.toString()
    );

    assertEqual(
        'pTON router wallet',
        routerPtonWallet.toRawString(),
        EXPECTED_ROUTER_PTON_WALLET.toRawString()
    );

    console.log('\n===== 4. ROOSTER BALANCE =====');

    /*
     * IMPORTANT:
     * get_wallet_data MUST be called on the USER'S
     * ROOSTER JETTON WALLET, not on the Jetton Master.
     */

    const balanceResult =
        await provider.provider(
            derivedUserWallet
        ).get('get_wallet_data', []);

    const balance =
        balanceResult.stack.readBigNumber();

    console.log(
        'User ROOSTER wallet:',
        derivedUserWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Current ROOSTER nano balance:',
        balance.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Current ROOSTER balance:',
        Number(balance) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'Required ROOSTER nano:',
        ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Required ROOSTER:',
        Number(ROOSTER_AMOUNT) / 1e9
    );

    if (balance < ROOSTER_AMOUNT) {
        throw new Error(
            `Insufficient ROOSTER balance.\n` +
            `Required: ${ROOSTER_AMOUNT}\n` +
            `Available: ${balance}`
        );
    }

    console.log('ROOSTER balance: PASS');

    console.log('\n===== 5. FRESH DEADLINE =====');

    const now =
        Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);

    const deadline =
        now + 900;

    console.log(
        'Current Unix time:',
        now
    );

    console.log(
        'Fresh deadline:',
        deadline.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Lifetime: 900 seconds'
    );

    if (deadline <= now) {
        throw new Error(
            'Deadline validation FAILED.'
        );
    }

    console.log('Deadline: PASS');

    console.log('\n===== 6. BUILD FRESH SDK TRANSACTION =====');

    const router =
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(ROUTER);

    /*
     * SDK 2.7.0 requires the router provider
     * as the first argument.
     */

    const routerProvider =
        provider.provider(ROUTER);

    const txParams =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                userWalletAddress: USER,
                sendTokenAddress: ROOSTER_MASTER,
                otherTokenAddress: PTON_MASTER,
                sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT,
                minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT,
                deadline,
                gasAmount: GAS_AMOUNT,
                forwardGasAmount: FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT,
                transferExcessAddress: USER,
            }
        );

    console.log(
        'SDK transaction built: PASS'
    );

    console.log('\n===== 7. DESTINATION CHECK =====');

    assertEqual(
        'Destination',
        txParams.to.toRawString(),
        EXPECTED_USER_JETTON_WALLET.toRawString()
    );

    console.log('\n===== 8. GAS CHECK =====');

    assertBigInt(
        'Gas',
        BigInt(txParams.value),
        GAS_AMOUNT
    );

    console.log('\n===== 9. BODY STRUCTURE =====');

    const body = txParams.body;

    if (!body) {
        throw new Error(
            'SDK transaction body is missing. Aborting before send.'
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'Bits:',
        body.bits.length
    );

    console.log(
        'Refs:',
        body.refs.length
    );

    if (body.bits.length !== 720) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected body bits: ${body.bits.length}`
        );
    }

    if (body.refs.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected body refs: ${body.refs.length}`
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'Body structure: PASS'
    );

    console.log('\n===== 10. BODY CONTENT =====');

    const parser =
        body.beginParse();

    const transferOpcode =
        parser.loadUint(32);

    const queryId =
        parser.loadUintBig(64);

    const amount =
        parser.loadCoins();

    const destination =
        parser.loadAddress();

    const responseDestination =
        parser.loadAddress();

    const customPayloadPresent =
        parser.loadBit();

    if (customPayloadPresent) {
        parser.loadRef();
    }

    const forwardAmount =
        parser.loadCoins();

    const forwardPayload =
        parser.loadRef();

    const provideParser =
        forwardPayload.beginParse();

    const provideOpcode =
        provideParser.loadUint(32);

    const routerWallet =
        provideParser.loadAddress();

    const refundAddress =
        provideParser.loadAddress();

    const excessesAddress =
        provideParser.loadAddress();

   const encodedDeadline =
    provideParser.loadUintBig(64);

const provideBody =
    provideParser.loadRef();

const provideBodyParser =
    provideBody.beginParse();

const minLpOut =
    provideBodyParser.loadCoins();

const receiver =
    provideBodyParser.loadAddress();

const bothPositive =
    provideBodyParser.loadBit();

const forwardGas =
    provideBodyParser.loadCoins();

const provideCustomPayloadPresent =
    provideBodyParser.loadBit();

if (provideCustomPayloadPresent) {
    provideBodyParser.loadRef();
}

    console.log(
        'Transfer opcode:',
        `0x${transferOpcode.toString(16)}`
    );

    console.log(
        'Query ID:',
        queryId.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Amount:',
        amount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Destination:',
        destination.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Response destination:',
        responseDestination.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Forward TON:',
        forwardAmount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Provide LP opcode:',
        `0x${provideOpcode.toString(16)}`
    );

    console.log(
        'Router wallet:',
        routerWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Refund:',
        refundAddress.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Excesses:',
        excessesAddress.toString()
    );

    console.log(

        encodedDeadline.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'minLpOut:',
        minLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Receiver:',
        receiver.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'bothPositive:',
        bothPositive
    );

    console.log(
        'Custom gas:',
        forwardGas.toString()
    );

    console.log('\n===== 11. FINAL CONTENT GUARDS =====');

    assertEqual(
        'Transfer opcode',
        `0x${transferOpcode.toString(16)}`,
        `0x${TRANSFER_OPCODE.toString(16)}`
    );

    assertBigInt(
        'Query ID',
        queryId,
        0n
    );

        amount,
        ROOSTER_AMOUNT
    );

    assertEqual(

        destination.toRawString(),
        ROUTER.toRawString()
    );

    );

    );

    );

        );

    console.log(

    );

    assertBigInt(
    'Forward gas',

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_FUNC = 1974;
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

const TARGET_CALLS = new Set([
  0x002314c7,
  0x002314d0,
  0x002314e9,
]);

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function readName(pos: number): { text: string; next: number } {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  const end = n.next + n.value;

  let s = "";
  for (let i = n.next; i < end; i++) {
    s += String.fromCharCode(wasm[i]);
  }

  return {
    text: s,
    next: end,
  };
}

type Body = {
  ordinal: number;
  globalFunc: number;
  bodyStart: number;
  instrStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  size: number;
};

function parseCodeSection(): Body[] {
  /*
   * Locate section id 10 (Code).
   */
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[p++];

    const sizeInfo = uleb(p);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
    const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
      let q = payloadStart;

      const countInfo = uleb(q);
      const count = countInfo.value;
      q = countInfo.next;

      const bodies: Body[] = [];

      for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count; ordinal++) {
        const bodySizeInfo = uleb(q);
        const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
        const bodyStart = bodySizeInfo.next;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

        /*
         * Function body:
         *
         * vec(locals)
         * expression
         *
         * We only need to skip the local declaration vector
         * to locate the first instruction.
         */
        let r = bodyStart;

        const localCountInfo = uleb(r);
        const localCount = localCountInfo.value;
        r = localCountInfo.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < localCount; i++) {
          const n = uleb(r);
          r = n.next;

          // valtype is one byte
          r += 1;
        }

        bodies.push({
          ordinal,
          globalFunc: ordinal + IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS,
          bodyStart,
          instrStart: r,
          bodyEnd,
          size: bodySize,
        });

        q = bodyEnd;
      }

      return bodies;
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
  }

  throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

const bodies = parseCodeSection();

type Instr = {
  addr: number;
  op: number;
  name: string;
  imm?: number;
};

function decode(start: number, end: number): Instr[] {
  const out: Instr[] = [];
  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    try {
      switch (op) {

        case 0x00:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "unreachable" });
          break;

        case 0x01:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "nop" });
          break;

        case 0x02:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "block" });
          p += 1;
          break;

        case 0x03:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "loop" });
          p += 1;
          break;

        case 0x04:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "if" });
          p += 1;
          break;

        case 0x05:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "else" });
          break;

        case 0x0b:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "end" });
          break;

        case 0x0c: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "br", imm: x.value });
          break;
        }

        case 0x0d: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "br_if", imm: x.value });
          break;
        }

        case 0x0f:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "return" });
          break;

        case 0x10: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "call", imm: x.value });
          break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          p += 1;
          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "call_indirect",
            imm: x.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x1a:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "drop" });
          break;

        case 0x20: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "local.get",
            imm: x.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "local.set",
            imm: x.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "local.tee",
            imm: x.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x23: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "global.get",
            imm: x.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x24: {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "global.set",
            imm: x.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x28: {
          const align = uleb(p);
          p = align.next;

          const offset = uleb(p);
          p = offset.next;

          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "i32.load",
            imm: offset.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x2d: {
          const align = uleb(p);
          p = align.next;

          const offset = uleb(p);
          p = offset.next;

          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "i32.load8_u",
            imm: offset.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x36: {
          const align = uleb(p);
          p = align.next;

          const offset = uleb(p);
          p = offset.next;

          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "i32.store",
            imm: offset.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x3a: {
          const align = uleb(p);
          p = align.next;

          const offset = uleb(p);
          p = offset.next;

          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "i32.store8",
            imm: offset.value,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
          const x = sleb(p);
          p = x.next;

          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: "i32.const",
            imm: x.value >>> 0,
          });
          break;
        }

        case 0x45:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.eqz" });
          break;

        case 0x46:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.eq" });
          break;

        case 0x47:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.ne" });
          break;

        case 0x4b:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.ge_u" });
          break;

        case 0x6a:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.add" });
          break;

        case 0x6b:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.sub" });
          break;

        case 0x71:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.and" });
          break;

        case 0x72:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.or" });
          break;

        case 0x74:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.shl" });
          break;

        case 0x7c:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.add" });
          break;

        case 0xa7:
          out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.wrap_i64" });
          break;

        default:
          out.push({
            addr,
            op,
            name: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
          });
          break;
      }
    } catch {
      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      });
      break;
    }
  }

  return out;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_FUNC = 2057;
const IMPORTED = 83;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function findCodeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p++];

    const s = readULEB(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function decode(pos: number): { text: string; next: number } {
  const op = buf[pos++];

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00:
      return { text: "unreachable", next: pos };

    case 0x01:
      return { text: "nop", next: pos };

    case 0x02: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `block ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x03: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `loop ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x04:
      return { text: "if", next: pos };

    case 0x05:
      return { text: "else", next: pos };

    case 0x0b:
      return { text: "end", next: pos };

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `br ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `br_if ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x0f:
      return { text: "return", next: pos };

    case 0x10: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `call ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      const y = readULEB(x.next);
      return {
        text: `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${y.value}`,
        next: y.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x20: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.get ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.set ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.tee ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `global.get ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `global.set ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const o = readULEB(a.next);
      return {
        text: `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
        next: o.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x2d: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const o = readULEB(a.next);
      return {
        text: `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
        next: o.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const o = readULEB(a.next);
      return {
        text: `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
        next: o.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x3f:
      return { text: "memory.size", next: pos + 1 };

    case 0x40:
      return { text: "memory.grow", next: pos + 1 };

    case 0x41: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);
      return { text: `i32.const ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);
      return { text: `i64.const ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x45:
      return { text: "i32.eqz", next: pos };

    case 0x46:
      return { text: "i32.eq", next: pos };

    case 0x47:
      return { text: "i32.ne", next: pos };

    case 0x4b:
      return { text: "i32.gt_u", next: pos };

    case 0x4f:
      return { text: "i32.ge_u", next: pos };

    case 0x50:
      return { text: "i64.eqz", next: pos };

    case 0x6a:
      return { text: "i32.add", next: pos };

    case 0x6b:
      return { text: "i32.sub", next: pos };

    case 0x71:
      return { text: "i32.and", next: pos };

    case 0x74:
      return { text: "i32.shl", next: pos };

    case 0xa7:
      return { text: "i32.wrap_i64", next: pos };

    case 0xad:
      return { text: "i64.extend_i32_u", next: pos };

    default:
      return {
        text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        next: pos,
      };
  }
}

const code = findCodeSection();

let p = code.start;

const count = readULEB(p);
p = count.next;

const functions: {
  ordinal: number;
  globalFunc: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
}[] = [];

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
  const s = readULEB(p);
  p = s.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + s.value;

  functions.push({
    ordinal,
    globalFunc: ordinal + IMPORTED,
    start,
    end,
  });

  p = end;
}

let hits = 0;

for (const f of functions) {
  let q = f.start;

  const ins: {
    pos: number;
    text: string;
  }[] = [];

  while (q < f.end) {
    const pos = q;
    const d = decode(q);

    ins.push({
      pos,
      text: d.text,
    });

    if (d.next <= q) break;
    q = d.next;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
    if (ins[i].text !== `call ${TARGET_FUNC}`) continue;

    hits++;

    console.log(
      `CALL @0x${ins[i].pos.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
    );
    console.log(
      `  CALLER GLOBAL = ${f.globalFunc}`
    );
    console.log(
      `  CALLER ORDINAL = ${f.ordinal}`
    );
    console.log(
      `  BODY = 0x${f.start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${f.end
        .toString(16)
        .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log("  PRE-CALL INSTRUCTIONS:");

    const from = Math.max(0, i - 12);

    for (let k = from; k < i; k++) {
      console.log(
        `    0x${ins[k].pos.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${ins[k].text}`
      );
    }

    console.log("");
  }
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log(`TOTAL DIRECT CALLS = ${hits}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 0x93e16;

function readU32LE(p: number): number {
  return (
    buf[p] |
    (buf[p + 1] << 8) |
    (buf[p + 2] << 16) |
    (buf[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readName(p: number): { name: string; next: number } {
  const len = readULEB(p);
  p = len.next;

  const end = p + len.value;
  let s = "";

  while (p < end) {
    s += String.fromCharCode(buf[p++]);
  }

  return { name: s, next: p };
}

function findCodeSection(): { start: number; end: number } {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + size;

    if (id === 10) {
      return {
        start: payloadStart,
        end: payloadEnd,
      };
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

const code = findCodeSection();

let p = code.start;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const functionCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

console.log("IDENTIFY FUNCTION AT ADDRESS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET = 0x${TARGET.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`);
console.log(`FUNCTION BODIES = ${functionCount}`);
console.log("");

let found = false;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < functionCount; ordinal++) {
  const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
  p = bodySizeInfo.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

  if (TARGET >= bodyStart && TARGET < bodyEnd) {
    const globalFunc = ordinal + 83;

    console.log("MATCH FOUND");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log(`CODE ORDINAL = ${ordinal}`);
    console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC   = ${globalFunc}`);
    console.log(
      `BODY          = 0x${bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${bodyEnd
        .toString(16)
        .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );
    console.log(`BODY SIZE     = ${bodySize}`);
    console.log(
      `TARGET OFFSET = 0x${(TARGET - bodyStart).toString(16)}`
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("RAW BODY PREFIX");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    const end = Math.min(bodyEnd, bodyStart + 160);

    for (let q = bodyStart; q < end; q += 16) {
      const lineEnd = Math.min(q + 16, end);

      const hex: string[] = [];

      for (let r = q; r < lineEnd; r++) {
        hex.push(buf[r].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
      }

      console.log(
        `0x${q.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${hex.join(" ")}`
      );
    }

    found = true;
    break;
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

if (!found) {
  console.log("NO FUNCTION BODY CONTAINS TARGET");
}

console.log("");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");

    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\node_modules\\@ston-fi\\sdk'
);

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

function walk(dir: string): string[] {
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];

    const result: string[] = [];

    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, {
        withFileTypes: true,
    })) {
        const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);

        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
            result.push(...walk(full));
        } else {
            result.push(full);
        }
    }

    return result;
}

function isText(file: string): boolean {
    return [
        '.js',
        '.cjs',
        '.mjs',
        '.map',
        '.d.ts',
    ].includes(path.extname(file).toLowerCase());
}

function showValue(label: string, value: any) {
    console.log(`${label}:`);

    try {
        console.log(value.toString());
    } catch {
        console.log('<unavailable>');
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x0001226d;
const END = 0x0001295c;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 122 + FUNCTION 87 INLINE ANALYSIS v1");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();
console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(
  `Range     : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`
);
console.log();

type Value = string;

interface Slot {
  id: number;
  arg1: Value;
  arg3: Value;
  callNo: number;
  pc: number;
}

function slotName(n: number): string {
  return `S${n}`;
}

function clean(x: string): string {
  return x.replace(/\s+/g, "");
}

/*
 * Function 87 was fully decoded previously.
 *
 * Inputs:
 *   local0 = destination
 *   local1 = arg1
 *   local2 = arg2
 *   local3 = arg3
 *   local4 = arg4
 *
 * In Function 122:
 *   arg2 = 0
 *   arg4 = 0
 *
 * Function 87 finally performs:
 *
 *   STORE64 [local0 + 8]
 *   STORE64 [local0]
 *
 * The symbolic expressions below reproduce the two output
 * expressions while keeping them readable.
 */

function function87Outputs(
  a: Value,
  b: Value
): { lo: Value; hi: Value } {

  /*
   * Reconstruct the symbolic state of Function 87.
   *
   * From the decoded Function 87:
   *
   * local1 =
   *   (((local1 | 0xffffffff)
   *      / (local3 rotl 32))
   *      - (...))
   *
   * local3 =
   *   ((((local3 | 0xffffffff)
   *       / (local1 | 0xffffffff))
   *       rotl 32)
   *       - ((local3 | 0xffffffff)
   *          / (local1 rotl 32)))
   *
   * local5 =
   *   (local3 | 0xffffffff)
   *   / (local1 | 0xffffffff)
   *
   * The exact signed-i64 semantics are preserved symbolically.
   */

  const A = `(${a})`;
  const B = `(${b})`;

  const Aor = `(${A} | 0xffffffff)`;
  const Bor = `(${B} | 0xffffffff)`;

  const Brot = `rotl32(${B})`;
  const Arot = `rotl32(${A})`;

  const q1 = `(${Aor} / ${Brot})`;

  const l1 = `(${q1} - (${Aor} / ${Brot}))`;

  /*
   * Keep the intermediate names explicit rather than
   * expanding them recursively.
   *
   * This is intentional: the next analysis stage will
   * resolve exact expression dependencies.
   */

  const q = `(${Bor} / ${Aor})`;

  const l3 = `(rotl32(${q}) - (${Bor} / ${Arot}))`;

  const l1r = `rotl32(${l1})`;
  const l3r = `rotl32(${l3})`;

  const outLo = `((${l1r} * ${B}) | ${l3r})`;
  const outHi = `((${l3r} * ${A}) | ${l1r})`;

  return {
    lo: outLo,
    hi: outHi,
  };
}

function asciiAt(p: number, n = 80) {
  let s = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < n && p + i < wasm.length; i++) {
    const b = wasm[p + i];
    s += b >= 32 && b <= 126 ? String.fromCharCode(b) : ".";
  }
  return s;
}

function hexAt(p: number, n = 32) {
  return Array.from(wasm.subarray(p, p + n))
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };
    s += 7;
  }
}

const targets = [84, 85, 86, 89, 91, 96, 101, 134, 2413, 259];

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 122 HELPER FAMILY");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const target of targets) {
  let found = false;

  for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length - 1; p++) {
    if (wasm[p] !== 0x10) continue;

    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    if (x.value !== target) continue;

    // Show first occurrence and surrounding bytes only.
    console.log("");
    console.log(`CALL FUNC_${target} @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);

    const s = Math.max(0, p - 24);
    const e = Math.min(wasm.length, p + 12);

    console.log(
      Array.from(wasm.subarray(s, e))
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ")
    );

    found = true;
    break;
  }

  if (!found) {
    console.log(`FUNC_${target} : no call found`);
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0, shift = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: pos };
        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v, n = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("INSPECT 0x19534C DATA / MEMORY");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(`TARGET : ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log();

let p = 8;
let hit = false;
let dataCount = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {

    const sectionId = wasm[p++];

    const si = uleb(p);
    p = si.next;

    const end = p + si.value;

    if (sectionId !== 11) {
        p = end;
        continue;
    }

    const ci = uleb(p);
    const count = ci.value;
    p = ci.next;

    dataCount = count;

    console.log(`DATA SEGMENTS : ${count}`);
    console.log();

    for (let seg = 0; seg < count; seg++) {

        const fi = uleb(p);
        const flags = fi.value;
        p = fi.next;

        let offset = null;

        if (flags === 0) {

            const opcode = wasm[p++];

            if (opcode !== 0x41) {
                console.log(`SEG ${seg}: unsupported offset opcode`);
                process.exit(1);
            }

            const oi = uleb(p);
            offset = oi.value;
            p = oi.next;

            if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b) {
                console.log(`SEG ${seg}: bad offset end`);
                process.exit(1);
            }

        } else if (flags === 2) {

            const mi = uleb(p);
            const memoryIndex = mi.value;
            p = mi.next;

            const opcode = wasm[p++];

            if (opcode !== 0x41) {
                console.log(`SEG ${seg}: unsupported offset opcode`);
                process.exit(1);
            }

            const oi = uleb(p);
            offset = oi.value;
            p = oi.next;

            p++; // end expression

        } else if (flags === 1) {

            const li = uleb(p);
            p = li.next + li.value;
            continue;

        } else {
            console.log(`SEG ${seg}: flags=${flags}`);
            process.exit(1);
        }

        const li = uleb(p);
        const len = li.value;
        p = li.next;

        const dataStart = p;
        const dataEnd = p + len;

        const segEnd = offset + len;

        // Check whether TARGET falls anywhere near this segment.
        if (
            TARGET >= offset - 32 &&
            TARGET <= segEnd + 32
        ) {

            hit = true;

            console.log("############################################################");
            console.log(`SEGMENT ${seg}`);
            console.log("############################################################");
            console.log(`OFFSET : ${hex(offset)}`);
            console.log(`SIZE   : ${len}`);
            console.log(`END    : ${hex(segEnd)}`);
            console.log();

            const from = Math.max(offset, TARGET - 32);
            const to = Math.min(segEnd, TARGET + 32);

            for (let addr = from; addr < to; addr++) {

                const idx = dataStart + (addr - offset);
                const b = wasm[idx];

                const mark =
                    addr >= TARGET && addr < TARGET + 4
                        ? "  <=== TARGET"
                        : "";

                console.log(
                    `${hex(addr)}  ${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}${mark}`
                );
            }

            console.log();

            // If the target is fully contained, decode LE values.
            if (TARGET >= offset && TARGET + 4 <= segEnd) {

                const idx = dataStart + (TARGET - offset);

                const b0 = wasm[idx];
                const b1 = wasm[idx + 1];
                const b2 = wasm[idx + 2];
                const b3 = wasm[idx + 3];

                const value =
                    (b0 |
                    (b1 << 8) |
                    (b2 << 16) |
                    (b3 << 24)) >>> 0;

                console.log("TARGET VALUE");
                console.log(`RAW  : ${[b0,b1,b2,b3]
                    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"))
                    .join(" ")}`);

                console.log(`I32  : ${value}`);
                console.log(`HEX  : ${hex(value)}`);
                console.log();

                console.log("RESULT:");
                console.log(`MEM[0x19534C] = ${value} (${hex(value)})`);
            }
        }

        p = dataEnd;
    }

    break;
}

console.log();

if (!hit) {
    console.log("NO DATA SEGMENT NEAR TARGET.");
    console.log("Therefore the selector is almost certainly initialized dynamically.");
}

console.log();
