console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

for (const funcId of [...TARGETS].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {
  const definedIndex = funcId - importedFunctionCount;
  const body = parsed.codeBodies[definedIndex];
  const ft = getFunctionType(funcId);

  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`FUNC ${funcId}`);

  if (!body) {
    console.log("BODY : NOT FOUND");
    continue;
  }

  console.log(
    `BODY : 0x${body.bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${body.bodyEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
  );

  if (ft?.type) {
    const p = ft.type.params.map(x => `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(",");
    const r = ft.type.results.map(x => `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(",");

    console.log(`TYPE : ${ft.typeIndex}`);
    console.log(`SIG  : (${p}) -> (${r})`);
  } else {
    console.log("TYPE : unknown");
  }

  const decoded = decodeBody(body.bodyStart, body.bodyEnd);

  console.log(
    `LOCALS GROUPS : ${decoded.locals.length}`
  );

  if (decoded.locals.length) {
    console.log(
      "LOCALS : " +
      decoded.locals
        .map(x => `${x.count}x0x${x.type.toString(16)}`)
        .join(", ")
    );
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS:");

  let important = 0;

  for (const ins of decoded.instructions) {
    if (
      ins.name === "call" ||
      ins.name === "call_indirect" ||
      ins.name === "i32.const" ||
      ins.name === "i32.load" ||
      ins.name === "i32.load8_u" ||
      ins.name === "i32.store" ||
      ins.name === "i64.load" ||
      ins.name === "i64.store" ||
      ins.name === "local.get" ||
      ins.name === "local.set" ||
      ins.name === "local.tee" ||
      ins.name === "i32.add" ||
      ins.name === "i32.sub" ||
      ins.name === "i32.eq"
    ) {
      let s =
        `0x${ins.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ${ins.name}`;

      if (ins.value !== undefined) {
        s += ` ${ins.value}`;
      }

      if (ins.func !== undefined) {
        s += ` FUNC=${ins.func}`;
      }

      if (ins.type !== undefined) {
        s += ` TYPE=${ins.type} TABLE=${ins.table}`;
      }

      if (ins.local !== undefined) {
        s += ` LOCAL=${ins.local}`;
      }

      if (ins.offsetImm !== undefined) {
        s += ` OFFSET=${ins.offsetImm}`;
      }

      console.log(s);
      important++;
    }
  }

  console.log();
  console.log(
    `DIRECT CALLS : ${decoded.instructions.filter(x => x.name === "call").length}`
  );

  for (const ins of decoded.instructions) {
    if (ins.name === "call") {
      console.log(`  -> FUNC ${ins.func}`);
    }
  }

  console.log(

  );

  for (const ins of decoded.instructions) {
    if (ins.name === "call_indirect") {

      );
    }
  }

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 248;
const CONTEXT = 40;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    result |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

function skipBlockType(pos) {
  const b = wasm[pos];

  if (
    b === 0x40 ||
    b === 0x7f ||
    b === 0x7e ||
    b === 0x7d ||
    b === 0x7c ||
    b === 0x7b ||
    b === 0x70 ||
    b === 0x6f
  ) {
    return pos + 1;
  }

  return readSLEB(pos).next;
}

function skipMemArg(pos) {
  const align = readULEB(pos);
  const offset = readULEB(align.next);

  return {
    next: offset.next,
    align: align.value,
    offset: offset.value
  };
}

function decodeInstructions(start, end) {
  const instructions = [];

  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const opPos = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    try {
      let text = `0x${opPos.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  `;

      switch (op) {
        case 0x00:
          text += "unreachable";
          break;

        case 0x01:
          text += "nop";
          break;

        case 0x02:
          p = skipBlockType(p);
          text += "block";
          break;

        case 0x03:
          p = skipBlockType(p);
          text += "loop";
          break;

        case 0x04:
          p = skipBlockType(p);
          text += "if";
          break;

        case 0x05:
          text += "else";
          break;

        case 0x0b:
          text += "end";
          break;

        case 0x0c: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `br ${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x0d: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `br_if ${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x0e: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          const labels = [];

          for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
            const x = readULEB(p);
            p = x.next;
            labels.push(x.value);
          }

          const def = readULEB(p);
          p = def.next;

          text += `br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${def.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x0f:
          text += "return";
          break;

        case 0x10: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `call ${r.value}`;

          if (r.value === TARGET) {
            text += "  <<< TARGET CALL";
          }

          break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
          const type = readULEB(p);
          p = type.next;

          const table = readULEB(p);
          p = table.next;

          text += `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x1a:
          text += "drop";
          break;

        case 0x1b:
          text += "select";
          break;

        case 0x20: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `local.get local=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `local.set local=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `local.tee local=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x23: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `global.get global=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x24: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `global.set global=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x25: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `table.get table=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x26: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `table.set table=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x28:
        case 0x29:
        case 0x2a:
        case 0x2b:
        case 0x2c:
        case 0x2d:
        case 0x2e:
        case 0x2f:
        case 0x30:
        case 0x31:
        case 0x32:
        case 0x33:
        case 0x34:
        case 0x35:
        case 0x36:
        case 0x37:
        case 0x38:
        case 0x39:
        case 0x3a:
        case 0x3b:
        case 0x3c:
        case 0x3d:
        case 0x3e: {
          const mem = skipMemArg(p);
          p = mem.next;

          const names = {
            0x28: "i32.load",
            0x29: "i64.load",
            0x2a: "f32.load",
            0x2b: "f64.load",
            0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
            0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
            0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
            0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
            0x30: "i64.load8_s",
            0x31: "i64.load8_u",
            0x32: "i64.load16_s",
            0x33: "i64.load16_u",
            0x34: "i64.load32_s",
            0x35: "i64.load32_u",
            0x36: "i32.store",
            0x37: "i64.store",
            0x38: "f32.store",
            0x39: "f64.store",
            0x3a: "i32.store8",
            0x3b: "i32.store16",
            0x3c: "i64.store8",
            0x3d: "i64.store16",
            0x3e: "i64.store32"
          };

          text += `${names[op]} align=${mem.align} offset=${mem.offset}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0x3f: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `memory.size ${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x40: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `memory.grow ${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
          const r = readSLEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `i32.const ${r.value}`;

          if (r.value === 4275) {
            text += "  <<< 4275";
          }

          break;
        }

        case 0x42: {
          const r = readSLEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text += `i64.const ${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x43:
          p += 4;
          text += "f32.const";
          break;

        case 0x44:
          p += 8;
          text += "f64.const";
          break;

        default:
          text += `UNKNOWN opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

          instructions.push({
            pos: opPos,
            text
          });

          return instructions;
      }

      instructions.push({
        pos: opPos,
        text
      });
    } catch {
      return instructions;
    }
  }

  return instructions;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Locate Code Section

let pos = 8;
let bodies = [];

while (pos < wasm.length) {
  const sectionId = wasm[pos++];

  const secSize = readULEB(pos);
  const size = secSize.value;
  pos = secSize.next;

  const secStart = pos;
  const secEnd = secStart + size;

  if (sectionId === 10) {
    const count = readULEB(pos);
    pos = count.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
      const bodySize = readULEB(pos);
      pos = bodySize.next;

      const bodyStart = pos;
      const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize.value;

      bodies.push({
        index: i,
        start: bodyStart,
        end: bodyEnd
      });

      pos = bodyEnd;
    }

    break;
  }

  pos = secEnd;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find callers
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const callers = [];

for (const body of bodies) {
  const instructions = decodeInstructions(body.start, body.end);

  for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
    if (
      instructions[i].text.includes(
        `call ${TARGET}`
      )
    ) {
      callers.push({
        func: body.index,
        instructions,
        index: i
      });
    }
  }
}

function dump(addr: number) {
    const start = Math.max(0, addr - BEFORE);
    const end = Math.min(b.length, addr + AFTER);

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`CALL @ ${hex(addr)}`);
    console.log(`Range ${hex(start)} .. ${hex(end)}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const q = Math.min(p + 16, end);

        const bytes = [];
        const ascii = [];

        for (let i = p; i < q; i++) {
            bytes.push(b[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
            ascii.push(
                b[i] >= 0x20 && b[i] <= 0x7e
                    ? String.fromCharCode(b[i])
                    : "."
            );
        }

        console.log(
            `${hex(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ").padEnd(47, " ")}  ${ascii.join("")}`
        );
    }

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;

const TARGET_TYPE = 4;

const TARGETS = [
  0x002bacae,
  0x002bbfa9,
  0x002bf7e6,
  0x002ced71,
  0x0030211a,
  0x0030229c,
];

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { v, p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function opcodeName(op: number) {

  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",
    0x23: "global.get",
    0x24: "global.set",

    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x29: "i64.load",
    0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
    0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x37: "i64.store",

    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x42: "i64.const",

    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x48: "i32.lt_s",
    0x4a: "i32.gt_s",

    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x72: "i32.or",
    0x74: "i32.shl",

    0x10: "call",
    0x11: "call_indirect",

    0x0b: "end",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
    0x0f: "return",
  };

  return names[op] ?? `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos:number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function readVec(pos:number) {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  return { count:n.value, pos:n.next };
}

function intToIP(int: number) {
    const part1 = int & 255;
    const part2 = (int >> 8) & 255;
    const part3 = (int >> 16) & 255;
    const part4 = (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const CP0_PATH = path.join(
    process.cwd(),
    'node_modules',
    '@tact-lang',
    'opcode',
    'dist',
    'spec',
    'cp0.json'
);

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log(' @TACT-LANG/OPCODE CP0 PUSHCONT INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - LOCAL FILE ONLY');
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log();

    console.log(`File: ${CP0_PATH}`);
    console.log();

    if (!fs.existsSync(CP0_PATH)) {
        throw new Error(`cp0.json not found: ${CP0_PATH}`);
    }

    const cp0 = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(CP0_PATH, 'utf8'));

    console.log(`Instruction count: ${cp0.instructions?.length ?? 0}`);
    console.log();

    const names = [
        'PUSHCONT',
        'PUSHCONT_SHORT',
    ];

    for (const name of names) {
        console.log('================================================================');
        console.log(` SEARCH: ${name}`);
        console.log('================================================================');

        const matches = (cp0.instructions ?? []).filter(
            (inst: any) =>
                inst?.mnemonic === name ||
                inst?.mnemonic?.includes(name)
        );

        console.log(`Matches: ${matches.length}`);
        console.log();

        for (let i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
            const inst = matches[i];

            console.log(`--- Match ${i + 1} ---`);
            console.log(JSON.stringify(inst, null, 2));
            console.log();
        }
    }

    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(' SEARCH PREFIXES AROUND 0x50C6A654');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log();

    const target = '50C6A654';

    for (const inst of cp0.instructions ?? []) {
        const prefix = inst?.bytecode?.prefix;

        if (typeof prefix !== 'string') {
            continue;
        }

        const normalized = prefix
            .replace(/[^0-9A-Fa-f]/g, '')
            .toUpperCase();

        if (
            normalized.startsWith(target.slice(0, 2)) ||
            target.startsWith(normalized.slice(0, 2))
        ) {
            console.log(JSON.stringify(inst, null, 2));
            console.log();
        }
    }

    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log(' INSPECTION COMPLETE');
    console.log('========================================================================');
}

import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v3';

const ROUTER_RAW =
    '0:92E1411AE546892F33B2C8A89EA90390D8FF4CFBB917A643B91E73F706FDB9D1';

const TX_LT =
    '99491281000007';

const DELAY_MS =
    1300;

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function getJson(
    url: string,
    label: string
): Promise<any> {

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 5; attempt++) {

        const response = await fetch(url);

        if (response.ok) {
            return await response.json();
        }

        if (response.status === 429) {
            const wait =
                DELAY_MS * attempt;

            console.log(
                `429 for ${label}; waiting ${wait} ms...`
            );

            await sleep(wait);
            continue;
        }

        throw new Error(
            `${label}: HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`
        );
    }

    throw new Error(
        `${label}: too many 429 responses`
    );
}

async function main(
    provider: NetworkProvider
) {

    void provider;

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' CURRENT ROUTER JETTON_NOTIFY RESPONSE INSPECTOR'
    );
    console.log(
        ' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION'
    );
    console.log(
        '================================================'
    );

    console.log('');
console.log(
    'Router raw:',
    ROUTER_RAW
);

    console.log(
        'Target LT:',
        TX_LT
    );

    /*
     * Find the exact Router transaction.
     */

    const txParams =
        new URLSearchParams();

    txParams.set(
        'account',
        ROUTER_RAW
    );

    txParams.set(
        'limit',
        '20'
    );

    txParams.set(
        'offset',
        '0'
    );

    const txUrl =
        `${TONCENTER}/transactions?${txParams}`;

    const txData =
        await getJson(
            txUrl,
            'ROUTER TRANSACTIONS'
        );

    const txs =
        txData.transactions ?? [];

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Router transactions returned:',
        txs.length
    );

    const tx =
        txs.find(
            (x: any) =>
                String(x.lt) === TX_LT
        );

    if (!tx) {
        throw new Error(
            `Router transaction LT ${TX_LT} not found`
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'TARGET ROUTER TRANSACTION FOUND'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'TX HASH:',
        tx.hash ?? 'N/A'

    console.log(
        'LT:',
        tx.lt ?? 'N/A'
    );

    console.log(
        'TRACE:',

    /*

     */

    );

    console.log(
        'msg.boc:',
        typeof msg.boc,
        msg.boc ?? 'N/A'

    console.log(

    if (msg.message_content) {

FILE: scripts\inspectCurrentPoolV22.ts
====================================================================================================
import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000009n;

function opcode(body: any): string {
    try {
        if (!body || body.bits.length < 32) return 'NONE';

        const s = body.beginParse();
        return '0x' + s.loadUint(32).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    } catch {
        return 'ERROR';
    }
}

function typeOf(op: string): string {
    switch (op) {
        case '0x37c096df': return 'stonfi_provide_lp_v2';
        case '0x50c6a654': return 'stonfi_add_liquidity_v2';
        case '0x06ecd527': return 'stonfi_cb_add_liquidity_v2';
        case '0x178d4519': return 'jetton_internal_transfer';
        case '0x0f8a7ea5': return 'jetton_transfer';
        case '0x01f3835d': return 'pton_ton_transfer';
        case '0x7362d09c': return 'jetton_notify';
        default: return 'unknown';
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' CURRENT POOL TRANSACTION v2.2');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL:');
    console.log(POOL.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET LT:');
    console.log(TARGET_LT.toString());

    const client = provider.api() as TonClient;

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(
        POOL,
        {
            limit: 30,
        }
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(`Fetched ${txs.length} transactions`);

    let found = false;

    for (const tx of txs) {
        if (tx.lt !== TARGET_LT) continue;

        found = true;

        console.log('');
        console.log('================================================');
        console.log('TARGET TRANSACTION FOUND');
        console.log('================================================');

        console.log(`LT:   ${tx.lt.toString()}`);
        console.log(`HASH: ${tx.hash().toString('base64')}`);

        if (tx.now) {
            console.log(
                `TIME: ${new Date(tx.now * 1000).toISOString()}`
            );
        }

        const inBody = tx.inMessage?.body;
        const inOp = opcode(inBody);

        console.log('');
        console.log('----- INPUT -----');
        console.log(`OPCODE: ${inOp}`);
        console.log(`TYPE:   ${typeOf(inOp)}`);

        if (tx.inMessage?.info.type === 'internal') {
            console.log(
                `FROM:   ${tx.inMessage.info.src.toString()}`
            );

            console.log(
                `TO:     ${tx.inMessage.info.dest.toString()}`
            );

            console.log(
                `VALUE:  ${tx.inMessage.info.value.coins.toString()}`
            );
        }

        if (inBody && inBody.bits.length > 0) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('INPUT BODY BOC:');
            console.log(
                inBody.toBoc().toString('base64')
            );
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('----- OUTPUTS -----');
        console.log(`COUNT: ${tx.outMessagesCount}`);

        for (let i = 0; i < tx.outMessagesCount; i++) {
            const msg = tx.outMessages.get(i);
if (!msg) continue;
            const body = msg.body;
            const op = opcode(body);

            console.log('');
            console.log(`OUTPUT #${i + 1}`);
            console.log(`OPCODE: ${op}`);
            console.log(`TYPE:   ${typeOf(op)}`);

            if (msg.info.type === 'internal') {
                console.log(
                    `FROM:  ${msg.info.src.toString()}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `TO:    ${msg.info.dest.toString()}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `VALUE: ${msg.info.value.coins.toString()}`
                );
            }

            if (body && body.bits.length > 0) {
                console.log('BODY BOC:');
                console.log(
                    body.toBoc().toString('base64')
                );
            }
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('----- FEES -----');

        if (tx.totalFees) {
            console.log(
                `TOTAL FEES: ${tx.totalFees.coins.toString()}`
            );
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('TARGET TRANSACTION INSPECTION COMPLETE');
    }

    if (!found) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('TARGET LT NOT FOUND');
        console.log('');
        console.log('Available LT range:');

        if (txs.length > 0) {
            console.log(
                `${txs[0].lt.toString()} -> ${txs[txs.length - 1].lt.toString()}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' READ ONLY CHECK COMPLETE');
    console.log(' Transaction submission: NONE');
    console.log('================================================');

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const PTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000003n;
const RANGE = 15;

function getOpcode(body: any): string {
    try {
        if (!body || body.bits.length < 32) return 'NONE';

        const s = body.beginParse();
        return '0x' + s.loadUint(32).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    } catch {
        return 'DECODE_ERROR';
    }
}

function getType(opcode: string): string {
    switch (opcode) {
        case '0x01f3835d':
            return 'pton_ton_transfer';
        case '0x0f8a7ea5':
            return 'jetton_transfer';
        case '0x7362d09c':
            return 'jetton_notify';
        case '0x37c096df':
            return 'stonfi_provide_lp_v2';
        case '0x06ecd527':
            return 'stonfi_cb_add_liquidity_v2';
        case '0x50c6a654':
            return 'stonfi_add_liquidity_v2';
        default:
            return 'unknown';
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' CURRENT pTON WALLET TRANSACTIONS v2.2');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log('pTON Wallet:');
    console.log(PTON_WALLET.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Target LT:');
    console.log(TARGET_LT.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log(`Range: ${RANGE} transactions before/after`);
    console.log('');

    const client = provider.api() as TonClient;

    // Fetch recent transactions.
    const txs = await client.getTransactions(
        PTON_WALLET,
        {
            limit: 50,
        }
    );

    // Sort newest -> oldest, as returned by TON.
    let targetIndex = -1;

    for (let i = 0; i < txs.length; i++) {
        if (txs[i].lt === TARGET_LT) {
            targetIndex = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (targetIndex === -1) {
        console.log('TARGET LT NOT FOUND IN FETCHED TRANSACTIONS');
        console.log('');
        console.log('Fetched LT range:');

        if (txs.length > 0) {
            console.log(
                `${txs[0].lt.toString()} -> ${txs[txs.length - 1].lt.toString()}`
            );
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    const start = Math.max(0, targetIndex - RANGE);
    const end = Math.min(txs.length, targetIndex + RANGE + 1);

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(
        `SHOWING ${start + 1}-${end} OF ${txs.length}`
    );
    console.log('================================================');

    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
        const tx = txs[i];

        const hash = tx.hash().toString('base64');
        const opcode = getOpcode(tx.inMessage?.body);
        const type = getType(opcode);

        const time = tx.now
            ? new Date(tx.now * 1000).toISOString()
            : 'unknown';

        console.log('');
        console.log('-----------------------------------------------');
        console.log(`#${i + 1}`);
        console.log(`LT:       ${tx.lt.toString()}`);
        console.log(`TIME:     ${time}`);
        console.log(`HASH:     ${hash}`);
        console.log(`OPCODE:   ${opcode}`);
        console.log(`TYPE:     ${type}`);

        if (tx.inMessage?.info.type === 'internal') {
            console.log(
                `IN VALUE: ${tx.inMessage.info.value.coins.toString()}`
            );

            console.log(
                `IN FROM:  ${tx.inMessage.info.src.toString()}`
            );
        }

        if (tx.inMessage?.info.type === 'internal') {
            console.log(
                `IN TO:    ${tx.inMessage.info.dest.toString()}`
            );
        }

        if (tx.outMessagesCount > 0) {
            console.log(`OUT MSGS: ${tx.outMessagesCount}`);
        }

        // Print a larger body preview only for relevant operations.
        if (
            opcode === '0x01f3835d' ||
            opcode === '0x0f8a7ea5' ||
            opcode === '0x37c096df' ||
            opcode === '0x06ecd527'
        ) {
            try {
                const boc = tx.inMessage?.body
                    .toBoc()
                    .toString('base64');

                console.log(`BODY BOC: ${boc}`);
            } catch {
                console.log('BODY BOC: <decode error>');
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' READ ONLY CHECK COMPLETE');
    console.log(' Transaction submission: NONE');
    console.log('================================================');
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [0x195350, 0x195354];

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function findSection(id: number) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const sectionId = wasm[p++];

        const s = readULEB(p);
        p = s.next;

        if (sectionId === id) {
            return {
                start: p,
                end: p + s.value
            };
        }

        p += s.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

console.log("INSPECT DATA SECTION FOR 0x195350 / 0x195354");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

const sec = findSection(11);

console.log(
    `DATA SECTION = 0x${sec.start.toString(16)} .. 0x${sec.end.toString(16)}`
);

let p = sec.start;

const count = readULEB(p);
p = count.next;

console.log(`DATA SEGMENTS = ${count.value}`);
console.log("");

let total = 0;

for (let seg = 0; seg < count.value; seg++) {

    const flags = readULEB(p);
    p = flags.next;

    let memoryIndex = 0;
    let offset = 0;

    if (flags.value === 0) {
        const op = wasm[p++];

        if (op !== 0x41) {
            console.log(
                `SEGMENT ${seg}: unexpected offset opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
            );
            process.exit(1);
        }

        const x = readSLEB(p);
        p = x.next;

        offset = x.value >>> 0;

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b) {
            console.log(`SEGMENT ${seg}: missing offset end`);
            process.exit(1);
        }

    } else if (flags.value === 2) {

        const mi = readULEB(p);
        p = mi.next;

        memoryIndex = mi.value;

        const op = wasm[p++];

        if (op !== 0x41) {
            console.log(
                `SEGMENT ${seg}: unexpected offset opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
            );
            process.exit(1);
        }

        const x = readSLEB(p);
        p = x.next;

        offset = x.value >>> 0;

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b) {
            console.log(`SEGMENT ${seg}: missing offset end`);
            process.exit(1);
        }

    } else if (flags.value === 1) {

        const size = readULEB(p);
        p = size.next;

        p += size.value;

        continue;

    } else if (flags.value === 3) {

        const mi = readULEB(p);
        p = mi.next;

        memoryIndex = mi.value;

    } else {

        console.log(
            `SEGMENT ${seg}: unsupported flags ${flags.value}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const dataStart = p;
    const dataEnd = p + sizeInfo.value;

    console.log(
        `SEGMENT ${seg}: memory=${memoryIndex} ` +
        `offset=0x${offset.toString(16)} ` +
        `size=${sizeInfo.value}`
    );

    for (const target of TARGETS) {

        if (target < offset) continue;

        const rel = target - offset;

        if (rel < 0 || rel + 4 > sizeInfo.value) continue;

        const a = dataStart + rel;

        const b0 = wasm[a];
        const b1 = wasm[a + 1];
        const b2 = wasm[a + 2];
        const b3 = wasm[a + 3];

        const value =
            (b0 |
            (b1 << 8) |
            (b2 << 16) |
            (b3 << 24)) >>> 0;

        console.log("");
        console.log(
            `  TARGET 0x${target.toString(16)} (${target})`
        );
        console.log(
            `  DATA OFFSET = 0x${a.toString(16)}`
        );
        console.log(
            `  BYTES = ${[b0,b1,b2,b3]
                .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"))
                .join(" ")}`
        );
        console.log(
            `  VALUE = ${value} (0x${value.toString(16)})`
        );

        total++;
    }

    p = dataEnd;
}

console.log("");

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x0019534c;
const RANGE = 64;

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];

    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return {
        start,
        end,
        size: s.value,
      };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

function dumpBytes(start: number, end: number) {
  const lines: string[] = [];

  for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
    const e = Math.min(p + 16, end);

    let hexes = "";

    for (let q = p; q < e; q++) {
      hexes += wasm[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0") + " ";
    }

    let ascii = "";

    for (let q = p; q < e; q++) {
      const b = wasm[q];

      ascii +=
        b >= 32 && b <= 126
          ? String.fromCharCode(b)
          : ".";
    }

    lines.push(
      `${hex(p)}  ${hexes.padEnd(48)} ${ascii}`
    );
  }

  return lines;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const file =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGET = 0x250fa0;

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function u32(pos) {
    if (pos + 4 > buf.length)
        return null;

    return (
        buf[pos] |
        (buf[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (buf[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (buf[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function dumpCell(cell: any, name: string, depth = 0) {
    const pad = ' '.repeat(depth * 2);

            const op = s.loadUint(32);

            console.log(
                `${pad}opcode: ${hex(BigInt(op))}`
            );

            if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
                const qid = s.loadUintBig(64);

                console.log(
                    `${pad}query_id: ${qid}`
                );
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            `${pad}slice decode error: ${e}`
        );
    }

    try {
        for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
            dumpCell(
                cell.refs[i],
                `ref[${i}]`,
                depth + 1
            );
        }
    } catch {}
}

function printMessage(message: any, label: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(label);
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    const info: any = message.info;

    try {
        console.log(`src: ${info.src?.toString()}`);
    } catch {}

    try {
        console.log(`dest: ${info.dest?.toString()}`);
    } catch {}

    try {
        console.log(
            `value: ${info.value.coins} nanoTON`
        );

        console.log(
            `value TON: ${(Number(info.value.coins) / 1e9).toFixed(9)}`
        );
    } catch {}

    try {
        console.log(
            `createdLt: ${info.createdLt}`
        );
    } catch {}

    try {
        console.log(
            `createdAt: ${info.createdAt}`
        );
    } catch {}

    console.log('');

    if (message.body) {
        dumpCell(
            message.body,
            'BODY'
        );
    } else {
        console.log('BODY: empty');
    }
}

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 DESTINATION TRANSACTION INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        `Destination: ${DESTINATION.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Target LT: ${TARGET_LT}`
    );

    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: TONCENTER,
    });

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(
        DESTINATION,
        {
            limit: 20,
        }
    );

    console.log(
        `Transactions returned: ${txs.length}`
    );

    console.log('');

    let found = false;

    for (const tx of txs) {
        let lt: bigint;

        try {
            lt = BigInt(tx.lt);
        } catch {
            continue;
        }

        console.log(`Available LT: ${lt}`);

        if (lt !== TARGET_LT) {
            continue;
        }

        found = true;

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            '############################################################'
        );
        console.log(
            'TARGET DESTINATION TRANSACTION FOUND'
        );
        console.log(
            '############################################################'
        );

        console.log(`LT: ${tx.lt}`);

        try {
            console.log(
                `hash: ${Buffer.from(tx.hash()).toString('base64')}`
            );
        } catch {}

        console.log('');

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Incoming message
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (tx.inMessage) {
            printMessage(
                tx.inMessage,
                'INCOMING MESSAGE'
            );
        } else {
            console.log('No incoming message.');
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Outgoing messages
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        console.log('');

        if (!tx.outMessages || tx.outMessages.size === 0) {
            console.log(
                'No outgoing messages.'
            );
        } else {
            console.log(
                `Outgoing messages: ${tx.outMessages.size}`
            );

            let i = 0;

            for (const [, message] of tx.outMessages) {
                printMessage(
                    message,
                    `OUTGOING MESSAGE #${i}`
                );

                i++;
            }
        }

        break;
    }

    if (!found) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'TARGET TRANSACTION NOT FOUND.'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log(' INSPECTION COMPLETE');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('================================================================');
    console.log('');
}

    provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    await main();
}

function u32(pos: number): number {
  if (pos < 0 || pos + 4 > buf.length) return 0;
  return buf.readUInt32LE(pos);
}

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function in412(v: number): boolean {
  return v >= SEG412_START && v <= SEG412_END;
}

function in413(v: number): boolean {
  return v >= SEG413_START && v <= SEG413_END;
}

/*
 * Build a memory-image map from active WASM data segments.
 * Supports the common active forms:
 *   flags 0 = memory 0 + i32.const offset
 *   flags 2 = explicit memory index + i32.const offset
 */
function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function parseDataSection() {
  // Known verified data section.
  const sectionStart = 0x00324ef5;
  const payloadStart = 0x00324ef9;

  if (buf[sectionStart] !== 11) {
    throw new Error("Data section header mismatch");
  }

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(sectionStart + 1);
  const payloadEnd = sectionStart + 1 +
    (sizeInfo.next - (sectionStart + 1)) +
    sizeInfo.value;

  let p = payloadStart;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  const count = countInfo.value;
  p = countInfo.next;

  const memory = new Map<number, number>();

  for (let seg = 0; seg < count; seg++) {
    const flags = buf[p++];

    let memoryIndex = 0;
    let offset = 0;

    if (flags === 0) {
      const opcode = buf[p++];
      if (opcode !== 0x41) {
        throw new Error(`Unsupported offset expr at segment ${seg}`);
      }

      const offInfo = readULEB(p);
      offset = offInfo.value >>> 0;
      p = offInfo.next;

      if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
        throw new Error(`Missing end expr at segment ${seg}`);
      }

    } else if (flags === 2) {
      const memInfo = readULEB(p);
      memoryIndex = memInfo.value;
      p = memInfo.next;

      const opcode = buf[p++];
      if (opcode !== 0x41) {
        throw new Error(`Unsupported offset expr at segment ${seg}`);
      }

      const offInfo = readULEB(p);
      offset = offInfo.value >>> 0;
      p = offInfo.next;

      if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
        throw new Error(`Missing end expr at segment ${seg}`);
      }

    } else {
      throw new Error(
        `Unsupported data segment flags=${flags} at segment ${seg}`
      );
    }

    const lenInfo = readULEB(p);
    const len = lenInfo.value;
    p = lenInfo.next;

    if (memoryIndex === 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        memory.set(offset + i, buf[p + i]);
      }
    }

    p += len;
  }

  console.log(`Data segments = ${count}`);
  console.log(`Data parser end = ${hex(p)}`);
  console.log(`Expected payload end = ${hex(payloadEnd)}`);
  console.log(`Memory bytes mapped = ${memory.size}`);

  return memory;
}

const memory = parseDataSection();

function memU32(addr: number): number | null {
  const b0 = memory.get(addr);
  const b1 = memory.get(addr + 1);
  const b2 = memory.get(addr + 2);
  const b3 = memory.get(addr + 3);

  if (
    b0 === undefined ||
    b1 === undefined ||
    b2 === undefined ||
    b3 === undefined
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    b0 |
    (b1 << 8) |
    (b2 << 16) |
    (b3 << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function classify(v: number): string {
  if (in412(v)) return "SEG412";
  if (in413(v)) return "SEG413";
  if (ANCHORS.includes(v)) return "ANCHOR";
  return "";
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_FUNCS = [113, 119, 2057];

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(idWanted: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === idWanted) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${idWanted} not found`);
}

/*
 * IMPORTS
 */
const importSec = findSection(2);

let importedFunctions = 0;

{
  let p = importSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const ml = readUleb(p);
    p = ml.next + ml.value;

    const nl = readUleb(p);
    p = nl.next + nl.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const t = readUleb(p);
      p = t.next;
      importedFunctions++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;
      const flags = readUleb(p);
      p = flags.next;

      const min = readUleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readUleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = readUleb(p);
      p = flags.next;

      const min = readUleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readUleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }
}

/*
 * CODE
 */
const codeSec = findSection(10);

const bodies = new Map<number, { start: number; end: number }>();

{
  let p = codeSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    bodies.set(importedFunctions + i, { start, end });

    p = end;
  }
}

function decodeFunc(func: number) {
  const body = bodies.get(func);

  if (!body) {
    console.log(`FUNC ${func}: BODY NOT FOUND`);
    return;
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
  console.log(`BODY = ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`);
  console.log(`SIZE = ${body.end - body.start}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  let p = body.start;

  while (p < body.end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = readSleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} i32.const ${hex(x.value >>> 0)}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
      const x = readSleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} i64.const ${x.value}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(`${hex(at)} local.get ${x.value}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(`${hex(at)} local.set ${x.value}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(`${hex(at)} local.tee ${x.value}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(`${hex(at)} call FUNC ${x.value}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = readUleb(p);
      p = t.next;

      const table = readUleb(p);
      p = table.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} call_indirect TYPE ${t.value} TABLE ${table.value}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Memory loads/stores.
     */
    if (
      op >= 0x28 &&
      op <= 0x3e
    ) {
      const a = readUleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const off = readUleb(p);
      p = off.next;

      let name = `memop ${hex(op, 2)}`;

      switch (op) {
        case 0x28: name = "i32.load"; break;
        case 0x29: name = "i64.load"; break;
        case 0x2a: name = "f32.load"; break;
        case 0x2b: name = "f64.load"; break;
        case 0x2c: name = "i32.load8_s"; break;
        case 0x2d: name = "i32.load8_u"; break;
        case 0x2e: name = "i32.load16_s"; break;
        case 0x2f: name = "i32.load16_u"; break;
        case 0x30: name = "i64.load8_s"; break;
        case 0x31: name = "i64.load8_u"; break;
        case 0x32: name = "i64.load16_s"; break;
        case 0x33: name = "i64.load16_u"; break;
        case 0x34: name = "i64.load32_s"; break;
        case 0x35: name = "i64.load32_u"; break;
        case 0x36: name = "i32.store"; break;
        case 0x37: name = "i64.store"; break;
        case 0x38: name = "f32.store"; break;
        case 0x39: name = "f64.store"; break;
        case 0x3a: name = "i32.store8"; break;
        case 0x3b: name = "i32.store16"; break;
        case 0x3c: name = "i64.store8"; break;
        case 0x3d: name = "i64.store16"; break;
        case 0x3e: name = "i64.store32"; break;
      }

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} ${name} offset=${hex(off)}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Control flow.
     */
    if (op === 0x00) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} unreachable`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x01) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} nop`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      const bt = wasm[p++];

      const name =
        op === 0x02 ? "block" :
        op === 0x03 ? "loop" :
        "if";

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} ${name} blocktype=${hex(bt, 2)}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x05) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} else`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0b) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} end`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(`${hex(at)} br ${x.value}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0d) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(`${hex(at)} br_if ${x.value}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0e) {
      const n = readUleb(p);
      p = n.next;

      const labels: number[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const x = readUleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        labels.push(x.value);
      }

      const d = readUleb(p);
      p = d.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${d.value}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0f) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} return`);
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Common numeric operations.
     */
    const simple: Record<number, string> = {
      0x1a: "drop",
      0x45: "i32.eqz",
      0x46: "i32.eq",
      0x47: "i32.ne",
      0x48: "i32.lt_s",
      0x49: "i32.lt_u",
      0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
      0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
      0x4c: "i32.le_s",
      0x4d: "i32.le_u",
      0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
      0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
      0x6a: "i32.add",
      0x6b: "i32.sub",
      0x71: "i32.and",
      0x72: "i32.or",
      0x73: "i32.xor",
      0x74: "i32.shl",
      0x75: "i32.shr_s",
      0x76: "i32.shr_u",
    };

    if (simple[op]) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} ${simple[op]}`);
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Extended opcode prefix.
     * Do not interpret semantics here.
     */
    if (op === 0xfc) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} 0xfc subopcode=${hex(x.value, 4)}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Local declaration bytes / other raw bytes.
     */
    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} opcode=${hex(op, 2)}`
    );
  }
}

for (const f of TARGET_FUNCS) {
  decodeFunc(f);
}

]);

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readU32(buf: Buffer, off: number) {
    if (off < 0 || off + 4 > buf.length)
        return null;

    return buf.readUInt32LE(off);
}

/*
 * Parse sections.
 */
let p = 8;

let dataStart = 0;
let dataEnd = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {

    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    const payload = s.next;
    const end = payload + s.value;

    if (id === 11) {
        dataStart = payload;
        dataEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

if (!dataStart)
    throw new Error("Data section not found");

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" DISPATCH CONSTANT MEMORY INSPECTOR");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Data section : ${hex(dataStart)} .. ${hex(dataEnd)}`);
console.log();

/*
 * Build WASM linear-memory image from active data segments.
 */
const memory = Buffer.alloc(0x2000000);

p = dataStart;

const count = uleb(p);
p = count.next;

console.log(`Data segments : ${count.value}`);
console.log();

type Segment = {
    id: number;
    memStart: number;
    size: number;
    fileStart: number;
};

const segments: Segment[] = [];

for (let seg = 0; seg < count.value; seg++) {

    const flags = uleb(p);
    p = flags.next;

    let memOffset = 0;

    if (flags.value === 0) {

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x41)
            throw new Error("Expected i32.const");

        const off = uleb(p);
        p = off.next;

        memOffset = off.value;

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error("Expected end");

    } else if (flags.value === 2) {

        const memidx = uleb(p);
        p = memidx.next;

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x41)
            throw new Error("Expected i32.const");

        const off = uleb(p);
        p = off.next;

        memOffset = off.value;

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error("Expected end");

    } else {

        /*
         * Passive / unsupported for this analysis.
         */
        if (flags.value === 1) {
            const sz = uleb(p);
            p = sz.next + sz.value;
            continue;
        }

        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported data flags ${flags.value}`
        );
    }

    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const fileStart = p;

    if (
        memOffset + size.value <= memory.length
    ) {
        wasm.copy(
            memory,
            memOffset,
            fileStart,
            fileStart + size.value
        );
    }

    segments.push({
        id: seg,
        memStart: memOffset,
        size: size.value,
        fileStart
    });

    p += size.value;
}

function findSegment(addr: number) {
    return segments.find(
        s =>
            addr >= s.memStart &&
            addr < s.memStart + s.size
    );
}

function inspectAddress(addr: number, label: string) {

    console.log(
        "------------------------------------------------------------"
    );

    console.log(`${label}`);
    console.log(`Address : ${addr} (${hex(addr)})`);

    const seg = findSegment(addr);

    if (seg) {

        console.log(
            `Segment : ${seg.id}`
        );

        console.log(
            `Segment memory : ${hex(seg.memStart)}`
        );

        console.log(
            `Segment end    : ${hex(seg.memStart + seg.size)}`
        );

        console.log(
            `Relative       : ${hex(addr - seg.memStart)}`
        );

        console.log(
            `File offset    : ${hex(
                seg.fileStart + (addr - seg.memStart)
            )}`
        );

    } else {

        console.log("Segment : NOT FOUND");
    }

    console.log();
    console.log("Nearby i32 values:");

    const base = addr & ~3;

    for (let d = -32; d <= 64; d += 4) {

        const a = base + d;
        const v = readU32(memory, a);

        if (v === null)
            continue;

        let tag = "";

        if (TARGETS.has(v)) {
            tag =
                `  <== TARGET ${TARGETS.get(v)}`;
        }

        const pointed = findSegment(v);

        if (pointed) {
            tag +=
                `  -> Segment ${pointed.id} @ ${hex(v)}`;
        }

        console.log(
            `  ${hex(a)} : ${v.toString().padStart(10)} ${hex(v)}${tag}`
        );
    }

    console.log();
}

            for (const off of [0, 16, 40]) {

}

import fs from "fs";

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function dump(offset: number, radius = 96) {
    const start = Math.max(0, offset - radius);
    const end = Math.min(wasm.length, offset + radius + 4);

    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const rowEnd = Math.min(p + 16, end);
        const bytes = wasm.subarray(p, rowEnd);

        const hexBytes = Array.from(bytes)
            .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
            .join(" ");

        const ascii = Array.from(bytes)
            .map(b => (b >= 32 && b <= 126 ? String.fromCharCode(b) : "."))
            .join("");

        const marker =
            offset >= p && offset < rowEnd ? "  <--- TARGET" : "";

        console.log(
            `${hex(p)}  ${hexBytes.padEnd(47)}  ${ascii}${marker}`
        );
    }
}

function u32(offset: number): number {
    if (offset < 0 || offset + 4 > wasm.length) return 0;
    return wasm.readUInt32LE(offset);
}

function u16(offset: number): number {
    if (offset < 0 || offset + 2 > wasm.length) return 0;
    return wasm.readUInt16LE(offset);
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [
  8948,
  8949,
  8950,
  8951,
  8952,
  8953,
  8954,
  8955,
  8956
];

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u8(p) {
  return buf[p];
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(pos++);

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = u8(pos++);

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function hex(n, w = 8) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function opcodeName(op) {
  const names = {
    0x00: "unreachable",
    0x01: "nop",
    0x02: "block",
    0x03: "loop",
    0x04: "if",
    0x05: "else",
    0x0b: "end",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
    0x0f: "return",

    0x10: "call",
    0x11: "call_indirect",

    0x1a: "drop",
    0x1b: "select",

    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",

    0x23: "global.get",
    0x24: "global.set",

    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x29: "i64.load",
    0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
    0x2d: "i32.load8_u",

    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x37: "i64.store",
    0x3a: "i32.store8",

    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x42: "i64.const",

    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",

    0x48: "i32.lt_s",
    0x49: "i32.lt_u",

    0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
    0x4b: "i32.gt_u",

    0x4c: "i32.le_s",
    0x4d: "i32.le_u",

    0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
    0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x6c: "i32.mul",

    0x7c: "i64.add",
    0x7d: "i64.sub",
    0x7e: "i64.mul"
  };

  return names[op] ||
    `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function parseSections() {

  let p = 8;

  const types = [];
  const funcTypes = [];
  const bodies = [];

  while (p < buf.length) {

    const sectionId = u8(p++);

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const end = p + size;

    if (sectionId === 1) {

      const nInfo = readULEB(p);
      p = nInfo.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < nInfo.value; i++) {

        const form = u8(p++);

        if (form !== 0x60) {
          throw new Error("Unexpected type form");
        }

        const np = readULEB(p);
        p = np.next;

        const params = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < np.value; j++) {
          params.push(u8(p++));
        }

        const nr = readULEB(p);
        p = nr.next;

        const results = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < nr.value; j++) {
          results.push(u8(p++));
        }

        types.push({
          params,
          results
        });
      }
    }

    else if (sectionId === 3) {

      const nInfo = readULEB(p);
      p = nInfo.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < nInfo.value; i++) {

        const t = readULEB(p);
        p = t.next;

        funcTypes.push(t.value);
      }
    }

    else if (sectionId === 10) {

      const nInfo = readULEB(p);
      p = nInfo.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < nInfo.value; i++) {

        const bodyInfo = readULEB(p);
        const bodySize = bodyInfo.value;

        p = bodyInfo.next;

        const start = p;
        const endBody = p + bodySize;

        bodies.push({
          start,
          end: endBody
        });

        p = endBody;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return {
    types,
    funcTypes,
    bodies
  };
}

function decodeBody(start, end) {

  let p = start;

  const localInfo = readULEB(p);
  p = localInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localInfo.value; i++) {

    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    p++;
  }

  const instructions = [];

  while (p < end) {

    const offset = p;
    const op = u8(p++);

    const ins = {
      offset,
      op,
      name: opcodeName(op)
    };

    if (op === 0x41) {

      const x = readSLEB(p);

      ins.value = x.value;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (op === 0x42) {

      const x = readSLEB(p);

      ins.value = x.value;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {

      const x = readULEB(p);

      ins.func = x.value;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (op === 0x11) {

      const t = readULEB(p);
      p = t.next;

      const table = readULEB(p);
      p = table.next;

      ins.type = t.value;
      ins.table = table.value;
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22
    ) {

      const x = readULEB(p);

      ins.local = x.value;
      p = x.next;
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x28 ||
      op === 0x29 ||
      op === 0x2c ||
      op === 0x2d ||
      op === 0x36 ||
      op === 0x37 ||
      op === 0x3a
    ) {

      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const offsetImm = readULEB(p);
      p = offsetImm.next;

      ins.align = align.value;
      ins.offset = offsetImm.value;
    }

    instructions.push(ins);

    if (op === 0x0b && p >= end) {
      break;
    }
  }

  return instructions;
}

const parsed = parseSections();

const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readUleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v: number, w = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function section(idWanted: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === idWanted)
      return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("section not found");
}

/* imports */

const imp = section(2);

let importedFunctions = 0;

{
  let p = imp.start;
  const c = readUleb(p);
  p = c.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
    const ml = readUleb(p);
    p = ml.next + ml.value;

    const nl = readUleb(p);
    p = nl.next + nl.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const t = readUleb(p);
      p = t.next;
      importedFunctions++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;
      const f = readUleb(p);
      p = f.next;
      const a = readUleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      if (f.value & 1) {
        const b = readUleb(p);
        p = b.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const f = readUleb(p);
      p = f.next;
      const a = readUleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      if (f.value & 1) {
        const b = readUleb(p);
        p = b.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }
}

/* types */

const typeSec = section(1);

const types: {
  params: number[];
  results: number[];
}[] = [];

{
  let p = typeSec.start;

  const c = readUleb(p);
  p = c.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
    const form = wasm[p++];

    if (form !== 0x60)
      throw new Error("bad function type");

    const pc = readUleb(p);
    p = pc.next;

    const params: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++)
      params.push(wasm[p++]);

    const rc = readUleb(p);
    p = rc.next;

    const results: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++)
      results.push(wasm[p++]);

    types.push({ params, results });
  }
}

/* function section */

const funcSec = section(3);

const typeIndex: number[] = [];

{
  let p = funcSec.start;

  const c = readUleb(p);
  p = c.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
    const x = readUleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    typeIndex.push(x.value);
  }
}

function getType(func: number) {
  const i = func - importedFunctions;

  if (i < 0 || i >= typeIndex.length)
    return null;

  const ti = typeIndex[i];

  return {
    index: ti,
    type: types[ti]
  };
}

const bodies = new Map<number, { start: number; end: number }>();

{
  let p = codeSec.start;

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 113;

function uleb(pos:number) {
  let v=0, shift=0, p=pos;
  while(p<wasm.length) {
    const b=wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if(!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return {value:v>>>0,next:p};
}

let p=8;
let imported=0;
let start=0,end=0;

while(p<wasm.length) {
  const id=wasm[p++];
  const s=uleb(p);
  p=s.next;
  const secEnd=p+s.value;

  if(id===2) {
    let q=p;
    const n=uleb(q); q=n.next;

    for(let i=0;i<n.value;i++) {
      const ml=uleb(q); q=ml.next+ml.value;
      const nl=uleb(q); q=nl.next+nl.value;
      const kind=wasm[q++];

      if(kind===0) {
        q=uleb(q).next;
        imported++;
      } else if(kind===1) {
        q++;
        q=uleb(q).next;
        q=uleb(q).next;
      } else if(kind===2) {
        const f=uleb(q); q=f.next;
        q=uleb(q).next;
        if(f.value&1) q=uleb(q).next;
      } else if(kind===3) {
        q+=2;
      }
    }
  }

  if(id===10) {
    let q=p;
    const n=uleb(q); q=n.next;

    for(let i=0;i<n.value;i++) {
      const bs=uleb(q); q=bs.next;
      const st=q;
      const en=q+bs.value;

      if(imported+i===TARGET) {
        start=st;
        end=en;
      }

      q=en;
    }
    break;
  }

  p=secEnd;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 113 DISPATCH ANALYSIS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY : 0x${start.toString(16)} .. 0x${end.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");

for(let q=start;q<end;) {
  const pos=q;
  const op=wasm[q++];
  let imm="";

  if(
    op===0x20 || op===0x21 || op===0x22 ||
    op===0x10 || op===0x0c || op===0x0d ||
    op===0x41 || op===0x42
  ) {
    const x=uleb(q);
    imm=` ${x.value}`;
    q=x.next;
  }
  else if(op>=0x28 && op<=0x3e) {
    const a=uleb(q); q=a.next;
    const o=uleb(q); q=o.next;
    imm=` align=${a.value} offset=0x${o.value.toString(16)}`;
  }
  else if(op===0x11) {
    const t=uleb(q); q=t.next;
    const tab=uleb(q); q=tab.next;
    imm=` type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
  }

  let mark="";
  if(op>=0x28 && op<=0x35) mark=" <<< LOAD";
  if(op>=0x36 && op<=0x3e) mark=" <<< STORE";
  if(op===0x10) mark=" <<< CALL";
  if(op===0x11) mark=" <<< CALL_INDIRECT";

  console.log(
    `0x${pos.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}  ` +
    `${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}${imm}${mark}`
  );
}

FILE: scripts\inspectDispatchHandlers.ts

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_FUNCS = [122, 656, 91, 787];
const TARGET_ADDRS = [
  0x195348,
  0x19534c,
  0x195350,
  0x195354,
  0x195358,
];

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8): string {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(idWanted: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === idWanted) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${idWanted} not found`);
}

console.log("INSPECT DISPATCH HANDLERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(
  "TARGET FUNCS = " + TARGET_FUNCS.join(", ")
);

console.log(
  "TARGET ADDRS = " +
  TARGET_ADDRS.map(x => hex(x)).join(", ")
);

const importSec = findSection(2);
const funcSec = findSection(3);
const codeSec = findSection(10);

let importedFunctionCount = 0;

//
// Count imported functions
//
{
  let p = importSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const ml = readUleb(p);
    p = ml.next + ml.value;

    const nl = readUleb(p);
    p = nl.next + nl.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const t = readUleb(p);
      p = t.next;
      importedFunctionCount++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p += 1;

      const flags = readUleb(p);
      p = flags.next;

      const min = readUleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readUleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = readUleb(p);
      p = flags.next;

      const min = readUleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readUleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }
}

//
// Get code body offsets
//
let codeBodies: {
  func: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
}[] = [];

{
  let p = codeSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    codeBodies.push({
      func: importedFunctionCount + i,
      start,
      end,
    });

    p = end;
  }
}

function getBody(func: number) {
  return codeBodies.find(x => x.func === func);
}

function scanFunction(func: number) {
  const body = getBody(func);

  if (!body) {
    console.log(`FUNC ${func}: BODY NOT FOUND`);
    return;
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
  console.log(
    `BODY = ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`
  );
  console.log(
    `SIZE = ${body.end - body.start}`
  );
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  let hits = 0;

  for (let p = body.start; p < body.end; p++) {
    const b = wasm[p];

    //
    // Detect literal i32.const 0x195xxx
    //
    if (b === 0x41) {
      const x = readUleb(p + 1);

      if (TARGET_ADDRS.includes(x.value)) {
        console.log(
          `${hex(p)} i32.const ${hex(x.value)}`
        );
        hits++;
      }
    }

    //
    // Detect direct call to one of the four handlers
    //
    if (b === 0x10) {
      const x = readUleb(p + 1);

      if (TARGET_FUNCS.includes(x.value)) {
        console.log(
          `${hex(p)} call FUNC ${x.value}`
        );
        hits++;
      }
    }
  }

  if (hits === 0) {
    console.log("NO DIRECT TARGET HITS");
  }
}

for (const func of TARGET_FUNCS) {
  scanFunction(func);
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log("DISPATCH MAP:");
console.log("0x12B4 -> FUNC 122");
console.log("0x12B5 -> FUNC 656");
console.log("0x12B6 -> FUNC 91");
console.log("0x12B7 -> FUNC 787");

console.log("");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
