import fs from 'node:fs';

const file = 'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

const targets = [0x2530a4, 0x252d04];

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= wasm.length) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF in ULEB');
        const byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('Invalid ULEB');
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte;

    do {
        if (pos >= wasm.length) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF in SLEB');
        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);
        shift += 7;
    } while (byte & 0x80);

    if (byte & 0x40) value -= 2 ** shift;

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

let pos = 8;
let dataSection = null;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];
    const size = readULEB(pos);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (end > wasm.length) throw new Error('Invalid section size');

    if (id === 11) {
        dataSection = { start, end };
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

console.log('FUNC 1769 MEMORY INSPECTION');
console.log('READ ONLY - OFFLINE');
console.log('============================================================');
console.log(`FILE SIZE = ${wasm.length}`);

if (!dataSection) {
    console.log('DATA SECTION NOT FOUND');
    process.exit(0);
}

pos = dataSection.start;
const count = readULEB(pos);
pos = count.next;

const segments = [];
let activeCount = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const flags = readULEB(pos);
    pos = flags.next;

    let active = false;
    let offset = null;

    if (flags.value === 0) {
        active = true;
        if (wasm[pos++] !== 0x41) throw new Error('Expected i32.const offset');
        const expr = readSLEB(pos);
        offset = expr.value;
        pos = expr.next;
        if (wasm[pos++] !== 0x0b) throw new Error('Expected end of offset expression');
    } else if (flags.value === 1) {
        active = false;
    } else if (flags.value === 2) {
        active = true;
        const memidx = readULEB(pos);
        pos = memidx.next;
        if (wasm[pos++] !== 0x41) throw new Error('Expected i32.const offset');
        const expr = readSLEB(pos);
        offset = expr.value;
        pos = expr.next;
        if (wasm[pos++] !== 0x0b) throw new Error('Expected end of offset expression');
    } else {
        throw new Error(`Unsupported data segment flags: ${flags.value}`);
    }

    const length = readULEB(pos);
    pos = length.next;

    const payloadStart = pos;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + length.value;

    if (payloadEnd > dataSection.end) throw new Error('Data segment exceeds section');

    if (active) {
        activeCount++;
        segments.push({
            index: i,
            offset: offset >>> 0,
            length: length.value,
            payloadStart,
            payloadEnd
        });
    }

    pos = payloadEnd;
}

console.log(`DATA SEGMENTS = ${count.value}`);
console.log(`ACTIVE SEGMENTS = ${activeCount}`);

for (const target of targets) {
    console.log('\n============================================================');
    console.log(`TARGET LINEAR MEMORY ADDRESS ${hex(target)}`);

    const matches = segments.filter(s =>
        target >= s.offset && target + 16 <= s.offset + s.length
    );

    if (matches.length === 0) {
        console.log('No single active data segment fully covers 16 bytes here.');
        const partial = segments.filter(s =>
            target < s.offset + s.length && target + 16 > s.offset
        );

        if (partial.length) {
            for (const s of partial) {
                console.log(
                    `OVERLAP: segment=${s.index}, base=${hex(s.offset)}, length=${s.length}`
                );
            }
        } else {
            console.log('No active data segment overlaps this address.');
        }
        continue;
    }

    for (const s of matches) {
        const relative = target - s.offset;
        const from = s.payloadStart + relative;
        const bytes = wasm.subarray(from, from + 16);

        console.log(`SEGMENT = ${s.index}`);
        console.log(`BASE = ${hex(s.offset)}`);
        console.log(`LENGTH = ${s.length}`);
        console.log(`RELATIVE OFFSET = ${hex(relative)}`);
        console.log(
            [...bytes].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' ')
        );

        console.log('ASCII: ' + [...bytes]
            .map(b => b >= 32 && b <= 126 ? String.fromCharCode(b) : '.')
            .join(''));
    }
}

console.log('\nDONE - READ ONLY - NO WASM EXECUTION');

const TARGET = 1968;

function u() {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return v >>> 0;
}

let codeStart = 0;

  const id = b[p++];
  const size = u();
  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  if (id === 1) typeStart = start;
  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

const bodyCount = u();

const bodies = [];

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {
  const size = u();
  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  // Skip locals
  const groups = u();
  for (let g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
    u();
    p++;
  }

  bodies.push({
    func: i + 91,
    start,
    end
  });

  p = end;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const BODY_START = 0x0008f17c;
const BODY_END   = 0x0008f1a1;

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

type Instr = {
  addr: number;
  op: number;
  name: string;
  imm?: number;
};

function decode(start: number, end: number): Instr[] {
  const out: Instr[] = [];
  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    switch (op) {

      case 0x00:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "unreachable" });
        break;

      case 0x01:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "nop" });
        break;

      case 0x02:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "block" });
        p += 1;
        break;

      case 0x03:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "loop" });
        p += 1;
        break;

      case 0x04:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "if" });
        p += 1;
        break;

      case 0x05:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "else" });
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "end" });
        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "br",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "br_if",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x0f:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "return" });
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "call",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        p += 1;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "call_indirect",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x1a:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "drop" });
        break;

      case 0x20: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "local.get",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "local.set",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "local.tee",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "global.get",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "global.set",
          imm: x.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x28: {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "i32.load",
          imm: o.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x36: {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "i32.store",
          imm: o.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x3a: {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "i32.store8",
          imm: o.value,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        const x = sleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "i32.const",
          imm: x.value >>> 0,
        });
        break;
      }

      case 0x45:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.eqz" });
        break;

      case 0x46:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.eq" });
        break;

      case 0x47:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.ne" });
        break;

      case 0x4b:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.ge_u" });
        break;

      case 0x6a:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.add" });
        break;

      case 0x6b:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.sub" });
        break;

      case 0x71:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.and" });
        break;

      case 0x72:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.or" });
        break;

      case 0x74:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.shl" });
        break;

      case 0x7c:
        out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.add" });
        break;

      case 0xa7:
        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name: "i32.wrap_i64",
        });
        break;

      default:
        out.push({
          addr,
          op,
          name:
            `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        });
        break;
    }
  }

  return out;
}

====================================================================================================
FILE: scripts\inspectFunc2034.ts

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 2034;
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32LE(pos: number): number {
  return (
    wasm[pos] |
    (wasm[pos + 1] << 8) |
    (wasm[pos + 2] << 16) |
    (wasm[pos + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readString(pos: number): { value: string; next: number } {
  const r = readULEB(pos);
  const end = r.next + r.value;

  return {
    value: wasm.subarray(r.next, end).toString("utf8"),
    next: end,
  };
}

function readSections() {
  const sections: {
    id: number;
    start: number;
    payloadStart: number;
    end: number;
  }[] = [];

  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const end = payloadStart + sizeInfo.value;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: payloadStart,
      payloadStart,
      end,
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return sections;
}

const sections = readSections();

const typeSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 1);
const importSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 2);
const funcSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 3);
const codeSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 10);

if (!funcSec || !codeSec) {
  throw new Error("Missing FUNCTION or CODE section");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORT COUNT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let importedCount = 0;

if (importSec) {
  let p = importSec.payloadStart;
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const mod = readString(p);
    p = mod.next;

    const name = readString(p);
    p = name.next;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    switch (kind) {
      case 0x00: {
        // function
        readULEB(p);
        p = readULEB(p).next;
        importedCount++;
        break;
      }

      case 0x01: {
        // table
        const elemType = wasm[p++];
        void elemType;

        const flags = wasm[p++];
        p = readULEB(p).next;

        if (flags & 1) {
          p = readULEB(p).next;
        }
        break;
      }

      case 0x02: {
        // memory
        const flags = wasm[p++];
        p = readULEB(p).next;

        if (flags & 1) {
          p = readULEB(p).next;
        }
        break;
      }

      case 0x03: {
        // global
        p += 2;
        break;
      }

      case 0x04: {
        // tag
        p++;
        p = readULEB(p).next;
        break;
      }

      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown import kind 0x${kind.toString(16)}`);
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let functionTypes: number[] = [];

{
  let p = funcSec.payloadStart;
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  functionTypes = new Array(count.value);

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;
    functionTypes[i] = r.value;
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

interface Body {
  globalFunc: number;
  ordinal: number;
  typeIndex: number;
  bodyStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  bodySize: number;
  codeStart: number;
  codeEnd: number;
}

const bodies: Body[] = [];

{
  let p = codeSec.payloadStart;
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

    const localDeclCount = readULEB(p);
    p = localDeclCount.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount.value; i++) {
      p = readULEB(p).next; // local count
      p++; // value type
    }

    const codeStart = p;
    const codeEnd = bodyEnd;

    const globalFunc = importedCount + ordinal;

    bodies.push({
      globalFunc,
      ordinal,
      typeIndex: functionTypes[ordinal],
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd,
      bodySize: sizeInfo.value,
      codeStart,
      codeEnd,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }
}

const target = bodies.find((b) => b.globalFunc === TARGET_FUNC);

if (!target) {
  throw new Error(`FUNC ${TARGET_FUNC} not found`);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// BASIC OPCODE DECODER
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function readI32Const(p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      break;
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  // signed i32
  if (shift < 32 && (result & (1 << shift)) !== 0) {
    result |= (-1 << (shift + 1));
  }

  return {
    value: result | 0,
    next: p,
  };
}

function readMemArg(p: number): {
  align: number;
  offset: number;
  next: number;
} {
  const a = readULEB(p);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next,
  };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

        p = x.next;

      p = def.next;

      break;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value:v, next:p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_FUNC = 2057;

function readU32LE(pos: number): number {
  return wasm.readUInt32LE(pos);
}

function readU8(pos: number): number {
  return wasm[pos];
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = readU8(pos++);
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = readU8(pos++);
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function pop(): string {
  return stack.length ? stack.pop()! : "<UNKNOWN>";

      "]"

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const GLOBAL_FUNC = 2057;
const IMPORTED = 83;
const CODE_ORDINAL = GLOBAL_FUNC - IMPORTED;

const TARGETS = new Set([
  0x195348,
  0x19534c,
  0x195350,
  0x195354,
  0x195358,
]);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function readU32LE(pos: number): number {
  return (
    buf[pos] |
    (buf[pos + 1] << 8) |
    (buf[pos + 2] << 16) |
    (buf[pos + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function findCodeSection(): { start: number; end: number } {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p++];

    const s = readULEB(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function decodeInstruction(pos: number): {
  text: string;
  next: number;
} {
  const op = buf[pos++];

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00:
      return { text: "unreachable", next: pos };

    case 0x01:
      return { text: "nop", next: pos };

    case 0x02:
      return { text: "block", next: pos + 1 };

    case 0x03:
      return { text: "loop", next: pos + 1 };

    case 0x04:
      return { text: "if", next: pos };

    case 0x05:
      return { text: "else", next: pos };

    case 0x0b:
      return { text: "end", next: pos };

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `br ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `br_if ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x0f:
      return { text: "return", next: pos };

    case 0x10: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `call ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      const table = readULEB(x.next);
      return {
        text: `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${table.value}`,
        next: table.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x20: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.get ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.set ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.tee ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `global.get ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `global.set ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const off = readULEB(a.next);
      return {
        text: `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${off.value}`,
        next: off.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const off = readULEB(a.next);
      return {
        text: `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${off.value}`,
        next: off.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);
      return {
        text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
        next: x.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);
      return {
        text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
        next: x.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x45:
      return { text: "i32.eqz", next: pos };

    case 0x46:
      return { text: "i32.eq", next: pos };

    case 0x47:
      return { text: "i32.ne", next: pos };

    case 0x6a:
      return { text: "i32.add", next: pos };

    case 0x6b:
      return { text: "i32.sub", next: pos };

    case 0x6c:
      return { text: "i32.mul", next: pos };

    case 0x6d:
      return { text: "i32.div_s", next: pos };

    case 0x6e:
      return { text: "i32.div_u", next: pos };

    case 0x71:
      return { text: "i32.and", next: pos };

    case 0x72:
      return { text: "i32.or", next: pos };

    case 0x73:
      return { text: "i32.xor", next: pos };

    case 0x74:
      return { text: "i32.shl", next: pos };

    case 0x75:
      return { text: "i32.shr_s", next: pos };

    case 0x76:
      return { text: "i32.shr_u", next: pos };

    case 0xa7:
      return { text: "i32.wrap_i64", next: pos };

    case 0xad:
      return { text: "i64.extend_i32_u", next: pos };

    default:
      return {
        text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        next: pos,
      };
  }
}

const code = findCodeSection();

let p = code.start;
const count = readULEB(p);
p = count.next;

let bodyStart = -1;
let bodyEnd = -1;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + sizeInfo.value;

  if (ordinal === CODE_ORDINAL) {
    bodyStart = start;
    bodyEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (bodyStart < 0) {
  throw new Error("TARGET FUNCTION BODY NOT FOUND");
}

console.log("INSPECT FUNC2057 STORE DATAFLOW");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC   = ${GLOBAL_FUNC}`);
console.log(`CODE ORDINAL  = ${CODE_ORDINAL}`);
console.log(
  `BODY          = 0x${bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${bodyEnd
    .toString(16)
    .padStart(8, "0")}`
);
console.log(`BODY SIZE     = ${bodyEnd - bodyStart}`);
console.log("");

const instructions: {
  pos: number;
  text: string;
}[] = [];

let q = bodyStart;

while (q < bodyEnd) {
  const pos = q;
  const d = decodeInstruction(q);
  instructions.push({ pos, text: d.text });

  if (d.next <= q) break;
  q = d.next;
}

console.log(`INSTRUCTIONS = ${instructions.length}`);
console.log("");

for (const ins of instructions) {
  console.log(
    `0x${ins.pos.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${ins.text}`
  );
}

console.log("");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("TARGET ADDRESS LITERALS");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let targetLiteralCount = 0;

for (const ins of instructions) {
  const m = ins.text.match(/^i32\.const (-?\d+)$/);

  if (!m) continue;

  const value = Number(m[1]) >>> 0;

  if (TARGETS.has(value)) {
    console.log(

    targetLiteralCount++;
  }
}

if (targetLiteralCount === 0) {

    storeCount++;
  }

if (storeCount === 0) {
  console.log("NONE");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
const TARGET = 2075;
const IMPORTED = 83;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

let p = 8;
let funcSec = null;
let codeSec = null;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];

  const z = uleb(p);
  const size = z.value;
  p = z.next;

  if (id === 3)
    funcSec = { start: p, end: p + size };

  if (id === 10)
    codeSec = { start: p, end: p + size };

  p += size;
}

const ordinal = TARGET - IMPORTED;

let fp = funcSec.start;
const fc = uleb(fp);
fp = fc.next;

let typeIndex = null;

for (let i = 0; i <= ordinal; i++) {
  const x = uleb(fp);
  fp = x.next;

  if (i === ordinal)
    typeIndex = x.value;
}

let cp = codeSec.start;
const cc = uleb(cp);
cp = cc.next;

let body = null;

for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
  const z = uleb(cp);
  const size = z.value;
  cp = z.next;

  const start = cp;
  const end = cp + size;

  if (i === ordinal) {
    body = { start, end };
    break;
  }

  cp = end;
}

function decode(p) {
  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  const R = (next, s) => ({
    next,
    text:
      `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${s}`
  });

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00: return R(p, "UNREACHABLE");
    case 0x01: return R(p, "NOP");
    case 0x05: return R(p, "ELSE");
    case 0x0b: return R(p, "END");
    case 0x0f: return R(p, "RETURN");
    case 0x1a: return R(p, "DROP");
    case 0x1b: return R(p, "SELECT");

    case 0x02:
      return R(p + 1, `BLOCK type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x03:
      return R(p + 1, `LOOP type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x04:
      return R(p + 1, `IF type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `BR ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `BR_IF ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(p);
      p = t.next;
      const tb = uleb(p);
      p = tb.next;
      return R(
        p,
        `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tb.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `GLOBAL.GET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `GLOBAL.SET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      return R(
        p,
        `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x29: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      return R(
        p,
        `I64.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      return R(
        p,
        `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      return R(
        x.next,
        `I32.CONST ${x.value} (0x${(x.value >>> 0).toString(16)})`
      );
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `I64.CONST ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x45: return R(p, "I32.EQZ");
    case 0x46: return R(p, "I32.EQ");
    case 0x47: return R(p, "I32.NE");
    case 0x48: return R(p, "I32.LT_S");
    case 0x49: return R(p, "I32.LT_U");
    case 0x4a: return R(p, "I32.GT_S");
    case 0x4b: return R(p, "I32.GT_U");
    case 0x4c: return R(p, "I32.LE_S");
    case 0x4d: return R(p, "I32.GE_U");

    case 0x6a: return R(p, "I32.ADD");
    case 0x6b: return R(p, "I32.SUB");
    case 0x71: return R(p, "I32.AND");
    case 0x72: return R(p, "I32.OR");
    case 0x73: return R(p, "I32.XOR");
    case 0x74: return R(p, "I32.SHL");
    case 0x75: return R(p, "I32.SHR_S");
    case 0x76: return R(p, "I32.SHR_U");

    default:
      return R(
        p,
        `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      );
  }
}

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const dir = path.dirname(decodeURIComponent(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname).replace(/^\/([A-Za-z]:)/, '$1'));
const scannerPath = path.join(dir, 'disassembleAddressUsers.mjs');
const tempDecoderPath = path.join(
    dir,
    '__traceFunc215_decoder_temp.mjs'
);

const scannerSource = fs.readFileSync(scannerPath, 'utf8');
const marker =
    "console.log('\\nROOSTER WASM - FUNC 2034 AND CALLERS');";

const cut = scannerSource.indexOf(marker);

if (cut < 0) {
    throw new Error('Could not find decoder bootstrap marker');
}

const decoderBootstrap = scannerSource.slice(0, cut);

let decoder;

try {
    fs.writeFileSync(
        tempDecoderPath,
        decoderBootstrap +
            '\nexport { wasm, bodies, decodeFunction, hex };\n',
        'utf8'
    );

    decoder = await import(
        pathToFileURL(tempDecoderPath).href +
        '?inspectFunc215'
    );
} finally {
    fs.rmSync(tempDecoderPath, { force: true });
}

const { bodies, decodeFunction, hex } = decoder;
const target = 215;

if (!bodies.has(target)) {
    throw new Error(`Function ${target} has no defined body`);
}

const { body, instructions } = decodeFunction(target);

console.log('ROOSTER WASM — FUNCTION 215');
console.log('READ ONLY / OFFLINE / NO WASM EXECUTION');
console.log('====================================================');
console.log(`FUNCTION: ${target}`);
console.log(`BODY START: ${hex(body.start)}`);
console.log(`INSTRUCTION COUNT: ${instructions.length}`);
console.log('====================================================');

const interestingCalls = new Set([91, 104, 813, 1079, 1533, 2034]);

for (const ins of instructions) {
    const text = String(ins.text);
    const callMatch = text.match(/\bcall\s+(\d+)\b/);
    const callTarget = callMatch ? Number(callMatch[1]) : null;

    const addressHit =
        /0x0*(?:195348|250f30|250f5c)\b/i.test(text) ||
        /\b(?:1659720|2428720|2428764)\b/.test(text);

    const importantCall =
        callTarget !== null && interestingCalls.has(callTarget);

    const prefix =
        addressHit ? '>>> ' :
        importantCall ? '*** ' :
        '    ';

    console.log(`${prefix}${hex(ins.start)}  ${ins.raw}  ${text}`);
}

console.log('\n====================================================');
console.log('TARGETED CALL SUMMARY');
console.log('====================================================');

for (const ins of instructions) {
    const text = String(ins.text);
    const callMatch = text.match(/\bcall\s+(\d+)\b/);

    if (callMatch && interestingCalls.has(Number(callMatch[1]))) {
        console.log(`${hex(ins.start)}  ${text}`);
    }
}

console.log('\nInspection complete. No WASM execution performed.');

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 23;
const IMPORTED = 83;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 23 EXACT BODY");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET GLOBAL FUNC = ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${IMPORTED}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function u32leb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function s32leb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        b = buf[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function sectionHeader(pos: number) {
    const id = buf[pos];
    const size = u32leb(pos + 1);

    return {
        id,
        size: size.value,
        payloadStart: size.next,
        payloadEnd: size.next + size.value,
    };
}

let functionStart = -1;
let functionEnd = -1;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

let p = 8;

while (p < buf.length) {
    const s = sectionHeader(p);

    if (s.id === 3) {
        functionStart = s.payloadStart;
        functionEnd = s.payloadEnd;
    }

    if (s.id === 10) {
        codeStart = s.payloadStart;
        codeEnd = s.payloadEnd;
    }

    p = s.payloadEnd;
}

if (functionStart < 0 || codeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("Required sections not found");
}

console.log(`FUNCTION SECTION = ${hex(functionStart)} .. ${hex(functionEnd)}`);
console.log(`CODE SECTION     = ${hex(codeStart)} .. ${hex(codeEnd)}`);

let fp = functionStart;

const functionCount = u32leb(fp);
fp = functionCount.next;

const definedCount = functionCount.value;
const typeIndices: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++) {
    const r = u32leb(fp);
    fp = r.next;
    typeIndices.push(r.value);
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 2431;
const IMPORTED = 83;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function i32uleb(pos) {
  return uleb(pos);
}

function findCodeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const sz = uleb(p);
    p = sz.next;

    if (id === 10) {
      return { start: p, end: p + sz.value };
    }

    p += sz.value;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

function skipBlockType(p) {
  const x = b[p];
  if (x === 0x40 || x === 0x7f || x === 0x7e ||
      x === 0x7d || x === 0x7c || x === 0x7b) {
    return p + 1;
  }
  return uleb(p).next;
}

import fs from 'node:fs';

const file = 'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte;

    do {
        if (pos >= wasm.length) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF');
        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);
        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('Invalid ULEB');
    } while (byte & 0x80);

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function dump(start, end) {
    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const stop = Math.min(p + 16, end);
        const bytes = [...wasm.subarray(p, stop)]
            .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join(' ');
        console.log(`${hex(p)}  ${bytes}`);
    }
}

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];
    const size = uleb(pos);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (id === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) throw new Error('Code section not found');

const count = uleb(codeStart);
pos = count.next;

const bodies = new Map();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const size = uleb(pos);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    bodies.set(83 + ordinal, { start, end, size: size.value });
    pos = end;
}

for (const func of [2524, 2525, 2526, 2527, 2528]) {
    const body = bodies.get(func);

    console.log('\n============================================================');
    console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);

    if (!body) {
        console.log('BODY NOT FOUND');
        continue;
    }

    console.log(`BODY = ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`);
    console.log(`SIZE = ${body.size}`);
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');
    dump(body.start, body.end);
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 259;

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: v, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v, n = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

while (p < wasm.length) {

    const sectionId = wasm[p++];

    const si = uleb(p);
    p = si.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + si.value;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        const ci = uleb(p);
        codeCount = ci.value;
        p = ci.next;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));

console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));

console.log();

let bodyEnd = null;

    const si = uleb(p);
    const size = si.value;
    p = si.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + size;

    if (i + 83 === TARGET) {
        bodyStart = start;
        bodyEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

if (bodyStart === null) {
    console.log("FUNC 259 NOT FOUND");
    process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`BODY : ${hex(bodyStart)} .. ${hex(bodyEnd)}`);
console.log(`SIZE : ${bodyEnd - bodyStart}`);
console.log();

console.log("RAW BYTES");
console.log("-".repeat(72));

for (let a = bodyStart; a < bodyEnd; a += 16) {

    const e = Math.min(a + 16, bodyEnd);

    const bytes = [];

    for (let x = a; x < e; x++) {
        bytes.push(
            wasm[x].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
        );
    }

    console.log(
        `${hex(a)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
    );
}

console.log();
console.log("CALL REFERENCES");
console.log("-".repeat(72));

// Skip local declaration vector.
const localCountInfo = uleb(p);
p = localCountInfo.next;

for (let i = 0; i < localCountInfo.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;
    p++; // value type
}

while (p < bodyEnd) {

    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op === 0x10) {

        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(at)} CALL FUNC ${x.value}`
        );

    } else if (op === 0x11) {

        const t = uleb(p);
        p = t.next;

        const table = uleb(p);
        p = table.next;

        console.log(
            `${hex(at)} CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`
        );

    } else if (op === 0x0f) {

        console.log(`${hex(at)} RETURN`);

    } else if (op === 0x0b) {

        console.log(`${hex(at)} END`);
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function readWasmSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections: any[] = [];

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const r = readULEB(p);
    const size = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + size,
      size
    });

    p += size;
  }

  return sections;
}

const sections = readWasmSections();

const funcSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 3);
const codeSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 10);

if (!funcSection || !codeSection) {
  throw new Error("Function/code section not found");
}

let p = funcSection.start;

const fr = readULEB(p);
const funcCount = fr.value;
p = fr.next;

const typeIndices: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < funcCount; i++) {
  const r = readULEB(p);

  typeIndices.push(r.value);

  p = r.next;
}

const targetGlobalFunc = 265;
const importedFunctions = 83;

if (targetGlobalFunc < importedFunctions) {
  throw new Error("FUNC265 is imported, unexpected");
}

const codeOrdinal = targetGlobalFunc - importedFunctions;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 265 BODY");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC     = ${targetGlobalFunc}`);
console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCS  = ${importedFunctions}`);
console.log(`CODE ORDINAL    = ${codeOrdinal}`);
console.log(`TYPE INDEX      = ${typeIndices[codeOrdinal]}`);
console.log("");

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = codeSection.start;

const cr = readULEB(p);
const bodyCount = cr.value;
p = cr.next;

let targetStart = -1;
let targetEnd = -1;
let targetSize = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {
  const sr = readULEB(p);
  const bodySize = sr.value;

  p = sr.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

  if (i === codeOrdinal) {
    targetStart = bodyStart;
    targetEnd = bodyEnd;
    targetSize = bodySize;
    break;
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

if (targetStart < 0) {
  throw new Error("FUNC265 body not found");
}

console.log(
  `BODY = 0x${targetStart
    .toString(16)
    .padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${(targetEnd - 1)
    .toString(16)
    .padStart(8, "0")}`
);

console.log(`SIZE = ${targetSize}`);
console.log("");

console.log("RAW BODY");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let q = targetStart; q < targetEnd; q++) {
  console.log(
    `0x${q.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${b[q]
      .toString(16)
      .padStart(2, "0")}`
  );
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 265;
const IMPORTED = 83;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 265 EXACT STRUCTURE ANALYSIS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET GLOBAL FUNC = ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${IMPORTED}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function u32leb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function s32leb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function sectionHeader(pos: number) {
  const id = buf[pos];
  const size = u32leb(pos + 1);

  return {
    id,
    size: size.value,
    payloadStart: size.next,
    payloadEnd: size.next + size.value,
  };
}

let functionStart = -1;
let functionEnd = -1;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

let p = 8;

while (p < buf.length) {
  const s = sectionHeader(p);

  if (s.id === 3) {
    functionStart = s.payloadStart;
    functionEnd = s.payloadEnd;
  }

  if (s.id === 10) {
    codeStart = s.payloadStart;
    codeEnd = s.payloadEnd;
  }

  p = s.payloadEnd;
}

if (functionStart < 0 || codeStart < 0) {
  throw new Error("Required WASM sections not found");
}

console.log(`FUNCTION SECTION = ${hex(functionStart)} .. ${hex(functionEnd)}`);
console.log(`CODE SECTION     = ${hex(codeStart)} .. ${hex(codeEnd)}`);

//
// Parse function section.
//

let fp = functionStart;

const functionCountInfo = u32leb(fp);
fp = functionCountInfo.next;

const definedCount = functionCountInfo.value;

const typeIndices: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++) {
  const r = u32leb(fp);
  fp = r.next;
  typeIndices.push(r.value);
}

const codeOrdinal = TARGET_FUNC - IMPORTED;

if (codeOrdinal < 0 || codeOrdinal >= definedCount) {
  throw new Error(`Invalid code ordinal: ${codeOrdinal}`);
}

//
// Parse code section.
//

let cp = codeStart;

const bodyCountInfo = u32leb(cp);
cp = bodyCountInfo.next;

const bodyCount = bodyCountInfo.value;

let bodyStart = -1;
let bodyEnd = -1;
let bodySize = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {
  const sizeInfo = u32leb(cp);

  const start = sizeInfo.next;
  const end = start + sizeInfo.value;

  if (i === codeOrdinal) {
    bodyStart = start;
    bodyEnd = end;
    bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
    break;
  }

  cp = end;
}

if (bodyStart < 0) {
  throw new Error("FUNC265 body not found");
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS = ${definedCount}`);
console.log(`CODE ORDINAL      = ${codeOrdinal}`);
console.log(`TYPE INDEX        = ${typeIndices[codeOrdinal]}`);
console.log(`BODY START        = ${hex(bodyStart)}`);
console.log(`BODY END          = ${hex(bodyEnd)}`);
console.log(`BODY SIZE         = ${bodySize}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

//
// Local declarations.
//

let q = bodyStart;

const localGroupsInfo = u32leb(q);
q = localGroupsInfo.next;

console.log(`LOCAL DECL GROUPS = ${localGroupsInfo.value}`);

let extraLocals = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < localGroupsInfo.value; i++) {
  const countInfo = u32leb(q);
  q = countInfo.next;

  const type = buf[q++];

  extraLocals += countInfo.value;

  console.log(
    `  GROUP ${i}: COUNT=${countInfo.value} TYPE=0x${type
      .toString(16)
      .padStart(2, "0")}`
  );
}

console.log(`TOTAL EXTRA LOCALS = ${extraLocals}`);
console.log(`INSTRUCTION START  = ${hex(q)}`);

//
// FUNC265 has TYPE2 from previous analysis:
// (i32) -> i32
//
// Therefore local 0 is the input structure pointer.
//

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("EXPECTED SIGNATURE: TYPE2 = (i32) -> i32");
console.log("LOCAL 0 = STRUCTURE POINTER / INPUT");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

const knownFields = [
  0x04,
  0x0c,
  0x14,
  0x18,
  0x1c,
  0x24,
  0x2c,
  0x30,
  0x34,
  0x38,
];

function fieldName(offset: number) {
  if (knownFields.includes(offset)) {
    return ` <<< FIELD +0x${offset.toString(16)}`;
  }

  return "";
}

function emit(pos: number, bytes: string, text: string) {
  console.log(
    `${hex(pos)}  ${bytes.padEnd(22)} ${text}`
  );
}

let instr = q;

while (instr < bodyEnd) {
  const pos = instr;
  const op = buf[instr++];

  //
  // local.get
  //
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `20 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `LOCAL.GET ${r.value}${r.value === 0 ? " <<< STRUCT PTR" : ""}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // local.set
  //
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `21 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `LOCAL.SET ${r.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // local.tee
  //
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `22 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `LOCAL.TEE ${r.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // global.get
  //
  if (op === 0x23) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `23 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `GLOBAL.GET ${r.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // global.set
  //
  if (op === 0x24) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `24 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `GLOBAL.SET ${r.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.const
  //
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = s32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `41 ${(r.value >>> 0).toString(16)}`,
      `I32.CONST ${r.value < 0 ? r.value : hex(r.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.load
  //
  if (op === 0x28) {
    const align = u32leb(instr);
    instr = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(instr);
    instr = offset.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `28 ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}${fieldName(
        offset.value
      )}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.load8_s
  //
  if (op === 0x2c) {
    const align = u32leb(instr);
    instr = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(instr);
    instr = offset.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `2c ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD8_S align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.load8_u
  //
  if (op === 0x2d) {
    const align = u32leb(instr);
    instr = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(instr);
    instr = offset.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `2d ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD8_U align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.load16_s
  //
  if (op === 0x2e) {
    const align = u32leb(instr);
    instr = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(instr);
    instr = offset.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `2e ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD16_S align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.load16_u
  //
  if (op === 0x2f) {
    const align = u32leb(instr);
    instr = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(instr);
    instr = offset.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `2f ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD16_U align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.store
  //
  if (op === 0x36) {
    const align = u32leb(instr);
    instr = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(instr);
    instr = offset.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `36 ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.STORE align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}${fieldName(
        offset.value
      )}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.store8
  //
  if (op === 0x3a) {
    const align = u32leb(instr);
    instr = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(instr);
    instr = offset.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `3a ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.STORE8 align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.add
  //
  if (op === 0x6a) {
    emit(pos, "6a", "I32.ADD");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.sub
  //
  if (op === 0x6b) {
    emit(pos, "6b", "I32.SUB");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.and
  //
  if (op === 0x71) {
    emit(pos, "71", "I32.AND");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.or
  //
  if (op === 0x72) {
    emit(pos, "72", "I32.OR");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.xor
  //
  if (op === 0x73) {
    emit(pos, "73", "I32.XOR");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.shl
  //
  if (op === 0x74) {
    emit(pos, "74", "I32.SHL");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.shr_s
  //
  if (op === 0x75) {
    emit(pos, "75", "I32.SHR_S");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.shr_u
  //
  if (op === 0x76) {
    emit(pos, "76", "I32.SHR_U");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.rotl
  //
  if (op === 0x77) {
    emit(pos, "77", "I32.ROTL");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // i32.rotr
  //
  if (op === 0x78) {
    emit(pos, "78", "I32.ROTR");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // comparisons
  //
  if (op === 0x45) {
    emit(pos, "45", "I32.EQZ");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x46) {
    emit(pos, "46", "I32.EQ");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x47) {
    emit(pos, "47", "I32.NE");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x48) {
    emit(pos, "48", "I32.LT_S");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x49) {
    emit(pos, "49", "I32.LT_U");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x4a) {
    emit(pos, "4a", "I32.GT_S");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x4b) {
    emit(pos, "4b", "I32.GT_U");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x4c) {
    emit(pos, "4c", "I32.LE_S");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x4d) {
    emit(pos, "4d", "I32.LE_U");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x4e) {
    emit(pos, "4e", "I32.GE_S");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x4f) {
    emit(pos, "4f", "I32.GE_U");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // control
  //
  if (op === 0x00) {
    emit(pos, "00", "UNREACHABLE");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x01) {
    emit(pos, "01", "NOP");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x02) {
    const type = buf[instr++];
    emit(
      pos,
      `02 ${type.toString(16)}`,
      `BLOCK type=0x${type.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x03) {
    const type = buf[instr++];
    emit(
      pos,
      `03 ${type.toString(16)}`,
      `LOOP type=0x${type.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x04) {
    const type = buf[instr++];
    emit(
      pos,
      `04 ${type.toString(16)}`,
      `IF type=0x${type.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x05) {
    emit(pos, "05", "ELSE");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    emit(pos, "0b", "END");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x0c) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `0c ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `BR ${r.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x0d) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `0d ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `BR_IF ${r.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x0f) {
    emit(pos, "0f", "RETURN");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // stack
  //
  if (op === 0x1a) {
    emit(pos, "1a", "DROP");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x1b) {
    emit(pos, "1b", "SELECT");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // call
  //
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `10 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `CALL FUNC${r.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // call_indirect
  //
  if (op === 0x11) {
    const type = u32leb(instr);
    instr = type.next;

    const table = u32leb(instr);
    instr = table.next;

    emit(
      pos,
      `11 ${type.value.toString(16)} ${table.value.toString(16)}`,
      `CALL_INDIRECT TYPE${type.value} TABLE${table.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  //
  // memory.size
  //
  if (op === 0x3f) {
    const mem = buf[instr++];
    emit(pos, `3f ${mem.toString(16)}`, "MEMORY.SIZE");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // memory.grow
  //
  if (op === 0x40) {
    const mem = buf[instr++];
    emit(pos, `40 ${mem.toString(16)}`, "MEMORY.GROW");
    continue;
  }

  //
  // Extended instructions.
  //
  if (op === 0xfc) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    let name = `EXTENDED 0xfc ${r.value.toString(16)}`;

    if (r.value === 0x0a) {
      name = "MEMORY.COPY";
    } else if (r.value === 0x0b) {
      name = "MEMORY.FILL";
    }

    emit(
      pos,
      `fc ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      name
    );
    continue;
  }

  emit(
    pos,
    op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
    `UNKNOWN OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
  );
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC265 FIELD TARGETS");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const off of knownFields) {
  console.log(
    `+0x${off.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}  READ/WRITE TRACE TARGET`
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections: any[] = [];

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + r.value
    });

    p += r.value;
  }

  return sections;
}

const sections = readSections();

const typeSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 1);
const funcSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 3);

if (!typeSection || !funcSection) {
  throw new Error("Required sections not found");
}

const typeCount = tr.value;
p = tr.next;

const types: any[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < typeCount; i++) {
  const form = b[p++];

  const pc = readULEB(p);
  const paramCount = pc.value;
  p = pc.next;

  const params: number[] = [];

  for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
    params.push(b[p++]);
  }

  const rc = readULEB(p);
  const resultCount = rc.value;
  p = rc.next;

  const results: number[] = [];

  for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
    results.push(b[p++]);
  }

  types.push({
    form,
    params,
    results
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = funcSection.start;

const fr = readULEB(p);
const functionCount = fr.value;
p = fr.next;

const typeIndices: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < functionCount; i++) {
  const r = readULEB(p);
  typeIndices.push(r.value);
  p = r.next;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 270;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
  return (
    "0x" +
    (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0")
  );
}

function readMemArg(pos: number) {
  const a = readULEB(pos);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next,
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTIONS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const sections: {
  id: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
}[] = [];

let p = 8;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];

  const size = readULEB(p);
  p = size.next;

  sections.push({
    id,
    start: p,
    end: p + size.value,
  });

  p += size.value;
}

const importSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 2);
const funcSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 3);
const codeSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 10);

if (!funcSec || !codeSec) {
  throw new Error("Missing FUNCTION/CODE section");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORT COUNT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let importedCount = 0;

if (importSec) {
  p = importSec.start;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const ml = readULEB(p);
    p = ml.next + ml.value;

    const nl = readULEB(p);
    p = nl.next + nl.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0x00) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      importedCount++;
    } else if (kind === 0x01) {
      p++;

      const flags = wasm[p++];

      p = readULEB(p).next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        p = readULEB(p).next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 0x02) {
      const flags = wasm[p++];

      p = readULEB(p).next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        p = readULEB(p).next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 0x03) {
      p += 2;
    } else if (kind === 0x04) {
      p++;
      p = readULEB(p).next;
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const functionTypes: number[] = [];

p = funcSec.start;

{
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    functionTypes.push(r.value);
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = count.next;

  p = size.next;

  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + size.value;

  const localDecls = readULEB(p);
  p = localDecls.next;

    p = n.next;
    p++;

  const codeStart = p;
  const globalFunc = importedCount + ordinal;

  if (globalFunc !== TARGET_FUNC) {
    p = bodyEnd;
    continue;
  }

  found = true;

  console.log(
    `BODY = ${hex(bodyStart)} .. ${hex(bodyEnd)}`
  );
  console.log(`SIZE = ${bodyEnd - bodyStart}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  let q = codeStart;

  while (q < bodyEnd) {
    const addr = q;
    const op = wasm[q++];

    let text =
      `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

    switch (op) {

      }

      case 0x0f:

        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const r = readULEB(q);
        q = r.next;
        text = `call func=${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x1a:
        text = "drop";
        break;

      case 0x20: {
        const r = readULEB(q);
        q = r.next;
        text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const r = readULEB(q);
        q = r.next;
        text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const r = readULEB(q);
        q = r.next;
        text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const r = readULEB(q);
        q = r.next;
        text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const r = readULEB(q);
        q = r.next;

      case 0x28: {

import * as nodefs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = nodefs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { v, p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const buf = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_ORDINAL = 30;
const IMPORTED = 83;
const TARGET_GLOBAL = TARGET_ORDINAL + IMPORTED;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

// Locate sections
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const sections: {
    id: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
}[] = [];

let p = 8;

    const id = buf[p++];

    const s = readULEB(p);
    p = s.next;

    sections.push({
        id,
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
    });

    p += s.value;
}

//

// Code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

if (!codeSec) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

let c = codeSec.start;

const count = readULEB(c);
c = count.next;

let target:
    | {
        start: number;
        end: number;
        instrStart: number;
    }
    | null = null;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {

    const bodySize = readULEB(c);
    c = bodySize.next;

    const start = c;
    const end = c + bodySize.value;

    let x = start;

    const localGroups = readULEB(x);
    x = localGroups.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {

        const n = readULEB(x);
        x = n.next;

        // local value type
        x++;
    }

    if (ordinal === TARGET_ORDINAL) {

        target = {
            start,
            end,
            instrStart: x
        };

        break;
    }

    c = end;
}

if (!target) {
    throw new Error(
        `TARGET CODE ORDINAL NOT FOUND: ${TARGET_ORDINAL}`
    );

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 306;

function uleb(pos:number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

let p = 8;
let imported = 0;
let start = 0, end = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];
  const s = uleb(p);
  p = s.next;
  const secEnd = p + s.value;

  if (id === 2) {
    let q = p;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const ml = uleb(q); q = ml.next + ml.value;
      const nl = uleb(q); q = nl.next + nl.value;
      const kind = wasm[q++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        q = uleb(q).next;
        imported++;
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        q++;
        q = uleb(q).next;
        q = uleb(q).next;
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        q = uleb(q).next;
        q = uleb(q).next;
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        q += 2;
      }
    }
  }

  if (id === 10) {
    let q = p;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const bs = uleb(q); q = bs.next;
      const st = q;
      const en = q + bs.value;

      if (imported + i === TARGET) {
        start = st;
        end = en;
        break;
      }

      q = en;
    }
    break;
  }

  p = secEnd;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 306 DISPATCH ANALYSIS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY : 0x${start.toString(16)} .. 0x${end.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");

for (let q = start; q < end;) {
  const pos = q;
  const op = wasm[q++];
  let imm = "";

  if (
    op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x10 || op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d ||
    op === 0x41 || op === 0x42 ||
    op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04
  ) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    imm = ` ${x.value}`;
    q = x.next;
  }
  else if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
    const a = uleb(q); q = a.next;
    const o = uleb(q); q = o.next;
    imm = ` align=${a.value} offset=0x${o.value.toString(16)}`;
  }
  else if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = uleb(q); q = t.next;
    const tab = uleb(q); q = tab.next;
    imm = ` type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
  }

  let mark = "";

  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) mark = " <<< LOAD";
  if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) mark = " <<< STORE";
  if (op === 0x10) mark = " <<< CALL";
  if (op === 0x11) mark = " <<< CALL_INDIRECT";

  console.log(
    `0x${pos.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}  ` +
    `${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}${imm}${mark}`
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 32;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  let code = null;
  let imported = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 2) {
      let q = start;
      const c = uleb(q);
      q = c.next;

      imported = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const ml = uleb(q);
        q = ml.next + ml.value;

        const nl = uleb(q);
        q = nl.next + nl.value;

        const kind = b[q++];

        if (kind === 0) {
          const t = uleb(q);
          q = t.next;
          imported++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
          q += 1;
          const flags = uleb(q);
          q = flags.next;

          if (flags.value & 1) {
            const x = uleb(q);
            q = x.next;
          }

          const y = uleb(q);
          q = y.next;
        } else if (kind === 2) {
          const flags = uleb(q);
          q = flags.next;

          const x = uleb(q);
          q = x.next;

          if (flags.value & 1) {
            const y = uleb(q);
            q = y.next;
          }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
          q += 1;
        }
      }
    }

    if (id === 10)
      code = { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  return { code, imported };
}

const { code, imported } = readSections();

let p = code.start;

const count = uleb(p);
p = count.next;

let target = null;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {

  const bodySize = uleb(p);
  p = bodySize.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bodySize.value;

  const funcIndex = imported + ordinal;

  if (funcIndex === TARGET) {
    target = {
      funcIndex,
      ordinal,
      start: bodyStart,
      end: bodyEnd,
      size: bodySize.value
    };
    break;
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

if (!target)
  throw new Error(`FUNC ${TARGET} not found`);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 32 RAW BODY");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(
  `FUNCTION INDEX : ${target.funcIndex}`
);

console.log(
  `CODE ORDINAL   : ${target.ordinal}`
);

console.log(
  `BODY           : 0x${target.start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${target.end.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
);

console.log(
  `SIZE           : ${target.size}`
);

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let p = target.start; p < target.end; p += 16) {

  const e = Math.min(p + 16, target.end);

  const bytes = [];

  for (let q = p; q < e; q++)
    bytes.push(
      b[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
    );

  console.log(
    `0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
  );
}
