import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

const sourcePath = path.resolve(
    'scripts/disassembleAddressUsers.mjs'
);

const outputPath = path.resolve(
    'scripts/inspectFunc3837Atomic_output.txt'
);

const targetFunction = 3837;
const targetOffset = 0x0019570B;
const contextCount = 20;

const source = fs.readFileSync(sourcePath, 'utf8');

const marker =
    "console.log('\\nROOSTER WASM - FUNC 2034 AND CALLERS');";

const markerIndex = source.indexOf(marker);

if (markerIndex < 0) {
    throw new Error(
        'Could not locate the reporting marker in the original decoder.'
    );
}

/*
 * Keep only the original decoder definitions.
 * Do not execute its reporting code.
 */
let bootstrap = source.slice(0, markerIndex);

/*
 * Add support for the WebAssembly 0xFE atomic prefix.
 *
 * Atomic instructions with memory arguments use memarg.
 * atomic.fence uses a single reserved immediate byte.
 * Unsupported subopcodes fail explicitly rather than
 * guessing instruction boundaries.
 */
const feHandler = String.raw`
        if (op === 0xfe) {
            const sub = readU(p, body.end);
            p = sub.next;

            let text = '';

            if (sub.value === 3) {
                needBytes(p, 1, body.end, 'atomic.fence');
                const reserved = wasm[p++];
                text = 'atomic.fence reserved=' + reserved;
            } else if (
                sub.value <= 2 ||
                (sub.value >= 0x10 && sub.value <= 0x4e)
            ) {
                const mem = readMemArg(p, body.end);
                p = mem.next;
                text =
                    'atomic.subop=' + sub.value +
                    ' ' + mem.text;
            } else {
                throw new Error(
                    'Unsupported 0xFE subopcode ' +
                    sub.value + ' at ' + hex(start)
                );
            }

            instructions.push({
                start,
                end: p,
                text,
                raw: readBytes(start, p),
            });

            continue;
        }

`;

const fcPattern = /(\s*)if \(op === 0xfc\) \{/;

if (!fcPattern.test(bootstrap)) {
    throw new Error(
        'Could not locate the 0xFC decoder branch; original file unchanged.'
    );
}

bootstrap = bootstrap.replace(
    fcPattern,
    (_match, indent) =>
        feHandler.replace(/^        /gm, indent) +
        indent + 'if (op === 0xfc) {'
);

const tempPath = path.join(
    os.tmpdir(),
    'rooster_decoder_func3837_atomic.mjs'
);

fs.writeFileSync(
    tempPath,
    bootstrap + '\nexport { bodies, decodeFunction };\n',
    'utf8'
);

const output = [];

function log(value = '') {
    output.push(String(value));
}

function hex(value) {
    return '0x' + value.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

try {
    const decoder = await import(
        pathToFileURL(tempPath).href +
        '?run=' + Date.now()
    );

    const { bodies, decodeFunction } = decoder;
    const body = bodies.get(targetFunction);

    if (!body) {
        throw new Error(
            `Function ${targetFunction} has no decoded body range.`
        );
    }

    log('FUNC 3837 ATOMIC-AWARE INSPECTION');
    log('READ ONLY - OFFLINE - NO WASM EXECUTION');
    log('============================================================');
    log(`TARGET FUNCTION : ${targetFunction}`);
    log(`TARGET OFFSET   : ${hex(targetOffset)}`);
    log(`BODY START      : ${hex(body.start)}`);
    log(`BODY END        : ${hex(body.end)}`);
    log(`BODY SIZE       : ${body.end - body.start}`);
    log('------------------------------------------------------------');

    if (
        targetOffset < body.start ||
        targetOffset >= body.end
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            'Target offset is outside the function body.'
        );
    }

    const decoded = decodeFunction(targetFunction);
    const instructions = decoded.instructions;

    let targetIndex = instructions.findIndex(
        ins =>
            ins.start <= targetOffset &&
            targetOffset < ins.end
    );

    if (targetIndex < 0) {
        log('TARGET OFFSET IS NOT INSIDE A DECODED INSTRUCTION.');
        log('This may indicate a decoder gap or incorrect instruction boundary.');
    } else {
        log('');
        log('INSTRUCTIONS AROUND TARGET');
        log('------------------------------------------------------------');

        const from = Math.max(0, targetIndex - contextCount);
        const to = Math.min(
            instructions.length - 1,
            targetIndex + contextCount
        );

        for (let i = from; i <= to; i++) {
            const ins = instructions[i];
            const mark =
                ins.start <= targetOffset &&
                targetOffset < ins.end
                    ? '>>> '
                    : '    ';

            log(
                `${mark}${hex(ins.start)}  ` +
                `${ins.raw.padEnd(38)} ${ins.text}`
            );
        }

        const targetIns = instructions[targetIndex];

        log('');
        log('TARGET BOUNDARY CHECK');
        log(`INSTRUCTION START : ${hex(targetIns.start)}`);
        log(`INSTRUCTION END   : ${hex(targetIns.end)}`);
        log(`INSTRUCTION TEXT  : ${targetIns.text}`);
        log(`EXACT START MATCH : ${targetIns.start === targetOffset}`);
    }

    log('');
    log('ALL DECODED CALL_INDIRECT INSTRUCTIONS');
    log('------------------------------------------------------------');

    const indirectCalls = instructions.filter(
        ins => ins.text.startsWith('call_indirect')
    );

    log(`COUNT: ${indirectCalls.length}`);

    for (const ins of indirectCalls) {
        log(
            `${hex(ins.start)}  ` +
            `${ins.raw.padEnd(24)} ${ins.text}`
        );
    }

    log('');
    log('ATOMIC INSTRUCTIONS DECODED');
    log('------------------------------------------------------------');

    const atomics = instructions.filter(
        ins => ins.raw.startsWith('fe ')
    );

    log(`COUNT: ${atomics.length}`);

    for (const ins of atomics) {
        log(
            `${hex(ins.start)}  ` +
            `${ins.raw.padEnd(24)} ${ins.text}`
        );
    }

    log('');
    log('LIMITATIONS');
    log('- Table membership alone does not prove an executed call path.');
    log('- call_indirect type and runtime table index must be established separately.');
    log('- This report does not execute WASM or modify the contract.');
} catch (error) {
    log('DECODING FAILED');
    log(String(error));
    log('');
    log('No call-path conclusion can be drawn from a failed decode.');
} finally {
    fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, output.join('\n') + '\n', 'utf8');
    console.log(output.join('\n'));
    console.log('');
    console.log(`REPORT: ${outputPath}`);
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO WASM EXECUTION - NO TRANSACTIONS');
}

import fs from 'node:fs';

const file = 'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte;

    do {
        if (pos >= wasm.length) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF in ULEB');
        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);
        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('ULEB too large');
    } while (byte & 0x80);

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function dump(start, end) {
    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const stop = Math.min(p + 16, end);
        const bytes = [...wasm.subarray(p, stop)]
            .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join(' ');
        console.log(`${hex(p)}  ${bytes}`);
    }
}

const targetSection = 10;
let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];
    const sizeInfo = uleb(pos);
    const sectionStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sizeInfo.value;

    if (id === targetSection) {
        codeStart = sectionStart;
        codeEnd = sectionEnd;
        break;
    }

    pos = sectionEnd;
}

if (codeStart < 0) throw new Error('Code section not found');

pos = codeStart;
const countInfo = uleb(pos);
const bodyCount = countInfo.value;
pos = countInfo.next;

const bodies = new Map();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < bodyCount; ordinal++) {
    const sizeInfo = uleb(pos);
    const bodyStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;
    const globalFunc = 83 + ordinal;

    bodies.set(globalFunc, {
        start: bodyStart,
        end: bodyEnd,
        size: sizeInfo.value
    });

    pos = bodyEnd;
}

console.log('FUNC 4099 TARGET INSPECTION');
console.log('READ ONLY - OFFLINE');
console.log('============================================================');
console.log(`FILE SIZE       = ${wasm.length}`);
console.log(`CODE BODY COUNT = ${bodyCount}`);
console.log(`CODE SECTION    = ${hex(codeStart)} .. ${hex(codeEnd)}`);

const target = bodies.get(4099);

if (!target) {
    throw new Error('FUNC 4099 body not found');

console.log('\nTARGET FUNCTION 4099');

const checks = [
    { func: 3626, hit: 0x00118d40 },

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
const TARGET = 445;
const IMPORTED = 83;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

let p = 8;
let funcSec = null;
let codeSec = null;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];

  const z = uleb(p);
  const size = z.value;
  p = z.next;

  if (id === 3)
    funcSec = { start: p, end: p + size };

  if (id === 10)
    codeSec = { start: p, end: p + size };

  p += size;
}

const ordinal = TARGET - IMPORTED;

let fp = funcSec.start;
const fc = uleb(fp);
fp = fc.next;

let typeIndex = null;

for (let i = 0; i <= ordinal; i++) {
  const x = uleb(fp);
  fp = x.next;

  if (i === ordinal)
    typeIndex = x.value;
}

let cp = codeSec.start;
const cc = uleb(cp);
cp = cc.next;

let body = null;

for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
  const z = uleb(cp);
  const size = z.value;
  cp = z.next;

  const start = cp;
  const end = cp + size;

  if (i === ordinal) {
    body = { start, end };
    break;
  }

  cp = end;
}

function decode(p) {
  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  const R = (next, s) => ({
    next,
    text:
      `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${s}`
  });

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00: return R(p, "UNREACHABLE");
    case 0x01: return R(p, "NOP");
    case 0x05: return R(p, "ELSE");
    case 0x0b: return R(p, "END");
    case 0x0f: return R(p, "RETURN");
    case 0x1a: return R(p, "DROP");
    case 0x1b: return R(p, "SELECT");

    case 0x02:
      return R(p + 1, `BLOCK type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x03:
      return R(p + 1, `LOOP type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x04:
      return R(p + 1, `IF type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `BR ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `BR_IF ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(p);
      p = t.next;
      const tb = uleb(p);
      p = tb.next;
      return R(
        p,
        `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tb.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `GLOBAL.GET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `GLOBAL.SET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      return R(
        p,
        `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x29: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      return R(
        p,
        `I64.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      return R(
        p,
        `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      return R(
        x.next,
        `I32.CONST ${x.value} (0x${(x.value >>> 0).toString(16)})`
      );
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `I64.CONST ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x45: return R(p, "I32.EQZ");
    case 0x46: return R(p, "I32.EQ");
    case 0x47: return R(p, "I32.NE");
    case 0x48: return R(p, "I32.LT_S");
    case 0x49: return R(p, "I32.LT_U");
    case 0x4a: return R(p, "I32.GT_S");
    case 0x4b: return R(p, "I32.GT_U");
    case 0x4c: return R(p, "I32.LE_S");
    case 0x4f: return R(p, "I32.GE_S");

    case 0x6a: return R(p, "I32.ADD");
    case 0x6b: return R(p, "I32.SUB");
    case 0x71: return R(p, "I32.AND");
    case 0x72: return R(p, "I32.OR");
    case 0x73: return R(p, "I32.XOR");
    case 0x74: return R(p, "I32.SHL");
    case 0x75: return R(p, "I32.SHR_S");
    case 0x76: return R(p, "I32.SHR_U");

    default:
      return R(
        p,
        `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      );
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 445 EXACT BODY");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`FUNCTION INDEX : ${TARGET}`);
console.log(`TYPE INDEX     : ${typeIndex}`);
console.log(
  `BODY           : 0x${body.start.toString(16)} .. 0x${body.end.toString(16)}`
);
console.log(`SIZE           : ${body.end - body.start}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let q = body.start;

while (q < body.end) {

function u32leb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function s32leb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function sectionHeader(pos: number) {
  const id = buf[pos];
  const size = u32leb(pos + 1);

  return {
    id,
    size: size.value,
    payloadStart: size.next,
    payloadEnd: size.next + size.value,
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function readWasmSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections: any[] = [];

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const r = readULEB(p);
    const size = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + size,
      size
    });

    p += size;
  }

  return sections;
}

    throw new Error('Could not find decoder bootstrap marker');

try {
    fs.writeFileSync(
        tempPath,
        source.slice(0, cut) +
            '\nexport { bodies, decodeFunction, hex };\n',
        'utf8'
    );

        pathToFileURL(tempPath).href + '?inspectFunc7006'
    );

    throw new Error(`Function ${target} has no defined body`);

    /195348/i,
    /250f5c/i,
    /\bcall\s+(1533|2034|3315|3336)\b/,
    /\bcall_indirect\b/
];

function add(index, reason) {
    if (!selected.has(index)) selected.set(index, new Set());
    selected.get(index).add(reason);
}

for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
    const text = String(instructions[i].text);

    const matched = patterns.filter(pattern => pattern.test(text));
    const direct = text.match(/\bcall\s+(\d+)\b/);
    const indirect = /\bcall_indirect\b/.test(text);

    if (direct) {
        calls.push(`${hex(instructions[i].start)}  call ${direct[1]}`);
    } else if (indirect) {
        calls.push(`${hex(instructions[i].start)}  ${text}`);
    }

    if (matched.length > 0) {
        for (const pattern of matched) add(i, `MATCH ${pattern}`);

        for (
            let j = Math.max(0, i - 8);
            j <= Math.min(instructions.length - 1, i + 8);
            j++
        ) {
            add(j, 'CONTEXT');
        }
    }
}

    if (index > previous + 1) out('...');

    const ins = instructions[index];
    const labels = [...reasons]
        .filter(reason => reason !== 'CONTEXT')
        .join(', ');

    out(
        `${labels ? '[' + labels + ']' : '[context]'} ` +
        `${hex(ins.start)}  ${ins.raw}  ${ins.text}`
    );

    previous = index;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 7006;
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
  return (
    "0x" +
    (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0")
  );
}

function readMemArg(pos: number) {
  const a = readULEB(pos);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next,
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTIONS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const sections: {
  id: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
}[] = [];

let p = 8;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];

  const size = readULEB(p);
  p = size.next;

  sections.push({
    id,
    start: p,
    end: p + size.value,
  });

  p += size.value;
}

const importSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 2);
const funcSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 3);

if (!funcSec || !codeSec) {
  throw new Error("Missing FUNCTION/CODE section");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORT COUNT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let importedCount = 0;

if (importSec) {
  p = importSec.start;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const moduleLen = readULEB(p);
    p = moduleLen.next + moduleLen.value;

    const nameLen = readULEB(p);
    p = nameLen.next + nameLen.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0x00) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      importedCount++;
    } else if (kind === 0x01) {
      p++;

      const flags = wasm[p++];

      p = readULEB(p).next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        p = readULEB(p).next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 0x02) {
      const flags = wasm[p++];

      p = readULEB(p).next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        p = readULEB(p).next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 0x03) {
      p += 2;
    } else if (kind === 0x04) {
      p++;
      p = readULEB(p).next;
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const functionTypes: number[] = [];

p = funcSec.start;

{
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    functionTypes.push(r.value);
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 725;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: pos };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, x;
  while (true) {
    x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v -= 2 ** shift;
  return { value: v | 0, next: pos };
}

// Find Code Section
let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;
let codeEnd = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p];
  const s = uleb(p + 1);
  const payload = s.next;
  const end = payload + s.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = payload;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

let q = codeStart;
const count = uleb(q);
q = count.next;

let target = null;

for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
  const sz = uleb(q);
  const start = sz.next;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (i === TARGET) {
    target = {
      start,
      end: end - 1,
      size: sz.value
    };
    break;
  }

  q = end;
}

if (!target) throw new Error("FUNC725 not found");

console.log("FUNC 725 EXACT RAW + BASIC DECODE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY SIZE : ${target.size}`);
console.log(
  `BODY      : 0x${target.start.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} .. ` +
  `0x${target.end.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}`
);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("RAW BODY");

for (let x = target.start; x <= target.end; x += 16) {
  const e = Math.min(x + 15, target.end);
  console.log(
    `0x${x.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}  ` +
    [...b.slice(x, e + 1)]
      .map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"))
      .join(" ")
  );
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("I32.CONST / CALL / CALL_INDIRECT / MEMORY OPS");

let x = target.start;

while (x <= target.end) {
  const at = x;
  const op = b[x++];

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = sleb(x);
    console.log(
      `I32.CONST @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `VALUE=${r.value} HEX=0x${(r.value >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}`
    );
    x = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = uleb(x);
    console.log(
      `CALL @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} FUNC=${r.value}`
    );
    x = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const r1 = uleb(x);
    const r2 = uleb(r1.next);
    console.log(
      `CALL_INDIRECT @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `TYPE=${r1.value} TABLE=${r2.value}`
    );
    x = r2.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 ||
    op === 0x38 || op === 0x39 ||
    op === 0x3a
  ) {
    const a = uleb(x);
    const o = uleb(a.next);

    const names = {
      0x28: "I32.LOAD",
      0x29: "I64.LOAD",
      0x36: "I32.STORE",
      0x37: "I64.STORE",
      0x38: "F32.STORE",
      0x39: "F64.STORE",
      0x3a: "I32.STORE8"
    };

    console.log(
      `${names[op] || "MEMORY"} @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
    );

    x = o.next;
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

const buf = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_GLOBAL = 787;
const IMPORTED = 83;
const ORDINAL = TARGET_GLOBAL - IMPORTED;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

    id: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
}[] = [];

    const s = readULEB(p);
    p = s.next;

    sections.push({
        id,
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
    });

    c = end;

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
const TARGET = 810;
const IMPORTED = 83;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

let p = 8;
let funcSec = null;
let codeSec = null;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];

  const z = uleb(p);
  const size = z.value;
  p = z.next;

  if (id === 3)
    funcSec = { start: p, end: p + size };

  if (id === 10)
    codeSec = { start: p, end: p + size };

  p += size;
}

const ordinal = TARGET - IMPORTED;

let pFunc = funcSec.start;
const fc = uleb(pFunc);
pFunc = fc.next;

let typeIndex = null;

for (let i = 0; i <= ordinal; i++) {
  const x = uleb(pFunc);
  pFunc = x.next;

  if (i === ordinal)
    typeIndex = x.value;
}

let pCode = codeSec.start;
const cc = uleb(pCode);
pCode = cc.next;

let body = null;

for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
  const z = uleb(pCode);
  const size = z.value;
  pCode = z.next;

  const start = pCode;
  const end = pCode + size;

  if (i === ordinal) {
    body = { start, end };
    break;
  }

  pCode = end;
}

function decode(p) {
  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  const R = (next, s) => ({
    next,
    text:
      `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${s}`
  });

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00: return R(p, "UNREACHABLE");
    case 0x01: return R(p, "NOP");
    case 0x0b: return R(p, "END");
    case 0x0f: return R(p, "RETURN");
    case 0x1a: return R(p, "DROP");
    case 0x1b: return R(p, "SELECT");

    case 0x02:
      return R(p + 1, `BLOCK type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x03:
      return R(p + 1, `LOOP type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x04:
      return R(p + 1, `IF type=0x${b[p].toString(16)}`);

    case 0x05:
      return R(p, "ELSE");

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `BR ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `BR_IF ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(p);
      p = t.next;

      const tb = uleb(p);
      p = tb.next;

      return R(
        p,
        `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tb.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `GLOBAL.GET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `GLOBAL.SET ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      return R(
        p,
        `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x29: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      return R(
        p,
        `I64.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      return R(
        p,
        `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb(p);

      return R(
        x.next,
        `I32.CONST ${x.value} (0x${(x.value >>> 0).toString(16)})`
      );
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      return R(x.next, `I64.CONST ${x.value}`);
    }

    case 0x45: return R(p, "I32.EQZ");
    case 0x46: return R(p, "I32.EQ");
    case 0x47: return R(p, "I32.NE");
    case 0x48: return R(p, "I32.LT_S");
    case 0x49: return R(p, "I32.LT_U");
    case 0x4a: return R(p, "I32.GT_S");
    case 0x4b: return R(p, "I32.GT_U");
    case 0x4c: return R(p, "I32.LE_S");

    case 0x6a: return R(p, "I32.ADD");
    case 0x6b: return R(p, "I32.SUB");
    case 0x71: return R(p, "I32.AND");
    case 0x72: return R(p, "I32.OR");
    case 0x73: return R(p, "I32.XOR");
    case 0x74: return R(p, "I32.SHL");
    case 0x75: return R(p, "I32.SHR_S");
    case 0x76: return R(p, "I32.SHR_U");

    default:
      return R(
        p,
        `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      );
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGETS = [813, 1079];
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readI32Const(pos: number): {
  value: number;
  next: number;
} {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      break;
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: result | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function readMemArg(pos: number): {
  align: number;
  offset: number;
  next: number;
} {
  const a = readULEB(pos);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next,
  };
}

function readString(pos: number): {
  value: string;
  next: number;
} {
  const r = readULEB(pos);
  const end = r.next + r.value;

  return {
    value: wasm.subarray(r.next, end).toString("utf8"),
    next: end,
  };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

  p = size.next;

  const payloadStart = p;
  const end = p + size.value;

  sections.push({
    id,
    payloadStart,
    end,
  });

  p = end;
}

    p = mod.next;

    switch (kind) {

        p += 2;

        p++;

      default:

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {

                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos

        shift += 7;
    }
}

    0x255884,

    stores: 0,
    directCalls: 0,
    indirectCalls: 0,
    targetAddressHits: 0
};

function addReason(index, reason) {
    if (!selected.has(index)) selected.set(index, new Set());
    selected.get(index).add(reason);
}

function isTargetAddress(text) {
    const lower = text.toLowerCase();

    if (targetAddresses.some(addr =>
        lower.includes('0x' + addr.toString(16))
    )) {
        return true;
    }

    const numbers = text.match(/\b\d+\b/g) ?? [];
    return numbers.some(n => targetDecimals.has(n));
}

    const text = String(instructions[i].text);
    const lower = text.toLowerCase();

    const isStore = /\b(?:i32|i64|f32|f64)\.store(?:8|16|32)?\b/.test(lower);
    const isDirectCall = /\bcall\s+\d+\b/.test(text);
    const isIndirectCall = /\bcall_indirect\b/.test(text);
    const addressHit = isTargetAddress(text);

    if (isStore) counts.stores++;
    if (isDirectCall) counts.directCalls++;
    if (isIndirectCall) counts.indirectCalls++;
    if (addressHit) counts.targetAddressHits++;

    const reasons = [];
    if (isStore) reasons.push('STORE');
    if (isDirectCall) reasons.push('CALL');
    if (isIndirectCall) reasons.push('CALL_INDIRECT');
    if (addressHit) reasons.push('TARGET_ADDRESS');

    if (reasons.length) {
        for (const reason of reasons) addReason(i, reason);

        // Include surrounding instructions to retain local dataflow context.
        for (let j = Math.max(0, i - 3);
             j <= Math.min(instructions.length - 1, i + 3);
             j++) {
            addReason(j, 'CONTEXT');
        }
    }
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    }

                x = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(x);
                x = b.next;
            }

            continue;
        }

    p = bodyEnd;

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 87;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readVec(pos: number) {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  let p = n.next;
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    out.push(x.value);
    p = x.next;
  }
  return { values: out, next: p };
}

// Find sections
let p = 8;
let typeSec: { start: number; end: number } | null = null;
let funcSec: { start: number; end: number } | null = null;

  const id = wasm[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  p = sz.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + sz.value;

  if (id === 1) typeSec = { start, end };
  if (id === 3) funcSec = { start, end };
  if (id === 10) codeSec = { start, end };

  p = end;
}

}

    case 0x7d: return "f32";
    case 0x7c: return "f64";
    case 0x70: return "funcref";
    case 0x6f: return "externref";
    default: return `0x${x.toString(16)}`;
  }
}

    p = countInfo.next;

      start: payloadStart,
      end: payloadEnd,

      q = moduleLen.next + moduleLen.value;

      const nameLen = uleb(q);
      q = nameLen.next + nameLen.value;

      const kind = buf[q++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        const typeInfo = uleb(q);
        q = typeInfo.next;
        importFuncCount++;
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        q++; // elemtype
        const flags = buf[q++];
        if (flags & 1) q = uleb(q).next;
        q = uleb(q).next;
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        q++;
        const flags = buf[q++];
        q = uleb(q).next;
        if (flags & 1) q = uleb(q).next;
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        q += 2;
      }
    }
  }

  if (id === 3) {
    let q = p;

    const countInfo = uleb(q);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    q = countInfo.next;

      q = t.next;
      functionTypes.push(t.value);

    console.log("DEFINED FUNCTIONS :", count);
    console.log("IMPORTED FUNCTIONS:", importFuncCount);
    console.log("TOTAL FUNCTION IDX :", importFuncCount + count);
  }

  p = payloadEnd;
}

  console.log("TYPE SECTION NOT FOUND");
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log("");

  console.log("");
  console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
  console.log("CODE INDEX :", codeIndex);

  if (codeIndex < 0 || codeIndex >= functionTypes.length) {
    console.log("TYPE INDEX : OUT OF RANGE");
    continue;
  }

  const typeIndex = functionTypes[codeIndex];

  console.log("TYPE INDEX :", typeIndex);

  // Re-scan type section to locate the target type.
  let q = typeSection.start;
  const countInfo = uleb(q);
  q = countInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {
    const typeStart = q;
    const form = buf[q++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      console.log("Unexpected type form at", hex(typeStart));
      break;
    }

    const paramInfo = uleb(q);
    const paramCount = paramInfo.value;
    q = paramInfo.next;

    const params: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++)
      params.push(buf[q++]);

    const resultInfo = uleb(q);
    const resultCount = resultInfo.value;
    q = resultInfo.next;

    const results: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++)
      results.push(buf[q++]);

    if (i === typeIndex) {
      const typeName = (v: number) => {
        switch (v) {
          case 0x7f: return "i32";
          case 0x7e: return "i64";
          case 0x7d: return "f32";
          case 0x7c: return "f64";
          case 0x70: return "funcref";
          case 0x6f: return "externref";
          default: return hex(v);
        }
      };

      console.log("PARAM COUNT :", params.length);
      console.log(
        "PARAMS      :",
        params.map(typeName).join(", ") || "(none)"
      );

      console.log("RESULT COUNT:", results.length);
      console.log(
        "RESULTS     :",
        results.map(typeName).join(", ") || "(none)"
      );

        "SIGNATURE   :",
        `(${params.map(typeName).join(", ")}) -> (${results.map(typeName).join(", ")})`
      );

      console.log(
        "TYPE RAW    :",

          .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${IMPORTED}`);

function u32leb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function s32leb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function readName(pos: number) {
  const n = u32leb(pos);
  const start = n.next;
  const end = start + n.value;

  return {
    name: buf.subarray(start, end).toString("utf8"),
    next: end,
  };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readSectionHeader(pos: number) {
  const id = buf[pos];
  const size = u32leb(pos + 1);

  return {
    id,
    size: size.value,
    payloadStart: size.next,
    payloadEnd: size.next + size.value,
  };
}

  const op = buf[instr++];

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `20 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `LOCAL.GET ${r.value}${r.value === 3 ? "   <<< STRUCT BASE" : ""}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // local.set
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(pos, `21 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `LOCAL.SET ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // local.tee
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(pos, `22 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `LOCAL.TEE ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // global.get
  if (op === 0x23) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(pos, `23 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `GLOBAL.GET ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // global.set
  if (op === 0x24) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(pos, `24 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `GLOBAL.SET ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = s32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `41 ${(r.value >>> 0).toString(16)}`,
      `I32.CONST ${r.value < 0 ? r.value : hex(r.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // i32.load
  if (op === 0x28) {
    const a = u32leb(instr);
    instr = a.next;

    const o = u32leb(instr);
    instr = o.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `28 ${a.value.toString(16)} ${o.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${hex(o.value)}${fieldTag(o.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // i32.load8_u
  if (op === 0x2d) {
    const a = u32leb(instr);
    instr = a.next;

    const o = u32leb(instr);
    instr = o.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `2d ${a.value.toString(16)} ${o.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD8_U align=${a.value} offset=${hex(o.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // i32.load16_u
  if (op === 0x2f) {
    const a = u32leb(instr);
    instr = a.next;

    const o = u32leb(instr);
    instr = o.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `2f ${a.value.toString(16)} ${o.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD16_U align=${a.value} offset=${hex(o.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // i32.store
  if (op === 0x36) {
    const a = u32leb(instr);
    instr = a.next;

    const o = u32leb(instr);
    instr = o.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `36 ${a.value.toString(16)} ${o.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${hex(o.value)}${fieldTag(o.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // i32.store8
  if (op === 0x3a) {
    const a = u32leb(instr);
    instr = a.next;

    const o = u32leb(instr);
    instr = o.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `3a ${a.value.toString(16)} ${o.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.STORE8 align=${a.value} offset=${hex(o.value)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // i32.add
  if (op === 0x6a) {
    print(pos, "6a", "I32.ADD");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.sub
  if (op === 0x6b) {
    print(pos, "6b", "I32.SUB");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.and
  if (op === 0x71) {
    print(pos, "71", "I32.AND");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.or
  if (op === 0x72) {
    print(pos, "72", "I32.OR");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.xor
  if (op === 0x73) {
    print(pos, "73", "I32.XOR");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.shr_u
  if (op === 0x76) {
    print(pos, "76", "I32.SHR_U");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.eqz
  if (op === 0x45) {
    print(pos, "45", "I32.EQZ");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.eq
  if (op === 0x46) {
    print(pos, "46", "I32.EQ");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.ne
  if (op === 0x47) {
    print(pos, "47", "I32.NE");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.lt_u
  if (op === 0x49) {
    print(pos, "49", "I32.LT_U");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.gt_u
  if (op === 0x4b) {
    print(pos, "4b", "I32.GT_U");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.lt_s
  if (op === 0x48) {
    print(pos, "48", "I32.LT_S");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.gt_s
  if (op === 0x4a) {
    print(pos, "4a", "I32.GT_S");
    continue;
  }

  // block
  if (op === 0x02) {
    const type = buf[instr++];
    print(pos, `02 ${type.toString(16)}`, `BLOCK type=0x${type.toString(16)}`);
    continue;
  }

  // loop
  if (op === 0x03) {
    const type = buf[instr++];
    print(pos, `03 ${type.toString(16)}`, `LOOP type=0x${type.toString(16)}`);
    continue;
  }

  // if
  if (op === 0x04) {
    const type = buf[instr++];
    print(pos, `04 ${type.toString(16)}`, `IF type=0x${type.toString(16)}`);
    continue;
  }

  // else
  if (op === 0x05) {
    print(pos, "05", "ELSE");
    continue;
  }

  // end
  if (op === 0x0b) {
    print(pos, "0b", "END");
    continue;
  }

  // br
  if (op === 0x0c) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(pos, `0c ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `BR ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // br_if
  if (op === 0x0d) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(pos, `0d ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `BR_IF ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // return
  if (op === 0x0f) {
    print(pos, "0f", "RETURN");
    continue;
  }

  // drop
  if (op === 0x1a) {
    print(pos, "1a", "DROP");
    continue;
  }

  // select
  if (op === 0x1b) {
    print(pos, "1b", "SELECT");
    continue;
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(pos, `10 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `CALL FUNC${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // call_indirect
  if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = u32leb(instr);
    instr = t.next;

    const table = u32leb(instr);
    instr = table.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `11 ${t.value.toString(16)} ${table.value.toString(16)}`,
      `CALL_INDIRECT TYPE${t.value} TABLE${table.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // memory.size
  if (op === 0x3f) {
    const x = buf[instr++];
    print(pos, `3f ${x.toString(16)}`, "MEMORY.SIZE");
    continue;
  }

  // memory.grow
  if (op === 0x40) {
    const x = buf[instr++];
    print(pos, `40 ${x.toString(16)}`, "MEMORY.GROW");
    continue;
  }

  // extended opcode prefix
  if (op === 0xfc) {
    const r = u32leb(instr);
    instr = r.next;

    print(
      pos,
      `fc ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `EXTENDED OPCODE 0xfc ${r.value.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  print(
    pos,
    op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
    `UNKNOWN OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[pos++];
        v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if (!(x & 0x80)) {
            return { value: v, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const START = 0x00007c36;
const END   = 0x00007c5b;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: pos };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, x;
  while (true) {
    x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v -= 2 ** shift;
  return { value: v | 0, next: pos };
}

function readULEB(p) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, len: shift / 7 + 1 };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

    if (x.value !== 5232) continue;

    console.log(`\n5232 @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);

    const e = Math.min(r.end, p + 32);

    for (let q = s; q < e; q++) {
      console.log(
        `0x${q.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ${b[q].toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
      );
    }
  }

  let calls87 = 0;
  let indirect = 0;

  for (let p = r.start; p < r.end; p++) {

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x14000;
const MAX_BYTES = 0x3000;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 1020 INSPECTION v27");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log("");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value -= Math.pow(2, shift);
            }

            return { value, next: p };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid SLEB32");
}

function hex(x: number) {
    return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function raw(pos: number, n = 32) {
    return Array.from(
        wasm.subarray(pos, Math.min(pos + n, wasm.length))
    )
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

function mem(
    addr: number,
    name: string,
    p: number
) {
    const a = readULEB(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = readULEB(p);
    p = o.next;

    console.log(
        `${name.padEnd(14)} @ ${hex(addr)} ` +
        `align=${a.value} offset=${hex(o.value)}`
    );

    return p;
}

// function body only after the existing code metadata is found.

for (const call of found) {

    console.log("");

    console.log(`CALLER CONTEXT @ ${hex(call)}`);

            console.log(

                `local=${r.value}`

        }

        if (op === 0x41) {

            console.log(

            );

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x28) {
            p = mem(addr, "i32.load", p);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x29) {
            p = mem(addr, "i64.load", p);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x2d) {
            p = mem(addr, "i32.load8_u", p);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x2f) {
            p = mem(addr, "i32.load16_u", p);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x36) {
            p = mem(addr, "i32.store", p);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x37) {
            p = mem(addr, "i64.store", p);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x10) {

            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            console.log(
                `call`.padEnd(14) +
                ` @ ${hex(addr)} function=${r.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            console.log(
                `${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"}`.padEnd(14) +
                ` @ ${hex(addr)} depth=${r.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {

            const r = readSLEB32(p);
            p = r.next;

            console.log(
                `${op === 0x02 ? "block" :
                   op === 0x03 ? "loop" : "if"}`.padEnd(14) +
                ` @ ${hex(addr)} ` +
                `type=${r.value === 64 ? "empty" : r.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x05) {
            console.log(`else`.padEnd(14) + ` @ ${hex(addr)}`);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0b) {
            console.log(`end`.padEnd(14) + ` @ ${hex(addr)}`);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x1b) {
            console.log(`select`.padEnd(14) + ` @ ${hex(addr)}`);
            continue;
        }

        if (names[op]) {
            console.log(
                `${names[op].padEnd(14)} @ ${hex(addr)}`
            );
            continue;
        }

        console.log(
            `UNKNOWN`.padEnd(14) +
            ` @ ${hex(addr)} opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
        );
    }

import fs from "fs";

// ============================================================
// FUNCTION 122 / 259 INSPECTOR v25
// READ ONLY - OFFLINE
//
// Target chain:
//
//   Segment 669
//        ↓
//   Function 656
//        ↓
//   Function 122
//        ↓
//   Function 259
//        ↓
//   Functions 83 / 84 / 85 / 86
//
// NO TON
// NO RPC
// NO WALLET
// NO TRANSACTION
// NO SIGNING
// ============================================================

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCTIONS = [
    656,
    122,
    259,
    83,
    84,
    85,
    86,
];

function readULEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    off: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 8 && off < buf.length; i++) {
        const b = buf[off++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: off };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: -1, next: off };
}

function readName(
    buf: Buffer,
    off: number
): { value: string; next: number } {
    const n = readULEB(buf, off);

    if (n.value < 0) {
        return {
            value: "",
            next: buf.length,
        };
    }

    const end = n.next + n.value;

    if (end > buf.length) {
        return {
            value: "",
            next: buf.length,
        };
    }

    return {
        value: buf.subarray(n.next, end).toString("utf8"),
        next: end,
    };
}

function hex(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
): string {
    return Array.from(
        buf.subarray(start, end)
    )
        .map((b) =>
            b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
        )
        .join(" ");
}

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {
    let off = 8;

    const sections: {
        id: number;
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }[] = [];

    while (off < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[off++];

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(
            buf,
            off
        );

        off = sizeInfo.next;

        const payloadStart = off;
        const payloadEnd =
            payloadStart + sizeInfo.value;

        if (
            sizeInfo.value < 0 ||
            payloadEnd > buf.length
        ) {
            throw new Error(
                `Invalid section id=${id}`
            );
        }

        sections.push({
            id,
            payloadStart,
            payloadEnd,
        });

        off = payloadEnd;
    }

    return sections;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORTS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function countImportedFunctions(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }
) {
    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const countInfo =
        readULEB(buf, off);

    const count = countInfo.value;
    off = countInfo.next;

    let importedFunctions = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const mod = readName(buf, off);
        off = mod.next;

        const name = readName(buf, off);
        off = name.next;

        const kind = buf[off++];

        switch (kind) {
            // function
            case 0:
                {
                    const type =
                        readULEB(buf, off);

                    off = type.next;
                    importedFunctions++;
                }
                break;

            // table
            case 1:
                {
                    off += 1;

                    const flags = buf[off++];

                    const min =
                        readULEB(buf, off);

                    off = min.next;

                    if (flags & 1) {
                        const max =
                            readULEB(buf, off);

                        off = max.next;
                    }
                }
                break;

            // memory
            case 2:
                {
                    const flags = buf[off++];

                    const min =
                        readULEB(buf, off);

                    off = min.next;

                    if (flags & 1) {
                        const max =
                            readULEB(buf, off);

                        off = max.next;
                    }
                }
                break;

            // global
            case 3:
                off += 2;
                break;

            default:
                throw new Error(
                    `Unknown import kind: ${kind}`
                );
        }
    }

    return importedFunctions;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function parseFunctionTypes(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }
) {
    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const countInfo =
        readULEB(buf, off);

    const count = countInfo.value;
    off = countInfo.next;

    const types: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const info =
            readULEB(buf, off);

        types.push(info.value);
        off = info.next;
    }

    return types;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function parseCodeBodies(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }
) {
    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const countInfo =
        readULEB(buf, off);

    const count = countInfo.value;
    off = countInfo.next;

    const bodies: {
        bodyIndex: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
        codeStart: number;
        bodySize: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (
        let bodyIndex = 0;
        bodyIndex < count;
        bodyIndex++
    ) {
        const sizeInfo =
            readULEB(buf, off);

        const bodySize =
            sizeInfo.value;

        off = sizeInfo.next;

        const bodyStart = off;
        const bodyEnd =
            bodyStart + bodySize;

        let p = bodyStart;

        const localCountInfo =
            readULEB(buf, p);

        p = localCountInfo.next;

        for (
            let j = 0;
            j < localCountInfo.value;
            j++
        ) {
            const n =
                readULEB(buf, p);

            p = n.next;

            // value type
            p += 1;
        }

        bodies.push({
            bodyIndex,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            codeStart: p,
            bodySize,
        });

        off = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// EXPORTS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function parseExports(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    } | undefined
) {
    const result = new Map<
        number,
        string[]
    >();

    if (!section) {
        return result;
    }

    let off = section.payloadStart;

    const countInfo =
        readULEB(buf, off);

    off = countInfo.next;

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < countInfo.value;
        i++
    ) {
        const nameInfo =
            readName(buf, off);

        off = nameInfo.next;

        const kind = buf[off++];

        const indexInfo =
            readULEB(buf, off);

        off = indexInfo.next;

        if (kind !== 0) {
            continue;
        }

        const arr =
            result.get(indexInfo.value) ??
            [];

        arr.push(nameInfo.value);

        result.set(
            indexInfo.value,
            arr
        );
    }

    return result;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CALL SCAN
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function scanCalls(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    const calls: {
        offset: number;
        target: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (
        let p = start;
        p < end;
        p++
    ) {
        if (buf[p] !== 0x10) {
            continue;
        }

        const info =
            readULEB(buf, p + 1);

        if (
            info.value >= 0 &&
            info.next <= end
        ) {
            calls.push({
                offset: p,
                target: info.value,
            });
        }
    }

    return calls;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CONSTANT SCAN
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function scanI32Consts(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    const result: {
        offset: number;
        value: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (
        let p = start;
        p < end;
        p++
    ) {
        // i32.const
        if (buf[p] !== 0x41) {
            continue;
        }

        const info =
            readULEB(buf, p + 1);

        if (
            info.value >= 0 &&
            info.next <= end
        ) {
            result.push({
                offset: p,
                value: info.value,
            });
        }
    }

    return result;
}

function reportFunction(
    wasm: Buffer,
    realFunctionIndex: number,
    importedFunctions: number,
    typeIndices: number[],
    bodies: ReturnType<
        typeof parseCodeBodies
    >,
    exports: Map<number, string[]>
) {
    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        ` FUNCTION ${realFunctionIndex}`
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    if (
        realFunctionIndex <
        importedFunctions
    ) {
        console.log(
            "This is an IMPORTED function."
        );

        return;
    }

    const bodyIndex =
        realFunctionIndex -
        importedFunctions;

    const body =
        bodies[bodyIndex];

    if (!body) {
        console.log(
            `Body ${bodyIndex} NOT FOUND`
        );

        return;
    }

    console.log(
        `real function index : ${realFunctionIndex}`
    );

    console.log(
        `body index          : ${bodyIndex}`
    );

    console.log(
        `type index           : ${
            typeIndices[bodyIndex]
        }`
    );

    console.log(
        `body start           : 0x${body.bodyStart
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log(
        `code start           : 0x${body.codeStart
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log(
        `body end             : 0x${body.bodyEnd
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log(
        `body size            : ${body.bodySize}`
    );

    const exp =
        exports.get(realFunctionIndex);

    console.log(
        `exports              : ${
            exp?.join(", ") ??
            "none"
        }`
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("I32.CONST");

    const constants =
        scanI32Consts(
            wasm,
            body.codeStart,
            body.bodyEnd
        );

    for (const c of constants) {
        console.log(
            `  @0x${c.offset
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, "0")}` +
            ` → ${c.value}` +
            ` (0x${c.value
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, "0")})`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("CALLS");

    const calls =
        scanCalls(

    for (const c of calls) {
        console.log(

                .toString(16)

        );
    }

    if (!calls.length) {
        console.log("  none");
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("BODY HEX");

        )
    );

    console.log(
        " READ ONLY - OFFLINE"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    if (!fs.existsSync(WASM_PATH)) {
        throw new Error(
            `WASM not found:\n${WASM_PATH}`
        );
    }

    const wasm =
        fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

    console.log(
        `WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`
    );

    const sections =
        parseSections(wasm);

    const importSection =
        sections.find(
            (s) => s.id === 2
        );

    const functionSection =
        sections.find(
            (s) => s.id === 3
        );

    const exportSection =
        sections.find(
            (s) => s.id === 7
        );

    const codeSection =
        sections.find(
            (s) => s.id === 10
        );

    if (
        !importSection ||
        !functionSection ||
        !codeSection
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            "Required WASM sections missing"
        );
    }

    const importedFunctions =
        countImportedFunctions(
            wasm,
            importSection
        );

    const typeIndices =
        parseFunctionTypes(
            wasm,
            functionSection
        );

    const bodies =
        parseCodeBodies(
            wasm,
            codeSection
        );

    const exports =
        parseExports(
            wasm,
            exportSection
        );

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        " MODULE"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    console.log(
        `imported functions : ${importedFunctions}`
    );

    console.log(
        `defined functions  : ${typeIndices.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `code bodies        : ${bodies.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `total function space: ${
            importedFunctions +
            typeIndices.length
        }`
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        " TARGET CHAIN"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    console.log(
        "Segment 669"
    );

    console.log(
        "    ↓"
    );

    console.log(
        "Function 656"
    );

    console.log(
        "    ↓"
    );

    console.log(
        "Function 122"
    );

    console.log(
        "    ↓"
    );

    console.log(
        "Function 259 / 83 / 84 / 85 / 86"
    );

    for (
        const fn of TARGET_FUNCTIONS
    ) {
        reportFunction(
            wasm,
            fn,
            importedFunctions,
            typeIndices,
            bodies,
            exports
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(

        " READ ONLY: no wallet"
    );
    console.log(
        " READ ONLY: no transaction"
    );
    console.log(
        " READ ONLY: no signing"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const TARGET = 1566;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[p++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    result -= 2 ** shift;
  }

  return { value: result | 0, next: p };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = null;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
  const sectionStart = pos;
  const id = wasm[pos++];

  const sz = readULEB(pos);
  pos = sz.next;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = pos;
    break;
  }

  pos = sectionStart + 1 + (sz.next - (sectionStart + 1)) + sz.value;
}

if (codeStart === null) {
  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

const count = readULEB(codeStart);
const bodyCount = count.value;

let p = count.next;

let bodyStart = null;
let bodyEnd = null;

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {
  const sz = readULEB(p);
  p = sz.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + sz.value;

  if (i === TARGET) {
    bodyStart = start;
    bodyEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (bodyStart === null) {
  throw new Error("TARGET BODY NOT FOUND");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// BLOCKTYPE
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function readBlockType(pos) {
  const b = wasm[pos];

  // Empty block type
  if (b === 0x40) {
    return {
      value: "0x40",
      next: pos + 1
    };
  }

  // Value types
  const valueTypes = {
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64"
  };

  if (valueTypes[b]) {
    return {
      value: valueTypes[b],
      next: pos + 1
    };
  }

  // Otherwise it is a signed type index
  return readSLEB(pos);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION DECODER
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function decode(start, end) {
  let p = start;

  const decl = readULEB(p);
  const declCount = decl.value;
  p = decl.next;

  const locals = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < declCount; i++) {
    const n = readULEB(p);
    p = n.next;

    const type = wasm[p++];

    for (let j = 0; j < n.value; j++) {
      locals.push(type);
    }
  }

  const out = [];

  while (p < end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CONTROL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      const bt = readBlockType(p);
      p = bt.next;

      const name =
        op === 0x02 ? "block" :
        op === 0x03 ? "loop" :
        "if";

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `${name} type=${bt.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x05) {
      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: "else"
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0b) {
      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: "end"
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        text:
          op === 0x0c
            ? `br ${x.value}`
            : `br_if ${x.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0f) {
      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: "return"
      });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // LOCALS
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      const name =
        op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
        op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
        "local.tee";

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        local: x.value,
        text: `${name} local${x.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CONSTANTS
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = readSLEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        value: x.value,
        text: `i32.const ${x.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
      let q = p;
      let result = 0n;
      let shift = 0n;
      let b;

      while (true) {
        b = wasm[q++];
        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7n;
      }

      p = q;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `i64.const ${result}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CALL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        target: x.value,
        text: `call ${x.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = readULEB(p);
      p = t.next;

      const table = readULEB(p);
      p = table.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        text: `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // MEMORY
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const memNames = {
      0x28: "i32.load",
      0x29: "i64.load",
      0x2a: "f32.load",
      0x2b: "f64.load",
      0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
      0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
      0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
      0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
      0x30: "i64.load8_s",
      0x31: "i64.load8_u",
      0x32: "i64.load16_s",
      0x33: "i64.load16_u",
      0x34: "i64.load32_s",
      0x35: "i64.load32_u",
      0x36: "i32.store",
      0x37: "i64.store",
      0x38: "f32.store",
      0x39: "f64.store",
      0x3a: "i32.store8",
      0x3b: "i32.store16",
      0x3c: "i64.store8",
      0x3d: "i64.store16",
      0x3e: "i64.store32"
    };

    if (memNames[op]) {
      const a = readULEB(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = readULEB(p);
      p = o.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        offset: o.value,
        text:
          `${memNames[op]} align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      });

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // INTEGER OPERATIONS
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const names = {
