import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TYPE_SECTION_START = 0x00000008;
const TYPE_SECTION_END   = 0x0000039b;

const FUNCTION_SECTION_START = 0x000005ae;
const FUNCTION_SECTION_END   = 0x00002a69;

const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;
const TARGET_FUNC = 205;

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function readULEB(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let q = p;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[q++];

        value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: q };
}

function valType(x: number): string {
    switch (x) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        case 0x7b: return "v128";
        case 0x70: return "funcref";
        case 0x6f: return "externref";
        default: return `type(${hex(x, 2)})`;
    }
}

function main() {
    const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" FUNCTION 205 SIGNATURE INSPECTOR V1");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log();

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * TYPE SECTION
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     */

    let p = TYPE_SECTION_START;

    if (b[p++] !== 0x01) {
        throw new Error("Type section ID mismatch");
    }

    const typePayload = readULEB(b, p);
    p = typePayload.next;

    const typeEnd = p + typePayload.value;

    const typeCount = readULEB(b, p);
    p = typeCount.next;

    console.log(`Type count : ${typeCount.value}`);
    console.log();

    type TypeInfo = {
        params: string[];
        results: string[];
    };

    const types: TypeInfo[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < typeCount.value; i++) {

        const form = b[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unsupported type form ${hex(form, 2)} at ${hex(p - 1)}`
            );
        }

        const pc = readULEB(b, p);
        p = pc.next;

        const params: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
            params.push(valType(b[p++]));
        }

        const rc = readULEB(b, p);
        p = rc.next;

        const results: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
            results.push(valType(b[p++]));
        }

        types.push({ params, results });
    }

    if (p !== typeEnd) {
        console.log(
            `WARNING: type parser ended at ${hex(p)}, expected ${hex(typeEnd)}`
        );
    }

    /*
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     * FUNCTION SECTION
     * ------------------------------------------------------------
     *
     * Function section contains type indices for defined functions.
     *
     * Function 83 is the first defined function because there are
     * 83 imported functions.
     */

    p = FUNCTION_SECTION_START;

    if (b[p++] !== 0x03) {
        throw new Error("Function section ID mismatch");
    }

    const fnPayload = readULEB(b, p);
    p = fnPayload.next;

    const fnEnd = p + fnPayload.value;

    const fnCount = readULEB(b, p);
    p = fnCount.next;

    console.log(`Defined functions : ${fnCount.value}`);
    console.log(`Import count      : ${IMPORT_COUNT}`);
    console.log();

    const targetBodyIndex = TARGET_FUNC - IMPORT_COUNT;

    if (targetBodyIndex < 0 || targetBodyIndex >= fnCount.value) {
        throw new Error("Target function is not a defined function");
    }

    let targetTypeIndex = -1;

    for (let i = 0; i < fnCount.value; i++) {
        const r = readULEB(b, p);
        p = r.next;

        const realFunc = IMPORT_COUNT + i;

        if (realFunc === TARGET_FUNC) {
            targetTypeIndex = r.value;

            console.log(
                `Function ${TARGET_FUNC} body index : ${i}`
            );

            console.log(
                `Function ${TARGET_FUNC} type index : ${r.value}`
            );
        }
    }

    if (p !== fnEnd) {
        console.log(
            `WARNING: function parser ended at ${hex(p)}, expected ${hex(fnEnd)}`
        );
    }

    if (targetTypeIndex < 0) {
        throw new Error("Function 205 type index not found");
    }

    const t = types[targetTypeIndex];

    if (!t) {
        throw new Error(
            `Type index ${targetTypeIndex} does not exist`
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" FUNCTION 205 EXACT SIGNATURE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(
        `(${t.params.join(", ")}) -> (${t.results.join(", ")})`
    );

    console.log();
    console.log(`Parameter count : ${t.params.length}`);
    console.log(`Result count    : ${t.results.length}`);

    console.log();
    console.log("PARAMETERS");

    t.params.forEach((x, i) => {
        console.log(`  arg${i} : ${x}`);
    });

    console.log();
    console.log("RESULTS");

    t.results.forEach((x, i) => {
        console.log(`  result${i} : ${x}`);
    });

    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("DONE");
    console.log("============================================================");
}

main();

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
        if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;
        if (!(x & 0x80)) {
            if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
                v |= (~0 << shift);
            }
            break;
        }
    }

    return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

    if (id === 1) {

        let q = start;
        const count = uleb(q);
        q = count.next;

            if (form !== 0x60) {
                console.log(`type ${i}: form=0x${form.toString(16)}`);

            const np = uleb(q);
            q = np.next;

            const params: number[] = [];

            for (let j = 0; j < np.value; j++) {
                params.push(b[q++]);
            }

            const nr = uleb(q);
            q = nr.next;

            const results: number[] = [];

            for (let j = 0; j < nr.value; j++) {

            }

            if (i === 9) {

                ));
                console.log("results =", results.map(x =>
                    `0x${x.toString(16)}`
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    p = end;
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x00095ea0;
const END   = 0x00096ab8;

const TARGETS = new Set([
    0x00095fcc, // L7 tee
    0x000964d1, // L7 tee
    0x0009698a, // L6 tee
    0x00096a4f, // L6 tee
]);

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function readULEB(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let q = p;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[q++];

        value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: q };
}

function readSLEB(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let q = p;
    let x = 0;

    while (true) {
        x = b[q++];

        value |= BigInt(x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7n;
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (x & 0x40)) {
        value |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
    }

    return { value, next: q };
}

function opName(op: number) {
    const m: Record<number, string> = {
        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",
        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x30: "i64.load8_u",
        0x31: "i64.load8_s",
        0x34: "i64.load32_s",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",

        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x74: "i32.shl",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",

        0x83: "i64.and",
        0x84: "i64.or",
        0x85: "i64.xor",
        0x86: "i64.shl",
        0x87: "i64.shr_s",
        0x88: "i64.shr_u",

        0xa7: "i32.wrap_i64",
        0xac: "i64.extend_i32_s",
        0xad: "i64.extend_i32_u",

        0x10: "call",
    };

    return m[op] ?? `op=${hex(op, 2)}`;
}

function decodeOne(b: Buffer, pc: number) {
    const start = pc;
    const op = b[pc++];

    const name = opName(op);

    let imm = "";

    if (
        op === 0x20 ||
        op === 0x21 ||
        op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 ||
        op === 0x24 ||
        op === 0x10
    ) {
        const r = readULEB(b, pc);
        pc = r.next;

        imm = String(r.value);
    }

    else if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = readSLEB(b, pc);
        pc = r.next;

        imm = r.value.toString();
    }

    else if (op === 0x42) {
        const r = readSLEB(b, pc);
        pc = r.next;

        imm = r.value.toString();
    }

    else if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) {
        const a = readULEB(b, pc);
        pc = a.next;

        const o = readULEB(b, pc);
        pc = o.next;

        imm = `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
    }

    else if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const a = readULEB(b, pc);
        pc = a.next;

        const o = readULEB(b, pc);
        pc = o.next;

        imm = `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
    }

    return {
        start,
        end: pc,
        op,
        name,
        imm,
    };
}

function main() {
    const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(`WASM size : ${b.length.toLocaleString()}`);
    console.log(`Window    : ${hex(START)} .. ${hex(END)}`);
    console.log();

    let p = START;

    const decoded: any[] = [];

    while (p < END) {
        const ins = decodeOne(b, p);

        decoded.push(ins);

        p = ins.end;
    }

    for (const target of [...TARGETS].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {

        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`TARGET @ ${hex(target)}`);
        console.log("============================================================");

        const index = decoded.findIndex(x => x.start === target);

        if (index < 0) {
            console.log("TARGET NOT FOUND ON INSTRUCTION BOUNDARY");
            console.log();
            continue;
        }

        const from = Math.max(0, index - 12);
        const to = Math.min(decoded.length, index + 5);

        for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {
            const x = decoded[i];

            const mark =
                x.start === target ? "  <<< TARGET" : "";

            console.log(
                `${hex(x.start)}  ${x.name.padEnd(16)} ${x.imm}${mark}`
            );
        }

        console.log();
    }

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("RAW BYTES AROUND TARGETS");
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (const target of [...TARGETS].sort((a, b) => a - b)) {

        console.log();

        const from = target - 24;

  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b;

  do {
    b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

  } while (b & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: p
  };
}

    count.value,
    "TYPE",
    hex(type)
  );
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

/*
 * ============================================================
 * RAW INSTRUCTION DUMP
 *
 * Only decode the instructions we need.
 * Unknown opcodes are shown as raw bytes.
 * ============================================================
 */

let q = p;

let callFound = false;

while (q < targetBody.end) {

  const off = q;
  const op = wasm[q++];

  let text = "";

  switch (op) {

    case 0x20: {
      const x = readULEB(q);
      q = x.next;
      text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = readULEB(q);
      q = x.next;
      text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = readULEB(q);
      q = x.next;
      text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = readSLEB(q);
      q = x.next;
      text = `i32.const ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const align = readULEB(q);
      q = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(q);
      q = offset.next;

      text =
        `i32.load align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x2d: {
      const align = readULEB(q);
      q = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(q);
      q = offset.next;

      text =
        `i32.load8_u align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = readULEB(q);
      q = x.next;

      text = `call ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {

      const type = readULEB(q);
      q = type.next;

      const table = readULEB(q);
      q = table.next;

      text =
        `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;

      if (type.value === 3) {
        callFound = true;
      }

      break;
    }

    case 0x6a:
      text = "i32.add";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      text = "i32.sub";
      break;

    case 0x6c:
      text = "i32.mul";
      break;

    case 0x46:
      text = "i32.eq";
      break;

    case 0x47:
      text = "i32.ne";
      break;

    case 0x45:
      text = "i32.eqz";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      text = "end";
      break;

    default:

      text =
        `UNKNOWN ${hex(op)}`;

      /*
       * Do NOT stop.
       *
       * Print raw byte and continue.
       */

      break;
  }

  console.log(
    hex(off),
    text
  );

  if (callFound)
    break;
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

if (callFound) {

  console.log(
    "TYPE-3 CALL FOUND : YES"
  );

  console.log(
    "IMPORTANT: inspect stack immediately before call_indirect."
  );

} else {

  console.log(
    "TYPE-3 CALL FOUND : NO"
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCTION = 259;

const TARGET_LOADS = new Set([
    0x144fb,
    0x14634,
    0x146e2,
]);

function readULEB(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[p++];

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p,
    };
}

function readSections(b: Buffer) {
    const result: any[] = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < b.length) {
        const id = b[p++];

        const size = readULEB(b, p);
        p = size.next;

        const payload = p;
        const end = payload + size.value;

        result.push({
            id,
            payload,
            size: size.value,
            end,
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return result;
}

function section(
    sections: any[],
    id: number
) {
    const s = sections.find(x => x.id === id);

    if (!s) {
        throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
    }

    return s;
}

function countImportedFunctions(
    b: Buffer,
    s: any
) {
    let p = s.payload;

    const n = readULEB(b, p);
    p = n.next;

    let functions = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

        const ml = readULEB(b, p);
        p = ml.next + ml.value;

        const nl = readULEB(b, p);
        p = nl.next + nl.value;

        const kind = b[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const t = readULEB(b, p);
            p = t.next;
            functions++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {

            const flags = b[p++];

            const x = readULEB(b, p);
            p = x.next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                const y = readULEB(b, p);
                p = y.next;
            }

        } else if (kind === 2) {

            const flags = b[p++];

            const x = readULEB(b, p);
            p = x.next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                const y = readULEB(b, p);
                p = y.next;
            }

        } else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;

        } else if (kind === 4) {

            const x = readULEB(b, p);
            p = x.next;

            const y = readULEB(b, p);
            p = y.next;
        }
    }

    return functions;
}

function getFunctionTypes(
    b: Buffer,
    s: any
) {
    let p = s.payload;

    const n = readULEB(b, p);
    p = n.next;

    const result: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const x = readULEB(b, p);
        p = x.next;

        result.push(x.value);
    }

    return result;
}

function getBodies(
    b: Buffer,
    s: any
) {
    let p = s.payload;

    const n = readULEB(b, p);
    p = n.next;

    const bodies: any[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(b, p);
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

        const localCount = readULEB(b, p);
        p = localCount.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localCount.value; j++) {

            const count = readULEB(b, p);
            p = count.next;

            p += 1;
        }

        const codeStart = p;

        bodies.push({
            bodyStart,
            codeStart,
            bodyEnd,
            bodySize: sizeInfo.value,
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function hex8(x: number) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function opcodeName(op: number) {
    const m: Record<number, string> = {
        0x20: "local.get",

        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x23: "global.get",

type Instr = {
    pos: number;
    abs: number;
    op: number;
    name: string;
    args: string;
};

function decode(
    code: Buffer,
    codeStart: number
): Instr[] {

    const result: Instr[] = [];

    let p = 0;

    while (p < code.length) {

        const start = p;
        const op = code[p++];

        let args = "";

        try {

            switch (op) {

                case 0x20:
                case 0x21:
                case 0x22:
                case 0x23:
                case 0x24: {
                    const x = readULEB(code, p);
                    p = x.next;

                    args = `${x.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x41: {
                    const x = readSLEB(code, p);
                    p = x.next;

                    args = `${x.value} (${hex8(x.value >>> 0)})`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x42: {
                    const x = readSLEB(code, p);
                    p = x.next;

                    args = `${x.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x10: {
                    const x = readULEB(code, p);
                    p = x.next;

                    args = `function ${x.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x11: {
                    const x = readULEB(code, p);
                    p = x.next;

                    const y = readULEB(code, p);
                    p = y.next;

                    args = `type ${x.value}, table ${y.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x28:
                case 0x29:
                case 0x2a:
                case 0x2b:
                case 0x2c:
                case 0x2d:
                case 0x2e:
                case 0x2f:
                case 0x30:
                case 0x31:
                case 0x32:
                case 0x33:
                case 0x34:
                case 0x35:
                case 0x36:
                case 0x37:
                case 0x38:
                case 0x39:
                case 0x3a:
                case 0x3b:
                case 0x3c:
                case 0x3d:
                case 0x3e: {

                    const align = readULEB(code, p);
                    p = align.next;

                    const off = readULEB(code, p);
                    p = off.next;

                    args =
                        `align=${align.value} offset=${hex8(off.value)}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x3f:
                case 0x40: {
                    p += 1;
                    args = "memory 0";
                    break;
                }

                /*
                 * ref.null
                 */
                case 0xd0:
                    p += 1;
                    args = "heaptype";
                    break;

                /*
                 * ref.func
                 */
                case 0xd2: {
                    const x = readULEB(code, p);
                    p = x.next;

                    args = `function ${x.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                /*
                 * select typed / misc prefixes are intentionally
                 * handled conservatively.
                 */
                default:
                    break;
            }

        } catch {
            break;
        }

        result.push({
            pos: start,
            abs: codeStart + start,
            op,
            name: opcodeName(op),
            args,
        });
    }

    return result;
}

function printInstruction(
    x: Instr
) {
    console.log(
        `${hex8(x.abs)}  ${x.name.padEnd(15)} ${x.args}`
    );
}

function printWindow(
    instructions: Instr[],
    center: number,
    radius = 22
) {

    const index = instructions.findIndex(
        x => x.abs === center
    );

    if (index < 0) {
        console.log(`Instruction ${hex8(center)} not found`);
        return;
    }

    const a = Math.max(0, index - radius);
    const z = Math.min(
        instructions.length,
        index + radius + 1
    );

    for (let i = a; i < z; i++) {
        const x = instructions[i];

        const marker =
            x.abs === center ? " >>> " : "     ";

        console.log(
            marker +
            `${hex8(x.abs)}  ` +
            `${x.name.padEnd(15)} ` +
            x.args
        );
    }
}

function printMemoryReferences(
    instructions: Instr[]
) {

    console.log("");
    console.log("STATIC MEMORY REFERENCES");
    console.log("");

    for (const x of instructions) {

        if (
            x.op >= 0x28 &&
            x.op <= 0x3e
        ) {

            console.log(
                `${hex8(x.abs)}  ` +
                `${x.name.padEnd(15)} ` +
                x.args
            );
        }
    }
}

function printCalls(
    instructions: Instr[]
) {

    console.log("");
    console.log("REAL CALL INSTRUCTIONS");
    console.log("");

    let count = 0;

    for (const x of instructions) {

        if (x.op === 0x10) {

            console.log(
                `${hex8(x.abs)} → ${x.args}`
            );

            count++;
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log(`CALL COUNT : ${count}`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [
    0x00250fb8,
    0x0025587c,
    0x00255880,
    0x00255884,
    0x00255888,
    0x0025588c,
    0x00255890,
    0x00255894,
    0x00255898,
    0x0025589c,
    0x002558a0,
    0x002558a4,
    0x002559ac,
    0x00255a5c,
];

function readULEB(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
        }
    }
}

function readSections(b: Buffer) {
    const out: {
        id: number;
        payload: number;
        size: number;
        end: number;
    }[] = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < b.length) {
        const id = b[p++];

        const s = readULEB(b, p);
        p = s.next;

        const payload = p;
        const end = payload + s.value;

        out.push({
            id,
            payload,
            size: s.value,
            end,
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return out;
}

function getSection(
    sections: ReturnType<typeof readSections>,
    id: number
) {
    const s = sections.find(x => x.id === id);

    if (!s) {
        throw new Error(`Missing section ${id}`);
    }

    return s;
}

function parseImportFunctionCount(
    b: Buffer,
    section: ReturnType<typeof getSection>
) {
    let p = section.payload;

    const c = readULEB(b, p);
    p = c.next;

    let functions = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const ml = readULEB(b, p);
        p = ml.next + ml.value;

        const nl = readULEB(b, p);
        p = nl.next + nl.value;

        const kind = b[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const t = readULEB(b, p);
            p = t.next;
            functions++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
            const flags = b[p++];

            const a = readULEB(b, p);
            p = a.next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                const m = readULEB(b, p);
                p = m.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 2) {
            const flags = b[p++];

            const a = readULEB(b, p);
            p = a.next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                const m = readULEB(b, p);
                p = m.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;
        } else if (kind === 4) {
            const a = readULEB(b, p);
            p = a.next;

            const b2 = readULEB(b, p);
            p = b2.next;
        }
    }

    return functions;
}

function parseFunctionSection(
    b: Buffer,
    section: ReturnType<typeof getSection>
) {
    let p = section.payload;

    const c = readULEB(b, p);
    p = c.next;

    const types: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const x = readULEB(b, p);
        p = x.next;
        types.push(x.value);
    }

    return types;
}

function parseBodies(
    b: Buffer,
    section: ReturnType<typeof getSection>
) {
    let p = section.payload;

    const c = readULEB(b, p);
    p = c.next;

    const bodies: {
        start: number;
        codeStart: number;
        end: number;
        bytes: Buffer;
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const size = readULEB(b, p);
        p = size.next;

        const start = p - (size.next - (p - size.next));

        const bodyStart = size.next;

        const localCount = readULEB(b, p);
        p = localCount.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localCount.value; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(b, p);
            p = n.next;

            p += 1;
        }

        const codeStart = p;
        const end = bodyStart + size.value;

        bodies.push({
            start: bodyStart,
            codeStart,
            end,
            bytes: b.subarray(bodyStart, end),
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function ulebAt(
    b: Buffer,
    p: number
) {
    return readULEB(b, p);
}

function signedLEBAt(
    b: Buffer,
    p: number
) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = b[p++];

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p,
    };
}

function isMemoryLoad(op: number) {
    return (
        op === 0x28 || // i32.load
        op === 0x29 || // i64.load
        op === 0x2a || // f32.load
        op === 0x2b || // f64.load
        op === 0x2c || // i32.load8_s
        op === 0x2d || // i32.load8_u
        op === 0x2e || // i32.load16_s
        op === 0x2f || // i32.load16_u
        op === 0x30 || // i64.load8_s
        op === 0x31 || // i64.load8_u
        op === 0x32 || // i64.load16_s
        op === 0x33 || // i64.load16_u
        op === 0x34 || // i64.load32_s
        op === 0x35    // i64.load32_u
    );
}

function isMemoryStore(op: number) {
    return (
        op === 0x36 || // i32.store
        op === 0x37 || // i64.store
        op === 0x38 || // f32.store
        op === 0x39 || // f64.store
        op === 0x3a || // i32.store8
        op === 0x3b || // i32.store16
        op === 0x3c || // i64.store8
        op === 0x3d || // i64.store16
        op === 0x3e    // i64.store32
    );
}

function memoryName(op: number) {
    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2a: "f32.load",
        0x2b: "f64.load",
        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
        0x30: "i64.load8_s",
        0x31: "i64.load8_u",
        0x32: "i64.load16_s",
        0x33: "i64.load16_u",
        0x34: "i64.load32_s",
        0x35: "i64.load32_u",
        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",
        0x38: "f32.store",
        0x39: "f64.store",
        0x3a: "i32.store8",
        0x3b: "i32.store16",
        0x3c: "i64.store8",
        0x3d: "i64.store16",
        0x3e: "i64.store32",
    };

    return names[op] ?? `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`;
}

function context(
    code: Buffer,
    pos: number,
    radius = 18
) {
    const a = Math.max(0, pos - radius);
    const z = Math.min(code.length, pos + radius + 12);

    return code
        .subarray(a, z)
        .toString("hex")
        .match(/.{1,2}/g)
        ?.join(" ") ?? "";
}

function scanMemoryInstructions(
    code: Buffer,
    codeStart: number
) {
    const hits: {
        pos: number;
        opcode: number;
        align: number;
        offset: number;
        context: string;
    }[] = [];

    let p = 0;

    while (p < code.length) {
        const pos = p;
        const op = code[p++];

        try {
            if (op === 0x41) {
                const x = signedLEBAt(code, p);
                p = x.next;
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x42) {
                const x = signedLEBAt(code, p);
                p = x.next;
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x43) {
                p += 4;
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x44) {
                p += 8;
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x10) {
                const x = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = x.next;
                continue;
            }

            if (
                op === 0x11
            ) {
                const x = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = x.next;

                const y = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = y.next;

                continue;
            }

            if (isMemoryLoad(op) || isMemoryStore(op)) {
                const align = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = off.next;

                hits.push({
                    pos,
                    opcode: op,
                    align: align.value,
                    offset: off.value,
                    context: context(code, pos),
                });

                continue;
            }

            /*
             * Memory.size / memory.grow
             */
            if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
                p += 1;
                continue;
            }

            /*
             * Simple opcodes with no immediate are left alone.
             * This decoder is intentionally conservative.
             */
        } catch {
            break;
        }
    }

    return hits.map(x => ({
        ...x,
        absolute: codeStart + x.pos,
    }));
}

function scanCalls(
    code: Buffer,
    codeStart: number
) {
    const calls: {
        absolute: number;
        target: number;
    }[] = [];

    let p = 0;

    while (p < code.length) {
        const pos = p;
        const op = code[p++];

        try {
            if (op === 0x10) {
                const x = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = x.next;

                calls.push({
                    absolute: codeStart + pos,
                    target: x.value,
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x11) {
                const x = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = x.next;

                const y = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = y.next;

                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x41 || op === 0x42) {
                const x = signedLEBAt(code, p);
                p = x.next;
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x43) {
                p += 4;
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x44) {
                p += 8;
                continue;
            }

            if (isMemoryLoad(op) || isMemoryStore(op)) {
                const a = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = ulebAt(code, p);
                p = o.next;

                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
                p += 1;
                continue;
            }
        } catch {
            break;
        }
    }

    return calls;
}

function inspectTargetAccesses(
    code: Buffer,
    codeStart: number,
    hits: ReturnType<typeof scanMemoryInstructions>
) {
    console.log("");
    console.log("TARGET MEMORY ACCESSES");
    console.log("");

    let found = 0;

    for (const h of hits) {
        const absoluteOffset = h.offset;

        for (const target of TARGETS) {
            /*
             * A wasm memory instruction uses:
             * effective_address = stack_address + immediate_offset
             *
             * We can only identify a direct absolute access here
             * when the offset itself equals the target.
             */
            if (absoluteOffset === target) {
                console.log(
                    `@0x${h.absolute.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
                    `${memoryName(h.opcode)} ` +
                    `align=${h.align} ` +
                    `offset=0x${absoluteOffset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
                );

                console.log(`  context: ${h.context}`);

                found++;
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log(`DIRECT TARGET OFFSETS FOUND : ${found}`);
}

function readULEB(): number {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
            return v;

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function valtype(x: number): string {
    switch (x) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        case 0x7b: return "v128";
        case 0x70: return "funcref";
        case 0x6f: return "externref";
        default:
            return `UNKNOWN(0x${x.toString(16)})`;
    }
}

function readULEB(buf, p) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function readSLEB(buf, p) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
                result |= (~0 << shift);

            return { value: result | 0, next: p };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function hex(n, width = 8) {
    return n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function opName(op) {
    const m = {
        0x0b: "end",
        0x0c: "br",
        0x0d: "br_if",
        0x0e: "br_table",
        0x0f: "return",
        0x10: "call",
        0x11: "call_indirect",

        0x1b: "select",

        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul"
    };

    return m[op] || `opcode_0x${hex(op, 2)}`;
}

function decodeInstruction(buf, p, end) {
    const start = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = readSLEB(buf, p);
        return {
            start,
            end: r.next,
            text: `i32.const ${r.value}`,
            value: r.value >>> 0
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const r = readSLEB(buf, p);
        return {
            start,
            end: r.next,
            text: `i64.const ${r.value}`
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        return {
            start,
            end: r.next,
            text: `call func=${r.value}`,
            callTarget: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        const table = buf[r.next];

        return {
            start,
            end: r.next + 2,
            text: `call_indirect type=${r.value} table=${table}`
        };
    }

    if (op >= 0x20 && op <= 0x22) {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            start,
            end: r.next,
            text: `${opName(op)} local=${r.value}`
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            start,
            end: r.next,
            text: `${opName(op)} global=${r.value}`
        };
    }

    if (
        op === 0x28 ||
        op === 0x29 ||
        op === 0x2c ||
        op === 0x2d ||
        op === 0x36 ||
        op === 0x37
    ) {
        const align = readULEB(buf, p);
        const offset = readULEB(buf, align.next);

        return {
            start,
            end: offset.next,
            text:
                `${opName(op)} ` +
                `align=${align.value} ` +
                `offset=${offset.value}`
        };
    }

    return {
        start,
        end: p,
        text: opName(op)
    };
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 446;

function readULEB(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 0;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: pos
    };
}

function skipBlockType(pos) {

    const b = wasm[pos];

    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c ||
        b === 0x7b ||
        b === 0x70 ||
        b === 0x6f
    ) {
        return pos + 1;
    }

    return readSLEB(pos).next;
}

function memArg(pos) {

    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: o.value,
        next: o.next
    };
}

function decode(body) {

    const out = [];

    let p = body.start;

    while (p < body.end) {

        const at = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text;

        try {

            switch (op) {

                case 0x00:
                    text = "unreachable";
                    break;

                case 0x01:
                    text = "nop";
                    break;

                case 0x02:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "block";
                    break;

                case 0x03:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "loop";
                    break;

                case 0x04:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "if";
                    break;

                case 0x05:
                    text = "else";
                    break;

                case 0x0b:
                    text = "end";
                    break;

                case 0x0c: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `br ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0d: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0e: {

                    const n = readULEB(p);
                    p = n.next;

                    const labels = [];

                    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                        const r = readULEB(p);
                        p = r.next;
                        labels.push(r.value);
                    }

                    const d = readULEB(p);
                    p = d.next;

                    text =
                        `br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${d.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x0f:
                    text = "return";
                    break;

                case 0x10: {

                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `call ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x11: {

                    const t = readULEB(p);
                    p = t.next;

                    const table = readULEB(p);
                    p = table.next;

                    text =
                        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x1a:
                    text = "drop";
                    break;

                case 0x1b:
                    text = "select";
                    break;

                case 0x20: {

                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `local.get ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x21: {

                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `local.set ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x22: {

                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x23: {

                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `global.get ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x24: {

                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `global.set ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x28:
                case 0x29:
                case 0x2a:
                case 0x2b:
                case 0x2c:
                case 0x2d:
                case 0x2e:
                case 0x2f:
                case 0x30:
                case 0x31:
                case 0x32:
                case 0x33:
                case 0x34:
                case 0x35:
                case 0x36:
                case 0x37:
                case 0x38:
                case 0x39:
                case 0x3a:
                case 0x3b:
                case 0x3c:
                case 0x3d:
                case 0x3e: {

                    const m = memArg(p);
                    p = m.next;

                    const names = {
                        0x28: "i32.load",
                        0x29: "i64.load",
                        0x2a: "f32.load",
                        0x2b: "f64.load",
                        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
                        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
                        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
                        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
                        0x30: "i64.load8_s",
                        0x31: "i64.load8_u",
                        0x32: "i64.load16_s",
                        0x33: "i64.load16_u",
                        0x34: "i64.load32_s",
                        0x35: "i64.load32_u",
                        0x36: "i32.store",
                        0x37: "i64.store",
                        0x38: "f32.store",
                        0x39: "f64.store",
                        0x3a: "i32.store8",
                        0x3b: "i32.store16",
                        0x3c: "i64.store8",
                        0x3d: "i64.store16",
                        0x3e: "i64.store32"
                    };

                    text =
                        `${names[op]} align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x3f: {

                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `memory.size ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x40: {

                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `memory.grow ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x41: {

                    const r = readSLEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x42: {

                    const r = readSLEB(p);
                    p = r.next;

                    text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                default:

                    text =
                        `opcode 0x${op
                            .toString(16)
                            .padStart(2, "0")}`;

                    break;
            }

        } catch {

            text = "DECODE ERROR";
        }

        out.push({
            pos: at,
            op,
            text
        });
    }

    return out;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 66;
const START = 0x126c0;
const END = 0x126fa;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32LEB(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p.v++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return result >>> 0;
}

function readName(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): string {
    const len = readU32LEB(buf, p);
    const s = buf.subarray(p.v, p.v + len).toString("utf8");
    p.v += len;
    return s;
}

function valType(b: number): string {
    switch (b) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        case 0x7b: return "v128";
        case 0x70: return "funcref";
        case 0x6f: return "externref";
        default: return `0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }
}

interface FuncType {
    params: string[];
    results: string[];
}

const types: FuncType[] = [];
const functionTypeIndices: number[] = [];

let importedFunctionCount = 0;

interface Section {
    id: number;
    start: number;
    payloadStart: number;
    payloadEnd: number;
}

const sections: Section[] = [];

let pos = 8;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];

    const p = { v: pos };
    const size = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

    const payloadStart = p.v;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + size;

    sections.push({
        id,
        start: pos - 1,
        payloadStart,
        payloadEnd,
    });

    pos = payloadEnd;
}

/* ============================================================
   TYPE SECTION
   ============================================================ */

const typeSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 1);

if (!typeSec) {
    throw new Error("Type section not found");
}

{
    const p = { v: typeSec.payloadStart };
    const count = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const form = wasm[p.v++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unsupported type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at type ${i}`
            );
        }

        const paramCount = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
        const params: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
            params.push(valType(wasm[p.v++]));
        }

        const resultCount = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
        const results: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
            results.push(valType(wasm[p.v++]));
        }

        types.push({ params, results });
    }
}

/* ============================================================
   IMPORT SECTION
   ============================================================ */

const importSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 2);

if (importSec) {
    const p = { v: importSec.payloadStart };
    const count = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const moduleName = readName(wasm, p);
        const fieldName = readName(wasm, p);
        const kind = wasm[p.v++];

        if (kind === 0x00) {
            const typeIndex = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            importedFunctionCount++;

            console.log(
                `IMPORT FUNC #${importedFunctionCount - 1}` +
                ` ${moduleName}.${fieldName}` +
                ` type=${typeIndex}`
            );
        } else if (kind === 0x01) {
            p.v += 1; // elem type
            const flags = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            if (flags & 1) {
                readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            }

            readU32LEB(wasm, p);
        } else if (kind === 0x02) {
            const flags = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            if (flags & 1) {
                readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            }
        } else if (kind === 0x03) {
            p.v += 2;
        } else {
            throw new Error(`Unknown import kind 0x${kind.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }
}

/* ============================================================

function readS32LEB(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = buf[p.v++];
        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return result | 0;
}

function readS64LEB(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): bigint {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = buf[p.v++];

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7n;
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1n) << shift;
    }

    return result;
}

function fmtI64(v: bigint): string {
    return v.toString();
}

const p = { v: START };

const stack: string[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, string>();

function pop(): string {
    if (stack.length === 0) {
        return "STACK_UNDERFLOW";
    }

    return stack.pop()!;
}

function push(x: string) {
    stack.push(x);
}

while (p.v < END) {
    const pc = p.v;
    const op = wasm[p.v++];

    let text = "";

    switch (op) {
        case 0x00:
            text = "unreachable";
            break;

        case 0x0b:
            text = "end";
            break;

        case 0x1a: {
            const x = pop();
            text = `drop ${x}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x20: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            const v = locals.get(idx) ?? `L${idx}`;
            push(v);
            text = `local.get ${idx} -> ${v}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            const v = pop();
            locals.set(idx, v);
            text = `local.set ${idx} = ${v}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            const v = pop();
            locals.set(idx, v);
            push(v);
            text = `local.tee ${idx} = ${v}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const v = readS32LEB(wasm, p);
            push(`i32.const(${v})`);
            text = `i32.const ${v}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x42: {

            push(`i64.const(${fmtI64(v)})`);
            text = `i64.const ${v}`;

            const a = pop();
            push(`(${a} + ${b})`);
            text = `i64.add (${a}) + (${b})`;
            break;

        case 0x7d: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();
            push(`(${a} - ${b})`);
            text = `i64.sub (${a}) - (${b})`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x7e: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();
            push(`(${a} * ${b})`);
            text = `i64.mul`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x83: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();
            push(`(${a} & ${b})`);
            text = `i64.and`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x84: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();
            push(`(${a} | ${b})`);
            text = `i64.or`;
            break;

        case 0x86: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();
            push(`(${a} << ${b})`);
            text = `i64.shl`;

        case 0x88: {

        case 0xad: {
            const a = pop();
            push(`i64.extend32_s(${a})`);
            text = `i64.extend32_s`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x54: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();
            push(`(${a} <u ${b})`);
            text = `i64.lt_u`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x56: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();
            push(`(${a} >u ${b})`);
            text = `i64.gt_u`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x29: {
            const align = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            const offset = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const addr = pop();

            const expr = `MEM64[${addr} + ${offset}]`;

            push(expr);

            text =
                `i64.load align=${align} offset=${offset} ` +
                `=> ${expr}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const align = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            const offset = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const value = pop();
            const addr = pop();

            text =
                `i64.store align=${align} offset=${offset} ` +
                `MEM64[${addr} + ${offset}] = ${value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const sig =
                idx < importedFunctionCount
                    ? "IMPORTED"
                    : (() => {
                        const di = idx - importedFunctionCount;
                        const ti = functionTypeIndices[di];
                        const t = types[ti];
                        return `(${t.params.join(",")}) -> (${t.results.join(",")})`;
                    })();

            text = `CALL ${idx} ${sig}`;

            let resultCount = 0;

            if (idx >= importedFunctionCount) {
                const di = idx - importedFunctionCount;

                if (di >= 0 && di < functionTypeIndices.length) {
                    const ti = functionTypeIndices[di];
                    resultCount = types[ti].results.length;
                }
            }

            /*
             * IMPORTANT:
             * We intentionally do not invent argument names here.
             * We only model result arity.
             */
            if (resultCount === 1) {
                push(`CALL${idx}_RESULT`);
            } else if (resultCount > 1) {
                for (let i = 0; i < resultCount; i++) {
                    push(`CALL${idx}_RESULT${i}`);
                }
            }

            break;
        }

        default:
            text = `UNKNOWN opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
            break;
    }

    console.log(
        `0x${pc.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${text}`
    );

        break;

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const FUNC_START = 0x0001226d;
const FUNC_END   = 0x0001295c;

// Function 87 outputs:
// S0..S29, each 16 bytes.
const slots = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({
    name: `S${i}`,
    base: i * 16,
}));

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

function u32le(p: number): number {
    return (
        wasm[p] |
        (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
    return n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function opcodeName(op: number): string {
    const m: Record<number, string> = {
        0x00: "unreachable",
        0x01: "nop",
        0x02: "block",
        0x03: "loop",
        0x04: "if",
        0x05: "else",
        0x0b: "end",
        0x0c: "br",
        0x0d: "br_if",
        0x0e: "br_table",
        0x0f: "return",

        0x10: "call",
        0x11: "call_indirect",

        0x1a: "drop",
        0x1b: "select",

        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",
        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x25: "table.get",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2a: "f32.load",
        0x2b: "f64.load",
        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
        0x30: "i64.load8_s",
        0x31: "i64.load8_u",
        0x32: "i64.load16_s",
        0x33: "i64.load16_u",
        0x34: "i64.load32_s",
        0x35: "i64.load32_u",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",
        0x48: "i32.lt_s",
        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

        0x50: "i64.eqz",
        0x51: "i64.eq",
        0x52: "i64.ne",
        0x53: "i64.lt_s",
        0x54: "i64.lt_u",
        0x55: "i64.gt_s",
        0x56: "i64.gt_u",
        0x57: "i64.le_s",
        0x58: "i64.le_u",
        0x59: "i64.ge_s",
        0x5a: "i64.ge_u",

        0x67: "i32.clz",
        0x68: "i32.ctz",
        0x69: "i32.popcnt",

        0x79: "i64.clz",
        0x7a: "i64.ctz",
        0x7b: "i64.popcnt",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",
        0x7f: "i64.div_s",
        0x80: "i64.div_u",
        0x81: "i64.rem_s",
        0x82: "i64.rem_u",

        0x86: "i64.shl",
        0x87: "i64.shr_s",
        0x88: "i64.shr_u",
        0x89: "i64.rotl",
        0x8a: "i64.rotr",

        0xa7: "i64.extend_i32_s",
        0xad: "i64.extend_i32_u",
    };

    return m[op] ?? `UNKNOWN(0x${hex(op, 2)})`;
}

// Read ULEB128, returning [value,nextPosition].
function readULEB(pos: number): [number, number] {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return [value >>> 0, pos];
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return [value >>> 0, pos];
}

// Decode only enough immediate operands to keep instruction boundaries.
// This is intentionally conservative.
function instructionLength(pos: number): number {
    const op = wasm[pos];

    switch (op) {
        case 0x20: // local.get
        case 0x21: // local.set
        case 0x22: // local.tee
        case 0x23: // global.get
        case 0x24: // global.set
        case 0x0c: // br
        case 0x0d: // br_if
        case 0x10: { // call
            const [, next] = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return next - pos;
        }

        case 0x25: { // table.get
            const [, next] = readULEB(pos + 1);
            return next - pos;
        }

        case 0x28: // i32.load
        case 0x29: // i64.load
        case 0x2a: // f32.load
        case 0x2b: // f64.load
        case 0x2c:
        case 0x2d:
        case 0x2e:
        case 0x2f:
        case 0x30:
        case 0x31:
        case 0x32:
        case 0x33:
        case 0x34:
        case 0x35:
        case 0x36:
        case 0x37: {
            // memory immediate = align + offset
            let p = pos + 1;
            const [, p1] = readULEB(p);
            const [, p2] = readULEB(p1);
            return p2 - pos;
        }

        case 0x41: { // i32.const
            let p = pos + 1;
            while (p < wasm.length) {
                const b = wasm[p++];
                if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
            }
            return p - pos;
        }

        case 0x42: { // i64.const
            let p = pos + 1;
            while (p < wasm.length) {
                const b = wasm[p++];
                if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
            }
            return p - pos;
        }

        default:
            return 1;
    }
}

function readMemImmediate(pos: number): { align: number; offset: number } {
    let p = pos + 1;

    const [align, p1] = readULEB(p);
    const [offset, p2] = readULEB(p1);

    return {
        align,
        offset,
    };
}

function slotForOffset(offset: number): string | null {
    for (const s of slots) {
        if (offset === s.base) return `${s.name} word0`;
        if (offset === s.base + 8) return `${s.name} word1`;
    }

    return null;
}

            const s = slotForOffset(mem.offset);

        if (op === 0x10) {
            const [fn] = readULEB(q + 1);
            extra = ` function=${fn}`;
        }

        console.log(
            `0x${hex(q)}  ${opcodeName(op).padEnd(22)}${extra}`
        );

        q += len;
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;

  while (true) {
    if (pos >= wasm.length)
      throw new Error("ULEB out of range");

    const b = wasm[pos++];

    value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7n;

    if (shift > 70n)
      throw new Error("ULEB too long");
  }
}

function H(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function sectionName(id: number) {
  switch (id) {
    case 0: return "custom";
    case 1: return "type";
    case 2: return "import";
    case 3: return "function";
    case 4: return "table";
    case 5: return "memory";
    case 6: return "global";
    case 7: return "export";
    case 8: return "start";
    case 9: return "element";
    case 10: return "code";
    case 11: return "data";
    case 12: return "data_count";
    default: return `section_${id}`;
  }
}

  fn: number;
  bodyStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  localsStart: number;
  codeStart: number;
  codeEnd: number;
  size: number;
  bytes: Buffer;
}

          const minInfo = uleb(q);

          // global
          q += 2;
          break;

        case 0x04: {
          // tag
          const attr = wasm[q++];
          void attr;

          const typeInfo = uleb(q);
          q = typeInfo.next;

          break;
        }

        default:
          throw new Error(
            `Unknown import kind 0x${kind.toString(16)} @ ${H(q - 1)}`
          );
      }
    }

    console.log(`  imported functions : ${importedFunctions}`);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // FUNCTION SECTION

  if (id === 3) {

    const count = Number(countInfo.value);
    q = countInfo.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const typeInfo = uleb(q);
      q = typeInfo.next;

      functionTypeIndices.push(Number(typeInfo.value));
    }

    console.log(`  defined functions  : ${definedFunctions}`);

    const countInfo = uleb(q);
    const count = Number(countInfo.value);
    q = countInfo.next;

    console.log(`  code bodies        : ${count}`);

    if (count !== definedFunctions) {
      console.log(

      );
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

      const fn = importedFunctions + i;

      const bodySizeInfo = uleb(q);
      const bodySize = Number(bodySizeInfo.value);

      const bodyStart = bodySizeInfo.next;
      const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

      if (bodyEnd > payloadEnd)
        throw new Error(

      // local declarations:
      let r = bodyStart;

      const localDeclInfo = uleb(r);
      const localDeclCount = Number(localDeclInfo.value);
      r = localDeclInfo.next;

      for (let d = 0; d < localDeclCount; d++) {
        const nInfo = uleb(r);
        r = nInfo.next;

        // value type
        r++;
      }

      const codeStart = r;

      if (fn === TARGET_FN) {
        targetCodeBody = {
          fn,
          bodyStart,
          bodyEnd,
          localsStart: bodyStart,
          codeStart,
          codeEnd: bodyEnd,
          size: bodySize,
          bytes: Buffer.from(body)
        };
      }

      q = bodyEnd;
    }
  }

  p = payloadEnd;
}

    q = x.next;

    console.log(
      `CALL #${String(directCalls).padStart(2, " ")} @ ${H(at)} -> function ${fn}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // local.get/set/tee
  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    q = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // global.get/set
  if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    q = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // br / br_if
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    q = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // block / loop / if
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    q = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    let x = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
      const b = wasm[q++];

      x |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

      if (!(b & 0x80))
        break;

      shift += 7;
    }

    continue;
  }

  // i64.const
  if (op === 0x42) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    q = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // memory load/store memarg
  if (
    (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e)
  ) {
    const a = uleb(q);
    q = a.next;

    const o = uleb(q);
    q = o.next;

    continue;
  }

  // br_table
  if (op === 0x0e) {
    const n = uleb(q);
    q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < Number(n.value) + 1; i++) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      q = x.next;
    }

    continue;
  }

  // call_indirect
  if (op === 0x11) {
    const a = uleb(q);
    q = a.next;

    const b = uleb(q);
    q = b.next;

    continue;
  }

  // memory.size / memory.grow
  if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
    q++;
    continue;
  }

  // prefixed opcode
  if (op === 0xfc) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    q = x.next;

    console.log(
      `PREFIX 0xfc @ ${H(at)} subopcode=${x.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // 0xfd SIMD prefix
  if (op === 0xfd) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    q = x.next;

    console.log(
      `PREFIX 0xfd @ ${H(at)} subopcode=${x.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // 0xfe atomic prefix
  if (op === 0xfe) {
    const x = uleb(q);
    q = x.next;

    console.log(
      `PREFIX 0xfe @ ${H(at)} subopcode=${x.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_FUNC = 9046;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("INSPECT FUNC 9046 DISPATCH OBJECT");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log("TARGET FUNC :", TARGET_FUNC);

function uleb(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value: result, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    b = buf[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
      }

      return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
    }

    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readBytes(start, end) {
  const out = [];

  for (let i = start; i < end && i < buf.length; i++) {
    out.push(buf[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
  }

  return out.join(" ");
}

 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Locate Code Section
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

let p = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (p < buf.length) {
  const sectionId = buf[p++];

  const size = uleb(p);

  if (!size) {
    throw new Error("Failed reading section size at " + hex(p));
  }

  p = size.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = start + size.value;

  if (sectionId === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
  throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

console.log("CODE SECTION :", hex(codeStart), "..", hex(codeEnd));

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Parse all function bodies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

let q = codeStart;

const countInfo = uleb(q);

if (!countInfo) {
  throw new Error("Failed reading code body count");
}

const bodyCount = countInfo.value;
q = countInfo.next;

console.log("CODE BODY COUNT :", bodyCount);

if (bodyCount !== 9398) {
  console.log("WARNING: expected 9398 bodies");
}

let target = null;

for (let func = 0; func < bodyCount; func++) {
  const sizeInfo = uleb(q);

  if (!sizeInfo) {
    throw new Error("Failed body size at function " + func);
  }

  const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
  const bodySizePos = q;

  const bodyStart = sizeInfo.next;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

  if (func === TARGET_FUNC) {
    target = {
      func,
      bodySize,
      bodySizePos,
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd
    };

    break;
  }

  q = bodyEnd;
}

if (!target) {
  throw new Error("Target function not found");
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("FUNC :", target.func);
console.log("BODY :", hex(target.bodyStart), "..", hex(target.bodyEnd));
console.log("BODY SIZE :", target.bodySize);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

if (!localCountInfo) {
  throw new Error("Failed local declaration count");
}

x = localCountInfo.next;

const localTypes = [];

for (let g = 0; g < localGroups; g++) {

  if (!nInfo) {
    throw new Error("Failed local group");
  }

  const n = nInfo.value;
  x = nInfo.next;

  if (x >= target.bodyEnd) {
    throw new Error("Unexpected end in local declarations");
  }

  const type = buf[x++];

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    localTypes.push(type);
  }
}

console.log("LOCAL GROUPS :", localGroups);
console.log("TOTAL LOCALS  :", localTypes.length);
console.log("INSTRUCTION START :", hex(x));
