/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Conservative instruction decoder
 *
 * We only need enough decoding to identify:
 *   local.get
 *   local.set
 *   local.tee
 *   i32.const
 *   i32.add
 *   i32.sub
 *   i32.load
 *   i32.store
 *   call
 *   call_indirect
 *   branches
 *
 * Unknown instructions are printed but do not terminate the
 * entire function. For every target store we also preserve
 * raw bytes.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function decodeOne(pos) {
  const start = pos;
  const op = buf[pos++];

  const ins = {
    start,
    end: pos,
    op,
    text: "unknown"
  };

  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;

    const name =
      op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
      op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
      "local.tee";

    ins.text = `${name} local=${a.value}`;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const a = sleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;
    ins.value = a.value;
    ins.text = `i32.const ${a.value}`;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x42) {
    const a = sleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;
    ins.value = a.value;
    ins.text = `i64.const ${a.value}`;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;
    ins.text = `call ${a.value}`;
    ins.callTarget = a.value;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.text = `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;

    ins.text =
      `${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"} ${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x0e) {
    const n = uleb(pos);
    if (!n) return null;

    pos = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
      const a = uleb(pos);
      if (!a) return null;
      pos = a.next;
    }

    ins.end = pos;
    ins.text = "br_table";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    if (pos >= target.bodyEnd) return null;

    /*
     * blocktype can be one byte for the forms expected here.
     */
    pos++;

    ins.end = pos;

    ins.text =
      op === 0x02 ? "block" :
      op === 0x03 ? "loop" :
      "if";

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x05) {
    ins.text = "else";
    ins.end = pos;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    ins.text = "end";
    ins.end = pos;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x0f) {
    ins.text = "return";
    ins.end = pos;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x28) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.text = `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x29) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.text = `i64.load align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x2c) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.text = `i32.load8_s align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x2d) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.text = `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x36) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.text = `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
    ins.isStore = true;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x37) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.text = `i64.store align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
    ins.isStore = true;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x3a) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.text = `i32.store8 align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
    ins.isStore = true;
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x3b) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.text = `i32.store16 align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;
    ins.isStore = true;
    return ins;
  }

  const simple = {
    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x67: "i32.clz",
    0x71: "i32.and",
    0x72: "i32.or",
    0x73: "i32.xor",
    0x74: "i32.shl",
    0x75: "i32.shr_s",
    0x76: "i32.shr_u",
    0x1b: "select",
    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x48: "i32.lt_s",
    0x49: "i32.lt_u",
    0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
    0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
    0x4c: "i32.le_s",
    0x4d: "i32.le_u",
    0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
    0x4f: "i32.ge_u"
  };

  if (simple[op]) {
    ins.end = pos;
    ins.text = simple[op];
    return ins;
  }

  /*
   * Other common no-immediate instructions.
   */
  if (
    (op >= 0x1a && op <= 0x1c) ||
    (op >= 0x45 && op <= 0xc4)
  ) {
    ins.end = pos;
    ins.text = `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`;
    return ins;
  }

  /*
   * Unknown opcode: consume only opcode.
   */
  ins.end = pos;
  ins.text = `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`;

  return ins;
}

/*
 * Decode function.
 */
const instructions = [];

x = x;

while (x < target.bodyEnd) {
  const ins = decodeOne(x);

  if (!ins) {
    console.log("DECODER FAILURE @", hex(x));
    break;
  }

  instructions.push(ins);
  x = ins.end;
}

/*

 * Target stores
 * ------------------------------------------------------------

const stores = instructions.filter(
  i => i.isStore &&
       (i.offset === 0 || i.offset === 4 || i.offset === 36)
);

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET STORES");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log("TOTAL +0/+4/+36 :", stores.length);

for (const s of stores) {
  console.log("");
  console.log(
    hex(s.start),
    s.text
  );

  const idx = instructions.indexOf(s);

  const from = Math.max(0, idx - 8);
  const to = Math.min(instructions.length, idx + 2);

  console.log("CONTEXT:");

  for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {

    console.log(

    );
  }

  const rawFrom = Math.max(target.bodyStart, s.start - 24);
  const rawTo = Math.min(target.bodyEnd, s.end + 8);

    readBytes(rawFrom, rawTo)
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readU32LE(b: Buffer, p: number): number {
    return b.readUInt32LE(p);
}

function readULEB(b: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
    }
}

function hex(b: Buffer, start: number, end: number): string {
    return b.subarray(start, end).toString("hex").match(/.{1,2}/g)?.join(" ") ?? "";
}

function readSections(b: Buffer) {
    let p = 8;
    const sections: {
        id: number;
        payload: number;
        size: number;
        end: number;
    }[] = [];

    while (p < b.length) {
        const id = b[p++];
        const s = readULEB(b, p);
        p = s.next;

        const payload = p;
        const end = payload + s.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            payload,
            size: s.value,
            end,
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function getSection(
    sections: ReturnType<typeof readSections>,
    id: number
) {
    const s = sections.find(x => x.id === id);
    if (!s) throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
    return s;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(b: Buffer, typeSection: ReturnType<typeof getSection>) {
    let p = typeSection.payload;

    const count = readULEB(b, p);
    p = count.next;

    const types: {
        params: number[];
        results: number[];
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const form = b[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected type form 0x${form.toString(16)}`);
        }

        const pc = readULEB(b, p);
        p = pc.next;

        const params = [...b.subarray(p, p + pc.value)];
        p += pc.value;

        const rc = readULEB(b, p);
        p = rc.next;

        const results = [...b.subarray(p, p + rc.value)];
        p += rc.value;

        types.push({ params, results });
    }

    return types;
}

function parseImportFunctionCount(
    b: Buffer,
    importSection: ReturnType<typeof getSection>
) {
    let p = importSection.payload;

    const count = readULEB(b, p);
    p = count.next;

    let functions = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const ml = readULEB(b, p);
        p = ml.next + ml.value;

        const nl = readULEB(b, p);
        p = nl.next + nl.value;

        const kind = b[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const t = readULEB(b, p);
            p = t.next;
            functions++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
            p += 4;
            const limits = b[p - 1];

            if (limits & 1) {
                const a = readULEB(b, p);
                p = a.next;

                const m = readULEB(b, p);
                p = m.next;
            } else {
                const a = readULEB(b, p);
                p = a.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 2) {
            const flags = b[p++];

            const a = readULEB(b, p);
            p = a.next;

            if (flags & 1) {
                const m = readULEB(b, p);
                p = m.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;
        } else if (kind === 4) {
            const a = readULEB(b, p);
            p = a.next;
            const b2 = readULEB(b, p);
            p = b2.next;
        }
    }

    return functions;
}

function parseFunctionTypeIndices(
    b: Buffer,
    functionSection: ReturnType<typeof getSection>
) {
    let p = functionSection.payload;

    const count = readULEB(b, p);
    p = count.next;

    const types: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const x = readULEB(b, p);
        p = x.next;
        types.push(x.value);
    }

    return types;
}

function parseCodeBodies(
    b: Buffer,
    codeSection: ReturnType<typeof getSection>
) {
    let p = codeSection.payload;

    const count = readULEB(b, p);
    p = count.next;

    const bodies: {
        start: number;
        codeStart: number;
        end: number;
        size: number;
        bytes: Buffer;
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const sizePos = p;

        const s = readULEB(b, p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = sizePos;
        const end = p + s.value;

        const localCount = readULEB(b, p);
        p = localCount.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localCount.value; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(b, p);
            p = n.next;
            p += 1;
        }

        const codeStart = p;

        bodies.push({
            start,
            codeStart,
            end,
            size: s.value,
            bytes: b.subarray(start, end),
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function readI32Const(b: Buffer, p: number) {
    const x = readULEB(b, p);
    return {
        value: x.value | 0,
        next: x.next,
    };
}

function scanCalls(body: Buffer, codeStart: number) {
    const calls: {
        offset: number;
        target: number;
    }[] = [];

    /*
     * For this first pass we only report CALL opcodes.
     * The immediate following CALL index is decoded as ULEB.
     *
     * We also print the surrounding bytes so any ambiguous
     * occurrence can be checked directly against the body.
     */
    for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
        if (body[i] !== 0x10) continue;

        try {
            const x = readULEB(body, i + 1);

            calls.push({
                offset: codeStart + i,
                target: x.value,
            });
        } catch {
            // ignore malformed candidate
        }
    }

    return calls;
}

function scanI32Consts(body: Buffer, codeStart: number) {
    const out: {
        offset: number;
        value: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
        if (body[i] !== 0x41) continue;

        try {
            const x = readI32Const(body, i + 1);

            out.push({
                offset: codeStart + i,
                value: x.value,
            });
        } catch {
            // ignore
        }
    }

    return out;
}

function inspectFunction(
    realIndex: number,
    importedFunctions: number,
    typeIndices: number[],
    bodies: ReturnType<typeof parseCodeBodies>,
    types: ReturnType<typeof parseFunctionTypes>
) {
    const bodyIndex = realIndex - importedFunctions;

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(` FUNCTION ${realIndex}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(`real function index : ${realIndex}`);
    console.log(`body index          : ${bodyIndex}`);

    if (bodyIndex < 0 || bodyIndex >= bodies.length) {
        console.log("ERROR: body index outside code section");
        return;
    }

    const typeIndex = typeIndices[bodyIndex];
    console.log(`type index           : ${typeIndex}`);

    if (types[typeIndex]) {
        console.log(`params               : ${types[typeIndex].params.length}`);
        console.log(`results              : ${types[typeIndex].results.length}`);
    }

    const body = bodies[bodyIndex];

    console.log(`body start           : 0x${body.start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`);
    console.log(`code start           : 0x${body.codeStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`);
    console.log(`body end             : 0x${body.end.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`);
    console.log(`body size            : ${body.size}`);

    console.log("");
    console.log("I32.CONST");

    const constants = scanI32Consts(
        body.bytes.subarray(body.codeStart - body.start),
        body.codeStart
    );

    for (const c of constants) {
        console.log(
            `  @0x${c.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} → ` +
            `${c.value} (0x${(c.value >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0")})`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("CALL CANDIDATES");

    const calls = scanCalls(
        body.bytes.subarray(body.codeStart - body.start),
        body.codeStart
    );

    for (const c of calls) {
        console.log(
            `  @0x${c.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} → function ${c.target}`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("BODY HEX");

    const code = body.bytes.subarray(body.codeStart - body.start);
    console.log(hex(code, 0, code.length));
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;

        shift += 0;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function section(id: number) {

    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {

        const sid = wasm[p++];

        const size = uleb(p);
        p = size.next;

        if (sid === id) {
            return {
                start: p,
                end: p + size.value
            };
        }

        p += size.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_IMPORT = 23;

function u32leb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function readName(pos: number) {
    const r = u32leb(pos);
    const start = r.next;
    const end = start + r.value;

    return {
        text: buf.subarray(start, end).toString("utf8"),
        next: end,
    };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

let importEnd = -1;

while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p];

    const sizeInfo = u32leb(p + 1);

    const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sizeInfo.value;

    if (id === 2) {
        importStart = payloadStart;
        importEnd = payloadEnd;
        break;
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
}

if (importStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("IMPORT SECTION NOT FOUND");

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const module = readName(q);
    q = module.next;

    q = name.next;

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 3;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function readString(p) {
  const x = uleb(p);

  const start = x.next;
  const end = start + x.value;

  return {
    value: Buffer.from(bytes.subarray(start, end)).toString("utf8"),
    next: end
  };
}

function findImportSection() {

  let p = 8;

  while (p < bytes.length) {

    const id = bytes[p++];

    const len = uleb(p);
    p = len.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + len.value;

    if (id === 2)
      return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("Import section not found");
}

function inspect() {

  const sec = findImportSection();

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  let functionIndex = 0;

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("IMPORT FUNCTION INSPECTOR");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`WASM SIZE : ${bytes.length.toLocaleString()}`);
  console.log(`TARGET    : Function ${TARGET}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const mod = readString(p);
    p = mod.next;

    const name = readString(p);
    p = name.next;

    const kind = bytes[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {

      const type = uleb(p);
      p = type.next;

      console.log(
        `IMPORT #${functionIndex}  module=${mod.value}  name=${name.value}  type=${type.value}`
      );

      if (functionIndex === TARGET) {

        console.log("");
        console.log("TARGET FOUND");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(`FUNCTION : ${functionIndex}`);
        console.log(`MODULE   : ${mod.value}`);
        console.log(`NAME     : ${name.value}`);
        console.log(`TYPE     : ${type.value}`);
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
        console.log("END");
        console.log("============================================================");

        return;
      }

      functionIndex++;
    }

    else if (kind === 1) {

      p++;

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      let x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 2) {

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      let x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 3) {

      p += 2;
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Imported Function ${TARGET} not found`
  );
}

inspect();

import fs from 'node:fs';

const file =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;
const TARGET_FUNCTION = 96;
const TARGET_CALL = 3;
const CONTEXT = 10;

function hex(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function uleb(p, end = wasm.length) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < end) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value, next: p };

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('Invalid ULEB at ' + hex(p));
    }

    throw new Error('Unexpected EOF at ' + hex(p));
}

function sleb(p, end) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;

    do {
        if (p >= end) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF at ' + hex(p));
        b = wasm[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('Invalid SLEB at ' + hex(p));
    } while (b & 0x80);

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) value -= 2 ** shift;

    return { value, next: p };
}

function bytes(a, b) {
    return [...wasm.subarray(a, b)]
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' ');
}

function readSection(idWanted) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];
        const size = uleb(p);
        const start = size.next;
        const end = start + size.value;

        if (end > wasm.length) throw new Error('Invalid section bounds');

        if (id === idWanted) return { start, end };
        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error('Section not found: ' + idWanted);
}

const code = readSection(10);
const count = uleb(code.start, code.end);
let p = count.next;
const bodies = new Map();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const size = uleb(p, code.end);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (end > code.end) throw new Error('Invalid body ' + ordinal);

    bodies.set(IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + ordinal, { start, end });
    p = end;
}

const body = bodies.get(TARGET_FUNCTION);
if (!body) throw new Error('Function body not found');

const names = {
    0x00: 'unreachable', 0x01: 'nop',
    0x02: 'block', 0x03: 'loop', 0x04: 'if',
    0x05: 'else', 0x0b: 'end',
    0x0c: 'br', 0x0d: 'br_if', 0x0e: 'br_table',
    0x0f: 'return', 0x10: 'call', 0x11: 'call_indirect',
    0x1a: 'drop', 0x1b: 'select',
    0x20: 'local.get', 0x21: 'local.set', 0x22: 'local.tee',
    0x23: 'global.get', 0x24: 'global.set',
    0x28: 'i32.load', 0x29: 'i64.load',
    0x2a: 'f32.load', 0x2b: 'f64.load',
    0x36: 'i32.store', 0x37: 'i64.store',
    0x3f: 'memory.size', 0x40: 'memory.grow',
    0x41: 'i32.const', 0x42: 'i64.const',
    0x43: 'f32.const', 0x44: 'f64.const',
    0x45: 'i32.eqz', 0x46: 'i32.eq',
    0x47: 'i32.ne', 0x48: 'i32.lt_s',
    0x49: 'i32.lt_u', 0x4a: 'i32.gt_s',
    0x4b: 'i32.gt_u', 0x4c: 'i32.le_s',
    0x4d: 'i32.le_u', 0x4e: 'i32.ge_s',
    0x4f: 'i32.ge_u',
    0x6a: 'i32.add', 0x6b: 'i32.sub',
    0x6c: 'i32.mul', 0x71: 'i32.and',
    0x72: 'i32.or', 0x73: 'i32.xor',
    0x74: 'i32.shl', 0x75: 'i32.shr_s',
    0x76: 'i32.shr_u'
};

const memoryOps = new Set([
    0x28, 0x29, 0x2a, 0x2b, 0x36, 0x37
]);

let q = body.start;
const localGroups = uleb(q, body.end);
q = localGroups.next;

for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(q, body.end);
    q = n.next + 1;
    if (q > body.end) throw new Error('Invalid local declaration');
}

const instructions = [];

while (q < body.end) {
    const start = q;
    const op = wasm[q++];
    let text = names[op];

    
    if (op === 0xfc) {
        const sub = uleb(q, body.end);
        q = sub.next;

        const fcNames = {
            0: 'i32.trunc_sat_f32_s',
            1: 'i32.trunc_sat_f32_u',
            2: 'i32.trunc_sat_f64_s',
            3: 'i32.trunc_sat_f64_u',
            4: 'i64.trunc_sat_f32_s',
            5: 'i64.trunc_sat_f32_u',
            6: 'i64.trunc_sat_f64_s',
            7: 'i64.trunc_sat_f64_u',
            8: 'memory.init',
            9: 'data.drop',
            10: 'memory.copy',
            11: 'memory.fill',
            12: 'table.init',
            13: 'elem.drop',
            14: 'table.copy',
            15: 'table.grow',
            16: 'table.size',
            17: 'table.fill'
        };

        text = `0xfc.${sub.value} ${fcNames[sub.value] ?? 'unknown'}`;

        const readImm = () => {
            const v = uleb(q, body.end);
            q = v.next;
            return v.value;
        };

        if ([8, 10, 12, 14].includes(sub.value)) {
            text += ` ${readImm()} ${readImm()}`;
        } else if ([9, 11, 13, 15, 16, 17].includes(sub.value)) {
            text += ` ${readImm()}`;
        } else if (sub.value > 17) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unsupported 0xfc subopcode ${sub.value} at ${hex(start)}`
            );
        }
    } else if (text === undefined) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported opcode 0x${op.toString(16)} at ${hex(start)}`
        );
    }


    if ([0x02, 0x03, 0x04].includes(op)) {
        const bt = wasm[q++];
        text += bt === 0x40 ? ' void' : ` blocktype=0x${bt.toString(16)}`;
    } else if (
        [0x0c, 0x0d, 0x10, 0x20, 0x21, 0x22, 0x23, 0x24].includes(op)
    ) {
        const imm = uleb(q, body.end);
        q = imm.next;
        text += ' ' + imm.value;
    } else if (op === 0x11) {
        const t = uleb(q, body.end);
        const table = uleb(t.next, body.end);
        q = table.next;
        text += ` type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`;
    } else if (memoryOps.has(op)) {
        const align = uleb(q, body.end);
        const offset = uleb(align.next, body.end);
        q = offset.next;
        text += ` align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
    } else if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
        const mem = uleb(q, body.end);
        q = mem.next;
        text += ` memory=${mem.value}`;
    } else if (op === 0x41) {
        const imm = sleb(q, body.end);
        q = imm.next;
        text += ` ${imm.value} (${hex(imm.value >>> 0)})`;
    } else if (op === 0x42) {
        const imm = sleb(q, body.end);
        q = imm.next;
        text += ` ${imm.value}`;
    } else if (op === 0x43) {
        text += ` bytes=${bytes(q, q + 4)}`;
        q += 4;
    } else if (op === 0x44) {
        text += ` bytes=${bytes(q, q + 8)}`;
        q += 8;
    }

    if (q > body.end) throw new Error('Instruction exceeds body at ' + hex(start));

    instructions.push({
        start,
        end: q,
        text,
        raw: bytes(start, q)
    });

    if (op === 0x0b && q === body.end) break;
}

console.log('FUNCTION:', TARGET_FUNCTION);

const matches = [];

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readString(buf: Buffer, pos: number) {
    const len = readULEB(buf, pos);
    const start = len.next;
    const end = start + len.value;

    return {
        value: buf.subarray(start, end).toString("utf8"),
        next: end,
    };
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_IMPORT = 66;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32LEB(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p.v++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return result;
}

function readName(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): string {
    const len = readU32LEB(buf, p);

    const s = buf
        .subarray(p.v, p.v + len)
        .toString("utf8");

    p.v += len;

    return s;
}

function typeName(b: number): string {
    switch (b) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        case 0x7b: return "v128";
        case 0x70: return "funcref";
        case 0x6f: return "externref";
        default:
            return `0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }
}

interface FuncType {
    params: string[];
    results: string[];
}

/* ============================================================
   FIND SECTIONS
   ============================================================ */

const sections: {
    id: number;
    payloadStart: number;
    payloadEnd: number;
}[] = [];

let pos = 8;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];

    const p = { v: pos };
    const size = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

    const payloadStart = p.v;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + size;

    sections.push({
        id,
        payloadStart,
        payloadEnd,
    });

    pos = payloadEnd;
}

/* ============================================================
   TYPE SECTION
   ============================================================ */

const typeSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 1);

if (!typeSection) {
    throw new Error("Type section not found");
}

const types: FuncType[] = [];

{
    const p = { v: typeSection.payloadStart };

    const count = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const form = wasm[p.v++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unsupported type form at ${i}: 0x${form.toString(16)}`
            );
        }

        const paramCount = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

        const params: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
            params.push(typeName(wasm[p.v++]));
        }

        const resultCount = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

        const results: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
            results.push(typeName(wasm[p.v++]));
        }

        types.push({
            params,
            results,
        });
    }
}

/* ============================================================
   IMPORT SECTION
   ============================================================ */

const importSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 2);

if (!importSection) {
    throw new Error("Import section not found");
}

const p = { v: importSection.payloadStart };

const importCount = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

let functionImportIndex = 0;

let targetTypeIndex = -1;
let targetModule = "";
let targetName = "";

for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {
    const moduleName = readName(wasm, p);
    const fieldName = readName(wasm, p);

    const kind = wasm[p.v++];

    if (kind === 0x00) {
        const typeIndex = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

        if (functionImportIndex === TARGET_IMPORT) {
            targetTypeIndex = typeIndex;
            targetModule = moduleName;
            targetName = fieldName;
        }

        functionImportIndex++;

    } else if (kind === 0x01) {
        /*
         * table
         */
        p.v++; // elem type

        const flags = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

        readU32LEB(wasm, p);

        if (flags & 1) {
            readU32LEB(wasm, p);
        }

    } else if (kind === 0x02) {
        /*
         * memory
         */
        const flags = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

        readU32LEB(wasm, p);

        if (flags & 1) {
            readU32LEB(wasm, p);
        }

    } else if (kind === 0x03) {
        /*
         * global
         */
        p.v += 2;

    } else {
        throw new Error(
            `Unknown import kind: 0x${kind.toString(16)}`
        );
    }
}

   RESULT
   ============================================================ */

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 65;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function str(pos) {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  const start = n.next;
  const end = start + n.value;

  return {
    value: new TextDecoder().decode(b.slice(start, end)),
    next: end
  };
}

function findImportSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {

    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    if (id === 2) {
      return {
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
      };
    }

    p += s.value;
  }

  throw new Error("IMPORT section not found");
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 91;
const TARGET_TABLE = 4790;
const TARGET_TYPE = 6;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32Leb(buf: Buffer, pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) throw new Error(`ULEB too large @ 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
  }

  throw new Error("Unexpected EOF in ULEB");
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionStart = p;
    const sid = wasm[p++];

    const s = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    const size = s.value;
    p = s.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + size;

    if (sid === id) {
      return {
        sectionStart,
        payloadStart,
        payloadEnd,
        size,
      };
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
}

function readVectorCount(start: number) {
  return readU32Leb(wasm, start);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const importSection = findSection(2);
const functionSection = findSection(3);
const codeSection = findSection(10);

console.log("INSPECT INDIRECT TABLE[4790]");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET TABLE = ${TARGET_TABLE}`);
console.log(`TARGET FUNC  = ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log(`TARGET TYPE  = ${TARGET_TYPE}`);
console.log();

let p = importSection.payloadStart;

let r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
const importCount = r.value;
p = r.next;

let importedFunctions = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {
  // module name
  r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
  const moduleLen = r.value;
  p = r.next + moduleLen;

  // field name
  r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
  const fieldLen = r.value;
  p = r.next + fieldLen;

  const kind = wasm[p++];

  if (kind === 0) {
    importedFunctions++;

    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = r.next;
  } else if (kind === 1) {
    // table
    p += 1;

    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = r.next;

    const flags = wasm[p - 1];

    if (flags & 1) {
      r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
      p = r.next;
    }

    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = r.next;
  } else if (kind === 2) {
    // memory
    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    const flags = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = r.next;

    if (flags & 1) {
      r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
      p = r.next;
    }
  } else if (kind === 3) {
    // global
    p += 2;
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind}`);
  }
}

console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${importedFunctions}`);
console.log(`FUNCTION SECTION   = 0x${hex(functionSection.payloadStart)} .. 0x${hex(functionSection.payloadEnd)}`);
console.log(`CODE SECTION        = 0x${hex(codeSection.payloadStart)} .. 0x${hex(codeSection.payloadEnd)}`);
console.log();

if (definedOrdinal < 0 || definedOrdinal >= definedCount) {
  throw new Error(`Invalid defined ordinal ${definedOrdinal}`);
}

let targetType = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++) {
  r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);

  if (i === definedOrdinal) {
    targetType = r.value;
  }

  p = r.next;
}

console.log("TARGET FUNCTION MAPPING");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC      = ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log(`DEFINED ORDINAL  = ${definedOrdinal}`);
console.log(`TYPE INDEX       = ${targetType}`);
console.log();

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE BODIES
// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = codeSection.payloadStart;

r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
const bodyCount = r.value;
p = r.next;

if (bodyCount !== definedCount) {
  throw new Error(
    `FUNCTION/CODE count mismatch: ${definedCount} vs ${bodyCount}`
  );
}

let targetBodyStart = -1;
let targetBodyEnd = -1;
let targetBodySize = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {
  const bodySizePos = p;

  r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
  const bodySize = r.value;
  p = r.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

  if (i === definedOrdinal) {
    targetBodyStart = bodyStart;
    targetBodyEnd = bodyEnd;
    targetBodySize = bodySize;
  }

  p = bodyEnd;

  const chunk = body.subarray(i, Math.min(i + 16, body.length));

  const bytes = [...chunk]
    .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");

  console.log(
    `+0x${i.toString(16).padStart(4, "0")}  ` +

  );
}

// We only recognize enough opcodes to locate call_indirect.
// We DO NOT attempt to fully decode the WASM here.
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("CALL_INDIRECT TYPE-6 CANDIDATES");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let found = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
  if (body[i] !== 0x11) continue;

  let q = i + 1;

  try {
    const typeRead = readU32Leb(body, q);
    q = typeRead.next;

    const tableRead = readU32Leb(body, q);

    if (typeRead.value === TARGET_TYPE) {
      found++;

      console.log(
        `MATCH #${found}: ` +
        `body+0x${i.toString(16).padStart(4, "0")} ` +
        `ABS=0x${hex(targetBodyStart + i)} ` +
        `type=${typeRead.value} ` +
        `table=${tableRead.value}`
      );

      const from = Math.max(0, i - 24);
      const to = Math.min(body.length, q + 8);

      console.log("  CONTEXT:");

      for (let j = from; j < to; j++) {
        const mark = j === i ? " <-- call_indirect" : "";

        console.log(
          `    +0x${j.toString(16).padStart(4, "0")} ` +
          `0x${hex(targetBodyStart + j)} ` +
          `${body[j].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}${mark}`
        );
      }

      console.log();
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore bytes that are not safely decodable as call_indirect immediates.
  }
}

console.log(`TOTAL TYPE-6 CANDIDATES = ${found}`);
console.log();

import { readFileSync } from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_INDEX = 7969;

type Instr = {
    offset: number;
    op: number;
    name: string;
    args?: any;
};

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        next: p,
    };
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number, bits = 32) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = buf[p++];

        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < bits && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: p,
    };
}

function nameOf(op: number) {
    const m: Record<number, string> = {
        0x0b: "end",
        0x10: "call",
        0x11: "call_indirect",

        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",
        0x3a: "i32.store8",
        0x3b: "i32.store16",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",
        0x48: "i32.lt_s",
        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",
        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",
        0x74: "i32.shl",
        0x75: "i32.shr_s",
        0x76: "i32.shr_u",
    };

    return m[op] ??
        `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function decodeBody(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
): Instr[] {
    const out: Instr[] = [];

    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const offset = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        let args: any = undefined;

        if (
            op === 0x20 ||
            op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22
        ) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, p);

            args = {
                local: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (
            op === 0x23 ||
            op === 0x24
        ) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, p);

            args = {
                global: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (
            op === 0x28 ||
            op === 0x29 ||
            op === 0x2c ||
            op === 0x2d ||
            op === 0x2e ||
            op === 0x2f ||
            op === 0x36 ||
            op === 0x37 ||
            op === 0x3a ||
            op === 0x3b
        ) {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const b = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            args = {
                align: a.value,
                offset: b.value,
            };

            p = b.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = readSLEB(buf, p, 32);

            args = {
                value: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x42) {
            const r = readSLEB(buf, p, 64);

            args = {
                value: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, p);

            args = {
                func: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x11) {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const b = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            args = {
                type: a.value,
                table: b.value,
            };

            p = b.next;
        }

        out.push({
            offset,
            op,
            name: nameOf(op),
            args,
        });

        if (op === 0x0b) break;
    }

    return out;
}

function readBodies(buf: Buffer) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const s = readULEB(buf, p);
        const size = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const payload = p;
        const end = payload + size;

        if (id === 10) {
            let q = payload;

            const countInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
            const count = countInfo.value;
            q = countInfo.next;

            const bodies: any[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
                const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
                q = sizeInfo.next;

                const bodyStart = q;
                const bodyEnd = q + bodySize;

                let x = bodyStart;

                const localInfo = readULEB(buf, x);
                const localCount = localInfo.value;
                x = localInfo.next;

                for (let j = 0; j < localCount; j++) {
                    const n = readULEB(buf, x);
                    x = n.next;

                    x++;
                }

                bodies.push({
                    func: 83 + i,
                    instrStart: x,
                    instrEnd: bodyEnd,
                });

                q = bodyEnd;
            }

            if (q !== end) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Code mismatch: 0x${q.toString(16)} != 0x${end.toString(16)}`
                );
            }

            return bodies;
        }

        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error("Code section not found.");
}

function fmt(i: Instr) {
    let s =
        `0x${i.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
        i.name;

    if (!i.args) return s;

    if (
        i.name === "local.get" ||
        i.name === "local.set" ||
        i.name === "local.tee"
    ) {
        s += ` ${i.args.local}`;
    }

    else if (i.name === "call") {
        s += ` ${i.args.func}`;
    }

    else if (
        i.name === "i32.const" ||
        i.name === "i64.const"
    ) {
        s += ` ${i.args.value}`;
    }

    else if (i.name === "call_indirect") {
        s +=
            ` type=${i.args.type}` +
            ` table=${i.args.table}`;
    }

    else if (
        i.name === "i32.load" ||
        i.name === "i64.load" ||
        i.name === "i32.load8_s" ||
        i.name === "i32.load8_u" ||
        i.name === "i32.load16_s" ||
        i.name === "i32.load16_u"
    ) {
        s +=
            ` align=${i.args.align}` +
            ` offset=${i.args.offset}`;
    }

    return s;
}

export async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" INSPECT ALL TYPE0/TABLE0 INDIRECT DISPATCHES");
    console.log(" TARGET TABLE INDEX = 7969");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("");

    const wasm = readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

    console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length}`);
    console.log(`Target    : ${TARGET_INDEX}`);
    console.log("");

    const bodies = readBodies(wasm);

    let n = 0;

    for (const body of bodies) {
        const instr = decodeBody(
            wasm,
            body.instrStart,
            body.instrEnd
        );

        for (let i = 0; i < instr.length; i++) {
            const x = instr[i];

            if (
                x.name !== "call_indirect" ||
                x.args?.type !== 0 ||
                x.args?.table !== 0
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            n++;

            console.log("============================================================");
            console.log(`DISPATCH #${n}`);
            console.log("============================================================");

            console.log(
                `Function : ${body.func}`
            );

            console.log(
                `Offset   : 0x${x.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
            );

            console.log("");

            /*
             * Show a wider producer window.
             *
             * We deliberately do NOT claim this proves the value.
             * It only identifies the immediate computation feeding
             * the indirect call.
             */

            const from = Math.max(0, i - 14);

            for (let j = from; j <= i; j++) {
                console.log(
                    (j === i ? ">>> " : "    ") +
                    fmt(instr[j])
                );
            }

            console.log("");

            /*
             * Look for especially interesting instructions.
             */

            const window =
                instr.slice(from, i);

            const interesting = window.filter(
                z =>
                    z.name === "i32.const" ||
                    z.name === "i32.load" ||
                    z.name === "i32.load8_u" ||
                    z.name === "i32.load8_s" ||
                    z.name === "i32.load16_u" ||
                    z.name === "i32.load16_s" ||
                    z.name === "local.get" ||
                    z.name === "call" ||
                    z.name === "i32.add" ||
                    z.name === "i32.sub" ||
                    z.name === "i32.mul"
            );

            console.log("PRODUCER CANDIDATES:");

            if (interesting.length === 0) {
                console.log("  none");
            } else {
                for (const z of interesting) {
                    console.log(
                        `  ${fmt(z)}`
                    );
                }
            }

            console.log("");

            /*
             * Exact 7969 nearby.
             */

            const exact = window.filter(
                z =>
                    z.name === "i32.const" &&
                    z.args?.value === TARGET_INDEX
            );

            console.log(
                `Nearby CONST(7969) : ${exact.length}`
            );

            console.log("");
        }
    }

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SUMMARY");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(
        `Type0/table0 dispatches inspected : ${n}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Target table index                : ${TARGET_INDEX}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Target function                   : 4815`
    );

    console.log("");

    console.log(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    );

    console.log(
        "This report identifies candidate producer paths."
    );

    console.log(
        "It does not yet prove runtime index = 7969."
    );

    console.log(
        "The next step is to dataflow the strongest candidates."
    );
}

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const FILE = path.resolve(
  process.cwd(),
  "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS_EXPECTED = 83;
const TARGETS = [4095, 4096, 4097, 4098, 4099, 4100, 4101, 4102, 4103, 4104, 4105, 4106, 4107, 4108, 4109, 4110, 4111, 4112, 4113, 4114, 4115];

function uleb(buf, s) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (s.pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[s.pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) return value;
    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 49) {
      throw new Error("Invalid ULEB");
    }
  }

  throw new Error("Unexpected EOF reading ULEB");
}

function sleb(buf, s) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  do {
    if (s.pos >= buf.length) throw new Error("Unexpected EOF reading SLEB");
    b = buf[s.pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (b & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return value;
}

function readName(buf, s) {
  const len = uleb(buf, s);
  const end = s.pos + len;

  if (end > buf.length) throw new Error("Invalid name length");

  const value = buf.toString("utf8", s.pos, end);
  s.pos = end;
  return value;
}

function valueType(t) {
  const names = {
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64",
    0x7b: "v128",
    0x70: "funcref",
    0x6f: "externref"
  };

  return names[t] ?? `type_0x${t.toString(16)}`;
}

function parseSections(buf) {
  const sections = new Map();
  const s = { pos: 8 };

  while (s.pos < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[s.pos++];
    const size = uleb(buf, s);
    const start = s.pos;
    const end = start + size;

    if (end > buf.length) throw new Error("Section exceeds file");

    sections.set(id, { start, end, size });
    s.pos = end;
  }

  return sections;
}

function parseTypes(buf, section) {
  if (!section) return [];

  const s = { pos: section.start };
  const count = uleb(buf, s);
  const types = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const form = buf[s.pos++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      throw new Error(
        `Unsupported function type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at ${s.pos - 1}`
      );
    }

    const paramCount = uleb(buf, s);
    const params = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
      params.push(valueType(buf[s.pos++]));
    }

    const resultCount = uleb(buf, s);
    const results = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
      results.push(valueType(buf[s.pos++]));
    }

    types.push({ params, results });
  }

  return types;
}

function parseImportedFunctionTypes(buf, section) {
  if (!section) return [];

  const s = { pos: section.start };
  const count = uleb(buf, s);
  const functionTypes = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    readName(buf, s);
    readName(buf, s);

    const kind = buf[s.pos++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      functionTypes.push(uleb(buf, s));
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      s.pos++; // element type
      const flags = uleb(buf, s);
      uleb(buf, s); // minimum
      if (flags & 1) uleb(buf, s); // maximum
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = uleb(buf, s);
      uleb(buf, s); // minimum
      if (flags & 1) uleb(buf, s); // maximum
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      s.pos += 2; // value type and mutability
    } else if (kind === 4) {
      uleb(buf, s); // tag attribute
      uleb(buf, s); // tag type index
    } else {
      throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind}`);
    }
  }

  return functionTypes;
}

function parseDefinedFunctionTypes(buf, section) {
  if (!section) return [];

  const s = { pos: section.start };
  const count = uleb(buf, s);
  const indices = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    indices.push(uleb(buf, s));
  }

  return indices;
}

function parseBodies(buf, section, importedCount) {
  if (!section) return [];

  const s = { pos: section.start };
  const count = uleb(buf, s);
  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const bodySize = uleb(buf, s);
    const start = s.pos;
    const end = start + bodySize;

    if (end > section.end) throw new Error("Function body exceeds code section");

    bodies.push({
      fn: importedCount + i,
      start,
      end,
      size: bodySize
    });

    s.pos = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function dumpBytes(buf, start, end) {
  for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
    const q = Math.min(p + 16, end);
    const bytes = [];

    for (let i = p; i < q; i++) {
      bytes.push(buf[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
    }

    console.log(
      `0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
    );
  }
}

function main() {
  const buf = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

  if (
    buf.subarray(0, 4).toString("hex") !== "0061736d"
  ) {
    throw new Error("File does not have a WASM magic header");
  }

  const sections = parseSections(buf);
  const types = parseTypes(buf, sections.get(1));
  const importedTypes = parseImportedFunctionTypes(buf, sections.get(2));
  const definedTypes = parseDefinedFunctionTypes(buf, sections.get(3));
  const bodies = parseBodies(buf, sections.get(10), importedTypes.length);

  const allTypes = [...importedTypes, ...definedTypes];
  const bodyByFunction = new Map(bodies.map(b => [b.fn, b]));

  console.log("INDIRECT CALL FUNCTION INSPECTION");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`FILE SIZE = ${buf.length}`);
  console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${importedTypes.length}`);
  console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS = ${definedTypes.length}`);
  console.log(`TOTAL FUNCTION BODIES = ${bodies.length}`);
  console.log(`TYPE COUNT = ${types.length}`);
  console.log("");

  if (importedTypes.length !== IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS_EXPECTED) {
    console.log(
      `WARNING: expected ${IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS_EXPECTED} imports, found ${importedTypes.length}`
    );
    console.log("");
  }

  for (const fn of TARGETS) {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`GLOBAL FUNCTION ${fn}`);

    const typeIndex = allTypes[fn];

    if (typeIndex === undefined) {
      console.log("TYPE INDEX NOT FOUND");
    } else {
      const t = types[typeIndex];

      console.log(`TYPE INDEX = ${typeIndex}`);

      if (t) {
        console.log(`PARAMETERS = (${t.params.join(", ")})`);
        console.log(`RESULTS = (${t.results.join(", ")})`);
      } else {
        console.log("TYPE SIGNATURE NOT FOUND");
      }
    }

    const body = bodyByFunction.get(fn);

    if (!body) {
      console.log("NO DEFINED FUNCTION BODY");
      console.log("");
      continue;
    }

    console.log(`BODY START = 0x${body.start.toString(16)}`);
    console.log(`BODY END   = 0x${body.end.toString(16)}`);
    console.log(`BODY SIZE  = ${body.size}`);
    console.log("RAW BODY:");
    dumpBytes(buf, body.start, body.end);
    console.log("");
  }

  console.log("DONE - NO WASM EXECUTION");
}

try {
  main();
} catch (error) {
  console.error("FAILED:", error);
  process.exitCode = 1;
}

FILE: scripts\inspectIndirectTarget.mjs

import fs from 'node:fs';

const file = 'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);
const TARGET = 2034;
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

function uleb(p, limit = wasm.length) {
    let value = 0, shift = 0;
    while (p < limit) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value += (b & 127) * 2 ** shift;
        if (!(b & 128)) return { value, next: p };
        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('Invalid ULEB');
    }
    throw new Error('Unexpected EOF in ULEB');
}

function sleb(p, limit) {
    let value = 0, shift = 0, b;
    do {
        if (p >= limit) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF in SLEB');
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 127) << shift;
        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('Invalid SLEB');
    } while (b & 128);
    if (shift < 32 && (b & 64)) value |= (-1 << shift);
    return { value, next: p };
}

function sections() {
    const result = new Map();
    let p = 8;
    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];
        const s = uleb(p);
        const start = s.next;
        const end = start + s.value;
        if (end > wasm.length) throw new Error('Section exceeds file');
        if (!result.has(id)) result.set(id, []);
        result.get(id).push({ start, end });
        p = end;
    }
    return result;
}

function readName(p, end) {
    const n = uleb(p, end);
    return { value: n.value, next: n.next + n.value };
}

const sec = sections();
const typeSection = sec.get(1)?.[0];
const functionSection = sec.get(3)?.[0];
const elementSections = sec.get(9) ?? [];

if (!typeSection || !functionSection) {
    throw new Error('Missing type or function section');
}

// Parse function types.
let p = typeSection.start;
const typeCount = uleb(p, typeSection.end);
p = typeCount.next;
const types = [];

for (let i = 0; i < typeCount.value; i++) {
    if (wasm[p++] !== 0x60) throw new Error(`Unexpected type form ${i}`);

    const pc = uleb(p, typeSection.end);
    p = pc.next;
    const params = [...wasm.subarray(p, p + pc.value)];
    p += pc.value;

    const rc = uleb(p, typeSection.end);
    p = rc.next;
    const results = [...wasm.subarray(p, p + rc.value)];
    p += rc.value;

    types.push({ params, results });
}

// Function section gives type indices for defined functions.
p = functionSection.start;
const funcCount = uleb(p, functionSection.end);
p = funcCount.next;
const functionTypes = [];

for (let i = 0; i < funcCount.value; i++) {
    const t = uleb(p, functionSection.end);
    p = t.next;
    functionTypes.push(t.value);
}

const ordinal = TARGET - IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS;
const targetTypeIndex = functionTypes[ordinal];

if (targetTypeIndex === undefined) {
    throw new Error(`Function ${TARGET} is outside defined function range`);
}

const targetType = types[targetTypeIndex];

function sig(t) {
    const names = {
        0x7f: 'i32', 0x7e: 'i64',
        0x7d: 'f32', 0x7c: 'f64',
        0x7b: 'v128', 0x70: 'funcref', 0x6f: 'externref'
    };
    return `(${t.params.map(x => names[x] ?? `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(', ')}) -> ` +
        `(${t.results.map(x => names[x] ?? `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(', ')})`;
}

// Parse static element segments, including legacy function-index segments.
const matches = [];
const segmentInfo = [];

for (const es of elementSections) {
    let q = es.start;
    const count = uleb(q, es.end);
    q = count.next;

    for (let s = 0; s < count.value; s++) {
        const flags = uleb(q, es.end);
        q = flags.next;

        if (flags.value === 0) {
            // offset expression, normally i32.const <offset>; end
            if (wasm[q++] !== 0x41) throw new Error('Unexpected elem offset expr');
            const offset = sleb(q, es.end);
            q = offset.next;
            if (wasm[q++] !== 0x0b) throw new Error('Missing offset end');

            const n = uleb(q, es.end);
            q = n.next;
            const funcs = [];

            for (let j = 0; j < n.value; j++) {
                const f = uleb(q, es.end);
                q = f.next;
                funcs.push(f.value);
                if (f.value === TARGET) {
                    matches.push({ segment: s, slot: offset.value + j });
                }
            }

            segmentInfo.push({
                segment: s,
                flags: 0,
                offset: offset.value,
                entries: funcs.length
            });
        } else {
            console.log(`Element segment ${s}: flags=${flags.value}; not decoded by this checker`);
            throw new Error('Non-legacy element segment encountered; stopping safely');
        }
    }
}

console.log('STATIC INDIRECT-TARGET CHECK — READ ONLY');
console.log(`Target function: ${TARGET}`);
console.log(`Target type index: ${targetTypeIndex}`);
console.log(`Target signature: ${sig(targetType)}`);
console.log(`Defined functions: ${funcCount.value}`);
console.log(`Element segments: ${segmentInfo.length}`);

for (const s of segmentInfo) {
    console.log(`Segment ${s.segment}: flags=${s.flags}, offset=${s.offset}, entries=${s.entries}`);
}

console.log(
    matches.length
        ? `TARGET FOUND IN ELEMENT TABLE: ${JSON.stringify(matches)}`
        : 'TARGET NOT FOUND IN STATIC ELEMENT SEGMENTS'
);

const compatible = types
    .map((t, i) => ({ type: t, index: i }))
    .filter(x =>
        JSON.stringify(x.type.params) === JSON.stringify(targetType.params) &&
        JSON.stringify(x.type.results) === JSON.stringify(targetType.results)
    )
    .map(x => x.index);

console.log(`Compatible call_indirect type indices: ${compatible.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);
console.log('No WASM code executed; no network or transactions used.');

function addressToCell(address: Address) {
    const { beginCell } = require('@ton/core');

    return beginCell()
        .storeAddress(address)
        .endCell();
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const filePath = path.resolve(
        process.cwd(),
        'initial_rooster_pool_body.boc'
    );

    console.log('===== ROOSTER INITIAL LIQUIDITY DECODER =====');
    console.log('File:', filePath);

    const bocBase64 = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8').trim();

    const cells = Cell.fromBoc(
        Buffer.from(bocBase64, 'base64')
    );

    const root = cells[0];

    console.log('\n===== JETTON TRANSFER =====');

    const s = root.beginParse();

    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

    console.log(
        'Opcode:',
        '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
    );

    const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
    console.log('Query ID:', queryId.toString());

    const amount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log(
        'Jetton amount:',
        amount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER amount:',
        Number(amount) / 1e9
    );

    const destination = s.loadAddress();

    console.log(
        'Destination:',
        destination.toString()
    );

    const responseDestination = s.loadAddress();

    console.log(
        'Response destination:',
        responseDestination.toString()
    );

    const customPayload = s.loadMaybeRef();

    console.log(
        'Custom payload:',
        customPayload ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

    console.log(
        'Forward TON amount:',
        forwardTonAmount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Forward TON:',
        Number(forwardTonAmount) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'Remaining root bits:',
        s.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'Remaining root refs:',
        s.remainingRefs
    );

    if (s.remainingBits < 1) {
        throw new Error(
            'No forward payload flag found.'
        );
    }

    const forwardPayloadIsRef = s.loadBit();

    console.log(
        'Forward payload:',
        forwardPayloadIsRef ? 'REF' : 'INLINE'
    );

    let forwardPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (forwardPayloadIsRef) {
        if (s.remainingRefs < 1) {
            throw new Error(
                'Forward payload says REF but no ref exists.'
            );
        }

        forwardPayload = s.loadRef();
    } else {
        forwardPayload = s.asCell();
    }

    if (!forwardPayload) {
        throw new Error(
            'Forward payload not found.'
        );
    }

    console.log('\n===== FORWARD PAYLOAD =====');

    console.log(
        'Bits:',
        forwardPayload.bits.length
    );

    console.log(
        'Refs:',
        forwardPayload.refs.length
    );

    const fp = forwardPayload.beginParse();

    if (fp.remainingBits >= 32) {
        const forwardOpcode = fp.loadUint(32);

        console.log(
            'Forward opcode:',
            '0x' +
            forwardOpcode
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, '0')
        );

        console.log(
            'Forward opcode decimal:',
            forwardOpcode
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'Remaining bits:',
        fp.remainingBits
    );

    console.log(
        'Remaining refs:',
        fp.remainingRefs
    );

    console.log('\n===== COMPLETE CELL TREE =====');

    function dumpCell(
        cell: Cell,
        level: number,
        index: string
    ) {
        const indent = ' '.repeat(level * 2);

        console.log(
            `${indent}[${index}] bits=${cell.bits.length} refs=${cell.refs.length}`
        );

        for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
            dumpCell(
                cell.refs[i],
                level + 1,
                `${index}.${i}`
            );
        }
    }

    dumpCell(root, 0, '0');

    console.log('\nNO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
}
