FILE: scripts\inspectInvokeTargets.ts
====================================================================================================

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const WASM_PATH = path.resolve(
    process.cwd(),
    "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS_EXPECTED = 83;
const TARGET_TYPE_INDEX = 0;

const TARGETS = [
    295,
    484,
    871,
    560,
    1746,
    2530,
    2527,
    1393,
    1747,
];

class Reader {
    data: Buffer;
    pos: number;
    end: number;

    constructor(data: Buffer, start = 0, end = data.length) {
        this.data = data;
        this.pos = start;
        this.end = end;
    }

    byte(): number {
        if (this.pos >= this.end) {
            throw new Error(`Unexpected EOF at 0x${this.pos.toString(16)}`);
        }
        return this.data[this.pos++];
    }

    uleb(): number {
        let result = 0;
        let shift = 0;

        while (true) {
            const b = this.byte();
            result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

            if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
                return result;
            }

            shift += 7;
            if (shift > 49) {
                throw new Error("ULEB128 is too large");
            }
        }
    }

    sleb(): number {
        let result = 0;
        let shift = 0;
        let b = 0;

        while (true) {
            b = this.byte();
            result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
            shift += 7;

            if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

            if (shift > 35) {
                throw new Error("SLEB128 is too large");
            }
        }

        if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40) !== 0) {
            result |= (~0 << shift);
        }

        return result;
    }

    string(): string {
        const length = this.uleb();
        const start = this.pos;
        this.pos += length;

        if (this.pos > this.end) {
            throw new Error("String extends beyond section");
        }

        return this.data.toString("utf8", start, this.pos);
    }

    skip(count: number): void {
        this.pos += count;
        if (this.pos > this.end) {
            throw new Error("Read extends beyond section");
        }
    }
}

type FuncType = {
    params: number[];
    results: number[];
};

type SectionInfo = {
    id: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
};

function readSections(data: Buffer): SectionInfo[] {
    const r = new Reader(data);

    if (
        r.byte() !== 0x00 ||
        r.byte() !== 0x61 ||
        r.byte() !== 0x73 ||
        r.byte() !== 0x6d
    ) {
        throw new Error("Not a WebAssembly binary");
    }

    const version = [
        r.byte(),
        r.byte(),
        r.byte(),
        r.byte(),
    ];

    if (version.join(",") !== "1,0,0,0") {
        throw new Error(`Unexpected WASM version: ${version.join(",")}`);
    }

    const sections: SectionInfo[] = [];

    while (r.pos < r.end) {
        const id = r.byte();
        const size = r.uleb();
        const start = r.pos;
        const end = start + size;

        if (end > r.end) {
            throw new Error(`Section ${id} exceeds file bounds`);
        }

        sections.push({ id, start, end });
        r.pos = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function sectionReader(
    data: Buffer,
    sections: SectionInfo[],
    id: number
): Reader | undefined {
    const section = sections.find((s) => s.id === id);
    if (!section) return undefined;

    return new Reader(data, section.start, section.end);
}

function readTypes(
    data: Buffer,
    sections: SectionInfo[]
): FuncType[] {
    const r = sectionReader(data, sections, 1);
    if (!r) return [];

    const count = r.uleb();
    const types: FuncType[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const form = r.byte();

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(`Unsupported function type form 0x${form.toString(16)}`);
        }

        const paramCount = r.uleb();
        const params: number[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
            params.push(r.byte());
        }

        const resultCount = r.uleb();
        const results: number[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
            results.push(r.byte());
        }

        types.push({ params, results });
    }

    return types;
}

function readImportedFunctionTypes(
    data: Buffer,
    sections: SectionInfo[]
): number[] {
    const r = sectionReader(data, sections, 2);
    if (!r) return [];

    const importCount = r.uleb();
    const functionTypes: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {
        r.string(); // module
        r.string(); // import name

        const kind = r.byte();

        switch (kind) {
            case 0:
                functionTypes.push(r.uleb());
                break;

            case 1: {
                r.byte(); // element type
                const flags = r.uleb();
                r.uleb(); // minimum
                if (flags & 1) r.uleb(); // maximum
                break;
            }

            case 2: {
                const flags = r.uleb();
                r.uleb(); // minimum
                if (flags & 1) r.uleb(); // maximum
                break;
            }

            case 3:
                r.byte(); // value type
                r.byte(); // mutability
                break;

            case 4:
                r.uleb(); // attribute
                r.uleb(); // type index
                break;

            default:
                throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind}`);
        }
    }

    return functionTypes;
}

function readDefinedFunctionTypes(
    data: Buffer,
    sections: SectionInfo[]
): number[] {
    const r = sectionReader(data, sections, 3);
    if (!r) return [];

    const count = r.uleb();
    const result: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        result.push(r.uleb());
    }

    return result;
}

/**
 * Reads a common constant-expression form used for element offsets.
 * Returns null when the expression is valid but not a simple i32.const.
 */
function readOffsetExpression(r: Reader): number | null {
    const opcode = r.byte();
    let value: number | null = null;

    if (opcode === 0x41) {
        value = r.sleb();
    } else if (opcode === 0x23) {
        r.uleb(); // global.get index
    } else if (opcode === 0x43) {
        r.skip(4); // f32.const
    } else if (opcode === 0x44) {
        r.skip(8); // f64.const
    } else if (opcode === 0xd0) {
        r.byte(); // heap type (signed LEB encoding may be multi-byte)
        // For the offsets used in this file, this is not expected.
    } else {
        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported element offset expression opcode 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    const endOpcode = r.byte();

    if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
        throw new Error(
            `Expected end of offset expression, got 0x${endOpcode.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    return value;
}

function readElementKindOrType(r: Reader, expressionForm: boolean): void {
    if (expressionForm) {
        r.byte(); // reference type, e.g. funcref
    } else {
        r.byte(); // elemkind, normally 0
    }
}

function readFunctionIndexVector(r: Reader): number[] {
    const count = r.uleb();
    const funcs: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        funcs.push(r.uleb());
    }

    return funcs;
}

function readExpressionVector(r: Reader): Array<number | null> {
    const count = r.uleb();
    const funcs: Array<number | null> = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        let functionIndex: number | null = null;

        while (true) {
            const opcode = r.byte();

            if (opcode === 0x0b) {
                break;
            }

            if (opcode === 0xd2) {
                functionIndex = r.uleb(); // ref.func
            } else if (opcode === 0xd0) {
                // ref.null has a heap-type immediate.
                // Read its signed LEB value.
                r.sleb();
            } else {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unsupported element expression opcode 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
                );
            }
        }

        funcs.push(functionIndex);
    }

    return funcs;
}

function readElementTables(
    data: Buffer,
    sections: SectionInfo[]
): Array<Array<number | undefined>> {
    const r = sectionReader(data, sections, 9);
    const tables: Array<Array<number | undefined>> = [];

    if (!r) return tables;

    const segmentCount = r.uleb();

    for (let segment = 0; segment < segmentCount; segment++) {
        const flags = r.uleb();

        let active = false;
        let tableIndex = 0;
        let offset: number | null = null;
        let functions: Array<number | null> = [];

        switch (flags) {
            case 0: {
                active = true;
                tableIndex = 0;
                offset = readOffsetExpression(r);
                functions = readFunctionIndexVector(r);
                break;
            }

            case 1: {
                readElementKindOrType(r, false);
                functions = readFunctionIndexVector(r);
                break;
            }

            case 2: {
                active = true;
                tableIndex = r.uleb();
                offset = readOffsetExpression(r);
                readElementKindOrType(r, false);
                functions = readFunctionIndexVector(r);
                break;
            }

            case 3: {
                readElementKindOrType(r, false);
                functions = readFunctionIndexVector(r);
                break;
            }

            case 4: {
                active = true;
                tableIndex = 0;
                offset = readOffsetExpression(r);
                functions = readExpressionVector(r);
                break;
            }

            case 5: {
                readElementKindOrType(r, true);
                functions = readExpressionVector(r);
                break;
            }

            case 6: {
                active = true;
                tableIndex = r.uleb();
                offset = readOffsetExpression(r);
                readElementKindOrType(r, true);
                functions = readExpressionVector(r);
                break;
            }

            case 7: {
                readElementKindOrType(r, true);
                functions = readExpressionVector(r);
                break;
            }

            default:
                throw new Error(`Unsupported element segment flags ${flags}`);
        }

        if (!active) continue;

        if (offset === null) {
            console.log(
                `WARNING: Element segment ${segment} has a non-constant offset; skipped`
            );
            continue;
        }

        if (!tables[tableIndex]) tables[tableIndex] = [];

        const table = tables[tableIndex];

        for (let i = 0; i < functions.length; i++) {
            const func = functions[i];

            if (func !== null) {
                table[offset + i] = func;
            }
        }
    }

    return tables;
}

function formatValType(type: number): string {
    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x7f: "i32",
        0x7e: "i64",
        0x7d: "f32",
        0x7c: "f64",
        0x7b: "v128",
        0x70: "funcref",
        0x6f: "externref",
    };

    return names[type] ?? `type_0x${type.toString(16)}`;
}

function formatSignature(type: FuncType): string {
    const params = type.params.map(formatValType).join(", ");
    const results = type.results.map(formatValType).join(", ");

    return `(${params}) -> (${results})`;
}

function main(): void {
    console.log("WASM TABLE / FUNCTION TYPE INSPECTION");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    if (!fs.existsSync(WASM_PATH)) {
        throw new Error(`WASM file not found: ${WASM_PATH}`);
    }

    const data = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);
    const sections = readSections(data);
    const types = readTypes(data, sections);
    const importedFunctionTypes = readImportedFunctionTypes(data, sections);
    const definedFunctionTypes = readDefinedFunctionTypes(data, sections);
    const tables = readElementTables(data, sections);

    const importedFunctionCount = importedFunctionTypes.length;

    console.log(`WASM FILE          = ${WASM_PATH}`);
    console.log(`FILE SIZE          = ${data.length}`);
    console.log(`TYPE COUNT         = ${types.length}`);
    console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${importedFunctionCount}`);
    console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS  = ${definedFunctionTypes.length}`);
    console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC RANGE  = ${importedFunctionCount} .. ${
        importedFunctionCount + definedFunctionTypes.length - 1
    }`);

    if (importedFunctionCount !== IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS_EXPECTED) {
        console.log(
            `WARNING: Expected ${IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS_EXPECTED} imported functions, found ${importedFunctionCount}`
        );
    }

    function getTypeIndex(globalFunction: number): number | undefined {
        if (globalFunction < importedFunctionCount) {
            return importedFunctionTypes[globalFunction];
        }

        const ordinal = globalFunction - importedFunctionCount;

        if (ordinal < 0 || ordinal >= definedFunctionTypes.length) {
            return undefined;
        }

        return definedFunctionTypes[ordinal];
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log(`TYPE ${TARGET_TYPE_INDEX}`);
    console.log("------------------------------------------------");

    const targetType = types[TARGET_TYPE_INDEX];

    if (targetType) {
        console.log(`Signature: ${formatSignature(targetType)}`);
    } else {
        console.log("WARNING: Target type index does not exist");
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("DEFINED FUNCTIONS MATCHING TYPE 0");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------");

    let matchingFunctionCount = 0;

    for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < definedFunctionTypes.length; ordinal++) {
        if (definedFunctionTypes[ordinal] !== TARGET_TYPE_INDEX) continue;

        const globalFunction = importedFunctionCount + ordinal;

        console.log(`GLOBAL ${globalFunction} | ORDINAL ${ordinal}`);
        matchingFunctionCount++;
    }

    console.log(`MATCH COUNT: ${matchingFunctionCount}`);

    console.log("");
    console.log("TARGET FUNCTION SIGNATURES");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------");

    for (const globalFunction of TARGETS) {
        const typeIndex = getTypeIndex(globalFunction);

        console.log("");
        console.log(`FUNCTION ${globalFunction}`);

        if (typeIndex === undefined) {
            console.log("  Type index : UNKNOWN");
            console.log("  Signature  : UNKNOWN");
            continue;
        }

        console.log(`  Type index : ${typeIndex}`);

        const type = types[typeIndex];

        if (type) {
            console.log(`  Signature  : ${formatSignature(type)}`);
        } else {
            console.log("  Signature  : TYPE NOT FOUND");
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("ELEMENT TABLE LOOKUP");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------");

    const lookups = [0x0a6e, 0x0cdd, 0x2163, 0x21d2];

    for (const index of lookups) {
        const func = tables[0]?.[index];

        if (func === undefined) {
            console.log(`TABLE[${index}] = UNDEFINED`);
            continue;
        }

        const typeIndex = getTypeIndex(func);
        console.log(
            `TABLE[${index}] = GLOBAL ${func} | TYPE ${
                typeIndex === undefined ? "UNKNOWN" : typeIndex
            }`
        );
    }

    // IMPORTANT:
    // This scan must stay inside main(), because it uses tables and
    // getTypeIndex(), which are local to main().
    console.log("");
    console.log("TABLE 0 ENTRIES WITH TYPE 0");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------");

    let matchingEntries = 0;

    const table0 = tables[0] ?? [];

    for (let index = 0; index < table0.length; index++) {
        const func = table0[index];

        if (func === undefined) continue;

        const typeIndex = getTypeIndex(func);

        if (typeIndex === TARGET_TYPE_INDEX) {
            console.log(`TABLE[${index}] = GLOBAL ${func}`);
            matchingEntries++;
        }
    }

    console.log(`MATCHING TABLE ENTRIES: ${matchingEntries}`);

    console.log("");
    console.log("DONE - NO WASM EXECUTION");
}

try {
    main();
} catch (error) {
    console.error("");
    console.error("SCRIPT ERROR");
    console.error("------------------------------------------------");
    console.error(error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

        'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
    );

    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' ROOSTER / pTON MASTER INSPECTION');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY ONLY');
    console.log('==========================================');

    for (const [name, address] of [
        ['ROOSTER', rooster],
        ['pTON', pton],
    ] as const) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(`${name} Master:`);
        console.log(address.toString());

        const state = await provider.provider(address).getState();

        console.log(`${name} State:`);
        console.log('type:', state.state.type);
        console.log('balance:', state.balance);

        if (state.state.type === 'active') {
            console.log(
                'code bytes:',
                state.state.code ? state.state.code.length : 0
            );

            console.log(
                'data bytes:',
                state.state.data ? state.state.data.length : 0
            );
        } else {
            console.log('code bytes: N/A');
            console.log('data bytes: N/A');
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');

import fs from 'fs';

const WASM = './emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const TARGETS = [
    5539, // Ka
    618,
    106,
    95,
    170,
];

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

let p = 8;

function readULEB(): number {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return value >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readULEBAt(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let i = pos;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[i++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: i,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

let importedFuncs = 0;
let codeStart = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
    const sectionId = b[p++];
    const sectionSize = readULEB();

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 2) {
        const count = readULEB();

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

            const moduleLen = readULEB();
            p += moduleLen;

            const nameLen = readULEB();
            p += nameLen;

            const kind = b[p++];

            if (kind === 0) {
                readULEB();
                importedFuncs++;
            }
            else if (kind === 1) {
                p++;
                const flags = readULEB();
                readULEB();

                if (flags & 1) {
                    readULEB();
                }
            }
            else if (kind === 2) {
                const flags = readULEB();
                readULEB();

                if (flags & 1) {
                    readULEB();
                }
            }
            else if (kind === 3) {
                p += 2;
            }
        }
    }

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

p = codeStart;

const functionCount = readULEB();

interface Func {
    index: number;
    definedIndex: number;
    offset: number;
    size: number;
    body: Buffer;
}

const funcs: Func[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < functionCount; i++) {

    const sizeInfo = readULEBAt(p);

    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const offset = p;

    const body = b.subarray(
        offset,
        offset + sizeInfo.value
    );

    funcs.push({
        index: importedFuncs + i,
        definedIndex: i,
        offset,
        size: sizeInfo.value,
        body,
    });

    p += sizeInfo.value;
}

function readCalls(body: Buffer) {
    const result: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {

        if (body[i] !== 0x10) {
            continue;
        }

        let value = 0;
        let shift = 0;
        let j = i + 1;

        while (j < body.length) {

            const x = body[j++];

            value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

            if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
                break;
            }

            shift += 7;
        }

        result.push(value >>> 0);

        i = j - 1;
    }

    return result;
}

function readU32At(pos: number): number {
    const r = readULEBAt(pos);
    return r.value;
}

function u32LengthAt(pos: number): number {
    return readULEBAt(pos).length;
}

function readULEBAt(pos: number): {
    value: number;
    length: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let i = pos;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[i++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                length: i - pos,
                next: i
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readULEBFromBuffer(
    buf: Buffer,
    pos: number
): {
    value: number;
    length: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let i = pos;

    while (true) {
        const x = buf[i++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                length: i - pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

            }
            else if (kind === 1) {
                p++;
                skipLimits();
            }
            else if (kind === 2) {
                skipLimits();
            }
            else if (kind === 3) {
                p += 2;
            }
        }
    }

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = sectionStart;
        break;
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
}

p = codeStart;

const functionCount = readULEB().value;

interface FuncBody {
    index: number;
    offset: number;
    size: number;
    bytes: Buffer;
}

const funcs: FuncBody[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < functionCount; i++) {

    const sizeInfo = readULEBAt(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const offset = p;

    const bytes = b.subarray(
        offset,
        offset + sizeInfo.value
    );

    funcs.push({
        index: importedFuncs + i,
        offset,
        size: sizeInfo.value,
        bytes
    });

    p += sizeInfo.value;
}

function readCallTargets(bytes: Buffer): number[] {

    const calls: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {

        if (bytes[i] !== 0x10) {
            continue;
        }

        let value = 0;
        let shift = 0;
        let j = i + 1;

        while (j < bytes.length) {

            const x = bytes[j++];

            value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

            if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
                break;
            }

            shift += 7;
        }

        calls.push(value >>> 0);

        i = j - 1;
    }

    return calls;
}

console.log('============================================================');
console.log(' Ka NEXT-LAYER CALL GRAPH');
console.log('============================================================');
console.log(`Imported functions : ${importedFuncs}`);
console.log(`Defined functions  : ${functionCount}`);
console.log('');

for (const target of TARGETS) {

    const f = funcs[target - importedFuncs];

    if (!f) {
        console.log(`target=${target} NOT FOUND`);
        continue;
    }

    const calls = readCallTargets(f.bytes);

    console.log(
        `target=${target.toString().padStart(4, ' ')}`
    );

    console.log(
        `  defined #${(target - importedFuncs)}`
    );

    console.log(
        `  offset=${f.offset} size=${f.size}`
    );

    console.log(
        `  CALLS (${calls.length}): ${
            calls.length ? calls.join(', ') : 'none'
        }`
    );

    console.log(
        `  FIRST: ${
            [...f.bytes.subarray(0, Math.min(80, f.bytes.length))]
                .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
                .join(' ')
        }`
    );

    console.log('');
}

console.log('============================================================');
console.log(' DONE');
console.log('============================================================');

async function inspectContract(
    provider: NetworkProvider,
    label: string,
    address: Address
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('-'.repeat(70));
    console.log(` ${label}`);
    console.log('-'.repeat(70));

    console.log('ADDRESS:');
    console.log(address.toString());

    try {
        const contractState =
            await provider.provider(address).getState();

        console.log('');
        console.log('STATE TYPE:', contractState.state.type);

        console.log(
            'BALANCE:',
            contractState.balance.toString()
        );

        if (contractState.state.type === 'active') {
            console.log('CODE: PRESENT');
            console.log('DATA: PRESENT');

            console.log(
                'CODE BYTES:',
                contractState.state.code?.length ?? 0
            );

            console.log(
                'DATA BYTES:',
                contractState.state.data?.length ?? 0
            );
        } else if (contractState.state.type === 'uninit') {
            console.log('CODE: MISSING');
            console.log('DATA: MISSING');
        } else if (contractState.state.type === 'frozen') {
            console.log('CODE: NOT AVAILABLE');
            console.log('DATA: NOT AVAILABLE');

            console.log(
                'STATE HASH:',
                contractState.state.stateHash.toString('hex')
            );
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(`${label} ERROR:`);

        if (error instanceof Error) {
            console.log(error.message);
        } else {
            console.log(error);
        }
    }
}

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

export async function run() {

    const libraryHash = Buffer.from(
        '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86',
        'hex'
    );

    const servers = [
        {
            name: 'SERVER 2',
            host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            name: 'SERVER 3',
            host: 'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088',
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    console.log('===== DIRECT LIBRARY SERVER TEST =====');
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Library hash:',
        libraryHash.toString('hex')
    );
    console.log('');

    for (const server of servers) {

        console.log('========================================');
        console.log(server.name);
        console.log(server.host);
        console.log('========================================');

        const key = Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64');

        console.log('Key bytes:', key.length);

        if (key.length !== 32) {
            console.log('INVALID KEY');
            continue;
        }

        const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
            host: server.host,
            publicKey: key,
            reconnectTimeout: 5000,
        });

        try {

            console.log('Waiting for engine...');

            let ready = false;

            for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {

                const isReady = engine.isReady();
                const isClosed = engine.isClosed();

                console.log(
                    `Wait ${i + 1}/30 | ready=${isReady} | closed=${isClosed}`
                );

                if (isReady) {
                    ready = true;
                    break;
                }

                if (isClosed) {
                    console.log(
                        'Engine closed before becoming ready.'
                    );
                    break;
                }

                await sleep(500);
            }

            if (!ready) {

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    'ENGINE NOT READY - SKIPPING SERVER'
                );

                continue;
            }

            console.log('');
            console.log('ENGINE READY');
            console.log('');

            const client = new LiteClient({
                engine,
                batchSize: 1,
            });

            console.log(
                'Getting masterchain info...'
            );

            const master =
                await client.getMasterchainInfo();

            console.log(
                'Masterchain seqno:',
                master.last.seqno
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'Calling getLibraries()...'
            );

            const result =
                await client.getLibraries([
                    libraryHash
                ]);

            console.log('');
            console.log('===== RAW RESULT =====');

            console.dir(result, {
                depth: 10
            });

            console.log('');

            if (
                !result.result ||
                result.result.length === 0
            ) {

                console.log(
                    '>>> LIBRARY NOT RETURNED'
                );

            } else {

                console.log(
                    '>>> LIBRARY FOUND'
                );

                console.log(
                    'Result count:',
                    result.result.length
                );

                for (
                    let i = 0;
                    i < result.result.length;
                    i++
                ) {

                    console.log('');
                    console.log(
                        '----- LIBRARY ENTRY',
                        i,
                        '-----'
                    );

                    console.dir(
                        result.result[i],
                        {
                            depth: 10
                        }
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (error) {

            console.log('');
            console.log('===== ERROR =====');
            console.error(error);

        } finally {

            console.log('');
            console.log('Closing engine...');
            engine.close();
        }

        console.log('');
    }

    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('TEST FINISHED');
    console.log('========================================');
}

const USER = Address.parse(

const PROVIDE_LP = 935368415;
const TON_TRANSFER = 32736093;

function addressToString(address: Address | null | undefined): string {
    return address ? address.toString() : 'null';
}

function decodeProvideLp(cell: Cell): void {
    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log(' PROVIDE_LP FORWARD PAYLOAD');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');

    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

        console.log('Opcode:', opcode);
        console.log(
            'Opcode hex:',
            '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );

        if (opcode !== PROVIDE_LP) {
            console.log('WARNING: opcode is NOT PROVIDE_LP');
            return;
        }

        const routerWalletAddress = s.loadAddress();
        const refundAddress = s.loadAddress();
        const excessesAddress = s.loadAddress();

        const deadline = s.loadUintBig(64);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Router wallet:');
        console.log(addressToString(routerWalletAddress));

        console.log('');
        console.log('Refund address:');
        console.log(addressToString(refundAddress));

        console.log('');
        console.log('Excesses address:');
        console.log(addressToString(excessesAddress));

        console.log('');
        console.log('Deadline:');
        console.log(deadline.toString());

        const params = s.loadRef().beginParse();

        const minLpOut = params.loadCoins();
        const receiverAddress = params.loadAddress();
        const bothPositive = params.loadBit();

        const dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount =
            params.loadCoins();

        const hasCustomPayload = params.loadBit();

        console.log('');
        console.log('minLpOut:');
        console.log(minLpOut.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('Receiver:');
        console.log(addressToString(receiverAddress));

        console.log('');
        console.log('bothPositive:');
        console.log(bothPositive);

        console.log('');
        console.log('DEX custom payload forward gas:');
        console.log(
            dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount.toString()
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Has custom payload:');
        console.log(hasCustomPayload);

        if (hasCustomPayload) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('Custom payload exists: YES');
        } else {
            console.log('');
            console.log('Custom payload exists: NO');
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('Provide LP payload BOC:');
        console.log(cell.toBoc().toString('base64'));
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('ERROR decoding PROVIDE_LP payload:');
        console.log(error);
    }
}

function decodePtonBody(body: Cell): void {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' pTON BODY DECODE');
    console.log('============================================================');

    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
        const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
        const tonAmount = s.loadCoins();
        const refundAddress = s.loadAddress();

        const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

        console.log('');
        console.log('TON_TRANSFER opcode:');
        console.log(opcode);

        console.log(
            'Opcode hex:',
            '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Expected TON_TRANSFER:');
        console.log(TON_TRANSFER);

        console.log(
            'Expected hex:',
            '0x' + TON_TRANSFER.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Query ID:');
        console.log(queryId.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('TON amount:');
        console.log(tonAmount.toString());

        console.log(
            'TON amount display:',
            Number(tonAmount) / 1e9,
            'TON'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Refund address:');
        console.log(addressToString(refundAddress));

        console.log('');
        console.log('Has forward payload:');
        console.log(hasForwardPayload);

        if (hasForwardPayload) {
            const forwardPayload = s.loadRef();

            decodeProvideLp(forwardPayload);
        } else {
            console.log('');
            console.log('ERROR: No forward payload found.');
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('pTON body BOC:');
        console.log(body.toBoc().toString('base64'));
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('ERROR decoding pTON body:');
        console.log(error);
    }
}

function decodeJettonBody(body: Cell): void {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' ROOSTER JETTON BODY DECODE');
    console.log('============================================================');

    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
        const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
        const amount = s.loadCoins();

        const destination = s.loadAddress();
        const responseDestination = s.loadAddress();

        const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

        if (hasCustomPayload) {
            s.loadRef();
        }

        const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

        const hasForwardPayload = s.loadBit();

        console.log('');
        console.log('Jetton opcode:');
        console.log(opcode);

        console.log(
            'Opcode hex:',
            '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Query ID:');
        console.log(queryId.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('ROOSTER amount raw:');
        console.log(amount.toString());

        console.log(
            'ROOSTER amount display:',
            Number(amount) / 1e9
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Destination:');
        console.log(addressToString(destination));

        console.log('');
        console.log('Response destination:');
        console.log(addressToString(responseDestination));

        console.log('');
        console.log('Has custom payload:');
        console.log(hasCustomPayload);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Forward TON amount raw:');
        console.log(forwardTonAmount.toString());

        console.log(
            'Forward TON amount:',
            Number(forwardTonAmount) / 1e9,
            'TON'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Has forward payload:');
        console.log(hasForwardPayload);

        if (hasForwardPayload) {
            const forwardPayload = s.loadRef();

            decodeProvideLp(forwardPayload);
        } else {
            console.log('');
            console.log('ERROR: No forward payload found.');
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('ROOSTER body BOC:');
        console.log(body.toBoc().toString('base64'));
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('ERROR decoding ROOSTER body:');
        console.log(error);
    }
}

import { Address, TonClient, Cell } from '@ton/ton';

const USER_WALLET =
    '0QDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N6R-';

const ROOSTER_WALLET =
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh';

const ROUTER =
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250nC3';

const PTON_ROUTER_WALLET =
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3';

const POOL =
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf';

const MAX_TX = 20;

const client = new TonClient({
    endpoint: 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
});

function shortAddress(value: string): string {
    if (value.length <= 28) return value;
    return `${value.slice(0, 12)}...${value.slice(-10)}`;
}

function formatNano(value: bigint | string | number): string {
    try {
        const n = BigInt(value);
        return `${n.toString()} nanotons (${Number(n) / 1e9} TON)`;
    } catch {
        return String(value);
    }
}

function getOpcode(body: Cell | null | undefined): string {
    if (!body) return 'NO BODY';

    try {
        const slice = body.beginParse();

        if (slice.remainingBits < 32) {
            return 'NO 32-BIT OPCODE';
        }

        const opcode = slice.loadUint(32);

        return `0x${opcode
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, '0')}`;
    } catch {
        return 'OPCODE READ ERROR';
    }
}

function opcodeName(opcode: string): string {
    switch (opcode.toLowerCase()) {

        case '0x37c096df':
            return 'provide_lp';

        case '0x0f8a7ea5':
            return 'provide_lp / pool-side message';

        case '0x00000015':
            return 'mint';

        default:
            return 'unknown';
    }
}

function addressFromInfo(info: any): string {
    try {
        if (info?.type === 'internal' && info.dest) {
            return info.dest.toString();
        }

        if (info?.dest) {
            return info.dest.toString();
        }

        if (info?.src) {
            return info.src.toString();
        }
    } catch {
        return 'unknown';
    }

    return 'unknown';
}

function sourceFromInfo(info: any): string {
    try {
        if (info?.type === 'internal' && info.src) {
            return info.src.toString();
        }

        if (info?.src) {
            return info.src.toString();
        }
    } catch {
        return 'unknown';
    }

    return 'unknown';
}

function messageValue(message: any): bigint {
    try {
        if (
            message?.info?.type === 'internal' &&
            message.info.value?.coins !== undefined
        ) {
            return BigInt(message.info.value.coins);
        }
    } catch {
        // ignore
    }

    return 0n;
}

function printMessage(
    message: any,
    direction: string,
    index: number
) {
    if (!message) return;

    const info = message.info;

    const source =
        sourceFromInfo(info);

    const destination =
        addressFromInfo(info);

    const value =
        messageValue(message);

    const opcode =
        getOpcode(message.body);

    console.log('');
    console.log(`    ${direction} MESSAGE ${index}`);
    console.log(`      Source      : ${shortAddress(source)}`);
    console.log(`      Destination : ${shortAddress(destination)}`);
    console.log(`      Value       : ${formatNano(value)}`);
    console.log(`      Opcode      : ${opcode}`);
    console.log(`      Meaning     : ${opcodeName(opcode)}`);
}

async function inspectAddress(
    label: string,
    addressText: string
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(label);
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(`Address: ${addressText}`);

    let address: Address;

    try {
        address = Address.parse(addressText);
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'ADDRESS ERROR:',
            error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : String(error)
        );
        return [];
    }

    try {

        const transactions =
            await client.getTransactions(
                address,
                {
                    limit: MAX_TX,
                }
            );

        console.log(
            `Transactions returned: ${transactions.length}`
        );

        if (transactions.length === 0) {
            console.log('No transactions found.');
            return [];
        }

        transactions.forEach(
            (tx: any, index: number) => {

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    `---------------- Transaction ${index + 1} ----------------`
                );

                console.log(
                    `LT          : ${tx.lt}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `Hash        : ${Buffer.from(tx.hash()).toString('base64')}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `Account     : ${shortAddress(address.toString())}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `In message  : ${tx.inMessage ? 'YES' : 'NO'}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `Out messages: ${tx.outMessages?.size ?? 0}`
                );

                if (tx.inMessage) {
                    printMessage(
                        tx.inMessage,
                        'IN',
                        1
                    );
                }

                if (tx.outMessages) {

                    let i = 1;

                    for (
                        const message
                        of tx.outMessages.values()
                    ) {

                        printMessage(
                            message,
                            'OUT',
                            i
                        );

                        i++;
                    }
                }
            }
        );

        return transactions;

    } catch (error) {

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'TRANSACTION READ ERROR:',
            error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : String(error)
        );

        return [];
    }
}

function normalize(value: string): string {
    return value
        .replace(/^EQ/, '')
        .replace(/^UQ/, '')
        .toLowerCase();
}

function sameAddress(
    a: string,
    b: string
): boolean {
    return normalize(a) === normalize(b);
}

function analyzeRoute(
    allTransactions: any[]
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('             ROUTE ANALYSIS');
    console.log('================================================');

    const expected = [
        USER_WALLET,
        ROOSTER_WALLET,
        ROUTER,
        PTON_ROUTER_WALLET,
        POOL,
    ];

    console.log('');
    console.log('Expected V2.2 route:');

    expected.forEach(
        (address, index) => {
            console.log(
                `${index + 1}. ${shortAddress(address)}`
            );
        }
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Observed matching messages:');

    let matches = 0;

    for (const item of allTransactions) {

        const tx = item.tx;
        const owner = item.owner;

        if (!tx) continue;

        if (tx.inMessage) {

            const info =
                tx.inMessage.info;

            const src =
                sourceFromInfo(info);

            const dst =
                addressFromInfo(info);

            if (
                expected.some(
                    x => sameAddress(x, src)
                ) ||
                expected.some(
                    x => sameAddress(x, dst)
                )
            ) {

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    `ACCOUNT: ${shortAddress(owner)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `IN: ${shortAddress(src)} -> ${shortAddress(dst)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `OPCODE: ${getOpcode(tx.inMessage.body)}`
                );

                matches++;
            }
        }

        if (tx.outMessages) {

            for (
                const message
                of tx.outMessages.values()
            ) {

                const info =
                    message.info;

                const src =
                    sourceFromInfo(info);

                const dst =
                    addressFromInfo(info);

                if (
                    expected.some(
                        x => sameAddress(x, src)
                    ) ||
                    expected.some(
                        x => sameAddress(x, dst)
                    )
                ) {

                    console.log('');
                    console.log(
                        `ACCOUNT: ${shortAddress(owner)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `OUT: ${shortAddress(src)} -> ${shortAddress(dst)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `OPCODE: ${getOpcode(message.body)}`
                    );

                    matches++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');

    if (matches === 0) {
        console.log(
            'No direct route messages were found in the fetched transactions.'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            `Route-related messages found: ${matches}`
        );
    }
}

export async function run() {

    console.log('');

    console.log('');

    );

    console.log(
        'This diagnostic reads existing blockchain transactions only.'
    );

    const accounts = [
        {
            label: '1. USER WALLET',
            address: USER_WALLET,
        },
        {
            label: '2. ROOSTER JETTON WALLET',
            address: ROOSTER_WALLET,
        },
        {
            label: '3. ROUTER pTON WALLET',
            address: PTON_ROUTER_WALLET,
        },
        {
            label: '4. STON.FI ROUTER V2.2',
            address: ROUTER,
        },
        {
            label: '5. POOL',
            address: POOL,
        },
    ];

    const allTransactions: {
        owner: string;
        tx: any;
    }[] = [];

    for (const account of accounts) {

        const transactions =
            await inspectAddress(
                account.label,
                account.address
            );

        for (const tx of transactions) {
            allTransactions.push({
                owner: account.address,
                tx,
            });
        }
    }

    analyzeRoute(allTransactions);

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('                     TRACE FINISHED');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('IMPORTANT:');
    console.log('READ ONLY');
    console.log('NO TONCONNECT REQUEST');
    console.log('NO TONKEEPER APPROVAL');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('');
}

const ROOSTER_WALLET =
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh';

const PTon_ROUTER_WALLET =

const POOL =
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf';

const ROUTER =

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v3';

const DELAY_MS = 1200;
const MAX_RETRIES = 4;

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function getJson(
    url: string,
    label: string
): Promise<any> {

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_RETRIES; attempt++) {

        try {

            const response = await fetch(url);

            if (response.ok) {
                return await response.json();
            }

            if (response.status === 429) {

                const wait =
                    DELAY_MS * attempt * 2;

                console.log(
                    `[${label}] HTTP 429 - waiting ${wait} ms...`
                );

                await sleep(wait);
                continue;
            }

            throw new Error(
                `[${label}] HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`
            );

        } catch (error: any) {

            if (attempt === MAX_RETRIES) {
                throw error;
            }

            const wait =
                DELAY_MS * attempt;

            console.log(
                `[${label}] request error - retry ${attempt}/${MAX_RETRIES} after ${wait} ms`
            );

            await sleep(wait);
        }
    }

    throw new Error(
        `[${label}] request failed after retries`
    );
}

async function getTransactions(
    address: string,
    label: string
): Promise<any[]> {

    const url =
        `${TONCENTER}/transactions` +
        `?account=${encodeURIComponent(address)}` +
        `&limit=20` +
        `&sort=desc`;

    const data =
        await getJson(url, label);

    await sleep(DELAY_MS);

    return data.transactions ?? [];
}

function printTransaction(
    tx: any,
    index: number,
    prefix: string
) {

    console.log(`${prefix} #${index + 1}`);

    console.log(
        'hash:',
        tx.hash ?? 'N/A'
    );

    console.log(
        'lt:',
        tx.lt ?? 'N/A'
    );

    console.log(
        'utime:',
        tx.utime
            ? new Date(
                  Number(tx.utime) * 1000
              ).toISOString()
            : 'N/A'
    );

    console.log(
        'total_fees:',
        tx.total_fees ?? 'N/A'
    );

    console.log(
        'success:',
        tx.success ?? 'N/A'
    );

    console.log(
        'end_status:',
        tx.end_status ?? 'N/A'
    );

    if (tx.in_msg) {
        console.log(
            'in_msg:',
            JSON.stringify(tx.in_msg)
        );
    }

    if (
        tx.out_msgs &&
        Array.isArray(tx.out_msgs)
    ) {
        console.log(
            'out_msgs:',
            JSON.stringify(tx.out_msgs)
        );
    }

    if (tx.description) {
        console.log(
            'description:',
            JSON.stringify(tx.description)
        );
    }

    console.log('');
}

import { Address, TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99809465000001n;

const EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET =
    'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh';

const EXPECTED_PTON_POOL_WALLET =
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3';

function hexOpcode(body: any): string {
    try {
        const slice = body.beginParse();

        if (slice.remainingBits < 32) {
            return 'NO_32BIT_OPCODE';
        }

        return '0x' + slice.loadUint(32).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    } catch {
        return 'UNREADABLE';
    }
}

function messageInfo(message: any, index: number | string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`MESSAGE ${index}`);
    console.log('----------------------------------------');

    if (!message) {
        console.log('MESSAGE: NULL');
        return;
    }

    console.log('TYPE:', message.info.type);

    if (message.info.type === 'internal') {
        console.log('FROM:', message.info.src.toString());
        console.log('TO:', message.info.dest.toString());
        console.log(
            'VALUE:',
            message.info.value.coins.toString(),
            'nanoTON'
        );
    }

    console.log('OPCODE:', hexOpcode(message.body));

    try {
        console.log(
            'BODY BOC:',
            message.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
        );
    } catch {
        console.log('BODY BOC: UNAVAILABLE');
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI V2.2 LIQUIDITY TRANSACTION INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log('NETWORK: TESTNET');
    console.log('WALLET:', USER.toString());
    console.log('TARGET LT:', TARGET_LT.toString());
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet-v4.tonhubapi.com',
    });

    const last = await client.getLastBlock();

    const account = await client.getAccount(
        last.last.seqno,
        USER
    );

    if (!account.account.last) {
        throw new Error('Wallet has no transaction history.');
    }

    const latestLt = BigInt(account.account.last.lt);

    const latestHash = Buffer.from(
        account.account.last.hash,
        'base64'
    );

    const transactions = await client.getAccountTransactions(
        USER,
        latestLt,
        latestHash
    );

    const item = transactions.find(
        (x: any) => BigInt(x.tx.lt) === TARGET_LT
    );

    if (!item) {
        throw new Error(
            `Target transaction LT ${TARGET_LT} was not found in recent transactions.`
        );
    }

    const tx: any = item.tx;

    console.log('TRANSACTION FOUND: PASS');
    console.log('');
    console.log('LT:', tx.lt.toString());
    console.log('HASH:', tx.hash().toString('hex'));
    console.log('TIME:', tx.now);
    console.log('BLOCK SEQNO:', item.block.seqno);
    console.log(
        'TOTAL FEES:',
        tx.totalFees.coins.toString(),
        'nanoTON'
    );
    console.log('OUT MESSAGES:', tx.outMessagesCount);

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('INCOMING MESSAGE');
    console.log('============================================================');

    messageInfo(tx.inMessage, 'IN');

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('OUTGOING MESSAGES');
    console.log('============================================================');

   const outMessages: any[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < tx.outMessagesCount; i++) {
    const message = tx.outMessages.get(i);
    outMessages.push(message);
}

    console.log('');
    console.log('Decoded outgoing messages:', outMessages.length);

    for (let i = 0; i < outMessages.length; i++) {
        messageInfo(outMessages[i], i + 1);
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('EXPECTED DESTINATION CHECKS');
    console.log('============================================================');

    for (let i = 0; i < outMessages.length; i++) {
        const message = outMessages[i];

        if (message.info.type !== 'internal') {
            continue;
        }

        const destination = message.info.dest.toString();

        console.log('');
        console.log(`MESSAGE ${i + 1} DESTINATION:`);
        console.log(destination);

        console.log(
            'ROOSTER WALLET MATCH:',
            destination === EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET
                ? 'YES'
                : 'NO'
        );

        console.log(
            'pTON POOL WALLET MATCH:',
            destination === EXPECTED_PTON_POOL_WALLET
                ? 'YES'
                : 'NO'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' INSPECTION COMPLETE');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');
    console.log('READ ONLY.');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('');

    void provider;
}

import { Address, beginCell, fromNano } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQBsGx9ArADUrREB34W-ghgsCgBShvfUr4Jvlu-0KGc33Rbt'
);

const ROOSTER_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
);

const USER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    '0QDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N6R-'
);

// فقط برای ساخت پارامتر تراکنش.
// این مقدار هرگز ارسال نمی‌شود.
const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 100n * 1_000_000_000n;
const MIN_LP_OUT = 1n;

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi V1 READ-ONLY LIQUIDITY INSPECTION');
    console.log('==============================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER Master:');
    console.log(ROOSTER_MASTER.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON V1 Master:');
    console.log(PTON_MASTER.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Router:');
    console.log(ROUTER.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('User wallet:');
    console.log(USER_WALLET.toString());

    const router = DEX.v1.Router.create(ROUTER);
    const routerProvider = provider.provider(ROUTER);

    // ------------------------------------------
    // 1. Calculate pool address
    // ------------------------------------------

    const poolAddress =
        await router.getPoolAddressByJettonMinters(
            routerProvider,
            {
                token0: ROOSTER_MASTER,
                token1: PTON_MASTER,
            }
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------');
    console.log('POOL');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------');

    console.log('Pool address:');
    console.log(poolAddress.toString());

    // ------------------------------------------
    // 2. Get ROOSTER Router wallet
    // ------------------------------------------

    const roosterRouterWalletResult =
        await provider
            .provider(ROOSTER_MASTER)
            .get('get_wallet_address', [
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: addressToCell(ROUTER),
                },
            ]);

    const roosterRouterWalletAddress =
        roosterRouterWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER Router wallet:');
    console.log(roosterRouterWalletAddress.toString());

    // ------------------------------------------
    // 3. Get pTON Router wallet
    // ------------------------------------------

    const ptonRouterWalletResult =
        await provider
            .provider(PTON_MASTER)
            .get('get_wallet_address', [
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: addressToCell(ROUTER),
                },
            ]);

    const ptonRouterWalletAddress =
        ptonRouterWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON Router wallet:');
    console.log(ptonRouterWalletAddress.toString());

    // ------------------------------------------
    // 4. Get user's ROOSTER wallet
    // ------------------------------------------

    const roosterUserWalletResult =
        await provider
            .provider(ROOSTER_MASTER)
            .get('get_wallet_address', [
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: addressToCell(USER_WALLET),
                },
            ]);

    const roosterUserWalletAddress =
        roosterUserWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

    console.log('');
    console.log('User ROOSTER wallet:');
    console.log(roosterUserWalletAddress.toString());

    // ------------------------------------------
    // 5. Build liquidity transaction parameters
    // ------------------------------------------

    console.log('');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------');
    console.log('BUILDING LIQUIDITY TX PARAMETERS');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Test amount:');
    console.log('100 ROOSTER');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Minimum LP out:');
    console.log(MIN_LP_OUT.toString());

    const txParams =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                userWalletAddress: USER_WALLET,
                sendTokenAddress: ROOSTER_MASTER,
                otherTokenAddress: PTON_MASTER,
                sendAmount: ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString(),
                minLpOut: MIN_LP_OUT.toString(),
            }
        );

    // ------------------------------------------
    // 6. Print transaction parameters
    // ------------------------------------------

    console.log('');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------');
    console.log('TRANSACTION PARAMETERS');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Destination (to):');
    console.log(txParams.to.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('TON value:');
    console.log(txParams.value.toString(), 'nanoTON');

    console.log(
        'TON value:',
        fromNano(txParams.value),
        'TON'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER amount:');
    console.log(ROOSTER_AMOUNT.toString(), 'raw');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER amount:',
        Number(ROOSTER_AMOUNT) / 1_000_000_000,
        'ROOSTER'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Body exists:');
    console.log(txParams.body ? 'YES' : 'NO');

    if (txParams.body) {
        const bodyBoc = txParams.body.toBoc();

        console.log('');
        console.log('Transaction body BOC:');
        console.log(bodyBoc.toString('base64'));

        console.log('');
        console.log('Transaction body size:');
        console.log(bodyBoc.length, 'bytes');
    } else {
        console.log('');
        console.log('Transaction body BOC: NONE');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------
    // 7. Read current pool state
    // ------------------------------------------

    console.log('');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------');
    console.log('CURRENT POOL STATE');
    console.log('----------------------------------------------');

    try {
        const poolData =
            await provider
                .provider(poolAddress)
                .get('get_pool_data', []);

        console.log('Pool get_pool_data succeeded.');
        console.log(poolData.stack);
    } catch (error) {
        console.log(
            'Pool get_pool_data could not be executed.'
        );

        console.log(
            'This normally means the calculated pool is not deployed yet.'
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------
    // 8. Safety information
    // ------------------------------------------

    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY CHECK COMPLETE');
    console.log('==============================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('NO ROOSTER WAS TRANSFERRED.');
    console.log('NO TON WAS TRANSFERRED.');
    console.log('NO LIQUIDITY WAS ADDED.');

    console.log('');
}

const TARGET_LT = 99809465000012n;

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v3/transactions';

function opName(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';

    switch (op >>> 0) {
        case 0x06ecd527:
            return 'LP_ACCOUNT_CALLBACK';

        case 0x50c6a654:
            return 'ADD_LIQUIDITY';

        case 0x178d4519:
            return 'JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER';

        case 0x37c096df:
            return 'ROUTER_PROVIDE_LP_V22';

        case 0x0f8a7ea5:
            return 'PROVIDE_LP';

        default:
            return 'UNKNOWN';
    }
}

function printSeparator() {
    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(70));
}

    console.log('NOW:');
    console.log(tx.now);

    console.log('END STATUS:');
    console.log(tx.end_status);

    console.log('TOTAL FEES:');
    console.log(tx.total_fees);
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    console.log('='.repeat(70));
    console.log(' STON.fi v2.2 LP ACCOUNT TRANSACTION SEARCH');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));

    console.log('\nLP ACCOUNT:');
    console.log(LP_ACCOUNT.toString());

    console.log('\nTARGET LT:');
    console.log(TARGET_LT.toString());

    console.log('\nSOURCE:');
    console.log(TONCENTER);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fetch recent transactions from TON Center Testnet V3
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const url =
        TONCENTER +
        '?account=' +
        encodeURIComponent(LP_ACCOUNT.toString()) +
        '&limit=20' +
        '&offset=0' +
        '&sort=desc';

    console.log('\nFetching transactions...');

    const response = await fetch(url);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `TONCENTER HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`
        );
    }

    const data = await response.json();

    const transactions = data.transactions ?? [];

    console.log('\nTRANSACTIONS RETURNED:');
    console.log(transactions.length);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Print timeline
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    printSeparator();
    console.log(' LP ACCOUNT TRANSACTION TIMELINE');
    printSeparator();

    for (const tx of transactions) {

        const lt = BigInt(tx.lt);

        console.log('\n' + '-'.repeat(70));

        printShortTx(tx);

        if (lt === TARGET_LT) {
            console.log('\n*** TARGET TRANSACTION ***');
        }

        if (lt > TARGET_LT) {
            console.log('\n*** NEWER THAN TARGET ***');
        }

        if (lt < TARGET_LT) {
            console.log('\n*** OLDER THAN TARGET ***');
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Find target
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const target = transactions.find(
        (tx: any) => BigInt(tx.lt) === TARGET_LT
    );

    printSeparator();
    console.log(' TARGET SEARCH');
    printSeparator();

    if (!target) {

        console.log('\nTARGET FOUND: NO');

        console.log(
            '\nThe returned 20 transactions did not contain LT',
            TARGET_LT.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            '\nThis does NOT mean the transaction is missing.'
        );

        console.log(
            'It may simply be outside the first 20 indexed results.'
        );

    } else {

        console.log('\nTARGET FOUND: YES');

        printShortTx(target);

        console.log('\nTARGET JSON:');

        console.log(
            JSON.stringify(target, null, 2)
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Newer transactions
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const newer = transactions.filter(
        (tx: any) => BigInt(tx.lt) > TARGET_LT
    );

    printSeparator();
    console.log(' TRANSACTIONS AFTER TARGET');
    printSeparator();

    console.log(
        '\nCOUNT:',
        newer.length
    );

    for (const tx of newer) {

        console.log('\nLT:', tx.lt);
        console.log('HASH:', tx.hash);
        console.log('NOW:', tx.now);
        console.log('END STATUS:', tx.end_status);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Older transactions
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const older = transactions.filter(
        (tx: any) => BigInt(tx.lt) < TARGET_LT
    );

    printSeparator();
    console.log(' TRANSACTIONS BEFORE TARGET');
    printSeparator();

    console.log(
        '\nCOUNT:',
        older.length
    );

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Final
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    printSeparator();
    console.log(' SEARCH COMPLETE');
    printSeparator();

    console.log('\nREAD ONLY');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
}

function formatToken(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction.length > 0
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : whole.toString();
}

FILE: scripts\inspectLpAccountFlowV22.ts
