import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LP_ACCOUNT = Address.parse(
    'EQCEwfJtb6ZmPJdNw387eJwed2N51K6dFFbH82jTxe_cf31e'
);

const TARGET_CALLBACK_LT = '99809465000012';

const OP_JETTON_TRANSFER = 0x0f8a7ea5;
const OP_CALLBACK_ADD_LIQUIDITY = 0x06ecd527;
const OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY = 0x50c6a654;

function opcodeHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) {
        return 'UNKNOWN';
    }

    return (
        '0x' +
        op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
    );
}

function getOpcode(cell: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = cell.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function formatInteger(value: bigint): string {
    return value
        .toString()
        .replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
}

function formatToken9(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    if (fraction.length === 0) {
        return whole.toLocaleString();
    }

    return `${whole.toLocaleString()}.${fraction}`;
}

function messageInfo(
    body: Cell,
    prefix: string
) {
    const opcode = getOpcode(body);

    console.log('');
    console.log(`${prefix} OPCODE:`);
    console.log(opcodeHex(opcode));

    console.log('');
    console.log(`${prefix} BODY:`);
    console.log(
        `${body.bits.length} bits / ${body.refs.length} refs`
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(`${prefix} BOC:`);
    console.log(
        body.toBoc().toString('base64')
    );

    return opcode;
}

function tryDecodeJettonTransfer(
    body: Cell
) {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

        if (opcode !== OP_JETTON_TRANSFER) {
            return;
        }

        const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

        const amount = s.loadCoins();

        const destination = s.loadAddress();

        const responseDestination = s.loadAddress();

        const customPayloadBit = s.loadBit();

        if (customPayloadBit) {
            s.loadRef();
        }

        const forwardTonAmount = s.loadCoins();

        let forwardPayloadDescription = '';

        if (s.remainingBits > 0) {
            const forwardPayloadIsRef = s.loadBit();

            if (forwardPayloadIsRef) {
                if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
                    const forwardPayload = s.loadRef();

                    forwardPayloadDescription =
                        `ref: ${forwardPayload.bits.length} bits / ${forwardPayload.refs.length} refs`;
                }
            } else {
                forwardPayloadDescription =
                    'inline';
            }
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('---------------- JETTON TRANSFER DECODE ----------------');

        console.log('');
        console.log('QUERY ID:');
        console.log(queryId.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('AMOUNT RAW:');
        console.log(formatInteger(amount));

        console.log('');
        console.log('AMOUNT TOKEN UNITS:');
        console.log(formatToken9(amount));

        console.log('');
        console.log('DESTINATION:');
        console.log(
            destination
                ? destination.toString()
                : 'NULL'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('RESPONSE DESTINATION:');
        console.log(
            responseDestination
                ? responseDestination.toString()
                : 'NULL'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('FORWARD TON AMOUNT:');
        console.log(
            formatInteger(forwardTonAmount)
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('FORWARD PAYLOAD:');
        console.log(
            forwardPayloadDescription || 'NONE'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('--------------------------------------------------------');
    } catch {
        console.log('');
        console.log('JETTON TRANSFER DECODE: FAILED');
    }
}

function tryDecodeCallback(
    body: Cell
) {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        const opcode = s.loadUint(32);

        if (opcode !== OP_CALLBACK_ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
            return;
        }

        const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

        const amount0 = s.loadCoins();

        const amount1 = s.loadCoins();

        const userAddress = s.loadAddress();

        const minLpOut = s.loadCoins();

        const fwdAmount = s.loadCoins();

        const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

        if (hasCustomPayload) {
            s.loadRef();
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('================ CALLBACK DECODE =================');

        console.log('');
        console.log('QUERY ID:');
        console.log(queryId.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('TOT AM0:');
        console.log(
            `${formatInteger(amount0)} raw`
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('TOT AM0 TOKEN:');
        console.log(
            formatToken9(amount0)
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('TOT AM1:');
        console.log(
            `${formatInteger(amount1)} raw`
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('TOT AM1 TOKEN:');
        console.log(
            formatToken9(amount1)
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('USER:');
        console.log(
            userAddress
                ? userAddress.toString()
                : 'NULL'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('MIN LP OUT:');
        console.log(
            formatInteger(minLpOut)
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('FWD AMOUNT:');
        console.log(
            formatInteger(fwdAmount)
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            '================================================='
        );
    } catch {
        console.log('');
        console.log('CALLBACK DECODE: FAILED');
    }
}

export async function run(
    _provider: NetworkProvider
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi v2.2 LP ACCOUNT FLOW INSPECTOR');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('LP ACCOUNT:');
    console.log(LP_ACCOUNT.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET CALLBACK LT:');
    console.log(TARGET_CALLBACK_LT);

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint:
            'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('Fetching LP Account transactions...');

    const transactions =
        await client.getTransactions(
            LP_ACCOUNT,
            {
                limit: 100,
            }
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log('TRANSACTIONS FETCHED:');
    console.log(transactions.length);

    let txIndex = 0;

    for (const tx of transactions) {

        txIndex++;

        const lt = tx.lt.toString();

        const hash =
            tx.hash().toString('base64');

        console.log('');
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );
        console.log(
            ` LP ACCOUNT TX #${txIndex}`
        );
        console.log(
            '============================================================'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('LT:');
        console.log(lt);

        console.log('');
        console.log('HASH:');
        console.log(hash);

        console.log('');
        console.log('TIMESTAMP:');
        console.log(tx.now.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('MATCH TARGET CALLBACK LT:');
        console.log(
            lt === TARGET_CALLBACK_LT
                ? 'YES'
                : 'NO'
        );


        /*
         * ========================================================
         * INCOMING MESSAGE
         * ========================================================
         */

        if (tx.inMessage) {

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                '---------------- INCOMING MESSAGE ----------------'
            );

            const inMessage =
                tx.inMessage;

            if (
                inMessage.info.type ===
                'internal'
            ) {
                console.log('');
                console.log('SOURCE:');
                console.log(
                    inMessage.info.src.toString()
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('DESTINATION:');
                console.log(
                    inMessage.info.dest.toString()
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('VALUE:');
                console.log(
                    inMessage.info.value.coins.toString()
                );
            }

            const opcode =
                messageInfo(
                    inMessage.body,
                    'INCOMING'
                );

            console.log('');
            console.log('KNOWN OPCODE:');

            if (
                opcode ===
                OP_JETTON_TRANSFER
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'JETTON TRANSFER 0x0f8a7ea5'
                );

                tryDecodeJettonTransfer(
                    inMessage.body
                );
            } else if (
                opcode ===
                OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'ADD LIQUIDITY 0x50c6a654'
                );
            } else if (
                opcode ===
                OP_CALLBACK_ADD_LIQUIDITY
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'CALLBACK ADD LIQUIDITY 0x06ecd527'
                );

                tryDecodeCallback(
                    inMessage.body
                );
            } else {
                console.log(
                    'OTHER / UNKNOWN'
                );
            }
        }


        /*
         * ========================================================
         * OUTGOING MESSAGES
         * ========================================================
         */

        let outIndex = 0;

        for (
            const outMessage
            of tx.outMessages.values()
        ) {

            outIndex++;

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `---------------- OUTGOING MESSAGE #${outIndex} ----------------`
            );

            if (
                outMessage.info.type ===
                'internal'
            ) {
                console.log('');
                console.log('SOURCE:');

                console.log(
                    outMessage.info.src.toString()
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('DESTINATION:');

                console.log(
                    outMessage.info.dest.toString()
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('VALUE:');

                console.log(
                    outMessage.info.value.coins.toString()
                );
            }

            const opcode =
                messageInfo(
                    outMessage.body,
                    'OUTGOING'
                );

            console.log('');
            console.log('KNOWN OPCODE:');

            if (
                opcode ===
                OP_JETTON_TRANSFER
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'JETTON TRANSFER 0x0f8a7ea5'
                );

                tryDecodeJettonTransfer(
                    outMessage.body
                );
            } else if (
                opcode ===
                OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'ADD LIQUIDITY 0x50c6a654'
                );
            } else if (
                opcode ===
                OP_CALLBACK_ADD_LIQUIDITY
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'CALLBACK ADD LIQUIDITY 0x06ecd527'
                );

                tryDecodeCallback(
                    outMessage.body
                );
            } else {
                console.log(
                    'OTHER / UNKNOWN'
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');

import { Address, TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';

function printObjectKeys(label: string, obj: any) {
    console.log(`${label} KEYS:`);

    if (obj && typeof obj === 'object') {
        console.log(Object.keys(obj));
    } else {
        console.log('NOT AN OBJECT');
    }
}

function inspectMessage(label: string, message: any) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`========== ${label} ==========`);

    if (!message) {
        console.log('MESSAGE: null');
        return;
    }

    printObjectKeys('MESSAGE', message);

    console.log(
        'MESSAGE TYPE:',
        message?.constructor?.name
    );

    if (message.info) {
        console.log('MESSAGE.INFO KEYS:');
        console.log(Object.keys(message.info));

        console.log(
            'MESSAGE.INFO:',
            message.info
        );
    }

    if (message.body) {
        console.log(
            'BODY TYPE:',
            message.body?.constructor?.name
        );

        try {
            console.log(
                'BODY BOC:',
                message.body
                    .toBoc()
                    .toString('base64')
            );
        } catch (e) {
            console.log(
                'BODY BOC ERROR:',
                e
            );
        }

        try {
            console.log(
                'BODY HASH:',
                message.body
                    .hash()
                    .toString('hex')
            );
        } catch (e) {
            console.log(
                'BODY HASH ERROR:',
                e
            );
        }
    }
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';

const TARGET = Address.parse(
    'EQCEwfJtb6ZmPJdNw387eJwed2N51K6dFFbH82jTxe_cf31e'
);

const CODE_BOC =
    'te6cckEBAQEAIwAIQgLJWi7SKrUW93+dSJjcRXjnLxiiRI6PaDIzSwtL9QG8eU64SPQ=';

const DATA_BOC =
    'te6cckEBAQEASwAAkYAeM/JhbYuSvXHvxwN8SFZlPJVS0Yw5quApnQybzRcvhvAD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B/teWN17MZq1F0h26AAJ1XV7e';

function printHex(buffer: Buffer) {
    console.log(buffer.toString('hex'));

    console.log();
    console.log('BYTES:');

    for (let i = 0; i < buffer.length; i += 16) {
        const row: string[] = [];

        for (
            let j = i;
            j < Math.min(i + 16, buffer.length);
            j++
        ) {
            row.push(
                buffer[j].toString(16).padStart(2, '0')
            );
        }

        console.log(
            i.toString().padStart(4, '0'),
            row.join(' ')
        );
    }
}

);

);

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

function fmt(value: bigint, decimals: number): string {
    const negative = value < 0n;
    const v = negative ? -value : value;

    const s = v.toString().padStart(decimals + 1, '0');
    const integer = s.slice(0, -decimals);
    const fraction = s.slice(-decimals);

    return `${negative ? '-' : ''}${integer}.${fraction}`;
}

);

const RPC = 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

function fmt9(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;
    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0');

    return `${whole}.${frac}`;
}

function printAddress(label: string, address: Address | null) {
    console.log(`${label}:`);
    console.log(address ? address.toString() : 'null');
}

            [
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: beginCell()
                        .storeAddress(OWNER)
                        .endCell(),
                },
            ]
        );

        console.log('\nRAW STACK:');
        console.dir(result.stack, { depth: null });

        const calculated = result.stack.readAddress();

        printAddress('\nCALCULATED LP WALLET', calculated);
        printAddress('\nKNOWN LP WALLET', LP_WALLET);

        console.log(
            '\nLP WALLET MATCH:',
            calculated.equals(LP_WALLET)
        );

    } catch (e) {
        console.log('\nget_wallet_address ERROR:');
        console.log(e);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 4. get_lp_account_address(owner)
    // ============================================================

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('4. POOL get_lp_account_address(owner)');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    let lpAccount: Address | null = null;

    try {
        const result = await client.runMethod(
            POOL,
            'get_lp_account_address',
            [
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: beginCell()
                        .storeAddress(OWNER)
                        .endCell(),
                },
            ]
        );

        console.log('\nRAW STACK:');
        console.dir(result.stack, { depth: null });

        lpAccount = result.stack.readAddress();

        printAddress('\nLP ACCOUNT ADDRESS', lpAccount);

    } catch (e) {
        console.log('\nget_lp_account_address ERROR:');
        console.log(e);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 5. LP Account getter
    // ============================================================

    if (lpAccount) {

        console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
        console.log('5. LP ACCOUNT DATA');
        console.log('='.repeat(78));

        try {
            const result = await client.runMethod(
                lpAccount,
                'get_lp_account_data',
                []
            );

            console.log('\nRAW STACK:');
            console.dir(result.stack, { depth: null });

        } catch (e) {
            console.log('\nLP ACCOUNT GETTER ERROR:');
            console.log(e);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 6. LP Wallet getter
    // ============================================================

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('6. LP WALLET get_wallet_data()');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    try {
        const result = await client.runMethod(
            LP_WALLET,
            'get_wallet_data',
            []
        );

        console.log('\nRAW STACK:');
        console.dir(result.stack, { depth: null });

        const balance = result.stack.readBigNumber();
        const owner = result.stack.readAddress();
        const master = result.stack.readAddress();
        const code = result.stack.readCell();

        console.log('\nDECODED LP WALLET');

        console.log('\n1. BALANCE RAW:');
        console.log(balance.toString());

        console.log('\n2. BALANCE / 1e9:');
        console.log(fmt9(balance));

        printAddress('\n3. OWNER', owner);
        printAddress('\n4. MASTER / POOL', master);

        console.log('\n5. CODE BOC:');
        console.log(code.toBoc().toString('hex'));

    } catch (e) {
        console.log('\nLP WALLET DATA ERROR:');
        console.log(e);
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('INSPECTION COMPLETE');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

import { Address, TonClient4 } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const TESTNET_ENDPOINT = 'https://testnet-v4.tonhubapi.com';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const LP_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCNnXhynq5G7RZ8glhXSNg6eXby1kzqD-p8HNxu6PN5SIgd'
);

const TARGET_LT = BigInt('99809465000012');

const TARGET_HASH = Buffer.from(
    '7f91056d5cef6db3b01afa3304191b66ec64b9839d15cc660ba9c85d00efa3cf',
    'hex'
);

const INTERNAL_TRANSFER_OP = 0x178d4519;

function printAddress(label: string, address: Address) {
    console.log(`${label}: ${address.toString()}`);
}

function inspectMessage(message: any) {
    if (!message) {
        console.log('MESSAGE: null');
        return;
    }

    console.log('MESSAGE TYPE:', message.constructor?.name);

    if (message.info) {
        console.log('INFO:', message.info);
    }

    if (!message.body) {
        console.log('NO BODY');
        return;
    }

    console.log(
        'BODY BOC:',
        message.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
    );

    try {
        const slice = message.body.beginParse();

        const op = slice.loadUint(32);

        console.log(
            'OPCODE:',
            '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );

        if (op !== INTERNAL_TRANSFER_OP) {
            return;
        }

        const queryId = slice.loadUintBig(64);
        const amount = slice.loadCoins();
        const from = slice.loadAddress();
        const responseAddress = slice.loadAddress();
        const forwardTonAmount = slice.loadCoins();

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            '========== JETTON INTERNAL TRANSFER =========='
        );

        console.log(
            'query_id:',
            queryId.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'LP TOKEN AMOUNT:',
            amount.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'LP TOKEN AMOUNT DISPLAY:',
            Number(amount) / 1_000_000_000
        );

        console.log('');

        printAddress('from:', from);

        console.log('');

        printAddress(
            'response_address:',
            responseAddress
        );

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'forward_ton_amount:',
            forwardTonAmount.toString()
        );

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'REMAINING BITS:',
            slice.remainingBits
        );

        console.log(
            'REMAINING REFS:',
            slice.remainingRefs
        );
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'BODY PARSE ERROR:',
            error
        );
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '=============================================================='
    );
    console.log(
        ' STON.FI v2.2 LP MINT INSPECTOR'
    );
    console.log(
        ' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT'
    );
    console.log(
        '=============================================================='
    );
    console.log('');

    const client = new TonClient4({
        endpoint: TESTNET_ENDPOINT,
    });

    const latest = await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log(
        'MASTERCHAIN SEQNO:',
        latest.last.seqno
    );

    console.log('');

    printAddress('POOL', POOL);

    console.log(
        'TARGET LT:',
        TARGET_LT.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'TARGET HASH:',
        TARGET_HASH.toString('hex')
    );

    console.log('');

    const transactions =
        await client.getAccountTransactions(
            POOL,
            TARGET_LT,
            TARGET_HASH
        );

    console.log(
        'TRANSACTIONS RETURNED:',
        transactions.length
    );

    console.log('');

    for (let i = 0; i < transactions.length; i++) {
        const tx: any = transactions[i].tx;

        if (!tx) {
            continue;
        }

        console.log(
            '=============================================================='
        );

        console.log(
            `TRANSACTION #${i + 1}`
        );

        console.log(
            '=============================================================='
        );

        console.log(
            'LT:',
            tx.lt?.toString()
        );

        const txHash =
            typeof tx.hash === 'function'
                ? tx.hash().toString('hex')
                : tx.hash
                    ? Buffer.from(tx.hash).toString('hex')
                    : 'N/A';

        console.log(
            'HASH:',
            txHash
        );

        console.log(
            'OUT MESSAGES:',
            tx.outMessagesCount
        );

        const outMessages: any =
            tx.outMessages;

        console.log(
            'OUT_MESSAGES TYPE:',
            outMessages?.constructor?.name
        );

        console.log(
            'INTERNAL MAP TYPE:',
            outMessages?._map?.constructor?.name
        );

        if (!outMessages?._map) {
            console.log(
                'NO INTERNAL _map FOUND'
            );
            continue;
        }

        const internalMap: Map<any, any> =
            outMessages._map;

        console.log(
            'INTERNAL MAP SIZE:',
            internalMap.size
        );

        for (
            const [key, message]
            of internalMap.entries()
        ) {
            console.log('');
            console.log(
                '--------------------------------------------------------------'
            );

            console.log(
                'OUTBOUND DICTIONARY KEY:',
                key
            );

            if (!message) {
                continue;
            }

            if (message.info) {
                console.log(
                    'DESTINATION:',
                    message.info.dest?.toString?.()
                );

                console.log(
                    'VALUE:',
                    message.info.value
                );
            }

            if (message.body) {
                console.log(
                    'BODY BOC:',
                    message.body
                        .toBoc()
                        .toString('base64')
                );

                try {
                    const probe =
                        message.body.beginParse();

                    const op =
                        probe.loadUint(32);

                    console.log(
                        'OPCODE:',
                        '0x' +
                        op
                            .toString(16)
                            .padStart(8, '0')
                    );

                    if (
                        op === INTERNAL_TRANSFER_OP
                    ) {
                        console.log('');
                        console.log(
                            '*** FOUND LP INTERNAL TRANSFER ***'
                        );

                        inspectMessage(message);
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.log(
                        'OPCODE PARSE ERROR:',
                        error
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '=============================================================='
    );
    console.log(
        ' READ ONLY: YES'
    );
    console.log(
        ' TRANSACTION SENT: NO'
    );
    console.log(
        '=============================================================='
    );
    console.log('');
}

);

const RPC = 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

function safeError(e: any): string {
    return e?.response?.data?.result ||
           e?.message ||
           String(e);
}

function fmt9(n: bigint): string {
    const whole = n / 1_000_000_000n;
    const frac = (n % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0');

    return `${whole}.${frac}`;
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: RPC,
    });

    console.log('='.repeat(70));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP SHORT INSPECTOR');

    console.log('='.repeat(70));

    // ============================================================
    // 1
    // ============================================================

    console.log('\n[1] get_jetton_data');

    try {
        const r = await client.runMethod(
            POOL,
            'get_jetton_data',
            []
        );

        const totalSupply = r.stack.readBigNumber();
        const mintable = r.stack.readBigNumber();
        const admin = r.stack.readAddress();

        console.log('ERROR =', safeError(e));
    }

    // ============================================================

        );

        console.log('STACK_ITEMS =', r.stack.remaining);

        while (r.stack.remaining > 0) {
            try {
                console.log('ITEM =', r.stack.readBigNumber().toString());
            } catch {
                try {
                    console.log('ITEM =', r.stack.readAddress()?.toString());
                } catch {
                    console.log('ITEM = [non-numeric/non-address]');
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.log('ERROR =', safeError(e));
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 3

    console.log('\n[3] get_wallet_address');

    try {

import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LP_WALLET =
    'EQCNnXhynq5G7RZ8glhXSNg6eXby1kzqD-p8HNxu6PN5SIgd';

const ENDPOINT =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

async function rpc(method: string, params: any) {
    const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            jsonrpc: '2.0',
            id: 1,
            method,
            params,
        }),
    });

    return await response.json();
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP WALLET GETTER');
    console.log(' get_wallet_data()');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    console.log('\nLP Wallet:');
    console.log(LP_WALLET);

    console.log('\nCalling get_wallet_data...');

    const result = await rpc(
        'runGetMethod',
        {
            address: LP_WALLET,
            method: 'get_wallet_data',
            stack: [],
        }
    );

    console.log('\nRAW GETTER RESPONSE:');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

    if (!result.ok || !result.result) {
        console.log('\nGETTER FAILED');
        return;
    }

    const stack = result.result.stack ?? [];

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('GETTER STACK');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    console.log(
        JSON.stringify(stack, null, 2)
    );

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('EXPECTED LP WALLET DATA');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    console.log(`
Expected get_wallet_data() result:

[0] balance
[1] owner_address
[2] master_address
[3] wallet_code
`);

    if (stack.length >= 1) {
        console.log(
            '\n[0] LP BALANCE RAW:'
        );
        console.log(
            JSON.stringify(stack[0], null, 2)
        );
    }

    if (stack.length >= 2) {
        console.log(
            '\n[1] OWNER RAW:'
        );
        console.log(
            JSON.stringify(stack[1], null, 2)
        );
    }

    if (stack.length >= 3) {
        console.log(
            '\n[2] MASTER / POOL RAW:'
        );
        console.log(
            JSON.stringify(stack[2], null, 2)
        );
    }

    if (stack.length >= 4) {
        console.log(
            '\n[3] WALLET CODE RAW:'
        );
        console.log(
            JSON.stringify(stack[3], null, 2)
        );
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('GETTER COMPLETE');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LP_WALLET_RAW =
    '0:8D9D78729EAE46ED167C82585748D83A7976F2D64CEA0FEA7C1CDC6EE8F37948';

const POOL_RAW =
    '0:F900B682B84A89ECC8BDAA55CE03B04732B4EAF1ED9F67907FB5E58DD7B319AB';

const EXPECTED_AMOUNT = '146643762880';

const API =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v3/transactions';

function friendly(raw: string) {
    try {
        return Address.parse(raw).toString({
            urlSafe: true,
            bounceable: true,
            testOnly: true,
        });
    } catch {
        return raw;
    }
}

function printSeparator() {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
}

function printMessage(msg: any, index: number) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`MESSAGE #${index}`);
    console.log('-'.repeat(72));

    console.log('hash        =', msg.hash);
    console.log('source      =', msg.source);
    console.log('destination =', msg.destination);
    console.log('value       =', msg.value);
    console.log('created_lt  =', msg.created_lt);
    console.log('opcode      =', msg.opcode);
    console.log('decoded     =', msg.decoded_opcode);
    console.log('bounced     =', msg.bounced);

    if (msg.message_content?.decoded) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('DECODED BODY:');

        console.dir(
            msg.message_content.decoded,
            {
                depth: null,
                colors: false,
            }
        );
    }
}

    }

    // TON Center v3 returns:
    // {

    // }

    const transactions: any[] =

                ? raw.transactions

    console.log('');

        return;
    }

    for (

        );

            tx.prev_trans_lt
        );

        console.log(

            tx.now
        );

        console.log(

            tx.total_fees
        );

        console.log(
            'aborted         =',
            tx.description?.aborted
        );

        console.log(
            'compute_success =',
            tx.description?.compute_ph?.success
        );

        console.log(
            'compute_exit    =',

        );

            tx.finality
        );

        console.log('');

        );

        if (tx.account_state_after) {
            console.log(
                'balance         =',
                tx.account_state_after.balance
            );

            console.log(
                'account_status  =',
                tx.account_state_after.account_status
            );

            console.log(
                'code_hash       =',
                tx.account_state_after.code_hash
            );

            console.log(
                'data_hash       =',
                tx.account_state_after.data_hash
            );
        } else {
            console.log(
                'NO ACCOUNT STATE AFTER'
            );
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'INCOMING MESSAGE:'
        );

        if (tx.in_msg) {
            printMessage(
                tx.in_msg,
                1
            );

            const decoded =
                tx.in_msg
                    ?.message_content
                    ?.decoded;

            const amount =
                decoded?.amount?.value;

            if (
                tx.in_msg.source === POOL_RAW &&
                tx.in_msg.opcode === '0x178d4519'
            ) {
                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    '*** MATCH: POOL -> LP WALLET ***'
                );

                console.log(
                    'transfer amount =',
                    amount ??
                    'NOT DECODED'
                );

                console.log(
                    'expected amount =',
                    EXPECTED_AMOUNT
                );

                console.log(
                    'amount match    =',
                    amount === EXPECTED_AMOUNT
                        ? 'YES'
                        : 'NO'
                );
            }
        } else {
            console.log(
                'NO INCOMING MESSAGE'
            );
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'OUTGOING MESSAGES:'
        );

        if (
            Array.isArray(tx.out_msgs)
        ) {
            console.log(
                'count =',
                tx.out_msgs.length
            );

            tx.out_msgs.forEach(
                (msg: any, j: number) => {
                    printMessage(
                        msg,
                        j + 1
                    );
                }
            );
        } else {
            console.log(
                'NO OUTGOING MESSAGES'
            );
        }
    }

    printSeparator();

    console.log(
        ' END OF READ-ONLY LP WALLET INSPECTION'
    );

    printSeparator();
}

const LP_WALLET =

const ENDPOINT =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

async function rpc(
    method: string,
    params: any
) {
    const response = await fetch(ENDPOINT, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            jsonrpc: '2.0',
            id: 1,
            method,
            params,
        }),
    });

    return await response.json();
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LP_WALLET =
    'EQCNnXhynq5G7RZ8glhXSNg6eXby1kzqD-p8HNxu6PN5SIgd';

const TARGET_LT = 99809465000012n;

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/getTransactions';

const OPCODE_LP_TRANSFER = 0x178d4519;

function opcodeHex(value: number): string {
    return '0x' + value.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function nanoToTon(value: string | number | bigint): string {
    return (Number(value) / 1e9).toFixed(9);
}

function decodeBody(bodyBase64: string) {
    try {
        const cell = Cell.fromBoc(
            Buffer.from(bodyBase64, 'base64')
        )[0];

        const slice = cell.beginParse();

        const opcode = slice.loadUint(32);

        let queryId: bigint | null = null;

        if (slice.remainingBits >= 64) {
            queryId = slice.loadUintBig(64);
        }

        return {
            opcode,
            queryId,
            remainingBits: slice.remainingBits,
            remainingRefs: slice.remainingRefs,
        };
    } catch (e) {
        return {
            error: String(e),
        };
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP WALLET MESSAGE TRACE');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    console.log('\nLP Wallet:');
    console.log(LP_WALLET);

    console.log('\nTarget Pool LT:');
    console.log(TARGET_LT.toString());

    console.log('\nExpected opcode:');
    console.log(opcodeHex(OPCODE_LP_TRANSFER));

    console.log('\nFETCHING LP WALLET TRANSACTIONS...');

    const response = await fetch(TONCENTER, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
            address: LP_WALLET,
            limit: 30,
        }),
    });

    const json: any = await response.json();

    if (!json.ok) {
        console.log('\nTONCENTER ERROR:');
        console.log(JSON.stringify(json, null, 2));
        return;
    }

    const transactions = json.result ?? [];

    console.log(
        `Fetched ${transactions.length} recent LP Wallet transactions.`
    );

    let found = 0;

    for (const tx of transactions) {
        const lt = BigInt(
            tx.transaction_id?.lt ?? 0
        );

        /*
         * We are interested in the LP Wallet transaction
         * immediately after Pool LT 99809465000012.
         *
         * The exact LT may differ because account LT is local,
         * so inspect a small surrounding window.
         */
        if (
            lt < TARGET_LT - 20n ||
            lt > TARGET_LT + 20n
        ) {
            continue;
        }

        found++;

        console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
        console.log(`TRANSACTION LT: ${lt}`);
        console.log('='.repeat(78));

        console.log('\nHASH:');
        console.log(
            tx.transaction_id?.hash ?? ''
        );

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // INCOMING
        // --------------------------------------------------

        const inMsg = tx.in_msg;

        console.log('\n' + '-'.repeat(78));
        console.log('INCOMING MESSAGE');
        console.log('-'.repeat(78));

        if (!inMsg) {
            console.log('No incoming message.');
        } else {
            console.log('Source:');
            console.log(inMsg.source ?? 'null');

            console.log('Destination:');
            console.log(inMsg.destination ?? 'null');

            console.log('Value (nanoTON):');
            console.log(inMsg.value ?? '0');

            console.log('Value (TON):');
            console.log(
                nanoToTon(inMsg.value ?? '0')
            );

            console.log('Message type:');
            console.log(inMsg.msg_type ?? '');

            const body =
                inMsg.message_content?.body;

            if (!body) {
                console.log('\nNo body BOC.');
            } else {
                console.log('\nBody BOC HEX:');
                console.log(body);

                const decoded =
                    decodeBody(body);

                console.log('\nDecoded BODY HEADER:');

                if ('error' in decoded) {
                    console.log(
                        'Decode error:',
                        decoded.error
                    );
                } else {
                    console.log(
                        'Opcode:',
                        opcodeHex(decoded.opcode)
                    );

                    console.log(
                        'Query ID:',
                        decoded.queryId?.toString() ??
                            'not available'
                    );

                    console.log(
                        'Remaining bits:',
                        decoded.remainingBits
                    );

                    console.log(
                        'Remaining refs:',
                        decoded.remainingRefs
                    );

                    if (
                        decoded.opcode ===
                        OPCODE_LP_TRANSFER
                    ) {
                        console.log(
                            '\n*** MATCH: 0x178d4519 ***'
                        );

                        console.log(
                            'This transaction contains the expected LP Wallet message.'
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // OUTGOING
        // --------------------------------------------------

        console.log('\n' + '-'.repeat(78));
        console.log('OUTGOING MESSAGES');
        console.log('-'.repeat(78));

        const outMsgs =
            tx.out_msgs ?? [];

        if (outMsgs.length === 0) {
            console.log('No outgoing messages.');
        }

        let index = 0;

        for (const msg of outMsgs) {
            index++;

            console.log(
                `\nOUTGOING MESSAGE #${index}`
            );

            console.log('Source:');
            console.log(msg.source ?? '');

            console.log('Destination:');
            console.log(msg.destination ?? '');

            console.log('Value (nanoTON):');
            console.log(msg.value ?? '0');

            console.log('Value (TON):');
            console.log(
                nanoToTon(msg.value ?? '0')
            );

            console.log('Message type:');
            console.log(msg.msg_type ?? '');

            const body =
                msg.message_content?.body;

            if (!body) {
                console.log('No body BOC.');
                continue;
            }

            console.log('\nBody BOC HEX:');
            console.log(body);

            const decoded =
                decodeBody(body);

            if ('error' in decoded) {
                console.log(
                    '\nDecode error:',
                    decoded.error
                );
            } else {
                console.log(
                    '\nDecoded opcode:',
                    opcodeHex(decoded.opcode)
                );

                console.log(
                    'Query ID:',
                    decoded.queryId?.toString() ??
                        'not available'
                );

                console.log(
                    'Remaining bits:',
                    decoded.remainingBits
                );

                console.log(
                    'Remaining refs:',
                    decoded.remainingRefs
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));

    if (found === 0) {
        console.log(
            'NO LP WALLET TRANSACTION FOUND IN TARGET LT WINDOW.'
        );
        console.log(
            'The LP Wallet has a different LT sequence.'
        );
        console.log(
            'We will widen the search window in the next step.'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            `FOUND ${found} LP WALLET TRANSACTION(S).`
        );
    }

    console.log('TRACE COMPLETE');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

export async function run() {
    const server = {
        host: 'tcp://49.12.147.32:27842',
        key: 'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM='
    };

    console.log('===== MASTERCHAIN LIBRARY ENVIRONMENT =====');

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host: server.host,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64'),
        reconnectTimeout: 3000
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        if (engine.isReady()) break;
        await sleep(500);
    }

    console.log('Engine ready:', engine.isReady());

    if (!engine.isReady()) {
        console.log('ENGINE NOT READY');
        return;
    }

    const client = new LiteClient({ engine });

    const info = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

    console.log('Masterchain seqno:', info.last.seqno);
    console.log('Masterchain workchain:', info.last.workchain);
    console.log('Masterchain shard:', info.last.shard.toString());

    console.log('\nRaw masterchain info:');
    console.log(info);
}

    if (result.result.length === 0) {
        console.log('');

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'The LiteServer did not return a public library entry'

            console.log('Data hex:', data.toString('hex'));

                const cell = Cell.fromBoc(data)[0];

                console.log('BOC decoded successfully');
                console.log('Cell bits:', cell.bits.length);
                console.log('Cell refs:', cell.refs.length);
                console.log(
                    'Cell hash:',
                    cell.hash().toString('hex')
                );
            } catch (e) {
                console.log('Could not decode library data as BOC');
                console.log(String(e));
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' TEST FINISHED');
    console.log('========================================');

    await engine.close();
}

main().catch(async (e) => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('ERROR:');
    console.error(e);

    try {
        await engine.close();
    } catch {}

    process.exit(1);
});

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {

        `?account=${POOL}` +
        `&lt=${LT}` +
        `&limit=1` +
        `&include_msg_body=true` +
        `&include_actions=true`;

    const response = await fetch(url);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Toncenter HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`
        );
    }

    const data = await response.json();

    const tx = data?.transactions?.[0];

    if (!tx) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('NO TRANSACTION FOUND');
        return;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('TRANSACTION');
    console.log('-'.repeat(70));
    console.log('account :', tx.account);
    console.log('lt      :', tx.lt);
    console.log('hash    :', tx.hash);
    console.log('trace   :', tx.trace_id);

    const msg = tx.in_msg;

    if (!msg) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('NO IN MESSAGE');
        return;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('IN MESSAGE');
    console.log('-'.repeat(70));
    console.log('hash        :', msg.hash);
    console.log('source      :', msg.source);
    console.log('destination :', msg.destination);
    console.log('value       :', msg.value);
    console.log('created_lt  :', msg.created_lt);
    console.log('opcode      :', msg.opcode);
    console.log('decoded     :', msg.decoded_opcode);

    console.log('');
    console.log('MESSAGE BODY');
    console.log('-'.repeat(70));
    console.log(msg.message_content?.body ?? '(none)');

    console.log('');
    console.log('DECODED MESSAGE');
    console.log('-'.repeat(70));
    console.log(
        JSON.stringify(
            msg.message_content?.decoded ?? null,
            null,
            2
        )
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));
    console.log('SOURCE ADDRESS');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));
    console.log(msg.source);

    console.log('');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));
}

FILE: scripts\inspectPoolCallbackFlowV22.ts
====================================================================================================

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const LP_ACCOUNT = Address.parse(
    'EQCEwfJtb6ZmPJdNw387eJwed2N51K6dFFbH82jTxe_cf31e'
);

const TARGET_CALLBACK_LT = '99809465000012';

const OP_CALLBACK = 0x06ecd527;
const OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY = 0x50c6a654;
const OP_JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER = 0x178d4519;
const OP_JETTON_TRANSFER = 0x0f8a7ea5;
const OP_EXCESSES = 0xd53276db;

function getOpcode(body: Cell): number | null {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();
        if (s.remainingBits < 32) return null;
        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function hexOpcode(op: number | null): string {
    return op === null
        ? 'UNKNOWN'
        : '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function fmt(value: bigint): string {
    return value.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
}

function fmt9(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;
    const fraction = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction
        ? `${whole.toLocaleString()}.${fraction}`
        : whole.toLocaleString();
}

function decodeCallback(body: Cell) {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.loadUint(32) !== OP_CALLBACK) return;

        const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);
        const amount0 = s.loadCoins();
        const amount1 = s.loadCoins();
        const user = s.loadAddress();
        const minLpOut = s.loadCoins();
        const fwdAmount = s.loadCoins();
        const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();

        if (hasCustomPayload) s.loadRef();

        const additional = s.loadRef();

        console.log('');
        console.log('CALLBACK FIELDS:');
        console.log('query_id:', queryId.toString());
        console.log('tot_am0 raw:', fmt(amount0));
        console.log('tot_am0 token:', fmt9(amount0));
        console.log('tot_am1 raw:', fmt(amount1));
        console.log('tot_am1 token:', fmt9(amount1));
        console.log('user:', user?.toString() ?? 'NULL');
        console.log('min_lp_out:', fmt(minLpOut));
        console.log('fwd_amount:', fmt(fwdAmount));
        console.log('custom_payload:', hasCustomPayload ? 'YES' : 'NO');
        console.log('additional bits:', additional.bits.length);
        console.log('additional refs:', additional.refs.length);
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('CALLBACK DECODE FAILED:', String(e));
    }
}

function printMessage(label: string, message: any) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`--- ${label} ---`);

    if (message.info.type === 'internal') {
        console.log('source:', message.info.src.toString());
        console.log('destination:', message.info.dest.toString());
        console.log('TON value:', message.info.value.coins.toString());
    } else {
        console.log('message type:', message.info.type);
    }

    const body: Cell = message.body;
    const opcode = getOpcode(body);

    console.log('opcode:', hexOpcode(opcode));
    console.log('body:', `${body.bits.length} bits / ${body.refs.length} refs`);
    console.log('BOC:', body.toBoc().toString('base64'));

    if (opcode === OP_CALLBACK) {
        decodeCallback(body);
    } else if (opcode === OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY) {
        console.log('message type: STON.fi ADD_LIQUIDITY');
    } else if (opcode === OP_JETTON_INTERNAL_TRANSFER) {
        console.log('message type: Jetton internal_transfer');
    } else if (opcode === OP_JETTON_TRANSFER) {
        console.log('message type: Jetton transfer');
    } else if (opcode === OP_EXCESSES) {
        console.log('message type: Excesses');
    } else {
        console.log('message type: other / unknown');
    }
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi v2.2 POOL CALLBACK FLOW INSPECTOR');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('POOL:', POOL.toString());
    console.log('LP ACCOUNT:', LP_ACCOUNT.toString());
    console.log('TARGET CALLBACK LT:', TARGET_CALLBACK_LT);

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('Fetching Pool transactions...');

    const transactions = await client.getTransactions(POOL, {
        limit: 30,
    });

    console.log('TRANSACTIONS FETCHED:', transactions.length);

    let callbackCount = 0;
    let txIndex = 0;

    for (const tx of transactions) {
        txIndex++;

        const lt = tx.lt.toString();
        const hash = tx.hash().toString('base64');

        const inMessage = tx.inMessage;
        const inOpcode = inMessage ? getOpcode(inMessage.body) : null;

        const relevant =
            inOpcode === OP_CALLBACK ||
            inOpcode === OP_ADD_LIQUIDITY ||
            lt.startsWith('99809465');

        if (!relevant) continue;

        console.log('');
        console.log('');
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log(`POOL TX #${txIndex}`);
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log('LT:', lt);
        console.log('HASH:', hash);
        console.log('TIMESTAMP:', tx.now.toString());
        console.log('INCOMING OPCODE:', hexOpcode(inOpcode));

        if (inMessage) {
            printMessage('POOL INCOMING MESSAGE', inMessage);

            if (
                inOpcode === OP_CALLBACK &&
                inMessage.info.type === 'internal' &&
                inMessage.info.src.equals(LP_ACCOUNT)
            ) {
                callbackCount++;
                console.log('');
                console.log('*** CALLBACK SOURCE MATCHES LP ACCOUNT ***');
            }
        }

        let outIndex = 0;
        for (const outMessage of tx.outMessages.values()) {
            outIndex++;
            printMessage(`POOL OUTGOING MESSAGE #${outIndex}`, outMessage);
        }

        const description: any = tx.description;
        console.log('');
        console.log('TRANSACTION STATUS:');
        console.log('description type:', description.type);

        if (description.type === 'generic') {
            console.log('aborted:', description.aborted);
            console.log('destroyed:', description.destroyed);

            if (description.computePhase?.type === 'vm') {
                console.log(
                    'compute exit code:',
                    description.computePhase.exitCode
                );
                console.log(
                    'compute success:',
                    description.computePhase.success
                );
            }

            if (description.actionPhase) {
                console.log(
                    'action result code:',
                    description.actionPhase.resultCode
                );
                console.log(
                    'action success:',
                    description.actionPhase.success
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('POOL CALLBACK FLOW SUMMARY');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('Matching callback messages found:', callbackCount);
    console.log('READ ONLY');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const BOC =
    '';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 CALLBACK BOC STRUCTURE INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - OFFLINE');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const bytes = Buffer.from(BOC, 'hex');

    console.log('\nHEX LENGTH:', BOC.length);
    console.log('BYTE LENGTH:', bytes.length);
    console.log('MAGIC:', bytes.subarray(0, 4).toString('hex'));

    const roots = Cell.fromBoc(bytes);

    console.log('\nROOT COUNT:', roots.length);

    function inspectCell(cell: Cell, name: string, depth: number) {
        const indent = ' '.repeat(depth * 2);

        console.log(`\n${indent}${name}`);
        console.log(`${indent}bits = ${cell.bits.length}`);
        console.log(`${indent}refs = ${cell.refs.length}`);

        console.log(
            `${indent}BOC = ${cell.toBoc().toString('base64')}`
        );

        console.log(
            `${indent}HEX DATA = ${cell.bits.toString()}`
        );

        cell.refs.forEach((ref, i) => {
            inspectCell(
                ref,
                `${name}.ref[${i}]`,
                depth + 1
            );
        });
    }

    inspectCell(roots[0], 'ROOT', 0);

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' INSPECTION COMPLETE');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

FILE: scripts\inspectPoolCellStructureV22.ts
====================================================================================================
import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000009n;

function hexBits(cell: any): string {
    try {
        const bytes = cell.bits.toBuffer();
        return bytes.toString('hex');
    } catch {
        return '<UNAVAILABLE>';
    }
}

function dumpCell(cell: any, name: string, depth = 0) {
    const pad = ' '.repeat(depth * 2);

    console.log('');
    console.log(`${pad}===== ${name} =====`);
    console.log(`${pad}bits: ${cell.bits.length}`);
    console.log(`${pad}refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);
    console.log(`${pad}hex:  ${hexBits(cell)}`);

    try {
        console.log(
            `${pad}boc:  ${cell.toBoc().toString('base64')}`
        );
    } catch {
        console.log(`${pad}boc: <ERROR>`);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
        dumpCell(
            cell.refs[i],
            `${name}.ref[${i}]`,
            depth + 1
        );
    }
}

function dumpSliceBits(cell: any, name: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`===== ${name} BIT STREAM =====`);

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    let index = 0;

    while (s.remainingBits >= 8) {
        try {
            const value = s.loadUint(8);

            console.log(
                `${index.toString().padStart(3, '0')}: ` +
                `0x${value.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')} ` +
                `(${value})`
            );

            index++;
        } catch {
            break;
        }
    }

    console.log(
        `Remaining bits after byte dump: ${s.remainingBits}`
    );
}

function dumpTopLevelFields(cell: any, name: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`===== ${name} TOP LEVEL =====`);

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    if (s.remainingBits >= 32) {
        const op = s.loadUint(32);

        console.log(
            `opcode: 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')}`
        );
    }

    if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
        const qid = s.loadUintBig(64);

        console.log(
            `query_id: ${qid.toString()}`
        );
    }

    console.log(
        `remaining bits: ${s.remainingBits}`
    );

    console.log(
        `remaining refs: ${s.remainingRefs}`
    );
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi v2.2 POOL CELL STRUCTURE INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log(`POOL: ${POOL.toString()}`);
    console.log(`TARGET LT: ${TARGET_LT.toString()}`);

    const client = provider.api() as TonClient;

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(
        POOL,
        {
            limit: 20,
        }
    );

    const tx = txs.find(
        t => t.lt === TARGET_LT
    );

    if (!tx) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('TARGET TRANSACTION NOT FOUND');
        return;
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('TARGET TRANSACTION');
    console.log('================================================');

    console.log(`LT: ${tx.lt.toString()}`);
    console.log(
        `HASH: ${tx.hash().toString('base64')}`
    );

    if (tx.now) {
        console.log(
            `TIME: ${new Date(tx.now * 1000).toISOString()}`
        );
    }

    if (tx.inMessage) {
        const body = tx.inMessage.body;

        dumpTopLevelFields(
            body,
            'INPUT'
        );

        dumpCell(
            body,
            'INPUT CELL'
        );

        dumpSliceBits(
            body,
            'INPUT'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('OUTPUT MESSAGES');
    console.log('================================================');

    for (let i = 0; i < tx.outMessagesCount; i++) {
        const msg = tx.outMessages.get(i);

        if (!msg) continue;

        const body = msg.body;

        dumpTopLevelFields(
            body,
            `OUTPUT #${i + 1}`
        );

        dumpCell(
            body,
            `OUTPUT #${i + 1} CELL`
        );

        dumpSliceBits(
            body,
            `OUTPUT #${i + 1}`
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================================================');
    console.log(' READ ONLY CHECK COMPLETE');
    console.log(' Transaction submission: NONE');
    console.log('================================================');
}

import { StonApiClient } from '@ston-fi/api';

const ROOSTER_MASTER =
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx';

export async function run() {
    console.log('===== INSPECT V2.2 POOL-CREATION ROUTERS =====');
    console.log('ROOSTER MASTER:', ROOSTER_MASTER);
    console.log('');

    const api = new StonApiClient({
        baseURL: 'https://api.ston.fi',
    });

    try {
        const routers = await api.getRouters({
            dexV2: true,
        });

        console.log('TOTAL ROUTERS:', routers.length);

        const candidates = routers.filter((router) =>
            router.majorVersion === 2 &&
            router.minorVersion === 2 &&
            router.routerType === 'ConstantProduct' &&
            router.poolCreationEnabled === true
        );

        console.log('POOL-CREATION V2.2 CPI CANDIDATES:', candidates.length);
        console.log('');

        candidates.forEach((router, index) => {
            console.log('==================================================');
            console.log(`CANDIDATE #${index + 1}`);
            console.log('==================================================');

            console.log('Address:', router.address);
            console.log(
                'Version:',
                `${router.majorVersion}.${router.minorVersion}`,
            );
            console.log('Router Type:', router.routerType);
            console.log('Pool Creation Enabled:', router.poolCreationEnabled);
            console.log('pTON Version:', router.ptonVersion);
            console.log('pTON Master:', router.ptonMasterAddress);
            console.log('pTON Wallet:', router.ptonWalletAddress);

            console.log('');
            console.log('ALL API FIELDS:');

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(router)) {
                console.log(`  ${key}:`, value);
            }

            console.log('');
        });

        console.log('==================================================');
        console.log('SUMMARY');
        console.log('==================================================');

        candidates.forEach((router, index) => {
            console.log(
                `#${index + 1}`,
                router.address,
                '|',
                `${router.majorVersion}.${router.minorVersion}`,
                '|',
                router.routerType,
                '|',
                'poolCreation:',
                router.poolCreationEnabled,
                '|',
                'pTON:',
                router.ptonMasterAddress,
                '|',
                'pTON wallet:',
                router.ptonWalletAddress,
            );
        });

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== INSPECTION COMPLETE =====');
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'API ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e),
        );
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI POOL INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('');

        endpoint: ENDPOINT,
    });

    const pool = Address.parse(POOL);

        await client.getLastBlock();

    console.log(

    console.log(`RAW : ${pool.toRawString()}`);

            latest.last.seqno,

            `CODE          : ${
                account.account.state.code
                    ? 'PRESENT'
                    : 'ABSENT'
            }`,
        );

        console.log(
            `DATA          : ${
                account.account.state.data
                    ? 'PRESENT'
                    : 'ABSENT'
            }`,
        );
    } else {
        console.log('Pool account is not active.');
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('================ GET_POOL_DATA =================');

    try {
        const result =
            await client.runMethod(
                latest.last.seqno,
                pool,
                'get_pool_data',
            );

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            `EXIT CODE: ${result.exitCode}`,
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('RESULT RAW:');
        console.log(result.resultRaw);

        if (result.exitCode === 0) {
            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'GET_POOL_DATA: SUCCESS',
            );
        } else {
            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'GET_POOL_DATA: FAILED',
            );
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'GET_POOL_DATA CALL ERROR:',
        );

        console.log(
            e instanceof Error
                ? e.message
                : String(e),
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' FINISHED - READ ONLY');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL =
    '0:f900b682b84a89ecc8bdaa55ce03b04732b4eaf1ed9f67907fb5e58dd7b319ab';

function friendly(address: Address) {
    return address.toString({
        urlSafe: true,
        bounceable: true,
        testOnly: true,
    });
}

async function tryGetter(
    provider: NetworkProvider,
    address: Address,
    name: string,
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(`GETTER: ${name}`);
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    try {
        const result = await provider.provider(address).get(name, []);

        console.log('SUCCESS');

        console.dir(result.stack, {
            depth: null,
            colors: false,
        });

        return result.stack;
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('FAILED');

        console.dir(e, {
            depth: null,
            colors: false,
        });

        return null;
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 POOL GETTER INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    const address = Address.parse(POOL);

    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL RAW:');
    console.log(address.toRawString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL FRIENDLY:');
    console.log(friendly(address));

    /*
     * First: standard Jetton Master getter.
     *
     * The Pool is also the LP Jetton Master.
     */
    await tryGetter(
        provider,
        address,
        'get_jetton_data',
    );

    /*
     * Possible Pool state getters.
     *
     * We intentionally try several names.
     * Failed getters are harmless and READ ONLY.
     */
    await tryGetter(
        provider,
        address,
        'get_pool_data',
    );

    await tryGetter(
        provider,
        address,
        'get_pool_state',
    );

    await tryGetter(
        provider,
        address,
        'get_pool_params',
    );

    await tryGetter(
        provider,
        address,
        'get_pool_address',
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' END OF READ-ONLY POOL GETTER INSPECTION');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
}

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const LTS = [
    99809465000011n,
    99809465000012n,
];

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 POOL MESSAGE INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    console.log('\nPool:', POOL.toString());

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(POOL, {
        limit: 50,
        archival: true,
    });

    console.log(`\nFetched transactions: ${txs.length}`);

    for (const lt of LTS) {
        console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
        console.log(`LT ${lt}`);
        console.log('='.repeat(78));

        const tx = txs.find(
            (x: any) => BigInt(x.lt.toString()) === lt
        );

        if (!tx) {
            console.log('Transaction not found in returned range.');
            continue;
        }

        console.log('hash:', tx.hash().toString('hex'));
        console.log('lt:', tx.lt.toString());
        console.log('utime:', tx.now);

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // IN MESSAGE
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        console.log('\nIN MESSAGE');
        console.log('----------');

        if (tx.inMessage) {
            const info: any = tx.inMessage.info;

            console.log('type:', info.type);

            if (info.src) {
                try {
                    console.log('src:', info.src.toString());
                } catch {}
            }

            if (tx.inMessage.body) {
                const boc = tx.inMessage.body
                    .toBoc({ idx: false })
                    .toString('base64');

                console.log('body BOC:');
                console.log(boc);
            } else {
                console.log('No body');
            }
        } else {
            console.log('No inMessage');
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // OUT MESSAGES
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        console.log('\nOUT MESSAGES');
        console.log('------------');

        if (!tx.outMessages) {
            console.log('No outMessages');
            continue;
        }

        let index = 0;

        for (const [key, msg] of tx.outMessages) {
            console.log(`\nOUT #${index++}`);
            console.log('key:', key);

            const info: any = msg.info;

            console.log('type:', info.type);

            if (info.dest) {
                try {
                    console.log('dest:', info.dest.toString());
                } catch {}
            }

            if (msg.body) {
                const boc = msg.body
                    .toBoc({ idx: false })
                    .toString('base64');

                console.log('body BOC:');
                console.log(boc);
            } else {
                console.log('No body');
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(78));
    console.log('DONE');
    console.log('='.repeat(78));
}

import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run() {
    console.log('===== SDK V2.2 POOL METHOD =====');

    const Router = DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI;

    let proto: any = Router.prototype;
    let level = 0;

    while (proto) {
        const names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(proto);

        console.log(`\n--- PROTOTYPE LEVEL ${level} ---`);

        for (const name of names) {
            if (name === 'constructor') continue;

            const value = proto[name];

            if (typeof value === 'function') {
                console.log(`METHOD: ${name}`);
                console.log(value.toString());
            }
        }

        proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(proto);
        level++;
    }
}
