import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteRoundRobinEngine,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

import {
    Address,
    Cell,
} from '@ton/core';

async function main() {

    const router = Address.parse(
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
    );

    const servers = [
        {
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            ip: -1468575011,
            port: 51088,
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER CODE STRUCTURE INSPECTION');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO WALLET');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('');

    const engines: LiteSingleEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {

        const engine =
            new LiteSingleEngine({
                host:
                    `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`,
                publicKey:
                    Buffer.from(
                        server.key,
                        'base64'
                    ),
                reconnectTimeout: 5000,
            });

        engines.push(engine);
    }

    const rr =
        new LiteRoundRobinEngine(
            engines
        );

    const client =
        new LiteClient({
            engine: rr,
            batchSize: 1,
        });

    try {

        // ====================================
        // MASTERCHAIN
        // ====================================

        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('MASTERCHAIN');

        const master =
            await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log(
            'Seqno:',
            master.last.seqno
        );

        // ====================================
        // ACCOUNT
        // ====================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ROUTER ACCOUNT');

        const account =
            await client.getAccountState(
                router,
                master.last
            );

        if (
            account.state === null
        ) {

            console.log(
                'ERROR: account state is null'
            );

            return;
        }

        console.log(
            'State:',
            account.state.storage.state.type
        );

        if (
            account.state.storage.state.type !==
            'active'
        ) {

            console.log(
                'ERROR: Router is not active'
            );

            return;
        }

        const active =
            account.state.storage.state.state;

        const code:
            Cell | null | undefined =
            active.code;

        if (!code) {

            console.log(
                'ERROR: code is missing'
            );

            return;
        }

        // ====================================
        // ROOT
        // ====================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ROOT CODE CELL');

        printCell(
            code,
            'ROOT'
        );

        // ====================================
        // RECURSIVE TREE
        // ====================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('FULL CODE TREE');

        inspectCell(
            code,
            'ROOT',
            0,
            new Set<string>()
        );

        // ====================================
        // CODE BOC
        // ====================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('CODE BOC');

        console.log(
            Buffer.from(
                code.toBoc({
                    idx: false,
                })
            ).toString('base64')
        );

        // ====================================
        // FINAL
        // ====================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('========================================');
        console.log(' INSPECTION FINISHED');
        console.log('========================================');
        console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');

    } finally {

        for (const engine of engines) {
            engine.close();
        }
    }
}

function printCell(
    cell: Cell,
    name: string
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(name);

    console.log(
        'Type:',
        cell.type
    );

    console.log(
        'Bits:',
        cell.bits.length
    );

    console.log(
        'Refs:',
        cell.refs.length
    );

    console.log(
        'Hash:',
        cell.hash().toString('hex')
    );

    console.log(
        'BOC:',
        Buffer.from(
            cell.toBoc({
                idx: false,
            })
        ).toString('base64')
    );

    console.log(
        'Bits binary:',
        cell.bits.toString()
    );
}

function inspectCell(
    cell: Cell,
    path: string,
    depth: number,
    visited: Set<string>
) {

    if (depth > 8) {
        console.log(
            `${path}: MAX DEPTH`
        );
        return;
    }

    const hash =
        cell.hash().toString('hex');

    if (visited.has(hash)) {

        console.log(
            `${path}: ALREADY VISITED`
        );

        return;
    }

    visited.add(hash);

    printCell(
        cell,
        path
    );

    for (
        let i = 0;
        i < cell.refs.length;
        i++
    ) {

        inspectCell(
            cell.refs[i],
            `${path}.ref${i}`,
            depth + 1,
            visited
        );
    }
}

function intToIP(int: number) {

    const part1 =
        int & 255;

    const part2 =
        (int >> 8) & 255;

    const part3 =
        (int >> 16) & 255;

    const part4 =
        (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

main().catch(
    (error) => {

        console.error('');
        console.error('========================================');
        console.error('ERROR');
        console.error('========================================');

        console.error(error);

        process.exit(1);
    }
);

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteSingleEngine
} from 'ton-lite-client';

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

export async function run() {
    console.log('===== ROUTER DATA INSPECTION =====');

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
        publicKey: Buffer.from(
            'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
            'base64'
        ),
        reconnectTimeout: 3000
    });

    console.log('Connecting...');

    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        if (engine.isReady()) {
            break;
        }

        await sleep(500);

        console.log(
            `Waiting... ${i + 1}/20 | closed=${engine.isClosed()} ready=${engine.isReady()}`
        );
    }

    if (!engine.isReady()) {
        console.log('ENGINE NOT READY');
        engine.close();
        return;
    }

    console.log('ENGINE READY');

    try {
        const client = new LiteClient({ engine });

        const info = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log(
            'Masterchain seqno:',
            info.last.seqno
        );

        const result = await client.runMethod(
            ROUTER,
            'get_router_data',
            Buffer.alloc(0),
            info.last
        );

        console.log('Exit code:', result.exitCode);

        if (result.result) {
            const cell = Cell.fromBoc(
                Buffer.from(result.result, 'base64')
            )[0];

            console.log(
                'Result BOC:',
                cell.toBoc().toString('base64')
            );

            console.log(
                'Result bits:',
                cell.bits.toString()
            );

            console.log(
                'Result refs:',
                cell.refs.length
            );

if (cell.refs.length > 0) {
    console.log(
        'Ref[0] BOC:',
        cell.refs[0].toBoc().toString('base64')
    );

    console.log(
        'Ref[0] bits:',
        cell.refs[0].bits.toString()
    );
}
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.log('ERROR:');
        console.log(
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    } finally {
        engine.close();
    }
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

   const router = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

    console.log('===== ROUTER ON-CHAIN CHECK =====');

    console.log(
        'Address:',
        router.toString({
            urlSafe: true,
            bounceable: true,
            testOnly: true,
        })
    );

    try {
        const state = await client.getContractState(router);

        console.log('\n===== CONTRACT STATE =====');
        console.log('state:', state.state);
        console.log('balance:', state.balance.toString());
        console.log('code:', state.code ? 'PRESENT' : 'EMPTY');
        console.log('data:', state.data ? 'PRESENT' : 'EMPTY');

        if (state.code) {
            console.log('code bytes:', state.code.length);
        }

        if (state.data) {
            console.log('data bytes:', state.data.length);
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'STATE ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    }

    try {
        console.log('\n===== GET ROUTER DATA =====');

        const result = await client.runMethod(
            router,
            'get_router_data',
            []
        );

        console.log('SUCCESS');
        console.log(result.stack);

    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'GET_ROUTER_DATA ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    }
}

import {
    Address,
    beginCell,
    Cell,
    serializeTuple
} from '@ton/core';

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteSingleEngine
} from 'ton-lite-client';

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

const ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQAmO8BvKx4ta9jkCCDx197VqrUrsaC42Dv6yhDAyKzFpi2S'
);

const PTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQBy4zGgSS4opE7HGNu767ikjUALNJ23busLGv-CuE8fPQ66'
);

const server = {
    host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
    key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk='
};

async function test(
    client: LiteClient,
    name: string,
    token0: Address,
    token1: Address,
    block: any
) {
    const args = serializeTuple([
        {
            type: 'slice',
            cell: beginCell()
                .storeAddress(token0)
                .endCell()
        },
        {
            type: 'slice',
            cell: beginCell()
                .storeAddress(token1)
                .endCell()
        }
    ]).toBoc({
        idx: false,
        crc32: false
    });

    const result = await client.runMethod(
        ROUTER,
        'get_pool_address',
        args,
        block
    );

    console.log(`${name}: exit=${result.exitCode}`);

    if (result.result) {
        const cell = Cell.fromBoc(
            Buffer.from(result.result, 'base64')
        )[0];

        console.log(
            `${name}: result=${cell.toBoc().toString('base64')}`
        );
    }
}

export async function run() {
    console.log('===== POOL ADDRESS ORDER TEST =====');

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host: server.host,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64'),
        reconnectTimeout: 3000
    });

    console.log('Connecting...');

    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        if (engine.isReady()) {
            break;
        }

        await sleep(500);

        console.log(
            `Waiting... ${i + 1}/20 | closed=${engine.isClosed()} ready=${engine.isReady()}`
        );
    }

    if (!engine.isReady()) {
        console.log('ENGINE NOT READY');
        engine.close();
        return;
    }

    console.log('ENGINE READY');

    try {
        const client = new LiteClient({
            engine
        });

        const info = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log(
            'Masterchain seqno:',
            info.last.seqno
        );

        await test(
            client,
            'ROOSTER -> pTON',
            ROOSTER_WALLET,
            PTON_WALLET,
            info.last
        );

        await test(
            client,
            'pTON -> ROOSTER',
            PTON_WALLET,
            ROOSTER_WALLET,
            info.last
        );

        console.log('===== DONE =====');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');

    } catch (e) {
        console.log('ERROR:');
        console.log(
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    } finally {
        engine.close();
    }
}

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteRoundRobinEngine,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

import {
    Address,
    beginCell,
    Cell,
    parseTuple,
    serializeTuple,
} from '@ton/core';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

const ROOSTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON = Address.parse(
    'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
);

async function main() {

    console.log('===== ROUTER POOL INPUT INSPECTION =====');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Router:');
    console.log(ROUTER.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER master:');
    console.log(ROOSTER.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON master:');
    console.log(PTON.toString());

    const servers = [
        {
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            ip: -1468575011,
            port: 51088,
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    const engines: LiteSingleEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {

        engines.push(
            new LiteSingleEngine({
                host: `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`,
                publicKey: Buffer.from(
                    server.key,
                    'base64'
                ),
                reconnectTimeout: 3000,
            })
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'Adding:',
            `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`
        );
    }

    const engine = new LiteRoundRobinEngine(
        engines
    );

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine,
        batchSize: 1,
    });

    try {

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== MASTERCHAIN =====');

        const master =
            await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log(
            'Seqno:',
            master.last.seqno
        );

        /*
         * get_wallet_address(owner)
         *
         * LiteServer expects the method parameters
         * as a serialized TVM Tuple.
         */
        const args = [
            {
                type: 'slice' as const,
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(ROUTER)
                    .endCell(),
            },
        ];

        const paramsCell =
            serializeTuple(args);

        const paramsBoc =
            paramsCell.toBoc({
                idx: false,
                crc32: false,
            });

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== GET WALLET ADDRESS =====');

        console.log('');
        console.log('Serialized VmStack BOC:');

        console.log(
            Buffer.from(paramsBoc).toString('base64')
        );

        /*
         * ---------------------------------------------------------
         * ROOSTER
         * ---------------------------------------------------------
         */

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== ROOSTER =====');

        const roosterResult =
            await client.runMethod(
                ROOSTER,
                'get_wallet_address',
                Buffer.from(paramsBoc),
                master.last
            );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Exit code:');

        console.log(
            roosterResult.exitCode
        );

        if (roosterResult.result === null) {

            console.log('');
            console.log('ROOSTER result: null');

        } else {

            console.log('');
            console.log('ROOSTER result base64:');

            console.log(
                roosterResult.result
            );

            const roosterCell =
                Cell.fromBoc(
                    Buffer.from(
                        roosterResult.result,
                        'base64'
                    )
                )[0];

            const roosterTuple =
                parseTuple(roosterCell);

            console.log('');
            console.log('ROOSTER tuple:');

            console.log(
                roosterTuple
            );

            if (
                roosterTuple.length > 0 &&
                roosterTuple[0].type === 'slice'
            ) {

                const roosterWallet =
                    Address.parse(
                        roosterTuple[0].cell
                            .beginParse()
                            .loadAddress()
                            .toString()
                    );

                console.log('');
                console.log('ROOSTER Router Wallet:');

                console.log(
                    roosterWallet.toString()
                );
            }
        }

        /*
         * ---------------------------------------------------------
         * pTON
         * ---------------------------------------------------------
         */

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== pTON =====');

        const ptonResult =
            await client.runMethod(
                PTON,
                'get_wallet_address',
                Buffer.from(paramsBoc),
                master.last
            );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Exit code:');

        console.log(
            ptonResult.exitCode
        );

        if (ptonResult.result === null) {

            console.log('');
            console.log('pTON result: null');

        } else {

            console.log('');
            console.log('pTON result base64:');

            console.log(
                ptonResult.result
            );

            const ptonCell =
                Cell.fromBoc(
                    Buffer.from(
                        ptonResult.result,
                        'base64'
                    )
                )[0];

            const ptonTuple =
                parseTuple(ptonCell);

            console.log('');
            console.log('pTON tuple:');

            console.log(
                ptonTuple
            );

            if (
                ptonTuple.length > 0 &&
                ptonTuple[0].type === 'slice'
            ) {

}

function intToIP(int: number) {

    const part1 = int & 255;
    const part2 = (int >> 8) & 255;
    const part3 = (int >> 16) & 255;
    const part4 = (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

main().catch((error) => {

    console.error('');
    console.error('===== ERROR =====');
    console.error(error);

    process.exit(1);
});

export async function run() {
    await main();
}

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteRoundRobinEngine,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

import { Address } from '@ton/core';

async function main() {

    const servers = [
        {
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            ip: -1468575011,
            port: 51088,
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    const ROUTER =
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval';

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER ACCOUNT STATE TEST');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO WALLET');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('');

    const engines: LiteSingleEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {

        const host =
            `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`;

        const engine =
            new LiteSingleEngine({
                host,
                publicKey: Buffer.from(
                    server.key,
                    'base64'
                ),
                reconnectTimeout: 5000,
            });

        engines.push(engine);
    }

    const engine =
        new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines);

    const client =
        new LiteClient({
            engine,
            batchSize: 1,
        });

    try {

        console.log('Getting masterchain info...');

        const master =
            await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'Masterchain seqno:',
            master.last.seqno
        );

        console.log(
            'Masterchain root hash:',
            Buffer.from(
                master.last.rootHash
            ).toString('hex')
        );

        const router =
            Address.parse(ROUTER);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Router:');
        console.log(router.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('Running getAccountState...');

        const state =
            await client.getAccountState(
                router,
                master.last
            );

        console.log('');
        console.log('========================================');
        console.log(' ACCOUNT STATE');
        console.log('========================================');

        console.dir(
            state,
            { depth: 8 }
        );

    } catch (error) {

        console.log('');
        console.log('ERROR');
        console.error(error);

    } finally {

        console.log('');
        console.log('Closing engines...');

        for (const e of engines) {
            e.close();
        }

        console.log('Done.');
    }

    process.exit(0);
}

function intToIP(int: number) {

    const part1 =
        int & 255;

    const part2 =
        (int >> 8) & 255;

    const part3 =
        (int >> 16) & 255;

    const part4 =
        (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

        console.log(
            '__initStatic2:',
            typeof router.__initStatic2 === 'function'
                ? Function.prototype.toString.call(router.__initStatic2)
                : 'none'
        );
    }
}

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const TARGET_POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const TARGET_VALUE = 238458238n;

function getOpcode(body: any): number | null {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function opcodeHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';

    return '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function formatTon(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const fraction =
        (value % 1_000_000_000n)
            .toString()
            .padStart(9, '0')
            .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : whole.toString();
}

async function main() {
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER -> POOL TARGET TX SEARCH v2.2');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY ONLY');
    console.log('==========================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROUTER:');
    console.log(ROUTER.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET POOL:');
    console.log(TARGET_POOL.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET VALUE:');
    console.log(
        formatTon(TARGET_VALUE),
        'TON'
    );

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint:
            'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(
        ROUTER,
        {
            limit: 100,
        }
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROUTER TRANSACTIONS FETCHED:');
    console.log(txs.length);

    let found = 0;

    for (const tx of txs) {
        let outIndex = 0;

        for (
            const outMessage
            of tx.outMessages.values()
        ) {
            if (
                outMessage.info.type !==
                'internal'
            ) {
                outIndex++;
                continue;
            }

            const destination =
                outMessage.info.dest;

            const value =
                outMessage.info.value.coins;

            if (
                destination.equals(TARGET_POOL) &&
                value === TARGET_VALUE
            ) {
                found++;

                const body =
                    outMessage.body;

                const op =
                    getOpcode(body);

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    '=========================================='
                );
                console.log(
                    `MATCH #${found}`
                );
                console.log(
                    '=========================================='
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('ROUTER TX LT:');
                console.log(
                    tx.lt.toString()
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('ROUTER TX HASH:');
                console.log(
                    tx.hash().toString('hex')
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('TIMESTAMP:');
                console.log(tx.now);

                console.log(
                    new Date(
                        tx.now * 1000
                    ).toISOString()
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('OUT INDEX:');
                console.log(outIndex);

                console.log('');
                console.log('SOURCE:');
                console.log(
                    outMessage.info.src.toString()
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('DESTINATION:');
                console.log(
                    destination.toString()
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('VALUE:');
                console.log(
                    formatTon(value),
                    'TON'
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('OPCODE:');
                console.log(
                    opcodeHex(op)
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('BODY:');
                console.log(
                    body.bits.length,
                    'bits /',
                    body.refs.length,
                    'refs'
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('BOC:');
                console.log(
                    body
                        .toBoc()
                        .toString('base64')
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    'THIS IS THE ROUTER MESSAGE'
                );
                console.log(
                    'THAT CREATED POOL LT 99491281000009.'
                );
            }

            outIndex++;
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '=========================================='
    );
    console.log(
        'MATCHES FOUND:',
        found
    );
    console.log(
        'READ ONLY COMPLETE'
    );
    console.log(
        'NO TRANSACTION SENT'
    );
    console.log(
        '=========================================='
    );
}

main().catch((error) => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('ERROR:');
    console.error(error);
});

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROUTER =
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3';

const TARGET_LT = '99809465000006';

const TONCENTER =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/getTransactions';

function rawAddress(address: string | null | undefined): string {
    if (!address) return 'null';

    try {
        return Address.parse(address).toRawString();
    } catch {
        return address;
    }
}

function printMessage(label: string, msg: any) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');
    console.log(label);
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');

    if (!msg) {
        console.log('NO MESSAGE');
        return;
    }

    console.log('source:', rawAddress(msg.source));
    console.log('destination:', rawAddress(msg.destination));
    console.log('value:', msg.value ?? 'null');
    console.log('created_lt:', msg.created_lt ?? 'null');

    if (!msg.message_content) {
        console.log('NO MESSAGE CONTENT');
        return;
    }

    const body = msg.message_content;

    console.log('body type:', body['@type']);

    if (body.body) {
        const boc = body.body;

        console.log('body BOC:');
        console.log(boc);

        try {
            const cell = Cell.fromBase64(boc);
            const slice = cell.beginParse();

            if (slice.remainingBits >= 32) {
                const opcode = slice.loadUint(32);

                const hex =
                    '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');

                console.log('opcode:', hex);

                switch (opcode) {
                    case 0x37c096df:
                        console.log(
                            'opcode name: stonfi_provide_lp_v2'
                        );
                        break;

                    case 0x50c6a654:
                        console.log(
                            'opcode name: stonfi_add_liquidity_v2'
                        );
                        break;

                    case 0x7362d09c:
                        console.log(
                            'opcode name: jetton_notify'
                        );
                        break;

                    case 0x01f3835d:
                        console.log(
                            'opcode name: pton_ton_transfer'
                        );
                        break;

                    case 0x06ecd527:
                        console.log(
                            'opcode name: stonfi_cb_add_liquidity_v2'
                        );
                        break;

                    default:
                        console.log('opcode name: unknown');
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.log(
                'opcode decode failed:',
                String(e)
            );
        }
    }
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

function inspectCell(cell: Cell, name: string) {
    console.log(`===== ${name} =====`);

    console.log('Cell:', cell.toString());
    console.log('Bits:', cell.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', cell.refs.length);

    // Exotic-cell detection.
    console.log('Exotic:', cell.isExotic);

    console.log('');

    console.log('Bits as hex:');

    try {
        console.log(cell.bits.toString());
    } catch {
        console.log('HEX_UNAVAILABLE');
    }

    console.log('');

    if (cell.isExotic) {
        console.log('EXOTIC CELL - beginParse() intentionally skipped');
        console.log('');

        console.log('Refs:');

        for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
            const ref = cell.refs[i];

            console.log(`REF ${i}:`);
            console.log('Bits:', ref.bits.length);
            console.log('Refs:', ref.refs.length);
            console.log('Exotic:', ref.isExotic);

            try {
                console.log('Cell:', ref.toString());
            } catch {
                console.log('CELL_STRING_UNAVAILABLE');
            }

            console.log('');
        }

        return;
    }

    try {
        const slice = cell.beginParse();

        console.log('Remaining bits:', slice.remainingBits);
        console.log('Remaining refs:', slice.remainingRefs);
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('beginParse ERROR');

        if (error instanceof Error) {
            console.log('Message:', error.message);
        } else {
            console.log(error);
        }
    }

    console.log('');

    if (cell.refs.length > 0) {
        console.log('Refs:');

        for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
            const ref = cell.refs[i];

            console.log(`REF ${i}:`);
            console.log('Bits:', ref.bits.length);
            console.log('Refs:', ref.refs.length);
            console.log('Exotic:', ref.isExotic);

            try {
                console.log('Cell:', ref.toString());
            } catch {
                console.log('CELL_STRING_UNAVAILABLE');
            }

            console.log('');
        }
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    console.log('==================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 ROUTER CELL STRUCTURE INSPECTOR');
    console.log(' SAFE EXOTIC-CELL MODE');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('==================================================');
    console.log('');

    const client = (provider as any)._tc;

    if (!client) {
        throw new Error('TonClient not found');
    }

    console.log('Router:', ROUTER.toString());
    console.log('Network:', provider.network());
    console.log('');

    const result = await client.runMethodWithError(
        ROUTER,
        'get_router_data',
        []
    );

    const items = result.stack.items;

    console.log('Stack item count:', items.length);
    console.log('');

    for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        const item = items[i];

        if (item.type === 'int') {
            console.log(`===== ITEM ${i} =====`);
            console.log('Type:', item.type);
            console.log('Value:', item.value.toString());
            console.log('');
            continue;
        }

        if (item.type === 'cell') {
            inspectCell(item.cell, `ITEM ${i}`);
            console.log('');
            continue;
        }

        console.log(`===== ITEM ${i} =====`);
        console.log('Unknown type:', item.type);
        console.log('');
    }

    console.log('==================================================');
    console.log(' END - READ ONLY');
    console.log('==================================================');
}

import {
    Address
} from '@ton/core';

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteSingleEngine
} from 'ton-lite-client';

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

const server = {
   host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
    key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk='
};

export async function run() {
    console.log('===== ROUTER VERSION TEST =====');

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host: server.host,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64'),
        reconnectTimeout: 3000
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
        if (engine.isReady()) break;
        await sleep(500);
    }

    if (!engine.isReady()) {
        console.log('ENGINE NOT READY');
        engine.close();
        return;
    }

    console.log('ENGINE READY');

    try {
        const client = new LiteClient({ engine });
        const info = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        const result = await client.runMethod(
            ROUTER,
            'get_router_version',
            Buffer.alloc(0),
            info.last
        );

        console.log('Exit code:', result.exitCode);
        console.log(
            'Result BOC:',
            result.result || 'NONE'
        );

    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    } finally {
        engine.close();
    }
}

import { Address, Cell, beginCell } from "@ton/core";
import { DEX } from "@ston-fi/sdk";
import * as fs from "fs";
import * as crypto from "crypto";

const ROOSTER_MASTER =
  "EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx";

const PTON_MASTER =
  "EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S";

const ROUTER =
  "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3";

const USER =
  "EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix";

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 200073535827652n;
const MIN_LP_OUT = 300329052918n;

const GAS_AMOUNT = 300000000n;
const FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT = 240000000n;

const BOC_FILE =
  "./final_v22_rooster_liquidity.boc";

function sha256(data: Buffer): string {
  return crypto
    .createHash("sha256")
    .update(data)
    .digest("hex");
}

function printCell(
  name: string,
  cell: Cell,
  depth = 0,
): void {
  const prefix = "  ".repeat(depth);

  const boc = cell.toBoc({ idx: false });

  console.log(`${prefix}${name}`);
  console.log(`${prefix}bits: ${cell.bits.length}`);
  console.log(`${prefix}refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);
  console.log(`${prefix}hash: ${cell.hash().toString("hex")}`);
  console.log(`${prefix}BOC bytes: ${boc.length}`);
  console.log(`${prefix}BOC SHA-256: ${sha256(boc)}`);

  for (let i = 0; i < cell.refs.length; i++) {
    printCell(`ref[${i}]`, cell.refs[i], depth + 1);
  }
}

function inspectJettonTransfer(
  label: string,
  cell: Cell,
): void {
  console.log();
  console.log(`===== ${label}: ROOT PARSE =====`);

  const s = cell.beginParse();

  console.log("Remaining bits:", s.remainingBits);
  console.log("Remaining refs:", s.remainingRefs);

  if (s.remainingBits >= 32) {
    const opcode = s.loadUint(32);
    console.log(
      "Opcode:",
      "0x" + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, "0"),
    );
  }

  if (s.remainingBits >= 64) {
    console.log("query_id:", s.loadUintBig(64).toString());
  }

  if (s.remainingBits >= 124) {
    console.log("amount:", s.loadCoins().toString());
  }

  if (s.remainingBits >= 2) {
    const destination = s.loadAddress();
    console.log(
      "destination:",
      destination?.toString() ?? "null",
    );
  }

  if (s.remainingBits >= 2) {
    const response = s.loadAddress();
    console.log(
      "response:",
      response?.toString() ?? "null",
    );
  }

  if (s.remainingBits >= 1) {
    const hasCustomPayload = s.loadBit();
    console.log(
      "custom payload:",
      hasCustomPayload ? "present" : "none",
    );

    if (hasCustomPayload) {
      console.log(
        "custom payload is in a reference/slice structure",
      );
    }
  }

  if (s.remainingBits >= 1) {
    const forwardPayloadInRef = s.loadBit();

    console.log(
      "forward payload:",
      forwardPayloadInRef
        ? "reference"
        : "inline",
    );

    if (forwardPayloadInRef) {
      if (s.remainingRefs > 0) {
        const forward = s.loadRef();

        console.log();
        console.log(
          "===== FORWARD PAYLOAD ROOT =====",
        );

        printCell("forwardPayload", forward);

        const fslice = forward.beginParse();

        console.log(
          "Forward remaining bits:",
          fslice.remainingBits,
        );
        console.log(
          "Forward remaining refs:",
          fslice.remainingRefs,
        );

        if (fslice.remainingBits >= 32) {
          const forwardOpcode = fslice.loadUint(32);

          console.log(
            "Forward opcode:",
            "0x" +
              forwardOpcode
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, "0"),
          );
        }

        if (fslice.remainingBits >= 2) {
          const routerWallet =
            fslice.loadAddress();

          console.log(
            "routerWalletAddress:",
            routerWallet?.toString() ?? "null",
          );
        }

        if (fslice.remainingBits >= 124) {
          console.log(
            "minLpOut:",
            fslice.loadCoins().toString(),
          );
        }

        console.log(
          "Forward trailing bits:",
          fslice.remainingBits,
        );

        console.log(
          "Forward trailing refs:",
          fslice.remainingRefs,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  console.log();
  console.log(
    "ROOT trailing bits:",
    s.remainingBits,
  );

  console.log(
    "ROOT trailing refs:",
    s.remainingRefs,
  );
}

FILE: scripts\inspectSegment412Consumers.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = new Set([2053, 2101, 2612]);

const SEG412_START = 0x00187708;
const SEG412_END   = 0x00187874;

const SEG413_START = 0x0018f0d8;

function u32(buf: Buffer, off: number): number {
    if (off < 0 || off + 4 > buf.length) return 0xffffffff;
    return buf.readUInt32LE(off);
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function isSeg412Ptr(v: number): boolean {
    return v >= SEG412_START && v <= SEG412_END;
}

function isLikelyMemoryPtr(v: number): boolean {
    return (
        v >= 0x00180000 &&
        v < 0x00200000 &&
        (v & 3) === 0
    );
}

function collectFunctions(buf: Buffer): number[] {
    const found = new Set<number>();

    /*
     * Candidate function-index values observed in the
     * Segment 413 structures.
     *
     * We deliberately do not assume that every u32 in the
     * data area is a function index.
     */
    for (let off = SEG413_START; off < SEG413_START + 0x400; off += 4) {
        const v = u32(buf, off);

        if (
            v >= 2000 &&
            v < 5000
        ) {
            found.add(v);
        }
    }

    return [...found].sort((a, b) => a - b);
}

function main() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("SEGMENT 412 CONSUMER INSPECTOR");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    if (!fs.existsSync(WASM)) {
        console.error("");
        console.error("WASM NOT FOUND:");
        console.error(WASM);
        process.exit(1);
    }

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log(`WASM size : ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`);
    console.log("");

    /*
     * Search all 32-bit aligned data locations for the
     * three target table indexes.
     */
    const hits: {
        target: number;
        offset: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let off = 0; off + 4 <= buf.length; off += 4) {
        const v = u32(buf, off);

        if (TARGETS.has(v)) {
            hits.push({
                target: v,
                offset: off,
            });
        }
    }

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("TARGET HITS");
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (const h of hits) {
        console.log(
            `TARGET ${h.target} @ ${hex(h.offset)}`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("STRUCTURE CONSUMER ANALYSIS");
    console.log("============================================================");

    for (const h of hits) {
        console.log("");
        console.log(
            `TARGET ${h.target} @ ${hex(h.offset)}`
        );
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        const base = h.offset;

        /*
         * Inspect the surrounding structure.
         */
        for (let rel = 0; rel <= 0x9c; rel += 4) {
            const off = base + rel;
            if (off + 4 > buf.length) break;

            const v = u32(buf, off);

            let tag = "";

            if (isSeg412Ptr(v)) {
                tag = " <<< SEG412";
            } else if (v === SEG413_START) {
                tag = " <<< SEG413";
            } else if (isLikelyMemoryPtr(v)) {
                tag = " <<< PTR?";
            }

            if (
                rel < 0x20 ||
                isSeg412Ptr(v) ||
                v === SEG413_START ||
                (v >= 2000 && v < 5000)
            ) {
                console.log(
                    `+${rel.toString().padStart(3, " ")} ` +
                    `${hex(off)}  ${hex(v)}  ${v}${tag}`
                );
            }
        }

        /*
         * Examine each SEG412 pointer from this structure.
         */
        console.log("");
        console.log("SEG412 POINTERS:");

        const seg412Ptrs = new Set<number>();

        for (let rel = 0; rel <= 0x9c; rel += 4) {
            const off = base + rel;
            if (off + 4 > buf.length) break;

            const v = u32(buf, off);

            if (isSeg412Ptr(v)) {
                seg412Ptrs.add(v);
                console.log(
                    `  +${rel.toString().padStart(3, " ")} -> ${hex(v)}`
                );
            }
        }

        /*
         * For each SEG412 pointer inspect a compact window.
         */
        for (const ptr of seg412Ptrs) {
            console.log("");
            console.log(`SEG412 WINDOW @ ${hex(ptr)}`);

            const start = Math.max(0, ptr - 0x20);
            const end = Math.min(buf.length, ptr + 0x80);

            for (let off = start; off < end; off += 4) {
                const v = u32(buf, off);

                let tag = "";

                if (isSeg412Ptr(v)) {
                    tag = " SEG412";
                } else if (v === SEG413_START) {
                    tag = " SEG413";
                } else if (v >= 2000 && v < 5000) {
                    tag = " FUNC?";
                }

                if (
                    isSeg412Ptr(v) ||
                    v === SEG413_START ||
                    (v >= 2000 && v < 5000)
                ) {
                    console.log(
                        `  ${hex(off)} = ${hex(v)} ${v}${tag}`
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /*
     * Collect the function-index candidates from SEG413.
     */
    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("SEG413 FUNCTION INDEX CANDIDATES");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const functions = collectFunctions(buf);

    console.log(`Count : ${functions.length}`);
    console.log("");

    for (const fn of functions) {
        console.log(`  FUNCTION ${fn}`);
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("IMPORTANT");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(
        "This pass identifies structural/data relationships only."
    );
    console.log(
        "No WASM instruction execution or modification is performed."
    );
    console.log("============================================================");
}

main();

====================================================================================================
FILE: scripts\inspectSegment412Structure.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [
    0x00187724,
    0x0018744c,
    0x00189dec,
    0x00189f9c,
    0x0018a8b0,
    0x0018ab5c
];

const SEG412_START = 0x0018744c;
const SEG412_END   = 0x0018ab8d;

const SEG413_START = 0x0018ab98;
const SEG413_END   = 0x0018f512;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse data section and reconstruct linear memory
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function uleb(buf: Buffer, pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function readU32(mem: Buffer, addr: number) {
    if (addr < 0 || addr + 4 > mem.length)
        return 0;

    return mem.readUInt32LE(addr);
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function region(v: number) {
    if (v >= SEG412_START && v < SEG412_END)
        return "SEG412";

    if (v >= SEG413_START && v < SEG413_END)
        return "SEG413";

    if (v === 2053 || v === 2101 || v === 2612)
        return "TARGET_TABLE_INDEX";

    if (v >= 2700 && v <= 9000)
        return "FUNCTION_INDEX?";

    return "";
}

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35)
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
    }
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function findSection(id: number) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const sectionId = wasm[p++];
        const s = readULEB(p);
        p = s.next;

        if (sectionId === id) {
            return { start: p, end: p + s.value };
        }

        p += s.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

const sec = findSection(11);
let p = readULEB(sec.start).next;

for (let seg = 0; seg < 670; seg++) {
    const flags = readULEB(p);
    p = flags.next;

    if (flags.value === 1) {
        const size = readULEB(p);
        p = size.next + size.value;
        continue;
    }

    let memoryIndex = 0;
    let offset = 0;

    if (flags.value === 2) {
        const mem = readULEB(p);
        memoryIndex = mem.value;
        p = mem.next;
    } else if (flags.value !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported flags ${flags.value} at segment ${seg}`
        );
    }

    if (wasm[p++] !== 0x41) {
        throw new Error(`Unexpected offset opcode at segment ${seg}`);
    }

    const off = readSLEB(p);
    offset = off.value >>> 0;
    p = off.next;

    if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b) {
        throw new Error(`Missing offset end at segment ${seg}`);
    }

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const dataStart = p;
    const dataEnd = dataStart + sizeInfo.value;

    if (seg === 669) {
        console.log("SEGMENT 669");
        console.log(`MEMORY = ${memoryIndex}`);
        console.log(`LINEAR OFFSET = 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        console.log(`SIZE = ${sizeInfo.value}`);
        console.log(`WASM FILE OFFSET = 0x${dataStart.toString(16)}`);
        console.log("");

        for (let i = 0; i < sizeInfo.value; i += 8) {
            const end = Math.min(i + 8, sizeInfo.value);
            const bytes = Array.from(
                wasm.subarray(dataStart + i, dataStart + end)
            );

            console.log(
                `+${i.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}: ` +
                bytes.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ")
            );
        }

        console.log("");
        console.log("TARGET WORDS:");

        for (const target of [0x195350, 0x195354]) {
            const rel = target - offset;
            const value = wasm.readUInt32LE(dataStart + rel);

            console.log(
                `0x${target.toString(16)} = ${value} (0x${value.toString(16)})`
            );
        }

        break;
    }

    p = dataEnd;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SEGMENT 412 / 413 RAW INSPECTOR");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log("");

function u32(pos: number): number {
  return (
    (wasm[pos] |
      (wasm[pos + 1] << 8) |
      (wasm[pos + 2] << 16) |
      (wasm[pos + 3] << 24)) >>>
    0
  );
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB128 too large");
    }
  }

  throw new Error("Unexpected EOF while reading ULEB128");
}

function findDataSection(): { payload: number; size: number } {
  if (
    wasm[0] !== 0x00 ||
    wasm[1] !== 0x61 ||
    wasm[2] !== 0x73 ||
    wasm[3] !== 0x6d
  ) {
    throw new Error("Not a valid WASM file");
  }

  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    if (sectionId === 11) {
      return {
        payload: p,
        size: sectionSize,
      };
    }

    p += sectionSize;
  }

  throw new Error("WASM data section not found");
}

const dataSection = findDataSection();

console.log("DATA SECTION");
console.log(`  payload : 0x${dataSection.payload.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`);
console.log(`  size    : ${dataSection.size.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log("");

let p = dataSection.payload;

const segmentCountInfo = readULEB(p);
const segmentCount = segmentCountInfo.value;
p = segmentCountInfo.next;

console.log(`Data segments : ${segmentCount.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log("");

interface SegmentInfo {
  index: number;
  flags: number;
  memoryIndex?: number;
  offsetExpr?: number;
  dataOffset: number;
  size: number;
  end: number;
}

const segments: SegmentInfo[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < segmentCount; i++) {
  const flagsInfo = readULEB(p);
  const flags = flagsInfo.value;
  p = flagsInfo.next;

  let memoryIndex: number | undefined;
  let offsetExpr: number | undefined;

  /*
   * Passive segment:
   *   flags bit 0 = 1
   *
   * Active segment:
   *   flags bit 0 = 0
   *
   * For the normal active form:
   *   flags = 0:
   *      offset expression
   *
   *   flags = 2:
   *      memory index
   *      offset expression
   */

  if ((flags & 1) === 0) {
    if (flags === 2) {
      const memInfo = readULEB(p);
      memoryIndex = memInfo.value;
      p = memInfo.next;
    }

    /*
     * Read the offset expression.
     * We only need the resulting i32.const value.
     *
     * Expected form:
     *   0x41 <signed/unsigned LEB> 0x0b
     */
    const opcode = wasm[p++];

    if (opcode === 0x41) {
      const valueInfo = readULEB(p);
      offsetExpr = valueInfo.value;
      p = valueInfo.next;
    } else {
      /*
       * Non-constant offset expression.
       * Skip instructions until END (0x0b).
       */
      while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        if (b === 0x0b) {
          break;
        }

        /*
         * This branch is only a fallback.
         * We do not attempt to evaluate the expression.
         */
      }
    }

    /*
     * If the expression was constant, consume END.
     * If it was non-constant, END was already consumed above.
     */
    if (offsetExpr !== undefined && wasm[p] === 0x0b) {
      p++;
    }
  }

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  const size = sizeInfo.value;
  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const dataOffset = p;
  const end = dataOffset + size;

  segments.push({
    index: i,
    flags,
    memoryIndex,
    offsetExpr,
    dataOffset,
    size,
    end,
  });

  p = end;
}

function printSegment(index: number) {
  const s = segments[index];

  if (!s) {
    console.log(`Segment ${index}: NOT FOUND`);
    return;
  }

  console.log(`SEGMENT ${index}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`index       : ${s.index}`);
  console.log(`flags       : ${s.flags}`);
  console.log(
    `memoryIndex : ${
      s.memoryIndex === undefined ? "n/a" : s.memoryIndex
    }`
  );
  console.log(
    `memory addr : ${
      s.offsetExpr === undefined
        ? "non-constant"
        : "0x" + s.offsetExpr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")
    }`
  );
  console.log(
    `data offset : 0x${s.dataOffset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
  );
  console.log(`data size   : ${s.size.toLocaleString()}`);
  console.log(
    `data end    : 0x${s.end.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
  );
  console.log("");
}

printSegment(412);
printSegment(413);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SEGMENT RELATION");
console.log("============================================================");

const s412 = segments[412];
const s413 = segments[413];

if (s412 && s413) {
  console.log(
    `412 memory range : 0x${(s412.offsetExpr ?? 0)
      .toString(16)
      .padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${((s412.offsetExpr ?? 0) + s412.size)
      .toString(16)
      .padStart(8, "0")}`
  );

  console.log(
    `413 memory range : 0x${(s413.offsetExpr ?? 0)
      .toString(16)
      .padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${((s413.offsetExpr ?? 0) + s413.size)
      .toString(16)
      .padStart(8, "0")}`
  );

  console.log("");

  if (
    s412.offsetExpr !== undefined &&
    s413.offsetExpr !== undefined
  ) {
    const end412 = s412.offsetExpr + s412.size;

    if (end412 === s413.offsetExpr) {
      console.log("RESULT : SEGMENT 413 STARTS IMMEDIATELY AFTER SEGMENT 412");
    } else if (end412 < s413.offsetExpr) {
      console.log(
        `RESULT : GAP = ${(s413.offsetExpr - end412).toLocaleString()} bytes`
      );
    } else {
      console.log(
        `RESULT : OVERLAP = ${(end412 - s413.offsetExpr).toLocaleString()} bytes`
      );
    }
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("RAW FIRST 64 BYTES");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const index of [412, 413]) {
  const s = segments[index];

  if (!s) continue;

  console.log(`SEGMENT ${index}:`);

  const count = Math.min(64, s.size);
  let line = "";

    if ((i + 1) % 16 === 0) {
      console.log(line.trim());

    }
  }

  if (line.length > 0) {

}

import fs from "fs";

const w = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(p:number) {
  let v=0,s=0;
  while(true) {
    const b=w[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2**s;
    if(!(b&0x80)) return {v,p};
    s+=7;
  }
}

function hex(n:number) {
  return "0x"+n.toString(16).padStart(8,"0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("INSPECT DATA INITIALIZATION NEAR 0x19534C");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let p=8;
let dataFound=false;

while(p<w.length) {
  const id=w[p++];
  const z=uleb(p);
  p=z.p;
  const end=p+z.v;

  if(id===11) {
    console.log("DATA SECTION START :", hex(p));
    console.log("DATA SECTION END   :", hex(end));
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    let q=p;
    const count=uleb(q);
    q=count.p;

    for(let seg=0;seg<count.v;seg++) {
      console.log(`DATA SEGMENT ${seg} @ ${hex(q)}`);

      const flags=uleb(q);
      q=flags.p;

      // active segment with memory index 0
      if(flags.v===0) {
        // offset expression
        const op=w[q++];

        if(op===0x41) {
          const off=uleb(q);
          q=off.p;

          const offset=off.v;

          if(w[q]===0x0b) q++;

          const len=uleb(q);
          q=len.p;

          const dataStart=q;
          const dataEnd=q+len.v;

          console.log("  OFFSET :",hex(offset));
          console.log("  SIZE   :",len.v);

          const segEnd=dataEnd;

          if(TARGET>=offset && TARGET<offset+len.v) {
            dataFound=true;

            console.log("  *** TARGET IS INSIDE THIS SEGMENT ***");

            const a=Math.max(offset,TARGET-32);
            const b=Math.min(offset+len.v,TARGET+64);

            console.log("  MEMORY RANGE:",hex(a),"..",hex(b));

            for(let addr=a;addr<b;addr+=16) {
              const row:number[]=[];

              for(let j=0;j<16 && addr+j<b;j++) {
                row.push(w[dataStart+(addr+j-offset)]);
              }

              console.log(
                "  "+hex(addr)+" : "+
                row.map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join(" ")
              );
            }
          }

          q=segEnd;
        }
      }
    }

    break;
  }

  p=end;
}

if(!dataFound) {
  console.log("TARGET NOT PRESENT DIRECTLY IN ACTIVE DATA SEGMENTS.");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("============================================================");

FILE: scripts\inspectSelectorDispatchFamily.ts

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGETS = [4788, 4789, 4790, 4791];

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function valTypeName(v: number): string {
    switch (v) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        case 0x7b: return "v128";
        case 0x70: return "funcref";
        case 0x6f: return "externref";
        default: return `0x${v.toString(16)}`;
    }
}

type FuncType = {
    params: number[];
    results: number[];
};

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTION LOCATOR
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const sections: {
    id: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
}[] = [];

let p = 8;

while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    sections.push({
        id,
        start: p,
        end: p + size
    });

    p += size;
}

function getSection(id: number) {
    return sections.find(s => s.id === id);
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// TYPE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const types: FuncType[] = [];

const typeSec = getSection(1);

if (!typeSec) {
    throw new Error("TYPE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

let t = typeSec.start;

const typeCountInfo = readULEB(t);
const typeCount = typeCountInfo.value;
t = typeCountInfo.next;

for (let i = 0; i < typeCount; i++) {

    const form = buf[t++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected type form at ${hex(t - 1)} = ${hex(form)}`
        );
    }

    const pc = readULEB(t);
    t = pc.next;

    const params: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
        params.push(buf[t++]);
    }

    const rc = readULEB(t);
    t = rc.next;

    const results: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
        results.push(buf[t++]);
    }

    types.push({
        params,
        results
    });
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ordinal -> type index
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const functionTypes: number[] = [];

const funcSec = getSection(3);

if (!funcSec) {
    throw new Error("FUNCTION SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

let f = funcSec.start;

const funcCountInfo = readULEB(f);
const funcCount = funcCountInfo.value;
f = funcCountInfo.next;

for (let i = 0; i < funcCount; i++) {
    const x = readULEB(f);
    functionTypes.push(x.value);
    f = x.next;
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// TABLE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const tableSec = getSection(4);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SELECTOR DISPATCH FAMILY");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TYPE COUNT       = ${types.length}`);
console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS= ${funcCount}`);
console.log(`TARGET TABLE     = ${TARGETS.join(", ")}`);
console.log("============================================================");

if (tableSec) {

    let z = tableSec.start;

    const tableCountInfo = readULEB(z);
    const tableCount = tableCountInfo.value;
    z = tableCountInfo.next;

    console.log(`TABLE COUNT      = ${tableCount}`);

    for (let i = 0; i < tableCount; i++) {

        const elemType = buf[z++];

        const limFlags = readULEB(z);
        z = limFlags.next;

        const min = readULEB(z);
        z = min.next;

        let max: number | null = null;

        if (limFlags.value & 1) {
            const mx = readULEB(z);
            max = mx.value;
            z = mx.next;
        }

        console.log("");
        console.log(`TABLE #${i}`);
        console.log(`  ELEM TYPE = ${valTypeName(elemType)}`);
        console.log(`  MIN       = ${min.value}`);
        console.log(`  MAX       = ${max ?? "none"}`);
    }

} else {
    console.log("TABLE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// ELEMENT SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const tableEntries = new Map<number, number>();

const elemSec = getSection(9);

if (!elemSec) {
    console.log("ELEMENT SECTION NOT FOUND");
} else {

    let e = elemSec.start;

    const segCountInfo = readULEB(e);
    const segCount = segCountInfo.value;
    e = segCountInfo.next;

    console.log("");
    console.log(`ELEMENT SEGMENT COUNT = ${segCount}`);

    for (let seg = 0; seg < segCount; seg++) {

        const flagsInfo = readULEB(e);
        const flags = flagsInfo.value;
        e = flagsInfo.next;

        //
        // We only decode the common active-table forms:
        //
        // flags 0 = active table 0, funcidx vector
        // flags 2 = active explicit table, funcidx vector
        //
        if (flags === 0 || flags === 2) {

            let tableIndex = 0;

            if (flags === 2) {
                const ti = readULEB(e);
                tableIndex = ti.value;
                e = ti.next;
            }

            //
            // offset expression
            //
            const opcode = buf[e++];

            if (opcode === 0x41) {
                const off = readSLEB(e);
                e = off.next;

                const end = buf[e++];

                if (end !== 0x0b) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Bad element offset expression at ${hex(e - 1)}`
                    );
                }

                const vecInfo = readULEB(e);
                const vecCount = vecInfo.value;
                e = vecInfo.next;

                const base = off.value >>> 0;

                for (let j = 0; j < vecCount; j++) {

                    const fi = readULEB(e);
                    const funcIndex = fi.value;
                    e = fi.next;

                    tableEntries.set(
                        base + j,
                        funcIndex
                    );
                }

                continue;
            }

            //
            // Unsupported offset expression:
            // skip conservatively is unsafe, so report and stop.
            //
            console.log(
                `SEGMENT ${seg}: unsupported offset opcode ${hex(opcode)}`
            );

            break;

        } else if (flags === 1) {

            //
            // passive element segment with elemkind + expressions
            //
            const elemKind = buf[e++];

            const vecInfo = readULEB(e);
            const count = vecInfo.value;
            e = vecInfo.next;

            //
            // Skip references conservatively.
            //
            for (let j = 0; j < count; j++) {
                //
                // ref.func is usually 0xd2 followed by function index.
                //
                const op = buf[e++];

                if (op === 0xd2) {
                    const fi = readULEB(e);
                    e = fi.next;
                } else {
                    //
                    // Not decoding passive expression form further.
                    //
                    console.log(
                        `SEGMENT ${seg}: unsupported passive expr ${hex(op)}`
                    );
                    break;
                }
            }

        } else {

            console.log(
                `SEGMENT ${seg}: flags=${flags} not decoded`
            );

            break;
        }
    }
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// TARGET TABLE ENTRIES
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET TABLE ENTRIES");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const tableIndex of TARGETS) {

    const globalFunc = tableEntries.get(tableIndex);

    if (globalFunc === undefined) {
        console.log(
            `TABLE[${tableIndex}] = NOT RESOLVED`
        );
        continue;
    }

    const typeIndex = globalFunc < 83
        ? null
        : functionTypes[globalFunc - 83];

    console.log("");
    console.log(`TABLE[${tableIndex}]`);
    console.log(`  GLOBAL FUNC = ${globalFunc}`);

    if (typeIndex === null) {
        console.log(`  TYPE        = IMPORTED`);
        continue;
    }

    const ft = types[typeIndex];

    console.log(`  TYPE INDEX  = ${typeIndex}`);
    console.log(
        `  PARAMS      = [${ft.params.map(valTypeName).join(", ")}]`
    );
    console.log(
        `  RESULTS     = [${ft.results.map(valTypeName).join(", ")}]`
    );
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SAME-TYPE TABLE MEMBERS
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SAME-TYPE TABLE MEMBERS");
console.log("============================================================");

const targetTypeIndices = new Set<number>();

for (const tableIndex of TARGETS) {

    const globalFunc = tableEntries.get(tableIndex);

    if (
        globalFunc !== undefined &&
        globalFunc >= 83
    ) {
        const typeIndex =
            functionTypes[globalFunc - 83];

        targetTypeIndices.add(typeIndex);
    }
}

for (const typeIndex of targetTypeIndices) {

    const ft = types[typeIndex];

    console.log("");
    console.log(`TYPE ${typeIndex}`);
    console.log(
        `  PARAMS  = [${ft.params.map(valTypeName).join(", ")}]`
    );
    console.log(
        `  RESULTS = [${ft.results.map(valTypeName).join(", ")}]`
    );

    let shown = 0;

    for (const [tableIndex, globalFunc] of tableEntries) {

        if (globalFunc < 83)
            continue;

        const ti =
            functionTypes[globalFunc - 83];

        if (ti !== typeIndex)
            continue;

        console.log(
            `  TABLE[${tableIndex}] -> FUNC ${globalFunc}`
        );

        shown++;

        if (shown >= 80) {
            console.log("  ... output limited to 80 entries");
            break;
        }
    }

    console.log(`  TOTAL SHOWN = ${shown}`);
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("END");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("============================================================");

const segments = [
  { id: 1165, file: 0x004c58b0, runtime: 0x001a7900, size: 110 },
  { id: 1166, file: 0x004c5926, runtime: 0x001a7980, size: 110 },
  { id: 1167, file: 0x004c599c, runtime: 0x001a7a00, size: 110 },

function u32(p) {
  return (
    b[p] |
    (b[p + 1] << 8) |
    (b[p + 2] << 16) |
    (b[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

  console.log(`FILE    : 0x${s.file.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`RUNTIME : 0x${s.runtime.toString(16)}`);

  for (let off = 0; off + 8 <= s.size; off += 8) {
    const key = u32(s.file + off);
    const sel = u32(s.file + off + 4);

    console.log(
      `  +0x${off.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")} ` +
      `KEY=${key.toString().padStart(3)} ` +
      `SELECTOR=${sel.toString().padStart(4)} ` +
      `RUNTIME=0x${(s.runtime + off).toString(16)}`
    );
  }
