import fs from 'node:fs';

const file = 'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

function readUleb(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte;

    do {
        if (pos >= wasm.length) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF');
        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value += (byte & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);
        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('Invalid ULEB');
    } while (byte & 0x80);

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function dump(start, end) {
    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const stop = Math.min(p + 16, end);
        const bytes = [...wasm.subarray(p, stop)]
            .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
            .join(' ');
        console.log(`${hex(p)}  ${bytes}`);
    }
}

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[pos++];
    const size = readUleb(pos);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) throw new Error('Code section not found');

const count = readUleb(codeStart);
pos = count.next;

const bodies = new Map();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const size = readUleb(pos);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    bodies.set(83 + ordinal, {
        start,
        end,
        size: size.value
    });

    pos = end;
}

const targets = [83, 394, 615, 700, 1022];

console.log('SHARED HELPER INSPECTION');
console.log('READ ONLY - OFFLINE');
console.log('============================================================');
console.log(`FILE SIZE = ${wasm.length}`);
console.log(`FUNCTION BODIES = ${count.value}`);

for (const func of targets) {
    const body = bodies.get(func);

    console.log('\n============================================================');
    console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC ${func}`);

    if (!body) {
        console.log('BODY NOT FOUND');
        continue;
    }

    console.log(`BODY = ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`);
    console.log(`SIZE = ${body.size}`);
    console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');

    if (body.size <= 240) {
        dump(body.start, body.end);
    } else {
        console.log('FIRST 240 BYTES ONLY');
        dump(body.start, body.start + 240);
    }
}

console.log('\nDONE - READ ONLY - NO WASM EXECUTION');

FILE: scripts\inspectStonPackagesV22.ts

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

const NODE_MODULES = path.resolve(
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\node_modules'
);

const KEYWORDS = [
    'ston',
    'pool',
    'liquidity',
    'lp',
    'router',
    'swap',
    'callback',
    'provide',
    'transfer',
    'notification',
];

const MAX_RESULTS = 250;

let results = 0;

function score(name: string): number {
    const lower = name.toLowerCase();

    let s = 0;

    for (const keyword of KEYWORDS) {
        if (lower.includes(keyword)) {
            s++;
        }
    }

    return s;
}

function walk(dir: string) {
    let entries: fs.Dirent[];

    try {
        entries = fs.readdirSync(
            dir,
            { withFileTypes: true }
        );
    } catch {
        return;
    }

    for (const entry of entries) {
        if (results >= MAX_RESULTS) {
            return;
        }

        const full =
            path.join(dir, entry.name);

        if (entry.isDirectory()) {
            walk(full);
            continue;
        }

        if (!entry.isFile()) {
            continue;
        }

        const relative =
            path.relative(
                NODE_MODULES,
                full
            );

        const s = score(relative);

        if (s >= 2) {
            console.log(
                `[${s}] ${relative}`
            );

            results++;
        }
    }
}

export async function run() {
    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' STON.FI PACKAGE / FILE STRUCTURE INSPECTOR'
    );
    console.log(
        ' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION'
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Searching node_modules for STON.fi-related files...'
    );
    console.log('');

    walk(NODE_MODULES);

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        `RESULTS: ${results}`
    );
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'Next step: identify the actual SDK package/file containing'
    );
    console.log(
        'Pool / LP / Router message builders or parsers.'
    );
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const router = DEX.v2_1.Router.CPI.create(
        Address.parse(
            'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
        )
    );

    console.log('===== STON.FI ROUTER v2.1 =====');
    console.log('Address:', router.address.toString());

    const routerProvider = provider.provider(router.address);

    try {
        const version = await router.getRouterVersion(routerProvider);
        console.log('Router version:', version);
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('getRouterVersion ERROR:', e);
    }

    try {
        const data = await router.getRouterData(routerProvider);
        console.log('Router data:', data);
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('getRouterData ERROR:', e);
    }
}

import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log(`
============================================================
 STON.FI v2.2 SDK EXPORT / SCHEMA INSPECTOR
 READ ONLY - LOCAL node_modules ONLY
============================================================
`);

    const root = join(
        process.cwd(),
        'node_modules',
        '@ston-fi',
        'sdk',
        'dist',
        'contracts',
        'dex',
        'v2_2'
    );

    const files = [
        'LpAccount/LpAccountV2_2.js',
        'LpAccount/LpAccountV2_2.cjs',

        'pool/BasePoolV2_2.js',
        'pool/BasePoolV2_2.cjs',
        'pool/CPIPoolV2_2.js',
        'pool/CPIPoolV2_2.cjs',

        'router/BaseRouterV2_2.js',
        'router/BaseRouterV2_2.cjs',
        'router/CPIRouterV2_2.js',
        'router/CPIRouterV2_2.cjs',
    ];

    const needles = [
        '0x50c6a654',
        '50c6a654',
        '0x178d4519',
        '178d4519',
        'addLiquidity',
        'ADD_LIQUIDITY',
        'provideLp',
        'provide_lp',
        'transfer',
        'mint',
        'burn',
        'callback',
        'excess',
        'refund',
        'minLpOut',
        'bothPositive',
    ];

    for (const relative of files) {
        const file = join(root, relative);

        if (!existsSync(file)) {
            console.log(`\n[MISSING] ${relative}`);
            continue;
        }

        console.log(`\n============================================================`);
        console.log(`FILE: ${relative}`);
        console.log(`============================================================`);

        const text = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
        const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);

        let hits = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            const line = lines[i];

            if (
                needles.some((needle) =>
                    line.toLowerCase().includes(needle.toLowerCase())
                )
            ) {
                hits++;

                console.log(`\n--- MATCH line ${i + 1} ---`);

                const start = Math.max(0, i - 4);
                const end = Math.min(lines.length, i + 7);

                for (let j = start; j < end; j++) {
                    console.log(
                        `${String(j + 1).padStart(6, ' ')} | ${lines[j]}`
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        console.log(`\nMatches in file: ${hits}`);
    }

    console.log(`
============================================================
 INSPECTION COMPLETE
============================================================

Focus:
  1. 0x50c6a654  -> ADD_LIQUIDITY
  2. 0x178d4519  -> LP-related transfer/callback path
  3. addLiquidity / provideLp
  4. LP mint / transfer / callback fields

No transaction was created or sent.
`);
}

import { existsSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

function inspectFile(file: string, label: string) {
    if (!existsSync(file)) {
        console.log(`\n[MISSING] ${label}`);
        return;
    }

    console.log(`\n============================================================`);
    console.log(`FILE: ${label}`);
    console.log(`============================================================`);

    const text = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');

    const needles = [
        '50c6a654',
        '0x50c6a654',
        '178d4519',
        '0x178d4519',
        'add_liquidity',
        'addLiquidity',
        'provideLp',
        'provide_lp',
        'ADD_LIQUIDITY',
        'LpAccountV2_2',
        'CPIPoolV2_2',
        'BasePoolV2_2',
        'CPIRouterV2_2',
        'minLpOut',
        'bothPositive',
        'lpOut',
        'lp_wallet',
        'jetton_wallet',
    ];

    let total = 0;

    for (const needle of needles) {
        let pos = 0;
        let count = 0;

        while (true) {
            const found = text
                .toLowerCase()
                .indexOf(needle.toLowerCase(), pos);

            if (found === -1) break;

            count++;
            total++;

            const from = Math.max(0, found - 250);
            const to = Math.min(text.length, found + needle.length + 500);

            console.log(`\n--- MATCH: "${needle}" #${count} ---`);
            console.log(text.slice(from, to));

            pos = found + needle.length;

            // جلوگیری از خروجی بیش از حد
            if (count >= 8) break;
        }

        if (count > 0) {
            console.log(`\nOccurrences shown for "${needle}": ${count}`);
        }
    }

    console.log(`\nTotal matches shown: ${total}`);
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log(`
============================================================
 STON.FI v2.2 SOURCE MAP / CHUNK INSPECTOR
 READ ONLY - LOCAL node_modules ONLY
============================================================
`);

    const sdkRoot = join(
        process.cwd(),
        'node_modules',
        '@ston-fi',
        'sdk',
        'dist'
    );

    const v22Root = join(
        sdkRoot,
        'contracts',
        'dex',
        'v2_2'
    );

    console.log(`SDK root : ${sdkRoot}`);
    console.log(`v2.2 root: ${v22Root}`);

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. v2.2 source maps
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const v22Dirs = [
        join(v22Root, 'LpAccount'),
        join(v22Root, 'pool'),
        join(v22Root, 'router'),
    ];

    for (const dir of v22Dirs) {
        if (!existsSync(dir)) continue;

        for (const name of readdirSync(dir)) {
            if (!name.endsWith('.map')) continue;

            inspectFile(
                join(dir, name),
                `v2_2/${dir.split('v2_2\\')[1]}\\${name}`
            );
        }
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. SDK chunks
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (existsSync(sdkRoot)) {
        for (const name of readdirSync(sdkRoot)) {
            if (
                name.startsWith('chunk-') &&
                (name.endsWith('.js') ||
                    name.endsWith('.cjs') ||
                    name.endsWith('.js.map') ||
                    name.endsWith('.cjs.map'))
            ) {
                inspectFile(
                    join(sdkRoot, name),
                    `dist/${name}`
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. helpers / utility files
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const extraFiles = [
        join(sdkRoot, 'helpers.js'),
        join(sdkRoot, 'helpers.cjs'),
        join(
            sdkRoot,
            'utils',
            'createJettonTransferMessage.js'
        ),
        join(
            sdkRoot,
            'utils',
            'createJettonTransferMessage.cjs'
        ),
    ];

    for (const file of extraFiles) {
        inspectFile(file, file.replace(sdkRoot, 'dist'));
    }

    console.log(`
============================================================
 INSPECTION COMPLETE
============================================================

IMPORTANT TARGETS:

  0x50c6a654  = Pool ADD_LIQUIDITY
  0x178d4519  = LP-related message
  7.219004800 ROOSTER
              = 7219004800 nano ROOSTER

No transaction was created or sent.
`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x12b4;

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8): string {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function sectionEnd(start: number): number {
  const s = readUleb(start);
  return s.next + s.value;
}

console.log("INSPECT TABLE[0x12B4]");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET TABLE INDEX = ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log("============================================================");

let p = 8;

let tableSection: {
  start: number;
  end: number;
} | null = null;

let elementSection: {
  start: number;
  end: number;
} | null = null;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];

  const size = readUleb(p);
  p = size.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + size.value;

  if (id === 4) {
    tableSection = { start, end };
  }

  if (id === 9) {
    elementSection = { start, end };
  }

  p = end;
}

if (!tableSection) {
  throw new Error("TABLE section not found");
}

if (!elementSection) {
  throw new Error("ELEMENT section not found");
}

console.log(
  `TABLE SECTION = ${hex(tableSection.start)} .. ${hex(tableSection.end)}`
);

console.log(
  `ELEMENT SECTION = ${hex(elementSection.start)} .. ${hex(elementSection.end)}`
);

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TABLE SECTION");
console.log("============================================================");

let t = tableSection.start;

const tableCount = readUleb(t);
t = tableCount.next;

console.log(`TABLE COUNT = ${tableCount.value}`);

for (let i = 0; i < tableCount.value; i++) {
  const elemType = wasm[t++];

  const flags = readUleb(t);
  t = flags.next;

  const min = readUleb(t);
  t = min.next;

  let max: number | null = null;

  if (flags.value & 1) {
    const x = readUleb(t);
    t = x.next;
    max = x.value;
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log(`TABLE #${i}`);
  console.log(`  ELEM TYPE = ${hex(elemType, 2)}`);
  console.log(`  FLAGS     = ${flags.value}`);
  console.log(`  MIN       = ${min.value}`);
  console.log(`  MAX       = ${max === null ? "none" : max}`);

  if (i === 0) {
    console.log(
      `  TARGET INDEX ${hex(TARGET)} IS ${
        TARGET < min.value ? "OUTSIDE MINIMUM" : "WITHIN MINIMUM"
      }`
    );

    if (max !== null) {
      console.log(
        `  TARGET INDEX ${hex(TARGET)} IS ${
          TARGET < max ? "BELOW MAXIMUM" : "AT/ABOVE MAXIMUM"
        }`
      );
    }
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("ELEMENT SECTION");
console.log("============================================================");

let e = elementSection.start;

const elemCount = readUleb(e);
e = elemCount.next;

console.log(`ELEMENT SEGMENT COUNT = ${elemCount.value}`);

let found = false;

for (let seg = 0; seg < elemCount.value; seg++) {
  const flags = readUleb(e);
  e = flags.next;

  /*
   * We decode the common active/passive function-index forms.
   *
   * flags:
   *   0 = active, table 0, i32 offset, vec(funcidx)
   *   1 = passive, elemkind + vec(funcidx)
   *   2 = active, explicit table, i32 offset, elemkind + vec(funcidx)
   *   3 = declarative, elemkind + vec(funcidx)
   *   4 = active, table 0, expr offset, vec(expr)
   *   5 = passive, ref.null/ref.func expressions
   *   6 = active, explicit table, expr offset
   *   7 = declarative expressions
   */

  console.log("");
  console.log(`ELEMENT SEGMENT #${seg} FLAGS=${flags.value}`);

  let mode = "";

  if (flags.value === 0) {
    mode = "active-func";
  } else if (flags.value === 1) {
    mode = "passive-func";
  } else if (flags.value === 2) {
    mode = "active-table-func";
  } else if (flags.value === 3) {
    mode = "declarative-func";
  } else if (flags.value === 4) {
    mode = "active-expr";
  } else if (flags.value === 5) {
    mode = "passive-expr";
  } else if (flags.value === 6) {
    mode = "active-table-expr";
  } else if (flags.value === 7) {
    mode = "declarative-expr";
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported element flags ${flags.value}`);
  }

  console.log(`  MODE = ${mode}`);

  let tableIndex = 0;
  let offsetValue: number | null = null;

  if (flags.value === 0 || flags.value === 2) {
    if (flags.value === 2) {
      const ti = readUleb(e);
      e = ti.next;
      tableIndex = ti.value;
    }

    const op = wasm[e++];

    if (op !== 0x41) {
      throw new Error(
        `Segment ${seg}: expected i32.const offset, got ${hex(op, 2)}`
      );
    }

    const off = readSleb(e);
    e = off.next;

    offsetValue = off.value >>> 0;

    const end = wasm[e++];

    if (end !== 0x0b) {
      throw new Error(`Segment ${seg}: malformed offset expr`);
    }
  }

  if (flags.value === 4 || flags.value === 6) {
    if (flags.value === 6) {
      const ti = readUleb(e);
      e = ti.next;
      tableIndex = ti.value;
    }

    const op = wasm[e++];

    if (op !== 0x41) {
      throw new Error(
        `Segment ${seg}: expected i32.const expr offset, got ${hex(op, 2)}`
      );
    }

    const off = readSleb(e);
    e = off.next;

    offsetValue = off.value >>> 0;

    const end = wasm[e++];

    if (end !== 0x0b) {
      throw new Error(`Segment ${seg}: malformed expr offset`);
    }
  }

  if (flags.value === 1 || flags.value === 3 || flags.value === 5 || flags.value === 7) {
    // passive/declarative: no active table offset
  }

  if (flags.value === 0 || flags.value === 2) {
    const kindOrCount = readUleb(e);
    e = kindOrCount.next;

    const count = kindOrCount.value;

    console.log(`  TABLE INDEX = ${tableIndex}`);
    console.log(`  OFFSET      = ${hex(offsetValue ?? 0)}`);
    console.log(`  ELEMENTS    = ${count}`);

    const targetStart =
      tableIndex === 0 &&
      offsetValue !== null &&
      TARGET >= offsetValue &&
      TARGET < offsetValue + count
        ? TARGET - offsetValue
        : -1;

    for (let j = 0; j < count; j++) {
      const f = readUleb(e);
      e = f.next;

      if (targetStart === j) {
        console.log("");
        console.log(">>> TARGET TABLE ENTRY FOUND <<<");
        console.log(`  TABLE INDEX = ${TARGET}`);
        console.log(`  SEGMENT     = ${seg}`);
        console.log(`  SEG OFFSET  = ${hex(offsetValue!)}`);
        console.log(`  ELEMENT POS = ${j}`);
        console.log(`  TARGET FUNC = ${f.value}`);
        console.log(`  FUNC INDEX  = ${f.value}`);
        found = true;
      }
    }

    continue;
  }

  if (flags.value === 1 || flags.value === 3) {
    const kind = wasm[e++];
    const count = readUleb(e);
    e = count.next;

    console.log(`  ELEM KIND = ${hex(kind, 2)}`);
    console.log(`  ELEMENTS  = ${count.value}`);

    for (let j = 0; j < count.value; j++) {
      const f = readUleb(e);
      e = f.next;

      if (
        flags.value === 1 &&
        TARGET === j
      ) {
        console.log("");
        console.log(">>> TARGET PASSIVE ELEMENT FOUND <<<");
        console.log(`  ELEMENT POS = ${j}`);
        console.log(`  TARGET FUNC = ${f.value}`);
        found = true;
      }
    }

    continue;
  }

  if (flags.value === 4 || flags.value === 6 || flags.value === 5 || flags.value === 7) {
    const count = readUleb(e);
    e = count.next;

    console.log(`  ELEMENT EXPRESSIONS = ${count.value}`);

    for (let j = 0; j < count.value; j++) {
      const op = wasm[e++];

      let funcIndex: number | null = null;

      if (op === 0xd2) {
        const f = readUleb(e);
        e = f.next;
        funcIndex = f.value;
      } else if (op === 0xd0) {
        const heapType = readSleb(e);
        e = heapType.next;
      } else {
        // Skip conservatively to end of expression.
        while (e < wasm.length && wasm[e++] !== 0x0b) {}
      }

      const end = wasm[e++];

      if (
        (flags.value === 4 || flags.value === 6) &&
        offsetValue !== null &&
        tableIndex === 0 &&
        TARGET === offsetValue + j &&
        funcIndex !== null
      ) {
        console.log("");
        console.log(">>> TARGET TABLE ENTRY FOUND <<<");
        console.log(`  TABLE INDEX = ${TARGET}`);
        console.log(`  SEGMENT     = ${seg}`);
        console.log(`  SEG OFFSET  = ${hex(offsetValue)}`);
        console.log(`  ELEMENT POS = ${j}`);
        console.log(`  TARGET FUNC = ${funcIndex}`);
        found = true;
      }
    }
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`TARGET TABLE INDEX = ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log(`FOUND = ${found}`);

if (!found) {
  console.log("");
  console.log(
    "TARGET ENTRY NOT RESOLVED BY STATIC ELEMENT SEGMENT SCAN"
  );
}

console.log("");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [0x12b4, 0x12b5, 0x12b6, 0x12b7];

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8): string {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(idWanted: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === idWanted) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${idWanted} not found`);
}

console.log("INSPECT TABLE[0x12B4..0x12B7]");

);

const elementSec = findSection(9);

let p = elementSec.start;

const segmentCount = readUleb(p);
p = segmentCount.next;

console.log(`ELEMENT SEGMENT COUNT = ${segmentCount.value}`);

const resolved = new Map<number, number>();

for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount.value; seg++) {
  const flags = readUleb(p);
  p = flags.next;

  // This WASM has one active function element segment.
  if (flags.value !== 0) {
    throw new Error(
      `Unsupported element segment flags=${flags.value} at segment ${seg}`
    );
  }

  const op = wasm[p++];

  if (op !== 0x41) {
    throw new Error(
      `Segment ${seg}: expected i32.const, got ${hex(op, 2)}`
    );
  }

  const off = readSleb(p);
  p = off.next;

  const offset = off.value >>> 0;

  const end = wasm[p++];

  if (end !== 0x0b) {
    throw new Error(`Segment ${seg}: malformed offset expression`);
  }

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  console.log("");
  console.log(`SEGMENT #${seg}`);
  console.log(`OFFSET = ${hex(offset)}`);
  console.log(`COUNT  = ${count.value}`);

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const f = readUleb(p);
p = f.next;

const func = f.value;
const tableIndex = offset + i;

if (TARGETS.includes(tableIndex)) {
  resolved.set(tableIndex, func);

  console.log(
    `${hex(tableIndex)} -> FUNC ${func}`
  );
}
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL RESOLUTION");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const target of TARGETS) {
  const func = resolved.get(target);

  if (func === undefined) {
    console.log(`${hex(target)} -> NOT FOUND`);
  } else {
    console.log(`${hex(target)} -> FUNC ${func}`);
  }
}

  }`
);

FILE: scripts\inspectTable4788Neighborhood.ts

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 4788;
const BEFORE = 12;
const AFTER = 12;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

//
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Sections
// ------------------------------------------------------------
//

const sections: {
    id: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
}[] = [];

let p = 8;

while (p < buf.length) {

    const id = buf[p++];

    const s = readULEB(p);
    const size = s.value;
    p = s.next;

    sections.push({
        id,
        start: p,
        end: p + size
    });

    p += size;
}

function section(id: number) {
    return sections.find(x => x.id === id);
}

    params: number[];
    results: number[];

        throw new Error("Unexpected type form");

    const pc = readULEB(t);
    t = pc.next;

    const params: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++)
        params.push(buf[t++]);

    const rc = readULEB(t);
    t = rc.next;

    const results: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++)
        results.push(buf[t++]);

    types.push({ params, results });
}

function vt(v: number) {
    switch (v) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        case 0x7b: return "v128";
        default: return "0x" + v.toString(16);
    }
}

}

        console.log(

        );
        break;

    const base = off.value;

    if (end !== 0x0b)

    const count = n.value;
    e = n.next;

        const fi = readULEB(e);
        const funcIndex = fi.value;
        e = fi.next;

        table.set(base + i, funcIndex);
    }

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function findSection(id: number) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const sectionId = wasm[p++];
        const s = readULEB(p);
        p = s.next;

        if (sectionId === id) {
            return { start: p, end: p + s.value };
        }

        p += s.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u8(p) {
  return buf[p];
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(pos++);

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = u8(pos++);

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      break;
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function hex(n, w = 8) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function skipInitExpr(pos) {
  const op = u8(pos++);

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const v = readSLEB(pos);
    pos = v.next;

    if (u8(pos++) !== 0x0b) {
      throw new Error("Invalid i32.const init expr");
    }

    return pos;
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Unsupported init expr opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
  );
}

import fs from 'node:fs';

const file =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);
const TARGET_START = 0x183e60;
const TARGET_END = 0x1840b0;

function hex(n, width = 8) {
    return '0x' + n.toString(16).padStart(width, '0');
}

function uleb(s) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (s.p >= wasm.length) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF in ULEB');
        const b = wasm[s.p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) return value >>> 0;
        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error('ULEB too large');
    }
}

function sleb(s) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;

    do {
        if (s.p >= wasm.length) throw new Error('Unexpected EOF in SLEB');
        b = wasm[s.p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;
    } while (b & 0x80);

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) value |= (~0 << shift);
    return value | 0;
}

function sections() {
    const result = [];
    const s = { p: 8 };

    while (s.p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[s.p++];
        const size = uleb(s);
        const start = s.p;
        const end = start + size;

        if (end > wasm.length) throw new Error('Invalid section size');

        result.push({ id, start, end });
        s.p = end;
    }

    return result;
}

function initExpr(s) {
    const op = wasm[s.p++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const value = sleb(s);
        if (wasm[s.p++] !== 0x0b) throw new Error('Invalid i32 init expr');
        return { kind: 'i32', value: value >>> 0 };
    }

    if (op === 0x23) {
        const index = uleb(s);
        if (wasm[s.p++] !== 0x0b) throw new Error('Invalid global init expr');
        return { kind: 'global', index };
    }

    throw new Error(`Unsupported init expr opcode ${hex(op, 2)}`);
}

function parseData(sec) {
    const s = { p: sec.start };
    const count = uleb(s);
    const segments = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const flags = uleb(s);
        let active = false;
        let memoryIndex = 0;
        let expr = null;

        if (flags === 0) {
            active = true;
            expr = initExpr(s);
        } else if (flags === 1) {
            active = false;
        } else if (flags === 2) {
            active = true;
            memoryIndex = uleb(s);
            expr = initExpr(s);
        } else {
            throw new Error(`Unsupported data flags ${flags}`);
        }

        const length = uleb(s);
        const fileOffset = s.p;
        const fileEnd = fileOffset + length;

        if (fileEnd > sec.end) throw new Error('Segment exceeds Data section');

        segments.push({
            index: i,
            active,
            memoryIndex,
            expr,
            start: active && memoryIndex === 0 && expr?.kind === 'i32'
                ? expr.value
                : null,
            length,
            fileOffset,
            fileEnd,
        });

        s.p = fileEnd;
    }

    return segments;
}

const dataSection = sections().find(sec => sec.id === 11);
if (!dataSection) throw new Error('Data section not found');

const segments = parseData(dataSection);
const memory = Buffer.alloc(TARGET_END - TARGET_START, 0);
const covered = Buffer.alloc(TARGET_END - TARGET_START, 0);

for (const seg of segments) {
    if (!seg.active || seg.start === null) continue;

    const segEnd = seg.start + seg.length;
    const overlapStart = Math.max(seg.start, TARGET_START);
    const overlapEnd = Math.min(segEnd, TARGET_END);

    if (overlapStart >= overlapEnd) continue;

    const src = seg.fileOffset + overlapStart - seg.start;
    const dst = overlapStart - TARGET_START;
    const length = overlapEnd - overlapStart;

    wasm.copy(memory, dst, src, src + length);
    covered.fill(1, dst, dst + length);
}

console.log('RECONSTRUCTED INITIAL DATA MEMORY');
console.log('READ ONLY - NO WASM EXECUTION');
console.log(`FILE SIZE: ${wasm.length}`);
console.log(`RANGE: ${hex(TARGET_START)} .. ${hex(TARGET_END)}`);
console.log('NOTE: Uncovered bytes are displayed as zero-initialized memory.');
console.log('They are not proof of their later runtime values.');

for (let address = TARGET_START; address < TARGET_END; address += 16) {
    const offset = address - TARGET_START;
    const bytes = memory.subarray(offset, Math.min(offset + 16, memory.length));
    const marks = covered.subarray(offset, Math.min(offset + 16, covered.length));

    const byteText = [...bytes]
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join(' ');

    const coverage = [...marks]
        .map(b => b ? '#' : '.')
        .join('');

    const ascii = [...bytes]
        .map(b => b >= 0x20 && b <= 0x7e ? String.fromCharCode(b) : '.')
        .join('');

    console.log(`${hex(address)}  ${byteText.padEnd(47)}  ${ascii}  ${coverage}`);
}

console.log('\n32-BIT WORDS AT ALIGNED ADDRESSES');
for (let address = Math.ceil(TARGET_START / 4) * 4;
     address + 4 <= TARGET_END;
     address += 4) {
    const offset = address - TARGET_START;
    const value = memory.readUInt32LE(offset);
    const marks = [...covered.subarray(offset, offset + 4)]
        .map(b => b ? '#' : '.')
        .join('');

    console.log(`${hex(address)}  ${hex(value)}  ${value}  coverage=${marks}`);
}

console.log('\nDATA SEGMENTS NEAR TARGET');
for (const seg of segments) {
    if (seg.start === null) continue;

    const end = seg.start + seg.length;
    if (end <= TARGET_START - 0x100 || seg.start >= TARGET_END + 0x100) continue;

    console.log(
        `SEG ${seg.index}  mem=${hex(seg.start)}..${hex(end)} ` +
        `file=${hex(seg.fileOffset)}..${hex(seg.fileEnd)} ` +
        `length=${seg.length}`
    );
}

console.log('\nDONE - READ ONLY - NO WASM EXECUTION');

    process.cwd(),
    'temp',
    'testnet',
    'tonconnect.json'

const MANIFEST_URL =
    'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ton-org/blueprint/main/tonconnect/manifest.json';

type RuntimeFeature = {
    name?: string;
    maxMessages?: number;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};

type RuntimeDevice = {
    platform?: string;
    appVersion?: string;
    features?: RuntimeFeature[];
};

type RuntimeWallet = {
    name?: string;
    appName?: string;
    device?: RuntimeDevice;
    account?: {
        address?: string;
        chain?: string;
    };
};

function section(title: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('='.repeat(60));
    console.log(title);
    console.log('='.repeat(60));
}

function createStorage() {
    return {
        async setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
            const dir = path.dirname(STORAGE_PATH);

            if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
                fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
            }

            let data: Record<string, string> = {};

            if (fs.existsSync(STORAGE_PATH)) {
                try {
                    data = JSON.parse(
                        fs.readFileSync(STORAGE_PATH, 'utf8')
                    );
                } catch {
                    data = {};
                }
            }

            data[key] = value;

            fs.writeFileSync(
                STORAGE_PATH,
                JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)
            );
        },

        async getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
            if (!fs.existsSync(STORAGE_PATH)) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                const data: Record<string, string> = JSON.parse(
                    fs.readFileSync(STORAGE_PATH, 'utf8')
                );

                return data[key] ?? null;
            } catch {
                return null;
            }
        },

        async removeItem(key: string): Promise<void> {
            if (!fs.existsSync(STORAGE_PATH)) {
                return;
            }

            try {
                const data: Record<string, string> = JSON.parse(
                    fs.readFileSync(STORAGE_PATH, 'utf8')
                );

                delete data[key];

                fs.writeFileSync(
                    STORAGE_PATH,
                    JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)
                );
            } catch {
                // Intentionally ignored.
                // This script is diagnostic/read-only.
            }
        },
    };
}

function normalizeAddress(value: string): string {
    return Address.parse(value).toRawString();
}

function sameAddress(
    connected: string,
    expected: Address
): boolean {
    return normalizeAddress(connected) === expected.toRawString();
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_TYPE = 1;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function valtype(x) {

  const names = {
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64",
    0x7b: "v128",
    0x70: "funcref",
    0x6f: "externref"
  };

  return names[x] || `0x${x.toString(16)}`;
}

function findTypeSection() {

  let p = 8;

  while (p < bytes.length) {

    const id = bytes[p++];

    const len = uleb(p);
    p = len.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + len.value;

    if (id === 1)
      return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("Type section not found");
}

function inspect() {

  const sec = findTypeSection();

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("TYPE INSPECTOR");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`WASM SIZE : ${bytes.length.toLocaleString()}`);
  console.log(`TARGET    : TYPE ${TARGET_TYPE}`);
  console.log(`TYPE COUNT: ${count.value}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  if (TARGET_TYPE >= count.value) {
    throw new Error(
      `Type ${TARGET_TYPE} does not exist`
    );
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const form = bytes[p++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      throw new Error(
        `Unexpected type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at type ${i}`
      );
    }

    const params = uleb(p);
    p = params.next;

    const paramTypes = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < params.value; j++) {
      paramTypes.push(
        valtype(bytes[p++])
      );
    }

    const results = uleb(p);
    p = results.next;

    const resultTypes = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < results.value; j++) {
      resultTypes.push(
        valtype(bytes[p++])
      );
    }

    if (i === TARGET_TYPE) {

      console.log(`TYPE INDEX : ${i}`);
      console.log(
        `PARAM COUNT: ${params.value}`
      );
      console.log(
        `PARAMS     : (${paramTypes.join(", ")})`
      );
      console.log(
        `RESULT CNT : ${results.value}`
      );
      console.log(
        `RESULTS    : (${resultTypes.join(", ")})`
      );

      console.log("");
      console.log("SIGNATURE");
      console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

      console.log(
        `(${paramTypes.join(", ")}) -> (${resultTypes.join(", ")})`
      );

      console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
      console.log("END");
      console.log("============================================================");

      return;
    }
  }

  throw new Error(
    `Type ${TARGET_TYPE} not found`
  );
}

inspect();

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_TYPE = 2;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM TYPE 2 EXACT SIGNATURE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

function u32leb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value,
        next: p,
    };
}

function typeName(t: number) {
    switch (t) {
        case 0x7f:
            return "i32";
        case 0x7e:
            return "i64";
        case 0x7d:
            return "f32";
        case 0x7c:
            return "f64";
        case 0x7b:
            return "v128";
        case 0x70:
            return "funcref";
        case 0x6f:
            return "externref";
        case 0x40:
            return "void";
        default:
            return `0x${t.toString(16)}`;
    }
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

let p = 8;

let typeStart = -1;
let typeEnd = -1;

while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p];

    const sizeInfo = u32leb(p + 1);

    const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sizeInfo.value;

    if (id === 1) {
        typeStart = payloadStart;
        typeEnd = payloadEnd;
        break;
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
}

if (typeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("TYPE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

console.log(
    `TYPE SECTION = ${hex(typeStart)} .. ${hex(typeEnd)}`
);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let q = typeStart;

const countInfo = u32leb(q);
q = countInfo.next;

const count = countInfo.value;

console.log(`TYPE COUNT = ${count}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const form = buf[q++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at TYPE ${i}`
        );
    }

    const paramInfo = u32leb(q);
    q = paramInfo.next;

    const params: string[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < paramInfo.value; j++) {
        params.push(typeName(buf[q++]));
    }

    const resultInfo = u32leb(q);
    q = resultInfo.next;

    const results: string[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < resultInfo.value; j++) {
        results.push(typeName(buf[q++]));
    }

    if (i === TARGET_TYPE) {
        console.log(`TYPE INDEX = ${i}`);
        console.log(`PARAM COUNT = ${params.length}`);
        console.log(
            `PARAMS      = [ ${params.join(", ")} ]`
        );
        console.log(`RESULT COUNT = ${results.length}`);
        console.log(
            `RESULTS     = [ ${results.join(", ")} ]`
        );
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        console.log("KNOWN USERS OF TYPE 2:");
        console.log("  FUNC23  = imported \"a\".\"x\"");
        console.log("  FUNC265 = defined function");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        break;
    }
}

console.log("END");

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;

const TARGET_TYPE = 4;

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { v, p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TYPE-4 CALL_INDIRECT CONTEXT INSPECTOR");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

let hits = 0;

for (let i = CODE_START; i < CODE_END - 2; i++) {

  if (b[i] !== 0x11)
    continue;

  try {

    const typeR = uleb(i + 1);
    const tableR = uleb(typeR.p);

    if (
      typeR.v !== TARGET_TYPE ||
      tableR.v !== 0
    )
      continue;

    hits++;

    console.log(
      `HIT #${hits} @ ${hex(i)}`
    );

    const from = Math.max(CODE_START, i - 80);
    const to = Math.min(CODE_END, tableR.p);

    console.log(
      Array.from(b.slice(from, to))
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ")
    );

    console.log("");
  }
  catch {
    // ignore malformed byte patterns
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TOTAL : ${hits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("END");

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"

const TARGET_TYPE = 4;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

  p += size;
}

FILE: scripts\inspectType7Wrappers.js

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const targets = [3901, 6521, 8952];

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readU32LE(pos) {
  return (
    buf[pos] |
    (buf[pos + 1] << 8) |
    (buf[pos + 2] << 16) |
    (buf[pos + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readString(pos) {
  const r = readULEB(pos);
  const bytes = buf.subarray(r.next, r.next + r.value);
  return {
    value: Buffer.from(bytes).toString("utf8"),
    next: r.next + r.value,
  };
}

function typeName(v) {
  switch (v) {
    case 0x7f: return "i32";
    case 0x7e: return "i64";
    case 0x7d: return "f32";
    case 0x7c: return "f64";
    case 0x70: return "funcref";
    case 0x6f: return "externref";
    default: return "0x" + v.toString(16);
  }
}

let pos = 8;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Sections
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let typeSection = null;
let functionSection = null;
let codeSection = null;

while (pos < buf.length) {
  const id = buf[pos++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
  const size = sizeInfo.value;
  pos = sizeInfo.next;

  const start = pos;
  const end = start + size;

  if (id === 1) typeSection = { start, end };
  if (id === 3) functionSection = { start, end };
  if (id === 10) codeSection = { start, end };

  pos = end;
}

if (!typeSection || !functionSection || !codeSection) {
  throw new Error("Required WASM sections not found.");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// TYPE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const types = [];

{
  let p = typeSection.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  const count = countInfo.value;
  p = countInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const form = buf[p++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      throw new Error(
        `Unexpected function type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at ${p - 1}`
      );
    }

    const paramInfo = readULEB(p);
    const paramCount = paramInfo.value;
    p = paramInfo.next;

    const params = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
      params.push(buf[p++]);
    }

    const resultInfo = readULEB(p);
    const resultCount = resultInfo.value;
    p = resultInfo.next;

    const results = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
      results.push(buf[p++]);
    }

    types.push({ params, results });
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const definedTypes = [];

{
  let p = functionSection.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  const count = countInfo.value;
  p = countInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const t = readULEB(p);
    definedTypes.push(t.value);
    p = t.next;
  }
}

// Imported functions = 83 for this module.
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let codeBodies = [];

{
  let p = codeSection.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  const count = countInfo.value;
  p = countInfo.next;

  for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < count; bodyIndex++) {
    const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
    const bodyStart = bodySizeInfo.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    codeBodies.push({
      bodyIndex,
      start: bodyStart,
      end: bodyEnd,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// HELPERS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function functionType(funcIndex) {
  if (funcIndex < IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS) {
    return null;
  }

  const bodyIndex = funcIndex - IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS;

  if (bodyIndex < 0 || bodyIndex >= definedTypes.length) {
    return null;
  }

  const typeIndex = definedTypes[bodyIndex];

  return {
    typeIndex,
    type: types[typeIndex],
  };
}

function readLocals(body) {
  let p = body.start;

  const localCountInfo = readULEB(p);
  const localDeclCount = localCountInfo.value;
  p = localCountInfo.next;

  const locals = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
    const countInfo = readULEB(p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const valueType = buf[p++];

    locals.push({
      count,
      valueType,
    });
  }

  return {
    localDeclCount,
    locals,
    instructionStart: p,
  };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// OUTPUT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("DEFINED FUNCTIONS :", codeBodies.length);
console.log("TOTAL FUNCTIONS :", IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + codeBodies.length);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (const funcIndex of targets) {

  const locals = readLocals(body);

import fs from "node:fs";

const file = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0, shift = 0, b;
  do {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (b & 0x80);
  return { value, next: pos };
}

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[pos++];
  const size = uleb(pos);
  const payload = size.next;
  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = payload;
    break;
  }
  pos = payload + size.value;
}

if (codeStart < 0) throw new Error("Code section not found");

pos = codeStart;
const count = uleb(pos);
pos = count.next;

const wanted = new Set([9479, 9480]);

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
  const size = uleb(pos);
  const bodyStart = size.next;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + size.value;
  const func = 83 + ordinal;

  if (wanted.has(func)) {
    console.log(`\nFUNC ${func}`);
    console.log(`BODY 0x${bodyStart.toString(16)} .. 0x${bodyEnd.toString(16)}`);
    for (let at = bodyStart; at < bodyEnd; at += 16) {
      const end = Math.min(at + 16, bodyEnd);
      const hex = [...wasm.subarray(at, end)]
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
      console.log(`0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${hex}`);
    }
  }

  pos = bodyEnd;
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const PTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCFe1J8epgixmnGvSWBsB6O7gEABl1BiY8NJkL2pjqv1I6S'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const TARGET_FROM = 99490000000000n;
const TARGET_TO   = 99493000000000n;

function getOpcode(cell: Cell | null | undefined): string {
    if (!cell) return 'NONE';

    const s = cell.beginParse();

    if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
        return 'NO_32BIT_OPCODE';
    }

    return (
        '0x' +
        s.loadUint(32).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
    );
}

function printMessage(label: string, message: any) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(label);

    console.log('MESSAGE TYPE:');
    console.log(message.info.type);

    if (message.info.type === 'internal') {
        console.log('SOURCE:');
        console.log(message.info.src.toString());

        console.log('DESTINATION:');
        console.log(message.info.dest.toString());

        console.log('VALUE:');
        console.log(message.info.value.coins.toString());
    } else {
        console.log('SOURCE:');
        console.log(
            message.info.src
                ? message.info.src.toString()
                : 'NONE'
        );

        console.log('DESTINATION:');
        console.log(
            message.info.dest
                ? message.info.dest.toString()
                : 'NONE'
        );
    }

    console.log('OPCODE:');
    console.log(getOpcode(message.body));

    console.log('BODY BOC:');
    console.log(
        message.body
            .toBoc()
            .toString('base64')
    );
}

    console.log('');
    console.log('USER:');
    console.log(USER.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON WALLET:');
    console.log(PTON_WALLET.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('TARGET LT RANGE:');
    console.log(`${TARGET_FROM} -> ${TARGET_TO}`);

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint:
            'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('Connected to TON Center Testnet.');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Fetching pTON wallet history...');

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(
        PTON_WALLET,
        {
            limit: 20,
            to_lt: TARGET_TO.toString(),
        }
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(`TRANSACTIONS RECEIVED: ${txs.length}`);

    let found = 0;

    for (const tx of txs) {
        const lt = BigInt(tx.lt);

        if (lt < TARGET_FROM || lt > TARGET_TO) {
            continue;
        }

        found++;

        console.log('');
        console.log('==============================================');
        console.log(`MATCH #${found}`);
        console.log('==============================================');

        console.log('');
        console.log('LT:');
        console.log(tx.lt.toString());

        console.log('');
        console.log('TIME:');
        console.log(
            new Date(tx.now * 1000).toISOString()
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('TRANSACTION HASH:');
        console.log(tx.hash().toString('base64'));

        printMessage(
            '--- IN MESSAGE ---',
            tx.inMessage
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            `OUT MESSAGE COUNT: ${tx.outMessagesCount}`
        );

        let index = 0;

        for (const message of tx.outMessages.values()) {
            index++;

            printMessage(
                `--- OUT MESSAGE #${index} ---`,
                message
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================');
    console.log(`MATCHES IN TARGET RANGE: ${found}`);
    console.log('==============================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
}

    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'

async function getJettonWalletAddress(
    provider: NetworkProvider,
    jettonMaster: Address,
    owner: Address
): Promise<Address> {
    const contractProvider = provider.provider(jettonMaster);

    const result = await contractProvider.get('get_wallet_address', [
        {
            type: 'slice',
            cell: beginCell()
                .storeAddress(owner)
                .endCell(),
        },
    ]);

    return result.stack.readAddress();
}

FILE: scripts\inspectWasmImports.mjs
====================================================================================================
import fs from 'node:fs';

const FILE = 'emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';
const TARGETS = new Set([1, 8, 14]);

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);
let pos = 8;
let globalFunctionIndex = 0;

function readU32() {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        if (pos >= wasm.length || shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid ULEB128 at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
        }

        const byte = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            return value >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readName() {
    const length = readU32();

    if (pos + length > wasm.length) {
        throw new Error('Import name exceeds file bounds');
    }

    const value = wasm.toString('utf8', pos, pos + length);
    pos += length;
    return value;
}

function skipLimits() {
    const flags = readU32();
    readU32(); // minimum

    if (flags & 1) {
        readU32(); // maximum
    }

    if (flags & ~7) {
        throw new Error(`Unknown limits flags: ${flags}`);
    }
}

function skipImport(kind) {
    switch (kind) {
        case 0:
            return readU32(); // function type index

        case 1:
            pos++; // reference type
            skipLimits();
            return null;

        case 2:
            skipLimits();
            return null;

        case 3:
            pos++; // value type
            pos++; // mutability
            return null;

        case 4:
            pos++; // tag attribute
            return readU32(); // tag type index

        default:
            throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind}`);
    }
}

function readSectionSize() {
    return readU32();
}

try {
    if (
        wasm[0] !== 0x00 ||
        wasm[1] !== 0x61 ||
        wasm[2] !== 0x73 ||
        wasm[3] !== 0x6d
    ) {
        throw new Error('Invalid WASM magic');
    }

    while (pos < wasm.length) {
        const sectionId = wasm[pos++];
        const sectionSize = readSectionSize();
        const sectionEnd = pos + sectionSize;

        if (sectionEnd > wasm.length) {
            throw new Error('Section exceeds file bounds');
        }

        if (sectionId !== 2) {
            pos = sectionEnd;
            continue;
        }

        const importCount = readU32();

        console.log('WASM IMPORT INSPECTOR');
        console.log('READ ONLY - OFFLINE');
        console.log('========================================');
        console.log(`Import entries: ${importCount}`);

        for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {
            const moduleName = readName();
            const fieldName = readName();
            const kind = wasm[pos++];

            const typeIndex = skipImport(kind);

            if (kind === 0) {
                if (TARGETS.has(globalFunctionIndex)) {
                    console.log(
                        `FUNCTION ${globalFunctionIndex}: ` +
                        `${moduleName}.${fieldName} ` +
                        `(type index ${typeIndex})`
                    );
                }

                globalFunctionIndex++;
            }
        }

        if (pos !== sectionEnd) {
            throw new Error(
                `Import section cursor mismatch: ` +
                `0x${pos.toString(16)} != 0x${sectionEnd.toString(16)}`
            );
        }

        console.log(`Imported functions: ${globalFunctionIndex}`);
        break;
    }

    if (globalFunctionIndex === 0) {
        throw new Error('Import section not found');
    }
} catch (error) {
    console.error('ERROR:', error.message);
    process.exitCode = 1;
}

FILE: scripts\inspectWasmImports.ts

import fs from 'fs';

const WASM = './emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

let p = 8;

function readULEB(): number {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return value >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readString(): string {
    const len = readULEB();

    const s = b.subarray(
        p,
        p + len
    ).toString('utf8');

    p += len;

    return s;
}

console.log('============================================================');
console.log(' WASM IMPORT TABLE');
console.log('============================================================');

while (p < b.length) {

    const sectionId = b[p++];

    const sectionSize = readULEB();

    const sectionStart = p;
    const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId !== 2) {
        p = sectionEnd;
        continue;
    }

    const count = readULEB();

    console.log(`Imports: ${count}`);
    console.log('');

    let funcIndex = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

        const moduleName = readString();
        const fieldName = readString();

        const kind = b[p++];

        let extra = '';

        if (kind === 0) {

            const typeIndex = readULEB();

            extra =
                `type=${typeIndex}`;

            console.log(
                `${funcIndex.toString().padStart(3, ' ')}  ` +
                `FUNC  ` +
                `${moduleName}.${fieldName}  ` +
                extra
            );

            funcIndex++;
        }

        else if (kind === 1) {

            const elementType = b[p++];

            const flags = readULEB();
            const min = readULEB();

            let max = '';

            if (flags & 1) {
                max = String(readULEB());
            }

            extra =
                `table elem=0x${elementType.toString(16)} ` +
                `min=${min}` +
                (max ? ` max=${max}` : '');

            console.log(
                `---  TABLE ${moduleName}.${fieldName} ${extra}`
            );
        }

        else if (kind === 2) {

            const flags = readULEB();
            const min = readULEB();

            let max = '';

            if (flags & 1) {
                max = String(readULEB());
            }

            extra =
                `memory min=${min}` +
                (max ? ` max=${max}` : '');

            console.log(
                `---  MEMORY ${moduleName}.${fieldName} ${extra}`
            );
        }

        else if (kind === 3) {

            const valueType = b[p++];
            const mutable = b[p++];

            console.log(
                `---  GLOBAL ${moduleName}.${fieldName} ` +
                `type=0x${valueType.toString(16)} ` +
                `mutable=${mutable}`
            );
        }
    }

    break;
}

console.log('');
console.log('============================================================');
console.log('DONE');
console.log('============================================================');

FILE: scripts\inspectWasmKa.ts

import fs from 'fs';

const WASM = './emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
let p = 8; // skip WASM magic + version

function readU32(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const byte = b[p++];
        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readBytes(n: number): Buffer {
    const out = b.subarray(p, p + n);
    p += n;
    return out;
}

function readName(): string {
    const len = readU32();
    return readBytes(len).toString('utf8');
}

function valType(byte: number): string {
    switch (byte) {
        case 0x7f: return 'i32';
        case 0x7e: return 'i64';
        case 0x7d: return 'f32';
        case 0x7c: return 'f64';
        case 0x70: return 'funcref';
        case 0x6f: return 'externref';
        default: return `0x${byte.toString(16)}`;
    }
}

const types: { params: string[]; results: string[] }[] = [];
const importedFuncTypeIndices: number[] = [];
const definedFuncTypeIndices: number[] = [];
const exports: { name: string; kind: number; index: number }[] = [];

while (p < b.length) {
    const sectionId = b[p++];
    const sectionSize = readU32();

    const sectionStart = p;
    const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

    switch (sectionId) {
        case 1: {
            // Type section
            const count = readU32();

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const form = b[p++];

                if (form !== 0x60) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Unsupported type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at type ${i}`
                    );
                }

                const paramCount = readU32();
                const params: string[] = [];

                for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
                    params.push(valType(b[p++]));
                }

                const resultCount = readU32();
                const results: string[] = [];

                for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
                    results.push(valType(b[p++]));
                }

                types.push({ params, results });
            }

            break;
        }

        case 2: {
            // Import section
            const count = readU32();

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                readName(); // module
                readName(); // name

                const kind = b[p++];

                if (kind === 0) {
                    const typeIndex = readU32();
                    importedFuncTypeIndices.push(typeIndex);
                } else if (kind === 1) {
                    p++; // table element type
                    const flags = readU32();
                    if (flags & 1) readU32();
                    readU32();
                } else if (kind === 2) {
                    const flags = readU32();
                    readU32();
                    if (flags & 1) readU32();
                } else if (kind === 3) {
                    p += 2;
                }
            }

            break;
        }

        case 3: {
            // Function section
            const count = readU32();

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                definedFuncTypeIndices.push(readU32());
            }

            break;
        }

        case 7: {
            // Export section
            const count = readU32();

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const name = readName();
                const kind = b[p++];
                const index = readU32();

                exports.push({ name, kind, index });
            }

            break;
        }
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
}

const ka = exports.find(x => x.name === 'Ka');

if (!ka) {
    throw new Error('Export Ka not found');
}

console.log('============================================================');
console.log(' WASM EXPORT ABI INSPECTOR');
console.log('============================================================');

console.log(`WASM: ${WASM}`);
console.log(`Size: ${b.length} bytes`);

console.log('');
console.log('=== Ka EXPORT ===');
console.log(`Name          : ${ka.name}`);
console.log(`Kind          : ${ka.kind} (0=function)`);
console.log(`Function index: ${ka.index}`);

const importedCount = importedFuncTypeIndices.length;

let typeIndex: number | undefined;

if (ka.index < importedCount) {
    typeIndex = importedFuncTypeIndices[ka.index];
    console.log(`Function kind : IMPORTED`);
} else {
    const definedIndex = ka.index - importedCount;
    typeIndex = definedFuncTypeIndices[definedIndex];

    console.log(`Function kind : DEFINED`);
    console.log(`Defined index : ${definedIndex}`);
}

console.log(`Type index    : ${typeIndex}`);

if (typeIndex === undefined || !types[typeIndex]) {
    throw new Error(`Type ${typeIndex} not found`);
}

const type = types[typeIndex];

console.log('');
console.log('=== Ka SIGNATURE ===');
console.log(`Parameters (${type.params.length}):`);

type.params.forEach((x, i) => {
    console.log(`  arg${i}: ${x}`);
});

console.log(`Results (${type.results.length}):`);

type.results.forEach((x, i) => {
    console.log(`  result${i}: ${x}`);
});

console.log('');
console.log('=== SUMMARY ===');
console.log(
    `Ka(${type.params.join(', ')}) -> (${type.results.join(', ')})`
);

import fs from 'fs';

const WASM = './emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';
const TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX = 5456;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
let p = 8;

function readU32(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const byte = b[p++];

        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readBytes(n: number): Buffer {
    const out = b.subarray(p, p + n);
    p += n;
    return out;
}

function hex(data: Buffer): string {
    return Array.from(data)
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
        .join(' ');
}

let codeSectionFound = false;

while (p < b.length) {
    const sectionId = b[p++];
    const sectionSize = readU32();

    const sectionStart = p;
    const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeSectionFound = true;

        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log(' WASM CODE SECTION INSPECTOR');
        console.log('============================================================');

        console.log(`Code section offset : ${sectionStart}`);
        console.log(`Code section size   : ${sectionSize}`);

        const functionCount = readU32();

        console.log(`Defined functions   : ${functionCount}`);
        console.log(`Target defined idx  : ${TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX}`);

        if (TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX >= functionCount) {
            throw new Error(
                `Target ${TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX} >= function count ${functionCount}`
            );
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < functionCount; i++) {
            const bodySize = readU32();
            const bodyStart = p;

            if (i === TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX) {
                const body = readBytes(bodySize);

                console.log('');
                console.log('=== TARGET FUNCTION ===');
                console.log(`Defined index : ${i}`);
                console.log(`Body offset   : ${bodyStart}`);
                console.log(`Body size     : ${bodySize} bytes`);

                console.log('');
                console.log('=== FIRST 256 BYTES ===');

                const first = body.subarray(
                    0,
                    Math.min(256, body.length)
                );

                console.log(hex(first));

                console.log('');
                console.log('=== LAST 32 BYTES ===');

                const last = body.subarray(
                    Math.max(0, body.length - 32)
                );

                console.log(hex(last));

                console.log('');
                console.log('=== DONE ===');

                process.exit(0);
            }

            p += bodySize;
        }

        throw new Error('Target function body was not found');
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
}

if (!codeSectionFound) {
    throw new Error('WASM Code section not found');
}

const TARGETS = [
    0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 12, 18, 54, 65, 82,

        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {

        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readName(): string {

}

function typeName(v: number): string {
    switch (v) {
        case 0x7f: return 'i32';
        case 0x7e: return 'i64';
        case 0x7d: return 'f32';
        case 0x7c: return 'f64';
        case 0x70: return 'funcref';
        case 0x6f: return 'externref';
        default: return `0x${v.toString(16)}`;
    }
