const types: {
    params: string[];
    results: string[];
}[] = [];

const importedFuncTypes: number[] = [];
const definedFuncTypes: number[] = [];

while (p < b.length) {
    const sectionId = b[p++];
    const sectionSize = readU32();

    const sectionStart = p;
    const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 1) {
        const count = readU32();

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const form = b[p++];

            if (form !== 0x60) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unsupported type form: 0x${form.toString(16)}`
                );
            }

            const paramCount = readU32();
            const params: string[] = [];

            for (let j = 0; j < paramCount; j++) {
                params.push(typeName(b[p++]));
            }

            const resultCount = readU32();
            const results: string[] = [];

            for (let j = 0; j < resultCount; j++) {
                results.push(typeName(b[p++]));
            }

            types.push({ params, results });
        }
    }

    if (sectionId === 2) {
        const count = readU32();

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            readName();
            readName();

            const kind = b[p++];

            if (kind === 0) {
                importedFuncTypes.push(readU32());
            } else if (kind === 1) {
                p++;
                const flags = readU32();
                readU32();
                if (flags & 1) readU32();
            } else if (kind === 2) {
                const flags = readU32();
                readU32();
                if (flags & 1) readU32();
            } else if (kind === 3) {
                p += 2;
            }
        }
    }

    if (sectionId === 3) {
        const count = readU32();

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            definedFuncTypes.push(readU32());
        }
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
}

console.log('============================================================');
console.log(' WASM Ka TARGET SIGNATURES');
console.log('============================================================');

console.log(`Imported functions : ${importedFuncTypes.length}`);
console.log(`Defined functions  : ${definedFuncTypes.length}`);

console.log('');

for (const target of TARGETS) {

    let typeIndex: number;
    let kind: string;

    if (target < importedFuncTypes.length) {
        typeIndex = importedFuncTypes[target];
        kind = `IMPORT #${target}`;
    } else {
        const definedIndex =
            target - importedFuncTypes.length;

        if (definedIndex >= definedFuncTypes.length) {
            console.log(
                `target=${target} INVALID`
            );
            continue;
        }

        typeIndex = definedFuncTypes[definedIndex];
        kind = `DEFINED #${definedIndex}`;
    }

    const type = types[typeIndex];

    if (!type) {
        console.log(
            `target=${target} ${kind} TYPE=${typeIndex} NOT_FOUND`
        );
        continue;
    }

    console.log(
        `target=${target.toString().padStart(4, ' ')}  ` +
        `${kind.padEnd(14, ' ')}  ` +
        `type=${typeIndex.toString().padStart(3, ' ')}  ` +
        `(${type.params.join(', ')}) -> (${type.results.join(', ')})`
    );
}

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const WASM_PATH = path.resolve("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 0x36cc7;
const RADIUS = 96;

function readU32(buf: Buffer, state: { p: number }): number {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (state.p < buf.length && shift < 35) {
        const b = buf[state.p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return value >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error(`Invalid ULEB at ${hex(state.p)}`);
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {
    const sections = new Map<number, { start: number; end: number }>();
    const state = { p: 8 };

    while (state.p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[state.p++];
        const size = readU32(buf, state);
        const start = state.p;
        const end = start + size;

        if (end > buf.length) {
            throw new Error(`Section ${id} exceeds file bounds`);
        }

        sections.set(id, { start, end });
        state.p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function readName(buf: Buffer, state: { p: number }): string {
    const len = readU32(buf, state);
    const end = state.p + len;

    if (end > buf.length) {
        throw new Error("Invalid import name");
    }

    const result = buf.toString("utf8", state.p, end);
    state.p = end;
    return result;
}

function countImportedFunctions(
    buf: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; end: number }
): number {
    const state = { p: sec.start };
    const count = readU32(buf, state);
    let functions = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        readName(buf, state);
        readName(buf, state);

        const kind = buf[state.p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            readU32(buf, state);
            functions++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
            state.p++; // reference type
            const flags = readU32(buf, state);
            readU32(buf, state);

            if (flags & 1) readU32(buf, state);
        } else if (kind === 2) {
            const flags = readU32(buf, state);
            readU32(buf, state);

            if (flags & 1) readU32(buf, state);
        } else if (kind === 3) {
            state.p += 2;
        } else if (kind === 4) {
            readU32(buf, state);
            readU32(buf, state);
        } else {
            throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind}`);
        }

        if (state.p > sec.end) {
            throw new Error("Import section overrun");
        }
    }

    return functions;
}

function main() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(WASM_PATH)) {
        throw new Error(`WASM file not found: ${WASM_PATH}`);
    }

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

    if (buf.toString("hex", 0, 4) !== "0061736d") {
        throw new Error("Invalid WASM magic");
    }

    console.log("WASM RAW OFFSET INSPECTOR");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`FILE SIZE = ${buf.length}`);
    console.log(`TARGET    = ${hex(TARGET)}`);

    const sections = parseSections(buf);
    const importSec = sections.get(2);
    const codeSec = sections.get(10);

    if (!importSec || !codeSec) {
        throw new Error("Import or code section not found");
    }

    const importedFunctions = countImportedFunctions(buf, importSec);

    console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${importedFunctions}`);
    console.log(`CODE SECTION       = ${hex(codeSec.start)}..${hex(codeSec.end)}`);

    const state = { p: codeSec.start };
    const functionCount = readU32(buf, state);

    console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS  = ${functionCount}`);
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    let containing: {
        ordinal: number;
        globalFunc: number;
        sizeField: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
    } | null = null;

    let nearestBefore: {
        ordinal: number;
        globalFunc: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
    } | null = null;

    let nearestAfter: {
        ordinal: number;
        globalFunc: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
    } | null = null;

    for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < functionCount; ordinal++) {
        const sizeField = state.p;
        const size = readU32(buf, state);
        const bodyStart = state.p;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + size;

        if (bodyEnd > codeSec.end) {
            throw new Error(
                `Body ${ordinal} exceeds code section at ${hex(bodyStart)}`
            );
        }

        const item = {
            ordinal,
            globalFunc: importedFunctions + ordinal,
            sizeField,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd
        };

        if (TARGET >= bodyStart && TARGET < bodyEnd) {
            containing = item;
        }

        if (bodyEnd <= TARGET) {
            if (!nearestBefore || bodyEnd > nearestBefore.bodyEnd) {
                nearestBefore = item;
            }
        }

        if (bodyStart > TARGET) {
            if (!nearestAfter || bodyStart < nearestAfter.bodyStart) {
                nearestAfter = item;
            }
        }

        state.p = bodyEnd;
    }

    if (state.p !== codeSec.end) {
        console.log(
            `WARNING: code parser ended at ${hex(state.p)}, expected ${hex(codeSec.end)}`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("TARGET FUNCTION MAPPING");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    if (containing) {
        console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC = ${containing.globalFunc}`);
        console.log(`CODE ORDINAL = ${containing.ordinal}`);
        console.log(`SIZE FIELD = ${hex(containing.sizeField)}`);
        console.log(`BODY START = ${hex(containing.bodyStart)}`);
        console.log(`BODY END   = ${hex(containing.bodyEnd)}`);
        console.log(`BODY SIZE  = ${containing.bodyEnd - containing.bodyStart}`);
    } else {
        console.log("TARGET is not inside any parsed function body.");
    }

    if (nearestBefore) {
        console.log("");
        console.log("NEAREST PREVIOUS FUNCTION");
        console.log(`FUNC ${nearestBefore.globalFunc}`);
        console.log(`${hex(nearestBefore.bodyStart)}..${hex(nearestBefore.bodyEnd)}`);
    }

    if (nearestAfter) {
        console.log("");
        console.log("NEAREST NEXT FUNCTION");
        console.log(`FUNC ${nearestAfter.globalFunc}`);
        console.log(`${hex(nearestAfter.bodyStart)}..${hex(nearestAfter.bodyEnd)}`);
    }

    const from = Math.max(0, TARGET - RADIUS);
    const to = Math.min(buf.length, TARGET + RADIUS + 1);

    console.log("");
    console.log("RAW BYTES AROUND TARGET");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    for (let offset = from; offset < to; offset += 16) {
        const end = Math.min(offset + 16, to);
        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let p = offset; p < end; p++) {
            bytes.push(buf[p].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
        }

        console.log(`${hex(offset)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`);
    }

    if (containing) {
        console.log("");
        console.log("RAW FUNCTION BODY");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        const start = containing.bodyStart;
        const end = containing.bodyEnd;
        const windowStart = Math.max(start, TARGET - RADIUS);
        const windowEnd = Math.min(end, TARGET + RADIUS + 1);

        console.log(`WINDOW = ${hex(windowStart)}..${hex(windowEnd)}`);

        for (let offset = windowStart; offset < windowEnd; offset += 16) {
            const lineEnd = Math.min(offset + 16, windowEnd);
            const bytes: string[] = [];

            for (let p = offset; p < lineEnd; p++) {
                bytes.push(buf[p].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
            }

            console.log(`${hex(offset)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`);
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("END - NO WASM EXECUTION");
}

main();

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(p: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];
        v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

        if (!(x & 0x80))
            return { value: v, next: p };

        s += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");

while (p < b.length) {

    const end = p + size;

    console.log(

        " @ " + hex(start) +
        " SIZE=" + size

    if (id === 4) {
        console.log("");

        const q = uleb(p);
        const count = q.value;
        p = q.next;

        console.log("TABLE COUNT = " + count);

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const elemType = b[p++];

            const flags = b[p++];

            const min = uleb(p);
            p = min.next;

            let max: number | null = null;

            if (flags & 0x01) {
                const m = uleb(p);
                max = m.value;
                p = m.next;
            }

            console.log("");
            console.log("TABLE #" + i);
            console.log("  ELEM TYPE = 0x" + elemType.toString(16));
            console.log("  FLAGS     = 0x" + flags.toString(16));
            console.log("  MIN       = " + min.value);
            console.log("  MAX       = " + (max === null ? "none" : max));
        }
    }

    if (id === 9) {
        console.log("");
        console.log("**************** ELEMENT SECTION ****************");

        const q = uleb(p);
        const count = q.value;
        p = q.next;

        console.log("ELEMENT SEGMENT COUNT = " + count);

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            console.log("");
            console.log("ELEMENT SEGMENT #" + i);

            const flags = uleb(p);
            p = flags.next;

            console.log("  FLAGS = " + hex(flags.value));

            // Decode common active-table forms.
            if (flags.value === 0) {
                console.log("  MODE = active table 0");

                console.log("  OFFSET EXPR:");

                const opcode = b[p++];
                console.log(
                    "    opcode = " + hex(opcode)
                );

                if (opcode === 0x41) {
                    const off = uleb(p);
                    p = off.next;

                    console.log(
                        "    i32.const = " + hex(off.value)
                    );
                }

                const endOpcode = b[p++];
                console.log(
                    "    end = " + hex(endOpcode)
                );

                const n = uleb(p);
                const funcCount = n.value;
                p = n.next;

                console.log(
                    "  FUNCTION COUNT = " + funcCount
                );

                const show = Math.min(funcCount, 20);

                for (let j = 0; j < funcCount; j++) {
                    const f = uleb(p);
                    p = f.next;

                    if (j < show) {
                        console.log(
                            "    [" + j + "] = FUNC " +
                            f.value
                        );
                    }
                }

                if (funcCount > show)
                    console.log(
                        "    ... " +
                        (funcCount - show) +
                        " more"
                    );
            }
            else {
                console.log(
                    "  Non-zero element flags; raw parsing deferred."
                );
            }
        }
    }

    p = end;
    section++;

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

function hex8(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 87 EXACT SSA -> FUNCTION 122 v2");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log(" RAW SSA INSTANTIATION");
console.log(" NO APPROXIMATE FORMULAS");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log();

type Expr =
  | { k: "sym"; v: string }
  | { k: "const"; v: bigint }
  | { k: "bin"; op: string; a: Expr; b: Expr };

function sym(v: string): Expr {
  return { k: "sym", v };
}

function cnst(v: bigint): Expr {
  return { k: "const", v };
}

function bin(op: string, a: Expr, b: Expr): Expr {
  return { k: "bin", op, a, b };
}

function render(x: Expr): string {
  if (x.k === "sym") return x.v;
  if (x.k === "const") return `i64(${x.v})`;

  return `(${render(x.a)} ${x.op} ${render(x.b)})`;
}

/*
 * These expressions are NOT manually derived.
 * They are the exact SSA expressions produced by
 * decodeFunction87ExactSSA.ts.
 */

const MASK = cnst(4294967295n);
const SH32 = cnst(32n);

/*
 * Function 87 initial parameters:
 *
 * local0 = destination
 * local1 = A
 * local2 = 0
 * local3 = B
 * local4 = 0
 *
 * local5 is an SSA temporary.
 */

function instantiate(
  destination: string,
  A: Expr,
  B: Expr
) {
  const L0_0 = sym(destination);
  const L1_0 = A;
  const L2_0 = cnst(0n);
  const L3_0 = B;
  const L4_0 = cnst(0n);

  /*
   * Exact SSA:
   *
   * L2_1 = L3_0 >>u 32
   * L4_1 = L1_0 >>u 32
   * L3_1 = L3_0 & 0xffffffff
   * L1_1 = L1_0 & 0xffffffff
   * L5_1 = L3_1 * L1_1
   */

  const L2_1 =
    bin(
      "i64.shr_u",
      L3_0,
      SH32
    );

  const L4_1 =
    bin(
      "i64.shr_u",
      L1_0,
      SH32
    );

  const L3_1 =
    bin(
      "i64.and",
      L3_0,
      MASK
    );

  const L1_1 =
    bin(
      "i64.and",
      L1_0,
      MASK
    );

  const L5_1 =
    bin(
      "i64.mul",
      L3_1,
      L1_1
    );

  /*
   * L3_2 =
   *
   * (L5_1 >>u 32)
   * +
   * (L3_1 * L4_1)
   */

  const L3_2 =
    bin(
      "i64.add",
      bin(
        "i64.shr_u",
        L5_1,
        SH32
      ),
      bin(
        "i64.mul",
        L3_1,
        L4_1
      )
    );

  /*
   * L1_2 =
   *
   * (L1_1 * L2_1)
   * +
   * ((L3_2 & 0xffffffff))
   */

  const L1_2 =
    bin(
      "i64.add",
      bin(
        "i64.mul",
        L1_1,
        L2_1
      ),
      bin(
        "i64.and",
        L3_2,
        MASK
      )
    );

  /*
   * STORE #1
   *
   * destination + 8
   *
   * Exact stack expression:
   *
   * (((L1_0 * L4_0)
   *   + (L2_0 * L3_0))
   *   + (L2_1 * L4_1))
   *   + (L3_2 >> 32)
   *   + (L1_2 >> 32)
   */

  const storeHigh =
    bin(
      "i64.add",
      bin(
        "i64.add",
        bin(
          "i64.add",
          bin(
            "i64.mul",
            L1_0,
            L4_0
          ),
          bin(
            "i64.mul",
            L2_0,
            L3_0
          )
        ),
        bin(
          "i64.mul",
          L2_1,
          L4_1
        )
      ),
      bin(
        "i64.add",
        bin(
          "i64.shr_u",
          L3_2,
          SH32
        ),
        bin(
          "i64.shr_u",
          L1_2,
          SH32
        )
      )
    );

  /*
   * STORE #2
   *
   * destination + 0
   *
   * Exact expression:
   *
   * (L5_1 & 0xffffffff)
   * |
   * ((L1_2 & 0xffffffff) << 32)
   */

  const storeLow =
    bin(
      "i64.or",
      bin(
        "i64.and",
        L5_1,
        MASK
      ),
      bin(
        "i64.shl",
        bin(
          "i64.and",
          L1_2,
          MASK
        ),
        SH32
      )
    );

  return {
    destination: L0_0,
    low: storeLow,
    high: storeHigh,
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const IMPORTS = 83;
const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, end: pos };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function findBodies() {
  let p = 8;
  const bodies = [];

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.end;
    const end = p + r.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      const c = uleb(p);
      let q = c.end;

      for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const z = uleb(q);
        q = z.end;

        bodies.push({
          start: q,
          end: q + z.value
        });

        q += z.value;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = findBodies();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("ALL S1 READERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET :", hex(TARGET));
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let total = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {

  const func = IMPORTS + i;
  const body = bodies[i];

  for (let p = body.start; p < body.end - 4; p++) {

    if (
      b[p] === 0x41 &&
      b[p+1] === 0xcc &&
      b[p+2] === 0xa6 &&
      b[p+3] === 0xe5 &&
      b[p+4] === 0x00
    ) {

      console.log(
        `FUNC ${func}  CONST @ ${hex(p)}`
      );

      total++;
    }
  }
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("TOTAL S1 READERS :", total);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("============================================================");

function fmtTon(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;
    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0');

    return `${whole}.${frac}`;
}

function fmtRooster(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;
    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return frac ? `${whole}.${frac}` : `${whole}`;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 0x004af36b;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("LOCATE RAW 4275 DATA SEGMENT");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log("TARGET    :", "0x" + TARGET.toString(16));
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let start = pos;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: result >>> 0,
        next: pos,
        bytes: pos - start
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    byte = buf[pos++];

    result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
      }

      return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }
  }

  throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function readString(pos) {
  const r = readULEB(pos);
  const len = r.value;
  const start = r.next;
  const end = start + len;

  return {
    value: buf.subarray(start, end).toString("utf8"),
    next: end
  };
}

function sectionName(id) {
  return {
    0: "CUSTOM",
    1: "TYPE",
    2: "IMPORT",
    3: "FUNCTION",
    4: "TABLE",
    5: "MEMORY",
    6: "GLOBAL",
    7: "EXPORT",
    8: "START",
    9: "ELEMENT",
    10: "CODE",
    11: "DATA",
    12: "DATACOUNT"
  }[id] || ("SECTION_" + id);
}

let p = 8;
let dataSectionFound = false;

while (p < buf.length) {

  const sectionStart = p;

  const id = buf[p++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const payloadStart = p;
  const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

  console.log(
    "SECTION",
    id,
    sectionName(id),
    "START",
    "0x" + sectionStart.toString(16),
    "PAYLOAD",
    "0x" + payloadStart.toString(16),
    "..",
    "0x" + payloadEnd.toString(16)
  );

  if (id === 11) {

    dataSectionFound = true;

    let q = payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(q);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    q = countInfo.next;

    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log("DATA SEGMENT COUNT :", count);

    for (let seg = 0; seg < count; seg++) {

      const segStart = q;

      const flagInfo = readULEB(q);
      const flags = flagInfo.value;
      q = flagInfo.next;

      let memoryIndex = 0;
      let offset = null;

      if (flags === 0) {

        // active segment, memory 0
        if (buf[q] !== 0x41) {
          throw new Error(
            `Unexpected offset opcode at 0x${q.toString(16)}`
          );
        }

        q++;

        const off = readSLEB(q);
        offset = off.value;
        q = off.next;

        if (buf[q++] !== 0x0b) {
          throw new Error("Missing end opcode");
        }

      } else if (flags === 2) {

        const memInfo = readULEB(q);
        memoryIndex = memInfo.value;
        q = memInfo.next;

        if (buf[q] !== 0x41) {
          throw new Error(
            `Unexpected offset opcode at 0x${q.toString(16)}`
          );
        }

        q++;

        const off = readSLEB(q);
        offset = off.value;
        q = off.next;

        if (buf[q++] !== 0x0b) {
          throw new Error("Missing end opcode");
        }

      } else if (flags === 1 || flags === 3) {

        // passive / declarative segment
        const lenInfo = readULEB(q);
        const len = lenInfo.value;
        q = lenInfo.next;

        q += len;

        continue;

      } else {

        console.log(
          "UNKNOWN DATA FLAGS:",
          flags,
          "at",
          "0x" + segStart.toString(16)
        );

        break;
      }

      const lenInfo = readULEB(q);
      const dataLen = lenInfo.value;
      q = lenInfo.next;

      const dataStart = q;
      const dataEnd = dataStart + dataLen;

      const targetInSegment =
        offset !== null &&
        TARGET >= offset &&
        TARGET < offset + dataLen;

      if (targetInSegment) {

        const relative = TARGET - offset;

        console.log("");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log("TARGET DATA SEGMENT FOUND");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log("SEGMENT       :", seg);
        console.log("SEGMENT START :", "0x" + segStart.toString(16));
        console.log("FLAGS         :", flags);
        console.log("MEMORY INDEX  :", memoryIndex);
        console.log("MEMORY OFFSET :", "0x" + offset.toString(16));
        console.log("DATA LENGTH   :", dataLen);
        console.log("DATA START    :", "0x" + dataStart.toString(16));
        console.log("DATA END      :", "0x" + dataEnd.toString(16));
        console.log("TARGET        :", "0x" + TARGET.toString(16));
        console.log("RELATIVE      :", "0x" + relative.toString(16));

        const from = Math.max(dataStart, TARGET - 32);

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

// IMPORTANT:
// This is FILE OFFSET, not linear-memory address.
const TARGET_FILE_OFFSET = 0x004af36b;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("LOCATE FILE OFFSET 0x4AF36B INSIDE DATA SEGMENTS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log(
  "TARGET FILE OFFSET :",
  "0x" + TARGET_FILE_OFFSET.toString(16)
);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function readSLEB32(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result -= Math.pow(2, shift);
      }

      return { value: result, next: pos };
    }
  }

  throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function readOffsetExpr(pos) {
  const opcode = buf[pos++];

  if (opcode !== 0x41) {
    throw new Error(
      "Expected i32.const (0x41), got 0x" +
      opcode.toString(16) +
      " at 0x" +
      (pos - 1).toString(16)
    );
  }

  const v = readSLEB32(pos);
  pos = v.next;

  if (buf[pos++] !== 0x0b) {
    throw new Error("Expected end opcode 0x0B");
  }

  return {
    value: v.value,
    next: pos
  };
}

function sectionName(id) {
  const names = {
    0: "CUSTOM",
    1: "TYPE",
    2: "IMPORT",
    3: "FUNCTION",
    4: "TABLE",
    5: "MEMORY",
    6: "GLOBAL",
    7: "EXPORT",
    8: "START",
    9: "ELEMENT",
    10: "CODE",
    11: "DATA",
    12: "DATACOUNT"
  };

  return names[id] || ("SECTION_" + id);
}

let p = 8;
let dataFound = false;

while (p < buf.length) {

  const sectionFileStart = p;

  const sectionId = buf[p++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const payloadStart = p;
  const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

  if (sectionId !== 11) {
    p = payloadEnd;
    continue;
  }

  dataFound = true;

  console.log("DATA SECTION");
  console.log(
    "FILE RANGE :",
    "0x" + payloadStart.toString(16),
    "..",
    "0x" + payloadEnd.toString(16)
  );

  let q = payloadStart;

  const countInfo = readULEB(q);
  const segmentCount = countInfo.value;
  q = countInfo.next;

  console.log("SEGMENT COUNT :", segmentCount);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount; seg++) {

    const segmentStart = q;

    const flagsInfo = readULEB(q);
    const flags = flagsInfo.value;
    q = flagsInfo.next;

    let memoryIndex = null;
    let memoryOffset = null;

    /*
      flags:
        0 = active, memory 0, offset expr
        1 = passive
        2 = active, explicit memory index + offset expr
    */

    if (flags === 0) {

      const off = readOffsetExpr(q);
      memoryOffset = off.value;
      q = off.next;

    } else if (flags === 1) {

      // Passive segment: no memory offset expression.

    } else if (flags === 2) {

      const mem = readULEB(q);
      memoryIndex = mem.value;
      q = mem.next;

      const off = readOffsetExpr(q);
      memoryOffset = off.value;
      q = off.next;

    } else {

      console.log(
        "UNKNOWN FLAGS",
        flags,
        "SEGMENT",
        seg,
        "AT FILE OFFSET",
        "0x" + segmentStart.toString(16)
      );

      break;
    }

    const lenInfo = readULEB(q);
    const dataLength = lenInfo.value;
    q = lenInfo.next;

    const dataStart = q;
    const dataEnd = dataStart + dataLength;

    const contains =
      TARGET_FILE_OFFSET >= dataStart &&
      TARGET_FILE_OFFSET < dataEnd;

    if (contains) {

      const relativeFileOffset =

function ulebAt(pos: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= wasm.length) {
            throw new Error("ULEB outside WASM");
        }

        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function sectionName(id: number): string {
    switch (id) {
        case 0: return "custom";
        case 1: return "type";
        case 2: return "import";
        case 3: return "function";
        case 4: return "table";
        case 5: return "memory";
        case 6: return "global";
        case 7: return "export";
        case 8: return "start";
        case 9: return "element";
        case 10: return "code";
        case 11: return "data";
        case 12: return "data-count";
        default: return `section-${id}`;
    }
}

import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROOT =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\node_modules\\@tact-lang\\opcode\\dist';

const PATTERNS = [
    'decodeInstruction',
    'Bad operand',
    'parseInstructions',
    'PUSHCONT',
    'operand c',
];

function walk(dir: string): string[] {
    const result: string[] = [];

    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
        return result;
    }

    for (const name of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
        const full = path.join(dir, name);
        const stat = fs.statSync(full);

        if (stat.isDirectory()) {
            result.push(...walk(full));
        } else if (name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.js')) {
            result.push(full);
        }
    }

    return result;
}

function inspectFile(file: string) {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/);

    let found = false;

    for (const pattern of PATTERNS) {
        for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            if (!lines[i].toLowerCase().includes(pattern.toLowerCase())) {
                continue;
            }

            if (!found) {
                console.log();
                console.log('============================================================');
                console.log(`FILE: ${file}`);
                console.log('============================================================');
                found = true;
            }

            console.log();
            console.log(`PATTERN: ${pattern}`);

            const start = Math.max(0, i - 6);
            const end = Math.min(lines.length, i + 16);

            console.log(`--- lines ${start + 1}-${end} ---`);

            for (let j = start; j < end; j++) {
                console.log(
                    `${String(j + 1).padStart(5, ' ')} | ${lines[j]}`
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 DECODER SOURCE LOCATOR');
    console.log(' LOCAL NODE_MODULES ONLY');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================================================');

    console.log();
    console.log(`Search root: ${ROOT}`);
    console.log();

    const files = walk(ROOT);

    console.log(`JavaScript files found: ${files.length}`);
    console.log();

    for (const file of files) {
        inspectFile(file);
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log(' SEARCH COMPLETE');
    console.log('========================================================================');
}

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

import { readFileSync } from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const CANDIDATE_START = 4057;
const CANDIDATE_END = 4188;

function readU32LE(buf: Buffer, off: number): number {
  return (
    (buf[off] |
      (buf[off + 1] << 8) |
      (buf[off + 2] << 16) |
      (buf[off + 3] << 24)) >>>
    0
  );
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, off: number): {
  value: number;
  next: number;
} {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = off;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error(`ULEB too large at 0x${off.toString(16)}`);
    }
  }

  throw new Error("Unexpected EOF in ULEB");
}

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

type FuncInfo = {
  index: number;
  body: number;
  bodySize: number;
  codeStart: number;
  codeEnd: number;
};

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {
  let p = 8;

  let functionPayload = -1;
  let functionSize = 0;

  let codePayload = -1;
  let codeSize = 0;

  let importedFunctions = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p++];

    const s = readULEB(buf, p);
    const size = s.value;
    p = s.next;

    const payload = p;

    if (id === 2) {
      let q = payload;

      const c = readULEB(buf, q);
      const importCount = c.value;
      q = c.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {
        const moduleLen = readULEB(buf, q);
        q = moduleLen.next + moduleLen.value;

        const nameLen = readULEB(buf, q);
        q = nameLen.next + nameLen.value;

        const kind = buf[q++];

        if (kind === 0) {
          importedFunctions++;
          const typeIndex = readULEB(buf, q);
          q = typeIndex.next;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
          q += 4;
        } else if (kind === 2) {
          q += 4;
        } else if (kind === 3) {
          q += 2;
        }
      }
    }

    if (id === 3) {
      functionPayload = payload;
      functionSize = size;
    }

    if (id === 10) {
      codePayload = payload;
      codeSize = size;
    }

    p = payload + size;
  }

  return {
    functionPayload,
    functionSize,
    codePayload,
    codeSize,
    importedFunctions,
  };
}

function parseFunctionTypes(
  buf: Buffer,
  payload: number
): number[] {
  let p = payload;

  const count = readULEB(buf, p);
  p = count.next;

  const types: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const t = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = t.next;
    types.push(t.value);
  }

  return types;
}

function parseCodeBodies(
  buf: Buffer,
  payload: number,
  importedFunctions: number
): FuncInfo[] {
  let p = payload;

  const count = readULEB(buf, p);
  p = count.next;

  const funcs: FuncInfo[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const body = p;

    const s = readULEB(buf, p);
    const bodySize = s.value;
    p = s.next;

    const codeStart = p;
    const codeEnd = p + bodySize - 1;

    funcs.push({
      index: importedFunctions + i,
      body,
      bodySize,
      codeStart,
      codeEnd,
    });

    p += bodySize;
  }

  return funcs;
}

export async function run() {
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" SEGMENT 413 CANDIDATES → CALLER FUNCTIONS");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log();

  const wasm = readFileSync(WASM);

  console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);

  if (
    wasm[0] !== 0x00 ||
    wasm[1] !== 0x61 ||
    wasm[2] !== 0x73 ||
    wasm[3] !== 0x6d
  ) {
    throw new Error("Invalid WASM magic");
  }

  const sec = parseSections(wasm);

  console.log(`Imported functions : ${sec.importedFunctions}`);
  console.log();

  const functionTypes = parseFunctionTypes(
    wasm,
    sec.functionPayload
  );

  const funcs = parseCodeBodies(
    wasm,
    sec.codePayload,
    sec.importedFunctions
  );

  const byIndex = new Map<number, FuncInfo>();

  for (const f of funcs) {
    byIndex.set(f.index, f);
  }

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" CANDIDATE FUNCTIONS");
  console.log("============================================================");

  for (
    let i = CANDIDATE_START;
    i <= CANDIDATE_END;
    i++
  ) {
    const f = byIndex.get(i);

    if (!f) {
      console.log(`MISSING ${i}`);
      continue;
    }

    const type =
      functionTypes[i - sec.importedFunctions] ?? -1;

    console.log(
      `${i.toString().padStart(5)} ` +
      `type=${type.toString().padStart(4)} ` +
      `code=${hex(f.codeStart)}..${hex(f.codeEnd)} ` +
      `size=${f.bodySize.toString().padStart(6)}`
    );
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" SCANNING CALL INSTRUCTIONS");
  console.log("============================================================");

  type Caller = {
    caller: number;
    callOffset: number;
    target: number;
  };

  const callers = new Map<number, Caller[]>();

  let currentFunc = 0;

  for (const f of funcs) {
    currentFunc = f.index;

    let p = f.codeStart;

    while (p <= f.codeEnd) {
      const op = wasm[p];

      /*
       * CALL
       *
       * 0x10
       * followed by function index ULEB128
       */
      if (op === 0x10) {
        try {
          const imm = readULEB(wasm, p + 1);
          const target = imm.value;

          if (
            target >= CANDIDATE_START &&
            target <= CANDIDATE_END
          ) {
            const arr = callers.get(target) ?? [];

            arr.push({
              caller: currentFunc,
              callOffset: p,
              target,
            });

            callers.set(target, arr);
          }

          p = imm.next;
          continue;
        } catch {
          break;
        }
      }

      /*
       * CALL_INDIRECT
       *
       * 0x11
       *
       * The immediate here is a type index followed by
       * a table index / reserved byte depending on WASM encoding.
       *
       * We only record the opcode location here.
       */
      if (op === 0x11) {
        p++;
        continue;
      }

      /*
       * We intentionally do NOT attempt full WASM instruction
       * decoding here.
       *
       * This first pass searches raw code for opcode 0x10.
       */
      p++;
    }
  }

  console.log();

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" CALLER RESULTS");
  console.log("============================================================");

  let withCallers = 0;
  let withoutCallers = 0;
  let totalCalls = 0;

  for (
    let target = CANDIDATE_START;
    target <= CANDIDATE_END;
    target++
  ) {
    const arr = callers.get(target) ?? [];

    if (arr.length === 0) {
      withoutCallers++;

      console.log(
        `${target.toString().padStart(5)}  CALLERS = 0`
      );

      continue;
    }

    withCallers++;
    totalCalls += arr.length;

    console.log(
      `${target.toString().padStart(5)}  CALLERS = ${arr.length}`
    );

    for (const c of arr) {
      const callerInfo = byIndex.get(c.caller);

      console.log(
        `       caller=${c.caller} ` +
        `CALL@${hex(c.callOffset)} ` +
        `callerCode=${
          callerInfo
            ? `${hex(callerInfo.codeStart)}..${hex(callerInfo.codeEnd)}`
            : "?"
        }`
      );
    }
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" SUMMARY");
  console.log("============================================================");

  console.log(`Candidates           : ${CANDIDATE_END - CANDIDATE_START + 1}`);
  console.log(`With direct CALL     : ${withCallers}`);
  console.log(`Without direct CALL  : ${withoutCallers}`);
  console.log(`Total direct CALLs   : ${totalCalls}`);

  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" END");
  console.log("============================================================");
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_START = 4057;
const TARGET_END = 4188;

function readU32LE(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    return buf.readUInt32LE(p);
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB128 too large");
        }
    }
}

function sectionName(id: number): string {
    switch (id) {
        case 0: return "custom";
        case 1: return "type";
        case 2: return "import";
        case 3: return "function";
        case 4: return "table";
        case 5: return "memory";
        case 6: return "global";
        case 7: return "export";
        case 8: return "start";
        case 9: return "element";
        case 10: return "code";
        case 11: return "data";
        default: return `section-${id}`;
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

type FuncInfo = {
    index: number;
    typeIndex: number;
    bodyOffset: number;
    bodySize: number;
    localsStart: number;
    codeStart: number;
    codeEnd: number;
};

export async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SEGMENT 413 → WASM FUNCTION INDEX MAPPING");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log();

    if (!fs.existsSync(WASM)) {
        throw new Error(`WASM not found:\n${WASM}`);
    }

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log(`WASM size : ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`);
    console.log(`Candidate : ${TARGET_START} .. ${TARGET_END}`);
    console.log();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // WASM header
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        buf[0] !== 0x00 ||
        buf[1] !== 0x61 ||
        buf[2] !== 0x73 ||
        buf[3] !== 0x6d
    ) {
        throw new Error("Invalid WASM magic");
    }

    console.log("WASM magic : OK");
    console.log(
        `WASM version: ${buf.readUInt32LE(4) === 1 ? "1" : hex(buf.readUInt32LE(4))}`
    );
    console.log();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Parse sections
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    let p = 8;

    let functionSection: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
        count: number;
        typeIndices: number[];
    } | null = null;

    let codeSection: {
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
        count: number;
        bodyOffsets: number[];
        bodySizes: number[];
    } | null = null;

    console.log("WASM SECTIONS");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const sectionId = buf[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        const payloadSize = sizeInfo.value;
        const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
        const payloadEnd = payloadStart + payloadSize;

        console.log(
            `id=${sectionId.toString().padStart(2)} ` +
            `${sectionName(sectionId).padEnd(8)} ` +
            `payload=${hex(payloadStart)} size=${payloadSize}`
        );

        if (payloadEnd > buf.length) {
            throw new Error(
                `Section exceeds file: id=${sectionId} end=${hex(payloadEnd)}`
            );
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Function section
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (sectionId === 3) {
            let q = payloadStart;

            const countInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
            const count = countInfo.value;
            q = countInfo.next;

            const typeIndices: number[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const x = readULEB(buf, q);
                typeIndices.push(x.value);
                q = x.next;
            }

            functionSection = {
                payloadStart,
                payloadEnd,
                count,
                typeIndices,
            };
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Code section
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (sectionId === 10) {
            let q = payloadStart;

            const countInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
            const count = countInfo.value;
            q = countInfo.next;

            const bodyOffsets: number[] = [];
            const bodySizes: number[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const bodyStart = q;

                const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
                const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
                q = bodySizeInfo.next;

                const bodyOffset = q;

                bodyOffsets.push(bodyOffset);
                bodySizes.push(bodySize);

                q += bodySize;

                if (q > payloadEnd) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Code body exceeds section: function=${i}`
                    );
                }

                // Keep bodyStart referenced conceptually for diagnostics.
                void bodyStart;
            }

            codeSection = {
                payloadStart,
                payloadEnd,
                count,
                bodyOffsets,
                bodySizes,
            };
        }

        p = payloadEnd;
    }

    console.log();

    if (!functionSection) {
        throw new Error("Function section not found");
    }

    if (!codeSection) {
        throw new Error("Code section not found");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Imported functions
    //
    // Function section indices are NOT necessarily zero-based
    // relative to the function section itself.
    //
    // We need the number of imported functions before assigning
    // actual function indexes.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    // For this first pass, inspect the import section directly.
    let importedFunctions = 0;

    p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const sectionId = buf[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        const payloadSize = sizeInfo.value;
        const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
        const payloadEnd = payloadStart + payloadSize;

        if (sectionId === 2) {
            let q = payloadStart;

            const countInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
            const count = countInfo.value;
            q = countInfo.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                // module name
                const modLen = readULEB(buf, q);
                q = modLen.next + modLen.value;

                // field/name
                const fieldLen = readULEB(buf, q);
                q = fieldLen.next + fieldLen.value;

                const kind = buf[q++];

                switch (kind) {
                    case 0: {
                        // function import
                        const typeInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
                        q = typeInfo.next;
                        importedFunctions++;
                        break;
                    }

                    case 1: {
                        // table
                        q = skipTableType(buf, q);
                        break;
                    }

                    case 2: {
                        // memory
                        q = skipLimits(buf, q);
                        break;
                    }

                    case 3: {
                        // global
                        q = skipGlobalType(buf, q);
                        break;
                    }

                    case 4: {
                        // tag
                        q = skipTagType(buf, q);
                        break;
                    }

                    default:
                        throw new Error(
                            `Unknown import kind ${kind} at ${hex(q - 1)}`
                        );
                }
            }
        }

        p = payloadEnd;
    }

    console.log("FUNCTION / CODE COUNTS");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log(`Imported functions : ${importedFunctions}`);
    console.log(`Defined functions  : ${functionSection.count}`);
    console.log(`Code bodies        : ${codeSection.count}`);
    console.log(
        `Total function indexes expected : ${
            importedFunctions + functionSection.count
        }`
    );
    console.log();

    if (functionSection.count !== codeSection.count) {
        console.log("WARNING:");
        console.log("Function section count != Code section count");
        console.log();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Build defined function map
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const funcs = new Map<number, FuncInfo>();

    for (let i = 0; i < functionSection.count; i++) {
        const index = importedFunctions + i;

        const bodyOffset = codeSection.bodyOffsets[i];
        const bodySize = codeSection.bodySizes[i];

        // Decode local declaration vector to find actual instruction
        // start inside the function body.
        let q = bodyOffset;

        const localCountInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
        const localCount = localCountInfo.value;
        q = localCountInfo.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localCount; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(buf, q);
            q = n.next;

            // valtype byte
            q += 1;
        }

        const localsStart = bodyOffset;
        const codeStart = q;
        const codeEnd = bodyOffset + bodySize;

        funcs.set(index, {
            index,
            typeIndex: functionSection.typeIndices[i],
            bodyOffset,
            bodySize,
            localsStart,
            codeStart,
            codeEnd,
        });
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Candidate range
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" CANDIDATE FUNCTION MAPPING");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log();

    for (let index = TARGET_START; index <= TARGET_END; index++) {
        const f = funcs.get(index);

        if (!f) {
            console.log(`${index} : NOT A DEFINED FUNCTION`);
            continue;
        }

        console.log(
            `${index.toString().padStart(5)} ` +
            `type=${f.typeIndex.toString().padStart(5)} ` +
            `body=${hex(f.bodyOffset)} ` +
            `size=${f.bodySize.toString().padStart(6)} ` +
            `code=${hex(f.codeStart)}..${hex(f.codeEnd)}`
        );
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Boundary / continuity test
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" CONTINUITY TEST");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log();

    let valid = 0;
    let invalid = 0;

    for (let index = TARGET_START; index <= TARGET_END; index++) {
        const f = funcs.get(index);

        if (!f) {
            invalid++;
            continue;
        }

        valid++;
    }

    console.log(`Valid candidate functions : ${valid}`);
    console.log(`Invalid / missing         : ${invalid}`);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Neighborhood
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" FUNCTION NEIGHBORHOOD");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log();

    const neighborhoodStart = Math.max(0, TARGET_START - 5);
    const neighborhoodEnd = Math.min(
        importedFunctions + functionSection.count - 1,
        TARGET_END + 5
    );

    for (
        let index = neighborhoodStart;
        index <= neighborhoodEnd;
        index++
    ) {
        const f = funcs.get(index);

        if (!f) {
            console.log(`${index} : IMPORT / UNDEFINED`);
            continue;
        }

        console.log(
            `${index.toString().padStart(5)} ` +
            `type=${f.typeIndex.toString().padStart(5)} ` +
            `body=${hex(f.bodyOffset)} ` +
            `size=${f.bodySize.toString().padStart(6)} ` +
            `code=${hex(f.codeStart)}..${hex(f.codeEnd)}`
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" END");
    console.log("============================================================");
}

function skipLimits(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    const flags = buf[p++];

    const minInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = minInfo.next;

    if (flags & 0x01) {
        const maxInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = maxInfo.next;
    }

    return p;
}

function skipTableType(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    // element reference type
    p += 1;

    return skipLimits(buf, p);
}

function skipGlobalType(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    // valtype + mutability
    p += 2;
    return p;
}

function skipTagType(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    // attribute + type index
    p += 1;

    const typeInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    return typeInfo.next;
}

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function readSection(pos) {
    const id = bytes[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);

    const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sizeInfo.value;

    return {
        id,
        size: sizeInfo.value,
        payloadStart,
        payloadEnd
    };
}

function findCodeSection() {
    let pos = 8;

    while (pos < bytes.length) {
        const section = readSection(pos);

        if (section.id === 10) {
            return section;
        }

        pos = section.payloadEnd;
    }

    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function hex(n) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function findSection(sectionId) {
  let p = 8; // WASM magic + version

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size;

    if (id === sectionId) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 87;
const IMPORTS = 83;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: pos };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error("ULEB");
    }

    throw new Error("EOF");
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value -= 2 ** shift;
            }

            return { value, next: p };
        }

        if (shift > 35) throw new Error("SLEB");
    }

    throw new Error("EOF");
}

function matchLocalGet2(p: number): boolean {
    return buf[p] === 0x20 && buf[p + 1] === 0x02;
}

function decodeConst(p: number) {
    if (buf[p] !== 0x41) return null;

    try {
        return sleb(p + 1);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCTION_INDEX = 87;

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(
  buf: Buffer,
  pos: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB128 too large");
    }
  }
}

function readName(
  buf: Buffer,
  pos: number
): { value: string; next: number } {
  const r = readULEB(buf, pos);
  const end = r.next + r.value;

  return {
    value: buf.subarray(r.next, end).toString("utf8"),
    next: end,
  };
}

function findSection(
  wasm: Buffer,
  wantedId: number
): { start: number; end: number } | null {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sizeInfo.value;

    if (id === wantedId) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

function skipLimits(buf: Buffer, pos: number): number {
  const flags = buf[pos++];

  const min = readULEB(buf, pos);
  pos = min.next;

  if (flags & 0x01) {
    const max = readULEB(buf, pos);
    pos = max.next;
  }

  return pos;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(p, end) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (p < end) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function readString(p, end) {
  const n = uleb(p, end);
  if (!n) return null;

  const e = n.next + n.value;
  if (e > end) return null;

  return {
    text: buf.subarray(n.next, e).toString("utf8"),
    next: e
  };
}

let p = 8;

let importedFunctions = 0;
let definedFunctions = 0;

let codeSection = null;

while (p < buf.length) {
  const sectionId = buf[p++];

  const size = uleb(p, buf.length);
  if (!size) break;

  p = size.next;

  const sectionStart = p;
  const sectionEnd = p + size.value;

  if (sectionId === 2) {
    // Import section
    const count = uleb(p, sectionEnd);

    if (!count) {
      p = sectionEnd;
      continue;
    }

    p = count.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
      const mod = readString(p, sectionEnd);
      if (!mod) break;

      p = mod.next;

      const name = readString(p, sectionEnd);
      if (!name) break;

      p = name.next;

      const kind = buf[p++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        const typeIndex = uleb(p, sectionEnd);
        if (!typeIndex) break;

        p = typeIndex.next;
        importedFunctions++;
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        // table
        p++; // elem type

        const flags = uleb(p, sectionEnd);
        if (!flags) break;

        p = flags.next;

        const min = uleb(p, sectionEnd);
        if (!min) break;

        p = min.next;

        if (flags.value & 1) {
          const max = uleb(p, sectionEnd);
          if (!max) break;
          p = max.next;
        }
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        // memory
        const flags = uleb(p, sectionEnd);
        if (!flags) break;

        p = flags.next;

        const min = uleb(p, sectionEnd);
        if (!min) break;

        p = min.next;

        if (flags.value & 1) {
          const max = uleb(p, sectionEnd);
          if (!max) break;

          p = max.next;
        }
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        // global
        p += 2;
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (sectionId === 3) {
    // Function section
    const count = uleb(p, sectionEnd);

    if (count) {
      definedFunctions = count.value;
    }
  }

  if (sectionId === 10) {
    codeSection = {
      start: sectionStart,
      end: sectionEnd
    };
  }

  p = sectionEnd;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function leb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function typeName(x: number) {
  return x === 0x7f ? "i32" :
         x === 0x7e ? "i64" :
         x === 0x7d ? "f32" :
         x === 0x7c ? "f64" :
         `0x${x.toString(16)}`;
}

let p = 8;
let importFuncCount = 0;
let types: any[] = [];
let definedTypeIndices: number[] = [];
let codeStart = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];
  const r = leb(p);
  p = r.next;
  const end = p + r.value;

  if (id === 1) {
    const c = leb(p);
    p = c.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
      p++; // form

      const pc = leb(p);
      p = pc.next;
      const params = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) params.push(wasm[p++]);

      const rc = leb(p);
      p = rc.next;
      const results = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) results.push(wasm[p++]);

      types.push({ params, results });
    }
  }

  if (id === 2) {
    const c = leb(p);
    p = c.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
      const ml = leb(p); p = ml.next + ml.value;
      const nl = leb(p); p = nl.next + nl.value;

      const kind = wasm[p++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        const tr = leb(p);
        p = tr.next;
        importFuncCount++;
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        p++; // elemtype
        p++; // limits flags
        const a = leb(p); p = a.next;
        if (wasm[p - 1] === 1) {
          const b = leb(p); p = b.next;
        }
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        p++;
        const flags = wasm[p++];
        const a = leb(p); p = a.next;
        if (flags & 1) {
          const b = leb(p); p = b.next;
        }
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        p += 2;
      }
    }
  }

  if (id === 3) {
    const c = leb(p);
    p = c.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
      const t = leb(p);
      p = t.next;
      definedTypeIndices.push(t.value);
    }
  }

  if (id === 10) {

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { v, p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readU32(buf, p) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readName(buf, p) {
    const n = readU32(buf, p);
    p = n.next;

    return {
        next: p + n.value
    };
}

function skipLimits(buf, p) {
    const flags = buf[p++];

    const min = readU32(buf, p);
    p = min.next;

    if (flags & 1) {
        const max = readU32(buf, p);
        p = max.next;
    }

    return p;
}

function getSections(buf) {
    const sections = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {

        const id = buf[p++];

        const size = readU32(buf, p);
        p = size.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = start + size.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start,
            end,
            size: size.value
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseTypes(buf, section) {

    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const types = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {

        const form = buf[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            types.push(null);
            continue;
        }

        const pc = readU32(buf, p);
        p = pc.next;

        const params = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
            params.push(buf[p++]);
        }

        const rc = readU32(buf, p);
        p = rc.next;

        const results = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
            results.push(buf[p++]);
        }

        types.push({
            params,
            results
        });
    }

    return types;
}

function parseImports(buf, section) {

    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const importedTypes = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {

        const module = readName(buf, p);
        p = module.next;

        const name = readName(buf, p);
        p = name.next;

        const kind = buf[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {

            const t = readU32(buf, p);
            p = t.next;

            importedTypes.push(t.value);

        } else if (kind === 1) {

            p += 1;
            p = skipLimits(buf, p);

        } else if (kind === 2) {

            p = skipLimits(buf, p);

        } else if (kind === 3) {

            p += 2;

        } else {

            throw new Error(
                `Unknown import kind ${kind}`
            );
        }
    }

    return importedTypes;
}

function parseFunctions(buf, section) {

    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const definedTypes = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {

        const t = readU32(buf, p);
        p = t.next;

        definedTypes.push(t.value);
    }

    return definedTypes;
}
