import {
    Address,
    beginCell,
    Cell,
    Contract,
    ContractProvider,
    Sender,
    SendMode,
    contractAddress,
    toNano,
} from '@ton/core';

import { Blockchain } from '@ton/sandbox';
import fs from 'fs';

const PTON_SOURCE =
    'pton_source/libs/src/wrappers/PTon.ts';

const DEPLOY_WALLET_OP = 0x6cc43573;

function extractCode(name: string): Cell {
    const source = fs.readFileSync(PTON_SOURCE, 'utf8');

    const marker = `export const ${name} = codeFromString("`;
    const start = source.indexOf(marker);

    if (start < 0) {
        throw new Error(`Cannot find ${name}`);
    }

    const valueStart = start + marker.length;
    const valueEnd = source.indexOf('"', valueStart);

    if (valueEnd < 0) {
        throw new Error(`Cannot parse ${name}`);
    }

    const hex = source.substring(valueStart, valueEnd);

    console.log(`${name}: ${hex.length} hex characters`);

    return Cell.fromBoc(Buffer.from(hex, 'hex'))[0];
}

const PTON_MINTER_CODE_V1 =
    extractCode('PTON_MINTER_CODE_v1');

const PTON_WALLET_CODE_V1 =
    extractCode('PTON_WALLET_CODE_v1');

class PtonMinterV1 implements Contract {

    readonly init: {
        code: Cell;
        data: Cell;
    };

    constructor(
        readonly address: Address,
        init: {
            code: Cell;
            data: Cell;
        }
    ) {
        this.init = init;
    }

    static create() {

        const data = beginCell()
            .storeRef(PTON_WALLET_CODE_V1)
            .endCell();

        const init = {
            code: PTON_MINTER_CODE_V1,
            data,
        };

        const address = contractAddress(0, init);

        return new PtonMinterV1(address, init);
    }

    async sendDeploy(
        provider: ContractProvider,
        via: Sender,
        value: bigint
    ) {
        await provider.internal(via, {
            value,
            sendMode: SendMode.PAY_GAS_SEPARATELY,
            body: beginCell().endCell(),
        });
    }

    async sendDeployWallet(
        provider: ContractProvider,
        via: Sender,
        ownerAddress: Address,
        excessesAddress: Address,
        value: bigint
    ) {

        const body = beginCell()
            .storeUint(DEPLOY_WALLET_OP, 32)
            .storeUint(0, 64)
            .storeAddress(ownerAddress)
            .storeAddress(excessesAddress)
            .endCell();

        console.log('');
        console.log('Deploy Wallet message:');
        console.log(
            `Opcode:          0x${DEPLOY_WALLET_OP.toString(16)}`
        );
        console.log(
            `Owner:           ${ownerAddress.toString()}`
        );
        console.log(
            `Excesses:        ${excessesAddress.toString()}`
        );
        console.log(
            `Value:            ${Number(value) / 1e9} TON`
        );
        console.log(
            `Body bits:        ${body.bits.length}`
        );
        console.log('');

        await provider.internal(via, {
            value,
            sendMode: SendMode.PAY_GAS_SEPARATELY,
            body,
        });
    }

    getWalletAddress(ownerAddress: Address): Address {

        const data = beginCell()
            .storeCoins(0)
            .storeAddress(ownerAddress)
            .storeAddress(this.address)
            .endCell();

        return contractAddress(0, {
            code: PTON_WALLET_CODE_V1,
            data,
        });
    }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(p, end) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (p < end && shift <= 35) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

let p = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (p < buf.length) {
  const sectionId = buf[p++];

  const s = uleb(p, buf.length);
  if (!s) throw new Error("Invalid section");

  p = s.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + s.value;

  if (sectionId === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
  throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

let q = codeStart;

const count = uleb(q, codeEnd);
if (!count) throw new Error("Invalid code count");

q = count.next;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("RAW CALL 96 INSIDE CODE SECTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE     :", buf.length.toLocaleString());
console.log("CODE SECTION  :",
  "0x" + codeStart.toString(16),
  "..",
  "0x" + codeEnd.toString(16)
);
console.log("DEFINED FUNCS :", count.value);
console.log("TARGET BYTES   : 10 60");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let total = 0;

for (let codeIndex = 0; codeIndex < count.value; codeIndex++) {
  const body = uleb(q, codeEnd);
  if (!body) throw new Error("Invalid body size");

  q = body.next;

  const bodyStart = q;
  const bodyEnd = q + body.value;

  for (let x = bodyStart; x + 1 < bodyEnd; x++) {
    if (buf[x] === 0x10 && buf[x + 1] === 0x60) {
      total++;

      const globalFunctionIndex = codeIndex + 83;

      console.log("");
      console.log("HIT #" + total);
      console.log("CODE INDEX :", codeIndex);
      console.log("GLOBAL FUNC:", globalFunctionIndex);
      console.log(
        "OFFSET     : 0x" +
          x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")
      );
      console.log(
        "BODY       : 0x" +
          bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0") +
          " .. 0x" +
          bodyEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")
      );
    }
  }

  q = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("RAW 10 60 INSIDE CODE BODIES :", total);

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 5079;

// 5079 = 0x13d7
// ULEB128 = d7 27
const a = [0x10, 0xd7, 0x27];

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("RAW CALL 5079 SEARCH v42");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`Target CALL : ${TARGET}`);
console.log(`Pattern     : ${a.map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(" ")}`);
console.log("");

let hits = 0;

for (let i = 0; i <= b.length - a.length; i++) {

  if (
    b[i] === a[0] &&
    b[i + 1] === a[1] &&
    b[i + 2] === a[2]
  ) {

    hits++;

    console.log(
      `HIT #${hits} @ 0x${i.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
    );

    console.log(
      "bytes :",
      Array.from(
        b.slice(Math.max(0, i - 8), Math.min(b.length, i + 11))
      )
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ")
    );
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TOTAL RAW HITS : ${hits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("END V42");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return [v >>> 0, p];

    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];

  const [size, q] = uleb(p);
  p = q;

  if (id !== 10) {
    p += size;
    continue;
  }

  const [count, q2] = uleb(p);
  p = q2;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const [bodySize, q3] = uleb(p);
    p = q3;

    const func = 83 + i;

    if (func === 119) {
      const start = p;
      const end = p + bodySize;

      console.log("FUNC 119 RAW BODY");
      console.log("============================================================");
      console.log(
        `START : 0x${start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
      );
      console.log(
        `END   : 0x${end.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
      );
      console.log(`SIZE  : ${bodySize}`);
      console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

      const hex = [...b.subarray(start, end)]
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");

      console.log(hex);
      console.log("============================================================");
      process.exit(0);
    }

    p += bodySize;
  }

  process.exit(0);
}

console.log("FUNC 119 NOT FOUND");

FILE: scripts\rawGetLibraries.ts

import { ADNLClientTCP } from 'adnl';
import { TLWriteBuffer, TLReadBuffer } from 'ton-tl';
import { Functions, Codecs } from 'ton-lite-client/dist/schema';
import { randomBytes } from 'tweetnacl';

const SERVER = 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787';
const SERVER_KEY = 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=';

const LIBRARIES = [
    'fa0d2b89d20ae82e5f5544eff4d621224573519899c0c98f6a1ced78b5c2ddf3',
    '631cf98bbb3ee540dacc48256975d8e2c3080c6342e3ff4a9edaac6db73730041',
    '7c1f3aa01265453058887378a358cf37314856350400804c169b648c3fdfbe4c',
    '1b63154f10acd98345a65890997094e9856aa2be4f1e37060865519fa42032fd',
];

function toHex(value: any): string {
    if (Buffer.isBuffer(value)) {
        return value.toString('hex');
    }

    if (value instanceof Uint8Array) {
        return Buffer.from(value).toString('hex');
    }

    if (value?.data && Array.isArray(value.data)) {
        return Buffer.from(value.data).toString('hex');
    }

    return String(value);
}

async function main() {
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' STON.fi ROUTER LIBRARY CHECK');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');

    const client = new ADNLClientTCP(SERVER, SERVER_KEY);

    client.on('error', (err: any) => {
        console.error('ADNL ERROR:', err);
    });

    console.log('Connecting...');

    await client.connect();

    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error('ADNL ready timeout'));
        }, 10000);

        client.once('ready', () => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            resolve();
        });

        client.once('error', (err: any) => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(err);
        });
    });

    console.log('ADNL READY');
    console.log('');

    const request = {
        kind: 'liteServer.getLibraries' as const,
        libraryList: LIBRARIES.map((h) => Buffer.from(h, 'hex')),
    };

    const writer = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Functions.liteServer_getLibraries.encodeRequest(
        request,
        writer
    );

    const body = writer.build();

    const queryWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Functions.liteServer_query.encodeRequest(
        {
            kind: 'liteServer.query',
            data: body,
        },
        queryWriter
    );

    const query = queryWriter.build();
    const queryId = Buffer.from(randomBytes(32));

    const adnlWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Codecs.adnl_Message.encode(
        {
            kind: 'adnl.message.query',
            queryId,
            query,
        },
        adnlWriter
    );

    const packet = adnlWriter.build();

    const result = await new Promise<any>((resolve, reject) => {
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error('getLibraries timeout'));
        }, 10000);

        const onData = (data: Buffer) => {
            try {
                const message = Codecs.adnl_Message.decode(
                    new TLReadBuffer(data)
                );

                if (message.kind !== 'adnl.message.answer') {
                    return;
                }

                if (!message.queryId.equals(queryId)) {
                    return;
                }

                clearTimeout(timeout);

                const answer = message.answer;

                if (answer.readInt32LE(0) === -1146494648) {
                    const error =
                        Codecs.liteServer_Error.decode(
                            new TLReadBuffer(answer)
                        );

                    reject(
                        new Error(
                            'LiteServer error: ' +
                            error.message
                        )
                    );

                    return;
                }

                const decoded =
                    Functions.liteServer_getLibraries.decodeResponse(
                        new TLReadBuffer(answer)
                    );

                resolve(decoded);

            } catch (err) {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                reject(err);
            }
        };

        client.once('data', onData);
        client.write(packet);
    });

    console.log('===== LIBRARY RESULT =====');
    console.log('Returned entries:', result.result.length);
    console.log('');

    const returned = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of result.result) {
        const hash = toHex(entry.hash);
        returned.add(hash);

        console.log(
            'RETURNED:',
            hash,
            '| data bytes:',
            entry.data.length
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== EXPECTED LIBRARIES =====');

    let allFound = true;

    for (let i = 0; i < LIBRARIES.length; i++) {
        const expected = LIBRARIES[i];
        const found = returned.has(expected);

        console.log(
            `Library ${i + 1}:`,
            expected,
            '->',
            found ? 'FOUND' : 'NOT FOUND'
        );

        if (!found) {
            allFound = false;
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');

    if (allFound) {
        console.log('RESULT: ALL 4 LIBRARIES FOUND');
    } else {
        console.log('RESULT: ONE OR MORE LIBRARIES NOT FOUND');
    }

    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION SENT.');

    client.end();
}

main().catch((err: any) => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('TEST FAILED');
    console.error(err?.stack || err);
    process.exit(1);
});

import { ADNLClientTCP } from 'adnl';
import { TLWriteBuffer } from 'ton-tl';
import { Functions, Codecs } from 'ton-lite-client/dist/schema';
import { randomBytes } from 'tweetnacl';

const SERVER = 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787';
const SERVER_KEY = 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=';

console.log('========================================');
console.log(' RAW liteServer.getMasterchainInfo TEST');
console.log('========================================');
console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
console.log('');
console.log('Server:', SERVER);

async function main() {
    const client = new ADNLClientTCP(SERVER, SERVER_KEY);

    client.on('error', (err: any) => {
        console.error('ADNL ERROR:', err);
    });

    client.on('close', () => {
        console.log('ADNL CLOSED');
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== CONNECT =====');

   await client.connect();

console.log('===== ADNL CONNECTED =====');
console.log('Waiting for ADNL READY...');

await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        reject(new Error('ADNL ready timeout'));
    }, 10000);

    client.once('ready', () => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        console.log('===== ADNL READY =====');
        resolve();
    });

    client.once('error', (err: any) => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        reject(err);
    });
});

    const queryId = randomBytes(32);

    // liteServer.getMasterchainInfo request
    const writer = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Functions.liteServer_getMasterchainInfo.encodeRequest(
        {},
        writer
    );

    const body = writer.build();

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== getMasterchainInfo ENCODED =====');
    console.log('Bytes:', body.length);
    console.log('Hex:', body.toString('hex'));

    // Wrap in liteServer.query
    const queryWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Functions.liteServer_query.encodeRequest(
        {
            kind: 'liteServer.query',
            data: body,
        },
        queryWriter
    );

    const queryBody = queryWriter.build();

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== liteServer.query ENCODED =====');
    console.log('Bytes:', queryBody.length);
    console.log('Hex:', queryBody.toString('hex'));

    // Wrap in ADNL query
    const adnlWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Codecs.adnl_Message.encode(
        {
            kind: 'adnl.message.query',
            queryId,
            query: queryBody,
        },
        adnlWriter
    );

    const packet = adnlWriter.build();

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== ADNL PACKET =====');
    console.log('Query ID:', Buffer.from(queryId).toString('hex'));
    console.log('Packet bytes:', packet.length);

    let finished = false;

    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!finished) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('===== TIMEOUT =====');
            console.log('No LiteServer response received.');
            console.log('');
            console.log('ADNL connection itself was successful.');
            process.exit(1);
        }
    }, 10000);

    client.on('data', (data: Buffer) => {
        if (finished) return;

        try {
            console.log('');
            console.log('===== ADNL RESPONSE =====');
            console.log('Bytes:', data.length);
            console.log('Hex:', data.toString('hex'));

            const reader = new (require('ton-tl').TLReadBuffer)(data);

            const message = Codecs.adnl_Message.decode(reader);

            console.log('');
            console.log('===== DECODED ADNL MESSAGE =====');
            console.log('Kind:', message.kind);

            if (message.kind !== 'adnl.message.answer') {
                console.log('Unexpected ADNL message kind.');
                return;
            }

            console.log('');
            console.log('===== LITESERVER ANSWER =====');

            const answerReader = new (require('ton-tl').TLReadBuffer)(
                message.answer
            );

            const result =
                Functions.liteServer_getMasterchainInfo.decodeResponse(
                    answerReader
                );

            console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

            finished = true;
            clearTimeout(timeout);

            console.log('');
            console.log('===== SUCCESS =====');
            console.log('Current masterchain information received.');
            console.log('NO TRANSACTION SENT.');

            process.exit(0);

        } catch (err: any) {
            console.error('');
            console.error('===== DECODE ERROR =====');
            console.error(err?.stack || err);

            finished = true;
            clearTimeout(timeout);

            process.exit(1);
        }
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== SEND QUERY =====');

    client.write(packet);

    console.log('Query sent.');
    console.log('Waiting for LiteServer response...');
}

main().catch((err) => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('===== FATAL ERROR =====');
    console.error(err?.stack || err);
    process.exit(1);
});

                    );
                    return;
                }

                const decoded =
                    Functions.liteServer_getLibraries.decodeResponse(
                        new TLReadBuffer(answer)
                    );

                resolve(decoded);

            } catch (err) {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                reject(err);
            }
        };

        client.once('data', onData);
        client.write(packet);
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== RESULT =====');
    console.log('Returned entries:', result.result.length);
    console.log('');

    const returned = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of result.result) {
        const hash = toHex(entry.hash);
        returned.add(hash);

        console.log('FOUND:', hash);
        console.log('Data bytes:', entry.data.length);
        console.log('');
    }

    console.log('===== FINAL =====');

    for (const hash of MISSING) {
        console.log(
            hash,
            '->',
            returned.has(hash) ? 'FOUND' : 'NOT FOUND'
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION SENT.');

    client.end();
}

main().catch((err: any) => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('TEST FAILED');
    console.error(err?.stack || err);
    process.exit(1);
});

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';

export async function run() {
    const endpoint =
        'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/runGetMethod';

    const router = Address.parse(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

   const roosterWallet = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const ptonWallet = Address.parse(
    'EQCM3B12QK1e4yZSf8GtBRT0aLMNyEsBc_DhVfRRtOEffLez'
);

    function addressSlice(address: Address) {
        return {
            bytes: beginCell()
                .storeAddress(address)
                .endCell()
                .toBoc()
                .toString('base64'),
        };
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== RAW TESTNET POOL GETTER =====');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Router:', router.toString());
    console.log(
        'ROOSTER Router Wallet:',
        roosterWallet.toString()
    );
    console.log(
        'pTON Router Wallet:',
        ptonWallet.toString()
    );

    const body = {
        address: router.toString(),
        method: 'get_pool_address',
        stack: [
            ['slice', addressSlice(roosterWallet)],
            ['slice', addressSlice(ptonWallet)],
        ],
    };

    console.log('');
    console.log('Calling get_pool_address...');
    console.log('');

    try {
        const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(body),
        });

        const text = await response.text();

        console.log('HTTP:', response.status);
        console.log('');
        console.log('RAW RESPONSE:');
        console.log(text);
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('REQUEST ERROR:');
        console.log(String(error));
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('================================');
}

import { ADNLClientTCP } from 'adnl';
import { TLWriteBuffer, TLReadBuffer } from 'ton-tl';
import { Functions, Codecs } from 'ton-lite-client/dist/schema';
import { crc16 } from 'ton-lite-client/dist/utils/crc16';
import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { randomBytes } from 'tweetnacl';

const SERVER = 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787';
const SERVER_KEY = 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=';

const ROUTER =
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval';

const METHOD = 'get_router_data';

console.log('========================================');
console.log(' RAW CURRENT-BLOCK get_router_data TEST');
console.log('========================================');
console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
console.log('');
console.log('Server:', SERVER);
console.log('Router:', ROUTER);
console.log('Method:', METHOD);

async function main() {
    const client = new ADNLClientTCP(SERVER, SERVER_KEY);

    client.on('error', (err: any) => {
        console.error('ADNL ERROR:', err);
    });

    client.on('close', () => {
        console.log('ADNL CLOSED');
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== CONNECT =====');

    await client.connect();

    console.log('===== ADNL CONNECTED =====');
    console.log('Waiting for ADNL READY...');

    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error('ADNL ready timeout'));
        }, 10000);

        client.once('ready', () => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            console.log('===== ADNL READY =====');
            resolve();
        });

        client.once('error', (err: any) => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            reject(err);
        });
    });

    // ============================================================
    // STEP 1: GET CURRENT MASTERCHAIN INFO
    // ============================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' STEP 1: getMasterchainInfo');
    console.log('========================================');

    const mcWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Functions.liteServer_getMasterchainInfo.encodeRequest(
        {},
        mcWriter
    );

    const mcBody = mcWriter.build();

    const mcQueryWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Functions.liteServer_query.encodeRequest(
        {
            kind: 'liteServer.query',
            data: mcBody,
        },
        mcQueryWriter
    );

    const mcQuery = mcQueryWriter.build();

    const mcQueryId = Buffer.from(randomBytes(32));

    const mcAdnlWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Codecs.adnl_Message.encode(
        {
            kind: 'adnl.message.query',
            queryId: mcQueryId,
            query: mcQuery,
        },
        mcAdnlWriter
    );

    const mcPacket = mcAdnlWriter.build();

    const masterchain = await new Promise<any>((resolve, reject) => {
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error('getMasterchainInfo timeout'));
        }, 10000);

        const onData = (data: Buffer) => {
            try {
                const message = Codecs.adnl_Message.decode(
                    new TLReadBuffer(data)
                );

                if (message.kind !== 'adnl.message.answer') {
                    return;
                }

                if (!message.queryId.equals(mcQueryId)) {
                    return;
                }

                clearTimeout(timeout);

                const result =
                    Functions.liteServer_getMasterchainInfo.decodeResponse(
                        new TLReadBuffer(message.answer)
                    );

                resolve(result);
            } catch (err) {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                reject(err);
            }
        };

        client.once('data', onData);
        client.write(mcPacket);
    });

    const block = masterchain.last;

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== CURRENT MASTERCHAIN BLOCK =====');
    console.log('Workchain:', block.workchain);
    console.log('Shard:', block.shard.toString());
    console.log('Seqno:', block.seqno);
    console.log(
        'Root hash:',
        Buffer.from(block.rootHash).toString('hex')
    );
    console.log(
        'File hash:',
        Buffer.from(block.fileHash).toString('hex')
    );

    // ============================================================
    // STEP 2: RUN get_router_data ON CURRENT BLOCK
    // ============================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' STEP 2: runSmcMethod');
    console.log('========================================');

    const routerAddress = Address.parse(ROUTER);

    const methodId =
        (((crc16(METHOD) & 0xffff) | 0x10000)) >>> 0;

    console.log('Method ID:', methodId);

    const request = {
        mode: 4,
        id: {
            kind: 'tonNode.blockIdExt',
            workchain: block.workchain,
            shard: block.shard,
            seqno: block.seqno,
            rootHash: Buffer.from(block.rootHash),
            fileHash: Buffer.from(block.fileHash),
        },
        account: {
            kind: 'liteServer.accountId',
            workchain: routerAddress.workChain,
            id: routerAddress.hash,
        },
        methodId,
        params: Buffer.alloc(0),
    };

    const smcWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Functions.liteServer_runSmcMethod.encodeRequest(
        request,
        smcWriter
    );

    const smcBody = smcWriter.build();

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== runSmcMethod ENCODED =====');
    console.log('Bytes:', smcBody.length);
    console.log('Hex:', smcBody.toString('hex'));

    const lsWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Functions.liteServer_query.encodeRequest(
        {
            kind: 'liteServer.query',
            data: smcBody,
        },
        lsWriter
    );

    const lsBody = lsWriter.build();

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== liteServer.query ENCODED =====');
    console.log('Bytes:', lsBody.length);
    console.log('Hex:', lsBody.toString('hex'));

    const queryId = Buffer.from(randomBytes(32));

    const adnlWriter = new TLWriteBuffer();

    Codecs.adnl_Message.encode(
        {
            kind: 'adnl.message.query',
            queryId,
            query: lsBody,
        },
        adnlWriter
    );

    const packet = adnlWriter.build();

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== ADNL PACKET =====');
    console.log(
        'Query ID:',
        queryId.toString('hex')
    );
    console.log('Packet bytes:', packet.length);

    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            reject(new Error('runSmcMethod timeout'));
        }, 10000);

        const onData = (data: Buffer) => {
            try {
                console.log('');
                console.log('===== ADNL RESPONSE =====');
                console.log('Bytes:', data.length);
                console.log('Hex:', data.toString('hex'));

                const message = Codecs.adnl_Message.decode(
                    new TLReadBuffer(data)
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('===== DECODED ADNL MESSAGE =====');
                console.log('Kind:', message.kind);

                if (message.kind !== 'adnl.message.answer') {
                    return;
                }

                if (!message.queryId.equals(queryId)) {
                    return;
                }

                clearTimeout(timeout);

                const answer = message.answer;

                console.log('');
                console.log('===== LITESERVER ANSWER =====');
                console.log(
                    'Answer bytes:',
                    answer.length
                );

                // liteServer.error constructor
                if (answer.readInt32LE(0) === -1146494648) {
                    const error =
                        Codecs.liteServer_Error.decode(
                            new TLReadBuffer(answer)
                        );

                    console.error('');
                    console.error('===== LITESERVER ERROR =====');
                    console.error(error.message);

                    reject(
                        new Error(
                            'LiteServer error: ' +
                            error.message
                        )
                    );

                    return;
                }

                const result =
                    Functions.liteServer_runSmcMethod.decodeResponse(
                        new TLReadBuffer(answer)
                    );

                console.log('');
                console.log('===== runSmcMethod RESULT =====');
                console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

                resolve();
            } catch (err: any) {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                reject(err);
            }
        };

        client.once('data', onData);

        console.log('');
        console.log('===== SEND QUERY =====');
        client.write(packet);
        console.log('Query sent.');
        console.log('Waiting for LiteServer response...');
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' FINAL RESULT');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('Current block:', block.seqno);
    console.log('Router:', ROUTER);
    console.log('Getter:', METHOD);
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION SENT.');

    client.end();
}

main().catch((err: any) => {
    console.error('');
    console.error('========================================');
    console.error(' TEST FAILED');
    console.error('========================================');
    console.error(err?.stack || err);
    process.exit(1);
});

        console.log('TOTAL FEES:');
        console.log(tx.total_fees);

        if (lt === TARGET_LT) {
            console.log('\n*** TARGET TRANSACTION ***');
        }

        if (lt > TARGET_LT) {
            console.log('\n*** NEWER THAN TARGET ***');
        }
    }

    const target = transactions.find(
        (tx: any) => BigInt(tx.lt) === TARGET_LT
    );

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(70));
    console.log(' TARGET SEARCH');
    console.log('='.repeat(70));

    if (target) {

        console.log('\nTARGET FOUND: YES');

        console.log('\nTARGET TRANSACTION JSON:');

        console.log(
            JSON.stringify(target, null, 2)
        );

    } else {

        console.log('\nTARGET FOUND: NO');

        console.log(
            '\nThe first 20 transactions did not contain the target LT.'
        );
    }

    const newer = transactions.filter(
        (tx: any) => BigInt(tx.lt) > TARGET_LT
    );

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(70));
    console.log(' TRANSACTIONS AFTER TARGET');

FILE: scripts\readMemory19534CInit.mjs
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readI32LE(pos) {
    return (
        wasm[pos] |
        (wasm[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function hx(v, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("READ INITIAL MEMORY AT 0x19534C");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(`TARGET ADDRESS : ${hx(TARGET)}`);
console.log();

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// DATA SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let pos = 8;
let found = false;

while (pos < wasm.length) {

    const sectionId = wasm[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = uleb(pos);
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const sectionStart = pos;
    const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sizeInfo.value;

    if (sectionId === 11) {

        console.log("DATA SECTION FOUND");
        console.log(`SECTION : ${hx(sectionStart)} .. ${hx(sectionEnd)}`);
        console.log();

        let p = sectionStart;

        const countInfo = uleb(p);
        const count = countInfo.value;
        p = countInfo.next;

        console.log(`DATA SEGMENTS : ${count}`);
        console.log("-".repeat(72));

        for (let seg = 0; seg < count; seg++) {

            const flagsInfo = uleb(p);
            const flags = flagsInfo.value;
            p = flagsInfo.next;

            let memoryIndex = 0;
            let offsetValue = null;

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // Active segment
            // ------------------------------------------------
            if (flags === 0) {

                // offset expression
                const opcode = wasm[p++];

                if (opcode !== 0x41) {
                    console.log(
                        `SEGMENT ${seg}: unsupported offset opcode ${hx(opcode, 2)}`
                    );

                    process.exit(1);
                }

                const off = uleb(p);
                offsetValue = off.value;
                p = off.next;

                // end expression
                if (wasm[p] !== 0x0b) {
                    console.log(
                        `SEGMENT ${seg}: invalid offset expression`
                    );
                    process.exit(1);
                }

                p++;

            } else if (flags === 2) {

                const mem = uleb(p);
                memoryIndex = mem.value;
                p = mem.next;

                const opcode = wasm[p++];

                if (opcode !== 0x41) {
                    console.log(
                        `SEGMENT ${seg}: unsupported offset opcode`
                    );
                    process.exit(1);
                }

                const off = uleb(p);
                offsetValue = off.value;
                p = off.next;

                if (wasm[p] !== 0x0b) {
                    console.log(
                        `SEGMENT ${seg}: invalid offset expression`
                    );
                    process.exit(1);
                }

                p++;

            } else if (flags === 1) {

                // Passive segment: no fixed memory address.
                const lenInfo = uleb(p);
                const len = lenInfo.value;
                p = lenInfo.next + len;

                console.log(
                    `SEGMENT ${seg}: PASSIVE size=${len}`
                );

                continue;

            } else {

                console.log(
                    `SEGMENT ${seg}: unsupported flags=${flags}`
                );

                process.exit(1);
            }

            const sizeInfo2 = uleb(p);
            const dataSize = sizeInfo2.value;
            p = sizeInfo2.next;

            const dataStart = p;
            const dataEnd = p + dataSize;

            const segStart = offsetValue;
            const segEnd = offsetValue + dataSize;

            console.log(
                `SEGMENT ${seg}  memory=${memoryIndex} ` +
                `offset=${hx(offsetValue)} size=${dataSize} ` +
                `range=${hx(segStart)}..${hx(segEnd)}`
            );

            // ------------------------------------------------
            // Does this segment contain 0x19534C?
            // ------------------------------------------------
            if (
                memoryIndex === 0 &&
                TARGET >= segStart &&
                TARGET + 4 <= segEnd
            ) {

                found = true;

                const localOffset = TARGET - segStart;
                const wasmPos = dataStart + localOffset;

                const value = readI32LE(wasmPos);

                console.log();
                console.log("!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!");
                console.log("TARGET FOUND IN INITIAL DATA");
                console.log("!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!");
                console.log(`TARGET ADDRESS : ${hx(TARGET)}`);
                console.log(`SEGMENT        : ${seg}`);
                console.log(`SEGMENT OFFSET : ${hx(segStart)}`);
                console.log(`LOCAL OFFSET   : ${hx(localOffset)}`);
                console.log(`WASM DATA POS  : ${hx(wasmPos)}`);
                console.log(`RAW BYTES      : ${
                    [...wasm.slice(wasmPos, wasmPos + 4)]
                        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
                        .join(" ")
                }`);
                console.log(`I32 VALUE      : ${value}`);
                console.log(`I32 HEX        : ${hx(value)}`);
                console.log();
                console.log("THIS IS THE VALUE USED BY");
                console.log("CALL_INDIRECT IN FUNC 122.");
                console.log();
            }

            p = dataEnd;
        }
    }

    pos = sectionEnd;
}

console.log();

if (!found) {
    console.log("TARGET NOT FOUND IN INITIAL ACTIVE DATA SEGMENTS.");
    console.log("The value may be initialized dynamically.");
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("DONE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { JettonMaster } from '@ton/ton';

const ROUTER =
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3';

const TOKEN0_WALLET =
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq';

const TOKEN1_WALLET =
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3';

async function getMasterFromWallet(
    provider: NetworkProvider,
    walletAddress: string,
): Promise<Address> {
    const result = await provider.provider(
        Address.parse(walletAddress)
    ).get('get_wallet_data', []);

    // get_wallet_data:
    // 0 = balance
    // 1 = owner_address
    // 2 = jetton_master_address
    // 3 = wallet_code

    result.stack.readBigNumber();
    result.stack.readCell();

    const masterCell = result.stack.readCell();

    return masterCell.beginParse().loadAddress();
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('===== ROUTER JETTON WALLETS =====');

    const router = Address.parse(ROUTER);

    console.log('\nReading TOKEN0 master from Pool Wallet...');
    const token0Master =
        await getMasterFromWallet(provider, TOKEN0_WALLET);

    console.log(
        `TOKEN0 master: ${token0Master.toString()}`
    );

    console.log('\nReading TOKEN1 master from Pool Wallet...');
    const token1Master =
        await getMasterFromWallet(provider, TOKEN1_WALLET);

    console.log(
        `TOKEN1 master: ${token1Master.toString()}`
    );

    const token0JettonMaster = provider.open(
        JettonMaster.create(token0Master)
    );

    const token1JettonMaster = provider.open(
        JettonMaster.create(token1Master)
    );

    console.log('\nGetting Router TOKEN0 wallet...');

    const token0RouterWallet =
        await token0JettonMaster.getWalletAddress(router);

    console.log(
        `TOKEN0 Router wallet: ${token0RouterWallet.toString()}`
    );

    console.log('\nGetting Router TOKEN1 wallet...');

    const token1RouterWallet =
        await token1JettonMaster.getWalletAddress(router);

    console.log(
        `TOKEN1 Router wallet: ${token1RouterWallet.toString()}`
    );

    console.log('\n===== RESULT =====');
    console.log(`Router: ${ROUTER}`);

    console.log(
        `TOKEN0 master: ${token0Master.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `TOKEN0 router wallet: ${token0RouterWallet.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `TOKEN1 master: ${token1Master.toString()}`
    );

    console.log(
        `TOKEN1 router wallet: ${token1RouterWallet.toString()}`
    );

    console.log('\n===== DONE =====');
}

import { Address, beginCell, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';

const ORIGINAL_BOC_FILE =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\pton_v22_generated.boc';

const TON_TRANSFER_OPCODE = 0x01f3835d;
const PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE = 0x37c096df;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Exact values decoded from the original BOC
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const QUERY_ID = 0n;
const TON_AMOUNT = 249908n;

const USER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const ROUTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq'
);

const MIN_LP_OUT = 150109265n;

const BOTH_POSITIVE = true;

const DEX_CUSTOM_PAYLOAD_FORWARD_GAS = 0n;

// Decoded from original BOC
const DEADLINE = 1790763877n;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Helpers
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function hex(data: Buffer | Uint8Array): string {
    return Buffer.from(data).toString('hex');
}

function cellBoc(cell: Cell): string {
    return hex(cell.toBoc());
}

function cellHash(cell: Cell): string {
    return hex(cell.hash());
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Header
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log('='.repeat(75));
console.log(' STON.FI pTON v2.2 EXACT BOC REBUILDER');
console.log(' ORIGINAL vs REBUILT');
console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
console.log('='.repeat(75));

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Load original BOC
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const originalBoc = readFileSync(ORIGINAL_BOC_FILE);

const originalRoots = Cell.fromBoc(originalBoc);

if (originalRoots.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(
        `Expected exactly 1 original root, got ${originalRoots.length}`
    );
}

const originalRoot = originalRoots[0];

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Build PROVIDE_LP params ref
//
// SDK:
//
// beginCell()
//   .storeCoins(minLpOut)
//   .storeAddress(receiverAddress)
//   .storeUint(bothPositive ? 1 : 0, 1)
//   .storeCoins(dexCustomPayloadForwardGasAmount)
//   .storeMaybeRef(dexCustomPayload)
//   .endCell()
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const paramsRef = beginCell()
    .storeCoins(MIN_LP_OUT)
    .storeAddress(USER_WALLET)
    .storeUint(BOTH_POSITIVE ? 1 : 0, 1)
    .storeCoins(DEX_CUSTOM_PAYLOAD_FORWARD_GAS)
    .storeBit(false)
    .endCell();

// ------------------------------------------------------------

//
// SDK:
//
// storeUint(PROVIDE_LP, 32)
// storeAddress(routerWalletAddress)
// storeAddress(refundAddress)
// storeAddress(excessesAddress)
// storeUint(deadline, 64)
// storeRef(paramsRef)
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const provideLp = beginCell()
    .storeUint(PROVIDE_LP_OPCODE, 32)
    .storeAddress(ROUTER_WALLET)
    .storeAddress(USER_WALLET)
    .storeAddress(USER_WALLET)
    .storeUint(DEADLINE, 64)
    .storeRef(paramsRef)
    .endCell();

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Build pTON TON_TRANSFER
//
// SDK:
//
// storeUint(TON_TRANSFER, 32)
// storeUint(queryId, 64)
// storeCoins(tonAmount)
// storeAddress(refundAddress)
// storeBit(true)
// storeRef(forwardPayload)
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const rebuiltRoot = beginCell()
    .storeUint(TON_TRANSFER_OPCODE, 32)
    .storeUint(QUERY_ID, 64)
    .storeCoins(TON_AMOUNT)
    .storeAddress(USER_WALLET)
    .storeBit(true)
    .storeRef(provideLp)
    .endCell();

console.log('');

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Compare PROVIDE_LP child

const originalProvideLp =

if (!originalProvideLp) {
    throw new Error(

const originalHex = hex(originalBoc);
const rebuiltHex = hex(rebuiltBoc);

if (originalHex === rebuiltHex) {

    console.log('');

    console.log(' EXACT MATCH');
    console.log('===========================================================');

    console.log(
        'Original BOC and rebuilt BOC are byte-for-byte identical.'

} else {

    console.log('');
    console.log('===========================================================');
    console.log(' BOC DIFFERENCE DETECTED');
    console.log('===========================================================');

    const maxLength = Math.max(
        originalHex.length,
        rebuiltHex.length
    );

    let firstDifference = -1;

    for (let i = 0; i < maxLength; i++) {

        if (originalHex[i] !== rebuiltHex[i]) {
            firstDifference = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    console.log(
        'First differing HEX character:',
        firstDifference
    );

    if (firstDifference >= 0) {

        const byteOffset =
            Math.floor(firstDifference / 2);

        console.log(
            'Approximate byte offset:',
            byteOffset
        );

        console.log(
            'Original:',
            originalHex.slice(
                Math.max(0, firstDifference - 32),
                firstDifference + 64
            )
        );

        console.log(
            'Rebuilt:',
            rebuiltHex.slice(
                Math.max(0, firstDifference - 32),
                firstDifference + 64
            )
        );
    }

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const targets = [
  [6464, 0x22838e],
  [6611, 0x22c948],
  [6611, 0x22c9ef],
  [6613, 0x22cb34],
  [6615, 0x22cc55],
  [6615, 0x22cc5e],
  [6618, 0x22d083],
  [7467, 0x25093d],
  [7579, 0x2562b8],
] as const;

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function decode(p: number) {
  const op = wasm[p];

  if (op === 0x20)
    return [`local.get ${wasm[p + 1]}`, p + 2];

  if (op === 0x21)
    return [`local.set ${wasm[p + 1]}`, p + 2];

  if (op === 0x22)
    return [`local.tee ${wasm[p + 1]}`, p + 2];

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return [`i32.const ${x.value}`, x.next];
  }

  if (op === 0x28) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return [`i32.load offset=${x.value}`, x.next];
  }

  if (op === 0x36) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return [`i32.store offset=${x.value}`, x.next];
  }

  const simple: Record<number,string> = {
    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x6c: "i32.mul",
    0x47: "i32.lt_u",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x10: "call"
  };

  if (simple[op])
    return [simple[op], p + 1];

  return [`opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`, p + 1];
}

// Find the exact code body containing an offset.
function findBody(off: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 10 && off >= start && off < end)
      return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 113 ARG0 BACKWARD RESOLUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const [func, target] of targets) {

  const body = findBody(target);

  console.log(`\nFUNC ${func}  CALL113 @ ${hex(target)}`);
  console.log("--------------------------------------------");

  if (!body) {
    console.log("BODY NOT FOUND");
    continue;
  }

  // Decode the preceding ~100 bytes.
  let p = Math.max(body.start, target - 100);

  while (p < target) {
    const at = p;
    const [txt, next] = decode(p);

    console.log(`${hex(at)}  ${txt}`);

    p = next;
  }

  console.log(`${hex(target)}  >>> CALL 113`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const targets = new Set([
  141606,
  144293,
  149912,
  149932,
]);

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function readConst(pos: number) {
  if (wasm[pos] !== 0x41) return null;
  return uleb(pos + 1);
}

function fmt(p: number) {
  return "0x" + p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function opName(b: number) {
  const m: Record<number, string> = {
    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",
    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x42: "i64.const",
    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x71: "i32.and",
    0x72: "i32.or",
    0x73: "i32.xor",
    0x74: "i32.shl",
    0x79: "i32.rotl",
    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x4c: "i32.le_s",
    0x4d: "i32.gt_s",
    0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
    0x10: "call",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
    0x04: "if",
    0x02: "block",
    0x0b: "end",
  };
  return m[b] ?? `OP 0x${b.toString(16)}`;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 122 — BACKWARD ARGUMENT RESOLVER");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let total = 0;

for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length - 1; p++) {
  const c1 = readConst(p);
  if (!c1 || !targets.has(c1.value)) continue;

  // Search shortly after CONST1 for CONST2 + CALL 122
  let c2Pos = -1;
  let c2Value = -1;
  let callPos = -1;

  for (let q = c1.next; q < Math.min(wasm.length, c1.next + 20); q++) {
    const c2 = readConst(q);
    if (!c2) continue;

    for (let r = c2.next; r < Math.min(wasm.length, c2.next + 10); r++) {
      if (wasm[r] !== 0x10) continue;

      const f = uleb(r + 1);
      if (f.value === 122) {
        c2Pos = q;
        c2Value = c2.value;
        callPos = r;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (callPos >= 0) break;
  }

  if (callPos < 0) continue;

  total++;

  console.log("");
  console.log(`CALL122 #${total} @ ${fmt(callPos)}`);
  console.log(`  CONST1 = ${c1.value} (${fmt(c1.value)})`);
  console.log(`  CONST2 = ${c2Value} (${fmt(c2Value)})`);
  console.log("  BACKWARD:");

  // Show previous 18 bytes, decoding simple producers
  const start = Math.max(0, p - 45);

  for (let x = start; x < p; ) {
    const b = wasm[x];
    let text = opName(b);
    let next = x + 1;

    if (b === 0x20 || b === 0x21 || b === 0x22) {
      const z = uleb(x + 1);
      text += ` ${z.value}`;
      next = z.next;
    } else if (b === 0x41 || b === 0x42) {
      const z = uleb(x + 1);
      text += ` ${z.value}`;
      next = z.next;
    } else if (b === 0x10) {
      const z = uleb(x + 1);
      text += ` FUNC_${z.value}`;
      next = z.next;
    }

    console.log(`    ${fmt(x)}  ${text}`);
    x = next;
  }

  if (total >= 20) break;
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_FILE = 0x4c605c;

let p = 8;

function u(): number {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x: number;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return v >>> 0;
}

console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const size = u();
  const sectionStart = p;
  const end = p + size;

  if (id !== 11) {
    p = end;
    continue;
  }

  const segmentCount = u();

  console.log("DATA SECTION START : 0x" + sectionStart.toString(16));
  console.log("SEGMENT COUNT       :", segmentCount);
  console.log("");

  for (let s = 0; s < segmentCount; s++) {
    const flags = u();

    let memoryOffset = 0;

    if (flags === 0) {
      if (b[p++] !== 0x41) {
        console.log("Unexpected offset expression");
        process.exit(1);
      }
      memoryOffset = u();

      if (b[p++] !== 0x0b) {
        console.log("Unexpected offset end");
        process.exit(1);
      }
    } else if (flags === 2) {
      u(); // memory index
      if (b[p++] !== 0x41) {
        console.log("Unexpected offset expression");

      }
      memoryOffset = u();
      if (b[p++] !== 0x0b) {
        console.log("Unexpected offset end");
        process.exit(1);
      }
    } else {
      console.log("UNSUPPORTED FLAGS:", flags);
      process.exit(1);
    }

    const len = u();
    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + len;

    if (
      TARGET_FILE >= payloadStart &&
      TARGET_FILE < payloadEnd
    ) {
      const delta = TARGET_FILE - payloadStart;
      const runtimeAddress = memoryOffset + delta;

      console.log("############################################################");
      console.log("TARGET SEGMENT FOUND");
      console.log("############################################################");
      console.log("SEGMENT       :", s);
      console.log("FLAGS         :", flags);
      console.log("MEMORY START  : 0x" + memoryOffset.toString(16));
      console.log("PAYLOAD START : 0x" + payloadStart.toString(16));
      console.log("PAYLOAD END   : 0x" + payloadEnd.toString(16));
      console.log("TARGET FILE   : 0x" + TARGET_FILE.toString(16));
      console.log("DELTA         : 0x" + delta.toString(16));

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const CALLS = [
  { func: 473,  addr: 0x00020087 },
  { func: 599,  addr: 0x000284fb },
  { func: 1249, addr: 0x00057842 },
  { func: 1601, addr: 0x00071954 },
  { func: 2161, addr: 0x0009b0b8 },
  { func: 2161, addr: 0x0009b0fe },
  { func: 3490, addr: 0x0010da53 },
  { func: 6665, addr: 0x0022fa9e },
  { func: 7020, addr: 0x0023d95e },
];

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function section(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

function getBodies() {
  const sec = section(10);
  let p = sec.start;

  const n = uleb(p);
  p = n.next;

  const out: {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    code: number;
  }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const sz = uleb(p);
    p = sz.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + sz.value;

    const locals = uleb(p);
    p = locals.next;

    for (let j = 0; j < locals.value; j++) {
      const count = uleb(p);
      p = count.next;

      // value type
      p++;
    }

    out.push({
      start,
      end,
      code: p,
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return out;
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

type Expr = string;

function readI32Const(p: number) {
  const r = uleb(p);
  return {
    value: r.value | 0,
    next: r.next,
  };
}

function decodeBefore(
  start: number,
  target: number
) {
  const stack: Expr[] = [];
  const locals = new Map<number, Expr>();

  let p = start;

  function pop(): Expr {
    if (!stack.length) return "<?>";

    return stack.pop()!;
  }

  function push(x: Expr) {
    stack.push(x);
  }

  while (p < target) {
    const opPos = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    switch (op) {
      case 0x20: {
        // local.get
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.next;

        const local = r.value;

        push(
          locals.get(local) ?? `local[${local}]`
        );
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        // local.set
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.next;

        const local = r.value;
        const v = pop();

        locals.set(local, v);
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        // local.tee
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.next;

        const local = r.value;
        const v = pop();

        locals.set(local, v);
        push(v);
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        const r = readI32Const(p);
        p = r.next;

        push(`i32.const(${r.value})`);
        break;
      }

      case 0x28: {
        // i32.load
        const align = uleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const off = uleb(p);
        p = off.next;

        const addr = pop();

        push(
          `i32.load(${addr}+${hex(off.value)})`
        );
        break;
      }

      case 0x36: {
        // i32.store
        const align = uleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const off = uleb(p);
        p = off.next;

        const value = pop();
        const addr = pop();

        locals.set(
          -1,
          `STORE[${addr}+${hex(off.value)}]=${value}`
        );
        break;
      }

      case 0x6a: {
        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(`(${a}+${b})`);
        break;
      }

      case 0x6b: {
        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(`(${a}-${b})`);
        break;
      }

      case 0x6c: {
        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(`(${a}*${b})`);
        break;
      }

      case 0x4a: {
        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(`(${a}!=${b})`);
        break;
      }

      case 0x45: {
        const a = pop();

        push(`(${a}==0)`);
        break;
      }

      case 0x47: {
        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(`(${a}==${b})`);
        break;
      }

      case 0x04: {
        // if
        const blockType = wasm[p++];

        console.log(
          `  ${hex(opPos)} IF type=${blockType.toString(16)}`
        );

        pop();
        break;
      }

      case 0x05:
        console.log(`  ${hex(opPos)} ELSE`);
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        console.log(`  ${hex(opPos)} END`);
        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.next;

        console.log(
          `  ${hex(opPos)} BR ${r.value}`
        );
        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.next;

        console.log(
          `  ${hex(opPos)} BR_IF ${r.value}`
        );

        pop();
        break;
      }

      case 0x0f:
        console.log(`  ${hex(opPos)} RETURN`);
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const r = uleb(p);
        p = r.next;

        const args = [...stack];

        stack.length = 0;

        push(
          `CALL[${r.value}](${args.join(", ")})`
        );

        console.log(
          `  ${hex(opPos)} CALL ${r.value}`
        );

        break;
      }

      case 0x1a: {
        pop();
        break;
      }

      case 0x1b: {
        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(`select(${a},${b})`);
        break;
      }

      case 0x36:
        p++;
        break;

      default: {
        /*
         * Unknown opcode.
         * Stop instead of corrupting the symbolic stack.
         */
        return {
          stack,
          locals,
          stoppedAt: opPos,
          opcode: op,
        };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    stack,
    locals,
    stoppedAt: target,
    opcode: -1,
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_BODIES = new Set([
    0x0001ddd6,
    0x0001dee3
]);

function uleb(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function findCodeSection() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const s = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        if (id === 10) {
            return { start, end };
        }

        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

/*
 * Count imported functions.
 */
function countImportedFunctions() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const s = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        if (id === 2) {
            let x = start;

            const c = uleb(wasm, x);
            x = c.next;

            let count = 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {

                const ml = uleb(wasm, x);
                x = ml.next + ml.value;

                const nl = uleb(wasm, x);
                x = nl.next + nl.value;

                const kind = wasm[x++];

                if (kind === 0) {
                    count++;

                    const t = uleb(wasm, x);
                    x = t.next;
                }
                else if (kind === 1) {
                    x++; // ref type
                    x = skipLimits(x);
                }
                else if (kind === 2) {
                    x = skipLimits(x);
                }
                else if (kind === 3) {
                    x += 2;
                }
                else if (kind === 4) {
                    x++;
                    const t = uleb(wasm, x);
                    x = t.next;
                }
            }

            return count;
        }

        p = end;
    }

    return 0;
}

function skipLimits(p: number) {
    const flags = wasm[p++];

    const min = uleb(wasm, p);
    p = min.next;

    if (flags & 1) {
        const max = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = max.next;
    }

    return p;
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 4154;
const TARGET_SLOT = 114;
const TARGET_TYPE = 0;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32(p: number): number {
    return (
        wasm[p] |
        (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

interface Ins {
    off: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    imm?: number;
    memOffset?: number;
}

interface FuncBody {
    index: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    code: number[];
}

function parseSections(): {
    codePayload: number;
    codeSize: number;
    codeCount: number;
} {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];
        const s = readULEB(p);
        const size = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const payload = p;

        if (id === 10) {
            const c = readULEB(p);
            return {
                codePayload: payload,
                codeSize: size,
                codeCount: c.value
            };
        }

        p += size;
    }

    throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

function parseCodeBodies(): FuncBody[] {
    const sec = parseSections();

    let p = sec.codePayload;
    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    const bodies: FuncBody[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const s = readULEB(p);
        const bodySize = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

        const localDecl = readULEB(p);
        p = localDecl.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localDecl.value; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(p);
            p = n.next;
            p++; // valtype
        }

        const codeStart = p;
        const code: number[] = [];

        while (p < bodyEnd)
            code.push(wasm[p++]);

        bodies.push({
            index: 83 + i,
            start: codeStart,
            end: bodyEnd,
            code
        });
    }

    return bodies;
}

function decodeAt(body: FuncBody, rel: number): Ins | null {
    const b = body.code;
    const p0 = rel;

    if (p0 >= b.length)
        return null;

    const op = b[p0];

    const one = (text: string): Ins => ({
        off: body.start + p0,
        op,
        text
    });

    // control
    if (op === 0x00) return one("unreachable");
    if (op === 0x01) return one("nop");
    if (op === 0x02) return one("block");
    if (op === 0x03) return one("loop");
    if (op === 0x04) return one("if");
    if (op === 0x05) return one("else");
    if (op === 0x0b) return one("end");

    if (op === 0x0c) {
        const x = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return { off: body.start + p0, op, text: `br ${x.value}`, imm: x.value };
    }

    if (op === 0x0d) {
        const x = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return { off: body.start + p0, op, text: `br_if ${x.value}`, imm: x.value };
    }

    if (op === 0x0e) {
        let q = body.start + p0 + 1;
        const n = readULEB(q);
        q = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
            const x = readULEB(q);
            q = x.next;
        }

        const d = readULEB(q);

        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `br_table`,
            imm: d.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x0f) return one("return");

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `call ${x.value}`,
            imm: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const t = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        const tb = readULEB(t.next);

        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tb.value}`,
            imm: t.value
        };
    }

    // locals
    if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
            imm: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
            imm: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
            imm: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x23) {
        const x = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `global.get ${x.value}`,
            imm: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x24) {
        const x = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `global.set ${x.value}`,
            imm: x.value
        };
    }

    // constants
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = readSLEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
            imm: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = readSLEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
            imm: x.value
        };
    }

    // memory load family
    const loads: Record<number, string> = {
        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
        0x30: "i64.load8_s",
        0x31: "i64.load8_u",
        0x32: "i64.load16_s",
        0x33: "i64.load16_u",
        0x34: "i64.load32_s",
        0x35: "i64.load32_u"
    };

    if (loads[op]) {
        const a = readULEB(body.start + p0 + 1);
        const o = readULEB(a.next);

        return {
            off: body.start + p0,
            op,
            text: `${loads[op]} offset=${o.value}`,
            memOffset: o.value
        };
    }

    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",
        0x48: "i32.lt_s",
        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
        0x67: "i32.clz",
        0x68: "i32.ctz",
        0x69: "i32.popcnt",
        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",
        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",
        0x74: "i32.shl",
        0x75: "i32.shr_s",
        0x76: "i32.shr_u",
        0x77: "i32.rotl",
        0x78: "i32.rotr"
    };

    if (names[op])
        return one(names[op]);

    return one(`op=0x${op.toString(16)}`);
}

function decodeBody(body: FuncBody): Ins[] {
    const out: Ins[] = [];

    let p = 0;

    while (p < body.code.length) {
        const ins = decodeAt(body, p);
        if (!ins)
            break;

        out.push(ins);

        const rel = ins.off - body.start;
        let next = rel + 1;

        const op = body.code[rel];

        if (
            op === 0x0c ||
            op === 0x0d ||
            op === 0x10 ||
            op === 0x20 ||
            op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22 ||
            op === 0x23 ||
            op === 0x24 ||
            op === 0x41 ||
            op === 0x42
        ) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + next);
            next = x.next - body.start;
        }
        else if (op === 0x11) {
            const a = readULEB(body.start + next);
            const b = readULEB(a.next);
            next = b.next - body.start;
        }
        else if (
            op >= 0x28 &&
            op <= 0x35
        ) {
            const a = readULEB(body.start + next);
            const b = readULEB(a.next);
            next = b.next - body.start;
        }
        else if (op === 0x0e) {
            const a = readULEB(body.start + next);
            let q = a.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < a.value; i++) {
                q = readULEB(q).next;
            }

            q = readULEB(q).next;
            next = q - body.start;
        }

        p = next;
    }

    return out;
}

function hex(x: number): string {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function showWindow(ins: Ins[], center: number, radius = 7) {
    const i = ins.findIndex(x => x.off === center);

    if (i < 0)
        return;

    const a = Math.max(0, i - radius);
    const b = Math.min(ins.length, i + radius + 1);

    for (let j = a; j < b; j++) {
        const x = ins[j];
        console.log(
            `    ${hex(x.off)} ${x.text}`
        );
    }
}

function findPrevLocalDefs(
    ins: Ins[],
    index: number,
    local: number
): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];

    for (let i = index - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const x = ins[i];

        if (
            (x.text === `local.set ${local}`) ||
            (x.text === `local.tee ${local}`)
        ) {
            out.push(i);

            if (out.length >= 12)
                break;
        }
    }

    return out;
}

export async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
