    console.log("Target function :", TARGET_FUNC);
    console.log("Target table slot :", TARGET_SLOT);
    console.log("Target type :", TARGET_TYPE);
    console.log("");

    const bodies = parseCodeBodies();

    console.log("Code bodies :", bodies.length);
    console.log("");

    let indirectSites = 0;
    let targetTypeSites = 0;

    const interesting: {
        body: FuncBody;
        ins: Ins[];
        index: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (const body of bodies) {
        const ins = decodeBody(body);

        for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
            const x = ins[i];

            if (
                x.text ===
                `call_indirect type=${TARGET_TYPE} table=0`
            ) {
                indirectSites++;
                targetTypeSites++;

                interesting.push({
                    body,
                    ins,
                    index: i
                });
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("type-0/table-0 sites :", targetTypeSites);
    console.log("");

    let exact114 = 0;
    let constantOther = 0;
    let load = 0;
    let call = 0;
    let local = 0;
    let arithmetic = 0;
    let unknown = 0;

    let printed = 0;

    for (const site of interesting) {
        const { body, ins, index } = site;

        /*
         * The stack immediately before call_indirect contains:
         *
         *   ... function-index
         *
         * We inspect the instruction immediately before it and
         * recursively follow local definitions.
         */

        let i = index - 1;

        if (i < 0) {
            unknown++;
            continue;
        }

        const x = ins[i];

        if (x.text === `i32.const ${TARGET_SLOT}`) {
            exact114++;

            if (printed < 20) {
                console.log(
                    `EXACT CONST(114): func=${body.index} call=${hex(ins[index].off)}`
                );
                showWindow(ins, ins[index].off);
                console.log("");
                printed++;
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (
            x.text.startsWith("i32.const ")
        ) {
            constantOther++;

            if (printed < 20) {
                console.log(
                    `OTHER CONST: func=${body.index} value=${x.imm} call=${hex(ins[index].off)}`
                );
                showWindow(ins, ins[index].off);
                console.log("");
                printed++;
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (
            x.text.startsWith("i32.load") ||
            x.text.startsWith("i64.load")
        ) {
            load++;

            if (printed < 20) {
                console.log(
                    `ROOT LOAD: func=${body.index} offset=${x.memOffset} call=${hex(ins[index].off)}`
                );
                showWindow(ins, ins[index].off);
                console.log("");
                printed++;
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (x.text.startsWith("call ")) {
            call++;

            if (printed < 20) {
                console.log(
                    `ROOT CALL: func=${body.index} ${x.text} call=${hex(ins[index].off)}`
                );
                showWindow(ins, ins[index].off);
                console.log("");
                printed++;
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (x.text.startsWith("local.get")) {
            local++;

            const m = x.text.match(/local\.get (\d+)/);

            if (m && printed < 20) {
                const localNo = Number(m[1]);
                const defs = findPrevLocalDefs(ins, i, localNo);

                console.log(
                    `ROOT LOCAL: func=${body.index} local=${localNo} call=${hex(ins[index].off)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  definitions found : ${defs.length}`
                );

                for (const d of defs.slice(0, 4)) {
                    console.log(
                        `  DEF @ ${hex(ins[d].off)} ${ins[d].text}`
                    );
                }

                showWindow(ins, ins[index].off);
                console.log("");
                printed++;
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (
            x.text === "i32.add" ||
            x.text === "i32.sub" ||
            x.text === "i32.mul" ||
            x.text === "i32.and" ||
            x.text === "i32.or" ||
            x.text === "i32.xor" ||
            x.text === "i32.shl" ||
            x.text === "i32.shr_s" ||
            x.text === "i32.shr_u"
        ) {
            arithmetic++;

            if (printed < 20) {
                console.log(
                    `ROOT ARITH: func=${body.index} ${x.text} call=${hex(ins[index].off)}`
                );
                showWindow(ins, ins[index].off);
                console.log("");
                printed++;
            }

            continue;
        }

        unknown++;
    }

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("SUMMARY");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("");
    console.log("type-0/table-0 sites :", targetTypeSites);
    console.log("Exact CONST(114)     :", exact114);
    console.log("Other constants      :", constantOther);
    console.log("LOAD roots           :", load);
    console.log("CALL roots           :", call);
    console.log("LOCAL roots          :", local);
    console.log("Arithmetic roots     :", arithmetic);
    console.log("Unknown roots        :", unknown);
    console.log("");

    if (exact114 > 0) {
        console.log(
            "!!! DIRECT 114 PRODUCER FOUND !!!"
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            "No direct CONST(114) immediately before call_indirect."
        );
        console.log(
            "Next step: resolve LOAD/CALL/LOCAL roots to actual values."
        );
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function readVec(pos: number) {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  const arr: number[] = [];
  pos = n.next;
  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(pos);
    arr.push(x.value);
    pos = x.next;
  }
  return { arr, next: pos };
}

// Parse sections and collect function type indices.
// Function section gives type index for defined funcs.
// Import section is needed because function numbering includes imports.

let p = 8;
let funcSection: number[] = [];
let importedFuncCount = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  const start = sz.next;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (id === 2) {
    let q = start;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const ml = uleb(q); q = ml.next + ml.value;
      const nl = uleb(q); q = nl.next + nl.value;

      const kind = b[q++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        uleb(q); q = uleb(q).next; // overwritten below
      }

      // Reparse cleanly is easier from section start, so stop here.
      // This pass only counts imported functions by scanning kind.
    }
  }

  if (id === 3) {
    const r = readVec(start);
    funcSection = r.arr;
  }

  p = end;
}

// Reparse import section correctly.
p = 8;
while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  const start = sz.next;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (id === 2) {
    let q = start;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const ml = uleb(q); q = ml.next + ml.value;
      const nl = uleb(q); q = nl.next + nl.value;

      const kind = b[q++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        uleb(q); q = uleb(q).next;
        importedFuncCount++;
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        q++; // elemtype
        const flags = uleb(q); q = flags.next;
        const limMin = uleb(q); q = limMin.next;
        if (flags.value & 1) {
          q = uleb(q).next;
        }
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        q = uleb(q).next;
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        q += 2;
      }
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

function funcType(funcNo: number) {
  const definedIndex = funcNo - importedFuncCount;
  if (definedIndex < 0 || definedIndex >= funcSection.length)
    return null;
  return funcSection[definedIndex];
}

// Parse type section.
let types: { params: number[]; results: number[] }[] = [];

p = 8;
while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  const start = sz.next;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (id === 1) {
    let q = start;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const form = b[q++];
      if (form !== 0x60) throw new Error("bad functype");

      const np = uleb(q); q = np.next;
      const params = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < np.value; j++) {
        params.push(b[q++]);
      }

      const nr = uleb(q); q = nr.next;
      const results = [];
      for (let j = 0; j < nr.value; j++) {
        results.push(b[q++]);
      }

      types.push({ params, results });
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

for (const fn of [113, 306]) {
  const ti = funcType(fn);
  console.log(`FUNC ${fn}`);
  console.log(`IMPORT COUNT : ${importedFuncCount}`);
  console.log(`TYPE INDEX   : ${ti}`);

  if (ti !== null) {
    const t = types[ti];
    console.log(
      `SIGNATURE    : (${t.params.map(x => x === 0x7f ? "i32" : "0x" + x.toString(16)).join(", ")}) -> (${t.results.map(x => x === 0x7f ? "i32" : "0x" + x.toString(16)).join(", ")})`
    );
  }

  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v=0,s=0;
  while(true){
    const x=b[p++];
    v+=(x&127)*2**s;
    if(!(x&128)) return [v>>>0,p];
    s+=7;
  }
}

// Find sections
let p=8;
let typeSec=null, funcSec=null, tableSec=null, elemSec=null, codeSec=null;

while(p<b.length){
  const id=b[p++];
  const [n,q]=u(p); p=q;
  const start=p, end=p+n;

  if(id===1) typeSec=[start,end];
  if(id===3) funcSec=[start,end];
  if(id===4) tableSec=[start,end];
  if(id===9) elemSec=[start,end];
  if(id===10) codeSec=[start,end];

  p=end;
}

// ---------------- TYPES ----------------
const types=[];

{
  let q=typeSec[0];
  const [count,q0]=u(q); q=q0;

  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const form=b[q++];
    const [pc,q1]=u(q); q=q1;

    const params=[];
    for(let j=0;j<pc;j++) params.push(b[q++]);

    const [rc,q2]=u(q); q=q2;

    const results=[];
    for(let j=0;j<rc;j++) results.push(b[q++]);

    types.push({params,results});
  }
}

// ---------------- FUNCTION TYPE ----------------
let funcTypes=[];

{
  let q=funcSec[0];
  const [count,q0]=u(q); q=q0;

  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const [t,q1]=u(q); q=q1;
    funcTypes.push(t);
  }
}

// ---------------- TABLE 0 ----------------
let table0=[];

{
  let q=elemSec[0];
  const [segments,q0]=u(q); q=q0;

  for(let s=0;s<segments;s++){

    const flags=b[q++];

    // flags 0 = active table0, offset expr follows
    if(flags===0){
      q++; // i32.const opcode

      const [,q1]=u(q); q=q1;

      q++; // end

      const [cnt,q2]=u(q); q=q2;

      for(let i=0;i<cnt;i++){
        const [f,q3]=u(q); q=q3;
        table0.push(f);
      }
    }
    else {
      // This script only needs active segment 0.
      // Stop parsing other forms conservatively.
      break;
    }
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos:number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return { value:v >>> 0, next:p };
}

console.log("============================================================");

let p = 8;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];
  const s = uleb(p);
  p = s.next;
  const end = p + s.value;

  if (id === 1) {
    let q = p;

    for (let i=0; i<n.value; i++) {
      const form = wasm[q++];
      const pc = uleb(q); q = pc.next;

      const params:number[] = [];

        params.push(wasm[q++]);

      const rc = uleb(q); q = rc.next;
      const results:number[] = [];
      for(let j=0;j<rc.value;j++) {
        results.push(wasm[q++]);
      }

      types.push({i,form,params,results});
    }
  }

  if(id === 2) {
    let q = p;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for(let i=0;i<n.value;i++) {
      const ml=uleb(q); q=ml.next+ml.value;
      const nl=uleb(q); q=nl.next+nl.value;
      const kind=wasm[q++];

      if(kind===0) {
        q=uleb(q).next;
        imported++;
      } else if(kind===1) {
        q++;
        q=uleb(q).next;
        q=uleb(q).next;
      } else if(kind===2) {
        q=uleb(q).next;
        q=uleb(q).next;
      } else if(kind===3) {
        q+=2;
      }
    }
  }

  if(id === 10) {
    let q=p;
    const n=uleb(q); q=n.next;

    const targets=[113,306];

    for(let i=0;i<n.value;i++) {
      const bs=uleb(q); q=bs.next;
      const st=q, en=q+bs.value;
      const fn=imported+i;

      if(targets.includes(fn)) {
        console.log("");

        console.log(`BODY 0x${st.toString(16)} .. 0x${en.toString(16)}`);

        for(let z=st;z<en;) {
          const pos=z;
          const op=wasm[z++];
          let imm="";

          if(
            op===0x20 || op===0x21 || op===0x22 ||
            op===0x10 || op===0x0c || op===0x0d ||
            op===0x41 || op===0x42
          ) {
            const x=uleb(z);
            imm=` ${x.value}`;
            z=x.next;
          }
          else if(op>=0x28 && op<=0x3e) {
            const a=uleb(z); z=a.next;
            const o=uleb(z); z=o.next;
            imm=` align=${a.value} offset=0x${o.value.toString(16)}`;
          }
          else if(op===0x11) {
            const t=uleb(z); z=t.next;
            const tab=uleb(z); z=tab.next;
            imm=` type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
          }

          console.log(
            `0x${pos.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
            `${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}${imm}`

        }

function uleb(pos) {

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x11793;
const END   = 0x11887;

function readULEB(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let n = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    n++;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function readSLEB(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let n = 0;
  let x;

  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    n++;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: v | 0, len: n };
}

function hx(v) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("FUNC 104 SELECTOR 16 RESOLUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(`BODY : ${hx(START)} .. ${hx(END)}`);
console.log("SELECTOR : 16");
console.log("-".repeat(72));

/*
 * Find br_table.
 *
 * FUNC 104 contains:
 *
 *   local.get 1
 *   br_table ...
 *
 * We decode the complete label vector and default label.
 */

let p = START;
let found = false;

while (p < END) {

  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  if (op !== 0x0e)
    continue;

  found = true;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  if (!count) break;

  p += count.len;

  console.log(`br_table @ ${hx(at)}`);
  console.log(`LABEL COUNT : ${count.value}`);
  console.log("");

  const labels = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    if (!r) break;

    p += r.len;

    labels.push(r.value);

    console.log(
      `LABEL[${i}] = ${r.value}`
    );
  }

  const def = readULEB(p);

  if (def) {
    p += def.len;

    console.log(`DEFAULT    = ${def.value}`);
  }

  console.log("");

  if (16 < labels.length) {
    console.log(
      `SELECTOR 16 -> LABEL ${labels[16]}`
    );
  } else {
    console.log("SELECTOR 16 -> DEFAULT");
    console.log(`DEFAULT LABEL = ${def?.value}`);
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("-".repeat(72));

  /*
   * Print the complete body with offsets so the selected
   * branch can be located from its nesting/label structure.
   */

  p = START;

  while (p < END) {

    const q = p;
    const x = b[p++];

    let s =
      `${hx(q)}  ${x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

    if (x === 0x20) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      s += `  local.get ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (x === 0x21) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      s += `  local.set ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (x === 0x22) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      s += `  local.tee ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (x === 0x41) {
      const r = readSLEB(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      s += `  i32.const ${r.value} (${hx(r.value)})`;
    }

    else if (x === 0x28 || x === 0x36) {
      const align = b[p++];
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;

      s +=
        `  ${x === 0x28 ? "i32.load" : "i32.store"}` +
        ` align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (x === 0x10) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      s += `  call ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (x === 0x0e) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;

      p += r.len;

      const labs = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
        const z = readULEB(p);
        if (!z) break;
        p += z.len;
        labs.push(z.value);
      }

      const d = readULEB(p);
      if (d) p += d.len;

      s +=
        `  br_table count=${r.value} ` +
        `labels=[${labs.join(",")}] default=${d?.value}`;
    }

    else if (x === 0x0f) {
      s += "  return";
    }

    else if (x === 0x0b) {
      s += "  end";
    }

    else if (x === 0x0c || x === 0x0d) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;
      p += r.len;
      s += `${x === 0x0c ? "  br" : "  br_if"} ${r.value}`;
    }

    else {
      s += `  opcode=0x${x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
    }

    console.log(s);
  }

  break;
}

if (!found)
  console.log("br_table NOT FOUND");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 106;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8;
let importedFunctions = 0;
let targetType = null;
let functionSection = null;
let typeSection = null;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FIND SECTIONS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

while (p < b.length) {

  const id = b[p++];

  const s = uleb(p);
  p = s.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + s.value;

  if (id === 2) {
    // IMPORT SECTION
    let q = start;

    const count = uleb(q);
    q = count.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

      // module name
      const ml = uleb(q);
      q = ml.next + ml.value;

      // import name
      const nl = uleb(q);
      q = nl.next + nl.value;

      const kind = b[q++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        // function
        const t = uleb(q);
        q = t.next;
        importedFunctions++;

      } else if (kind === 1) {
        // table
        q++;

        const flags = uleb(q);
        q = flags.next;

        q = uleb(q).next;

        if (flags.value & 1)
          q = uleb(q).next;

      } else if (kind === 2) {
        // memory
        const flags = uleb(q);
        q = flags.next;

        q = uleb(q).next;

        if (flags.value & 1)
          q = uleb(q).next;

      } else if (kind === 3) {
        // global
        q += 2;
      }
    }
  }

  if (id === 3) {
    functionSection = {
      start,
      end
    };
  }

  if (id === 1) {
    typeSection = {
      start,
      end
    };
  }

  p = end;
}

  );
}

    targetType = t.value;

function typeName(x) {

  if (x === 0x7f) return "i32";
  if (x === 0x7e) return "i64";
  if (x === 0x7d) return "f32";
  if (x === 0x7c) return "f64";
  if (x === 0x70) return "funcref";
  if (x === 0x6f) return "externref";

  return `0x${x.toString(16)}`;
}

for (let i = 0; i < typeCount.value; i++) {

  const form = b[q++];

  if (form !== 0x60)
    throw new Error(
      `Unexpected type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at type ${i}`
    );

  const pc = uleb(q);
  q = pc.next;

  const params = [];

  for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++)
    params.push(b[q++]);

  const rc = uleb(q);
  q = rc.next;

  const results = [];

  for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++)
    results.push(b[q++]);

  if (i === targetType) {

    console.log("TARGET TYPE FOUND");
    console.log("--------------------------------------------");

    console.log(`TYPE INDEX  : ${i}`);
    console.log(`PARAM COUNT : ${params.length}`);

    params.forEach((x, n) => {
      console.log(
        `  PARAM ${n} : ${typeName(x)}`
      );
    });

    console.log(`RESULT COUNT : ${results.length}`);

    results.forEach((x, n) => {
      console.log(
        `  RESULT ${n} : ${typeName(x)}`
      );
    });

    console.log("");

    console.log(
      `SIGNATURE : (${params.map(typeName).join(", ")}) -> (${results.map(typeName).join(", ")})`
    );
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 1968;

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return [v >>> 0, p];
}

const typeNames = {
  0x7f: "i32",
  0x7e: "i64",
  0x7d: "f32",
  0x7c: "f64"
};

let p = 8;
let typeSection = null;
let funcSection = null;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  let size;
  [size, p] = u(p);

  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  if (id === 1) typeSection = [start, end];
  if (id === 3) funcSection = [start, end];

  p = end;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 1968 TYPE RESOLUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

// Parse type section
const types = [];

{
  let q = typeSection[0];
  let n;
  [n, q] = u(q);

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const form = b[q++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      console.log("UNEXPECTED TYPE FORM", form);
      break;
    }

    let pc;
    [pc, q] = u(q);

    const params = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < pc; j++) {
      params.push(typeNames[b[q++]] ?? "unknown");
    }

    let rc;
    [rc, q] = u(q);

    const results = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < rc; j++) {
      results.push(typeNames[b[q++]] ?? "unknown");
    }

    types.push({ params, results });
  }
}

// Function section
let targetType = null;

{
  let q = funcSection[0];
  let n;
  [n, q] = u(q);

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let typeidx;
    [typeidx, q] = u(q);

    const func = i + 91;

    if (func === TARGET) {
      targetType = typeidx;
      break;
    }
  }
}

console.log("FUNC        :", TARGET);

if (targetType !== null) {
  console.log(

    types[targetType].params.join(", ") || "()"
  );

  );

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGETS = new Set([
  0x0019534c,
  0x00195350,
  0x00195354,
  0x00195358,
]);

const FUNC = 1974;
const BODY_START = 0x00093e16;
const BODY_END = 0x00093f30;

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("RESOLVE FUNC1974 STORE ADDRESSES");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(60));
console.log(`FUNCTION = ${FUNC}`);
console.log(`BODY = ${hex(BODY_START)} .. ${hex(BODY_END)}`);
console.log("TARGETS:");
for (const x of TARGETS) console.log(`  ${hex(x)}`);
console.log();

console.log("IMPORTANT:");
console.log("We resolve the ADDRESS operand of i32.store.");
console.log("The preceding constant 0x19534c is NOT assumed to be");
console.log("the store destination.");
console.log();

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

type Instr = {
  addr: number;
  op: number;
  name: string;
  imm?: number;
};

const localNames: Record<number, string> = {};

function localName(i: number) {
  return `local${i}`;
}

function decode(start: number, end: number): Instr[] {
  const out: Instr[] = [];
  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op === 0x0b) {
      out.push({ addr, op, name: "end" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: "local.get",
        imm: x.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: "local.set",
        imm: x.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: "local.tee",
        imm: x.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = sleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: "i32.const",
        imm: x.value >>> 0,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      const y = uleb(p);
      p = y.next;

      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: `i32.load offset=${hex(y.value)}`,
        imm: y.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x36) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      const y = uleb(p);
      p = y.next;

      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: `i32.store offset=${hex(y.value)}`,
        imm: y.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6a) {
      out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.add" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6b) {
      out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.sub" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x47) {
      out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.ne" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x45) {
      out.push({ addr, op, name: "i32.eqz" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: "call",
        imm: x.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0d) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: "br_if",
        imm: x.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x24) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: "global.set",
        imm: x.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x23) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        addr,
        op,
        name: "global.get",
        imm: x.value,
      });
      continue;
    }

    // i32 load/store variants and common simple instructions
    // that are not needed for exact destination resolution.
    out.push({
      addr,
      op,
      name: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
    });
  }

  return out;
}

const ins = decode(BODY_START, BODY_END);

console.log(`INSTRUCTIONS = ${ins.length}`);
console.log();

function showWindow(index: number, radius = 14) {
  const a = Math.max(0, index - radius);
  const b = Math.min(ins.length, index + radius + 1);

  for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {
    const x = ins[i];

    let extra = "";

    if (
      x.name === "local.get" ||
      x.name === "local.set" ||
      x.name === "local.tee"
    ) {
      extra = ` ${localName(x.imm!)}`;
    } else if (x.name === "i32.const") {
      extra = ` ${hex(x.imm!)}`;
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(x.addr)} ${x.name}${extra}`
    );
  }
}

const stores = ins.filter(x => x.name.startsWith("i32.store"));

console.log(`I32.STORE COUNT = ${stores.length}`);
console.log();

for (const s of stores) {
  const index = ins.indexOf(s);

  console.log("-".repeat(60));
  console.log(`STORE @ ${hex(s.addr)}`);
  console.log(`OFFSET = ${hex(s.imm ?? 0)}`);

  showWindow(index, 12);

  console.log();

  // Look immediately backward for the final local.get
  // that supplies the store address.
  let addrLocal: number | undefined;

  for (let i = index - 1; i >= Math.max(0, index - 8); i--) {
    if (ins[i].name === "local.get") {
      addrLocal = ins[i].imm;
      break;
    }

    if (
      ins[i].name === "local.set" ||
      ins[i].name === "local.tee"
    ) {
      break;
    }
  }

  if (addrLocal === undefined) {
    console.log("ADDRESS LOCAL = NOT RESOLVED");
    continue;
  }

  console.log(`ADDRESS LOCAL = ${localName(addrLocal)}`);

  // Find all recent definitions before the store.
  const defs: Instr[] = [];

  for (let i = index - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (
      (ins[i].name === "local.set" ||
        ins[i].name === "local.tee") &&
      ins[i].imm === addrLocal
    ) {
      defs.push(ins[i]);

      if (defs.length >= 5) break;
    }
  }

  if (defs.length === 0) {
    console.log("LOCAL DEFINITION = NONE FOUND");
    continue;
  }

  for (const d of defs) {
    console.log(
      `LOCAL DEFINITION @ ${hex(d.addr)} = ${d.name}`
    );

    const di = ins.indexOf(d);

    for (
      let j = Math.max(0, di - 8);
      j < di;
      j++
    ) {
      const x = ins[j];

      let extra = "";

      if (
        x.name === "local.get" ||
        x.name === "local.set" ||
        x.name === "local.tee"
      ) {
        extra = ` ${localName(x.imm!)}`;
      } else if (x.name === "i32.const") {
        extra = ` ${hex(x.imm!)}`;
      }

      console.log(
        `  ${hex(x.addr)} ${x.name}${extra}`
      );
    }
  }

  console.log();
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 32;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readString(pos) {
  const x = uleb(pos);
  const start = x.next;
  const end = start + x.value;

  return {
    value: b.toString("utf8", start, end),
    next: end
  };
}

let p = 8;
let importedFunctions = 0;

let importFound = null;
let codeSection = null;

while (p < b.length) {

  const id = b[p++];

  const s = uleb(p);
  p = s.next;

  const sectionStart = p;
  const sectionEnd = p + s.value;

  // IMPORT SECTION
  if (id === 2) {

    let q = sectionStart;

    const count = uleb(q);
    q = count.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

      const mod = readString(q);
      q = mod.next;

      const name = readString(q);
      q = name.next;

      const kind = b[q++];

      if (kind === 0) {

        const type = uleb(q);
        q = type.next;

        if (importedFunctions === TARGET) {

          importFound = {
            index: importedFunctions,
            module: mod.value,
            name: name.value,
            type: type.value
          };
        }

        importedFunctions++;

      } else if (kind === 1) {

        q++;

        const flags = uleb(q);
        q = flags.next;

        const min = uleb(q);
        q = min.next;

        if (flags.value & 1) {
          const max = uleb(q);
          q = max.next;
        }

      } else if (kind === 2) {

        const flags = uleb(q);
        q = flags.next;

        const min = uleb(q);
        q = min.next;

        if (flags.value & 1) {
          const max = uleb(q);
          q = max.next;
        }

      } else if (kind === 3) {

        q += 2;
      }
    }
  }

  // CODE SECTION
  if (id === 10) {

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 0x001078a9;
const FUNC = 3315;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// READ WASM
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// ULEB128
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function readULEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB128 overflow");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// LOCATE CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[pos++];

    const s = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    pos = s.next;

    const start = pos;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// LOCATE FUNC 3315 BODY
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let p = codeStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
const functionCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

let bodyStart = -1;
let bodyEnd = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < functionCount; i++) {
    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + size;

    if (i === FUNC) {
        bodyStart = start;
        bodyEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

if (bodyStart < 0) {
    throw new Error(`FUNC ${FUNC} not found`);
}

// VERIFY TARGET
// ------------------------------------------------------------
if (TARGET < bodyStart || TARGET >= bodyEnd) {
    throw new Error(
        `TARGET 0x${TARGET.toString(16)} is outside FUNC ${FUNC}`
    );
}

// call_indirect is:
// 0x11 <typeidx:ULEB> <tableidx:ULEB>
//
// At 0x1078A9:
//   11 03 00
//
// therefore:
//   opcode  = 0x11
//   typeidx = 3
//   tableidx = 0

console.log("=".repeat(72));

            wasm[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
        );
    }

    console.log(
        `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
    );

    );

for (let addr = contextStart; addr < TARGET; addr++) {
    console.log(

    if (wasm[addr] !== 0x11) {
        continue;

        // Ignore invalid byte patterns.
    }

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 7151;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function hex(v, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("FUNC 7151 DIRECT CALL RESOLUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));

let importedFunctions = 0;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FIND IMPORT COUNT
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let pos = 8;

while (pos < wasm.length) {

    const sectionId = wasm[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = pos;
    const end = start + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 2) {

        let p = start;

        const c = readULEB(wasm, p);
        const count = c.value;
        p = c.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

            let r = readULEB(wasm, p);
            p = r.next + r.value;

            r = readULEB(wasm, p);
            p = r.next + r.value;

            const kind = wasm[p++];

            if (kind === 0) {

                importedFunctions++;

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;

            } else if (kind === 1) {

                p++;

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;

                if (wasm[p - 1] & 1) {
                    r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                    p = r.next;
                }

            } else if (kind === 2) {

                const flags = wasm[p++];

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;

                if (flags & 1) {
                    r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                    p = r.next;
                }

            } else if (kind === 3) {

                p += 2;

            } else if (kind === 4) {

                p++;

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;
            }
        }
    }

    pos = end;
}

console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTION COUNT : ${importedFunctions}`);
console.log();

// FIND FUNC 7151 BODY
// ------------------------------------------------------------
pos = 8;

        p = c.next;

        for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < bodyCount; ordinal++) {

            const size = readULEB(wasm, p);
            const bodySize = size.value;
            p = size.next;

            const bodyStart = p;
            const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

            const functionIndex =
                importedFunctions + ordinal;

            if (functionIndex === TARGET_FUNC) {

                console.log("TARGET BODY");
                console.log("-".repeat(72));

                console.log(
                    `FUNCTION INDEX : ${functionIndex}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `CODE ORDINAL   : ${ordinal}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `BODY           : ${hex(bodyStart)} .. ${hex(bodyEnd)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `SIZE           : ${bodySize}`
                );

                console.log();
                console.log("RAW CALL SCAN");
                console.log("-".repeat(72));

                for (let q = bodyStart; q < bodyEnd; q++) {

                    const opcode = wasm[q];

                    if (opcode === 0x10) {

                        const target = readULEB(
                            wasm,
                            q + 1
                        );

                        console.log(
                            `${hex(q)}  CALL FUNC ${target.value} ` +
                            `(ULEB bytes: ${target.next - (q + 1)})`
                        );
                    }
                }

                console.log();
                console.log("DECODED BODY");
                console.log("-".repeat(72));

                let q = bodyStart;

                while (q < bodyEnd) {

                    const opcode = wasm[q];

                    if (opcode === 0x00) {
                        console.log(
                            `${hex(q)}  unreachable`
                        );
                        q++;
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (opcode === 0x20) {

                        const local = readULEB(
                            wasm,
                            q + 1
                        );

                        console.log(
                            `${hex(q)}  local.get ${local.value}`
                        );

                            q + 1
                        );

                        console.log(
                            `${hex(q)}  call ${target.value}`
                        );

                        q = target.next;
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (opcode === 0x0b) {

                        console.log(
                            `${hex(q)}  end`
                        );

                        q++;
                        continue;
                    }

                    console.log(
                        `${hex(q)}  opcode=0x${opcode.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
                    );

                    q++;
                }

                console.log();
                console.log("=".repeat(72));
                console.log("DONE");

                process.exit(0);
            }

            p = bodyEnd;
        }

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 725;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: pos };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, x;
  while (true) {
    x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v -= 2 ** shift;
  return { value: v | 0, next: pos };
}

// Find Code Section
let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;
let codeEnd = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p];
  const s = uleb(p + 1);
  const payload = s.next;
  const end = payload + s.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = payload;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

let q = codeStart;
const count = uleb(q);
q = count.next;

let target = null;

for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
  const sz = uleb(q);
  const start = sz.next;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (i === TARGET) {
    target = {
      start,
      end: end - 1,
      size: sz.value
    };
    break;
  }

  q = end;
}

if (!target) throw new Error("FUNC725 not found");

console.log("FUNC 725 EXACT RAW + BASIC DECODE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY SIZE : ${target.size}`);
console.log(
  `BODY      : 0x${target.start.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} .. ` +
  `0x${target.end.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}`
);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("RAW BODY");

for (let x = target.start; x <= target.end; x += 16) {
  const e = Math.min(x + 15, target.end);
  console.log(
    `0x${x.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}  ` +
    [...b.slice(x, e + 1)]
      .map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2,"0"))
      .join(" ")
  );
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("I32.CONST / CALL / CALL_INDIRECT / MEMORY OPS");

let x = target.start;

while (x <= target.end) {
  const at = x;
  const op = b[x++];

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = sleb(x);
    console.log(
      `I32.CONST @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `VALUE=${r.value} HEX=0x${(r.value >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}`
    );
    x = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = uleb(x);
    console.log(
      `CALL @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} FUNC=${r.value}`
    );
    x = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const r1 = uleb(x);
    const r2 = uleb(r1.next);
    console.log(
      `CALL_INDIRECT @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `TYPE=${r1.value} TABLE=${r2.value}`
    );
    x = r2.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 ||
    op === 0x38 || op === 0x39 ||
    op === 0x3a
  ) {
    const a = uleb(x);
    const o = uleb(a.next);

    const names = {
      0x28: "I32.LOAD",
      0x29: "I64.LOAD",
      0x36: "I32.STORE",
      0x37: "I64.STORE",
      0x38: "F32.STORE",
      0x39: "F64.STORE",
      0x3a: "I32.STORE8"
    };

    console.log(
      `${names[op] || "MEMORY"} @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
    );

    x = o.next;
  }
}

    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: pos };

  const id = b[pos++];
  const s = uleb(pos);
  return {
    id,
    start: pos,
    end: pos = s.next + s.value
  };
}

      `VALUE=${r.value} ` +
      `HEX=0x${(r.value >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}`
    );
    p = r.next;
  }
  else if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    console.log(
      `CALL @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} FUNC=${r.value}`
    );
    p = r.next;
  }
  else if (op === 0x11) {
    const a = uleb(p);
    const t = uleb(a.next);
    console.log(
      `CALL_INDIRECT @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `TYPE=${a.value} TABLE=${t.value}`
    );
    p = t.next;
  }
  else if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    console.log(
      `LOCAL.GET @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} L${r.value}`
    );
    p = r.next;
  }
  else if (op === 0x22) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    console.log(
      `LOCAL.TEE @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} L${r.value}`
    );
    p = r.next;
  }
  else if (op === 0x21) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    console.log(
      `LOCAL.SET @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} L${r.value}`
    );
    p = r.next;
  }
  else if (op === 0x0f) {
    console.log(`RETURN @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}`);
  }
  else {
    console.log(
      `OPCODE @ 0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
    );
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 91;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: pos };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readVecTypes(pos) {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  pos = n.next;
  const types = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    types.push(b[pos++]);
  }
  return { types, next: pos };
}

const typeNames = {
  0x7f: "i32",
  0x7e: "i64",
  0x7d: "f32",
  0x7c: "f64"
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------

// ------------------------------------------------------------
let p = 8;
let typeSection = null;
let functionSection = null;
let codeSection = null;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p];
  const s = uleb(p + 1);
  const payload = s.next;
  const end = payload + s.value;

  if (id === 1) typeSection = { start: payload, end };
  if (id === 3) functionSection = { start: payload, end };
  if (id === 10) {
    codeSection = { start: payload, end };
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (!typeSection || !functionSection || !codeSection)
  throw new Error("Required sections not found");

// Parse types

t = typeCount.next;

  if (form !== 0x60)
    throw new Error(`Unexpected type form at ${i}: 0x${form.toString(16)}`);

  const params = readVecTypes(t);
  t = params.next;

  const results = readVecTypes(t);
  t = results.next;

  types.push({
    params: params.types,
    results: results.types
  });
}

f = funcCount.next;

  const r = uleb(f);

  f = r.next;

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 91;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(data: Buffer, pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = data[pos++];

        if (b === undefined) {
            throw new Error("Unexpected EOF while reading ULEB");
        }

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function valType(v: number): string {
    switch (v) {
        case 0x7f: return "i32";
        case 0x7e: return "i64";
        case 0x7d: return "f32";
        case 0x7c: return "f64";
        case 0x7b: return "v128";
        case 0x70: return "funcref";
        case 0x6f: return "externref";
        default: return `0x${v.toString(16)}`;
    }
}

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: p };

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid ULEB");
}

function readName(pos: number) {
    const n = readULEB(pos);
    const start = n.next;
    const end = start + n.value;

    return {
        value: Buffer.from(wasm.subarray(start, end)).toString("utf8"),
        next: end
    };
}

function hex(x: number) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function raw(pos: number, n: number) {
    return Array.from(
        wasm.subarray(pos, Math.min(pos + n, wasm.length))
    )
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

function sectionName(id: number) {
    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0: "custom",
        1: "type",
        2: "import",
        3: "function",
        4: "table",
        5: "memory",
        6: "global",
        7: "export",
        8: "start",
        9: "element",
        10: "code",
        11: "data",
        12: "data_count",
        13: "tag"
    };

    return names[id] ?? `section_${id}`;
}

import fs from "fs";

const FILE = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_OFFSET = Number(process.argv[2] ?? 1660683);
const b = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    if (pos >= b.length)
      throw new Error("Unexpected EOF while reading ULEB");

    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 49)
      throw new Error("ULEB too large");
  }
}

function findSection(id) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const sectionId = b[p++];
    const size = uleb(p);
    const start = size.next;
    const end = start + size.value;

    if (end > b.length)
      throw new Error("Section exceeds file size");

    if (sectionId === id)
      return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

  const payload = s.next;
  const end = payload + s.value;

  if (id === 2)
    importSection = { start: payload, end };

  if (id === 10) {
    codeSection = { start: payload, end };
    break;

  p = end;

  const kind = b[q++];

  if (kind === 0x00) {
    // function import
    uleb(q);
    q = uleb(q).next;
    importedFunctions++;

    q = min.next;

    q = flags.next;

    q = min.next;

    if (flags.value & 1) {
      const max = uleb(q);
      q = max.next;
    }
  }

    q += 2;

  }

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const targets = [0x95a47, 0x95d4f];

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { v: v >>> 0, p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (-1 << s);
  return { v: v | 0, p };
}

function decode(start: number, end: number) {
  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {

      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;

      const n: Record<number,string> = {
        0x20:"local.get",
        0x21:"local.set",
        0x22:"local.tee",
        0x23:"global.get",
        0x24:"global.set"
      };

      console.log(`${hex(at)} ${n[op]} ${r.v}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} i32.const ${r.v}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
      const r = sleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} i64.const ${r.v}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} call ${r.v}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.p;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.p;

      const type = op >= 0x36 ? "STORE" : "LOAD";

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} ${type} op=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
        `align=${a.v} offset=${o.v}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6a || op === 0x6b ||
        op === 0x71 || op === 0x72 ||
        op === 0x73 || op === 0x74 ||
        op === 0x75 || op === 0x76 ||
        op === 0x7e || op === 0x7f ||
        op === 0x80 || op === 0x81 ||
        op === 0x82 || op === 0x83 ||
        op === 0x84 || op === 0x85 ||
        op === 0x86 || op === 0x87 ||
        op === 0x88) {

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0b || op === 0x05 || op === 0x1a) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} control/drop op=0x${op.toString(16)}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} ${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"} ${r.v}`
      );
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      if (b[p] === 0x40) {
        p++;
        console.log(`${hex(at)} block/loop/if 0x40`);
      } else {
        const r = sleb(p);
        p = r.p;
        console.log(`${hex(at)} blocktype ${r.v}`);
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0xfc) {
      const r = uleb(p);
      p = r.p;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} 0xfc subop=${r.v}`);

      if (r.v === 8 || r.v === 10) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.p;
        const c = uleb(p);
        p = c.p;
      }
      continue;
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
    );
  }
}

for (const target of targets) {
  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`TARGET ${hex(target)}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  decode(target - 180, target + 25);
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 114;

function uleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
  throw Error("ULEB");
}

function sleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  while (p < b.length) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 127) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 128)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 64)) v |= -1 << s;
  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function readName(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  return n.next + n.value;
}

function sections(b: Buffer): any {
  let p = 8;
  const r: any = {};

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;
    r[id] = { start: p, size: s.value };
    p += s.value;
  }

  return r;
}

function importedFuncs(b: Buffer, sec: any) {
  let p = sec.start;
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  let count = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    p = readName(b, p);
    p = readName(b, p);

    const kind = b[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      p = uleb(b, p).next;
      count++;
    } else if (kind === 1 || kind === 2) {
      const f = uleb(b, p);
      p = f.next;
      p = uleb(b, p).next;
      if (f.value & 1) p = uleb(b, p).next;
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return count;
}

function bodies(b: Buffer, sec: any, imported: number) {
  let p = sec.start;
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  const out: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    out.push({
      func: imported + i,
      start: p,
      end: p + s.value,
      bytes: b.subarray(p, p + s.value)
    });

    p += s.value;
  }

  return out;
}

type I = {
  off: number;
  op: number;
  imm: number[];
  text: string;
};

function decode(b: Buffer, base: number): I[] {
  const a: I[] = [];
  let p = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const off = base + p;
    const op = b[p++];
    const imm: number[] = [];
    let text = `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`;

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text =
        op === 0x20 ? `local.get ${r.value}` :
        op === 0x21 ? `local.set ${r.value}` :
        `local.tee ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = uleb(b, p);
      p = t.next;
      const tab = uleb(b, p);
      p = tab.next;
      imm.push(t.value, tab.value);
      text = `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `call ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
      const al = uleb(b, p);
      p = al.next;
      const of = uleb(b, p);
      p = of.next;
      imm.push(al.value, of.value);
      text = `load offset=${of.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x23) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x24) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
    }
    else if (op === 0x6a) text = "i32.add";
    else if (op === 0x6b) text = "i32.sub";
    else if (op === 0x6c) text = "i32.mul";
    else if (op === 0x1a) text = "drop";
    else if (op === 0x0b) text = "end";
    else if (op === 0x05) text = "else";
    else if (op === 0x0f) text = "return";
    else if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      p++;
      text = op === 2 ? "block" : op === 3 ? "loop" : "if";
    }
    else if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;
      imm.push(r.value);
      text = op === 0x0c ? `br ${r.value}` : `br_if ${r.value}`;
    }

    a.push({ off, op, imm, text });
  }

  return a;
}

function show(a: I[], i: number) {
  for (
    let j = Math.max(0, i - 10);
    j <= Math.min(a.length - 1, i + 4);
    j++
  ) {
    console.log(
      `${j === i ? " >>>" : "    "} ` +
      `0x${a[j].off.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ${a[j].text}`
    );
  }
}

export async function run() {
  const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
  const s = sections(wasm);

  const imp = importedFuncs(wasm, s[2]);
  const bs = bodies(wasm, s[10], imp);

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(" RESOLVE INDEX VALUE -> 114");
  console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length}`);
  console.log();

  let sites = 0;
  let exact = 0;
  let derived = 0;
  let unresolved = 0;

  for (const body of bs) {
    let a: I[];

    try {
      a = decode(body.bytes, body.start);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      const c = a[i];

      if (
        c.op !== 0x11 ||
        c.imm[0] !== 0 ||
        c.imm[1] !== 0
      ) continue;

      sites++;

      /*
       * Direct constant immediately before call.
       */
      if (
        i > 0 &&
        a[i - 1].op === 0x41 &&
        a[i - 1].imm[0] === TARGET
      ) {
        exact++;
        console.log(
          `EXACT CONST(114): func=${body.func} ` +
          `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)}`
        );
        show(a, i);
        continue;
      }

      /*
       * Look for:
       *   local.get
       *   load
       *   call_indirect
       *
       * or:
       *   load
       *   load
       *   call_indirect
       */
      const p1 = i > 0 ? a[i - 1] : undefined;
      const p2 = i > 1 ? a[i - 2] : undefined;

      if (
        p1 &&
        p1.op >= 0x28 &&
        p1.op <= 0x3e
      ) {
        derived++;

        /*
         * Strong structural pattern:
         * previous instruction is another load.
         */
        if (
          p2 &&
          p2.op >= 0x28 &&
          p2.op <= 0x3e
        ) {
          console.log(
            `CHAIN: func=${body.func} ` +
            `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)} ` +
            `outerLoad=0x${p1.off.toString(16)} ` +
            `offset=${p1.imm[1]} ` +
            `innerLoad=0x${p2.off.toString(16)} ` +
            `offset=${p2.imm[1]}`
          );
        }

        continue;
      }

      unresolved++;
    }
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("SUMMARY");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`Type-0/table-0 sites : ${sites}`);
  console.log(`Exact CONST(114)     : ${exact}`);
  console.log(`Memory-derived       : ${derived}`);
  console.log(`Unresolved           : ${unresolved}`);
  console.log();
  console.log(
    "Next target: identify which memory field actually contains 114."
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const IMPORTS = 83;
const TARGETS = [91, 119, 656];

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value: v, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v: number) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];

    const sz = uleb(p);
    p = sz.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sz.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * TYPE SECTION
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

const typeSec = readSection(1);

let p = typeSec.start;

const typeCount = uleb(p);
p = typeCount.next;

const types: {
  params: number[];
  results: number[];
}[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < typeCount.value; i++) {
  const form = wasm[p++];

  if (form !== 0x60) {
    throw new Error(
      `Unexpected function type form at ${hex(p - 1)}: ${hex(form)}`
    );
  }

  const pc = uleb(p);
  p = pc.next;

  const params: number[] = [];

  for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
    params.push(wasm[p++]);
  }

  const rc = uleb(p);
  p = rc.next;

  const results: number[] = [];

  for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
    results.push(wasm[p++]);
  }

  types.push({ params, results });
}

const funcCount = uleb(p);
p = funcCount.next;

  funcTypes.push(x.value);

p = codeSec.start;

const codeCount = uleb(p);
p = codeCount.next;

const bodies = new Map<number, {
  start: number;
  end: number;
  type: number;
}>();

for (let i = 0; i < codeCount.value; i++) {
  const sz = uleb(p);
  p = sz.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  const globalFunc = IMPORTS + i;

  bodies.set(globalFunc, {
    start,
    end,
    type: funcTypes[i]
  });

  p = end;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * VALUE REPRESENTATION
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

type Value = {
  kind: string;
  detail?: string;
};

function val(kind: string, detail?: string): Value {
  return { kind, detail };
}

function show(v: Value | undefined) {
  if (!v) return "UNKNOWN";
  return v.detail ? `${v.kind}(${v.detail})` : v.kind;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * TARGET FUNCTION
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function analyze(func: number) {
  const body = bodies.get(func);

  if (!body) {
    console.log(`FUNC ${func}: body not found`);
    return;
  }

  const type = types[body.type];

  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC = ${func}`);
  console.log(`TYPE INDEX  = ${body.type}`);
  console.log(`PARAMS      = ${type.params.length}`);
  console.log(`RESULTS     = ${type.results.length}`);
  console.log(`BODY        = ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end - 1)}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  /*
   * Decode local declarations.
   */
  let p = body.start;

  const localDecls = uleb(p);
  p = localDecls.next;

  const localTypes: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < localDecls.value; i++) {
    const count = uleb(p);
    p = count.next;

    const vt = wasm[p++];

    for (let j = 0; j < count.value; j++) {
      localTypes.push(vt);
    }
  }

  const localCount = type.params.length + localTypes.length;

  console.log(`TOTAL LOCALS = ${localCount}`);

  /*
   * Symbolic locals.
   */
  const locals: Value[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < type.params.length; i++) {
    locals.push(val("PARAM", `local${i}`));
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < localTypes.length; i++) {
    locals.push(val("LOCAL", `local${type.params.length + i}`));
  }

  const stack: Value[] = [];

  function push(v: Value) {
    stack.push(v);
  }

  function pop(): Value {
    if (stack.length === 0) {
      return val("UNKNOWN", "STACK_UNDERFLOW");
    }

    return stack.pop()!;
  }

  function dumpStack() {
    if (stack.length === 0) {
      console.log("    STACK = []");
      return;
    }

    console.log(
      "    STACK = [" +
      stack.map(show).join(", ") +
      "]"
    );
  }

  /*
   * Track structured IF depth.
   */
  let ifDepth = 0;

  while (p < body.end) {
    const opPos = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    switch (op) {

      case 0x41: { // i32.const
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        push(val(
          "I32_CONST",
          `${x.value} (${hex(x.value)})`
        ));

        break;
      }

      case 0x20: { // local.get
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        const v = locals[x.value] ??
          val("UNKNOWN", `local${x.value}`);

        push(v);

        break;
      }

      case 0x21: { // local.set
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        const v = pop();

        locals[x.value] = v;

        break;
      }

      case 0x22: { // local.tee
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        const v = pop();

        locals[x.value] = v;
        push(v);

        break;
      }

      case 0x28: { // i32.load
        const align = uleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = uleb(p);
        p = offset.next;

        const address = pop();

        push(val(
          "I32_LOAD",
          `${show(address)} + ${hex(offset.value)}`
        ));

        break;
      }

      case 0x47: { // i32.ne
        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        push(val(
          "I32_NE",
          `${show(a)} != ${show(b)}`
        ));

        break;
      }

      case 0x04: { // if
        const cond = pop();

        ifDepth++;

        console.log();
        console.log(`IF @ ${hex(opPos)}`);
        console.log(`    CONDITION = ${show(cond)}`);
        dumpStack();

        break;
      }

      case 0x05: { // else
        console.log(`ELSE @ ${hex(opPos)}`);
        dumpStack();
        break;
      }

      case 0x0b: { // end
        if (ifDepth > 0) {
          ifDepth--;
        }

        break;
      }

      case 0x0f: { // return
        console.log(`RETURN @ ${hex(opPos)}`);
        dumpStack();
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: { // call_indirect
        const typeIndex = uleb(p);
        p = typeIndex.next;

        const tableIndex = uleb(p);
        p = tableIndex.next;

        const targetType = types[typeIndex.value];

        console.log();
        console.log("************************************************************");
        console.log(`CALL_INDIRECT @ ${hex(opPos)}`);
        console.log(`TYPE         = ${typeIndex.value}`);
        console.log(`TABLE        = ${tableIndex.value}`);
        console.log(`PARAM COUNT  = ${targetType.params.length}`);
        console.log(`RESULT COUNT = ${targetType.results.length}`);

        const argc = targetType.params.length;

        const args: Value[] = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < argc; i++) {
          args.unshift(pop());
        }

        const index = pop();

        console.log("ARGS:");

        args.forEach((a, i) => {
          console.log(`    ARG${i} = ${show(a)}`);
        });

        console.log(`INDEX       = ${show(index)}`);

        if (index.kind === "I32_CONST") {
          console.log("INDEX SOURCE = CONSTANT");
        } else if (index.kind === "PARAM") {
          console.log("INDEX SOURCE = FUNCTION PARAMETER");
        } else if (index.kind === "LOCAL") {
          console.log("INDEX SOURCE = LOCAL");
        } else if (index.kind === "I32_LOAD") {
          console.log("INDEX SOURCE = MEMORY LOAD");
        } else if (index.kind === "I32_NE") {
          console.log("INDEX SOURCE = COMPARISON");
        } else if (index.kind === "UNKNOWN") {
          console.log("INDEX SOURCE = UNKNOWN / STACK UNDERFLOW");
        } else {
          console.log(`INDEX SOURCE = ${index.kind}`);
        }

        dumpStack();

        /*
         * Symbolically push result(s).
         */
        for (let i = 0; i < targetType.results.length; i++) {
          push(val(
            "CALL_RESULT",
            `call_indirect(type=${typeIndex.value})`
          ));
        }

        console.log("************************************************************");
        break;
      }

      default: {
        /*
         * For this focused trace we don't execute unknown opcodes.
         * This is intentional: unknown instructions can affect stack.
         */
        break;
      }
    }

    /*
     * Focus output around the relevant memory constant.
     */
    if (
      op === 0x41 &&
      wasm[opPos + 1] === 0xd4 &&
      wasm[opPos + 2] === 0xa6 &&
      wasm[opPos + 3] === 0xe5 &&
      wasm[opPos + 4] === 0x00
    ) {
      console.log();
      console.log(
        `TARGET MEMORY ADDRESS @ ${hex(opPos)}`
      );
      dumpStack();
    }
  }
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * MAIN
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

console.log("RESOLVE INDIRECT INDEX");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log();
console.log(`TYPE COUNT = ${types.length}`);

for (const f of TARGETS) {
  analyze(f);
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("READ ONLY - NO EXECUTION - NO TRANSACTION");
console.log("============================================================");
