import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;
const IMPORTS = 83;

const TARGETS = new Map<number, string>([
  [2053, "Function 8952"],
  [2101, "Function 8927"],
  [2612, "Function 8637"],
]);

const SEG412_START = 0x0018744c;
const SEG412_END   = 0x0018ab8d;

const SEG413_START = 0x0018ab98;
const SEG413_END   = 0x0018f512;

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value, next: pos };
}

/*
 * Exact verified function-body parser.
 */
function parseFunctions() {
  const countInfo = readULEB(CODE_START);
  const count = countInfo.value;

  let p = countInfo.next;

  const funcs: Array<{
    body: number;
    global: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
  }> = [];

  for (let body = 0; body < count; body++) {
    const s = readULEB(p);

    const start = s.next;
    const end = start + s.value;

    funcs.push({
      body,
      global: IMPORTS + body,
      start,
      end
    });

    p = end;
  }

  if (p !== CODE_END) {
    throw new Error(
      `Function parser mismatch ${hex(p)} != ${hex(CODE_END)}`
    );
  }

  return funcs;
}

/*
 * Return instruction size for the opcodes relevant to our
 * backward stack reconstruction. Unknown opcodes are treated
 * conservatively as one byte.
 */
function instrSize(pos: number): number {
  const op = buf[pos];

  if (
    op === 0x00 || op === 0x01 ||
    op === 0x05 ||
    op === 0x0b || op === 0x0f ||
    op === 0x1a || op === 0x1b
  ) return 1;

  if (
    op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 || op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24
  ) {
    return readULEB(pos + 1).next - pos;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    return readULEB(pos + 1).next - pos;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
    const b = readULEB(a.next);
    return b.next - pos;
  }

  if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 ||
      op === 0x2a || op === 0x2b ||
      op === 0x2c || op === 0x2d ||
      op === 0x2e || op === 0x2f ||
      op === 0x30 || op === 0x31 ||
      op === 0x32 || op === 0x33 ||
      op === 0x34 || op === 0x35 ||
      op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 ||
      op === 0x38 || op === 0x39 ||
      op === 0x3a || op === 0x3b ||
      op === 0x3c || op === 0x3d ||
      op === 0x3e) {

    const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
    const b = readULEB(a.next);
    return b.next - pos;
  }

  if (op === 0x41 || op === 0x42) {
    return readSLEB(pos + 1).next - pos;
  }

  if (op === 0x43) return 5;
  if (op === 0x44) return 9;

  if (
    op === 0x02 ||
    op === 0x03 ||
    op === 0x04
  ) {
    return readSLEB(pos + 1).next - pos;
  }

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    return readULEB(pos + 1).next - pos;
  }

  return 1;
}

/*
 * Decode a function into instruction positions/opcodes.
 */
function decodeFunction(fn: {
  start: number;
  end: number;
}) {
  let p = fn.start;

  const locals = readULEB(p);
  p = locals.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {
    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next + 1;
  }

  const result: Array<{
    pos: number;
    op: number;
    size: number;
  }> = [];

  while (p < fn.end) {
    const size = instrSize(p);

    if (size <= 0 || p + size > fn.end) break;

    result.push({
      pos: p,
      op: buf[p],
      size
    });

    p += size;
  }

  return result;
}

function opname(pos: number): string {
  const op = buf[pos];

  if (op === 0x20) {
    return `local.get ${readULEB(pos + 1).value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x21) {
    return `local.set ${readULEB(pos + 1).value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x22) {
    return `local.tee ${readULEB(pos + 1).value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x23) {
    return `global.get ${readULEB(pos + 1).value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x24) {
    return `global.set ${readULEB(pos + 1).value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x28) {
    const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
    const b = readULEB(a.next);
    return `i32.load offset=${b.value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x2d) {
    const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
    const b = readULEB(a.next);
    return `i32.load8_u offset=${b.value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {
    return `i32.const ${readSLEB(pos + 1).value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    return `call ${readULEB(pos + 1).value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
    const b = readULEB(a.next);
    return `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;
  }

  return `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

const functions = parseFunctions();

const TARGET_BODY_SET = new Set(
  [...TARGETS.keys()].map(x => x - IMPORTS)
);

/*
 * We need only type=4 call_indirect.
 */
interface Hit {
  fn: typeof functions[number];
  pos: number;
  instructions: ReturnType<typeof decodeFunction>;
  indexSource: string;
  sourcePos: number | null;
}

const hits: Hit[] = [];

for (const fn of functions) {
  let ins: ReturnType<typeof decodeFunction>;

  try {
    ins = decodeFunction(fn);
  } catch {
    continue;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
    const cur = ins[i];

    if (cur.op !== 0x11) continue;

    const a = readULEB(cur.pos + 1);
    const b = readULEB(a.next);

    if (a.value !== 4) continue;

    /*
     * Look backwards up to 12 instructions for the index
     * producer. We specifically classify:
     *
     * local.get X
     * i32.load + offset
     *
     * i32.const
     * i32.load + offset
     *
     * nested load patterns.
     */
    const before = ins.slice(Math.max(0, i - 12), i);

    let source = "UNKNOWN";
    let sourcePos: number | null = null;

    for (let j = before.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      const x = before[j];

      if (x.op === 0x28) {
        const a2 = readULEB(x.pos + 1);
        const o2 = readULEB(a2.next).value;

        source = `i32.load(offset=${o2})`;
        sourcePos = x.pos;

        /*
         * Check preceding instruction for obvious base.
         */
        if (j > 0) {
          const prev = before[j - 1];

          if (prev.op === 0x20) {
            source +=
              ` <- local.get ${readULEB(prev.pos + 1).value}`;
          } else if (prev.op === 0x41) {
            source +=
              ` <- i32.const ${readSLEB(prev.pos + 1).value}`;
          }
        }

        break;
      }

      if (x.op === 0x41) {
        source =
          `i32.const ${readSLEB(x.pos + 1).value}`;
        sourcePos = x.pos;
        break;
      }

      if (x.op === 0x20) {
        source =
          `local.get ${readULEB(x.pos + 1).value}`;
        sourcePos = x.pos;
        break;
      }
    }

    hits.push({
      fn,
      pos: cur.pos,
      instructions: ins,
      indexSource: source,
      sourcePos
    });
  }
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LIBRARY_HASH_HEX =
    'C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const TESTNET_CONFIG_URL =
    'https://ton-blockchain.github.io/testnet-global.config.json';

function intToIP(ip: number): string {
    const n = ip >>> 0;

    return [
        (n >>> 24) & 255,
        (n >>> 16) & 255,
        (n >>> 8) & 255,
        n & 255,
    ].join('.');
}

async function getTestnetConfig(): Promise<any> {
    const response = await fetch(TESTNET_CONFIG_URL);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Cannot download Testnet config: HTTP ${response.status}`
        );
    }

    return await response.json();
}

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function waitForEngine(
    engine: LiteSingleEngine,
    timeoutMs: number
): Promise<void> {
    const started = Date.now();

    while (Date.now() - started < timeoutMs) {
        if (engine.isReady()) {
            return;
        }

        if (engine.isClosed()) {
            await sleep(250);
            continue;
        }

        await sleep(250);
    }

    throw new Error(
        `LiteSingleEngine did not become ready within ${timeoutMs} ms`
    );
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 ON-CHAIN LIBRARY RESOLVER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));

    console.log(`Library hash: ${LIBRARY_HASH_HEX}`);

    const config = await getTestnetConfig();

    if (!config.liteservers || config.liteservers.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('No Testnet LiteServers found');
    }

    console.log(
        `Testnet LiteServers available: ${config.liteservers.length}`
    );

    const libraryHash = Buffer.from(LIBRARY_HASH_HEX, 'hex');

    let lastError: unknown = null;

    for (let i = 0; i < config.liteservers.length; i++) {
        const server = config.liteservers[i];

        const ip = intToIP(server.ip);
        const port = server.port;
        const publicKey = Buffer.from(server.id.key, 'base64');

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            `Trying LiteServer ${i + 1}/${config.liteservers.length}: ${ip}:${port}`
        );

        let engine: LiteSingleEngine | null = null;

        try {
            engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
                host: `tcp://${ip}:${port}`,
                publicKey,
                reconnectTimeout: 3000,
            });

            console.log(
                `Initial state: closed=${engine.isClosed()} ready=${engine.isReady()}`
            );

            await waitForEngine(engine, 15000);

            console.log(
                `Engine ready: closed=${engine.isClosed()} ready=${engine.isReady()}`
            );

            const client = new LiteClient({

            });

            const master = await client.getMasterchainInfo({
                timeout: 10000,
            });

            console.log(
                `Masterchain seqno: ${master.last.seqno}`
            );

            const result = await client.getLibraries(
                [libraryHash],
                {
                    timeout: 15000,
                }
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log('getLibraries() returned');
            console.log(`Entries: ${result.result.length}`);

            if (result.result.length === 0) {
                console.log('');
                console.log('RESULT: LIBRARY NOT RETURNED');

                engine.close();
                return;
            }

            for (const entry of result.result) {
                const hashHex = Buffer.from(entry.hash).toString('hex');

                console.log('');
                console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');
                console.log(`Entry hash: ${hashHex}`);
                console.log(
                    `Requested : ${LIBRARY_HASH_HEX.toLowerCase()}`
                );

                console.log(`Library data bytes: ${data.length}`);

                console.log('');

                console.log(
                    data.subarray(0, 64).toString('hex')
                );

                let cells: Cell[];

                try {

                } catch (e) {
                    console.log('');

                    return;
                }

                console.log('');

                    return;

                console.log(`Root bits   : ${root.bits.length}`);
                console.log(`Root refs   : ${root.refs.length}`);
                console.log(`Root exotic : ${root.isExotic}`);

                const actualHash = root.hash().toString('hex');

                console.log('');
                console.log(`Root cell hash: ${actualHash}`);
                console.log(
                    `Expected hash : ${LIBRARY_HASH_HEX.toLowerCase()}`
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log(
                    `HASH MATCH: ${
                        actualHash.toLowerCase() ===
                        LIBRARY_HASH_HEX.toLowerCase()
                    }`
                );

                console.log('');
                console.log('Library BOC:');
                console.log(data.toString('base64'));

                console.log('');
                console.log('RESULT: ON-CHAIN LIBRARY RESOLVED');

                engine.close();
                return;
            }

            engine.close();
            return;
        } catch (e) {
            lastError = e;

            console.log(`LiteServer failed: ${String(e)}`);

            if (engine) {
                try {
                    engine.close();
                } catch {
                    // ignore
                }
            }
        }
    }

    throw new Error(
        `All Testnet LiteServers failed. Last error: ${String(lastError)}`
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x012200;
const END   = 0x01295b;
const TARGET = 0x0126b4;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(pos: number, bits: number) {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (
                shift + 7n < BigInt(bits) &&
                (b & 0x40)
            ) {
                value |=
                    (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }

    throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    const b = uleb(a.next);

    return {
        offset: b.value,
        next: b.next
    };
}

interface Ins {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    kind: string;
    local?: number;
    value?: bigint | number;
    offset?: number;
    call?: number;
}

function decode(pos: number): Ins {
    const start = pos;
    const op = buf[pos++];

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.get",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.set",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.tee",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = sleb(pos, 32);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
            kind: "i32.const",
            value: Number(x.value)
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = sleb(pos, 64);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
            kind: "i64.const",
            value: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = uleb(pos);

        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `call ${x.value}`,
            kind: "call",
            call: x.value
        };
    }

    if (
        op === 0x28 ||
        op === 0x29 ||
        op === 0x36 ||
        op === 0x37
    ) {
        const m = memarg(pos);

        let name = "memory";

        if (op === 0x28)
            name = "i32.load";

        if (op === 0x29)
            name = "i64.load";

        if (op === 0x36)
            name = "i32.store";

        if (op === 0x37)
            name = "i64.store";

        return {
            start,
            end: m.next,
            op,
            text: `${name} offset=${m.offset}`,
            kind: name,
            offset: m.offset
        };
    }

    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",
        0x83: "i64.and",
        0x84: "i64.or",
        0x86: "i64.shl",
        0x88: "i64.shr_u",

        0xad: "i64.extend32_s",
        0xac: "i64.extend_i32_u"
    };

    return {
        start,
        end: pos,
        op,
        text:
            names[op] ??
            `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        kind: "other"
    };
}

function H(n: number) {
    return "0x" +
        n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const ins: Ins[] = [];

let p = START;

while (p < END) {
    const x = decode(p);
    ins.push(x);
    p = x.end;
}

if (p !== END) {
    throw new Error(
        `decode ended ${H(p)} expected ${H(END)}`
    );
}

FILE: scripts\resolveMemoryBase4154.ts

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 114;

function uleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 128))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }

  throw Error("ULEB");
}

function sleb(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let x = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    x = b[p++];

    v |= (x & 127) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 128))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 64))
    v |= -1 << s;

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function skipName(b: Buffer, p: number) {
  const n = uleb(b, p);
  return n.next + n.value;
}

function sections(b: Buffer): any {
  let p = 8;
  const r: any = {};

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    r[id] = {
      start: p,
      size: s.value
    };

    p += s.value;
  }

  return r;
}

function importedFuncs(b: Buffer, sec: any) {
  let p = sec.start;

  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  let count = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    p = skipName(b, p);
    p = skipName(b, p);

    const kind = b[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      p = uleb(b, p).next;
      count++;
    }
    else if (kind === 1 || kind === 2) {
      const f = uleb(b, p);
      p = f.next;

      p = uleb(b, p).next;

      if (f.value & 1)
        p = uleb(b, p).next;
    }
    else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return count;
}

function getBodies(
  b: Buffer,
  sec: any,
  imported: number
) {
  let p = sec.start;

  const n = uleb(b, p);
  p = n.next;

  const out: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const s = uleb(b, p);
    p = s.next;

    out.push({
      func: imported + i,
      start: p,
      end: p + s.value,
      bytes: b.subarray(p, p + s.value)
    });

    p += s.value;
  }

  return out;
}

type I = {
  off: number;
  op: number;
  imm: number[];
  text: string;
};

function decode(b: Buffer, base: number): I[] {
  const a: I[] = [];

  let p = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const off = base + p;
    const op = b[p++];

    const imm: number[] = [];
    let text = `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`;

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = sleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);
      text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22
    ) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x20
          ? `local.get ${r.value}`
          : op === 0x21
          ? `local.set ${r.value}`
          : `local.tee ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x23 ||
      op === 0x24
    ) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x23
          ? `global.get ${r.value}`
          : `global.set ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text = `call ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = uleb(b, p);
      p = t.next;

      const tab = uleb(b, p);
      p = tab.next;

      imm.push(t.value, tab.value);

      text =
        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
    }

    else if (
      op >= 0x28 &&
      op <= 0x3e
    ) {
      const al = uleb(b, p);
      p = al.next;

      const of = uleb(b, p);
      p = of.next;

      imm.push(al.value, of.value);

      text = `load offset=${of.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x6a)
      text = "i32.add";

    else if (op === 0x6b)
      text = "i32.sub";

    else if (op === 0x6c)
      text = "i32.mul";

    else if (op === 0x1a)
      text = "drop";

    else if (op === 0x0f)
      text = "return";

    else if (op === 0x0b)
      text = "end";

    else if (op === 0x05)
      text = "else";

    else if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04
    ) {
      if (p < b.length)
        p++;

      text =
        op === 0x02
          ? "block"
          : op === 0x03
          ? "loop"
          : "if";
    }

    else if (
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d
    ) {
      const r = uleb(b, p);
      p = r.next;

      imm.push(r.value);

      text =
        op === 0x0c
          ? `br ${r.value}`
          : `br_if ${r.value}`;
    }

    a.push({
      off,
      op,
      imm,
      text
    });
  }

  return a;
}

function show(
  a: I[],
  i: number
) {
  console.log();

  for (
    let j = Math.max(0, i - 12);
    j <= Math.min(a.length - 1, i + 3);
    j++
  ) {
    console.log(
      `${j === i ? " >>>" : "    "} ` +
      `0x${a[j].off.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
      a[j].text
    );
  }
}

export async function run() {
  const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);
  const sec = sections(wasm);

  const imported = importedFuncs(
    wasm,
    sec[2]
  );

  const bodies = getBodies(
    wasm,
    sec[10],
    imported
  );

  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );
  console.log(
    " RESOLVE MEMORY BASE -> INDIRECT INDEX 114"
  );
  console.log(
    " READ ONLY - OFFLINE"
  );
  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );

  console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length}`);
  console.log(`Target    : ${TARGET}`);
  console.log();

  let sites = 0;
  let memorySites = 0;
  let simpleBases = 0;
  let constants = 0;
  let interesting = 0;

  for (const body of bodies) {
    let a: I[];

    try {
      a = decode(
        body.bytes,
        body.start
      );
    }
    catch {
      continue;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      const c = a[i];

      if (
        c.op !== 0x11 ||
        c.imm[0] !== 0 ||
        c.imm[1] !== 0
      )
        continue;

      sites++;

      if (i < 1)
        continue;

      const outer = a[i - 1];

      if (
        outer.op < 0x28 ||
        outer.op > 0x3e
      )
        continue;

      memorySites++;

      const inner =
        i >= 2 ? a[i - 2] : undefined;

      const base =
        i >= 3 ? a[i - 3] : undefined;

      /*
       * Pattern:
       *
       * BASE
       *   load +inner
       *   load +outer
       *   call_indirect
       */

      if (
        inner &&
        inner.op >= 0x28 &&
        inner.op <= 0x3e
      ) {
        if (
          base &&
          base.op === 0x20
        ) {
          simpleBases++;

          if (interesting < 80) {
            console.log(
              `BASE LOCAL: func=${body.func} ` +
              `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)} ` +
              `local=${base.imm[0]} ` +
              `inner=+${inner.imm[1]} ` +
              `outer=+${outer.imm[1]}`
            );

            interesting++;
          }
        }
        else if (
          base &&
          base.op === 0x41
        ) {
          constants++;

          /*
           * Direct static-memory candidate.
           */
          const addr =
            base.imm[0] +
            inner.imm[1];

          if (
            addr >= 0 &&
            addr + 4 <= wasm.length
          ) {
            const value =
              wasm.readUInt32LE(addr);

            if (value === TARGET) {
              console.log(
                `FOUND STATIC 114: ` +
                `func=${body.func} ` +
                `call=0x${c.off.toString(16)} ` +
                `addr=0x${addr.toString(16)}`
              );

              show(a, i);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  console.log();

  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );
  console.log("SUMMARY");
  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );

  console.log(
    `Indirect sites      : ${sites}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Memory-derived      : ${memorySites}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Local-base chains   : ${simpleBases}`
  );

  console.log(
    `Constant-base chains: ${constants}`
  );

  console.log();

  console.log(
    "NEXT: resolve LOCAL-base chains backward."
  );
}

import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const TARGET = Address.parse(
    'EQCEwfJtb6ZmPJdNw387eJwed2N51K6dFFbH82jTxe_cf31e'
);

const EXPECTED_HASH =
    'C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const TONCENTER_TESTNET =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

function separator() {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
}

function bufferToHex(buffer: Buffer): string {
    return buffer.toString('hex').toUpperCase();
}

async function main() {
    separator();
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 ON-CHAIN LIBRARY RESOLVER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    separator();

    console.log();
    console.log('TARGET:');
    console.log(TARGET.toString());

    console.log();
    console.log('EXPECTED LIBRARY HASH:');
    console.log(EXPECTED_HASH);

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: TONCENTER_TESTNET,
    });

    console.log();
    console.log('Fetching account state...');

    const state = await client.getContractState(TARGET);

    console.log();
    console.log('STATE:', state.state);
    console.log('BALANCE:', state.balance.toString());

    if (state.state !== 'active') {
        console.log();
        console.log('Account is not active.');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    if (!state.code) {
        console.log();
        console.log('NO CODE BOC RETURNED.');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    const codeBoc = state.code;

    console.log();
    console.log('CODE BOC BYTES:');
    console.log(codeBoc.length);

    let cells: Cell[];

    try {
        cells = Cell.fromBoc(codeBoc);
    } catch (error) {
        console.log();
        console.log('FAILED TO PARSE CODE BOC.');
        console.log(error);
        console.log();
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    if (cells.length === 0) {
        console.log();
        console.log('NO ROOT CELL.');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    const code = cells[0];

    console.log();
    separator();
    console.log(' ON-CHAIN CODE CELL');
    separator();

    console.log('bits:', code.bits.length);
    console.log('refs:', code.refs.length);
    console.log('exotic:', code.isExotic);

    console.log();
    console.log('CELL HASH:');
    console.log(
        code.hash().toString('hex').toUpperCase()
    );

    /*
     * IMPORTANT:
     *
     * The installed TON version uses:
     *
     *     beginParse(allowExotic)
     *
     * where the argument is boolean.
     */

    let slice;

    try {
        slice = code.beginParse(true);
    } catch (error) {
        console.log();
        console.log('FAILED TO PARSE CODE CELL.');
        console.log(error);
        console.log();
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('REMAINING BITS:');
    console.log(slice.remainingBits);

    console.log();
    console.log('REMAINING REFS:');
    console.log(slice.remainingRefs);

    if (slice.remainingBits < 8) {
        console.log();
        console.log('Not enough bits for exotic type.');
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    const exoticType = slice.loadUint(8);

    console.log();
    separator();
    console.log(' EXOTIC CELL');
    separator();

    console.log(
        'type:',
        `0x${exoticType.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`
    );

    console.log(
        'decimal type:',
        exoticType
    );

    /*
     * TON Library Reference:
     *
     * 0x02
     * followed by 256-bit library hash
     */

    if (exoticType !== 2) {
        console.log();
        console.log(
            'RESULT: NOT A LIBRARY REFERENCE'
        );

        console.log();
        console.log(
            'Expected exotic type: 0x02'
        );

        console.log();
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    if (slice.remainingBits < 256) {
        console.log();
        console.log(
            'ERROR: Library Reference has fewer than 256 hash bits.'
        );

        console.log();
        console.log('No transaction was sent.');
        return;
    }

    const libraryHash = slice.loadBuffer(32);

    const actualHash = bufferToHex(libraryHash);

    console.log();
    separator();
    console.log(' LIBRARY REFERENCE');
    separator();

    console.log();
    console.log('LIBRARY HASH FROM ON-CHAIN CODE:');
    console.log(actualHash);

    console.log();
    console.log('EXPECTED HASH:');
    console.log(EXPECTED_HASH);

    console.log();
    console.log(
        'HASH MATCH:',
        actualHash === EXPECTED_HASH
    );

    console.log();
    console.log('HASH LENGTH:');
    console.log(actualHash.length);

    console.log();
    console.log('REMAINING BITS AFTER HASH:');
    console.log(slice.remainingBits);

    console.log();
    console.log('REMAINING REFS AFTER HASH:');
    console.log(slice.remainingRefs);

    console.log();

    if (actualHash === EXPECTED_HASH) {
        separator();
        console.log(' RESULT: VERIFIED ON-CHAIN');
        separator();

        console.log();
        console.log(
            'The target account contains the expected'
        );

        console.log(
            '256-bit Library Reference hash.'
        );

        console.log();
        console.log(
            'Next step: resolve the Library itself.'
        );
    } else {
        separator();
        console.log(' RESULT: HASH MISMATCH');
        separator();

        console.log();
        console.log(
            'The on-chain Library Reference hash differs'
        );

        console.log(
            'from the previously observed hash.'
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('No transaction was sent.');
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    await main();
}

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return [v >>> 0, p];
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

    dataStart = p;
    dataEnd = p + size;
    break;
  }

  p += size;
}

    [memStart, q] = u(q);

  let size;

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const targets = [];
for (let x = 0x1462; x <= 0x1489; x++) targets.push(x);

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return [v >>> 0, p];
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

let p = 8;
let dataStart = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  let size;
  [size, p] = u(p);

  if (id === 11) {
    dataStart = p;
    break;
  }

  p += size;
}

let q = dataStart;
let count;
[count, q] = u(q);

const hits = new Map();

for (let seg = 0; seg < count; seg++) {
  let flags;
  [flags, q] = u(q);

  if (flags !== 0) break;

  if (b[q++] !== 0x41) break;

  let memStart;
  [memStart, q] = u(q);

  if (b[q++] !== 0x0b) break;

  let size;
  [size, q] = u(q);

  const start = q;
  const end = q + size;

  for (let x = start; x + 4 <= end; x++) {
    const value =
      b[x] |
      (b[x + 1] << 8) |
      (b[x + 2] << 16) |
      (b[x + 3] << 24);

    const v = value >>> 0;

    if (targets.includes(v)) {
      const arr = hits.get(v) || [];
      arr.push({
        seg,
        file: x,
        runtime: memStart + x - start
      });
      hits.set(v, arr);
    }
  }

  q = end;
}

====================================================================================================
FILE: scripts\resolveStaticIndex4154.ts

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 114;
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

interface Segment {
    id: number;
    runtime: number;
    dataOffset: number;
    size: number;
    endRuntime: number;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos
    };
}

function hex(x: number): string {
    return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readMemoryI32(
    memory: Map<number, number>,
    addr: number
): number | null {
    const b0 = memory.get(addr);
    const b1 = memory.get(addr + 1);
    const b2 = memory.get(addr + 2);
    const b3 = memory.get(addr + 3);

    if (
        b0 === undefined ||
        b1 === undefined ||
        b2 === undefined ||
        b3 === undefined
    )
        return null;

    return (
        b0 |
        (b1 << 8) |
        (b2 << 16) |
        (b3 << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function parseDataSegments(): {
    segments: Segment[];
    memory: Map<number, number>;
} {
    let p = 8;

    const memory = new Map<number, number>();
    const segments: Segment[] = [];

    let segmentId = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const sectionId = wasm[p++];

        const s = readULEB(p);
        const sectionSize = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const payloadStart = p;
        const payloadEnd = p + sectionSize;

        if (sectionId !== 11) {
            p = payloadEnd;
            continue;
        }

        const c = readULEB(p);
        const count = c.value;
        p = c.next;

        console.log("");
        console.log("Data section found");
        console.log("Segments :", count);
        console.log("");

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const flags = readULEB(p);
            p = flags.next;

            let runtimeAddress = 0;

            /*
             * flags 0:
             *   active, memory 0, offset expression
             *
             * flags 1:
             *   passive
             *
             * flags 2:
             *   active, explicit memory index
             */
            if (flags.value === 0) {
                const op = wasm[p++];

                if (op !== 0x41) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Unexpected data offset opcode 0x${op.toString(16)} at ${hex(p - 1)}`
                    );
                }

                const x = readSLEB(p);
                runtimeAddress = x.value >>> 0;
                p = x.next;

                const end = wasm[p++];

                if (end !== 0x0b) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Unexpected data offset end 0x${end.toString(16)}`
                    );
                }
            }
            else if (flags.value === 1) {
                // passive segment
            }
            else if (flags.value === 2) {
                const memidx = readULEB(p);
                p = memidx.next;

                const op = wasm[p++];

                if (op !== 0x41) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Unexpected active-memory offset opcode`
                    );
                }

                const x = readSLEB(p);
                runtimeAddress = x.value >>> 0;
                p = x.next;

                const end = wasm[p++];

                if (end !== 0x0b) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `Unexpected active-memory offset end`
                    );
                }
            }
            else {
                console.log(
                    `WARNING: unsupported data flags ${flags.value} segment ${i}`
                );

                /*
                 * Best effort:
                 * skip conservatively is unsafe, so stop.
                 */
                throw new Error(
                    `Unsupported data segment flags=${flags.value}`
                );
            }

            const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
            const size = sizeInfo.value;
            p = sizeInfo.next;

            const dataOffset = p;

            if (flags.value !== 1) {
                for (let j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                    memory.set(
                        runtimeAddress + j,
                        wasm[dataOffset + j]
                    );
                }
            }

            segments.push({
                id: i,
                runtime: runtimeAddress,
                dataOffset,
                size,
                endRuntime: runtimeAddress + size
            });

            segmentId++;

            p += size;
        }

        break;
    }

    return {
        segments,
        memory
    };
}

function findSegment(
    segments: Segment[],
    addr: number
): Segment | undefined {
    return segments.find(
        s =>
            addr >= s.runtime &&
            addr + 3 < s.endRuntime
    );
}

function dumpNearby(
    memory: Map<number, number>,
    addr: number,
    radius = 16
) {
    const start = addr - radius;
    const end = addr + radius + 4;

    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 4) {
        const v = readMemoryI32(memory, p);

        if (v === null)
            continue;

        console.log(
            `    ${hex(p)} : ${hex(v)} (${v})`
        );
    }
}

function checkCandidate(
    memory: Map<number, number>,
    segments: Segment[],
    base: number,
    loadOffset: number,
    label: string
) {
    const addr = (base + loadOffset) >>> 0;
    const value = readMemoryI32(memory, addr);
    const seg = findSegment(segments, addr);

    console.log("");
    console.log(`CANDIDATE: ${label}`);
    console.log(`  base       = ${hex(base)} (${base})`);
    console.log(`  loadOffset = ${loadOffset}`);
    console.log(`  address    = ${hex(addr)} (${addr})`);

    if (!seg) {
        console.log("  segment    = NOT INITIALIZED");
        console.log("  value      = UNKNOWN");
        return;
    }

    console.log(`  segment    = ${seg.id}`);
    console.log(
        `  segOffset  = ${hex(addr - seg.runtime)}`
    );

    if (value === null) {
        console.log("  value      = UNKNOWN");
        return;
    }

    console.log(
        `  value      = ${hex(value)} (${value})`
    );

    if (value === TARGET) {
        console.log(
            "  >>> MATCH: VALUE == TABLE SLOT 114 <<<"
        );
    }

    console.log("  nearby:");
    dumpNearby(memory, addr);
}

import fs from "fs";

  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_TABLE = 0;
const TARGET_INDEX = 4601;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// READ WASM
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function hex(v, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// ULEB128
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function readULEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB128 overflow");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SLEB128
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function readSLEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let byte;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        byte = buf[p++];

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
                value |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return {
                value: value | 0,
                next: p
            };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("SLEB128 overflow");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTION NAME
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const sectionNames = {
    0: "CUSTOM",
    1: "TYPE",
    2: "IMPORT",
    3: "FUNCTION",
    4: "TABLE",
    5: "MEMORY",
    6: "GLOBAL",
    7: "EXPORT",
    8: "START",
    9: "ELEMENT",
    10: "CODE",
    11: "DATA",
    12: "DATACOUNT",
    13: "TAG"
};

    wasm[3] !== 0x6d
) {
    throw new Error("Invalid WASM header");
}

    );

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// ELEMENT EXPRESSION DECODER
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function skipInitExpr(buf, pos) {

    while (pos < buf.length) {

        const opcode = buf[pos++];

        // i32.const
        if (opcode === 0x41) {
            const r = readSLEB(buf, pos);
            pos = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // i64.const
        if (opcode === 0x42) {
            const r = readSLEB(buf, pos);
            pos = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // f32.const
        if (opcode === 0x43) {
            pos += 4;
            continue;
        }

        // f64.const
        if (opcode === 0x44) {
            pos += 8;
            continue;
        }

        // global.get
        if (opcode === 0x23) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, pos);
            pos = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // ref.null
        if (opcode === 0xd0) {
            pos += 1;
            continue;
        }

        // ref.func
        if (opcode === 0xd2) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, pos);
            pos = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // end
        if (opcode === 0x0b) {
            return pos;
        }

        // Unknown opcode
        throw new Error(
            `Unknown init-expr opcode 0x${opcode.toString(16)} at ${hex(pos - 1)}`
        );
    }

    throw new Error("Init expression did not terminate");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------

for (const section of elementSections) {

    console.log();
    console.log("=".repeat(72));

    const countInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const segmentCount = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    console.log(`SEGMENT COUNT : ${segmentCount}`);

    for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount; seg++) {

        const segmentStart = p;

        const flagInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
        const flags = flagInfo.value;
        p = flagInfo.next;

        console.log();

        // ----------------------------------------------------

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos:number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

        q = off.next;

        console.log(`  OFFSET      : ${off.value}`);

        q++; // end
      }

      const count = uleb(q);
      q = count.next;

      console.log(`  FUNCTIONS   : ${count.value}`);

      const first = q;

      for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const f = uleb(q);
        q = f.next;

        if (i >= 4780 && i <= 4800) {
          console.log(`    TABLE[${i}] = FUNC ${f.value}`);
        }
      }

      // For large segments, explicitly inspect entries if this segment
      // overlaps target indices.
      if (count.value > 4788) {
        console.log(`  RAW TARGET WINDOW:`);
        let r = first;
        for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(count.value, 4800); i++) {
          const f = uleb(r);
          r = f.next;

          if (i >= 4788 && i <= 4791) {
            console.log(`    [${i}] -> FUNC ${f.value}`);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  p = secEnd;

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_TABLE_INDEX = 0x12B6;

function uleb(p: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

        if (!(x & 0x80))
            return { value: v, next: p };

        s += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

let p = 8;

while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const r = uleb(p);
    const size = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    const end = p + size;

    if (id === 9) {
        const c = uleb(p);
        const segmentCount = c.value;
        p = c.next;

        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log("RESOLVE TABLE[0x12B6]");
        console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log("TARGET TABLE INDEX = " + TARGET_TABLE_INDEX);
        console.log("DECIMAL            = " + TARGET_TABLE_INDEX);
        console.log("SEGMENTS            = " + segmentCount);
        console.log("");

        for (let seg = 0; seg < segmentCount; seg++) {

            const flags = uleb(p);
            p = flags.next;

            if (flags.value !== 0) {
                console.log("Non-zero flags: " + flags.value);
                break;
            }

            const offsetOpcode = b[p++];

            if (offsetOpcode !== 0x41) {
                console.log("Unexpected offset opcode");
                break;
            }

            const offset = uleb(p);
            p = offset.next;

            const offsetEnd = b[p++];

            const n = uleb(p);
            const count = n.value;
            p = n.next;

            console.log("ELEMENT SEGMENT #" + seg);
            console.log("OFFSET = " + hex(offset.value));
            console.log("COUNT  = " + count);
            console.log("");

            // table index = offset + element position
            const elementPos =
                TARGET_TABLE_INDEX - offset.value;

            console.log(
                "ELEMENT POSITION = " + elementPos
            );

            if (
                elementPos < 0 ||
                elementPos >= count
            ) {
                console.log("TARGET OUT OF RANGE");
                break;
            }

            let targetFunc = -1;

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const f = uleb(p);
                p = f.next;

                if (i === elementPos)
                    targetFunc = f.value;
            }

            console.log("");
            console.log("============================================================");
            console.log("RESULT");
            console.log("============================================================");
            console.log(
                "table[" + TARGET_TABLE_INDEX + "] = FUNC " +
                targetFunc
            );
            console.log(
                "TABLE INDEX = " + hex(TARGET_TABLE_INDEX)
            );
            console.log(
                "TARGET FUNC = " + hex(targetFunc)
            );
            console.log("============================================================");

            break;
        }

        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p: number): [number, number] {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);
  return [v, p];
}

function section(id: number): [number, number] {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const sid = b[p++];

    let size: number;
    [size, p] = u(p);

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size;

    if (sid === id) return [start, end];

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("SECTION NOT FOUND " + id);
}

/* ============================================================
   SECTION 3 — FUNCTION TYPE INDICES
   ============================================================ */

let [p] = section(3);

let funcCount: number;
[funcCount, p] = u(p);

const typeOf: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < funcCount; i++) {
  let t: number;
  [t, p] = u(p);
  typeOf.push(t);
}

/* ============================================================
   SECTION 9 — ELEMENT
   ============================================================ */

let [es] = section(9);
p = es;

let segCount: number;
[segCount, p] = u(p);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TABLE 0 EXACT RESOLUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNCTION COUNT :", funcCount);
console.log("ELEMENT SEGMENTS:", segCount);

for (let s = 0; s < segCount; s++) {

  let flags: number;
  [flags, p] = u(p);

  console.log("");
  console.log("SEGMENT", s, "FLAGS", flags);

  if (flags !== 0) {
    console.log("UNSUPPORTED FLAGS:", flags);
    break;
  }

  /* active table 0, offset expression */

  const op = b[p++];

  let offset: number;

  if (op === 0x41) {
    [offset, p] = u(p);
  } else {
    throw new Error(
      "Unexpected offset opcode 0x" + op.toString(16)
    );
  }

  if (b[p++] !== 0x0b) {
    throw new Error("Missing offset END");
  }

  let count: number;
  [count, p] = u(p);

  console.log("TABLE OFFSET :", offset);
  console.log("FUNCTIONS    :", count);

  const wantedStart = 4780;
  const wantedEnd = 4800;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

    let f: number;
    [f, p] = u(p);

    const ti = offset + i;

    if (ti >= wantedStart && ti <= wantedEnd) {
      console.log(
        `TABLE[${ti}] = FUNC ${f} TYPE ${typeOf[f]}`
      );
    }
  }
}

console.log("");

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

let p = 8;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];

  const r = readULEB(p);
  const size = r.value;
  p = r.next;

  if (id === 1) {
    const end = p + size;

    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    console.log("TYPE 6 RESOLUTION");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("========================================================================");
    console.log(`TYPE COUNT : ${count.value}`);

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
      const form = wasm[p++];

      const np = readULEB(p);
      p = np.next;

      const params = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < np.value; j++) {
        params.push(wasm[p++]);
      }

      const nr = readULEB(p);
      p = nr.next;

      const results = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < nr.value; j++) {
        results.push(wasm[p++]);
      }

      if (i === 6) {
        console.log(`TYPE[6] FORM : 0x${form.toString(16)}`);
        console.log(`PARAM COUNT  : ${params.length}`);
        console.log(
          "PARAMS       :",
          params.map(x => `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(", ")
        );
        console.log(`RESULT COUNT : ${results.length}`);
        console.log(
          "RESULTS      :",
          results.map(x => `0x${x.toString(16)}`).join(", ")
        );
      }
    }

    console.log("========================================================================");
    break;
  }

  p += size;
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { createHash } from 'crypto';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const router = Address.parse(
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
    );

    const state = await provider.provider(router).getState();

    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER CODE HASH');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY ONLY');
    console.log('==========================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Router:', router.toString());
    console.log('State:', state.state.type);

    if (state.state.type === 'active' && state.state.code) {
        const code = state.state.code;

        console.log('Code bytes:', code.length);
        console.log('Code SHA256:', createHash('sha256').update(code).digest('hex'));

        try {
            const cell = Cell.fromBoc(code)[0];

            console.log('Cell hash:', cell.hash().toString('hex'));
            console.log('Cell depth:', cell.depth());
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('Cell decode failed:', String(e));
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const address = Address.parse(
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
    );

    console.log('===== ROUTER ONCHAIN DATA CHECK =====');
    console.log('Router:', address.toString());
    console.log('');

    const state = await provider.provider(address).getState();

    if (state.state.type !== 'active') {
        console.log('STATE:', state.state.type);
        return;
    }

    const code = state.state.code;
    const data = state.state.data;

    if (!code || !data) {
        console.log('CODE/DATA NOT AVAILABLE');
        return;
    }

    console.log('CODE BYTES:', code.length);
    console.log('DATA BYTES:', data.length);
    console.log('');

    // ===== CODE =====
    const codeCells = Cell.fromBoc(code);

    if (codeCells.length === 0) {
        console.log('CODE BOC COULD NOT BE PARSED');
        return;
    }

    const codeCell = codeCells[0];

    console.log('===== CODE =====');
    console.log('Bits:', codeCell.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', codeCell.refs.length);
    console.log('Exotic:', codeCell.isExotic);
    console.log('Code hash:', codeCell.hash().toString('hex'));
    console.log('');

    if (codeCell.isExotic) {
        const slice = codeCell.beginParse(true);
        const type = slice.loadUint(8);

        console.log('Exotic type:', type);

        if (type === 2) {
            const libraryHash = slice.loadBuffer(32);
            console.log(
                'Library hash:',
                libraryHash.toString('hex')
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('');

    // ===== DATA =====
    console.log('===== RAW DATA =====');
    console.log('Data base64:');
    console.log(data.toString('base64'));
    console.log('');

    const dataCells = Cell.fromBoc(data);

    if (dataCells.length === 0) {
        console.log('DATA BOC COULD NOT BE PARSED');
        return;
    }

    const dataCell = dataCells[0];

    console.log('===== PARSED DATA =====');
    console.log('Bits:', dataCell.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', dataCell.refs.length);
    console.log('Exotic:', dataCell.isExotic);
    console.log('Data hash:', dataCell.hash().toString('hex'));
    console.log('');

    // ===== FIRST 32 BYTES =====
    const s = dataCell.beginParse();

    console.log('===== DATA PREFIX =====');
    console.log('Remaining bits:', s.remainingBits);
    console.log('Remaining refs:', s.remainingRefs);

    const bytesToRead = Math.min(
        32,
        Math.floor(s.remainingBits / 8)
    );

    if (bytesToRead > 0) {
        const prefix = s.loadBuffer(bytesToRead);
        console.log(
            'First bytes:',
            prefix.toString('hex')
        );
    }
    // ===== DATA STRUCTURE INSPECTION =====
    console.log('');
    console.log('===== DATA STRUCTURE INSPECTION =====');

    const ds = dataCell.beginParse();

    console.log('Root bits:', ds.remainingBits);
    console.log('Root refs:', ds.remainingRefs);

    if (ds.remainingBits >= 32) {
        const first32 = ds.loadUint(32);
        console.log(
            'First uint32:',
            '0x' + first32.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );
    }

    console.log('After uint32 - bits:', ds.remainingBits);
    console.log('After uint32 - refs:', ds.remainingRefs);

    console.log('');

    for (let i = 0; i < dataCell.refs.length; i++) {
        const ref = dataCell.refs[i];

        console.log(`REF ${i}:`);
        console.log('  bits:', ref.bits.length);
        console.log('  refs:', ref.refs.length);
        console.log('  exotic:', ref.isExotic);
        console.log('  hash:', ref.hash().toString('hex'));

        const rs = ref.beginParse();

        const bytes = Math.min(
            32,
            Math.floor(rs.remainingBits / 8)
        );

        if (bytes > 0) {
            console.log(
                '  first bytes:',
                rs.loadBuffer(bytes).toString('hex')
            );
        }

        console.log('');
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const RANGE_START = 0x18f000;
const RANGE_END   = 0x191000;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SCAN CODE FOR REFERENCES NEAR DATA TABLE 4271..4279");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log(
  "ADDRESS RANGE :",
  "0x" + RANGE_START.toString(16),
  "..",
  "0x" + RANGE_END.toString(16)
);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << (shift + 7));
      }

      return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/*
 * Locate CODE section.
 */
let p = 8;

let codePayloadStart = null;
let codePayloadEnd = null;

while (p < buf.length) {

  const sectionId = buf[p++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
  if (!sizeInfo) break;

  const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const payloadStart = p;
  const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

  if (sectionId === 10) {
    codePayloadStart = payloadStart;
    codePayloadEnd = payloadEnd;
    break;
  }

  p = payloadEnd;
}

if (codePayloadStart === null) {
  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

console.log(
  "CODE SECTION :",
  hex(codePayloadStart),
  "..",
  hex(codePayloadEnd)
);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

/*
 * Decode function bodies sufficiently to identify:
 *
 *   i32.const <value>
 *
 * and print values close to 0x190000.
 */
let q = codePayloadStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(q);
q = countInfo.next;

const functionCount = countInfo.value;

console.log("CODE FUNCTION COUNT :", functionCount);
console.log("");

let totalHits = 0;

for (let func = 0; func < functionCount; func++) {

  const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(q);
  q = bodySizeInfo.next;

  const bodyStart = q;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySizeInfo.value;

  if (bodyEnd > codePayloadEnd) {
    console.log("BODY OUT OF RANGE:", func);
    break;
  }

  let x = bodyStart;

  /*
   * Local declarations.
   */
  const localGroupsInfo = readULEB(x);
  x = localGroupsInfo.next;

  const localGroups = localGroupsInfo.value;

  for (let g = 0; g < localGroups; g++) {

    const nInfo = readULEB(x);
    x = nInfo.next;

    // valtype
    x++;
  }

  while (x < bodyEnd) {

    const opPos = x;
    const opcode = buf[x++];

    /*
     * i32.const
     */
    if (opcode === 0x41) {

      const r = readSLEB(x);

      if (!r) break;

      const signed = r.value;
      const value = signed >>> 0;

      x = r.next;

      if (
        value >= RANGE_START &&
        value <= RANGE_END
      ) {

        totalHits++;

        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(
          "FUNC :",
          func
        );
        console.log(
          "I32.CONST :",
          hex(value)
        );
        console.log(
          "CODE POS :",
          hex(opPos)
        );

        /*
         * Show surrounding bytes.
         */
        const from = Math.max(bodyStart, opPos - 16);
        const to = Math.min(bodyEnd, x + 32);

        console.log("CONTEXT:");

        for (let z = from; z < to; z += 16) {

          const rowEnd = Math.min(to, z + 16);

          const bytes = [];

          for (let k = z; k < rowEnd; k++) {
            bytes.push(
              buf[k]
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(2, "0")
            );
          }

          console.log(
            "  " +
            hex(z) +
            " : " +
            bytes.join(" ")
          );
        }
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Common immediates that need skipping.
     */

    // local.get / local.set / local.tee
    if (
      opcode === 0x20 ||
      opcode === 0x21 ||
      opcode === 0x22
    ) {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;
      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    // call
    if (opcode === 0x10) {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;
      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    // call_indirect
    if (opcode === 0x11) {
      const a = readULEB(x);
      if (!a) break;
      x = a.next;

      const b = readULEB(x);
      if (!b) break;
      x = b.next;

      continue;
    }

    // br / br_if / br_table
    if (opcode === 0x0c || opcode === 0x0d) {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;
      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (opcode === 0x0e) {

      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;

      x = r.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
        const t = readULEB(x);
        if (!t) break;
        x = t.next;
      }

      const def = readULEB(x);
      if (!def) break;

      x = def.next;
      continue;
    }

    // block / loop / if
    if (
      opcode === 0x02 ||
      opcode === 0x03 ||
      opcode === 0x04
    ) {
      x++;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * memory instructions with memarg:
     * alignment + offset
     */
    if (
      opcode === 0x28 || // i32.load
      opcode === 0x29 || // i64.load
      opcode === 0x2c || // i32.load8_s
      opcode === 0x2d || // i32.load8_u
      opcode === 0x2e || // i32.load16_s
      opcode === 0x2f || // i32.load16_u
      opcode === 0x30 || // i64.load8_s
      opcode === 0x31 || // i64.load8_u
      opcode === 0x32 || // i64.load16_s
      opcode === 0x33 || // i64.load16_u
      opcode === 0x34 || // i64.load32_s
      opcode === 0x35 || // i64.load32_u
      opcode === 0x36 || // i32.store
      opcode === 0x37 || // i64.store
      opcode === 0x3a || // i32.store8
      opcode === 0x3b || // i32.store16
      opcode === 0x38 || // i64.store8
      opcode === 0x39 || // i64.store16
      opcode === 0x3c || // i64.store32
      opcode === 0x3f || // memory.size
      opcode === 0x40    // memory.grow
    ) {

      const a = readULEB(x);
      if (!a) break;

      x = a.next;

      if (
        opcode !== 0x3f &&
        opcode !== 0x40
      ) {
        const b = readULEB(x);
        if (!b) break;
        x = b.next;
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Global get/set
     */
    if (
      opcode === 0x23 ||
      opcode === 0x24
    ) {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      if (!r) break;
      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Most remaining numeric/simple opcodes
     * have no immediate.
     */
  }

  q = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("CODE I32.CONST HITS :", totalHits);
console.log("============================================================");

const target = 0x19534c;

function readS32(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v |= (-1 << (s + 7));

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function ulebBytes(v: number) {
    const out: number[] = [];
    do {
        let x = v & 0x7f;
        v >>>= 7;
        if (v) x |= 0x80;
        out.push(x);
    } while (v);
    return out;
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

            TARGET & 0xff,
            (TARGET >>> 8) & 0xff,
            (TARGET >>> 16) & 0xff,

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8, code = null;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const [n, q] = u(p);
  p = q;
  if (id === 10) code = [p, p + n];
  p += n;
}

p = code[0];

p = q0;

const TARGET = 0x195354;

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  const [size, q] = u(p);
  p = q;

  const func = 83 + i;
  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  for (let x = start; x < end; x++) {

    // i32/i64/f32/f64 store families
    if (![0x36,0x37,0x38,0x39,0x3a,0x3b].includes(b[x]))
      continue;

    for (let z = Math.max(start, x - 100); z < x; z++) {
      if (b[z] !== 0x41) continue;

      const [v, qv] = u(z + 1);

      // exact target or target adjusted by a small store offset
      if (v < TARGET - 16 || v > TARGET + 16)
        continue;

      let y = qv;

      // allow address arithmetic before store
      while (y < x && y < qv + 20) {
        if (b[y] === 0x6a) { // i32.add
          console.log(
            `FUNC ${func} STORE @ 0x${x.toString(16)} ` +
            `CONST=0x${v.toString(16)} ADD-before-store`
          );
          console.log(
            [...b.subarray(Math.max(start,z-12),Math.min(end,x+8))]
              .map(a=>a.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join(" ")
          );
          console.log("--------------------------------------------");
          break;
        }

        y++;
      }
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const LO = 0x00195000;
const HI = 0x00196000;

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function getSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];

    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
}

function getBodies() {
  const sec = getSection(10);

  let p = sec.start;

  const c = readUleb(p);
  p = c.next;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    bodies.push({
      func: 83 + i,
      start: p,
      end: p + s.value,
    });

    p += s.value;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function decode(pos: number) {
  const addr = pos;
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);
    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "const",
      value: x.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "local.get",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "local.set",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "local.tee",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x23) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "global.get",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x24) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "global.set",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 || op === 0x2d) {
    const a = readUleb(pos);
    const o = readUleb(a.next);

    return {
      addr,
      next: o.next,
      kind: op === 0x2d ? "load8" : "load",
      offset: o.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 || op === 0x3a || op === 0x3b) {
    const a = readUleb(pos);
    const o = readUleb(a.next);

    return {
      addr,
      next: o.next,
      kind:
        op === 0x3a
          ? "store8"
          : op === 0x3b
          ? "store16"
          : "store",
      offset: o.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x6a) return { addr, next: pos, kind: "add" };
  if (op === 0x6b) return { addr, next: pos, kind: "sub" };

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "call",
      func: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind: op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if",
      depth: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      next: x.next,
      kind:
        op === 0x02
          ? "block"
          : op === 0x03
          ? "loop"
          : "if",
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    return {
      addr,
      next: pos,
      kind: "end",
    };
  }

  return {
    addr,
    next: pos,
    kind: `unknown_${hex(op, 2)}`,
  };
}

function show(x: any) {
  let s = `${hex(x.addr)} ${x.kind}`;

  if (x.value !== undefined) {
    s += ` ${hex(x.value)}`;
  }

  if (x.offset !== undefined) {
    s += ` offset=${hex(x.offset)}`;
  }

  if (x.index !== undefined) {
    s += ` index=${x.index}`;
  }

  if (x.func !== undefined) {
    s += ` func=${x.func}`;
  }

  return s;
}

console.log("SCAN REGION 0x195000 .. 0x196000");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let total = 0;

for (const body of getBodies()) {
  let p = body.start;
  const ins: any[] = [];

  while (p < body.end) {
    const x = decode(p);
    ins.push(x);

    p = x.next;

    if (x.kind.startsWith("unknown_")) {
      break;
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
    const x = ins[i];

    /*
     * Absolute memory access:
     *
     * i32.const C
     * i32.load/store
     *
     * The memory offset may be zero or non-zero.
     */
    if (
      x.kind === "const" &&
      x.value >= LO &&
      x.value < HI
    ) {
      console.log("");
      console.log("============================================================");
      console.log(
        `FUNC ${body.func} | CONST ${hex(x.value)} @ ${hex(x.addr)}`
      );
      console.log("============================================================");

      for (
        let j = Math.max(0, i - 3);
        j < Math.min(ins.length, i + 10);
        j++
      ) {
        console.log(show(ins[j]));
      }

      total++;
    }

    /*
     * Direct store with an offset inside the target region.
     *
     * This catches cases where the base is zero/implicit and the
     * encoded memarg itself lands in the region.
     */
    if (
      (x.kind === "store" ||
        x.kind === "store8" ||
        x.kind === "store16") &&
      x.offset >= LO &&
      x.offset < HI
    ) {
      console.log("");
      console.log("============================================================");
      console.log(
        `FUNC ${body.func} | STORE OFFSET ${hex(x.offset)} @ ${hex(x.addr)}`
      );
      console.log("============================================================");

      for (
        let j = Math.max(0, i - 5);
        j <= i;
        j++
      ) {
        console.log(show(ins[j]));
      }

      total++;
    }
  }
}
