import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = new Set([
  0x195348,
  0x19534c,
  0x195350,
  0x195354,
  0x195358
]);

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }

  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function codeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    const r = uleb(p);
    const size = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    if (id === 10)
      return { start: p, end: p + size };

    p += size;
  }

  throw new Error("code section not found");
}

function bodies() {
  const sec = codeSection();
  let p = sec.start;

  const c = uleb(p);
  p = c.next;

  const out = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    const size = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    out.push({
      func: 83 + i,
      start: p,
      end: p + size
    });

    p += size;
  }

  return out;
}

function decodeConst(pos) {
  if (wasm[pos] !== 0x41) return null;

  const r = uleb(pos + 1);

  return {
    value: r.value,
    next: r.next
  };
}

function decodeLoadStore(pos) {
  if (wasm[pos] !== 0x28 && wasm[pos] !== 0x36)
    return null;

  const a = uleb(pos + 1);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    op: wasm[pos] === 0x28 ? "LOAD" : "STORE",
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next
  };
}

      continue;

    console.log(
      `CONST FUNC ${body.func} @ 0x${p.toString(16)} = 0x${c.value.toString(16)}`
    );

    let q = c.next;
    let steps = 0;

    while (q < body.end && steps < 24) {

      const x = decodeLoadStore(q);

      if (x) {
        if (x.op === "STORE") {
          console.log(
            `  STORE @ 0x${q.toString(16)} offset=${x.offset}`
          );
          hits++;
        }

        q = x.next;
      } else {
        q++;
      }

      steps++;
    }

    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------------------");
  }
}

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(n: number): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];

    n >>>= 0;

    while (n >= 0x80) {
        out.push((n & 0x7f) | 0x80);
        n >>>= 7;
    }

    out.push(n);
    return out;
}

function hexByte(b: number): string {
    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
}

function hexAddr(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function dump(pos: number, radius = 20) {
    const start = Math.max(0, pos - radius);
    const end = Math.min(wasm.length, pos + radius + 1);

    const bytes: string[] = [];

    for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
        if (i === pos) {
            bytes.push(`[${hexByte(wasm[i])}]`);
        } else {
            bytes.push(hexByte(wasm[i]));
        }
    }

    console.log(`    file ${hexAddr(pos)}`);
    console.log(`    ${bytes.join(" ")}`);
}

function findBytes(
    start: number,
    end: number,
    pattern: number[]
): number[] {
    const hits: number[] = [];

    outer:
    for (let p = start; p + pattern.length <= end; p++) {
        for (let i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
            if (wasm[p + i] !== pattern[i]) {
                continue outer;
            }
        }

        hits.push(p);
    }

    return hits;
}

function classifyNearby(pos: number, target: number): string[] {
    const result: string[] = [];

    const from = Math.max(0, pos - 8);
    const to = Math.min(wasm.length, pos + 16);

    for (let p = from; p < to; p++) {
        const op = wasm[p];

        if (op === 0x41) {
            result.push(`i32.const candidate @ ${hexAddr(p)}`);
        }

        if (op === 0x28) {
            result.push(`i32.load @ ${hexAddr(p)}`);
        }

        if (op === 0x36) {
            result.push(`i32.store @ ${hexAddr(p)}`);
        }

        if (op === 0x22) {
            result.push(`local.tee @ ${hexAddr(p)}`);
        }

        if (op === 0x20) {
            result.push(`local.get @ ${hexAddr(p)}`);
        }

        if (op === 0x74) {
            result.push(`i32.shl @ ${hexAddr(p)}`);
        }

        if (op === 0x77) {
            result.push(`i32.rotl @ ${hexAddr(p)}`);
        }
    }

    return result;
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGETS = [
  0x50098050,
  0x50098054
];

const RANGE_START = 0x50098000;
const RANGE_END   = 0x50098080;

function hex(v, n = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < b.length) {

    const x = b[pos++];

    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

    const more = x & 0x80;

    shift += 7;

    if (!more) {

      // Correct i32 sign extension
      if (
        shift < 32 &&
        (x & 0x40)
      ) {
        value |=
          (-1 << shift);
      }

      return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }

    if (shift > 35) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function readName(pos) {
  const r = readULEB(pos);

  if (!r) return null;

  return {
    name:
      b.subarray(
        r.next,
        r.next + r.value
      ).toString("utf8"),

    next:
      r.next + r.value
  };
}

function skipLimits(pos) {
  const flags = readULEB(pos);

  if (!flags) return null;

  let q = flags.next;

  const min = readULEB(q);

  if (!min) return null;

  q = min.next;

  if (flags.value & 1) {

    const max = readULEB(q);

    if (!max) return null;

    q = max.next;
  }

  return q;
}

// ============================================================
// MODULE STRUCTURE
// ============================================================

let p = 8;

let importedFunctions = 0;

const codeBodies = [];

while (p < b.length) {

  const sectionId = b[p++];

  const sr = readULEB(p);

  if (!sr) break;

  const sectionSize = sr.value;

  p = sr.next;

  const sectionEnd =
    p + sectionSize;

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // IMPORT
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (sectionId === 2) {

    const cr = readULEB(p);

    if (!cr) break;

    const count = cr.value;

    p = cr.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

      const m = readName(p);
      if (!m) break;

      p = m.next;

      const n = readName(p);
      if (!n) break;

      p = n.next;

      const kind = b[p++];

      if (kind === 0) {

        const t = readULEB(p);

        if (!t) break;

        p = t.next;

        importedFunctions++;
      }

      else if (kind === 1) {

        p++;

        p = skipLimits(p);
      }

      else if (kind === 2) {

        p = skipLimits(p);
      }

      else if (kind === 3) {

        p += 2;
      }
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // CODE
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  else if (sectionId === 10) {

    const cr = readULEB(p);

    if (!cr) break;

    const count = cr.value;

    p = cr.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

      const br = readULEB(p);

      if (!br) break;

      const size = br.value;

      p = br.next;

      const start = p;
      const end = p + size;

      codeBodies.push({
        start,
        end
      });

      p = end;
    }
  }

  p = sectionEnd;
}

  let definedIndex = 0;
  definedIndex < codeBodies.length;
  definedIndex++
) {

  const func =
    importedFunctions + definedIndex;

  const body =
    codeBodies[definedIndex];

  let i = body.start;

  while (i < body.end) {

    const at = i;
    const op = b[i++];

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.load / i64.load
    // i32.load8_u / i32.load16_u
    // i32.store / i64.store
    // i32.store8 / i32.store16
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const memoryOps = [
      0x28, // i32.load
      0x29, // i64.load
      0x2c, // i32.load8_s
      0x2d, // i32.load8_u
      0x2e, // i32.load16_s
      0x2f, // i32.load16_u
      0x36, // i32.store
      0x37, // i64.store
      0x38, // f32.store
      0x39, // f64.store
      0x3a, // i32.store8
      0x3b  // i32.store16
    ];

    if (memoryOps.includes(op)) {

      const align =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!align) break;

      i = align.next;

      const off =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!off) break;

      i = off.next;

      const offset =
        off.value >>> 0;

      // We cannot know the runtime base of the
      // address from a memory instruction alone.
      // But if the offset itself lies in target range,
      // report it.

      if (
        offset >= RANGE_START &&
        offset < RANGE_END
      ) {

        total++;

        const kind =
          (
            op >= 0x36
              ? "STORE"
              : "LOAD"
          );

        console.log(
          `FUNC ${func} ` +
          `${kind} @ ${hex(at)} ` +
          `offset=${hex(offset)}`
        );
      }

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.const
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x41) {

      const r =
        readSLEB(i);

      if (!r) break;

      i = r.next;

      const u =
        r.value >>> 0;

      if (
        u >= RANGE_START &&
        u < RANGE_END
      ) {

        total++;

        console.log(
          `FUNC ${func} ` +
          `I32.CONST @ ${hex(at)} ` +
          `value=${hex(u)}`
        );
      }

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CALL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x10) {

      const r =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!r) break;

      i = r.next;

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // CALL INDIRECT
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x11) {

      const t =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!t) break;

      i = t.next;

      const table =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!table) break;

      i = table.next;

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // LOCAL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22
    ) {

      const r =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!r) break;

      i = r.next;

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // GLOBAL
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      op === 0x23 ||
      op === 0x24
    ) {

      const r =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!r) break;

      i = r.next;

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // BLOCK / LOOP / IF
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04
    ) {

      i++;

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // BR / BR_IF
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d
    ) {

      const r =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!r) break;

      i = r.next;

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // BR_TABLE
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x0e) {

      const r =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!r) break;

      let q = r.next;

      for (
        let k = 0;
        k < r.value;
        k++
      ) {

        const x =
          readULEB(q);

        if (!x) break;

        q = x.next;
      }

      const def =
        readULEB(q);

      if (!def) break;

      i = def.next;

      continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // PREFIX FC
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0xfc) {

      const r =
        readULEB(i);

      if (!r) break;

      i = r.next;

      continue;
    }
  }
}

import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const decoderPath = path.resolve("scripts/disassembleAddressUsers.mjs");
const source = fs.readFileSync(decoderPath, "utf8");

const marker = "console.log('\\nROOSTER WASM - FUNC 2034 AND CALLERS');";
const markerIndex = source.indexOf(marker);

if (markerIndex < 0) {
    throw new Error("Could not locate decoder bootstrap marker.");
}

const tempPath = path.join(
    os.tmpdir(),
    `rooster_bulk_memory_${process.pid}.mjs`
);

fs.writeFileSync(
    tempPath,
    source.slice(0, markerIndex) +
        "\nexport { bodies, decodeFunction };\n",
    "utf8"
);

let decoder;
try {
    decoder = await import(pathToFileURL(tempPath).href);
} finally {
    try {
        fs.unlinkSync(tempPath);
    } catch {}
}

const { bodies, decodeFunction } = decoder;

if (!(bodies instanceof Map) || typeof decodeFunction !== "function") {
    throw new Error("Could not initialize decoder exports.");
}

const CONTEXT = 6;
const MAX_REPORTS = 250;
const TARGET = 0x256aac;

const counts = {
    functions: bodies.size,
    decoded: 0,
    errors: 0,
    memoryInit: 0,
    memoryCopy: 0,
    memoryFill: 0,
    reports: 0
};

const output = [];

function log(s = "") {
    output.push(String(s));
}

function hex(n) {
    return `0x${n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`;
}

function isTargetOp(text) {
    if (/\bmemory\.init\b/.test(text)) return "memory.init";
    if (/\bmemory\.copy\b/.test(text)) return "memory.copy";
    if (/\bmemory\.fill\b/.test(text)) return "memory.fill";
    return null;
}

log("ROOSTER WASM — BULK MEMORY OPERATION SCAN");
log("READ ONLY / OFFLINE / NO WASM EXECUTION");
log(`REFERENCE ADDRESS: ${hex(TARGET)}`);
log(`CONTEXT: ${CONTEXT} instructions before/after`);
log("These are candidates, not proof of a write to the target.");
log("=".repeat(78));

for (const [func] of bodies) {
    let result;

    try {
        result = decodeFunction(func);
        counts.decoded++;
    } catch {
        counts.errors++;
        continue;
    }

    const instructions = result?.instructions;
    if (!Array.isArray(instructions)) {
        counts.errors++;
        continue;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
        const ins = instructions[i];
        const kind = isTargetOp(ins.text);

        if (!kind) continue;
        counts[kind === "memory.init" ? "memoryInit" :
               kind === "memory.copy" ? "memoryCopy" : "memoryFill"]++;

        if (counts.reports >= MAX_REPORTS) continue;
        counts.reports++;

        log("\n" + "-".repeat(78));
        log(`${kind} | FUNC ${func} | INSTRUCTION #${i} | ${hex(ins.start)}`);

        const from = Math.max(0, i - CONTEXT);
        const to = Math.min(instructions.length - 1, i + CONTEXT);

        for (let j = from; j <= to; j++) {
            const item = instructions[j];
            const mark = j === i ? " >>> " : "     ";
            log(`${mark}#${j} ${hex(item.start)} ${item.text}`);
        }
    }
}

log("\n" + "=".repeat(78));
log("SUMMARY");
for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(counts)) {
    log(`${key}: ${value}`);
}
log("Note: report cap applies to printed contexts, not operation counts.");

const outputPath = path.resolve("scripts/scan7006BulkMemoryOps_output.txt");
fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, output.join("\n") + "\n", "utf8");

console.log(output.slice(0, 90).join("\n"));
console.log(`\nFull report: ${outputPath}`);

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 8951;

// i32.const 8951
// opcode 0x41
// signed LEB128(8951) = f7 c5 00
const PATTERN = Buffer.from([
  0x41,
  0xf7,
  0xc5,
  0x00
]);

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {

    if (p >= bytes.length)
      throw new Error("ULEB out of range");

    const b = bytes[p++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value,
        next: p
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  throw new Error(`ULEB too long at 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
}

function readString(p) {

  const x = readULEB(p);
  const start = x.next;
  const end = start + x.value;

  return {
    value: bytes.toString("utf8", start, end),
    next: end
  };
}

function parseSections() {

  let p = 8;
  const sections = [];

  while (p < bytes.length) {

    const id = bytes[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + sizeInfo.value;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start,
      end
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return sections;
}

function parseImports(section) {

  let p = section.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  p = countInfo.next;

  let importedFunctions = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {

    const mod = readString(p);
    p = mod.next;

    const name = readString(p);
    p = name.next;

    const kind = bytes[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {

      const typeInfo = readULEB(p);
      p = typeInfo.next;

      importedFunctions++;
    }

    else if (kind === 1) {

      p++; // element type

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = readULEB(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const max = readULEB(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 2) {

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = readULEB(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const max = readULEB(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 3) {

      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return importedFunctions;
}

function parseFunctionSection(section) {

  let p = section.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  p = countInfo.next;

  const types = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {

    const typeInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = typeInfo.next;

    types.push(typeInfo.value);
  }

  return types;
}

function parseCodeSection(
  section,
  functionTypes,
  importedFunctions
) {

  let p = section.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  p = countInfo.next;

  const functions = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < countInfo.value; i++) {

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

    functions.push({
      index: importedFunctions + i,
      type: functionTypes[i],
      start: bodyStart,
      end: bodyEnd
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return functions;
}

function hex(n) {

  return (
    "0x" +
    n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")
  );
}

function context(pos) {

  const start =
    Math.max(0, pos - 12);

  const end =
    Math.min(bytes.length, pos + 20);

  return bytes
    .subarray(start, end)
    .toString("hex");
}

function findPattern(start, end) {

  const hits = [];

  for (
    let p = start;
    p <= end - PATTERN.length;
    p++
  ) {

    let match = true;

    for (
      let i = 0;
      i < PATTERN.length;
      i++
    ) {

      if (bytes[p + i] !== PATTERN[i]) {
        match = false;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (match)
      hits.push(p);
  }

  return hits;
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(p:number){
  let v=0,s=0;
  while(true){
    const x=b[p++];
    v |= (x&0x7f)<<s;
    if(!(x&0x80)) return {v:v>>>0,p};
    s+=7;
  }
}

function str(p:number){
  const x=uleb(p);
  return x.p+x.v;
}

let imported=0;
const funcs:{fn:number,code:number,end:number}[]=[];

let p=8;

while(p<b.length){
  const id=b[p++];
  const z=uleb(p);
  const start=z.p;
  const end=start+z.v;

  if(id===2){
    let q=start;
    const n=uleb(q); q=n.p;

    for(let i=0;i<n.v;i++){
      q=str(q);
      q=str(q);

      if(kind===0){

        imported++;
      }else if(kind===1){
        q++;

      }else if(kind===2){
        q=uleb(q).p;
      }else if(kind===3){
        q+=2;
      }
    }
  }

  if(id===10){
    let q=start;
    const n=uleb(q); q=n.p;

  p=end;
}

function decodeOne(p:number){
  const start=p;
  const op=b[p++];

  try{
    if(op===0x20){
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`local.get ${x.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x21){
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`local.set ${x.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x22){
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`local.tee ${x.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x41){
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`i32.const ${x.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x10){
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`call ${x.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x11){
      const x=uleb(p);
      p=x.p;
      const y=uleb(p);
      return {next:y.p,s:`call_indirect type=${x.v} table=${y.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x28){
      p=uleb(p).p;
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`i32.load offset=${x.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x29){
      p=uleb(p).p;
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`i64.load offset=${x.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x36){
      p=uleb(p).p;
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`i32.store offset=${x.v}`};
    }

    if(op===0x37){
      p=uleb(p).p;
      const x=uleb(p);
      return {next:x.p,s:`i64.store offset=${x.v}`};
    }

    const names:any = {
      0x6a:"i32.add",
      0x6b:"i32.sub",
      0x6c:"i32.mul",
      0x6d:"i32.div_s",
      0x45:"i32.eqz",
      0x47:"i32.lt_u",
      0x48:"i32.lt_s",
      0x46:"i32.eq",
      0x1a:"drop",
      0x84:"i64.mul",
      0x50:"i64.eqz",
      0x0b:"end"
    };

    return {
      next:p,
      s:names[op] ?? `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
    };

  }catch{
    return {next:p,s:`opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`};
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCS = new Set([480, 1907]);

const TARGET_START = 0x19534c;
const TARGET_END   = 0x195358 + 4;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, pos: number): { value: number, next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, pos: number): { value: number, next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value -= Math.pow(2, shift);

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function readSectionHeader(pos: number) {
    const id = bytes[pos++];
    const r = readULEB(bytes, pos);
    return {
        id,
        size: r.value,
        payload: r.next,
        next: r.next + r.value
    };
}

function getCodeSection() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const s = readSectionHeader(p);

        if (s.id === 10) {
            return {
                start: s.payload,
                end: s.next
            };
        }

        p = s.next;
    }

    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

const code = getCodeSection();

let p = code.start;

const functionCount = readULEB(bytes, p);
p = functionCount.next;

const bodies: {
    globalFunc: number;
    bodyStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;
    codeStart: number;
    codeEnd: number;
}[] = [];

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < functionCount.value; ordinal++) {
    const bodySize = readULEB(bytes, p);
    const bodyStart = bodySize.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize.value;

    let q = bodyStart;

    const localDecl = readULEB(bytes, q);
    q = localDecl.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localDecl.value; i++) {
        const n = readULEB(bytes, q);
        q = n.next;

        q++; // value type
    }

    bodies.push({
        globalFunc: ordinal + 83,
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
        codeStart: q,
        codeEnd: bodyEnd
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
}

function u32At(pos: number) {
    return (
        bytes[pos] |
        (bytes[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (bytes[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (bytes[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function decodeImmediate(pc: number) {
    const op = bytes[pc];

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = readSLEB(bytes, pc + 1);
        return {
            kind: "i32.const",
            value: r.value,
            end: r.next
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const r = readSLEB(bytes, pc + 1);
        return {
            kind: "i64.const",
            value: r.value,
            end: r.next
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const r = readULEB(bytes, pc + 1);
        return {
            kind: `local.get ${r.value}`,
            value: null,
            end: r.next
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const r = readULEB(bytes, pc + 1);
        return {
            kind: `local.set ${r.value}`,
            value: null,
            end: r.next
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const r = readULEB(bytes, pc + 1);
        return {
            kind: `local.tee ${r.value}`,
            value: null,
            end: r.next
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x6a)
        return { kind: "i32.add", value: null, end: pc + 1 };

    if (op === 0x6b)
        return { kind: "i32.sub", value: null, end: pc + 1 };

    if (op === 0x45)
        return { kind: "i32.eqz", value: null, end: pc + 1 };

    if (op === 0x47)
        return { kind: "i32.ne", value: null, end: pc + 1 };

    if (op === 0x28) {
        const a = bytes[pc + 1];
        const r = readULEB(bytes, pc + 2);

        return {
            kind: `i32.load offset=${hex(r.value)}`,
            value: null,
            end: r.next
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x36) {
        const a = bytes[pc + 1];
        const r = readULEB(bytes, pc + 2);

        return {
            kind: `i32.store offset=${hex(r.value)}`,
            value: null,
            end: r.next
        };
    }

    if (op === 0xfc) {
        const sub = readULEB(bytes, pc + 1);

        let kind = `0xfc/${sub.value}`;

        if (sub.value === 8) kind = "memory.init";
        if (sub.value === 9) kind = "data.drop";
        if (sub.value === 10) kind = "memory.copy";
        if (sub.value === 11) kind = "memory.fill";

        return {
            kind,
            value: null,
            end: sub.next
        };
    }

    return {
        kind: `opcode ${hex(op, 2)}`,
        value: null,
        end: pc + 1
    };
}

function findFunction(pc: number) {
    return bodies.find(
        b => pc >= b.codeStart && pc < b.codeEnd
    );
}

function formatOperand(kind: string, value: number | null) {
    if (value !== null)
        return `${kind} = ${value} (${hex(value)})`;

    return kind;
}

function staticRangeOverlap(dst: number | null, len: number | null) {
    if (dst === null || len === null)
        return "UNKNOWN";

    const end = dst + len - 1;

    return (
        dst <= TARGET_END - 1 &&
        end >= TARGET_START
    ) ? "YES" : "NO";
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const IMPORTED = 83;
const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[p++];
        v += (b & 127) * 2 ** s;
        if (!(b & 128)) return { value: v, next: p };
        s += 7;
    }
}

function findCode() {
    let p = 8;
    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];
        const z = uleb(p);
        const start = z.next;
        const end = start + z.value;
        if (id === 10) return { start, end };
        p = end;
    }
    throw Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function decode(p) {
    const start = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        return [x.next, `local.get ${x.value}`];
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        return [x.next, `local.set ${x.value}`];
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        return [x.next, `local.tee ${x.value}`];
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        return [x.next, `i32.const ${x.value}`];
    }

    if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x36) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        const o = uleb(a.next);
        const name = op === 0x28 ? "i32.load" : "i32.store";
        return [o.next, `${name} align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`];
    }

    if (op === 0x37) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        const o = uleb(a.next);
        return [o.next, `i64.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`];
    }

    if (op === 0x2d) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        const o = uleb(a.next);
        return [o.next, `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`];
    }

    if (op === 0x6a) return [p, "i32.add"];
    if (op === 0x6b) return [p, "i32.sub"];
    if (op === 0x46) return [p, "i32.eq"];
    if (op === 0x47) return [p, "i32.ne"];
    if (op === 0x45) return [p, "i32.eqz"];

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        return [x.next, `call ${x.value}`];
    }

    if (op === 0x0b) return [p, "end"];

    return [p, `opcode_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`];
}

const code = findCode();

let p = code.start;
const n = uleb(p);
p = n.next;

const hits = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

    const z = uleb(p);
    const bodyStart = z.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + z.value;
    const func = IMPORTED + i;

    let q = bodyStart;

    const groups = uleb(q);
    q = groups.next;

    for (let g = 0; g < groups.value; g++) {
        const cnt = uleb(q);
        q = cnt.next + 1;
    }

    const ins = [];

    while (q < bodyEnd) {
        const addr = q;
        const [next, text] = decode(q);

        ins.push({ addr, text });
        q = next;

        if (text === "end") break;
    }

    for (let j = 0; j < ins.length; j++) {

        if (ins[j].text === "i32.store align=2 offset=4" ||
            ins[j].text === "i32.store align=0 offset=4" ||
            ins[j].text === "i64.store align=2 offset=4") {

            hits.push({
                func,
                bodyStart,
                bodyEnd,
                index: j,
                ins
            });
        }
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

import fs from "fs";

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8, code = null;

}

  for (let x = start; x < end - 1; x++) {

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [480, 1907];

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: p,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    b = wasm[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      break;
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: p,
  };
}

function findSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[p++];

    const size = readULEB(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    if (sectionId === id) {
      return {
        start,
        end,
      };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

function parseBodies() {
  const sec = findSection(10);

  if (!sec) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
  }

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readULEB(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    bodies.push({
      ordinal: i,
      start,
      end,
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return {
    section: sec,
    bodies,
  };
}

function decodeInstruction(p: number) {
  const start = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  let text = `opcode_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

  switch (op) {
    case 0x02:
      {
        const r = readSLEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `block ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x03:
      {
        const r = readSLEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `loop ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x04:
      {
        const r = readSLEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `if ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x05:
      text = "else";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      text = "end";
      break;

    case 0x0c:
      {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `br ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x0d:
      {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x0f:
      text = "return";
      break;

    case 0x10:
      {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `call FUNC${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x11:
      {
        const type = readULEB(p);
        p = type.next;

        const table = readULEB(p);
        p = table.next;

        text = `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x1a:
      text = "drop";
      break;

    case 0x20:
      {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x21:
      {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x22:
      {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x23:
      {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x24:
      {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x28:
    case 0x29:
    case 0x2c:
    case 0x2d:
    case 0x36:
    case 0x37:
    case 0x3a:
      {
        const align = readULEB(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = readULEB(p);
        p = offset.next;

        text =
          `memop align=${align.value}` +
          ` offset=${hex(offset.value)}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x41:
      {
        const r = readSLEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text =
          `i32.const ${r.value}` +
          ` (${hex(r.value >>> 0)})`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x42:
      {
        const r = readSLEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
      }
      break;

    case 0x45:
      text = "i32.eqz";
      break;

    case 0x46:
      text = "i32.eq";
      break;

    case 0x47:
      text = "i32.ne";
      break;

    case 0x6a:
      text = "i32.add";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      text = "i32.sub";
      break;

    case 0x6c:
      text = "i32.mul";
      break;

    case 0xa7:
      text = "i32.wrap_i64";
      break;

    case 0xfc:
      {
        const sub = readULEB(p);
        p = sub.next;

        if (sub.value === 8) {
          const data = readULEB(p);
          p = data.next;

          const mem = readULEB(p);
          p = mem.next;

          text =
            `memory.init data=${data.value}` +
            ` mem=${mem.value}`;
        }

        else if (sub.value === 9) {
          const data = readULEB(p);
          p = data.next;

          text =
            `data.drop data=${data.value}`;
        }

        else if (sub.value === 10) {
          const dst = readULEB(p);
          p = dst.next;

          const src = readULEB(p);
          p = src.next;

          text =
            `memory.copy mem${dst.value}` +
            ` <- mem${src.value}`;
        }

        else if (sub.value === 11) {
          const mem = readULEB(p);
          p = mem.next;

          text = `memory.fill mem${mem.value}`;
        }

        else {
          text = `PREFIX_FC sub=${sub.value}`;
        }
      }
      break;

    default:
      break;
  }

  return {
    start,
    end: p,
    op,
    text,
  };
}

function decodeBody(start: number, end: number) {
  let p = start;

  const locals = readULEB(p);
  p = locals.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {
    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    // valtype
    p++;
  }

  const instructions = [];

  // Function body itself has an implicit outer block.
  let depth = 1;

  while (p < end) {
    const ins = decodeInstruction(p);

    instructions.push(ins);

    p = ins.end;

    if (ins.op === 0x02 || ins.op === 0x03 || ins.op === 0x04) {
      depth++;
    }

    else if (ins.op === 0x0b) {
      depth--;

      if (depth === 0) {
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  return instructions;
}

import fs from "node:fs";

const file = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0, shift = 0, b;
  do {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (b & 0x80);
  return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function slebBytes(value) {
  const out = [];
  let more = true;
  while (more) {
    let b = value & 0x7f;
    value >>= 7;
    const sign = (b & 0x40) !== 0;
    more = !((value === 0 && !sign) || (value === -1 && sign));
    if (more) b |= 0x80;
    out.push(b);
  }
  return out;
}

let pos = 8;
let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[pos++];
  const len = uleb(pos);
  const payload = len.next;
  const end = payload + len.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = payload;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }
  pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) throw new Error("WASM code section not found");

let p = codeStart;

p = count.next;

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const PTON_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3'
);

const OP_JETTON_TRANSFER = 0x0f8a7ea5;

function opHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';
    return '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function ton(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return frac ? `${whole}.${frac}` : whole.toString();
}

function getOpcode(body: any): number | null {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function separator(title: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(` ${title}`);
    console.log('============================================================');
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    separator('SCAN CURRENT pTON TRANSFERS v2.2');

    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');

    console.log('');
    console.log('PTON WALLET:');
    console.log(PTON_WALLET.toString());

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint:
            'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(
        PTON_WALLET,
        {
            limit: 20,
        }
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(`TRANSACTIONS FETCHED: ${txs.length}`);

    let transferCount = 0;

    for (const tx of txs) {

        if (!tx.inMessage) {
            continue;
        }

        const body = tx.inMessage.body;
        const op = getOpcode(body);

        if (op !== OP_JETTON_TRANSFER) {
            continue;
        }

        try {

            const s = body.beginParse();

            s.loadUint(32);

            const queryId =
                s.loadUintBig(64);

            const amount =
                s.loadCoins();

            const destination =
                s.loadAddress();

            const responseDestination =
                s.loadAddress();

            const customPayload =
                s.loadMaybeRef();

            const forwardTonAmount =
                s.loadCoins();

            const forwardIsRef =
                s.loadBit();

            let forwardPayload;

            if (forwardIsRef) {
                forwardPayload = s.loadRef();
            } else {
                forwardPayload = s.asCell();
            }

            transferCount++;

            console.log('');
            console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');

            console.log('TRANSFER #' + transferCount);

            console.log('LT:');
            console.log(tx.lt.toString());

            console.log('HASH:');
            console.log(
                tx.hash().toString('base64')
            );

            console.log('TIME:');
            console.log(
                new Date(
                    tx.now * 1000
                ).toISOString()
            );

            console.log('AMOUNT RAW:');
            console.log(amount.toString());

            console.log('AMOUNT:');
            console.log(ton(amount));

            console.log('QUERY ID:');
            console.log(queryId.toString());

            if (tx.inMessage.info.type === 'internal') {

                console.log('SOURCE:');
                console.log(
                    tx.inMessage.info.src.toString()
                );

                console.log('DESTINATION ACCOUNT:');
                console.log(
                    tx.inMessage.info.dest.toString()
                );

                console.log('TON VALUE:');
                console.log(
                    ton(tx.inMessage.info.value.coins)
                );
            }

            console.log('DESTINATION FIELD:');
            console.log(destination.toString());

            console.log('RESPONSE DESTINATION:');
            console.log(
                responseDestination.toString()
            );

            console.log('CUSTOM PAYLOAD:');
            console.log(
                customPayload ? 'YES' : 'NONE'
            );

            console.log('FORWARD TON:');
            console.log(
                ton(forwardTonAmount)
            );

            console.log('FORWARD PAYLOAD TYPE:');
            console.log(
                forwardIsRef
                    ? 'REFERENCE'
                    : 'INLINE'
            );

            console.log('FORWARD PAYLOAD OPCODE:');
            console.log(
                opHex(
                    getOpcode(forwardPayload)
                )
            );

            console.log('FORWARD PAYLOAD BOC:');
            console.log(
                forwardPayload
                    .toBoc()
                    .toString('base64')
            );
        }
        catch (e) {

            console.log('');
            console.log('DECODE ERROR:');
            console.log(String(e));
        }
    }

    separator('RESULT');

    console.log('');
    console.log('JETTON TRANSFERS FOUND:');
    console.log(transferCount);

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');

    separator('END');
}

const file =

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;

const IMPORTED = 83;

const TARGETS = new Set([
  7697, 7698, 7699, 7700, 7701, 7702,
  7704, 7705, 7707, 7708, 7709,
  2053, 2101, 2612
]);

const MAX_DISTANCE = 48;

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    if (pos + i >= b.length) return null;

    const x = b[pos + i];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value,
        end: pos + i + 1
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function getBodies() {

  let p = CODE_START;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  if (!count)
    throw new Error("Cannot read body count");

  p = count.end;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = readULEB(p);
    if (!size)
      throw new Error(`Bad body size at ${hex(p)}`);

    p = size.end;

    bodies.push({
      ordinal: i,
      global: i + IMPORTED,
      start: p,
      end: p + size.value
    });

    p += size.value;
  }

  return bodies;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const TARGETS = [2053, 2101, 2612];

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) break;
    }

    return { value: -1, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function sectionAt(offset: number): string {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];
        const s = readULEB(p);
        const payload = s.next;
        const end = payload + s.value;

        if (offset >= p - 1 && offset < end) {
            const names: Record<number, string> = {
                1: "type",
                2: "import",
                3: "function",
                4: "table",
                5: "memory",
                6: "global",
                7: "export",
                9: "element",
                10: "code",
                11: "data",
            };

            return `${names[id] ?? `section-${id}`} [${hex(payload)}..${hex(end)}]`;
        }

        p = end;
    }

    return "unknown";
}

        [1659724, "SLOT_19534C"],

        [1659732, "SLOT_195354"],
        [1659736, "SLOT_195358"]
    ]);

    const features = {
        exceptions: true,
        mutable_globals: true,
        sat_float_to_int: true,
        sign_extension: true,
        simd: true,
        threads: true,

        annotations: true,
        code_metadata: true,
        gc: true,
        memory64: true,
        multi_memory: true,
        extended_const: true,
        relaxed_simd: true
    };

    const mod = wabt.readWasm(fs.readFileSync(file), {
        readDebugNames: false,

    });

    const wat = mod.toText({
        foldExprs: false,
        inlineExport: false
    });

    const lines = wat.split(/\r?\n/);

    let funcLine = 0;
    let hits = 0;

    console.log("Context: 4 lines before and after each reference");

    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const start = lines[i].match(/^\s*\(func \(;(\d+);\)/);

        if (start) {
            funcId = Number(start[1]);
            funcLine = 1;
        } else if (funcId !== null) {
            funcLine++;
        }

        const match = lines[i].match(/i32\.const\s+(-?\d+)/);
        if (!match) continue;

        const address = Number(match[1]);
        if (!targets.has(address)) continue;

        hits++;

        console.log("");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(
            `${targets.get(address)} | FUNC ${funcId} | WAT LINE ${i + 1}`
        );

        const from = Math.max(0, i - 4);
        const to = Math.min(lines.length - 1, i + 4);

        for (let j = from; j <= to; j++) {
            console.log(
                `${j + 1}: ${j === i ? ">> " : "   "}${lines[j].trimEnd()}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("TOTAL CONSTANT REFERENCES:", hits);

    mod.destroy();
})().catch(error => {
    console.error(error);

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x1226d;
const END   = 0x1295b;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

FILE: scripts\scanFunction3837Ops.js

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 3837;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(buf, pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(buf, pos, bits = 32) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < bits && (b & 0x40)) {
    result -= Math.pow(2, shift);
  }

  return { value: result, next: pos };
}

function readName(buf, pos) {
  const n = readULEB(buf, pos);
  const end = n.next + n.value;

  return {
    text: buf.slice(n.next, end).toString("utf8"),
    next: end
  };
}

function skipLimits(buf, pos) {
  const flags = buf[pos++];

  const min = readULEB(buf, pos);
  pos = min.next;

  if (flags & 1) {
    const max = readULEB(buf, pos);
    pos = max.next;
  }

  return pos;
}

function skipTableType(buf, pos) {
  pos++; // elemtype
  return skipLimits(buf, pos);
}

function skipMemoryType(buf, pos) {
  return skipLimits(buf, pos);
}

function skipGlobalType(buf, pos) {
  pos += 2;
  return pos;
}

function countImportedFunctions(buf, sec) {
  let pos = sec.start;

  const n = readULEB(buf, pos);
  pos = n.next;

  let funcs = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const mod = readName(buf, pos);
    pos = mod.next;

    const name = readName(buf, pos);
    pos = name.next;

    const kind = buf[pos++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const typeIndex = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = typeIndex.next;
      funcs++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      pos = skipTableType(buf, pos);
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      pos = skipMemoryType(buf, pos);
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      pos = skipGlobalType(buf, pos);
    } else if (kind === 4) {
      const x = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = x.next;
    } else {
      throw new Error("Unknown import kind " + kind);
    }
  }

  return funcs;
}

function getSections(buf) {
  const sections = [];

  let pos = 8;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[pos++];

    const size = readULEB(buf, pos);
    pos = size.next;

    const start = pos;
    const end = start + size.value;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start,
      end,
      size: size.value
    });

    pos = end;
  }

  return sections;
}

function findTargetBody(buf, codeSec, importedFunctions) {
  let pos = codeSec.start;

  const count = readULEB(buf, pos);
  pos = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const bodySize = readULEB(buf, pos);
    pos = bodySize.next;

    const bodyStart = pos;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize.value;

    const funcIndex = importedFunctions + i;

    if (funcIndex === TARGET_FUNC) {
      return {
        funcIndex,
        bodyIndex: i,
        start: bodyStart,
        end: bodyEnd
      };
    }

    pos = bodyEnd;
  }

  return null;
}

function isInteresting(op) {
  return [
    0x10, // call
    0x11, // call_indirect
    0x20, // local.get
    0x21, // local.set
    0x22, // local.tee
    0x23, // global.get
    0x24, // global.set
    0x28, // i32.load
    0x29, // i64.load
    0x2d, // i32.load8_u
    0x36, // i32.store
    0x37, // i64.store
    0x3a, // i32.store8
    0x3b, // i32.store16
    0x41, // i32.const
    0x42, // i64.const
    0x6a, // i32.add
    0x6b, // i32.sub
    0x46, // i32.eq
    0x45, // i32.eqz
    0x1a, // drop
    0x1b  // select
  ].includes(op);
}

function scanBody(buf, start, end) {
  let pos = start;

  // Local declarations
  const localDecl = readULEB(buf, pos);
  pos = localDecl.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localDecl.value; i++) {
    const count = readULEB(buf, pos);
    pos = count.next;

    pos++; // valtype
  }

  const hits = [];

  while (pos < end) {
    const addr = pos;
    const op = buf[pos++];

    let item = {
      addr,
      opcode: op
    };

    // Control opcodes: do not try to decode their blocktype.
    if (
      op === 0x02 || // block
      op === 0x03 || // loop
      op === 0x04    // if
    ) {
      if (pos < end) {
        const blockType = buf[pos++];

        // Record it, but don't interpret it.
        if (isInteresting(op)) {
          item.extra = "blocktype=0x" +
            blockType.toString(16);
        }
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x05) {
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0b || op === 0x0f) {
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const x = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = x.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0e) {
      const n = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, pos);
        pos = x.next;
      }

      const d = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = d.next;

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = x.next;

      item.name = "call";
      item.func = x.value;
      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      const type = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = type.next;

      const table = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = table.next;

      item.name = "call_indirect";
      item.type = type.value;
      item.table = table.value;
      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const x = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = x.next;

      item.name =
        op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
        op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
        "local.tee";

      item.local = x.value;

      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
      const x = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = x.next;

      item.name =
        op === 0x23 ? "global.get" : "global.set";

      item.global = x.value;

      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      op === 0x28 ||
      op === 0x29 ||
      op === 0x2d ||
      op === 0x36 ||
      op === 0x37 ||
      op === 0x3a ||
      op === 0x3b
    ) {
      const align = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(buf, pos);
      pos = offset.next;

      const names = {
        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",
        0x3a: "i32.store8",
        0x3b: "i32.store16"
      };

      item.name = names[op];
      item.align = align.value;
      item.offset = offset.value;

      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = readSLEB(buf, pos, 32);
      pos = x.next;

      item.name = "i32.const";
      item.value = x.value;

      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
      const x = readSLEB(buf, pos, 64);
      pos = x.next;

      item.name = "i64.const";
      item.value = x.value;

      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6a || op === 0x6b) {
      item.name = op === 0x6a ? "i32.add" : "i32.sub";
      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x45 || op === 0x46 || op === 0x1a || op === 0x1b) {
      item.name =
        op === 0x45 ? "i32.eqz" :
        op === 0x46 ? "i32.eq" :
        op === 0x1a ? "drop" :
        "select";

      hits.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    // Everything else:
    // Do not stop. Continue scanning raw bytes.
  }

  return hits;
}

function formatHit(h) {
  let s =
    "0x" +
    h.addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0") +
    "  " +
    h.name;

  if (h.local !== undefined)
    s += " local=" + h.local;

  if (h.global !== undefined)
    s += " global=" + h.global;

  if (h.value !== undefined)
    s += " value=" + h.value;

  if (h.offset !== undefined)
    s += " offset=" + h.offset;

  if (h.align !== undefined)
    s += " align=" + h.align;

  if (h.func !== undefined)
    s += " func=" + h.func;

  if (h.type !== undefined)
    s += " type=" + h.type;

  if (h.table !== undefined)
    s += " table=" + h.table;

  return s;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [
    0x195350,
    0x195354
];

function uleb(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("SCAN GLOBAL 0 TARGET-REACHING OFFSETS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");

let p = 8;

let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

while (p < wasm.length) {

    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = uleb(wasm, p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

    throw new Error("CODE section not found");

q = fc.next;

let global0Sets = 0;
let targetArithmeticHits = 0;

console.log("DEFINED FUNCTIONS =", functionCount);
console.log("");

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < functionCount; ordinal++) {

    const bs = uleb(wasm, q);
    q = bs.next;

    const bodyStart = q;
    const bodyEnd = q + bs.value;

    let x = bodyStart;

    const lc = uleb(wasm, x);
    x = lc.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < lc.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(wasm, x);
        x = n.next;
        x++;
    }

    const recent: {
        at: number;
        kind: string;
        value?: number;
    }[] = [];

    while (x < bodyEnd) {

        const at = x;
        const op = wasm[x++];

        if (op === 0x23) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, x);
            x = r.next;

            if (r.value === 0) {
                global0Gets++;

                recent.push({
                    at,
                    kind: "GLOBAL0_GET"
                });
            }
        }

        else if (op === 0x24) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, x);
            x = r.next;

            if (r.value === 0) {
                global0Sets++;

                recent.push({
                    at,
                    kind: "GLOBAL0_SET"
                });
            }
        }

        else if (op === 0x41) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, x);
            x = r.next;

            const value = r.value >>> 0;

            /*
             * If a target-related constant appears near a
             * global.get 0 / global.set 0, print it.
             */
            const hasGlobal0 = recent.some(
                z => z.kind === "GLOBAL0_GET" ||
                     z.kind === "GLOBAL0_SET"
            );

            if (hasGlobal0) {

                for (const target of TARGETS) {

                    /*
                     * We are interested in small arithmetic
                     * distances between Global0 and target.
                     */
                    const d1 =
                        Math.abs(
                            (target >>> 0) -
                            (value >>> 0)
                        );

                    if (d1 <= 4096) {

                        console.log(
                            `FUNC ORDINAL ${ordinal} @ ${hex(at)}`
                        );

                        console.log(
                            `  GLOBAL0 nearby`
                        );

                        console.log(
                            `  CONST = ${value} (${hex(value)})`
                        );

                        console.log(
                            `  TARGET = ${hex(target)}`
                        );

                        console.log(
                            `  DISTANCE = ${d1}`
                        );

                        console.log("");

                        targetArithmeticHits++;
                    }
                }
            }

            recent.push({
                at,
                kind: "CONST",
                value
            });
        }

        else if (
            op === 0x6a ||
            op === 0x6b ||
            op === 0x6c ||
            op === 0x71 ||
            op === 0x72 ||
            op === 0x73
        ) {

            recent.push({
                at,
                kind: "ARITH"
            });
        }

        else {

            /*
             * Keep recent history short.
             */
            if (recent.length > 20) {
                recent.shift();
            }
        }

        if (recent.length > 20) {
            recent.shift();
        }
    }

    q = bodyEnd;
}

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: v, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSection(idWanted) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const s = uleb(p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = start + s.value;

        if (id === idWanted) {
            return { start, end };
        }

        p = end;
    }

    return null;
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;

const IMPORTED = 83;

function readULEB(pos: number) {

  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {

    if (pos + i >= b.length)
      return null;

    const x = b[pos + i];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value,
        end: pos + i + 1
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function getBodies() {

  let p = CODE_START;

  const count = readULEB(p);

  if (!count)
    throw new Error("Cannot read body count");

  p = count.end;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = readULEB(p);

    if (!size)
      throw new Error(`Bad body size at ${hex(p)}`);

    p = size.end;

    bodies.push({
      ordinal: i,
      global: i + IMPORTED,
      start: p,
      end: p + size.value
    });

    p += size.value;
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = getBodies();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("INDIRECT LOAD(+4) -> CALL_INDIRECT TYPE 4");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

let hits = 0;

for (const body of bodies) {

  for (let p = body.start; p < body.end; p++) {

    /*
       i32.load

       28 <align> <offset>
    */

    if (b[p] !== 0x28)
      continue;

    const align = readULEB(p + 1);

    if (!align)
      continue;

    const offset = readULEB(align.end);

    if (!offset)
      continue;

    if (offset.value !== 4)
      continue;

    /*
       Look immediately ahead for:

          call_indirect
          11 04 00
    */

    const q = offset.end;

    if (
      b[q] === 0x11 &&
      b[q + 1] === 0x04 &&
      b[q + 2] === 0x00
    ) {

      hits++;

      console.log("");
      console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

      console.log(
        `FUNCTION global=${body.global} body=${body.ordinal}`
      );

      console.log(
        `LOAD(+4) @ ${hex(p)}`
      );

      console.log(
        `CALL_INDIRECT @ ${hex(q)}`
      );

      const from = Math.max(
        body.start,
        p - 32
      );

      const to = Math.min(
        body.end,
        q + 8
      );

      console.log(
        `context ${hex(from)} .. ${hex(to)}`
      );

      console.log(
        Array.from(b.slice(from, to))
          .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
          .join(" ")
      );
    }
  }
}
