// SCAN ALL FUNCTIONS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const allIndirectType4 = [];
const allIndirect = [];

let decoderFailures = 0;

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < codeCount; bodyIndex++) {

    const bodySize = u32();

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    const locals = skipLocals();

    while (p < bodyEnd) {

        const insStart = p;

        const ins = decodeInstruction(insStart);

        if (ins.unknown) {

            decoderFailures++;

            // Move to next body rather than corrupting global scan.
            p = bodyEnd;
            break;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x11) {

            const functionIndex =
                importedFunctionCount + bodyIndex;

            const record = {
                bodyIndex,
                functionIndex,
                typeIndex: ins.typeIndex,
                tableIndex: ins.tableIndex,
                address: ins.start,
                functionType: getFunctionType(functionIndex)
            };

            allIndirect.push(record);

            if (ins.typeIndex === 4) {

                allIndirectType4.push(record);
            }
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x0b && p === bodyEnd)
            break;
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

function readU32(buf, p) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function getSections(buf) {
    const sections = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readU32(buf, p);
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = start + sizeInfo.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start,
            end,
            size: sizeInfo.value
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseCodeBodies(buf, section) {

    let p = section.start;

    const countInfo = readU32(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const bodies = [];

    for (
        let bodyIndex = 0;
        bodyIndex < countInfo.value;
        bodyIndex++
    ) {

        const sizeInfo = readU32(buf, p);
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

        let q = bodyStart;

        // local declaration vector
        const localCountInfo = readU32(buf, q);
        q = localCountInfo.next;

        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < localCountInfo.value;
            i++
        ) {

            const n = readU32(buf, q);
            q = n.next;

            // value type
            q++;
        }

        bodies.push({
            bodyIndex,
            functionIndex:
                IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + bodyIndex,
            bodyStart,
            codeStart: q,
            bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function hexByte(b) {
    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
}

FILE: scripts\scanWasmKaCalls.ts

import fs from 'fs';

const WASM = './emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';
const TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX = 5456;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

let p = 8;

function readU32(): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const byte = b[p++];

        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readName(): string {
    const len = readU32();
    const s = b.subarray(p, p + len).toString('utf8');
    p += len;
    return s;
}

function readULEB(data: Buffer, pos: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const byte = data[pos++];

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

let importedFunctions = 0;
let targetBody: Buffer | undefined;

while (p < b.length) {
    const sectionId = b[p++];
    const sectionSize = readU32();

    const sectionStart = p;
    const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 2) {
        // Import section
        const count = readU32();

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            readName();
            readName();

            const kind = b[p++];

            if (kind === 0) {
                readU32();
                importedFunctions++;
            } else if (kind === 1) {
                p++;
                const flags = readU32();
                readU32();
                if (flags & 1) readU32();
            } else if (kind === 2) {
                const flags = readU32();
                readU32();
                if (flags & 1) readU32();
            } else if (kind === 3) {
                p += 2;
            }
        }
    }

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        const functionCount = readU32();

        for (let i = 0; i < functionCount; i++) {
            const bodySize = readU32();
            const body = b.subarray(p, p + bodySize);

            if (i === TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX) {
                targetBody = Buffer.from(body);
                break;
            }

            p += bodySize;
        }

        break;
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
}

if (!targetBody) {
    throw new Error('Target Ka body not found');
}

console.log('============================================================');
console.log(' WASM Ka CALL SCANNER');
console.log('============================================================');

console.log(`Imported functions : ${importedFunctions}`);
console.log(`Ka defined index   : ${TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX}`);
console.log(`Ka function index  : ${importedFunctions + TARGET_DEFINED_INDEX}`);
console.log(`Ka body size       : ${targetBody.length}`);

console.log('');
console.log('=== CALL INSTRUCTIONS ===');

let found = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < targetBody.length; i++) {

    // 0x10 = call
    if (targetBody[i] !== 0x10) {
        continue;
    }

    const r = readULEB(targetBody, i + 1);

    const target = r.value;

    console.log(
        `offset=${i.toString().padStart(4, '0')}  ` +
        `opcode=10  ` +
        `target=${target}`
    );

    found++;
}

console.log('');
console.log(`Total CALL instructions: ${found}`);

FILE: scripts\scanWasmSections.ts

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(offset: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = offset;

    while (true) {
        if (p >= b.length) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB out of range at 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }

        const x = b[p++];
        value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB too large at 0x${offset.toString(16)}`);
        }
    }
}

const sectionNames: Record<number, string> = {
    0: "custom",
    1: "type",
    2: "import",
    3: "function",
    4: "table",
    5: "memory",
    6: "global",
    7: "export",
    8: "start",
    9: "element",
    10: "code",
    11: "data",
    12: "data-count",
    13: "tag",
};

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" WASM SECTION TABLE SCAN");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${b.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log("");

if (
    b[0] !== 0x00 ||
    b[1] !== 0x61 ||
    b[2] !== 0x73 ||
    b[3] !== 0x6d
) {
    throw new Error("Invalid WASM magic");
}

console.log("MAGIC     : OK");
console.log(
    `VERSION   : ${b[4].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} ` +
    `${b[5].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} ` +
    `${b[6].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} ` +
    `${b[7].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
);
console.log("");

let p = 8;
let index = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
    const sectionStart = p;
    const id = b[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const payloadSize = sizeInfo.value;
    const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + payloadSize;

    if (payloadEnd > b.length) {
        throw new Error(
            `Section ${index} exceeds file: ` +
            `end=0x${payloadEnd.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    const name = sectionNames[id] ?? `UNKNOWN(${id})`;

    console.log(
        `#${index.toString().padStart(2, "0")} ` +
        `id=${id.toString().padStart(2, " ")} ` +
        `${name.padEnd(10)} ` +
        `header=0x${sectionStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
        `payload=0x${payloadStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}..` +
        `0x${payloadEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
        `size=${payloadSize}`
    );

    if (id === 10) {
        console.log("");
        console.log(">>> CODE SECTION FOUND <<<");
        console.log(
            `    section header : 0x${sectionStart.toString(16)}`
        );
        console.log(
            `    payload start  : 0x${payloadStart.toString(16)}`
        );
        console.log(
            `    payload end    : 0x${payloadEnd.toString(16)}`
        );
        console.log(`    payload size   : ${payloadSize}`);
        console.log("");
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
    index++;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SCAN COMPLETE");
console.log("============================================================");

    console.log('Target ROOSTER:', TARGET);

        `${TONCENTER}` +
        `?address=${encodeURIComponent(POOL.toString())}` +
        `&limit=100`;

    console.log('Requesting Pool transactions...');
    console.log('');

    const response = await fetch(url);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Toncenter HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`
        );
    }

    const json: any = await response.json();

    if (!json.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Toncenter API error: ${JSON.stringify(json)}`
        );
    }

    const transactions = json.result ?? [];

    console.log('Transactions returned:', transactions.length);
    console.log('');

    let found = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < transactions.length; i++) {
        const tx = transactions[i];

        const lt = tx.lt;
        const hash = tx.transaction_id?.hash;
        const utime = tx.utime;

        console.log('-'.repeat(78));
        console.log(`#${i + 1}`);
        console.log('LT:', lt);
        console.log('Hash:', hash);
        console.log('UTIME:', utime);

        const inMsg = tx.in_msg;

        if (inMsg) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('IN MESSAGE');
            console.log('Source:', inMsg.source);
            console.log('Destination:', inMsg.destination);
            console.log('Value:', inMsg.value);

            if (inMsg.message) {
                console.log('Message:', inMsg.message);
            }

            if (inMsg.msg_data?.body) {
                console.log(
                    'Body BOC:',
                    inMsg.msg_data.body
                );
            }
        }

        const outMsgs = tx.out_msgs ?? [];

        console.log('');
        console.log('OUT MESSAGES:', outMsgs.length);

        for (let j = 0; j < outMsgs.length; j++) {
            const msg = outMsgs[j];

            console.log('');
            console.log(`OUT #${j + 1}`);
            console.log('Source:', msg.source);
            console.log('Destination:', msg.destination);
            console.log('Value:', msg.value);

            if (msg.message) {
                console.log('Message:', msg.message);
            }

            if (msg.msg_data?.body) {
                console.log(
                    'Body BOC:',
                    msg.msg_data.body
                );
            }

            /*
             * Direct decimal/string search.
             * This catches an exact visible value if returned
             * by the API.
             */
            const serialized = JSON.stringify(msg);

            if (
                serialized.includes(TARGET) ||
                serialized.includes(TARGET_NANO.toString())
            ) {
                found++;

                console.log('');
                console.log('*** TARGET STRING MATCH ***');
                console.log('Target:', TARGET);
                console.log('Target nano:', TARGET_NANO.toString());
            }
        }

        /*
         * Search the complete transaction object as a second pass.
         */
        const fullTx = JSON.stringify(tx);

        if (

        ) {
            found++;

            console.log('');
            console.log('*** TARGET TRANSACTION MATCH ***');

    console.log('');

    console.log('SEARCH COMPLETE');

    console.log('='.repeat(78));

        console.log(

        );

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const AMOUNT_ROOSTER = 500000000000000n;
const AMOUNT_PTON = 500000000n;

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log(' DIRECT ADD LIQUIDITY');
    console.log(' REAL TRANSACTION');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('');

    const pool = provider.open(
        DEX.v2_2.Pool.CPI.create(POOL)
    );

    const lpAccount = await pool.getLpAccount({
        ownerAddress: USER
    });

    console.log('LP Account:');
    console.log(lpAccount.address.toString());
    console.log('');

    const contractProvider = provider.provider(
        lpAccount.address
    );

    const data = await lpAccount.getLpAccountData(
        contractProvider
    );

    console.log('===== CURRENT LP ACCOUNT DATA =====');
    console.log('Amount 0:', data.amount0.toString());
    console.log('Amount 1:', data.amount1.toString());
    console.log('');

    if (data.amount0 !== AMOUNT_ROOSTER) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected ROOSTER amount: ${data.amount0}`
        );
    }

    if (data.amount1 !== AMOUNT_PTON) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected pTON amount: ${data.amount1}`
        );
    }

    console.log('Sending Direct Add Liquidity...');
    console.log('ROOSTER: 500,000');
    console.log('pTON: 0.5');
    console.log('Minimum LP: 1');
    console.log('Gas: 0.3 TON');
    console.log('');

    await lpAccount.sendDirectAddLiquidity(
        contractProvider,
        provider.sender(),
        {
            amount0: AMOUNT_ROOSTER,
            amount1: AMOUNT_PTON,
            minimumLpToMint: 1n,
            userWalletAddress: USER,
            refundAddress: USER,
            excessesAddress: USER
        }
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Transaction sent to wallet.');
    console.log('Confirm it in Tonkeeper.');
}

function ok(
    label: string,
    value: boolean
) {
    console.log(

    );

function loadBoc(
    filename: string
): Cell {
    const data = readFileSync(filename);

    const cells = Cell.fromBoc(data);

    if (cells.length !== 1) {
        throw new Error(
            `${filename}: expected exactly one root cell, got ${cells.length}`
        );
    }

    return cells[0];
}

function addressEqual(
    a: Address,
    b: Address
): boolean {
    return a.equals(b);
}

function inspectRoosterBody(
    body: Cell
) {
    const s = body.beginParse();

    const opcode =
        s.loadUint(32);

    const queryId =
        s.loadUintBig(64);

    const amount =
        s.loadCoins();

    const destination =
        s.loadAddress();

    const responseDestination =
        s.loadAddress();

    const hasCustomPayload =
        s.loadBit();

    let customPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (hasCustomPayload) {
        customPayload = s.loadRef();
    }

    const forwardTon =
        s.loadCoins();

    const hasForwardPayload =
        s.loadBit();

    let forwardPayload: Cell | null = null;

    if (hasForwardPayload) {
        forwardPayload = s.loadRef();
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER OUTER MESSAGE');
    console.log(
        'OPCODE:',
        '0x' + opcode.toString(16)
    );

    console.log(
        'QUERY ID:',
        queryId.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'AMOUNT:',
        amount.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'DESTINATION:',
        destination.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'RESPONSE:',
        responseDestination.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'CUSTOM PAYLOAD:',
        customPayload ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    console.log(
        'FORWARD TON:',
        forwardTon.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'FORWARD PAYLOAD:',
        forwardPayload ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER TRANSFER OPCODE',
        opcode === JETTON_TRANSFER_OP
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER AMOUNT',
        amount === ROOSTER_AMOUNT
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER DESTINATION = ROUTER',
        addressEqual(
            destination,
            ROUTER
        )
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER RESPONSE = USER',
        addressEqual(
            responseDestination,
            USER
        )
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER CUSTOM PAYLOAD = NO',
        customPayload === null
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER FORWARD TON',
        forwardTon === 235_000_000n
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER FORWARD PAYLOAD = YES',
        forwardPayload !== null
    );

    if (!forwardPayload) {
        throw new Error(
            'ROOSTER forward payload is missing.'
        );
    }

    inspectProvideLp(
        forwardPayload,
        'ROOSTER PROVIDE_LP'
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER ROOT REMAINING',
        s.remainingBits === 0 &&
        s.remainingRefs === 0
    );
}

function inspectProvideLp(
    cell: Cell,
    title: string
) {
    const s = cell.beginParse();

    const opcode =
        s.loadUint(32);

    const routerWallet =
        s.loadAddress();

    const refund =
        s.loadAddress();

    const excesses =
        s.loadAddress();

    const deadline =
        s.loadUintBig(64);

    const nested =
        s.loadRef();

    console.log('');
    console.log(title);

    console.log(
        'OPCODE:',
        '0x' + opcode.toString(16)
    );

    console.log(
        'ROUTER WALLET:',
        routerWallet.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'REFUND:',
        refund.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'EXCESSES:',
        excesses.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'DEADLINE:',
        deadline.toString()
    );

    ok(
        `${title} OPCODE`,
        opcode === PROVIDE_LP_OP
    );

    ok(
        `${title} REFUND = USER`,
        addressEqual(
            refund,
            USER
        )
    );

    ok(
        `${title} EXCESSES = USER`,
        addressEqual(
            excesses,
            USER
        )
    );

    ok(
        `${title} DEADLINE FUTURE`,
        deadline > BigInt(
            Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
        )
    );

    const n =
        nested.beginParse();

    const minLpOut =
        n.loadCoins();

    const receiver =
        n.loadAddress();

    const bothPositive =
        n.loadBit();

    const customGas =
        n.loadCoins();

    const hasCustomPayload =
        n.loadMaybeRef();

    console.log(
        'MIN LP OUT:',
        minLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'RECEIVER:',
        receiver.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'BOTH POSITIVE:',
        bothPositive
    );

    console.log(
        'CUSTOM GAS:',
        customGas.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'CUSTOM PAYLOAD:',
        hasCustomPayload ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    ok(
        `${title} MIN LP`,
        minLpOut === MIN_LP_OUT
    );

    ok(
        `${title} RECEIVER = USER`,
        addressEqual(
            receiver,
            USER
        )
    );

    ok(
        `${title} BOTH POSITIVE`,
        bothPositive === true
    );

    ok(
        `${title} CUSTOM GAS = 0`,
        customGas === 0n
    );

    ok(
        `${title} CUSTOM PAYLOAD = NO`,
        hasCustomPayload === null
    );

    ok(
        `${title} NESTED REMAINING`,
        n.remainingBits === 0 &&
        n.remainingRefs === 0
    );

    ok(
        `${title} REMAINING`,
        s.remainingBits === 0 &&
        s.remainingRefs === 0
    );
}

    );

    // ================================================================

    // ================================================================

    const roosterBody =
        loadBoc(
            './rooster_v22_generated.boc'
        );

    const ptonBody =
        loadBoc(
            './pton_v22_generated.boc'
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'BOC FILES: LOADED'
    );

    // ================================================================
    // ENVELOPE DEFINITIONS
    // ================================================================

    const roosterTo =
        ROOSTER_WALLET;

    const ptonTo =
        PTON_WALLET;

    const roosterValue =
        ROOSTER_VALUE;

    const ptonValue =
        PTON_VALUE;

    // ================================================================
    // ROOSTER ENVELOPE
    // ================================================================

    printEnvelope(
        'ROOSTER FINAL ENVELOPE',
        roosterTo,
        roosterValue,
        roosterBody
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER TO = USER ROOSTER WALLET',
        addressEqual(
            roosterTo,
            ROOSTER_WALLET
        )
    );

    ok(
        'ROOSTER VALUE',
        roosterValue ===
            ROOSTER_VALUE
    );

    inspectRoosterBody(
        roosterBody
    );

    // ================================================================
    // pTON ENVELOPE
    // ================================================================

    printEnvelope(
        'pTON FINAL ENVELOPE',
        ptonTo,
        ptonValue,
        ptonBody
    );

    ok(
        'pTON TO = ROUTER pTON WALLET',
        addressEqual(
            ptonTo,
            PTON_WALLET
        )
    );

    ok(
        'pTON VALUE',
        ptonValue ===
            PTON_VALUE
    );

    inspectPtonBody(
        ptonBody
    );

    // ================================================================
    // FINAL
    // ================================================================

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '======================================================================'
    );
    console.log(
        ' SEND ENVELOPE PREFLIGHT RESULT'
    );
    console.log(
        '======================================================================'
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER MESSAGE: VALIDATED'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON MESSAGE: VALIDATED'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'IMPORTANT:'
    );

    console.log(
        'NO TRANSACTION SENT'
    );

    console.log(
        'NO WALLET SIGNATURE'
    );

    console.log(
        'NO send() CALL'
    );

    console.log(
        'NO FUNDS MOVED'
    );

    console.log(
        'POOL NOT MODIFIED'
    );

    console.log(
        '======================================================================'
    );
}

function createStorage(
    storagePath: string
) {

    return {

        async setItem(
            key: string,
            value: string
        ): Promise<void> {

            let obj: Record<string, string> = {};

            try {

                obj =
                    JSON.parse(
                        await fs.promises.readFile(
                            storagePath,
                            'utf8'
                        )
                    );

            } catch {

                obj = {};

            }

            obj[key] = value;

            await fs.promises.mkdir(
                path.dirname(storagePath),
                {
                    recursive: true
                }
            );

            await fs.promises.writeFile(
                storagePath,
                JSON.stringify(obj)
            );
        },


        async getItem(
            key: string
        ): Promise<string | null> {

            try {

                const obj =
                    JSON.parse(
                        await fs.promises.readFile(
                            storagePath,
                            'utf8'
                        )
                    );

                return (
                    obj[key] ??
                    null
                );

            } catch {

                return null;

            }
        },


        async removeItem(
            key: string
        ): Promise<void> {

            let obj: Record<string, string> = {};

            try {

                obj =
                    JSON.parse(
                        await fs.promises.readFile(
                            storagePath,
                            'utf8'
                        )
                    );

            } catch {

                return;

            }

            delete obj[key];

            await fs.promises.writeFile(
                storagePath,
                JSON.stringify(obj)
            );
        }

    };

}


// ============================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================

function sameAddress(
    a: Address,
    b: Address
): boolean {

    return (
        a.toRawString() ===
        b.toRawString()
    );
}


function nanoToTon(
    value: bigint
): string {

    const whole =
        value /
        1000000000n;

    const fraction =
        (
            value %
            1000000000n
        )
            .toString()
            .padStart(
                9,
                '0'
            );

    return (
        whole.toString() +
        '.' +
        fraction
    );
}


function section(
    title: string
): void {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );

    console.log(title);

    console.log(
        '============================================================'
    );
}

export async function run(
    provider: NetworkProvider
) {

    section(
        'STON.FI v2.2 FINAL TWO-MESSAGE SEND'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'NETWORK: TESTNET'
    );

    console.log(
        'MODE: FINAL SEND GATE'
    );

    console.log(
        'PRIVATE KEY: NOT USED'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 1. TONCONNECT
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '1. TONCONNECT CONNECTION'
    );


    const storagePath =
        path.join(
            process.cwd(),
            'temp',
            'testnet',
            'tonconnect.json'
        );


    if (
        !fs.existsSync(
            storagePath
        )
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: TonConnect storage file does not exist'
        );
    }


    const connector =
        new TonConnect({

            storage:
                createStorage(
                    storagePath
                ),

            manifestUrl:
                'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ton-org/blueprint/main/tonconnect/manifest.json'

        });


    await connector.restoreConnection();


    if (
        !connector.wallet
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: TonConnect wallet was not restored'
        );
    }


    const connectedWallet =
        Address.parse(
            connector.wallet.account.address
        );


    console.log(
        'Connected wallet:',
        connectedWallet.toString({
            bounceable: true,
            testOnly: true
        })
    );


    console.log(
        'Expected wallet:',
        USER.toString({
            bounceable: true,
            testOnly: true
        })
    );


    if (
        !sameAddress(
            connectedWallet,
            USER
        )
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Connected wallet does not match USER'
        );
    }


    if (
        connector.wallet.account.chain !==
        CHAIN.TESTNET
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Connected wallet is not on TESTNET'
        );
    }


    console.log(
        'Wallet identity: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Network: TESTNET PASS'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 2. BUILD SDK TRANSACTIONS
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '2. BUILD FRESH SDK TRANSACTIONS'
    );


    const router =
        provider.open(
            DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(
                ROUTER_ADDRESS
            )
        );


    const proxyTon =
        DEX.v2_1.pTON.create(
            PTON_MASTER
        );


    const deadline =
        Math.floor(
            Date.now() / 1000
        ) + 600;


    console.log(
        'Deadline:',
        deadline
    );


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // ROOSTER LEG
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams({

            userWalletAddress:
                USER,

            sendTokenAddress:
                ROOSTER_MASTER,

            otherTokenAddress:
                PTON_MASTER,

            sendAmount:
                ROOSTER_AMOUNT,

            minLpOut:
                MIN_LP_OUT,

            receiverAddress:
                USER,

            refundAddress:
                USER,

            excessesAddress:
                USER,

            deadline

        });


    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // pTON LEG
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const ptonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityTonTxParams({

            userWalletAddress:
                USER,

            otherTokenAddress:
                ROOSTER_MASTER,

            sendAmount:
                PTON_AMOUNT,

            minLpOut:
                MIN_LP_OUT,

            receiverAddress:
                USER,

            refundAddress:
                USER,

            excessesAddress:
                USER,

            deadline,

            proxyTon

        });


    console.log(
        'ROOSTER SDK transaction: BUILT'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON SDK transaction: BUILT'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 3. OUTER MESSAGE VALIDATION
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '3. OUTER MESSAGE VALIDATION'
    );


    if (
        !sameAddress(
            roosterTx.to,
            ROOSTER_USER_WALLET
        )
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: ROOSTER destination mismatch'
        );
    }


    if (
        !sameAddress(
            ptonTx.to,
            PTON_POOL_WALLET
        )
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: pTON destination mismatch'
        );
    }


    if (
        roosterTx.value !==
        ROOSTER_TX_VALUE
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: ROOSTER outer TON value mismatch'
        );
    }


    if (
        ptonTx.value !==
        PTON_TX_VALUE
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: pTON outer TON value mismatch'
        );
    }


    if (
        !roosterTx.body
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: ROOSTER body missing'
        );
    }


    if (
        !ptonTx.body
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: pTON body missing'
        );
    }


    console.log(
        'ROOSTER destination: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON destination: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER value:',
        nanoToTon(
            roosterTx.value
        ),
        'TON - PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON value:',
        nanoToTon(
            ptonTx.value
        ),
        'TON - PASS'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 4. BUILD TONCONNECT PAYLOADS
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '4. BUILD TONCONNECT PAYLOADS'
    );


    const roosterPayload =
        roosterTx.body
            .toBoc()
            .toString('base64');


    const ptonPayload =
        ptonTx.body
            .toBoc()
            .toString('base64');


    console.log(
        'ROOSTER BOC: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON BOC: PASS'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 5. FINAL REQUEST
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '5. FINAL TONCONNECT REQUEST'
    );


    const request: SendTransactionRequest = {

        validUntil:
            deadline,

        network:
            CHAIN.TESTNET,

        messages: [

            {
                address:
                    roosterTx.to.toString(),

                amount:
                    roosterTx.value.toString(),

                payload:
                    roosterPayload
            },

            {
                address:
                    ptonTx.to.toString(),

                amount:
                    ptonTx.value.toString(),

                payload:
                    ptonPayload
            }

        ]

    };


    // ========================================================
    // 6. FINAL STRUCTURE CHECKS
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '6. FINAL SAFETY CHECKS'
    );


    if (
        request.messages.length !== 2
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Expected exactly 2 messages'
        );
    }


    if (
        request.network !==
        CHAIN.TESTNET
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Network is not TESTNET'
        );
    }


    if (
        request.validUntil !==
        deadline
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: validUntil/deadline mismatch'
        );
    }


    if (
        request.validUntil <=
        Math.floor(
            Date.now() / 1000
        )
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Request deadline has expired'
        );
    }


    if (
        request.messages[0].address !==
        roosterTx.to.toString()
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Message 1 destination changed'
        );
    }


    if (
        request.messages[1].address !==
        ptonTx.to.toString()
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Message 2 destination changed'
        );
    }


    if (
        request.messages[0].amount !==
        ROOSTER_TX_VALUE.toString()
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Message 1 amount changed'
        );
    }


    if (
        request.messages[1].amount !==
        PTON_TX_VALUE.toString()
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Message 2 amount changed'
        );
    }


    console.log(
        'Message count = 2: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Network TESTNET: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Shared deadline: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Message 1 destination: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Message 1 amount: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Message 1 payload: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Message 2 destination: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Message 2 amount: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Message 2 payload: PASS'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 7. DISPLAY EXACT TRANSACTION
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '7. TRANSACTION TO BE SENT'
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'ROOSTER'
    );

    console.log(
        '  Amount:',
        nanoToTon(
            ROOSTER_AMOUNT
        ),
        'ROOSTER'
    );

    console.log(
        '  To:',
        request.messages[0].address
    );

    console.log(
        '  Outer TON:',
        nanoToTon(
            BigInt(
                request.messages[0].amount
            )
        ),
        'TON'
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'pTON'
    );

    console.log(
        '  Amount:',
        PTON_AMOUNT.toString(),
        'nano pTON'
    );

    console.log(
        '  To:',
        request.messages[1].address
    );

    console.log(
        '  Outer TON:',
        nanoToTon(
            BigInt(
                request.messages[1].amount
            )
        ),
        'TON'
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'MIN LP OUT:',
        MIN_LP_OUT.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'TOTAL OUTER TON:',
        nanoToTon(
            TOTAL_TX_VALUE
        ),
        'TON'
    );

    console.log(
        'VALID UNTIL:',
        request.validUntil
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 8. FINAL HUMAN CONFIRMATION
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '8. FINAL CONFIRMATION'
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'WARNING: THE NEXT STEP CAN OPEN TONKEEPER'
    );

    console.log(
        'WARNING: TONKEEPER WILL ASK FOR TRANSACTION APPROVAL'
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'EXACTLY 2 MESSAGES WILL BE SENT:'
    );

    console.log(
        '1) 100 ROOSTER ->',
        request.messages[0].address
    );

    console.log(
        '   Outer TON:',
        nanoToTon(
            BigInt(
                request.messages[0].amount
            )
        )
    );

    console.log(
        '2) 249908 nano pTON ->',
        request.messages[1].address
    );

    console.log(
        '   Outer TON:',
        nanoToTon(
            BigInt(
                request.messages[1].amount
            )
        )
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'TOTAL OUTER TON:',
        nanoToTon(
            TOTAL_TX_VALUE
        )
    );

    console.log(
        'MIN LP OUT:',
        MIN_LP_OUT.toString()
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'No private key will be used.'
    );

    console.log(
        'No sender.send() will be used.'
    );

    console.log(
        'No wallet.send() will be used.'
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'TYPE EXACTLY: SEND'
    );

    console.log(
        'Anything else will CANCEL.'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 9. TERMINAL CONFIRMATION
    // ========================================================

    const readline =
        await import('readline');


    const rl =
        readline.createInterface({

            input:
                process.stdin,

            output:
                process.stdout

        });


    const answer =
        await new Promise<string>(
            resolve => {

                rl.question(
                    '\nConfirmation: ',
                    value => {

                        rl.close();

                        resolve(
                            value.trim()
                        );

                    }
                );

            }
        );


    if (
        answer !==
        'SEND'
    ) {

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'SEND CANCELLED.'
        );

        console.log(
            'connector.sendTransaction(): NOT CALLED'
        );

        return;
    }


    // ========================================================
    // 10. LAST-MOMENT DEADLINE CHECK
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '10. LAST-MOMENT CHECK'
    );


    const now =
        Math.floor(
            Date.now() / 1000
        );


    if (
        request.validUntil <=
        now
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Request expired before send'
        );
    }


    if (
        request.messages.length !== 2
    ) {

        throw new Error(
            'STOP: Message count changed'
        );
    }


    console.log(
        'Deadline still valid: PASS'
    );

    console.log(
        'Message count still 2: PASS'
    );


    // ========================================================
    // 11. SEND
    // ========================================================

    section(
        '11. TONCONNECT SEND'
    );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Calling connector.sendTransaction()...'
    );

    console.log(
        'TONKEEPER APPROVAL MAY NOW APPEAR.'
    );


    const result =
        await connector.sendTransaction(
            request
        );


    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'TONCONNECT RESPONSE RECEIVED.'
    );

import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
    );

    const roosterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const ptonMasterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
    );

    const userWalletAddress = Address.parse(
        '0QDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N6R-'
    );

    const router = DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(routerAddress);
    const proxyTon = DEX.v2_2.pTON.create(ptonMasterAddress);

    // ================================================
    // REAL LIQUIDITY AMOUNTS
    // ================================================

    const roosterAmount =
        100_000n * 1_000_000_000n;

    const ptonAmount =
        1n * 1_000_000_000n;

    // ================================================
    // GET REAL POOL
    // ================================================

    const routerProvider =
        provider.provider(routerAddress);

    const poolAddress =
        await router.getPoolAddress(
            routerProvider,
            {
                token0: roosterAddress,
                token1: ptonMasterAddress,
            }
        );

    const pool =
        await router.getPool(
            routerProvider,
            {
                token0: roosterAddress,
                token1: ptonMasterAddress,
            }
        );

    const poolProvider =
        provider.provider(poolAddress);

    const poolData =
        await pool.getPoolData(poolProvider);

    // ================================================
    // CALCULATE EXPECTED LP
    // ================================================

    const roosterRatio =
        roosterAmount * 1_000_000_000n /
        poolData.reserve0;

    const ptonRatio =
        ptonAmount * 1_000_000_000n /
        poolData.reserve1;

    const limitingRatio =
        roosterRatio < ptonRatio
            ? roosterRatio
            : ptonRatio;

    const expectedLp =
        poolData.totalSupplyLP *
        limitingRatio /
        1_000_000_000n;

    // 5% safety margin
    const minLpOut =
        expectedLp * 95n / 100n;

    // Deadline: 1 hour from now
    const deadline =
        Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600;

    // ================================================
    // SHOW REAL POOL DATA
    // ================================================

    console.log('');

    console.log('================================================');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Router:');
    console.log(routerAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Pool:');
    console.log(poolAddress.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Pool deployed:');
    console.log(
        await provider.isContractDeployed(poolAddress)
    );
    console.log('');

    console.log('CURRENT POOL');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER reserve:',
        Number(poolData.reserve0) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON reserve:',
        Number(poolData.reserve1) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'Total LP:',
        poolData.totalSupplyLP.toString()
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('LIQUIDITY TO ADD');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'ROOSTER:',
        Number(roosterAmount) / 1e9
    );

    console.log(
        'pTON:',
        Number(ptonAmount) / 1e9
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('LP CALCULATION');
    console.log('-----------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'Expected LP:',
        expectedLp.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'Minimum LP (95%):',
        minLpOut.toString()
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log('Deadline:');
    console.log(
        new Date(deadline * 1000).toISOString()
    );

    console.log('');

    // ================================================
    // BUILD ROOSTER TRANSACTION
    // ================================================

    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                sendTokenAddress: roosterAddress,
                otherTokenAddress: ptonMasterAddress,

                sendAmount: roosterAmount,

                userWalletAddress,

                receiverAddress:
                    userWalletAddress,

                refundAddress:

    // ================================================

    const tonTx =

                    roosterAddress,

                sendAmount:
                    ptonAmount,

                receiverAddress:
                    userWalletAddress,

                refundAddress:

                excessesAddress:

        );

    console.log('');

    console.log('================================================');

import { Address, internal } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const filePath = path.resolve(
        process.cwd(),
        'initial_rooster_leg.boc'
    );

    const bocBase64 = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8').trim();

    const { Cell } = await import('@ton/core');
    const body = Cell.fromBoc(
        Buffer.from(bocBase64, 'base64')
    )[0];

    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('INITIAL ROOSTER LIQUIDITY - LEG 1');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('Sending: 100,000,000 ROOSTER');
    console.log('Value:   0.3 TON');
    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION HAS BEEN SENT YET.');
    console.log('');

    await provider.sender().send({
        to: Address.parse(
            'EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh'
        ),
        value: 300000000n,
        body,
    });

    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('ROOSTER LEG TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Wait for confirmation before sending pTON.');
}

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { DEX, pTON } from '@ston-fi/sdk';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const routerAddress = Address.parse(
        'kQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWk0v'
    );

    const roosterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const pton = pTON.v2_1.create(
        Address.parse(
            'kQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT-Px'
        )
    );

    const userWalletAddress = provider.sender().address;

    if (!userWalletAddress) {
        throw new Error('Wallet address not available');
    }

    const router = provider.open(
        DEX.v2_1.Router.CPI.create(routerAddress)
    );

    const roosterAmount =
        100_000_000n * 1_000_000_000n;

    const ptonAmount = 100_000_000n;

    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('INITIAL ROOSTER / pTON LIQUIDITY');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('User:', userWalletAddress.toString());
    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER: 100,000,000');
    console.log('pTON:    0.1');
    console.log('');
    console.log('Two messages will be sent in ONE TonConnect');
    console.log('transaction.');
    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER gas: 0.3 TON');
    console.log('pTON gas:    0.3 TON');
    console.log('');

    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams({
            userWalletAddress,
            sendTokenAddress: roosterAddress,
            sendAmount: roosterAmount,
            otherTokenAddress: pton.address,
            minLpOut: 1n,
        });

    const ptonTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams({
            userWalletAddress,
            sendTokenAddress: pton.address,
            sendAmount: ptonAmount,
            otherTokenAddress: roosterAddress,
            minLpOut: 1n,
        });

    if (!roosterTx.body) {
        throw new Error('ROOSTER transaction body is missing');
    }

    if (!ptonTx.body) {
        throw new Error('pTON transaction body is missing');
    }

    console.log('========== FINAL CHECK ==========');
    console.log('ROOSTER wallet:', roosterTx.to.toString());
    console.log('pTON wallet:', ptonTx.to.toString());
    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER amount:', roosterAmount.toString());
    console.log('pTON amount:', ptonAmount.toString());
    console.log('');
    console.log('Sending to Tonkeeper...');
    console.log('==========================================');

    await provider.sender().send({
        to: roosterTx.to,
        value: roosterTx.value,
        body: roosterTx.body,
    });

    await provider.sender().send({
        to: ptonTx.to,
        value: ptonTx.value,
        body: ptonTx.body,
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('==========================================');
    console.log('BOTH LIQUIDITY LEGS SENT');
    console.log('==========================================');
}

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    "EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S"
);

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    "EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3"
);

const ROOSTER_AMOUNT = 200073535827652n;

const MIN_LP_OUT = 300329052918n;

const GAS_AMOUNT = 300000000n;

const FORWARD_GAS_AMOUNT = 240000000n;


function formatRooster(amount: bigint): string {
    return (
        Number(amount) / 1e9
    ).toLocaleString("en-US", {
        minimumFractionDigits: 9,
        maximumFractionDigits: 9,
    });
}


function formatTon(amount: bigint): string {
    return (
        Number(amount) / 1e9
    ).toFixed(9);
}


export async function run(provider: any) {

    console.log("");
    console.log("=================================================");
    console.log("       STON.fi v2.2 REAL LIQUIDITY SEND");
    console.log("=================================================");
    console.log("");
    console.log("REAL TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.");
    console.log("Tonkeeper confirmation is required.");
    console.log("");


    // ====================================================
    // 1. CONNECTED WALLET
    // ====================================================

    const sender = provider.sender();

    const senderAddress = sender.address;

    if (!senderAddress) {
        throw new Error(
            "Connected wallet address is unavailable."
        );
    }

    console.log(
        "===== 1. CONNECTED WALLET ====="
    );

    console.log(
        "Connected wallet:",
        senderAddress.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        "Expected wallet:",
        USER.toString()
    );

    if (!senderAddress.equals(USER)) {
        throw new Error(
            [
                "WRONG WALLET.",
                "",
                `Connected: ${senderAddress.toString()}`,
                `Expected:  ${USER.toString()}`,
            ].join("\n")
        );
    }

    console.log(
        "Wallet identity: PASS"
    );

    console.log("");


    // ====================================================
    // 2. FRESH DEADLINE
    // ====================================================

    const now =
        Math.floor(
            Date.now() / 1000
        );

    const deadline =
        now + 900;

    console.log(
        "===== 2. FRESH DEADLINE ====="
    );

    console.log(
        "Current Unix time:",
        now
    );

    console.log(
        "Fresh deadline:",
        deadline
    );

    console.log(
        "Lifetime:",
        "900 seconds"
    );

    console.log(
        "Deadline: PASS"
    );

    console.log("");


    // ====================================================
    // 3. USER ROOSTER WALLET
    // ====================================================

    console.log(
        "===== 3. ROOSTER JETTON WALLET ====="
    );

    /*
     * We intentionally do NOT import JettonMinter
     * from @ston-fi/sdk because SDK 2.7.0 does not
     * export that class.
     *
     * The SDK router itself will derive the wallet
     * when getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams() runs.
     */

    console.log(
        "Expected user ROOSTER wallet:"
    );

    console.log(
        "EQBzQOOJu9qQVli2R0o6p3pXvi_wj9O2ncMhv3UyAjvMiMOh"
    );

    console.log(
        "ROOSTER wallet reference: PASS"
    );

    console.log("");


    // ====================================================
    // 4. CREATE STON.fi v2.2 ROUTER
    // ====================================================

    console.log(
        "===== 4. STON.fi v2.2 ROUTER ====="
    );

    const router =
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(
            ROUTER
        );

    console.log(
        "Router:",
        ROUTER.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        "Router version:",
        "v2.2 CPI"
    );

    console.log(
        "Router: PASS"
    );

    console.log("");


    // ====================================================
    // 5. GENERATE SDK TRANSACTION
    // ====================================================

    console.log(
        "===== 5. BUILDING SDK TRANSACTION ====="
    );

    /*
     * IMPORTANT:
     *
     * SDK 2.7.0 signature is:
     *
     * getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
     *     provider,
     *     params
     * )
     *
     * pTON MASTER is passed as otherTokenAddress.
     * NOT the router pTON wallet.
     */

    const tx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
            provider,
            {
                userWalletAddress:
                    USER,

                sendTokenAddress:
                    ROOSTER_MASTER,

                otherTokenAddress:
                    PTON_MASTER,

                sendAmount:

                    MIN_LP_OUT,

                deadline:

const slice = body.beginParse();

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const ROOSTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const PTON = pTON.v2_1.create(PTON_MASTER);

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================');
    console.log(' PTON LIQUIDITY - SEND SCRIPT');
    console.log('==============================================');
    console.log('');
    console.log('This script WILL send a transaction when executed.');
    console.log('');

    const router = provider.open(
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(ROUTER)
    );

    const params = {
        proxyTon: PTON,
        otherTokenAddress: ROOSTER,
        sendAmount: 500000000n,
        userWalletAddress: USER,
        receiverAddress: USER,
        refundAddress: USER,
        excessesAddress: USER,
        minLpOut: 0n
    };

    console.log('pTON amount:', '0.5 pTON');
    console.log('Other token:', ROOSTER.toString());
    console.log('Router:', ROUTER.toString());
    console.log('Receiver:', USER.toString());
    console.log('minLpOut:', '0');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Sending pTON liquidity transaction...');

    await router.sendProvideLiquidityTon(
        provider.sender(),
        params
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON liquidity transaction submitted.');
    console.log('==============================================');
}

function format9(value: bigint): string {

    const whole =
        value / 1000000000n;

    const fraction =
        (value % 1000000000n)
            .toString()
            .padStart(9, '0')
            .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return fraction.length > 0
        ? `${whole}.${fraction}`
        : `${whole}`;
}


function assertEqual(
    label: string,
    actual: string,
    expected: string
) {

    if (actual !== expected) {

        throw new Error(
            `${label} FAILED\n` +
            `Expected: ${expected}\n` +
            `Actual:   ${actual}`
        );
    }

    console.log(`PASS  ${label}`);
}


function assertBigInt(
    label: string,
    actual: bigint,
    expected: bigint
) {

    if (actual !== expected) {

        throw new Error(
            `${label} FAILED\n` +
            `Expected: ${expected}\n` +
            `Actual:   ${actual}`
        );
    }

    console.log(`PASS  ${label}`);
}

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';
import { RoosterCoin } from '../wrappers/RoosterCoin';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    if (provider.network() !== 'testnet') {
        throw new Error('STOP: This script is only for TON Testnet.');
    }

    const masterAddress = Address.parse(
        'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
    );

    const master = provider.open(
        RoosterCoin.createFromAddress(masterAddress)
    );

    const metadataUrl =
        'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hosseinkhanihamid/Rooster-Coin/main/metadata.json';

    // TEP-64 off-chain metadata:
    // 0x01 + UTF-8 URL
    const content = beginCell()
        .storeUint(1, 8)
        .storeStringTail(metadataUrl)
        .endCell();

    console.log('');
    console.log('===== SET ROOSTER METADATA =====');
    console.log('Network: TESTNET');
    console.log('Master:', masterAddress.toString());
    console.log('Metadata URL:', metadataUrl);
    console.log('Content Cell:', content.toBoc().toString('base64'));
    console.log('');

    console.log('Sending ChangeMinterContent...');
    console.log('IMPORTANT: Tonkeeper must show TESTNET.');

    await master.sendChangeContent(
        provider.sender(),
        content
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('Transaction sent.');
    console.log('Wait for Testnet confirmation.');
}

function simplify(A: string, B: string) {
    const a0 = `(${A} & 0xffffffff)`;
    const a1 = `(${A} >>u 32)`;
    const b0 = `(${B} & 0xffffffff)`;
    const b1 = `(${B} >>u 32)`;

    const p = `(a0 * b0)`;

    const c0 = `(p >>u 32)`;

    const m = `(c0 + (a0 * b1))`;

    const q = `((b0 * a1) + (m & 0xffffffff))`;

    const low =
        `((p & 0xffffffff) | ((q & 0xffffffff) << 32))`;

    const high =
        `((a1 * b1) + (m >>u 32) + (q >>u 32))`;

    return {
        a0,
        a1,
        b0,
        b1,
        p,
        c0,
        m,
        q,
        low,
        high,
    };
}

function normalize128(A: string, B: string) {
    const x = simplify(A, B);

    return {
        A,
        B,
        low:
            x.low
                .replace(/\bp\b/g, x.p)
                .replace(/\bq\b/g, x.q),
        high:
            x.high
                .replace(/\ba1\b/g, x.a1)
                .replace(/\bb1\b/g, x.b1)
                .replace(/\bm\b/g, x.m)
                .replace(/\bq\b/g, x.q)
                .replace(/\bc0\b/g, x.c0)
                .replace(/\bp\b/g, x.p),
    };
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const CALLS = [
  { func: 473,  addr: 0x00020087 },
  { func: 599,  addr: 0x000284fb },
  { func: 1249, addr: 0x00057842 },
  { func: 1601, addr: 0x00071954 },
  { func: 2161, addr: 0x0009b0b8 },
  { func: 2161, addr: 0x0009b0fe },
  { func: 3490, addr: 0x0010da53 },
  { func: 6665, addr: 0x0022fa9e },
  { func: 7020, addr: 0x0023d95e },
];

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function section(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (sid === id) return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
}

function getBodies() {
  const sec = section(10);

  let p = sec.start;

  const n = uleb(p);
  p = n.next;

  const bodies: {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    code: number;
  }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + s.value;

    const localCount = uleb(p);
    p = localCount.next;

    for (let j = 0; j < localCount.value; j++) {
      const cnt = uleb(p);
      p = cnt.next;
      p++;
    }

    bodies.push({
      start,
      end,
      code: p,
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/*
 * Lightweight instruction decoder.
 *
 * Returns:
 *   opcode
 *   next
 *
 * It is intentionally conservative.
 */
function decode(p: number) {
  const start = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  switch (op) {
    case 0x20: // local.get
    case 0x21: // local.set
    case 0x22: // local.tee
    case 0x0c: // br
    case 0x0d: // br_if
    case 0x10: { // call
      const r = uleb(p);
      return {
        start,
        op,
        next: r.next,
        imm: r.value,
      };
    }

    case 0x41: { // i32.const
      const r = uleb(p);
      return {
        start,
        op,
        next: r.next,
        imm: r.value,
      };
    }

    case 0x28: { // i32.load
      const a = uleb(p);
      const b = uleb(a.next);

      return {
        start,
        op,
        next: b.next,
        align: a.value,
        offset: b.value,
      };
    }

    case 0x36: { // i32.store
      const a = uleb(p);
      const b = uleb(a.next);

      return {
        start,
        op,
        next: b.next,
        align: a.value,
        offset: b.value,
      };
    }

    case 0x04: // if
    case 0x02: // block
    case 0x03: { // loop
      return {
        start,
        op,
        next: p + 1,
        blockType: wasm[p],
      };
    }

    case 0x05:
    case 0x0b:
    case 0x0f:
    case 0x1a:
    case 0x45:
    case 0x47:
    case 0x4a:
    case 0x4f:
    case 0x6a:
    case 0x6b:
    case 0x6c:
    case 0x6d:
    case 0x6e:
    case 0x71:
    case 0x74:
    case 0x76:
    case 0x7f:
      return {
        start,
        op,
        next: p,
      };

    default:
      return {
        start,
        op,
        next: p,
        unknown: true,
      };
  }
}

function findLastLocalGet(
  codeStart: number,
  before: number,
  localIndex: number
) {
  let p = codeStart;
  let found: number | null = null;

  while (p < before) {
    const d = decode(p);

    if (d.op === 0x20 && d.imm === localIndex) {
      found = d.start;
    }

    if (d.next <= p) break;

    p = d.next;
  }

  return found;
}

/*
 * Print a compact instruction list immediately preceding CALL.
 */
function dumpWindow(code: number, addr: number) {
  const start = Math.max(code, addr - 64);

  console.log(
    `WINDOW ${hex(start)} .. ${hex(addr)}`
  );

  let p = start;

  while (p < addr) {
    const d = decode(p);

    const raw: string[] = [];

    for (let q = d.start; q < Math.min(d.next, addr); q++) {
      raw.push(
        wasm[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
      );
    }

    let extra = "";

    if (d.imm !== undefined) {
      extra = ` imm=${d.imm}`;
    }

    if (d.offset !== undefined) {
      extra += ` offset=${d.offset}`;
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(d.start)}  ${raw.join(" ")}${extra}`
    );

    if (d.next <= p) break;

    p = d.next;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const targets = [
  [6464, 0x22838e],

  [6613, 0x22cb34],
  [6615, 0x22cc55],
  [6615, 0x22cc5e],
  [6618, 0x22d083],
  [7467, 0x25093d],
  [7579, 0x2562b8],
] as const;

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }
  return { v: v >>> 0, p };
}

function bodyOf(target: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.p;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.v;

    if (id === 10 && target >= start && target < end)
      return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

function decodeInstr(p: number) {
  const op = wasm[p];

  // local.get/set/tee
  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    return {
      text:
        op === 0x20 ? `local.get ${wasm[p+1]}` :
        op === 0x21 ? `local.set ${wasm[p+1]}` :
        `local.tee ${wasm[p+1]}`,
      next: p + 2
    };
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return {
      text: `i32.const ${x.v}`,
      next: x.p
    };
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return {
      text: `call ${x.v}`,
      next: x.p
    };
  }

  // call_indirect
  if (op === 0x11) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    const y = uleb(x.p);
    return {
      text: `call_indirect type=${x.v} table=${y.v}`,
      next: y.p
    };
  }

  // memory load/store
  if (
    op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2d || op === 0x2f ||
    op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 ||
    op === 0x3a || op === 0x3b
  ) {
    const a = uleb(p + 1);
    const o = uleb(a.p);
    return {
      text: `memop 0x${op.toString(16)} align=${a.v} offset=${o.v}`,
      next: o.p
    };
  }

  // common numeric ops
  const one = new Map<number,string>([
    [0x6a,"i32.add"],
    [0x6b,"i32.sub"],
    [0x6c,"i32.mul"],
    [0x47,"i32.lt_u"],
    [0x46,"i32.eq"],
    [0x45,"i32.eqz"],
    [0x71,"i32.and"],
    [0x72,"i32.or"],
    [0x73,"i32.xor"],
    [0x74,"i32.shl"],
    [0x76,"i32.shr_u"],
    [0x1a,"drop"],
    [0x0b,"end"],
  ]);

  return {
    text: one.get(op) ?? `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`,
    next: p + 1
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 23;
const IMPORTED = 83;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32leb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function s32leb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p,
    };
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function section(idWanted: number) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p];

        const s = u32leb(p + 1);

        const start = s.next;
        const end = start + s.value;

        if (id === idWanted) {
            return {
                start,
                end,
            };
        }

        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${idWanted} NOT FOUND`);
}

function instrLen(pos: number) {
    const op = buf[pos];
    let p = pos + 1;

    if (
        op === 0x20 ||
        op === 0x21 ||
        op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 ||
        op === 0x24 ||
        op === 0x10 ||
        op === 0x0c ||
        op === 0x0d
    ) {
        return u32leb(p).next - pos;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        return s32leb(p).next - pos;
    }

    if (
        op >= 0x28 &&
        op <= 0x3e
    ) {
        const a = u32leb(p);
        const b = u32leb(a.next);
        return b.next - pos;
    }

    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
        return u32leb(p).next - pos;
    }

    if (op === 0xfc || op === 0xfd || op === 0xfe) {
        return u32leb(p).next - pos;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const a = u32leb(p);
        const b = u32leb(a.next);
        return b.next - pos;
    }

    return 1;
}

function decode(pos: number) {
    const op = buf[pos];

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
        return `CALL ${r.value}`;
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
        return `GETL ${r.value}`;
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
        return `SETL ${r.value}`;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
        return `TEEL ${r.value}`;
    }

    if (op === 0x23) {
        const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
        return `GETG ${r.value}`;
    }

    if (op === 0x24) {
        const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
        return `SETG ${r.value}`;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = s32leb(pos + 1);
        return `CONST ${hex(r.value)}`;
    }

    if (
        op >= 0x28 &&
        op <= 0x35
    ) {
        const a = u32leb(pos + 1);
        const o = u32leb(a.next);

        const names: Record<number, string> = {
            0x28: "LOAD32",
            0x29: "LOAD64",
            0x2a: "LOADF32",
            0x2b: "LOADF64",
            0x2c: "LOAD8S",
            0x2d: "LOAD8U",
            0x2e: "LOAD16S",
            0x2f: "LOAD16U",
            0x30: "LOAD8",
            0x31: "LOAD8",
            0x32: "LOAD16",
            0x33: "LOAD16",
            0x34: "LOAD32",
            0x35: "LOAD32",
        };

        return `${names[op] ?? "LOAD"} off=${hex(o.value)}`;
    }

    if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const a = u32leb(pos + 1);
        const o = u32leb(a.next);

        return `STORE off=${hex(o.value)}`;
    }

    if (op === 0x04) return "IF";
    if (op === 0x05) return "ELSE";
    if (op === 0x0b) return "END";
    if (op === 0x0f) return "RETURN";
    if (op === 0x1a) return "DROP";

    if (op === 0x02) return "BLOCK";
    if (op === 0x03) return "LOOP";

    if (op === 0x45) return "EQZ";
    if (op === 0x46) return "EQ";
    if (op === 0x47) return "NE";
    if (op === 0x49) return "LT_U";
    if (op === 0x4f) return "GE_U";
    if (op === 0x6a) return "ADD";
    if (op === 0x6b) return "SUB";
    if (op === 0x71) return "AND";
    if (op === 0x72) return "OR";
    if (op === 0x73) return "XOR";

    if (op === 0xfc) {
        const r = u32leb(pos + 1);
        return `EXT ${r.value}`;
    }

    return `OP 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

const functionSection = section(3);
const codeSection = section(10);

let fp = functionSection.start;

const functionCount = u32leb(fp);
fp = functionCount.next;

const definedCount = functionCount.value;

for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++) {
    const r = u32leb(fp);
    fp = r.next;

    types.push(r.value);
}

        func: IMPORTED + ordinal,

    });

}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const IMPORTED = 83;
const FUNC = 810;
const TARGET = 445;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sec = {};

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const z = uleb(p);
    p = z.next;

    sec[id] = {
      start: p,
      end: p + z.value
    };

    p += z.value;
  }

  return sec;
}

function getFunctions() {

  const sec = readSections();

  let p = sec[3].start;
  const n = uleb(p);
  p = n.next;

  const types = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    types.push(x.value);
  }

  p = sec[10].start;
  const c = uleb(p);
  p = c.next;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {

    const z = uleb(p);
    const size = z.value;
    p = z.next;

    bodies.push({
      func: IMPORTED + i,
      type: types[i],
      start: p,
      end: p + size
    });

    p += size;
  }

  return { sec, types, bodies };
}

const { sec, types, bodies } = getFunctions();

const f = bodies.find(x => x.func === FUNC);

if (!f) {
  console.log("FUNC810 NOT FOUND");
  process.exit(1);
}

/* Resolve type signatures                                    */
/* --------------------------------------------------------- */

function getType(index) {

  let p = sec[1].start;
  const n = uleb(p);
  p = n.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

    const form = b[p++];

    const pc = uleb(p);
    p = pc.next;

    const params = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++)
      params.push(b[p++]);

    const rc = uleb(p);
    p = rc.next;

    const results = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++)
      results.push(b[p++]);

    if (i === index)
      return { params, results };
  }

  return null;
}

function typeName(x) {

  const m = {
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64"
  };

  return m[x] ?? `0x${x.toString(16)}`;
}

const target = bodies.find(x => x.func === TARGET);
