import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x38447;
const END   = 0x38509;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);
      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }
  }
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readInstr(p) {

  const op = b[p];
  let q = p + 1;

  switch (op) {

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(q);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
        push: `local${x.value}`
      };
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(q);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
        set: x.value
      };
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(q);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
        tee: x.value
      };
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb(q);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
        push: `${x.value}`
      };
    }

    case 0x1a:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: "drop",
        drop: true
      };

    case 0x6a:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: "i32.add",
        binary: "+"
      };

    case 0x6b:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: "i32.sub",
        binary: "-"
      };

    case 0x71:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: "i32.and",
        binary: "&"
      };

    case 0x45:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: "i32.eqz",
        unary: "eqz"
      };

    case 0x46:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: "i32.eq",
        binary: "=="
      };

    case 0x47:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: "i32.ne",
        binary: "!="
      };

    case 0x28: {
      const align = uleb(q);
      const off = uleb(align.next);

      return {
        next: off.next,
        text: `i32.load offset=${off.value}`,
        load: off.value
      };
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const align = uleb(q);
      const off = uleb(align.next);

      return {
        next: off.next,
        text: `i32.store offset=${off.value}`,
        store: off.value
      };
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(q);

      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `call ${x.value}`,
        call: x.value
      };
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(q);

      return {
        next: t.next,
        text: `call_indirect type=${t.value}`,
        indirect: t.value
      };
    }

    case 0x0b:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: "end"
      };

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(q);

      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `br ${x.value}`
      };
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(q);

      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `br_if ${x.value}`
      };
    }

    case 0x02:
      return {
        next: q + 1,
        text: "block"
      };

    case 0x03:
      return {
        next: q + 1,
        text: "loop"
      };

    default:
      return {
        next: q,
        text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      };
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 810 FULL SYMBOLIC STACK TRACE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`RANGE : ${hex(START)} .. ${hex(END)}`);
console.log("");

const stack = [];

function showStack() {

  if (!stack.length) {
    console.log("STACK = []");
    return;
  }

  console.log(
    "STACK = [" +
    stack.map((x, i) => `${i}:${x}`).join(" | ") +
    "]"
  );
}

let p = START;

while (p < END) {

  const ins = readInstr(p);

  console.log(
    `${hex(p)}  ${ins.text}`
  );

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* local.get                                                */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.push !== undefined) {
    stack.push(ins.push);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* local.set                                                 */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.set !== undefined) {

    const value =
      stack.length
        ? stack.pop()
        : "<EMPTY>";

    console.log(
      `          local${ins.set} = ${value}`
    );
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* local.tee                                                 */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.tee !== undefined) {

    const value =
      stack.length
        ? stack[stack.length - 1]
        : "<EMPTY>";

    console.log(
      `          local${ins.tee} = ${value}`
    );
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* binary operation                                          */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.binary) {

    const b2 = stack.pop() ?? "<EMPTY>";
    const b1 = stack.pop() ?? "<EMPTY>";

    stack.push(`(${b1} ${ins.binary} ${b2})`);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* unary operation                                           */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.unary) {

    const a = stack.pop() ?? "<EMPTY>";

    stack.push(`${ins.unary}(${a})`);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* load                                                      */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.load !== undefined) {

    const addr = stack.pop() ?? "<EMPTY>";

    stack.push(`MEM[${addr}+${ins.load}]`);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* store                                                     */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.store !== undefined) {

    const value = stack.pop() ?? "<EMPTY>";
    const addr  = stack.pop() ?? "<EMPTY>";

    console.log(
      `          STORE MEM[${addr}+${ins.store}] = ${value}`
    );
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* drop                                                      */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.drop) {
    stack.pop();
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* FUNC CALL                                                 */
  /* ------------------------------------------------------- */

  if (ins.call !== undefined) {

    if (ins.call === 445) {

      console.log("");
      console.log("############################################################");
      console.log(`CALL FUNC445 @ ${hex(p)}`);
      console.log("############################################################");

      showStack();

      console.log("");
      console.log("FUNC445 TYPE = (i32, i32) -> i32");

      console.log(
        "Therefore the TOP TWO stack values are the arguments:"
      );

      const a1 = stack[stack.length - 2] ?? "<MISSING>";
      const a2 = stack[stack.length - 1] ?? "<MISSING>";

      console.log(`  arg0 = ${a1}`);
      console.log(`  arg1 = ${a2}`);

      console.log("");

      stack.pop();
      stack.pop();

      stack.push("FUNC445_RESULT");

    } else {

      /*
       * For unknown calls we do not guess parameter counts.
       * Keep the symbolic stack intact.
       */

      console.log(
        `          CALL FUNC${ins.call} [parameter count not resolved here]`
      );
    }
  }

  p = ins.next;
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL SYMBOLIC STACK");
console.log("============================================================");

showStack();

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

import { ADNLClientTCP } from 'adnl';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const TESTNET_CONFIG_URL =
    'https://ton-blockchain.github.io/testnet-global.config.json';

function intToIp(ip: number): string {
    return [
        ip & 255,
        (ip >>> 8) & 255,
        (ip >>> 16) & 255,
        (ip >>> 24) & 255,
    ].join('.');
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log(' ADNL CONNECTION TEST');
    console.log(' TESTNET GLOBAL CONFIG');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('='.repeat(72));
    console.log();

    const response = await fetch(TESTNET_CONFIG_URL);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Failed to download config: ${response.status}`
        );
    }

    const config: any = await response.json();

    if (!config.liteservers || config.liteservers.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('No LiteServers found in testnet config');
    }

    const ls = config.liteservers[0];

    const ip = intToIp(ls.ip);
    const port = ls.port;
    const host = `tcp://${ip}:${port}`;
    const publicKey = Buffer.from(ls.id.key, 'base64');

    console.log(`LiteServer: 1/${config.liteservers.length}`);
    console.log(`IP:         ${ip}`);
    console.log(`Port:       ${port}`);
    console.log(`Host:       ${host}`);
    console.log(`Public key: ${ls.id.key}`);
    console.log(`Key bytes:  ${publicKey.length}`);
    console.log();

    let client: ADNLClientTCP;

    try {
        client = new ADNLClientTCP(host, publicKey);
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('[CONSTRUCTOR ERROR]');
        console.error(err);
        return;
    }

    let finished = false;

    client.on('connect', () => {
        console.log('[CONNECT] TCP connection established');
    });

    client.on('ready', () => {
        if (finished) {
            return;
        }

        finished = true;

        console.log('[READY] ADNL handshake completed');
        console.log();
        console.log('RESULT: ADNL connection is READY');

        setTimeout(() => {
            try {
                client.end();
            } catch {}
        }, 500);
    });

    client.on('close', () => {
        console.log('[CLOSE] Socket closed');
    });

    client.on('error', (err) => {
        console.log();
        console.log('[ERROR] ADNL error:');
        console.log(err);
    });

    try {
        console.log('Connecting...');
        await client.connect();
        console.log('connect() returned');
    } catch (err) {
        console.error();
        console.error('[CONNECT EXCEPTION]');
        console.error(err);
    }

    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (!finished) {
                console.log();
                console.log('RESULT: Timeout waiting for READY');

                try {
                    client.end();
                } catch {}
            }

            resolve();
        }, 15000);
    });
}

FILE: scripts\testAllAdnlConnectionsV22.ts
====================================================================================================
import { ADNLClientTCP } from 'adnl';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const TESTNET_CONFIG_URL =
    'https://ton-blockchain.github.io/testnet-global.config.json';

function intToIp(ip: number): string {
    return [
        (ip >>> 24) & 255,
        (ip >>> 16) & 255,
        (ip >>> 8) & 255,
        ip & 255,
    ].join('.');
}

function testOne(
    index: number,
    total: number,
    ip: string,
    port: number,
    keyBase64: string
): Promise<string> {
    return new Promise(async (resolve) => {
        const host = `tcp://${ip}:${port}`;
        const publicKey = Buffer.from(keyBase64, 'base64');

        let done = false;

        const finish = (result: string) => {
            if (done) return;
            done = true;

            try {
                client?.end();
            } catch {}

            resolve(result);
        };

        let client: ADNLClientTCP;

        try {
            client = new ADNLClientTCP(host, publicKey);
        } catch (err: any) {
            finish(`CONSTRUCTOR ERROR: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}`);
            return;
        }

        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            finish('TIMEOUT');
        }, 8000);

        client.on('connect', () => {
            console.log(`  [${index}/${total}] TCP CONNECT`);
        });

        client.on('ready', () => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            console.log(`  [${index}/${total}] ADNL READY`);
            finish('READY');
        });

        client.on('error', (err: any) => {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            console.log(
                `  [${index}/${total}] ERROR: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}`
            );
            finish('ERROR');
        });

        client.on('close', () => {
            if (!done) {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                console.log(`  [${index}/${total}] CLOSE`);
                finish('CLOSE');
            }
        });

        try {
            await client.connect();
        } catch (err: any) {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            finish(`CONNECT THROW: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}`);
        }
    });
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log(' ALL TESTNET ADNL CONNECTIONS');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log();

    const response = await fetch(TESTNET_CONFIG_URL);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `Config HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`
        );
    }

    const config: any = await response.json();

    console.log(`LiteServers found: ${config.liteservers.length}`);
    console.log();

    const results: string[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < config.liteservers.length; i++) {
        const ls = config.liteservers[i];

        const ip = intToIp(ls.ip);
        const port = ls.port;

        console.log(
            `[${i + 1}/${config.liteservers.length}] ${ip}:${port}`
        );

        const result = await testOne(
            i + 1,
            config.liteservers.length,
            ip,
            port,
            ls.id.key
        );

        console.log(`  RESULT: ${result}`);
        console.log();

        results.push(`${i + 1}. ${ip}:${port} -> ${result}`);
    }

    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log(' SUMMARY');
    console.log('========================================================================');

    for (const result of results) {
        console.log(result);
    }

    console.log();
    console.log('No blockchain transaction was sent.');
}

async function getJettonWallet(
    provider: NetworkProvider,
    master: Address,
    owner: Address,
): Promise<Address> {
    const result = await provider
        .provider(master)
        .get('get_wallet_address', [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(owner)
                    .endCell(),
            },
        ]);

    return result.stack.readAddress();
}

import { Cell } from '@ton/core';
import { LiteClient, LiteSingleEngine } from 'ton-lite-client';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const LIBRARY_HASH_HEX =
    'C95A2ED22AB516F77F9D4898DC4578E72F18A2448E8F6832334B0B4BF501BC79';

const LITESERVER_HOST =
    'tcp://49.12.147.32:27842';

const LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY =
    'sU7QavX2F964iI9oToP9gffQpCQIoOLppeqL/pdPvpM=';

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LIBRARY GET TEST');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================================================');
    console.log();

    console.log(`Host:       ${LITESERVER_HOST}`);
    console.log(`Public key: ${LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY}`);
    console.log();

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host: LITESERVER_HOST,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(LITESERVER_PUBLIC_KEY, 'base64'),
    });

    try {
        console.log('Waiting for ADNL READY...');

        const started = Date.now();

        while (!engine.isReady()) {
            if (Date.now() - started > 15000) {
                throw new Error(
                    'LiteServer did not become ready within 15 seconds'
                );
            }

            await sleep(250);
        }

        console.log('ADNL READY');
        console.log();

        const client = new LiteClient({
            engine,
        });

        const hash = Buffer.from(LIBRARY_HASH_HEX, 'hex');

        console.log('Library hash:');
        console.log(LIBRARY_HASH_HEX);
        console.log();

        console.log('Calling getLibraries()...');

        const result = await client.getLibraries([hash]);

        console.log();
        console.log('getLibraries() returned.');
        console.log();

        console.log(`Result kind: ${result.kind}`);
        console.log(`Entries: ${result.result.length}`);

        for (let i = 0; i < result.result.length; i++) {
            const entry = result.result[i];

            console.log();
            console.log(`--- Entry ${i + 1} ---`);
            console.log(`Kind: ${entry.kind}`);
            console.log(
                `Hash: ${Buffer.from(entry.hash)
                    .toString('hex')
                    .toUpperCase()}`
            );
            console.log(`Data bytes: ${entry.data.length}`);

            try {
                const cell = Cell.fromBoc(Buffer.from(entry.data))[0];

                console.log('Cell BOC: VALID');
                console.log(
                    `Cell hash: ${cell.hash()
                        .toString('hex')
                        .toUpperCase()}`
                );
                console.log(`Cell bits: ${cell.bits.length}`);
                console.log(`Cell refs: ${cell.refs.length}`);
            } catch (err: any) {
                console.log('Cell BOC: INVALID');
                console.log(
                    `Decode error: ${err?.message ?? String(err)}`
                );
            }
        }

        console.log();
        console.log('========================================================================');
        console.log(' TEST COMPLETE');
        console.log('========================================================================');
        console.log('No blockchain transaction was sent.');
    } finally {
        engine.close();
    }
}

}

    LiteSingleEngine,

async function main() {

    const servers = [
        {
            name: 'Server 1',
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            name: 'Server 2',
            ip: -1468575011,
            port: 51088,
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    const LIBRARY_HASH =
        '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86';

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' TON LITE LIBRARY TEST');
    console.log('========================================');

    console.log('NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Target Library Hash:');
    console.log(LIBRARY_HASH);

    const engines: LiteSingleEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {

        const key =

        console.log('Key bytes:', key.length);

        const single =

                reconnectTimeout: 5000,

        engines.push(single);
    }

    console.log('');

    const engine =
        new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines);

    const client =
        new LiteClient({

        const hash =

            );

        console.log('Hash bytes:', hash.length);

        const result =

        );

        if (result.result.length > 0) {

            console.log('');

            for (
                let i = 0;
                i < result.result.length;
                i++
            ) {
                console.log('');

                console.dir(
                    result.result[i],
                    { depth: 5 }
                );

        } else {

            console.log('');

    }

    // Force exit only after all test logic and engine cleanup.
    process.exit(0);
}

function intToIP(int: number) {

    const part1 =
        int & 255;

    const part2 =
        (int >> 8) & 255;

    const part3 =
        (int >> 16) & 255;

    const part4 =
        (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

    console.error('FATAL ERROR');
    console.error(error);

    process.exit(1);
});

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteRoundRobinEngine,
    LiteSingleEngine,
    LiteEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

function intToIP(int: number) {
    const part1 = int & 255;
    const part2 = (int >> 8) & 255;
    const part3 = (int >> 16) & 255;
    const part4 = (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

async function main() {

async function main() {

        {
            name: 'Server 1',
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            name: 'Server 2',
            ip: -1468575011,
            port: 51088,
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' TON LITE ROUND ROBIN CONNECTION TEST');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO WALLET');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('');

    const engines: LiteSingleEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {

        const host =
            `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`;

        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log(server.name);
        console.log('Host:', host);

        const key =
            Buffer.from(
                server.key,
                'base64'
            );

        console.log(
            'Key bytes:',
            key.length
        );

        const engine =
            new LiteSingleEngine({
                host,
                publicKey: key,
                reconnectTimeout: 5000,
            });

        engines.push(engine);
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('Creating RoundRobin engine...');

    const engine =
        new LiteRoundRobinEngine(
            engines
        );

    const client =
        new LiteClient({
            engine,
            batchSize: 1,
        });

    try {

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('MASTERCHAIN TEST');

        const master =
            await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log('');
        console.log('SUCCESS');

            'Masterchain seqno:',
            master.last.seqno
        );

        console.log(
            'Root hash:',
            Buffer.from(
                master.last.rootHash
            ).toString('hex')
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('RoundRobin connection is working.');

    } catch (error) {

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ERROR');

        console.error(error);

    } finally {

        console.log('');
        console.log('Closing engines...');

        for (const e of engines) {
            e.close();
        }

        console.log('Done.');
    }
}

function intToIP(int: number) {

        int & 255;

    const part2 =
        (int >> 8) & 255;

    const part3 =
        (int >> 16) & 255;

    const part4 =
        (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

import { LiteClient } from "ton-lite-client";
import { LiteSingleEngine } from "ton-lite-client/dist/engines/single";

const MISSING_HASH = Buffer.from(
    "631cf98bbb3ee540dacc48256975d8e2c3080c6342e3ff4a9edaac6db73730041",
    "hex"
);

const SERVERS = [
    {
        name: "SERVER 1",
        host: "tcp://168.119.95.207:27787",
        key: "Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=",
    },
    {
        name: "SERVER 2",
        host: "tcp://168.119.82.221:51088",
        key: "Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=",
    },
];

async function waitUntilReady(
    engine: LiteSingleEngine,
    timeoutMs = 15000
) {
    const start = Date.now();

    while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
        if (engine.isReady()) {
            return true;
        }

        if (engine.isClosed()) {
            // Give the engine a little time to establish the connection.
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
        } else {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
        }
    }

    return false;
}

async function testServer(
    name: string,
    host: string,
    key: string
) {
    console.log(`\n===== ${name} =====`);
    console.log(`Server: ${host}`);
    console.log(`Requested hash: ${MISSING_HASH.toString("hex")}`);

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(key, "base64"),
        client: "tcp",
        reconnectTimeout: 3000,
    });

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine,
    });

    try {
        console.log("Waiting for LiteServer connection...");

        const ready = await waitUntilReady(engine, 15000);

        console.log("Engine ready:", ready);
        console.log("Engine closed:", engine.isClosed());

        if (!ready) {
            console.log("RESULT: CONNECTION NOT READY");
            return;
        }

        const result = await client.getLibraries([
            MISSING_HASH
        ]);

        console.log("Result kind:", result.kind);
        console.log("Result count:", result.result.length);

        if (result.result.length === 0) {
            console.log("RESULT: NOT FOUND");
        } else {
            console.log("RESULT: FOUND");

            for (const entry of result.result) {
                console.log(
                    "Returned hash:",
                    entry.hash.toString("hex")
                );

                console.log(
                    "Data bytes:",
                    entry.data.length
                );
            }
        }
    } catch (e: any) {
        console.log(
            "ERROR:",
            e?.message ?? e
        );
    } finally {
        engine.close();
    }
}

export async function run() {
    console.log("========================================");
    console.log(" MISSING ROUTER LIBRARY CROSS-SERVER TEST");
    console.log("========================================");
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.");

    for (const server of SERVERS) {
        await testServer(
            server.name,
            server.host,
            server.key
        );
    }

    console.log("\n========================================");
    console.log("TEST FINISHED");
    console.log("NO TRANSACTION");
    console.log("========================================");
}

        'EQBsGx9ArADUrREB34W-ghgsCgBShvfUr4Jvlu-0KGc33Rbt'
    );

    console.log('===== OFFICIAL STON TESTNET ROUTER =====');
    console.log('Router:', routerAddress.toString());

    try {
        const state = await provider.provider(routerAddress).getState();

        console.log('State:', state.state.type);
        console.log('Balance:', state.balance.toString());

        if (state.state.type !== 'active') {
            console.log('Router is NOT ACTIVE');
            return;
        }

        const tests = [
            'get_router_version',
            'get_router_data',
            'get_router_id',
        ];

        for (const method of tests) {
            try {
                const result =
                    await provider.provider(routerAddress).get(method, []);

                console.log(`\n${method}: SUCCESS`);
                console.log(result.stack);
            } catch (error) {
                console.log(`\n${method}: FAILED`);

                const message =
                    error instanceof Error
                        ? error.message
                        : String(error);

                console.log(message);
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('===== ROUTER INSPECTION FAILED =====');

        const message =
            error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : String(error);

        console.log(message);
    }
}

import { StonApiClient } from '@ston-fi/api';
import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const ROOSTER_MASTER =
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('===== DIRECT V2.2 POOL ADDRESS TEST =====');

    const api = new StonApiClient({
        baseUrl: 'https://api.ston.fi',
    });

    const routers = await api.getRouters({
        dexV2: true,
    });

    const candidates = routers.filter((r: any) =>
        r.majorVersion === 2 &&
        r.minorVersion === 2 &&
        r.routerType === 'ConstantProduct' &&
        r.poolCreationEnabled === true
    );

    console.log('CANDIDATES:', candidates.length);

    const r = candidates[0];

    const routerAddress = Address.parse(r.address);
    const roosterMaster = Address.parse(ROOSTER_MASTER);
    const ptonMaster = Address.parse(r.ptonMasterAddress);

    console.log('Router:', routerAddress.toString());
    console.log('ROOSTER master:', roosterMaster.toString());
    console.log('pTON master:', ptonMaster.toString());

    try {
        // --------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Get ROOSTER wallet belonging to Router
        // --------------------------------------------------
        const roosterWalletResult =
            await provider.provider(roosterMaster).get(
                'get_wallet_address',
                [
                    {
                        type: 'slice',
                        cell: beginAddressCell(routerAddress),
                    },
                ]
            );

        const roosterRouterWallet =
            roosterWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

        console.log(
            'ROOSTER Router Wallet:',
            roosterRouterWallet.toString()
        );

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Get pTON wallet belonging to Router
        // --------------------------------------------------
        const ptonWalletResult =
            await provider.provider(ptonMaster).get(
                'get_wallet_address',
                [
                    {
                        type: 'slice',
                        cell: beginAddressCell(routerAddress),
                    },
                ]
            );

        const ptonRouterWallet =
            ptonWalletResult.stack.readAddress();

        console.log(
            'pTON Router Wallet:',
            ptonRouterWallet.toString()
        );

        // --------------------------------------------------
        // 3. Call Router get_pool_address directly
        // --------------------------------------------------
        const poolResult =
            await provider.provider(routerAddress).get(
                'get_pool_address',
                [
                    {
                        type: 'slice',
                        cell: beginAddressCell(roosterRouterWallet),
                    },
                    {
                        type: 'slice',
                        cell: beginAddressCell(ptonRouterWallet),
                    },
                ]
            );

        const poolAddress =
            poolResult.stack.readAddress();

        console.log(
            'POOL:',
            poolAddress.toString()
        );

    } catch (e) {
        console.log(
            'ERROR:',
            e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)
        );
    }
}

function beginAddressCell(address: Address) {
    const { beginCell } = require('@ton/core');

    return beginCell()
        .storeAddress(address)
        .endCell();
}

        console.log(error?.message ?? error);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // get_expected_tokens
    // ------------------------------------------------
    try {
        const result = await pool.get('get_expected_tokens', [
            {
                type: 'int',
                value: roosterAmount
            },
            {
                type: 'int',
                value: ptonAmount
            }
        ]);

        console.log('\nget_expected_tokens: SUCCESS');
        console.log('Expected LP:', result.stack.readBigNumber().toString());
    } catch (error: any) {
        console.log('\nget_expected_tokens: FAILED');
        console.log(error?.message ?? error);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // get_expected_liquidity
    // ------------------------------------------------
    try {
        const result = await pool.get('get_expected_liquidity', [
            {
                type: 'int',
                value: lpAmount
            }
        ]);

        console.log('\nget_expected_liquidity: SUCCESS');

        console.log(
            'Amount0:',
            result.stack.readBigNumber().toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'Amount1:',
            result.stack.readBigNumber().toString()
        );
    } catch (error: any) {
        console.log('\nget_expected_liquidity: FAILED');
        console.log(error?.message ?? error);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------
    // get_expected_outputs
    // ------------------------------------------------
    try {
        const result = await pool.get('get_expected_outputs', [
            {
                type: 'int',
                value: roosterAmount
            },
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(ownerAddress)
                    .endCell()
            }
        ]);

        console.log('\nget_expected_outputs: SUCCESS');

        console.log(
            'Jetton to receive:',
            result.stack.readBigNumber().toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'Protocol fee:',
            result.stack.readBigNumber().toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'Ref fee:',
            result.stack.readBigNumber().toString()
        );
    } catch (error: any) {
        console.log('\nget_expected_outputs: FAILED');
        console.log(error?.message ?? error);
    }

    console.log('\n===== TEST FINISHED =====');
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';
import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteRoundRobinEngine,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';
import { Functions } from 'ton-lite-client/dist/schema';

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
);

// get_router_data
const GET_ROUTER_DATA = '128085';

// Common TON getter IDs to test.
// These are diagnostic only.
const TEST_METHODS = [
    {
        name: 'get_router_data',
        id: GET_ROUTER_DATA,
    },
];

async function main() {
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER GETTER EXECUTION TEST');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('========================================');

    const engines = [
        new LiteSingleEngine({
            host: 'tcp://168.119.95.207:27787',
            publicKey: Buffer.from(
                'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
                'base64'
            ),
        }),

        new LiteSingleEngine({
            host: 'tcp://168.119.82.221:51088',
            publicKey: Buffer.from(
                'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
                'base64'
            ),
        }),
    ];

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine: new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines),
    });

    const master = await client.getMasterchainInfo();

    console.log('\nMASTERCHAIN');
    console.log('seqno:', master.last.seqno);

    const baseRequest = {
        kind: 'liteServer.runSmcMethod' as const,

        id: {
            kind: 'tonNode.blockIdExt' as const,
            seqno: master.last.seqno,
            shard: master.last.shard,
            workchain: master.last.workchain,
            fileHash: master.last.fileHash,
            rootHash: master.last.rootHash,
        },

        account: {
            kind: 'liteServer.accountId' as const,
            workchain: ROUTER.workChain,
            id: Buffer.from(ROUTER.hash),
        },

        params: Buffer.alloc(0),
    };

    for (const method of TEST_METHODS) {
        console.log('\n----------------------------------------');
        console.log('METHOD:', method.name);
        console.log('METHOD ID:', method.id);
        console.log('----------------------------------------');

        const request = {
            ...baseRequest,
            mode: 4,
            methodId: method.id,
        };

        const result = await client.engine.query(
            Functions.liteServer_runSmcMethod,
            request
        );

        console.log('exit code:', result.exitCode);

        console.log(
            'result bytes:',
            result.result ? result.result.length : 0
        );

        if (result.result) {
            const boc = Buffer.from(result.result);

            console.log(
                'result BOC:',
                boc.toString('base64')
            );

            try {
                const cells = Cell.fromBoc(boc);

                console.log(
                    'decoded root count:',
                    cells.length
                );

                if (cells.length > 0) {
                    console.log(
                        'root bits:',
                        cells[0].bits.length
                    );

                    console.log(
                        'root refs:',
                        cells[0].refs.length
                    );
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.log(
                    'result BOC decode error:',
                    e instanceof Error ? e.message : e
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log('\n========================================');
    console.log('END');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('========================================');
}

main().catch((error) => {
    console.error('\nFATAL ERROR');
    console.error(error);
    process.exit(1);
});

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteRoundRobinEngine,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

import {
    Address,
} from '@ton/core';

import {
    Functions,
} from 'ton-lite-client/dist/schema';

import {
    crc16,
} from 'ton-lite-client/dist/utils/crc16';

async function main() {

    const servers = [
        {
            ip: -1468571697,
            port: 27787,
            key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
        },
        {
            ip: -1468575011,
            port: 51088,
            key: 'Sy5ghr3EahQd/1rDayzZXt5+inlfF+7kLfkZDJcU/ek=',
        },
    ];

    const ROUTER =
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval';

    const METHOD =
        'get_router_data';

    console.log('');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER LIB EXTRAS TEST');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO WALLET');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION');
    console.log('');

    const engines: LiteSingleEngine[] = [];

    for (const server of servers) {

        const host =
            `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`;

        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('Server');
        console.log('Host:', host);

        const engine =
            new LiteSingleEngine({
                host,
                publicKey: Buffer.from(
                    server.key,
                    'base64'
                ),
                reconnectTimeout: 5000,
            });

        engines.push(engine);
    }

    const engine =
        new LiteRoundRobinEngine(engines);

    const client =
        new LiteClient({
            engine,
            batchSize: 1,
        });

    try {

        console.log('');
        console.log('Getting masterchain info...');

        const master =
            await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log(
            'Masterchain seqno:',
            master.last.seqno
        );

        const router =
            Address.parse(ROUTER);

        const methodId =
            ((crc16(METHOD) & 0xffff) | 0x10000);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Method:', METHOD);
        console.log(
            'Method ID:',
            methodId
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Running direct liteServer.runSmcMethod...');
        console.log('Mode: 20');
        console.log('4  = result');
        console.log('16 = libExtras');
        console.log('');

        const request = {
            kind: 'liteServer.runSmcMethod' as const,

            mode: 20,

            id: {
                kind: 'tonNode.blockIdExt' as const,
                seqno: master.last.seqno,
                shard: master.last.shard,
                workchain: master.last.workchain,
                rootHash: master.last.rootHash,
                fileHash: master.last.fileHash,
            },

            account: {
                kind: 'liteServer.accountId' as const,
                workchain: router.workChain,
                id: router.hash,
            },

            methodId:
                methodId.toString(),

            params:
                Buffer.alloc(0),
        };

        const result =
            await client.engine.query(
                Functions.liteServer_runSmcMethod,
                request
            );

        console.log('');
        console.log('========================================');
        console.log(' RAW RUN SMC METHOD RESULT');
        console.log('========================================');

        console.log('');
        console.log('Exit code:');
        console.log(result.exitCode);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Mode returned:');
        console.log(result.mode);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Result bytes:');
        console.log(
            result.result
                ? result.result.length
                : null
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('Result BOC:');
        console.log(
            result.result
                ? result.result.toString('base64')
                : null
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('libExtras bytes:');
        console.log(
            result.libExtras
                ? result.libExtras.length
                : null
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('libExtras BOC:');
        console.log(
            result.libExtras
                ? result.libExtras.toString('base64')
                : null
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('========================================');
        console.log(' TEST FINISHED');
        console.log(' NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
        console.log('========================================');

    } catch (error) {

        console.log('');
        console.log('ERROR');
        console.error(error);

    } finally {

        console.log('');
        console.log('Closing engines...');

        for (const e of engines) {
            e.close();
        }

        console.log('Done.');
    }

    process.exit(0);
}

function intToIP(int: number) {

    const part1 =
        int & 255;

    const part2 =
        (int >> 8) & 255;

    const part3 =
        (int >> 16) & 255;

    const part4 =
        (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

main().catch((error) => {

    console.error('');
    console.error('FATAL ERROR');
    console.error(error);

    process.exit(1);
});

        .storeAddress(ptonWallet)

                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: token1Cell,
                },
            ]
        );

        console.log('===== GETTER SUCCESS =====');

            console.log('Pool Address:', result.stack.readAddress().toString());

import { Address } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const router = Address.parse(
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
    );

    const pton = Address.parse(
        'EQACS30DNoUQ7NfApPvzh7eBmSZ9L4ygJ-lkNWtba8TQT1h7'
    );

    console.log('===== ROUTER vs JETTON GETTER TEST =====');
    console.log('Router:', router.toString());
    console.log('pTON:', pton.toString());

    // -----------------------------
    // TEST 1: Router getter
    // -----------------------------
    console.log('\n[1] Router get_router_version');

    try {
        const r = await provider.provider(router).get(
            'get_router_version',
            []
        );

        console.log('SUCCESS');
        console.log('Stack:', r.stack);
    } catch (e) {
        console.log('FAILED');
        console.log(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // TEST 2: pTON getter
    // -----------------------------
    console.log('\n[2] pTON get_wallet_address');

    try {
        const r = await provider.provider(pton).get(
            'get_wallet_address',
            [
                {
                    type: 'slice',
                    cell: provider
                        .provider(pton)
                        ? undefined as never
                        : undefined as never
                }
            ]
        );

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const targets = [
  0x22838e, // 6464
  0x22c948, // 6611
  0x22c9ef, // 6611
  0x22cb34, // 6613
  0x22cc55, // 6615
  0x22cc5e, // 6615
  0x22d083, // 6618
  0x25093d, // 7467
  0x2562b8, // 7579
];

function readU32(p: number) {
  return wasm.readUInt32LE(p);
}

function findCallers(): Map<number, number[]> {
  const m = new Map<number, number[]>();

  for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length - 1; p++) {
    if (wasm[p] === 0x10) {
      let x = p + 1, v = 0, sh = 0;
      while (x < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[x++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << sh;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
        sh += 7;
      }
      if (v === 113) {
        if (!m.has(p)) m.set(p, []);
      }
    }
  }
  return m;
}

// Locate function bodies from the code section.
// Simple scanner based on known function bodies is enough for local context.
function findFuncContaining(off: number): number {
  // Function body ranges are extracted from code section.
  // We use the standard wasm code section parser.
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    let size = 0, sh = 0;
    while (p < wasm.length) {
      const b = wasm[p++];
      size |= (b & 0x7f) << sh;
      if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
      sh += 7;
    }

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size;

    if (id === 10 && off >= start && off < end) {
      return start;
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return -1;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("CALL113 ARG0 ORIGIN SCAN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const target of targets) {
  const base = target - 32;

  console.log(`\nTARGET CALL113 @ ${hex(target)}`);
  console.log("--------------------------------------------");

  for (let p = base; p <= target; p++) {
    const b = wasm[p];

    if (b === 0x20) {
      const local = wasm[p + 1];
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  local.get ${local}`);
    }
    else if (b === 0x21) {
      const local = wasm[p + 1];
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  local.set ${local}`);
    }
    else if (b === 0x22) {
      const local = wasm[p + 1];
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  local.tee ${local}`);
    }
    else if (b === 0x41) {
      let x = p + 1, v = 0, sh = 0;
      while (x < wasm.length) {
        const q = wasm[x++];
        v |= (q & 0x7f) << sh;
        if (!(q & 0x80)) break;
        sh += 7;
      }
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  i32.const ${v} (${hex(v)})`);
    }
    else if (b === 0x28) {
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  i32.load`);
    }
    else if (b === 0x6a) {
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  i32.add`);
    }
    else if (b === 0x10 && wasm[p + 1] === 113) {
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  CALL 113`);
    }
  }
}

====================================================================================================
FILE: scripts\trace113Arg0Producer.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGETS = [
  [6464, 0x22838e],
  [6611, 0x22c948],
  [6611, 0x22c9ef],
  [6613, 0x22cb34],
  [6615, 0x22cc55],
  [6615, 0x22cc5e],
  [6618, 0x22d083],
  [7467, 0x25093d],
  [7579, 0x2562b8],
] as const;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    n++;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }
  return { v: v >>> 0, n };
}

function i32(pos: number) {
  return uleb(pos);
}

function opcodeLen(pos: number): number {
  const op = wasm[pos];

  // locals
  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) return 1 + uleb(pos + 1).n;

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) return 1 + uleb(pos + 1).n;

  // i32 load/store family
  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
    const a = uleb(pos + 1);
    const b = uleb(pos + 1 + a.n);
    return 1 + a.n + b.n;
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) return 1 + uleb(pos + 1).n;

  // call_indirect
  if (op === 0x11) {
    const a = uleb(pos + 1);
    return 1 + a.n + 1;
  }

  // br / br_if
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d)
    return 1 + uleb(pos + 1).n;

  // block / loop / if
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04)
    return 2;

  // numeric unary/binary
  if (op >= 0x45 && op <= 0xbf) return 1;

  return 1;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("CALL113 ARG0 PRODUCER TRACE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const [func, callPos] of TARGETS) {
  console.log(`\nFUNC ${func} @ 0x${callPos.toString(16)}`);
  console.log("--------------------------------------------");

  const start = Math.max(0, callPos - 80);
  let p = start;

  while (p < callPos) {
    const op = wasm[p];

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);
      console.log(
        `0x${p.toString(16)} local.get ${x.v}`
      );
      p += 1 + x.n;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);
      console.log(
        `0x${p.toString(16)} i32.const ${x.v} (0x${x.v.toString(16)})`
      );
      p += 1 + x.n;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);
      console.log(
        `0x${p.toString(16)} local.tee ${x.v}`
      );
      p += 1 + x.n;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x2d || op === 0x2f) {
      const a = uleb(p + 1);
      const b = uleb(p + 1 + a.n);
      console.log(
        `0x${p.toString(16)} LOAD op=0x${op.toString(16)} offset=${b.v}`
      );
      p += 1 + a.n + b.n;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6a) {
      console.log(`0x${p.toString(16)} i32.add`);
      p++;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6b) {
      console.log(`0x${p.toString(16)} i32.sub`);
      p++;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6c) {
      console.log(`0x${p.toString(16)} i32.mul`);
      p++;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);
      console.log(`0x${p.toString(16)} call ${x.v}`);
      p += 1 + x.n;
      continue;
    }

    p += opcodeLen(p);
  }

  console.log(`0x${callPos.toString(16)} CALL 113`);
}

console.log("\n============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

====================================================================================================
FILE: scripts\trace113Args.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos, x = 0;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << s);
  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function readString(pos: number) {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  return { next: n.next + n.value };
}

type Type = { params: number[]; results: number[] };

const types: Type[] = [];
const definedTypes: number[] = [];
let importedFuncs = 0;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// sections
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let p = 8;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  const start = sz.next;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (id === 1) {
    let q = start;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      if (b[q++] !== 0x60) throw new Error("bad functype");

      const np = uleb(q); q = np.next;
      const params: number[] = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < np.value; j++)
        params.push(b[q++]);

      const nr = uleb(q); q = nr.next;
      const results: number[] = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < nr.value; j++)
        results.push(b[q++]);

      types.push({ params, results });
    }
  }

  if (id === 2) {
    let q = start;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const a = readString(q); q = a.next;
      const c = readString(q); q = c.next;

      const kind = b[q++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        const t = uleb(q);
        q = t.next;
        importedFuncs++;
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        q++;
        const fl = uleb(q); q = fl.next;
        const mn = uleb(q); q = mn.next;
        if (fl.value & 1) q = uleb(q).next;
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        q = uleb(q).next;
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        q += 2;
      }
    }
  }

  if (id === 3) {
    let q = start;
    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const t = uleb(q);
      definedTypes.push(t.value);
      q = t.next;
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

function funcType(fn: number): Type | null {
  const d = fn - importedFuncs;
  if (d < 0 || d >= definedTypes.length) return null;
  return types[definedTypes[d]];
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------
type FuncBody = {
  fn: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  codeStart: number;
  codeEnd: number;
  locals: number[];
};

const funcs: FuncBody[] = [];

p = 8;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  const start = sz.next;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    let q = start;

    const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      const bodySize = uleb(q);
      const bodyStart = bodySize.next;
      const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize.value;

      let z = bodyStart;

      const localDecls = uleb(z);
      z = localDecls.next;

      const locals: number[] = [];

      for (let k = 0; k < localDecls.value; k++) {
        const cnt = uleb(z);
        z = cnt.next;

        const type = b[z++];

        for (let j = 0; j < cnt.value; j++)
          locals.push(type);
      }

      funcs.push({
        fn: importedFuncs + i,
        start: bodyStart,
        end: bodyEnd,
        codeStart: z,
        codeEnd: bodyEnd - 1,
        locals
      });

      q = bodyEnd;
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// helpers
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function fmtConst(v: number) {
  if (v >= 0 && v < 100000)
    return String(v);

  return `${v} (0x${(v >>> 0).toString(16)})`;
}

function pop(stack: string[]): string {
  return stack.length ? stack.pop()! : "<EMPTY>";
}

function resultCount(fn: number): number {
  const t = funcType(fn);
  return t ? t.results.length : 0;
}

function argCount(fn: number): number {
  const t = funcType(fn);
  return t ? t.params.length : 0;
}

function decodeBody(f: FuncBody) {
  const t = funcType(f.fn);
  if (!t) return;

  const localCount = t.params.length + f.locals.length;

  const stack: string[] = [];
  const out: {
    off: number;
    text: string;
    before: string[];
    after: string[];
  }[] = [];

  let q = f.codeStart;

  while (q < f.codeEnd) {
    const off = q;
    const op = b[q++];

    const before = [...stack];

    try {
      if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = uleb(q); q = x.next;
        stack.push(`L${x.value}`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = uleb(q); q = x.next;
        pop(stack);
      }

      else if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(q); q = x.next;
        const v = pop(stack);
        stack.push(v);
        // tee leaves value on stack
      }

      else if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = sleb(q); q = x.next;
        stack.push(fmtConst(x.value));
      }

      else if (op === 0x28) {
        const al = uleb(q); q = al.next;
        const of = uleb(q); q = of.next;
        const base = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`MEM[${base}+${of.value}]`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x29) {
        const al = uleb(q); q = al.next;
        const of = uleb(q); q = of.next;
        const base = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`MEM64[${base}+${of.value}]`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x36) {
        const al = uleb(q); q = al.next;
        const of = uleb(q); q = of.next;
        const value = pop(stack);
        const base = pop(stack);
      }

      else if (op === 0x37) {
        const al = uleb(q); q = al.next;
        const of = uleb(q); q = of.next;
        const value = pop(stack);
        const base = pop(stack);
      }

      else if (op === 0x6a) {
        const b2 = pop(stack);
        const a2 = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`(${a2}+${b2})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x6b) {
        const b2 = pop(stack);
        const a2 = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`(${a2}-${b2})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x6c) {
        const b2 = pop(stack);
        const a2 = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`(${a2}*${b2})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x45) {
        const a2 = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`(${a2}==0)`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x46) {
        const bb = pop(stack);
        const aa = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`(${aa}==${bb})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x47) {
        const bb = pop(stack);
        const aa = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`(${aa}<u${bb})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x84) {
        const bb = pop(stack);
        const aa = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`(${aa}*${bb})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x50) {
        const aa = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`i64(${aa})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = uleb(q); q = x.next;
        const fn = x.value;

        const n = argCount(fn);
        const args: string[] = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
          args.unshift(pop(stack));

        const rc = resultCount(fn);

        if (fn === 113) {
          out.push({
            off,
            text: `CALL113(${args.join(", ")})`,
            before,
            after: [...stack]
          });
        }

        if (rc === 1)
          stack.push(`F${fn}(${args.join(",")})`);
        else if (rc > 1)
          for (let i = 0; i < rc; i++)
            stack.push(`F${fn}[${i}]`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x11) {
        const ti = uleb(q); q = ti.next;
        const table = uleb(q); q = table.next;

        const tinfo = types[ti.value];
        const n = tinfo ? tinfo.params.length : 0;

        const args: string[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
          args.unshift(pop(stack));

        const selector = pop(stack);

        if (tinfo?.results.length === 1)
          stack.push(`INDIRECT[${selector}](${args.join(",")})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x1a) {
        pop(stack);
      }

      else if (op === 0x1b) {
        const c = pop(stack);
        const bb = pop(stack);
        const aa = pop(stack);
        stack.push(`select(${aa},${bb},${c})`);
      }

      else if (op === 0x0b) {
        break;
      }

      else if (op === 0x0d) {
        q = uleb(q).next;
      }

      else if (op === 0x0c) {
        q = uleb(q).next;
      }

      else if (op === 0x0e) {
        const n = uleb(q); q = n.next;
        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
          q = uleb(q).next;
        q = uleb(q).next;
      }

      else if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
        q = uleb(q).next;
      }

      else if (op === 0x05) {
      }

      else if (op === 0x0f) {
        break;
      }

      else {
        // For unknown instructions, stop symbolic tracing.
        break;
      }
    } catch {
      break;
    }

    const after = [...stack];

    if (off >= f.codeStart && off < f.codeEnd) {
      out.push({
        off,
        text: `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`,
        before,
        after
      });
    }
  }

  return out;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [118, 122, 87];

function readU32Leb(buf: Buffer, pos: number) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function loadBodies() {
  let p = 8;
  let codeStart = -1;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    const s = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = s.next;

    if (id === 10) {
      codeStart = p;
      break;
    }

    p += s.value;
  }

  if (codeStart < 0) throw new Error("Code section not found");

  let q = codeStart;
  const count = readU32Leb(wasm, q);
  q = count.next;

  const bodies = new Map<number, Buffer>();

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const s = readU32Leb(wasm, q);
    const size = s.value;
    q = s.next;

    bodies.set(i, wasm.subarray(q, q + size));
    q += size;
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = loadBodies();

for (const func of TARGETS) {
  const body = bodies.get(func);

  if (!body) {
    console.log(`FUNC ${func}: NOT FOUND`);
    continue;
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
  console.log(`BODY SIZE : ${body.length}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
    if (body[i] !== 0x10) continue;

    const r = readU32Leb(body, i + 1);

    console.log(
      `CALL @ 0x${i.toString(16).padStart(4, "0")} -> FUNC ${r.value}`
    );

    i = r.next - 1;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 98;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0;
  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    n++;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };
    s += 7;
  }
  return null;
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    n++;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v | 0, len: n };
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/* locate code section */
let p = 8;
let funcs = [];

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  if (!sz) break;

  const start = p + sz.len;
  const end = start + sz.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    let q = start;
    const count = uleb(q);
    q += count.len;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
      const z = uleb(q);
      q += z.len;

      funcs.push({
        id: i,
        start: q,
        end: q + z.value
      });

      q += z.value;
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (pos < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, end: pos };

    s += 7;
  }

  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

        q = z.end;

        bodies.push({
          start: q,
          end: q + z.value
        });

        q += z.value;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 122;
const CALL_OPCODE = 0x10;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findBodies() {
  let p = 8;
  let imported = 0;
  const bodies: { start: number; end: number }[] = [];

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const section = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    const start = s.next;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (section === 2) {
      let q = start;
      const n = uleb(q);
      q = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const ml = uleb(q);
        q = ml.next + ml.value;

        const nl = uleb(q);
        q = nl.next + nl.value;

        const kind = wasm[q++];

        if (kind === 0) {
          imported++;
          const t = uleb(q);
          q = t.next;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
          q++;
          const lim = wasm[q++];
          const mn = uleb(q);
          q = mn.next;
          if (lim & 1) {
            const mx = uleb(q);
            q = mx.next;
          }
        } else if (kind === 2) {
          const lim = wasm[q++];
          const mn = uleb(q);
          q = mn.next;
          if (lim & 1) {
            const mx = uleb(q);
            q = mx.next;
          }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
          q += 2;
        }
      }
    }

    if (section === 10) {
      let q = start;
      const n = uleb(q);
      q = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const bs = uleb(q);
        const bodyStart = bs.next;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bs.value;

        bodies.push({
          start: bodyStart,
          end: bodyEnd,
        });

        q = bodyEnd;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return { imported, bodies };
}

    if (r.value !== TARGET)

    hits++;

    const from = Math.max(start, p - 48);

    console.log("");

    console.log(`BODY INDEX  : ${bodyIndex}`);
    console.log(`CALL @      : 0x${p.toString(16)}`);

    for (let q = from; q < to; q++) {

      const b = wasm[q];

      let name = `0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      let extra = "";

      if (b === 0x10) {

      else if (b === 0x20) {

        extra = ` ${x.value}`;
      }
      else if (b === 0x21) {
        const x = uleb(q + 1);
        name = "local.set";
        extra = ` ${x.value}`;
      }
      else if (b === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(q + 1);
        name = "local.tee";
        extra = ` ${x.value}`;
      }
      else if (b === 0x41) {
        const x = uleb(q + 1);
        name = "i32.const";
        extra = ` ${x.value}`;
      }
      else if (b === 0x28) {
        const a = uleb(q + 1);
        const o = uleb(a.next);
        name = "i32.load";
        extra = ` align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      }
      else if (b === 0x6a) {
        name = "i32.add";
      }
      else if (b === 0x6b) {
        name = "i32.sub";
      }
      else if (b === 0x45) {
        name = "i32.eqz";
      }
      else if (b === 0x46) {
        name = "i32.eq";
      }
      else if (b === 0x47) {
        name = "i32.ne";
      }
      else if (b === 0x72) {
        name = "i32.or";
      }

      console.log(
        `0x${q.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${name}${extra}`
      );
    }

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 122;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0, shift = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value, next: pos };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findBodies() {
  let p = 8;
  let imported = 0;
  const bodies: { start: number; end: number }[] = [];

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const section = wasm[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    const start = s.next;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (section === 2) {
      let q = start;
      const n = uleb(q);
      q = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const ml = uleb(q);
        q = ml.next + ml.value;

        const nl = uleb(q);
        q = nl.next + nl.value;

        const kind = wasm[q++];

        if (kind === 0) {
          imported++;
          const t = uleb(q);
          q = t.next;
        } else {
          // Skip remaining import descriptor.
          if (kind === 1) {
            q++;
            const flags = uleb(q);
            q = flags.next;
            if (flags.value & 1) {
              const x = uleb(q);
              q = x.next;
            }
            const y = uleb(q);
            q = y.next;
          } else if (kind === 2) {
            const x = uleb(q);
            q = x.next;
            const y = uleb(q);
            q = y.next;
          } else if (kind === 3) {
            q += 2;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (section === 10) {
      let q = start;
      const n = uleb(q);
      q = n.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const bs = uleb(q);
        const bodyStart = bs.next;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bs.value;

        bodies.push({ start: bodyStart, end: bodyEnd });
        q = bodyEnd;
      }
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return { imported, bodies };
}

const { imported, bodies } = findBodies();

function decodeAt(p: number) {
  const op = wasm[p];

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return `i32.const ${x.value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return `local.get ${x.value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return `local.set ${x.value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return `local.tee ${x.value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = uleb(p + 1);
    return `call ${x.value}`;
  }

  if (op === 0x1a) return "drop";
  if (op === 0x46) return "i32.eq";
  if (op === 0x45) return "i32.eqz";
  if (op === 0x6a) return "i32.add";
  if (op === 0x6b) return "i32.sub";
  if (op === 0x71) return "i32.and";
  if (op === 0x72) return "i32.or";
  if (op === 0x73) return "i32.xor";

  return `OP 0x${op.toString(16)}`;
}

console.log("============================================================");

console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let hits = 0;

for (let bi = 0; bi < bodies.length; bi++) {
  const { start, end } = bodies[bi];
  const func = imported + bi;

  for (let p = start; p < end - 1; p++) {

    if (wasm[p] !== 0x10) continue;

    const c = uleb(p + 1);

    hits++;

    console.log("");
    console.log(`############################################################`);
    console.log(`FUNC ${func} @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);

    // Show raw instruction neighborhood.
    let q = Math.max(start, p - 24);

    while (q < p) {
      const op = wasm[q];

      let next = q + 1;

      if (op === 0x41 || op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(q + 1);
        next = x.next;
      } else if (op === 0x10) {

      );

      q = next;
    }

      `0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  call 122`
    );

  }

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const targets = [
  { a: 141606, b: [309, 310, 143, 202, 168] },
  { a: 144293, b: [545, 336, 725, 138] },
  { a: 149912, b: [687, 328, 329, 1178] },
  { a: 149932, b: [424, 193] },

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = wasm[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function readConst(pos: number) {
  if (wasm[pos] !== 0x41) return null;
  return uleb(pos + 1);
}

function hex(p: number) {
  return "0x" + p.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

  console.log("");

  let shown = 0;

  for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length - 1; p++) {
    const c1 = readConst(p);
    if (!c1 || c1.value !== t.a) continue;

    // Search next ~20 bytes for CONST2 followed by CALL 122 (0x7a)
    for (let q = c1.next; q < Math.min(wasm.length, c1.next + 30); q++) {
      const c2 = readConst(q);
      if (!c2 || !t.b.includes(c2.value)) continue;

      let call122 = false;

      for (let r = c2.next; r < Math.min(wasm.length, c2.next + 12); r++) {
        if (wasm[r] === 0x10) {
          const f = uleb(r + 1);
          if (f.value === 122) {
            call122 = true;
            break;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!call122) continue;

      console.log("");
      console.log(`MATCH @ ${hex(p)}`);
      console.log(`  CONST1 : ${t.a}`);
      console.log(`  CONST2 : ${c2.value}`);
      console.log(`  CALL122: YES`);

      const start = Math.max(0, p - 18);
      const end = Math.min(wasm.length, c2.next + 8);

      let line = "";
      for (let x = start; x < end; x++) {
        line += wasm[x].toString(16).padStart(2, "0") + " ";
      }

      console.log(`  BYTES  : ${line.trim()}`);

      shown++;
      break;
    }

    if (shown >= 20) break;
  }

  console.log(`  MATCHES SHOWN : ${shown}`);
}
