import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 0x195348;
const OFFSETS = new Set([0, 4, 8, 12, 16]);

function readU32LE(p: number): number {
    return (
        buf[p] |
        (buf[p + 1] << 8) |
        (buf[p + 2] << 16) |
        (buf[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function opcodeName(op: number): string {
    switch (op) {
        case 0x20: return "local.get";
        case 0x21: return "local.set";
        case 0x22: return "local.tee";
        case 0x41: return "i32.const";
        case 0x6a: return "i32.add";
        case 0x36: return "i32.store";
        case 0x3a: return "i32.store8";
        case 0x3b: return "i32.store16";
        case 0x37: return "i64.store";
        default: return "opcode";
    }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("STRICT 0x195348 STORE CHAIN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET BASE = ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log("OFFSETS     = 0,4,8,12,16");
console.log("============================================================");

//
// Locate code section (id 10)
//
let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;
let codeEnd = 0;

while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p++];
    const s = readULEB(p);
    const size = s.value;
    p = s.next;

    const payloadStart = p;

    if (id === 10) {
        codeStart = payloadStart;
        codeEnd = payloadStart + size;
        break;
    }

    p += size;
}

if (!codeStart) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

let q = codeStart;
const count = readULEB(q);
q = count.next;

let total = 0;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(q);
    const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
    q = bodySizeInfo.next;

    const bodyStart = q;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    //
    // Skip local declarations
    //
    let x = bodyStart;

    const localGroups = readULEB(x);
    x = localGroups.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {
        const n = readULEB(x);
        x = n.next;
        x += 1; // valtype
    }

    const instrStart = x;

    //
    // Track locals that received exact TARGET.
    //
    const targetLocals = new Set<number>();

    //
    // Keep a short decoded history.
    //
    const hist: {
        pos: number;
        text: string;
    }[] = [];

    function pushHist(pos: number, text: string) {
        hist.push({ pos, text });
        if (hist.length > 12) hist.shift();
    }

    while (x < bodyEnd) {
        const opPos = x;
        const op = buf[x++];

        //
        // End of function body
        //
        if (op === 0x0b) {
            pushHist(opPos, "end");
            break;
        }

        //
        // local.get
        //
        if (op === 0x20) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            const local = r.value;

            pushHist(opPos, `local.get ${local}`);

            //
            // Nothing else needed here.
            //
            continue;
        }

        //
        // local.set / local.tee
        //
        if (op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            const local = r.value;

            //
            // If immediately preceded by i32.const TARGET,
            // this local becomes a target-base local.
            //
            const prev = hist[hist.length - 1];

            if (
                prev &&
                prev.text === `i32.const ${TARGET}`
            ) {
                targetLocals.add(local);

                console.log("");
                console.log(`FUNC ${ordinal}`);
                console.log(`  TARGET LOCAL = ${local}`);
                console.log(`  ${hex(prev.pos)}  i32.const ${hex(TARGET)}`);
                console.log(`  ${hex(opPos)}  ${opcodeName(op)} ${local}`);
            }

            pushHist(
                opPos,
                `${opcodeName(op)} ${local}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        //
        // i32.const
        //
        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = readSLEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            const value = r.value >>> 0;

            pushHist(
                opPos,
                `i32.const ${value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        //
        // i32.add
        //
        if (op === 0x6a) {
            pushHist(opPos, "i32.add");

            //
            // Look for:
            //
            // local.get X
            // i32.const OFFSET
            // i32.add
            //
            // where X is a target local.
            //
            if (hist.length >= 3) {
                const a = hist[hist.length - 3];
                const b = hist[hist.length - 2];

                const m = a.text.match(/^local\.get (\d+)$/);
                const n = b.text.match(/^i32\.const (\d+)$/);

                if (m && n) {
                    const local = Number(m[1]);
                    const offset = Number(n[1]);

                    if (
                        targetLocals.has(local) &&
                        OFFSETS.has(offset)
                    ) {
                        console.log(
                            `  ${hex(opPos)}  TARGET ADDRESS = ${hex(
                                TARGET + offset
                            )}`
                        );

                        console.log(
                            `  CHAIN: local ${local} + ${offset}`
                        );
                    }
                }
            }

            continue;
        }

        //
        // Stores
        //
        if (
            op === 0x36 ||
            op === 0x37 ||
            op === 0x3a ||
            op === 0x3b
        ) {
            //
            // Check whether the preceding expression contained
            // our target-local + small offset chain.
            //
            let targetChain = false;
            let chainOffset = 0;

            if (hist.length >= 3) {
                const a = hist[hist.length - 3];
                const b = hist[hist.length - 2];
                const c = hist[hist.length - 1];

                const m = a.text.match(/^local\.get (\d+)$/);
                const n = b.text.match(/^i32\.const (\d+)$/);

                if (
                    m &&
                    n &&
                    c.text === "i32.add"
                ) {
                    const local = Number(m[1]);
                    const offset = Number(n[1]);

                    if (
                        targetLocals.has(local) &&
                        OFFSETS.has(offset)
                    ) {
                        targetChain = true;
                        chainOffset = offset;
                    }
                }
            }

            //
            // Decode memarg.
            //
            const align = readULEB(x);
            x = align.next;

            const offset = readULEB(x);
            x = offset.next;

            if (targetChain) {
                total++;

                console.log("");
                console.log("############################################################");
                console.log(`MATCH #${total}`);
                console.log(`FUNC ${ordinal}`);
                console.log(`STORE @${hex(opPos)}`);
                console.log(`TARGET ADDRESS = ${hex(TARGET + chainOffset)}`);
                console.log(`OFFSET = +${chainOffset}`);
                console.log(`STORE = ${opcodeName(op)}`);
                console.log(`MEMARG OFFSET = ${offset.value}`);
                console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

                for (const h of hist) {
                    console.log(
                        `  ${hex(h.pos)}  ${h.text}`
                    );
                }

                console.log("############################################################");
            }

            pushHist(
                opPos,
                `${opcodeName(op)} offset=${offset.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        //
        // Memory load
        //
        if (
            op === 0x28 ||
            op === 0x29 ||
            op === 0x2c ||
            op === 0x2d
        ) {
            const align = readULEB(x);
            x = align.next;

            const offset = readULEB(x);
            x = offset.next;

            pushHist(
                opPos,
                `load offset=${offset.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        //
        // Simple control-flow instructions.
        //
        if (
            op === 0x02 ||
            op === 0x03 ||
            op === 0x04
        ) {
            //
            // block type
            //
            if (x < bodyEnd) {
                x++;
            }

            pushHist(opPos, opcodeName(op));
            continue;
        }

        if (
            op === 0x0c ||
            op === 0x0d
        ) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            pushHist(
                opPos,
                `${opcodeName(op)} ${r.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = readULEB(x);
            x = r.next;

            pushHist(
                opPos,
                `call ${r.value}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        //
        // Conservative fallback:
        // record opcode only and continue.
        //
        pushHist(
            opPos,
            `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    q = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`STRICT MATCHES = ${total}`);
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 0x0019534c;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8): string {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function section(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];

    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
}

function codeBodies() {
  const sec = section(10);

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const result: {
    func: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
  }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    result.push({
      func: 83 + i,
      start: p,
      end: p + size.value,
    });

    p += size.value;
  }

  return result;
}

type Ins = {
  addr: number;
  kind: string;
  value?: number;
  index?: number;
  offset?: number;
  func?: number;
};

function decode(pos: number): Ins {
  const addr = pos;
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "const",
      value: x.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "local.get",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "local.set",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "local.tee",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x23) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "global.get",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x24) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "global.set",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x28) {
    const a = readUleb(pos);
    const o = readUleb(a.next);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "load",
      offset: o.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x36) {
    const a = readUleb(pos);
    const o = readUleb(a.next);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "store",
      offset: o.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x3a) {
    const a = readUleb(pos);
    const o = readUleb(a.next);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "store8",
      offset: o.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x3b) {
    const a = readUleb(pos);
    const o = readUleb(a.next);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "store16",
      offset: o.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x6a) {
    return { addr, kind: "add" };
  }

  if (op === 0x6b) {
    return { addr, kind: "sub" };
  }

  if (op === 0x45) {
    return { addr, kind: "eqz" };
  }

  if (op === 0x46) {
    return { addr, kind: "eq" };
  }

  if (op === 0x47) {
    return { addr, kind: "ne" };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "call",
      func: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0c) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "br",
      value: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0d) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "br_if",
      value: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x02) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "block",
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x03) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "loop",
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x04) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);

    return {
      addr,
      kind: "if",
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    return {
      addr,
      kind: "end",
    };
  }

  /*
   * Unknown instruction.
   *
   * We intentionally stop decoding this function at unknown
   * instructions to avoid producing false address proofs.
   */
  return {
    addr,
    kind: `unknown_${hex(op, 2)}`,
  };
}

function printInstruction(x: Ins) {
  let s = `${hex(x.addr)} ${x.kind}`;

  if (x.value !== undefined) {
    s += ` ${hex(x.value)}`;
  }

  if (x.index !== undefined) {
    s += ` index=${x.index}`;
  }

  if (x.offset !== undefined) {
    s += ` offset=${hex(x.offset)}`;
  }

  if (x.func !== undefined) {
    s += ` func=${x.func}`;
  }

  return s;
}

console.log("TRACE 0x19534C ALIAS WRITERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET = ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log("MODE   = CONST -> LOCAL -> STORE");
console.log("============================================================");

const bodies = codeBodies();

let totalCandidates = 0;

for (const body of bodies) {
  let p = body.start;
  const ins: Ins[] = [];

  while (p < body.end) {
    const x = decode(p);
    ins.push(x);

    /*
     * Recover instruction length from next decoded address.
     * For unknown opcodes we stop because the following position
     * cannot safely be inferred.
     */
    let next = p + 1;

    if (x.kind === "const") {
      const q = readSleb(p + 1);
      next = q.next;
    } else if (
      x.kind === "local.get" ||
      x.kind === "local.set" ||
      x.kind === "local.tee" ||
      x.kind === "global.get" ||
      x.kind === "global.set" ||
      x.kind === "call" ||
      x.kind === "br" ||
      x.kind === "br_if"
    ) {
      const q = readUleb(p + 1);
      next = q.next;
    } else if (
      x.kind === "load" ||
      x.kind === "store" ||
      x.kind === "store8" ||
      x.kind === "store16"
    ) {
      const a = readUleb(p + 1);
      const o = readUleb(a.next);
      next = o.next;
    } else if (
      x.kind === "block" ||
      x.kind === "loop" ||
      x.kind === "if"
    ) {
      const q = readSleb(p + 1);
      next = q.next;
    }

    if (x.kind.startsWith("unknown_")) {
      break;
    }

    p = next;
  }

  /*
   * Look for:
   *
   *   i32.const 0x19534C
   *   local.set N
   *
   * or
   *
   *   i32.const 0x19534C
   *   local.tee N
   *
   * and then a store using local.get N.
   */
  for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
    const a = ins[i];

    if (a.kind !== "const" || a.value !== TARGET) {
      continue;
    }

    let aliasLocal: number | undefined;
    let aliasAt = -1;

    if (
      i + 1 < ins.length &&
      (ins[i + 1].kind === "local.set" ||
        ins[i + 1].kind === "local.tee")
    ) {
      aliasLocal = ins[i + 1].index;
      aliasAt = i + 1;
    }

    /*
     * Direct address:
     *
     * const TARGET
     * store
     */
    if (
      i + 1 < ins.length &&
      (ins[i + 1].kind === "store" ||
        ins[i + 1].kind === "store8" ||
        ins[i + 1].kind === "store16")
    ) {
      console.log("");
      console.log("============================================================");
      console.log(
        `DIRECT WRITER CANDIDATE FUNC ${body.func} @ ${hex(a.addr)}`
      );
      console.log("============================================================");

      for (const x of ins.slice(i, i + 4)) {
        console.log(printInstruction(x));
      }

      totalCandidates++;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Alias through local.
     */
    if (aliasLocal !== undefined) {
      for (
        let j = aliasAt + 1;
        j < Math.min(aliasAt + 40, ins.length);
        j++
      ) {
        const x = ins[j];

        if (
          x.kind === "store" ||
          x.kind === "store8" ||
          x.kind === "store16"
        ) {
          /*
           * Check whether the store's address stack contains
           * local.get aliasLocal.
           *
           * We use a bounded backwards scan because full WASM
           * stack simulation is not necessary for this first pass.
           */
          let localUse = -1;

          for (
            let k = Math.max(aliasAt + 1, j - 8);
            k < j;
            k++
          ) {
            if (
              ins[k].kind === "local.get" &&
              ins[k].index === aliasLocal
            ) {
              localUse = k;
            }
          }

          if (localUse >= 0) {
            console.log("");
            console.log("============================================================");
            console.log(
              `ALIAS WRITER CANDIDATE FUNC ${body.func}`
            );
            console.log("============================================================");
            console.log(
              `TARGET CONST @ ${hex(a.addr)}`
            );
            console.log(
              `ALIAS LOCAL = ${aliasLocal}`
            );
            console.log(
              `LOCAL SET  @ ${hex(ins[aliasAt].addr)}`
            );
            console.log(
              `LOCAL USE  @ ${hex(ins[localUse].addr)}`
            );
            console.log(
              `STORE      @ ${hex(x.addr)}`
            );
            console.log(
              `STORE TYPE = ${x.kind}`
            );
            console.log(
              `STORE OFF  = ${hex(x.offset ?? 0)}`
            );
            console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

            for (
              let k = Math.max(i, localUse - 6);
              k <= Math.min(j, localUse + 4);
              k++
            ) {
              console.log(printInstruction(ins[k]));
            }

            totalCandidates++;
          }

          break;
        }

        /*
         * If another local.set to the same local occurs,
         * the old alias is no longer reliable.
         */
        if (
          x.kind === "local.set" &&
          x.index === aliasLocal
        ) {
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WRITER CANDIDATES = ${totalCandidates}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("IMPORTANT:");
console.log("Candidates are address-alias based, not WASM execution.");
console.log("Unknown opcodes are not interpreted.");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 0x19534c;
const IMPORTED = 83;

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function findCodeSection(): { start: number; end: number } {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const id = buf[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sizeInfo.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function decode(pos: number): { text: string; next: number } {
  const op = buf[pos++];

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00:
      return { text: "unreachable", next: pos };

    case 0x01:
      return { text: "nop", next: pos };

    case 0x02: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `block ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x03: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `loop ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x04:
      return { text: "if", next: pos };

    case 0x05:
      return { text: "else", next: pos };

    case 0x0b:
      return { text: "end", next: pos };

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `br ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `br_if ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x0e: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      let q = x.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < x.value; i++) {
        const y = readULEB(q);
        q = y.next;
      }

      const def = readULEB(q);

      return {
        text: `br_table ${x.value}`,
        next: def.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x0f:
      return { text: "return", next: pos };

    case 0x10: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `call ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      const y = readULEB(x.next);

      return {
        text: `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${y.value}`,
        next: y.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x1a:
      return { text: "drop", next: pos };

    case 0x20: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.get ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.set ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `local.tee ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `global.get ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { text: `global.set ${x.value}`, next: x.next };
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const o = readULEB(a.next);

      return {
        text: `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
        next: o.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x2c: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const o = readULEB(a.next);

      return {
        text: `i32.load8_s align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
        next: o.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x2d: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const o = readULEB(a.next);

      return {
        text: `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
        next: o.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const o = readULEB(a.next);

      return {
        text: `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
        next: o.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x37: {
      const a = readULEB(pos);
      const o = readULEB(a.next);

      return {
        text: `i64.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
        next: o.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x3f:
      return {
        text: "memory.size",
        next: pos + 1,
      };

    case 0x40:
      return {
        text: "memory.grow",
        next: pos + 1,
      };

    case 0x41: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);

      return {
        text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
        next: x.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);

      return {
        text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
        next: x.next,
      };
    }

    case 0x45:

    default:
      return {
        text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        next: pos,
      };
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const FUNCS = [
  { id: 91,   start: 0x00007c00, end: 0x00007d00 },
  { id: 113,  start: 0x0000d800, end: 0x0000d900 },
  { id: 119,  start: 0x0000ec00, end: 0x0000ee50 },
  { id: 122,  start: 0x0000ed00, end: 0x0000f000 },
  { id: 656,  start: 0x0002c000, end: 0x0002d000 },
  { id: 2057, start: 0x00093d00, end: 0x00095000 },
];

const TARGET = 0x0019534c;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let len = 0;

  while (pos + len < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos + len];
    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    len++;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: value >>> 0, len };

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("TRACE 0x19534C WRITERS / REFERENCES");

console.log(`VALUE  : 4788 (0x12b4)`);
console.log();

for (const f of FUNCS) {
  console.log("-".repeat(72));
  console.log(`FUNC ${f.id}`);
  console.log(`BODY RANGE : ${hex(f.start)} .. ${hex(f.end)}`);

  let found = false;

  for (let p = f.start; p < f.end; p++) {

    // i32.const
    if (b[p] === 0x41) {
      const r = readULEB(p + 1);

      if (r && r.value === TARGET) {
        found = true;

        console.log(
          `CONST TARGET @ ${hex(p)}`
        );

        const s = Math.max(f.start, p - 8);
        const e = Math.min(f.end, p + 24);

        console.log(
          "  " +
          Array.from(b.slice(s, e))
            .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
            .join(" ")
        );
      }
    }

    // i32.store
    if (b[p] === 0x36) {
      const align = b[p + 1];
      const r = readULEB(p + 2);

      if (!r) continue;

      // Show stores with small offsets.
      if (r.value <= 128) {
        const s = Math.max(f.start, p - 12);
        const e = Math.min(f.end, p + 12);

        console.log(
          `STORE @ ${hex(p)} ` +
          `align=${align} offset=${r.value}`
        );

        console.log(
          "  " +
          Array.from(b.slice(s, e))
            .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
            .join(" ")
        );
      }
    }

    // local.set / local.tee
    if (b[p] === 0x21 || b[p] === 0x22) {
      const op = b[p] === 0x21 ? "local.set" : "local.tee";
      const r = readULEB(p + 1);

      if (r) {
        console.log(
          `${op} @ ${hex(p)} local=${r.value}`
        );
      }
    }

    // call
    if (b[p] === 0x10) {
      const r = readULEB(p + 1);

      if (r) {
        console.log(
          `CALL @ ${hex(p)} FUNC=${r.value}`
        );
      }
    }
  }

  if (!found) {
    console.log("TARGET CONST : NONE");
  }

  console.log();
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v=0,s=0;
  while(true){
    const x=b[p++];
    v+=(x&127)*2**s;
    if(!(x&128)) return [v>>>0,p];
    s+=7;
  }
}

let p=8, code=0;

while(p<b.length){
  const id=b[p++];
  const [n,q]=u(p); p=q;
  if(id===10){ code=p; break; }
  p+=n;
}

p=code;
const [count,q0]=u(p); p=q0;

const TARGET=0x19534c;

for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  const [size,q]=u(p); p=q;

  const func=83+i;
  const start=p, end=p+size;

  for(let x=start;x<end;x++){
    if(b[x]!==0x41) continue;

    const [v,qv]=u(x+1);
    if(v!==TARGET) continue;

    console.log(`\nFUNC ${func} CONST 0x19534c @ 0x${x.toString(16)}`);

    console.log(
      [...b.subarray(Math.max(start,x-30),Math.min(end,x+50))]
      .map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join(" ")
    );

    // classify immediate next meaningful opcode
    let y=qv;
    while(y<end && b[y]===0x1a) y++;

    if(y<end){
      console.log(`NEXT OPCODE = 0x${b[y].toString(16)}`);
    }

    console.log("--------------------------------------------");
  }

  p=end;
}

function uleb(buf: Buffer, off: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const b = buf[off + i];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, size: i + 1 };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(off: number, n = 24) {
  return wasm.subarray(off, off + n).toString("hex");
}

 * bytes that could contribute to 0x19534C.
 *
 * We deliberately do NOT execute the WASM.
 */

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSections() {
    let p = 8;

    const sections: {
        id: number;
        start: number;
        end: number;
    }[] = [];

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const s = uleb(p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        sections.push({ id, start, end });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

    throw new Error("Missing function/code section");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = fc.next;

// ------------------------------------------------------------

    throw new Error("Function/code count mismatch");
}

    ordinal: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < cc.value; ordinal++) {

    const end = p + bs.value;

    functions.push({

    });

    p = end;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 0x0019534c;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32(p: number): number {
  return (
    (wasm[p] |
      (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
      (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
      (wasm[p + 3] << 24)) >>> 0
  );
}

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (-1 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[p++];
    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (sectionId === id) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
}

function findCodeBodies() {
  const sec = findSection(10);
  let p = sec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const bodies: { func: number; start: number; end: number }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    bodies.push({
      func: 83 + i,
      start,
      end,
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function decodeInstruction(pos: number) {
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);
    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "const",
      value: x.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  // i32.store
  if (op === 0x36) {
    const align = readUleb(pos);
    const off = readUleb(align.next);

    return {
      op,
      next: off.next,
      kind: "store",
      align: align.value,
      offset: off.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  // i32.store8
  if (op === 0x3a) {
    const align = readUleb(pos);
    const off = readUleb(align.next);

    return {
      op,
      next: off.next,
      kind: "store8",
      align: align.value,
      offset: off.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  // i32.store16
  if (op === 0x3b) {
    const align = readUleb(pos);
    const off = readUleb(align.next);

    return {
      op,
      next: off.next,
      kind: "store16",
      align: align.value,
      offset: off.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "local.get",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  // local.set
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "local.set",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  // local.tee
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "local.tee",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  // global.get
  if (op === 0x23) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "global.get",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  // global.set
  if (op === 0x24) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "global.set",
      index: x.value,
    };
  }

  // i32.add
  if (op === 0x6a) {
    return {
      op,
      next: pos,
      kind: "add",
    };
  }

  // i32.sub
  if (op === 0x6b) {
    return {
      op,
      next: pos,
      kind: "sub",
    };
  }

  // i32.load
  if (op === 0x28) {
    const align = readUleb(pos);
    const off = readUleb(align.next);

    return {
      op,
      next: off.next,
      kind: "load",
      align: align.value,
      offset: off.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  // i32.load8_u
  if (op === 0x2d) {
    const align = readUleb(pos);
    const off = readUleb(align.next);

    return {
      op,
      next: off.next,
      kind: "load8",
      align: align.value,
      offset: off.value >>> 0,
    };
  }

  // i32.eqz
  if (op === 0x45) {
    return { op, next: pos, kind: "eqz" };
  }

  // i32.eq
  if (op === 0x46) {
    return { op, next: pos, kind: "eq" };
  }

  // i32.ne
  if (op === 0x47) {
    return { op, next: pos, kind: "ne" };
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "call",
      func: x.value,
    };
  }

  // br
  if (op === 0x0c) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "br",
      depth: x.value,
    };
  }

  // br_if
  if (op === 0x0d) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);

    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: "br_if",
      depth: x.value,
    };
  }

  // block / loop / if
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);

    return {
      op,
      next: x.next,
      kind: op === 0x02 ? "block" : op === 0x03 ? "loop" : "if",
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    return { op, next: pos, kind: "end" };
  }

  return {
    op,
    next: pos,
    kind: "other",
  };
}

console.log("TRACE 0x19534C WRITERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET = ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log("SEARCH = STATIC ADDRESS PROOF");
console.log("============================================================");

const bodies = findCodeBodies();

let hits = 0;

for (const body of bodies) {
  let p = body.start;

  const insns: any[] = [];

  while (p < body.end) {
    const ins = decodeInstruction(p);
    ins.addr = p;
    insns.push(ins);

    if (ins.kind === "end" && p > body.start) {
      // Do not stop here: nested blocks/functions can contain ends.
    }

    p = ins.next;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
    const a = insns[i];

    /*
     * Direct pattern:
     *
     *   i32.const 0x19534C
     *   ...
     *   i32.store
     *
     * We first report the immediate store case.
     */
    if (a.kind !== "const" || a.value !== TARGET) continue;

    const nearby = insns.slice(i, Math.min(i + 12, insns.length));

    let storeIndex = -1;

    for (let j = 1; j < nearby.length; j++) {
      if (
        nearby[j].kind === "store" ||
        nearby[j].kind === "store8" ||
        nearby[j].kind === "store16"
      ) {
        storeIndex = j;
        break;
      }

      // Stop at another obvious address-producing call.
      if (
        nearby[j].kind === "call" ||
        nearby[j].kind === "block" ||
        nearby[j].kind === "loop" ||
        nearby[j].kind === "if"
      ) {
        // Keep scanning only a short distance.
      }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`FUNC ${body.func} | CONST @ ${hex(a.addr)}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    if (storeIndex >= 0) {
      const s = nearby[storeIndex];

      console.log(
        `DIRECT STORE CANDIDATE @ ${hex(s.addr)} ` +
        `kind=${s.kind} offset=${hex(s.offset, 8)}`
      );

      console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

      for (const x of nearby.slice(0, storeIndex + 1)) {
        let extra = "";

        if (x.kind === "const") {
          extra = ` value=${hex(x.value)}`;
        } else if (
          x.kind === "store" ||
          x.kind === "store8" ||
          x.kind === "store16"
        ) {
          extra = ` offset=${hex(x.offset)}`;
        } else if (x.kind === "call") {
          extra = ` func=${x.func}`;
        } else if (
          x.kind === "local.get" ||
          x.kind === "local.set" ||
          x.kind === "local.tee"
        ) {
          extra = ` index=${x.index}`;
        }

        console.log(`${hex(x.addr)} ${x.kind}${extra}`);
      }
    } else {
      console.log("NO NEARBY STORE CANDIDATE");
    }

    hits++;
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`CONST 0x19534C HITS = ${hits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("IMPORTANT:");
console.log("This pass proves only direct/static candidates.");
console.log("Computed aliases through locals/globals require a second pass.");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_ADDR = 0x195354;
const TARGET_VALUE = 4790;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32Leb(buf: Buffer, pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];

    value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error(`ULEB too large @ 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
    }
  }

  throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function readS32Leb(buf: Buffer, pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    b = buf[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (-1 << shift);
      }

      return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p,
      };
    }

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error(`SLEB too large @ 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
    }
  }

  throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionStart = p;
    const sid = wasm[p++];

    const s = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    const size = s.value;
    p = s.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + size;

    if (sid === id) {
      return {
        sectionStart,
        payloadStart,
        payloadEnd,
        size,
      };
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTIONS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const importSection = findSection(2);
const functionSection = findSection(3);
const codeSection = findSection(10);

console.log("TRACE 0x195354 / VALUE 4790");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET MEMORY ADDRESS = 0x${hex(TARGET_ADDR)}`);
console.log(`TARGET VALUE          = ${TARGET_VALUE}`);
console.log(`TARGET VALUE HEX      = 0x${TARGET_VALUE.toString(16)}`);
console.log();

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORT COUNT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = importSection.payloadStart;

let r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
const importCount = r.value;
p = r.next;

let importedFunctions = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {
  r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
  const moduleLen = r.value;
  p = r.next + moduleLen;

  r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
  const fieldLen = r.value;
  p = r.next + fieldLen;

  const kind = wasm[p++];

  if (kind === 0) {
    importedFunctions++;

    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = r.next;
  } else if (kind === 1) {
    p++;

    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = r.next;

    const flags = wasm[p - 1];

    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = r.next;

    if (flags & 1) {
      r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
      p = r.next;
    }
  } else if (kind === 2) {
    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    const flags = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
    p = r.next;

    if (flags & 1) {
      r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
      p = r.next;
    }
  } else if (kind === 3) {
    p += 2;
  }
}

console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${importedFunctions}`);
console.log();

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION TYPE INDICES
// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = functionSection.payloadStart;

r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
const definedCount = r.value;
p = r.next;

const typeIndices: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++) {
  r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
  typeIndices.push(r.value);
  p = r.next;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE BODIES
// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = codeSection.payloadStart;

r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);
const bodyCount = r.value;
p = r.next;

if (bodyCount !== definedCount) {
  throw new Error(`BODY COUNT mismatch`);
}

function printContext(
  body: Buffer,
  bodyStart: number,
  pos: number,
  radius = 24
) {
  const from = Math.max(0, pos - radius);
  const to = Math.min(body.length, pos + radius + 1);

  for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {
    const mark = i === pos ? " <-- TARGET" : "";

    console.log(
      `    +0x${i.toString(16).padStart(5, "0")} ` +
      `0x${hex(bodyStart + i)} ` +
      `${body[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}${mark}`
    );
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Scan
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let addressHits = 0;
let valueHits = 0;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < bodyCount; ordinal++) {
  r = readU32Leb(wasm, p);

  const bodySize = r.value;
  p = r.next;

  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

  const body = wasm.subarray(bodyStart, bodyEnd);

  const globalFunc = importedFunctions + ordinal;
  const typeIndex = typeIndices[ordinal];

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Scan for:
  //
  //   i32.const 0x195354
  //   i32.const 4790
  //
  // We intentionally do NOT decode the entire function.
  // ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
    const opcode = body[i];

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32.const = 0x41
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (opcode !== 0x41) continue;

    try {
      const s = readS32Leb(body, i + 1);

      if (s.value === TARGET_ADDR) {
        addressHits++;

        console.log();
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`MEMORY ADDRESS HIT #${addressHits}`);
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC   = ${globalFunc}`);
        console.log(`DEFINED ORD   = ${ordinal}`);
        console.log(`TYPE INDEX    = ${typeIndex}`);
        console.log(`ABS ADDRESS   = 0x${hex(bodyStart + i)}`);
        console.log(`CONST VALUE   = 0x${hex(TARGET_ADDR)}`);
        console.log();
        console.log("CONTEXT");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        printContext(body, bodyStart, i);
      }

      if (s.value === TARGET_VALUE) {
        valueHits++;

        console.log();
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`VALUE 4790 HIT #${valueHits}`);
        console.log("============================================================");
        console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC   = ${globalFunc}`);
        console.log(`DEFINED ORD   = ${ordinal}`);
        console.log(`TYPE INDEX    = ${typeIndex}`);
        console.log(`ABS ADDRESS   = 0x${hex(bodyStart + i)}`);
        console.log(`CONST VALUE   = ${s.value}`);
        console.log(`CONST HEX     = 0x${s.value.toString(16)}`);
        console.log();
        console.log("CONTEXT");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        printContext(body, bodyStart, i);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore malformed candidates.
    }
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`0x${hex(TARGET_ADDR)} CONST HITS = ${addressHits}`);
console.log(`4790 CONST HITS        = ${valueHits}`);
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const IMPORTS = 83;
const TARGETS = [91, 119, 656];

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v: number) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function section(id: number) {
  let p = 8;
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];
    const z = uleb(p);
    p = z.next;
    const start = p, end = p + z.value;
    if (sid === id) return { start, end };
    p = end;
  }
  throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
}

const fsx = section(3);
const csx = section(10);

let p = fsx.start;
const fc = uleb(p);
p = fc.next;

const types: number[] = [];
for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
  const x = uleb(p);
  types.push(x.value);
  p = x.next;
}

let cp = csx.start;
const cc = uleb(cp);
cp = cc.next;

const bodies = new Map<number, {
  start: number;
  end: number;
  type: number;
}>();

for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
  const z = uleb(cp);
  cp = z.next;

  const start = cp;
  const end = start + z.value;
  const func = IMPORTS + i;

  bodies.set(func, {
    start,
    end,
    type: types[i]
  });

  cp = end;
}

function dump(func: number) {
  const b = bodies.get(func);
  if (!b) return;

  console.log();
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC = ${func}`);
  console.log(`TYPE INDEX  = ${b.type}`);
  console.log(`BODY        = ${hex(b.start)} .. ${hex(b.end - 1)}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  for (let p = b.start; p < b.end; p++) {
    const op = wasm[p];

    // i32.const
    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);

      if (x.value === 0x195354 || x.value === 4790) {
        console.log(
          `${hex(p)}  i32.const ${x.value} (${hex(x.value)})`
        );
      }

      p = x.next - 1;
      continue;
    }

    // local.get
    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  local.get ${x.value}`);
      p = x.next - 1;
      continue;
    }

    // local.set
    if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  local.set ${x.value}`);
      p = x.next - 1;
      continue;
    }

    // local.tee
    if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  local.tee ${x.value}`);
      p = x.next - 1;
      continue;
    }

    // i32.load
    if (op === 0x28) {
      const a = uleb(p + 1);
      const o = uleb(a.next);

      console.log(
        `${hex(p)}  i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${hex(o.value)}`
      );

      p = o.next - 1;
      continue;
    }

    // i32.ne
    if (op === 0x47) {
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  i32.ne`);
      continue;
    }

    // if
    if (op === 0x04) {
      console.log(`${hex(p)}  if`);
      continue;
    }

    // call_indirect
    if (op === 0x11) {
      const t = uleb(p + 1);
      const table = uleb(t.next);

      console.log();
      console.log(`>>> CALL_INDIRECT @ ${hex(p)}`);
      console.log(`    TYPE  = ${t.value}`);
      console.log(`    TABLE = ${table.value}`);

      const from = Math.max(b.start, p - 24);

      console.log("    STACK-PRECEDING BYTES:");

      for (let q = from; q < p; q++) {
        console.log(
          `    ${hex(q)}  ${wasm[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
        );
      }

      console.log("<<< END CALL_INDIRECT");
      console.log();

      p = table.next - 1;
      continue;
    }
  }
}

console.log("TRACE 0x195354 DATAFLOW");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const f of TARGETS) dump(f);

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("READ ONLY - NO EXECUTION - NO TRANSACTION");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCS = [91, 119, 656];
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < bytes.length) {
    const b = bytes[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function readU32LE(pos: number) {
  return (
    bytes[pos] |
    (bytes[pos + 1] << 8) |
    (bytes[pos + 2] << 16) |
    (bytes[pos + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < bytes.length) {
    const sectionId = bytes[p++];

    const sizeInfo = uleb(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + size;

    if (sectionId === id) {
      return { start, end, size };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

const codeCount = codeCountInfo.value;
cp = codeCountInfo.next;

if (codeCount !== functionCount) {
  console.log(
    `WARNING: code count ${codeCount} != function count ${functionCount}`
  );
  console.log();
}

const bodies = new Map<number, {
  ordinal: number;
  typeIndex: number;
  bodyStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  bodySize: number;
}>();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < codeCount; ordinal++) {
  const sizeInfo = uleb(cp);
  const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
  cp = sizeInfo.next;

  const bodyStart = cp;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

  const globalFunc = IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + ordinal;

  bodies.set(globalFunc, {
    ordinal,
    typeIndex: typeIndices[ordinal] ?? -1,
    bodyStart,
    bodyEnd,
    bodySize,
  });

  cp = bodyEnd;
}

function dumpBody(globalFunc: number) {
  const body = bodies.get(globalFunc);

  if (!body) {
    console.log(`FUNC ${globalFunc}: BODY NOT FOUND`);
    return;
  }

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`GLOBAL FUNC   = ${globalFunc}`);
  console.log(`DEFINED ORD   = ${body.ordinal}`);
  console.log(`TYPE INDEX    = ${body.typeIndex}`);
  console.log(`BODY          = ${hex(body.bodyStart)} .. ${hex(body.bodyEnd - 1)}`);
  console.log(`SIZE          = ${body.bodySize}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  //
  // Search for:
  //   i32.const 0x195354
  //   i32.const 4790
  //   call_indirect (0x11)
  //
  const data = bytes.subarray(body.bodyStart, body.bodyEnd);

  const hits195354: number[] = [];
  const hits4790: number[] = [];
  const indirects: { abs: number; typeIndex: number; tableIndex: number }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    const abs = body.bodyStart + i;

    if (data[i] === 0x41) {
      try {
        const x = uleb(abs + 1);

        if (x.value === 0x195354) {
          hits195354.push(abs);
        }

        if (x.value === 4790) {
          hits4790.push(abs);
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    if (data[i] === 0x11) {
      try {
        const typeInfo = uleb(abs + 1);
        const tableInfo = uleb(typeInfo.next);

        indirects.push({
          abs,
          typeIndex: typeInfo.value,
          tableIndex: tableInfo.value,
        });
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("CONST 0x195354 HITS");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (const h of hits195354) {
    console.log(`${hex(h)}  i32.const 0x195354`);
  }

  if (!hits195354.length) {
    console.log("NONE");
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("CONST 4790 HITS");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (const h of hits4790) {
    console.log(`${hex(h)}  i32.const 4790 (0x12b6)`);
  }

  if (!hits4790.length) {
    console.log("NONE");
  }

  console.log();
  console.log("CALL_INDIRECT HITS");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (const c of indirects) {
    console.log(
      `${hex(c.abs)}  call_indirect type=${c.typeIndex} table=${c.tableIndex}`
    );
  }

  if (!indirects.length) {
    console.log("NONE");
  }

  //
  // Dump a compact byte window around each relevant constant.
  //
  const interesting = [
    ...hits195354.map(x => ({ pos: x, label: "ADDR" })),
    ...hits4790.map(x => ({ pos: x, label: "VALUE" })),
    ...indirects.map(x => ({ pos: x.abs, label: "CALL_INDIRECT" })),
  ];

  console.log();
  console.log("RAW WINDOWS");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (const item of interesting) {
    const from = Math.max(body.bodyStart, item.pos - 12);
    const to = Math.min(body.bodyEnd, item.pos + 32);

    console.log();
    console.log(`${item.label} @ ${hex(item.pos)}`);

    for (let q = from; q < to; q++) {
      const mark = q === item.pos ? " <--" : "";
      console.log(
        `${hex(q)}  ${bytes[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}${mark}`
      );
    }
  }
}

for (const f of TARGET_FUNCS) {
  dumpBody(f);
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("READ ONLY - NO EXECUTION - NO TRANSACTION");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

function s32(v) {
  return v >>> 0;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16);
}

let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0, codeEnd = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const [n, q] = u(p);
  p = q;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = p;
    codeEnd = p + n;
    break;
  }

  p += n;
}

p = codeStart;
const [count, q0] = u(p);
p = q0;

const targets = new Set([3328, 3331, 3332]);

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  const [size, q] = u(p);
  p = q;

  const func = 83 + i;
  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  if (!targets.has(func)) {
    p = end;
    continue;
  }

  console.log("\n============================================================");
  console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  const locals = new Map();
  const stack = [];

  function L(n) {
    return locals.get(n) ?? `L${n}`;
  }

  function push(x) {
    stack.push(x);
  }

  function pop() {
    return stack.length ? stack.pop() : "?";
  }

  let x = start;

  while (x < end) {
    const op = b[x];
    const at = x;

    // local.get
    if (op === 0x20) {
      const [n, q2] = u(x + 1);
      x = q2;
      push(L(n));
      continue;
    }

    // local.set
    if (op === 0x21) {
      const [n, q2] = u(x + 1);
      x = q2;
      locals.set(n, pop());
      continue;
    }

    // local.tee
    if (op === 0x22) {
      const [n, q2] = u(x + 1);
      x = q2;
      const v = stack.length ? stack[stack.length - 1] : "?";
      locals.set(n, v);
      continue;
    }

    // global.get
    if (op === 0x23) {
      const [n, q2] = u(x + 1);
      x = q2;
      push(`G${n}`);
      continue;
    }

    // i32.const
    if (op === 0x41) {
      const [v, q2] = u(x + 1);
      x = q2;
      push(hex(v));
      continue;
    }

    // i32.add
    if (op === 0x6a) {
      x++;
      const b1 = pop();
      const a1 = pop();
      push(`(${a1}+${b1})`);
      continue;
    }

    // i32.sub
    if (op === 0x6b) {
      x++;
      const b1 = pop();
      const a1 = pop();
      push(`(${a1}-${b1})`);
      continue;
    }

    // i32.shl
    if (op === 0x74) {
      x++;
      const b1 = pop();
      const a1 = pop();
      push(`(${a1}<<${b1})`);
      continue;
    }

    // i32.load
    if (op === 0x28) {
      const [align, q2] = u(x + 1);
      const [off, q3] = u(q2);
      x = q3;

      const base = pop();
      push(`MEM[${base}+${hex(off)}]`);
      continue;
    }

    // i32.store
    if (op === 0x36) {
      const [align, q2] = u(x + 1);
      const [off, q3] = u(q2);
      x = q3;

      const value = pop();
      const addr = pop();

      // stack representation is normally value then address,
      // but print both so we can inspect the exact state.
      if (at > start && at < end) {
        console.log(
          `STORE @ 0x${at.toString(16)} ` +
          `ADDR=${addr} VALUE=${value} OFFSET=${off}`
        );
      }
      continue;
    }

    // direct call
    if (op === 0x10) {
      const [callee, q2] = u(x + 1);
      x = q2;

      if (callee === 2057) {
        const arg1 = pop();
        const arg0 = pop();

        console.log("");
        console.log(`CALL2057 @ 0x${at.toString(16)}`);
        console.log(`ARG0 = ${arg0}`);
        console.log(`ARG1 = ${arg1}`);

        if (arg1.includes("19534c"))
          console.log(">>> POSSIBLE 0x19534C PATH <<<");

        console.log("--------------------------------------------");
      } else {
        // Unknown return value: preserve symbolic call result.
        push(`CALL${callee}(...)`);
      }

      continue;
    }

    // i32.eqz
    if (op === 0x45) {
      x++;
      const a1 = pop();
      push(`eqz(${a1})`);
      continue;
    }

    // Drop
    if (op === 0x1a) {
      x++;
      pop();
      continue;
    }

    // Everything else: advance conservatively.
    if (op === 0xfc) {
      const [, q2] = u(x + 1);
      x = q2;
      continue;
    }

    x++;
  }

  p = end;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 2057;
const IMPORTS = 83;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

let p = 8;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FIND ALL CALLERS OF FUNC 2057");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET FUNC : ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let total = 0;

while (p < buf.length) {

  const sectionId = buf[p++];

  const si = readU32(p);
  p = si.next;

  const sectionEnd = p + si.value;

  if (sectionId !== 10) {
    p = sectionEnd;
    continue;
  }

  const ci = readU32(p);
  const bodyCount = ci.value;
  p = ci.next;

  for (let body = 0; body < bodyCount; body++) {

    const bi = readU32(p);
    const bodySize = bi.value;
    p = bi.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

    const li = readU32(p);
    const localDecls = li.value;
    p = li.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localDecls; i++) {
      p = readU32(p).next;
      p++;
    }

    const codeStart = p;

    for (let q = codeStart; q < bodyEnd; q++) {

      if (buf[q] !== 0x10)
        continue;

      const call = readU32(q + 1);

      if (call.value !== TARGET_FUNC)
        continue;

      total++;

      const realFunc = body + IMPORTS;

      console.log("");
      console.log("############################################################");
      console.log(`CALLER #${total}`);
      console.log("############################################################");
      console.log(`CALLER FUNC : ${realFunc}`);
      console.log(`BODY INDEX  : ${body}`);
      console.log(`BODY START  : ${hex(bodyStart)}`);
      console.log(`CALL OFFSET : ${hex(q)}`);
      console.log(`TARGET      : FUNC ${call.value}`);
      console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

      const from = Math.max(codeStart, q - 80);
      const to = Math.min(bodyEnd, q + 100);

      for (let x = from; x < to; x += 16) {

        const e = Math.min(to, x + 16);
        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let k = x; k < e; k++)
          bytes.push(buf[k].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));

        console.log(`${hex(x)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`);
      }
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  p = sectionEnd;
}
