import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCS = new Set<number>();

for (let i = 4057; i <= 4188; i++) {
    TARGET_FUNCS.add(i);
}

const TARGET_TABLE_VALUES = new Set<number>([
    0x91,
    0x93,
    0x94,
    0x95,
    0x96,
    0x97,
    0x98,
    0x99,
    0xfd9,
    0xfda,
]);

function readU32LE(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    return (
        buf[p] |
        (buf[p + 1] << 8) |
        (buf[p + 2] << 16) |
        (buf[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
        }
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {
    const sections: {
        id: number;
        start: number;
        payloadStart: number;
        payloadEnd: number;
    }[] = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const size = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = size.next;

        const payloadStart = p;
        const payloadEnd = p + size.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start: payloadStart,
            payloadStart,
            payloadEnd,
        });

        p = payloadEnd;
    }

    return sections;
}

function getSection(
    sections: ReturnType<typeof parseSections>,
    id: number
) {
    return sections.find((s) => s.id === id);
}

/*
 * Parse Element Section (id=9)
 *
 * We are interested in active element segments containing
 * function indexes. We intentionally keep this parser conservative.
 */
function parseElements(buf: Buffer, sec: any) {
    const results: {
        segment: number;
        mode: string;
        tableIndex: number;
        offset?: number;
        functions: number[];
    }[] = [];

    let p = sec.payloadStart;

    const count = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = count.next;

    for (let seg = 0; seg < count.value; seg++) {
        const flags = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = flags.next;

        let tableIndex = 0;
        let offset: number | undefined;

        /*
         * MVP active segment:
         * flags 0:
         *   offset expr
         *   elemkind
         *   vec(funcidx)
         *
         * flags 2:
         *   tableidx
         *   offset expr
         *   elemkind
         *   vec(funcidx)
         */

        if (flags.value === 0) {
            // offset expression
            if (buf[p] !== 0x41) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unexpected offset opcode at element ${seg}: ${hex(
                        buf[p]
                    )}`
                );
            }

            p++;

            const off = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = off.next;
            offset = off.value;

            if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error("Bad element offset end");
            }

            // elemkind
            p++;
        } else if (flags.value === 2) {
            const ti = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = ti.next;
            tableIndex = ti.value;

            if (buf[p] !== 0x41) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unexpected offset opcode at element ${seg}: ${hex(
                        buf[p]
                    )}`
                );
            }

            p++;

            const off = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = off.next;
            offset = off.value;

            if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error("Bad element offset end");
            }

            p++;
        } else {
            /*
             * Other element modes are intentionally skipped using
             * a conservative error rather than guessing.
             */
            throw new Error(
                `Unsupported element flags=${flags.value} segment=${seg}`
            );
        }

        const n = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = n.next;

        const functions: number[] = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
            const f = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = f.next;
            functions.push(f.value);
        }

        results.push({
            segment: seg,
            mode: flags.value === 0 ? "active" : "active-table",
            tableIndex,
            offset,
            functions,
        });
    }

    return results;
}

/*
 * Parse code section and locate REAL instructions.
 *
 * We do not scan raw bytes for 0x11.
 * We walk the instruction stream and recognize:
 *
 *   0x11 call_indirect
 *
 * Then decode its type index and table index.
 *
 * This is still a focused decoder. Unknown instructions are skipped
 * conservatively according to their immediate formats.
 */

function skipULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    return readULEB(buf, p).next;
}

function skipSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) return p;
    }
}

function skipMemArg(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    p = skipULEB(buf, p); // align
    p = skipULEB(buf, p); // offset
    return p;
}

function skipInstruction(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    const op = buf[p++];

    switch (op) {
        case 0x00: // unreachable
        case 0x01: // nop
        case 0x05: // else
        case 0x0b: // end
        case 0x0f: // return
        case 0x1a: // drop
        case 0x1b: // select
            return p;

        case 0x02: // block
        case 0x03: // loop
        case 0x04: // if
            return p + 1;

        case 0x0c: // br
        case 0x0d: // br_if
        case 0x10: // call
        case 0x11: // call_indirect -- handled below
        case 0x20: // local.get
        case 0x21: // local.set
        case 0x22: // local.tee
        case 0x23: // global.get
        case 0x24: // global.set
        case 0xd2: // ref.func
            return skipULEB(buf, p);

        case 0x0e: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < x.value; i++) {
                p = skipULEB(buf, p);
            }

            return skipULEB(buf, p);
        }

        case 0x41: // i32.const
            return skipSLEB(buf, p);

        case 0x42: // i64.const
            return skipSLEB(buf, p);

        case 0x43: // f32.const
            return p + 4;

        case 0x44: // f64.const
            return p + 8;

        case 0x28: // i32.load
        case 0x29:
        case 0x2a:
        case 0x2b:
        case 0x2c:
        case 0x2d:
        case 0x2e:
        case 0x2f:
        case 0x30:
        case 0x31:
        case 0x32:
        case 0x33:
        case 0x34:
        case 0x35:
        case 0x36:
        case 0x37:
        case 0x38:
        case 0x39:
        case 0x3a:
        case 0x3b:
        case 0x3c:
        case 0x3d:
        case 0x3e:
            return skipMemArg(buf, p);

        case 0x3f: // memory.size
        case 0x40: // memory.grow
            return p + 1;

        default:
            /*
             * Most numeric/simple opcodes have no immediates.
             * Prefix instructions need special handling.
             */
            if (op === 0xfc) {
                const sub = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = sub.next;

                switch (sub.value) {
                    case 8:  // memory.init
                        p = skipULEB(buf, p);
                        return p;

                    case 9:  // data.drop
                    case 13: // elem.drop
                        return skipULEB(buf, p);

                    case 10: // memory.copy
                        return p + 2;

                    case 12: // table.init
                        p = skipULEB(buf, p);
                        p = skipULEB(buf, p);
                        return p;

                    case 14: // table.copy
                        return p + 2;

                    case 15: // table.grow
                    case 16: // table.size
                    case 17: // table.fill
                        return p + (sub.value === 17 ? 1 : 1);

                    default:
                        return p;
                }
            }

            if (op === 0xfd) {
                const sub = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = sub.next;

                /*
                 * SIMD instructions are numerous. For this pass,
                 * don't guess their lengths. Returning the current
                 * position is unsafe, so abort the function parser.
                 */
                throw new Error(
                    `SIMD opcode encountered: ${hex(sub.value)}`
                );
            }

            return p;
    }
}

function decodeCallIndirect(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    let p = start;
    const hits: {
        offset: number;
        typeIndex: number;
        tableIndex: number;
    }[] = [];

    while (p < end) {
        const at = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        if (op === 0x11) {
            const type = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = type.next;

            const table = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = table.next;

            hits.push({
                offset: at,
                typeIndex: type.value,
                tableIndex: table.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0xfd) {
            /*
             * Stop rather than risking desynchronization.
             */
            break;
        }

        /*
         * Rewind and use generic instruction skipper.
         */
        p = at;

        try {
            p = skipInstruction(buf, p);
        } catch {
            break;
        }

        if (p <= at || p > end) break;
    }

    return hits;
}

export async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" 2101 → SEGMENT 413 → CALL_INDIRECT TRACE");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log("");
    console.log("WASM size :", buf.length.toLocaleString());

    const sections = parseSections(buf);

    const elementSec = getSection(sections, 9);
    const codeSec = getSection(sections, 10);
    const functionSec = getSection(sections, 3);

    if (!elementSec || !codeSec || !functionSec) {
        throw new Error("Required WASM sections missing");
    }

    console.log("Element section :", elementSec.payloadStart.toString(16));
    console.log("Code section    :", codeSec.payloadStart.toString(16));

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" ELEMENT / TABLE MAP");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const elements = parseElements(buf, elementSec);

    let candidateElementHits = 0;

    for (const e of elements) {
        const matched: {
            tableIndex: number;
            functionIndex: number;
        }[] = [];

        if (e.offset !== undefined) {
            for (let i = 0; i < e.functions.length; i++) {
                const tableIndex = e.offset + i;
                const fn = e.functions[i];

                if (
                    TARGET_TABLE_VALUES.has(tableIndex) ||
                    TARGET_FUNCS.has(fn)
                ) {
                    matched.push({
                        tableIndex,
                        functionIndex: fn,
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        if (matched.length > 0) {
            candidateElementHits++;

            console.log("");
            console.log(
                `ELEMENT ${e.segment} table=${e.tableIndex} offset=${e.offset}`
            );

            for (const m of matched) {
                console.log(
                    `  table[${m.tableIndex}] -> function ${m.functionIndex}`
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "Candidate element segments :",
        candidateElementHits
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" CALL_INDIRECT SCAN");
    console.log("============================================================");

    /*
     * Parse code bodies.
     *
     * Function section gives type indexes for defined functions.
     * Code bodies start after the body vector count.
     */

    let cp = codeSec.payloadStart;

    const bodyCount = readULEB(buf, cp);
    cp = bodyCount.next;

    console.log("Code bodies :", bodyCount.value);

    let totalIndirect = 0;
    let targetIndirect = 0;

    for (let body = 0; body < bodyCount.value; body++) {
        const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, cp);
        cp = sizeInfo.next;

        const bodyStart = cp;
        const bodyEnd = cp + sizeInfo.value;

        const localCountInfo = readULEB(buf, cp);
        cp = localCountInfo.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < localCountInfo.value; i++) {
            cp = skipULEB(buf, cp); // count
            cp += 1;                // value type
        }

        const instructionStart = cp;
        const hits = decodeCallIndirect(
            buf,
            instructionStart,
            bodyEnd
        );

        for (const h of hits) {
            totalIndirect++;

            /*
             * We are interested in:
             *   - table indexes seen in Segment 413
             *   - function indexes reached by known element mappings
             */
            let mappedFunction: number | undefined;

            for (const e of elements) {
                if (e.offset === undefined) continue;

                const idx = h.tableIndex - e.offset;

                if (
                    idx >= 0 &&
                    idx < e.functions.length
                ) {
                    mappedFunction = e.functions[idx];
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (
                TARGET_TABLE_VALUES.has(h.tableIndex) ||
                (
                    mappedFunction !== undefined &&
                    TARGET_FUNCS.has(mappedFunction)
                )
            ) {
                targetIndirect++;

                const functionIndex =
                    83 + body;

                console.log("");
                console.log(
                    `MATCH caller=${functionIndex}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  caller code : ${hex(instructionStart)}..${hex(
                        bodyEnd
                    )}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  call_indirect @ ${hex(h.offset)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  type index   : ${h.typeIndex}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  table index  : ${h.tableIndex}`
                );

                if (mappedFunction !== undefined) {
                    console.log(
                        `  table target : function ${mappedFunction}`
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        cp = bodyEnd;
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SUMMARY");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(
        "Element segments           :",
        elements.length
    );
    console.log(
        "Total call_indirect        :",
        totalIndirect
    );
    console.log(
        "Relevant indirect matches  :",
        targetIndirect
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("Focus:");
    console.log("  2101 → 0x0018f0d8 → Segment 413");
    console.log("  Segment 413 values: 0x91, 0x93..0x99, 0xfd9, 0xfda");
    console.log("============================================================");
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const SEG412_START = 0x0018744c;
const SEG412_END   = 0x0018ab8c;

const SEG413_START = 0x0018ab98;
const SEG413_END   = 0x0018f511;

const SEG413_FILE_START = 0x004a9de0;

const ROOT = 0x0018f0d8;

function hex(v: number): string {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function runtimeToFile(addr: number): number | null {
    if (addr >= SEG412_START && addr <= SEG412_END) {
        return 0x004a6695 + (addr - SEG412_START);
    }

    if (addr >= SEG413_START && addr <= SEG413_END) {
        return SEG413_FILE_START + (addr - SEG413_START);
    }

    return null;
}

function readU32File(file: number): number {
    return wasm.readUInt32LE(file);
}

function classify(v: number): string {
    if (v === 0)
        return "ZERO";

    if (v >= SEG412_START && v <= SEG412_END)
        return "SEG412_PTR";

    if (v >= SEG413_START && v <= SEG413_END)
        return "SEG413_PTR";

    if (v < 0x10000)
        return "INDEX";

    return "VALUE";
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET = 248;

function readULEB(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

function skipBlockType(pos) {
    const b = wasm[pos];

    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c ||
        b === 0x7b ||
        b === 0x70 ||
        b === 0x6f
    ) {
        return pos + 1;
    }

    return readSLEB(pos).next;
}

function memArg(pos) {
    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: o.value,
        next: o.next
    };
}

function decode(body) {

    const out = [];

    let p = body.start;

    while (p < body.end) {

        const at = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text = "";

        try {

            switch (op) {

                case 0x02:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "block";
                    break;

                case 0x03:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "loop";
                    break;

                case 0x04:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "if";
                    break;

                case 0x05:
                    text = "else";
                    break;

                case 0x0b:
                    text = "end";
                    break;

                case 0x0c: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `br ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0d: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0e: {
                    const n = readULEB(p);
                    p = n.next;

                    const labels = [];

                    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                        const r = readULEB(p);
                        p = r.next;
                        labels.push(r.value);
                    }

                    const d = readULEB(p);
                    p = d.next;

                    text =
                        `br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${d.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x0f:
                    text = "return";
                    break;

                case 0x10: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `call ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x11: {
                    const t = readULEB(p);
                    p = t.next;

                    const table = readULEB(p);
                    p = table.next;

                    text =
                        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x1a:
                    text = "drop";
                    break;

                case 0x1b:
                    text = "select";
                    break;

                case 0x20: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x21: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x22: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x23: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x24: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x28:
                case 0x29:
                case 0x2a:
                case 0x2b:
                case 0x2c:
                case 0x2d:
                case 0x2e:
                case 0x2f:
                case 0x30:
                case 0x31:
                case 0x32:
                case 0x33:
                case 0x34:
                case 0x35:
                case 0x36:
                case 0x37:
                case 0x38:
                case 0x39:
                case 0x3a:
                case 0x3b:
                case 0x3c:
                case 0x3d:
                case 0x3e: {

                    const m = memArg(p);
                    p = m.next;

                    const names = {
                        0x28: "i32.load",
                        0x29: "i64.load",
                        0x2a: "f32.load",
                        0x2b: "f64.load",
                        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
                        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
                        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
                        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
                        0x30: "i64.load8_s",
                        0x31: "i64.load8_u",
                        0x32: "i64.load16_s",
                        0x33: "i64.load16_u",
                        0x34: "i64.load32_s",
                        0x35: "i64.load32_u",
                        0x36: "i32.store",
                        0x37: "i64.store",
                        0x38: "f32.store",
                        0x39: "f64.store",
                        0x3a: "i32.store8",
                        0x3b: "i32.store16",
                        0x3c: "i64.store8",
                        0x3d: "i64.store16",
                        0x3e: "i64.store32"
                    };

                    text =
                        `${names[op]} align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x41: {
                    const r = readSLEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x42: {
                    const r = readSLEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                default:

                    text =
                        `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

                    break;
            }

        } catch {

            text = "DECODE ERROR";
        }

        out.push({
            pos: at,
            op,
            text
        });
    }

    return out;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE FUNC 248 DISPATCH OBJECT");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

const TARGET_FUNC = 248;
const TARGET_OFFSET = 4;
const CALL446 = 446;

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return null;
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (~0 << (shift + 7));
            }

            return {
                value: value | 0,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return null;
}

function hx(v) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readCodeSection() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const s = readULEB(p);
        if (!s) break;

        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = start + s.value;

        if (id === 10) {
            return {
                start,
                end
            };
        }

        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

const code = readCodeSection();

let p = code.start;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
p = countInfo.next;

const functionCount = countInfo.value;

const functions = [];

for (let func = 0; func < functionCount; func++) {

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    if (!sizeInfo) break;

    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

    functions.push({
        func,
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("FUNCTION COUNT :", functions.length);

/*
 * Decode a compact instruction stream.
 *
 * We are primarily interested in:
 *
 *   local.get
 *   local.set
 *   local.tee
 *   i32.const
 *   i32.load
 *   i32.store
 *   i32.add
 *   call
 *
 * The output is intentionally local around CALL 248.
 */

function decodeFunction(fn) {

    let p = fn.bodyStart;

    const locals = [];

    const localGroup = readULEB(p);
    if (!localGroup) return null;

    p = localGroup.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localGroup.value; i++) {

        const n = readULEB(p);
        if (!n) return null;

        p = n.next;

        const type = buf[p++];

        for (let j = 0; j < n.value; j++) {
            locals.push({
                type,
                kind: "local"
            });
        }
    }

    const instructions = [];

    while (p < fn.bodyEnd) {

        const pos = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        let ins = {
            pos,
            op,
            text: ""
        };

        /*
         * local.get
         */
        if (op === 0x20) {

            const r = readULEB(p);
            if (!r) break;

            p = r.next;

            ins.local = r.value;
            ins.text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
        }

        /*
         * local.set
         */
        else if (op === 0x21) {

            const r = readULEB(p);
            if (!r) break;

            p = r.next;

            ins.local = r.value;
            ins.text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
        }

        /*
         * local.tee
         */
        else if (op === 0x22) {

            const r = readULEB(p);
            if (!r) break;

            p = r.next;

            ins.local = r.value;
            ins.text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
        }

        /*
         * i32.const
         */
        else if (op === 0x41) {

            const r = readSLEB(p);
            if (!r) break;

            p = r.next;

            ins.value = r.value;
            ins.text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
        }

        /*
         * call
         */
        else if (op === 0x10) {

            const r = readULEB(p);
            if (!r) break;

            p = r.next;

            ins.target = r.value;
            ins.text = `call ${r.value}`;
        }

        /*
         * call_indirect
         */
        else if (op === 0x11) {

            const a = readULEB(p);
            if (!a) break;

            p = a.next;

            const b = readULEB(p);
            if (!b) break;

            p = b.next;

            ins.type = a.value;
            ins.table = b.value;
            ins.text =
                `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;
        }

        /*
         * i32.load / load8 / etc.
         */
        else if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) {

            const align = readULEB(p);
            if (!align) break;

            p = align.next;

            const off = readULEB(p);
            if (!off) break;

            p = off.next;

            ins.offset = off.value;
            ins.align = align.value;

            ins.text =
                `memory.load offset=${off.value}`;
        }

        /*
         * i32.store / store8 etc.
         */
        else if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {

            const align = readULEB(p);
            if (!align) break;

            p = align.next;

            const off = readULEB(p);
            if (!off) break;

            p = off.next;

            ins.offset = off.value;
            ins.align = align.value;

            ins.text =
                `memory.store offset=${off.value}`;
        }

        /*
         * i32.add
         */
        else if (op === 0x6a) {
            ins.text = "i32.add";
        }

        /*
         * i32.sub
         */
        else if (op === 0x6b) {
            ins.text = "i32.sub";
        }

        /*
         * i32.const-related / comparison / misc:
         * keep opcode but don't attempt full decode.
         */
        else {
            ins.text = `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
        }

        instructions.push(ins);
    }

    return instructions;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_CALL = 248;

const CALLERS = [
  1795,
  2717,
  3015,
  4725
];

function uleb(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: result, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        result |= (~0 << shift);

      return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function decode(pos, end) {

  const start = pos;

  if (pos >= end)
    return null;

  const op = buf[pos++];

  const ins = {
    start,
    end: pos,
    op,
    text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
  };

  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {

    const a = uleb(pos);

    if (!a)
      return null;

    ins.end = a.next;

    const name =
      op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
      op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
      "local.tee";

    ins.local = a.value;
    ins.text = `${name} local=${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {

    const a = sleb(pos);

    if (!a)
      return null;

    ins.end = a.next;
    ins.value = a.value;
    ins.text = `i32.const ${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {

    const a = uleb(pos);

    if (!a)
      return null;

    ins.end = a.next;
    ins.callTarget = a.value;
    ins.text = `call ${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {

    const a = uleb(pos);

    if (!a)
      return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);

    if (!b)
      return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.text =
      `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x28 ||
      op === 0x29 ||
      op === 0x2d) {

    const a = uleb(pos);

    if (!a)
      return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);

    if (!b)
      return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.isLoad = true;

    const name =
      op === 0x28 ? "i32.load" :
      op === 0x29 ? "i64.load" :
      "i32.load8_u";

    ins.text =
      `${name} align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x36) {

    const a = uleb(pos);

    if (!a)
      return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);

    if (!b)
      return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.isStore = true;

    ins.text =
      `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x6a) {
    ins.text = "i32.add";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x6b) {
    ins.text = "i32.sub";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x45) {
    ins.text = "i32.eqz";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x46) {
    ins.text = "i32.eq";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x47) {
    ins.text = "i32.ne";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    ins.text = "end";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x05) {
    ins.text = "else";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

    const a = uleb(pos);

    if (!a)
      return null;

    ins.end = a.next;

    ins.text =
      `${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"} ${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04) {

    if (pos >= end)
      return null;

    const bt = buf[pos++];

    ins.end = pos;

    ins.text =
      op === 0x02 ? "block" :
      op === 0x03 ? "loop" :
      "if";

    return ins;
  }

  return ins;
}

 * Locate code section.

let p = 8;

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGETS = {
    1795: [
        { addr: 0x0008671f, local: 2 },
        { addr: 0x00086758, local: 8 },
        { addr: 0x0008677e, local: 8 }
    ],

    2717: [
        { addr: 0x000db217, local: 1 },
        { addr: 0x000db226, local: 1 },
        { addr: 0x000db23c, local: 1 },
        { addr: 0x000db253, local: 1 },
        { addr: 0x000db26a, local: 1 },
        { addr: 0x000db29a, local: 1 }
    ],

    3015: [
        { addr: 0x000f0862, local: 13 },
        { addr: 0x000f08a8, local: 13 },
        { addr: 0x000f0a8f, local: 13 }
    ],

    4725: [
        { addr: 0x001eb215, local: 0 }
    ]
};

function readULEB(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

function skipBlockType(pos) {
    const b = wasm[pos];

    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c ||
        b === 0x7b ||
        b === 0x70 ||
        b === 0x6f
    ) {
        return pos + 1;
    }

    return readSLEB(pos).next;
}

function memArg(pos) {
    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: o.value,
        next: o.next
    };
}

function decode(body) {

    const out = [];

    let p = body.start;

    while (p < body.end) {

        const at = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text = "";

        try {

            switch (op) {

                case 0x02:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "block";
                    break;

                case 0x03:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "loop";
                    break;

                case 0x04:
                    p = skipBlockType(p);
                    text = "if";
                    break;

                case 0x05:
                    text = "else";
                    break;

                case 0x0b:
                    text = "end";
                    break;

                case 0x0c: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `br ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0d: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0e: {
                    const n = readULEB(p);
                    p = n.next;

                    const labels = [];

                    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                        const r = readULEB(p);
                        p = r.next;
                        labels.push(r.value);
                    }

                    const d = readULEB(p);
                    p = d.next;

                    text =
                        `br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${d.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x0f:
                    text = "return";
                    break;

                case 0x10: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `call ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x11: {
                    const t = readULEB(p);
                    p = t.next;

                    const table = readULEB(p);
                    p = table.next;

                    text =
                        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x1a:
                    text = "drop";
                    break;

                case 0x1b:
                    text = "select";
                    break;

                case 0x20: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x21: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x22: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x23: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x24: {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x28:
                case 0x29:
                case 0x2a:
                case 0x2b:
                case 0x2c:
                case 0x2d:
                case 0x2e:
                case 0x2f:
                case 0x30:
                case 0x31:
                case 0x32:
                case 0x33:
                case 0x34:
                case 0x35:
                case 0x36:
                case 0x37:
                case 0x38:
                case 0x39:
                case 0x3a:
                case 0x3b:
                case 0x3c:
                case 0x3d:
                case 0x3e: {

                    const m = memArg(p);
                    p = m.next;

                    const names = {
                        0x28: "i32.load",
                        0x29: "i64.load",
                        0x2a: "f32.load",
                        0x2b: "f64.load",
                        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
                        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
                        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
                        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
                        0x30: "i64.load8_s",
                        0x31: "i64.load8_u",
                        0x32: "i64.load16_s",
                        0x33: "i64.load16_u",
                        0x34: "i64.load32_s",
                        0x35: "i64.load32_u",
                        0x36: "i32.store",
                        0x37: "i64.store",
                        0x38: "f32.store",
                        0x39: "f64.store",
                        0x3a: "i32.store8",
                        0x3b: "i32.store16",
                        0x3c: "i64.store8",
                        0x3d: "i64.store16",
                        0x3e: "i64.store32"
                    };

                    text =
                        `${names[op]} align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;

                    break;
                }

                case 0x41: {
                    const r = readSLEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                case 0x42: {
                    const r = readSLEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
                    break;
                }

                default:
                    text =
                        `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
                    break;
            }

        } catch {
            text = "DECODE ERROR";
        }

        out.push({
            pos: at,
            op,
            text
        });
    }

    return out;
}

            const start = pos;
            const finish = start + b.value;

            bodies.push({
                index: i,
                start,

    pos = end;

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 0x00252d20;
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readI32Const(pos: number): {
  value: number;
  next: number;
} {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      break;
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: result | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function readMemArg(pos: number): {
  align: number;
  offset: number;
  next: number;
} {
  const a = readULEB(pos);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next,
  };
}

function readString(pos: number): {
  value: string;
  next: number;
} {
  const r = readULEB(pos);
  const end = r.next + r.value;

  return {
    value: wasm.subarray(r.next, end).toString("utf8"),
    next: end,
  };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SECTIONS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const sections: {
  id: number;
  payloadStart: number;
  end: number;
}[] = [];

let p = 8;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];

  const size = readULEB(p);
  p = size.next;

  const payloadStart = p;
  const end = p + size.value;

  sections.push({
    id,
    payloadStart,
    end,
  });

  p = end;
}

const importSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 2);
const funcSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 3);
const codeSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 10);

if (!funcSec || !codeSec) {
  throw new Error("Missing FUNCTION or CODE section");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORT COUNT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let importedCount = 0;

if (importSec) {
  p = importSec.payloadStart;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const mod = readString(p);
    p = mod.next;

    const name = readString(p);
    p = name.next;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    switch (kind) {
      case 0x00: {
        const type = readULEB(p);
        p = type.next;
        importedCount++;
        break;
      }

      case 0x01: {
        p++;

        const flags = wasm[p++];

        p = readULEB(p).next;

        if (flags & 1) {
          p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        break;
      }

      case 0x02: {
        const flags = wasm[p++];

        p = readULEB(p).next;

        if (flags & 1) {
          p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        break;
      }

      case 0x03:
        p += 2;
        break;

      case 0x04:
        p++;
        p = readULEB(p).next;
        break;

      default:
        throw new Error(
          `Unknown import kind 0x${kind.toString(16)}`
        );
    }
  }
}

// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const functionTypes: number[] = [];

p = funcSec.payloadStart;

{
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    functionTypes.push(r.value);
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

interface Body {
  globalFunc: number;
  ordinal: number;
  typeIndex: number;
  bodyStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  codeStart: number;
  codeEnd: number;
}

const bodies: Body[] = [];

p = codeSec.payloadStart;

{
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const size = readULEB(p);
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + size.value;

    const localDecls = readULEB(p);
    p = localDecls.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localDecls.value; i++) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      p++;
    }

    const codeStart = p;

    bodies.push({
      globalFunc: importedCount + ordinal,
      ordinal,
      typeIndex: functionTypes[ordinal],
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd,
      codeStart,
      codeEnd: bodyEnd,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// INSTRUCTION DECODER
// ------------------------------------------------------------

interface Instr {
  addr: number;
  op: number;
  text: string;
  next: number;
  constValue?: number;
  memOffset?: number;
}

function decodeOne(pos: number): Instr {
  const addr = pos;
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  let text = `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  let constValue: number | undefined;
  let memOffset: number | undefined;

  switch (op) {
    case 0x02: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `block type=${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x03: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `loop type=${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x04: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `if type=${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x05:
      text = "else";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      text = "end";
      break;

    case 0x0c: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `br ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0e: {
      const count = readULEB(pos);
      pos = count.next;

      const labels: number[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const r = readULEB(pos);
        pos = r.next;
        labels.push(r.value);
      }

      const def = readULEB(pos);
      pos = def.next;

      text =
        `br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${def.value}`;

      break;
    }

    case 0x0f:
      text = "return";
      break;

    case 0x10: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `call func=${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = readULEB(pos);
      pos = t.next;

      const table = readULEB(pos);
      pos = table.next;

      text =
        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`;

      break;
    }

    case 0x1a:
      text = "drop";
      break;

    case 0x20: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const r = readULEB(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const m = readMemArg(pos);
      pos = m.next;
      memOffset = m.offset;
      text =
        `i32.load align=${m.align} offset=${hex(m.offset)}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x29: {
      const m = readMemArg(pos);
      pos = m.next;
      memOffset = m.offset;
      text =
        `i64.load align=${m.align} offset=${hex(m.offset)}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x2c: {
      const m = readMemArg(pos);
      pos = m.next;
      memOffset = m.offset;
      text =
        `i32.load8_s align=${m.align} offset=${hex(m.offset)}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x2d: {
      const m = readMemArg(pos);
      pos = m.next;
      memOffset = m.offset;
      text =
        `i32.load8_u align=${m.align} offset=${hex(m.offset)}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const m = readMemArg(pos);
      pos = m.next;
      memOffset = m.offset;
      text =
        `i32.store align=${m.align} offset=${hex(m.offset)}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x3a: {
      const m = readMemArg(pos);
      pos = m.next;
      memOffset = m.offset;
      text =
        `i32.store8 align=${m.align} offset=${hex(m.offset)}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const r = readI32Const(pos);
      pos = r.next;
      constValue = r.value;
      text = `i32.const ${hex(r.value)}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x45:
      text = "i32.eqz";
      break;

    case 0x46:
      text = "i32.eq";
      break;

    case 0x47:
      text = "i32.ne";
      break;

    case 0x48:
      text = "i32.lt_s";
      break;

    case 0x49:
      text = "i32.lt_u";
      break;

    case 0x4a:
      text = "i32.gt_s";
      break;

    case 0x4b:
      text = "i32.gt_u";
      break;

    case 0x4c:
      text = "i32.le_s";
      break;

    case 0x4d:
      text = "i32.le_u";
      break;

    case 0x4e:
      text = "i32.ge_s";
      break;

    case 0x4f:
      text = "i32.ge_u";
      break;

    case 0x6a:
      text = "i32.add";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      text = "i32.sub";
      break;

    case 0x6c:
      text = "i32.mul";
      break;

    case 0x71:
      text = "i32.and";
      break;

    case 0x72:
      text = "i32.or";
      break;

    case 0x73:
      text = "i32.xor";
      break;

    case 0x74:
      text = "i32.shl";
      break;

    case 0x75:
      text = "i32.shr_s";
      break;

    case 0x76:
      text = "i32.shr_u";
      break;
  }

  return {
    addr,
    op,
    text,
    next: pos,
    constValue,
    memOffset,
  };
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE 0x252D20 STORE8");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET TABLE = ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${importedCount}`);
console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS = ${bodies.length}`);

let totalCandidates = 0;

for (const body of bodies) {
  const instructions: Instr[] = [];

  let q = body.codeStart;

  while (q < body.codeEnd) {
    const ins = decodeOne(q);
    instructions.push(ins);

    if (ins.next <= q) {
      break;
    }

    q = ins.next;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
    const store = instructions[i];

    if (store.op !== 0x3a) {
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Look backwards up to 16 instructions for:
     *
     *   i32.const 0x252d20
     *
     * or an equivalent nearby address-building sequence.
     */
    let targetConstIndex = -1;

    for (
      let j = Math.max(0, i - 16);
      j < i;
      j++
    ) {
      if (
        instructions[j].op === 0x41 &&
        instructions[j].constValue === TARGET
      ) {
        targetConstIndex = j;
      }
    }

    /*
     * Also detect the common pattern:
     *
     *   i32.const 0x252d20
     *   ...
     *   i32.add
     *   ...
     *   i32.store8
     */
    if (targetConstIndex < 0) {
      continue;
    }

    totalCandidates++;

    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`FUNC ${body.globalFunc}`);
    console.log(`CODE ORDINAL = ${body.ordinal}`);
    console.log(`TYPE INDEX = ${body.typeIndex}`);
    console.log(
      `BODY = ${hex(body.bodyStart)} .. ${hex(body.bodyEnd)}`
    );
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    const start = Math.max(0, targetConstIndex - 4);
    const end = Math.min(
      instructions.length,
      i + 4
    );

    for (let k = start; k < end; k++) {
      const x = instructions[k];

      const marker =
        k === targetConstIndex
          ? "TARGET"
          : k === i
          ? "STORE8"
          : "      ";

      console.log(
        `${marker} ${hex(x.addr)}  ${x.text}`
      );
    }

    /*
     * Try to identify an immediate value immediately before
     * store8. In the usual pattern:
     *
     *   ... address
     *   i32.const VALUE
     *   i32.store8
     */
    let valueConst: number | null = null;

    for (
      let j = i - 1;
      j >= Math.max(0, i - 5);
      j--
    ) {
      if (instructions[j].op === 0x41) {
        valueConst = instructions[j].constValue ?? null;
        break;
      }

      /*
       * Stop if we hit another store/load/call that likely
       * changes the stack relationship.
       */
      if (
        instructions[j].op === 0x10 ||
        instructions[j].op === 0x11 ||
        instructions[j].op === 0x28 ||
        instructions[j].op === 0x2c ||
        instructions[j].op === 0x2d ||
        instructions[j].op === 0x36 ||
        instructions[j].op === 0x3a
      ) {
        break;
      }
    }

    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    if (valueConst !== null) {
      console.log(
        `POSSIBLE STORED VALUE = ${hex(valueConst)} (${valueConst & 0xff})`
      );

      if ((valueConst & 0xff) === 0xff) {
        console.log(
          ">>> IMPORTANT: STORE8 VALUE = 0xFF"
        );
      }

      if ((valueConst & 0xff) === 0x01) {
        console.log(
          ">>> TABLE ACTIVATION VALUE = 0x01"
        );
      }

      if ((valueConst & 0xff) === 0x00) {
        console.log(
          ">>> TABLE CLEAR VALUE = 0x00"
        );
      }
    } else {
      console.log(
        "POSSIBLE STORED VALUE = DYNAMIC / NOT RESOLVED"
      );
    }
  }
}

console.log();

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 0x00252d20;
const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readString(pos: number): { value: string; next: number } {
  const r = readULEB(pos);
  const end = r.next + r.value;

  return {
    value: wasm.subarray(r.next, end).toString("utf8"),
    next: end,
  };
}

function readSections() {
  const sections: {
    id: number;
    payloadStart: number;
    end: number;
  }[] = [];

  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const size = readULEB(p);
    p = size.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    sections.push({
      id,
      payloadStart,
      end,
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return sections;
}

const sections = readSections();

const importSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 2);
const funcSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 3);
const codeSec = sections.find((s) => s.id === 10);

if (!funcSec || !codeSec) {
  throw new Error("Missing FUNCTION or CODE section");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// IMPORTED FUNCTION COUNT
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let importedCount = 0;

if (importSec) {
  let p = importSec.payloadStart;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const mod = readString(p);
    p = mod.next;

    const name = readString(p);
    p = name.next;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    switch (kind) {
      case 0x00: {
        const type = readULEB(p);
        p = type.next;
        importedCount++;
        break;
      }

      case 0x01: {
        p++; // elem type

        const flags = wasm[p++];

        p = readULEB(p).next;

        if (flags & 1) {
          p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        break;
      }

      case 0x02: {
        const flags = wasm[p++];

        p = readULEB(p).next;

        if (flags & 1) {
          p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        break;
      }

      case 0x03:
        p += 2;
        break;

      case 0x04:
        p++;
        p = readULEB(p).next;
        break;

      default:
        throw new Error(`Unknown import kind 0x${kind.toString(16)}`);
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const functionTypes: number[] = [];

{
  let p = funcSec.payloadStart;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    functionTypes.push(r.value);
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

interface Body {
  globalFunc: number;
  ordinal: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  codeStart: number;
  codeEnd: number;
}

const bodies: Body[] = [];

{
  let p = codeSec.payloadStart;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const size = readULEB(p);
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + size.value;

    const localCount = readULEB(p);
    p = localCount.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      p++;
    }

    const codeStart = p;

    bodies.push({
      globalFunc: importedCount + ordinal,
      ordinal,
      start: bodyStart,
      end: bodyEnd,
      codeStart,
      codeEnd: bodyEnd,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CONSTANT / MEMARG DECODERS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function readI32Const(pos: number): {
  value: number;
  next: number;
} {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      break;
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return {
    value: result | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function readMemArg(pos: number): {
  align: number;
  offset: number;
  next: number;
} {
  const a = readULEB(pos);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next,
  };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// TRACK SIMPLE STACK CONSTANTS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function getConstBefore(
  start: number,
  targetOffset: number
): number | null {
  let p = start;
  let lastConst: number | null = null;

  while (p < targetOffset) {
    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = readI32Const(p);
      p = r.next;
      lastConst = r.value;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (
      op === 0x28 ||
      op === 0x29 ||
      op === 0x2a ||
      op === 0x2b ||
      op === 0x2c ||
      op === 0x2d ||
      op === 0x2e ||
      op === 0x2f ||
      op === 0x30 ||
      op === 0x31 ||
      op === 0x32 ||
      op === 0x33 ||
      op === 0x34 ||
      op === 0x35 ||
      op === 0x36 ||
      op === 0x37 ||
      op === 0x38 ||
      op === 0x39 ||
      op === 0x3a ||
      op === 0x3b ||
      op === 0x3c ||
      op === 0x3d ||
      op === 0x3e
    ) {
      p = readMemArg(p).next;
      lastConst = null;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d || op === 0x10) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      lastConst = null;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      lastConst = null;
      continue;
    }
  }

  return lastConst;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// MAIN SCAN
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE 0x252D20 TABLE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET TABLE = ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS = ${importedCount}`);
console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS = ${bodies.length}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log();

let totalHits = 0;

for (const body of bodies) {
  let p = body.codeStart;

  const hits: {
    addr: number;
    kind: "LOAD8" | "STORE8" | "LOAD32" | "STORE32";
    offset: number;
    align: number;
    baseHint: number | null;
  }[] = [];

  while (p < body.codeEnd) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    // i32.load
    if (op === 0x28) {
      const m = readMemArg(p);
      p = m.next;

      if (m.offset === TARGET) {
        hits.push({
          addr,
          kind: "LOAD32",
          offset: m.offset,
          align: m.align,
          baseHint: getConstBefore(body.codeStart, addr),
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    // i32.load8_s
    if (op === 0x2c) {
      const m = readMemArg(p);
      p = m.next;

      if (m.offset === TARGET) {
        hits.push({
          addr,
          kind: "LOAD8",
          offset: m.offset,
          align: m.align,
          baseHint: getConstBefore(body.codeStart, addr),
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    // i32.load8_u
    if (op === 0x2d) {
      const m = readMemArg(p);
      p = m.next;

      if (m.offset === TARGET) {
        hits.push({
          addr,
          kind: "LOAD8",
          offset: m.offset,
          align: m.align,
          baseHint: getConstBefore(body.codeStart, addr),
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    // i32.store
    if (op === 0x36) {
      const m = readMemArg(p);
      p = m.next;

      if (m.offset === TARGET) {
        hits.push({
          addr,
          kind: "STORE32",
          offset: m.offset,
          align: m.align,
          baseHint: getConstBefore(body.codeStart, addr),
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    // i32.store8
    if (op === 0x3a) {
      const m = readMemArg(p);
      p = m.next;

      if (m.offset === TARGET) {
        hits.push({
          addr,
          kind: "STORE8",
          offset: m.offset,
          align: m.align,
          baseHint: getConstBefore(body.codeStart, addr),
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    // instructions with immediates
    if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04
    ) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d ||
      op === 0x10
    ) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22 ||
      op === 0x23 ||
      op === 0x24
    ) {
      p = readULEB(p).next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      p = readI32Const(p).next;
      continue;
    }
  }

  if (hits.length === 0) {
    continue;
  }

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`FUNC ${body.globalFunc}`);
  console.log(`CODE ORDINAL = ${body.ordinal}`);
  console.log(
    `BODY = ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`
  );
  console.log(`HITS = ${hits.length}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (const h of hits) {
    console.log(
      `${hex(h.addr)}  ${h.kind.padEnd(7)} ` +
      `offset=${hex(h.offset)} align=${h.align}`
    );

    if (h.baseHint !== null) {
      console.log(
        `             previous i32.const = ${hex(h.baseHint)}`
      );
    }
  }

  console.log();
  totalHits += hits.length;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TOTAL HITS = ${totalHits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("NOTE:");
console.log("This scan matches direct memory offsets equal to 0x252D20.");
console.log("Indexed accesses using another base + dynamic offset are");
console.log("reported only when their encoded memarg offset is exactly");
console.log("0x252D20.");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_BASE = 0x2559ac;
const TARGET_MASK = 0x255880;

const TARGETS = [
    0x25587c,
    0x255880,
    0x255884,
    0x255888,
    0x25588c,
    0x255890,
    0x255894,
