import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_MIN = 4057;
const TARGET_MAX = 4188;

function readULEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
        }
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {
    const sections: any[] = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const s = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start,
            end,
            size: s.value
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

/*
 * Skip a single WebAssembly instruction immediate.
 *
 * This decoder is used only to identify real instruction boundaries.
 * It does not execute anything.
 */

function skipInstruction(
    buf: Buffer,
    opPos: number
): { next: number; isCallIndirect: boolean; typeIndex?: number; tableIndex?: number } {

    let p = opPos;

    const op = buf[p++];

    /*
     * call_indirect
     *
     * 0x11 typeidx tableidx
     */
    if (op === 0x11) {
        const typeInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = typeInfo.next;

        const tableInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = tableInfo.next;

        return {
            next: p,
            isCallIndirect: true,
            typeIndex: typeInfo.value,
            tableIndex: tableInfo.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * No-immediate instructions.
     */
    const noImm = new Set<number>([
        0x00, 0x01,

        0x0b, 0x0f,

        0x1a, 0x1b,

        0x45,
        0x46, 0x47, 0x48, 0x49,
        0x4a, 0x4b, 0x4c, 0x4d,
        0x4e, 0x4f, 0x50, 0x51,
        0x52, 0x53, 0x54, 0x55,
        0x56, 0x57, 0x58, 0x59,
        0x5a, 0x5b, 0x5c, 0x5d,
        0x5e, 0x5f, 0x60, 0x61,
        0x62, 0x63, 0x64, 0x65,
        0x66, 0x67, 0x68, 0x69,
        0x6a, 0x6b, 0x6c, 0x6d,
        0x6e, 0x6f, 0x70, 0x71,
        0x72, 0x73, 0x74, 0x75,
        0x76, 0x77, 0x78, 0x79,
        0x7a, 0x7b, 0x7c, 0x7d,
        0x7e, 0x7f,

        0x80, 0x81, 0x82, 0x83,
        0x84, 0x85, 0x86, 0x87,
        0x88, 0x89, 0x8a, 0x8b,
        0x8c, 0x8d, 0x8e, 0x8f,
        0x90, 0x91, 0x92, 0x93,
        0x94, 0x95, 0x96, 0x97,
        0x98, 0x99, 0x9a, 0x9b,
        0x9c, 0x9d, 0x9e, 0x9f,
        0xa0, 0xa1, 0xa2, 0xa3,
        0xa4, 0xa5, 0xa6, 0xa7,
        0xa8, 0xa9, 0xaa, 0xab,
        0xac, 0xad, 0xae, 0xaf,
        0xb0, 0xb1, 0xb2, 0xb3,
        0xb4, 0xb5, 0xb6, 0xb7,
        0xb8, 0xb9, 0xba, 0xbb,
        0xbc, 0xbd, 0xbe, 0xbf,
        0xc0, 0xc1, 0xc2, 0xc3,
        0xc4, 0xc5, 0xc6, 0xc7,
        0xc8, 0xc9, 0xca, 0xcb,
        0xcc, 0xcd, 0xce, 0xcf,
        0xd0
    ]);

    if (noImm.has(op)) {
        return {
            next: p,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * block / loop / if
     *
     * blocktype:
     *   0x40
     *   valtype
     *   signed type index
     */
    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        if (b >= 0x40) {
            return {
                next: p,
                isCallIndirect: false
            };
        }

        if (
            b === 0x7f ||
            b === 0x7e ||
            b === 0x7d ||
            b === 0x7c ||
            b === 0x7b ||
            b === 0x70 ||
            b === 0x6f
        ) {
            return {
                next: p,
                isCallIndirect: false
            };
        }

        /*
         * type index encoded as signed LEB.
         */
        const t = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = t.next;

        return {
            next: p,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * br / br_if
     */
    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, p);
        return {
            next: x.next,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * br_table
     */
    if (op === 0x0e) {
        const n = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;
        }

        return {
            next: p,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * return_call / return_call_ref etc.
     */
    if (op === 0x12 || op === 0x13) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            next: x.next,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * call
     */
    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            next: x.next,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * local.get/set/tee
     * global.get/set
     */
    if (
        op === 0x20 ||
        op === 0x21 ||
        op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 ||
        op === 0x24
    ) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            next: x.next,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * memory load/store family
     *
     * memarg = align + offset
     */
    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const a = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = o.next;

        return {
            next: p,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * memory.size / memory.grow
     */
    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            next: x.next,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * i32.const
     */
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            next: x.next,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * i64.const
     *
     * signed LEB, but length decoding is identical for our boundary use.
     */
    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            next: x.next,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * f32.const
     */
    if (op === 0x43) {
        return {
            next: p + 4,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * f64.const
     */
    if (op === 0x44) {
        return {
            next: p + 8,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * ref.null
     */
    if (op === 0xd0) {
        return {
            next: p + 1,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * ref.func
     */
    if (op === 0xd2) {
        const x = readULEB(buf, p);

        return {
            next: x.next,
            isCallIndirect: false
        };
    }

    /*
     * prefixed instructions 0xfc / 0xfd / 0xfe
     *
     * Decode enough to safely cross common immediates.
     */
    if (op === 0xfc || op === 0xfd || op === 0xfe) {

        const sub = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = sub.next;

        /*
         * 0xfc bulk-memory / saturating conversions
         */
        if (op === 0xfc) {

            const s = sub.value;

            /*
             * saturating conversions 0..7
             */
            if (s <= 7) {
                return {
                    next: p,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * memory.init
             * dataidx + memidx
             */
            if (s === 8) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = b.next;

                return {
                    next: p,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * data.drop
             */
            if (s === 9) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);

                return {
                    next: a.next,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * memory.copy
             */
            if (s === 10) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = b.next;

                return {
                    next: p,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * memory.fill
             */
            if (s === 11) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);

                return {
                    next: a.next,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * table.init
             */
            if (s === 12) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = b.next;

                return {
                    next: p,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * elem.drop
             */
            if (s === 13) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);

                return {
                    next: a.next,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * table.copy
             */
            if (s === 14) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = b.next;

                return {
                    next: p,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * table.grow / table.size / table.fill
             */
            if (s === 15 || s === 16 || s === 17) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);

                return {
                    next: a.next,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            return {
                next: p,
                isCallIndirect: false
            };
        }

        /*
         * SIMD:
         *
         * Most SIMD opcodes have either no immediate,
         * a 16-byte lane mask, or a memarg.
         *
         * For the call_indirect scan we conservatively handle
         * the common forms.
         */
        if (op === 0xfd) {

            const s = sub.value;

            /*
             * SIMD memory operations.
             */
            const simdMem = new Set<number>([
                0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03,
                0x04, 0x05, 0x06, 0x07,
                0x08, 0x09, 0x0a, 0x0b,
                0x0c, 0x0d, 0x0e, 0x0f,
                0x10, 0x11, 0x12, 0x13,
                0x54, 0x55, 0x56, 0x57,
                0x58, 0x59, 0x5a, 0x5b,
                0x5c, 0x5d, 0x5e, 0x5f
            ]);

            if (simdMem.has(s)) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = b.next;

                return {
                    next: p,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * v128.const
             */
            if (s === 12) {
                return {
                    next: p + 16,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * shuffle
             */
            if (s === 13) {
                return {
                    next: p + 16,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            /*
             * lane-index instructions.
             */
            if (
                (s >= 21 && s <= 34) ||
                (s >= 84 && s <= 115)
            ) {
                return {
                    next: p + 1,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            return {
                next: p,
                isCallIndirect: false
            };
        }

        /*
         * Atomic / threads prefix.
         *
         * Most atomic memory operations use memarg.
         */
        if (op === 0xfe) {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = a.next;

            const atomicNoImm = new Set<number>([
                0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03
            ]);

            if (atomicNoImm.has(sub.value)) {
                return {
                    next: p,
                    isCallIndirect: false
                };
            }

            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = x.next;

            const y = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = y.next;

            return {
                next: p,
                isCallIndirect: false
            };
        }
    }

    /*
     * Unknown opcode.
     *
     * Return one byte forward. The caller will report it as a
     * decoder anomaly rather than silently trusting it.
     */
    return {
        next: p,
        isCallIndirect: false
    };
}

function parseCodeBodies(
    buf: Buffer,
    codeSection: { start: number; end: number }
) {
    let p = codeSection.start;

    const bodyCount = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = bodyCount.next;

    const bodies: {
        functionIndex: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        codeStart: number;
        codeEnd: number;
    }[] = [];

    /*
     * First 83 function indexes are imports.
     */
    const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

    for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount.value; i++) {

        const bodySize = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = bodySize.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + bodySize.value;

        const localCount = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = localCount.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localCount.value; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = n.next;

            /*
             * local type = one byte valtype/ref type
             */
            p++;
        }

        bodies.push({
            functionIndex: IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + i,
            bodyStart,
            codeStart: p,
            codeEnd: bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return {
        bodyCount: bodyCount.value,
        bodies,
        cursor: p
    };
}

export async function run() {

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SEGMENT 413 INDIRECT CALL TRACE");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log("");
    console.log("WASM size :", buf.length);

    const sections = parseSections(buf);

    const element = sections.find((x) => x.id === 9);
    const code = sections.find((x) => x.id === 10);

    if (!element) {
        throw new Error("Element section not found");
    }

    if (!code) {
        throw new Error("Code section not found");
    }

    /*
     * ----------------------------------------------------------
     * ELEMENT TABLE
     * ----------------------------------------------------------
     */

    let p = element.start;

    const segCount = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = segCount.next;

    const flags = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = flags.next;

    if (flags.value !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected element flags ${flags.value}`
        );
    }

    const offsetOpcode = buf[p++];

    if (offsetOpcode !== 0x41) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected offset opcode ${hex(offsetOpcode)}`
        );
    }

    const offset = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = offset.next;

    const endOpcode = buf[p++];

    if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
        throw new Error(
            `Unexpected offset end opcode ${hex(endOpcode)}`
        );
    }

    const countInfo = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const count = countInfo.value;

    const table = new Map<number, number>();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const fn = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = fn.next;

        table.set(offset.value + i, fn.value);
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("Element segments :", segCount.value);
    console.log("Table offset     :", offset.value);
    console.log("Function count   :", count);
    console.log(
        "Element cursor   :",
        hex(p),
        "expected",
        hex(element.end)
    );

    /*
     * ----------------------------------------------------------
     * CODE BODIES
     * ----------------------------------------------------------
     */

    const parsed = parseCodeBodies(buf, code);

    console.log("");
    console.log("Code bodies      :", parsed.bodyCount);
    console.log("Expected         : 9398");
    console.log(
        "Code cursor      :",
        hex(parsed.cursor),
        "expected",
        hex(code.end)
    );

    /*
     * ----------------------------------------------------------
     * INDIRECT CALL TRACE
     * ----------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" RESOLVED CALL_INDIRECT → SEGMENT 413 FUNCTIONS");
    console.log("============================================================");

    let totalIndirect = 0;
    let relevant = 0;
    let decodeErrors = 0;

    const hits: any[] = [];

    for (const body of parsed.bodies) {

        let q = body.codeStart;

        while (q < body.codeEnd) {

            const opPos = q;

            let ins;

            try {
                ins = skipInstruction(buf, q);
            } catch (e) {
                decodeErrors++;

                console.log("");
                console.log(
                    "DECODER ERROR @",
                    hex(q),
                    "function",
                    body.functionIndex
                );

                break;
            }

            if (ins.next <= q || ins.next > body.codeEnd) {
                decodeErrors++;

                console.log("");
                console.log(
                    "INVALID INSTRUCTION BOUNDARY @",
                    hex(q),
                    "function",
                    body.functionIndex
                );

                break;
            }

            if (ins.isCallIndirect) {

                totalIndirect++;

                const tableIndex = ins.tableIndex!;

                const resolved = table.get(tableIndex);

                if (
                    resolved !== undefined &&
                    resolved >= TARGET_MIN &&
                    resolved <= TARGET_MAX
                ) {

                    relevant++;

                    const hit = {
                        caller: body.functionIndex,
                        instruction: opPos,
                        typeIndex: ins.typeIndex,
                        tableIndex,
                        target: resolved
                    };

                    hits.push(hit);

                    console.log("");
                    console.log(
                        `CALL_INDIRECT #${relevant}`
                    );
                    console.log(
                        " caller function :",
                        body.functionIndex
                    );
                    console.log(
                        " instruction     :",
                        hex(opPos)
                    );
                    console.log(
                        " type index      :",
                        ins.typeIndex
                    );
                    console.log(
                        " table index     :",
                        hex(tableIndex)
                    );
                    console.log(
                        " resolved target :",
                        resolved
                    );
                }
            }

            q = ins.next;
        }
    }

    /*
     * ----------------------------------------------------------
     * SUMMARY
     * ----------------------------------------------------------
     */

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SUMMARY");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(
        "Total call_indirect :",
        totalIndirect
    );

    console.log(
        "Relevant matches    :",
        relevant
    );

    console.log(
        "Decoder errors      :",
        decodeErrors
    );

    console.log("");

    if (hits.length > 0) {

        console.log(
            "Unique target functions:"
        );

        const uniqueTargets =
            [...new Set(hits.map(x => x.target))];

        uniqueTargets.sort(
            (a, b) => a - b
        );

        for (const fn of uniqueTargets) {

            const n =
                hits.filter(
                    x => x.target === fn
                ).length;

            console.log(
                `  function ${fn} <- ${n} indirect call(s)`
            );
        }

    } else {
        console.log(
            "No resolved indirect calls reached functions 4057..4188."
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" END");
    console.log("============================================================");
}

====================================================================================================

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 4154;
const NEXT_FUNC = 1475;
const IMPORT_FUNC = 83;
const CALLER_FUNC = 6491;

const FIRST_CALL_INDIRECT = 0x00229661;

function readULEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    pos: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB EOF");
}

function readSLEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    pos: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function opcodeName(op: number): string {
    const m: Record<number, string> = {
        0x00: "unreachable",
        0x01: "nop",
        0x02: "block",
        0x03: "loop",
        0x04: "if",
        0x05: "else",
        0x0b: "end",
        0x0c: "br",
        0x0d: "br_if",
        0x0e: "br_table",
        0x0f: "return",
        0x10: "call",
        0x11: "call_indirect",
        0x1a: "drop",

        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2a: "f32.load",
        0x2b: "f64.load",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",

        0x3f: "memory.size",
        0x40: "memory.grow",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",

        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",
        0x74: "i32.shl",
        0x75: "i32.shr_s",
        0x76: "i32.shr_u",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",
    };

    return m[op] ?? `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function parseSections(buf: Buffer) {
    const sections: any[] = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;

        const payload = p;
        const end = payload + r.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            payload,
            size: r.value,
            end,
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseTypes(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: any
) {
    const types: any[] = [];

    let p = section.payload;

    const countR = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countR.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {
        const form = buf[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            types.push({
                index: i,
                form,
            });
            continue;
        }

        const paramR = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = paramR.next;

        const params: number[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < paramR.value; j++) {
            params.push(buf[p++]);
        }

        const resultR = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = resultR.next;

        const results: number[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < resultR.value; j++) {
            results.push(buf[p++]);
        }

        types.push({
            index: i,
            params,
            results,
        });
    }

    return types;
}

function parseImports(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: any
) {
    const imports: any[] = [];

    let p = section.payload;

    const countR = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countR.next;

    let functionIndex = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {
        const moduleLen = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = moduleLen.next;

        const module = buf
            .subarray(p, p + moduleLen.value)
            .toString("utf8");

        p += moduleLen.value;

        const nameLen = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = nameLen.next;

        const name = buf
            .subarray(p, p + nameLen.value)
            .toString("utf8");

        p += nameLen.value;

        const kind = buf[p++];

        if (kind === 0x00) {
            const typeR = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = typeR.next;

            imports.push({
                importIndex: i,
                functionIndex,
                module,
                name,
                typeIndex: typeR.value,
            });

            functionIndex++;
        } else if (kind === 0x01) {
            const elemType = buf[p++];

            const flagsR = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = flagsR.next;

            if (flagsR.value === 0) {
                p += 1;
                p += 1;
            } else {
                p += 1;
                p += 1;
            }
        } else if (kind === 0x02) {
            const flagsR = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = flagsR.next;

            p = readULEB(buf, p).next;

            if (flagsR.value & 1) {
                p = readULEB(buf, p).next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 0x03) {
            p += 1;
            p += 1;
        }
    }

    return imports;
}

function parseCode(
    buf: Buffer,
    section: any
) {
    const bodies: any[] = [];

    let p = section.payload;

    const countR = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countR.next;

    const imported = 83;

    for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {
        const sizeR = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = sizeR.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + sizeR.value;

        const localCountR = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = localCountR.next;

        const locals: any[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < localCountR.value; j++) {
            const nR = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = nR.next;

            const type = buf[p++];

            locals.push({
                count: nR.value,
                type,
            });
        }

        bodies.push({
            func: imported + i,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            instrStart: p,
            instrEnd: bodyEnd,
            locals,
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function decode(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const at = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        try {
            if (op === 0x10) {
                const r = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = r.next;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  call              func=${r.value}`
                );
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x11) {
                const t = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = t.next;

                const table = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = table.next;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  call_indirect     type=${t.value} table=${hex(table.value)}`
                );
                continue;
            }

            if (
                op === 0x20 ||
                op === 0x21 ||
                op === 0x22 ||
                op === 0x23 ||
                op === 0x24
            ) {
                const r = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = r.next;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  ${opcodeName(op).padEnd(18)} ${r.value}`
                );
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x41) {
                const r = readSLEB(buf, p);
                p = r.next;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i32.const         ${r.value} (${hex(r.value)})`
                );
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x42) {
                const r = readSLEB(buf, p);
                p = r.next;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  i64.const         ${r.value}`
                );
                continue;
            }

            if (
                op === 0x28 ||
                op === 0x29 ||
                op === 0x2a ||
                op === 0x2b ||
                op === 0x36 ||
                op === 0x37
            ) {
                const a = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = o.next;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  ${opcodeName(op).padEnd(18)} align=${a.value} offset=${hex(o.value)}`
                );
                continue;
            }

            if (
                op === 0x0c ||
                op === 0x0d ||
                op === 0x02 ||
                op === 0x03
            ) {
                const r = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = r.next;

                console.log(
                    `${hex(at)}  ${opcodeName(op).padEnd(18)} ${r.value}`
                );
                continue;
            }

            console.log(
                `${hex(at)}  ${opcodeName(op)}`
            );
        } catch {
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)}  ${opcodeName(op)} [decode-stop]`
            );
            break;
        }
    }
}

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" FUNCTION 4154 CHAIN TRACE");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log();

    const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    const typeSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 1);
    const importSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 2);
    const codeSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 10);

    if (!typeSection || !importSection || !codeSection) {
        throw new Error("Required section missing");
    }

    const types = parseTypes(buf, typeSection);
    const imports = parseImports(buf, importSection);
    const bodies = parseCode(buf, codeSection);

    console.log("WASM size :", buf.length);

    console.log("Imports   :", imports.length);
    console.log("Bodies    :", bodies.length);
    console.log();

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" IMPORT FUNCTION 83");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const imp83 = imports.find(
        x => x.functionIndex === IMPORT_FUNC
    );

    if (imp83) {
        console.log("Function :", IMPORT_FUNC);
        console.log("Module   :", imp83.module);
        console.log("Name     :", imp83.name);
        console.log("Type     :", imp83.typeIndex);

        const t = types[imp83.typeIndex];

        if (t) {
            console.log(
                "Params   :",
                t.params?.map((x: number) => hex(x, 2)).join(" ")
            );

            console.log(
                "Results  :",
                t.results?.map((x: number) => hex(x, 2)).join(" ")
            );
        }
    } else {
        console.log("IMPORT 83 NOT FOUND");
    }

    console.log();

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" FUNCTION 4154");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const f4154 = bodies.find(
        x => x.func === TARGET_FUNC
    );

    if (!f4154) {
        throw new Error("Function 4154 not found");
    }

    console.log(
        "Range :",
        `${hex(f4154.instrStart)} .. ${hex(f4154.instrEnd)}`
    );

    console.log(
        "Size  :",
        f4154.instrEnd - f4154.instrStart
    );

    const funcTypeIndex = (() => {
        const functionSection = sections.find(x => x.id === 3);

        if (!functionSection) return -1;

        let p = functionSection.payload;

        const countR = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = countR.next;

        const definedIndex = TARGET_FUNC - 83;

        if (
            definedIndex < 0 ||
            definedIndex >= countR.value
        ) {
            return -1;
        }

        for (let i = 0; i < definedIndex; i++) {
            p = readULEB(buf, p).next;
        }

        return readULEB(buf, p).value;
    })();

    console.log(
        "Type index :",
        funcTypeIndex
    );

    if (types[funcTypeIndex]) {
        console.log(
            "Params     :",
            types[funcTypeIndex].params
                ?.map((x: number) => hex(x, 2))
                .join(" ")
        );

        console.log(
            "Results    :",
            types[funcTypeIndex].results
                ?.map((x: number) => hex(x, 2))
                .join(" ")
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log("DECODE:");

    decode(
        buf,
        f4154.instrStart,
        f4154.instrEnd
    );

    console.log();

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" FUNCTION 1475");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const f1475 = bodies.find(
        x => x.func === NEXT_FUNC
    );

    if (!f1475) {
        throw new Error("Function 1475 not found");
    }

    console.log(
        "Range :",
        `${hex(f1475.instrStart)} .. ${hex(f1475.instrEnd)}`
    );

    console.log(
        "Size  :",
        f1475.instrEnd - f1475.instrStart
    );

    console.log();
    console.log("DECODE:");

    decode(
        buf,
        f1475.instrStart,
        f1475.instrEnd
    );

    console.log();

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" CALLER 6491 / FIRST INDIRECT CALL");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const f6491 = bodies.find(
        x => x.func === CALLER_FUNC
    );

    if (!f6491) {
        throw new Error("Function 6491 not found");
    }

    console.log(
        "Function 6491 range:",
        `${hex(f6491.instrStart)} .. ${hex(f6491.instrEnd)}`
    );

    const windowStart = Math.max(
        f6491.instrStart,
        FIRST_CALL_INDIRECT - 120
    );

    const windowEnd = Math.min(
        f6491.instrEnd,
        FIRST_CALL_INDIRECT + 40
    );

    console.log(
        "Window:",
        `${hex(windowStart)} .. ${hex(windowEnd)}`
    );

    console.log();

    decode(
        buf,
        windowStart,
        windowEnd
    );

    console.log();

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" RAW BYTES AROUND FIRST CALL");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const rawStart = Math.max(
        f6491.instrStart,
        FIRST_CALL_INDIRECT - 48
    );

    const rawEnd = Math.min(
        f6491.instrEnd,
        FIRST_CALL_INDIRECT + 16
    );

    for (
        let p = rawStart;
        p < rawEnd;
        p += 16
    ) {
        const e = Math.min(p + 16, rawEnd);

        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let q = p; q < e; q++) {
            bytes.push(
                buf[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
            );
        }

        console.log(
            `${hex(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
        );
    }

    console.log();
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" END");
    console.log("============================================================");
}

function readULEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    pos: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF in ULEB");
}

function readSLEB(
    buf: Buffer,
    pos: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (pos < buf.length) {
        b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        if (shift > 35) throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readU32(buf: Buffer, pos: number): number {
    return (
        buf[pos] |
        (buf[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (buf[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (buf[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function findSections(buf: Buffer) {
    let p = 8;

    const sections: {
        id: number;
        payload: number;
        size: number;
        end: number;
    }[] = [];

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;

        const payload = p;
        const end = payload + r.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            payload,
            size: r.value,
            end,
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseCodeBodies(
    buf: Buffer,
    codeSection: {
        payload: number;
        size: number;
        end: number;
    }
) {
    let p = codeSection.payload;

    const countR = readULEB(buf, p);
    p = countR.next;

    const bodies: {
        func: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
        instrStart: number;
        instrEnd: number;
    }[] = [];

    const importedFunctions = 83;

    for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {
        const sizeR = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = sizeR.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + sizeR.value;

        const localR = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = localR.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localR.value; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = n.next;

            p += 1; // valtype
        }

        bodies.push({
            func: importedFunctions + i,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            instrStart: p,
            instrEnd: bodyEnd,
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function dumpRaw(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
) {
    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const e = Math.min(p + 16, end);

        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let q = p; q < e; q++) {
            bytes.push(buf[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
        }

        console.log(
            `${hex(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
        );
    }
}

                case 0x02:
                case 0x03: {
                    const r = readULEB(buf, p);
                    p = r.next;

                    console.log(
                        `${hex(at)}  ${opcodeName(op).padEnd(16)} ${r.value}`
                    );
                    break;
                }

                case 0x0e: {
                    const n = readULEB(buf, p);
                    p = n.next;

                    const labels: number[] = [];

                    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
                        p = r.next;
                        labels.push(r.value);
                    }

                    const d = readULEB(buf, p);
                    p = d.next;

                    console.log(
                        `${hex(at)}  br_table         count=${n.value} default=${d.value}`
                    );
                    break;
                }

                default:
                    console.log(
                        `${hex(at)}  ${opcodeName(op)}`
                    );
                    break;
            }
        } catch {
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)}  ${opcodeName(op)}  [decode-stop]`
            );
            break;
        }
    }
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function parseSections() {
    let pos = 8;

    const sections: Record<
        number,
        { start: number; end: number }
    > = {};

    while (pos < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[pos++];

        const s = u32leb(pos);
        pos = s.next;

        const start = pos;
        const end = pos + s.value;

        sections[id] = { start, end };
        pos = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function readInstr(pos: number): {
    next: number;
    text: string;
    isCallIndirect: boolean;
} {
    const start = pos;
    const op = wasm[pos++];

    const result = (
        next: number,
        text: string,
        isCallIndirect = false
    ) => ({
        next,
        text,
        isCallIndirect,
    });

    // control
    if (op === 0x00)
        return result(pos, "unreachable");

    if (op === 0x01)
        return result(pos, "nop");

    if (op === 0x02) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        return result(pos, `block              ${b}`);
    }

    if (op === 0x03) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        return result(pos, `loop               ${b}`);
    }

    if (op === 0x04) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        return result(pos, `if                 ${b}`);
    }

    if (op === 0x05)
        return result(pos, "else");

    if (op === 0x0b)
        return result(pos, "end");

    if (op === 0x0c) {
        const x = u32leb(pos);
        return result(x.next, `br                 ${x.value}`);
    }

    if (op === 0x0d) {
        const x = u32leb(pos);
        return result(x.next, `br_if              ${x.value}`);
    }

    if (op === 0x0e) {
        const n = u32leb(pos);
        pos = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
            const x = u32leb(pos);
            pos = x.next;
        }

        const d = u32leb(pos);
        pos = d.next;

        return result(
            pos,
            `br_table            count=${n.value} default=${d.value}`
        );
    }

    if (op === 0x0f)
        return result(pos, "return");

    // calls
    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = u32leb(pos);
        return result(x.next, `call               func=${x.value}`);
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const type = u32leb(pos);
        pos = type.next;

        const table = u32leb(pos);
        pos = table.next;

        return result(
            pos,
            `CALL_INDIRECT      type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`,
            true
        );
    }

    // param/local
    if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = u32leb(pos);
        return result(x.next, `local.get          ${x.value}`);
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = u32leb(pos);
        return result(x.next, `local.set          ${x.value}`);
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = u32leb(pos);
        return result(x.next, `local.tee          ${x.value}`);
    }

    // constants
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = u32leb(pos);
        return result(x.next, `i32.const         ${x.value} (0x${x.value.toString(16)})`);
    }

    // memory
    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const align = wasm[pos++];

        const off = u32leb(pos);
        pos = off.next;

        const names: Record<number, string> = {
            0x28: "i32.load",
            0x29: "i64.load",
            0x2a: "f32.load",
            0x2b: "f64.load",
            0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
            0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
            0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
            0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
            0x30: "i64.load8_s",
            0x31: "i64.load8_u",
            0x32: "i64.load16_s",
            0x33: "i64.load16_u",
            0x34: "i64.load32_s",
            0x35: "i64.load32_u",
            0x36: "i32.store",
            0x37: "i64.store",
            0x38: "f32.store",
            0x39: "f64.store",
            0x3a: "i32.store8",
            0x3b: "i32.store16",
            0x3c: "i64.store8",
            0x3d: "i64.store16",
            0x3e: "i64.store32",
        };

        return result(
            pos,
            `${names[op] ?? "memory"}        align=${align} offset=0x${off.value.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
        );
    }

    // memory.size / memory.grow
    if (op === 0x3f)
        return result(pos + 1, "memory.size");

    if (op === 0x40)
        return result(pos + 1, "memory.grow");

    // comparisons
    const comparisons: Record<number, string> = {
        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",
        0x48: "i32.lt_s",
        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
    };

    if (comparisons[op])
        return result(pos, comparisons[op]);

    // i32 numeric
    const numeric: Record<number, string> = {
        0x67: "i32.clz",
        0x68: "i32.ctz",
        0x69: "i32.popcnt",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",

        0x6d: "i32.div_s",
        0x6e: "i32.div_u",
        0x6f: "i32.rem_s",
        0x70: "i32.rem_u",

        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",

        0x74: "i32.shl",
        0x75: "i32.shr_s",
        0x76: "i32.shr_u",
        0x77: "i32.rotl",
        0x78: "i32.rotr",
    };

    if (numeric[op])
        return result(pos, numeric[op]);

    // selected conversions
    const conversions: Record<number, string> = {
        0xa7: "i32.wrap_i64",
        0xac: "i64.extend_i32_s",
        0xad: "i64.extend_i32_u",
    };

    if (conversions[op])
        return result(pos, conversions[op]);

    throw new Error(
        `Unknown opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} at 0x${start
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(8, "0")}`
    );
}

function decodeWindow(start: number, end: number) {
    let pos = start;

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" FUNCTION 6491 — TRUE INSTRUCTION DECODER");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("");

    let indirectCount = 0;

    while (pos < end) {
        const at = pos;

        const ins = readInstr(pos);
        pos = ins.next;

        console.log(
            `0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${ins.text}`
        );

        if (ins.isCallIndirect) {
            indirectCount++;

            console.log(
                `             >>> REAL call_indirect #${indirectCount}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`REAL call_indirect count = ${indirectCount}`);
    console.log("============================================================");
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << (shift + 7));
      }

      return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

      x = r.next;
      continue;
    }
  }

  q = bodyEnd;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;
const TARGET = 446;

function readU32(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
        }

        s += 7;
    }
}

function readS32(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
                v |= (~0 << (s + 7));

            return { value: v | 0, next: p };
        }

        s += 7;
    }
}

function skipBlockType(p) {
    const b = buf[p];

    // blocktype is either valtype byte or signed LEB type index
    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c
    ) {
        return p + 1;
    }

    return readS32(p).next;
}

function skipInstruction(p) {

    const op = buf[p++];

    // control
    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
        return skipBlockType(p);
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
        return readU32(p).next;
    }

    if (op === 0x0e) {
        const n = readU32(p);
        p = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
            p = readU32(p).next;

        return readU32(p).next;
    }

    if (op === 0x0f || op === 0x1a || op === 0x1b) {
        return p;
    }

    // locals/globals
    if (
        op === 0x20 ||
        op === 0x21 ||
        op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 ||
        op === 0x24
    ) {
        return readU32(p).next;
    }

    // calls
    if (op === 0x10) {
        return readU32(p).next;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
        const a = readU32(p);
        const b = readU32(a.next);
        return b.next;
    }

    // memory load/store
    if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const a = readU32(p);
        return readU32(a.next).next;
    }

    // memory.size / grow
    if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
        return p + 1;
    }

    // constants
    if (op === 0x41) {
        return readS32(p).next;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        // signed i64 LEB
        while (true) {
            const b = buf[p++];
            if (!(b & 0x80))
                return p;
        }
    }

    if (op === 0x43)
        return p + 4;

    if (op === 0x44)
        return p + 8;

    // ref.null
    if (op === 0xd0) {
        return p + 1;
    }

    // ref.func
    if (op === 0xd2) {
        return readU32(p).next;
    }

    // bulk-memory / prefixed instructions
    if (op === 0xfc) {
        const sub = readU32(p);
        p = sub.next;

        // Most relevant bulk-memory forms have variable immediates.
        // Conservative fallback.
        return p;
    }

    // SIMD
    if (op === 0xfd) {
        const sub = readU32(p);
        return sub.next + 16;
    }

    // EH / misc prefixes
    if (op === 0xfb) {
        const sub = readU32(p);
        return sub.next;
    }

    return p;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse function section and code section.
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = 8;

let functionTypes = [];
let bodies = [];

while (p < buf.length) {

    const sectionId = buf[p++];

    const sz = readU32(p);
    p = sz.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + sz.value;

    if (sectionId === 3) {

        const n = readU32(p);
        p = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

            const t = readU32(p);
            p = t.next;

            functionTypes.push(t.value);
        }
    }

    if (sectionId === 10) {

        const n = readU32(p);
        p = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

            const bodyStart = p;

            const bs = readU32(p);
            p = bs.next;

            const bodyEnd = p + bs.value;

            const locals = readU32(p);
            p = locals.next;

            let extra = 0;

            for (let j = 0; j < locals.value; j++) {

                const cnt = readU32(p);
                p = cnt.next;

                p++;
                extra += cnt.value;
            }

            bodies.push({
                bodyStart,
                instrStart: p,
                bodyEnd,
                extra
            });

            p = bodyEnd;
        }
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const START = 0x000222c0;
const END   = 0x000225f2;

function uleb(pos) {
  let r = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    r += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }

  return { value: r >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let r = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[p++];
    r += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    r -= 2 ** s;
  }

  return { value: r | 0, next: p };
}

function decode() {
  let p = START;

  // locals
  const ld = uleb(p);
  p = ld.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < ld.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next + 1;
  }

  const out = [];

  while (p < END) {
    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        kind:
          op === 0x20 ? "get" :
          op === 0x21 ? "set" :
          "tee",
        local: x.value
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = sleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        kind: "const",
        value: x.value
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 ||
        op === 0x2d || op === 0x2c) {

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        kind: "load",
        offset: o.value
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6a ||
        op === 0x6b ||
        op === 0x6c ||
        op === 0x71 ||
        op === 0x72 ||
        op === 0x73 ||
        op === 0x74 ||
        op === 0x75 ||
        op === 0x76 ||
        op === 0x67 ||
        op === 0x1b) {

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        kind: "op"
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x04 ||
        op === 0x05 ||
        op === 0x0b ||
        op === 0x0c ||
        op === 0x0d) {

      if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          at,
          op,
          kind: "branch",
          depth: x.value
        });
      } else {
        out.push({
          at,
          op,
          kind:
            op === 0x04 ? "if" :
            op === 0x05 ? "else" :
            "end"
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      out.push({
        at,
        op,
        kind: "call",
        target: x.value
      });

      continue;
    }

    out.push({
      at,
      op,
      kind: "unknown"
    });
  }

  return out;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const TARGET = 1795;

function readU32(pos) {
  return wasm.readUInt32LE(pos);
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    result |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: result | 0, next: p };
}

function decode(start, end) {
  let p = start;

  // locals
  const localDeclCountInfo = readULEB(p);
  const localDeclCount = localDeclCountInfo.value;
  p = localDeclCountInfo.next;

  const locals = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
    const nInfo = readULEB(p);
    const n = nInfo.value;
    p = nInfo.next;

    const type = wasm[p++];
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) locals.push(type);
  }

  const params = 5;
  const localTypes = Array(params).fill(0x7f).concat(locals);

  function localName(n) {
    return `local${n}`;
  }

  const ins = [];

  while (p < end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op === 0x0b) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "end" });
      break;
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      ins.push({ at, text: `local.get ${localName(x.value)}` });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      ins.push({ at, text: `local.set ${localName(x.value)}` });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      ins.push({ at, text: `local.tee ${localName(x.value)}` });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = readSLEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      ins.push({ at, text: `i32.const ${x.value}` });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      ins.push({ at, text: `call ${x.value}` });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28) {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        text: `i32.load align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x2d) {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        text: `i32.load8_u align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x36) {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      ins.push({
        at,
        text: `i32.store align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`
      });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6a) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "i32.add" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6b) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "i32.sub" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x71) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "i32.and" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x72) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "i32.or" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x73) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "i32.xor" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x74) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "i32.shl" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x75) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "i32.shr_s" });
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x76) {
      ins.push({ at, text: "i32.shr_u" });
      continue;
    }

    // generic one-byte opcode
    ins.push({ at, text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}` });
  }

  return ins;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

function u32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function i32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }
  }
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

    p = x.next;

      o.value === 0
        ? `MEM[${addr}]`
        : `MEM[${addr}+${o.value}]`;

    push(e);

    print(
      `${hx(off)} i32.load offset=${o.value} : ${addr} -> ${e}`
    );

    continue;
  }

    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    const addr = pop();

    const e =
      o.value === 0
        ? `MEM64[${addr}]`
        : `MEM64[${addr}+${o.value}]`;

    push(e);

    print(
      `${hx(off)} i64.load offset=${o.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // call

    p = x.next;

    print(`${hx(off)} CALL ${x.value}`);

      print("CALL 446 INPUT");
      print("************************************************************");
      print(`ARG0 = ${arg}`);
      print("Expected:");
      print("ARG0 = MEM[local4 + 40]");
      print("************************************************************");
      print("");
    }

    else if (x.value === 248) {

      const a3 = pop();
      const a2 = pop();
      const a1 = pop();

      push(`RET[248]`);

      print(
        `CALL 248 args = [${a1}, ${a2}, ${a3}]`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // local stack-related control
  if (op === 0x45) {

    const a = pop();

    print(`${hx(off)} i32.eqz ${a}`);

    push(`(${a}==0)`);

  }

  if (op === 0x0d) {

    p = x.next;

      `${hx(off)} br_if ${x.value} [${cond}]`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.add
  if (op === 0x6a) {

    const b = pop();
    const a = pop();

    const e = `(${a}+${b})`;

    push(e);

    print(
      `${hx(off)} i32.add -> ${e}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  print(
    `${hx(off)} opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
  );

function readULEB(p) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        v += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return null;
}

function readSLEB(p) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {

            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                v |= (~0 << (shift + 7));
            }

            return {
                value: v | 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    return null;
}

function hx(v) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: result, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {

      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        result |= (~0 << shift);

      return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: pos
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function decode(pos, end) {

  if (pos >= end)
    return null;

  const start = pos;
  const op = buf[pos++];

  const ins = {
    start,
    end: pos,
    op,
    text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
  };

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22
  ) {

    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;
    ins.local = a.value;

    const name =
      op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
      op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
      "local.tee";

    ins.text = `${name} local=${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {

    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;
    ins.callTarget = a.value;
    ins.text = `call ${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2d
  ) {

    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.isLoad = true;

    const name =
      op === 0x28 ? "i32.load" :
      op === 0x29 ? "i64.load" :
      "i32.load8_u";

    ins.text =
      `${name} align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x36) {

    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    ins.end = b.next;
    ins.offset = b.value;
    ins.isStore = true;

    ins.text =
      `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {

    const a = sleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;
    ins.value = a.value;
    ins.text = `i32.const ${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x6a) {
    ins.text = "i32.add";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x6b) {
    ins.text = "i32.sub";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    ins.text = "end";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x05) {
    ins.text = "else";
    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x04) {

    if (pos >= end)
      return null;

    pos++;
    ins.end = pos;
    ins.text = "if";

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03) {

    if (pos >= end)
      return null;

    pos++;
    ins.end = pos;
    ins.text =
      op === 0x02 ? "block" : "loop";

    return ins;
  }

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

    const a = uleb(pos);
    if (!a) return null;

    ins.end = a.next;

    ins.text =
      `${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"} ${a.value}`;

    return ins;
  }

  return ins;
}

 * Locate code section.
 */

while (p < buf.length) {

let totalCalls = 0;
let useful = 0;

for (let func = 0; func < bodyCount; func++) {

  const sizeInfo = uleb(q);
  if (!sizeInfo)
    break;

  const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
  const bodyStart = sizeInfo.next;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

  q = bodyEnd;

  let x = bodyStart;

  const localInfo = uleb(x);
  if (!localInfo)
    continue;

  x = localInfo.next;

  /*
   * Skip local declaration groups.
   */
  let localGroupCount = localInfo.value;

  for (let g = 0; g < localGroupCount; g++) {

    const n = uleb(x);
    if (!n) {
      x = bodyEnd;
      break;
    }

    x = n.next;

    if (x >= bodyEnd)
      break;

    x++;
  }

  const ins = [];

  while (x < bodyEnd) {

    const z = decode(x, bodyEnd);

    if (!z)
      break;

    ins.push(z);
    x = z.end;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {

    if (ins[i].callTarget !== 446)
      continue;

    totalCalls++;

    /*
     * We only care when call 446 is immediately captured.
     */
    if (
      i + 1 >= ins.length ||
      ins[i + 1].text.indexOf("local.tee") !== 0
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    const returnedLocal = ins[i + 1].local;

    const hits = [];

    /*
     * Scan forward until the returned local is overwritten.
     */
    for (
      let j = i + 2;
      j < Math.min(ins.length, i + 80);
      j++
    ) {

      if (
        (ins[j].text === `local.set local=${returnedLocal}`) ||
        (ins[j].text === `local.tee local=${returnedLocal}`)
      ) {
        break;
      }

      if (
        ins[j].isLoad &&
        [0, 4, 36, 128].includes(ins[j].offset)
      ) {

        /*
         * Check whether immediately before the load
         * there is local.get returnedLocal.
         */
        const prev = ins[j - 1];

        if (
          prev &&
          prev.text === `local.get local=${returnedLocal}`
        ) {

          hits.push({
            index: j,
            offset: ins[j].offset
          });
        }
      }

      /*
       * Detect direct call 248 using returned local.
       */
      if (
        ins[j].callTarget === 248 &&
        j >= 1
      ) {

        const from = Math.max(i + 2, j - 8);

        for (let k = from; k < j; k++) {

          if (
            ins[k].text ===
            `local.get local=${returnedLocal}`
          ) {

            hits.push({
              index: j,
              offset: "CALL_248"
            });

            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (hits.length === 0)
      continue;

    useful++;

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("FUNC", func);
    console.log(
      "CALL 446 @",
      hex(ins[i].start)
    );
    console.log(
      "RETURN CAPTURED IN LOCAL",
      returnedLocal
    );
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log("");
    console.log("CALL 446:");
    console.log(
      " ",
      hex(ins[i].start),
      ins[i].text
    );
    console.log(
      " ",
      hex(ins[i + 1].start),
      ins[i + 1].text
    );

    console.log("");
    console.log("CONSUMERS:");

    for (const h of hits) {

      const j = h.index;

      console.log("");
      console.log(
        " ",
        h.offset === "CALL_248"
          ? "FUNC 248"
          : `LOAD +${h.offset}`
      );

      const from = Math.max(i, j - 8);

      for (let k = from; k <= j; k++) {

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readU32(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
        }
        s += 7;
    }
}

function readS32(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {
            if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
                v |= (~0 << (s + 7));
            return { value: v | 0, next: p };
        }

        s += 7;
    }
}

function readVecU32(p) {
    const c = readU32(p);
    p = c.next;

    const arr = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
        const r = readU32(p);
        arr.push(r.value);
        p = r.next;
    }

    return {
        values: arr,
        next: p
    };
}

let p = 8;

let functionTypes = [];

while (p < buf.length) {

    const sectionId = buf[p++];

    const size = readU32(p);
    p = size.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + size.value;

    if (sectionId === 3) {

        const r = readVecU32(p);

        functionTypes = r.values;
    }

        p = count.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

            const bodyStart = p;

            const bs = readU32(p);
            p = bs.next;

            const bodyEnd = p + bs.value;

            const localDecl = readU32(p);
            p = localDecl.next;

            let extraLocals = 0;

            for (let j = 0; j < localDecl.value; j++) {

                const n = readU32(p);
                p = n.next;

                const type = buf[p++];
                extraLocals += n.value;
            }

            functionBodies.push({
                bodyIndex: i,
                start: bodyStart,
                instrStart: p,
                end: bodyEnd,
                extraLocals
            });

            p = bodyEnd;
        }
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
}

                }
            }

            else {
                console.log(
                    "Unhandled element flags:",
                    flags
                );
            }
        }
    }

    p = payloadEnd;
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGET = 4788;
const TARGET_HEX = 0x12b4;

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return { value: v >>> 0, end: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
        v |= (-1 << s);
      }

      return { value: v | 0, end: p };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

let storeHits = [];

for (let p = 0; p < b.length - 2; p++) {
