import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [
    { index: 2053, addr: 0x00189dec, fn: 8952 },
    { index: 2101, addr: 0x00189f9c, fn: 8927 },
    { index: 2612, addr: 0x0018a8b0, fn: 8637 },
];

const SEG412_START = 0x0018744c;
const SEG412_END   = 0x0018ab8d;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32(p: number): number {
    if (p < 0 || p + 4 > bytes.length) return 0;
    return (
        bytes[p] |
        (bytes[p + 1] << 8) |
        (bytes[p + 2] << 16) |
        (bytes[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function in412(v: number): boolean {
    return v >= SEG412_START && v <= SEG412_END;
}

function isLow(v: number): boolean {
    return v < 0x00100000;
}

function isPtr(v: number): boolean {
    return in412(v) || (v >= 0x00100000 && v < 0x00200000);
}

function scanDataPointers(target: number, radius = 0x120) {
    const lo = Math.max(SEG412_START, target - radius);
    const hi = Math.min(SEG412_END, target + radius);

    console.log(`\nTARGET ${hex(target)}`);
    console.log(`WINDOW ${hex(lo)} .. ${hex(hi)}`);

    const hits: Array<{
        src: number;
        value: number;
        delta: number;
    }> = [];

    for (let addr = SEG412_START; addr <= SEG412_END - 4; addr += 4) {
        const file = findMemoryAddress(addr);
        if (file < 0) continue;

        const v = u32(file);

        if (v >= lo && v <= hi) {
            hits.push({
                src: addr,
                value: v,
                delta: v - target,
            });
        }
    }

    for (const h of hits) {
        console.log(
            `${hex(h.src)} -> ${hex(h.value)}  delta=${h.delta >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${h.delta}`
        );
    }

    console.log(`POINTERS INTO WINDOW = ${hits.length}`);

    return hits;
}

/*
 * Build a minimal memory-address -> file-offset map for data segments.
 * We parse the WASM data section directly.
 */
function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (pos < bytes.length) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function findSection(id: number): { payload: number; end: number } {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const sid = bytes[p++];
        const sz = readULEB(p);
        p = sz.next;

        const payload = p;
        const end = payload + sz.value;

        if (sid === id) {
            return { payload, end };
        }

        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
}

type Segment = {
    index: number;
    memoryStart: number;
    fileStart: number;
    size: number;
    fileEnd: number;
};

const dataSegments: Segment[] = [];

function parseDataSegments() {
    const sec = findSection(11);

    let p = sec.payload;

    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const flags = readULEB(p);
        p = flags.next;

        let memoryStart = 0;

        if (flags.value === 0) {
            if (bytes[p++] !== 0x41) {
                throw new Error("Expected i32.const in data offset");
            }

            const off = readULEB(p);
            p = off.next;

            memoryStart = off.value;

            if (bytes[p++] !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error("Expected end opcode in data offset");
            }
        } else if (flags.value === 2) {
            const memidx = readULEB(p);
            p = memidx.next;

            if (bytes[p++] !== 0x41) {
                throw new Error("Expected i32.const in active data offset");
            }

            const off = readULEB(p);
            p = off.next;

            memoryStart = off.value;

            if (bytes[p++] !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error("Expected end opcode in data offset");
            }
        } else {
            if (flags.value === 1) {
                const len = readULEB(p);
                p = len.next;
                p += len.value;
                continue;
            }

            throw new Error(`Unsupported data segment flags=${flags.value}`);
        }

        const len = readULEB(p);
        p = len.next;

        const fileStart = p;

        dataSegments.push({
            index: i,
            memoryStart,
            fileStart,
            size: len.value,
            fileEnd: fileStart + len.value,
        });

        p += len.value;
    }
}

function findMemoryAddress(addr: number): number {
    for (const s of dataSegments) {
        if (
            addr >= s.memoryStart &&
            addr < s.memoryStart + s.size
        ) {
            return s.fileStart + (addr - s.memoryStart);
        }
    }

    return -1;
}

function inspectWord(addr: number): {
    value: number;
    file: number;
} | null {
    const file = findMemoryAddress(addr);

    if (file < 0 || file + 4 > bytes.length) {
        return null;
    }

    return {
        value: u32(file),
        file,
    };
}

/*
 * Trace a bounded pointer graph inside data memory.
 *
 * We deliberately do NOT treat arbitrary integers as pointers.
 * Only values inside known data-memory ranges are followed.
 */
function tracePointerGraph(root: number, depthMax = 4) {
    console.log(`\nROOT GRAPH ${hex(root)}`);

    const seen = new Set<number>();

    function walk(addr: number, depth: number, path: string[]) {
        if (depth > depthMax) return;
        if (seen.has(addr)) return;

        seen.add(addr);

        const info = inspectWord(addr);

        if (!info) {
            console.log(
                `${" ".repeat(depth * 2)}depth ${depth}: ${hex(addr)} -> [not mapped]`
            );
            return;
        }

        const v = info.value;

        console.log(
            `${" ".repeat(depth * 2)}depth ${depth}: ` +
            `${hex(addr)} -> ${v} (${hex(v)})` +
            `${in412(v) ? " -> SEG412" : ""}`
        );

        if (!isPtr(v)) return;

        walk(v, depth + 1, [...path, hex(addr)]);
    }

    walk(root, 0, []);
}

/*
 * Inspect the exact record and identify all pointer-like fields.
 */
function inspectRecord(addr: number, radius = 0x80) {
    const start = Math.max(SEG412_START, addr - radius);
    const end = Math.min(SEG412_END, addr + radius);

    console.log(`\nRECORD ${hex(addr)}`);
    console.log(`RANGE  ${hex(start)} .. ${hex(end)}`);

    for (let p = start; p <= end - 4; p += 4) {
        const info = inspectWord(p);
        if (!info) continue;

        const v = info.value;

        if (p === addr) {
            console.log(
                `${hex(p)} : ${v} ${hex(v)} <<< TARGET`
            );
            continue;
        }

        if (in412(v)) {
            console.log(
                `${hex(p)} : ${v} ${hex(v)} -> SEG412`
            );
        } else if (isLow(v)) {
            console.log(
                `${hex(p)} : ${v} ${hex(v)} -> LOW`
            );
        }
    }
}

/*
 * Search for raw occurrences of target addresses and nearby addresses
 * in the entire WASM. This is intentionally independent of code/data
 * classification and is used only as a cross-check.
 */
function rawAddressSearch(target: number) {
    console.log(`\nRAW ADDRESS SEARCH ${hex(target)}`);

    let count = 0;

    for (let p = 0; p <= bytes.length - 4; p++) {
        if (u32(p) === target) {
            console.log(`file ${hex(p)} -> ${hex(target)}`);
            count++;
        }
    }

    console.log(`TOTAL RAW ADDRESS HITS = ${count}`);
}

/*
 * Search for 32-bit values in the target neighborhood.
 */
function rawNeighborhoodSearch(target: number, radius = 0x100) {
    console.log(`\nRAW NEIGHBORHOOD ADDRESS SEARCH ${hex(target)}`);

    const lo = target - radius;
    const hi = target + radius;

    let count = 0;

    for (let p = 0; p <= bytes.length - 4; p++) {
        const v = u32(p);

        if (v >= lo && v <= hi && in412(v)) {
            console.log(
                `file ${hex(p)} -> ${hex(v)}`
            );
            count++;
        }
    }

    console.log(`TOTAL NEIGHBORHOOD HITS = ${count}`);
}

/*
 * Code-section discovery.
 */
function getCodeSection() {
    return findSection(10);
}

function scanCodeForI32Const(value: number) {
    const sec = getCodeSection();

    console.log(
        `\nCODE CONST SEARCH ${value} ${hex(value)}`
    );

    let hits = 0;

    for (let p = sec.payload; p < sec.end - 5; p++) {
        if (bytes[p] !== 0x41) continue;

        const r = readULEB(p + 1);

        if (r.value === value) {
            console.log(`file ${hex(p)} -> i32.const ${hex(value)}`);
            hits++;
        }
    }

    console.log(`TOTAL CODE CONST HITS = ${hits}`);
}

FILE: scripts\traceBulkCallerArgs.ts

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = new Map<number, string>([
    [480, "memory.fill"],
    [1907, "memory.copy"],
]);

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: pos,
            };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function readBlockType(pos: number) {
    const b = wasm[pos];

    if (b === 0x40)
        return { next: pos + 1 };

    if (
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c
    ) {
        return { next: pos + 1 };
    }

    return readSLEB(pos);
}

function parseCodeSection() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const s = readULEB(p);
        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        if (id !== 10) {
            p = end;
            continue;
        }

        const count = readULEB(p);
        p = count.next;

        const bodies: {
            ordinal: number;
            start: number;
            end: number;
            codeStart: number;
        }[] = [];

        for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
            const bodySize = readULEB(p);
            p = bodySize.next;

            const bodyStart = p;
            const bodyEnd = p + bodySize.value;

            const localCount = readULEB(p);
            p = localCount.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {
                const n = readULEB(p);
                p = n.next;
                p++;
            }

            bodies.push({
                ordinal,
                start: bodyStart,
                end: bodyEnd,
                codeStart: p,
            });

            p = bodyEnd;
        }

        return {
            start,
            end,
            bodies,
        };
    }

    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

type Val =
    | { kind: "const"; value: number }
    | { kind: "local"; index: number }
    | { kind: "global"; index: number }
    | { kind: "unknown" };

function describe(v: Val) {
    if (v.kind === "const")
        return `CONST(${hex(v.value)})`;

    if (v.kind === "local")
        return `LOCAL(${v.index})`;

    if (v.kind === "global")
        return `GLOBAL(${v.index})`;

    return "UNKNOWN";
}

const code = parseCodeSection();

console.log("TRACE BULK CALLER ARGUMENTS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`CODE SECTION = ${hex(code.start)} .. ${hex(code.end)}`);
console.log(`CODE BODIES  = ${code.bodies.length}`);
console.log("");
console.log("TARGETS:");
console.log("  FUNC480  = memory.fill");
console.log("  FUNC1907 = memory.copy");
console.log("============================================================");

let calls = 0;

for (const body of code.bodies) {
    let p = body.codeStart;

    const stack: Val[] = [];

    function pop(): Val {
        if (stack.length === 0)
            return { kind: "unknown" };

        return stack.pop()!;
    }

    function push(v: Val) {
        stack.push(v);
    }

    while (p < body.end) {
        const pc = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        if (op === 0x0b)
            break;

        if (op === 0x01)
            continue;

        if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
            p = readBlockType(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x05)
            continue;

        if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0e) {
            const n = readULEB(p);
            p = n.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
                p = readULEB(p).next;

            p = readULEB(p).next;

            pop();
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0f)
            continue;

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // LOCAL
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x20) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            push({
                kind: "local",
                index: r.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x21) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            pop();
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x22) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            const v = pop();
            push(v);

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // GLOBAL
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x23) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            push({
                kind: "global",
                index: r.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x24) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            pop();
            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // CONST
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = readSLEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            push({
                kind: "const",
                value: r.value >>> 0,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x42) {
            const r = readSLEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            push({
                kind: "unknown",
            });

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // CALL
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            if (TARGETS.has(r.value)) {
                calls++;

                const name = TARGETS.get(r.value)!;

                console.log("");
                console.log("============================================================");
                console.log("BULK CALL");
                console.log("============================================================");
                console.log(`CALLER FUNC = ${body.ordinal}`);
                console.log(`CALL PC     = ${hex(pc)}`);
                console.log(`TARGET FUNC = ${r.value}`);
                console.log(`TARGET      = ${name}`);
                console.log("");
                console.log("STACK BEFORE CALL:");
                
                const start = Math.max(0, stack.length - 8);

                for (let i = start; i < stack.length; i++) {
                    console.log(
                        `  [${i - start}] ${describe(stack[i])}`
                    );
                }

                console.log("");
                console.log("IMPORTANT:");
                console.log("Arguments are shown symbolically.");
                console.log("No WASM execution.");
                console.log("============================================================");
            }

            /*
             * Do not clear stack here.
             * We want to see the exact caller-side argument
             * provenance immediately before the bulk call.
             */
            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // MEMORY LOAD
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
            op >= 0x28 &&
            op <= 0x35
        ) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;

            pop();

            push({
                kind: "unknown",
            });

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // MEMORY STORE
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
            op >= 0x36 &&
            op <= 0x3e
        ) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;

            pop();
            pop();

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // MEMORY.SIZE / GROW
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
            p++;
            push({
                kind: "unknown",
            });
            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // BINARY NUMERIC OPS
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        const binaryOps = new Set([
            0x46, 0x47, 0x48, 0x49, 0x4a, 0x4b,
            0x4c, 0x4d, 0x4e, 0x4f, 0x50, 0x51,
            0x6a, 0x6b, 0x6c, 0x6d, 0x6e, 0x6f,
            0x70, 0x71, 0x72, 0x73, 0x74, 0x75,
            0x76, 0x77, 0x78, 0x79, 0x7a,
            0x7b, 0x7c, 0x7d, 0x7e,
        ]);

        if (binaryOps.has(op)) {
            pop();
            pop();

            push({
                kind: "unknown",
            });

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // UNARY
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
            op === 0x45 ||
            op === 0x67 ||
            op === 0x68 ||
            op === 0x69
        ) {
            pop();

            push({
                kind: "unknown",
            });

            continue;
        }

        // Unknown instruction:
        // leave stack untouched.
    }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BULK CALLS FOUND = ${calls}`);
console.log("");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_START = 0x19534c;
const TARGET_END   = 0x19535c;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value -= 2 ** shift;

    return { value, next: pos };
}

function getCodeSection() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];

        const s = readULEB(p);
        const start = s.next;
        const end = start + s.value;

        if (id === 10)
            return { start, end };

        p = end;
    }

    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

const code = getCodeSection();

interface Body {
    func: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    codeStart: number;
}

const bodies: Body[] = [];

let p = code.start;

const fc = readULEB(p);
p = fc.next;

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < fc.value; ordinal++) {
    const bs = readULEB(p);
    const bodyStart = bs.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bs.value;

    let q = bodyStart;

    const locals = readULEB(q);
    q = locals.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {
        const count = readULEB(q);
        q = count.next;
        q++;
    }

    bodies.push({
        func: ordinal + 83,
        start: bodyStart,
        end: bodyEnd,
        codeStart: q
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
}

const f480 = bodies.find(x => x.func === 480);

if (!f480)
    throw new Error("FUNC480 NOT FOUND");

interface Ins {
    pc: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    imm?: number;
}

const instructions: Ins[] = [];

function decode(pc: number): Ins {
    const op = bytes[pc];

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const r = readULEB(pc + 1);
        return {
            pc,
            op,
            text: `local.get ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const r = readULEB(pc + 1);
        return {
            pc,
            op,
            text: `local.set ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const r = readULEB(pc + 1);
        return {
            pc,
            op,
            text: `local.tee ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = readSLEB(pc + 1);

        return {
            pc,
            op,
            text: `i32.const ${r.value} (${hex(r.value)})`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x6a)
        return { pc, op, text: "i32.add" };

    if (op === 0x6b)
        return { pc, op, text: "i32.sub" };

    if (op === 0x28) {
        const r = readULEB(pc + 2);

        return {
            pc,
            op,
            text: `i32.load offset=${hex(r.value)}`
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x36) {
        const r = readULEB(pc + 2);

        return {
            pc,
            op,
            text: `i32.store offset=${hex(r.value)}`
        };
    }

    if (op === 0xfc) {
        const r = readULEB(pc + 1);

        if (r.value === 10)
            return { pc, op, text: "memory.copy" };

        if (r.value === 11)
            return { pc, op, text: "memory.fill" };

        return { pc, op, text: `0xfc/${r.value}` };
    }

    // Control-flow / simple one-byte instructions.
    return {
        pc,
        op,
        text: `opcode ${hex(op, 2)}`
    };
}

function nextPC(pc: number) {
    const op = bytes[pc];

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
        return readULEB(pc + 1).next;
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        return readSLEB(pc + 1).next;
    }

    if (
        op === 0x28 ||
        op === 0x29 ||
        op === 0x2a ||
        op === 0x2b ||
        op === 0x36 ||
        op === 0x37 ||
        op === 0x38 ||
        op === 0x39
    ) {
        return readULEB(pc + 2).next;
    }

    if (op === 0xfc) {
        return readULEB(pc + 1).next;
    }

    return pc + 1;
}

let q = f480.codeStart;

while (q < f480.end) {
    const ins = decode(q);
    instructions.push(ins);

    const n = nextPC(q);

    if (n <= q)
        q++;
    else
        q = n;
}

function isTarget(v: number) {
    return v >= TARGET_START && v < TARGET_END;
}

function showBackward(local: number, fromIndex: number, depth = 0, seen = new Set<string>()) {
    if (depth > 12)
        return ["MAX_DEPTH"];

    const key = `${local}@${fromIndex}`;

    if (seen.has(key))
        return ["LOOP"];

    seen.add(key);

    const lines: string[] = [];

    for (let i = fromIndex; i >= 0; i--) {
        const x = instructions[i];

        if (
            (x.text === `local.set ${local}` ||
             x.text === `local.tee ${local}`)
        ) {
            lines.push(
                `${" ".repeat(depth * 2)}${hex(x.pc)} ${x.text}`
            );

            const producerIndex = i - 1;

            if (producerIndex >= 0) {
                const prod = instructions[producerIndex];

                lines.push(
                    `${" ".repeat(depth * 2)}  <- ${hex(prod.pc)} ${prod.text}`
                );

                if (
                    prod.text.startsWith("i32.const")
                ) {
                    const v = prod.imm!;

                    if (isTarget(v)) {
                        lines.push(
                            `${" ".repeat(depth * 2)}  >>> TARGET CONSTANT ${hex(v)}`
                        );
                    }
                }

                if (
                    prod.text === "local.get " + local
                ) {
                    lines.push(
                        `${" ".repeat(depth * 2)}  SELF-REFERENCE`
                    );
                }
            }

            break;
        }
    }

    return lines.length ? lines : ["NO LOCAL DEFINITION FOUND"];
}

for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
    const ins = instructions[i];

    if (
        ins.text !== "memory.fill" &&
        ins.text !== "memory.copy"

        continue;

    bulkCount++;

    console.log("");

    /*
     * Immediately preceding stack producers.
     *
     * For this diagnostic we intentionally only identify
     * direct local/constant destination producers.
     */
    const before = instructions.slice(
        Math.max(0, i - 8),
        i
    );

    const gets = before.filter(
        x => x.text.startsWith("local.get ")
    );

    const consts = before.filter(
        x => x.text.startsWith("i32.const ")
    );

    console.log("RECENT:");

    for (const x of before)
        console.log(`${hex(x.pc)} ${x.text}`);

    if (gets.length === 0) {
        console.log("DESTINATION LOCAL = NONE");
        continue;
    }

    /*
     * For fill/copy the first stack operand is destination.
     * The nearest local.get before the bulk op is normally the
     * destination in these compiler-generated patterns.
     */
    const dstGet = gets[0];
    const local = dstGet.imm!;

    console.log(`DESTINATION LOCAL = ${local}`);

    const provenance = showBackward(
        local,
        i - 1
    );

    for (const line of provenance)
        console.log(line);
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x961f0;

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { v: v >>> 0, p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (-1 << s);
  return { v: v | 0, p };
}

      0x20: "local.get",

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 2094;
const TARGET_CALL = 185;

const START = 0x95e67;
const END = 0x96da8;
const CONTEXT = 24;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u8(p: number): number {
  return wasm[p];
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(p++);
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value, next: p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number, bits = 32): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = u8(p++);
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (shift < bits && (b & 0x40)) {
    value -= 2 ** shift;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function bytes(a: number, b: number): string {
  return Array.from(wasm.slice(a, b))
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");
}

function decode(pos: number): {
  next: number;
  text: string;
} {
  const op = u8(pos++);

  switch (op) {
    case 0x00: return { next: pos, text: "unreachable" };
    case 0x01: return { next: pos, text: "nop" };
    case 0x05: return { next: pos, text: "else" };
    case 0x0b: return { next: pos, text: "end" };
    case 0x0f: return { next: pos, text: "return" };

    case 0x02:
    case 0x03:
    case 0x04: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos, 33);
      const name =
        op === 0x02 ? "block" :
        op === 0x03 ? "loop" : "if";
      return { next: x.next, text: `${name} ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x0c:
    case 0x0d: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"} ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x0e: {
      const n = readULEB(pos);
      pos = n.next;

      const labels: number[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
        const x = readULEB(pos);
        pos = x.next;
        labels.push(x.value);
      }

      const d = readULEB(pos);
      pos = d.next;

      return {
        next: pos,
        text: `br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${d.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return { next: x.next, text: `call ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      pos = x.next;

      const t = readULEB(pos);
      pos = t.next;

      return {
        next: pos,
        text: `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${t.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x1a: return { next: pos, text: "drop" };
    case 0x1b: return { next: pos, text: "select" };

    case 0x20:
    case 0x21:
    case 0x22: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);

      const n =
        op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
        op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
        "local.tee";

      return { next: x.next, text: `${n} ${x.value}` };
    }

    case 0x23:
    case 0x24: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);

      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `${op === 0x23 ? "global.get" : "global.set"} ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x28:
    case 0x29:
    case 0x2a:
    case 0x2b:
    case 0x2c:
    case 0x2d:
    case 0x2e:
    case 0x2f:
    case 0x30:
    case 0x31:
    case 0x32:
    case 0x33:
    case 0x34:
    case 0x35:
    case 0x36:
    case 0x37:
    case 0x38:
    case 0x39:
    case 0x3a:
    case 0x3b:
    case 0x3c:
    case 0x3d:
    case 0x3e: {
      const align = readULEB(pos);
      pos = align.next;

      const off = readULEB(pos);
      pos = off.next;

      const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2a: "f32.load",
        0x2b: "f64.load",
        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
        0x30: "i64.load8_s",
        0x31: "i64.load8_u",
        0x32: "i64.load16_s",
        0x33: "i64.load16_u",
        0x34: "i64.load32_s",
        0x35: "i64.load32_u",
        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",
        0x38: "f32.store",
        0x39: "f64.store",
        0x3a: "i32.store8",
        0x3b: "i32.store16",
        0x3c: "i64.store8",
        0x3d: "i64.store16",
        0x3e: "i64.store32",
      };

      return {
        next: pos,
        text:
          `${names[op]} ` +
          `align=${align.value} offset=${off.value} (${hex(off.value)})`,
      };
    }

    case 0x3f:
    case 0x40: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `${op === 0x3f ? "memory.size" : "memory.grow"} ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos, 32);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos, 64);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x45: return { next: pos, text: "i32.eqz" };
    case 0x46: return { next: pos, text: "i32.eq" };
    case 0x47: return { next: pos, text: "i32.ne" };
    case 0x48: return { next: pos, text: "i32.lt_s" };
    case 0x49: return { next: pos, text: "i32.lt_u" };
    case 0x4a: return { next: pos, text: "i32.gt_s" };
    case 0x4b: return { next: pos, text: "i32.gt_u" };
    case 0x4c: return { next: pos, text: "i32.le_s" };
    case 0x4d: return { next: pos, text: "i32.le_u" };
    case 0x4e: return { next: pos, text: "i32.ge_s" };
    case 0x4f: return { next: pos, text: "i32.ge_u" };

    case 0x50: return { next: pos, text: "i64.eqz" };
    case 0x51: return { next: pos, text: "i64.eq" };
    case 0x52: return { next: pos, text: "i64.ne" };
    case 0x53: return { next: pos, text: "i64.lt_s" };
    case 0x54: return { next: pos, text: "i64.lt_u" };
    case 0x55: return { next: pos, text: "i64.gt_s" };
    case 0x56: return { next: pos, text: "i64.gt_u" };
    case 0x57: return { next: pos, text: "i64.le_s" };
    case 0x58: return { next: pos, text: "i64.le_u" };
    case 0x59: return { next: pos, text: "i64.ge_s" };
    case 0x5a: return { next: pos, text: "i64.ge_u" };

    case 0x6a: return { next: pos, text: "i32.add" };
    case 0x6b: return { next: pos, text: "i32.sub" };
    case 0x6c: return { next: pos, text: "i32.mul" };
    case 0x6d: return { next: pos, text: "i32.div_s" };
    case 0x6e: return { next: pos, text: "i32.div_u" };
    case 0x71: return { next: pos, text: "i32.and" };
    case 0x72: return { next: pos, text: "i32.or" };
    case 0x73: return { next: pos, text: "i32.xor" };
    case 0x74: return { next: pos, text: "i32.shl" };
    case 0x75: return { next: pos, text: "i32.shr_s" };
    case 0x76: return { next: pos, text: "i32.shr_u" };

    case 0x7c: return { next: pos, text: "i64.add" };
    case 0x7d: return { next: pos, text: "i64.sub" };
    case 0x7e: return { next: pos, text: "i64.mul" };
    case 0x7f: return { next: pos, text: "i64.div_s" };
    case 0x80: return { next: pos, text: "i64.div_u" };
    case 0x81: return { next: pos, text: "i64.rem_s" };
    case 0x82: return { next: pos, text: "i64.rem_u" };
    case 0x83: return { next: pos, text: "i64.and" };
    case 0x84: return { next: pos, text: "i64.or" };
    case 0x85: return { next: pos, text: "i64.xor" };
    case 0x86: return { next: pos, text: "i64.shl" };
    case 0x87: return { next: pos, text: "i64.shr_s" };
    case 0x88: return { next: pos, text: "i64.shr_u" };

    case 0xad:
      return { next: pos, text: "i64.extend_i32_u" };

    case 0xac:
      return { next: pos, text: "i64.extend_i32_s" };

    default:
      return {
        next: pos,
        text: `UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      };
  }
}

function parseSections() {
  const out: any[] = [];
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const start = p;
    const id = u8(p++);

    const sz = readULEB(p);
    p = sz.next;

    out.push({
      id,
      start,
      payloadStart: p,
      payloadEnd: p + sz.value,
      size: sz.value,
    });

    p += sz.value;
  }

  return out;
}

        p = max.next;
      }

      p += 2;
    }
  }
}

function replaceExactlyOnce(input, search, replacement, label) {
    const first = input.indexOf(search);

    if (first < 0 || input.indexOf(search, first + search.length) >= 0) {
        throw new Error(`Expected exactly one replacement point: ${label}`);
    }

    return input.slice(0, first) +
        replacement +
        input.slice(first + search.length);
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 2057;
const CALL_OFFSETS = [
  0x00100fff,
  0x001015ac,
  0x00101759
];

function readULEB(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let n = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    n++;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35)
      return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/*
 * Parse code section and locate function bodies.
 */
function parseCodeSection() {

  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {

    const sectionId = b[p++];

    const sr = readULEB(p);
    if (!sr) break;

    const sectionSize = sr.value;
    const sectionStart = p + sr.len;
    const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 10) {

      let q = sectionStart;

      const cr = readULEB(q);
      if (!cr) return [];

      const count = cr.value;
      q += cr.len;

      const funcs = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

        const br = readULEB(q);
        if (!br) break;

        const bodySize = br.value;
        q += br.len;

        const bodyStart = q;
        const bodyEnd = q + bodySize;

        funcs.push({
          func: i + 100, // corrected below using imported count
          start: bodyStart,
          end: bodyEnd
        });

        q = bodyEnd;
      }

      return funcs;
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
  }

  return [];
}

/*
 * Get imported function count.
 */
function getImportedFunctionCount() {

  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {

    const sectionId = b[p++];

    const sr = readULEB(p);
    if (!sr) break;

    const sectionSize = sr.value;
    const sectionStart = p + sr.len;
    const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 2) {

      let q = sectionStart;

      const r = readULEB(q);
      if (!r) return 0;

      const count = r.value;
      q += r.len;

      let funcs = 0;

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

        const ml = readULEB(q);
        q += ml.len;

        const fl = readULEB(q);
        q += fl.len;

        const kl = readULEB(q);
        q += kl.len;

        // import kind:
        // 0=function
        // 1=table
        // 2=memory
        // 3=global

        if (kl.value === 0) {

          const typeIndex = readULEB(q);
          q += typeIndex.len;

          funcs++;
        }
        else if (kl.value === 1) {

          const elemType = b[q++];

          const flags = readULEB(q);
          q += flags.len;

          if (flags.value & 1) {
            const a = readULEB(q);
            q += a.len;
          }

          const initial = readULEB(q);
          q += initial.len;

        }
        else if (kl.value === 2) {

          const flags = readULEB(q);
          q += flags.len;

          const initial = readULEB(q);
          q += initial.len;

          if (flags.value & 1) {
            const maximum = readULEB(q);
            q += maximum.len;
          }

        }
        else if (kl.value === 3) {

          q += 2;
        }
      }

      return funcs;
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
  }

  return 0;
}

const importedCount = getImportedFunctionCount();
const bodies = parseCodeSection();

for (const x of bodies)
  x.func += importedCount;

function findFunction(offset) {
  return bodies.find(x => offset >= x.start && offset < x.end);
}

        text += `  local.tee ${r.value}`;
        p += r.len;
      }
    }
    else if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (r) {
        text += `  i32.const ${r.value} (${hex(r.value)})`;
        p += r.len;
      }
    }
    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (r) {
        text += `  call ${r.value}`;
        p += r.len;
      }
    }
    else if (op === 0x28) {
      if (p + 1 < b.length) {
        const align = b[p++];
        const r = readULEB(p);
        if (r) {
          text += `  i32.load align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;
          p += r.len;
        }
      }
    }
    else if (op === 0x36) {
      if (p + 1 < b.length) {
        const align = b[p++];
        const r = readULEB(p);
        if (r) {
          text += `  i32.store align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;
          p += r.len;
        }
      }
    }
    else if (op === 0x6a) {
      text += "  i32.add";
    }
    else if (op === 0x6b) {
      text += "  i32.sub";
    }
    else if (op === 0x74) {
      text += "  i32.shl";
    }
    else if (op === 0x76) {
      text += "  i32.shr_u";
    }
    else if (op === 0x45) {
      text += "  i32.eqz";
    }
    else if (op === 0x0d) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (r) {
        text += `  br_if ${r.value}`;
        p += r.len;
      }
    }
    else if (op === 0x0c) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (r) {
        text += `  br ${r.value}`;
        p += r.len;
      }
    }
    else if (op === 0x0b) {
      text += "  end";
    }
    else if (op === 0x02) {
      text += `  block 0x${b[p].toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      p++;
    }
    else if (op === 0x04) {
      text += `  if 0x${b[p].toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      p++;
    }
    else if (op === 0x05) {
      text += "  else";
    }
    else {
      text += `  opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
    }

    console.log(text);
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log("DONE");
console.log("=".repeat(72));

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 2094;

const STORES = [

console.log("============================================================");

const bytes = new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(WASM));

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; end: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, end: p };
}

function sleb32(pos: number): { value: number; end: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        end: p,
    };
}

function readSections() {
    let p = 8;

    let codeStart = 0;
    let codeEnd = 0;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];

        const s = uleb(p);
        p = s.end;

        const payload = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        if (id === 10) {
            codeStart = payload;
            codeEnd = end;
        }

        p = end;
    }

    return { codeStart, codeEnd };
}

function importedFunctions(): number {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const id = bytes[p++];

        const s = uleb(p);
        p = s.end;

        const end = p + s.value;

        if (id !== 2) {
            p = end;
            continue;
        }

        let q = p;

        const count = uleb(q);
        q = count.end;

        let n = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

            const ml = uleb(q);
            q = ml.end + ml.value;

            const nl = uleb(q);
            q = nl.end + nl.value;

            const kind = bytes[q++];

            if (kind === 0) {
                const t = uleb(q);
                q = t.end;
                n++;
            } else if (kind === 1) {
                q += 4;
            } else if (kind === 2) {
                q += 1;
            } else if (kind === 3) {
                q += 2;
            }
        }

        return n;
    }

    return 0;
}

function getBody(func: number) {

    const sec = readSections();

    const imported = importedFunctions();

    const bodyIndex = func - imported;

    let p = sec.codeStart;

    const count = uleb(p);
    p = count.end;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

        const s = uleb(p);

        const bodyStart = s.end;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + s.value;

        if (i === bodyIndex) {
            return {
                bodyStart,
                bodyEnd,
                imported,
            };
        }

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    throw new Error("Function body not found");
}

function decode(pc: number) {

    const op = bytes[pc];

    let p = pc + 1;

    switch (op) {

        case 0x20: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = sleb32(p);
            return {
                text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x42: {
            while (bytes[p++] & 0x80) {}

            return {
                text: "i64.const",
                end: p,
            };
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const x = uleb(p);

            return {
                text: `call ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x28:
        case 0x29:
        case 0x2a:
        case 0x2b:
        case 0x36:
        case 0x37:
        case 0x38:
        case 0x39: {

            const a = uleb(p);
            const o = uleb(a.end);

            return {
                text:
                    `memory-op 0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
                    `offset=${o.value}`,
                end: o.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x6a:
            return { text: "i32.add", end: p };

        case 0x6b:
            return { text: "i32.sub", end: p };

        case 0x0b:
            return { text: "end", end: p };

        case 0x0c: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `br ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const x = uleb(p);
            return {
                text: `br_if ${x.value}`,
                end: x.end,
            };
        }

        case 0x02:
        case 0x03:
        case 0x04: {

            const bt = bytes[p++];

            const name =
                op === 0x02 ? "block" :
                op === 0x03 ? "loop" :
                "if";

            return {
                text:
                    `${name} blocktype=0x${bt.toString(16)}`,
                end: p,
            };
        }

        default:
            return {
                text:
                    `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
                end: p,
            };
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x012200;
const END   = 0x01295b;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(pos: number, bits: number): {
    value: bigint;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (
                shift + 7n < BigInt(bits) &&
                (b & 0x40)
            ) {
                value |=
                    (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }

    throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    const o = uleb(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: o.value,
        next: o.next
    };
}

interface Ins {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    kind: string;
    local?: number;
    offset?: number;
    call?: number;
}

function decode(pos: number): Ins {
    const start = pos;
    const op = buf[pos++];

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = uleb(pos);
        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.get",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = uleb(pos);
        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.set",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(pos);
        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
            kind: "local.tee",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = sleb(pos, 32);
        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
            kind: "i32.const"
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = sleb(pos, 64);
        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
            kind: "i64.const"
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = uleb(pos);
        return {
            start,
            end: x.next,
            op,
            text: `call ${x.value}`,
            kind: "call",
            call: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 || op === 0x36 || op === 0x37) {
        const m = memarg(pos);

        let name = `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`;

        if (op === 0x28)
            name = "i32.load";

        if (op === 0x29)
            name = "i64.load";

        if (op === 0x36)
            name = "i32.store";

        if (op === 0x37)
            name = "i64.store";

        return {
            start,
            end: m.next,
            op,
            text: `${name} offset=${m.offset}`,
            kind: name,
            offset: m.offset
        };
    }

    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",

        0x83: "i64.and",
        0x84: "i64.or",
        0x86: "i64.shl",
        0x88: "i64.shr_u",

        0x50: "i64.eqz",
        0x54: "i64.lt_u",
        0x55: "i64.gt_u",
        0x56: "i64.le_u",

        0xad: "i64.extend32_s",
        0xac: "i64.extend_i32_u"
    };

    return {
        start,
        end: pos,
        op,
        text:
            names[op] ??
            `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        kind: "other"
    };
}

const ins: Ins[] = [];

let p = START;

while (p < END) {
    const x = decode(p);
    ins.push(x);
    p = x.end;
}

if (p !== END) {
    throw new Error(
        `Decode mismatch: ${p.toString(16)} != ${END.toString(16)}`
    );
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" +
        n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Address symbolic expressions
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

type Expr = string;

const stack: Expr[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, Expr>();

function push(x: Expr) {
    stack.push(x);
}

function pop(): Expr {
    if (!stack.length)
        return "STACK_UNDERFLOW";

    return stack.pop()!;
}

function pop2(): [Expr, Expr] {
    const b = pop();
    const a = pop();
    return [a, b];
}

function normalizeAddress(x: Expr): Expr {
    /*
     * Convert common equivalent forms into one canonical form.
     */
    x = x.replace(/\s+/g, "");

    x = x.replace(
        /^\(local2-(-?\d+)\)$/,
        "local2+$1"
    );

    x = x.replace(
        /^\(local2\+(-?\d+)\)$/,
        "local2+$1"
    );

    return x;
}

function addressOffset(x: Expr): number | null {
    x = normalizeAddress(x);

    if (x === "local2")
        return 0;

    const m =
        /^local2\+(-?\d+)$/.exec(x);

    if (!m)
        return null;

    return Number(m[1]);
}

function addAddress(
    a: Expr,
    b: Expr,
    subtract = false
): Expr {
    /*
     * local2 +/- constant
     */
    const ao = addressOffset(a);
    const bo = addressOffset(b);

    if (ao !== null) {
        const n = Number(b);

        if (Number.isFinite(n)) {
            return `local2+${ao + (subtract ? -n : n)}`;
        }
    }

    if (bo !== null) {
        const n = Number(a);

        if (Number.isFinite(n)) {
            return `local2+${bo + (subtract ? n : n)}`;
        }
    }

    return subtract
        ? `(${a}-${b})`
        : `(${a}+${b})`;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Important known address events
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

interface Event {
    at: number;
    type: string;
    address: string;
    offset: number | null;
    detail: string;
}

const events: Event[] = [];

function event(
    at: number,
    type: string,
    address: string,
    detail: string
) {
    events.push({
        at,
        type,
        address: normalizeAddress(address),
        offset: addressOffset(address),
        detail
    });
}

/*
 * We are particularly interested in:
 *
 *   CALL #26 destination
 *   loads/stores at +432 / +440
 *   all addresses around the second half
 */
let call26Dest = "";
let call26At = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
    const x = ins[i];

    switch (x.kind) {
        case "local.get": {
            push(
                locals.get(x.local!) ??
                `local${x.local!}`
            );
            break;
        }

        case "local.set": {
            const v = pop();
            locals.set(x.local!, v);
            break;
        }

        case "local.tee": {
            const v =
                stack.length
                    ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                    : "STACK_UNDERFLOW";

            locals.set(x.local!, v);
            break;
        }

        case "i32.const": {
            const value =
                x.text.substring("i32.const ".length);

            push(value);
            break;
        }

        case "i64.const": {
            const value =
                x.text.substring("i64.const ".length);

            push(`i64:${value}`);
            break;
        }

        case "i32.load": {
            const [base] = [pop()];

            push(
                `LOAD32(${normalizeAddress(base)}+${x.offset ?? 0})`
            );

            break;
        }

        case "i64.load": {
            const base = pop();

            const addr =
                addressOffset(base) !== null
                    ? `local2+${(addressOffset(base) ?? 0) + (x.offset ?? 0)}`
                    : `(${base}+${x.offset ?? 0})`;

            event(
                x.start,
                "LOAD",
                addr,
                x.text
            );

            push(
                `MEM64[${normalizeAddress(addr)}]`
            );

            break;
        }

        case "i32.store": {
            const value = pop();
            const base = pop();

            const addr =
                addressOffset(base) !== null
                    ? `local2+${(addressOffset(base) ?? 0) + (x.offset ?? 0)}`
                    : `(${base}+${x.offset ?? 0})`;

            event(
                x.start,
                "STORE32",
                addr,
                `value=${value}`
            );

            break;
        }

        case "i64.store": {
            const value = pop();
            const base = pop();

            const addr =
                addressOffset(base) !== null
                    ? `local2+${(addressOffset(base) ?? 0) + (x.offset ?? 0)}`
                    : `(${base}+${x.offset ?? 0})`;

            event(
                x.start,
                "STORE",
                addr,
                `value=${value}`
            );

            break;
        }

        case "call": {
            if (x.call !== 87)
                break;

            /*
             * Function 87:
             *
             * destination, A, zero, B, zero
             */
            const zero2 = pop();
            const B = pop();
            const zero1 = pop();
            const A = pop();
            const destination = pop();

            if (x.start === 0x0126b4) {
                call26At = x.start;
                call26Dest =
                    normalizeAddress(destination);

                console.log(
                    "\n============================================================"
                );

                console.log(
                    "CALL #26 DESTINATION PROVENANCE"
                );

                console.log(
                    "============================================================"
                );

                console.log(
                    `CALL @ ${hex(x.start)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `destination expression = ${destination}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `normalized             = ${call26Dest}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `resolved offset        = ${
                        addressOffset(call26Dest)
                    }`
                );

                console.log(
                    `A = ${A}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `B = ${B}`
                );
            }

            /*
             * Function 87 returns nothing.
             */
            break;
        }

        case "other": {
            if (
                x.text === "i32.add" ||
                x.text === "i32.sub"
            ) {
                const [a, b] = pop2();

                /*
                 * i32 arithmetic is used for addresses.
                 */
                if (x.text === "i32.add") {
                    const ao = addressOffset(a);

                    if (
                        ao !== null &&
                        /^-?\d+$/.test(b)
                    ) {
                        push(
                            `local2+${ao + Number(b)}`
                        );
                    } else {
                        push(
                            `(${a}+${b})`
                        );
                    }
                } else {
                    const ao = addressOffset(a);

                    if (
                        ao !== null &&
                        /^-?\d+$/.test(b)
                    ) {
                        push(
                            `local2+${ao - Number(b)}`
                        );
                    } else {
                        push(
                            `(${a}-${b})`
                        );
                    }
                }

                break;
            }

            if (
                x.text === "i64.add" ||
                x.text === "i64.sub" ||
                x.text === "i64.mul" ||
                x.text === "i64.and" ||
                x.text === "i64.or" ||
                x.text === "i64.shl" ||
                x.text === "i64.shr_u"
            ) {
                const [a, b] = pop2();

                push(
                    `(${a} ${x.text.replace("i64.", "")} ${b})`
                );

                break;
            }

            if (
                x.text === "i64.lt_u" ||
                x.text === "i64.gt_u" ||
                x.text === "i64.le_u"
            ) {
                const [a, b] = pop2();

                push(
                    `(${a} ${x.text.replace("i64.", "")} ${b})`
                );

                break;
            }

            if (
                x.text === "i64.extend32_s" ||
                x.text === "i64.extend_i32_u"
            ) {
                const a = pop();

                push(
                    `${x.text}(${a})`
                );

                break;
            }

            if (x.text === "i64.eqz") {
                const a = pop();

                push(
                    `eqz(${a})`
                );

                break;
            }

            /*
             * Unknown opcode:
             *
             * We deliberately don't fabricate stack effects.
             */
            break;
        }
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const START = 0x01226d;
const END   = 0x01295b;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) return { value, next: pos };
        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error(`ULEB overflow @ 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
}

function readSLEB(pos: number, bits: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift + 7n < BigInt(bits) && (b & 0x40)) {
                result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }
            return { value: result, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }

    throw new Error(`SLEB overflow @ 0x${pos.toString(16)}`);
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: o.value,
        next: o.next
    };
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

interface Ins {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    kind: string;
    local?: number;
    offset?: number;
    call?: number;
}

function decode(pos: number): Ins {
    const start = pos;
    const op = buf[pos++];

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = readULEB(pos);
        return {
            start, end: x.next, op,
            text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
            kind: "get",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = readULEB(pos);
        return {
            start, end: x.next, op,
            text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
            kind: "set",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = readULEB(pos);
        return {
            start, end: x.next, op,
            text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
            kind: "tee",
            local: x.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = readSLEB(pos, 32);
        return {
            start, end: x.next, op,
            text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
            kind: "const"
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = readSLEB(pos, 64);
        return {
            start, end: x.next, op,
            text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
            kind: "const"
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = readULEB(pos);
        return {
            start, end: x.next, op,
            text: `call ${x.value}`,
            kind: "call",
            call: x.value
        };
    }

    if (
        op === 0x29 ||
        op === 0x2f ||
        op === 0x37
    ) {
        const m = memarg(pos);

        const name =
            op === 0x29 ? "i64.load" :
            op === 0x2f ? "i64.load32_u" :
            "i64.store";

        return {
            start,
            end: m.next,
            op,
            text: `${name} align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`,
            kind: name,
            offset: m.offset
        };
    }

    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x0b: "end",
        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",
        0x80: "i64.div_u",
        0x83: "i64.and",
        0x84: "i64.or",
        0x86: "i64.shl",
        0x88: "i64.shr_u",
        0x54: "i64.lt_u",
        0x55: "i64.ne",
        0x56: "i64.gt_u",
        0x57: "i64.le_u",
        0x50: "i64.eqz",
        0x7f: "i64.extend_i32_u",
        0xad: "i64.extend32_s"
    };

    return {
        start,
        end: pos,
        op,
        text: names[op] ?? `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
        kind: "other"
    };
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

/*
 * Function 122
 *
 * Function body starts at:
 *   0x1226d
 *
 * Local declarations:
 *   0x1226d  02        -> 2 local-declaration groups
 *   0x1226e  03 7f     -> 3 x i32
 *   0x12270  25 7e     -> 37 x i64
 *
 * Therefore the first REAL instruction is:
 *   0x12272
 *
 * Function end:
 *   0x1295c
 */

const START = 0x00012272;
const END   = 0x0001295c;

const CALL26 = 0x000126b4;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
    return n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(`ULEB too long at 0x${hex(pos)}`);
        }
    }

    throw new Error(`EOF in ULEB at 0x${hex(pos)}`);
}

function sleb(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let p = pos;
    let byte = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        byte = wasm[p++];

        result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if ((byte & 0x40) !== 0 && shift < 64n) {
                result |= (-1n) << shift;
            }

            return { value: result, next: p };
        }

        if (shift >= 70n) {
            throw new Error(`SLEB too long at 0x${hex(pos)}`);
        }
    }

    throw new Error(`EOF in SLEB at 0x${hex(pos)}`);
}

function memarg(pos: number): {
    align: number;
    offset: number;
    next: number;
} {
    const a = uleb(pos);
    const o = uleb(a.next);

    return {
        align: a.value,
        offset: o.value,
        next: o.next
    };
}

function decodeInstruction(pos: number): {
    op: number;
    next: number;
    name: string;
    immediate?: number | bigint;
    memOffset?: number;
    localIndex?: number;
    globalIndex?: number;
    functionIndex?: number;
} {
    const op = wasm[pos];

    if (op === undefined) {
        throw new Error(`EOF at 0x${hex(pos)}`);
    }

    let p = pos + 1;

    const simple: Record<number, string> = {
        0x00: "unreachable",
        0x01: "nop",

        0x05: "else",
        0x0b: "end",
        0x0f: "return",

        0x1a: "drop",
        0x1b: "select",

        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",

        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",

        0x30: "i64.load8_s",
        0x31: "i64.load8_u",
        0x32: "i64.load16_s",
        0x33: "i64.load16_u",
        0x34: "i64.load32_s",
        0x35: "i64.load32_u",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",

        0x3a: "i32.store8",
        0x3b: "i32.store16",
        0x3e: "i64.store32",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",
        0x48: "i32.lt_s",
        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

        0x50: "i64.eqz",
        0x51: "i64.eq",
        0x52: "i64.ne",
        0x53: "i64.lt_s",
        0x54: "i64.lt_u",
        0x55: "i64.gt_s",
        0x56: "i64.gt_u",
        0x57: "i64.le_s",
        0x58: "i64.le_u",
        0x59: "i64.ge_s",
        0x5a: "i64.ge_u",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",
        0x6d: "i32.div_s",
        0x6e: "i32.div_u",

        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",
        0x74: "i32.shr_s",
        0x75: "i32.shr_u",

        0x7c: "i64.add",
        0x7d: "i64.sub",
        0x7e: "i64.mul",
        0x7f: "i64.div_s",
        0x80: "i64.div_u",
        0x81: "i64.rem_s",
        0x82: "i64.rem_u",
        0x83: "i64.and",
        0x84: "i64.or",
        0x85: "i64.xor",
        0x86: "i64.shl",
        0x87: "i64.shr_s",
        0x88: "i64.shr_u",
        0x89: "i64.rotl",
        0x8a: "i64.rotr",

        0xad: "i64.extend_i32_u",
        0xac: "i64.extend_i32_s"
    };

    /*
     * block / loop / if
     */
    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
        const x = sleb(p);

        return {
            op,
            next: x.next,
            name:
                op === 0x02
                    ? "block"
                    : op === 0x03
                        ? "loop"
                        : "if",
            immediate: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * br / br_if
     */
    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
        const x = uleb(p);

        return {
            op,
            next: x.next,
            name: op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if",
            immediate: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * br_table
     */
    if (op === 0x0e) {
        const count = uleb(p);

        let q = count.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
            const x = uleb(q);
            q = x.next;
        }

        const def = uleb(q);

        return {
            op,
            next: def.next,
            name: "br_table",
            immediate: def.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * call
     */
    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = uleb(p);

        return {
            op,
            next: x.next,
            name: "call",
            functionIndex: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * local.get / local.set / local.tee
     */
    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(p);

        return {
            op,
            next: x.next,
            name:
                op === 0x20
                    ? "local.get"
                    : op === 0x21
                        ? "local.set"
                        : "local.tee",
            localIndex: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * global.get / global.set
     */
    if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
        const x = uleb(p);

        return {
            op,
            next: x.next,
            name: op === 0x23 ? "global.get" : "global.set",
            globalIndex: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * Memory instructions
     */
    if (
        op >= 0x28 &&
        op <= 0x3e
    ) {
        const m = memarg(p);

        return {
            op,
            next: m.next,
            name: simple[op] ?? `opcode 0x${hex(op, 2)}`,
            memOffset: m.offset
        };
    }

    /*
     * i32.const
     */
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = sleb(p);

        return {
            op,
            next: x.next,
            name: "i32.const",
            immediate: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * i64.const
     */
    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = sleb(p);

        return {
            op,
            next: x.next,
            name: "i64.const",
            immediate: x.value
        };
    }

    /*
     * Everything else in the verified Function 122 stream
     * must be one of the simple opcodes above.
     */
    if (simple[op]) {
        return {
            op,
            next: p,
            name: simple[op]
        };
    }

    throw new Error(
        `UNKNOWN OPCODE 0x${hex(op, 2)} at 0x${hex(pos)}`
    );
}

interface Instr {
    addr: number;
    next: number;
    op: number;
    name: string;
    local?: number;
    global?: number;
    functionIndex?: number;
    memOffset?: number;
    immediate?: number | bigint;
}

const instructions: Instr[] = [];

let pos = START;

while (pos < END) {
    const d = decodeInstruction(pos);

    instructions.push({
        addr: pos,
        next: d.next,
        op: d.op,
        name: d.name,
        local: d.localIndex,
        global: d.globalIndex,
        functionIndex: d.functionIndex,
        memOffset: d.memOffset,
        immediate: d.immediate
    });

    pos = d.next;
}

if (pos !== END) {
    throw new Error(
        `Decoder end mismatch: 0x${hex(pos)} != 0x${hex(END)}`
    );
}
