import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x0019534c;
const VALUE = 0x000012b4;

function hex(v: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function findSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];

    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return {
        start,
        end,
        size: size.value,
      };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

function readInitExpr(pos: number) {
  const start = pos;
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  /*
   * Expected:
   *   i32.const <value>
   *   end
   */

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = readSleb(pos);
    pos = x.next;

    const end = wasm[pos++];

    return {
      start,
      next: pos,
      kind: "i32.const",
      value: x.value >>> 0,
      end,
    };
  }

  /*
   * global.get
   */
  if (op === 0x23) {
    const x = readUleb(pos);
    pos = x.next;

    const end = wasm[pos++];

    return {
      start,
      next: pos,
      kind: "global.get",
      value: x.value >>> 0,
      end,
    };
  }

  /*
   * Unknown init expression.
   * Scan until END.
   */
  while (pos < wasm.length) {
    if (wasm[pos++] === 0x0b) {
      break;
    }
  }

  return {
    start,
    next: pos,
    kind: "unknown",
    value: 0,
    end: 0,
  };
}

console.log("TRACE DATA SEGMENTS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET MEMORY = ${hex(TARGET)}`);
console.log(`TARGET VALUE  = ${hex(VALUE)}`);
console.log("============================================================");

const data = findSection(11);

if (!data) {
  console.log("DATA SECTION NOT FOUND");
  process.exit(0);
}

let p = data.start;

const count = readUleb(p);
p = count.next;

console.log(`DATA SEGMENT COUNT = ${count.value}`);
console.log("");

let targetSegments = 0;
let valueSegments = 0;

for (let seg = 0; seg < count.value; seg++) {
  const segStart = p;

  const flags = readUleb(p);
  p = flags.next;

  /*
   * MVP active segment:
   *
   * flags = 0
   * memory index implicit 0
   * offset expression follows
   *
   * flags = 2
   * memory index follows
   * offset expression follows
   *
   * passive = 1
   */
  let memoryIndex = 0;
  let offsetExpr: any = null;

  if (flags.value === 0) {
    offsetExpr = readInitExpr(p);
    p = offsetExpr.next;
  } else if (flags.value === 2) {
    const mi = readUleb(p);
    memoryIndex = mi.value;
    p = mi.next;

    offsetExpr = readInitExpr(p);
    p = offsetExpr.next;
  } else if (flags.value === 1) {
    /*
     * Passive data segment:
     * no runtime linear-memory initialization offset.
     */
    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = p + size.value;

    let foundValue = false;

    for (let q = payloadStart; q + 4 <= payloadEnd; q++) {
      const v =
        wasm[q] |
        (wasm[q + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[q + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[q + 3] << 24);

      if ((v >>> 0) === VALUE) {
        foundValue = true;
        console.log(
          `PASSIVE SEGMENT #${seg} ` +
          `contains 0x12B4 @ file ${hex(q)}`
        );
        valueSegments++;
      }
    }

    p = payloadEnd;

    continue;
  } else {
    console.log(
      `SEGMENT #${seg}: unsupported flags=${flags.value}`
    );

    /*
     * Cannot safely continue without knowing format.
     */
    break;
  }

  const sizeInfo = readUleb(p);
  p = sizeInfo.next;

  const payloadStart = p;
  const payloadEnd = p + sizeInfo.value;

  /*
   * Search payload for 0x12B4.
   */
  const hits: number[] = [];

  for (let q = payloadStart; q + 4 <= payloadEnd; q++) {
    const v =
      wasm[q] |
      (wasm[q + 1] << 8) |
      (wasm[q + 2] << 16) |
      (wasm[q + 3] << 24);

    if ((v >>> 0) === VALUE) {
      hits.push(q);
    }
  }

  /*
   * Search whether the segment itself starts at TARGET.
   */
  let exactTarget = false;

  if (
    offsetExpr &&
    offsetExpr.kind === "i32.const" &&
    offsetExpr.value === TARGET
  ) {
    exactTarget = true;
  }

  if (hits.length > 0 || exactTarget) {
    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`DATA SEGMENT #${seg}`);
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`SEGMENT FLAGS = ${flags.value}`);
    console.log(`MEMORY INDEX  = ${memoryIndex}`);
    console.log(
      `OFFSET EXPR  = ${offsetExpr?.kind ?? "unknown"}`
    );

    if (offsetExpr?.value !== undefined) {
      console.log(
        `OFFSET VALUE  = ${hex(offsetExpr.value)}`
      );
    }

    console.log(`PAYLOAD FILE  = ${hex(payloadStart)}`);
    console.log(`PAYLOAD SIZE  = ${sizeInfo.value}`);

    if (exactTarget) {
      console.log("");
      console.log(">>> EXACT TARGET INITIALIZATION <<<");
      console.log(
        `RUNTIME ADDRESS = ${hex(TARGET)}`
      );
      targetSegments++;
    }

    if (hits.length > 0) {
      console.log("");
      console.log("0x12B4 PAYLOAD HITS:");

      for (const q of hits) {
        const runtime =
          offsetExpr?.kind === "i32.const"
            ? (
                offsetExpr.value +
                (q - payloadStart)
              ) >>> 0
            : null;

        console.log(
          `FILE ${hex(q)}`
          +
          (runtime !== null
            ? ` -> RUNTIME ${hex(runtime)}`
            : "")
        );

        if (runtime === TARGET) {
          console.log(
            ">>> 0x12B4 INITIALIZES TARGET 0x19534C <<<"
          );

          targetSegments++;
        }

        valueSegments++;
      }
    }
  }

  p = payloadEnd;

  /*
   * Segment boundary sanity check.
   */
  if (p !== payloadEnd) {
    console.log(
      `WARNING segment ${seg} parse mismatch`
    );
    break;
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(
  `EXACT TARGET SEGMENTS = ${targetSegments}`
);
console.log(
  `0x12B4 DATA PAYLOAD HITS = ${valueSegments}`
);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 656;

const CALLS = [
  { func: 473,  addr: 0x00020087 },
  { func: 599,  addr: 0x000284fb },
  { func: 1249, addr: 0x00057842 },
  { func: 1601, addr: 0x00071954 },
  { func: 2161, addr: 0x0009b0b8 },
  { func: 2161, addr: 0x0009b0fe },
  { func: 3490, addr: 0x0010da53 },
  { func: 6665, addr: 0x0022fa9e },
  { func: 7020, addr: 0x0023d95e },
];

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32(p: number): number {
  return (
    wasm[p] |
    (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
    (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
    (wasm[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findSection(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];
    const s = readULEB(p);
    const start = s.next;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return {
        id: sid,
        start,
        end,
        size: s.value,
      };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  return null;
}

/*
 * Decode only the function section.
 *
 * Section 3 contains type indices for defined functions.
 * Import functions are excluded from this vector.
 */
function getDefinedFunctionTypes(): number[] {
  const sec = findSection(3);

  if (!sec) {
    throw new Error("FUNCTION SECTION NOT FOUND");
  }

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  const types: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const t = readULEB(p);
    p = t.next;
    types.push(t.value);
  }

  return types;
}

/*
 * Parse code section and return exact body ranges
 * indexed by defined-function ordinal.
 */
function getDefinedFunctionBodies() {
  const sec = findSection(10);

  if (!sec) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
  }

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  const bodies: {
    bodyStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;
    codeStart: number;
    codeEnd: number;
  }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readULEB(p);
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

    const localCount = readULEB(p);
    p = localCount.next;

    for (let j = 0; j < localCount.value; j++) {
      const n = readULEB(p);
      p = n.next;

      // value type
      p++;
    }

    const codeStart = p;

    bodies.push({
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd,
      codeStart,
      codeEnd: bodyEnd,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function dumpBytes(start: number, end: number) {
  const safeStart = Math.max(0, start);
  const safeEnd = Math.min(wasm.length, end);

  for (let p = safeStart; p < safeEnd; p += 16) {
    const e = Math.min(p + 16, safeEnd);

    const bytes: string[] = [];

    for (let q = p; q < e; q++) {
      bytes.push(wasm[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
    );
  }
}

/*
 * Find the actual code-body containing the CALL address.
 * This avoids relying on a separate function-address table.
 */
function findBodyForCall(addr: number, bodies: ReturnType<typeof getDefinedFunctionBodies>) {
  for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
    const b = bodies[i];

    if (addr >= b.codeStart && addr < b.codeEnd) {
      return {
        ordinal: i,
        ...b,
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

console.log(`TARGET FUNC = ${TARGET_FUNC}`);

const types = getDefinedFunctionTypes();
const bodies = getDefinedFunctionBodies();

console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS = ${bodies.length}`);
console.log(`FUNCTION TYPES    = ${types.length}`);

for (const item of CALLS) {

  if (!found) {
    console.log("BODY = NOT FOUND");

  }

  console.log(

function isGlobalReference(text) {
    return text.includes(`0x${GLOBAL_ADDR.toString(16)}`) ||
        new RegExp(`\\b${GLOBAL_ADDR}\\b`).test(text);
}

function isSlotConstant(text) {
    return new RegExp(`\\b${TARGET_SLOT}\\b`).test(text);
}

function isIndirectCall(text) {
    return /\bcall_indirect\b/.test(text);
}

function contextBlock(funcIndex, instructions, index, label, radius = 8) {
    const start = Math.max(0, index - radius);
    const end = Math.min(instructions.length - 1, index + radius);
    const block = [];

    block.push('');
    block.push('----------------------------------------------------');
    block.push(`FUNCTION: ${funcIndex}`);
    block.push(`MATCH: ${label}`);
    block.push(`MATCH ADDRESS: ${hex(instructions[index].start)}`);
    block.push('CONTEXT:');

    for (let j = start; j <= end; j++) {
        const ins = instructions[j];
        const prefix = j === index ? '>>> ' : '    ';

        block.push(
            `${prefix}${hex(ins.start)}  ${ins.raw}  ${ins.text}`
        );
    }

    return block;
}

for (const funcIndex of bodies.keys()) {
    let decoded;

    try {
        decoded = decodeFunction(funcIndex);
        decodedCount++;
    } catch {
        decodeErrors++;
        continue;
    }

    const instructions = decoded.instructions;
    const anchors = [];

    let hasGlobalRef = false;
    let hasSlotConstant = false;
    let hasIndirect = false;

    for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
        const text = String(instructions[i].text);

        if (isGlobalReference(text)) {
            hasGlobalRef = true;
            globalRefs++;
            anchors.push({
                index: i,
                label: 'GLOBAL ADDRESS 0x195354'
            });
        }

        if (isSlotConstant(text)) {
            hasSlotConstant = true;
            slotConstants++;
            anchors.push({
                index: i,
                label: 'CONSTANT 4769'
            });
        }

        if (isIndirectCall(text)) {
            hasIndirect = true;
            indirectSites++;
        }
    }

    if (!hasGlobalRef && !hasSlotConstant) {
        continue;
    }

    relevantFunctions++;

    results.push({
        funcIndex,
        instructions,
        anchors,
        hasGlobalRef,
        hasSlotConstant,
        hasIndirect
    });
}

        `HAS_CALL_INDIRECT=${hasIndirect}`
    );

    const seen = new Set();

    for (const anchor of anchors) {
        const key = `${anchor.index}:${anchor.label}`;

        if (seen.has(key)) continue;
        seen.add(key);

        for (const line of contextBlock(

        }

    if (hasIndirect) {

            for (const line of contextBlock(
                funcIndex,
                instructions,
                i,
                'CALL_INDIRECT IN RELEVANT FUNCTION',
                10

                out(line);
            }
        }
    }

import fs from "fs";

const FILE =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

const TARGETS = [
    0x189dec, // table index 2053
    0x189f9c, // table index 2101
    0x18a8b0, // table index 2612
];

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: p,
    };
}

function readSection(pos: number) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];
    const len = readULEB(pos);

    return {
        id,
        start: len.next,
        end: len.next + len.value,
    };
}

import fs from "fs";

const FILE = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

const TARGET_FILE_OFFSETS = [
    0x004a9035, // index 2053
    0x004a91e5, // index 2101
    0x004a9af9, // index 2612
];

function u32(p: number): number {
    return (
        wasm[p] |
        (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSection(pos: number) {
    const id = wasm[pos++];
    const len = readULEB(pos);
    const start = len.next;
    const end = start + len.value;

    return { id, start, end };
}

//
// Find data section
//

while (p < wasm.length) {
    const s = readSection(p);

    if (s.id === 11) {
        dataStart = s.start;
        dataEnd = s.end;
        break;
    }

    p = s.end;
}

if (!dataStart) {
    throw new Error("Data section not found");
}

console.log(
    `Data section : 0x${dataStart.toString(16)}..0x${dataEnd.toString(16)}`
);

//
// Parse data segments and locate target file offsets
//
let q = dataStart;
const segCount = readULEB(q);
q = segCount.next;

console.log(`Data segments : ${segCount.value}`);
console.log();

type TargetInfo = {
    fileOffset: number;
    segment: number;
    segmentFileStart: number;
    segmentMemStart: number;
    relative: number;
    memoryAddress: number;
};

const found: TargetInfo[] = [];

for (let seg = 0; seg < segCount.value; seg++) {
    const flags = readULEB(q);
    q = flags.next;

    let memStart = 0;

    if (flags.value === 0) {
        // active, memory 0
        if (wasm[q] !== 0x41)
            throw new Error(`Unexpected data offset opcode at segment ${seg}`);

        q++;

        const off = readULEB(q);
        memStart = off.value;
        q = off.next;

        if (wasm[q++] !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error(`Missing end of init expr at segment ${seg}`);
    }
    else if (flags.value === 2) {
        const memoryIndex = readULEB(q);
        q = memoryIndex.next;

        if (wasm[q] !== 0x41)
            throw new Error(`Unexpected data offset opcode at segment ${seg}`);

        q++;

        const off = readULEB(q);
        memStart = off.value;
        q = off.next;

        if (wasm[q++] !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error(`Missing end of init expr at segment ${seg}`);
    }
    else if (flags.value === 1) {
        // passive segment
        // no memory address
        memStart = 0;
    }
    else {
        throw new Error(`Unsupported data segment flags ${flags.value}`);
    }

    const size = readULEB(q);
    q = size.next;

    const bytesStart = q;
    const bytesEnd = q + size.value;

    for (const target of TARGET_FILE_OFFSETS) {
        if (target >= bytesStart && target < bytesEnd) {
            found.push({
                fileOffset: target,
                segment: seg,
                segmentFileStart: bytesStart,
                segmentMemStart: memStart,
                relative: target - bytesStart,
                memoryAddress:
                    flags.value === 1
                        ? 0
                        : memStart + (target - bytesStart),
            });
        }
    }

    q = bytesEnd;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET MEMORY ADDRESSES");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const x of found) {
    console.log();
    console.log(
        `FILE 0x${x.fileOffset.toString(16)}`
    );
    console.log(
        `  segment       = ${x.segment}`
    );
    console.log(
        `  segment start = 0x${x.segmentFileStart.toString(16)}`
    );
    console.log(
        `  relative      = 0x${x.relative.toString(16)}`
    );
    console.log(
        `  memory addr   = 0x${x.memoryAddress.toString(16)}`
    );
}

//
// Locate code section
//
p = 8;

let codeStart = 0;
let codeEnd = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {
    const s = readSection(p);

    if (s.id === 10) {
        codeStart = s.start;
        codeEnd = s.end;
        break;
    }

    p = s.end;
}

if (!codeStart)
    throw new Error("Code section not found");

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("CODE REFERENCE SEARCH");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(
    `Code : 0x${codeStart.toString(16)}..0x${codeEnd.toString(16)}`
);

//
// Search little-endian i32 constants equal to target memory addresses.
// Also search byte sequences surrounding the references.
//
for (const x of found) {
    const a = x.memoryAddress;

    console.log();
    console.log(
        `TARGET FILE 0x${x.fileOffset.toString(16)}`
    );
    console.log(
        `MEMORY ADDRESS 0x${a.toString(16)}`
    );

    const b0 = a & 0xff;
    const b1 = (a >>> 8) & 0xff;
    const b2 = (a >>> 16) & 0xff;
    const b3 = (a >>> 24) & 0xff;

    let hits = 0;

    for (let i = codeStart; i + 5 <= codeEnd; i++) {

        // i32.const opcode 0x41
        if (
            wasm[i] === 0x41 &&
            wasm[i + 1] === b0 &&
            wasm[i + 2] === b1 &&
            wasm[i + 3] === b2 &&
            wasm[i + 4] === b3
        ) {
            hits++;

            const from = Math.max(codeStart, i - 16);
            const to = Math.min(codeEnd, i + 32);

            const hex = Array.from(
                wasm.slice(from, to)
            )
                .map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
                .join(" ");

            console.log();
            console.log(
                `  i32.const HIT @ 0x${i.toString(16)}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  bytes [0x${from.toString(16)}..0x${to.toString(16)}]`
            );
            console.log(`  ${hex}`);
        }
    }

    console.log();
    console.log(`  TOTAL i32.const REFERENCES = ${hits}`);
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SCAN COMPLETE");
console.log("============================================================");

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const FIRST_FUNC = 8948;
const LAST_FUNC  = 8956;

function u8(p) {
  return wasm[p];
}

function readULEB(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(p++);

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: p
      };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = u8(p++);

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: p
  };
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   SECTIONS
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function parseSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections = [];

  while (p < wasm.length) {

    const id = u8(p++);

    const sizeR = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeR.value;

    p = sizeR.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + size,
      size
    });

    p += size;
  }

  return sections;
}

const sections = parseSections();

const sec3  = sections.find(x => x.id === 3);
const sec10 = sections.find(x => x.id === 10);

if (!sec3 || !sec10)
  throw new Error("Function/Code sections not found");

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   FUNCTION TYPES
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function parseFunctionTypes() {

  let p = sec3.start;

  const countR = readULEB(p);
  const count = countR.value;

  p = countR.next;

  const result = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

    const r = readULEB(p);

    result.push(r.value);

    p = r.next;
  }

  return result;
}

const definedTypes = parseFunctionTypes();

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   CODE BODIES
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function parseCodeBodies() {

  let p = sec10.start;

  const countR = readULEB(p);
  const count = countR.value;

  p = countR.next;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

    const sizeR = readULEB(p);
    const bodySize = sizeR.value;

    const sizeStart = p;

    p = sizeR.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

    bodies.push({
      func: 83 + i,
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd,
      bodySize,
      sizeStart
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = parseCodeBodies();

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   SAFE IMMEDIATE DECODER
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function readMemArg(p) {

  const alignR = readULEB(p);
  p = alignR.next;

  const offsetR = readULEB(p);
  p = offsetR.next;

  return {
    align: alignR.value,
    offset: offsetR.value,
    next: p
  };
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   FUNCTION DECODER
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function decodeFunction(body) {

  let p = body.bodyStart;

  const localCountR = readULEB(p);
  const localCount = localCountR.value;

  p = localCountR.next;

  /*
   * Skip local declarations.
   */

  for (let i = 0; i < localCount; i++) {

    const nR = readULEB(p);
    p = nR.next;

    p++; // value type
  }

  const instructions = [];

  while (p < body.bodyEnd) {

    const off = p;
    const op = u8(p++);

    let text =
      `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

    let imm = null;

    try {

      switch (op) {

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           CONTROL
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x00:
          text = "unreachable";
          break;

        case 0x01:
          text = "nop";
          break;

        case 0x02: {
          const r = readSLEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text = `block type=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x03: {
          const r = readSLEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text = `loop type=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x04: {
          const r = readSLEB(p);
          p = r.next;
          text = `if type=${r.value}`;
          break;
        }

        case 0x05:
          text = "else";
          break;

        case 0x0b:
          text = "end";
          instructions.push({
            off,
            op,
            text,
            imm
          });

          return instructions;

        case 0x0c: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `br ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;
          break;
        }

        case 0x0d: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;
          break;
        }

        case 0x0e: {

          const nR = readULEB(p);
          const n = nR.value;

          p = nR.next;

          const labels = [];

          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            labels.push(r.value);
            p = r.next;
          }

          const defR = readULEB(p);
          p = defR.next;

          text =
            `br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${defR.value}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0x0f:
          text = "return";
          break;

        case 0x10: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `call ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;
          break;
        }

        case 0x11: {

          const typeR = readULEB(p);
          p = typeR.next;

          const tableR = readULEB(p);
          p = tableR.next;

          text =
            `call_indirect type=${typeR.value} table=${tableR.value}`;

          imm = typeR.value;

          break;
        }

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           PARAMETRIC
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x1a:
          text = "drop";
          break;

        case 0x1b:
          text = "select";
          break;

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           VARIABLES
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x20: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;
          break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;
          break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;
          break;
        }

        case 0x23: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;
          break;
        }

        case 0x24: {
          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;
          break;
        }

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           MEMORY
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x28:
        case 0x29:
        case 0x2a:
        case 0x2b:
        case 0x2c:
        case 0x2d:
        case 0x2e:
        case 0x2f:
        case 0x30:
        case 0x31:
        case 0x32:
        case 0x33:
        case 0x34:
        case 0x35: {

          const r = readMemArg(p);
          p = r.next;

          const names = {
            0x28: "i32.load",
            0x29: "i64.load",
            0x2a: "f32.load",
            0x2b: "f64.load",
            0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
            0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
            0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
            0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
            0x30: "i64.load8_s",
            0x31: "i64.load8_u",
            0x32: "i64.load16_s",
            0x33: "i64.load16_u",
            0x34: "i64.load32_s",
            0x35: "i64.load32_u"
          };

          text =
            `${names[op]} align=${r.align} offset=${r.offset}`;

          imm = r.offset;

          break;
        }

        case 0x36:
        case 0x37:
        case 0x38:
        case 0x39:
        case 0x3a:
        case 0x3b:
        case 0x3c:
        case 0x3d:
        case 0x3e: {

          const r = readMemArg(p);
          p = r.next;

          const names = {
            0x36: "i32.store",
            0x37: "i64.store",
            0x38: "f32.store",
            0x39: "f64.store",
            0x3a: "i32.store8",
            0x3b: "i32.store16",
            0x3c: "i64.store8",
            0x3d: "i64.store16",
            0x3e: "i64.store32"
          };

          text =
            `${names[op]} align=${r.align} offset=${r.offset}`;

          imm = r.offset;

          break;
        }

        case 0x3f: {

          const mem = u8(p++);
          text = `memory.size mem=${mem}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0x40: {

          const mem = u8(p++);
          text = `memory.grow mem=${mem}`;

          break;
        }

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           CONSTANTS
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x41: {

          const r = readSLEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text =
            `i32.const ${r.value} (${hex(r.value >>> 0)})`;

          imm = r.value;

          break;
        }

        case 0x42: {

          const r = readSLEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
          imm = r.value;

          break;
        }

        case 0x43: {

          p += 4;

          text = "f32.const";

          break;
        }

        case 0x44: {

          p += 8;

          text = "f64.const";

          break;
        }

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           INTEGER COMPARISON
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x45:
          text = "i32.eqz";
          break;

        case 0x46:
          text = "i32.eq";
          break;

        case 0x47:
          text = "i32.ne";
          break;

        case 0x48:
          text = "i32.lt_s";
          break;

        case 0x49:
          text = "i32.lt_u";
          break;

        case 0x4a:
          text = "i32.gt_s";
          break;

        case 0x4b:
          text = "i32.gt_u";
          break;

        case 0x4c:
          text = "i32.le_s";
          break;

        case 0x4d:
          text = "i32.le_u";
          break;

        case 0x4e:
          text = "i32.ge_s";
          break;

        case 0x4f:
          text = "i32.ge_u";
          break;

        case 0x50:
          text = "i64.eqz";
          break;

        case 0x51:
          text = "i64.eq";
          break;

        case 0x52:
          text = "i64.ne";
          break;

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           INTEGER ARITHMETIC
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x67:
          text = "i32.clz";
          break;

        case 0x68:
          text = "i32.ctz";
          break;

        case 0x69:
          text = "i32.popcnt";
          break;

        case 0x6a:
          text = "i32.add";
          break;

        case 0x6b:
          text = "i32.sub";
          break;

        case 0x6c:
          text = "i32.mul";
          break;

        case 0x6d:
          text = "i32.div_s";
          break;

        case 0x6e:
          text = "i32.div_u";
          break;

        case 0x6f:
          text = "i32.rem_s";
          break;

        case 0x70:
          text = "i32.rem_u";
          break;

        case 0x71:
          text = "i32.and";
          break;

        case 0x72:
          text = "i32.or";
          break;

        case 0x73:
          text = "i32.xor";
          break;

        case 0x74:
          text = "i32.shl";
          break;

        case 0x75:
          text = "i32.shr_s";
          break;

        case 0x76:
          text = "i32.shr_u";
          break;

        case 0x77:
          text = "i32.rotl";
          break;

        case 0x78:
          text = "i32.rotr";
          break;

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           I64 INTEGER OPERATIONS
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x7c:
          text = "i64.add";
          break;

        case 0x7d:
          text = "i64.sub";
          break;

        case 0x7e:
          text = "i64.mul";
          break;

        case 0x7f:
          text = "i64.div_s";
          break;

        case 0x80:
          text = "i64.div_u";
          break;

        case 0x81:
          text = "i64.rem_s";
          break;

        case 0x82:
          text = "i64.rem_u";
          break;

        case 0x83:
          text = "i64.and";
          break;

        case 0x84:
          text = "i64.or";
          break;

        case 0x85:
          text = "i64.xor";
          break;

        case 0x86:
          text = "i64.shl";
          break;

        case 0x87:
          text = "i64.shr_s";
          break;

        case 0x88:
          text = "i64.shr_u";
          break;

        case 0x89:
          text = "i64.rotl";
          break;

        case 0x8a:
          text = "i64.rotr";
          break;

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           CONVERSIONS
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0xa7:
          text = "i32.wrap_i64";
          break;

        case 0xac:
          text = "i64.extend_i32_s";
          break;

        case 0xad:
          text = "i64.extend_i32_u";
          break;

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           REFERENCE / OTHER
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0xd0: {

          const r = u8(p++);

          text = `ref.null type=0x${r.toString(16)}`;

          break;
        }

        case 0xd1:
          text = "ref.is_null";
          break;

        case 0xd2: {

          const r = readULEB(p);
          p = r.next;

          text = `ref.func ${r.value}`;

          imm = r.value;

          break;
        }

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           PREFIX 0xfc
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0xfc: {

          const subR = readULEB(p);
          p = subR.next;

          text =
            `0xfc subopcode=${subR.value}`;

          /*
           * Most 0xfc operations have immediates.
           * Keep the instruction visible without
           * risking desynchronization.
           */

          break;
        }

        /* -------------------------------------------------
           UNKNOWN
        ------------------------------------------------- */

        default:

          text =
            `UNKNOWN op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

          /*
           * Do not consume arbitrary bytes.
           * The raw offset remains visible.
           */

          break;
      }

    } catch (err) {

      text =
        `DECODE_ERROR op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} ${err.message}`;

      instructions.push({
        off,
        op,
        text,
        imm
      });

      return instructions;
    }

    instructions.push({
      off,
      op,
      text,
      imm
    });
  }

  return instructions;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_FUNCS = [122, 656, 91, 787];

const TARGET_ADDRS = new Set([
  0x195348,
  0x19534c,
  0x195350,
  0x195354,
  0x195358,
]);

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8): string {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(idWanted: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === idWanted) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${idWanted} not found`);
}

const importSec = findSection(2);
const funcSec = findSection(3);
const codeSec = findSection(10);

let importedFunctionCount = 0;

{
  let p = importSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const ml = readUleb(p);
    p = ml.next + ml.value;

    const nl = readUleb(p);
    p = nl.next + nl.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      importedFunctionCount++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;
      const flags = readUleb(p);
      p = flags.next;
      const min = readUleb(p);
      p = min.next;
      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readUleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = readUleb(p);
      p = flags.next;
      const min = readUleb(p);
      p = min.next;
      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readUleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }
}

const bodies = new Map<number, { start: number; end: number }>();

{
  let p = codeSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    bodies.set(importedFunctionCount + i, { start, end });

    p = end;
  }
}

function signedLeb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
  const align = readUleb(pos);
  pos = align.next;

  const offset = readUleb(pos);
  pos = offset.next;

  return {
    align: align.value,
    offset: offset.value,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function scan(func: number) {
  const body = bodies.get(func);

  if (!body) {
    console.log(`FUNC ${func}: BODY NOT FOUND`);
    return;
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
  console.log(`BODY = ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`);
  console.log(`SIZE = ${body.end - body.start}`);
  console.log("============================================================");

  let p = body.start;

  while (p < body.end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = signedLeb(p);
      p = x.next;

      const value = x.value >>> 0;

      if (TARGET_ADDRS.has(value)) {
        console.log(
          `${hex(at)}  i32.const ${hex(value)}  <<< TARGET ADDRESS`
        );
      } else {
        console.log(
          `${hex(at)}  i32.const ${hex(value)}`
        );
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  call FUNC ${x.value}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      const type = readUleb(p);
      p = type.next;

      const table = readUleb(p);
      p = table.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  call_indirect TYPE ${type.value} TABLE ${table.value}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28) {
      const m = memarg(p);
      p = m.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.load offset=${hex(m.offset)}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x29) {
      const m = memarg(p);
      p = m.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i64.load offset=${hex(m.offset)}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x2d) {
      const m = memarg(p);
      p = m.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.load8_u offset=${hex(m.offset)}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x36) {
      const m = memarg(p);
      p = m.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.store offset=${hex(m.offset)}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x3a) {
      const m = memarg(p);
      p = m.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  i32.store8 offset=${hex(m.offset)}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  local.get ${x.value}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  local.set ${x.value}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  local.tee ${x.value}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0b) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  end`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  br ${x.value}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0d) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  br_if ${x.value}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0e) {
      const x = readUleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      const labels: number[] = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < x.value; i++) {
        const y = readUleb(p);
        p = y.next;
        labels.push(y.value);
      }

      const def = readUleb(p);
      p = def.next;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)}  br_table [${labels.join(",")}] default=${def.value}`
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0f) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  return`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  control opcode ${hex(op, 2)}`);

      if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03) {
        const blockType = wasm[p++];
        console.log(
          `${hex(at)}  blocktype=${hex(blockType, 2)}`
        );
      } else {
        const blockType = wasm[p++];
        console.log(
          `${hex(at)}  if blocktype=${hex(blockType, 2)}`
        );
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x40) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  blocktype=empty`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x45) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.eqz`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x46) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.eq`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x47) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.ne`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x4a) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.gt_u`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6a) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.add`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x71) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.and`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x72) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.or`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x74) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  i32.shl`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x1a) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)}  drop`);
      continue;
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)}  opcode ${hex(op, 2)}`
    );
  }
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;
const IMPORTED   = 83;

const TARGETS = new Set([8637, 8927, 8952]);

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    if (pos + i >= b.length) return null;

    const x = b[pos + i];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, end: pos + i + 1 };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function getBodies() {
  let p = CODE_START;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  if (!count) throw new Error("Cannot read body count");

  p = count.end;

  const bodies: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readULEB(p);
    if (!size) throw new Error(`Bad body size at ${hex(p)}`);

    p = size.end;

    bodies.push({
      ordinal: i,
      global: i + IMPORTED,
      start: p,
      end: p + size.value
    });

    p += size.value;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function decodeInstruction(pos: number) {
  const op = b[pos];

  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!x) return null;

    return {
      op,
      end: x.end,
      text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
      local: x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x28) {
    const align = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!align) return null;

    const offset = readULEB(align.end);
    if (!offset) return null;

    return {
      op,
      end: offset.end,
      text: `i32.load offset=${offset.value}`,
      offset: offset.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x2d) {
    const align = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!align) return null;

    const offset = readULEB(align.end);
    if (!offset) return null;

    return {
      op,
      end: offset.end,
      text: `i32.load8_u offset=${offset.value}`,
      offset: offset.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const type = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!type) return null;

    const table = readULEB(type.end);
    if (!table) return null;

    return {
      op,
      end: table.end,
      text: `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`,
      type: type.value
    };
  }

  return {
    op,
    end: pos + 1,
    text: `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`
  };
}

function expressionBefore(
  bodyStart: number,
  callPos: number,
  maxBack = 20
) {
  const ins: any[] = [];

  let p = bodyStart;

  while (p < callPos) {
    const d = decodeInstruction(p);

    if (!d || d.end <= p || d.end > callPos) break;

    ins.push({
      pos: p,
      ...d
    });

    p = d.end;
  }

  return ins.slice(-maxBack);
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [
    {
        name: "Function 3621 dispatch source",
        address: 2428392,
        hex: "0x251088",
    },
    {
        name: "Function 3658 root pointer",
        address: 1837608,
        hex: "0x1C0188",
    },
];

const TARGET_INDEX = 7969;

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: p };

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35)
            throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF in ULEB");
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        b = buf[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        if (shift > 35)
            throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (-1 << shift);

    return { value, next: p };
}

function ulebBytes(value: number): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];

    do {
        let b = value & 0x7f;
        value >>>= 7;

        if (value !== 0)
            b |= 0x80;

        out.push(b);
    } while (value !== 0);

    return out;
}

function findSection(
    wasm: Buffer,
    wantedId: number
): { id: number; payloadStart: number; payloadEnd: number } | null {

    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
        const payloadStart = sizeInfo.next;
        const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sizeInfo.value;

        if (payloadEnd > wasm.length)
            return null;

        if (id === wantedId) {
            return {
                id,
                payloadStart,
                payloadEnd,
            };
        }

        p = payloadEnd;
    }

    return null;
}

function parseCodeBodies(wasm: Buffer) {
    const sec = findSection(wasm, 10);

    if (!sec)
        throw new Error("Code section not found");

    let p = sec.payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const bodies: {
        func: number;
        bodyStart: number;
        bodyEnd: number;
        codeStart: number;
        codeEnd: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
        const bodyStart = sizeInfo.next;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

        if (bodyEnd > sec.payloadEnd)
            throw new Error(`Invalid code body ${i}`);

        const localCountInfo = readULEB(wasm, bodyStart);
        let q = localCountInfo.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localCountInfo.value; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(wasm, q);
            q = n.next;

            // valtype
            q++;
        }

        bodies.push({
            func: 83 + i,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            codeStart: q,
            codeEnd: bodyEnd,
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function matchBytes(
    wasm: Buffer,
    pos: number,
    bytes: number[]
): boolean {
    if (pos + bytes.length > wasm.length)
        return false;

    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
        if (wasm[pos + i] !== bytes[i])
            return false;
    }

    return true;
}

function findPattern(
    wasm: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number,
    pattern: number[]
): number[] {
    const hits: number[] = [];

    for (let p = start; p + pattern.length <= end; p++) {
        if (matchBytes(wasm, p, pattern))
            hits.push(p);
    }

    return hits;
}

function formatHex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function u32LE(wasm: Buffer, p: number): number {
    if (p + 4 > wasm.length)
        return 0;

    return (
        wasm[p] |
        (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function inspectDataSegments(wasm: Buffer, addresses: number[]) {
    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" DATA SEGMENT INITIALIZATION");
    console.log("============================================================");

    const sec = findSection(wasm, 11);

    if (!sec) {
        console.log("Data section not found.");
        return;
    }

    let p = sec.payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    console.log(`Data segments: ${count}`);
    console.log("");

    const wanted = new Set(addresses);

    for (let seg = 0; seg < count; seg++) {
        const flagsInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
        const flags = flagsInfo.value;
        p = flagsInfo.next;

        let memoryIndex = 0;
        let offset = 0;

        if (flags === 0) {
            // active, memory 0
            // offset expression

            if (wasm[p] !== 0x41) {
                console.log(
                    `segment ${seg}: unsupported offset expression opcode ${formatHex(wasm[p])}`
                );
                return;
            }

            p++;

            const offInfo = readSLEB(wasm, p);
            offset = offInfo.value >>> 0;
            p = offInfo.next;

            if (wasm[p] !== 0x0b)
                throw new Error(`segment ${seg}: missing end`);

            p++;
        }
        else if (flags === 2) {
            // active with explicit memory index
            const memInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
            memoryIndex = memInfo.value;
            p = memInfo.next;

            if (wasm[p] !== 0x41) {
                console.log(
                    `segment ${seg}: unsupported offset expression`
                );
                return;
            }

            p++;

            const offInfo = readSLEB(wasm, p);
            offset = offInfo.value >>> 0;
            p = offInfo.next;

            if (wasm[p] !== 0x0b)
                throw new Error(`segment ${seg}: missing end`);

            p++;
        }

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
        const size = sizeInfo.value;
        const dataStart = sizeInfo.next;
        const dataEnd = dataStart + size;

        for (const addr of addresses) {
            if (addr >= offset && addr + 4 <= offset + size) {
                const rel = addr - offset;

                console.log(
                    `TARGET ${formatHex(addr)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  segment       : ${seg}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  memory index  : ${memoryIndex}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  segment start : ${formatHex(offset)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  segment size  : ${size}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  relative      : ${formatHex(rel)}`
                );

                if (rel + 4 <= size) {
                    const value = u32LE(wasm, dataStart + rel);

                    console.log(
                        `  initial i32   : ${value} (${formatHex(value)})`
                    );

                    if (value === TARGET_INDEX) {
                        console.log(
                            `  *** INITIAL VALUE IS TABLE INDEX ${TARGET_INDEX} ***`
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        p = dataEnd;
    }
}

function inspectStaticAddressWriters(
    wasm: Buffer,
    bodies: ReturnType<typeof parseCodeBodies>,
    target: number
) {
    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(` STATIC ADDRESS WRITERS FOR ${formatHex(target)}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    const imm = ulebBytes(target);

    // i32.const target
    const constPattern = [0x41, ...imm];

    let totalConst = 0;
    let store8 = 0;
    let store16 = 0;
    let store32 = 0;

    for (const body of bodies) {
        const hits = findPattern(
            wasm,
            body.codeStart,
            body.codeEnd,
            constPattern
        );

        if (hits.length === 0)
            continue;

        for (const hit of hits) {
            totalConst++;

            console.log("");
            console.log(
                `Function ${body.func}  const ${formatHex(target)} @ ${formatHex(hit)}`
            );

            const end = Math.min(body.codeEnd, hit + 20);

            let p = hit;

            while (p < end) {
                const op = wasm[p];

                if (op === 0x41) {
                    const x = readSLEB(wasm, p + 1);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)}  i32.const ${x.value}`
                    );
                    p = x.next;
                    continue;
                }

                if (op === 0x21) {
                    const x = readULEB(wasm, p + 1);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)}  local.set ${x.value}`
                    );
                    p = x.next;
                    continue;
                }

                if (op === 0x22) {
                    const x = readULEB(wasm, p + 1);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)}  local.tee ${x.value}`
                    );
                    p = x.next;
                    continue;
                }

                if (op === 0x20) {
                    const x = readULEB(wasm, p + 1);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)}  local.get ${x.value}`
                    );
                    p = x.next;
                    continue;
                }

                if (op === 0x3a) {
                    const align = wasm[p + 1];
                    const off = readULEB(wasm, p + 2);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)}  i32.store8 align=${align} offset=${off.value}`
                    );
                    store8++;
                    p = off.next;
                    continue;
                }

                if (op === 0x3b) {
                    const align = wasm[p + 1];
                    const off = readULEB(wasm, p + 2);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)}  i32.store16 align=${align} offset=${off.value}`
                    );
                    store16++;
                    p = off.next;
                    continue;
                }

                if (op === 0x36) {
                    const align = wasm[p + 1];
                    const off = readULEB(wasm, p + 2);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)}  i32.store align=${align} offset=${off.value}`
                    );
                    store32++;
                    p = off.next;
                    continue;
                }

                // stop when another control-flow boundary appears
                if (
                    op === 0x0b ||
                    op === 0x0f ||
                    op === 0x0c ||
                    op === 0x0d
                ) {
                    break;
                }

                p++;
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("SUMMARY");
    console.log(`  i32.const hits : ${totalConst}`);
    console.log(`  store8 nearby  : ${store8}`);
    console.log(`  store16 nearby : ${store16}`);
    console.log(`  store32 nearby : ${store32}`);
}

function inspectImmediateValueWrites(
    wasm: Buffer,
    bodies: ReturnType<typeof parseCodeBodies>,
    value: number
) {
    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(` WRITERS OF VALUE ${value} (${formatHex(value)})`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    const imm = ulebBytes(value);
    const pattern = [0x41, ...imm];

    let count = 0;

    for (const body of bodies) {
        const hits = findPattern(
            wasm,
            body.codeStart,
            body.codeEnd,
            pattern
        );

        for (const hit of hits) {
            count++;

            const end = Math.min(body.codeEnd, hit + 18);

            console.log("");
            console.log(
                `Function ${body.func} @ ${formatHex(hit)}`
            );

            let p = hit;

            while (p < end) {
                const op = wasm[p];

                if (op === 0x41) {
                    const x = readSLEB(wasm, p + 1);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)} i32.const ${x.value}`
                    );
                    p = x.next;
                    continue;
                }

                if (op === 0x20) {
                    const x = readULEB(wasm, p + 1);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)} local.get ${x.value}`
                    );
                    p = x.next;
                    continue;
                }

                if (op === 0x36) {
                    const off = readULEB(wasm, p + 2);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)} i32.store offset=${off.value}`
                    );
                    p = off.next;
                    break;
                }

                if (op === 0x3a) {
                    const off = readULEB(wasm, p + 2);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)} i32.store8 offset=${off.value}`
                    );
                    p = off.next;
                    break;
                }

                if (op === 0x3b) {
                    const off = readULEB(wasm, p + 2);
                    console.log(
                        `  ${formatHex(p)} i32.store16 offset=${off.value}`
                    );
                    p = off.next;
                    break;
                }

                p++;
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log(`Total CONST(${value}) sites: ${count}`);
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;

const IMPORTED = 83;

const TARGETS = [8637, 8927, 8952];

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    if (pos + i >= b.length)
      return null;

    const x = b[pos + i];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value, end: pos + i + 1 };

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

type Body = {
  ordinal: number;
  global: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
};

function getBodies(): Body[] {

  let p = CODE_START;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  if (!count)
    throw new Error("Cannot read body count");

  p = count.end;

  const out: Body[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = readULEB(p);
    if (!size)
      throw new Error(`Bad body size at ${hex(p)}`);

    p = size.end;

    out.push({
      ordinal: i,
      global: i + IMPORTED,
      start: p,
      end: p + size.value
    });

    p += size.value;
  }

  return out;
}

const bodies = getBodies();

function ulebBytes(pos: number) {
  const r = readULEB(pos);
  return r ? r.end : pos;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const SELECTORS = [
  { addr: 0x19534c, value: 4788, name: "SELECTOR0" },
  { addr: 0x195350, value: 4789, name: "SELECTOR1" },
  { addr: 0x195354, value: 4790, name: "SELECTOR2" },
  { addr: 0x195358, value: 4791, name: "SELECTOR3" },
];

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function findCodeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = readULEB(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function parseBodies() {
  const code = findCodeSection();

  let p = code.start;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  const bodies: any[] = [];

  for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
    const size = readULEB(p);
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

    const locals = readULEB(p);
    p = locals.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {
      const n = readULEB(p);
      p = n.next;

      // local type
      p++;
    }

    bodies.push({
      ordinal,
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd,
      instrStart: p,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function bytes(start: number, end: number) {
  return Array.from(wasm.subarray(start, end))
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");
}

function decodeInstruction(p: number) {
  const start = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = readSLEB(p);

    return {
      next: x.next,
      op,
      text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = readULEB(p);

    return {
      next: x.next,
      op,
      text: `call ${x.value}`,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const type = readULEB(p);
    p = type.next;

    const table = readULEB(p);
    p = table.next;

    return {
      next: p,
      op,
      text: `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`,
    };
  }

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24
  ) {
    const x = readULEB(p);

    const names: Record<number, string> = {
      0x20: "local.get",
      0x21: "local.set",
      0x22: "local.tee",
      0x23: "global.get",
      0x24: "global.set",
    };

    return {
      next: x.next,
      op,
      text: `${names[op]} ${x.value}`,
    };
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x29 ||
    op === 0x2a ||
    op === 0x2b ||
    op === 0x2c ||
    op === 0x2d ||
    op === 0x2e ||
    op === 0x2f ||
    op === 0x36 ||
    op === 0x37 ||
    op === 0x38 ||
    op === 0x39
  ) {
    const align = readULEB(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = readULEB(p);
    p = offset.next;

    return {
      next: p,
      op,
      text: `memory-op align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`,
    };
  }

  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x71: "i32.xor",
    0x0b: "end",
    0x0f: "return",
    0x04: "if",
    0x05: "else",
    0x02: "block",
    0x03: "loop",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
  };

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const x = readULEB(p);

    return {
      next: x.next,
      op,
      text: `${names[op]} ${x.value}`,
    };
  }

  return {
    next: p,
    op,
    text: names[op] ?? `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
  };
}

const bodies = parseBodies();

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_START = 0x00189dc0;
const TARGET_END   = 0x00189e24;

const TARGET_VALUES = new Set([
  2049, 2050, 2051, 2052, 2053, 2054, 2055
]);

function u8(p) {
  return wasm[p];
}

function readULEB(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = u8(p++);
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = u8(p++);
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readString(p) {
  const r = readULEB(p);

  return {
    text: Buffer.from(
      wasm.subarray(r.next, r.next + r.value)
    ).toString(),
    next: r.next + r.value
  };
}

function skipLimits(p) {
  const flags = u8(p++);

  let r = readULEB(p);
  p = r.next;

  if (flags & 1) {
    r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;
  }

  return p;
}

function parseSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections = [];

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = u8(p++);

    const sizeR = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeR.value;
    p = sizeR.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + size,
      size
    });

    p += size;
  }

  return sections;
}

const sections = parseSections();

const sec1  = sections.find(x => x.id === 1);
const sec3  = sections.find(x => x.id === 3);
const sec10 = sections.find(x => x.id === 10);

if (!sec1 || !sec3 || !sec10) {
  throw new Error("Required WASM sections not found");
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   TYPE SECTION
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function parseTypes() {
  let p = sec1.start;

  const countR = readULEB(p);
  const count = countR.value;
  p = countR.next;

  const types = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const form = u8(p++);

    if (form !== 0x60)
      throw new Error(
        `Unexpected type form at ${hex(p - 1)}`
      );

    let r = readULEB(p);
    const nParams = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    const params = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < nParams; j++)
      params.push(u8(p++));

    r = readULEB(p);
    const nResults = r.value;
    p = r.next;

    const results = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < nResults; j++)
      results.push(u8(p++));

    types.push({
      params,
      results
    });
  }

  return types;
}

const types = parseTypes();

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   FUNCTION SECTION
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function parseFunctionTypes() {
  let p = sec3.start;

  const countR = readULEB(p);
  const count = countR.value;
  p = countR.next;

  const result = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const r = readULEB(p);

    result.push(r.value);
    p = r.next;
  }

  return result;
}

const definedTypes = parseFunctionTypes();
