   CODE SECTION
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function parseCodeBodies() {
  let p = sec10.start;

  const countR = readULEB(p);
  const count = countR.value;
  p = countR.next;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const sizeR = readULEB(p);
    const bodySize = sizeR.value;
    const sizeStart = p;

    p = sizeR.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

    bodies.push({
      func: 83 + i,
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd,
      bodySize,
      sizeStart
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = parseCodeBodies();

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   CONSTANT / ADDRESS DECODER
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function decodeBody(body) {
  let p = body.bodyStart;

  const localCountR = readULEB(p);
  const localCount = localCountR.value;
  p = localCountR.next;

  const locals = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < localCount; i++) {
    const nR = readULEB(p);
    const n = nR.value;
    p = nR.next;

    const type = u8(p++);

    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++)
      locals.push(type);
  }

  const instructions = [];

  while (p < body.bodyEnd) {
    const off = p;
    const op = u8(p++);

    let text =
      `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

    let imm = null;

    switch (op) {

      case 0x0b:
        instructions.push({
          off,
          op,
          text: "end"
        });

        return instructions;

      case 0x0f:
        instructions.push({
          off,
          op,
          text: "return"
        });

        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text = `call ${r.value}`;
        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        const table = readULEB(p);
        p = table.next;

        text =
          `call_indirect type=${r.value} table=${table.value}`;

        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x20: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text = `local.get ${r.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text = `local.set ${r.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x28: {
        const align = u8(p++);

        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text =
          `i32.load align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;

        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x2d: {
        const align = u8(p++);

        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text =
          `i32.load8_u align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;

        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x29: {
        const align = u8(p++);

        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text =
          `i64.load align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;

        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x36: {
        const align = u8(p++);

        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text =
          `i32.store align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;

        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x37: {
        const align = u8(p++);

        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text =
          `i64.store align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;

        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        const r = readSLEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text =
          `i32.const ${r.value} (${hex(r.value >>> 0)})`;

        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x42: {
        const r = readSLEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        text =
          `i64.const ${r.value}`;

        imm = r.value;

        break;
      }

      case 0x6a:
        text = "i32.add";
        break;

      case 0x46:
        text = "i32.eq";
        break;

      case 0x1b:
        text = "select";
        break;

      case 0x00:
        text = "unreachable";
        break;

      default:
        text =
          `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

        break;
    }

    instructions.push({
      off,
      op,
      text,
      imm
    });
  }

  return instructions;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   Runtime address -> Data Segment file offset
--------------------------------------------------------- */

const dataAddressMap = new Map();

function findRuntimeDataOffset(runtimeAddress) {
  /*
   * Data segment parser below identifies all active
   * segments and maps runtime addresses to file offsets.
   */
  return dataAddressMap.get(runtimeAddress) ?? null;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   DATA SEGMENTS
--------------------------------------------------------- */

function parseDataSegments() {
  const sec11 = sections.find(x => x.id === 11);

  if (!sec11)
    return;

  let p = sec11.start;

  const countR = readULEB(p);
  const count = countR.value;
  p = countR.next;

  for (let seg = 0; seg < count; seg++) {

    const flagsR = readULEB(p);
    const flags = flagsR.value;
    p = flagsR.next;

    let memoryIndex = 0;
    let runtimeBase = null;

    if (flags === 0) {

      /* active, implicit memory 0 */

      const op = u8(p++);

      if (op !== 0x41)
        throw new Error(
          `Unexpected data offset opcode ${hex(p - 1)}`
        );

      const offR = readSLEB(p);

      runtimeBase = offR.value >>> 0;
      p = offR.next;

      if (u8(p++) !== 0x0b)
        throw new Error(
          "Missing data segment end"
        );

    } else if (flags === 2) {

      /* active, explicit memory index */

      const memR = readULEB(p);

      memoryIndex = memR.value;
      p = memR.next;

      const op = u8(p++);

      if (op !== 0x41)
        throw new Error(
          "Unexpected data offset opcode"
        );

      const offR = readSLEB(p);

      runtimeBase = offR.value >>> 0;
      p = offR.next;

      if (u8(p++) !== 0x0b)
        throw new Error(
          "Missing data segment end"
        );

    } else {

      /*
       * Passive segments are ignored here.
       */

      if (flags !== 1)
        throw new Error(
          `Unsupported data flags ${flags}`
        );

      const lenR = readULEB(p);

      p = lenR.next + lenR.value;

      continue;
    }

    const lenR = readULEB(p);
    const len = lenR.value;
    p = lenR.next;

    const bytesStart = p;
    const bytesEnd = p + len;

    if (
      memoryIndex === 0 &&
      runtimeBase !== null
    ) {

      const lo =
        Math.max(runtimeBase, TARGET_START);

      const hi =
        Math.min(
          runtimeBase + len,
          TARGET_END + 1
        );

      for (
        let addr = lo;
        addr < hi;
        addr++
      ) {

        dataAddressMap.set(
          addr,
          bytesStart + (addr - runtimeBase)
        );
      }
    }

    p = bytesEnd;
  }
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   BUILD DATA ADDRESS MAP
--------------------------------------------------------- */

/*
 * IMPORTANT:
 * This MUST happen before STATIC DATA WINDOW,
 * because findRuntimeDataOffset() depends on
 * dataAddressMap being populated.
 */

parseDataSegments();

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   STATIC DATA WINDOW
--------------------------------------------------------- */

  );

  console.log(

  );

  for (const i of relevant) {

    console.log(
      `  ${hex(i.off)}  ${i.text}`
    );
  }

  totalHits += relevant.length;

  } catch {
    continue;

    const i = ins[k];

    if (
      i.op !== 0x28 &&
      i.op !== 0x29 &&
      i.op !== 0x2d &&
      i.op !== 0x36 &&
      i.op !== 0x37
    )
      continue;

    /*
     * We cannot prove the runtime address
     * from an offset alone.
     *
     * Print nearby constants and
     * address-producing instructions.
     */

    const before = ins.slice(
      Math.max(0, k - 5),
      k
    );

    const hasTargetConst =
      before.some(x =>
        x.op === 0x41 &&
        (
          (x.imm >>> 0) >= TARGET_START &&
          (x.imm >>> 0) <= TARGET_END
        )
      );

    if (!hasTargetConst)
      continue;

    console.log("");
    console.log(
      `FUNC ${body.func} @ ${hex(i.off)}`
    );

    console.log(
      `  ${i.text}`
    );

    for (const b of before) {

      console.log(
        `    ${hex(b.off)}  ${b.text}`
      );
    }

    memoryHits++;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [2053, 2101, 2612];

const ROOTS = [
    1633928, // 0x18ee88
    1633988, // 0x18eec4
    1634104, // 0x18ef38
    1634128, // 0x18ef50
    1634268, // 0x18efdc
    1634408, // 0x18f068
    1617084, // 0x18acbc
];

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value,
                next: pos,
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40) !== 0) {
        value -= Math.pow(2, shift);
    }

    return {
        value,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function hex(v: number): string {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readMemU32(mem: Uint8Array, addr: number): number | null {
    if (addr < 0 || addr + 4 > mem.length) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        mem[addr] |
        (mem[addr + 1] << 8) |
        (mem[addr + 2] << 16) |
        (mem[addr + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function region(addr: number): string {
    if (addr >= 0x0018744c && addr < 0x0018ab8d) {
        return "SEG412";
    }

    if (addr >= 0x0018ab98 && addr < 0x0018f512) {
        return "SEG413";
    }

    return "OTHER";
}

    const sectionId = buf[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;

    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const payloadStart = pos;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 11) {
        dataStart = payloadStart;
        dataEnd = payloadEnd;
    }

    pos = payloadEnd;

    throw new Error("DATA SECTION NOT FOUND");

 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

let p = dataStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const dataCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

console.log(`  segments      = ${dataCount}`);

type Segment = {
    memoryIndex: number;
    offset: number;
    bytes: Uint8Array;
};

const segments: Segment[] = [];

let maxAddress = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < dataCount; i++) {
    const flagsInfo = readULEB(p);
    const flags = flagsInfo.value;
    p = flagsInfo.next;

    let memoryIndex = 0;
    let offset = -1;

    if (flags === 0) {
        const opcode = buf[p++];

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${i}: unexpected offset opcode ${hex(opcode)}`
            );
        }

        const offInfo = readSLEB(p);
        offset = offInfo.value;
        p = offInfo.next;

        if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
            throw new Error(`Segment ${i}: missing end opcode`);
        }
    } else if (flags === 2) {
        const memInfo = readULEB(p);
        memoryIndex = memInfo.value;
        p = memInfo.next;

        const opcode = buf[p++];

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
            throw new Error(
                `Segment ${i}: unexpected offset opcode ${hex(opcode)}`
            );
        }

        const offInfo = readSLEB(p);
        offset = offInfo.value;
        p = offInfo.next;

        if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
            throw new Error(`Segment ${i}: missing end opcode`);
        }
    } else if (flags === 1) {
        const lenInfo = readULEB(p);
        const len = lenInfo.value;
        p = lenInfo.next;

        const bytes = buf.subarray(p, p + len);
        p += len;

        segments.push({
            memoryIndex: -1,
            offset: -1,
            bytes,
        });

        continue;
    } else {
        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported data segment flags=${flags} at segment ${i}`
        );
    }

    const lenInfo = readULEB(p);
    const len = lenInfo.value;
    p = lenInfo.next;

    const bytes = buf.subarray(p, p + len);
    p += len;

    segments.push({
        memoryIndex,
        offset,
        bytes,
    });

    if (memoryIndex === 0 && offset >= 0) {
        const end = offset + len;

        if (end > maxAddress) {
            maxAddress = end;
        }
    }
}

console.log(`  parser end    = ${hex(p)}`);
console.log(`  expected end  = ${hex(dataEnd)}`);

if (p !== dataEnd) {
    throw new Error(

    );
}

(async () => {
    const fs = require("fs");
    const wabt = await require("wabt")();

    const file =
        "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

    const targets = new Map([
        [1659724, "SLOT_19534C"],
        [1659728, "SLOT_195350"],
        [1659732, "SLOT_195354"],
        [1659736, "SLOT_195358"]
    ]);

    const features = {
        exceptions: true,
        mutable_globals: true,
        sat_float_to_int: true,
        sign_extension: true,
        simd: true,
        threads: true,
        function_references: true,
        multi_value: true,
        tail_call: true,
        bulk_memory: true,
        reference_types: true,
        annotations: true,
        code_metadata: true,
        gc: true,
        memory64: true,
        multi_memory: true,
        extended_const: true,
        relaxed_simd: true
    };

    const mod = wabt.readWasm(fs.readFileSync(file), {
        readDebugNames: false,
        ...features
    });

    mod.validate();

    const wat = mod.toText({
        foldExprs: false,
        inlineExport: false
    });

    const lines = wat.split(/\r?\n/);
    let funcId = null;
    let hits = 0;

    console.log("DISPATCH SLOT STORE SCAN");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("Direct-address stores and nearby context only");

    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const start = lines[i].match(/^\s*\(func \(;(\d+);\)/);

        if (start) {
            funcId = Number(start[1]);
        }

        // A direct-address store usually has i32.const ADDRESS
        // immediately before the store, possibly with a value
        // pushed between them. Print candidate stores whose
        // nearby instructions mention a target address.
        if (!/\bi32\.store(?:8|16)?\b|\bi64\.store\b|\bf32\.store\b|\bf64\.store\b/.test(lines[i])) {
            continue;
        }

        const from = Math.max(0, i - 8);
        const context = lines.slice(from, i + 1);
        const found = [];

        for (const [address, label] of targets) {
            if (context.some(line =>
                new RegExp(`\\bi32\\.const\\s+${address}\\b`).test(line)
            )) {
                found.push(`${label} (${address})`);
            }
        }

        if (found.length === 0) continue;

        hits++;
        console.log("");
        console.log("------------------------------------------------");
        console.log(`FUNC ${funcId} | STORE LINE ${i + 1}`);
        console.log("TARGET CANDIDATE:", found.join(", "));

        for (let j = from; j <= i; j++) {
            console.log(`${j + 1}: ${lines[j].trimEnd()}`);
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("DIRECT STORE CANDIDATES:", hits);
    console.log("NOTE: Pointer-based writes may not appear in this scan.");

    mod.destroy();
})().catch(error => {
    console.error(error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
});

FILE: scripts\traceDispatchSlotWriters.ts

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [
  0x195348,
  0x19534c,
  0x195350,
  0x195354,
  0x195358,
];

function readUleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= -1 << shift;
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(v: number, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function findSection(idWanted: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = readUleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === idWanted) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${idWanted} not found`);
}

/*
 * Import section
 */
const importSec = findSection(2);

let importedFunctions = 0;

{
  let p = importSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const ml = readUleb(p);
    p = ml.next + ml.value;

    const nl = readUleb(p);
    p = nl.next + nl.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const t = readUleb(p);
      p = t.next;
      importedFunctions++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;
      const flags = readUleb(p);
      p = flags.next;

      const min = readUleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readUleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = readUleb(p);
      p = flags.next;

      const min = readUleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags.value & 1) {
        const max = readUleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }
}

/*
 * Function + Code sections
 */
const funcSec = findSection(3);
const codeSec = findSection(10);

const definedTypes: number[] = [];

{
  let p = funcSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const t = readUleb(p);
    p = t.next;
    definedTypes.push(t.value);
  }
}

const bodies = new Map<number, { start: number; end: number }>();

{
  let p = codeSec.start;

  const count = readUleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = readUleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    bodies.set(importedFunctions + i, { start, end });

    p = end;
  }
}

/*
 * Scan every defined function.
 *
 * We specifically search:
 *
 * A) i32.const TARGET
 *
 * B) i32.store with offset 0
 *
 * C) i32.store8 with offset 0
 *
 * D) nearby patterns:
 *
 *    const TARGET
 *    ...
 *    store
 *
 * The purpose is to catch both obvious and slightly
 * separated absolute-address writes.
 */
console.log("TRACE DISPATCH SLOT WRITERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const target of TARGETS) {
  console.log("");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`TARGET ${hex(target)}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  let hitCount = 0;

  for (const [func, body] of bodies.entries()) {
    const hits: string[] = [];

    let p = body.start;

    while (p < body.end) {
      const at = p;
      const op = wasm[p++];

      if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = readSleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        if ((x.value >>> 0) === target) {
          hits.push(
            `${hex(at)} i32.const ${hex(target)}`
          );
        }

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * i32.store
       */
      if (op === 0x36) {
        const align = readUleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = readUleb(p);
        p = offset.next;

        if (offset.value === 0) {
          hits.push(
            `${hex(at)} i32.store offset=0`
          );
        }

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * i32.store8
       */
      if (op === 0x3a) {
        const align = readUleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = readUleb(p);
        p = offset.next;

        if (offset.value === 0) {
          hits.push(
            `${hex(at)} i32.store8 offset=0`
          );
        }

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * Skip memarg instructions that are loads.
       */
      if (
        op === 0x28 || // i32.load
        op === 0x29 || // i64.load
        op === 0x2a || // f32.load
        op === 0x2b || // f64.load
        op === 0x2c || // i32.load8_s
        op === 0x2d || // i32.load8_u
        op === 0x2e || // i32.load16_s
        op === 0x2f || // i32.load16_u
        op === 0x30 || // i64.load8_s
        op === 0x31 || // i64.load8_u
        op === 0x32 || // i64.load16_s
        op === 0x33 || // i64.load16_u
        op === 0x34 || // i64.load32_s
        op === 0x35    // i64.load32_u
      ) {
        const align = readUleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = readUleb(p);
        p = offset.next;

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * Simple instructions with immediates.
       */
      if (
        op === 0x10 || // call
        op === 0x0c || // br
        op === 0x0d || // br_if
        op === 0x20 || // local.get
        op === 0x21 || // local.set
        op === 0x22    // local.tee
      ) {
        const x = readUleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        continue;
      }

      if (op === 0x11) {
        const type = readUleb(p);
        p = type.next;

        const table = readUleb(p);
        p = table.next;

        continue;
      }

      if (
        op === 0x02 ||
        op === 0x03 ||
        op === 0x04
      ) {
        p++;
        continue;
      }

      /*
       * br_table
       */
      if (op === 0x0e) {
        const n = readUleb(p);
        p = n.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
          const x = readUleb(p);
          p = x.next;
        }

        const d = readUleb(p);
        p = d.next;

        continue;
      }
    }

    /*
     * Only report functions where the target address
     * itself was found.
     */
    if (hits.some(x => x.includes("i32.const"))) {
      console.log("");
      console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
      console.log(
        `BODY ${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end)}`
      );

      for (const h of hits) {
        console.log(`  ${h}`);
      }

      hitCount++;
    }
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log(`FUNCTIONS WITH TARGET CONST = ${hitCount}`);
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_CALLS = new Map([
    [202, "CALL_202"],
    [1151, "CALL_1151"],
    [1152, "CALL_1152"],
]);

const TARGET_VALUES = new Map([
    [0x0003ef51, "ID_3EF51"],
    [0x0003f0a0, "ID_3F0A0"],
    [2049, "TABLE_2049"],
    [2050, "TABLE_2050"],
    [2051, "TABLE_2051"],
    [2052, "TABLE_2052"],
    [2053, "TABLE_2053"],
    [2054, "TABLE_2054"],
    [2055, "TABLE_2055"],
]);

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(
                `ULEB too long at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`
            );
        }
    }

    throw new Error(
        `Unexpected EOF while reading ULEB at 0x${pos.toString(16)}`
    );
}

function parseSections() {
    const sections = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const sizeR = readULEB(p);
        const size = sizeR.value;
        p = sizeR.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + size;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start,
            end
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseFunctionSection(section) {
    const result = [];

    let p = section.start;

    const countR = readULEB(p);
    const count = countR.value;
    p = countR.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const r = readULEB(p);

        result.push(r.value);

        p = r.next;
    }

    return result;
}

function parseCodeSection(section, functionTypes) {
    const bodies = [];

    let p = section.start;

    const countR = readULEB(p);
    const count = countR.value;
    p = countR.next;

    const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

        const sizeR = readULEB(p);
        const bodySize = sizeR.value;
        p = sizeR.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

        const localsR = readULEB(p);
        const localGroups = localsR.value;
        p = localsR.next;

        for (let g = 0; g < localGroups; g++) {
            const nR = readULEB(p);
            p = nR.next;

            // local value type
            p++;
        }

        bodies.push({
            func: IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + i,
            typeIndex: functionTypes[i],
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            codeStart: p,
            codeEnd: bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function hex(v, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function bytesAt(start, end) {
    const arr = [];

    for (let p = start; p < end && p < buf.length; p++) {
        arr.push(buf[p].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
    }

    return arr.join(" ");
}

function showContext(pos, bodyStart, bodyEnd) {
    const from = Math.max(bodyStart, pos - 12);
    const to = Math.min(bodyEnd, pos + 20);

    console.log(
        `    CONTEXT ${hex(from)} .. ${hex(to)}`
    );

    console.log(
        `    ${bytesAt(from, to)}`
    );
}

function scanFunction(body) {

    const hits = [];

    let p = body.codeStart;

    while (p < body.codeEnd) {

        const op = buf[p];

        /*
         * call
         * 0x10 + ULEB function index
         */
        if (op === 0x10) {

            const r = readULEB(p + 1);

            if (TARGET_CALLS.has(r.value)) {

                hits.push({
                    kind: "call",
                    pos: p,
                    label: TARGET_CALLS.get(r.value),
                    value: r.value
                });
            }

            p = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        /*
         * i32.const
         * 0x41 + SLEB32
         *
         * We do not need to decode signedness here.
         * Read the immediate bytes and compare the unsigned
         * 32-bit representation when it terminates.
         */
        if (op === 0x41) {

            let q = p + 1;
            let value = 0;
            let shift = 0;

            while (q < body.codeEnd) {

                const b = buf[q++];

                value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

                if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {

                    const u32 = value >>> 0;

                    if (TARGET_VALUES.has(u32)) {

                        hits.push({
                            kind: "i32.const",
                            pos: p,
                            label: TARGET_VALUES.get(u32),
                            value: u32
                        });
                    }

                    break;
                }

                shift += 7;

                if (shift > 35) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            /*
             * Even if this is an unknown/invalid immediate,
             * only move to the first byte after the encoded
             * immediate when termination was found.
             */
            if (q > p + 1) {
                p = q;
            } else {
                p++;
            }

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * call_indirect
         *
         * opcode = 0x11
         * immediate = typeidx ULEB + tableidx ULEB
         */
        if (op === 0x11) {

            const typeR = readULEB(p + 1);
            const tableR = readULEB(typeR.next);

            hits.push({
                kind: "call_indirect",
                pos: p,
                typeIndex: typeR.value,
                table: tableR.value
            });

            p = tableR.next;
            continue;
        }

        p++;
    }

    return hits;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DISPATCH TARGET TRACE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(
    `WASM SIZE : ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`
);

const sections = parseSections();

const funcSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 3);
const codeSec = sections.find(s => s.id === 10);

if (!funcSec || !codeSec) {
    throw new Error("Function or Code section not found.");
}

const functionTypes = parseFunctionSection(funcSec);
const bodies = parseCodeSection(codeSec, functionTypes);

    );

    if (hits.length === 0) {

    for (const hit of hits) {

            );

            showContext(
                hit.pos,

            );
        }
    }
}

console.log("GLOBAL TARGET SCAN");

const globalHits = [];

for (const body of bodies) {

    const hits = scanFunction(body);

    for (const hit of hits) {

        if (
            hit.kind === "call" ||

        ) {

    }
}

for (const hit of globalHits) {

FILE: scripts\traceExactSelectorAddressExpressions.ts

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const TARGETS = [
    0x19534c,
    0x195350,
    0x195354,
    0x195358,
];

const TARGET_SET = new Set(TARGETS);

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function readULEB(p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = bytes[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value -= 2 ** shift;

    return { value, next: p };
}

interface Ins {
    pc: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    imm?: number;
}

function decode(p: number): Ins {

    const op = bytes[p];

    if (op === 0x20) {
        const r = readULEB(p + 1);

        return {
            pc: p,
            op,
            text: `local.get ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
        const r = readULEB(p + 1);

        return {
            pc: p,
            op,
            text: `local.set ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
        const r = readULEB(p + 1);

        return {
            pc: p,
            op,
            text: `local.tee ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = readSLEB(p + 1);

        return {
            pc: p,
            op,
            text: `i32.const ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x23) {
        const r = readULEB(p + 1);

        return {
            pc: p,
            op,
            text: `global.get ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x24) {
        const r = readULEB(p + 1);

        return {
            pc: p,
            op,
            text: `global.set ${r.value}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x28) {
        const r = readULEB(p + 2);

        return {
            pc: p,
            op,
            text: `i32.load offset=${hex(r.value)}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x36) {
        const r = readULEB(p + 2);

        return {
            pc: p,
            op,
            text: `i32.store offset=${hex(r.value)}`,
            imm: r.value
        };
    }

    if (op === 0x6a)
        return { pc: p, op, text: "i32.add" };

    if (op === 0x6b)
        return { pc: p, op, text: "i32.sub" };

    if (op === 0x74)
        return { pc: p, op, text: "i32.shl" };

    if (op === 0x75)
        return { pc: p, op, text: "i32.shr_s" };

    if (op === 0x76)
        return { pc: p, op, text: "i32.shr_u" };

    if (op === 0x77)
        return { pc: p, op, text: "i32.rotl" };

    if (op === 0x78)
        return { pc: p, op, text: "i32.rotr" };

    if (op === 0xa7)
        return { pc: p, op, text: "i32.wrap_i64" };

    if (op === 0xfc) {

        const r = readULEB(p + 1);

        if (r.value === 10)
            return { pc: p, op, text: "memory.copy" };

        if (r.value === 11)
            return { pc: p, op, text: "memory.fill" };
    }

    return {
        pc: p,
        op,
        text: `opcode ${hex(op, 2)}`
    };
}

function nextPC(p: number) {

    const op = bytes[p];

    if (
        op === 0x20 ||
        op === 0x21 ||
        op === 0x22 ||
        op === 0x23 ||
        op === 0x24
    )
        return readULEB(p + 1).next;

    if (op === 0x41)
        return readSLEB(p + 1).next;

    if (
        op === 0x28 ||
        op === 0x29 ||
        op === 0x2a ||
        op === 0x2b ||
        op === 0x36 ||
        op === 0x37 ||
        op === 0x38 ||
        op === 0x39
    )
        return readULEB(p + 2).next;

    if (op === 0xfc)
        return readULEB(p + 1).next;

    return p + 1;
}

/*
 * Find every literal target address in the entire WASM.
 */
console.log("TRACE EXACT SELECTOR ADDRESS EXPRESSIONS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const target of TARGETS)
    console.log(`TARGET = ${hex(target)}`);

console.log("");

let literalHits = 0;
let storeCandidates = 0;

let p = 0;

while (p < bytes.length) {

    /*
     * Only inspect opcode 0x41 because selector addresses
     * are i32 constants.
     */
    if (bytes[p] === 0x41) {

        const r = readSLEB(p + 1);

        if (TARGET_SET.has(r.value)) {

            literalHits++;

            console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
            console.log(
                `LITERAL TARGET @ ${hex(p)} = ${hex(r.value)}`
            );

            /*
             * Show nearby raw bytes.
             */
            const start = Math.max(0, p - 16);
            const end = Math.min(bytes.length, r.next + 24);

            console.log(
                `RAW RANGE ${hex(start)} .. ${hex(end)}`
            );

            for (let q = start; q < end; q += 16) {

                const row: string[] = [];

                for (
                    let k = q;
                    k < Math.min(q + 16, end);
                    k++
                ) {
                    row.push(
                        bytes[k].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
                    );
                }

                console.log(
                    `${hex(q)}  ${row.join(" ")}`
                );
            }

            /*
             * Decode the following instructions.
             */
            console.log("FOLLOWING:");

            let q = r.next;

            for (let n = 0; n < 20 && q < bytes.length; n++) {

                const ins = decode(q);

                console.log(
                    `  ${hex(ins.pc)} ${ins.text}`
                );

                /*
                 * Any store shortly after the exact target
                 * literal is a candidate, but NOT yet proven.

                if (ins.op === 0x36) {
                    storeCandidates++;

                    console.log(
                        "  >>> STORE CANDIDATE AFTER TARGET CONSTANT"
                    );
                }

                q = nextPC(q);
            }
        }
    }

    p++;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = new Set([
  0x250fb4,
  0x250fc0,
]);

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function u32(pos) {
  return wasm.readUInt32LE(pos);
}

function lebU32(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let i = pos;

  while (i < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[i++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result >>> 0, next: i };
}

function lebI32(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let i = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (i < wasm.length) {
    b = wasm[i++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    result |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: result | 0, next: i };
}

function opcodeName(op) {
  const map = {
    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x3a: "i32.store8",
    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",
    0x10: "call",
    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x6c: "i32.mul",
    0x71: "i32.and",
    0x72: "i32.or",
    0x73: "i32.xor",
    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x48: "i32.lt_s",
    0x49: "i32.lt_u",
    0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
    0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
    0x4c: "i32.le_s",
    0x4d: "i32.le_u",
    0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
    0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
  };

  return map[op] || `0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const FILE = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const IMPORTS = 83;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function uleb(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
        s += 7;
    }
    return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0, b;
    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        s += 7;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    }
    if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);
    return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function findSection(type) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const t = wasm[p++];

        const z = uleb(p);
        p = z.next;

        if (t === type)
            return { start: p, end: p + z.value };

        p += z.value;
    }

    return null;
}

function decode(start, end) {

    let p = start;

    const lg = uleb(p);
    p = lg.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < lg.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;
        p++;
    }

    const a = [];

    while (p < end) {

        const addr = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text = `opcode_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;

        switch (op) {

            case 0x20: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x21: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x22: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x41: {
                const x = sleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `i32.const ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x28: {
                const al = uleb(p);
                p = al.next;

                const of = uleb(p);
                p = of.next;

                text = `i32.load align=${al.value} offset=${of.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x2d: {
                const al = uleb(p);
                p = al.next;

                const of = uleb(p);
                p = of.next;

                text = `i32.load8_u align=${al.value} offset=${of.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x36: {
                const al = uleb(p);
                p = al.next;

                const of = uleb(p);
                p = of.next;

                text = `i32.store align=${al.value} offset=${of.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x10: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `call ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x11: {
                const t = uleb(p);
                p = t.next;

                const tab = uleb(p);
                p = tab.next;

                text = `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x23: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `global.get ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x24: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `global.set ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x45:
                text = "i32.eqz";
                break;

            case 0x46:
                text = "i32.eq";
                break;

            case 0x47:
                text = "i32.ne";
                break;

            case 0x6a:
                text = "i32.add";
                break;

            case 0x6b:
                text = "i32.sub";
                break;

            case 0x1a:
                text = "drop";
                break;

            case 0x0b:
                text = "end";
                break;
        }

        a.push({ addr, text });
    }

    return a;
}

function getBodies() {

    const sec = findSection(10);

    if (!sec)
        throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

    let p = sec.start;

    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;

    const bodies = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

        const z = uleb(p);
        p = z.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + z.value;

        bodies.push({
            func: IMPORTS + i,
            start,
            end
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function hx(x) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8,"0");
}

import fs from 'fs';

const WASM_PATH =
    'G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm';

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

const START = 61125;
const SIZE = 127;
const END = START + SIZE;

function readU32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readI32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return { value, next: pos };
        }
    }
}

function skipBlockType(pos: number) {
    const b = wasm[pos];

    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c ||
        b === 0x7b ||
        b === 0x70 ||
        b === 0x6f
    ) {
        return pos + 1;
    }

    return readI32(pos).next;
}

function decode(pos: number) {
    const start = pos;
    const op = wasm[pos++];

    let text = `0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    switch (op) {

        case 0x20: {
            const r = readU32(pos);
            text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
            pos = r.next;
            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const r = readU32(pos);
            text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
            pos = r.next;
            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const r = readU32(pos);
            text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
            pos = r.next;
            break;
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const r = readI32(pos);
            text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
            pos = r.next;
            break;
        }

        case 0x28: {
            const align = readU32(pos);
            pos = align.next;

            const offset = readU32(pos);
            pos = offset.next;

            text = `i32.load align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const r = readU32(pos);
            pos = r.next;
            text = `call ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x11: {
            const type = readU32(pos);
            pos = type.next;

            const table = readU32(pos);
            pos = table.next;

            text =
                `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x47:
            text = 'i32.gt_u';
            break;

        case 0x45:
            text = 'i32.eqz';
            break;

        case 0x0d: {
            const r = readU32(pos);
            pos = r.next;
            text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x0c: {
            const r = readU32(pos);
            pos = r.next;
            text = `br ${r.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x0e: {
            const n = readU32(pos);
            pos = n.next;

            const labels: number[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                const x = readU32(pos);
                pos = x.next;
                labels.push(x.value);
            }

            const def = readU32(pos);
            pos = def.next;

            text =
                `br_table [${labels.join(',')}] default=${def.value}`;
            break;
        }

        case 0x04:
            pos = skipBlockType(pos);
            text = 'if';
            break;

        case 0x05:
            text = 'else';
            break;

        case 0x0b:
            text = 'end';
            break;
    }

    return {
        start,
        end: pos,
        text,
        op,
    };
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readULEB(
    data: Uint8Array,
    pos: { v: number }
): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = data[pos.v++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return result >>> 0;
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
        }
    }
}

function hex(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
    return Buffer.from(bytes)
        .toString("hex")
        .match(/.{1,2}/g)
        ?.join(" ") ?? "";
}

function u32le(bytes: Uint8Array): number {
    return (
        bytes[0] |
        (bytes[1] << 8) |
        (bytes[2] << 16) |
        (bytes[3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readVecBytes(
    data: Uint8Array,
    pos: { v: number }
): Uint8Array {
    const len = readULEB(data, pos);
    const start = pos.v;
    pos.v += len;

    return data.subarray(start, start + len);
}

function decodeDataSection(
    data: Uint8Array,
    sectionStart: number,
    sectionSize: number
) {
    const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sectionSize;

    const pos = {
        v: sectionStart,
    };

    const count = readULEB(data, pos);

    console.log(`Data segments : ${count}`);

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const flags = readULEB(data, pos);

        let memoryIndex = 0;
        let offsetValue: number | null = null;

        /*
         * flags:
         *
         * 0 = active, memory 0, offset expr
         * 1 = passive
         * 2 = active, explicit memory index
         */

        if (flags === 0) {
            const opcode = data[pos.v++];

            if (opcode !== 0x41) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unexpected offset opcode 0x${opcode.toString(16)} at ${pos.v - 1}`
                );
            }

            offsetValue = readULEB(data, pos);

            const endOpcode = data[pos.v++];

            if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unexpected end opcode 0x${endOpcode.toString(16)}`
                );
            }
        } else if (flags === 1) {
            /*
             * passive segment
             */
        } else if (flags === 2) {
            memoryIndex = readULEB(data, pos);

            const opcode = data[pos.v++];

            if (opcode !== 0x41) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unexpected offset opcode 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
                );
            }

            offsetValue = readULEB(data, pos);

            const endOpcode = data[pos.v++];

            if (endOpcode !== 0x0b) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Unexpected end opcode 0x${endOpcode.toString(16)}`
                );
            }
        } else {
            throw new Error(
                `Unsupported data segment flags ${flags}`
            );
        }

        const segmentData = readVecBytes(data, pos);

        if (i === 669) {
            console.log("\n============================================================");
            console.log(" DATA SEGMENT 669");
            console.log("============================================================");

            console.log(`segment       : ${i}`);
            console.log(`flags         : ${flags}`);
            console.log(`memory index  : ${memoryIndex}`);
            console.log(
                `segment offset: ${offsetValue ?? "passive"}`
            );

            if (offsetValue !== null) {
                console.log(
                    `offset hex    : 0x${offsetValue
                        .toString(16)
                        .toUpperCase()}`
                );
            }

            console.log(
                `data size     : ${segmentData.length}`
            );

            console.log("\nRAW DATA:");

            console.log(hex(segmentData));

            console.log("\nMEMORY MAP:");

            if (offsetValue !== null) {
                for (let j = 0; j < segmentData.length; j++) {
                    const addr = offsetValue + j;

                    const mark =
                        addr === 1_659_724
                            ? " <<< TARGET"
                            : "";

                    console.log(
                        `addr=${addr
                            .toString()
                            .padStart(9, " ")} ` +
                        `0x${addr
                            .toString(16)
                            .padStart(8, "0")} ` +
                        `byte=0x${segmentData[j]
                            .toString(16)
                            .padStart(2, "0")}${mark}`
                    );
                }
            }

            console.log("\n32-BIT VALUES:");

            for (
                let j = 0;
                j + 4 <= segmentData.length;
                j += 4
            ) {
                const value = u32le(
                    segmentData.subarray(j, j + 4)
                );

                console.log(
                    `relative=${j
                        .toString()
                        .padStart(3, " ")} ` +
                    `addr=0x${(
                        (offsetValue ?? 0) + j
                    )
                        .toString(16)
                        .padStart(8, "0")} ` +
                    `value=${value} ` +
                    `0x${value
                        .toString(16)
                        .padStart(8, "0")}`
                );
            }

            console.log("\nNEXT SEGMENTS:");

            for (
                let k = i + 1;
                k < Math.min(i + 5, count);
                k++
            ) {
                /*
                 * We cannot jump here without parsing,
                 * so this is intentionally only a marker.
                 */
            }
        }
    }

    console.log(
        `\nData section parser ended at ${pos.v}, expected ${sectionEnd}`
    );
}

    }

        fs.readFileSync(WASM)
    );

     * Parse WASM sections.
     */

    let dataSectionSize = -1;

            break;
        }

        p = payloadEnd;
    }

const fs = require("fs");

    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = new Set([
    8948, 8949, 8950, 8951, 8952,
    8953, 8954, 8955, 8956, 8957,
    8958, 8959, 8960
]);

function hex(x, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

let p = 8;

function u8() {
    return buf[p++];
}

function u32() {
    let r = 0;
    let s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        r |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            return r >>> 0;

        s += 7;
    }
}

function i32() {
    let r = 0;
    let s = 0;
    let b;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p++];
        r |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        s += 7;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            break;
    }

    if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        r |= (~0 << s);

    return r | 0;
}

function name() {
    const n = u32();
    const start = p;
    p += n;
    return Buffer.from(buf.subarray(start, p)).toString("utf8");
}

function skipMem() {
    u32();
    u32();
}

function skipBlockType() {
    const b = buf[p];

    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c ||
        b === 0x7b
    ) {
        p++;
    } else {
        u32();
    }
}

function decode() {

}

    const op = b[x];

    if (
      op !== 0x20 &&
      op !== 0x21 &&
      op !== 0x22 &&
      op !== 0x28 &&
      op !== 0x29 &&
      op !== 0x36 &&
      op !== 0x10 &&
      op !== 0x11 &&
      op !== 0x41
    ) continue;

    let text = opName(op);

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const [v] = u(x + 1);
      text += " " + v;
    }
    else if (op === 0x41) {
      const [v] = u(x + 1);
      text += " " + v;
    }
    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const [v] = u(x + 1);
      text += " " + v;
    }
    else if (op === 0x11) {
      let v, z;
      [v, z] = u(x + 1);
      let t;
      [t] = u(z);
      text += " type=" + v + " table=" + t;
    }
    else {
      // Show immediate alignment/offset bytes only.
      let align, z;
      [align, z] = u(x + 1);
      let offset;
      [offset] = u(z);
      text += " offset=" + offset;
    }

    console.log(
      "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0"),
      text
    );
  }

  q = end;
}

console.log("DONE");

const fs = require("fs");

const FILE =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const IMPORTS = 83;

const TARGETS = new Set([
    8948, 8949, 8950, 8951, 8952,
    8953, 8954, 8955, 8956
]);

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function uleb(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            break;

        s += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: v >>> 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function sleb(p) {
    let v = 0, s = 0, b;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
        s += 7;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            break;
    }

    if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);

    return {
        value: v | 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function findSection(type) {

    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {

        const t = wasm[p++];

        const z = uleb(p);
        p = z.next;

        if (t === type) {
            return {
                start: p,
                end: p + z.value
            };
        }

        p += z.value;
    }

    return null;
}

function decodeBody(start, end) {

    let p = start;

    const lg = uleb(p);
    p = lg.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < lg.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;
        p++;
    }

    const ins = [];

    while (p < end) {

        const addr = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text =
            `opcode_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

        switch (op) {

            case 0x20: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x21: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x22: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x41: {
                const x = sleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `i32.const ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x10: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `call ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x11: {
                const t = uleb(p);
                p = t.next;

                const tab = uleb(p);
                p = tab.next;

                text =
                    `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x28: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text =
                    `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x29: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text =
                    `i64.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x2d: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text =
                    `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x36: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text =
                    `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x37: {
                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                text =
                    `i64.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x23: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `global.get ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x24: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `global.set ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x45:
                text = "i32.eqz";
                break;

            case 0x46:
                text = "i32.eq";
                break;

            case 0x47:
                text = "i32.ne";
                break;

            case 0x6a:
                text = "i32.add";
                break;

            case 0x6b:
                text = "i32.sub";
                break;

            case 0x1a:
                text = "drop";
                break;

            case 0x04:
                text = "if";
                break;

            case 0x05:
                text = "else";
                break;

            case 0x0b:
                text = "end";
                break;

            case 0x0c: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `br ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0d: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `br_if ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }
        }

        ins.push({
            addr,
            text
        });
    }

    return ins;
}

function getBodies() {

    const sec = findSection(10);

    if (!sec)
        throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

    let p = sec.start;

    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;

    const bodies = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

        const z = uleb(p);
        p = z.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + z.value;

        bodies.push({
            body: i,
            func: IMPORTS + i,
            start,
            end
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function hx(x) {
    return "0x" +
        x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

    const b = wasm[p++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))

function i32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }
  }
}

  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x964d1;
const END   = 0x965c7;

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function sleb32(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function memarg(p: number) {
  const a = uleb(p);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next
  };
}

function fcInstruction(p: number) {
  const sub = uleb(p);
  let next = sub.next;

  /*
   * Bulk-memory / reference instructions.
   * Decode the immediate according to subopcode.
   */

  switch (sub.value) {

    // memory.init
    case 8: {
      const data = uleb(next);
      next = data.next;

      const mem = uleb(next);
      next = mem.next;

      return {
        text: `memory.init data=${data.value} mem=${mem.value}`,
        next
      };
    }

    // data.drop
    case 9: {
      const data = uleb(next);

      return {
        text: `data.drop ${data.value}`,
        next: data.next
      };
    }

    // memory.copy
    case 10: {
      const dst = uleb(next);
      const src = uleb(dst.next);

      return {
        text: `memory.copy dst=${dst.value} src=${src.value}`,
        next: src.next
      };
    }

    // memory.fill
    case 11: {
      const mem = uleb(next);

      return {
        text: `memory.fill mem=${mem.value}`,
        next: mem.next
      };
    }

    default:
      return {
        text: `0xfc subopcode=${sub.value}`,
        next
      };
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGET = 104;

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << (s + 7));

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let n = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    n++;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function findCode() {
  let p = 8;
  let imported = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const sid = b[p++];
    const sr = readULEB(p);
    if (!sr) break;

    const ss = sr.value;
    const st = p + sr.len;
    const en = st + ss;

    if (sid === 2) {
      let q = st;
      const r = readULEB(q);
      q += r.len;

      for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
        const ml = readULEB(q); q += ml.len;
        const fl = readULEB(q); q += fl.len;
        const kl = readULEB(q); q += kl.len;

        if (kl.value === 0) {
          const t = readULEB(q);
          q += t.len;
          imported++;
        } else if (kl.value === 1) {
          q++;
          const f = readULEB(q); q += f.len;
          const a = readULEB(q); q += a.len;
          if (f.value & 1) {
            const m = readULEB(q); q += m.len;
          }
        } else if (kl.value === 2) {
          const f = readULEB(q); q += f.len;
          const a = readULEB(q); q += a.len;
          if (f.value & 1) {
            const m = readULEB(q); q += m.len;
          }
        } else if (kl.value === 3) {
          q += 2;
        }
      }
    }

    if (sid === 10) {
      let q = st;
      const r = readULEB(q);
      q += r.len;

      const funcs = [];

      for (let i = 0; i < r.value; i++) {
        const z = readULEB(q);
        q += z.len;

        funcs.push({
          func: imported + i,
          start: q,
          end: q + z.value
        });

        q += z.value;
      }

      return funcs;
    }

    p = en;
  }

  return [];
}

    p += tab.len;

    out += `  call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;

  else if (op === 0x0f) {
    out += "  return";

  else if (op === 0x0b) {
    out += "  end";

  else if (op === 0x6a) {

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const IMPORTED = 83;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findCodeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    if (id === 10) {
      return {
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
      };
    }

    p += s.value;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

function skipBlockType(p) {
  const x = b[p];

  if (
    x === 0x40 ||
    x === 0x7f ||
    x === 0x7e ||
    x === 0x7d ||
    x === 0x7c ||
    x === 0x7b
  ) {
    return p + 1;
  }

  return uleb(p).next;
}

function decodeBody(start, end) {
  let p = start;
  const out = [];

  while (p < end) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    const x = {
      addr,
      op,
      name: `0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    };

    switch (op) {
      case 0x02:
        x.name = "BLOCK";
        p = skipBlockType(p);
        break;

      case 0x03:
        x.name = "LOOP";
        p = skipBlockType(p);
        break;

      case 0x04:
        x.name = "IF";
        p = skipBlockType(p);
        break;

      case 0x05:
        x.name = "ELSE";
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        x.name = "END";
        break;

      case 0x0c:
        x.name = "BR";
        x.value = uleb(p).value;
        p = uleb(p).next;
        break;

      case 0x0d: {
        x.name = "BR_IF";
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0f:
        x.name = "RETURN";
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        x.name = "CALL";
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        x.name = "CALL_INDIRECT";

        const t = uleb(p);
        p = t.next;

        const tab = uleb(p);
        p = tab.next;

        x.typeidx = t.value;
        x.tableidx = tab.value;
        break;
      }

      case 0x20: {
        x.name = "LOCAL.GET";
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        x.name = "LOCAL.SET";
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        x.name = "LOCAL.TEE";
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        x.name = "GLOBAL.GET";
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        x.name = "GLOBAL.SET";
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x28:
      case 0x29:
      case 0x2a:
      case 0x2b:
      case 0x2c:
      case 0x2d:
      case 0x2e:
      case 0x2f:
      case 0x30:
      case 0x31:
      case 0x32:
      case 0x33:
      case 0x34:
      case 0x35:
      case 0x36:
      case 0x37:
      case 0x38:
      case 0x39:
      case 0x3a:
      case 0x3b:
      case 0x3c:
      case 0x3d:
      case 0x3e:
      case 0x3f:
      case 0x40: {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        x.name = op <= 0x35 ? "LOAD" : "STORE";
        x.align = a.value;
        x.offset = o.value;
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        x.name = "I32.CONST";
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      default:
        break;
    }

    out.push(x);
  }

  return out;
}

function getFunction(funcIndex) {
  const code = findCodeSection();

  let p = code.start;
  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;
    const index = IMPORTED + i;

    if (index === funcIndex) {
      return {
        index,
        start,
        end,
        size: size.value,
        instructions: decodeBody(start, end)
      };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`FUNC ${funcIndex} not found`);
}

function printFunction(fn) {
  console.log(
    `FUNCTION ${fn.index}  BODY 0x${fn.start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${fn.end.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
  );

  for (const x of fn.instructions) {
    const a = "0x" + x.addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");

    let s = `${a}  ${x.name}`;

    if (x.value !== undefined) {
      s += ` ${x.value}`;
    }

    if (x.offset !== undefined) {
      s += ` offset=${x.offset}`;
    }

    if (x.typeidx !== undefined) {
      s += ` type=${x.typeidx} table=${x.tableidx}`;
    }

    console.log(s);
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x0000d3f0;
const END   = 0x0000d425;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte;

  do {
    byte = b[pos++];
    value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (byte & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value, next: pos };
}

function readInstruction(p) {

  const start = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let text = `0x${start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  `;

  switch (op) {

    case 0x20: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `LOCAL.GET ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `LOCAL.SET ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `LOCAL.TEE ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      text += `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x29: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      text += `I64.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;
      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;
      text += `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const q = sleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `I32.CONST ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const q = sleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `I64.CONST ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x6a:
      text += "I32.ADD";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      text += "I32.SUB";
      break;

    case 0x10: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `CALL FUNC ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      const table = uleb(p);
      p = table.next;
      text += `CALL_INDIRECT type=${q.value} table=${table.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x1a:
      text += "DROP";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      text += "END";
      break;

    case 0x0f:
      text += "RETURN";
      break;

    default:
      text += `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      break;
  }

  return { next: p, text };
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 107;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function hex(v, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB128 overflow");
}

let importedFunctions = 0;

    const sectionId = wasm[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const sectionStart = pos;
    const sectionEnd = pos + sectionSize;

        const countInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
