        p = countInfo.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {

            let r = readULEB(wasm, p);
            p = r.next + r.value;

            r = readULEB(wasm, p);
            p = r.next + r.value;

            const kind = wasm[p++];

            if (kind === 0) {

                importedFunctions++;

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;
            }
            else if (kind === 1) {

                p++;

                const flags = wasm[p++];

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;

                if (flags & 1) {
                    r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                    p = r.next;
                }
            }
            else if (kind === 2) {

                const flags = wasm[p++];

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;

                if (flags & 1) {
                    r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                    p = r.next;
                }
            }
            else if (kind === 3) {
                p += 2;
            }
            else if (kind === 4) {

                p++;

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;
            }
        }
    }

    pos = sectionEnd;

function hex(v, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB128 overflow");
}

function readSLEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {

            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return {
                value: value | 0,
                next: p
            };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("SLEB128 overflow");
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const IMPORTED = 83;
const TARGET_FUNC = 107;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findCode() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    if (id === 10) {
      return {
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
      };
    }

    p += s.value;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

function getFunction(index) {
  const code = findCode();

  let p = code.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    if (IMPORTED + i === index) {
      return { start, end, size: size.value };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`FUNC ${index} not found`);
}

const fn = getFunction(TARGET_FUNC);

const returns = [];

for (let p = fn.start; p < fn.end; p++) {
  if (b[p] === 0x0f) {
    returns.push(p);
  }
}

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    if (id === 10) {
      return {
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
      };
    }

    p += s.value;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

function getFunction(index) {
  const code = findCodeSection();

  let p = code.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    const funcIndex = IMPORTED + i;

    if (funcIndex === index) {
      return { start, end, size: size.value };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`FUNC ${index} not found`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x0000d3eb;
const END   = 0x0000d3f5;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readInstruction(p) {

  const start = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let text = `0x${start.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  `;

  switch (op) {

    case 0x20: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `LOCAL.GET ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `LOCAL.SET ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;
      text += `LOCAL.TEE ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      text += `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      text += `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;

      text += `I32.CONST ${q.value} (0x${q.value.toString(16)})`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const q = uleb(p);
      p = q.next;

      text += `CALL FUNC ${q.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x6a:
      text += "I32.ADD";
      break;

    default:
      text += `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      break;
  }

  return { next: p, text };
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x0000d379;
const END   = 0x0000d3f7;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let x;

  do {
    x = b[pos++];
    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    value |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value, next: pos };
}

function ins(p) {

  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let s =
    `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  `;

  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    s += `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    s += `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    s += `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x28) {
    const a = uleb(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = uleb(p);
    p = o.next;

    s += `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x36) {
    const a = uleb(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = uleb(p);
    p = o.next;

    s += `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = sleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    s += `I32.CONST ${x.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    s += `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = uleb(p);
    p = t.next;

    const tab = uleb(p);
    p = tab.next;

    s += `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x6a) {
    s += "I32.ADD";

  } else if (op === 0x6b) {
    s += "I32.SUB";

  } else if (op === 0x45) {
    s += "I32.EQZ";

  } else if (op === 0x47) {
    s += "I32.NE";

  } else if (op === 0x04) {
    const x = b[p++];
    s += `IF type=0x${x.toString(16)}`;

  } else if (op === 0x02) {
    const x = b[p++];
    s += `BLOCK type=0x${x.toString(16)}`;

  } else if (op === 0x03) {
    const x = b[p++];
    s += `LOOP type=0x${x.toString(16)}`;

  } else if (op === 0x0c) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    s += `BR ${x.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x0d) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    s += `BR_IF ${x.value}`;

  } else if (op === 0x1a) {
    s += "DROP";

  } else if (op === 0x0b) {
    s += "END";

  } else {
    s += `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  return { next: p, text: s };
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 107;
const IMPORTS = 83;

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
        s += 7;
    }
}

function hx(v) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

let pos = 8;

while (pos < wasm.length) {

    const section = wasm[pos++];

    const si = uleb(pos);
    pos = si.next;

    const end = pos + si.value;

    if (section === 10) {

        let p = pos;

        const ci = uleb(p);
        const count = ci.value;

        for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count; ordinal++) {

            const bi = uleb(p);

                console.log(`SIZE     : ${size}`);
                console.log("-".repeat(72));

                let q = start;

                while (q < bodyEnd) {

                    const op = wasm[q];

                    // local.get
                    if (op === 0x20) {

                        );
                        q = r.next;
                        continue;
                    }

                    // local.tee
                    if (op === 0x22) {
                        const r = uleb(q + 1);
                        console.log(
                            `${hx(q)}  local.tee ${r.value}`
                        );
                        q = r.next;

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

// Known FUNC 122 body from previous analysis
const START = 0x1226d;
const END   = 0x1295b;

const TARGETS = new Set([
  0x242bd,
  0x242d1,
]);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 122 ARG2 DATAFLOW");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE :", buf.length);
console.log("FUNC 122  :", `0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("TARGETS   : 0x242bd / 0x242d1");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    b = buf[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    result |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: result | 0, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function dumpAround(pos: number, radius = 12) {
  const a = Math.max(START, pos - radius);
  const b = Math.min(END, pos + radius);

  const bytes: string[] = [];

  for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {
    bytes.push(buf[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
  }

  console.log(
    `  ${hex(a)} .. ${hex(b)} : ${bytes.join(" ")}`
  );
}

console.log("\nSCANNING CONSTANTS INSIDE FUNC 122");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let p = START;
let count = 0;

while (p < END) {
  const opPos = p;
  const op = buf[p++];

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = readSLEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    const value = r.value >>> 0;

    if (TARGETS.has(value)) {
      console.log("");
      console.log("############################################################");
      console.log("MATCH i32.const");
      console.log("############################################################");
      console.log("OFFSET :", hex(opPos));
      console.log("VALUE  :", hex(value));
      dumpAround(opPos);
      count++;
    }

    continue;
  }

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  // local.set / local.tee
  if (op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  // i32.load / load8 / load16 etc.
  if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x2c ||
    op === 0x2d ||
    op === 0x2e ||
    op === 0x2f
  ) {
    const align = readULEB(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = readULEB(p);
    p = offset.next;

    console.log(
      `MEM LOAD @ ${hex(opPos)}  align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.store variants
  if (
    op === 0x36 ||
    op === 0x3a ||
    op === 0x3b ||
    op === 0x3c ||
    op === 0x3e
  ) {
    const align = readULEB(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = readULEB(p);
    p = offset.next;

    console.log(
      `MEM STORE @ ${hex(opPos)}  align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    console.log(
      `CALL @ ${hex(opPos)} -> FUNC ${r.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // br / br_if
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  // block / loop / if
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    if (p < END) p++;
    continue;
  }

  // common no-immediate opcodes
}

console.log("\n------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("MATCH COUNT :", count);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readU32LE(p: number) {
  return (
    wasm[p] |
    (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
    (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
    (wasm[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function readLeb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function u32() {
  let n = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    n |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return n >>> 0;
    s += 7;
  }
}

function vu(buf: Buffer, q: {v:number}) {
  let n=0,s=0;
  while(true){
    const x=buf[q.v++];
    n |= (x&127)<<s;
    if(!(x&128)) return n>>>0;
    s+=7;
  }
}

function s64(buf: Buffer, q:{v:number}) {
  let n=0n,s=0n;
  while(true){
    const x=buf[q.v++];
    n |= BigInt(x&127)<<s;
    if(!(x&128)){
      if(s<63n && (x&64)) n |= (-1n) << (s+7n);
      return n;
    }
    s+=7n;
  }
}

function sec() {
  const id=b[p++];
  const size=u32();
  const start=p, end=p+size;
  return {id,start,end};
}

while(p<b.length){
  const s=sec();
  const q=s.start;

  if(s.id===1){

      const np=vu(b,qq);

      } else if(kind===1){
        qq.v++; vu(b,qq);
        const lim=b[qq.v++];
        vu(b,qq);
        if(lim===1) vu(b,qq);
      } else if(kind===2){
        qq.v++;
      } else if(kind===3){

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x1226d;
const END   = 0x1295b;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    value |= ~0 << shift;

  return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function decode(pos: number) {
  const start = pos;
  const op = buf[pos++];

  const r = (name: string, value?: number) => ({
    start,
    end: pos,
    name,
    value,
  });

  switch (op) {
    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      return r("local.get", x.value);
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      return r("local.set", x.value);
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      return r("local.tee", x.value);
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      return r("i32.const", x.value);
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      return r("call", x.value);
    }

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      return r("br", x.value);
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(pos);
      pos = x.next;
      return r("br_if", x.value);
    }

    case 0x02:
      if (pos < END) pos++;
      return r("block");

    case 0x03:
      if (pos < END) pos++;
      return r("loop");

    case 0x04:
      if (pos < END) pos++;
      return r("if");

    default:
      return r("opcode_" + op.toString(16));
  }
}

let p = START;

while (p < END) {
  const ins = decode(p);

  if (ins.end <= p)
    break;

  instructions.push(ins);
  p = ins.end;
}

let found = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
  const ins = instructions[i];

  if (ins.name !== "call" || ins.value !== 87)
    continue;

  found++;

  console.log("");
  console.log("############################################################");
  console.log(`CALL 87 #${found} @ ${hx(ins.start)}`);
  console.log("############################################################");

  const from = Math.max(0, i - 12);
  const to = Math.min(instructions.length, i + 1);

  console.log("PREVIOUS INSTRUCTIONS");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  for (let j = from; j < to; j++) {
    const x = instructions[j];

    let extra = "";

    if (
      x.name === "i32.const" &&
      (x.value === 0x242bd || x.value === 0x242d1)
    ) {
      extra = "  <<< TARGET CONSTANT";
    }

    if (x.name === "local.get")
      extra = `  <<< local ${x.value}`;

    if (x.name === "local.tee")
      extra = `  <<< local.tee ${x.value}`;

    console.log(
      `${hx(x.start)}  ${x.name}` +
      (x.value !== undefined ? ` ${x.value}` : "") +
      extra
    );
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("STACK-NEAR-CALL INTERPRETATION");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  const recent = instructions.slice(from, i);

  for (const x of recent) {
    if (x.name === "i32.const") {
      console.log(
        `${hx(x.start)}  PUSH CONST  ${x.value} (${hx(x.value >>> 0)})`
      );
    }

    else if (x.name === "local.get") {
      console.log(
        `${hx(x.start)}  PUSH LOCAL  ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    else if (x.name === "local.tee") {
      console.log(

      );
    }

    else if (x.name === "call") {
      console.log(

                        );

                        q = r.next;
                        continue;
                    }

                        const r = uleb(q + 1);

                        console.log(
                            `${hx(q)}  CALL FUNC ${r.value}`
                        );

                        q = r.next;
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (op === 0x11) {
                        const r = uleb(q + 1);

                        console.log(
                            `${hx(q)}  CALL_INDIRECT type=${r.value}`
                        );

                        q = r.next + 1;
                        continue;
                    }

                    // global.get
                    if (op === 0x23) {
                        const r = uleb(q + 1);

                        console.log(
                            `${hx(q)}  GLOBAL.GET ${r.value}`
                        );

                        q = r.next;
                        continue;
                    }

                    // global.set
                    if (op === 0x24) {
                        const r = uleb(q + 1);

                        console.log(
                            `${hx(q)}  GLOBAL.SET ${r.value}`
                        );

                        q = r.next;
                        continue;
                    }

                    // return
                    if (op === 0x0f) {
                        console.log(
                            `${hx(q)}  RETURN`
                        );
                        q++;
                        continue;
                    }

                    q++;
                }

            }

            p = bodyEnd;
        }
    }

    pos = end;

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80))

        shift += 7;
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const START = 0x0000eec5;
const END   = 0x0000ef44;

const ARG0 = 32;
const ARG1 = 0x242d1;
const ARG2 = 902;

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << (s + 7));

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

while (p < END) {

  const a = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let s = "";

  switch (op) {

    case 0x00:
      s = "unreachable";
      break;

    case 0x01:
      s = "nop";
      break;

    case 0x02:
      s = "block";
      p++;
      break;

    case 0x03:
      s = "loop";
      p++;
      break;

    case 0x04:
      s = "if";
      p++;
      break;

    case 0x05:
      s = "else";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      s = "end";
      break;

    case 0x0c: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `br ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `br_if ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0f:
      s = "return";
      break;

    case 0x10: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `CALL FUNC ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = readULEB(p);
      p = t.next;

      const tab = readULEB(p);
      p = tab.next;

      s = `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;

      if (t.value === 3 && tab.value === 0) {
        s += "  <-- IMPORTANT INDIRECT CALL";
        s += " | selector = local3";
      }

      break;
    }

    case 0x1a:
      s = "drop";
      break;

    case 0x20: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;

      const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0: `local0=${ARG0}`,
        1: `local1=${hex(ARG1)}`,
        2: `local2=${ARG2}`,
        3: "local3=<runtime>",
      };

      s = names[r.value] ?? `local.get ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `local.set ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      s = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const al = readULEB(p);
      p = al.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      s = `i32.load align=${al.value} offset=${off.value}`;

      if (a === 0x0000eed3) {
        s += "  <-- MEM[0x19534C]";
      }

      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const al = readULEB(p);
      p = al.next;

      const off = readULEB(p);
      p = off.next;

      s = `i32.store align=${al.value} offset=${off.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const r = readSLEB(p);
      p = r.next;

      s = `i32.const ${r.value} (${hex(r.value >>> 0)})`;

      if (r.value === 4788)
        s += "  <-- TABLE[4788] = FUNC122";

      if ((r.value >>> 0) === 0x19534c)
        s += "  <-- ADDRESS 0x19534C";

      break;
    }

    case 0x45:
      s = "i32.eqz";
      break;

    case 0x46:
      s = "i32.eq";
      break;

    case 0x47:
      s = "i32.ne";
      break;

    case 0x6a:
      s = "i32.add";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      s = "i32.sub";
      break;

    default:
      s = `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      break;
  }

  console.log(`${hex(a)}  ${s}`);
}

FILE: scripts\traceFunc1974Callers.ts

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_FUNC = 1974;

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;

const TARGETS = new Set([
  0x0019534c,
  0x00195350,
  0x00195354,
  0x00195358,
]);

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readU32LE(pos: number) {
  return (
    wasm[pos] |
    (wasm[pos + 1] << 8) |
    (wasm[pos + 2] << 16) |
    (wasm[pos + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function isI32Const(pos: number) {
  return wasm[pos] === 0x41;
}

function readSleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = wasm[pos++];
    value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function skipImmediate(op: number, p: number): number {
  switch (op) {

    // block / loop / if
    case 0x02:
    case 0x03:
    case 0x04:
      return p + 1;

    // br / br_if
    case 0x0c:
    case 0x0d: {
      return uleb(p).next;
    }

    // call
    case 0x10: {
      return uleb(p).next;
    }

    // call_indirect
    case 0x11: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      return a.next + 1;
    }

    // local.get / set / tee
    case 0x20:
    case 0x21:
    case 0x22:
      return uleb(p).next;

    // global.get / set
    case 0x23:
    case 0x24:
      return uleb(p).next;

    // i32.load
    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      return uleb(a.next).next;
    }

    // i32.store
    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      return uleb(a.next).next;
    }

    // i32.const
    case 0x41:
      return readSleb(p).next;

    // memory.copy
    case 0xfc: {
      const sub = uleb(p);
      if (sub.value === 10) {
        return sub.next + 2;
      }
      return sub.next;
    }

    // memory.fill
    case 0xfc: {
      return p;
    }

    default:
      return p;
  }
}

type Hit = {
  pc: number;
  caller: number;
  args: string[];
};

console.log("TRACE FUNC1974 CALLERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("=".repeat(60));
console.log(`TARGET FUNC = ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
console.log(`CODE = ${hex(CODE_START)} .. ${hex(CODE_END)}`);
console.log();

const hits: Hit[] = [];

let p = CODE_START;
let currentFunc = -1;

while (p < CODE_END - 4) {

  const start = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  // Function boundaries cannot be reliably reconstructed from raw bytes
  // without the code-section body table, so we identify direct calls first.
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    if (x.value === TARGET_FUNC) {

      const args: string[] = [];

      // Inspect preceding ~20 bytes/instructions.
      let q = Math.max(CODE_START, start - 80);

      while (q < start) {
        const a = q;
        const o = wasm[q++];

        if (o === 0x20) {
          const x2 = uleb(q);
          q = x2.next;
          args.push(`local${x2.value} @ ${hex(a)}`);
          continue;
        }

        if (o === 0x41) {
          const x2 = readSleb(q);
          q = x2.next;
          args.push(`CONST(${hex(x2.value >>> 0)}) @ ${hex(a)}`);
          continue;
        }

        if (o === 0x23) {
          const x2 = uleb(q);
          q = x2.next;
          args.push(`global${x2.value} @ ${hex(a)}`);
          continue;
        }

        if (o === 0x28) {
          const x2 = uleb(q);
          q = x2.next;
          const x3 = uleb(q);
          q = x3.next;
          args.push(
            `i32.load(offset=${hex(x3.value)}) @ ${hex(a)}`
          );
          continue;
        }

        if (o === 0x21 || o === 0x22 || o === 0x24) {
          const x2 = uleb(q);
          q = x2.next;
          continue;
        }

        q = skipImmediate(o, q);
      }

      hits.push({
        pc: start,
        caller: currentFunc,
        args,
      });

      console.log("-".repeat(60));
      console.log(`CALL FUNC1974 @ ${hex(start)}`);
      console.log(`RAW PRECEDING ARGUMENT CANDIDATES:`);

      for (const a of args.slice(-12)) {
        console.log(`  ${a}`);
      }

      // Show exact bytes around call.
      const lo = Math.max(CODE_START, start - 32);
      const hi = Math.min(CODE_END, start + 8);

      console.log();
      console.log(`RAW ${hex(lo)} .. ${hex(hi)}`);

      for (let z = lo; z < hi; z += 16) {
        const end = Math.min(hi, z + 16);

        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let k = z; k < end; k++) {
          bytes.push(
            wasm[k].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
          );
        }

        console.log(
          `${hex(z)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
        );
      }

      // Check whether the immediately preceding bytes contain
      // a target selector constant.
      for (let z = Math.max(CODE_START, start - 40); z < start; z++) {
        if (!isI32Const(z)) continue;

        const x2 = readSleb(z + 1);

        if (TARGETS.has(x2.value >>> 0)) {
          console.log();
          console.log(
            `>>> TARGET CONSTANT BEFORE CALL = ${hex(x2.value >>> 0)}`
          );
          console.log(
            `>>> CONST PC = ${hex(z)}`
          );
        }
      }
    }

    continue;
  }

  // Keep scanner moving.
  p = skipImmediate(op, p);
}

function readULEB(pos) {
  let v = 0;

    const x = b[pos++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };

    s += 7;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const TARGET = 2055;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;

  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function sections() {

  let p = 8;
  let functionSection = null;
  let codeSection = null;

  while (p < b.length) {

    const id = b[p++];

    const z = uleb(p);
    const size = z.value;
    p = z.next;

    if (id === 3)
      functionSection = {
        start: p,
        end: p + size
      };

    if (id === 10)
      codeSection = {
        start: p,
        end: p + size
      };

    p += size;
  }

  return { functionSection, codeSection };
}

const { functionSection, codeSection } = sections();

if (!functionSection || !codeSection) {
  console.log("FUNCTION/CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
  process.exit(1);
}

/*
 * Function Section:
 *
 * vector of type indices for DEFINED functions only.
 * Function index = imported_count + code_ordinal.
 *
 * Therefore first obtain imported_count from Import Section.
 */

function getImportedFunctionCount() {

  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {

    const id = b[p++];

    const z = uleb(p);
    const size = z.value;
    p = z.next;

    if (id !== 2) {
      p += size;
      continue;
    }

    const end = p + size;

    const c = uleb(p);
    p = c.next;

    let count = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {

      const ml = uleb(p);
      p = ml.next + ml.value;

      const nl = uleb(p);
      p = nl.next + nl.value;

      const kind = b[p++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        uleb(p);
        p = uleb(p).next;
        count++;
      }

      else if (kind === 1) {
        p += 4;
      }

      else if (kind === 2) {
        const fl = uleb(p);
        p = fl.next + fl.value;
      }

      else if (kind === 3) {
        p += 2;
      }
    }

    return count;
  }

  return 0;
}

const importedCount = getImportedFunctionCount();

const ordinal = TARGET - importedCount;

function decode(p) {

  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let text =
    `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  `;

  switch (op) {

    case 0x01:
      text += "NOP";
      break;

    case 0x02:
      text += `BLOCK type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    case 0x03:
      text += `LOOP type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    case 0x04:
      text += `IF type=0x${b[p++].toString(16)}`;
      break;

    case 0x05:
      text += "ELSE";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      text += "END";
      break;

    case 0x0c: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `BR ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `BR_IF ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0f:
      text += "RETURN";
      break;

    case 0x10: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = uleb(p);
      p = t.next;

      const tab = uleb(p);
      p = tab.next;

      text +=
        `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x1a:
      text += "DROP";
      break;

    case 0x1b:
      text += "SELECT";
      break;

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `GLOBAL.GET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
      text += `GLOBAL.SET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      text +=
        `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x2d: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      text +=
        `I32.LOAD8_U align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      text +=
        `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x3a: {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      text +=
        `I32.STORE8 align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      text += `I32.CONST ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const x = sleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      text += `I64.CONST ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x45:
      text += "I32.EQZ";
      break;

    case 0x46:
      text += "I32.EQ";
      break;

    case 0x47:
      text += "I32.NE";
      break;

    case 0x48:
      text += "I32.LT_S";
      break;

    case 0x49:
      text += "I32.LT_U";
      break;

    case 0x4a:
      text += "I32.GT_S";
      break;

    case 0x4b:
      text += "I32.GT_U";
      break;

    case 0x6a:
      text += "I32.ADD";
      break;

    case 0x6b:
      text += "I32.SUB";
      break;

    case 0x71:
      text += "I32.AND";
      break;

    case 0x72:
      text += "I32.OR";
      break;

    case 0x73:
      text += "I32.XOR";
      break;

    case 0x74:
      text += "I32.SHL";
      break;

    case 0x75:
      text += "I32.SHR_S";
      break;

    case 0x76:
      text += "I32.SHR_U";
      break;

    default:
      text +=
        `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      break;
  }

  return { next:p, text };
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v=0,s=0,x;
  do {
    x=b[p++];
    v |= (x&0x7f)<<s;
    s+=7;
  } while(x&0x80);

function dec(p) {
  const a=p, op=b[p++];

  switch(op) {
    case 0x20:{const x=uleb(p);return {next:x.next,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`};}
    case 0x21:{const x=uleb(p);return {next:x.next,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`};}
    case 0x22:{const x=uleb(p);return {next:x.next,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`};}
    case 0x41:{const x=sleb(p);return {next:x.next,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.CONST ${x.value}`};}
    case 0x10:{const x=uleb(p);return {next:x.next,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} CALL ${x.value}`};}
    case 0x11:{
      const t=uleb(p); p=t.next;
      const tb=uleb(p); p=tb.next;
      return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tb.value}`};
    }
    case 0x28:{
      const al=uleb(p);p=al.next;
      const of=uleb(p);p=of.next;
      return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.LOAD offset=${of.value}`};
    }
    case 0x6a:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.ADD`};
    case 0x6b:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.SUB`};
    case 0x45:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.EQZ`};
    case 0x46:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.EQ`};
    case 0x47:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.NE`};
    case 0x48:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.LT_S`};
    case 0x4a:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.GT_S`};
    case 0x4c:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} I32.LE_S`};
    case 0x0b:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} END`};
    case 0x0d:{const x=uleb(p);return {next:x.next,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} BR_IF ${x.value}`};}
    case 0x1a:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} DROP`};
    default:return {next:p,s:`0x${a.toString(16)} OP 0x${op.toString(16)}`};
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x93d80;

function readULEB(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let n = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    n++;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, len: n };

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) return null;
  }

  return null;
}

function hx(v) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

        );
      }

      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;

      extra = ` ${r.value} (${hx(r.value)})`;
      p += r.len;
      break;
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;

      extra = ` call ${r.value}`;
      p += r.len;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28:
    case 0x36: {
      const align = b[p++];

      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;

      extra = ` align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;
      p += r.len;

      if (op === 0x36) {
        console.log(

        );
      }

      break;

    case 0x02:
    case 0x03:
    case 0x04: {
      const bt = b[p++];
      extra = ` blocktype=0x${bt.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0c:
    case 0x0d: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;

      extra = ` ${r.value}`;
      p += r.len;
      break;
    }

    default:
      break;
  }

    op !== 0x20 &&
    op !== 0x21 &&
    op !== 0x22 &&
    op !== 0x36
  ) {
    console.log(
      `${hx(at)}  ${b[at].toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}  opcode${extra}`
    );

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x93e60;
const END   = 0x93eb0;

function readULEB(p) {

  let n = 0;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

function hex(v, n = 8) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

function opName(op) {
  const m = {
    0x00: "unreachable",
    0x01: "nop",
    0x02: "block",
    0x03: "loop",
    0x04: "if",
    0x05: "else",
    0x0b: "end",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
    0x0e: "br_table",
    0x0f: "return",

    0x10: "call",
    0x11: "call_indirect",

    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",

    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x2d: "i32.load8_u",

    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x3a: "i32.store8",

    0x41: "i32.const",

    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x47: "i32.lt_u",

    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x76: "i32.shr_u"
  };

  return m[op] ?? `opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

while (p < END) {
  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let extra = "";

  switch (op) {

    case 0x41: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;

      extra = ` ${r.value} (${hex(r.value)})`;
      p += r.len;
      break;
    }

    case 0x20:
    case 0x21:
    case 0x22:
    case 0x0c:
    case 0x0d:
    case 0x10: {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;

      extra = ` ${r.value}`;
      p += r.len;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28:
    case 0x2d:
    case 0x36:
    case 0x3a: {
      const align = b[p++];

      const r = readULEB(p);
      if (!r) break;

      extra = ` align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;
      p += r.len;

      if (op === 0x36 || op === 0x3a) {
        console.log(
          `STORE @ ${hex(at)} ${opName(op)}${extra}`
        );
      }

      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const type = readULEB(p);
      if (!type) break;
      p += type.len;

      const table = readULEB(p);
      if (!table) break;
      p += table.len;

      extra = ` type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x02:
    case 0x03:
    case 0x04: {
      const blockType = b[p++];
      extra = ` blocktype=0x${blockType.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      break;
    }

    default:
      break;
  }

  console.log(
    `${hex(at)}  ${b[at].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}  ${opName(op)}${extra}`
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 2075;
const IMPORTED = 83;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------- */
/* FIND SECTIONS                                              */
/* --------------------------------------------------------- */

let p = 8;
let funcSec = null;
let codeSec = null;

while (p < b.length) {

  const id = b[p++];

  const z = uleb(p);
  const size = z.value;
  p = z.next;

  if (id === 3)
    funcSec = { start: p, end: p + size };

  if (id === 10)
    codeSec = { start: p, end: p + size };

  p += size;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------- */
/* FUNCTION BODY                                              */
/* --------------------------------------------------------- */

const ordinal = TARGET - IMPORTED;

let fp = funcSec.start;
const fc = uleb(fp);
fp = fc.next;

let typeIndex = null;

for (let i = 0; i <= ordinal; i++) {
  const x = uleb(fp);
  fp = x.next;

  if (i === ordinal)
    typeIndex = x.value;
}

let cp = codeSec.start;
const cc = uleb(cp);
cp = cc.next;

let body = null;

for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {

  const z = uleb(cp);
  const size = z.value;
  cp = z.next;

  const start = cp;
  const end = cp + size;

  if (i === ordinal) {
    body = { start, end };
    break;
  }

  cp = end;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x00095b55;
const END   = 0x00095b83;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value:v, next:p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value:v, next:p };
}

function decode(p) {
  const addr = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  let t = `0x${addr.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}  `;

  switch(op) {

    case 0x20: {
      const x = uleb(p); p=x.next;
      t += `LOCAL.GET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const x = uleb(p); p=x.next;
      t += `LOCAL.SET ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const x = uleb(p); p=x.next;
      t += `LOCAL.TEE ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a=uleb(p); p=a.next;
      const o=uleb(p); p=o.next;
      t += `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a=uleb(p); p=a.next;
      const o=uleb(p); p=o.next;
      t += `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x=sleb(p); p=x.next;
      t += `I32.CONST ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x10: {
      const x=uleb(p); p=x.next;
      t += `CALL FUNC ${x.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x1b:
      t += "SELECT";
      break;

    case 0x6a:
      t += "I32.ADD";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      t += "END";
      break;

    default:
      t += `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  }

  return {next:p,text:t};
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 2088;
const TARGET_GLOBAL = 0;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function hex(v, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * (2 ** shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB128 overflow");
}

) {

            let r = readULEB(wasm, p);
            p = r.next + r.value;

            r = readULEB(wasm, p);
            p = r.next + r.value;

            const kind = wasm[p++];

            if (kind === 0) {
                importedFunctions++;

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;
            }
            else if (kind === 1) {
                p += 1;

                const flags = wasm[p++];

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;

                if (flags & 1) {
                    r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                    p = r.next;
                }
            }
            else if (kind === 2) {

                const flags = wasm[p++];

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;

                if (flags & 1) {
                    r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                    p = r.next;
                }
            }
            else if (kind === 3) {
                p += 2;
            }
            else if (kind === 4) {
                p++;

                r = readULEB(wasm, p);
                p = r.next;
            }
        }

    pos = end;

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const IMPORTED = 83;
const TARGET_FUNC = 2088;
const TARGET_CALL = 106;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function findCodeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    if (id === 10) {
      return {
        start: p,
        end: p + s.value
      };
    }

    p += s.value;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

function readBlockType(p) {
  const x = b[p];

  if (
    x === 0x40 ||
    x === 0x7f ||
    x === 0x7e ||
    x === 0x7d ||
    x === 0x7c ||
    x === 0x7b
  ) {
    return p + 1;
  }

  return uleb(p).next;
}

function decode(start, end) {
  const ins = [];
  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    const x = {
      addr,
      op,
      name: `0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    };

    switch (op) {

      case 0x02:
        x.name = "BLOCK";
        p = readBlockType(p);
        break;

      case 0x03:
        x.name = "LOOP";
        p = readBlockType(p);
        break;

      case 0x04:
        x.name = "IF";
        p = readBlockType(p);
        break;

      case 0x05:
        x.name = "ELSE";
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        x.name = "END";
        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "BR";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "BR_IF";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0f:
        x.name = "RETURN";
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "CALL";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const t = uleb(p);
        p = t.next;

        const table = uleb(p);
        p = table.next;

        x.name = "CALL_INDIRECT";
        x.typeidx = t.value;
        x.tableidx = table.value;
        break;
      }

      case 0x20: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "LOCAL.GET";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "LOCAL.SET";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "LOCAL.TEE";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "GLOBAL.GET";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "GLOBAL.SET";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x28:
      case 0x29:
      case 0x2a:
      case 0x2b:
      case 0x2c:
      case 0x2d:
      case 0x2e:
      case 0x2f:
      case 0x30:
      case 0x31:
      case 0x32:
      case 0x33:
      case 0x34:
      case 0x35:
      case 0x36:
      case 0x37:
      case 0x38:
      case 0x39:
      case 0x3a:
      case 0x3b:
      case 0x3c:
      case 0x3d:
      case 0x3e:
      case 0x3f:
      case 0x40: {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        x.name = op <= 0x35 ? "LOAD" : "STORE";
        x.align = a.value;
        x.offset = o.value;
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "I32.CONST";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      case 0x42: {
        const q = uleb(p);
        x.name = "I64.CONST";
        x.value = q.value;
        p = q.next;
        break;
      }

      default:
        break;
    }

    ins.push(x);
  }

  return ins;
}

function getFunction(index) {
  const code = findCodeSection();

  let p = code.start;
  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + size.value;

    const funcIndex = IMPORTED + i;

    if (funcIndex === index) {
      return {
        index: funcIndex,
        start,
        end,
        size: size.value,
        ins: decode(start, end)
      };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`FUNC ${index} not found`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const TARGET = 2161;

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  do {
    x = wasm[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  do {
    x = wasm[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function section(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];
    const z = uleb(p);
    p = z.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + z.value;

    if (sid === id) return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
}

function importedFunctionCount() {
  const s = section(2);
  let p = s.start;

  const c = uleb(p);
  p = c.next;

  let n = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
    const ml = uleb(p);
    p = ml.next + ml.value;

    const nl = uleb(p);
    p = nl.next + nl.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      n++;
      p = uleb(p).next;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p += 4;
      if (wasm[p - 1] & 1) p = uleb(p).next;
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = wasm[p + 1];
      p += 2;
      p = uleb(p).next;
      if (flags & 1) p = uleb(p).next;
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p++;
      p = uleb(p).next;
    }
  }

  return n;
}

function getBody(funcIndex: number) {
  const imported = importedFunctionCount();
  const ordinal = funcIndex - imported;

  const fs = section(3);
  let p = fs.start;

  const fc = uleb(p);
  p = fc.next;

  const types: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    types.push(x.value);
  }

  const cs = section(10);
  p = cs.start;

  const cc = uleb(p);
  p = cc.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
    const z = uleb(p);
    p = z.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + z.value;

    if (i === ordinal) {
      return { start, end, type: types[ordinal] };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("FUNC body not found");
}

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x00014308;
const END   = 0x00014420;

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0, shift = 0;
    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: pos };
        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGET = 259;

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << (s + 7));

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections: any[] = [];

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + r.value
    });

    p += r.value;
  }

  return sections;
}

  p = r.next;
}

      break;

    case 0x03:
      s = "loop";
      x++;
      break;

    case 0x04:
      s = "if";
      x++;
      break;

    case 0x05:
      s = "else";
      break;

    case 0x0b:
      s = "end";
      break;

    case 0x0c: {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `br ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0d: {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `br_if ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x0f:
      s = "return";
      break;

    case 0x10: {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `CALL FUNC ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x11: {
      const t = readULEB(x);
      x = t.next;
      const tab = readULEB(x);
      x = tab.next;
      s = `CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x1a:
      s = "drop";
      break;

    case 0x20: {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `local.get ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x21: {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `local.set ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x22: {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x23: {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `global.get ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x24: {
      const r = readULEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `global.set ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x28: {
      const a1 = readULEB(x);
      x = a1.next;

      const off = readULEB(x);
      x = off.next;

      s = `i32.load align=${a1.value} offset=${off.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x36: {
      const a1 = readULEB(x);
      x = a1.next;

      const off = readULEB(x);
      x = off.next;

      s = `i32.store align=${a1.value} offset=${off.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const r = readSLEB(x);
      x = r.next;

      s = `i32.const ${r.value} (${hex(r.value >>> 0)})`;

      if ((r.value >>> 0) === 0x251004)
        s += "  <-- FUNC6919 INPUT";

      break;
    }

    case 0x42: {
      const r = readSLEB(x);
      x = r.next;
      s = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
      break;
    }

    case 0x45: s = "i32.eqz"; break;
    case 0x46: s = "i32.eq"; break;
    case 0x47: s = "i32.ne"; break;
    case 0x48: s = "i32.lt_s"; break;
    case 0x49: s = "i32.lt_u"; break;
    case 0x4a: s = "i32.gt_s"; break;
    case 0x4b: s = "i32.gt_u"; break;
    case 0x4c: s = "i32.le_s"; break;
    case 0x4d: s = "i32.le_u"; break;
    case 0x4e: s = "i32.ge_s"; break;
    case 0x4f: s = "i32.ge_u"; break;

    case 0x6a: s = "i32.add"; break;
    case 0x6b: s = "i32.sub"; break;
    case 0x71: s = "i32.and"; break;
    case 0x72: s = "i32.or"; break;
    case 0x73: s = "i32.xor"; break;

    default:
      s = `opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      break;
  }

  console.log(`${hex(a)}  ${s}`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_START = 0x195340;
const TARGET_END   = 0x195364;

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function signed(v: number) {
    return v >>> 0;
}

/*
 * Lightweight symbolic stack.
 * Important: calls are represented conservatively so that
 * suspicious addresses are not falsely resolved.
 */

type Sym =
    | { kind: "const", value: number }
    | { kind: "global0" }
    | { kind: "local", index: number }
    | { kind: "add", a: Sym, b: Sym }
    | { kind: "sub", a: Sym, b: Sym }
    | { kind: "load", addr: Sym, offset: number }
    | { kind: "unknown", text: string };

function show(s: Sym): string {
    switch (s.kind) {
        case "const":
            return `CONST(${hex(s.value)})`;

        case "global0":
            return "GLOBAL0";

        case "local":
            return `LOCAL${s.index}`;

        case "add":
            return `(${show(s.a)} + ${show(s.b)})`;

        case "sub":
            return `(${show(s.a)} - ${show(s.b)})`;

        case "load":
            return `LOAD(${show(s.addr)}+${hex(s.offset)})`;

        case "unknown":
            return s.text;
    }
}

function knownValue(s: Sym): number | null {

    if (s.kind === "const")
        return s.value >>> 0;

    if (
        s.kind === "add" &&
        s.a.kind === "const" &&
        s.b.kind === "const"
    )
        return (s.a.value + s.b.value) >>> 0;

    if (
        s.kind === "sub" &&
        s.a.kind === "const" &&
        s.b.kind === "const"
    )
        return (s.a.value - s.b.value) >>> 0;

    return null;
}

const stack: Sym[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, Sym>();

function pop(): Sym {
    return stack.length
        ? stack.pop()!
        : { kind: "unknown", text: "STACK_UNDERFLOW" };
}

function push(s: Sym) {
    stack.push(s);
}

function checkAddress(
    address: Sym,
    offset: number,
    at: number,
    type: string,
    value: Sym
) {
    const base = knownValue(address);

    const effective =
        base === null
            ? null
            : ((base + offset) >>> 0);

    const expr =
        effective !== null
            ? hex(effective)
            : `${show(address)} + ${hex(offset)}`;

    console.log("");
    console.log(`STORE @ ${hex(at)}`);
    console.log(`TYPE    = ${type}`);
    console.log(`ADDRESS = ${show(address)}`);
    console.log(`OFFSET  = ${hex(offset)}`);
    console.log(`VALUE   = ${show(value)}`);
    console.log(`EFFECTIVE = ${expr}`);

    if (
        effective !== null &&
        effective >= TARGET_START &&
        effective <= TARGET_END
    ) {
        console.log("*** TARGET RANGE HIT ***");
    }

    if (
        show(address).includes("GLOBAL0")
    ) {
        console.log("*** GLOBAL0-DERIVED ADDRESS ***");
    }
}

while (x < bodyEnd) {

    const at = x;
    const op = wasm[x++];

    if (op === 0x0b) {
        console.log(hex(at), "end");

    }

    if (op === 0x20) {

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {

        x = r.next;

        const value = pop();

        locals.set(r.value, value);

        console.log(
            hex(at),
            op === 0x21
                ? `local.set ${r.value} <= ${show(value)}`
                : `local.tee ${r.value} <= ${show(value)}`
        );

        if (op === 0x22)
            push(value);

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x23) {

        const r = readULEB(x);
        x = r.next;

        if (r.value === 0) {
            const s: Sym = { kind: "global0" };
            push(s);

            console.log(
                hex(at),
                "global.get 0 => GLOBAL0"
            );
        } else {
            push({
                kind: "unknown",
                text: `GLOBAL${r.value}`
            });
        }

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x24) {

        const r = readULEB(x);
        x = r.next;

        const value = pop();

        );

    }

            value
        };

        push(s);

        console.log(
            hex(at),
            `i32.const ${value} (${hex(value)})`
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x6a || op === 0x6b) {

        const b = pop();
        const a = pop();

        const s: Sym =
            op === 0x6a
                ? { kind: "add", a, b }
                : { kind: "sub", a, b };

        push(s);

        console.log(
            hex(at),
            op === 0x6a

                : `i32.sub ${show(a)}, ${show(b)} => ${show(s)}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29) {

        const align = readULEB(x);
        x = align.next;

        const off = readULEB(x);
        x = off.next;

        const addr = pop();

        const s: Sym = {
            kind: "load",
            addr,
            offset: off.value
        };

        push(s);

        console.log(
            hex(at),
            op === 0x28
                ? `i32.load ADDR=${show(addr)} OFFSET=${hex(off.value)}`
                : `i64.load ADDR=${show(addr)} OFFSET=${hex(off.value)}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (
        op === 0x36 ||
        op === 0x37
    ) {

        const align = readULEB(x);
        x = align.next;

        const off = readULEB(x);
        x = off.next;

        const value = pop();
        const address = pop();

        checkAddress(
            address,
            off.value,
            at,
            op === 0x36
                ? "i32.store"
                : "i64.store",
            value
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {

        const r = readULEB(x);
        x = r.next;

        console.log(
            hex(at),
            `call ${r.value}`
        );

        /*
         * We deliberately do NOT pretend the call result
         * has a known value. This avoids false address
         * resolution.
         */
        push({
            kind: "unknown",
            text: `CALL${r.value}_RESULT`
        });

        continue;
    }

    /*
     * Handle common simple instructions without trying
     * to infer their full semantics.
     */
    console.log(
        hex(at),
        `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const FUNC = 3315;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// READ WASM ULEB128
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function readULEB(buf, pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB128 overflow");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// PARSE CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let pos = 8;

if (
    wasm[0] !== 0x00 ||
    wasm[1] !== 0x61 ||
    wasm[2] !== 0x73 ||
    wasm[3] !== 0x6d
) {
    throw new Error("Not a valid WASM file");
}

let codeSectionStart = -1;
let codeSectionEnd = -1;

while (pos < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, pos);
    const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const sectionStart = pos;
    const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sectionSize;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeSectionStart = sectionStart;
        codeSectionEnd = sectionEnd;
        break;
    }

    pos = sectionEnd;
}

if (codeSectionStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("CODE section not found");
}

// CODE VECTOR
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const funcCountInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
const funcCount = funcCountInfo.value;
p = funcCountInfo.next;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// LOCATE FUNCTION BODY
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let bodyEnd = -1;
let targetBodySize = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < funcCount; i++) {
    const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + bodySize;

    if (i === FUNC) {
        bodyStart = start;
        bodyEnd = end;
        targetBodySize = bodySize;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

    throw new Error(`FUNC ${FUNC} not found`);

console.log(`BODY         : 0x${bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} .. 0x${bodyEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`);

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 445;
const IMPORTED = 83;

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const out = {};

  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];

    const z = uleb(p);
    const size = z.value;
    p = z.next;

    out[id] = {
      start: p,
      end: p + size
    };

    p += size;
  }

  return out;
}

function getFunctionBodies() {
  const sec = readSections();

  const funcSec = sec[3];
  const codeSec = sec[10];

  let fp = funcSec.start;
  const fc = uleb(fp);
  fp = fc.next;

  const types = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(fp);
    fp = x.next;
    types.push(x.value);
  }

  let cp = codeSec.start;
  const cc = uleb(cp);
  cp = cc.next;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
    const z = uleb(cp);
    const size = z.value;
    cp = z.next;

    bodies.push({
      func: IMPORTED + i,
      type: types[i],
      start: cp,
      end: cp + size
    });

    cp += size;
  }

  return bodies;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x0001ddd6;
const END   = 0x0001dea0;

function uleb(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function opname(op: number) {
    const m: Record<number, string> = {
        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",
        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",
        0x3a: "i32.store8",
        0x3b: "i32.store16",
        0x3e: "i64.store32",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",
        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",

        0x10: "call",
        0x11: "call_indirect",

        0x02: "block",
        0x03: "loop",
        0x04: "if",
        0x05: "else",
        0x0b: "end",
        0x0c: "br",
        0x0d: "br_if",
        0x0f: "return"
    };

    return m[op] ?? `op_${hex(op)}`;
}

console.log("TRACE FUNC 457 STORE ADDRESS EXPRESSIONS");
