FILE: scripts\traceFunc83EffectiveAddress.mjs
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const FILE = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x6e81;
const END   = 0x74a6;

const TARGET_START = 0x195348;
const TARGET_END   = 0x195360;

const b = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function readULEB(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hx(v, n = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

function raw(a, z) {
  return [...b.subarray(a, z)]
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");
}

/*
 * Lightweight symbolic stack.
 *
 * We only resolve addresses when the address expression is
 * unambiguous:
 *
 *   i32.const X
 *   local.get L
 *   i32.add
 *
 * or
 *
 *   i32.const X
 *   i32.load offset=Y
 *
 * Complex expressions remain UNKNOWN.
 */

const stack = [];
const locals = new Map();

function push(x) {
  stack.push(x);
}

function pop() {
  return stack.length ? stack.pop() : { type: "unknown" };
}

function unknown() {
  return { type: "unknown" };
}

function symbolicConst(v) {
  return {
    type: "const",
    value: v >>> 0
  };
}

function symbolicLocal(n) {
  if (locals.has(n))
    return locals.get(n);

  return {
    type: "local",
    index: n
  };
}

function add(a, c) {
  if (a?.type === "const" && c?.type === "const") {
    return symbolicConst((a.value + c.value) >>> 0);
  }

  if (a?.type === "const" && c?.type === "local") {
    return {
      type: "local_plus",
      index: c.index,
      base: a.value >>> 0
    };
  }

  if (a?.type === "local" && c?.type === "const") {
    return {
      type: "local_plus",
      index: a.index,
      base: c.value >>> 0
    };
  }

  return unknown();
}

function sub(a, c) {
  if (a?.type === "const" && c?.type === "const") {
    return symbolicConst((a.value - c.value) >>> 0);
  }

  return unknown();
}

function describe(x) {
  if (!x)
    return "UNKNOWN";

  if (x.type === "const")
    return hx(x.value);

  if (x.type === "local")
    return `LOCAL[${x.index}]`;

  if (x.type === "local_plus")
    return `LOCAL[${x.index}] + ${hx(x.base)}`;

  return "UNKNOWN";
}

function isTarget(v) {
  return v >= TARGET_START && v <= TARGET_END;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 83 EFFECTIVE ADDRESS TRACE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY : ${hx(START)} .. ${hx(END)}`);
console.log(`TARGET: ${hx(TARGET_START)} .. ${hx(TARGET_END)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let p = START;

/*
 * Function body begins with local declaration vector.
 */
const localGroups = readULEB(p);
p = localGroups.next;

for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  const type = b[p++];

  // Initialize locals as unknown.
  // Number is not needed for the symbolic pass.
}

let instructionCount = 0;

while (p < END) {
  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  instructionCount++;

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // local.get
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    push(symbolicLocal(r.value));
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // local.set
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    const v = pop();
    locals.set(r.value, v);

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // local.tee
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    const v = stack.length
      ? stack[stack.length - 1]
      : unknown();

    locals.set(r.value, v);

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // global.get
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x23) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    push({
      type: "global",
      index: r.value
    });

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // global.set
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x24) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    pop();
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.const
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    push(symbolicConst(r.value));
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.add
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x6a) {
    const rhs = pop();
    const lhs = pop();

    push(add(lhs, rhs));
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.sub
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x6b) {
    const rhs = pop();
    const lhs = pop();

    push(sub(lhs, rhs));
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.or
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x72) {
    pop();
    pop();
    push(unknown());
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.xor
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x73) {
    pop();
    pop();
    push(unknown());
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.and
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x71) {
    pop();
    pop();
    push(unknown());
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // comparisons
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op >= 0x45 && op <= 0x4f) {
    pop();
    pop();
    push(unknown());
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.load
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x28) {
    const align = readULEB(p);
    p = align.next;

    const off = readULEB(p);
    p = off.next;

    const base = pop();

    let effective = null;

    if (base?.type === "const") {
      effective = (base.value + off.value) >>> 0;
    }

    console.log(
      `LOAD  ${hx(at)}  ` +
      `raw=[${raw(at, p)}]  ` +
      `base=${describe(base)}  ` +
      `offset=${off.value}  ` +
      `EA=${effective === null ? "UNKNOWN" : hx(effective)}`
    );

    if (effective !== null && isTarget(effective)) {
      console.log(
        `       *** TARGET HIT: ${hx(effective)} ***`
      );
    }

    push(unknown());
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.store
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x36) {
    const align = readULEB(p);
    p = align.next;

    const off = readULEB(p);
    p = off.next;

    const value = pop();
    const base = pop();

    let effective = null;

    if (base?.type === "const") {
      effective = (base.value + off.value) >>> 0;
    }

    console.log(
      `STORE ${hx(at)}  ` +
      `raw=[${raw(at, p)}]  ` +
      `base=${describe(base)}  ` +
      `offset=${off.value}  ` +
      `EA=${effective === null ? "UNKNOWN" : hx(effective)}`
    );

    if (effective !== null && isTarget(effective)) {
      console.log(
        `       *** TARGET HIT: ${hx(effective)} ***`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // call
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;

    push(unknown());
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // call_indirect
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x11) {
    const type = readULEB(p);
    p = type.next;

    const table = readULEB(p);
    p = table.next;

    push(unknown());
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // br / br_if
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const r = readULEB(p);
    p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // block / loop / if
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    p++;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // drop
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x1a) {
    pop();
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // select
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x1b) {
    const c = pop();
    const b2 = pop();
    const a = pop();

    push(unknown());
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // return
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x0f) {
    if (stack.length)
      pop();

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // end
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x0b) {
    continue;
  }

  /*
   * For instructions we don't model, clear the symbolic
   * stack rather than making a false claim.
   */
  if (
    op !== 0x00 &&
    op !== 0x01
  ) {
    // Preserve locals, invalidate transient stack.
    stack.length = 0;
  }
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log(`INSTRUCTIONS SCANNED : ${instructionCount}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");
console.log("============================================================");

FILE: scripts\traceFunc83MemoryRaw.mjs

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x6e81;
const END   = 0x74a6;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function hex(v, n = 8) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(n, "0");
}

function bytes(a, z) {
  return [...b.subarray(a, z)]
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");
}

let p = START;

// Skip locals
const groups = uleb(p);
p = groups.next;

for (let i = 0; i < groups.value; i++) {
  const n = uleb(p);
  p = n.next;
  p++;
}

const hits = [];

while (p < END) {
  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // memory load
  // 0x28 = i32.load
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x28) {
    const a = uleb(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = uleb(p);
    p = o.next;

    hits.push({
      at,
      kind: "LOAD",
      op,
      align: a.value,
      offset: o.value,
      rawEnd: p
    });

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i64.load etc.
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op >= 0x29 && op <= 0x35) {
    const a = uleb(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = uleb(p);
    p = o.next;

    hits.push({
      at,
      kind: "LOAD",
      op,
      align: a.value,
      offset: o.value,
      rawEnd: p
    });

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // stores
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {
    const a = uleb(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = uleb(p);
    p = o.next;

    hits.push({
      at,
      kind: "STORE",
      op,
      align: a.value,
      offset: o.value,
      rawEnd: p
    });

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i32.const
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // i64.const
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x42) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // local/global
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24
  ) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // br / br_if
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // br_table
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x0e) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++)
      p = uleb(p).next;

    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // block / loop / if
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    p++;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // call / call_indirect
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x10) {
    p = uleb(p).next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    p = uleb(p).next;
    p = uleb(p).next;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // memory.size / memory.grow
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
    p++;
    continue;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  // select
  // ----------------------------------------------------------
  if (op === 0x1c) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;
    p += n.value;
    continue;
  }
}

  ) {
    console.log(

    );
  }

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const targetFunc = 84;

const b = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function u32(p: number): number {
  return (
    b[p] |
    (b[p + 1] << 8) |
    (b[p + 2] << 16) |
    (b[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = b[pos++];
    value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function sectionStart(id: number): { start: number; end: number } {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < b.length) {
    const sid = b[p++];
    const sz = readULEB(p);
    p = sz.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sz.value;

    if (sid === id) return { start, end };
    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
}

function getCodeBody(funcIndex: number): {
  bodyStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  typeIndex: number;
} {
  // Function section = 3
  const fs = sectionStart(3);
  let p = fs.start;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  const types: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const x = readULEB(p);
    p = x.next;
    types.push(x.value);
  }

  // Code section = 10
  const cs = sectionStart(10);
  p = cs.start;

  const cc = readULEB(p);
  p = cc.next;

  // func 84 is after imported functions.
  // Parse import section to determine defined-function ordinal.
  let importedFunctions = 0;

  try {
    const is = sectionStart(2);
    let q = is.start;

    const ic = readULEB(q);
    q = ic.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < ic.value; i++) {
      const ml = readULEB(q);
      q = ml.next + ml.value;

      const nl = readULEB(q);
      q = nl.next + nl.value;

      const kind = b[q++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        importedFunctions++;
        const t = readULEB(q);
        q = t.next;
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        q += 4;
        const flags = b[q - 1];
        if (flags & 1) {
          const x = readULEB(q);
          q = x.next;
        }
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        const flags = b[q + 1];
        q += 2;
        const x = readULEB(q);
        q = x.next;
        if (flags & 1) {
          const y = readULEB(q);
          q = y.next;
        }
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        q++;
        const x = readULEB(q);
        q = x.next;
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  const ordinal = funcIndex - importedFunctions;

  if (ordinal < 0 || ordinal >= cc.value) {
    throw new Error(
      `FUNC ${funcIndex} invalid: imported=${importedFunctions}, codeCount=${cc.value}`
    );
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
    const sz = readULEB(p);
    p = sz.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + sz.value;

    if (i === ordinal) {
      return {
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
        typeIndex: types[ordinal],
      };
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  throw new Error("body not found");
}

function readMemArg(pos: number): {
  next: number;
  align: number;
  offset: number;
} {
  const a = readULEB(pos);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    next: o.next,
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
  };
}

    0x7c: "f64",

function readULEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];

    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << (s + 7));

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const TARGET = 86;

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = wasm[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  do {
    x = wasm[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 0x80);

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << s);

  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function section(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];
    const z = uleb(p);
    p = z.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + z.value;

    if (sid === id) return { start, end };

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`Section ${id} not found`);
}

function importedFunctionCount() {
  const s = section(2);
  let p = s.start;

  const c = uleb(p);
  p = c.next;

  let n = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
    const ml = uleb(p);
    p = ml.next + ml.value;

    const nl = uleb(p);
    p = nl.next + nl.value;

    const kind = wasm[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      n++;
      const t = uleb(p);
      p = t.next;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p += 4;
      if (wasm[p - 1] & 1) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = wasm[p + 1];
      p += 2;

      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const y = uleb(p);
        p = y.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p++;
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;
    }
  }

  return n;
}

function getBody(funcIndex: number) {
  const imported = importedFunctionCount();
  const ordinal = funcIndex - imported;

  const fs = section(3);
  let p = fs.start;

  const fc = uleb(p);
  p = fc.next;

  const types: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    types.push(x.value);
  }

  const cs = section(10);
  p = cs.start;

  const cc = uleb(p);
  p = cc.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
    const z = uleb(p);
    p = z.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + z.value;

    if (i === ordinal) {
      return {
        start,
        end,
        type: types[ordinal]
      };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("FUNC body not found");
}

  0x1a: "drop",
  0x1b: "select",

  0x20: "local.get",
  0x21: "local.set",

  0x28: "i32.load",

  0x2d: "i32.load8_u",

  0x6a: "i32.add",

  0x70: "i32.rem_u",

  0x74: "i32.shl",

  0x76: "i32.shr_u"
};

function memarg(pos: number) {
  const a = uleb(pos);
  const o = uleb(a.next);
  return {
    next: o.next,
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function leb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8;

  const r = leb(p);
  p = r.next;

    break;
  }

  p += r.value;
}

q = count.next;

  q = br.next;

  const bodyEnd = q + bodySize;

  if (func !== 87) {
    q = bodyEnd;

  console.log("FUNC 87 EXACT BODY");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`BODY SIZE : ${bodySize}`);

    console.log(
      `0x${x.toString(16).padStart(6, "0")}  0x${wasm[x].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    );
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("DONE");
  break;
}

for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length; p++) {
  if (wasm[p] !== 0x10) continue;

  let q = p + 1;
  let func = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (q < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[q++];
    func |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    shift += 7;

  const from = Math.max(0, p - 40);
  const to = Math.min(wasm.length, q + 4);

    .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x317300;
const END   = 0x317700;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 9106 STRUCTURE FIELD FLOW");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`SCAN = 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log("TARGET STRUCTURE:");
console.log("  base = local3");
console.log("  important fields:");
console.log("    +0x1c");
console.log("    +0x30");
console.log("    +0x34");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

function u32leb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
}

function s32leb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    b = buf[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function out(pos: number, bytes: string, text: string) {
  console.log(`${hx(pos)}  ${bytes.padEnd(18)} ${text}`);
}

function fieldName(offset: number) {
  switch (offset) {
    case 0x1c: return "FIELD +0x1C";
    case 0x30: return "FIELD +0x30";
    case 0x34: return "FIELD +0x34";
    default: return `FIELD +${hx(offset)}`;
  }
}

let p = START;

while (p < END) {
  const pos = p;
  const op = buf[p++];

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    out(
      pos,
      `20 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `LOCAL.GET ${r.value}${r.value === 3 ? "   <-- STRUCT BASE" : ""}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x21) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    out(pos, `21 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `LOCAL.SET ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // local.tee
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    out(pos, `22 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `LOCAL.TEE ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    out(pos, `23 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `GLOBAL.GET ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

    p = r.next;

      `I32.LOAD align=${a.value} offset=${hx(o.value)}${note}`
    );

  }

    p = o.next;

      o.value === 0x30 ||
      o.value === 0x34

        : "";

      `I32.STORE align=${a.value} offset=${hx(o.value)}${note}`

  // i32.shr_u
  if (op === 0x76) {
    out(pos, "76", "I32.SHR_U");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.eqz
  if (op === 0x45) {
    out(pos, "45", "I32.EQZ");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.eq
  if (op === 0x46) {
    out(pos, "46", "I32.EQ");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.ne
  if (op === 0x47) {
    out(pos, "47", "I32.NE");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.lt_u
  if (op === 0x49) {
    out(pos, "49", "I32.LT_U");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.gt_u
  if (op === 0x4b) {
    out(pos, "4b", "I32.GT_U");
    continue;
  }

  // block
  if (op === 0x02) {
    const blockType = buf[p++];

    out(
      pos,
      `02 ${blockType.toString(16)}`,
      `BLOCK type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // loop
  if (op === 0x03) {
    const blockType = buf[p++];

    out(
      pos,
      `03 ${blockType.toString(16)}`,
      `LOOP type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // if
  if (op === 0x04) {
    const blockType = buf[p++];

    out(
      pos,
      `04 ${blockType.toString(16)}`,
      `IF type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // else
  if (op === 0x05) {
    out(pos, "05", "ELSE");
    continue;
  }

  // end
  if (op === 0x0b) {
    out(pos, "0b", "END");
    continue;

    p = r.next;

    continue;

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    out(pos, `10 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `CALL FUNC${r.value}`);
    continue;

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = u32leb(p);
    p = t.next;

    const table = u32leb(p);
    p = table.next;

      pos,
      `11 ${t.value.toString(16)} ${table.value.toString(16)}`,
      `CALL_INDIRECT TYPE${t.value} TABLE${table.value}`
    );
    continue;
  }

  // drop
  if (op === 0x1a) {
    out(pos, "1a", "DROP");
    continue;
  }

  // select
  if (op === 0x1b) {
    out(pos, "1b", "SELECT");
    continue;
  }

  // return
  if (op === 0x0f) {
    out(pos, "0f", "RETURN");
    continue;
  }

  // memory.size / memory.grow
  if (op === 0x3f) {
    const x = buf[p++];
    out(pos, `3f ${x.toString(16)}`, "MEMORY.SIZE");
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x40) {
    const x = buf[p++];
    out(pos, `40 ${x.toString(16)}`, "MEMORY.GROW");
    continue;
  }

  out(
    pos,
    op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
    `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
  );
}

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    const local = r.value;

    if (local === 5) {
      print(start, "20 05", "LOCAL.GET 5   <-- FRAME POINTER");
    } else if (local === 3) {
      print(start, "20 03", "LOCAL.GET 3");
    } else if (local === 1) {
      print(start, "20 01", "LOCAL.GET 1");
    } else if (local === 0) {
      print(start, "20 00", "LOCAL.GET 0");
    } else {
      print(start, `20 ${local.toString(16)}`, `LOCAL.GET ${local}`);
    }

    continue;
  }

  // local.set
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    const local = r.value;

    print(
      start,
      `21 ${local.toString(16)}`,
      `LOCAL.SET ${local}${local === 5 ? "   <-- FRAME POINTER" : ""}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // local.tee
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    const local = r.value;

    print(
      start,
      `22 ${local.toString(16)}`,
      `LOCAL.TEE ${local}${local === 5 ? "   <-- FRAME POINTER" : ""}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // global.get
  if (op === 0x23) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    print(start, `23 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `GLOBAL.GET ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // global.set
  if (op === 0x24) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    print(start, `24 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `GLOBAL.SET ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = s32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    print(
      start,
      `41 ${r.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.CONST ${r.value < 0 ? r.value : hex(r.value >>> 0)}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.add
  if (op === 0x6a) {
    print(start, "6a", "I32.ADD");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.sub
  if (op === 0x6b) {
    print(start, "6b", "I32.SUB");
    continue;
  }

  // i32.load
  if (op === 0x28) {
    const align = u32leb(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(p);
    p = offset.next;

    print(
      start,
      `28 ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.store
  if (op === 0x36) {
    const align = u32leb(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(p);
    p = offset.next;

    print(
      start,
      `36 ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.STORE align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    print(start, `10 ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `CALL FUNC${r.value}`);

    continue;
  }

  // call_indirect
  if (op === 0x11) {
    const type = u32leb(p);
    p = type.next;

    const table = u32leb(p);
    p = table.next;

    print(
      start,
      `11 ${type.value.toString(16)} ${table.value.toString(16)}`,
      `CALL_INDIRECT TYPE${type.value} TABLE${table.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.load8_u
  if (op === 0x2d) {
    const align = u32leb(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(p);
    p = offset.next;

    print(
      start,
      `2d ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD8_U align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.load16_u
  if (op === 0x2f) {
    const align = u32leb(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = u32leb(p);
    p = offset.next;

    print(
      start,
      `2f ${align.value.toString(16)} ${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
      `I32.LOAD16_U align=${align.value} offset=${hex(offset.value)}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // drop
  if (op === 0x1a) {
    print(start, "1a", "DROP");
    continue;
  }

  // return
  if (op === 0x0f) {
    print(start, "0f", "RETURN");
    continue;
  }

  // if
  if (op === 0x04) {
    print(start, "04", "IF");
    continue;
  }

  // else
  if (op === 0x05) {
    print(start, "05", "ELSE");
    continue;
  }

  // end
  if (op === 0x0b) {
    print(start, "0b", "END");
    continue;
  }

  // br
  if (op === 0x0c) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    print(start, `0c ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `BR ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // br_if
  if (op === 0x0d) {
    const r = u32leb(p);
    p = r.next;

    print(start, `0d ${r.value.toString(16)}`, `BR_IF ${r.value}`);
    continue;
  }

  // select
  if (op === 0x1b) {
    print(start, "1b", "SELECT");
    continue;
  }

  // Unknown opcode
  print(
    start,
    op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"),
    `OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
  );
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 91;
const TARGET_TABLE_INDEX = 4790;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(data: Buffer, pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = data[pos++];

        if (b === undefined) {
            throw new Error("Unexpected EOF while reading ULEB");
        }

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB(data: Buffer, pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = data[pos++];

        if (byte === undefined) {
            throw new Error("Unexpected EOF while reading SLEB");
        }

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
                value |= -(1 << shift);
            }
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("SLEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function hexByte(b: number): string {
    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
}

function hexAt(pos: number, count: number): string {
    const out: string[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count && pos + i < wasm.length; i++) {
        out.push(hexByte(wasm[pos + i]));
    }

    return out.join(" ");
}

function sectionName(id: number): string {
    switch (id) {
        case 0: return "CUSTOM";
        case 1: return "TYPE";
        case 2: return "IMPORT";
        case 3: return "FUNCTION";
        case 4: return "TABLE";
        case 5: return "MEMORY";
        case 6: return "GLOBAL";
        case 7: return "EXPORT";
        case 8: return "START";
        case 9: return "ELEMENT";
        case 10: return "CODE";
        case 11: return "DATA";
        default: return `SECTION_${id}`;
    }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 10;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB too long");
    }
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("SLEB too long");
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;

  const sections = [];

  while (p < bytes.length) {
    const id = bytes[p++];

    const len = uleb(p);
    p = len.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + len.value
    });

    p += len.value;
  }

  return sections;
}

function parseImports(section) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  let functions = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const mod = uleb(p);
    p = mod.next + mod.value;

    const name = uleb(p);
    p = name.next + name.value;

    const kind = bytes[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const type = uleb(p);
      p = type.next;
      functions++;
    }

    else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = uleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const max = uleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = uleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const max = uleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return functions;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(section) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const ids = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    ids.push(x.value);
  }

  return ids;
}

function parseCode(section, functionTypes, importedCount) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const funcs = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

    funcs.push({
      funcIndex: importedCount + i,
      typeIndex: functionTypes[i],
      start: bodyStart,
      end: bodyEnd
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return funcs;
}

function decode(func) {

  let p = func.start;

  const localCount = uleb(p);
  p = localCount.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {

    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;

    p++;
  }

  console.log(`BODY : ${hex(func.start)} .. ${hex(func.end)}`);
  console.log(`TYPE : ${func.typeIndex}`);

  console.log(
    "------------------------------------------------------------"
  );

  while (p < func.end) {

    const at = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    let text = null;

    switch (op) {

      case 0x00:
        text = "unreachable";
        break;

      case 0x01:
        text = "nop";
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        text = "end";
        break;

      case 0x0f:
        text = "return";
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `call ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        const y = uleb(p);
        p = y.next;

        text =
          `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${y.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x1a:
        text = "drop";
        break;

      case 0x1b:
        text = "select";
        break;

      case 0x20: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `global.get ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `global.set ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        const x = sleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text =
          `i32.const ${x.value} (${hex(x.value >>> 0)})`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x42: {

        let value = 0n;
        let shift = 0n;

        while (true) {

          const b = BigInt(bytes[p++]);

          value |=
            (b & 0x7fn) << shift;

          if ((b & 0x80n) === 0n) {
            break;
          }

          shift += 7n;
        }

        break;
      }

      case 0x28:
      case 0x29:
      case 0x2c:
      case 0x2d:
      case 0x2e:
      case 0x2f:
      case 0x30:
      case 0x31:
      case 0x32:
      case 0x33:
      case 0x34:
      case 0x35: {

        p = align.next;

          0x29: "i64.load",
          0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
          0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
          0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
          0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
          0x30: "i64.load8_s",
          0x31: "i64.load8_u",
          0x32: "i64.load16_s",
          0x33: "i64.load16_u",
          0x34: "i64.load32_s",
          0x35: "i64.load32_u"
        };

        text =
          `${names[op]} ` +
          `align=${align.value} ` +
          `offset=${offset.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x36:
      case 0x37:
      case 0x3a:
      case 0x3b:
      case 0x3c:
      case 0x3d:
      case 0x3e: {

        const align = uleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = uleb(p);
        p = offset.next;

        const names = {
          0x36: "i32.store",
          0x37: "i64.store",
          0x3a: "i32.store8",
          0x3b: "i32.store16",
          0x3c: "i64.store8",
          0x3d: "i64.store16",
          0x3e: "i64.store32"
        };

        text =
          `${names[op]} ` +
          `align=${align.value} ` +
          `offset=${offset.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x45:
        text = "i32.eqz";
        break;

      case 0x46:
        text = "i32.eq";
        break;

      case 0x47:
        text = "i32.ne";
        break;

      case 0x48:
        text = "i32.lt_s";
        break;

      case 0x49:
        text = "i32.lt_u";
        break;

      case 0x4a:
        text = "i32.gt_s";
        break;

      case 0x4b:
        text = "i32.gt_u";
        break;

      case 0x4c:
        text = "i32.le_s";
        break;

      case 0x4d:
        text = "i32.le_u";
        break;

      case 0x4e:
        text = "i32.ge_s";
        break;

      case 0x4f:
        text = "i32.ge_u";
        break;

      case 0x6a:
        text = "i32.add";
        break;

      case 0x6b:
        text = "i32.sub";
        break;

      case 0x6c:
        text = "i32.mul";
        break;

      case 0x71:
        text = "i32.and";
        break;

      case 0x72:
        text = "i32.or";
        break;

      case 0x73:
        text = "i32.xor";
        break;

      case 0x74:
        text = "i32.shl";
        break;

      case 0x75:
        text = "i32.shr_s";
        break;

      case 0x76:
        text = "i32.shr_u";
        break;

      case 0x77:
        text = "i32.rotl";
        break;

      case 0x78:
        text = "i32.rotr";
        break;

      case 0x02:
      case 0x03:
      case 0x04: {

        const blockType = bytes[p++];

        const name =
          op === 0x02
            ? "block"
            : op === 0x03
              ? "loop"
              : "if";

        text =
          `${name} type=${hex(blockType)}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x05:
        text = "else";
        break;

      case 0x0c: {

        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `br ${x.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {

        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `br_if ${x.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x0e: {

        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;

        const labels = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;

          labels.push(x.value);
        }

        const d = uleb(p);
        p = d.next;

        labels.push(`default=${d.value}`);

        text =
          `br_table ${labels.join(",")}`;

        break;
      }

      default:

        console.log(
          `${hex(at)}  UNKNOWN opcode ${hex(op)}`
        );

        console.log(
          "RAW REMAINING : " +
          Buffer.from(
            bytes.subarray(at, func.end)
          ).toString("hex")
        );

        return;
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)}  ${text}`
    );
  }

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
  let result = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;

  while (true) {
    if (pos >= wasm.length) throw new Error("ULEB beyond WASM");

    const b = wasm[pos++];

    result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7n;

    if (shift > 70n) throw new Error("ULEB too long");
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
  let result = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    if (pos >= wasm.length) throw new Error("SLEB beyond WASM");

    byte = wasm[pos++];

    result |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7n;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > 70n) throw new Error("SLEB too long");
  }

  if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
    result |= (-1n) << shift;
  }

  return { value: result, next: pos };
}

function readMemArg(pos: number) {
  const a = readULEB(pos);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    align: Number(a.value),
    offset: Number(o.value),
    next: o.next,
  };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function clean(s: string): string {
  if (s.length <= 180) return s;
  return s.slice(0, 177) + "...";
}

function frameSlot(expr: string): string | null {
  const m = expr.match(/^\(frame \+ (-?\d+)\)$/);

  if (!m) return null;

  const offset = Number(m[1]);

  if (offset >= 0 && offset < 512 && offset % 16 === 0) {
    return `S${offset / 16}`;
  }

  return null;
}

type Value = string;

const stack: Value[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, Value>();

let frameExpr = "frame";

function pop(): Value {
  if (stack.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("STACK UNDERFLOW");
  }

  return stack.pop()!;
}

function push(v: Value) {
  stack.push(v);
}

function bin(op: string) {
  const b = pop();
  const a = pop();
  push(`(${a} ${op} ${b})`);
}

function unary(op: string) {
  const a = pop();
  push(`${op}(${a})`);
}

function loadExpr(type: string, offset: number) {
  const addr = pop();

  if (type === "i64") {
    push(`MEM64[${addr}${offset ? `+${offset}` : ""}]`);
  } else {
    push(`MEM32[${addr}${offset ? `+${offset}` : ""}]`);
  }
}

function storeExpr(type: string, offset: number) {
  const value = pop();
  const addr = pop();

  const mem =
    type === "i64"
      ? `MEM64[${addr}${offset ? `+${offset}` : ""}]`
      : `MEM32[${addr}${offset ? `+${offset}` : ""}]`;

  console.log(`      STORE ${mem} = ${clean(value)}`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0n;
  let s = 0n;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: pos };

    s += 7n;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0n;
  let s = 0n;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7n;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 64n && (b & 0x40))
    v |= (-1n) << s;

  return { value: v, next: pos };
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
  const a = uleb(pos);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    align: Number(a.value),
    offset: Number(o.value),
    next: o.next
  };
}

function H(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function short(x: string) {
  return x.length > 220 ? x.slice(0, 217) + "..." : x;
}

type V = string;

const stack: V[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, V>();

function push(x: V) {
  stack.push(x);
}

function pop(): V {
  if (!stack.length)
    return "STACK_UNKNOWN";

  return stack.pop()!;
}

function binary(op: string) {
  const b = pop();
  const a = pop();
  push(`(${a} ${op} ${b})`);
}

function unary(op: string) {
  const a = pop();
  push(`${op}(${a})`);
}

function frameSlot(x: string): string {
  const m = x.match(/^\(frame \+ (-?\d+)\)$/);

  if (!m)
    return "UNKNOWN";

  const n = Number(m[1]);

  if (n >= 0 && n <= 464 && n % 16 === 0)
    return `S${n / 16}`;

  return "UNKNOWN";
}

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0n;
  let s = 0n;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: pos };

    s += 7n;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0n;
  let s = 0n;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];

    v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7n;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 64n && (b & 0x40))
    v |= (-1n) << s;

  return { value: v, next: pos };
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
  const a = uleb(pos);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    align: Number(a.value),
    offset: Number(o.value),
    next: o.next
  };
}

function H(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function short(x: string) {
  return x.length > 220 ? x.slice(0, 217) + "..." : x;
}

type V = string;

const locals = new Map<number, V>();

function push(x: V) {
  stack.push(x);

function pop(): V {

function binary(op: string) {

function unary(op: string) {

/*
 * Normalize:
 *
 *   ((STACK_PTR i32.sub i32(512)) i32.add i32(432))
 *
 * into:
 *
 *   FRAME+432
 *
 * where:
 *
 *   FRAME = STACK_PTR-512
 *
 * This is exactly the frame convention used by the
 * existing Function 122 trace.
 */
function resolveFrameSlot(x: string): string {

  const normalized = x.replace(/\s+/g, "");

  const m = normalized.match(
    /^\(\(STACK_PTRi32\.subi32\(512\)\)i32\.addi32\((-?\d+)\)\)$/
  );

  if (m) {
    const offset = Number(m[1]);

    if (offset >= 0 && offset % 16 === 0) {
      return `S${offset / 16}`;
    }

    return `FRAME+${offset}`;
  }

  /*
   * Also recognize the algebraically equivalent form:
   *
   * ((STACK_PTR i32.sub i32(512)) i32.sub i32(64))
   *
   */

  const m2 = normalized.match(
    /^\(\(STACK_PTRi32\.subi32\(512\)\)i32\.subi32\((-?\d+)\)\)$/
  );

  if (m2) {
    const sub = Number(m2[1]);
    const offset = -sub;

    if (offset >= 0 && offset % 16 === 0) {
      return `S${offset / 16}`;
    }

    return `FRAME${offset >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${offset}`;
  }

  /*
   * Simple FRAME form.
   */

  const m3 = normalized.match(
    /^FRAME(?:\+(-?\d+))?$/
  );

  if (m3) {
    const offset = Number(m3[1] ?? "0");

    if (offset >= 0 && offset % 16 === 0)
      return `S${offset / 16}`;

    return `FRAME+${offset}`;
  }

  return "UNKNOWN";
}

    case 0x1b: {

      const condition = pop();
      const b = pop();
      const a = pop();

      push(
        `select(${a},${b},${condition})`
      );

      break;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // drop
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    case 0x1a:
      pop();
      break;

    default:

      console.log(
        `UNHANDLED opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} @ ${H(at)}`
      );

      throw new Error("Unsupported opcode");
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FINAL SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`Instructions : ${count}`);
console.log(`CALL 87      : ${calls}`);
console.log(`Final pos    : ${H(p)}`);
console.log(`Expected end : ${H(END)}`);
console.log(`Final stack  : ${stack.length}`);

if (p === END)
  console.log("STATUS       : EXACT END MATCH");
else
  console.log("STATUS       : END MISMATCH");

console.log("============================================================");

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x1226d;
const END   = 0x1295b;

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): {
    value: bigint;
    next: number;
} {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p++];

        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        next: p
    };
}

type Instr = {
    pc: number;
    op: number;
    name: string;
    a?: number;
    b?: number;
};

function decode(buf: Buffer, p: number): {
    instr: Instr;
    next: number;
} {
    const pc = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    switch (op) {

        case 0x00:
            return {
                instr: { pc, op, name: "unreachable" },
                next: p
            };

        case 0x01:
            return {
                instr: { pc, op, name: "nop" },
                next: p
            };

        case 0x02: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: { pc, op, name: "block" },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x03: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: { pc, op, name: "loop" },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x04: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: { pc, op, name: "if" },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x05:
            return {
                instr: { pc, op, name: "else" },
                next: p
            };

        case 0x0b:
            return {
                instr: { pc, op, name: "end" },
                next: p
            };

        case 0x0c: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "br",
                    a: x.value
                },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "br_if",
                    a: x.value
                },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x0f:
            return {
                instr: { pc, op, name: "return" },
                next: p
            };

        case 0x10: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "call",
                    a: x.value
                },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x20: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "local.get",
                    a: x.value
                },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "local.set",
                    a: x.value
                },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "local.tee",
                    a: x.value
                },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "i32.const"
                },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x42: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "i64.const",
                    a: Number(x.value)
                },
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x28: {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const b = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "i32.load",
                    a: a.value,
                    b: b.value
                },
                next: b.next
            };
        }

        case 0x29: {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const b = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "i64.load",
                    a: a.value,
                    b: b.value
                },
                next: b.next
            };
        }

        case 0x36: {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const b = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "i32.store",
                    a: a.value,
                    b: b.value
                },
                next: b.next
            };
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const b = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: "i64.store",
                    a: a.value,
                    b: b.value
                },
                next: b.next
            };
        }

        case 0x7c: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.add" }, next: p };
        case 0x7d: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.sub" }, next: p };
        case 0x7e: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.mul" }, next: p };
        case 0x7f: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.div_s" }, next: p };
        case 0x80: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.div_u" }, next: p };
        case 0x81: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.rem_s" }, next: p };
        case 0x82: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.rem_u" }, next: p };
        case 0x83: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.and" }, next: p };
        case 0x84: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.or" }, next: p };
        case 0x85: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.xor" }, next: p };
        case 0x86: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.shl" }, next: p };
        case 0x87: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.shr_s" }, next: p };
        case 0x88: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.shr_u" }, next: p };
        case 0x89: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.rotl" }, next: p };
        case 0x8a: return { instr: { pc, op, name: "i64.rotr" }, next: p };

        default:
            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    op,
                    name: `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16)})`
                },
                next: p
            };
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const FUNC_START = 0x0001226d;
const FUNC_END   = 0x0001295b;

const CALL_TARGET = 87;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u8(p: number): number {
    return buf[p];
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = u8(pos++);
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = u8(pos++);
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return { value, next: pos };
}

type Expr =
    | { kind: "local"; index: number }
    | { kind: "const"; value: number }
    | { kind: "unknown"; opcode: number }
    | { kind: "add"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "sub"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "mul"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "load64"; addr: Expr; offset: number }
    | { kind: "load32"; addr: Expr; offset: number }
    | { kind: "shl"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "shr_s"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "shr_u"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "and"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "or"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "xor"; a: Expr; b: Expr };

function expr(e: Expr): string {
    switch (e.kind) {
        case "local":
            return `L${e.index}`;

        case "const":
            return `I32CONST(${e.value})`;

        case "unknown":
            return `UNKNOWN(0x${e.opcode.toString(16)})`;

        case "add":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}+${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "sub":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}-${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "mul":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}*${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "load64":
            return `MEM64[${expr(e.addr)}+${e.offset}]`;

        case "load32":
            return `MEM32[${expr(e.addr)}+${e.offset}]`;

        case "shl":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}<<${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "shr_s":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}>>s${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "shr_u":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}>>u${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "and":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}&${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "or":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}|${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "xor":
            return `(${expr(e.a)}^${expr(e.b)})`;
    }
}

type Instr = {
    pos: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
};

function decodeInstructions(start: number, end: number): Instr[] {
    const out: Instr[] = [];
    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const pos = p;
        const op = u8(p++);

        let text = `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16)})`;

        switch (op) {
            case 0x20: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x21: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x22: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x41: {
                const r = readSLEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x42: {
                const r = readSLEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x28: {
                const align = u8(p++);
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `i32.load align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x29: {
                const align = u8(p++);
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `i64.load align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x37: {
                const align = u8(p++);
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `i64.store align=${align} offset=${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x6a:
                text = "i32.add";
                break;

            case 0x6b:
                text = "i32.sub";
                break;

            case 0x7c:
                text = "i64.add";
                break;

            case 0x7d:
                text = "i64.sub";
                break;

            case 0x7e:
                text = "i64.mul";
                break;

            case 0x83:
                text = "i64.and";
                break;

            case 0x84:
                text = "i64.or";
                break;

            case 0x85:
                text = "i64.xor";
                break;

            case 0x86:
                text = "i64.shl";
                break;

            case 0x87:
                text = "i64.shr_s";
                break;

            case 0x88:
                text = "i64.shr_u";
                break;

            case 0x10: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `call ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0b:
                text = "end";
                break;

            case 0x02:
                text = "block";
                break;

            case 0x03:
                text = "loop";
                break;

            case 0x04:
                text = "if";
                break;

            case 0x0c: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `br ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0d: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }
        }

        out.push({ pos, op, text });
    }

    return out;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Conservative symbolic stack
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 * CALL 87 is modeled as:
 *
 *     destination, A, 0, B, 0
 *
 * and RETURNS NOTHING.
 *
 * Function 87 writes:
 *
 *     [destination + 0] = LOW
 *     [destination + 8] = HIGH
 *
 * Therefore we record memory writes rather than pushing
 * synthetic return values.
 */

type Val = Expr | { kind: "i64zero" };

function zero64(): Expr {
    return { kind: "const", value: 0 };
}

function pop(stack: Val[], where: number): Val {
    if (stack.length === 0) {
        throw new Error(`STACK_UNDERFLOW @ ${hex(where)}`);
    }

    return stack.pop()!;
}

function asExpr(v: Val): Expr {
    return v.kind === "i64zero" ? zero64() : v;
}

function sameExpr(a: Expr, b: Expr): boolean {
    return expr(a) === expr(b);
}

type StoreRecord = {
    callNo: number;
    callPos: number;
    destination: Expr;
    lowOffset: number;
    highOffset: number;
};

type LoadRecord = {
    pos: number;
    addr: Expr;
    offset: number;
};

const ins = decodeInstructions(FUNC_START, FUNC_END);

const stack: Val[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, Val>();

const stores: StoreRecord[] = [];
const loads: LoadRecord[] = [];

let callNo = 0;

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(" FUNCTION 122 MEMORY PROVENANCE v3");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log(" CALL 87 RETURNS NOTHING");
console.log(" TRACK CALL87 MEMORY WRITES + LATER LOADS");
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log();

for (const i of ins) {
    try {
        switch (i.op) {

            case 0x20: {
                const n = parseInt(i.text.split(" ")[2]);
                stack.push(locals.get(n) ?? {
                    kind: "local",
                    index: n
                });
                break;
            }

            case 0x21: {
                const n = parseInt(i.text.split(" ")[2]);
                locals.set(n, pop(stack, i.pos));
                break;
            }

            case 0x22: {
                const n = parseInt(i.text.split(" ")[2]);
                const v = pop(stack, i.pos);
                locals.set(n, v);
                stack.push(v);
                break;
            }

            case 0x41: {
                const n = Number(i.text.substring("i32.const ".length));
                stack.push({
                    kind: "const",
                    value: n
                });
                break;
            }

            case 0x42: {
                const n = Number(i.text.substring("i64.const ".length));
                stack.push({
                    kind: "const",
                    value: n
                });
                break;
            }

            case 0x29: {
                const offset = Number(
                    i.text.match(/offset=(\d+)/)?.[1] ?? 0
                );

                const addr = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                const load: Expr = {
                    kind: "load64",
                    addr,
                    offset
                };

                stack.push(load);

                loads.push({
                    pos: i.pos,

                });

                break;

            case 0x28: {
