                stack.push({
                    kind: "load32",
                    addr,
                    offset
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x6a: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "add",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x6b: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "sub",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x7c: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "add",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x7d: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "sub",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x7e: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "mul",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x83: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "and",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x84: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "or",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x85: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "xor",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x86: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "shl",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x87: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "shr_s",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x88: {
                const b = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const a = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                stack.push({
                    kind: "shr_u",
                    a,
                    b
                });

                break;
            }

            case 0x10: {
                const target = Number(
                    i.text.substring("call ".length)
                );

                if (target !== CALL_TARGET) {
                    throw new Error(
                        `UNSUPPORTED CALL ${target} @ ${hex(i.pos)}`
                    );
                }

                callNo++;

                /*
                 * Exact Function 87 ABI:
                 *
                 * destination
                 * A
                 * 0
                 * B
                 * 0
                 *
                 * No return value.
                 */

                const arg4 = pop(stack, i.pos);
                const B    = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const arg2 = pop(stack, i.pos);
                const A    = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));
                const dest = asExpr(pop(stack, i.pos));

                console.log(
                    `CALL #${callNo} @ ${hex(i.pos)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  DEST = ${expr(dest)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  A    = ${expr(A)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  B    = ${expr(B)}`
                );

                /*
                 * The two stores are not computed here.
                 * We attach symbolic Function-87 output labels
                 * to the destination memory.
                 */

                stores.push({
                    callNo,
                    callPos: i.pos,
                    destination: dest,
                    lowOffset: 0,
                    highOffset: 8
                });

                console.log(
                    `  WRITE LOW  -> [${expr(dest)} + 0]`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  WRITE HIGH -> [${expr(dest)} + 8]`
                );
                console.log();

                break;
            }

            case 0x37: {
                /*
                 * We don't need ordinary stores for this phase.
                 * Consume them conservatively.
                 */

                const offset = Number(
                    i.text.match(/offset=(\d+)/)?.[1] ?? 0
                );

                const value = pop(stack, i.pos);
                const addr = pop(stack, i.pos);

                console.log(
                    `ORDINARY STORE @ ${hex(i.pos)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  ADDR=${expr(asExpr(addr))} + ${offset}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `  VALUE=${expr(asExpr(value))}`
                );

                break;
            }

            case 0x02:
            case 0x03:
            case 0x04:
            case 0x0b:
            case 0x0c:
            case 0x0d:
                /*
                 * Control-flow instructions are intentionally
                 * not given fake stack effects here.
                 */
                break;

            default:
                throw new Error(
                    `UNKNOWN_OPCODE 0x${i.op.toString(16)} @ ${hex(i.pos)}`
                );
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.log();
        console.log("!".repeat(72));
        console.log(`TRACE STOP @ ${hex(i.pos)}`);
        console.log(String(e));
        console.log("!".repeat(72));
        console.log();
        break;
    }
}

console.log();
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(" CALL87 DESTINATION SUMMARY");
console.log("=".repeat(72));

for (const s of stores) {
    console.log(
        `CALL #${s.callNo} @ ${hex(s.callPos)}`
    );
    console.log(
        `  DEST = ${expr(s.destination)}`
    );
    console.log(
        `  LOW  = [${expr(s.destination)} + 0]`
    );
    console.log(
        `  HIGH = [${expr(s.destination)} + 8]`
    );
}

console.log();
console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(" LOADS FROM CALL87 DESTINATIONS");
console.log("=".repeat(72));

for (const l of loads) {
    const matches: string[] = [];

    for (const s of stores) {
        const base = expr(s.destination);
        const addr = expr(l.addr);

        /*
         * Exact textual match first.
         *
         * This intentionally does NOT attempt algebraic
         * equivalence through unknown instructions.
         */
        if (addr === base) {
            if (l.offset === 0)
                matches.push(`CALL #${s.callNo} LOW`);

            if (l.offset === 8)
                matches.push(`CALL #${s.callNo} HIGH`);
        }
    }

    if (matches.length > 0) {
        console.log(
            `${hex(l.pos)} LOAD offset=${l.offset} -> ${matches.join(", ")}`
        );
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x0001226d;
const END   = 0x0001295b;

const TARGET_CALL = 87;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function byte(p: number): number {
    return buf[p];
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = byte(pos++);
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function sleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = byte(pos++);
        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if ((b & 0x40) !== 0)
        value -= 2 ** shift;

    return { value, next: pos };
}

type E =
    | { k: "local"; n: number }
    | { k: "i32"; n: number }
    | { k: "i64"; n: number }
    | { k: "load64"; a: E; o: number }
    | { k: "load32"; a: E; o: number }
    | { k: "un"; op: string; a: E }
    | { k: "bin"; op: string; a: E; b: E }
    | { k: "unknown"; op: number };

function show(e: E): string {
    switch (e.k) {
        case "local":
            return `L${e.n}`;

        case "i32":
            return `I32CONST(${e.n})`;

        case "i64":
            return `I64CONST(${e.n})`;

        case "load64":
            return `MEM64[${show(e.a)}+${e.o}]`;

        case "load32":
            return `MEM32[${show(e.a)}+${e.o}]`;

        case "un":
            return `${e.op}(${show(e.a)})`;

        case "bin":
            return `(${show(e.a)}${e.op}${show(e.b)})`;

        case "unknown":
            return `UNKNOWN(0x${e.op.toString(16)})`;
    }
}

type V = E;

function local(n: number): E {
    return { k: "local", n };
}

function i64zero(): E {
    return { k: "i64", n: 0 };
}

function pop(stack: V[], pos: number): V {
    if (!stack.length)
        throw new Error(`STACK_UNDERFLOW @ ${hex(pos)}`);

    return stack.pop()!;
}

function bin(
    stack: V[],
    op: string,
    pos: number
) {
    const b = pop(stack, pos);
    const a = pop(stack, pos);

    stack.push({
        k: "bin",
        op,
        a,
        b
    });
}

function un(
    stack: V[],
    op: string,
    pos: number
) {
    const a = pop(stack, pos);

    stack.push({
        k: "un",
        op,
        a
    });
}

interface CallWrite {
    callNo: number;
    pos: number;
    dest: E;
    A: E;
    B: E;
}

interface Barrier {
    pos: number;
    opcode: number;
}

const stack: V[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, V>();

const calls: CallWrite[] = [];
const barriers: Barrier[] = [];

let callNo = 0;

console.log("=".repeat(72));
console.log(" FUNCTION 122 MEMORY PROVENANCE v4");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log(" CALL 87 RETURNS NOTHING");
console.log(" UNKNOWN OPCODES = PROVENANCE BARRIERS");

let p = START;

while (p < END) {

    const pos = p;
    const op = byte(p++);

    try {

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // locals
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x20) {
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            stack.push(
                locals.get(r.value) ?? local(r.value)
            );

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x21) {
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            locals.set(r.value, pop(stack, pos));

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x22) {
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            const v = pop(stack, pos);

            locals.set(r.value, v);
            stack.push(v);

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // constants
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = sleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            stack.push({
                k: "i32",
                n: r.value
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x42) {
            const r = sleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            stack.push({
                k: "i64",
                n: r.value
            });

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // memory loads
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29) {

            p++; // alignment

            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            const addr = pop(stack, pos);

            if (op === 0x29) {
                stack.push({
                    k: "load64",
                    a: addr,
                    o: r.value
                });
            } else {
                stack.push({
                    k: "load32",
                    a: addr,
                    o: r.value
                });
            }

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // i32 arithmetic
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x6a) {
            bin(stack, "+", pos);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x6b) {
            bin(stack, "-", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // i64 arithmetic
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x7c) {
            bin(stack, "+", pos);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x7d) {
            bin(stack, "-", pos);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x7e) {
            bin(stack, "*", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // IMPORTANT:
        // 0x7f = i64.div_s
        if (op === 0x7f) {
            bin(stack, "/s", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x80 = i64.div_u
        if (op === 0x80) {
            bin(stack, "/u", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x81 = i64.rem_s
        if (op === 0x81) {
            bin(stack, "%s", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x82 = i64.rem_u
        if (op === 0x82) {
            bin(stack, "%u", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x83 = i64.and
        if (op === 0x83) {
            bin(stack, "&", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x84 = i64.or
        if (op === 0x84) {
            bin(stack, "|", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x85 = i64.xor
        if (op === 0x85) {
            bin(stack, "^", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x86 = i64.shl
        if (op === 0x86) {
            bin(stack, "<<", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x87 = i64.shr_s
        if (op === 0x87) {
            bin(stack, ">>s", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x88 = i64.shr_u
        if (op === 0x88) {
            bin(stack, ">>u", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x89 = i64.rotl
        if (op === 0x89) {
            bin(stack, "rotl", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // 0x8a = i64.rotr
        if (op === 0x8a) {
            bin(stack, "rotr", pos);
            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // CALL
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x10) {

            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            const target = r.value;

            if (target !== TARGET_CALL) {

                /*
                 * Unknown call ABI.
                 * Do not guess its stack effect.
                 */

                console.log(
                    `CALL ${target} @ ${hex(pos)} -> ABI UNKNOWN`
                );

                barriers.push({
                    pos,
                    opcode: op
                });

                continue;
            }

            callNo++;

            /*
             * Exact known ABI of Function 87:
             *
             * destination
             * A
             * 0
             * B
             * 0
             *
             * Function 87 returns NOTHING.
             */

            const arg4 = pop(stack, pos);
            const B = pop(stack, pos);
            const arg2 = pop(stack, pos);
            const A = pop(stack, pos);
            const dest = pop(stack, pos);

            console.log(
                `CALL #${callNo} @ ${hex(pos)}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  DEST = ${show(dest)}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  A    = ${show(A)}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  B    = ${show(B)}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  WRITE LOW  = MEM64[DEST+0]`
            );

            console.log(
                `  WRITE HIGH = MEM64[DEST+8]`
            );

            console.log();

            calls.push({
                callNo,
                pos,
                dest,
                A,
                B
            });

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // stores
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x37) {

            p++; // alignment

            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            const value = pop(stack, pos);
            const addr = pop(stack, pos);

            console.log(
                `STORE @ ${hex(pos)}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  ADDR  = ${show(addr)} + ${r.value}`
            );

            console.log(
                `  VALUE = ${show(value)}`
            );

            console.log();

            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // control flow
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
            op === 0x02 ||
            op === 0x03 ||
            op === 0x04
        ) {
            /*
             * We deliberately don't invent block stack effects.
             * The important memory provenance before the barrier
             * remains valid.
             */

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0b) {
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;
            continue;
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------
        // UNKNOWN
        // ------------------------------------------------------------

        console.log(
            `UNKNOWN OPCODE @ ${hex(pos)} = 0x${op.toString(16)}`
        );

        barriers.push({
            pos,
            opcode: op
        });

        /*
         * Do NOT guess stack effect.
         *
         * Clear symbolic stack because subsequent expressions
         * cannot safely inherit an unknown stack state.
         */

        stack.length = 0;

    } catch (err) {

        console.log();
        console.log(
            `TRACE ERROR @ ${hex(pos)}`
        );

        console.log(String(err));

        console.log(
            "SYMBOLIC STACK CLEARED"
        );

        stack.length = 0;

        barriers.push({
            pos,
            opcode: op
        });
    }
}

    console.log(

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x12690;
const END = 0x126fa;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32LEB(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p.v++];
        result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return result;
}

function readS32LEB(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): number {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p.v++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return result | 0;
}

function readS64LEB(buf: Buffer, p: { v: number }): bigint {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p.v++];

        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7n;
    }

    if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1n) << shift;
    }

    return result;
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

/* ============================================================
   STACK
   ============================================================ */

const stack: string[] = [];

let unreachable = false;

function pop(): string {
    if (unreachable) {
        return "POLYMORPHIC";
    }

    if (stack.length === 0) {
        return "STACK_UNDERFLOW";
    }

    return stack.pop()!;
}

function push(v: string) {
    if (!unreachable) {
        stack.push(v);
    }
}

function showStack(): string {
    if (unreachable) return "[POLYMORPHIC / UNREACHABLE]";

    if (stack.length === 0) return "[]";

    return "[" + stack.join(" | ") + "]";
}

/* ============================================================
   LOCALS
   ============================================================ */

const locals = new Map<number, string>();

function getLocal(i: number): string {
    return locals.get(i) ?? `L${i}`;
}

/* ============================================================
   CONTROL FLOW
   ============================================================ */

interface Frame {
    kind: string;
    startPc: number;
}

const control: Frame[] = [];

/* ============================================================
   DECODE
   ============================================================ */

const p = { v: START };

while (p.v < END) {
    const pc = p.v;
    const op = wasm[p.v++];

    let desc = "";

    switch (op) {

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           CONTROL
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x00:
            desc = "unreachable";

            unreachable = true;
            break;

        case 0x02: {
            const blockType = wasm[p.v++];

            control.push({
                kind: "block",
                startPc: pc
            });

            desc =
                `block type=0x${blockType.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x03: {
            const blockType = wasm[p.v++];

            control.push({
                kind: "loop",
                startPc: pc
            });

            desc =
                `loop type=0x${blockType.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x04: {
            const blockType = wasm[p.v++];

            control.push({
                kind: "if",
                startPc: pc
            });

            const cond = pop();

            desc =
                `if type=0x${blockType.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")} cond=${cond}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x05:
            desc = "else";

            /*
             * For our limited trace, ELSE switches execution
             * back from the unreachable branch to the reachable
             * branch if this is the matching IF.
             */
            unreachable = false;

            break;

        case 0x0b: {
            const frame = control.pop();

            desc =
                `end${frame ? ` (${frame.kind})` : ""}`;

            /*
             * Do not blindly clear stack here.
             * We only clear polymorphic state.
             */
            if (unreachable) {
                unreachable = false;
            }

            break;
        }

        case 0x0c: {
            const depth = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            desc = `br ${depth}`;

            /*
             * A branch terminates the current path.
             */
            unreachable = true;

            break;
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const depth = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            const cond = pop();

            desc =
                `br_if ${depth} cond=${cond}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x0f:
            desc = "return";
            unreachable = true;
            break;

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           CALL
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x10: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            if (idx === 66) {
                const a4 = pop();
                const a3 = pop();
                const a2 = pop();
                const a1 = pop();

                desc =
                    `call 66 a.ma ` +
                    `(i32 ${a1}, i32 ${a2}, i32 ${a3}, i32 ${a4}) -> ()`;
            }
            else if (idx === 87) {

                /*
                 * Function 87 has three i64 parameters:
                 *
                 * destination, A, B
                 *
                 * and NO results.
                 */
                const b = pop();
                const a = pop();
                const dst = pop();

                desc =
                    `call 87 ` +
                    `DEST=${dst} A=${a} B=${b} -> ()`;
            }
            else {
                desc = `call ${idx} (not expanded)`;
            }

            break;
        }

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           LOCALS
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x20: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const v = getLocal(idx);

            push(v);

            desc =
                `local.get ${idx} -> ${v}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const v = pop();

            locals.set(idx, v);

            desc =
                `local.set ${idx} = ${v}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const v = pop();

            locals.set(idx, v);

            push(v);

            desc =
                `local.tee ${idx} = ${v}`;

            break;
        }

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           CONSTANTS
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x41: {
            const v = readS32LEB(wasm, p);

            push(`i32.const(${v})`);

            desc = `i32.const ${v}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x42: {
            const v = readS64LEB(wasm, p);

            push(`i64.const(${v})`);

            desc = `i64.const ${v}`;

            break;
        }

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           INTEGER OPS
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x6a: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} + ${b})`);

            desc = `i32.add`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x6b: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} - ${b})`);

            desc = `i32.sub`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x7c: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} + ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.add`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x7d: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} - ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.sub`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x7e: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} * ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.mul`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x83: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} & ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.and`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x84: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} | ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.or`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x86: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} << ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.shl`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x88: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} >>u ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.shr_u`;

            break;
        }

        case 0xad: {
            const a = pop();

            push(`extend32s(${a})`);

            desc = `i64.extend32_s`;

            break;
        }

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           COMPARISONS
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x54: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} <u ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.lt_u`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x56: {
            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(`(${a} >u ${b})`);

            desc = `i64.gt_u`;

            break;
        }

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           MEMORY
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x29: {
            const align = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            const offset = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const addr = pop();

            const value =
                `MEM64[${addr} + ${offset}]`;

            push(value);

            desc =
                `i64.load align=${align} offset=${offset}`;

            break;
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const align = readU32LEB(wasm, p);
            const offset = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const value = pop();
            const addr = pop();

            desc =
                `i64.store align=${align} offset=${offset} ` +
                `addr=${addr} value=${value}`;

            break;
        }

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           GLOBAL SET
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        case 0x24: {
            const idx = readU32LEB(wasm, p);

            const value = pop();

            desc =
                `global.set ${idx} = ${value}`;

            break;
        }

        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           DEFAULT
        ---------------------------------------------------- */

        default:
            desc =
                `UNKNOWN opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
            break;
    }

    console.log(
        `${hex(pc)}  ${desc.padEnd(65)} STACK=${showStack()}`
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x0001226d;
const END = 0x0001295b;

function hex8(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function hex64(n: bigint): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(16, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
  let result = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];

    result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if ((b & 0x40) !== 0) {
        result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
      }

      return {
        value: result,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7n;
  }
}

type Instr = {
  pos: number;
  op: number;
  name: string;
  arg?: bigint | number;
};

function decodeInstructions(buf: Buffer): Instr[] {
  const out: Instr[] = [];

  let p = START;

  while (p <= END) {
    const pos = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    let name = `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16)})`;
    let arg: bigint | number | undefined;

    switch (op) {
      case 0x00:
        name = "unreachable";
        break;

      case 0x01:
        name = "nop";
        break;

      case 0x02:
        name = "block";
        break;

      case 0x03:
        name = "loop";
        break;

      case 0x04:
        name = "if";
        break;

      case 0x05:
        name = "else";
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        name = "end";
        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "br";
        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "br_if";
        break;
      }

      case 0x0e: {
        const count = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = count.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value + 1; i++) {
          const r = readULEB(buf, p);
          p = r.next;
        }

        name = "br_table";
        break;
      }

      case 0x0f:
        name = "return";
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "call";
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const r1 = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r1.next;

        const r2 = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r2.next;

        name = "call_indirect";
        arg = r1.value;
        break;
      }

      case 0x20: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "local.get";
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "local.set";
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "local.tee";
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "global.get";
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "global.set";
        break;
      }

      case 0x28:
        name = "i32.load";
        p += readULEB(buf, p).next - p;
        break;

      case 0x29:
        name = "i64.load";
        p += readULEB(buf, p).next - p;
        break;

      case 0x36:
        name = "i32.store";
        p += readULEB(buf, p).next - p;
        break;

      case 0x37:
        name = "i64.store";
        p += readULEB(buf, p).next - p;
        break;

      case 0x41: {
        const r = readSLEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "i32.const";
        break;
      }

      case 0x42: {
        const r = readSLEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "i64.const";
        break;
      }

      case 0x45:
        name = "i32.eqz";
        break;

      case 0x46:
        name = "i32.eq";
        break;

      case 0x47:
        name = "i32.ne";
        break;

      case 0x48:
        name = "i32.lt_s";
        break;

      case 0x49:
        name = "i32.lt_u";
        break;

      case 0x4a:
        name = "i32.gt_s";
        break;

      case 0x4b:
        name = "i32.gt_u";
        break;

      case 0x4c:
        name = "i32.le_s";
        break;

      case 0x4d:
        name = "i32.le_u";
        break;

      case 0x4e:
        name = "i32.ge_s";
        break;

      case 0x4f:
        name = "i32.ge_u";
        break;

      case 0x50:
        name = "i64.eqz";
        break;

      case 0x51:
        name = "i64.eq";
        break;

      case 0x52:
        name = "i64.ne";
        break;

      case 0x53:
        name = "i64.lt_s";
        break;

      case 0x54:
        name = "i64.lt_u";
        break;

      case 0x55:
        name = "i64.gt_s";
        break;

      case 0x56:
        name = "i64.gt_u";
        break;

      case 0x57:
        name = "i64.le_s";
        break;

      case 0x58:
        name = "i64.le_u";
        break;

      case 0x59:
        name = "i64.ge_s";
        break;

      case 0x5a:
        name = "i64.ge_u";
        break;

      case 0x5b:
        name = "i32.clz";
        break;

      case 0x5c:
        name = "i32.ctz";
        break;

      case 0x5d:
        name = "i32.popcnt";
        break;

      case 0x7c:
        name = "i64.add";
        break;

      case 0x7d:
        name = "i64.sub";
        break;

      case 0x7e:
        name = "i64.mul";
        break;

      case 0x7f:
        name = "i64.div_s";
        break;

      case 0x80:
        name = "i64.div_u";
        break;

      case 0x81:
        name = "i64.rem_s";
        break;

      case 0x82:
        name = "i64.rem_u";
        break;

      case 0x83:
        name = "i64.and";
        break;

      case 0x84:
        name = "i64.or";
        break;

      case 0x85:
        name = "i64.xor";
        break;

      case 0x86:
        name = "i64.shl";
        break;

      case 0x87:
        name = "i64.shr_s";
        break;

      case 0x88:
        name = "i64.shr_u";
        break;

      case 0x89:
        name = "i64.rotl";
        break;

      case 0x8a:
        name = "i64.rotr";
        break;
    }

    out.push({
      pos,
      op,
      name,
      arg,
    });

    if (p > END + 1) {
      break;
    }
  }

  return out;
}

  console.log();

  );

  const before = ins.slice(Math.max(0, idx - 10), idx);
  const after = ins.slice(idx + 1, Math.min(ins.length, idx + 16));

  console.log("  BEFORE CALL:");

  for (const x of before) {

  for (const x of after) {

        x.arg !== undefined ? ` ${x.arg.toString()}` : ""
      }`
    );
  }

  /*
   * Search forward until the next CALL/store boundary for local
   * operations which may carry the returned values.
   */
  const localOps = [];

  for (
    let j = idx + 1;
    j < ins.length && j < idx + 80;
    j++
  ) {
    const x = ins[j];

    if (
      x.name === "call" ||
      x.name === "i64.store" ||
      x.name === "end"

    if (
      x.name === "local.get" ||
      x.name === "local.set" ||
      x.name === "local.tee" ||

      x.name === "i64.sub" ||
      x.name === "i64.mul" ||
      x.name === "i64.and" ||
      x.name === "i64.or" ||
      x.name === "i64.xor" ||
      x.name === "i64.shl" ||
      x.name === "i64.shr_s" ||
      x.name === "i64.shr_u"

    }

  console.log("  DATAFLOW CANDIDATES:");

  if (localOps.length === 0) {
    console.log("    NONE");
  } else {

      console.log(

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const FUNC_START = 0x1226d;
const FUNC_END   = 0x1295b;

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): {
    value: bigint;
    next: number;
} {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p++];

        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }

        shift += 7n;

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error("SLEB too large");
        }
    }

    if ((shift < 64n) && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        next: p,
    };
}

type Value = {
    id: number;
    text: string;
    origin?: string;
};

let nextId = 1;

function value(text: string, origin?: string): Value {
    return {
        id: nextId++,
        text,
        origin,
    };
}

type Instr = {
    pc: number;
    opcode: number;
    name: string;
    imm?: string;
};

function decodeInstruction(buf: Buffer, p: number): {
    instr: Instr;
    next: number;
} {
    const pc = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    switch (op) {
        case 0x0b:
            return {
                instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "end" },
                next: p,
            };

        case 0x20: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "local.get",
                    imm: String(x.value),
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "local.set",
                    imm: String(x.value),
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "local.tee",
                    imm: String(x.value),
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x41: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "i32.const",
                    imm: x.value.toString(),
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x42: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "i64.const",
                    imm: x.value.toString(),
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "call",
                    imm: String(x.value),
                },
                next: x.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x28: {
            const align = readULEB(buf, p);
            const offset = readULEB(buf, align.next);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "i32.load",
                    imm: `align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`,
                },
                next: offset.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x29: {
            const align = readULEB(buf, p);
            const offset = readULEB(buf, align.next);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "i64.load",
                    imm: `align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`,
                },
                next: offset.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x36: {
            const align = readULEB(buf, p);
            const offset = readULEB(buf, align.next);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "i32.store",
                    imm: `align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`,
                },
                next: offset.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const align = readULEB(buf, p);
            const offset = readULEB(buf, align.next);

            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: "i64.store",
                    imm: `align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`,
                },
                next: offset.next,
            };
        }

        case 0x7c: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.add" }, next: p };
        case 0x7d: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.sub" }, next: p };
        case 0x7e: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.mul" }, next: p };
        case 0x7f: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.div_s" }, next: p };
        case 0x80: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.div_u" }, next: p };
        case 0x81: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.rem_s" }, next: p };
        case 0x82: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.rem_u" }, next: p };
        case 0x83: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.and" }, next: p };
        case 0x84: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.or" }, next: p };
        case 0x85: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.xor" }, next: p };
        case 0x86: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.shl" }, next: p };
        case 0x87: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.shr_s" }, next: p };
        case 0x88: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.shr_u" }, next: p };
        case 0x89: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.rotl" }, next: p };
        case 0x8a: return { instr: { pc, opcode: op, name: "i64.rotr" }, next: p };

        default:
            return {
                instr: {
                    pc,
                    opcode: op,
                    name: `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16)})`,
                },
                next: p,
            };
    }
}

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log(" RAW WASM DATAFLOW");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

console.log("Range     :", `${hex(FUNC_START)} .. ${hex(FUNC_END)}`);
console.log("");

/*
 * Decode the exact Function-122 byte range.
 */
const instructions: Instr[] = [];

let p = FUNC_START;

while (p < FUNC_END) {
    const d = decodeInstruction(wasm, p);
    instructions.push(d.instr);

    if (d.next <= p) {
        throw new Error(`Decoder did not advance at ${hex(p)}`);
    }

    p = d.next;
}

console.log("Instructions decoded :", instructions.length);
console.log("Final position       :", hex(p));
console.log("Expected end         :", hex(FUNC_END));

if (p !== FUNC_END) {
    throw new Error("EXACT END MISMATCH");
}

/*
 * Function 87 is function index 87.
 *
 * We first identify all CALL 87 instructions.
 */
const calls87 = instructions.filter(
    x => x.name === "call" && x.imm === "87"
);

console.log("CALL 87 count        :", calls87.length);
console.log("");

/*
 * The important part:
 *
 * A CALL 87 receives:
 *
 *   arg0 = destination pointer
 *   arg1 = A
 *   arg2 = 0
 *   arg3 = B
 *   arg4 = 0
 *   arg5 = temporary/local value
 *
 * We do not infer the destination from the slot number.
 *
 * Instead we perform a lightweight symbolic stack simulation around
 * every CALL 87 to recover the actual argument expressions.
 */

type Sym = {
    text: string;
};

function S(text: string): Sym {
    return { text };
}

function bin(op: string, a: Sym, b: Sym): Sym {
    return S(`(${a.text} ${op} ${b.text})`);
}

function unary(op: string, a: Sym): Sym {
    return S(`(${a.text} ${op})`);
}

function constI64(n: string): Sym {
    return S(`i64(${n})`);
}

function parseMemoryImmediate(imm?: string): {
    align: number;
    offset: number;
} {
    if (!imm) {
        throw new Error("Missing memory immediate");
    }

    const m = /^align=(\d+) offset=(\d+)$/.exec(imm);

    if (!m) {
        throw new Error(`Bad memory immediate: ${imm}`);
    }

    return {
        align: Number(m[1]),
        offset: Number(m[2]),
    };
}

/*
 * Build a symbolic trace independently for each CALL 87.
 *
 * This is deliberately conservative:
 * unsupported control-flow is reported instead of guessed.
 */
type CallTrace = {
    call: Instr;
    args: Sym[];
    before: number;
    status: string;
};

function traceCall(index: number): CallTrace {
    const locals = new Map<number, Sym>();

    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        locals.set(i, S(`local${i}`));
    }

    const stack: Sym[] = [];

    /*
     * We need the instruction stream preceding the CALL.
     * Because Function 122 is straight-line for this region,
     * replay from the function beginning.
     */
    for (let i = 0; i <= index; i++) {
        const ins = instructions[i];

        switch (ins.name) {
            case "local.get": {
                const n = Number(ins.imm);
                stack.push(locals.get(n) ?? S(`local${n}`));
                break;
            }

            case "local.set": {
                const n = Number(ins.imm);
                const v = stack.pop();

                if (!v) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                locals.set(n, v);
                break;
            }

            case "local.tee": {
                const n = Number(ins.imm);
                const v = stack[stack.length - 1];

                if (!v) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                locals.set(n, v);
                break;
            }

            case "i32.const":
            case "i64.const":
                stack.push(S(`${ins.name === "i32.const" ? "i32" : "i64"}(${ins.imm})`));
                break;

            case "i64.load": {
                const mem = parseMemoryImmediate(ins.imm);
                const addr = stack.pop();

                if (!addr) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `LOAD ADDRESS UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(
                    S(`MEM64[${addr.text}+${mem.offset}]`)
                );
                break;
            }

            case "i64.store": {
                /*
                 * address + value
                 */
                const value = stack.pop();
                const addr = stack.pop();

                if (!value || !addr) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `STORE STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                break;
            }

            case "i64.add": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `ADD STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.add", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.sub": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `SUB STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.sub", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.mul": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `MUL STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.mul", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.and": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `AND STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.and", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.or": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `OR STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.or", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.xor": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `XOR STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.xor", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.shl": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `SHL STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.shl", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.shr_s": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `SHR_S STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.shr_s", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.shr_u": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `SHR_U STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin("i64.shr_u", a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "i64.div_s":
            case "i64.div_u":
            case "i64.rem_s":
            case "i64.rem_u":
            case "i64.rotl":
            case "i64.rotr": {
                const b = stack.pop();
                const a = stack.pop();

                if (!a || !b) {
                    return {
                        call: instructions[index],
                        args: [],
                        before: stack.length,
                        status: `${ins.name} STACK UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                    };
                }

                stack.push(bin(ins.name, a, b));
                break;
            }

            case "call": {
                const target = Number(ins.imm);

                if (target === 87) {
                    /*
                     * Function 87 has 5 parameters.
                     *
                     * Stack order:
                     *   ... arg0 arg1 arg2 arg3 arg4
                     *
                     * The last five stack entries are therefore
                     * the actual call arguments.
                     */
                    if (stack.length < 5) {
                        return {
                            call: instructions[index],
                            args: [],
                            before: stack.length,
                            status:
                                `CALL87 ARG UNDERFLOW at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                        };
                    }

                    const args = stack.slice(-5);

                    /*
                     * We are interested in the current CALL only.
                     */
                    if (i === index) {
                        return {
                            call: ins,
                            args,
                            before: stack.length - 5,
                            status: "OK",
                        };
                    }

                    /*
                     * Function 87 returns void.
                     */
                    stack.splice(stack.length - 5, 5);
                } else {
                    /*
                     * Unknown call.
                     *
                     * Do not invent its return values.
                     * For Function 122 this trace is primarily used
                     * to recover the arguments of CALL 87.
                     */
                    stack.length = Math.max(0, stack.length - 0);
                }

                break;
            }

            case "end":
                break;

            default:
                return {
                    call: instructions[index],
                    args: [],
                    before: stack.length,
                    status:
                        `UNSUPPORTED ${ins.name} (${hex(ins.opcode)}) at ${hex(ins.pc)}`,
                };
        }
    }

    return {
        call: instructions[index],
        args: [],
        before: stack.length,
        status: "NOT REACHED",
    };
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" CALL 87 DESTINATION / ARGUMENT RECOVERY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

for (let i = 0; i < instructions.length; i++) {
    if (
        instructions[i].name === "call" &&
        instructions[i].imm === "87"
    ) {
        const t = traceCall(i);

        console.log(`CALL @ ${hex(t.call.pc)}`);

        if (t.status !== "OK") {
            console.log("  STATUS :", t.status);
            console.log("");
            continue;
        }

        console.log("  ARG0 / DESTINATION =", t.args[0].text);
        console.log("  ARG1 / A           =", t.args[1].text);
        console.log("  ARG2                =", t.args[2].text);
        console.log("  ARG3 / B           =", t.args[3].text);
        console.log("  ARG4                =", t.args[4].text);
        console.log("");
    }
}

console.log(" END");

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x1226d;
const END   = 0x1295b;

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p++];
        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7n;
    }

    if ((shift < 64n) && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
    }

    return { value: result, next: p };
}

type Instr = {
    pc: number;
    op: number;
    name: string;
    imm?: number;
    imm2?: number;
};

function ins(
    pc: number,
    op: number,
    name: string,
    imm?: number,
    imm2?: number
): Instr {
    return { pc, op, name, imm, imm2 };
}

function decode(buf: Buffer, p: number): { x: Instr; next: number } {
    const pc = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    switch (op) {

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // CONTROL
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        case 0x00:
            return { x: ins(pc, op, "unreachable"), next: p };

        case 0x01:
            return { x: ins(pc, op, "nop"), next: p };

        case 0x02: {
            const b = readSLEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "block"),
                next: b.next
            };
        }

        case 0x03: {
            const b = readSLEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "loop"),
                next: b.next
            };
        }

        case 0x04: {
            const b = readSLEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "if"),
                next: b.next
            };
        }

        case 0x05:
            return { x: ins(pc, op, "else"), next: p };

        case 0x0b:
            return { x: ins(pc, op, "end"), next: p };

        case 0x0c: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "br", x.value),
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x0d: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "br_if", x.value),
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x0e: {
            const n = readULEB(buf, p);
            p = n.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                const x = readULEB(buf, p);
                p = x.next;
            }

            const def = readULEB(buf, p);

            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "br_table", n.value, def.value),
                next: def.next
            };
        }

        case 0x0f:
            return { x: ins(pc, op, "return"), next: p };

        case 0x10: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "call", x.value),
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // LOCALS
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        case 0x20: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "local.get", x.value),
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x21: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "local.set", x.value),
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x22: {
            const x = readULEB(buf, p);
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "local.tee", x.value),
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // CONSTANTS
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        case 0x41: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);

            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "i32.const"),
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        case 0x42: {
            const x = readSLEB(buf, p);

            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "i64.const"),
                next: x.next
            };
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // LOADS
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        case 0x28: {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const o = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "i32.load", a.value, o.value),
                next: o.next
            };
        }

        case 0x29: {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const o = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "i64.load", a.value, o.value),
                next: o.next
            };
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // STORES
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        case 0x36: {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const o = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "i32.store", a.value, o.value),
                next: o.next
            };
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const o = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, "i64.store", a.value, o.value),
                next: o.next
            };
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // I64 ALU
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        case 0x7c: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.add"), next: p };
        case 0x7d: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.sub"), next: p };
        case 0x7e: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.mul"), next: p };
        case 0x7f: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.div_s"), next: p };
        case 0x80: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.div_u"), next: p };
        case 0x81: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.rem_s"), next: p };
        case 0x82: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.rem_u"), next: p };
        case 0x83: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.and"), next: p };
        case 0x84: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.or"), next: p };
        case 0x85: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.xor"), next: p };
        case 0x86: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.shl"), next: p };
        case 0x87: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.shr_s"), next: p };
        case 0x88: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.shr_u"), next: p };
        case 0x89: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.rotl"), next: p };
        case 0x8a: return { x: ins(pc, op, "i64.rotr"), next: p };

        default:
            return {
                x: ins(pc, op, `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16)})`),
                next: p
            };
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x0001226d;
const END = 0x0001295b;

type Value = {
  id: string;
  kind: "i32" | "i64" | "unknown";
};

type Instr = {
  pos: number;
  op: number;
  name: string;
  arg?: bigint | number;
};

function hx(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
  let value = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];

    value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (b & 0x40) {
        value |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
      }

      return { value, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7n;
  }
}

function decode(buf: Buffer): Instr[] {
  const out: Instr[] = [];

  let p = START;

  while (p <= END) {
    const pos = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    let name = `UNKNOWN(0x${op.toString(16)})`;
    let arg: bigint | number | undefined;

    switch (op) {
      case 0x00:
        name = "unreachable";
        break;

      case 0x01:
        name = "nop";
        break;

      case 0x02:
        name = "block";
        break;

      case 0x03:
        name = "loop";
        break;

      case 0x04:
        name = "if";
        break;

      case 0x05:
        name = "else";
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        name = "end";
        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "br";
        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "br_if";
        break;
      }

      case 0x0f:
        name = "return";
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "call";
        break;
      }

      case 0x20: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "local.get";
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "local.set";
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "local.tee";
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "global.get";
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const r = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "global.set";
        break;
      }

      case 0x28: {
        const align = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = align.next;

        const off = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = off.next;

        arg = off.value;
        name = "i32.load";
        break;
      }

      case 0x29: {
        const align = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = align.next;

        const off = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = off.next;

        arg = off.value;
        name = "i64.load";
        break;
      }

      case 0x36: {
        const align = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = align.next;

        const off = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = off.next;

        arg = off.value;
        name = "i32.store";
        break;
      }

      case 0x37: {
        const align = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = align.next;

        const off = readULEB(buf, p);
        p = off.next;

        arg = off.value;
        name = "i64.store";
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        const r = readSLEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "i32.const";
        break;
      }

      case 0x42: {
        const r = readSLEB(buf, p);
        p = r.next;
        arg = r.value;
        name = "i64.const";
        break;
      }

      case 0x45:
        name = "i32.eqz";
        break;

      case 0x46:
        name = "i32.eq";
        break;

      case 0x47:
        name = "i32.ne";
        break;

      case 0x48:
        name = "i32.lt_s";
        break;

      case 0x49:
        name = "i32.lt_u";
        break;

      case 0x4a:
        name = "i32.gt_s";
        break;

      case 0x4b:
        name = "i32.gt_u";
        break;

      case 0x4c:
        name = "i32.le_s";
        break;

      case 0x4d:
        name = "i32.le_u";
        break;

      case 0x4e:
        name = "i32.ge_s";
        break;

      case 0x4f:
        name = "i32.ge_u";
        break;

      case 0x50:
        name = "i64.eqz";
        break;

      case 0x51:
        name = "i64.eq";
        break;

      case 0x52:
        name = "i64.ne";
        break;

      case 0x53:
        name = "i64.lt_s";
        break;

      case 0x54:
        name = "i64.lt_u";
        break;

      case 0x55:
        name = "i64.gt_s";
        break;

      case 0x56:
        name = "i64.gt_u";
        break;

      case 0x57:
        name = "i64.le_s";
        break;

      case 0x58:
        name = "i64.le_u";
        break;

      case 0x59:
        name = "i64.ge_s";
        break;

      case 0x5a:
        name = "i64.ge_u";
        break;

      case 0x6a:
        name = "i32.add";
        break;

      case 0x6b:
        name = "i32.sub";
        break;

      case 0x7c:
        name = "i64.add";
        break;

      case 0x7d:
        name = "i64.sub";
        break;

      case 0x7e:
        name = "i64.mul";
        break;

      case 0x7f:
        name = "i64.div_s";
        break;

      case 0x80:
        name = "i64.div_u";
        break;

      case 0x81:
        name = "i64.rem_s";
        break;

      case 0x82:
        name = "i64.rem_u";
        break;

      case 0x83:
        name = "i64.and";
        break;

      case 0x84:
        name = "i64.or";
        break;

      case 0x85:
        name = "i64.xor";
        break;

      case 0x86:
        name = "i64.shl";
        break;

      case 0x87:
        name = "i64.shr_s";
        break;

      case 0x88:
        name = "i64.shr_u";
        break;

      case 0x89:
        name = "i64.rotl";
        break;

      case 0x8a:
        name = "i64.rotr";
        break;
    }

    out.push({ pos, op, name, arg });

    if (p > END + 1) break;
  }

  return out;
}

function pop(stack: Value[], n: number): Value[] {
  const r: Value[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    r.unshift(
      stack.length
        ? stack.pop()!
        : { id: "STACK_UNDERFLOW", kind: "unknown" }
    );
  }

  return r;
}

function push(stack: Value[], id: string, kind: "i32" | "i64" | "unknown") {
  stack.push({ id, kind });
}

function fmt(v: Value | undefined): string {
  if (!v) return "NONE";
  return v.id;
}

const locals = new Map<number, Value>();
const stack: Value[] = [];

let call87 = 0;

const resultConsumers: {
  callNo: number;
  pos: number;
  low: Value;
  high: Value;
  consumers: string[];
}[] = [];

function noteConsumer(callNo: number, value: Value, pos: number, op: string) {
  if (!value.id.startsWith("CALL87_")) return;

  const rec = resultConsumers.find((x) => x.callNo === callNo);

  if (rec) {
    rec.consumers.push(`${hx(pos)} ${op} <- ${value.id}`);
  }
}

/*
 * Map a CALL87 result value to its CALL number.
 *
 * Each result is represented by two explicit symbolic values.
 */
const valueOwner = new Map<string, number>();

function rememberResult(callNo: number, low: Value, high: Value) {
  valueOwner.set(low.id, callNo);
  valueOwner.set(high.id, callNo);

  resultConsumers.push({
    callNo,
    pos: 0,
    low,
    high,
    consumers: [],
  });
}

function consumeValue(v: Value, pos: number, op: string) {
  const owner = valueOwner.get(v.id);

  if (owner !== undefined) {
    noteConsumer(owner, v, pos, op);
  }
}

for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
  const x = ins[i];

  /*
   * CALL 87
   *
   * Before the call:
   *
   *   destination
   *   A
   *   arg2
   *   B
   *   arg4
   *
   * Function 87 returns:
   *
   *   low
   *   high
   *
   * The exact ABI has already been established separately.
   */
  if (x.name === "call" && Number(x.arg) === 87) {
    const args = pop(stack, 5);

    call87++;

    const low: Value = {
      id: `CALL87_${call87}_LOW`,
      kind: "i64",
    };

    const high: Value = {
      id: `CALL87_${call87}_HIGH`,
      kind: "i64",
    };

    rememberResult(call87, low, high);

    resultConsumers[resultConsumers.length - 1].pos = x.pos;

    /*
     * WASM multi-value return order:
     * push result values back on the stack.
     */
    push(stack, low.id, "i64");
    push(stack, high.id, "i64");

    console.log();
    console.log(
