import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x00095e62;
const END   = 0x00096da8;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hx(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];

        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            return { value: v, next: pos };

        s += 7;
    }
}

function sleb32(pos: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];

        v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) {

            if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
                v |= (-1 << (s + 7));

            return {
                value: v | 0,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        s += 7;
    }
}

type I = {
    pc: number;
    op: string;
    text: string;
    local?: number;
    imm?: number;
    offset?: number;
};

function decode(): I[] {

    const out: I[] = [];

    let p = START;

    while (p < END) {

        const pc = p;
        const b = bytes[p++];

        try {

            if (b === 0x20) {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "local.get",
                    local: x.value,
                    text: `local.get ${x.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x21) {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "local.set",
                    local: x.value,
                    text: `local.set ${x.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x22) {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "local.tee",
                    local: x.value,
                    text: `local.tee ${x.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x23) {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "global.get",
                    text: `global.get ${x.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x24) {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "global.set",
                    text: `global.set ${x.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x41) {
                const x = sleb32(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "i32.const",
                    imm: x.value,
                    text: `i32.const ${x.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x42) {

                let q = p;

                while (true) {
                    const z = bytes[q++];

                    if (!(z & 0x80))
                        break;
                }

                p = q;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "i64.const",
                    text: "i64.const"
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x28) {

                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "i32.load",
                    offset: o.value,
                    text: `i32.load offset=${o.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x29) {

                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "i64.load",
                    offset: o.value,
                    text: `i64.load offset=${o.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x31) {

                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "i64.load8_u",
                    offset: o.value,
                    text: `i64.load8_u offset=${o.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x36) {

                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "i32.store",
                    offset: o.value,
                    text: `i32.store offset=${o.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x37) {

                const a = uleb(p);
                p = a.next;

                const o = uleb(p);
                p = o.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "i64.store",
                    offset: o.value,
                    text: `i64.store offset=${o.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            const simple: Record<number, string> = {

                0x1a: "drop",
                0x1b: "select",

                0x6a: "i32.add",
                0x6b: "i32.sub",
                0x74: "i32.shl",
                0x75: "i32.shr_s",
                0x76: "i32.shr_u",

                0x7c: "i64.add",
                0x7d: "i64.sub",
                0x7e: "i64.mul",
                0x83: "i64.and",
                0x84: "i64.or",
                0x85: "i64.xor",
                0x86: "i64.shl",
                0x88: "i64.shr_u",

                0x45: "i32.eqz",
                0x46: "i32.eq",
                0x47: "i32.ne",
                0x48: "i32.lt_s",
                0x49: "i32.lt_u",
                0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
                0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
            };

            if (simple[b]) {

                out.push({

                    op: simple[b],

                });

            }

            if (b === 0x10) {

                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "call",
                    imm: x.value,
                    text: `call ${x.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x0c || b === 0x0d) {

                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: b === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if",
                    imm: x.value,
                    text:
                        `${b === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"} ${x.value}`
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x02 || b === 0x03 || b === 0x04) {

                const x = sleb32(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op:
                        b === 0x02
                            ? "block"
                            : b === 0x03
                            ? "loop"
                            : "if",
                    text:
                        b === 0x02
                            ? "block"
                            : b === 0x03
                            ? "loop"
                            : "if"
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x05) {

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "else",
                    text: "else"
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (b === 0x0b) {

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    op: "end",
                    text: "end"
                });

                continue;
            }

            out.push({
                pc,
                op: "unknown",
                text:
                    `UNKNOWN 0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
            });

        } catch {

            out.push({
                pc,
                op: "decode_error",
                text: "DECODE_ERROR"
            });

            break;
        }
    }

    return out;
}


/* ============================================================ */
/* SYMBOLIC EXPRESSIONS                                         */
/* ============================================================ */

type Expr =
    | { kind: "unknown"; text: string }
    | { kind: "const"; value: number }
    | { kind: "local"; n: number }
    | { kind: "global"; n: number }
    | { kind: "add"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "sub"; a: Expr; b: Expr }
    | { kind: "shl"; a: Expr; bits: number }
    | { kind: "load"; addr: Expr; offset: number }
    | { kind: "load8"; addr: Expr; offset: number }
    | { kind: "select"; a: Expr; b: Expr; c: Expr };

function C(v: number): Expr {
    return {
        kind: "const",
        value: v
    };
}

function L(n: number): Expr {
    return {
        kind: "local",
        n
    };
}

function G(n: number): Expr {
    return {
        kind: "global",
        n
    };
}

function U(text: string): Expr {
    return {
        kind: "unknown",
        text
    };
}

function add(a: Expr, b: Expr): Expr {
    return {
        kind: "add",
        a,
        b
    };
}

function sub(a: Expr, b: Expr): Expr {
    return {
        kind: "sub",
        a,
        b
    };
}

function shl(a: Expr, bits: number): Expr {
    return {
        kind: "shl",
        a,
        bits
    };
}

function expr(e: Expr): string {

    switch (e.kind) {

        case "unknown":
            return e.text;

        case "const":
            return `${e.value}`;

        case "local":
            return `L${e.n}`;

        case "global":
            return `G${e.n}`;

        case "add":
            return `(${expr(e.a)} + ${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "sub":
            return `(${expr(e.a)} - ${expr(e.b)})`;

        case "shl":
            return `(${expr(e.a)} << ${e.bits})`;

        case "load":
            return `MEM64[${expr(e.addr)}+${e.offset}]`;

        case "load8":
            return `MEM8[${expr(e.addr)}+${e.offset}]`;

        case "select":
            return `select(${expr(e.a)},${expr(e.b)},${expr(e.c)})`;
    }
}


/* ============================================================ */
/* NORMALIZATION                                                */
/* ============================================================ */

function normalize(e: Expr): string {

    const s = expr(e);

    const patterns: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [

        [
            /^\(L7 \+ 256\)$/,
            "G-208"
        ],

        [
            /^\(L7 \+ 192\)$/,
            "G-272"
        ],

        [
            /^\(L7 \+ 128\)$/,
            "G-336"
        ],

        [
            /^\(L7 - 64\)$/,
            "G-528"
        ],

        [
            /^\(L7 \+ 256\) \+ \(L0 << 3\)$/,
            "G-208 + i*8"
        ],

        [
            /^\(L7 \+ 192\) \+ \(L0 << 3\)$/,
            "G-272 + i*8"
        ],

        [
            /^\(L7 \+ 128\) \+ \(L0 << 3\)$/,
            "G-336 + i*8"
        ],

        [
            /^\(L7 - 64\) \+ \(L0 << 3\)$/,
            "G-528 + i*8"
        ],
    ];

    for (const [r, v] of patterns) {

        if (r.test(s))
            return v;
    }

    return s;
}

/* SYMBOLIC STACK                                               */

const ins = decode();

const stack: Expr[] = [];

const locals = new Map<number, Expr>();

function pop(): Expr {

    if (!stack.length)
        return U("STACK_UNDERFLOW");

    return stack.pop()!;
}

function push(x: Expr) {
    stack.push(x);
}

 *   (i32, i64, i64, i64, i64) -> void

 * Therefore call 205 consumes exactly five stack values.

const call205Args: Array<{

/*
 * Other calls are NOT given fabricated signatures.
 *
 * If we encounter one, the safest behavior is to poison only
 * the current symbolic stack rather than pretending that it
 * returned no value.
 */

function poisonStack(reason: string) {

    stack.length = 0;

    stack.push(
        U(`STACK_RESET(${reason})`)
    );
}

for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {

    const x = ins[i];

    switch (x.op) {

        case "local.get":

            push(
                locals.get(x.local!) ??
                L(x.local!)
            );

            break;


        case "local.set": {

            const v = pop();

            locals.set(
                x.local!,
                v
            );

            break;
        }


        case "local.tee": {

            const v =
                stack.length
                    ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                    : U("STACK_UNDERFLOW");

            locals.set(
                x.local!,
                v
            );

            break;
        }


        case "global.get":

            push(G(0));

            break;


        case "global.set":

            pop();

            break;


        case "i32.const":

            push(C(x.imm!));

            break;


        case "i32.add": {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(add(a, b));

            break;
        }


        case "i32.sub": {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(sub(a, b));

            break;
        }


        case "i32.shl": {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            if (b.kind === "const")
                push(shl(a, b.value));
            else
                push(
                    U(
                        `${expr(a)} << ${expr(b)}`
                    )
                );

            break;
        }


        case "i64.load8_u": {

            const a = pop();

            push({
                kind: "load8",
                addr: a,
                offset: x.offset ?? 0
            });

            break;
        }


        case "i64.load": {

            const a = pop();

            push({
                kind: "load",
                addr: a,
                offset: x.offset ?? 0
            });

            break;
        }


        case "select": {

            /*
             * WebAssembly select:
             *
             *   val1 val2 condition
             *
             * => one value
             */

            const condition = pop();
            const val2 = pop();
            const val1 = pop();

            push({
                kind: "select",
                a: val1,
                b: val2,
                c: condition
            });

            break;
        }


        case "i64.add": {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(add(a, b));

            break;
        }


        case "i64.sub": {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(sub(a, b));

            break;
        }


        case "i64.mul": {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push(
                U(
                    `MUL64(${expr(a)},${expr(b)})`
                )
            );

            break;
        }


        case "drop":

            pop();

            break;


        case "i64.store": {

            const value = pop();
            const address = pop();

            stores.push({
                pc: x.pc,
                address,
                value
            });

            break;
        }


        case "i32.store": {

            const value = pop();
            const address = pop();

            stores.push({
                pc: x.pc,
                address,
                value
            });

            break;
        }


        case "call": {

            const target = x.imm!;

            if (target === 205) {

                /*
                 * Stack order:
                 *
                 * arg0 arg1 arg2 arg3 arg4
                 *
                 * The last pushed value is arg4.
                 */

                const args: Expr[] = [];

                for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++)
                    args.unshift(pop());

                call205Args.push({
                    pc: x.pc,
                    args
                });

                /*
                 * Function 205 returns void.
                 * Therefore it leaves no result on stack.
                 */

                break;
            }


            /*
             * Unknown call signature.
             *
             * Do not let unknown stack effects contaminate all
             * subsequent memory analysis.
             */

            poisonStack(
                `CALL_${target}_UNKNOWN_SIGNATURE`
            );

            break;
        }


        default:

            /*
             * Control-flow instructions and unsupported operations
             * are intentionally not allowed to fabricate symbolic
             * values.
             */

            break;
    }
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 2094;

const TARGET_STORES = [
    0x0009670d,
    0x000967c8,
    0x00096883,
    0x00096baf,
];

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u32(pos: number): number {
    return (
        bytes[pos] |
        (bytes[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (bytes[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (bytes[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];
        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 63n && (b & 0x40))
                result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);

            return { value: result, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
                result |= (-1 << (shift + 7));

            return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function findFunction205Body(): {
    bodyStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;
} {
    const codeSectionStart = 0x00006e78;
    const payload = 0x00006e7d;
    const codeSectionEnd = 0x00324ef5;

    let p = payload;

    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const size = readULEB(p);
        const sizeField = p;

        const codeStart = size.next;
        const bodyEnd = codeStart + size.value;

        if (i === 2011) {
            if (codeStart !== 0x00095e62) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Function 2094 body mismatch: ${hex(codeStart)}`
                );
            }

            return {
                bodyStart: codeStart,
                bodyEnd,
            };
        }

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    throw new Error("Function 2094 not found");
}

type Instr = {
    pc: number;
    end: number;
    text: string;
    kind: string;
    local?: number;
    offset?: number;
    immediate?: bigint | number;
};

function decodeRange(start: number, end: number): Instr[] {
    const out: Instr[] = [];
    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const pc = p;
        const op = bytes[p++];

        try {
            // local.get
            if (op === 0x20) {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
                    kind: "local.get",
                    local: x.value,
                });
                continue;
            }

            // local.set
            if (op === 0x21) {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
                    kind: "local.set",
                    local: x.value,
                });
                continue;
            }

            // local.tee
            if (op === 0x22) {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
                    kind: "local.tee",
                    local: x.value,
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i32.const
            if (op === 0x41) {
                const x = readSLEB32(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
                    kind: "i32.const",
                    immediate: x.value,
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.const
            if (op === 0x42) {
                const x = readSLEB64(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
                    kind: "i64.const",
                    immediate: x.value,
                });
                continue;
            }

            // global.get
            if (op === 0x23) {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `global.get ${x.value}`,
                    kind: "global.get",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // global.set
            if (op === 0x24) {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `global.set ${x.value}`,
                    kind: "global.set",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i32.add
            if (op === 0x6a) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i32.add",
                    kind: "i32.add",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i32.sub
            if (op === 0x6b) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i32.sub",
                    kind: "i32.sub",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i32.and
            if (op === 0x71) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i32.and",
                    kind: "i32.and",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i32.shl
            if (op === 0x74) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i32.shl",
                    kind: "i32.shl",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i32.shr_u
            if (op === 0x76) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i32.shr_u",
                    kind: "i32.shr_u",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.add
            if (op === 0x7c) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i64.add",
                    kind: "i64.add",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.sub
            if (op === 0x7d) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i64.sub",
                    kind: "i64.sub",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.mul
            if (op === 0x7e) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i64.mul",
                    kind: "i64.mul",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.and
            if (op === 0x83) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i64.and",
                    kind: "i64.and",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.or
            if (op === 0x84) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i64.or",
                    kind: "i64.or",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.shl
            if (op === 0x86) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i64.shl",
                    kind: "i64.shl",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.shr_u
            if (op === 0x88) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "i64.shr_u",
                    kind: "i64.shr_u",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // i64.load / i32.load
            if (op === 0x29 || op === 0x28) {
                const align = readULEB(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = readULEB(p);
                p = off.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text:
                        op === 0x29
                            ? `i64.load offset=${off.value}`
                            : `i32.load offset=${off.value}`,
                    kind:
                        op === 0x29
                            ? "i64.load"
                            : "i32.load",
                    offset: off.value,
                });

                continue;
            }

            // i64.store / i32.store
            if (op === 0x37 || op === 0x36) {
                const align = readULEB(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = readULEB(p);
                p = off.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text:
                        op === 0x37
                            ? `i64.store offset=${off.value}`
                            : `i32.store offset=${off.value}`,
                    kind:
                        op === 0x37
                            ? "i64.store"
                            : "i32.store",
                    offset: off.value,
                });

                continue;
            }

            // call
            if (op === 0x10) {
                const x = readULEB(p);
                p = x.next;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `call ${x.value}`,
                    kind: "call",
                });

                continue;
            }

            // block / loop / if / else / end
            if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
                p++;

                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text:
                        op === 0x02
                            ? "block"
                            : op === 0x03
                            ? "loop"
                            : "if",
                    kind: "control",
                });

                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x05) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "else",
                    kind: "control",
                });
                continue;
            }

            if (op === 0x0b) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: "end",
                    kind: "control",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // comparison operators commonly encountered
            if (
                op === 0x45 ||
                op === 0x46 ||
                op === 0x47 ||
                op === 0x48 ||
                op === 0x49 ||
                op === 0x4a ||
                op === 0x4b ||
                op === 0x50
            ) {
                out.push({
                    pc,
                    end: p,
                    text: `compare 0x${op.toString(16)}`,
                    kind: "compare",
                });
                continue;
            }

            // unknown: do not guess immediate length
            out.push({
                pc,
                end: p,
                text: `UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
                kind: "unknown",
            });

        } catch {
            out.push({
                pc,
                end: p,
                text: `DECODE_ERROR 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
                kind: "unknown",
            });

            break;
        }
    }

    return out;
}

function dumpMemory(pc: number, radius: number): void {
    const a = Math.max(0, pc - radius);
    const b = Math.min(bytes.length, pc + radius);

    console.log(
        `RAW ${hex(a)} .. ${hex(b)}`
    );

    for (let p = a; p < b; p += 16) {
        const lineEnd = Math.min(b, p + 16);

        let s = `${hex(p)}  `;

        for (let q = p; q < lineEnd; q++) {
            s += bytes[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0") + " ";
        }

        console.log(s);
    }
}

function printBackward(
    instructions: Instr[],
    targetIndex: number
): void {
    const from = Math.max(0, targetIndex - 18);

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        `BACKWARD WINDOW: ${hex(instructions[from].pc)} .. ${hex(instructions[targetIndex].pc)}`
    );

    for (let i = from; i <= targetIndex; i++) {
        const x = instructions[i];

        const marker =
            i === targetIndex
                ? "  <=== TARGET STORE"
                : "";

        console.log(
            `${hex(x.pc)}  ${x.text}${marker}`
        );
    }

    console.log("");
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const BODY_START = 0x00095e62;
const BODY_END   = 0x00096da8;

const TARGETS = [
  0x0009670d,
  0x000967c8,
  0x00096883,
  0x00096baf,
];

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[pos++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb32(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[pos++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (-1 << (shift + 7));

      return { value: v | 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function sleb64(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
  let v = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[pos++];

    v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);

      return { value: v, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7n;
  }
}

type Instr = {
  pc: number;
  end: number;
  op: string;
  text: string;
  local?: number;
  offset?: number;
  imm?: number | bigint;
};

function decode(start: number, end: number): Instr[] {
  const out: Instr[] = [];
  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const pc = p;
    const b = bytes[p++];

    try {

      // local.get
      if (b === 0x20) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "local.get",
          local: x.value,
          text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // local.set
      if (b === 0x21) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "local.set",
          local: x.value,
          text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // local.tee
      if (b === 0x22) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "local.tee",
          local: x.value,
          text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i32.const
      if (b === 0x41) {
        const x = sleb32(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i32.const",
          imm: x.value,
          text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.const
      if (b === 0x42) {
        const x = sleb64(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.const",
          imm: x.value,
          text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.load
      if (b === 0x29) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.load",
          offset: o.value,
          text: `i64.load offset=${o.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i32.load
      if (b === 0x28) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i32.load",
          offset: o.value,
          text: `i32.load offset=${o.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.store
      if (b === 0x37) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.store",
          offset: o.value,
          text: `i64.store offset=${o.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i32.store
      if (b === 0x36) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const o = uleb(p);
        p = o.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i32.store",
          offset: o.value,
          text: `i32.store offset=${o.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i32.add
      if (b === 0x6a) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i32.add",
          text: "i32.add",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i32.sub
      if (b === 0x6b) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i32.sub",
          text: "i32.sub",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i32.shl
      if (b === 0x74) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i32.shl",
          text: "i32.shl",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i32.shr_u
      if (b === 0x76) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i32.shr_u",
          text: "i32.shr_u",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.add
      if (b === 0x7c) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.add",
          text: "i64.add",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.sub
      if (b === 0x7d) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.sub",
          text: "i64.sub",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.mul
      if (b === 0x7e) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.mul",
          text: "i64.mul",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.and
      if (b === 0x83) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.and",
          text: "i64.and",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.or
      if (b === 0x84) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.or",
          text: "i64.or",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.shl
      if (b === 0x86) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.shl",
          text: "i64.shl",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // i64.shr_u
      if (b === 0x88) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "i64.shr_u",
          text: "i64.shr_u",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // global.get
      if (b === 0x23) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "global.get",
          text: `global.get ${x.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // global.set
      if (b === 0x24) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "global.set",
          text: `global.set ${x.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // call
      if (b === 0x10) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "call",
          text: `call ${x.value}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // drop
      if (b === 0x1a) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "drop",
          text: "drop",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // comparisons
      if (
        b === 0x45 ||
        b === 0x46 ||
        b === 0x47 ||
        b === 0x48 ||
        b === 0x49 ||
        b === 0x4a ||
        b === 0x4b ||
        b === 0x50
      ) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: `cmp_${b.toString(16)}`,
          text: `compare 0x${b.toString(16)}`,
        });

        continue;
      }

      // control instructions
      if (b === 0x02 || b === 0x03 || b === 0x04) {
        const x = sleb32(p);
        p = x.next;

        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "control",
          text:
            b === 0x02
              ? "block"
              : b === 0x03
              ? "loop"
              : "if",
        });

        continue;
      }

      if (b === 0x05) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "control",
          text: "else",
        });

        continue;
      }

      if (b === 0x0b) {
        out.push({
          pc,
          end: p,
          op: "control",
          text: "end",
        });

        continue;
      }

      // Unknown: do NOT invent its length.
      out.push({
        pc,
        end: p,
        op: "unknown",
        text: `UNKNOWN 0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      });

    } catch {
      out.push({
        pc,
        end: p,
        op: "decode_error",
        text: `DECODE_ERROR 0x${b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      });

      break;
    }
  }

  return out;
}

function previousLocalMutation(
  ins: Instr[],
  index: number,
  local: number
): number {
  for (let i = index - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const x = ins[i];

    if (
      (x.op === "local.tee" || x.op === "local.set") &&
      x.local === local
    ) {
      return i;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}

function printWindow(
  ins: Instr[],
  center: number,
  radius: number
): void {
  const a = Math.max(0, center - radius);
  const b = Math.min(ins.length - 1, center + radius);

  for (let i = a; i <= b; i++) {
    const x = ins[i];

    console.log(
      `${hex(x.pc)}  ${x.text}`
    );
  }
}

function findPreviousLocalGets(
  ins: Instr[],
  index: number,
  local: number,
  count: number
): number[] {
  const result: number[] = [];

  for (let i = index - 1; i >= 0 && result.length < count; i--) {
    const x = ins[i];

    if (
      (x.op === "local.get" ||
       x.op === "local.set" ||
       x.op === "local.tee") &&
      x.local === local
    ) {
      result.push(i);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 2479;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB too long");
    }
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("SLEB too long");
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections = [];

  while (p < bytes.length) {
    const id = bytes[p++];

    const len = uleb(p);
    p = len.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + len.value
    });

    p += len.value;
  }

  return sections;
}

function parseImports(section) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  let functions = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const mod = uleb(p);
    p = mod.next + mod.value;

    const name = uleb(p);
    p = name.next + name.value;

    const kind = bytes[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const type = uleb(p);
      p = type.next;
      functions++;
    }

    else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = uleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const max = uleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = uleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const max = uleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return functions;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(section) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const ids = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    ids.push(x.value);
  }

  return ids;
}

function parseCode(section, functionTypes, importedCount) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const funcs = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

    funcs.push({
      funcIndex: importedCount + i,
      typeIndex: functionTypes[i],
      start: bodyStart,
      end: bodyEnd
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return funcs;
}

function decode(func) {

  let p = func.start;

  const localCount = uleb(p);
  p = localCount.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;
    p++;
  }

  console.log(`BODY : ${hex(func.start)} .. ${hex(func.end)}`);
  console.log(`TYPE : ${func.typeIndex}`);

  console.log(
    "------------------------------------------------------------"
  );

  while (p < func.end) {

    const at = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    let text = null;

    switch (op) {

      case 0x00:
        text = "unreachable";
        break;

      case 0x01:
        text = "nop";
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        text = "end";
        break;

      case 0x0f:
        text = "return";

        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `call ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        const y = uleb(p);
        p = y.next;

        text =
          `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${y.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x1a:
        text = "drop";
        break;

      case 0x20: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
        break;

      case 0x23: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

          if ((b & 0x80n) === 0n) break;

          shift += 7n;

          0x28: "i32.load",

          0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
          0x2e: "i32.load16_s",

        break;

      case 0x78:
        text = "i32.rotr";
        break;

      case 0x02:
      case 0x03:
      case 0x04: {

        const blockType = bytes[p++];

        const name =
          op === 0x02
            ? "block"
            : op === 0x03

              : "if";

        text =
          `${name} type=${hex(blockType)}`;

        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `br ${x.value}`;
        break;

        text = `br_if ${x.value}`;

      default:

        console.log(

        console.log(
          "RAW REMAINING : " +
          Buffer.from(
            bytes.subarray(at, func.end)

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 2499;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) throw new Error("ULEB too long");
  }

  return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = bytes[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > 35) throw new Error("SLEB too long");
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections = [];

  while (p < bytes.length) {
    const id = bytes[p++];
    const len = uleb(p);
    p = len.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + len.value
    });

    p += len.value;
  }

  return sections;
}

function parseTypes(section) {
  let p = section.start;
  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const types = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const form = bytes[p++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported type form at ${hex(p - 1)}`);
    }

    const pc = uleb(p);
    p = pc.next;

    const params = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
      params.push(bytes[p++]);
    }

    const rc = uleb(p);
    p = rc.next;

    const results = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
      results.push(bytes[p++]);
    }

    types.push({ params, results });
  }

  return types;
}

function parseImports(section) {
  let p = section.start;
  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  let functions = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const mod = uleb(p);
    p = mod.next;

    p += mod.value;

    const name = uleb(p);
    p = name.next;

    p += name.value;

    const kind = bytes[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const t = uleb(p);
      p = t.next;
      functions++;
    } else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;
      const lim = bytes[p++];

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      if (lim & 1) {
        const b = uleb(p);
        p = b.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 2) {
      const lim = bytes[p++];

      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      if (lim & 1) {
        const b = uleb(p);
        p = b.next;
      }
    } else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return functions;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(section) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const ids = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;
    ids.push(x.value);
  }

  return ids;
}

function parseCode(section, functionTypes, importedCount) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const funcs = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

    funcs.push({
      funcIndex: importedCount + i,
      typeIndex: functionTypes[i],
      start: bodyStart,
      end: bodyEnd
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return funcs;
}

function decode(func) {
  let p = func.start;

  const localCount = uleb(p);
  p = localCount.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;
    p++;
  }

  console.log(`BODY : ${hex(func.start)} .. ${hex(func.end)}`);
  console.log(`TYPE : ${func.typeIndex}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  while (p < func.end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    let text = null;

    switch (op) {
      case 0x0b:
        text = "end";
        break;

      case 0x01:
        text = "nop";
        break;

      case 0x00:
        text = "unreachable";
        break;

      case 0x0f:
        text = "return";
        break;

      case 0x1a:
        text = "drop";
        break;

      case 0x1b:
        text = "select";
        break;

      case 0x20: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `global.get ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `global.set ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x10: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `call ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        const y = uleb(p);
        p = y.next;

        text = `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${y.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x02:
      case 0x03:
      case 0x04: {
        const blockType = bytes[p++];

        let name =
          op === 0x02 ? "block" :
          op === 0x03 ? "loop" :
          "if";

        text = `${name} type=${hex(blockType)}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x05:
        text = "else";
        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `br ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `br_if ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0e: {
        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;

        const labels = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;
          labels.push(x.value);
        }

        const d = uleb(p);
        p = d.next;

        labels.push(`default=${d.value}`);

        text = `br_table ${labels.join(",")}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        const x = sleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        text = `i32.const ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x42: {
        let v = 0n;
        let shift = 0n;

        while (true) {
          const b = BigInt(bytes[p++]);
          v |= (b & 0x7fn) << shift;

          if ((b & 0x80n) === 0n) break;

          shift += 7n;
        }

        text = `i64.const ${v}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x28:
      case 0x29:
      case 0x2c:
      case 0x2d:
      case 0x2e:
      case 0x2f:
      case 0x30:
      case 0x31:
      case 0x32:
      case 0x33:
      case 0x34:
      case 0x35: {
        const a = uleb(p);
        p = a.next;

        const names = {

          0x29: "i64.load",

          0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
          0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
          0x2f: "i32.load16_u",

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 259;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: p };

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35)
            throw new Error("ULEB too long at 0x" + pos.toString(16));
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function readSLEB(pos, bits = 32) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < bits && (b & 0x40))
                value -= Math.pow(2, shift);

            return { value, next: p };
        }

        if (shift > bits + 7)
            throw new Error("SLEB too long");
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function hex(v) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function parseSections() {
    const sections = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const sizeR = readULEB(p);
        p = sizeR.next;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start: p,
            end: p + sizeR.value
        });

        p += sizeR.value;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseFunctionSection(section) {
    const types = [];

    let p = section.start;

    const countR = readULEB(p);
    p = countR.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        types.push(r.value);
        p = r.next;
    }

    return types;
}

function parseCodeSection(section, functionTypes) {
    const bodies = [];

    let p = section.start;

    const countR = readULEB(p);
    p = countR.next;

    const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

    for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {

        const sizeR = readULEB(p);
        const bodySize = sizeR.value;
        p = sizeR.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

        const localsR = readULEB(p);
        p = localsR.next;

        for (let g = 0; g < localsR.value; g++) {
            const nR = readULEB(p);
            p = nR.next;
            p++;
        }

        bodies.push({
            func: IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + i,
            typeIndex: functionTypes[i],
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            codeStart: p,
            codeEnd: bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function memarg(p) {
    const align = buf[p++];

    const off = readULEB(p);

    return {
        align,
        offset: off.value,
        next: off.next
    };
}

function decode(body) {

    let p = body.codeStart;

    while (p < body.codeEnd) {

        const offset = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        let text;

        switch (op) {

            case 0x00:
                text = "unreachable";
                break;

            case 0x01:
                text = "nop";
                break;

            case 0x02: {
                const t = buf[p++];
                text = `block type=0x${t.toString(16)}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x03: {
                const t = buf[p++];
                text = `loop type=0x${t.toString(16)}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x04: {
                const t = buf[p++];
                text = `if type=0x${t.toString(16)}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x05:
                text = "else";
                break;

            case 0x0b:
                text = "end";
                break;

            case 0x0c: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `br ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0d: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;
                text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
                break;

                const n = readULEB(p);
                p = n.next;

                    p = r.next;
                    labels.push(r.value);

                p = d.next;

                text =
                    `br_table [${labels.join(", ")}] default=${d.value}`;

                break;

                text = "return";
                break;

                const r = readULEB(p);

                break;

                text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
                break;

            case 0x28: {
                const m = memarg(p);
                p = m.next;
                text =

                break;
            }

            case 0x29: {

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const END   = 0x14a20;

console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`RANGE     : 0x${START.toString(16)} - 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid ULEB128");
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value -= Math.pow(2, shift);
            }

            return { value, next: p };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid SLEB32");
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number) {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7n;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40)) {
                value -= 1n << shift;
            }

            return { value, next: p };
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Invalid SLEB64");
}

function hex8(x: number) {
    return "0x" + (x >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function raw(pos: number, n = 28) {
    return Array.from(
        wasm.subarray(pos, Math.min(pos + n, END))
    )
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

function showMemory(
    addr: number,
    name: string,
    p: number
) {
    const align = readULEB(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = readULEB(p);
    p = offset.next;

    console.log(
        `${name.padEnd(12)} @ ${hex8(addr)} ` +
        `align=${align.value} offset=${hex8(offset.value)}`
    );

    console.log(`             RAW: ${raw(addr)}`);

    return p;
}

let p = START;
let local9Count = 0;

while (p < END) {

    const addr = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // local.get / set / tee
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {

        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        const name =
            op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
            op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
            "local.tee";

        if (r.value === 9) {
            local9Count++;

            console.log("");
            console.log(
                `******** LOCAL 9 @ ${hex8(addr)} ********`
            );
            console.log(`${name} 9`);
            console.log(`RAW: ${raw(addr, 36)}`);
        } else {
            console.log(
                `${name.padEnd(12)} @ ${hex8(addr)} local=${r.value}`
            );
        }

        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // constants
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x41) {

        const r = readSLEB32(p);
        p = r.next;

        console.log(
            `i32.const    @ ${hex8(addr)} ` +
            `value=${r.value} (${hex8(r.value)})`
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x42) {

        const r = readSLEB64(p);
        p = r.next;

        console.log(
            `i64.const    @ ${hex8(addr)} value=${r.value}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // memory
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x28) {
        p = showMemory(addr, "i32.load", p);
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x29) {
        p = showMemory(addr, "i64.load", p);
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x2d) {
        p = showMemory(addr, "i32.load8_u", p);
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x2f) {
        p = showMemory(addr, "i32.load16_u", p);
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x36) {
        p = showMemory(addr, "i32.store", p);
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x37) {
        p = showMemory(addr, "i64.store", p);
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // control flow
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {

        const r = readSLEB32(p);
        p = r.next;

        const name =
            op === 0x02 ? "block" :
            op === 0x03 ? "loop" :
            "if";

        console.log(
            `${name.padEnd(12)} @ ${hex8(addr)} ` +
            `type=${r.value === 64 ? "empty" : r.value}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x05) {
        console.log(`else         @ ${hex8(addr)}`);
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0b) {
        console.log(`end          @ ${hex8(addr)}`);
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        console.log(
            `${op === 0x0c ? "br" : "br_if"}           ` +
            `@ ${hex8(addr)} depth=${r.value}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0f) {
        console.log(`return       @ ${hex8(addr)}`);
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {

        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        console.log(
            `call         @ ${hex8(addr)} function=${r.value}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // comparisons
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const compareNames: Record<number, string> = {
        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",
        0x48: "i32.lt_s",
        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u"
    };

    if (compareNames[op]) {
        console.log(
            `${compareNames[op].padEnd(12)} @ ${hex8(addr)}`
        );
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // i32 arithmetic / bitwise
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    const arithmetic: Record<number, string> = {
        0x67: "i32.clz",
        0x68: "i32.ctz",
        0x69: "i32.popcnt",
        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",
        0x6d: "i32.div_s",
        0x6e: "i32.div_u",

        0x70: "i32.rem_u",
        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",

        0x74: "i32.shl",
        0x75: "i32.shr_s",
        0x76: "i32.shr_u",
        0x77: "i32.rotl",
        0x78: "i32.rotr"
    };

    if (arithmetic[op]) {
        console.log(
            `${arithmetic[op].padEnd(12)} @ ${hex8(addr)}`
        );
        continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x1b) {
        console.log(`select       @ ${hex8(addr)}`);
        continue;
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------
    // unknown
    // --------------------------------------------------------

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        `STOP @ ${hex8(addr)} UNKNOWN OPCODE=0x${

import * as fs from "fs";

const wasmPath =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x14555;
const END   = 0x1493c;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

console.log("============================================================");

console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`RANGE     : 0x${START.toString(16)} - 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");

// Known WASM control-flow opcodes
const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x02: "block",
    0x03: "loop",
    0x04: "if",
    0x05: "else",
    0x0b: "end",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
    0x0e: "br_table",
    0x0f: "return",
    0x10: "call",

    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",

    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x36: "i32.store",

    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x48: "i32.lt_s",
    0x49: "i32.lt_u",
    0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
    0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
    0x4c: "i32.le_s",
    0x4d: "i32.le_u",
    0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
    0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
};

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
        if (shift > 35) break;
    }

    return {
        value: 0xffffffff,
        next: p
    };
}

function hex8(x: number) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function raw(pos: number, n = 12) {
    return Array.from(wasm.subarray(pos, Math.min(pos + n, END)))
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

let p = START;
let local9Hits = 0;
let cfHits = 0;

while (p < END) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    // local.get / set / tee
    if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        if (r.value === 9) {
            local9Hits++;

            const kind =
                op === 0x20 ? "local.get 9" :
                op === 0x21 ? "local.set 9" :
                "local.tee 9";

            console.log(
                `LOCAL9 @ ${hex8(addr)}  ${kind}  RAW: ${raw(addr, Math.min(16, END - addr))}`
            );
        }

        continue;
    }

    // call
    if (op === 0x10) {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        console.log(
            `CALL   @ ${hex8(addr)}  function=${r.value}  RAW: ${raw(addr, Math.min(12, END - addr))}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    // block / loop / if
    if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        cfHits++;

        console.log(
            `CF     @ ${hex8(addr)}  ${names[op]}  blocktype=${r.value}  RAW: ${raw(addr, Math.min(12, END - addr))}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    // else / end / return
    if (op === 0x05 || op === 0x0b || op === 0x0f) {
        cfHits++;

        console.log(
            `CF     @ ${hex8(addr)}  ${names[op]}  RAW: ${raw(addr, Math.min(12, END - addr))}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    // br / br_if
    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        cfHits++;

        console.log(
            `CF     @ ${hex8(addr)}  ${names[op]} depth=${r.value}  RAW: ${raw(addr, Math.min(12, END - addr))}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    // br_table
    if (op === 0x0e) {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;

        const count = r.value;

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
        }

        p = readULEB(p).next;

        cfHits++;

        console.log(
            `CF     @ ${hex8(addr)}  br_table count=${count}  RAW: ${raw(addr, Math.min(24, END - addr))}`
        );

        continue;
    }

    // i32.load
    if (op === 0x28) {
        const align = readULEB(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = readULEB(p);
        p = offset.next;

        // Only show loads involving local9.
        // We cannot know the stack operand here from opcode alone,
        // so the instruction is reported only as structural context.
        continue;
    }

    // i32.store
    if (op === 0x36) {
        const align = readULEB(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = readULEB(p);
        p = offset.next;

        continue;
    }

    // i32.const
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = readULEB(p);
        p = r.next;
        continue;
    }

    // Generic known one-byte instruction.
    // Important: unknown opcodes are NOT treated as single-byte
    // instructions because that could desynchronize the decoder.
    if (names[op]) {
        continue;
    }

    // For this focused scan, stop rather than guessing instruction length.
    console.log(
        `STOP   @ ${hex8(addr)}  UNKNOWN OPCODE=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    );
    console.log(`RAW: ${raw(addr, 24)}`);
    break;
}

console.log(" SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`LOCAL 9 EVENTS : ${local9Hits}`);
console.log(`CONTROL-FLOW    : ${cfHits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("READ ONLY: no TON connection");
console.log("READ ONLY: no wallet");
console.log("READ ONLY: no transaction");

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        value: 0xffffffff,
        next: p
    };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let byte = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        byte = wasm[p++];

        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
                value |= (~0 << shift);
            }
            break;
        }

        if (shift > 35) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function hex8(x: number) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function raw(pos: number, n = 20) {
    return Array.from(
        wasm.subarray(pos, Math.min(pos + n, END))
    )
        .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}
