import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x00007675;
const END   = 0x000076e7;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 87 DATAFLOW v1");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log(" SYMBOLIC STACK / LOCAL TRACKING");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");
console.log(`WASM size : ${wasm.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Range     : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0n;
  let s = 0n;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: pos };

    s += 7n;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0n;
  let s = 0n;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];

    v |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7n;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 64n && (b & 0x40))
    v |= (-1n) << s;

  return { value: v, next: pos };
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
  const a = uleb(pos);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    align: Number(a.value),
    offset: Number(o.value),
    next: o.next
  };
}

function H(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function short(x: string) {
  return x.length > 500 ? x.slice(0, 497) + "..." : x;
}

type V = string;

const stack: V[] = [];
const locals = new Map<number, V>();

function push(x: V) {
  stack.push(x);
}

function pop(): V {
  if (!stack.length)
    return "STACK_UNKNOWN";

  return stack.pop()!;
}

function binary(op: string) {
  const b = pop();
  const a = pop();

  push(`(${a} ${op} ${b})`);
}

function unary(op: string) {
  const a = pop();

  push(`${op}(${a})`);
}

function printStack(label: string) {
  console.log(`STACK ${label}:`);

  if (!stack.length) {
    console.log("  <empty>");
    return;
  }

  for (let i = stack.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    console.log(`  [${i}] ${short(stack[i])}`);
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readS32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function readU64Leb(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let value = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7n;
    }
}

function slotOf(expr: string): number | null {
    const m = expr.match(
        /\(\(STACK_PTR - 512\) \+ (\d+)\)/
    );

    if (!m)
        return null;

    const offset = Number(m[1]);

    if (offset < 0 || offset >= 480 || offset % 16 !== 0)
        return null;

    return offset / 16;
}

function clean(expr: string): string {
    return expr
        .replace(/\(\(STACK_PTR - 512\) - -(\d+)\)/g,
            "((STACK_PTR - 512) + $1)");
}

function describeInput(expr: string): string {
    expr = clean(expr);

    const s = slotOf(expr);

    if (s !== null)
        return `S${s} [frame+${s * 16}]`;

    return expr;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const FUNC_START = 0x0001226d;
const FUNC_END   = 0x0001295c;
const TARGET_FUNC = 87;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function u8(pos: number): number {
    return wasm[pos];
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: result,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error("ULEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
    let result = 0n;
    let shift = 0n;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (b & 0x40) {
                result |= (-1n) << (shift + 7n);
            }

            return {
                value: result,
                next: pos
            };
        }

        shift += 7n;

        if (shift > 70n) {
            throw new Error("SLEB too large");
        }
    }
}

function hex(n: number): string {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

type Expr = {
    type: "i32" | "i64" | "unknown";
    text: string;
};

function i32(text: string): Expr {
    return { type: "i32", text };
}

function i64(text: string): Expr {
    return { type: "i64", text };
}

function unknown(): Expr {
    return { type: "unknown", text: "<UNKNOWN>" };
}

    return stack.pop() ?? unknown();

            const a = pop(stack);

            stack.push(
                i64(`(${a.text} >>> ${b.text})`)
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0x29: {
            const align = readULEB(p);
            p = align.next;

            const off = readULEB(p);
            p = off.next;

            const address = pop(stack);

            let text = `MEM64[${address.text}`;

            if (off.value !== 0) {
                text += `+${off.value}`;
            }

            text += "]";

            stack.push(i64(text));

            break;
        }

        case 0x37: {
            const align = readULEB(p);
            p = align.next;

            const off = readULEB(p);
            p = off.next;

            /*
             * i64.store:
             *
             * stack = [..., address, value]
             */
            const value = pop(stack);
            const address = pop(stack);

            /*
             * We are only interested in stores made by Function 87.
             * Function 87 itself is not executed here, so this is
             * intentionally not added to the map.
             */
            void value;
            void address;
            void off;

            break;
        }

        case 0xa7: {
            const x = pop(stack);

            stack.push(
                i32(`wrap_i64(${x.text})`)
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0xac: {
            const x = pop(stack);

            stack.push(
                i64(`extend_i32_s(${x.text})`)
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0xad: {
            const x = pop(stack);

            stack.push(
                i64(`extend_i32_u(${x.text})`)
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0x45: {
            const x = pop(stack);

            stack.push(
                i32(`eqz(${x.text})`)
            );

            break;
        }
        /*
         * i32 comparisons
         *
         * 0x45 = i32.eqz
         * 0x46 = i32.eq
         * 0x47 = i32.ne
         * 0x48 = i32.lt_s
         * 0x49 = i32.lt_u
         * 0x4a = i32.gt_s
         * 0x4b = i32.gt_u
         * 0x4c = i32.le_s
         * 0x4d = i32.le_u
         * 0x4e = i32.ge_s
         * 0x4f = i32.ge_u
         */

        case 0x46:
        case 0x47:
        case 0x48:
        case 0x49:
        case 0x4a:
        case 0x4b:
        case 0x4c:
        case 0x4d:
        case 0x4e:
        case 0x4f: {
            const b = pop(stack);
            const a = pop(stack);

            const names: Record<number, string> = {
                0x46: "eq",
                0x47: "ne",
                0x48: "lt_s",
                0x49: "lt_u",
                0x4a: "gt_s",
                0x4b: "gt_u",
                0x4c: "le_s",
                0x4d: "le_u",
                0x4e: "ge_s",
                0x4f: "ge_u"
            };

            stack.push(
                i32(`${names[op]}(${a.text},${b.text})`)
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0x50: {
            const x = pop(stack);

            stack.push(
                i32(`i64.eqz(${x.text})`)
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0x51:
        case 0x52:
        case 0x53:
        case 0x54:
        case 0x55:
        case 0x56:
        case 0x57:
        case 0x58:
        case 0x59:
        case 0x5a: {
            const b = pop(stack);
            const a = pop(stack);

            stack.push(
                i32(`cmp(${a.text},${b.text})`)
            );

            break;
        }

        case 0x10: {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            if (r.value === TARGET_FUNC) {

                callNo++;

                /*
                 * Function 87 signature:
                 *
                 * (i32, i64, i64, i64, i64) -> ()
                 */
                const arg4 = pop(stack);
                const arg3 = pop(stack);
                const arg2 = pop(stack);
                const arg1 = pop(stack);
                const arg0 = pop(stack);

                /*
                 * Function 87 performs:
                 *
                 * i64.store offset=8
                 * i64.store offset=0
                 *
                 * using arg0 as destination.
                 */
                const write0 = `${arg0.text}`;
                const write1 = `(${arg0.text} + 8)`;

                writes.push({
                    callNo,
                    callOffset: opPos,
                    arg0: arg0.text,
                    write0,
                    write1
                });

                /*
                 * Function 87 returns void.
                 */
                void arg1;
                void arg2;
                void arg3;
                void arg4;
            }

            break;
        }

        default: {
            console.log();
            console.log(
                `STOP: unsupported opcode ${hex(op)} at ${hex(opPos)}`
            );
            console.log(
                `Calls decoded before stop: ${callNo}`
            );

            process.exit(0);
        }
    }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION 87 WRITE MAP FROM FUNCTION 122 v1");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log();

console.log(`Function 122 : ${hex(FUNC_START)} .. ${hex(FUNC_END)}`);
console.log(`Target call  : ${TARGET_FUNC}`);

        `${w.write1}`
    );
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET = 9368;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readName(pos) {
    const r = uleb(pos);
    const len = r.value;
    const start = r.next;
    return {
        name: bytes.subarray(start, start + len).toString("utf8"),
        next: start + len
    };
}

function readSection(pos) {
    const id = bytes[pos++];
    const s = uleb(pos);
    const size = s.value;
    const payload = s.next;

    return {
        id,
        size,
        payload,
        end: payload + size
    };
}

function findCodeSection() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const s = readSection(p);

        if (s.id === 10) {
            return s;
        }

        p = s.end;
    }

    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function decodeInstruction(p) {
    const start = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    const hex = (n) => "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");

    // local.get
    if (op === 0x20) {
        const r = uleb(p);
        return {
            next: r.next,
            text: `local.get ${r.value}`
        };
    }

    // local.set
    if (op === 0x21) {
        const r = uleb(p);
        return {
            next: r.next,
            text: `local.set ${r.value}`
        };
    }

    // local.tee
    if (op === 0x22) {
        const r = uleb(p);
        return {
            next: r.next,
            text: `local.tee ${r.value}`
        };
    }

    // i32.const
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const r = uleb(p);
        return {
            next: r.next,
            text: `i32.const ${r.value} (${hex(r.value)})`
        };
    }

    // i64.const
    if (op === 0x42) {
        let q = uleb(p);
        return {
            next: q.next,
            text: `i64.const ${q.value}`
        };
    }

    // i32.add
    if (op === 0x6a) {
        return { next: p, text: "i32.add" };
    }

    // i32.sub
    if (op === 0x6b) {
        return { next: p, text: "i32.sub" };
    }

    // i32.load
    if (op === 0x28) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        const o = uleb(a.next);

        return {
            next: o.next,
            text: `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
        };
    }

    // i32.load8_u
    if (op === 0x2d) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        const o = uleb(a.next);

        return {
            next: o.next,
            text: `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
        };
    }

    // i64.load
    if (op === 0x29) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        const o = uleb(a.next);

        return {
            next: o.next,
            text: `i64.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
        };
    }

    // i32.store
    if (op === 0x36) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        const o = uleb(a.next);

        return {
            next: o.next,
            text: `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
        };
    }

    // i64.store
    if (op === 0x37) {
        const a = uleb(p);
        const o = uleb(a.next);

        return {
            next: o.next,
            text: `i64.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
        };
    }

    // i32.eq
    if (op === 0x46) {
        return { next: p, text: "i32.eq" };
    }

    // i32.ne
    if (op === 0x47) {
        return { next: p, text: "i32.ne" };
    }

    // call
    if (op === 0x10) {
        const r = uleb(p);
        return {
            next: r.next,
            text: `call func=${r.value}`
        };
    }

    // call_indirect
    if (op === 0x11) {
        const t = uleb(p);
        const table = bytes[t.next];

        return {
            next: t.next + 1,
            text: `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table}`
        };
    }

    // select
    if (op === 0x1b) {
        return { next: p, text: "select" };
    }

    // end
    if (op === 0x0b) {
        return { next: p, text: "end" };
    }

    return {
        next: p,
        text: `UNKNOWN opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    };
}

const code = findCodeSection();

let p = code.payload;

const functionCount = uleb(p);
p = functionCount.next;

let targetBody = null;

for (let i = 0; i < functionCount.value; i++) {
    const sizeInfo = uleb(p);
    const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
    const bodyStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    if (i === TARGET) {
        targetBody = {
            bodyIndex: i,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            bodySize
        };
        break;
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

if (!targetBody) {
    throw new Error(`FUNCTION ${TARGET} NOT FOUND`);
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 96;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB too long");
    }
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function sleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  while (true) {
    b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("SLEB too long");
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections = [];

  while (p < bytes.length) {
    const id = bytes[p++];

    const len = uleb(p);
    p = len.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + len.value
    });

    p += len.value;
  }

  return sections;
}

function parseImports(section) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  let functions = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const mod = uleb(p);
    p = mod.next + mod.value;

    const name = uleb(p);
    p = name.next + name.value;

    const kind = bytes[p++];

    if (kind === 0) {
      const type = uleb(p);
      p = type.next;
      functions++;
    }

    else if (kind === 1) {
      p++;

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = uleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const max = uleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 2) {
      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = uleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const max = uleb(p);
        p = max.next;
      }
    }

    else if (kind === 3) {
      p += 2;
    }
  }

  return functions;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(section) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const ids = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(p);
    p = x.next;

    ids.push(x.value);
  }

  return ids;
}

function parseCode(section, functionTypes, importedCount) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const funcs = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = uleb(p);
    p = size.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + size.value;

    funcs.push({
      funcIndex: importedCount + i,
      typeIndex: functionTypes[i],
      start: bodyStart,
      end: bodyEnd
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return funcs;
}

function decode(func) {

  let p = func.start;

  const localCount = uleb(p);
  p = localCount.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {
    const n = uleb(p);
    p = n.next;
    p++;
  }

  console.log(`BODY : ${hex(func.start)} .. ${hex(func.end)}`);
  console.log(`TYPE : ${func.typeIndex}`);

  console.log(
    "------------------------------------------------------------"
  );

  while (p < func.end) {

    const at = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    let text = null;

    switch (op) {

      case 0x00:
        text = "unreachable";
        break;

      case 0x01:
        text = "nop";
        break;

      case 0x0b:
        text = "end";
        break;

      case 0x0f:
        text = "return";
        break;

      case 0x10: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `call ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x11: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        const y = uleb(p);
        p = y.next;

        text =
          `call_indirect type=${x.value} table=${y.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x1a:
        text = "drop";
        break;

      case 0x1b:
        text = "select";
        break;

      case 0x20: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x21: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x22: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x23: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `global.get ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x24: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `global.set ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x41: {
        const x = sleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text =
          `i32.const ${x.value} (${hex(x.value >>> 0)})`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x42: {

        let value = 0n;
        let shift = 0n;

        while (true) {

          const b = BigInt(bytes[p++]);

          value |=
            (b & 0x7fn) << shift;

          if ((b & 0x80n) === 0n) break;

          shift += 7n;
        }

        text = `i64.const ${value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x28:
      case 0x29:
      case 0x2c:
      case 0x2d:
      case 0x2e:
      case 0x2f:
      case 0x30:
      case 0x31:
      case 0x32:
      case 0x33:
      case 0x34:
      case 0x35: {

        const align = uleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = uleb(p);
        p = offset.next;

        const names = {
          0x28: "i32.load",
          0x29: "i64.load",
          0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
          0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
          0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
          0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
          0x30: "i64.load8_s",
          0x31: "i64.load8_u",
          0x32: "i64.load16_s",
          0x33: "i64.load16_u",
          0x34: "i64.load32_s",
          0x35: "i64.load32_u"
        };

        text =
          `${names[op]} align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x36:
      case 0x37:
      case 0x3a:
      case 0x3b:
      case 0x3c:
      case 0x3d:
      case 0x3e: {

        const align = uleb(p);
        p = align.next;

        const offset = uleb(p);
        p = offset.next;

        const names = {
          0x36: "i32.store",
          0x37: "i64.store",
          0x3a: "i32.store8",
          0x3b: "i32.store16",
          0x3c: "i64.store8",
          0x3d: "i64.store16",
          0x3e: "i64.store32"
        };

        text =
          `${names[op]} align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x45:
        text = "i32.eqz";
        break;

      case 0x46:
        text = "i32.eq";
        break;

      case 0x47:
        text = "i32.ne";
        break;

      case 0x48:
        text = "i32.lt_s";
        break;

      case 0x49:
        text = "i32.lt_u";
        break;

      case 0x4a:
        text = "i32.gt_s";
        break;

      case 0x4b:
        text = "i32.gt_u";
        break;

      case 0x4c:
        text = "i32.le_s";
        break;

      case 0x4d:
        text = "i32.le_u";
        break;

      case 0x4e:
        text = "i32.ge_s";
        break;

      case 0x4f:
        text = "i32.ge_u";
        break;

      case 0x6a:
        text = "i32.add";
        break;

      case 0x6b:
        text = "i32.sub";
        break;

      case 0x6c:
        text = "i32.mul";
        break;

      case 0x71:

      case 0x77:
        text = "i32.rotl";
        break;

      case 0x78:
        text = "i32.rotr";
        break;

      case 0x02:
      case 0x03:
      case 0x04: {

        const blockType = bytes[p++];

        const name =
          op === 0x02
            ? "block"
            : op === 0x03
              ? "loop"
              : "if";

        text =
          `${name} type=${hex(blockType)}`;

        break;
      }

      case 0x05:
        text = "else";
        break;

      case 0x0c: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `br ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0d: {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;

        text = `br_if ${x.value}`;
        break;
      }

      case 0x0e: {

        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;

        const labels = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {

          const x = uleb(p);
          p = x.next;

          labels.push(x.value);
        }

        const d = uleb(p);
        p = d.next;

        labels.push(`default=${d.value}`);

        text =
          `br_table ${labels.join(",")}`;

        break;
      }

      default:

        console.log(
          `${hex(at)}  UNKNOWN opcode ${hex(op)}`
        );

        console.log(
          "RAW REMAINING : " +
          Buffer.from(
            bytes.subarray(at, func.end)
          ).toString("hex")
        );

        return;
    }

    console.log(`${hex(at)}  ${text}`);
  }

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const START = 0x00008111;
const END   = 0x00008174;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[p++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);

      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }
  }
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function decode() {

  let p = START;

  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log("FUNCTION 96 LOCAL CONSUMER TRACE");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`WASM SIZE : ${bytes.length.toLocaleString()}`);
  console.log(`RANGE     : ${hex(START)} .. ${hex(END)}`);
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  while (p < END) {

    const at = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    let text = `0x${at.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  `;

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      text += `local.get ${x.value}`;

      if (x.value === 0 || x.value === 2)
        text += "   <== TRACKED";
    }

    else if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      text += `local.set ${x.value}`;

      if (x.value === 0 || x.value === 2)
        text += "   <== TRACKED";
    }

    else if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      text += `local.tee ${x.value}`;

      if (x.value === 0 || x.value === 2)
        text += "   <== TRACKED";
    }

    else if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = sleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      text += `i32.const ${x.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x6a) {
      text += "i32.add";
    }

    else if (op === 0x71) {
      text += "i32.and";
    }

    else if (op === 0x72) {
      text += "i32.or";
    }

    else if (op === 0x46) {
      text += "i32.eq";
    }

    else if (op === 0x47) {
      text += "i32.ne";
    }

    else if (op === 0x45) {
      text += "i32.eqz";
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      text += `call ${x.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x28) {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      text += `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x36) {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = uleb(p);
      p = o.next;

      text += `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x0d) {
      const x = uleb(p);
      p = x.next;

      text += `br_if ${x.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x04) {
      text += "if";
    }

    else if (op === 0x02) {
      text += "block";
    }

    else if (op === 0x0b) {
      text += "end";
    }

    else {
      text += `UNKNOWN opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }

    console.log(text);
  }

  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log("END");
  console.log("============================================================");

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 98;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(
                "ULEB too long at 0x" + pos.toString(16)
            );
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function readSLEB(pos, bits = 32) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let byte;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        byte = buf[p++];

        value += (byte & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < bits && (byte & 0x40)) {
                value -= Math.pow(2, shift);
            }

            return { value, next: p };
        }

        if (shift > bits + 7) {
            throw new Error(
                "SLEB too long at 0x" + pos.toString(16)
            );
        }
    }

    throw new Error("Unexpected EOF");
}

function hex(v) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function parseSections() {
    const sections = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const sizeR = readULEB(p);
        p = sizeR.next;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start: p,
            end: p + sizeR.value
        });

        p += sizeR.value;
    }

    return sections;
}

function parseFunctionSection(section) {

    const types = [];

    let p = section.start;

    const countR = readULEB(p);
    p = countR.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {
        const r = readULEB(p);

        types.push(r.value);

        p = r.next;
    }

    return types;
}

function parseCodeSection(section, functionTypes) {

    const bodies = [];

    let p = section.start;

    const countR = readULEB(p);
    p = countR.next;

    const IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS = 83;

    for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {

        const sizeR = readULEB(p);

        const bodySize = sizeR.value;

        p = sizeR.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

        const localsR = readULEB(p);

        p = localsR.next;

        for (let g = 0; g < localsR.value; g++) {

            const nR = readULEB(p);

            p = nR.next;

            p++;
        }

        bodies.push({
            func: IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + i,
            typeIndex: functionTypes[i],
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            codeStart: p,
            codeEnd: bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function memarg(p) {

    const align = buf[p++];

    const off = readULEB(p);

    return {
        align,
        offset: off.value,
        next: off.next
    };
}

function decode(body) {

    let p = body.codeStart;

    let depth = 0;

    while (p < body.codeEnd) {

        const offset = p;

        const op = buf[p++];

        let text;

        switch (op) {

            case 0x00:
                text = "unreachable";
                break;

            case 0x01:
                text = "nop";
                break;

            case 0x02: {
                const blockType = buf[p++];
                text = `block type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`;
                depth++;
                break;
            }

            case 0x03: {
                const blockType = buf[p++];
                text = `loop type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`;
                depth++;
                break;
            }

            case 0x04: {
                const blockType = buf[p++];
                text = `if type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`;
                depth++;
                break;
            }

            case 0x05:
                text = "else";
                break;

            case 0x0b:
                text = "end";

                if (depth > 0)
                    depth--;

                break;

            case 0x0c: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                text = `br ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0d: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                text = `br_if ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0e: {
                const countR = readULEB(p);
                p = countR.next;

                const labels = [];

                for (let i = 0; i < countR.value; i++) {
                    const r = readULEB(p);
                    p = r.next;
                    labels.push(r.value);
                }

                const def = readULEB(p);
                p = def.next;

                labels.push(`default=${def.value}`);

                text =
                    `br_table ${labels.join(", ")}`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x0f:
                text = "return";
                break;

            case 0x10: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                text = `call ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x11: {
                const a = readULEB(p);
                p = a.next;

                const b = readULEB(p);
                p = b.next;

                text =
                    `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x1a:
                text = "drop";
                break;

            case 0x1b:
                text = "select";
                break;

            case 0x20: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x21: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x22: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x23: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x24: {
                const r = readULEB(p);
                p = r.next;

                text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x28: {
                const m = memarg(p);
                p = m.next;

                text =
                    `i32.load align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x29: {
                const m = memarg(p);
                p = m.next;

                text =
                    `i64.load align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x2d: {
                const m = memarg(p);
                p = m.next;

                text =
                    `i32.load8_u align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x36: {
                const m = memarg(p);
                p = m.next;

                text =
                    `i32.store align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`;

                break;
            }

            case 0x3a: {
                const m = memarg(p);
                p = m.next;

                text =

                break;
            }

                const r = readSLEB(p, 32);
                p = r.next;

                text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x42: {

                break;

                break;

                break;

            case 0x47:
                text = "i32.ne";

            case 0x49:

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x965c7;
const END   = 0x96654;

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB32(pos: number) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    result |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: result | 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB64(pos: number) {
  let result = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = buf[p++];
    result |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7n;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 64n && (b & 0x40))
    result |= (-1n) << shift;

  return { value: result, next: p };
}

function memarg(pos: number) {
  const a = readULEB(pos);
  const o = readULEB(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next,
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x965cf;

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function sleb32(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let x = 0;

  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= ~0 << s;

  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function memarg(p: number) {
  const a = uleb(p);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_BODIES = [
    {
        name: "GLOBAL FUNC 457",
        start: 0x0001ddd6,
        end: 0x0001dea0
    },
    {
        name: "GLOBAL FUNC 459",
        start: 0x0001dee3,
        end: 0x0001e5f1
    }
];

function uleb(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function opName(op: number) {
    const m: Record<number, string> = {
        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",
        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",
        0x3a: "i32.store8",
        0x3b: "i32.store16",
        0x3e: "i64.store32",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",
        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",

        0x10: "call",
        0x11: "call_indirect",

        0x02: "block",
        0x03: "loop",
        0x04: "if",
        0x05: "else",
        0x0b: "end",
        0x0c: "br",
        0x0d: "br_if",
        0x0f: "return"
    };

    return m[op] ?? `opcode_${hex(op)}`;
}

console.log("TRACE GLOBAL 0 DERIVED STORE ADDRESSES");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const target of TARGET_BODIES) {

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(target.name);
    console.log(
        `BODY ${hex(target.start)} .. ${hex(target.end)}`
    );
    console.log("============================================================");

    let p = target.start;

    const localDecls = uleb(wasm, p);
    p = localDecls.next;

    console.log("LOCAL DECL COUNT =", localDecls.value);

    /*
     * Skip local declarations.
     */
    for (let i = 0; i < localDecls.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(wasm, p);
        p = n.next;

        p++; // valtype
    }

    /*
     * Track only simple symbolic values.
     *
     * local N may become:
     *
     *   GLOBAL0
     *   GLOBAL0 +/- CONST
     *   LOCAL M
     *   LOCAL M +/- CONST
     *   CONST
     *   UNKNOWN
     */

    const locals = new Map<number, string>();

    const stack: string[] = [];

    function pop() {
        return stack.length
            ? stack.pop()!
            : "UNKNOWN";
    }

    function push(v: string) {
        stack.push(v);
    }

    let global0Derived = 0;
    let stores = 0;

    while (p < target.end) {

        const at = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text = "";

        if (op === 0x20) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;

            const local = r.value;
            const value = locals.get(local) ?? `LOCAL${local}`;

            push(value);

            text =
                `local.get ${local} => ${value}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x21) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;

            const local = r.value;
            const value = pop();

            locals.set(local, value);

            text =
                `local.set ${local} <= ${value}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x22) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;

            const local = r.value;
            const value = stack.length
                ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                : "UNKNOWN";

            locals.set(local, value);

            text =
                `local.tee ${local} <= ${value}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x23) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;

            if (r.value === 0) {
                push("GLOBAL0");
                global0Derived++;
                text = "global.get 0 => GLOBAL0";
            }
            else {
                push(`GLOBAL${r.value}`);
                text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
            }
        }

        else if (op === 0x24) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;

            const value = pop();

            text =
                `global.set ${r.value} <= ${value}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x41) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;

            push(`CONST(${r.value})`);

            text =
                `i32.const ${r.value}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x28 || op === 0x29) {

            const a = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = a.next;

            const o = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = o.next;

            const address = pop();

            push(`LOAD(${address}+${hex(o.value)})`);

            text =
                `${opName(op)} ${address} + ${hex(o.value)}`;
        }

        else if (
            op === 0x36 ||
            op === 0x37 ||
            op === 0x3a ||
            op === 0x3b ||
            op === 0x3e
        ) {

            const a = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = a.next;

            const o = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = o.next;

            const value = pop();
            const address = pop();

            stores++;

            const related =
                address.includes("GLOBAL0") ||
                address.includes("LOCAL2") ||
                address.includes("GLOBAL0");

            console.log("");
            console.log(">>> STORE");
            console.log("    OFFSET =", hex(at));
            console.log("    OP     =", opName(op));
            console.log("    ADDR   =", address);
            console.log("    OFFSET =", hex(o.value));
            console.log("    VALUE  =", value);

            if (related) {
                console.log(
                    "    *** GLOBAL0-DERIVED ADDRESS ***"
                );
            }

            console.log("<<< STORE");

            text =
                `${opName(op)} addr=${address} value=${value}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x6a || op === 0x6b) {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            let result = "UNKNOWN";

            if (
                a === "GLOBAL0" &&
                b.startsWith("CONST(")
            ) {
                result =
                    `GLOBAL0 ${op === 0x6a ? "+" : "-"} ${b}`;
            }
            else if (
                a.startsWith("LOCAL") &&
                b.startsWith("CONST(")
            ) {
                result =
                    `${a} ${op === 0x6a ? "+" : "-"} ${b}`;
            }

            push(result);

            text =
                `${opName(op)} ${a}, ${b} => ${result}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x6c) {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push("UNKNOWN");

            text =
                `i32.mul ${a}, ${b}`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x71 || op === 0x72 || op === 0x73) {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            push("UNKNOWN");

            text =
                `${opName(op)} ${a}, ${b} => UNKNOWN`;
        }

        else if (op === 0x10) {

            const r = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = r.next;

            text = `call ${r.value}`;

            /*
             * Unknown call result.
             */
            push("CALL_RESULT");
        }

        else if (op === 0x11) {

            const t = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = t.next;

            const table = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = table.next;

            text =
                `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`;

            push("CALL_RESULT");
        }

        else {

            text = opName(op);
        }

        /*
         * Only print significant dataflow operations.
         */
        if (
            op === 0x23 ||
            op === 0x24 ||
            op === 0x20 ||
            op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22 ||
            op === 0x28 ||
            op === 0x36 ||
            op === 0x37 ||
            op === 0x3a ||
            op === 0x3b ||
            op === 0x3e ||
            op === 0x41 ||
            op === 0x6a ||
            op === 0x6b
        ) {
            console.log(
                `${hex(at)}  ${text}`
            );
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("SUMMARY");
    console.log("  GLOBAL0 DERIVED OPS =", global0Derived);
    console.log("  STORES              =", stores);
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        result |= (~0 << shift);
    }

    return { value: result | 0, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

let global0SetTotal = 0;

const interesting: {
    func: number;
    bodyStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;
    sets: number[];
    stores: number[];
}[] = [];

for (let func = 0; func < functionCount; func++) {
    const bs = readULEB(wasm, q);
    const bodySize = bs.value;
    q = bs.next;

    const bodyStart = q;
    const bodyEnd = q + bodySize;

    let x = bodyStart;

    // locals vector
    const lc = readULEB(wasm, x);
    const localDeclCount = lc.value;
    x = lc.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
        const n = readULEB(wasm, x);
        x = n.next;

        // valtype
        x++;
    }

    const instrStart = x;

    const sets: number[] = [];
    const stores: number[] = [];

    /*
      We intentionally do a conservative byte scan.

      global.set 0 = 0x24 0x00

      Memory stores:
        i32.store       0x36
        i64.store       0x37
        f32.store       0x38
        f64.store       0x39
        i32.store8      0x3a
        i32.store16     0x3b
        i64.store8      0x3c
        i64.store16     0x3d
        i64.store32     0x3e
    */

    for (let i = instrStart; i + 1 < bodyEnd; i++) {
        if (wasm[i] === 0x24 && wasm[i + 1] === 0x00) {
            sets.push(i);
            global0SetTotal++;
        }

        if (
            wasm[i] >= 0x36 &&
            wasm[i] <= 0x3e
        ) {
            stores.push(i);
        }
    }

    if (sets.length > 0) {
        functionsWithGlobal0Set++;

        if (stores.length > 0) {
            functionsWithSetAndStore++;

            interesting.push({
                func,
                bodyStart,
                bodyEnd,
                sets,
                stores
            });
        }
    }

    q = bodyEnd;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_GLOBAL_FUNCS = new Set([374, 376]);

function uleb(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(n: number) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readString(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    const r = uleb(buf, p);
    const end = r.next + r.value;
    return {
        next: end,
        length: r.value
    };
}

function skipLimits(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    const flags = buf[p++];

    const min = uleb(buf, p);
    p = min.next;

    if (flags & 0x01) {
        const max = uleb(buf, p);
        p = max.next;
    }

    return p;
}

/*
 * Find number of imported functions.
 *
 * Function indices include imported functions before
 * locally-defined functions.
 */
function countImportedFunctions() {

    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {

        const sectionId = wasm[p++];

        const s = uleb(wasm, p);
        const size = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const sectionStart = p;
        const sectionEnd = p + size;

        if (sectionId === 2) {

            let x = sectionStart;

            const c = uleb(wasm, x);
            const importCount = c.value;
            x = c.next;

            let importedFunctions = 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {

                const mod = readString(wasm, x);
                x = mod.next;

                const name = readString(wasm, x);
                x = name.next;

                const kind = wasm[x++];

                /*
                 * external kind:
                 * 0 = function
                 * 1 = table
                 * 2 = memory
                 * 3 = global
                 * 4 = tag
                 */
                if (kind === 0) {
                    importedFunctions++;

                    const typeIndex = uleb(wasm, x);
                    x = typeIndex.next;
                }
                else if (kind === 1) {
                    /*
                     * table type
                     */
                    x++; // elem type

                    x = skipLimits(wasm, x);
                }
                else if (kind === 2) {
                    /*
                     * memory type
                     */
                    x = skipLimits(wasm, x);
                }
                else if (kind === 3) {
                    /*
                     * global type
                     */
                    x++; // value type
                    x++; // mutability
                }
                else if (kind === 4) {
                    /*
                     * tag type
                     */
                    x++; // attribute
                    const typeIndex = uleb(wasm, x);
                    x = typeIndex.next;
                }
            }

            return importedFunctions;
        }

        p = sectionEnd;
    }

    return 0;
}

const importedFunctions = countImportedFunctions();

        else {
            const names: Record<number, string> = {
                0x45: "i32.eqz",

                0x05: "else",
                0x02: "block",

            text = names[op] ?? `opcode ${hex(op)}`;

        const line =

  0x22: "local.tee",

  0x24: "global.set",

  0x29: "i64.load",

  0x36: "i32.store",
  0x37: "i64.store",

  0x41: "i32.const",
  0x42: "i64.const",

  0x45: "i32.eqz",
  0x46: "i32.eq",
  0x47: "i32.ne",

  0x85: "i64.xor",
  0x86: "i64.shl",
  0x87: "i64.shr_s",
  0x88: "i64.shr_u"
};

function signedLEB(p: number) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (true) {
    byte = b[p++];

    result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if (!(byte & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40))
    result |= -(1 << shift);

  return { value: result, p };
}

function readMemArg(p: number) {
  const a = uleb(p);
  p = a.p;

  const o = uleb(p);
  p = o.p;

  return {
    align: a.v,
    offset: o.v,
    p
  };
}

function localName(i: number) {
  if (i < 4)
    return `PARAM${i}`;

  return `LOCAL${i}`;
}

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const START = 0x95000;
const END   = 0x95e67;

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { v: v >>> 0, p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (-1 << s);
  return { v: v | 0, p };
}

let stack: string[] = [];
let lastLocal6 = false;
let lastConst: number | null = null;

while (p < END) {

  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    if (r.v === 6) {
      lastLocal6 = true;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} local.get 6`);
    } else {
      lastLocal6 = false;
    }

    continue;
  }

  // local.set / tee
  if (op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;
    lastLocal6 = false;
    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = sleb(p);
    p = r.p;
    lastConst = r.v;

    if (
      r.v === 68 ||
      r.v === -300 ||
      r.v === 300 ||
      r.v === 368
    ) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} i32.const ${r.v}`);
    }

    continue;
  }

  // i32.add / sub
  if (op === 0x6a || op === 0x6b) {

    if (lastLocal6 && lastConst !== null) {

      const off =
        op === 0x6a
          ? lastConst
          : -lastConst;

      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} ` +
        `${op === 0x6a ? "i32.add" : "i32.sub"} ` +
        `local6 ${off >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${off}`
      );

      if (off === 68) {
        console.log(
          `*** DIRECT TARGET ADDRESS: local6 + 68 = G-300 ***`
        );
      }
    }

    lastLocal6 = false;
    lastConst = null;
    continue;
  }

  // i32/i64 stores
  if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    p = a.p;

    const o = uleb(p);
    p = o.p;

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} STORE op=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
      `align=${a.v} offset=${o.v}`
    );

    if (o.v === 68) {
      console.log(
        `*** OFFSET 68 STORE CANDIDATE @ ${hex(at)} ***`
      );
    }

    lastLocal6 = false;
    lastConst = null;
    continue;
  }

  // loads
  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    p = a.p;

    const o = uleb(p);
    p = o.p;

    if (o.v === 68) {
      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} LOAD offset=68`
      );
    }

    lastLocal6 = false;
    lastConst = null;
    continue;
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} CALL ${r.v}`
    );

    lastLocal6 = false;
    lastConst = null;
    continue;
  }

  // global.get
  if (op === 0x23) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} global.get ${r.v}`
    );

    lastLocal6 = false;
    continue;
  }

  // global.set
  if (op === 0x24) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} global.set ${r.v}`
    );

    lastLocal6 = false;
    continue;
  }

  // memory.copy/fill
  if (op === 0xfc) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} PREFIX 0xfc subop=${r.v}`
    );

    // memory.copy
    if (r.v === 10) {
      const a = uleb(p);
      p = a.p;

      const c = uleb(p);
      p = c.p;
    }

    lastLocal6 = false;
    lastConst = null;
    continue;
  }

  // common no-immediate instructions
  if (
    op === 0x0b ||
    op === 0x05 ||
    op === 0x1a ||
    op === 0x6a ||
    op === 0x6b ||
    (op >= 0x45 && op <= 0x66) ||
    (op >= 0x67 && op <= 0x91) ||
    (op >= 0xa7 && op <= 0xbf)
  ) {
    continue;
  }

  lastLocal6 = false;
  lastConst = null;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET = 10;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB too long");
    }
  }

  return {
    value: value >>> 0,
    next: pos
  };
}

function readString(pos) {
  const n = uleb(pos);
  const start = n.next;
  const end = start + n.value;

  return {
    text: Buffer.from(
      bytes.subarray(start, end)
    ).toString("utf8"),
    next: end
  };
}

function readSections() {
  let p = 8;
  const sections = [];

  while (p < bytes.length) {
    const id = bytes[p++];

    const len = uleb(p);
    p = len.next;

    sections.push({
      id,
      start: p,
      end: p + len.value
    });

    p += len.value;
  }

  return sections;
}

function parseImports(section) {
  let p = section.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const imports = [];

  let functionIndex = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const module = readString(p);
    p = module.next;

    const name = readString(p);
    p = name.next;

    const kind = bytes[p++];

    const item = {
      importOrdinal: i,
      functionIndex: null,
      module: module.text,
      name: name.text,
      kind
    };

    if (kind === 0) {

      const type = uleb(p);
      p = type.next;

      item.functionIndex = functionIndex;
      item.typeIndex = type.value;

      functionIndex++;
    }

    else if (kind === 1) {

      const elementType = bytes[p++];

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = uleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      let max = null;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        max = x.value;
      }

      item.elementType = elementType;
      item.min = min.value;
      item.max = max;
    }

    else if (kind === 2) {

      const flags = bytes[p++];

      const min = uleb(p);
      p = min.next;

      let max = null;

      if (flags & 1) {
        const x = uleb(p);
        p = x.next;
        max = x.value;
      }

      item.min = min.value;
      item.max = max;
    }

    else if (kind === 3) {

      item.valueType = bytes[p++];
      item.mutable = bytes[p++];
    }

    imports.push(item);
  }

  return imports;
}

FILE: scripts\traceImport23Branches.ts

if (op === 0xfc) {
    const sub = readU32(buf, state);

    // 0..7: saturating conversions, no immediates
    if (sub <= 7) {
        // No additional bytes to consume.
    } else if (sub === 8) {
        // memory.init: data index + memory index
        readU32(buf, state);
        readU32(buf, state);
    } else if (sub === 9) {
        // data.drop: data index
        readU32(buf, state);
    } else if (sub === 10) {
        // memory.copy: destination + source memory indices
        readU32(buf, state);
        readU32(buf, state);
    } else if (sub === 11) {
        // memory.fill: memory index
        readU32(buf, state);
    } else if (sub === 12) {
        // table.init: element index + table index
        readU32(buf, state);
        readU32(buf, state);
    } else if (sub === 13) {
        // elem.drop: element index
        readU32(buf, state);
    } else if (sub === 14) {
        // table.copy: destination + source table indices
        readU32(buf, state);
        readU32(buf, state);
    } else if (sub === 15 || sub === 16 || sub === 17) {
        // table.grow, table.size, table.fill
        readU32(buf, state);
    } else {
        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported 0xfc subopcode ${sub} at ${hex(state.p - 1)}`
        );
    }
}

function u32leb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function sectionHeader(pos: number) {
    const id = buf[pos];
    const size = u32leb(pos + 1);

    return {
        id,
        size: size.value,
        payloadStart: size.next,
        payloadEnd: size.next + size.value,
    };
}

function readFunctionBodies() {
    let p = 8;

    let functionStart = -1;
    let codeStart = -1;
    let codeEnd = -1;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const s = sectionHeader(p);

        if (s.id === 3) {
            functionStart = s.payloadStart;
        }

        if (s.id === 10) {
            codeStart = s.payloadStart;
            codeEnd = s.payloadEnd;
        }

        p = s.payloadEnd;
    }

    if (functionStart < 0 || codeStart < 0) {
        throw new Error("FUNCTION/CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
    }

    let fp = functionStart;

    const fc = u32leb(fp);
    fp = fc.next;

    const definedCount = fc.value;

    const typeIndices: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++) {
        const r = u32leb(fp);
        fp = r.next;
        typeIndices.push(r.value);
    }

    let cp = codeStart;

    const bc = u32leb(cp);
    cp = bc.next;

    const bodies: {
        globalFunc: number;
        ordinal: number;
        typeIndex: number;
        start: number;
        end: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < bc.value; ordinal++) {
        const sizeInfo = u32leb(cp);

        const start = sizeInfo.next;
        const end = start + sizeInfo.value;

        bodies.push({
            globalFunc: IMPORTED_FUNCTIONS + ordinal,
            ordinal,
            typeIndex: typeIndices[ordinal],
            start,
            end,
        });

        cp = end;
    }

    return {
        functionStart,
        codeStart,
        codeEnd,
        bodies,
    };
}

        case 0xf1:

        case 0xf5:
        case 0xf6:
        case 0xf7:
        case 0xf8:
        case 0xf9:
        case 0xfa:
        case 0xfb:
            return 1;

        case 0xfc: {
            const r = u32leb(p);
            return r.next - pos;
        }

        case 0xfd: {
            const r = u32leb(p);
            return r.next - pos;
        }

        case 0xfe: {
            const r = u32leb(p);
            return r.next - pos;
        }

        default:
            return 1;
    }
}

function signedLebLength(pos: number): number {
    let p = pos;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    return p - pos;
}

                    } else if (opcode === 0xfc) {

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readU32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = bytes[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(pos: number, count: number): string {
    return Array.from(bytes.subarray(pos, pos + count))
        .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
        .join(" ");
}

function findSection(id: number) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const sectionId = bytes[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readU32Leb(p);
        const payloadSize = sizeInfo.value;
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const payloadStart = p;

        if (sectionId === id) {
            return {
                start: payloadStart,
                size: payloadSize,
            };
        }

        p += payloadSize;
    }

    throw new Error(`section ${id} not found`);
}

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < bodyCount; bodyIndex++) {
    const bodySizeInfo = readU32Leb(p);
    const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
    const bodyStart = bodySizeInfo.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    let q = bodyStart;

    const localDecls = readU32Leb(q);
    q = localDecls.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localDecls.value; i++) {
        const count = readU32Leb(q);
        q = count.next;

        // Skip valtype byte.
        q++;
    }

    const instructionStart = q;

    for (let i = instructionStart; i < bodyEnd; i++) {
        // call opcode
        if (bytes[i] !== 0x10) continue;

        const target = readU32Leb(i + 1);

        if (target.value !== 60) continue;

        found++;

        // Function index = imported functions + body index.
        const callerFunc = 83 + bodyIndex;

        console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

        console.log(`callerFunc  = ${callerFunc}`);
        console.log(`bodyIndex   = ${bodyIndex}`);
        console.log(`callOffset  = 0x${i.toString(16)}`);

        if (callerFunc === 1020) {
            console.log("*** THIS IS FUNCTION 1020 ***");
        }

        console.log();

        );
        console.log(hex(start, end - start));
        console.log();
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}
