import { readFileSync } from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNC = 4815;
const TARGET_TABLE_INDEX = 7969;

type Instr = {
    offset: number;
    op: number;
    name: string;
    args?: any;
};

function readULEB(buf: Buffer, p: number) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        result += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: result,
        next: p,
    };
}

function readSLEB(buf: Buffer, p: number, bits = 32) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = buf[p++];

        result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
    }

    if (shift < bits && (byte & 0x40)) {
        result |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: result | 0,
        next: p,
    };
}

function nameOf(op: number) {
    const names: Record<number, string> = {
        0x0b: "end",

        0x10: "call",
        0x11: "call_indirect",

        0x20: "local.get",
        0x21: "local.set",
        0x22: "local.tee",

        0x23: "global.get",
        0x24: "global.set",

        0x28: "i32.load",
        0x29: "i64.load",
        0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
        0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
        0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
        0x2f: "i32.load16_u",

        0x36: "i32.store",
        0x37: "i64.store",
        0x3a: "i32.store8",
        0x3b: "i32.store16",

        0x41: "i32.const",
        0x42: "i64.const",

        0x6a: "i32.add",
        0x6b: "i32.sub",
        0x6c: "i32.mul",

        0x71: "i32.and",
        0x72: "i32.or",
        0x73: "i32.xor",

        0x74: "i32.shl",
        0x75: "i32.shr_s",
        0x76: "i32.shr_u",

        0x45: "i32.eqz",
        0x46: "i32.eq",
        0x47: "i32.ne",
        0x48: "i32.lt_s",
        0x49: "i32.lt_u",
        0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
        0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
        0x4c: "i32.le_s",
        0x4d: "i32.le_u",
        0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
        0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
    };

    return names[op] ??
        `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function decodeBody(
    buf: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number
): Instr[] {
    const out: Instr[] = [];

    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const offset = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        let args: any = undefined;

        if (
            op === 0x20 ||
            op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22
        ) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, p);

            args = {
                local: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (
            op === 0x23 ||
            op === 0x24
        ) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, p);

            args = {
                global: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (
            op === 0x28 ||
            op === 0x29 ||
            op === 0x2c ||
            op === 0x2d ||
            op === 0x2e ||
            op === 0x2f ||
            op === 0x36 ||
            op === 0x37 ||
            op === 0x3a ||
            op === 0x3b
        ) {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const b = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            args = {
                align: a.value,
                offset: b.value,
            };

            p = b.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = readSLEB(buf, p, 32);

            args = {
                value: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x42) {
            const r = readSLEB(buf, p, 64);

            args = {
                value: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = readULEB(buf, p);

            args = {
                func: r.value,
            };

            p = r.next;
        }

        else if (op === 0x11) {
            const a = readULEB(buf, p);
            const b = readULEB(buf, a.next);

            args = {
                type: a.value,
                table: b.value,
            };

            p = b.next;
        }

        out.push({
            offset,
            op,
            name: nameOf(op),
            args,
        });

        if (op === 0x0b) break;
    }

    return out;
}

function readCodeSection(buf: Buffer) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const s = readULEB(buf, p);
        const size = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        const payload = p;

        if (id === 10) {
            const end = payload + size;

            let q = payload;

            const countInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
            const count = countInfo.value;
            q = countInfo.next;

            const bodies: any[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const sizeInfo = readULEB(buf, q);
                const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
                q = sizeInfo.next;

                const bodyStart = q;
                const bodyEnd = q + bodySize;

                let x = bodyStart;

                const localInfo = readULEB(buf, x);
                const localDeclCount = localInfo.value;
                x = localInfo.next;

                for (
                    let j = 0;
                    j < localDeclCount;
                    j++
                ) {
                    const n = readULEB(buf, x);
                    x = n.next;

                    x++;
                }

                bodies.push({
                    func: 83 + i,
                    instrStart: x,
                    instrEnd: bodyEnd,
                });

                q = bodyEnd;
            }

            if (q !== end) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Code parse mismatch: 0x${q.toString(16)} != 0x${end.toString(16)}`
                );
            }

            return bodies;
        }

        p = payload + size;
    }

    throw new Error("Code section not found.");
}

export async function run() {
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" TRACE INDIRECT DISPATCH TO FUNCTION 4815");
    console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("");

    const wasm = readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

    console.log(`WASM size        : ${wasm.length}`);
    console.log(`Target function  : ${TARGET_FUNC}`);
    console.log(`Target table idx : ${TARGET_TABLE_INDEX}`);
    console.log("");

    const bodies = readCodeSection(wasm);

    console.log(
        `Functions decoded : ${bodies.length}`
    );

    console.log("");

    let indirectCount = 0;
    let type0Table0 = 0;
    let exactConst = 0;
    let memoryLoad = 0;
    let localDerived = 0;
    let unknown = 0;

    for (const body of bodies) {
        const instr = decodeBody(
            wasm,
            body.instrStart,
            body.instrEnd
        );

        for (let i = 0; i < instr.length; i++) {
            const x = instr[i];

            if (x.name !== "call_indirect") {
                continue;
            }

            indirectCount++;

            /*
             * Previous investigation established that
             * the relevant dispatch family uses:
             *
             * type = 0
             * table = 0
             */
            if (
                x.args?.type !== 0 ||
                x.args?.table !== 0
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            type0Table0++;

            const from = Math.max(0, i - 10);
            const before = instr.slice(from, i);

            let classification = "unknown";

            /*
             * Search backward through a short stack-producing window.
             */

            for (let j = before.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                const b = before[j];

                if (
                    b.name === "i32.const"
                ) {
                    if (
                        b.args?.value ===
                        TARGET_TABLE_INDEX
                    ) {
                        classification =
                            "EXACT_CONST_7969";
                    } else {
                        classification =
                            "OTHER_CONST";
                    }

                    break;
                }

                if (
                    b.name === "i32.load" ||
                    b.name === "i32.load8_s" ||
                    b.name === "i32.load8_u" ||
                    b.name === "i32.load16_s" ||
                    b.name === "i32.load16_u"
                ) {
                    classification =
                        "MEMORY_LOAD";
                    break;
                }

                if (
                    b.name === "local.get"
                ) {
                    classification =
                        "LOCAL_DERIVED";
                    break;
                }

                if (
                    b.name === "global.get"
                ) {
                    classification =
                        "GLOBAL_DERIVED";
                    break;
                }

                if (
                    b.name === "call"
                ) {
                    classification =
                        "CALL_DERIVED";
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (classification === "EXACT_CONST_7969") {
                exactConst++;

                console.log("============================================================");
                console.log("EXACT TABLE INDEX MATCH");
                console.log("============================================================");

                console.log(
                    `Function : ${body.func}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `Offset   : 0x${x.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `Index    : ${TARGET_TABLE_INDEX}`
                );

                console.log("");

                for (
                    const b of before
                ) {
                    console.log(
                        `  0x${b.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ${b.name}` +
                        (
                            b.args
                                ? " " +
                                  JSON.stringify(b.args)
                                : ""
                        )
                    );
                }

                console.log(
                    `  >>> 0x${x.offset.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} call_indirect type=0 table=0`
                );

                console.log("");
            }

            else if (
                classification === "MEMORY_LOAD"
            ) {
                memoryLoad++;
            }

            else if (
                classification === "LOCAL_DERIVED"
            ) {
                localDerived++;
            }

            else {
                unknown++;
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(" SUMMARY");
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(
        `All call_indirect        : ${indirectCount}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Type0 / table0           : ${type0Table0}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Exact CONST(7969)        : ${exactConst}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Memory-derived           : ${memoryLoad}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Local-derived            : ${localDerived}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Unknown                  : ${unknown}`
    );

    console.log("");

    if (exactConst > 0) {
        console.log(
            "DIRECT STATIC DISPATCH TO TABLE INDEX 7969 FOUND."
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            "No direct CONST(7969) producer found."
        );

        console.log(
            "The dispatch index is likely memory/object-derived."
        );
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log(
        "Target mapping:"
    );
    console.log(
        `  table[${TARGET_TABLE_INDEX}] = Function ${TARGET_FUNC}`
    );
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;
const IMPORTED   = 83;

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const x = b[pos + i];
    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
      return { value, end: pos + i + 1 };

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function bodies() {
  let p = CODE_START;
  const c = readULEB(p)!;
  p = c.end;

  const out: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < c.value; i++) {
    const s = readULEB(p)!;
    p = s.end;

    out.push({
      ordinal: i,
      global: i + IMPORTED,
      start: p,
      end: p + s.value
    });

    p += s.value;
  }

  if (p !== CODE_END)
    throw new Error("CODE END mismatch");

  return out;
}

function ins(p: number) {
  const op = b[p];

  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
    const x = readULEB(p + 1);
    if (!x) return null;

    return {
      end: x.end,
      op,
      kind:
        op === 0x20 ? "get" :
        op === 0x21 ? "set" : "tee",
      local: x.value,
      text:
        `${op === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
          op === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
          "local.tee"} ${x.value}`
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = readULEB(p + 1);
    if (!x) return null;

    return {
      end: x.end,
      op,
      kind: "const",
      value: x.value,
      text: `i32.const ${x.value}`
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x6a)
    return { end: p + 1, op, kind: "add", text: "i32.add" };

  if (op === 0x6b)
    return { end: p + 1, op, kind: "sub", text: "i32.sub" };

  if (op === 0x28) {
    const a = readULEB(p + 1);
    if (!a) return null;

    const o = readULEB(a.end);
    if (!o) return null;

    return {
      end: o.end,
      op,
      kind: "load",
      offset: o.value,
      text: `i32.load offset=${o.value}`
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x2d) {
    const a = readULEB(p + 1);
    if (!a) return null;

    const o = readULEB(a.end);
    if (!o) return null;

    return {
      end: o.end,
      op,
      kind: "load8",
      offset: o.value,
      text: `i32.load8_u offset=${o.value}`
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = readULEB(p + 1);
    if (!x) return null;

    return {
      end: x.end,
      op,
      kind: "call",
      target: x.value,
      text: `call ${x.value}`
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = readULEB(p + 1);
    if (!t) return null;

    const tab = readULEB(t.end);
    if (!tab) return null;

    return {
      end: tab.end,
      op,
      kind: "indirect",
      type: t.value,
      text:
        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${tab.value}`
    };
  }

  return {
    end: p + 1,
    op,
    kind: "other",
    text: `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`
  };
}

function decodeBody(body: any) {
  const out: any[] = [];
  let p = body.start;

  while (p < body.end) {
    const d = ins(p);
    if (!d || d.end <= p || d.end > body.end)
      break;

    out.push({
      pos: p,
      ...d
    });

    p = d.end;
  }

  return out;
}

/*
  Lightweight stack simulation.

  We only care about the stack immediately before
  call_indirect.

  Each stack item is represented symbolically.
*/

function trace(body: any, instructions: any[]) {

  const stack: string[] = [];

  for (const d of instructions) {

    switch (d.kind) {

      case "get":
        stack.push(`local[${d.local}]`);
        break;

      case "const":
        stack.push(`const(${d.value})`);
        break;

      case "load": {

        const base =
          stack.length
            ? stack.pop()!
            : "UNKNOWN";

        stack.push(
          `load(${base}+${d.offset})`
        );

        break;
      }

      case "load8": {

        const base =
          stack.length
            ? stack.pop()!
            : "UNKNOWN";

        stack.push(
          `load8(${base}+${d.offset})`
        );

        break;
      }

      case "add": {

        const b2 =
          stack.length ? stack.pop()! : "UNKNOWN";

        const a =
          stack.length ? stack.pop()! : "UNKNOWN";

        stack.push(
          `(${a}+${b2})`
        );

        break;
      }

      case "sub": {

        const b2 =
          stack.length ? stack.pop()! : "UNKNOWN";

        const a =
          stack.length ? stack.pop()! : "UNKNOWN";

        stack.push(
          `(${a}-${b2})`
        );

        break;
      }

      case "tee": {

        const a =
          stack.length ? stack[stack.length - 1] : "UNKNOWN";

        stack.push(a);

        break;
      }

      case "set":
        if (stack.length)
          stack.pop();

        break;

      case "call": {

        /*
          Unknown number of arguments.
          Preserve a symbolic result so the stack
          does not collapse completely.
        */

        stack.push(
          `result(call ${d.target})`
        );

        break;
      }

      case "indirect": {

        if (d.type !== 4)
          break;

        /*
          The index is the LAST stack item.
        */

        const index =
          stack.length
            ? stack[stack.length - 1]
            : "UNKNOWN";

        console.log("");
        console.log(
          `FUNCTION ${body.global} BODY ${body.ordinal}`
        );
        console.log(
          `CALL_INDIRECT @ ${hex(d.pos)}`
        );
        console.log(
          `INDEX = ${index}`
        );

        if (
          index.includes("load(local[") &&
          index.includes("+4)")
        ) {
          console.log(
            ">>> FIELD +4 DISPATCH CANDIDATE <<<"
          );
        }

        stack.pop();

        /*
          call_indirect consumes its arguments too,
          but we deliberately don't guess their count.
        */

        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

const all = bodies();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("BACKWARD SYMBOLIC INDIRECT INDEX TRACE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

let count = 0;

for (const body of all) {

  const instructions = decodeBody(body);

  for (const d of instructions) {

    if (
      d.kind === "indirect" &&
      d.type === 4
    ) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  trace(body, instructions);
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`CALL_INDIRECT TYPE 4 = ${count}`);
console.log("============================================================");

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const CODE_START = 0x00006e7d;
const CODE_END   = 0x00324ef5;
const IMPORTED   = 83;

const TARGETS = new Set([8637, 8927, 8952]);

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    if (pos + i >= b.length)
      return null;

    const x = b[pos + i];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value,
        end: pos + i + 1
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function getBodies() {

  let p = CODE_START;

  const count = readULEB(p);
  if (!count)
    throw new Error("Bad code count");

  p = count.end;

  const bodies: any[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

    const size = readULEB(p);
    if (!size)
      throw new Error(`Bad body size @ ${hex(p)}`);

    p = size.end;

    bodies.push({
      ordinal: i,
      global: i + IMPORTED,
      start: p,
      end: p + size.value
    });

    p += size.value;
  }

  if (p !== CODE_END)
    throw new Error(
      `CODE END MISMATCH ${hex(p)} != ${hex(CODE_END)}`
    );

  return bodies;
}

function decode(pos: number) {

  const op = b[pos];

  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!x) return null;

    return {
      end: x.end,
      text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
      kind: "get",
      local: x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!x) return null;

    return {
      end: x.end,
      text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
      kind: "set",
      local: x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!x) return null;

    return {
      end: x.end,
      text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
      kind: "tee",
      local: x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!x) return null;

    return {
      end: x.end,
      text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
      kind: "const",
      value: x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x6a) {
    return {
      end: pos + 1,
      text: "i32.add",
      kind: "add"
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x6b) {
    return {
      end: pos + 1,
      text: "i32.sub",
      kind: "sub"
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x28) {

    const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!a) return null;

    const o = readULEB(a.end);
    if (!o) return null;

    return {
      end: o.end,
      text: `i32.load offset=${o.value}`,
      kind: "load",
      offset: o.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x2d) {

    const a = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!a) return null;

    const o = readULEB(a.end);
    if (!o) return null;

    return {
      end: o.end,
      text: `i32.load8_u offset=${o.value}`,
      kind: "load8",
      offset: o.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {

    const t = readULEB(pos + 1);
    if (!t) return null;

    const table = readULEB(t.end);
    if (!table) return null;

    return {
      end: table.end,
      text:
        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`,
      kind: "indirect",
      type: t.value
    };
  }

  return {
    end: pos + 1,
    text: `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`,
    kind: "other"
  };
}

function localUses(
  body: any,
  center: number,
  local: number
) {
  const hits: string[] = [];

  const from = Math.max(body.start, center - 256);
  const to = Math.min(body.end, center + 32);

  for (let p = from; p < to; p++) {

    if (
      b[p] !== 0x20 &&
      b[p] !== 0x21 &&
      b[p] !== 0x22
    )
      continue;

    const x = readULEB(p + 1);

    if (!x)
      continue;

    if (x.value !== local)
      continue;

    const op =
      b[p] === 0x20 ? "get" :
      b[p] === 0x21 ? "set" :
      "tee";

    hits.push(
      `${hex(p)} local.${op} ${local}`
    );
  }

  return hits;
}

const bodies = getBodies();

console.log("");

console.log("Targets: 8637 / 8927 / 8952");

let exact = 0;
let target = 0;

for (const body of bodies) {

  for (let p = body.start; p < body.end; p++) {

    if (b[p] !== 0x28)
      continue;

    const a = readULEB(p + 1);
    if (!a) continue;

    const o = readULEB(a.end);
    if (!o) continue;

    if (o.value !== 4)
      continue;

    const q = o.end;

    if (
      b[q] !== 0x11 ||
      b[q + 1] !== 0x04 ||
      b[q + 2] !== 0x00
    )
      continue;

    exact++;

    if (!TARGETS.has(body.global))
      continue;

    target++;

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`FUNCTION       ${body.global}`);
    console.log(`BODY           ${body.ordinal}`);
    console.log(`LOAD(+4)       ${hex(p)}`);
    console.log(`CALL_INDIRECT  ${hex(q)}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    /*
       Decode preceding instructions.
    */

    const ins: any[] = [];

    let x = Math.max(body.start, p - 96);

    while (x < p) {

      const d = decode(x);

      if (!d || d.end <= x || d.end > p)
        break;

      ins.push({
        pos: x,
        ...d
      });

      x = d.end;
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("PRECEDING INSTRUCTIONS");
    console.log("----------------------");

    for (const d of ins.slice(-24)) {
      console.log(
        `${hex(d.pos)}  ${d.text}`
      );
    }

    /*
       Find the immediate base of load(+4).
    */

    const last = ins[ins.length - 1];

    console.log("");
    console.log("LOAD(+4) BASE ANALYSIS");
    console.log("----------------------");

    if (last?.kind === "get") {

      console.log(
        `BASE = local ${last.local}`
      );

      const uses = localUses(
        body,
        p,
        last.local
      );

      console.log(
        `LOCAL ${last.local} USES = ${uses.length}`
      );

      for (const u of uses.slice(-20))
        console.log(`  ${u}`);

    } else {

      console.log(
        `BASE is expression ending with: ${last?.text ?? "UNKNOWN"}`
      );

      if (last) {

        const tail = ins.slice(-8);

        console.log("");
        console.log("BASE EXPRESSION TAIL");

        for (const d of tail) {
          console.log(
            `  ${hex(d.pos)} ${d.text}`
          );
        }
      }
    }

    /*
       Search nearby stores to offset +4.
    */

    console.log("");
    console.log("NEARBY STORE(+4) CANDIDATES");
    console.log("---------------------------");

    let stores = 0;

    const fromStore =
      Math.max(body.start, p - 512);

    for (
      let s = fromStore;
      s < Math.min(body.end, p + 16);
      s++
    ) {

      if (b[s] !== 0x36)
        continue;

      const a2 = readULEB(s + 1);
      if (!a2) continue;

      const o2 = readULEB(a2.end);
      if (!o2) continue;

      if (o2.value !== 4)
        continue;

      stores++;

      console.log(
        `  i32.store offset=4 @ ${hex(s)}`
      );
    }

    if (stores === 0)
      console.log("  none");
  }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_TABLE_INDEX = 2053;
const TARGET_TYPE = 4;

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE INDIRECT INDEX 2053");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("WASM SIZE        :", buf.length);
console.log("TARGET TABLE IDX :", TARGET_TABLE_INDEX);
console.log("TARGET TYPE      :", TARGET_TYPE);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let p = 8;

// ============================================================
// LEB128
// ============================================================

function u8() {
    return buf[p++];
}

function u32() {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return result >>> 0;

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function i32() {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b;

    while (true) {
        b = buf[p++];

        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        result |= (~0 << shift);

    return result | 0;
}

function readName() {
    const n = u32();
    const start = p;
    p += n;

    return Buffer
        .from(buf.subarray(start, p))
        .toString("utf8");
}

function hex(x, width = 8) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

// ============================================================
// SECTION PARSER
// ============================================================

p = 8;

const sections = [];

while (p < buf.length) {

    const sectionStart = p;

    const id = u8();
    const size = u32();

    const payloadStart = p;
    const payloadEnd = payloadStart + size;

    sections.push({
        id,
        sectionStart,
        payloadStart,
        payloadEnd,
        size
    });

    p = payloadEnd;
}

const importSection =
    sections.find(s => s.id === 2);

const functionSection =
    sections.find(s => s.id === 3);

const codeSection =
    sections.find(s => s.id === 10);

if (!functionSection)
    throw new Error("FUNCTION SECTION NOT FOUND");

if (!codeSection)
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

// ============================================================
// IMPORT FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================

let importedFunctions = 0;
const imports = [];

if (importSection) {

    p = importSection.payloadStart;

    const count = u32();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

        const module = readName();
        const name = readName();

        const kind = u8();

        let typeIndex = null;

        if (kind === 0x00) {

            typeIndex = u32();

            importedFunctions++;
        }

        else if (kind === 0x01) {

            u8();

            const flags = u8();

            u32();

            if (flags & 1)
                u32();
        }

        else if (kind === 0x02) {

            const flags = u8();

            u32();

            if (flags & 1)
                u32();
        }

        else if (kind === 0x03) {

            u8();
            u8();
        }

        imports.push({
            module,
            name,
            kind,
            typeIndex
        });
    }
}

console.log(
    "IMPORTED FUNCTIONS :",
    importedFunctions
);

// ============================================================
// FUNCTION TYPE MAP
// ============================================================

p = functionSection.payloadStart;

const definedCount = u32();

const functionTypes = [];

for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++)
    functionTypes.push(u32());

function getFunctionType(index) {

    if (index < importedFunctions)
        return imports[index]?.typeIndex ?? null;

    return functionTypes[
        index - importedFunctions
    ] ?? null;
}

// ============================================================
// BLOCK TYPE
// ============================================================

function skipBlockType() {

    const b = buf[p];

    if (
        b === 0x40 ||
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c ||
        b === 0x7b
    ) {
        p++;
        return;
    }

    u32();
}

// ============================================================
// MEMORY ARGUMENT
// ============================================================

function skipMemArg() {

    u32(); // alignment
    u32(); // offset
}

// ============================================================
// INSTRUCTION DECODER
// ============================================================

function decodeInstruction() {

    const start = p;

    const op = u8();

    const x = {
        start,
        op,
        name: `op_0x${op.toString(16)}`
    };

    switch (op) {

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // CONTROL
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x00:
            x.name = "unreachable";
            break;

        case 0x01:
            x.name = "nop";
            break;

        case 0x02:
            x.name = "block";
            skipBlockType();
            break;

        case 0x03:
            x.name = "loop";
            skipBlockType();
            break;

        case 0x04:
            x.name = "if";
            skipBlockType();
            break;

        case 0x05:
            x.name = "else";
            break;

        case 0x0b:
            x.name = "end";
            break;

        case 0x0c:
            x.name = "br";
            x.index = u32();
            break;

        case 0x0d:
            x.name = "br_if";
            x.index = u32();
            break;

        case 0x0e: {

            x.name = "br_table";

            const n = u32();

            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)
                u32();

            u32();

            break;
        }

        case 0x0f:
            x.name = "return";
            break;

        case 0x10:

            x.name = "call";

            x.functionIndex = u32();

            break;

        case 0x11:

            x.name = "call_indirect";

            x.typeIndex = u32();
            x.tableIndex = u32();

            break;

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // STACK
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x1a:
            x.name = "drop";
            break;

        case 0x1b:
            x.name = "select";
            break;

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // LOCALS / GLOBALS
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x20:

            x.name = "local.get";
            x.local = u32();

            break;

        case 0x21:

            x.name = "local.set";
            x.local = u32();

            break;

        case 0x22:

            x.name = "local.tee";
            x.local = u32();

            break;

        case 0x23:

            x.name = "global.get";
            x.global = u32();

            break;

        case 0x24:

            x.name = "global.set";
            x.global = u32();

            break;

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // LOAD
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        case 0x28:

            x.name = "i32.load";
            skipMemArg();

            break;

        case 0x29:

            x.name = "i64.load";
            skipMemArg();

            break;

        case 0x2a:

            x.name = "f32.load";
            skipMemArg();

            break;

        case 0x2b:

            x.name = "f64.load";
            skipMemArg();

            break;

        case 0x2c:

        const ins = decodeInstruction();

        if (ins.unknown) {

            p = bodyEnd;

            break;
        }

        instructions.push(ins);

        if (ins.name === "call_indirect") {

            totalIndirect++;

            if (ins.typeIndex === TARGET_TYPE) {

                type4Indirect++;

                const idx =
                    instructions.length - 1;

                const contextStart =
                    Math.max(0, idx - 20);

                const context =
                    instructions.slice(contextStart);

                // ------------------------------------------------
                // Search backward for direct constant 2053
                // ------------------------------------------------

                let direct2053 = false;

                for (
                    let j = Math.max(0, idx - 20);
                    j < idx;
                    j++
                ) {

                    const q = instructions[j];

                    if (
                        q.name === "i32.const" &&
                        q.value === TARGET_TABLE_INDEX
                    ) {
                        direct2053 = true;
                    }
                }

                // ------------------------------------------------
                // Look for load offset 4 immediately before call
                // ------------------------------------------------

                let loadOffset4 = false;

                for (
                    let j = Math.max(0, idx - 8);
                    j < idx;
                    j++
                ) {

                    const q = instructions[j];

                    if (
                        q.name === "i32.load"
                    ) {
                        loadOffset4 = true;
                    }
                }

                results.push({
                    functionIndex,
                    functionType:
                        getFunctionType(functionIndex),
                    address: ins.start,
                    direct2053,
                    loadOffset4,
                    context
                });
            }
        }
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCS = new Set([
  8,
  30,
  36,
  39,
  573,
  1974,
]);

const SELECTORS = new Map<number, string>([
  [0x0019534c, "4788"],
  [0x00195350, "4789"],
  [0x00195354, "4790"],
  [0x00195358, "4791"],
]);

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
  return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[pos++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    v |= ~0 << s;
  }

  return { value: v | 0, next: pos };
}

interface Ins {
  pc: number;
  end: number;
  op: number;
  name: string;

  imm?: number;
  offset?: number;
  align?: number;

  typeIndex?: number;
  tableIndex?: number;
}

function name(op: number): string {
  const m: Record<number, string> = {
    0x02: "block",
    0x03: "loop",
    0x04: "if",
    0x05: "else",
    0x0b: "end",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
    0x0e: "br_table",
    0x0f: "return",

    0x10: "call",
    0x11: "call_indirect",

    0x1a: "drop",

    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",

    0x23: "global.get",
    0x24: "global.set",

    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x29: "i64.load",
    0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
    0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
    0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
    0x2f: "i32.load16_u",

    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x3a: "i32.store8",
    0x3b: "i32.store16",

    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x42: "i64.const",

    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",

    0x48: "i32.lt_s",
    0x49: "i32.lt_u",
    0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
    0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
    0x4c: "i32.le_s",
    0x4d: "i32.le_u",
    0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
    0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x6c: "i32.mul",

    0x71: "i32.and",
    0x72: "i32.or",
    0x73: "i32.xor",
  };

  return m[op] ?? `op_${hex(op, 2)}`;
}

function isLoad(op: number) {
  return op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35;
}

function isStore(op: number) {
  return op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e;
}

function decode(pc: number): Ins {
  const start = pc;
  const op = wasm[pc++];

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24
  ) {
    const x = uleb(pc);

    return {
      pc: start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      name: name(op),
      imm: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x41 || op === 0x42) {
    const x = sleb(pc);

    return {
      pc: start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      name: name(op),
      imm: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (isLoad(op) || isStore(op)) {
    const a = uleb(pc);
    const o = uleb(a.next);

    return {
      pc: start,
      end: o.next,
      op,
      name: name(op),
      align: a.value,
      offset: o.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = uleb(pc);

    return {
      pc: start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      name: "call",
      imm: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = uleb(pc);
    const table = uleb(t.next);

    return {
      pc: start,
      end: table.next,
      op,
      name: "call_indirect",
      typeIndex: t.value,
      tableIndex: table.value,
    };
  }

  if (
    op === 0x02 ||
    op === 0x03 ||
    op === 0x04
  ) {
    /*
     * blocktype
     */
    if (wasm[pc] === 0x40) {
      pc++;
    } else {
      pc = sleb(pc).next;
    }

    return {
      pc: start,
      end: pc,
      op,
      name: name(op),
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const x = uleb(pc);

    return {
      pc: start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      name: name(op),
      imm: x.value,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0e) {
    const n = uleb(pc);
    pc = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
      pc = uleb(pc).next;
    }

    pc = uleb(pc).next;

    return {
      pc: start,
      end: pc,
      op,
      name: "br_table",
    };
  }

  return {
    pc: start,
    end: pc,
    op,
    name: name(op),
  };
}

/*
 * ============================================================
 * Find CODE section only.
 * ============================================================
 */

let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

let p = 8;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];

  const s = uleb(p);
  const size = s.value;

  p = s.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = start + size;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

  `TARGET FUNCS = ${[...TARGET_FUNCS].join(", ")}`
);

/*
 * ============================================================
 * Parse Code Section.
 *
 * IMPORTANT:
 * Here "FUNC ORDINAL" means the code-body ordinal, exactly
 * matching the numbering used by the previous successful
 * scripts.
 * ============================================================
 */

const nBodies = uleb(codeStart);
let q = nBodies.next;

interface Body {
  ordinal: number;
  bodyStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  instrStart: number;
}

const bodies = new Map<number, Body>();

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < nBodies.value; ordinal++) {
  const bs = uleb(q);
  q = bs.next;

  const bodyStart = q;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bs.value;

  const locals = uleb(q);
  q = locals.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {
    const count = uleb(q);
    q = count.next;

    /*
     * valtype
     */
    q++;
  }

  bodies.set(ordinal, {
    ordinal,
    bodyStart,
    bodyEnd,
    instrStart: q,
  });

  q = bodyEnd;
}

console.log(`CODE BODIES = ${bodies.size}`);
console.log("");

/*
 * ============================================================
 * Value model
 * ============================================================
 */

type Val =
  | {
      kind: "selector";
      addr: number;
      value: number;
      sourcePC: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "const";
      value: number;
      sourcePC: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "local";
      index: number;
    }
  | {
      kind: "unknown";
    };

function valText(v: Val): string {
  if (v.kind === "selector") {
    return `SELECTOR_${v.value}@${hex(v.addr)}`;
  }

  if (v.kind === "const") {
    return `CONST(${hex(v.value)})`;
  }

  if (v.kind === "local") {
    return `LOCAL(${v.index})`;
  }

  return "UNKNOWN";
}

/*
 * ============================================================
 * Analyze one target function
 * ============================================================
 */

let totalIndirect = 0;
let selectorIndex = 0;
let unknownIndex = 0;

for (const func of TARGET_FUNCS) {
  const body = bodies.get(func);

  if (!body) {
    console.log(`FUNC ${func}: BODY NOT FOUND`);
    continue;
  }

  const ins: Ins[] = [];

  let x = body.instrStart;

  while (x < body.bodyEnd) {
    const i = decode(x);
    ins.push(i);

    if (i.end <= x) break;

    x = i.end;
  }

  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );
  console.log(
    `FUNC ${func} | BODY ${hex(body.bodyStart)} .. ${hex(body.bodyEnd)}`
  );
  console.log(
    `INSTRUCTIONS = ${ins.length}`
  );
  console.log(
    "============================================================"
  );

  /*
   * Abstract stack.
   */
  const stack: Val[] = [];

  /*
   * Local values.
   */
  const locals = new Map<number, Val>();

  function pop(): Val {
    return (
      stack.pop() ?? {
        kind: "unknown",
      }
    );
  }

  function push(v: Val) {
    stack.push(v);
  }

  function resolve(v: Val): Val {
    if (v.kind !== "local") return v;

    const x = locals.get(v.index);

    if (!x) return v;

    if (x.kind === "local" && x.index === v.index) {
      return v;
    }

    return x;
  }

  /*
   * Keep a compact history of stack state.
   */
  for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
    const a = ins[i];

    /*
     * i32.const
     */
    if (a.op === 0x41) {
      push({
        kind: "const",
        value: a.imm! >>> 0,
        sourcePC: a.pc,
      });

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * local.get
     */
    if (a.op === 0x20) {
      const local = a.imm!;

      const v = locals.get(local);

      if (v) {
        push(v);
      } else {
        push({
          kind: "local",
          index: local,
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * local.set
     */
    if (a.op === 0x21) {
      const local = a.imm!;
      const v = resolve(pop());

      locals.set(local, v);

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * local.tee
     */
    if (a.op === 0x22) {
      const local = a.imm!;

      const v =
        stack.length > 0
          ? resolve(stack[stack.length - 1])
          : {
              kind: "unknown" as const,
            };

      locals.set(local, v);

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * ========================================================
     * Exact selector LOAD
     * ========================================================
     */

    if (a.op === 0x28) {
      const address = resolve(pop());

      if (address.kind === "const") {
        const effective =
          (address.value + (a.offset ?? 0)) >>> 0;

        const selector =
          SELECTORS.get(effective);

        if (selector) {
          push({
            kind: "selector",
            addr: effective,
            value: Number(selector),
            sourcePC: a.pc,
          });

          console.log(
            `SELECTOR LOAD @ ${hex(a.pc)} -> ${selector} @ ${hex(effective)}`
          );

          continue;
        }
      }

      push({
        kind: "unknown",
      });

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * ========================================================
     * call_indirect
     *
     * At this exact point the table index is the TOP stack
     * operand.
     * ========================================================
     */

    if (a.op === 0x11) {
      totalIndirect++;

      const indexValue =
        stack.length > 0
          ? resolve(stack[stack.length - 1])
          : {
              kind: "unknown" as const,
            };

      console.log("");
      console.log(
        `CALL_INDIRECT @ ${hex(a.pc)}`
      );
      console.log(
        `  TYPE INDEX = ${a.typeIndex}`
      );
      console.log(
        `  TABLE      = ${a.tableIndex}`
      );
      console.log(
        `  STACK SIZE = ${stack.length}`
      );
      console.log(
        `  TABLE INDEX VALUE = ${valText(indexValue)}`
      );

      if (indexValue.kind === "selector") {
        selectorIndex++;

        console.log(
          `  >>> EXACT SELECTOR INDEX = ${indexValue.value}`
        );
        console.log(
          `      SOURCE LOAD = ${hex(indexValue.sourcePC)}`
        );
        console.log(
          `      ADDRESS     = ${hex(indexValue.addr)}`
        );
      } else {
        unknownIndex++;

        console.log(
          `  >>> INDEX NOT RESOLVED`
        );
      }

      /*
       * We cannot safely pop the exact function arguments
       * without parsing the function type signature.
       *
       * But the TOP value has already been identified as the
       * table index.
       *
       * Preserve a conservative state after the call.
       */
      stack.length = 0;

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * ========================================================
     * Comparisons
     * ========================================================
     */

    if (
      a.op === 0x46 ||
      a.op === 0x47 ||
      a.op === 0x45 ||
      (a.op >= 0x48 && a.op <= 0x4f)
    ) {
      const rhs =
        a.op === 0x45
          ? null
          : resolve(pop());

      const lhs = resolve(pop());

      if (
        lhs.kind === "selector" ||
        rhs?.kind === "selector"
      ) {
        console.log("");
        console.log(
          `SELECTOR COMPARISON @ ${hex(a.pc)} ${a.name}`
        );
        console.log(
          `  LHS = ${valText(lhs)}`
        );

        if (rhs) {
          console.log(
            `  RHS = ${valText(rhs)}`
          );
        }
      }

      push({
        kind: "unknown",
      });

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * ========================================================
     * DROP
     * ========================================================
     */

    if (a.op === 0x1a) {
      pop();
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * ========================================================
     * Simple arithmetic
     * ========================================================
     */

    if (
      a.op === 0x6a ||
      a.op === 0x6b ||
      a.op === 0x6c ||
      a.op === 0x71 ||
      a.op === 0x72 ||
      a.op === 0x73
    ) {
      const b = resolve(pop());
      const c = resolve(pop());

      /*
       * Preserve selector only for arithmetic with zero.
       */
      if (
        b.kind === "selector" &&
        c.kind === "const" &&
        c.value === 0
      ) {
        push(b);
      } else if (
        c.kind === "selector" &&
        b.kind === "const" &&
        b.value === 0
      ) {
        push(c);
      } else {
        push({
          kind: "unknown",
        });
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * ========================================================
     * Calls
     * ========================================================
     */

    if (a.op === 0x10) {
      /*
       * Unknown number of args.
       */
      stack.length = 0;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * ========================================================
     * Stores
     * ========================================================
     */

    if (isStore(a.op)) {
      pop();
      pop();
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * ========================================================
     * Control flow
     * ========================================================
     */

    if (
      a.op === 0x02 ||
      a.op === 0x03 ||
      a.op === 0x04 ||
      a.op === 0x05 ||
      a.op === 0x0b ||
      a.op === 0x0c ||
      a.op === 0x0d ||
      a.op === 0x0e ||
      a.op === 0x0f
    ) {
      /*
       * Do not carry stack state across unknown CFG edges.
       */
      stack.length = 0;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Unknown opcode:
     * invalidate stack to avoid false positives.
     */
    stack.length = 0;
  }

  console.log("");
}

console.log(
  "============================================================"
);
console.log("FINAL SUMMARY");
console.log(
  "============================================================"
);
console.log(
  `CALL_INDIRECT FOUND       = ${totalIndirect}`
);
console.log(
  `EXACT SELECTOR INDEX      = ${selectorIndex}`
);
console.log(
  `UNRESOLVED INDEX          = ${unknownIndex}`
);
console.log("");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("NO WASM EXECUTION");

import fs from "fs";

const FILE =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

const TARGETS = new Set([2053, 2101, 2612]);

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if (!(b & 0x80))
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function i32(pos: number) {
    return (
        wasm[pos] |
        (wasm[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

type Ins = {
    pos: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    imm?: number;
    offset?: number;
};

function decodeBody(start: number, end: number): Ins[] {
    const out: Ins[] = [];
    let p = start;

    while (p < end) {
        const at = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        if (op === 0x0b) {
            out.push({ pos: at, op, text: "end" });
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            const n =
                op === 0x20
                    ? "local.get"
                    : op === 0x21
                        ? "local.set"
                        : "local.tee";

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op,
                text: `${n} ${r.value}`,
                imm: r.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x23 || op === 0x24) {
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op,
                text:
                    op === 0x23
                        ? `global.get ${r.value}`
                        : `global.set ${r.value}`,
                imm: r.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op,
                text: `i32.const ${r.value}`,
                imm: r.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op,
                text: `call ${r.value}`,
                imm: r.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x11) {
            const r1 = uleb(p);
            p = r1.next;

            const r2 = uleb(p);
            p = r2.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op,
                text:
                    `call_indirect type=${r1.value} table=${r2.value}`,
                imm: r1.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        /*
         * Memory loads.
         */
        if (
            op === 0x28 ||
            op === 0x29 ||
            op === 0x2a ||
            op === 0x2b ||
            op === 0x2c ||
            op === 0x2d
        ) {
            const align = wasm[p++];
            const r = uleb(p);
            p = r.next;

            const names: Record<number, string> = {
                0x28: "i32.load",
                0x29: "i64.load",
                0x2a: "f32.load",
                0x2b: "f64.load",
                0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
                0x2d: "i32.load8_u"
            };

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op,
                text:
                    `${names[op]} align=${align} offset=${r.value}`,
                offset: r.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        /*
         * Integer arithmetic / comparisons.
         */
        const names: Record<number, string> = {
            0x45: "i32.eqz",
            0x46: "i32.eq",
            0x47: "i32.ne",
            0x48: "i32.lt_s",
            0x49: "i32.lt_u",
            0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
            0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
            0x4c: "i32.le_s",
            0x4d: "i32.le_u",
            0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
            0x4f: "i32.ge_u",
            0x6a: "i32.add",
            0x6b: "i32.sub",
            0x6c: "i32.mul",
            0x71: "i32.and",
            0x72: "i32.or",
            0x73: "i32.xor",
            0x74: "i32.shl",
            0x75: "i32.shr_s",
            0x76: "i32.shr_u",
            0x77: "i32.rotl",
            0x78: "i32.rotr",
            0x0f: "return",
            0x1a: "drop",
            0x1b: "select"
        };

        out.push({
            pos: at,
            op,
            text: names[op] ?? `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`
        });
    }

    return out;
}

/*
 * Locate code section.
 */
let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;
let codeEnd = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];

    const r = uleb(p);
    const start = r.next;
    const end = start + r.value;

    if (id === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

if (!codeStart)
    throw new Error("Code section not found");

/*
 * Decode all function bodies.
 */
const bodies: {
    globalFn: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    instructions: Ins[];
}[] = [];

let q = codeStart;
const bodyCount = uleb(q);
q = bodyCount.next;

const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;

for (let body = 0; body < bodyCount.value; body++) {
    const size = uleb(q);
    const bodyStart = size.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + size.value;

    let x = bodyStart;

    const localGroups = uleb(x);
    x = localGroups.next;

    for (let g = 0; g < localGroups.value; g++) {
        const n = uleb(x);
        x = n.next;

        x += 1;
    }

    const globalFn = IMPORT_COUNT + body;

    bodies.push({
        globalFn,
        start: x,
        end: bodyEnd,
        instructions: decodeBody(x, bodyEnd)
    });

    q = bodyEnd;
}

console.log();

console.log(`CODE      : ${hex(codeStart)} .. ${hex(codeEnd)}`);
console.log(`FUNCTIONS : ${bodies.length}`);

let dispatchCount = 0;
let targetPatternCount = 0;

/*
 * We only want call_indirect(type=4).
 *
 * For each one, reconstruct the operand stack approximately.
 * The LAST stack item is the indirect-call index.
 */
for (const fn of bodies) {

    const stack: string[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < fn.instructions.length; i++) {

        const ins = fn.instructions[i];

        if (ins.op === 0x20) {
            stack.push(
                ins.imm! < 2
                    ? `param[${ins.imm}]`
                    : `local[${ins.imm}]`
            );
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x41) {
            stack.push(`const(${ins.imm})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x23) {
            stack.push(`global[${ins.imm}]`);
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x28) {
            const base = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(
                `MEM[${base}+${ins.offset}]`
            );
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x2d) {
            const base = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(
                `MEM8[${base}+${ins.offset}]`
            );
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x6a) {
            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(`(${a}+${b})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x6b) {
            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(`(${a}-${b})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x6c) {
            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(`(${a}*${b})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x71) {
            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(`(${a}&${b})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x72) {
            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(`(${a}|${b})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x73) {
            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(`(${a}^${b})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x74 || ins.op === 0x75 || ins.op === 0x76) {
            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(
                `SHIFT(${a},${b})`
            );
            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x10) {
            /*
             * Do not try to emulate arbitrary call results.
             * Represent result symbolically.
             */
            stack.push(`RESULT(call ${ins.imm})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (
            ins.op === 0x11 &&
            ins.imm === 4
        ) {
            dispatchCount++;

            const index =
                stack.length
                    ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                    : "UNKNOWN";

            /*
             * Look for target table-index constants
             * inside the symbolic expression.
             */
            const hit =
                [...TARGETS]
                    .filter(v =>
                        index.includes(`const(${v})`)
                    );

            if (hit.length) {
                targetPatternCount++;

                console.log(
                    `TARGET INDEX HIT @ ${hex(ins.pos)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  Function : ${fn.globalFn}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  Index    : ${index}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  Targets  : ${hit.join(", ")}`
                );

                console.log();
            }

            /*
             * Print only potentially useful dispatches:
             * - index is a memory load
             * - or index contains a local/param
             * - or index is derived from a memory load.
             */
            if (
                index.startsWith("MEM[") ||
                index.startsWith("MEM8[") ||
                index.includes("MEM[") ||
                index.includes("MEM8[")
            ) {

                console.log(
                    `DISPATCH #${dispatchCount} @ ${hex(ins.pos)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  Function : ${fn.globalFn}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `  INDEX    : ${index}`
                );

                /*
                 * Show previous 10 instructions.
                 */
                const begin =
                    Math.max(0, i - 10);

                for (
                    let j = begin;
                    j <= i;
                    j++
                ) {
                    const z = fn.instructions[j];

                    console.log(
                        `    ${hex(z.pos)}  ${z.text}`
                    );
                }

                console.log();
            }

            /*
             * call_indirect consumes its arguments and index.
             * Exact arity is unknown here, so reset symbolic stack.
             * This intentionally prevents false propagation.
             */
            stack.length = 0;

            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x22) {
            /*
             * tee leaves value on stack.
             * We don't have local-state reconstruction here;
             * retain symbolic value.
             */
            const v =
                stack.length
                    ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                    : "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(
                `local[${ins.imm}]=${v}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        if (ins.op === 0x21) {
            if (stack.length)
                stack.pop();

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * Conservative handling of instructions that consume
         * unknown operands.
         */
        if (
            ins.op === 0x1a ||
            ins.op === 0x0f
        ) {
            if (stack.length)
                stack.pop();

            continue;
        }
    }
}
