function opcode(body: any): string {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return 'NO_32BIT_OPCODE';
        }

        return (
            '0x' +
            s.loadUint(32).toString(16).padStart(8, '0')
        );
    } catch {
        return 'UNREADABLE';
    }
}

function outputs(tx: any): any[] {
    const result: any[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < tx.outMessagesCount; i++) {
        result.push(tx.outMessages.get(i));
    }

    return result;
}

function printMessage(
    message: any,
    index: number
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log(`MESSAGE ${index}`);
    console.log('----------------------------------------');

    if (!message) {
        console.log('NULL');
        return;
    }

    console.log('TYPE:', message.info.type);

    if (message.info.type === 'internal') {
        console.log(
            'FROM:',
            message.info.src.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'TO:',
            message.info.dest.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'VALUE:',
            message.info.value.coins.toString(),
            'nanoTON'
        );
    }

    console.log(
        'OPCODE:',
        opcode(message.body)
    );

    try {
        console.log(
            'BODY BOC:',
            message.body.toBoc().toString('base64')
        );
    } catch {
        console.log('BODY BOC: UNAVAILABLE');
    }
}

async function inspect(
    client: TonClient4,
    label: string,
    address: Address
) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(label);
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('ADDRESS:', address.toString());

    const last = await client.getLastBlock();

    const account = await client.getAccount(
        last.last.seqno,
        address
    );

    if (!account.account.last) {
        console.log('NO TRANSACTION HISTORY');
        return;
    }

    const latestLt = BigInt(account.account.last.lt);

    const latestHash = Buffer.from(
        account.account.last.hash,
        'base64'
    );

    const txs = await client.getAccountTransactions(
        address,
        latestLt,
        latestHash
    );

    let count = 0;

    for (const item of txs) {
        const tx: any = item.tx;

        if (Number(tx.now) < SOURCE_TIME) {
            continue;
        }

        count++;

        console.log('');
        console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');
        console.log('TRANSACTION');
        console.log('------------------------------------------------------------');

        console.log(
            'LT:',
            tx.lt.toString()
        );

        console.log(
            'HASH:',
            tx.hash().toString('hex')
        );

        console.log(
            'TIME:',
            tx.now
        );

        console.log(
            'BLOCK SEQNO:',
            item.block.seqno
        );

        console.log(
            'TOTAL FEES:',
            tx.totalFees.coins.toString(),
            'nanoTON'
        );

        console.log(
            'OUT MESSAGES:',
            tx.outMessagesCount
        );

        if (tx.inMessage) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('INCOMING MESSAGE');

            console.log(
                'TYPE:',
                tx.inMessage.info.type
            );

            if (
                tx.inMessage.info.type ===
                'internal'
            ) {
                console.log(
                    'FROM:',
                    tx.inMessage.info.src.toString()
                );

                console.log(
                    'TO:',
                    tx.inMessage.info.dest.toString()
                );

                console.log(
                    'VALUE:',
                    tx.inMessage.info.value.coins.toString(),
                    'nanoTON'
                );
            }

            console.log(
                'OPCODE:',
                opcode(tx.inMessage.body)
            );

            try {
                console.log(
                    'BODY BOC:',
                    tx.inMessage.body
                        .toBoc()
                        .toString('base64')
                );
            } catch {
                console.log(
                    'BODY BOC: UNAVAILABLE'
                );
            }
        }

        const out = outputs(tx);

        for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) {
            printMessage(out[i], i + 1);
        }
    }

    if (count === 0) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'NO TRANSACTION AT OR AFTER SOURCE TIME.'
        );
    }
}

            'nanoTON'
        );
        console.log('OUT MESSAGES:', tx.outMessagesCount);

        if (tx.inMessage) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('INCOMING:');

            console.log(
                'TYPE:',
                tx.inMessage.info.type
            );

            if (tx.inMessage.info.type === 'internal') {
                console.log(
                    'FROM:',
                    tx.inMessage.info.src.toString()
                );

                console.log(
                    'VALUE:',
                    tx.inMessage.info.value.coins.toString(),
                    'nanoTON'
                );
            }

            console.log(
                'OPCODE:',
                getOpcode(tx.inMessage.body)
            );
        }

        const outputs = getOutMessages(tx);

        for (let i = 0; i < outputs.length; i++) {
            printMessage(outputs[i], i + 1);
        }
    }

    if (found === 0) {
        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'NO TRANSACTION AT OR AFTER TARGET TIME WAS FOUND.'
        );
    }
}

function short(value: unknown, length = 36): string {
    const s = String(value ?? '');
    return s.length <= length
        ? s
        : `${s.slice(0, 16)}...${s.slice(-16)}`;
}

function getHash(tx: any): string {
    return String(
        tx.hash ??
        tx.transaction_hash ??
        tx.tx_hash ??
        ''
    );
}

function getMessages(tx: any): any[] {
    const candidates = [
        tx.messages,
        tx.out_msgs,
        tx.out_messages,
        tx.out_msgs_list,
    ];

    for (const value of candidates) {
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            return value;
        }
    }

    return [];
}

function getBody(msg: any): unknown {
    return (
        msg.message_content ??
        msg.msg_data ??
        msg.body ??
        msg.message?.body ??
        null
    );
}

function decodeOpcode(body: unknown): string {
    if (!body) {
        return 'NO_BODY';
    }

    try {
        let boc: string | null = null;

        if (typeof body === 'string') {
            boc = body;
        } else if (typeof body === 'object') {
            const b = body as Record<string, unknown>;

            if (typeof b.body === 'string') {
                boc = b.body;
            } else if (typeof b.boc === 'string') {
                boc = b.boc;
            } else if (typeof b.value === 'string') {
                boc = b.value;
            }
        }

        if (!boc) {
            return 'BODY_FORMAT_UNKNOWN';
        }

        const cell = Cell.fromBase64(boc);
        const slice = cell.beginParse();

        if (slice.remainingBits < 32) {
            return 'BODY_LT_32_BITS';
        }

        const opcode = slice.loadUint(32);

        return '0x' + opcode.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    } catch {
        return 'DECODE_ERROR';
    }
}

async function api(path: string): Promise<any> {
    const response = await fetch(`${API}${path}`);

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            `HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`
        );
    }

    return await response.json();
}

async function getTransactions(
    address: string
): Promise<any[]> {
    const data = await api(
        `/transactions?account=${encodeURIComponent(address)}&limit=50&offset=0&sort=desc`
    );

    if (Array.isArray(data)) {
        return data;
    }

    return Array.isArray(data.transactions)
        ? data.transactions
        : [];
}

        for (const tx of selected) {

            console.log('');

            );

            console.log(`LT: ${tx.lt ?? 'unknown'}`);

            const description =
                tx.description ??

            const compute =
                description.compute_phase ??

            console.log(

            );

            console.log(

                    action.result_code ??
                    action.resultCode ??
                    'unknown'
                }`
            );

            const messages = getMessages(tx);

            console.log(
                `Outgoing messages: ${messages.length}`

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const BODY_START = 0x0022ccb5;
const BODY_END   = 0x0022d0a1;

function u32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function i32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);
      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }
  }
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE LOCAL0 ORIGIN - FUNC 6618");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY : ${hx(BODY_START)} .. ${hx(BODY_END)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

let local0Writes = [];
let local0Reads = [];
let fieldUses = [];

let p = BODY_START;

// Skip local declarations
const groups = u32(p);
p = groups.next;

for (let i = 0; i < groups.value; i++) {
  const n = u32(p);
  p = n.next;
  p++; // valtype
}

while (p < BODY_END) {

  const off = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    if (x.value === 0) {
      local0Reads.push(off);
      console.log(
        `${hx(off)} local.get 0`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // local.set
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    if (x.value === 0) {
      local0Writes.push(off);

      console.log("");
      console.log(
        `*** LOCAL0 SET @ ${hx(off)} ***`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // local.tee
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    if (x.value === 0) {
      local0Writes.push(off);

      console.log("");
      console.log(
        `*** LOCAL0 TEE @ ${hx(off)} ***`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // i32.load
  if (op === 0x28) {

    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    if (o.value === 40 || o.value === 56 || o.value === 16) {

      fieldUses.push({
        address: off,
        kind: "load",
        offset: o.value
      });

      console.log(
        `${hx(off)} i32.load offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // i32.store
  if (op === 0x36) {

    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    if (o.value === 40 || o.value === 56 || o.value === 16) {

      fieldUses.push({
        address: off,
        kind: "store",
        offset: o.value
      });

      console.log(
        `${hx(off)} i32.store offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // i64.load
  if (op === 0x29) {

    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    if (o.value === 40 || o.value === 56 || o.value === 16) {
      console.log(
        `${hx(off)} i64.load offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // i64.store
  if (op === 0x37) {

    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    if (o.value === 40 || o.value === 56 || o.value === 16) {
      console.log(
        `${hx(off)} i64.store offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = i32(p);
    p = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    if (
      x.value === 446 ||
      x.value === 248 ||
      x.value === 6618
    ) {
      console.log(
        `${hx(off)} CALL ${x.value}`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // call_indirect
  if (op === 0x11) {
    const t = u32(p);
    p = t.next;

    const table = u32(p);
    p = table.next;

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} CALL_INDIRECT type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.add
  if (op === 0x6a) {
    continue;
  }

  // control / misc operands
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    // block type
    if (p < BODY_END && wasm[p] === 0x40)
      p++;
    else {
      // signed/valtype byte
      p++;
    }
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x05 || op === 0x0b) {
    continue;
  }
}

console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(
  `LOCAL0 SET/TEE COUNT : ${local0Writes.length}`

console.log(
  `LOCAL0 GET COUNT     : ${local0Reads.length}`
);

if (local0Writes.length === 0) {

  );

console.log("END");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const START = 0x95e67;
const TARGET = 0x963d1;

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
      break;

    s += 7;
  }

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function sleb32(p: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;
  let x = 0;

  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
      break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= ~0 << s;

  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function sleb64(p: number) {
  let v = 0n;
  let s = 0n;
  let x = 0;

  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];

    v |= BigInt(x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7n;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0)
      break;
  }

  if (s < 64n && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (-1n) << s;

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function memarg(p: number) {
  const a = uleb(p);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    next: o.next,
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value
  };
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const START = 0x96520;
const END   = 0x96600;

function hx(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }

  return { value: v, next: p };
}

function sleb32(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;

  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= ~0 << s;

  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function memarg(p: number) {
  const a = uleb(p);
  const o = uleb(a.next);

  return {
    align: a.value,
    offset: o.value,
    next: o.next
  };
}

  0x20:"local.get",
  0x21:"local.set",

const fs = require("fs");

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm"
);

const TARGET = 0x0022ce73;

function u32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function i32(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) {
      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);
      return { value: v | 0, next: p };
    }
  }
}

function hx(x) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Find code section
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;
let codeEnd = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {

  const id = wasm[p++];

  const s = u32(p);
  p = s.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + s.value;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    codeEnd = end;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (!codeStart) {
  throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Parse function bodies
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let q = codeStart;

const count = u32(q);
q = count.next;

let targetBody = null;

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < count.value; bodyIndex++) {

  const sz = u32(q);
  q = sz.next;

  const bodyStart = q;
  const bodyEnd = q + sz.value;

  if (TARGET >= bodyStart && TARGET < bodyEnd) {

    targetBody = {
      bodyIndex,
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd
    };

    break;
  }

  q = bodyEnd;
}

if (!targetBody) {
  throw new Error("Target address is not inside a function body");
}

const actualFunction = 83 + targetBody.bodyIndex;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE SOURCE OF LOCAL4");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET ADDRESS : ${hx(TARGET)}`);
console.log(`BODY INDEX     : ${targetBody.bodyIndex}`);
console.log(`FUNCTION       : ${actualFunction}`);
console.log(`BODY START     : ${hx(targetBody.bodyStart)}`);
console.log(`BODY END       : ${hx(targetBody.bodyEnd)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Skip local declaration vector
// ------------------------------------------------------------

p = targetBody.bodyStart;

const localGroups = u32(p);
p = localGroups.next;

console.log(`LOCAL GROUPS   : ${localGroups.value}`);

for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {

  const n = u32(p);
  p = n.next;

  // value type
  p++;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Symbolic stack
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const stack = [];
const locals = new Map();

function push(x) {
  stack.push(x);
}

function pop() {
  return stack.length ? stack.pop() : "<?>"; 
}

function getLocal(n) {
  return locals.has(n)
    ? locals.get(n)
    : `local${n}`;
}

function setLocal(n, e, addr) {

  locals.set(n, e);

  if (n === 4) {

    console.log("");
    console.log("************************************************************");
    console.log("LOCAL4 DEFINITION");
    console.log("************************************************************");
    console.log(`ADDRESS : ${hx(addr)}`);
    console.log(`local4  = ${e}`);
    console.log("************************************************************");
    console.log("");
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Decode
// ------------------------------------------------------------

while (p < targetBody.bodyEnd) {

  const off = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  // end
  if (op === 0x0b) {
    console.log(`${hx(off)} end`);
    continue;
  }

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {

    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = getLocal(x.value);

    push(e);

    if (x.value === 4) {
      console.log(
        `${hx(off)} local.get 4 -> ${e}  <=== LOCAL4`
      );
    }

    continue;
  }

  // local.set
  if (op === 0x21) {

    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = pop();

    setLocal(x.value, e, off);

    continue;
  }

  // local.tee
  if (op === 0x22) {

    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    const e = pop();

    setLocal(x.value, e, off);

    push(e);

    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {

    const x = i32(p);
    p = x.next;

    push(String(x.value));

    continue;
  }

  // i32.load
  if (op === 0x28) {

    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    const addr = pop();

    const e =
      o.value === 0
        ? `MEM[${addr}]`
        : `MEM[${addr}+${o.value}]`;

    push(e);

    continue;
  }

  // i32.store
  if (op === 0x36) {

    const a = u32(p);
    p = a.next;

    const o = u32(p);
    p = o.next;

    const value = pop();
    const addr = pop();

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} i32.store offset=${o.value} : ${addr} = ${value}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  // i32.add
  if (op === 0x6a) {

    const b = pop();
    const a = pop();

    push(`(${a}+${b})`);

    continue;
  }

  // i32.sub
  if (op === 0x6b) {

    const b = pop();
    const a = pop();

    push(`(${a}-${b})`);

    continue;
  }

  // call
  if (op === 0x10) {

    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} CALL ${x.value}`
    );

    // We do not know the exact signature here.
    // Preserve symbolic return for calls that can define local4.
    push(`RET[${x.value}]`);

    continue;
  }

  // call_indirect
  if (op === 0x11) {

    const type = u32(p);
    p = type.next;

    const table = u32(p);
    p = table.next;

    console.log(
      `${hx(off)} CALL_INDIRECT type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`
    );

    push(`RET[INDIRECT:type${type.value}]`);

    continue;
  }

  // i32.eqz
  if (op === 0x45) {

    const a = pop();

    push(`(${a}==0)`);

    continue;
  }

  // i32.eq
  if (op === 0x46) {

    const b = pop();
    const a = pop();

    push(`(${a}==${b})`);

    continue;
  }

  // br
  if (op === 0x0c) {

    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    pop();

    continue;
  }

  // br_if
  if (op === 0x0d) {

    const x = u32(p);
    p = x.next;

    pop();

    continue;
  }

  // i32.wrap_i64
  if (op === 0xa7) {

    const a = pop();

    push(`wrap32(${a})`);

    continue;
  }

  // unknown opcode
  console.log(
    `${hx(off)} UNKNOWN opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
  );
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL LOCAL DEFINITIONS");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const [n, e] of locals.entries()) {
  console.log(`local${n} = ${e}`);
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("END");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const file = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const START = 0x95e67;
const END   = 0x96265;

function readU32(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, q = p;
  while (q < b.length) {
    const x = b[q++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: q };
    s += 7;
  }
  throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function readS32(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, q = p, x = 0;
  while (q < b.length) {
    x = b[q++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (-1 << s);
  return { value: v | 0, next: q };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

let p = START;

console.log("============================================================");

console.log("TARGET: MEM[G-368+68] = MEM[G-300]");
console.log();

while (p < END) {
  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  // local.get
  if (op === 0x20) {
    const r = readU32(p); p = r.next;
    if (r.value === 6)
      console.log(`${hex(at)} local.get 6`);
    continue;
  }

  // local.set
  if (op === 0x21) {
    const r = readU32(p); p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  // local.tee
  if (op === 0x22) {
    const r = readU32(p); p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  // i32.const
  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = readS32(p); p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  // i64.const
  if (op === 0x42) {
    let q = p;
    let x = 0, s = 0, c = 0;
    while (q < b.length) {
      const z = b[q++];
      c++;
      x |= (z & 0x7f) << s;
      s += 7;
      if (!(z & 0x80)) break;
    }
    p = q;
    continue;
  }

  // memory load/store family
  if (
    op === 0x28 || op === 0x29 || op === 0x2a || op === 0x2b ||
    op === 0x2c || op === 0x2d || op === 0x2e || op === 0x2f ||
    op === 0x30 || op === 0x31 || op === 0x32 || op === 0x33 ||
    op === 0x34 || op === 0x35 ||
    op === 0x36 || op === 0x37 || op === 0x38 || op === 0x39 ||
    op === 0x3a || op === 0x3b || op === 0x3c || op === 0x3d ||
    op === 0x3e
  ) {
    const a = readU32(p); p = a.next;
    const o = readU32(p); p = o.next;

    if (o.value === 68 || o.value === 64 || o.value === 60 ||
        o.value === 56 || o.value === 52 || o.value === 48 ||
        o.value === 44 || o.value === 40 || o.value === 36 ||
        o.value === 32 || o.value === 28 || o.value === 24 ||
        o.value === 20 || o.value === 16 || o.value === 12 ||
        o.value === 8 || o.value === 4 || o.value === 0) {
      console.log(
        `${hex(at)} memory op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")} ` +
        `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`
      );
    }
    continue;
  }

  // calls
  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = readU32(p); p = r.next;
    if (r.value === 116 || r.value === 136 || r.value === 87 ||
        r.value === 205 || r.value === 3425) {
      console.log(`${hex(at)} call ${r.value}`);
    }
    continue;
  }

  // br / br_if
  if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
    const r = readU32(p); p = r.next;
    continue;
  }

  // block / loop / if
  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
    if (b[p] === 0x40) p++;
    else {
      const r = readS32(p); p = r.next;
    }
    continue;
  }

  // end / else / drop / arithmetic / comparisons etc.
  if (
    op === 0x0b || op === 0x05 || op === 0x1a ||
    (op >= 0x45 && op <= 0x66) ||
    (op >= 0x67 && op <= 0x91) ||
    (op >= 0xa7 && op <= 0xbf)
  ) {
    continue;
  }

  // memory.copy / memory.fill
  if (op === 0xfc) {
    const r = readU32(p);
    p = r.next;

    if (r.value === 8 || r.value === 10) {
      const a = readU32(p); p = a.next;
      const c = readU32(p); p = c.next;
      console.log(`${hex(at)} 0xfc subop=${r.value} imm=${a.value},${c.value}`);
    }
    continue;
  }

  console.log(`${hex(at)} UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`);
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" END V22");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const START = 0x0e1147;
const END   = 0x0e1181;

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      return { v: v >>> 0, p };

    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x = 0;

  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(x & 0x80))
      break;
  }

  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40))
    v |= (-1 << s);

  return { v: v | 0, p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(6, "0");
}

let p = START;

while (p < END) {

  const at = p;
  const op = b[p++];

  if (op >= 0x20 && op <= 0x24) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    const names: Record<number,string> = {
      0x20: "local.get",
      0x21: "local.set",
      0x22: "local.tee",
      0x23: "global.get",
      0x24: "global.set"
    };

    if (r.v === 2 || r.v === 3 || r.v === 8)
      console.log(`${hex(at)} ${names[op]} ${r.v}`);

    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const r = sleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    console.log(`${hex(at)} i32.const ${r.v}`);
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x42) {
    const r = sleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    console.log(`${hex(at)} i64.const ${r.v}`);
    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    console.log(`${hex(at)} CALL ${r.v}`);
    continue;
  }

  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    p = a.p;

    const o = uleb(p);
    p = o.p;

    console.log(
      `${hex(at)} ${op >= 0x36 ? "STORE" : "LOAD"} ` +
      `op=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
      `align=${a.v} offset=${o.v}`
    );

    continue;
  }

  if (op === 0xfc) {

    const r = uleb(p);
    p = r.p;

    console.log(`${hex(at)} 0xfc subop=${r.v}`);

    if (r.v === 8 || r.v === 10) {
      let x = uleb(p);
      p = x.p;

      x = uleb(p);
      p = x.p;
    }

    continue;
  }

  console.log(
    `${hex(at)} op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}`
  );
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("END V32");
console.log("============================================================");

);

const TARGET_LT = 99809465000014n;

const RPC =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC';

function addr(a: Address | null): string {
    return a ? a.toString() : 'null';
}

function opcode(body: any): string {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) return 'NONE';

        return '0x' +
            s.loadUint(32)
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, '0');
    } catch {
        return 'UNKNOWN';
    }
}

function boc(body: any): string {
    try {
        return body.toBoc().toString('hex');
    } catch {
        return 'ERROR';
    }
}

FILE: scripts\traceMappingDispatch.ts

import fs from "fs";

const wasmPath = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_FUNCS = [39, 1974];

function readU32LE(p: number): number {
  return (
    wasm[p] |
    (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
    (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
    (wasm[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function findCodeSection(): { start: number; end: number } {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sectionId = wasm[p++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    p = sizeInfo.next;

    const sectionStart = p;
    const sectionEnd = p + size;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
      return {
        start: sectionStart,
        end: sectionEnd,
      };
    }

    p = sectionEnd;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function parseCodeBodies(): {
  ordinal: number;
  bodyStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  instrStart: number;
}[] {
  const code = findCodeSection();

  let p = code.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  const count = countInfo.value;
  p = countInfo.next;

  const bodies = [];

  for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count; ordinal++) {
    const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
    p = bodySizeInfo.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

    const localCountInfo = readULEB(p);
    const localCount = localCountInfo.value;
    p = localCountInfo.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localCount; i++) {
      const n = readULEB(p);
      p = n.next;

      p += 1;
    }

    const instrStart = p;

    bodies.push({
      ordinal,
      bodyStart,
      bodyEnd,
      instrStart,
    });

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function opcodeName(op: number): string {
  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x10: "call",
    0x11: "call_indirect",
    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",
    0x23: "global.get",
    0x24: "global.set",
    0x28: "i32.load",
    0x36: "i32.store",
    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x45: "i32.eqz",
    0x46: "i32.eq",
    0x47: "i32.ne",
    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",
    0x71: "i32.xor",
    0x0b: "end",
    0x0c: "br",
    0x0d: "br_if",
    0x0f: "return",
  };

  return names[op] ?? `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function decodeOne(p: number): { next: number; text: string } {
  const start = p;
  const op = wasm[p++];

  if (op === 0x41) {
    const x = readSLEB(p);
    return {
      next: x.next,
      text: `${opcodeName(op)} ${x.value}`,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {
    const x = readULEB(p);
    return {
      next: x.next,
      text: `${opcodeName(op)} ${x.value}`,
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const type = readULEB(p);
    p = type.next;

    const table = readULEB(p);
    p = table.next;

    return {
      next: p,
      text: `${opcodeName(op)} type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`,
    };
  }

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22 ||
    op === 0x23 ||
    op === 0x24
  ) {
    const x = readULEB(p);

    return {
      next: x.next,
      text: `${opcodeName(op)} ${x.value}`,
    };
  }

  if (
    op === 0x28 ||
    op === 0x36
  ) {
    const align = readULEB(p);
    p = align.next;

    const offset = readULEB(p);
    p = offset.next;

    return {
      next: p,
      text: `${opcodeName(op)} align=${align.value} offset=0x${offset.value.toString(16)}`,
    };
  }

  if (
    op === 0x6a ||
    op === 0x6b ||
    op === 0x45 ||
    op === 0x46 ||
    op === 0x47 ||
    op === 0x71 ||
    op === 0x0b ||
    op === 0x0f ||
    op === 0x0c ||
    op === 0x0d
  ) {
    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      return {
        next: x.next,
        text: `${opcodeName(op)} ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    return {
      next: p,
      text: opcodeName(op),
    };
  }

  return {
    next: p,
    text: `op_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`,
  };
}

    }

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET_VALUES = new Set([
    4788,
    4789,
    4790,
    4791
]);

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value: v, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hx(v) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function signedLEB(pos) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (~0 << shift);
            }

            return { value: value | 0, next: p };
        }
    }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_SLOT = 114;
const TARGET_TYPE = 0;
const TARGET_TABLE = 0;

type Instr = {
    off: number;
    op: number;
    imm: number[];
    text: string;
};

type Body = {
    func: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    bytes: Buffer;
};

function uleb(buf: Buffer, p: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
}

function sleb(buf: Buffer, p: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            break;
        }
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= -1 << shift;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function readVec(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { count: number; next: number } {
    const r = uleb(buf, p);

    return {
        count: r.value,
        next: r.next,
    };
}

function readName(
    buf: Buffer,
    p: number
): { name: string; next: number } {
    const r = uleb(buf, p);

    const end = r.next + r.value;

    return {
        name: buf
            .subarray(r.next, end)
            .toString("utf8"),
        next: end,
    };
}

function parseSections(wasm: Buffer) {
    let p = 8;

    let typeSec:
        | { start: number; size: number }
        | undefined;

    let importSec:
        | { start: number; size: number }
        | undefined;

    let funcSec:
        | { start: number; size: number }
        | undefined;

    let codeSec:
        | { start: number; size: number }
        | undefined;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const s = uleb(wasm, p);

        p = s.next;

        const start = p;

        if (id === 1) {
            typeSec = {
                start,
                size: s.value,
            };
        }

        if (id === 2) {
            importSec = {
                start,
                size: s.value,
            };
        }

        if (id === 3) {
            funcSec = {
                start,
                size: s.value,
            };
        }

        if (id === 10) {
            codeSec = {
                start,
                size: s.value,
            };
        }

        p += s.value;
    }

    return {
        typeSec,
        importSec,
        funcSec,
        codeSec,
    };
}

function parseImports(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number }
): number {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);

    p = v.next;

    let importedFuncs = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < v.count; i++) {
        const mod = readName(wasm, p);
        p = mod.next;

        const name = readName(wasm, p);
        p = name.next;

        const kind = wasm[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const r = uleb(wasm, p);

            p = r.next;

            importedFuncs++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
            p++;

            const flags = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = flags.next;

            const min = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = min.next;

            if (flags.value & 1) {
                const max = uleb(wasm, p);
                p = max.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 2) {
            const flags = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = flags.next;

            const min = uleb(wasm, p);
            p = min.next;

            if (flags.value & 1) {
                const max = uleb(wasm, p);
                p = max.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;
        } else {
            throw new Error(
                `Unknown import kind ${kind}`
            );
        }
    }

    return importedFuncs;
}

function parseFunctionTypes(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number }
): number[] {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);

    p = v.next;

    const result: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < v.count; i++) {
        const r = uleb(wasm, p);

        result.push(r.value);

        p = r.next;
    }

    return result;
}

function parseBodies(
    wasm: Buffer,
    sec: { start: number; size: number },
    importedFuncs: number
): Body[] {
    let p = sec.start;

    const v = readVec(wasm, p);

    p = v.next;

    const result: Body[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < v.count; i++) {
        const s = uleb(wasm, p);

        p = s.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = p + s.value;

        result.push({
            func: importedFuncs + i,
            start,
            end,
            bytes: wasm.subarray(start, end),
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return result;
}

function decode(
    bytes: Buffer,
    base: number
): Instr[] {
    const out: Instr[] = [];

    let p = 0;

    while (p < bytes.length) {
        const start = p;
        const off = base + p;
        const op = bytes[p++];

        const imm: number[] = [];

        let text =
            `op=0x${op
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(2, "0")}`;

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = sleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x42) {
            const r = sleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `i64.const ${r.value}`;
        } else if (
            op === 0x20 ||
            op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22
        ) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text =
                op === 0x20
                    ? `local.get ${r.value}`
                    : op === 0x21
                    ? `local.set ${r.value}`
                    : `local.tee ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `call ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x11) {
            const a = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = a.next;

            const b = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = b.next;

            imm.push(a.value, b.value);

            text =
                `call_indirect type=${a.value} table=${b.value}`;
        } else if (
            op === 0x28 ||
            op === 0x29 ||
            op === 0x2a ||
            op === 0x2b ||
            op === 0x2c ||
            op === 0x2d ||
            op === 0x2e ||
            op === 0x2f ||
            op === 0x30 ||
            op === 0x31 ||
            op === 0x32 ||
            op === 0x33 ||
            op === 0x34 ||
            op === 0x35 ||
            op === 0x36 ||
            op === 0x37 ||
            op === 0x38 ||
            op === 0x39 ||
            op === 0x3a ||
            op === 0x3b ||
            op === 0x3c ||
            op === 0x3d ||
            op === 0x3e ||
            op === 0x3f ||
            op === 0x40
        ) {
            const align = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = align.next;

            const offset = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = offset.next;

            imm.push(
                align.value,
                offset.value
            );

            const name =
                op === 0x28
                    ? "i32.load"
                    : op === 0x29
                    ? "i64.load"
                    : op === 0x2c
                    ? "i32.load8_s"
                    : op === 0x2d
                    ? "i32.load8_u"
                    : op === 0x2e
                    ? "i32.load16_s"
                    : op === 0x2f
                    ? "i32.load16_u"
                    : "memory";

            text =
                `${name} align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x23) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `global.get ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x24) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `global.set ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x25) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `table.get ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x26) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text = `table.set ${r.value}`;
        } else if (
            op === 0x02 ||
            op === 0x03 ||
            op === 0x04
        ) {
            if (p >= bytes.length) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Missing blocktype"
                );
            }

            const first = bytes[p++];

            if (
                first !== 0x40 &&
                first >= 0x80
            ) {
                let b = first;
                let value = first & 0x7f;
                let shift = 7;

                while (b & 0x80) {
                    if (p >= bytes.length) {
                        throw new Error(
                            "Blocktype overflow"
                        );
                    }

                    b = bytes[p++];

                    value |=
                        (b & 0x7f) << shift;

                    shift += 7;
                }

                imm.push(value);
            } else {
                imm.push(first);
            }

            text =
                op === 0x02
                    ? "block"
                    : op === 0x03
                    ? "loop"
                    : "if";
        } else if (op === 0x05) {
            text = "else";
        } else if (op === 0x0b) {
            text = "end";
        } else if (op === 0x0f) {
            text = "return";
        } else if (
            op === 0x0c ||
            op === 0x0d
        ) {
            const r = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = r.next;

            imm.push(r.value);

            text =
                op === 0x0c
                    ? `br ${r.value}`
                    : `br_if ${r.value}`;
        } else if (op === 0x1a) {
            text = "drop";
        } else if (
            op >= 0x45 &&
            op <= 0x4f
        ) {
            text =
                `i32.compare 0x${op
                    .toString(16)}`;
        } else if (
            op >= 0x6a &&
            op <= 0x78
        ) {
            text =
                `i32.arith 0x${op
                    .toString(16)}`;
        } else if (op === 0x0e) {
            const n = uleb(bytes, p);

            p = n.next;

            for (
                let i = 0;
                i < n.value + 1;
                i++
            ) {
                const r = uleb(bytes, p);

                p = r.next;

                imm.push(r.value);
            }

            text = "br_table";
        }

        if (p <= start) {
            throw new Error(
                `Decoder stalled @ 0x${off.toString(16)}`
            );
        }

        out.push({
            off,
            op,
            imm,
            text,
        });
    }

    return out;
}

function showWindow(
    instrs: Instr[],
    index: number,
    radius: number
) {
    const from = Math.max(
        0,
        index - radius
    );

    const to = Math.min(
        instrs.length,
        index + radius + 1
    );

    for (let i = from; i < to; i++) {
        const mark =
            i === index
                ? " >>>"
                : "    ";

        console.log(
            `${mark} 0x${instrs[i].off
                .toString(16)
                .padStart(8, "0")}  ${instrs[i].text}`
        );
    }
}

export async function run() {
    const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        " MEMORY INDEX INVENTORY -> FUNCTION 4154"
    );
    console.log(
        " READ ONLY - OFFLINE"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log();

    console.log(
        `WASM size       : ${wasm.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Target slot     : ${TARGET_SLOT} (0x${TARGET_SLOT
            .toString(16)
            .padStart(2, "0")})`
    );

    console.log(
        `Target type     : ${TARGET_TYPE}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Target table    : ${TARGET_TABLE}`
    );

    console.log();

    const sections = parseSections(wasm);

    if (
        !sections.typeSec ||
        !sections.importSec ||
        !sections.funcSec ||
        !sections.codeSec
    ) {
        throw new Error(
            "Required sections missing"
        );
    }

    const importedFuncs = parseImports(
        wasm,
        sections.importSec
    );

    const funcTypes = parseFunctionTypes(
        wasm,
        sections.funcSec
    );

    const bodies = parseBodies(
        wasm,
        sections.codeSec,
        importedFuncs
    );

    console.log(
        `Imported funcs : ${importedFuncs}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Defined funcs  : ${funcTypes.length}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Code bodies    : ${bodies.length}`
    );

    console.log();

    let decodedBodies = 0;
    let decodeErrors = 0;

    let sites = 0;
    let loadPaths = 0;

    const histogram = new Map<
        number,
        number
    >();

    const samples: {
        func: number;
        callOff: number;
        loadOff: number;
        loadOp: number;
        align: number;
        offset: number;
        distance: number;
    }[] = [];

    for (const body of bodies) {
        let instrs: Instr[];

        try {
            instrs = decode(
                body.bytes,
                body.start
            );

            decodedBodies++;
        } catch {
            decodeErrors++;
            continue;
        }

        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < instrs.length;
            i++
        ) {
            const ci = instrs[i];

            if (
                ci.op !== 0x11 ||
                ci.imm[0] !== TARGET_TYPE ||
                ci.imm[1] !== TARGET_TABLE
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            sites++;

            /*
             * Find the nearest memory load that
             * appears to produce the table index.
             *
             * This is inventory only; no value is
             * assumed yet.
             */
            let loadIndex = -1;

            for (
                let j = i - 1;
                j >= 0 && j >= i - 12;
                j--
            ) {
                const x = instrs[j];

                if (
                    x.op >= 0x28 &&
                    x.op <= 0x3e
                ) {
                    loadIndex = j;
                    break;
                }

                /*
                 * Stop when crossing a call or
                 * another indirect call.
                 */
                if (
                    x.op === 0x10 ||
                    x.op === 0x11
                ) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (loadIndex < 0) {
                continue;
            }

            loadPaths++;

            const load = instrs[loadIndex];

            const offset =
                load.imm.length >= 2
                    ? load.imm[1]
                    : -1;

            const align =
                load.imm.length >= 1
                    ? load.imm[0]
                    : -1;

            const distance =
                i - loadIndex;

            histogram.set(
                offset,
                (histogram.get(offset) ?? 0) + 1
            );

            if (samples.length < 80) {
                samples.push({
                    func: body.func,
                    callOff: ci.off,
                    loadOff: load.off,
                    loadOp: load.op,
                    align,
                    offset,
                    distance,
                });
            }
        }
    }

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        "SUMMARY"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    console.log(
        `Decoded bodies     : ${decodedBodies}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Decode errors      : ${decodeErrors}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Type-0/table-0     : ${sites}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Memory-load paths  : ${loadPaths}`
    );

    console.log();

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        "LOAD OFFSET HISTOGRAM"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    const hist = Array.from(
        histogram.entries()
    ).sort(
        (a, b) => b[1] - a[1]
    );

    for (
        const [offset, count] of hist.slice(0, 50)
    ) {
        console.log(
            `offset=${offset
                .toString()
                .padStart(8, " ")}  count=${count}`
        );
    }

    console.log();

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        "FIRST 80 MEMORY-LOAD PATHS"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    for (const s of samples) {
        console.log(
            `func=${s.func} ` +
            `load=0x${s.loadOff.toString(16)} ` +
            `call_indirect=0x${s.callOff.toString(16)} ` +
            `align=${s.align} ` +
            `offset=${s.offset} ` +
            `distance=${s.distance}`
        );
    }

    console.log();

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        "DETAILED WINDOWS"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    /*
     * Show the first 10 paths with actual
     * instruction windows.
     */
    let shown = 0;

    for (const body of bodies) {
        if (shown >= 10) break;

        let instrs: Instr[];

        try {
            instrs = decode(
                body.bytes,
                body.start
            );
        } catch {
            continue;
        }

        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < instrs.length;
            i++
        ) {
            const ci = instrs[i];

            if (
                ci.op !== 0x11 ||
                ci.imm[0] !== TARGET_TYPE ||
                ci.imm[1] !== TARGET_TABLE
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            let loadIndex = -1;

            for (
                let j = i - 1;
                j >= 0 && j >= i - 12;
                j--
            ) {
                const x = instrs[j];

                if (
                    x.op >= 0x28 &&
                    x.op <= 0x3e
                ) {
                    loadIndex = j;
                    break;
                }

                if (
                    x.op === 0x10 ||
                    x.op === 0x11
                ) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (loadIndex < 0) {
                continue;
            }

            console.log();
            console.log(
                `--- FUNCTION ${body.func} ---`
            );

            console.log(
                `LOAD @ 0x${instrs[loadIndex].off.toString(16)}`
            );

            console.log(
                `CALL_INDIRECT @ 0x${ci.off.toString(16)}`
            );

            showWindow(
                instrs,
                i,
                8
            );

            shown++;
        }
    }

    console.log();

    console.log(
        "============================================================"

    console.log(

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );

    console.log(
        "No transaction sent."
    );

    console.log(
        "No WASM modification."
    );

    console.log(
        "Read-only / offline."
    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function section(id: number) {

    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {

        const sid = wasm[p++];

        const size = uleb(p);
        p = size.next;

        if (sid === id) {
            return {
                start: p,
                end: p + size.value
            };
        }

        p += size.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

const IMPORTED = 83;

// ============================================================
// GLOBAL DEFINITIONS
// ============================================================

const globalSec = section(6);

let gp = globalSec.start;

const globalCount = uleb(gp);
gp = globalCount.next;

interface GlobalInfo {
    index: number;
    type: number;
    mutable: boolean;
    init: string;
}

const globals: GlobalInfo[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < globalCount.value; i++) {

    const type = wasm[gp++];

    const mut = wasm[gp++];

    let init = "UNKNOWN";

    const op = wasm[gp++];

    if (op === 0x41) {

        const x = sleb(gp);
        gp = x.next;

        init =
            `i32.const ${x.value} (${hex(x.value)})`;

    } else if (op === 0x42) {

        const x = sleb(gp);
        gp = x.next;

        init =
            `i64.const ${x.value}`;

    } else if (op === 0x43) {

        gp += 4;

        init = "f32.const";

    } else if (op === 0x44) {

        gp += 8;

        init = "f64.const";

    } else if (op === 0x23) {

        const x = uleb(gp);
        gp = x.next;

        init =
            `global.get ${x.value}`;

    } else {

        init = `opcode ${hex(op)}`;

        while (
            gp < globalSec.end &&
            wasm[gp] !== 0x0b
        ) {
            gp++;
        }
    }

    if (wasm[gp] === 0x0b) {
        gp++;
    }

    globals.push({
        index: i,
        type,
        mutable: mut === 1,
        init
    });
}

// ============================================================
// FIND CODE SECTION
// ============================================================

const codeSec = section(10);

let cp = codeSec.start;

const bodyCount = uleb(cp);
cp = bodyCount.next;

interface Body {
    func: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    instrStart: number;
}

const bodies: Body[] = [];

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < bodyCount.value; ordinal++) {

    const size = uleb(cp);
    cp = size.next;

    const start = cp;
    const end = cp + size.value;

    let p = start;

    const localCount = uleb(p);
    p = localCount.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {

        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;

        p++;
    }

    bodies.push({
        func: IMPORTED + ordinal,
        start,
        end,
        instrStart: p
    });

    cp = end;
}

// ============================================================
// MUTABLE GLOBALS
// ============================================================

const mutable = globals.filter(g => g.mutable);

console.log("TRACE MUTABLE GLOBALS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

console.log(`TOTAL GLOBALS = ${globals.length}`);
console.log(`MUTABLE GLOBALS = ${mutable.length}`);
console.log("");

console.log("MUTABLE GLOBAL DEFINITIONS");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (const g of mutable) {

    console.log(
        `GLOBAL ${g.index} | TYPE=${g.type} | INIT=${g.init}`
    );
}

console.log("");

// ============================================================
// SET COUNTS
// ============================================================

const setCounts = new Map<number, number>();

for (const g of mutable) {
    setCounts.set(g.index, 0);
}

// ============================================================
// GLOBAL.GET / SET BY FUNCTION
// ============================================================

interface Ref {
    func: number;
    offset: number;
    kind: "GET" | "SET";
    global: number;
}

const refs: Ref[] = [];

for (const body of bodies) {

    let p = body.instrStart;

    while (p < body.end) {

        const offset = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // global.get
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x23) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            refs.push({
                func: body.func,
                offset,
                kind: "GET",
                global: x.value
            });

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // global.set
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x24) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            refs.push({
                func: body.func,
                offset,
                kind: "SET",
                global: x.value
            });

            if (setCounts.has(x.value)) {
                setCounts.set(
                    x.value,
                    setCounts.get(x.value)! + 1
                );
            }

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // Skip immediates for instructions we know.
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x41) {
            p = sleb(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x42) {
            p = sleb(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x43) {
            p += 4;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x44) {
            p += 8;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x10) {
            p = uleb(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x11) {
            p = uleb(p).next;
            p++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
            p = uleb(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
            p = uleb(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0e) {

            const n = uleb(p);
            p = n.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
                p = uleb(p).next;
            }

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // Memory instructions.
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {

            p = uleb(p).next;
            p = uleb(p).next;

            continue;
        }

        // memory.size / memory.grow
        if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {
            p++;
            continue;
        }

        // prefixed instruction
        if (op === 0xfc || op === 0xfd) {
            p = uleb(p).next;
            continue;
        }
    }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

const TARGET_OFFSET = 128;

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b;

  do {
    b = wasm[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;
  } while (b & 0x80);

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
    result |= (~0 << shift);

  return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

function hex(n) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readName(pos) {
  const x = readULEB(pos);
  return { next: x.next + x.value };
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Sections
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

let p = 8;

let importSection;
let functionSection;
let codeSection;

while (p < wasm.length) {

  const id = wasm[p++];

  const s = readULEB(p);
  const start = s.next;
  const end = start + s.value;

  if (id === 2)
    importSection = { start, end };

  if (id === 3)
    functionSection = { start, end };

  if (id === 10)
    codeSection = { start, end };

  p = end;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Imported function count
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

p = importSection.start;

let x = readULEB(p);
const importCount = x.value;
p = x.next;

let importedFunctions = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < importCount; i++) {

  p = readName(p).next;
  p = readName(p).next;

  const kind = wasm[p++];

  if (kind === 0) {

    p = readULEB(p).next;
    importedFunctions++;

  } else if (kind === 1) {

    p++;
    const flags = wasm[p++];

    p = readULEB(p).next;

    if (flags & 1)
      p = readULEB(p).next;

  } else if (kind === 2) {

    const flags = readULEB(p);
    p = flags.next;

    p = readULEB(p).next;

    if (flags.value & 1)
      p = readULEB(p).next;

  } else if (kind === 3) {

    p++;
    p++;
  }
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Function section
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

p = functionSection.start;

const fc = readULEB(p);
const definedCount = fc.value;
p = fc.next;

const functionTypes = [];

for (let i = 0; i < definedCount; i++) {

  const t = readULEB(p);

  functionTypes.push(t.value);

  p = t.next;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Code bodies
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

p = codeSection.start;

const bc = readULEB(p);
const bodyCount = bc.value;
p = bc.next;

const bodies = [];

for (let i = 0; i < bodyCount; i++) {

  const bs = readULEB(p);

  const bodySize = bs.value;
  const bodyStart = bs.next;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

  bodies.push({
    func: importedFunctions + i,
    start: bodyStart,
    end: bodyEnd
  });

  p = bodyEnd;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Decoder
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function decodeOne(pos) {

  const start = pos;
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {

    const x = readULEB(pos);

    return {
      start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      text:
        (op === 0x20 ? "local.get " :
         op === 0x21 ? "local.set " :
                        "local.tee ") + x.value,
      local: x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {

    const x = readSLEB(pos);

    return {
      start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
      value: x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {

    const x = readULEB(pos);

    return {
      start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      text: `call ${x.value}`,
      func: x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {

    const t = readULEB(pos);
    const table = readULEB(t.next);

    return {
      start,
      end: table.next,
      op,
      text:
        `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`,
      type: t.value
    };
  }

  /*
   * Loads
   */

  if (
    op >= 0x28 &&
    op <= 0x35
  ) {

    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
      start,
      end: o.next,
      op,
      text:
        `load opcode=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
        `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
      offset: o.value
    };
  }

  /*
   * Stores
   */

  if (
    op >= 0x36 &&
    op <= 0x3e
  ) {

    const a = readULEB(pos);
    const o = readULEB(a.next);

    return {
      start,
      end: o.next,
      op,
      text:
        `store opcode=0x${op.toString(16)} ` +
        `align=${a.value} offset=${o.value}`,
      offset: o.value,
      isStore: true
    };
  }

  /*
   * Control flow
   */

  if (
    op === 0x0c ||
    op === 0x0d
  ) {

    const x = readULEB(pos);

    return {
      start,
      end: x.next,
      op,
      text:
        (op === 0x0c ? "br " : "br_if ") +
        x.value
    };
  }

  if (op === 0x0e) {

    const n = readULEB(pos);

    pos = n.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
      pos = readULEB(pos).next;

    pos = readULEB(pos).next;

    return {
      start,
      end: pos,
      op,
      text: "br_table"
    };
  }

  /*
   * Memory
   */

  if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {

    return {
      start,
      end: pos + 1,
      op,
      text:
        op === 0x3f ?
        "memory.size" :
        "memory.grow"
    };
  }

  /*
   * Everything else
   */

  return {
    start,
    end: pos,
    op,
    text:
      `opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
  };
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Decode selected function
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

function decodeFunction(body) {

  let p = body.start;

  const locals = readULEB(p);
  p = locals.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {

    const count = readULEB(p);
    p = count.next;

    p++;
  }

  const code = [];

  while (p < body.end) {

    const ins = decodeOne(p);

    code.push(ins);

    p = ins.end;

    if (ins.op === 0x0b)
      break;
  }

  return code;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * Find all offset=128 stores
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

const results = [];

for (const body of bodies) {

  const code = decodeFunction(body);

  for (let i = 0; i < code.length; i++) {

    const ins = code[i];

    if (
      ins.isStore &&
      ins.offset === TARGET_OFFSET
    ) {

      results.push({
        func: body.func,
        index: i,
        code
      });
    }
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");

/*
 * First priority:
 *
 * functions close to the target dispatch region,
 * then older functions.
 */

results.sort((a, b) => {

  const priority = f => {

    if (f.func >= 8940)
      return 0;

    if (f.func >= 9000)
      return 1;

    return 2;
  };

  return priority(a) - priority(b) ||
         a.func - b.func ||
         a.index - b.index;
});

/*
 * Limit contextual output to 20 instructions
 * around each hit.
 */

for (const r of results) {

  const ins = r.code[r.index];

  console.log("");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(
    `FUNC ${r.func} @ ${hex(ins.start)}`
  );
  console.log(
    `STORE: ${ins.text}`
  );
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

  const start = Math.max(0, r.index - 16);
  const end = Math.min(
    r.code.length,
    r.index + 2
  );

  let has2053 = false;

  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {

    const x = r.code[i];

    let marker = "  ";

    if (i === r.index)
      marker = ">>";

    if (
      x.op === 0x41 &&
      x.value === 2053
    ) {
      marker = "!!";
      has2053 = true;
    }

    console.log(
      marker,
      hex(x.start),
      x.text
    );
  }

  console.log(
    "2053 IN LOCAL CONTEXT :",
    has2053 ? "YES" : "NO"
  );
}
