const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];

    v += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, s);

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: p };

    s += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;

  while (p < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[p++];

    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;

    if (!(b & 0x80)) {

      if (s < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        v |= (~0 << s);

      return {
        value: v | 0,
        next: p
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(x) {
  return "0x" +
    x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function decode(p, end) {

  if (p >= end)
    return null;

  const start = p;
  const op = buf[p++];

  const r = {
    start,
    end: p,
    op,
    text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`
  };

  if (
    op === 0x20 ||
    op === 0x21 ||
    op === 0x22
  ) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    r.end = a.next;
    r.local = a.value;

    r.text =
      op === 0x20
        ? `local.get local=${a.value}`
        : op === 0x21
          ? `local.set local=${a.value}`
          : `local.tee local=${a.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x10) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    r.end = a.next;
    r.callTarget = a.value;
    r.text = `call ${a.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x28) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    r.end = b.next;
    r.offset = b.value;
    r.isLoad = true;

    r.text =
      `i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x29) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    r.end = b.next;
    r.offset = b.value;
    r.isLoad = true;

    r.text =
      `i64.load align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x2d) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    r.end = b.next;
    r.offset = b.value;
    r.isLoad = true;

    r.text =
      `i32.load8_u align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x36) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    const b = uleb(a.next);
    if (!b) return null;

    r.end = b.next;
    r.offset = b.value;
    r.isStore = true;

    r.text =
      `i32.store align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x41) {

    const a = sleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    r.end = a.next;
    r.value = a.value;

    r.text =
      `i32.const ${a.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x6a) {
    r.text = "i32.add";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x6b) {
    r.text = "i32.sub";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x72) {
    r.text = "i32.or";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x73) {
    r.text = "i32.xor";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x71) {
    r.text = "i32.and";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x74) {
    r.text = "i32.shl";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x75) {
    r.text = "i32.shr_s";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x76) {
    r.text = "i32.shr_u";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x0b) {
    r.text = "end";
    return r;
  }

  if (op === 0x05) {
    r.text = "else";
    return r;
  }

  if (
    op === 0x02 ||
    op === 0x03 ||
    op === 0x04
  ) {

    if (p >= end)
      return null;

    p++;

    r.end = p;

    r.text =
      op === 0x02
        ? "block"
        : op === 0x03
          ? "loop"
          : "if";

    return r;
  }

  if (
    op === 0x0c ||
    op === 0x0d
  ) {

    const a = uleb(p);
    if (!a) return null;

    r.end = a.next;

    r.text =
      op === 0x0c
        ? `br ${a.value}`
        : `br_if ${a.value}`;

    return r;
  }

  return r;
}

/*
 * Locate code section.

let p = 8;
let codeStart = -1;

while (p < buf.length) {

  const section = buf[p++];

  const s = uleb(p);
  if (!s)
    throw new Error("bad section");

  p = s.next;

  const start = p;
  const end = start + s.value;

  if (section === 10) {
    codeStart = start;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0)
  throw new Error("code section not found");

const bodyCount = count.value;

let localValueStores = 0;

for (let func = 0; func < bodyCount; func++) {

  const sizeInfo = uleb(q);
  if (!sizeInfo)
    break;

  const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
  const bodyStart = sizeInfo.next;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

  q = bodyEnd;

  let x = bodyStart;

  const localInfo = uleb(x);
  if (!localInfo)
    continue;

  x = localInfo.next;

  for (
    let g = 0;
    g < localInfo.value;
    g++
  ) {

    const n = uleb(x);
    if (!n) {
      x = bodyEnd;
      break;
    }

    x = n.next + 1;
  }

  const ins = [];

  while (x < bodyEnd) {

    const z = decode(x, bodyEnd);

    if (!z)
      break;

    ins.push(z);
    x = z.end;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {

    if (
      !ins[i].isStore ||
      ins[i].offset !== 4
    )
      continue;

    total++;

    /*
     * In WASM stack order:
     *
     * address
     * value
     * i32.store
     *
     * Therefore inspect preceding instruction.
     */

    const valueIns = ins[i - 1];

    if (
      !valueIns ||
      !valueIns.text.startsWith("local.get")
    )
      continue;

    const valueLocal = valueIns.local;

    localValueStores++;

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("MATCH");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("FUNC :", func);
    console.log("STORE:", hex(ins[i].start));
    console.log("VALUE LOCAL:", valueLocal);

    console.log("");
    console.log("CONTEXT:");

    const from = Math.max(0, i - 12);

    for (let k = from; k <= i; k++) {

      console.log(
        " ",
        hex(ins[k].start),
        ins[k].text
      );
    }

    /*
     * Search backwards for the most recent definition
     * of the value local.
     */

    console.log("");
    console.log("BACKWARD DEFINITION:");

    for (
      let k = i - 2;
      k >= Math.max(0, i - 100);
      k--
    ) {

      if (
        ins[k].local === valueLocal &&
        (
          ins[k].text.startsWith("local.set") ||
          ins[k].text.startsWith("local.tee")
        )
      ) {

        console.log(
          " ",
          hex(ins[k].start),
          ins[k].text
        );

        /*
         * Show instructions before definition.
         */

        const dfrom = Math.max(0, k - 8);

        for (let z = dfrom; z < k; z++) {

          console.log(
            "   ",
            hex(ins[z].start),
            ins[z].text
          );
        }

        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let v = 0;
    let s = 0;
    let x = 0;
    do {
        x = b[pos++];
        v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
        s += 7;
    } while (x & 0x80);
    return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };
}

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const ROUTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCS4UEa5UaJLzOyyKieqQOQ2P9M-7kXpkO5HnP3Bv250cN3'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99809465000001n;

function opHex(body: any): string {
    try {
        if (body.bits.length < 32) return 'NO_OPCODE';
        return '0x' + body.beginParse().loadUint(32).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    } catch {
        return 'DECODE_ERROR';
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 POOL TRACE AFTER PROVIDE_LP');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('==============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL   :', POOL.toString());
    console.log('ROUTER :', ROUTER.toString());
    console.log('TARGET LT:', TARGET_LT.toString());

    const client = new TonClient({
        endpoint: 'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/jsonRPC',
    });

    console.log('');
    console.log('Reading Pool transactions...');

    const txs = await client.getTransactions(POOL, {
        limit: 50,
    });

    console.log('Transactions returned:', txs.length);
    console.log('');

    for (let i = 0; i < txs.length; i++) {
        const tx: any = txs[i];

        const lt = BigInt(tx.lt);

        if (lt < TARGET_LT - 100000000n) {
            continue;
        }

        console.log('--------------------------------------------------------------');
        console.log('TX #' + (i + 1));
        console.log('LT:', lt.toString());
        console.log('HASH:', tx.hash().toString('base64'));

        const inMsg: any = tx.inMessage;

        if (!inMsg) {
            console.log('No incoming message');
            continue;
        }

        if (inMsg.info?.type !== 'internal') {
            console.log('Incoming message is not internal');
            continue;
        }

        const src = inMsg.info.src;
        const value = inMsg.info.value?.coins ?? 0n;
        const body = inMsg.body;

        console.log('SOURCE :', src.toString());
        console.log('VALUE  :', value.toString());
        console.log('OPCODE :', opHex(body));

        if (src.equals(ROUTER)) {
            console.log('');
            console.log('*** ROUTER -> POOL MESSAGE FOUND ***');

            try {
                const boc = body.toBoc();

                console.log('BODY BOC BYTES :', boc.length);
                console.log('BODY BOC HEX   :', boc.toString('hex'));
                console.log('BODY BOC BASE64:');
                console.log(boc.toString('base64'));
            } catch (e) {
                console.log('BOC extraction error:', e);
            }

            console.log('');
        }
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================================');
    console.log('TRACE FINISHED');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('==============================================================');
}

import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const POOL =
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf';

const URL =
    'https://testnet.toncenter.com/api/v2/getTransactions';

const TARGET_LTS = new Set([
    '99809465000008',
    '99809465000009',
    '99809465000010',
    '99809465000011',
    '99809465000012',
]);

export async function run(_provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('='.repeat(80));
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 POOL LT TRACE');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));

    console.log('\nPOOL:');
    console.log(POOL);

    const response = await fetch(
        `${URL}?address=${POOL}&limit=20`
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
        console.log('\nHTTP ERROR:', response.status);
        console.log(await response.text());
        return;
    }

    const json: any = await response.json();

    if (!json.ok) {
        console.log('\nTONCENTER ERROR:');
        console.log(JSON.stringify(json, null, 2));
        return;
    }

    const transactions = json.result ?? [];

    console.log(
        `\nFetched ${transactions.length} transactions.`
    );

    const selected = transactions.filter((tx: any) =>
        TARGET_LTS.has(
            String(tx.transaction_id?.lt ?? '')
        )
    );

    selected.sort(
        (a: any, b: any) =>
            BigInt(a.transaction_id.lt) >
            BigInt(b.transaction_id.lt) ? 1 : -1
    );

    console.log(
        `Matched ${selected.length} target transactions.`
    );

    for (const tx of selected) {
        const lt = String(tx.transaction_id.lt);

        console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
        console.log(`LT: ${lt}`);
        console.log('HASH:', tx.transaction_id.hash);
        console.log('='.repeat(80));

        console.log('\nINCOMING');

        const input = tx.in_msg;

        if (!input) {
            console.log('No incoming message.');
        } else {
            console.log('Source:', input.source ?? 'null');
            console.log('Destination:', input.destination ?? 'null');
            console.log('Value:', input.value ?? '0');
            console.log('Type:', input.msg_type ?? '');

            const body =
                input.message_content?.body;

            console.log('BODY:');
            console.log(body ?? 'null');
        }

        console.log('\nOUTGOING');

        const outputs = tx.out_msgs ?? [];

        if (outputs.length === 0) {
            console.log('No outgoing messages.');
        }

        let i = 0;

        for (const msg of outputs) {
            i++;

            console.log(`\nOUT #${i}`);
            console.log('Source:', msg.source ?? 'null');
            console.log('Destination:', msg.destination ?? 'null');
            console.log('Value:', msg.value ?? '0');
            console.log('Type:', msg.msg_type ?? '');

            console.log('BODY:');
            console.log(
                msg.message_content?.body ?? 'null'
            );
        }
    }

    console.log('\n' + '='.repeat(80));
    console.log('TRACE COMPLETE');
    console.log('READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
    console.log('='.repeat(80));
}

const POOL_TXS = [

            'wOv69fdHU3O/g3rN+3mYEJvc/HRzq6xM+gmGyt9OB+Q=',
        outMsgHash:

        inMsgHash:
            'xOoEn8vtg71Crtx+pf9uLfeaaC0EgvEHd+d+mohK2GM=',
        outMsgHash:
            'iX0jSxgB4qXSTXX0h+Jz53XAyc/7WpwNOu8fEitjEic=',
    },
];

const DELAY_MS = 1300;

function sleep(ms: number) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function getJson(
    url: string,
    label: string
): Promise<any> {

    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 5; attempt++) {

        const response = await fetch(url);

        if (response.ok) {
            return await response.json();
        }

        if (response.status === 429) {
            const wait =
                DELAY_MS * attempt;

            console.log(
                `429 for ${label}; waiting ${wait} ms...`
            );

            await sleep(wait);
            continue;
        }

        throw new Error(
            `${label}: HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`
        );
    }

    throw new Error(
        `${label}: too many 429 responses`
    );
}

function txUrlByMessage(
    msgHash: string,
    direction: 'in' | 'out'
): string {

    const params = new URLSearchParams();

    params.set('msg_hash', msgHash);
    params.set('direction', direction);
    params.set('limit', '10');
    params.set('offset', '0');

    return `${TONCENTER}/transactionsByMessage?${params}`;
}

        for (let i = 0;

async function traceMessage(
    msgHash: string,
    name: string
) {

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `================================================`
    );

    console.log(
        `${name}`
    );

    console.log(
        `message hash: ${msgHash}`
    );

    console.log(
        `================================================`
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Looking for IN transaction...'
    );

    const inData =
        await getJson(
            txUrlByMessage(msgHash, 'in'),
            `${name} IN`
        );

    const inTxs =
        inData.transactions ?? [];

    console.log(
        'IN matches:',
        inTxs.length
    );

    for (const tx of inTxs) {
        printTx(
            tx,
            `${name} / IN`
        );
    }

    await sleep(DELAY_MS);

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        'Looking for OUT transaction...'
    );

    const outData =
        await getJson(
            txUrlByMessage(msgHash, 'out'),
            `${name} OUT`
        );

    const outTxs =
        outData.transactions ?? [];

    console.log(
        'OUT matches:',
        outTxs.length
    );

    for (const tx of outTxs) {
        printTx(
            tx,
            `${name} / OUT`
        );
    }

    return {
        inTxs,
        outTxs,
    };
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE ALL READS OF 0x19534C");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let hits = 0;

for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length - 10; p++) {

  if (wasm[p] !== 0x41) continue;

  const c = uleb(p + 1);

  if (c.value !== TARGET) continue;

  const from = Math.max(0, p - 16);
  const to = Math.min(wasm.length, p + 45);

  console.log("");
  console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
  console.log(`CONST : 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`RANGE : 0x${from.toString(16)} .. 0x${to.toString(16)}`);

  let q = from;

  while (q < to) {

    const pos = q;
    const op = wasm[q++];

    let imm = "";

    if (
      op === 0x20 ||
      op === 0x21 ||
      op === 0x22 ||
      op === 0x10 ||
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d ||
      op === 0x41 ||
      op === 0x42
    ) {
      const x = uleb(q);
      imm = ` ${x.value}`;
      q = x.next;
    }
    else if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
      const a = uleb(q);
      q = a.next;

      const o = uleb(q);
      q = o.next;

      imm = ` align=${a.value} offset=0x${o.value.toString(16)}`;
    }

    console.log(
      `0x${pos.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}  ${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}${imm}`
    );
  }

  hits++;
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TOTAL READ LOCATIONS : ${hits}`);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 122;
const IMPORTS = 83;

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0;
  let s = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[pos++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;

    if (!(b & 0x80))
      return { value: v, next: pos };

    s += 7;
  }
}

let p = 8;
let codeStart = -1;

while (p < wasm.length) {
  const id = wasm[p++];
  const sz = uleb(p);
  p = sz.next;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = p;
    break;
  }

  p += sz.value;
}

if (codeStart < 0)
  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

let q = codeStart;
const count = uleb(q);
q = count.next;

for (let body = 0; body < count.value; body++) {

  const bs = uleb(q);
  q = bs.next;

  const start = q;
  const end = q + bs.value;
  const realFunc = IMPORTS + body;

  if (realFunc !== TARGET) {
    q = end;
    continue;
  }

  console.log("REAL FUNC 122");
  console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
  console.log("============================================================");
  console.log(`BODY INDEX : ${body}`);
  console.log(`BODY START : 0x${start.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`BODY END   : 0x${end.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`BODY SIZE  : ${bs.value}`);
  console.log("");
  console.log("CALLS:");

  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {

    if (wasm[i] !== 0x10)
      continue;

    const r = uleb(i + 1);

    console.log(
      `  @ 0x${i.toString(16)} -> FUNC ${r.value}`
    );
  }

  console.log("");
  console.log("RAW:");
  for (let i = start; i < end; i++) {
    console.log(
      `0x${i.toString(16)}  ${wasm[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    );
  }

  console.log("============================================================");
  break;
  
  q = end;
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 0x8e7d4;

let p = 8;

function u(): number {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x: number;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return v >>> 0;
}

let codeStart = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const size = u();
  const end = p + size;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = p;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

p = codeStart;
const count = u();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE FUNC CONTAINING 0x8E7D4");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (let f = 0; f < count; f++) {
  const bodySize = u();
  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

  const groups = u();

  for (let g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
    u();
    p++;
  }

  if (TARGET >= bodyStart && TARGET < bodyEnd) {
    console.log("FUNC :", f + 91);
    console.log("BODY :", "0x" + bodyStart.toString(16),
                         ".. 0x" + bodyEnd.toString(16));
    console.log("TARGET:", "0x" + TARGET.toString(16));
    console.log("");

    const s = Math.max(bodyStart, TARGET - 80);
    const e = Math.min(bodyEnd, TARGET + 120);

    for (let q = s; q < e; q += 16) {
      const z = Math.min(e, q + 16);

      console.log(
        "0x" + q.toString(16).padStart(8, "0"),
        [...b.slice(q, z)]
          .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
          .join(" ")
      );
    }

    break;
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const FILE = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;

const TARGETS = new Set([9368, 9462, 9467, 9472]);

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function uleb(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value: result >>> 0, next: p };
}

function sleb(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;
        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        result |= (~0 << shift);

    return { value: result | 0, next: p };
}

function findSection(type) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const sectionType = wasm[p++];

        const s = uleb(p);
        const size = s.value;
        p = s.next;

        if (sectionType === type)
            return { start: p, end: p + size };

        p += size;
    }

    return null;
}

function decodeBody(start, end) {
    let p = start;

    const locals = uleb(p);
    p = locals.next;

    let localCount = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < locals.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;

        p++; // valtype

        localCount += n.value;
    }

    const instructions = [];

    while (p < end) {
        const addr = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        let text = `opcode_0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

        switch (op) {

            case 0x20: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.get ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x21: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.set ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x22: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `local.tee ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x41: {
                const x = sleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `i32.const ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x28: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `i32.load align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x2a: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `f32.load align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x29: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `i64.load align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x2b: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `f64.load align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x2c:
            case 0x2d: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `${op === 0x2c ? "i32.load8_s" : "i32.load8_u"} align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x2e:
            case 0x2f: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `${op === 0x2e ? "i32.load16_s" : "i32.load16_u"} align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x36: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `i32.store align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x37: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `i64.store align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x3a:
            case 0x3b: {
                const align = uleb(p);
                p = align.next;

                const off = uleb(p);
                p = off.next;

                text = `${op === 0x3a ? "i32.store8" : "i32.store16"} align=${align.value} offset=${off.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x10: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `call ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x11: {
                const type = uleb(p);
                p = type.next;

                const table = uleb(p);
                p = table.next;

                text = `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x1a:
                text = "drop";
                break;

            case 0x45:
                text = "i32.eqz";
                break;

            case 0x46:
                text = "i32.eq";
                break;

            case 0x47:
                text = "i32.ne";
                break;

            case 0x6a:
                text = "i32.add";
                break;

            case 0x6b:
                text = "i32.sub";
                break;

            case 0x71:
                text = "i32.and";
                break;

            case 0x72:
                text = "i32.or";
                break;

            case 0x73:
                text = "i32.xor";
                break;

            case 0x04:
                text = "if";
                break;

            case 0x05:
                text = "else";
                break;

            case 0x0b:
                text = "end";
                break;

            case 0x0c: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `br ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x0d: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `br_if ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x23: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `global.get ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x24: {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
                text = `global.set ${x.value}`;
                break;
            }

            case 0x02:
            case 0x03: {
                const blockType = wasm[p++];
                text = `${op === 0x02 ? "block" : "loop"} type=0x${blockType.toString(16)}`;
                break;
            }

            default:
                // Keep unknown opcode, but stop decoding operands.
                break;
        }

        instructions.push({
            addr,
            op,
            text
        });

        if (op === 0x0b && p === end)
            break;
    }

    return instructions;
}

function findCodeSection() {
    const sec = findSection(10);
    if (!sec) throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");

    let p = sec.start;

    const count = uleb(p);
    p = count.next;

    const bodies = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

        const sizeInfo = uleb(p);
        const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const bodyStart = p;
        const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

        bodies.push({
            bodyIndex: i,
            globalFunc: IMPORT_COUNT + i,
            start: bodyStart,
            end: bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function hex(x) {
    return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

            for (let j = a; j < b; j++) {

                const mark = j === i ? ">>" : "  ";

                console.log(
                    `${mark} ${hex(ins[j].addr)} ${ins[j].text}`
                );
            }

            /*
             * Look backwards for the nearest definition of this local.
             */
            let foundDef = false;

            for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {

                const t = ins[j].text;

                if (

                        console.log(
                            `${mark} ${hex(ins[k].addr)} ${ins[k].text}`
                        );

                    foundDef = true;

const ROOSTER_WALLET = Address.parse(

);

const TARGET_AMOUNT = 200073535827652n;

const OP_JETTON_TRANSFER = 0x0f8a7ea5;
const OP_JETTON_NOTIFY = 0x7362d09c;
const OP_PROVIDE_LP = 0x37c096df;

function opHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';
    return '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function getOpcode(body: any): number | null {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function ton(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return frac ? `${whole}.${frac}` : whole.toString();
}

function separator(title: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(` ${title}`);
    console.log('============================================================');
}

    let found = 0;

    for (const tx of txs) {
        if (!tx.inMessage) {
            continue;
        }

        const body = tx.inMessage.body;
        const op = getOpcode(body);

        if (op !== OP_JETTON_TRANSFER) {
            continue;
        }

        try {
            const s = body.beginParse();

            s.loadUint(32);

            const queryId = s.loadUintBig(64);

            const amount = s.loadCoins();

            if (amount !== TARGET_AMOUNT) {
                continue;
            }

            found++;

            separator('MATCHING ROOSTER TRANSFER');

            console.log('LT:');
            console.log(tx.lt.toString());

            console.log('HASH:');
            console.log(
                tx.hash().toString('base64')
            );

            console.log('TIME:');
            console.log(
                new Date(tx.now * 1000).toISOString()
            );

            console.log('OPCODE:');
            console.log(opHex(op));

            console.log('QUERY ID:');
            console.log(queryId.toString());

            console.log('ROOSTER AMOUNT RAW:');
            console.log(amount.toString());

            console.log('ROOSTER AMOUNT:');
            console.log(ton(amount));

            if (tx.inMessage.info.type === 'internal') {
                console.log('SOURCE:');
                console.log(
                    tx.inMessage.info.src.toString()
                );

                console.log('DESTINATION:');
                console.log(
                    tx.inMessage.info.dest.toString()
                );

                console.log('TON VALUE:');
                console.log(
                    ton(tx.inMessage.info.value.coins)
                );
            }

            console.log('');
            console.log('REMAINING BITS AFTER AMOUNT:');
            console.log(s.remainingBits);

            console.log('REMAINING REFS:');
            console.log(s.remainingRefs);

            console.log('');
            console.log('FULL TRANSFER BODY BOC:');
            console.log(
                body.toBoc().toString('base64')
            );

            console.log('');

            if (s.remainingBits >= 1) {
                console.log('PAYLOAD PARSE:');

                try {
                    const customPayload = s.loadMaybeRef();

                    if (customPayload) {
                        console.log(
                            'CUSTOM PAYLOAD REF: YES'
                        );

                        console.log(
                            customPayload
                                .toBoc()
                                .toString('base64')
                        );
                    } else {
                        console.log(
                            'CUSTOM PAYLOAD REF: NO'
                        );
                    }
                } catch {
                    console.log(
                        'CUSTOM PAYLOAD: DECODE FAILED'
                    );
                }
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('TRANSFER DECODE ERROR:');
            console.log(String(e));
        }
    }

    separator('RESULT');

    if (found === 0) {
        console.log(
            'TARGET ROOSTER TRANSFER NOT FOUND.'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            `MATCHES FOUND: ${found}`
        );
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');

    separator('END');
}

function opcodeFromBody(body: string): string {
    try {
        const raw = Buffer.from(body, 'base64');

        if (raw.length < 4) {
            return 'N/A';
        }

        return '0x' + raw.readUInt32BE(0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    } catch {
        return 'N/A';
    }
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [
    {
        name: "Function 3621 dispatch memory",
        address: 2428392,
        hex: "0x00250de8",
    },
    {
        name: "Function 3658 root pointer",
        address: 1837608,
        hex: "0x001c0a28",
    },
];

const TARGET_INDEX = 7969;

type Instr = {
    offset: number;
    opcode: number;
    text: string;
    next: number;
};

type Body = {
    func: number;
    bodyStart: number;
    bodyEnd: number;
    codeStart: number;
};

function readULEB(
    wasm: Buffer,
    p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: p };

        shift += 7;
    }

    throw new Error("ULEB EOF");
}

function readSLEB(
    wasm: Buffer,
    p: number
): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (-1 << shift);

    return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(v: number): string {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function findSection(
    wasm: Buffer,
    idWanted: number
): {
    payloadStart: number;
    payloadEnd: number;
} | null {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const size = readULEB(wasm, p);
        const start = size.next;
        const end = start + size.value;

        if (id === idWanted)
            return {
                payloadStart: start,
                payloadEnd: end,
            };

        p = end;
    }

    return null;
}

function parseBodies(wasm: Buffer): Body[] {
    const sec = findSection(wasm, 10);

    if (!sec)
        throw new Error("Code section not found");

    let p = sec.payloadStart;

    const countInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);
    const count = countInfo.value;
    p = countInfo.next;

    const bodies: Body[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const sizeInfo = readULEB(wasm, p);

        const bodyStart = sizeInfo.next;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + sizeInfo.value;

        let q = bodyStart;

        const localInfo = readULEB(wasm, q);
        q = localInfo.next;

        for (let j = 0; j < localInfo.value; j++) {
            const n = readULEB(wasm, q);
            q = n.next;

            // valtype
            q++;
        }

        bodies.push({
            func: 83 + i,
            bodyStart,
            bodyEnd,
            codeStart: q,
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return bodies;
}

function decodeOne(
    wasm: Buffer,
    p: number,
    end: number
): Instr | null {
    if (p >= end)
        return null;

    const start = p;
    const op = wasm[p++];

    // i32.const
    if (op === 0x41) {
        const x = readSLEB(wasm, p);

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
            next: x.next,
        };
    }

    // i64.const
    if (op === 0x42) {
        const x = readSLEB(wasm, p);

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `i64.const ${x.value}`,
            next: x.next,
        };
    }

    // local.get
    if (op === 0x20) {
        const x = readULEB(wasm, p);

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `local.get ${x.value}`,
            next: x.next,
        };
    }

    // local.set
    if (op === 0x21) {
        const x = readULEB(wasm, p);

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `local.set ${x.value}`,
            next: x.next,
        };
    }

    // local.tee
    if (op === 0x22) {
        const x = readULEB(wasm, p);

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `local.tee ${x.value}`,
            next: x.next,
        };
    }

    // global.get
    if (op === 0x23) {
        const x = readULEB(wasm, p);

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `global.get ${x.value}`,
            next: x.next,
        };
    }

    // global.set
    if (op === 0x24) {
        const x = readULEB(wasm, p);

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `global.set ${x.value}`,
            next: x.next,
        };
    }

    // i32.load / variants
    if (
        op === 0x28 ||
        op === 0x2c ||
        op === 0x2d ||
        op === 0x2e ||
        op === 0x2f
    ) {
        if (p >= end)
            return null;

        const align = wasm[p++];

        const off = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = off.next;

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `load opcode=0x${op.toString(16)} align=${align} offset=${off.value}`,
            next: p,
        };
    }

    // i32.store / store8 / store16
    if (
        op === 0x36 ||
        op === 0x3a ||
        op === 0x3b
    ) {
        if (p >= end)
            return null;

        const align = wasm[p++];

        const off = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = off.next;

        const name =
            op === 0x36
                ? "i32.store"
                : op === 0x3a
                    ? "i32.store8"
                    : "i32.store16";

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `${name} align=${align} offset=${off.value}`,
            next: p,
        };
    }

    // i64.store
    if (op === 0x37) {
        if (p >= end)
            return null;

        const align = wasm[p++];

        const off = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = off.next;

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `i64.store align=${align} offset=${off.value}`,
            next: p,
        };
    }

    // memory.copy
    if (op === 0xfc) {
        if (p >= end)
            return null;

        const sub = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = sub.next;

        if (sub.value === 10) {
            const a = readULEB(wasm, p);
            p = a.next;

            const b = readULEB(wasm, p);
            p = b.next;

            return {
                offset: start,
                opcode: op,
                text: `memory.copy dstmem=${a.value} srcmem=${b.value}`,
                next: p,
            };
        }

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `0xfc sub=${sub.value}`,
            next: p,
        };
    }

    // call
    if (op === 0x10) {
        const x = readULEB(wasm, p);

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `call ${x.value}`,
            next: x.next,
        };
    }

    // call_indirect
    if (op === 0x11) {
        const type = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = type.next;

        const table = readULEB(wasm, p);
        p = table.next;

        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`,
            next: p,
        };
    }

    // common zero-operand instructions
    const zeroOps = new Set([
        0x00, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04,
        0x05, 0x0b, 0x0f, 0x1a, 0x1b,
        0x45, 0x46, 0x47, 0x48, 0x49,
        0x4a, 0x4b, 0x4c, 0x4d, 0x4e,
        0x4f, 0x50, 0x51, 0x52, 0x53,
        0x54, 0x55, 0x56, 0x57, 0x58,
        0x59, 0x5a, 0x5b, 0x5c, 0x5d,
        0x5e, 0x5f, 0x60, 0x61, 0x62,
        0x63, 0x64, 0x65, 0x66, 0x67,
        0x68, 0x69, 0x6a, 0x6b, 0x6c,
        0x6d, 0x6e, 0x6f, 0x70, 0x71,
        0x72, 0x73, 0x74, 0x75, 0x76,
        0x77, 0x78, 0x79, 0x7a, 0x7b,
        0x7c, 0x7d, 0x7e, 0x7f, 0x80,
        0x81, 0x82, 0x83, 0x84, 0x85,
        0x86, 0x87, 0x88, 0x89, 0x8a,
        0x8b, 0x8c, 0x8d, 0x8e, 0x8f,
        0x90, 0x91, 0x92, 0x93, 0x94,
        0x95, 0x96, 0x97, 0x98, 0x99,
        0x9a, 0x9b, 0x9c, 0x9d, 0x9e,
        0x9f, 0xa0, 0xa1, 0xa2, 0xa3,
        0xa4, 0xa5, 0xa6, 0xa7, 0xa8,
        0xa9, 0xaa, 0xab, 0xac, 0xad,
        0xae, 0xaf, 0xb0, 0xb1, 0xb2,
        0xb3, 0xb4, 0xb5, 0xb6, 0xb7,
        0xb8, 0xb9, 0xba, 0xbb, 0xbc,
        0xbd, 0xbe, 0xbf, 0xc0, 0xc1,
        0xc2, 0xc3, 0xc4, 0xc5, 0xc6,
        0xc7, 0xc8, 0xc9, 0xca, 0xcb,
        0xcc, 0xcd, 0xce, 0xcf, 0xd0,
        0xd1, 0xd2, 0xd3, 0xd4, 0xd5,
        0xd6, 0xd7, 0xd8, 0xd9, 0xda,
        0xdb, 0xdc, 0xdd, 0xde, 0xdf,
        0xe0, 0xe1, 0xe2, 0xe3, 0xe4,
        0xe5, 0xe6, 0xe7, 0xe8, 0xe9,
        0xea, 0xeb, 0xec, 0xed, 0xee,
        0xef, 0xf0, 0xf1, 0xf2, 0xf3,
        0xf4, 0xf5, 0xf6, 0xf7, 0xf8,
        0xf9, 0xfa, 0xfb,
    ]);

    if (zeroOps.has(op)) {
        return {
            offset: start,
            opcode: op,
            text: `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`,
            next: p,
        };
    }

    return {
        offset: start,
        opcode: op,
        text: `UNKNOWN 0x${op.toString(16)}`,
        next: p,
    };
}

function decodeWindow(
    wasm: Buffer,
    start: number,
    end: number,
    maxInstr = 40
): Instr[] {
    const out: Instr[] = [];

    let p = start;

    for (let i = 0; i < maxInstr && p < end; i++) {
        const ins = decodeOne(wasm, p, end);

        if (!ins)
            break;

        out.push(ins);

        p = ins.next;

        if (
            ins.opcode === 0x0b ||
            ins.opcode === 0x0f
        )
            break;
    }

    return out;
}

function isStore(op: number): boolean {
    return (
        op === 0x36 ||
        op === 0x37 ||
        op === 0x38 ||
        op === 0x39 ||
        op === 0x3a ||
        op === 0x3b
    );
}

function findConstHits(
    wasm: Buffer,
    bodies: Body[],
    target: number
) {
    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(` SEARCH ADDRESS ${hex(target)}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    let total = 0;
    let possibleWriters = 0;

    for (const body of bodies) {
        const insns = decodeWindow(
            wasm,
            body.codeStart,
            body.bodyEnd,
            100000
        );

        for (let i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
            const ins = insns[i];

            if (
                ins.opcode !== 0x41 ||
                !ins.text.startsWith("i32.const ")
            )
                continue;

            const value = Number(
                ins.text.substring("i32.const ".length)
            );

            if ((value >>> 0) !== (target >>> 0))
                continue;

            total++;

            console.log("");
            console.log(
                `Function ${body.func} @ ${hex(ins.offset)}`
            );
            console.log(
                `  ${ins.text}`
            );

            const window = insns.slice(i, i + 20);

            for (const x of window) {
                console.log(
                    `  ${hex(x.offset)}  ${x.text}`
                );

                if (isStore(x.opcode)) {
                    possibleWriters++;
                    console.log(
                        "  >>> POSSIBLE STORE AFTER TARGET ADDRESS"
                    );
                    break;
                }

                if (
                    x.opcode === 0x0b ||
                    x.opcode === 0x0f
                )
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("SUMMARY");
    console.log(`  CONST hits          : ${total}`);
    console.log(`  possible store paths: ${possibleWriters}`);
}

function searchRawAddressBytes(
    wasm: Buffer,
    target: number
) {
    const b = Buffer.alloc(4);

    b.writeUInt32LE(target >>> 0, 0);

    console.log("");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(` RAW LITTLE-ENDIAN SEARCH ${hex(target)}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    console.log(
        `bytes: ${[...b]
            .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
            .join(" ")}`
    );

    let hits = 0;

    for (let p = 0; p <= wasm.length - 4; p++) {
        if (
            wasm[p] === b[0] &&
            wasm[p + 1] === b[1] &&
            wasm[p + 2] === b[2] &&
            wasm[p + 3] === b[3]
        ) {
            hits++;

            if (hits <= 50) {
                console.log(
                    `  raw hit @ ${hex(p)}`
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log(`Total raw hits: ${hits}`);
}

function searchTargetIndex(wasm: Buffer) {
    console.log("");

    b.writeUInt32LE(TARGET_INDEX >>> 0, 0);

    console.log(
        `i32 bytes: ${[...b]
            .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
            .join(" ")}`
    );

    let hits = 0;

    for (let p = 0; p <= wasm.length - 4; p++) {
        if (
            wasm[p] === b[0] &&
            wasm[p + 1] === b[1] &&
            wasm[p + 2] === b[2] &&
            wasm[p + 3] === b[3]
        ) {
            hits++;

            if (hits <= 80) {
                console.log(
                    `  raw hit @ ${hex(p)}`
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log(`Total raw hits: ${hits}`);
}

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");
const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
    s += 7;
  }
}

function sleb(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  while (true) {
    x = b[p++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << s;
    s += 7;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
  }
  if (s < 32 && (x & 0x40)) v |= (~0 << s);
  return { value: v | 0, next: p };
}

function sections() {
  let p = 8, out = [];
  while (p < b.length) {
    const id = b[p++];
    const z = uleb(p);
    p = z.next;
    out.push({ id, start:p, end:p+z.value });
    p += z.value;
  }
  return out;
}

const sec = sections().find(x => x.id === 10);
let p = sec.start;

const n = uleb(p);
p = n.next;

const funcs = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
  const z = uleb(p);
  p = z.next;

  funcs.push({
    func: i + 83,
    start: p,
    end: p + z.value
  });

  p += z.value;
}

function targetConst(q) {
  if (b[q] !== 0x41) return false;
  const x = sleb(q + 1);
  return (x.value >>> 0) === TARGET;
}

function localIndex(q) {
  const x = uleb(q + 1);
  return { index:x.value, next:x.next };
}

  for (let q = fn.start; q < fn.end; q++) {

    if (!targetConst(q)) continue;

    console.log("############################################################");
    console.log(`FUNC ${fn.func}`);
    console.log(
      `TARGET CONST @ 0x${q.toString(16)}`
    );
    console.log("############################################################");

    // inspect next 80 bytes
    let end = Math.min(fn.end, q + 100);

    for (let x = q; x < end; x++) {

      // local.set
      if (b[x] === 0x21) {
        const l = localIndex(x);
        console.log(
          `0x${x.toString(16)}  local.set L${l.index}`
        );
        x = l.next - 1;
        continue;
      }

      // local.tee
      if (b[x] === 0x22) {
        const l = localIndex(x);
        console.log(

        x = l.next - 1;
        continue;
      }

      // local.get
      if (b[x] === 0x20) {

      }

      // i32.store
      if (b[x] === 0x36) {
        const a = uleb(x+1);
        const o = uleb(a.next);

      // i32.load

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const SEG412_ADDR = 0x0018744c;
const SEG412_SIZE = 14145;

const SEG413_ADDR = 0x0018ab98;
const SEG413_SIZE = 18810;

const SEG412_FILE = 0x004a6695;

const TARGETS = [2053, 2101, 2612];

const SEG412_END = SEG412_ADDR + SEG412_SIZE;
const SEG413_END = SEG413_ADDR + SEG413_SIZE;

function u32(p: number): number {
  return (
    (wasm[p] |
      (wasm[p + 1] << 8) |
      (wasm[p + 2] << 16) |
      (wasm[p + 3] << 24)) >>>
    0
  );
}

function hex(n: number): string {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function runtimeToFile(addr: number): number {
  return SEG412_FILE + (addr - SEG412_ADDR);
}

function classify(v: number): string {
  if (v >= SEG412_ADDR && v < SEG412_END) {
    return "SEG412_PTR";
  }

  if (v >= SEG413_ADDR && v < SEG413_END) {
    return "SEG413_PTR";
  }

  if (TARGETS.includes(v)) {
    return "TARGET_INDEX";
  }

  return "";
}

import fs from "fs";

const FILE =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

const SEG412_START = 0x0018744c;
const SEG412_END   = 0x0018ab8d;

const SEG413_START = 0x0018ab98;
const SEG413_END   = 0x0018f512;

const TARGETS = new Map<number, string>([
    [2053, "Function 8952"],
    [2101, "Function 8927"],
    [2612, "Function 8637"]
]);

const ROOTS = [
    0x0018efc4,
    0x0018eec4,
    0x0018ee88,
    0x0018efdc,
    0x0018f068,
    0x0018ef50,
    0x0018ef38,
    0x0018acbc
];

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readU32(addr: number) {
    if (addr < 0 || addr + 4 > memory.length)
        return null;

    return memory.readUInt32LE(addr);
}

/*
 * Locate data section.
 */
let p = 8;
let dataStart = 0;
let dataEnd = 0;

while (p < wasm.length) {

    const id = wasm[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    const start = s.next;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (id === 11) {
        dataStart = start;
        dataEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    p = end;
}

if (!dataStart)
    throw new Error("Data section not found");

/*
 * Build linear memory.
 */
const memory = Buffer.alloc(0x02000000);

p = dataStart;

const count = uleb(p);
p = count.next;

type Segment = {
    id: number;
    start: number;
    size: number;
    fileStart: number;
};

const segments: Segment[] = [];

for (let id = 0; id < count.value; id++) {

    const flags = uleb(p);
    p = flags.next;

    let memStart = 0;

    if (flags.value === 0) {

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x41)
            throw new Error("Expected i32.const");

        const off = uleb(p);
        p = off.next;

        memStart = off.value;

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error("Expected end");

    } else if (flags.value === 2) {

        const memidx = uleb(p);
        p = memidx.next;

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x41)
            throw new Error("Expected i32.const");

        const off = uleb(p);
        p = off.next;

        memStart = off.value;

        if (wasm[p++] !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error("Expected end");

    } else if (flags.value === 1) {

        const sz = uleb(p);
        p = sz.next + sz.value;

        continue;

    } else {
        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported data flags ${flags.value}`
        );
    }

    const sz = uleb(p);
    p = sz.next;

    const fileStart = p;

    if (memStart + sz.value <= memory.length) {

        wasm.copy(
            memory,
            memStart,
            fileStart,
            fileStart + sz.value
        );
    }

    segments.push({
        id,
        start: memStart,
        size: sz.value,
        fileStart
    });

    p += sz.value;
}

function segmentOf(addr: number) {

    return segments.find(
        s =>
            addr >= s.start &&
            addr < s.start + s.size
    );
}

            !TARGETS.has(value)

        /*

        if (!seg)

import fs from "fs";

function hx(n: number, w = 8): string {
    return n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function uleb(n: number): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];

    while (n >= 0x80) {
        out.push((n & 0x7f) | 0x80);
        n >>>= 7;
    }

    out.push(n);
    return out;
}

function findAll(buf: Buffer, pattern: Buffer): number[] {
    const hits: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i <= buf.length - pattern.length; i++) {
        let ok = true;

        for (let j = 0; j < pattern.length; j++) {
            if (buf[i + j] !== pattern[j]) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (ok) hits.push(i);
    }

    return hits;
}

function dump(buf: Buffer, pos: number, radius = 96) {
    const start = Math.max(0, pos - radius);
    const end = Math.min(buf.length, pos + radius + 16);

    console.log(
        `\n--- context @ 0x${hx(pos)} ---`
    );

    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < 16 && p + j < end; j++) {
            bytes.push(
                buf[p + j].toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
            );
        }

        console.log(
            `0x${hx(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
        );
    }
}

function isFunctionBodyStart(buf: Buffer, pos: number): boolean {
    // Typical beginning of a WASM function body:
    // local decl count followed by local declarations.
    //
    // We don't assume this is definitive. This helper only
    // detects nearby structural candidates.

    if (pos < 1 || pos >= buf.length) return false;

    const b = buf[pos];

    return (
        b === 0x00 ||
        b === 0x01 ||
        b === 0x02 ||
        b === 0x03 ||
        b === 0x04 ||
        b === 0x05 ||
        b === 0x06 ||
        b === 0x07 ||
        b === 0x08
    );
}

function findNearestFunctionLikeStart(
    buf: Buffer,
    pos: number,
    maxBack = 4096
): number {
    const start = Math.max(0, pos - maxBack);

    for (let p = pos - 1; p >= start; p--) {
        // Function bodies frequently contain:
        // local declaration vector followed by local types.
        //
        // This is only a candidate marker.
        if (buf[p] === 0x00 && p + 1 < buf.length) {
            const next = buf[p + 1];

            if (
                next === 0x0b ||
                next === 0x20 ||
                next === 0x41 ||
                next === 0x02 ||
                next === 0x03 ||
                next === 0x04
            ) {
                return p;
            }
        }
    }

    return start;
}

import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

function u32le(buf: Buffer, p: number): number {
    if (p < 0 || p + 4 > buf.length) return 0;
    return (
        buf[p] |
        (buf[p + 1] << 8) |
        (buf[p + 2] << 16) |
        (buf[p + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function hex(n: number, width = 8): string {
    return n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function dump(buf: Buffer, pos: number, radius = 48) {
    const start = Math.max(0, pos - radius);
    const end = Math.min(buf.length, pos + radius + 16);

    console.log(
        `\n--- hit file=0x${hex(pos)} (${pos}) range=0x${hex(start)}..0x${hex(end)} ---`
    );

    for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
        const bytes: string[] = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < 16 && p + j < end; j++) {
            bytes.push(buf[p + j].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
        }

        console.log(
            `${hex(p)}  ${bytes.join(" ")}`
        );
    }
}

function findAll(buf: Buffer, pattern: Buffer): number[] {
    const hits: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i <= buf.length - pattern.length; i++) {
        let ok = true;

        for (let j = 0; j < pattern.length; j++) {
            if (buf[i + j] !== pattern[j]) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (ok) hits.push(i);
    }

    return hits;
}

function p32(n: number): Buffer {
    const b = Buffer.alloc(4);
    b.writeUInt32LE(n >>> 0, 0);
    return b;
}

function p16(n: number): Buffer {
    const b = Buffer.alloc(2);
    b.writeUInt16LE(n & 0xffff, 0);
    return b;
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGET = 0x19534c;

function uleb(pos) {
    let v = 0, shift = 0, p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) return { value: v, next: p };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hx(v) {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

                                `offset=${hx(o.value)}`

                        }

        shift += 7;

        b === 0x20 ? "local.get" :
        b === 0x21 ? "local.set" :
        "local.tee";

      extra = ` ${name} local=${value >>> 0}`;
    }

    // call
    if (b === 0x10) {
      let q = p + 1;
      let value = 0;
      let shift = 0;

      while (q < to) {
        const x = wasm[q++];
        value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
        if (!(x & 0x80)) break;
        shift += 7;
      }

      extra = ` call func=${value >>> 0}`;
    }

    // i32.store / i64.store / etc.
    if (b >= 0x36 && b <= 0x3e) {
      extra = " MEMORY_STORE";
    }

    // comparison
    if (b >= 0x45 && b <= 0x5f) {
      extra = " COMPARISON";
    }

    console.log(

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

let p = 8;

function u(): number {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x: number;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return v >>> 0;
}

let codeStart = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const size = u();
  const end = p + size;

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = p;
    break;
  }

  p = end;
}

p = codeStart;
const count = u();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TRACE TYPE-1 INDIRECT SELECTORS");
console.log("TARGET TABLE INDEX : 5311");
console.log("TARGET FUNC        : 6618");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (let f = 0; f < count; f++) {
  const bodySize = u();
  const bodyStart = p;
  const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

  const groups = u();

  for (let g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
    u();
    p++;
  }

  const vals: string[] = [];

  while (p < bodyEnd) {
    const pos = p;
    const op = b[p++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const v = u();
      vals.push(`CONST(${v})`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const l = u();
      vals.push(`L${l}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const l = u();
      vals.push(`TEE${l}`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28) {
      u();
      const off = u();
      vals.push(`LOAD(+${off})`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const fn = u();
      vals.push(`CALL(${fn})`);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x11) {
      const type = u();
      const table = u();

      if (type === 1 && table === 0) {
        console.log("");
        console.log(
          `FUNC ${f + 91} @ 0x${pos.toString(16)}`
        );
        console.log("STACK TAIL:");
        console.log(
          vals.slice(-12).join(" -> ")
        );
      }

      vals.length = Math.max(0, vals.length - 2);
      continue;
    }

    // common instructions which consume stack values
    if (
      op === 0x6a || // add
      op === 0x6b || // sub
      op === 0x6c || // mul
      op === 0x47 || // lt_u
      op === 0x46 || // eq
      op === 0x45    // eqz
    ) {
      vals.pop();
      vals.pop();
      vals.push("OP");
      continue;
    }

    // memory stores
    if (
      op === 0x36 ||
      op === 0x37 ||
      op === 0x3a ||
      op === 0x3b
    ) {
      u();
      u();
      vals.pop();
      vals.pop();
      continue;
    }

    // branches / blocks
    if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04
    ) {
      p++;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
      u();
      continue;
    }

    // local.set
    if (op === 0x21) {
      const l = u();
      vals.pop();
      continue;
    }

    // drop
    if (op === 0x1a) {
      vals.pop();
      continue;
    }

    // other constants
    if (op === 0x42) {
      u();
      vals.push("I64CONST");
      continue;
    }
  }

  p = bodyEnd;
}
