import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = new Set([
    0x195350,
    0x195351,
    0x195352,
    0x195353,
    0x195354,
    0x195355,
    0x195356,
    0x195357,
]);

const TARGET_START = 0x195350;
const TARGET_END = 0x195358;

const STORE_OPS = new Set([
    0x36, // i32.store
    0x37, // i64.store
    0x38, // f32.store
    0x39, // f64.store
    0x3a, // i32.store8
    0x3b, // i32.store16
    0x3c, // i64.store8
    0x3d, // i64.store16
    0x3e, // i64.store32
]);

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function sleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
        value |= ~0 << shift;
    }

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: p
    };
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function section(id: number) {

    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {

        const sid = wasm[p++];

        const size = uleb(p);
        p = size.next;

        if (sid === id) {
            return {
                start: p,
                end: p + size.value
            };
        }

        p += size.value;
    }

    throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

const IMPORTED = 83;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FUNCTION SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const funcSec = section(3);

let fp = funcSec.start;

const fc = uleb(fp);
fp = fc.next;

const functionTypes: number[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
    const x = uleb(fp);
    fp = x.next;
    functionTypes.push(x.value);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// CODE SECTION
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const codeSec = section(10);

let cp = codeSec.start;

const bc = uleb(cp);
cp = bc.next;

interface Body {
    func: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    instrStart: number;
}

const bodies: Body[] = [];

for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < bc.value; ordinal++) {

    const size = uleb(cp);
    cp = size.next;

    const start = cp;
    const end = cp + size.value;

    let p = start;

    const localDecls = uleb(p);
    p = localDecls.next;

    for (let i = 0; i < localDecls.value; i++) {

        const count = uleb(p);
        p = count.next;

        // valtype
        p++;
    }

    bodies.push({
        func: IMPORTED + ordinal,
        start,
        end,
        instrStart: p
    });

    cp = end;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// VALUE
// ------------------------------------------------------------

type Value =
    | { kind: "const"; value: number; origin: number }
    | { kind: "local"; index: number; origin: number }
    | { kind: "global"; index: number; origin: number }
    | { kind: "expr"; text: string; origin: number }
    | { kind: "unknown"; origin: number };

function unknown(origin: number): Value {
    return {
        kind: "unknown",
        origin
    };
}

function describe(v: Value): string {

    switch (v.kind) {

        case "const":
            return `CONST(${hex(v.value)})`;

        case "local":
            return `LOCAL(${v.index})`;

        case "global":
            return `GLOBAL(${v.index})`;

        case "expr":
            return v.text;

        default:
            return "UNKNOWN";
    }
}

function isConst(v: Value): v is Extract<Value, {kind: "const"}> {
    return v.kind === "const";
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// INTERESTING CONSTANT PAIRS
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const interesting: {
    value: number;
    func: number;
    offset: number;
}[] = [];

let arithmeticMatches = 0;
let exactStores = 0;
let literalStoreValues = 0;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// SCAN
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("TRACE SELECTOR ADDRESS ARITHMETIC");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

console.log(
    `TARGET = ${hex(TARGET_START)} .. ${hex(TARGET_END - 1)}`
);

console.log(
    "LOOKING FOR: CONST + ADD/SUB -> STORE ADDRESS"
);

console.log("");

for (const body of bodies) {

    let p = body.instrStart;

    const stack: Value[] = [];

    const locals = new Map<number, Value>();

    function pop(): Value {
        return stack.length
            ? stack.pop()!
            : unknown(p);
    }

    function push(v: Value) {
        stack.push(v);
    }

    while (p < body.end) {

        const opOffset = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i32.const
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x41) {

            const x = sleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            const value = x.value >>> 0;

            push({
                kind: "const",
                value,
                origin: opOffset
            });

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // local.get
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x20) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            push(
                locals.get(x.value) ?? {
                    kind: "local",
                    index: x.value,
                    origin: opOffset
                }
            );

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // local.set
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x21) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            locals.set(x.value, pop());

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // local.tee
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x22) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            const v = stack.length
                ? stack[stack.length - 1]
                : unknown(opOffset);

            locals.set(x.value, v);

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // global.get
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x23) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            push({
                kind: "global",
                index: x.value,
                origin: opOffset
            });

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i32.add
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x6a) {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            if (isConst(a) && isConst(b)) {

                push({
                    kind: "const",
                    value: (a.value + b.value) >>> 0,
                    origin: opOffset
                });

            } else {

                push({
                    kind: "expr",
                    text: `(${describe(a)} + ${describe(b)})`,
                    origin: opOffset
                });
            }

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i32.sub
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x6b) {

            const b = pop();
            const a = pop();

            if (isConst(a) && isConst(b)) {

                push({
                    kind: "const",
                    value: (a.value - b.value) >>> 0,
                    origin: opOffset
                });

            } else {

                push({
                    kind: "expr",
                    text: `(${describe(a)} - ${describe(b)})`,
                    origin: opOffset
                });
            }

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // LOAD
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) {

            const align = uleb(p);
            p = align.next;

            const off = uleb(p);
            p = off.next;

            const address = pop();

            // A load destroys the exact value provenance.
            push(
                unknown(opOffset)
            );

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // STORE
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (STORE_OPS.has(op)) {

            const align = uleb(p);
            p = align.next;

            const memOffset = uleb(p);
            p = memOffset.next;

            const value = pop();
            const address = pop();

            // -----------------------------------------------
            // CASE 1: EXACT CONSTANT ADDRESS
            // -----------------------------------------------

            if (isConst(address)) {

                const effective =
                    (address.value + memOffset.value) >>> 0;

                if (
                    effective >= TARGET_START &&
                    effective < TARGET_END
                ) {

                    exactStores++;

                    console.log("");
                    console.log("============================================================");
                    console.log("EXACT ARITHMETIC TARGET STORE");
                    console.log("============================================================");

                    console.log(
                        `FUNC       = ${body.func}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `STORE      = ${hex(opOffset)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `BASE       = ${hex(address.value)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `MEM OFFSET = ${hex(memOffset.value)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `EFFECTIVE  = ${hex(effective)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `VALUE      = ${describe(value)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `VALUE SRC  = ${hex(value.origin)}`
                    );

                    console.log("");
                }
            }

            // -----------------------------------------------
            // CASE 2: symbolic arithmetic expression
            // -----------------------------------------------

            if (
                address.kind === "expr" &&
                (
                    address.text.includes("0x001953") ||
                    address.text.includes("LOCAL") ||
                    address.text.includes("GLOBAL")
                )
            ) {

                arithmeticMatches++;

                console.log("");
                console.log("POTENTIAL SYMBOLIC STORE");
                console.log("--------------------------------------------");
                console.log(
                    `FUNC       = ${body.func}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `STORE      = ${hex(opOffset)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `ADDRESS    = ${describe(address)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `OFFSET     = ${hex(memOffset.value)}`
                );
                console.log(
                    `VALUE      = ${describe(value)}`
                );
                console.log("");
            }

            // -----------------------------------------------
            // CASE 3: literal selector value being stored
            // -----------------------------------------------

            if (
                isConst(value) &&
                (
                    value.value === 4789 ||
                    value.value === 4790
                )
            ) {

                literalStoreValues++;

                console.log("");
                console.log("============================================================");
                console.log("SELECTOR VALUE STORE");
                console.log("============================================================");

                console.log(
                    `FUNC       = ${body.func}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `STORE      = ${hex(opOffset)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `ADDRESS    = ${describe(address)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `OFFSET     = ${hex(memOffset.value)}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `VALUE      = ${value.value}`
                );

                console.log("");
            }

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // CALL
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x10) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            // Unknown signature.
            stack.length = 0;

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // CALL INDIRECT
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x11) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            // table index immediate
            p++;

            stack.length = 0;

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // DROP
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x1a) {

            pop();

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // SELECT
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x1b) {

            pop();
            pop();
            pop();

            push(
                unknown(opOffset)
            );

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // BRANCH / CONTROL
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03) {

            const blockType = wasm[p++];

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x04) {

            const blockType = wasm[p++];

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0e) {

            const n = uleb(p);
            p = n.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < n.value + 1; i++) {
                const x = uleb(p);
                p = x.next;
            }

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // COMPARISONS
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            op === 0x45 ||
            op === 0x46 ||
            op === 0x47 ||
            op === 0x48 ||
            op === 0x49 ||
            op === 0x4a ||
            op === 0x4b ||
            op === 0x4c ||
            op === 0x4d ||
            op === 0x4e ||
            op === 0x4f
        ) {

            if (op === 0x45) {
                pop();
            } else {
                pop();
                pop();
            }

            push(
                unknown(opOffset)
            );

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i32 unary
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            op === 0x67 ||
            op === 0x68 ||
            op === 0x69
        ) {

            pop();

            push(
                unknown(opOffset)
            );

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // i32 binary arithmetic
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (
            op >= 0x6c &&
            op <= 0x78
        ) {

            pop();
            pop();

            push(
                unknown(opOffset)
            );

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // MEMORY SIZE / GROW
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x3f || op === 0x40) {

            p++;

            push(
                unknown(opOffset)
            );

            continue;
        }

        // ----------------------------------------------------
        // MISC PREFIXES
        // ----------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0xfc || op === 0xfd) {

            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            // Conservative reset.
            stack.length = 0;

            continue;
        }
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// FINAL
// ------------------------------------------------------------

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL CLASSIFICATION");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(
    `EXACT TARGET STORES             = ${exactStores}`
);

console.log(
    `SYMBOLIC ADDRESS CANDIDATES     = ${arithmeticMatches}`
);

console.log(
    `LITERAL 4789/4790 VALUE STORES  = ${literalStoreValues}`
);

console.log("");

if (exactStores === 0) {

    console.log(
        "NO ARITHMETICALLY RESOLVED STORE TO 0x195350..0x195357."
    );
}

if (literalStoreValues === 0) {

    console.log(

    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_FUNCS = new Set([480, 1907, 6908]);

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
    return "0x" + (n >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let byte = 0;

    while (true) {
        byte = wasm[pos++];
        value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((byte & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos,
    };
}

function readBlockType(pos: number) {
    const b = wasm[pos];

    if (b === 0x40)
        return { next: pos + 1 };

    if (
        b === 0x7f ||
        b === 0x7e ||
        b === 0x7d ||
        b === 0x7c
    ) {
        return { next: pos + 1 };
    }

    return readSLEB(pos);
}

function parseCodeSection() {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const id = wasm[p++];

        const size = readULEB(p);
        p = size.next;

        const sectionStart = p;
        const sectionEnd = p + size.value;

        if (id !== 10) {
            p = sectionEnd;
            continue;
        }

        const count = readULEB(p);
        p = count.next;

        const bodies: {
            ordinal: number;
            start: number;
            end: number;
            codeStart: number;
        }[] = [];

        for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count.value; ordinal++) {
            const bodySize = readULEB(p);
            p = bodySize.next;

            const start = p;
            const end = start + bodySize.value;

            const localCount = readULEB(p);
            p = localCount.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < localCount.value; i++) {
                const n = readULEB(p);
                p = n.next;

                p += 1;
            }

            bodies.push({
                ordinal,
                start,
                end,
                codeStart: p,
            });

            p = end;
        }

        return {
            start: sectionStart,
            end: sectionEnd,
            bodies,
        };
    }

    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

const code = parseCodeSection();

console.log("TRACE SELECTOR BULK CALLERS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`CODE SECTION = ${hex(code.start)} .. ${hex(code.end)}`);
console.log(`CODE BODIES  = ${code.bodies.length}`);
console.log("");
console.log("TARGET BULK FUNCTIONS");
console.log("  FUNC480");
console.log("  FUNC1907");
console.log("  FUNC6908");
console.log("============================================================");

let totalCalls = 0;

for (const body of code.bodies) {
    let p = body.codeStart;

    while (p < body.end) {
        const pc = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        // END
        if (op === 0x0b)
            break;

        // BLOCK / LOOP / IF
        if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04) {
            p = readBlockType(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // ELSE
        if (op === 0x05)
            continue;

        // BR / BR_IF
        if (op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // BR_TABLE
        if (op === 0x0e) {
            const n = readULEB(p);
            p = n.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++)
                p = readULEB(p).next;

            p = readULEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // RETURN
        if (op === 0x0f)
            continue;

        // CALL
        if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            if (TARGET_FUNCS.has(r.value)) {
                totalCalls++;

                console.log("");
                console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
                console.log("DIRECT CALL TO BULK FUNCTION");
                console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
                console.log(`CALLER FUNC = ${body.ordinal}`);
                console.log(`CALL PC     = ${hex(pc)}`);
                console.log(`TARGET FUNC = ${r.value}`);
                console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
            }

            continue;
        }

        // CALL_INDIRECT
        if (op === 0x11) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // LOCAL GET/SET/TEE
        if (
            op === 0x20 ||
            op === 0x21 ||
            op === 0x22
        ) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // GLOBAL GET/SET
        if (
            op === 0x23 ||
            op === 0x24
        ) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // I32 CONST
        if (op === 0x41) {
            p = readSLEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // I64 CONST
        if (op === 0x42) {
            p = readSLEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // Memory loads
        if (
            op >= 0x28 &&
            op <= 0x35
        ) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // Memory stores
        if (
            op >= 0x36 &&
            op <= 0x3e
        ) {
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            p = readULEB(p).next;
            continue;
        }

        // memory.size / memory.grow
        if (
            op === 0x3f ||
            op === 0x40
        ) {
            p += 1;
            continue;
        }

        // Most numeric instructions have no immediates.
    }
}

console.log("");

console.log("FINAL SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`DIRECT CALLS FOUND = ${totalCalls}`);

console.log("");

console.log("============================================================");

for (const body of code.bodies) {
    if (!TARGET_FUNCS.has(body.ordinal))
        continue;

    console.log(

    );
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const funcs = [6464, 6611, 6613, 6615, 6618, 7467, 7579];

const selectors = new Set([4788, 4789, 4790, 4791]);

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, p = pos;
  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }
  return { value: v >>> 0, next: p };
}

function hex(v: number) {
  return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SELECTOR CONSTANT / TABLE-INDEX TRACE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const f of funcs) {
  console.log(`\nFUNC ${f}`);
  console.log("--------------------------------------------");

  /*
   * Search raw function-code area for:
   *   i32.const selector
   *   i32.const 4788..4791
   *
   * This is intentionally conservative:
   * we are looking for literal selector values near
   * calls to FUNC 113.
   */

  let hits = 0;

  for (let p = 0; p < wasm.length - 5; p++) {
    if (wasm[p] !== 0x41) continue;

    const x = uleb(p + 1);

    if (selectors.has(x.value)) {
      console.log(
        `CONST SELECTOR ${x.value} (${hex(x.value)}) @ ${hex(p)}`
      );
      hits++;
    }
  }

  if (!hits) {
    console.log("NO LITERAL SELECTOR CONSTANTS FOUND");
  }
}

  );

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [
  { f: 6611, call: 0x22c948, local: 6 },
  { f: 6611, call: 0x22c9ef, local: 2 },
  { f: 6613, call: 0x22cb34, local: 2 },
  { f: 6615, call: 0x22cc55, local: 1 },
  { f: 6615, call: 0x22cc5e, local: 1 },
  { f: 6618, call: 0x22d083, local: 1 },
  { f: 6464, call: 0x22838e, local: 11 },
];

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, shift = 0, n = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    n++;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }
  return { v: v >>> 0, n };
}

function skip(p: number): number {
  const op = wasm[p];

  if ([0x20,0x21,0x22,0x0c,0x0d,0x10,0x41].includes(op))
    return 1 + uleb(p + 1).n;

  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
    const a = uleb(p + 1);
    const b = uleb(p + 1 + a.n);
    return 1 + a.n + b.n;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) return 3;

  return 1;
}

function findBodies() {
  const bodies: { f:number, start:number, end:number }[] = [];

  // Find all function-body starts using known code section structure.
  // Code section starts at 0x5ae, body data starts after count.
  let p = 0x5ae;

  const sectionId = wasm[p];
  if (sectionId !== 3) throw new Error("FUNCTION SECTION NOT FOUND");

  const secSize = uleb(p + 1);
  let q = p + 1 + secSize.n + secSize.v;

  // Function section gives type indices; skip it.
  const count = uleb(q);
  q += count.n;

  // Code section search.
  for (let i = 0; i < wasm.length - 5; i++) {
    if (wasm[i] === 10) {
      const s = uleb(i + 1);
      const start = i + 1 + s.n;
      const c = uleb(start);
      if (c.v === 9398) {
        p = start + c.n;
        for (let f = 0; f < 9398; f++) {
          const bs = uleb(p);
          const bodyStart = p + bs.n;
          bodies.push({
            f: f + 83,
            start: bodyStart,
            end: bodyStart + bs.v
          });
          p = bodyStart + bs.v;
        }
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  return bodies;
}

const bodies = findBodies();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("EXACT SELECTOR LOCAL DEFINITIONS");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const t of TARGETS) {
  const body = bodies.find(x => x.f === t.f);
  if (!body) continue;

  console.log(`\nFUNC ${t.f}  CALL113 @ 0x${t.call.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`TARGET LOCAL = ${t.local}`);
  console.log("--------------------------------------------");

  let p = body.start;

  while (p < Math.min(body.end, t.call)) {
    const op = wasm[p];

    if (op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);

      if (x.v === t.local) {
        console.log(`\nDEF @ 0x${p.toString(16)}`);

        const s = Math.max(body.start, p - 20);
        let z = s;

        while (z < Math.min(body.end, p + 25)) {
          const o = wasm[z];

          if (o === 0x20) {
            const a = uleb(z + 1);
            console.log(`  0x${z.toString(16)} local.get ${a.v}`);
            z += 1 + a.n;
          } else if (o === 0x41) {
            const a = uleb(z + 1);
            console.log(
              `  0x${z.toString(16)} i32.const ${a.v} (0x${a.v.toString(16)})`
            );
            z += 1 + a.n;
          } else if (o === 0x21 || o === 0x22) {
            const a = uleb(z + 1);
            console.log(
              `  0x${z.toString(16)} ${o === 0x21 ? "local.set" : "local.tee"} ${a.v}`
            );
            z += 1 + a.n;
          } else if (o >= 0x28 && o <= 0x3e) {
            const a = uleb(z + 1);
            const b = uleb(z + 1 + a.n);
            console.log(
              `  0x${z.toString(16)} memop 0x${o.toString(16)} offset=${b.v}`
            );
            z += 1 + a.n + b.n;
          } else {
            const names: Record<number,string> = {
              0x6a:"i32.add",
              0x6b:"i32.sub",
              0x6c:"i32.mul",
              0x71:"i32.and",
              0x72:"i32.or",
              0x73:"i32.xor",
              0x74:"i32.shl",
              0x75:"i32.shr_s",
              0x76:"i32.shr_u"
            };
            console.log(`  0x${z.toString(16)} ${names[o] ?? `opcode 0x${o.toString(16)}`}`);
            z++;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    p += skip(p);
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = new Set([6464, 6611, 6613, 6615, 6618, 7467, 7579]);

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    shift += 7;
  }

  return { value, next: p };
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

// Parse WASM sections and obtain exact function body ranges.
function getCodeSection() {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const id = wasm[p++];
    const s = readULEB(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + s.value;

    if (id === 10) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

function getDefinedFunctionBodies() {
  const code = getCodeSection();

  let p = code.start;
  const count = readULEB(p);
  p = count.next;

  const bodies: { func: number; start: number; end: number }[] = [];

  // Defined function #0 corresponds to global function index 83.
  const FIRST_DEFINED = 83;

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const s = readULEB(p);
    p = s.next;

    const bodyStart = p;
    const bodyEnd = p + s.value;

    const func = FIRST_DEFINED + i;

    if (TARGETS.has(func)) {
      bodies.push({
        func,
        start: bodyStart,
        end: bodyEnd
      });
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
  }

  return bodies;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SELECTOR TRACE INSIDE EXACT FUNCTION BODIES");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

const bodies = getDefinedFunctionBodies();

for (const f of bodies) {
  console.log(`\nFUNC ${f.func}`);
  console.log(`BODY : ${hex(f.start)} .. ${hex(f.end)}`);
  console.log("--------------------------------------------");

  let hits = 0;

  for (let p = f.start; p < f.end; p++) {

    // i32.const
    if (wasm[p] === 0x41) {
      const x = readULEB(p + 1);

      if (
        x.value === 4788 ||
        x.value === 4789 ||
        x.value === 4790 ||
        x.value === 4791
      ) {
        console.log(
          `${hex(p)}  i32.const ${x.value} (${hex(x.value)})`
        );
        hits++;
      }
    }

    // call
    if (wasm[p] === 0x10) {
      const x = readULEB(p + 1);

      if (x.value === 113) {
        console.log(
          `${hex(p)}  CALL 113`
        );
        hits++;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!hits) {
    console.log("NO TARGET SELECTOR / CALL113");
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x001226d;
const END   = 0x001295b;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 122 - LOAD / SELECTOR DATAFLOW");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

const names: Record<number, string> = {
  0x28: "i32.load",
  0x29: "i64.load",
  0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
  0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
  0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
  0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
};

for (let p = START; p < END; p++) {
  const op = wasm[p];

  if (!(op in names)) continue;

  let q = p + 1;

  // memarg alignment
  let shift = 0;
  while (q < END) {
    const b = wasm[q++];
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    if (++shift > 5) break;
  }

  // memarg offset
  let offset = 0;
  shift = 0;

  while (q < END) {
    const b = wasm[q++];
    offset |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;
    shift += 7;
    if (shift > 35) break;
  }

  const from = Math.max(START, p - 12);
  const to = Math.min(END, q + 12);

  const raw = [...wasm.subarray(from, to)]
    .map(x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join(" ");

  console.log("");
  console.log(`OFFSET : 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`OPCODE : 0x${op.toString(16)} ${names[op]}`);
  console.log(`ALIGN  : ${shift}`);
  console.log(`OFFSET : 0x${(offset >>> 0).toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`RAW    : ${raw}`);
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGETS = new Set([5220, 5232, 5235]);
const DATA_START = 0x324ef9;

function u32(p) {
  return (
    b[p] |
    (b[p + 1] << 8) |
    (b[p + 2] << 16) |
    (b[p + 3] << 24)
  ) >>> 0;
}

  const v = u32(p);

  if (!TARGETS.has(v)) continue;

  console.log(
    `\nSELECTOR ${v} @ FILE 0x${p.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}`
  );

  const start = Math.max(DATA_START, p - 32);
  const end = Math.min(DATA_END, p + 36);

  for (let q = start; q < end; q += 4) {
    const x = u32(q);

    console.log(
      `  FILE 0x${q.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")} ` +
      `VALUE ${x} 0x${x.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")}`
    );
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [
    0x19534c,
    0x195350,
    0x195354,
    0x195358,
    0x195490,
    0x195494,
    0x1954a0,
    0x1954a4,
    0x1954b0,
    0x1954b4
];

function uleb(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v: number) {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readI32(pos: number) {
    return (
        wasm[pos] |
        (wasm[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

        hex(t),
        "=",
        readI32(t)
    );
}

    /*
     * Scan raw bytes for little-endian target addresses.

    for (let at = bodyStart; at + 4 <= bodyEnd; at++) {

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGET_START = 0x0019534c;
const TARGET_END = 0x0019535b;

const bytes = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number, w = 8) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(w, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    if (pos >= bytes.length) {
      throw new Error("ULEB out of bounds");
    }

    const b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos,
      };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB too large");
    }
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let b = 0;

  while (true) {
    if (pos >= bytes.length) {
      throw new Error("SLEB out of bounds");
    }

    b = bytes[pos++];

    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      break;
    }

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("SLEB too large");
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= ~0 << shift;
  }

  return {
    value: value | 0,
    next: pos,
  };
}

function readBytes(pos: number, count: number) {
  return bytes.subarray(pos, pos + count);
}

function overlaps(
  start: number,
  size: number,
  targetStart = TARGET_START,
  targetEnd = TARGET_END
) {
  if (size <= 0) return false;

  const end = start + size - 1;

  return start <= targetEnd && end >= targetStart;
}

function hexBytes(data: Uint8Array, max = 32) {
  const n = Math.min(data.length, max);

  const out: string[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    out.push(data[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0"));
  }

  return out.join(" ");
}

console.log("TRACE SELECTOR MEMORY INIT");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET MEMORY RANGE");
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
console.log(`START : ${hex(TARGET_START)}`);
console.log(`END   : ${hex(TARGET_END)}`);
console.log(`SIZE  : ${TARGET_END - TARGET_START + 1} bytes`);
console.log("============================================================");

if (
  bytes[0] !== 0x00 ||
  bytes[1] !== 0x61 ||
  bytes[2] !== 0x73 ||
  bytes[3] !== 0x6d
) {
  throw new Error("Not a WASM binary");
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * PASS 1
 * Parse Data Section.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

interface DataSegment {
  index: number;
  mode: "active" | "passive";
  memoryIndex: number | null;
  offset: number | null;
  dataStart: number;
  dataSize: number;
  dataEnd: number;
}

const dataSegments: DataSegment[] = [];

let sectionPos = 8;

while (sectionPos < bytes.length) {
  const sectionId = bytes[sectionPos++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(sectionPos);
  const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;

  sectionPos = sizeInfo.next;

  const sectionStart = sectionPos;
  const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sectionSize;

  if (sectionEnd > bytes.length) {
    throw new Error(
      `Section extends beyond file: ${hex(sectionStart)}`
    );
  }

  /*
   * Data section = 11
   */
  if (sectionId === 11) {
    const countInfo = readULEB(sectionPos);
    const count = countInfo.value;

    let p = countInfo.next;

    console.log("");
    console.log("DATA SECTION");
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log(`DATA SEGMENT COUNT = ${count}`);

    for (let index = 0; index < count; index++) {
      const flagsInfo = readULEB(p);
      const flags = flagsInfo.value;

      p = flagsInfo.next;

      let mode: "active" | "passive";
      let memoryIndex: number | null = null;
      let offset: number | null = null;

      if (flags === 0) {
        /*
         * Active segment, implicit memory 0.
         * offset expression follows.
         */
        mode = "active";
        memoryIndex = 0;

        /*
         * Expected form:
         *
         *   i32.const <offset>
         *   end
         */
        const op = bytes[p++];

        if (op !== 0x41) {
          throw new Error(
            `Unexpected data offset opcode at ${hex(p - 1)}: ${hex(
              op,
              2
            )}`
          );
        }

        const off = readSLEB(p);
        offset = off.value >>> 0;
        p = off.next;

        if (bytes[p++] !== 0x0b) {
          throw new Error(
            `Missing end opcode for data segment ${index}`
          );
        }
      } else if (flags === 1) {
        /*
         * Passive data segment.
         */
        mode = "passive";
      } else if (flags === 2) {
        /*
         * Active segment with explicit memory index.
         */
        mode = "active";

        const mem = readULEB(p);
        memoryIndex = mem.value;
        p = mem.next;

        const op = bytes[p++];

        if (op !== 0x41) {
          throw new Error(
            `Unexpected explicit data offset opcode at ${hex(
              p - 1
            )}: ${hex(op, 2)}`
          );
        }

        const off = readSLEB(p);
        offset = off.value >>> 0;
        p = off.next;

        if (bytes[p++] !== 0x0b) {
          throw new Error(
            `Missing end opcode for data segment ${index}`
          );
        }
      } else {
        throw new Error(
          `Unknown data segment flags ${flags} at ${hex(p)}`
        );
      }

      const sizeInfo2 = readULEB(p);
      const dataSize = sizeInfo2.value;
      p = sizeInfo2.next;

      const dataStart = p;
      const dataEnd = dataStart + dataSize;

      const seg: DataSegment = {
        index,
        mode,
        memoryIndex,
        offset,
        dataStart,
        dataSize,
        dataEnd,
      };

      dataSegments.push(seg);

      if (
        mode === "active" &&
        offset !== null &&
        overlaps(offset, dataSize)
      ) {
        console.log("");
        console.log(
          `*** TARGET-OVERLAPPING ACTIVE DATA SEGMENT ***`
        );
        console.log(`SEGMENT       = ${index}`);
        console.log(`MODE          = ACTIVE`);
        console.log(`MEMORY INDEX  = ${memoryIndex}`);
        console.log(`OFFSET        = ${hex(offset)}`);
        console.log(`SIZE          = ${dataSize}`);
        console.log(`END           = ${hex(offset + dataSize - 1)}`);
        console.log(
          `DATA FILE POS  = ${hex(dataStart)} .. ${hex(dataEnd - 1)}`
        );

        const shown = readBytes(dataStart, dataSize);

        console.log(`DATA          = ${hexBytes(shown, 64)}`);

        const targetOffset = Math.max(
          TARGET_START - offset,
          0
        );

        const targetEndOffset = Math.min(
          TARGET_END - offset,
          dataSize - 1
        );

        if (
          targetOffset <= targetEndOffset &&
          targetOffset >= 0
        ) {
          const targetBytes = shown.subarray(
            targetOffset,
            targetEndOffset + 1
          );

          console.log(
            `TARGET BYTES  = ${hexBytes(targetBytes, 64)}`
          );
        }
      }

      p = dataEnd;
    }

    console.log("");
    console.log("DATA SEGMENT SCAN COMPLETE");
  }

  sectionPos = sectionEnd;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * PASS 2
 * Scan code for:
 *
 *   memory.init
 *   memory.copy
 *   memory.fill
 *   data.drop
 *
 * Bulk memory instructions are encoded under 0xfc.
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("BULK MEMORY INSTRUCTION SCAN");
console.log("============================================================");

let memoryInitCount = 0;
let memoryCopyCount = 0;
let memoryFillCount = 0;
let dataDropCount = 0;

let bulkHits = 0;

interface BodyInfo {
  ordinal: number;
  bodyStart: number;
  bodyEnd: number;
  instrStart: number;
}

const bodies: BodyInfo[] = [];

sectionPos = 8;

while (sectionPos < bytes.length) {
  const sectionId = bytes[sectionPos++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(sectionPos);
  const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;

  sectionPos = sizeInfo.next;

  const sectionStart = sectionPos;
  const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sectionSize;

  if (sectionId === 10) {
    const countInfo = readULEB(sectionPos);
    const count = countInfo.value;

    let p = countInfo.next;

    for (let ordinal = 0; ordinal < count; ordinal++) {
      const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(p);
      const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;

      p = bodySizeInfo.next;

      const bodyStart = p;
      const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

      const localDeclInfo = readULEB(p);
      const localDeclCount = localDeclInfo.value;

      p = localDeclInfo.next;

      for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
        const n = readULEB(p);
        p = n.next;

        /*
         * local type
         */
        p += 1;
      }

      bodies.push({
        ordinal,
        bodyStart,
        bodyEnd,
        instrStart: p,
      });

      p = bodyEnd;
    }
  }

  sectionPos = sectionEnd;
}

/*
 * We need a lightweight constant stack only for bulk-memory
 * destination/length arguments.
 *
 * memory.fill:
 *     dst, value, len
 *
 * memory.copy:
 *     dst, src, len
 *
 * memory.init:
 *     dst, src, len
 *
 * For target detection, the destination is the important value.
 */

function scanBody(body: BodyInfo) {
  let p = body.instrStart;

  /*
   * Stack entries are:
   *   number  -> exact constant
   *   null    -> unknown
   */
  const stack: (number | null)[] = [];

  function pop() {
    if (stack.length === 0) return null;
    return stack.pop()!;
  }

  function push(v: number | null) {
    stack.push(v);
  }

  while (p < body.bodyEnd) {
    const start = p;
    const op = bytes[p++];

    if (op === 0x41) {
      const x = readSLEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      push(x.value >>> 0);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      push(null);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      pop();
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      const v = stack.length
        ? stack[stack.length - 1]
        : null;

      stack.push(v);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x23) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;
      push(null);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28) {
      const a = readULEB(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = readULEB(p);
      p = o.next;

      pop();
      push(null);
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x36 || op === 0x3a || op === 0x3b) {
      const a = readULEB(p);
      p = a.next;

      const o = readULEB(p);
      p = o.next;

      /*
       * address + value
       */
      pop();
      pop();
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * i32.add / i32.sub
     */
    if (op === 0x6a || op === 0x6b) {
      const b = pop();
      const a = pop();

      if (a !== null && b !== null) {
        push(
          op === 0x6a
            ? (a + b) >>> 0
            : (a - b) >>> 0
        );
      } else {
        push(null);
      }

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * call
     *
     * We cannot safely infer its result or parameter count here,
     * so invalidate the stack.
     */
    if (op === 0x10) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      stack.length = 0;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * call_indirect
     */
    if (op === 0x11) {
      const x = readULEB(p);
      p = x.next;

      const table = readULEB(p);
      p = table.next;

      stack.length = 0;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Bulk memory prefix.
     */
    if (op === 0xfc) {
      const sub = readULEB(p);
      p = sub.next;

      /*
       * memory.init = 0x08
       */
      if (sub.value === 0x08) {
        const seg = readULEB(p);
        p = seg.next;

        const mem = readULEB(p);
        p = mem.next;

        memoryInitCount++;

        const len = pop();
        const src = pop();
        const dst = pop();

        if (dst !== null && len !== null) {
          if (overlaps(dst, len)) {
            bulkHits++;

            console.log("");
            console.log(
              `FUNC ORDINAL ${body.ordinal} @ ${hex(start)}`
            );
            console.log("  OP           = memory.init");
            console.log(`  DATA SEGMENT = ${seg.value}`);
            console.log(`  MEMORY       = ${mem.value}`);
            console.log(`  DST          = ${hex(dst)}`);
            console.log(`  SRC           = ${src === null ? "UNKNOWN" : hex(src)}`);
            console.log(`  LENGTH       = ${len}`);
            console.log(
              `  RANGE        = ${hex(dst)} .. ${hex(
                dst + Math.max(len - 1, 0)
              )}`
            );
            console.log(
              "  *** TARGET RANGE OVERLAP ***"
            );
          }
        }

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * data.drop = 0x09
       */
      if (sub.value === 0x09) {
        const seg = readULEB(p);
        p = seg.next;

        dataDropCount++;

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * memory.copy = 0x0a
       */
      if (sub.value === 0x0a) {
        const dst = pop();
        const src = pop();
        const len = pop();

        const memDst = readULEB(p);
        p = memDst.next;

        const memSrc = readULEB(p);
        p = memSrc.next;

        memoryCopyCount++;

        if (dst !== null && len !== null) {
          if (overlaps(dst, len)) {
            bulkHits++;

            console.log("");
            console.log(
              `FUNC ORDINAL ${body.ordinal} @ ${hex(start)}`
            );
            console.log("  OP           = memory.copy");
            console.log(`  DST          = ${hex(dst)}`);
            console.log(
              `  SRC          = ${
                src === null ? "UNKNOWN" : hex(src)
              }`
            );
            console.log(`  LENGTH       = ${len}`);
            console.log(
              `  RANGE        = ${hex(dst)} .. ${hex(
                dst + Math.max(len - 1, 0)
              )}`
            );
            console.log(
              "  *** TARGET RANGE OVERLAP ***"
            );
          }
        }

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * memory.fill = 0x0b
       */
      if (sub.value === 0x0b) {
        const dst = pop();
        const value = pop();
        const len = pop();

        const mem = readULEB(p);
        p = mem.next;

        memoryFillCount++;

        if (dst !== null && len !== null) {
          if (overlaps(dst, len)) {
            bulkHits++;

            console.log("");
            console.log(
              `FUNC ORDINAL ${body.ordinal} @ ${hex(start)}`
            );
            console.log("  OP           = memory.fill");
            console.log(`  MEMORY       = ${mem.value}`);
            console.log(`  DST          = ${hex(dst)}`);
            console.log(
              `  VALUE        = ${
                value === null ? "UNKNOWN" : hex(value)
              }`
            );
            console.log(`  LENGTH       = ${len}`);
            console.log(
              `  RANGE        = ${hex(dst)} .. ${hex(
                dst + Math.max(len - 1, 0)
              )}`
            );
            console.log(
              "  *** TARGET RANGE OVERLAP ***"
            );
          }
        }

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * Unknown 0xfc instruction.
       * We cannot safely parse its immediates.
       */
      stack.length = 0;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * End / branch / control flow:
     * invalidate our tiny local stack model.
     */
    if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04 ||
      op === 0x05 ||
      op === 0x0b ||
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d ||
      op === 0x0e ||
      op === 0x0f
    ) {
      stack.length = 0;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Most remaining instructions are not relevant to our
     * constant destination analysis. To avoid false positives,
     * invalidate the stack when an unknown producer appears.
     */
    stack.length = 0;
  }
}

for (const body of bodies) {
  try {
    scanBody(body);
  } catch {
    /*
     * Read-only scanner: skip malformed/unsupported body
     * rather than inventing a result.
     */
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SUMMARY");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`DATA SEGMENTS       = ${dataSegments.length}`);
console.log(`memory.init COUNT   = ${memoryInitCount}`);
console.log(`memory.copy COUNT   = ${memoryCopyCount}`);
console.log(`memory.fill COUNT   = ${memoryFillCount}`);
console.log(`data.drop COUNT     = ${dataDropCount}`);
console.log(`TARGET BULK HITS    = ${bulkHits}`);
console.log("");

const activeTargets = dataSegments.filter(
  (s) =>
    s.mode === "active" &&
    s.offset !== null &&
    overlaps(s.offset, s.dataSize)
);

console.log(
  `ACTIVE DATA TARGET OVERLAPS = ${activeTargets.length}`
);

for (const s of activeTargets) {
  console.log(
    `  SEGMENT ${s.index}: ${hex(s.offset!)} + ${s.dataSize}`
  );
}

console.log("");
console.log("READ ONLY - NO WASM EXECUTION");

====================================================================================================
FILE: scripts\traceSelectorProducer.ts
====================================================================================================
import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const START = 0x001226d;
const END   = 0x001295b;
const TARGET = 0x0019534c;

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FUNC 122 - SELECTOR PRODUCER TRACE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`BODY   : 0x${START.toString(16)} .. 0x${END.toString(16)}`);
console.log(`TARGET : 0x${TARGET.toString(16)}`);
console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (let p = START; p < END; p++) {
  const b = wasm[p];

  // i32.const opcode
  if (b === 0x41) {
    let v = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let q = p + 1;

    while (q < END) {
      const x = wasm[q++];
      v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;

      if ((x & 0x80) === 0) break;
      shift += 7;
      if (shift > 35) break;
    }

    const u = v >>> 0;

    if (u === TARGET) {
      console.log("");
      console.log("############################################################");
      console.log("TARGET PRODUCER FOUND");
      console.log(`OFFSET : 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
      console.log(`VALUE  : 0x${u.toString(16)}`);
      console.log("############################################################");
    }
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

const TARGETS = [
  { f: 6611, call: 0x22c948, local: 6 },
  { f: 6611, call: 0x22c9ef, local: 2 },
  { f: 6613, call: 0x22cb34, local: 2 },
  { f: 6615, call: 0x22cc55, local: 1 },
  { f: 6615, call: 0x22cc5e, local: 1 },
  { f: 6618, call: 0x22d083, local: 1 },
  { f: 6464, call: 0x22838e, local: 11 },
];

function uleb(p: number) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, n = 0;
  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    v |= (b & 0x7f) << s;
    n++;
    if (!(b & 0x80)) break;
    s += 7;
  }
  return { v: v >>> 0, n };
}

function instrLen(p: number): number {
  const op = wasm[p];

  if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 || op === 0x22 ||
      op === 0x23 || op === 0x24 ||
      op === 0x0c || op === 0x0d ||
      op === 0x10 || op === 0x41)
    return 1 + uleb(p + 1).n;

  if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
    const a = uleb(p + 1);
    const b = uleb(p + 1 + a.n);
    return 1 + a.n + b.n;
  }

  if (op === 0x11) {
    const a = uleb(p + 1);
    return 1 + a.n + 1;
  }

  if (op === 0x02 || op === 0x03 || op === 0x04)
    return 2;

  return 1;
}

function findCode() {
  for (let i = 0; i < wasm.length - 10; i++) {
    if (wasm[i] !== 0x0a) continue;

    const s = uleb(i + 1);
    const start = i + 1 + s.n;

    const c = uleb(start);

    if (c.v !== 9398) continue;

    let p = start + c.n;
    const bodies = [];

    for (let f = 83; f < 83 + 9398; f++) {
      const sz = uleb(p);
      const bs = p + sz.n;

      bodies.push({
        f,
        start: bs,
        end: bs + sz.v
      });

      p = bs + sz.v;
    }

    return bodies;
  }

  throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

const bodies = findCode();

function opname(op: number) {
  const n: Record<number,string> = {
    0x20:"local.get",
    0x21:"local.set",
    0x22:"local.tee",
    0x41:"i32.const",
    0x6a:"i32.add",
    0x6b:"i32.sub",
    0x6c:"i32.mul",
    0x71:"i32.and",
    0x72:"i32.or",
    0x73:"i32.xor",
    0x74:"i32.shl",
    0x75:"i32.shr_s",
    0x76:"i32.shr_u",
    0x45:"i32.eqz"
  };
  return n[op] ?? `opcode 0x${op.toString(16)}`;
}

for (const t of TARGETS) {

  const body = bodies.find(x => x.f === t.f);
  if (!body) continue;

  const defs: {pos:number, kind:string, local:number}[] = [];

  let p = body.start;

  while (p < t.call) {
    const op = wasm[p];

    if (op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
      const x = uleb(p + 1);

      defs.push({
        pos: p,
        kind: op === 0x21 ? "set" : "tee",
        local: x.v
      });

      p += 1 + x.n;
      continue;
    }

    p += instrLen(p);
  }

  const relevant = defs.filter(x => x.local === t.local);

  console.log(`\nFUNC ${t.f}  CALL113 @ 0x${t.call.toString(16)}`);
  console.log(`SELECTOR LOCAL = ${t.local}`);
  console.log("--------------------------------------------");

  if (!relevant.length) {
    console.log("NO LOCAL DEFINITION FOUND BEFORE CALL");
    continue;
  }

  for (const d of relevant) {

    console.log(
      `\nDEF ${d.kind.toUpperCase()} @ 0x${d.pos.toString(16)}`
    );

    let q = Math.max(body.start, d.pos - 60);

    while (q < Math.min(body.end, d.pos + 4)) {

      const op = wasm[q];

      if (op === 0x20 || op === 0x21 ||
          op === 0x22 || op === 0x23 ||
          op === 0x24 || op === 0x41) {

        const x = uleb(q + 1);

        console.log(
          `  0x${q.toString(16)} ${opname(op)} ${x.v}` +
          (op === 0x41 ? ` (0x${x.v.toString(16)})` : "")
        );

        q += 1 + x.n;
        continue;
      }

      if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x3e) {
        const a = uleb(q + 1);
        const b = uleb(q + 1 + a.n);

        console.log(
          `  0x${q.toString(16)} memop 0x${op.toString(16)}` +
          ` align=${a.v} offset=${b.v}`
        );

        q += 1 + a.n + b.n;
        continue;
      }

      console.log(
        `  0x${q.toString(16)} ${opname(op)}`
      );

      q++;
    }
  }
