import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = [
    {
        index: 2053,
        addr: 0x00189dec,
        function: 8952,
    },
    {
        index: 2101,
        addr: 0x00189f9c,
        function: 8927,
    },
    {
        index: 2612,
        addr: 0x0018a8b0,
        function: 8637,
    },
];

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];

        value += (b & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: pos };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function hex(v: number): string {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readMemU32(mem: Uint8Array, addr: number): number {
    return (
        mem[addr] |
        (mem[addr + 1] << 8) |
        (mem[addr + 2] << 16) |
        (mem[addr + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * DATA SECTION -> LINEAR MEMORY
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

let pos = 8;

let dataStart = -1;
let dataEnd = -1;

while (pos < buf.length) {
    const sectionId = buf[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = pos;
    const end = start + size;

    if (sectionId === 11) {
        dataStart = start;
        dataEnd = end;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (dataStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("DATA SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

let p = dataStart;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const count = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

const segments: {
    offset: number;
    bytes: Uint8Array;
}[] = [];

let maxAddress = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const flagsInfo = readULEB(p);
    const flags = flagsInfo.value;
    p = flagsInfo.next;

    let offset = -1;

    if (flags === 0) {
        const opcode = buf[p++];

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
            throw new Error(`Bad data offset opcode at segment ${i}`);
        }

        const off = readULEB(p);
        offset = off.value;
        p = off.next;

        if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
            throw new Error(`Bad data segment end at ${i}`);
        }
    } else if (flags === 2) {
        const mem = readULEB(p);
        p = mem.next;

        const opcode = buf[p++];

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
            throw new Error(`Bad data offset opcode at segment ${i}`);
        }

        const off = readULEB(p);
        offset = off.value;
        p = off.next;

        if (buf[p++] !== 0x0b) {
            throw new Error(`Bad data segment end at ${i}`);
        }
    } else if (flags === 1) {
        const lenInfo = readULEB(p);
        p = lenInfo.next + lenInfo.value;
        continue;
    } else {
        throw new Error(`Unsupported data flags ${flags}`);
    }

    const lenInfo = readULEB(p);
    const len = lenInfo.value;
    p = lenInfo.next;

    const bytes = buf.subarray(p, p + len);
    p += len;

    segments.push({ offset, bytes });

    maxAddress = Math.max(maxAddress, offset + len);
}

if (p !== dataEnd) {
    throw new Error(
        `DATA PARSER MISMATCH ${hex(p)} != ${hex(dataEnd)}`
    );
}

const memory = new Uint8Array(
    Math.max(maxAddress + 0x1000, 0x02000000)
);

for (const seg of segments) {
    if (seg.offset >= 0) {
        memory.set(seg.bytes, seg.offset);
    }
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * VERIFIED TARGET RECORDS
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET RECORD READER SCAN");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log();
console.log(`WASM size = ${buf.length}`);
console.log(`DATA segments = ${count}`);
console.log(`MEMORY size = ${memory.length}`);

console.log();
console.log("TARGET RECORDS");

for (const t of TARGETS) {
    const actual = readMemU32(memory, t.addr);

    console.log(
        `  ${t.index} @ ${hex(t.addr)}` +
        ` -> ${actual}` +
        ` -> Function ${t.function}`
    );
}

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * CODE SECTION
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 */

let codeStart = -1;
let codeEnd = -1;

pos = 8;

while (pos < buf.length) {
    const sectionId = buf[pos++];

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    pos = sizeInfo.next;

    const start = pos;
    const end = start + size;

    if (sectionId === 10) {
        codeStart = start;
        codeEnd = end;
        break;
    }

    pos = end;
}

if (codeStart < 0) {
    throw new Error("CODE SECTION NOT FOUND");
}

let q = codeStart;

const functionCountInfo = readULEB(q);
const functionCount = functionCountInfo.value;
q = functionCountInfo.next;

console.log();
console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS = ${functionCount}`);

/*
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 * DECODE MINIMAL INSTRUCTIONS
 * ------------------------------------------------------------
 *
 * We look for:
 *
 *   i32.const
 *   i32.load
 *
 *   i32.add
 *
 * around references to:
 *
 *   0x189dec
 *   0x189f9c
 *   0x18a8b0
 *
 * Because the target addresses are data addresses,
 * direct constants may be absent.
 * Therefore we also inspect loads whose base/value
 * can point into SEGMENT 412.
 */

const interesting = new Set<number>();

for (const t of TARGETS) {
    interesting.add(t.addr);
}

function isSeg412(addr: number): boolean {
    return (
        addr >= 0x0018744c &&
        addr < 0x0018ab8d
    );
}

function isSeg413(addr: number): boolean {
    return (
        addr >= 0x0018ab98 &&
        addr < 0x0018f512
    );
}

let totalFunctions = 0;
let totalInstructions = 0;

const functionHits: {
    globalFunction: number;
    body: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    hits: string[];
}[] = [];

for (let body = 0; body < functionCount; body++) {
    const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(q);
    const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
    q = bodySizeInfo.next;

    const bodyStart = q;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    const globalFunction = body + 83;

    const hits: string[] = [];

    /*
     * Keep a small symbolic stack of constants and memory addresses.
     */
    const stack: {
        kind: string;
        value?: number;
    }[] = [];

    let ip = bodyStart;

    /*
     * locals count
     */
    const localGroupInfo = readULEB(ip);
    const localGroups = localGroupInfo.value;
    ip = localGroupInfo.next;

    for (let g = 0; g < localGroups; g++) {
        ip = readULEB(ip).next;
        ip += 1;
    }

    while (ip < bodyEnd) {
        const at = ip;
        const op = buf[ip++];

        totalInstructions++;

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const c = readULEB(ip);
            ip = c.next;

            stack.push({
                kind: "const",
                value: c.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x20) {
            const l = readULEB(ip);
            ip = l.next;

            stack.push({
                kind: `local${l.value}`,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x21 || op === 0x22) {
            const l = readULEB(ip);
            ip = l.next;

            if (op === 0x22) {
                stack.push({
                    kind: `local${l.value}`,
                });
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x28) {
            const align = buf[ip++];
            const off = readULEB(ip);
            ip = off.next;

            const base = stack.pop();

            if (
                base?.kind === "const" &&
                base.value !== undefined
            ) {
                const addr = base.value + off.value;

                if (
                    isSeg412(addr) ||
                    isSeg413(addr) ||
                    interesting.has(addr)
                ) {
                    hits.push(
                        `${hex(at)} i32.load ` +
                        `base=${hex(base.value)} ` +
                        `offset=${off.value} ` +
                        `addr=${hex(addr)}`
                    );
                }
            }

            stack.push({
                kind: "load",
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x6a) {
            const b = stack.pop();
            const a = stack.pop();

            if (
                a?.kind === "const" &&
                b?.kind === "const" &&
                a.value !== undefined &&
                b.value !== undefined
            ) {
                stack.push({
                    kind: "const",
                    value: (a.value + b.value) >>> 0,
                });
            } else {
                stack.push({
                    kind: "add",
                });
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x11) {
            /*
             * call_indirect:
             * type index + table index
             */
            const typeInfo = readULEB(ip);
            ip = typeInfo.next;

            ip += 1;

            const index = stack.pop();

            if (index?.kind === "const") {
                if (
                    index.value === 2053 ||
                    index.value === 2101 ||
                    index.value === 2612
                ) {
                    hits.push(
                        `${hex(at)} call_indirect ` +
                        `INDEX=${index.value}`
                    );
                }
            }

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * Simple stack effects for common instructions.
         */

        if (
            op === 0x46 ||
            op === 0x47 ||
            op === 0x48 ||
            op === 0x49 ||
            op === 0x4a ||
            op === 0x4b ||
            op === 0x4c ||
            op === 0x4d ||
            op === 0x4e ||
            op === 0x4f ||
            op === 0x50 ||
            op === 0x51 ||
            op === 0x52 ||
            op === 0x53 ||
            op === 0x54 ||
            op === 0x55 ||
            op === 0x56 ||
            op === 0x57 ||
            op === 0x58 ||
            op === 0x59 ||
            op === 0x5a ||
            op === 0x5b ||
            op === 0x5c ||
            op === 0x5d ||
            op === 0x5e ||
            op === 0x5f
        ) {
            stack.pop();
            stack.pop();
            stack.push({ kind: "unknown" });
            continue;
        }

        if (
            op === 0x45 ||
            op === 0x44 ||
            op === 0x43
        ) {
            if (op === 0x43) {
                ip += 4;
            } else if (op === 0x44) {
                ip += 8;
            }

            stack.push({ kind: "unknown" });
            continue;
        }

        /*
         * Conservative reset at control-flow instructions.
         */
        if (
            op === 0x0b ||
            op === 0x0c ||
            op === 0x0d ||
            op === 0x0e ||
            op === 0x0f
        ) {
            stack.length = 0;
            continue;
        }

        /*
         * Unknown instruction:
         * keep parser moving but don't trust stack.
         */
    }

    if (hits.length > 0) {
        functionHits.push({
            globalFunction,
            body,
            start: bodyStart,
            end: bodyEnd,
            hits,
        });
    }

    totalFunctions++;
    q = bodyEnd;
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("CODE SCAN RESULTS");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`Functions parsed = ${totalFunctions}`);
console.log(`Instructions scanned = ${totalInstructions}`);
console.log(`Functions with relevant hits = ${functionHits.length}`);

for (const f of functionHits) {
    console.log();
    console.log(
        `Function ${f.globalFunction} ` +
        `(body ${f.body})`
    );

    console.log(
        `  range ${hex(f.start)} .. ${hex(f.end)}`
    );

    for (const h of f.hits) {
        console.log(`  ${h}`);
    }
}

console.log();
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DIRECT TARGET ADDRESS BYTE SEARCH");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const t of TARGETS) {
    const pattern = [
        t.addr & 0xff,
        (t.addr >>> 8) & 0xff,
        (t.addr >>> 16) & 0xff,
        (t.addr >>> 24) & 0xff,
    ];

    let hits = 0;

    for (let i = codeStart; i + 4 <= codeEnd; i++) {
        if (
            buf[i] === pattern[0] &&
            buf[i + 1] === pattern[1] &&
            buf[i + 2] === pattern[2] &&
            buf[i + 3] === pattern[3]
        ) {
            hits++;

            if (hits <= 20) {
                console.log(
                    `TARGET ${t.index} address ` +
                    `${hex(t.addr)} found at ` +
                    `${hex(i)}`
                );
            }
        }
    }

    console.log(
        `TARGET ${t.index}: TOTAL BYTE PATTERN HITS = ${hits}`
    );
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const file =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const ELEMENT_START = 0x00002b0d;
const ELEMENT_END   = 0x00006e74;

const TARGETS = new Set([
  8637,
  8927,
  8952
]);

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {

    const x = b[pos + i];

    value += (x & 0x7f) * 2 ** shift;

    if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
      return {
        value,
        end: pos + i + 1
      };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }

  return null;
}

function hex(n: number) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TARGET FUNCTION -> TABLE ENTRY TRACE");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("");

p = segmentCount.end;

console.log(`Element segments = ${segmentCount.value}`);

const flags = b[p++];

console.log(`Flags = ${flags}`);

if (flags !== 0) {
  throw new Error("Unexpected element segment flags");
}

/*
   flags=0:

   offset expression:
   i32.const 1
   end
*/

if (b[p++] !== 0x41)
  throw new Error("Expected i32.const");

const tableOffset = readULEB(p)!;
p = tableOffset.end;

if (b[p++] !== 0x0b)
  throw new Error("Expected end");

console.log(`Table offset = ${tableOffset.value}`);

const count = readULEB(p)!;
p = count.end;

console.log(`Function entries = ${count.value}`);
console.log("");

let found = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {

  const fn = readULEB(p);

  if (!fn)
    throw new Error(`Bad function index at ${hex(p)}`);

  const tableIndex =
    tableOffset.value + i;

  if (TARGETS.has(fn.value)) {

    found++;

    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
    console.log(`FUNCTION       = ${fn.value}`);
    console.log(`ELEMENT INDEX  = ${i}`);
    console.log(`TABLE INDEX    = ${tableIndex}`);
    console.log(`BYTE OFFSET    = ${hex(p)}`);
  }

  p = fn.end;
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`TARGET ENTRIES FOUND = ${found}`);
console.log(`FINAL POINTER        = ${hex(p)}`);
console.log(`EXPECTED END         = ${hex(ELEMENT_END)}`);
console.log("============================================================");

import { Address, TonClient } from '@ton/ton';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const TARGET_LT = 99491281000001n;

const OP_PTON_TRANSFER = 0x01f3835d;
const OP_JETTON_TRANSFER = 0x0f8a7ea5;
const OP_JETTON_NOTIFY = 0x7362d09c;
const OP_PROVIDE_LP = 0x37c096df;

function opHex(op: number | null): string {
    if (op === null) return 'UNKNOWN';
    return '0x' + op.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function getOpcode(body: any): number | null {
    try {
        const s = body.beginParse();

        if (s.remainingBits < 32) {
            return null;
        }

        return s.loadUint(32);
    } catch {
        return null;
    }
}

function ton(value: bigint): string {
    const whole = value / 1_000_000_000n;

    const frac = (value % 1_000_000_000n)
        .toString()
        .padStart(9, '0')
        .replace(/0+$/, '');

    return frac ? `${whole}.${frac}` : whole.toString();
}

function separator(title: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(` ${title}`);
    console.log('============================================================');
}

                        s.remainingBits >= 16

                        console.log(
                            'JETTON AMOUNT RAW:'

                        console.log(

                    console.log('REMAINING BITS:');
                    console.log(s.remainingBits);

                    console.log('REMAINING REFS:');
                    console.log(s.remainingRefs);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.log('DECODE ERROR:');
                console.log(String(e));
            }

            index++;
        }

        separator('TARGET USER TRANSACTION BOC');

        if (tx.inMessage) {
            console.log(
                tx.inMessage.body
                    .toBoc()
                    .toString('base64')
            );
        }
    }

    if (!targetFound) {
        separator('RESULT');
        console.log('TARGET TRANSACTION NOT FOUND.');
    }

    separator('FINAL');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
}

import fs from "fs";

const FILE =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(FILE);

function readULEB(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = pos;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[p++];
        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: p,
    };
}

function hex(v: number): string {
    return "0x" + v.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function u32LE(pos: number): number {
    return (
        wasm[pos] |
        (wasm[pos + 1] << 8) |
        (wasm[pos + 2] << 16) |
        (wasm[pos + 3] << 24)
    ) >>> 0;
}

function decodeSimple(pos: number, end: number) {
    const out: {
        pos: number;
        op: string;
        arg?: number;
    }[] = [];

    let p = pos;

    while (p < end) {
        const at = p;
        const op = wasm[p++];

        if (op === 0x20) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: "local.get",
                arg: r.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x21) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: "local.set",
                arg: r.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x22) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: "local.tee",
                arg: r.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x28) {
            const align = wasm[p++];
            const off = readULEB(p);
            p = off.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: `i32.load align=${align} offset=${off.value}`,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x2d) {
            const align = wasm[p++];
            const off = readULEB(p);
            p = off.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: `i32.load8_u align=${align} offset=${off.value}`,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: "i32.const",
                arg: r.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x6a) {
            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: "i32.add",
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x6b) {
            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: "i32.sub",
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x11) {
            const type = readULEB(p);
            p = type.next;

            const table = readULEB(p);
            p = table.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`,
            });

            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x10) {
            const r = readULEB(p);
            p = r.next;

            out.push({
                pos: at,
                op: "call",
                arg: r.value,
            });

            continue;
        }

        /*
         * Skip common one-byte instructions.
         */

        const names: Record<number, string> = {
            0x45: "i32.eqz",
            0x46: "i32.eq",
            0x47: "i32.ne",
            0x4a: "i32.gt_u",
            0x4b: "i32.lt_u",
            0x71: "i32.and",
            0x72: "i32.or",
            0x73: "i32.xor",
            0x0b: "end",
            0x0f: "return",
        };

        out.push({
            pos: at,
            op: names[op] ?? `op=0x${op.toString(16)}`,
        });
    }

    return out;
}

for (const t of targets) {

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`FUNCTION ${t.fn}`);
    console.log(`DISPATCH @ ${hex(t.dispatch)}`);
    console.log("============================================================");

    const decoded = decodeSimple(t.start, t.end);

    for (const x of decoded) {

        let extra = "";

        if (x.arg !== undefined)
            extra = ` ${x.arg}`;

        console.log(
            `${hex(x.pos)}  ${x.op}${extra}`
        );
    }

    console.log();

    /*
     * Exact dispatch stack reconstruction.
     *
     * We specifically reconstruct the expression immediately
     * before call_indirect:
     *
     *     ... base
     *     i32.load offset=4
     *     call_indirect type=4
     */

    const stack: string[] = [];

    for (const x of decoded) {

        const op = x.op;

        if (op === "local.get") {

            if (x.arg! < 2) {
                stack.push(`param[${x.arg}]`);
            } else {
                stack.push(`local[${x.arg}]`);
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (op.startsWith("i32.const")) {

            stack.push(`const(${x.arg})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (op.startsWith("i32.load align=2 offset=")) {

            if (stack.length < 1)
                stack.push("UNKNOWN_BASE");
            else {
                const base = stack.pop()!;
                const off =
                    Number(op.split("offset=")[1]);

                stack.push(
                    `MEM[${base}+${off}]`
                );
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (op.startsWith("i32.load8_u")) {

            if (stack.length < 1)
                stack.push("UNKNOWN_BASE");
            else {
                const base = stack.pop()!;
                const off =
                    Number(op.split("offset=")[1]);

                stack.push(
                    `MEM8[${base}+${off}]`
                );
            }

            continue;
        }

        if (op === "i32.add") {

            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(`(${a}+${b})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === "i32.sub") {

            const b = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";
            const a = stack.pop() ?? "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(`(${a}-${b})`);
            continue;
        }

        if (op === "local.tee") {

            const v =
                stack[stack.length - 1] ??
                "UNKNOWN";

            stack.push(
                `local[${x.arg}]=${v}`
            );

            continue;
        }

        if (op === "local.set") {

            if (stack.length)
                stack.pop();

            continue;
        }

        if (
            op === "call_indirect type=4 table=0"
        ) {

            console.log(
                "STACK BEFORE CALL_INDIRECT:"
            );

            const n = stack.length;

            for (
                let i = 0;
                i < n;
                i++
            ) {
                console.log(
                    `  [${i}] ${stack[i]}`
                );
            }

            console.log();
        }
    }

    /*
     * Raw bytes around the dispatch.
     */

    const from =
        Math.max(codeStart, t.dispatch - 32);

    const to =
        Math.min(codeEnd, t.dispatch + 12);

    console.log(
        `RAW ${hex(from)} .. ${hex(to)}`
    );

    console.log(
        Array.from(wasm.slice(from, to))
            .map(v =>
                v.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
            )
            .join(" ")
    );

    console.log();
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("END");
console.log("============================================================");

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0, x;
  do {
    x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    s += 7;
  } while (x & 128);
  return [v >>> 0, p];
}

let p = 8;
let codeStart = 0;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  let size;
  [size, p] = u(p);

  if (id === 10) {
    codeStart = p;
    break;
  }

  p += size;
}

let q = codeStart;
let count;
[count, q] = u(q);

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TYPE-1 SELECTOR TRACE");
console.log("TARGET : FUNC 1968 / TABLE[5220,5232,5235]");
console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");

let hits = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  let size;
  [size, q] = u(q);

  const start = q;
  const end = q + size;
  const func = i + 91;

  for (let x = start; x < end - 3; x++) {

    if (b[x] !== 0x11) continue;

    let typeIdx, z;
    [typeIdx, z] = u(x + 1);

    let tableIdx;
    [tableIdx, z] = u(z);

    if (typeIdx !== 1 || tableIdx !== 0) continue;

    const from = Math.max(start, x - 40);
    const raw = [...b.slice(from, x + 3)]
      .map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join(" ");

    // Look backwards for direct i32.const immediately preceding
    // the final selector-producing stack operation.
    let direct = [];

    for (let k = Math.max(start, x - 40); k < x; k++) {
      if (b[k] !== 0x41) continue;

      let v = 0, s = 0, y = k + 1;

      while (y < x) {
        const c = b[y++];
        v += (c & 127) * 2 ** s;
        s += 7;
        if (!(c & 128)) break;
      }

      v >>>= 0;

      if (v === 5220 || v === 5232 || v === 5235) {
        direct.push({ offset: k, value: v });
      }
    }

    if (direct.length) {
      console.log("");
      console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");
      console.log("FUNC", func);
      console.log("CALL_INDIRECT", "0x" + x.toString(16));
      console.log("TYPE", typeIdx, "TABLE", tableIdx);

      for (const d of direct) {
        console.log(
          "DIRECT CONST :",
          "0x" + d.offset.toString(16),
          "=",
          d.value
        );
      }

      console.log("RAW:", raw);
      hits++;
    }
  }

  q = end;
}

console.log("");
console.log("MATCHING INDIRECT CALLS :", hits);
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("DONE");

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const TARGETS = {
    3901: {
        call: 0x001baa93,
        table: 1209
    },
    6521: {
        call: 0x0022b104,
        table: 579
    },
    8952: {
        call: 0x0030229c,
        table: 2053
    }
};

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos) {
    let result = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[pos++];
        result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readVec(pos) {
    return uleb(pos);
}

function sectionRange(id) {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const sid = buf[p++];
        const s = uleb(p);
        const start = s.next;
        const end = start + s.value;

        if (sid === id)
            return { start, end, size: s.value };

        p = end;
    }

    return null;
}

function readName(pos) {
    const x = uleb(pos);
    const end = x.next + x.value;

    return {
        text: buf.subarray(x.next, end).toString("utf8"),
        next: end
    };
}

function parseTypes() {
    const sec = sectionRange(1);
    if (!sec) throw new Error("Type section not found");

    let p = sec.start;

    const count = uleb(p);
    p = count.next;

    const types = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
        const form = buf[p++];

        if (form !== 0x60) {
            throw new Error(
                `Unexpected type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at ${p - 1}`
            );
        }

        const pc = uleb(p);
        p = pc.next;

        const params = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++)
            params.push(buf[p++]);

        const rc = uleb(p);
        p = rc.next;

        const results = [];

        for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++)
            results.push(buf[p++]);

        types.push({ params, results });
    }

    return types;
}

function parseFunctions(types) {
    const importSec = sectionRange(2);
    const funcSec = sectionRange(3);
    const codeSec = sectionRange(10);

    if (!importSec || !funcSec || !codeSec)
        throw new Error("Required sections missing");

    let p = importSec.start;

    const ic = uleb(p);
    p = ic.next;

    let importedFunctions = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < ic.value; i++) {
        const mod = readName(p);
        p = mod.next;

        const nm = readName(p);
        p = nm.next;

        const kind = buf[p++];

        if (kind === 0) {
            const ti = uleb(p);
            p = ti.next;
            importedFunctions++;
        } else if (kind === 1) {
            p += 4;
            const lim = uleb(p);
            p = lim.next;

            if (lim.value === 1) {
                const max = uleb(p);
                p = max.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 2) {
            const lim = uleb(p);
            p = lim.next;

            if (lim.value === 1) {
                const max = uleb(p);
                p = max.next;
            }
        } else if (kind === 3) {
            p += 2;
        } else {
            throw new Error(
                `Unknown import kind ${kind} at 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`
            );
        }
    }

    p = funcSec.start;

    const fc = uleb(p);
    p = fc.next;

    const definedTypes = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < fc.value; i++) {
        const t = uleb(p);
        p = t.next;
        definedTypes.push(t.value);
    }

    // Code bodies
    p = codeSec.start;

    const cc = uleb(p);
    p = cc.next;

    if (cc.value !== fc.value)
        throw new Error("Function/code count mismatch");

    const bodies = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < cc.value; i++) {
        const bs = uleb(p);
        const bodyStart = bs.next;
        const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bs.value;

        bodies.push({
            func: importedFunctions + i,
            type: definedTypes[i],
            start: bodyStart,
            end: bodyEnd
        });

        p = bodyEnd;
    }

    return {
        importedFunctions,
        bodies
    };
}

function hex(n) {
    return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function scanFunction(body, types) {
    const out = [];

    let p = body.start;

    // local declarations
    const localGroups = uleb(p);
    p = localGroups.next;

    let localCount = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < localGroups.value; i++) {
        const n = uleb(p);
        p = n.next;

        const type = buf[p++];

        localCount += n.value;
    }

    while (p < body.end) {
        const opPos = p;
        const op = buf[p++];

        // local.get
        if (op === 0x20) {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "local.get",
                local: x.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // local.set
        if (op === 0x21) {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "local.set",
                local: x.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // local.tee
        if (op === 0x22) {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "local.tee",
                local: x.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // i32.const
        if (op === 0x41) {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "i32.const",
                value: x.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // i32.load
        if (op === 0x28) {
            const align = uleb(p);
            p = align.next;

            const off = uleb(p);
            p = off.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "i32.load",
                offset: off.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // i32.store
        if (op === 0x36) {
            const align = uleb(p);
            p = align.next;

            const off = uleb(p);
            p = off.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "i32.store",
                offset: off.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // i32.load8_u
        if (op === 0x2d) {
            const align = uleb(p);
            p = align.next;

            const off = uleb(p);
            p = off.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "i32.load8_u",
                offset: off.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // call
        if (op === 0x10) {
            const x = uleb(p);
            p = x.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "call",
                func: x.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // call_indirect
        if (op === 0x11) {
            const type = uleb(p);
            p = type.next;

            const table = uleb(p);
            p = table.next;

            out.push({
                pos: opPos,
                kind: "call_indirect",
                type: type.value,
                table: table.value
            });
            continue;
        }

        // end
        if (op === 0x0b) {
            continue;
        }

        // common no-immediate instructions
        const noImmediate = new Set([
            0x00, 0x01,
            0x1a,
            0x45,
            0x46,
            0x47,
            0x48,
            0x4a,
            0x4b,
            0x4c,
            0x4d,
            0x4e,
            0x4f,
            0x50,
            0x51,
            0x52,
            0x53,
            0x54,
            0x55,
            0x56,
            0x57,
            0x58,
            0x59,
            0x5a,
            0x5b,
            0x5c,
            0x5d,
            0x5e,
            0x5f,
            0x60,
            0x61,
            0x62,
            0x63,
            0x64,
            0x65,
            0x66,
            0x67,
            0x68,
            0x69,
            0x6a,
            0x6b,
            0x6c,
            0x6d,
            0x6e,
            0x6f,
            0x70,
            0x71,
            0x72,
            0x73,
            0x74,
            0x75,
            0x76,
            0x77,
            0x78,
            0x79,
            0x7a,
            0x7b,
            0x7c,
            0x7d,
            0x7e,
            0x7f
        ]);

        if (noImmediate.has(op))
            continue;

        // For unsupported instructions, stop decoding this body.
        // We do not guess operand lengths.
        break;
    }

    return out;
}

const fs = require("fs");

const wasmPath =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const targets = [3901, 6521, 8952];

const buf = fs.readFileSync(wasmPath);

function readULEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    result |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: result >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function readSLEB(pos) {
  let result = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte;

  while (true) {
    byte = buf[pos++];
    result |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    result |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: result | 0, next: pos };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Sections
// ------------------------------------------------------------

let pos = 8;

let functionSection = null;
let codeSection = null;

while (pos < buf.length) {
  const id = buf[pos++];

  const sizeInfo = readULEB(pos);
  const size = sizeInfo.value;
  pos = sizeInfo.next;

  const start = pos;
  const end = start + size;

  if (id === 3) functionSection = { start, end };
  if (id === 10) codeSection = { start, end };

  pos = end;
}

if (!functionSection || !codeSection) {
  throw new Error("Required sections not found.");
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Defined function types
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const definedTypes = [];

{
  let p = functionSection.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  const count = countInfo.value;
  p = countInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const t = readULEB(p);
    definedTypes.push(t.value);
    p = t.next;
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Code bodies
// ------------------------------------------------------------

const bodies = [];

{
  let p = codeSection.start;

  const countInfo = readULEB(p);
  const count = countInfo.value;
  p = countInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const size = sizeInfo.value;
    const start = sizeInfo.next;
    const end = start + size;

    bodies.push({ start, end });

    p = end;
  }
}

const IMPORTED = 83;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Decode only target bodies
// ------------------------------------------------------------

function inspectFunction(funcIndex) {
  const bodyIndex = funcIndex - IMPORTED;
  const body = bodies[bodyIndex];

  let p = body.start;

  // locals
  const localDeclInfo = readULEB(p);
  const localDeclCount = localDeclInfo.value;
  p = localDeclInfo.next;

  for (let i = 0; i < localDeclCount; i++) {
    const countInfo = readULEB(p);
    p = countInfo.next;
    p += 1;
  }

  const instructions = [];

  while (p < body.end - 1) {
    const addr = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    let text = `opcode=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`;

    if (op === 0x20) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      text = `local.get ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x21) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      text = `local.set ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x22) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      text = `local.tee ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x41) {
      const r = readSLEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      text = `i32.const ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x28) {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(p);
      p = offset.next;

      text = `i32.load align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x2c) {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(p);
      p = offset.next;

      text = `i32.load8_s align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x2d) {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(p);
      p = offset.next;

      text = `i32.load8_u align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x36) {
      const align = readULEB(p);
      p = align.next;

      const offset = readULEB(p);
      p = offset.next;

      text = `i32.store align=${align.value} offset=${offset.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = readULEB(p);
      p = r.next;
      text = `call ${r.value}`;
    }

    else if (op === 0x11) {
      const type = readULEB(p);
      p = type.next;

      const table = readULEB(p);
      p = table.next;

      text = `call_indirect type=${type.value} table=${table.value}`;
    }

    instructions.push({ addr, text });
  }

  return instructions;
}

import * as fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const FUNC_INDEX = 2774;
const TARGET = 114;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

interface Ins {
    off: number;
    op: number;
    text: string;
    imm?: number;
    offset?: number;
    local?: number;
    func?: number;
    type?: number;
    table?: number;
}

interface Body {
    index: number;
    start: number;
    end: number;
    code: Uint8Array;
}

function hex(v: number): string {
    return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;

        shift += 7;
    }

    return {
        value: value >>> 0,
        next: pos
    };
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let b = 0;

    while (true) {
        b = wasm[pos++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
        shift += 7;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0)
            break;
    }

    if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40))
        value |= (~0 << shift);

    return {
        value: value | 0,
        next: pos
    };
}

function parseCodeBodies(): Body[] {
    let p = 8;

    while (p < wasm.length) {
        const sectionId = wasm[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
        const sectionSize = sizeInfo.value;
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const sectionEnd = p + sectionSize;

        if (sectionId !== 10) {
            p = sectionEnd;
            continue;
        }

        const countInfo = readULEB(p);
        const count = countInfo.value;
        p = countInfo.next;

        const result: Body[] = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            const bodySizeInfo = readULEB(p);
            const bodySize = bodySizeInfo.value;
            p = bodySizeInfo.next;

            const bodyStart = p;
            const bodyEnd = p + bodySize;

            const localDeclInfo = readULEB(p);
            const localDeclCount = localDeclInfo.value;
            p = localDeclInfo.next;

            for (let j = 0; j < localDeclCount; j++) {
                const n = readULEB(p);
                p = n.next;

                // valtype
                p++;
            }

            const codeStart = p;

            result.push({
                index: 83 + i,
                start: codeStart,
                end: bodyEnd,
                code: wasm.subarray(codeStart, bodyEnd)
            });

            p = bodyEnd;
        }

        return result;
    }

    throw new Error("Code section not found");
}

function decode(body: Body): Ins[] {
    const out: Ins[] = [];

    let rel = 0;

    const push = (
        op: number,
        text: string,
        extra: Partial<Ins> = {}
    ) => {
        out.push({
            off: body.start + rel,
            op,
            text,
            ...extra
        });
    };

    while (rel < body.code.length) {
        const op = body.code[rel];

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Control
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x00) {
            push(op, "unreachable");
            rel++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x01) {
            push(op, "nop");
            rel++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x02) {
            // blocktype
            const bt = body.code[rel + 1];

            push(
                op,
                `block type=0x${bt.toString(16)}`
            );

            rel += 2;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x03) {
            const bt = body.code[rel + 1];

            push(
                op,
                `loop type=0x${bt.toString(16)}`
            );

            rel += 2;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x04) {
            const bt = body.code[rel + 1];

            push(
                op,
                `if type=0x${bt.toString(16)}`
            );

            rel += 2;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x05) {
            push(op, "else");
            rel++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0b) {
            push(op, "end");
            rel++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0c) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `br ${x.value}`,
                { imm: x.value }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0d) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `br_if ${x.value}`,
                { imm: x.value }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0e) {
            let q = body.start + rel + 1;

            const n = readULEB(q);
            q = n.next;

            for (let i = 0; i < n.value; i++) {
                q = readULEB(q).next;
            }

            const def = readULEB(q);

            push(
                op,
                `br_table ${n.value} default=${def.value}`
            );

            rel = def.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x0f) {
            push(op, "return");
            rel++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x10) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `call ${x.value}`,
                {
                    func: x.value,
                    imm: x.value
                }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x11) {
            const t = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);
            const table = readULEB(t.next);

            push(
                op,
                `call_indirect type=${t.value} table=${table.value}`,
                {
                    type: t.value,
                    table: table.value
                }
            );

            rel = table.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Parametric
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x1a) {
            push(op, "drop");
            rel++;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x1b) {
            push(op, "select");
            rel++;
            continue;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Variables
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x20) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `local.get ${x.value}`,
                {
                    local: x.value,
                    imm: x.value
                }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x21) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `local.set ${x.value}`,
                {
                    local: x.value,
                    imm: x.value
                }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x22) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `local.tee ${x.value}`,
                {
                    local: x.value,
                    imm: x.value
                }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x23) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `global.get ${x.value}`,
                { imm: x.value }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x24) {
            const x = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `global.set ${x.value}`,
                { imm: x.value }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Constants
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (op === 0x41) {
            const x = readSLEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `i32.const ${x.value}`,
                { imm: x.value }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        if (op === 0x42) {
            const x = readSLEB(body.start + rel + 1);

            push(
                op,
                `i64.const ${x.value}`,
                { imm: x.value }
            );

            rel = x.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Loads
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (op >= 0x28 && op <= 0x35) {
            const names: Record<number, string> = {
                0x28: "i32.load",
                0x29: "i64.load",
                0x2a: "f32.load",
                0x2b: "f64.load",
                0x2c: "i32.load8_s",
                0x2d: "i32.load8_u",
                0x2e: "i32.load16_s",
                0x2f: "i32.load16_u",
                0x30: "i64.load8_s",
                0x31: "i64.load8_u",
                0x32: "i64.load16_s",
                0x33: "i64.load16_u",
                0x34: "i64.load32_s",
                0x35: "i64.load32_u"
            };

            const a = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);
            const o = readULEB(a.next);

            push(
                op,
                `${names[op]} offset=${o.value}`,
                { offset: o.value }
            );

            rel = o.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Stores
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        if (op >= 0x36 && op <= 0x3e) {
            const names: Record<number, string> = {
                0x36: "i32.store",
                0x37: "i64.store",
                0x38: "f32.store",
                0x39: "f64.store",
                0x3a: "i32.store8",
                0x3b: "i32.store16",
                0x3c: "i64.store8",
                0x3d: "i64.store16",
                0x3e: "i64.store32"
            };

            const a = readULEB(body.start + rel + 1);
            const o = readULEB(a.next);

            push(
                op,
                `${names[op]} offset=${o.value}`,
                { offset: o.value }
            );

            rel = o.next - body.start;
            continue;
        }

        // --------------------------------------------------------
        // Numeric
        // --------------------------------------------------------

        const names: Record<number, string> = {
            0x45: "i32.eqz",
            0x46: "i32.eq",
            0x47: "i32.ne",
            0x48: "i32.lt_s",
            0x49: "i32.lt_u",
            0x4a: "i32.gt_s",
            0x4b: "i32.gt_u",
            0x4c: "i32.le_s",
            0x4d: "i32.le_u",
            0x4e: "i32.ge_s",
            0x4f: "i32.ge_u",

            0x67: "i32.clz",
            0x68: "i32.ctz",
            0x69: "i32.popcnt",

            0x6a: "i32.add",
            0x6b: "i32.sub",
            0x6c: "i32.mul",
            0x6d: "i32.div_s",
            0x6e: "i32.div_u",
            0x6f: "i32.rem_s",
            0x70: "i32.rem_u",
            0x71: "i32.and",
            0x72: "i32.or",
            0x73: "i32.xor",
            0x74: "i32.shl",
            0x75: "i32.shr_s",
            0x76: "i32.shr_u",
            0x77: "i32.rotl",
            0x78: "i32.rotr"
        };

        if (names[op]) {
            push(op, names[op]);
            rel++;
            continue;
        }

        // Unknown opcode: preserve one byte.
        push(
            op,
            `op=0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
        );

        rel++;
    }

    return out;
}

function showRange(
    ins: Ins[],
    center: number,
    radius = 18
) {
    const idx = ins.findIndex(
        x => x.off === center
    );

    if (idx < 0)
        return;

    const a = Math.max(0, idx - radius);
    const b = Math.min(
        ins.length,
        idx + radius + 1
    );

    for (let i = a; i < b; i++) {
        console.log(
            `  ${hex(ins[i].off)} ${ins[i].text}`
        );
    }
}

function findLocalSources(
    ins: Ins[],
    targetLocal: number,
    beforeIndex: number
): number[] {
    const result: number[] = [];

    for (
        let i = beforeIndex - 1;
        i >= 0;
        i--
    ) {
        const x = ins[i];

        if (
            x.text ===
            `local.set ${targetLocal}`
        ) {
            result.push(i);

            // Continue backwards; later definitions
            // can reveal branch-dependent sources.
        }

        if (
            x.text ===
            `local.tee ${targetLocal}`
        ) {
            result.push(i);
        }
    }

    return result;
}

function traceLocalSource(
    ins: Ins[],
    local: number,
    setIndex: number,
    depth = 0
): string {
    if (depth > 6)
        return "DEPTH_LIMIT";

    for (
        let i = setIndex - 1;
        i >= Math.max(0, setIndex - 80);
        i--
    ) {
        const x = ins[i];

        if (
            x.text ===
            `i32.const ${TARGET}`
        ) {
            return `CONST_114 @ ${hex(x.off)}`;
        }

        if (
            x.text.startsWith(
                "local.get "
            )
        ) {
            const sourceLocal = x.local!;

            const sourceSets = findLocalSources(
                ins,
                sourceLocal,
                i
            );

            if (sourceSets.length > 0) {
                return (
                    `LOCAL_${sourceLocal} -> ` +
                    traceLocalSource(
                        ins,
                        sourceLocal,
                        sourceSets[0],
                        depth + 1
                    )
                );
            }

            return `LOCAL_${sourceLocal}`;
        }

        if (
            x.text.startsWith("call ")
        ) {
            return (
                `CALL_${x.func} before local ${local}`
            );
        }

        if (
            x.text.includes("load")
        ) {
            return (
                `MEMORY_LOAD before local ${local}`
            );
        }

        if (
            x.text === "if" ||
            x.text.startsWith("block") ||
            x.text.startsWith("loop") ||
            x.text === "else" ||
            x.text === "end"
        ) {
            continue;
        }
    }

    return "UNKNOWN";
}

export async function run() {
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        " TRACE FUNCTION 2774 WRITERS OF 114"
    );
    console.log(
        " READ ONLY - OFFLINE"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log("");

    console.log(
        "WASM size :",
        wasm.length
    );

    console.log(
        "Function  :",
        FUNC_INDEX
    );

    console.log(
        "Target    :",
        TARGET
    );

    console.log("");

    const bodies = parseCodeBodies();

    const body = bodies.find(
        x => x.index === FUNC_INDEX
    );

    if (!body)
        throw new Error(
            `Function ${FUNC_INDEX} not found`
        );

    const ins = decode(body);

    console.log(
        "Function range:",
        `${hex(body.start)} .. ${hex(body.end - 1)}`
    );

    console.log(
        "Instructions:",
        ins.length
    );

    console.log("");

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Locate CONST 114
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const constSites: number[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
        if (
            ins[i].text ===
            `i32.const ${TARGET}`
        ) {
            constSites.push(i);
        }
    }

    console.log(
        "CONST(114) sites:",
        constSites.length
    );

    console.log("");

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Analyze each CONST(114)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    for (
        let n = 0;
        n < constSites.length;
        n++
    ) {
        const ci = constSites[n];

        console.log(
            "------------------------------------------------------------"
        );

        console.log(
            `CONST(114) #${n + 1} @ ${hex(ins[ci].off)}`
        );

        console.log("");

        showRange(
            ins,
            ins[ci].off,
            16
        );

        console.log("");

        // Search next store.
        let storeIndex = -1;

        for (
            let i = ci + 1;
            i < Math.min(
                ins.length,
                ci + 20
            );
            i++
        ) {
            if (
                ins[i].text.includes("store")
            ) {
                storeIndex = i;
                break;
            }

            if (
                ins[i].text.startsWith(
                    "call_indirect"
                )
            )
                break;
        }

        if (storeIndex < 0) {
            console.log(
                "Next STORE: none"
            );
            console.log("");
            continue;
        }

        console.log(
            "Next STORE:",
            hex(ins[storeIndex].off)
        );

        console.log(
            "STORE instruction:",
            ins[storeIndex].text
        );

        /*
         * WebAssembly i32.store stack:
         *
         *   address
         *   value
         *   i32.store
         *
         * Therefore for:
         *
         *   local.get 2
         *   i32.const 114
         *   i32.store
         *
         * local 2 is the address.
         */

        if (
            ci + 1 === storeIndex - 1 &&
            ins[ci + 1].text.includes("store")
        ) {
            console.log(
                "Direct CONST(114) -> STORE : YES"
            );

            const addressIns = ins[ci - 1];

            if (
                addressIns &&
                addressIns.text.startsWith(
                    "local.get "
                )
            ) {
                const local =
                    addressIns.local!;

                console.log(
                    "STORE address local:",
                    local
                );

                const sources =
                    findLocalSources(
                        ins,
                        local,
                        ci
                    );

                console.log(
                    "Previous local definitions:",
                    sources.length
                );

                for (
                    const si of sources.slice(0, 20)
                ) {
                    console.log(
                        `  SET @ ${hex(ins[si].off)}`
                    );

                    console.log(
                        `    source = ${traceLocalSource(
                            ins,
                            local,
                            si
                        )}`
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        console.log("");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Locate all stores and identify address/value pattern
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        " ALL i32 STORE SITES IN FUNCTION 2774"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log("");

    let storeCount = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < ins.length; i++) {
        const x = ins[i];

        if (
            !x.text.startsWith("i32.store")
        )
            continue;

        storeCount++;

        console.log(
            `STORE #${storeCount} @ ${hex(x.off)} ${x.text}`
        );

        const a = Math.max(
            0,
            i - 4
        );

        for (
            let j = a;
            j <= i;
            j++
        ) {
            console.log(
                `  ${hex(ins[j].off)} ${ins[j].text}`
            );
        }

        console.log("");
    }

    console.log(
        "Total i32 stores:",
        storeCount
    );

    console.log("");

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Search loads of locals used as the address of 114 stores.
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        " FORWARD SEARCH AFTER 114 WRITERS"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log("");

    for (
        let n = 0;
        n < constSites.length;
        n++
    ) {
        const ci = constSites[n];

        if (
            ci === 0 ||
            !ins[ci - 1].text.startsWith(
                "local.get "
            )
        )
            continue;

        const addrLocal =
            ins[ci - 1].local!;

        let storeIndex = -1;

        for (
            let i = ci + 1;
            i < Math.min(
                ins.length,
                ci + 10
            );
            i++
        ) {
            if (
                ins[i].text.startsWith(
                    "i32.store"
                )
            ) {
                storeIndex = i;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (storeIndex < 0)
            continue;

        console.log(
            `Writer #${n + 1}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  address local = ${addrLocal}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  CONST @ ${hex(ins[ci].off)}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  STORE @ ${hex(ins[storeIndex].off)}`
        );

        console.log("");

        let loads = 0;
        let indirects = 0;

        for (
            let i = storeIndex + 1;
            i < ins.length;
            i++
        ) {
            const x = ins[i];

            if (
                x.text ===
                `local.get ${addrLocal}`
            ) {
                console.log(
                    `  LOCAL GET @ ${hex(x.off)}`
                );

                // Show following instructions.
                for (
                    let j = i + 1;
                    j < Math.min(
                        ins.length,
                        i + 8
                    );
                    j++
                ) {
                    console.log(
                        `    ${hex(ins[j].off)} ${ins[j].text}`
                    );

                    if (
                        ins[j].text.includes(
                            "load"
                        )
                    )
                        loads++;

                    if (
                        ins[j].text.startsWith(
                            "call_indirect"
                        )
                    ) {
                        indirects++;

                        console.log(
                            "    >>> CALL_INDIRECT AFTER WRITER <<<"
                        );
                    }
                }
            }

            if (
                x.text === "return"
            )
                break;
        }

        console.log(
            `  loads after writer = ${loads}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  indirects after writer = ${indirects}`
        );

        console.log("");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Final
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log(
        " FINAL"
    );
    console.log(
        "============================================================"
    );
    console.log("");

    console.log(
        "Function 2774 : analyzed"
    );

    console.log(
        "CONST(114)    :",
        constSites.length
    );

    console.log(
        "i32 stores    :",
        storeCount
    );

    console.log("");

    console.log(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    );

    console.log(
        "CONST(114)->STORE proves only a memory write."
    );

    console.log(
        "It does NOT yet prove table[114]."
    );

    console.log(
        "The decisive evidence is a later LOAD of the same"
    );

    console.log(
        "memory location feeding call_indirect type=0 table=0."
    );

    console.log("");
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log('READ ONLY');

    console.log('NO WALLET SIGNATURE WILL BE REQUESTED.');

        );

        console.log('get_pool_data: SUCCESS');
        console.log('');

        const stack = result.stack;

        const isLocked = stack.readBoolean();
        const routerAddress = stack.readAddress();

        const reserve0 = stack.readBigNumber();
        const reserve1 = stack.readBigNumber();

        const token1 = stack.readAddress();

        console.log('CURRENT ON-CHAIN DATA');

        console.log(`token0:       ${token0?.toString()}`);
        console.log(`token1:       ${token1?.toString()}`);
        console.log(`lp fee:       ${lpFee}`);

        console.log('');
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log(' 2. ADDRESS VALIDATION');
        console.log('============================================================');

        console.log(
            `${routerAddress?.equals(EXPECTED_ROUTER) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | Router`
        );

        console.log(
            `${token0?.equals(EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | Token0 = ROOSTER`
        );

        console.log(
            `${token1?.equals(EXPECTED_PTON_WALLET) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | Token1 = pTON`
        );

        console.log(
            `${isLocked === false ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | Pool unlocked`
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log(' 3. LIQUIDITY INPUT CROSS-CHECK');
        console.log('============================================================');

        console.log(`ROOSTER input: ${ROOSTER_AMOUNT}`);
        console.log(`ROOSTER display: ${Number(ROOSTER_AMOUNT) / 1e9}`);

        console.log(`pTON input: ${PTON_AMOUNT}`);
        console.log(`pTON display: ${Number(PTON_AMOUNT) / 1e9}`);

        console.log(`BOC minLpOut: ${BOC_MIN_LP}`);

        console.log('');
        console.log('CURRENT RESERVES');
        console.log(`ROOSTER reserve: ${reserve0}`);
        console.log(`pTON reserve:    ${reserve1}`);

        console.log('');
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log(' 4. BASIC RESERVE SANITY');
        console.log('============================================================');

        const roosterReservePositive = reserve0 > 0n;
        const ptonReservePositive = reserve1 > 0n;
        const lpSupplyPositive = totalSupply > 0n;

        console.log(
            `${roosterReservePositive ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | ROOSTER reserve > 0`
        );

        console.log(
            `${ptonReservePositive ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | pTON reserve > 0`
        );

        console.log(
            `${lpSupplyPositive ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | LP supply > 0`
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log(' 5. LP PROPORTION CHECK');
        console.log('============================================================');

        /*
         * For a proportional two-sided deposit, the LP amount is
         * constrained by both reserve ratios:
         *
         *   LP0 = amount0 * totalLP / reserve0
         *   LP1 = amount1 * totalLP / reserve1
         *
         * The smaller side is the limiting side.
         *
         * This is only a diagnostic calculation.
         * It does NOT build or send a transaction.
         */

        if (
            reserve0 > 0n &&
            reserve1 > 0n &&
            totalSupply > 0n
        ) {
            const lpFromRooster =
                (ROOSTER_AMOUNT * totalSupply) / reserve0;

            const lpFromPton =
                (PTON_AMOUNT * totalSupply) / reserve1;

            const proportionalLp =
                lpFromRooster < lpFromPton
                    ? lpFromRooster
                    : lpFromPton;

            console.log(`LP from ROOSTER side: ${lpFromRooster}`);
            console.log(`LP from pTON side:    ${lpFromPton}`);
            console.log(`Limiting LP amount:   ${proportionalLp}`);
            console.log(`BOC minLpOut:         ${BOC_MIN_LP}`);

            console.log('');

            console.log(
                `${BOC_MIN_LP <= proportionalLp ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | BOC minLpOut <= proportional LP estimate`
            );

            if (proportionalLp > 0n) {
                const slippageNumerator =
                    proportionalLp - BOC_MIN_LP;

                console.log(
                    `Difference from estimate: ${slippageNumerator}`
                );

                console.log(
                    `BOC minimum / estimate: ${Number(BOC_MIN_LP) / Number(proportionalLp)}`
                );
            }
        } else {
            console.log(
                'FAIL | Cannot calculate LP proportion because one or more reserves are zero.'
            );
        }

        console.log('');
        console.log('============================================================');
        console.log(' 6. FINAL READ-ONLY STATUS');
        console.log('============================================================');

        const addressesPass =
            routerAddress?.equals(EXPECTED_ROUTER) &&
            token0?.equals(EXPECTED_ROOSTER_WALLET) &&
            token1?.equals(EXPECTED_PTON_WALLET);

        const reservesPass =
            reserve0 > 0n &&
            reserve1 > 0n &&
            totalSupply > 0n;

        console.log(
            `${addressesPass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | Pool addresses`
        );

        console.log(
            `${reservesPass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | Pool reserves`
        );

        console.log(
            `${isLocked === false ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | Pool unlocked`
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            addressesPass && reservesPass && !isLocked
                ? 'STATUS: PASS'
                : 'STATUS: FAIL'
        );

    } catch (error) {
        console.log('');
        console.log('get_pool_data ERROR:');
        console.log(error);
    }

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' READ-ONLY INSPECTION FINISHED');
    console.log(' NO TRANSACTION SENT');
    console.log(' NO WALLET SIGNATURE REQUESTED');
    console.log('============================================================');
}

function header(title: string) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(` ${title}`);
    console.log('============================================================');

function check(
    label: string,
    actual: boolean,
    actualValue?: string,
    expectedValue?: string
) {
    console.log(`${actual ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} | ${label}`);

    if (!actual) {
        if (actualValue !== undefined) {
            console.log('  ACTUAL  :', actualValue);
        }

        if (expectedValue !== undefined) {
            console.log('  EXPECTED:', expectedValue);
        }
    }
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {

    console.log('NO FUNDS WILL MOVE.');

    // ============================================================

    const router =
        DEX.v2_2.Router.CPI.create(ROUTER);

    const routerProvider =
        provider.provider(ROUTER);

    const proxyTon =
        new DEX.v2_2.pTON(PTON_MASTER);

    console.log('Router:', ROUTER.toString());
    console.log('pTON master:', PTON_MASTER.toString());

    // ============================================================
    // 2. ROOSTER ENVELOPE
    // ============================================================

    header('2. ROOSTER EXTERNAL ENVELOPE');

    const roosterTx =
        await router.getProvideLiquidityJettonTxParams(
            routerProvider,
            {
                userWalletAddress: USER,

                sendTokenAddress:
