                otherTokenAddress:
                    PTON_MASTER,

                sendAmount:
                    100000000000n,

                minLpOut:
                    150109265n,

                receiverAddress:
                    USER,

                refundAddress:
                    USER,

                excessesAddress:
                    USER,

                transferExcessAddress:
                    USER,

                // Deadline is irrelevant for the
                // external destination/value check.
                // The saved BOC itself is validated separately.
                deadline:
                    Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 600,
            }
        );

    console.log('');
    console.log('SDK ROOSTER ENVELOPE');
    console.log('--------------------');

    console.log(
        'TO:',
        roosterTx.to.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'VALUE:',
        roosterTx.value.toString(),
        'nanoTON'
    );

    check(
        'ROOSTER external destination = ROOSTER wallet',

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const TARGET_FUNC = 656;

const CALLS = [
  { func: 473,  addr: 0x00020087 },
  { func: 599,  addr: 0x000284fb },
  { func: 1249, addr: 0x00057842 },
  { func: 1601, addr: 0x00071954 },
  { func: 2161, addr: 0x0009b0b8 },
  { func: 2161, addr: 0x0009b0fe },
  { func: 3490, addr: 0x0010da53 },
  { func: 6665, addr: 0x0022fa9e },
  { func: 7020, addr: 0x0023d95e },
];

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function uleb(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (true) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;
  }
}

function section(id: number) {
  let p = 8;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const sid = wasm[p++];

    const s = uleb(p);
    p = s.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = start + s.value;

    if (sid === id) {
      return { start, end };
    }

    p = end;
  }

  throw new Error(`SECTION ${id} NOT FOUND`);
}

function readTypes() {
  const sec = section(1);

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const types: {
    params: number[];
    results: number[];
  }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const form = wasm[p++];

    if (form !== 0x60) {
      throw new Error(
        `Unexpected type form 0x${form.toString(16)} at ${p - 1}`
      );
    }

    const pc = uleb(p);
    p = pc.next;

    const params: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < pc.value; j++) {
      params.push(wasm[p++]);
    }

    const rc = uleb(p);
    p = rc.next;

    const results: number[] = [];

    for (let j = 0; j < rc.value; j++) {
      results.push(wasm[p++]);
    }

    types.push({ params, results });
  }

  return types;
}

function getFunctionTypes() {
  const sec = section(3);

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const out: number[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const t = uleb(p);
    p = t.next;
    out.push(t.value);
  }

  return out;
}

function getBodies() {
  const sec = section(10);

  let p = sec.start;

  const count = uleb(p);
  p = count.next;

  const bodies: {
    start: number;
    end: number;
    code: number;
  }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
    const sz = uleb(p);
    p = sz.next;

    const start = p;
    const end = p + sz.value;

    const locals = uleb(p);
    p = locals.next;

    for (let j = 0; j < locals.value; j++) {
      const n = uleb(p);
      p = n.next;

      p++;
    }

    bodies.push({
      start,
      end,
      code: p,
    });

    p = end;
  }

  return bodies;
}

function hex(x: number) {
  return "0x" + x.toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
}

const types = readTypes();
const funcTypes = getFunctionTypes();
const bodies = getBodies();

      p = r.next;

    if (op === 0x41) {

      console.log(

      p = r.next;

    if (op === 0x22) {
      const r = uleb(p + 1);

      console.log(
        `${hex(p)} local.tee ${r.value}`
      );

      p = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x21) {
      const r = uleb(p + 1);

      console.log(
        `${hex(p)} local.set ${r.value}`
      );

      p = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x28) {
      const a = uleb(p + 1);
      const b = uleb(a.next);

      console.log(
        `${hex(p)} i32.load align=${a.value} offset=${b.value}`
      );

      p = b.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (op === 0x10) {
      const r = uleb(p + 1);

      console.log(
        `${hex(p)} call ${r.value}`
      );

      p = r.next;
      continue;
    }

    if (
      op === 0x6a ||
      op === 0x6b ||
      op === 0x6c ||
      op === 0x6d ||
      op === 0x6e ||
      op === 0x71 ||
      op === 0x74 ||
      op === 0x76 ||
      op === 0xa7
    ) {
      console.log(
        `${hex(p)} opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      );

      p++;
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * Stop at structural instructions.
     */
    if (
      op === 0x02 ||
      op === 0x03 ||
      op === 0x04 ||
      op === 0x05 ||
      op === 0x0b ||
      op === 0x0c ||
      op === 0x0d
    ) {
      console.log(
        `${hex(p)} structural opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
      );

      p++;
      continue;
    }

    console.log(
      `${hex(p)} opcode 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
    );

    p++;
  }
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM = "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const CALLS = [
  0x122c4, 0x122dc, 0x122f6, 0x12310, 0x1232c,
  0x12346, 0x12358, 0x1236b, 0x1237b, 0x1238b,
  0x1239b, 0x123ae, 0x123be, 0x123ce, 0x123de,
  0x123f0, 0x12403, 0x12416, 0x1242b, 0x12440,
  0x12455,
  0x12675, 0x12685, 0x12695, 0x126a5, 0x126b4,
  0x126c4, 0x126d4, 0x126e4, 0x126f4,
];

const EXPECTED_DEST = [
  432, 0, 384, 320, 96,
  208, 16, 224, 80, 192,
  464, 336, 304, 144, 416,
  32, 272, 160, 368, 128,
  256,
  48, 448, 400, 288, 432,
  176, 352, 112, 240,
];

const buf = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

function hex(n: number, width = 6) {
  return n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readU32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    const b = buf[pos++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: pos };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("ULEB overflow");
    }
  }

  throw new Error("EOF in ULEB");
}

function readI32Leb(pos: number): { value: number; next: number } {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let byte = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    byte = buf[pos++];
    value |= (byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error("SLEB overflow");
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (-1 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: pos };
}

function readI64Leb(pos: number): { value: bigint; next: number } {
  let value = 0n;
  let shift = 0n;
  let byte = 0;

  while (pos < buf.length) {
    byte = buf[pos++];
    value |= BigInt(byte & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7n;

    if ((byte & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > 70n) {
      throw new Error("I64 SLEB overflow");
    }
  }

  if (shift < 64n && (byte & 0x40)) {
    value |= (-1n) << shift;
  }

  return { value, next: pos };
}

function readU32(pos: number) {
  return buf.readUInt32LE(pos);
}

function readU64(pos: number) {
  return buf.readBigUInt64LE(pos);
}

function showBytes(start: number, end: number) {
  const a: string[] = [];

  for (let p = start; p < end; p += 16) {
    const e = Math.min(p + 16, end);

    let s = "";
    for (let q = p; q < e; q++) {
      s += buf[q].toString(16).padStart(2, "0") + " ";
    }

    console.log(
      `0x${hex(p)}  ${s.padEnd(48)}`
    );
  }
}

/*
 * Lightweight forward decoder.
 *
 * Important:
 * This is NOT the Function-122 semantic emulator.
 * It only recognizes instructions whose immediate encoding
 * is unambiguous and records the stack expression.
 */

type Val = {
  text: string;
};

function pop(stack: Val[], where: number): Val {
  if (stack.length === 0) {
    throw new Error(`STACK_UNDERFLOW @ 0x${hex(where)}`);
  }

  return stack.pop()!;
}

function binary(
  stack: Val[],
  op: string,
  where: number
) {
  const b = pop(stack, where);
  const a = pop(stack, where);

  stack.push({
    text: `(${a.text}${op}${b.text})`,
  });
}

function decodeWindow(
  start: number,
  end: number
) {
  const stack: Val[] = [];

  let p = start;

  while (p < end) {
    const at = p;
    const op = buf[p++];

    try {
      switch (op) {
        case 0x20: { // local.get
          const x = readU32Leb(p);
          p = x.next;

          stack.push({
            text: `L${x.value}`,
          });

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} local.get ${x.value}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x21: { // local.set
          const x = readU32Leb(p);
          p = x.next;

          const v = pop(stack, at);

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} local.set ${x.value} = ${v.text}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x22: { // local.tee
          const x = readU32Leb(p);
          p = x.next;

          const v = pop(stack, at);

          stack.push(v);

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} local.tee ${x.value} = ${v.text}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x41: { // i32.const
          const x = readI32Leb(p);
          p = x.next;

          stack.push({
            text: `I32CONST(${x.value})`,
          });

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} i32.const ${x.value}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x42: { // i64.const
          const x = readI64Leb(p);
          p = x.next;

          stack.push({
            text: `I64CONST(${x.value})`,
          });

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} i64.const ${x.value}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x28: { // i32.load
          const align = readU32Leb(p);
          p = align.next;

          const off = readU32Leb(p);
          p = off.next;

          const addr = pop(stack, at);

          stack.push({
            text: `MEM32[${addr.text}+${off.value}]`,
          });

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} i32.load offset=${off.value}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x29: { // i64.load
          const align = readU32Leb(p);
          p = align.next;

          const off = readU32Leb(p);
          p = off.next;

          const addr = pop(stack, at);

          stack.push({
            text: `MEM64[${addr.text}+${off.value}]`,
          });

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} i64.load offset=${off.value}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x36: { // i32.store
          const align = readU32Leb(p);
          p = align.next;

          const off = readU32Leb(p);
          p = off.next;

          const value = pop(stack, at);
          const addr = pop(stack, at);

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} i32.store offset=${off.value}`,
            `ADDR=${addr.text}`,
            `VALUE=${value.text}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x37: { // i64.store
          const align = readU32Leb(p);
          p = align.next;

          const off = readU32Leb(p);
          p = off.next;

          const value = pop(stack, at);
          const addr = pop(stack, at);

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} i64.store offset=${off.value}`,
            `ADDR=${addr.text}`,
            `VALUE=${value.text}`
          );
          break;
        }

        case 0x6a:
          binary(stack, "+", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i32.add`);
          break;

        case 0x6b:
          binary(stack, "-", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i32.sub`);
          break;

        case 0x7c:
          binary(stack, "+", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.add`);
          break;

        case 0x7d:
          binary(stack, "-", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.sub`);
          break;

        case 0x7e:
          binary(stack, "*", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.mul`);
          break;

        case 0x7f:
          binary(stack, "/", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.div_s`);
          break;

        case 0x80:
          binary(stack, "/u", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.div_u`);
          break;

        case 0x81:
          binary(stack, "%", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.rem_s`);
          break;

        case 0x82:
          binary(stack, "%u", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.rem_u`);
          break;

        case 0x83:
          binary(stack, "&", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.and`);
          break;

        case 0x84:
          binary(stack, "|", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.or`);
          break;

        case 0x85:
          binary(stack, "^", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.xor`);
          break;

        case 0x86:
          binary(stack, "<<", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.shl`);
          break;

        case 0x87:
          binary(stack, ">>s", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.shr_s`);
          break;

        case 0x88:
          binary(stack, ">>u", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.shr_u`);
          break;

        case 0x89:
          binary(stack, "rotl", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.rotl`);
          break;

        case 0x8a:
          binary(stack, "rotr", at);
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} i64.rotr`);
          break;

        case 0x10: { // call
          const f = readU32Leb(p);
          p = f.next;

          console.log(
            `0x${hex(at)} CALL ${f.value}`
          );

          /*
           * Function 87 has five i64 arguments:
           *
           * destination
           * A
           * arg2
           * B
           * arg4
           *
           * The exact type order was established separately.
           */
          if (f.value === 87) {
            const arg4 = pop(stack, at);
            const B = pop(stack, at);
            const arg2 = pop(stack, at);
            const A = pop(stack, at);
            const dest = pop(stack, at);

            console.log(`  DEST = ${dest.text}`);
            console.log(`  A    = ${A.text}`);
            console.log(`  B    = ${B.text}`);
            console.log(`  arg2 = ${arg2.text}`);
            console.log(`  arg4 = ${arg4.text}`);

            console.log(
              `  WRITE LOW  = MEM64[${dest.text}+0]`
            );

            console.log(
              `  WRITE HIGH = MEM64[${dest.text}+8]`
            );
          }

          break;
        }

        case 0x0b:
          console.log(`0x${hex(at)} END`);
          return;

        default:
          throw new Error(
            `UNKNOWN_OPCODE 0x${op.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")}`
          );
      }

    } catch (e) {
      console.log(
        `TRACE BARRIER @ 0x${hex(at)} : ${(e as Error).message}`
      );

      /*
       * Do not attempt to continue symbolic stack through
       * an unknown instruction.
       */
      stack.length = 0;

      /*
       * We stop this individual window.
       */
      return;
    }
  }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" CALL 87 WINDOW VERIFIER v1");

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${buf.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log("");

for (let i = 0; i < CALLS.length; i++) {
  const call = CALLS[i];

  /*
   * We intentionally inspect a bounded window before each CALL.
   * The window is independent from previous CALLs.
   */
  const start = Math.max(0, call - 48);

    `CALL #${i + 1} @ 0x${hex(call)}`
  );

  );

  showBytes(start, end);

  console.log("");

  try {
    decodeWindow(start, end);
  } catch (e) {

    );
  }

import fs from "fs";

const WASM_PATH =
  "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const CALLS = [
  [0x0122c4, 432],
  [0x0122dc, 0],
  [0x0122f6, 384],
  [0x012310, 320],
  [0x01232c, 96],
  [0x012346, 208],
  [0x012358, 16],
  [0x01236b, 224],
  [0x01237b, 80],
  [0x01238b, 192],
  [0x01239b, 464],
  [0x0123ae, 336],
  [0x0123be, 304],
  [0x0123ce, 144],
  [0x0123de, 416],
  [0x0123f0, 32],
  [0x012403, 272],
  [0x012416, 160],
  [0x01242b, 368],
  [0x012440, 128],
  [0x012455, 256],
  [0x012675, 48],
  [0x012685, 448],
  [0x012695, 400],
  [0x0126a5, 288],
  [0x0126b4, 432],
  [0x0126c4, 176],
  [0x0126d4, 352],
  [0x0126e4, 112],
  [0x0126f4, 240],
] as const;

const wasm = fs.readFileSync(WASM_PATH);

function hex(n: number, width = 6) {
  return "0x" + n.toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readULEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    const b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
      return { value: value >>> 0, next: p };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error(`ULEB too large @ ${hex(pos)}`);
    }
  }

  throw new Error(`EOF in ULEB @ ${hex(pos)}`);
}

function readSLEB(pos: number) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let p = pos;
  let b = 0;

  while (p < wasm.length) {
    b = wasm[p++];
    value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;
    shift += 7;

    if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

    if (shift > 35) {
      throw new Error(`SLEB too large @ ${hex(pos)}`);
    }
  }

  if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
    value |= (~0 << shift);
  }

  return { value: value | 0, next: p };
}

function readMemarg(pos: number) {
  const align = readULEB(pos);
  const offset = readULEB(align.next);

  return {
    align: align.value,
    offset: offset.value,
    next: offset.next,
  };
}

function opcodeName(op: number): string {
  const names: Record<number, string> = {
    0x0b: "end",
    0x10: "call",
    0x20: "local.get",
    0x21: "local.set",
    0x22: "local.tee",
    0x41: "i32.const",
    0x42: "i64.const",

    0x29: "i64.load",
    0x37: "i64.store",

    0x6a: "i32.add",
    0x6b: "i32.sub",

    0x7c: "i64.add",
    0x7d: "i64.sub",
    0x7e: "i64.mul",
    0x7f: "i64.div_s",
    0x80: "i64.div_u",
    0x81: "i64.rem_s",
    0x82: "i64.rem_u",
    0x83: "i64.and",
    0x84: "i64.or",
    0x85: "i64.xor",
    0x86: "i64.shl",
    0x87: "i64.shr_s",
    0x88: "i64.shr_u",
    0x89: "i64.rotl",
    0x8a: "i64.rotr",
  };

  return names[op] ?? `opcode_${hex(op, 2)}`;
}

function decodeOne(pos: number) {
  const start = pos;
  const op = wasm[pos++];

  switch (op) {
    case 0x20:
    case 0x21:
    case 0x22: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);
      return {
        start,
        next: x.next,
        text: `${opcodeName(op)} ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x41: {
      const x = readSLEB(pos);
      return {
        start,
        next: x.next,
        text: `i32.const ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x42: {
      /*
       * For this verifier we only need to identify i64.const.
       * Read signed LEB byte-wise.
       */
      let p = pos;
      let shift = 0n;
      let value = 0n;
      let b = 0;

      while (p < wasm.length) {
        b = wasm[p++];
        value |= BigInt(b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) break;

        shift += 7n;
      }

      return {
        start,
        next: p,
        text: `i64.const ${value.toString()}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x29:
    case 0x37: {
      const m = readMemarg(pos);

      return {
        start,
        next: m.next,
        text:
          `${opcodeName(op)} align=${m.align} offset=${m.offset}`,
      };
    }

    case 0x6a:
    case 0x6b:
    case 0x7c:
    case 0x7d:
    case 0x7e:
    case 0x7f:
    case 0x80:
    case 0x81:
    case 0x82:
    case 0x83:
    case 0x84:
    case 0x85:
    case 0x86:
    case 0x87:
    case 0x88:
    case 0x89:
    case 0x8a:
    case 0x0b:
      return {
        start,
        next: pos,
        text: opcodeName(op),
      };

    case 0x10: {
      const x = readULEB(pos);

      return {
        start,
        next: x.next,
        text: `call ${x.value}`,
      };
    }

    default:
      return {
        start,
        next: pos,
        text: `UNKNOWN ${hex(op, 2)}`,
      };
  }
}

/*
 * We know the CALL position exactly.
 *
 * Instead of pretending that the preceding bytes form an independent
 * function, locate instruction boundaries by trying candidate starts
 * and require exact decoding to end at the CALL byte.
 */
function findInstructionBoundary(callPos: number, maxBack = 48) {
  for (
    let candidate = Math.max(0, callPos - maxBack);
    candidate < callPos;
    candidate++
  ) {
    let p = candidate;
    let count = 0;

    try {
      while (p < callPos && count < 32) {
        const d = decodeOne(p);

        if (d.next <= p || d.next > callPos) {
          break;
        }

        p = d.next;
        count++;
      }

      if (p === callPos) {
        return candidate;
      }
    } catch {
      // try next candidate
    }
  }

  return null;
}

function printWindow(callPos: number) {
  const start = Math.max(0, callPos - 24);

  console.log(`RAW ${hex(start)} .. ${hex(callPos + 4)}`);

  for (let p = start; p < callPos + 4;) {
    const d = decodeOne(p);

    const bytes = Array.from(
      wasm.subarray(p, d.next)
    )
      .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join(" ");

    console.log(
      `${hex(p)}  ${bytes.padEnd(24)}  ${d.text}`
    );

    if (d.next <= p) break;
    p = d.next;
  }
}

let passed = 0;

for (let i = 0; i < CALLS.length; i++) {

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

const TARGETS = [
  0x50098050,
  0x50098054
];

function hex(v, width = 8) {
  return "0x" + (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(width, "0");
}

function readSLEB32(pos) {
  let value = 0;
  let shift = 0;
  let bytes = 0;

  while (pos + bytes < b.length) {
    const x = b[pos + bytes];

    value |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    bytes++;

    if (!(x & 0x80)) {
      shift += 7;

      // Sign extension for i32
      if (shift < 32 && (x & 0x40)) {
        value |= (~0 << shift);
      }

      return {
        signed: value | 0,
        unsigned: value >>> 0,
        bytes
      };
    }

    shift += 7;

    if (shift > 35) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

import fs from "fs";

const file = "emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";
const b = fs.readFileSync(file);

function uleb(pos) {
  let v = 0;
  let shift = 0;

  while (true) {
    const x = b[pos++];
    v |= (x & 0x7f) << shift;
    if (!(x & 0x80)) return { value: v >>> 0, next: pos };
    shift += 7;
  }
}

function skipInitExpr(pos) {
  const opcode = b[pos++];

  // i32.const
  if (opcode === 0x41) {
    const x = uleb(pos);
    pos = x.next;
  }
  // i64.const
  else if (opcode === 0x42) {
    const x = uleb(pos);
    pos = x.next;
  }
  // global.get
  else if (opcode === 0x23) {
    const x = uleb(pos);
    pos = x.next;
  }
  else {
    throw new Error(
      `Unknown init-expr opcode 0x${opcode.toString(16)} at 0x${(pos - 1).toString(16)}`
    );
  }

  if (b[pos++] !== 0x0b)
    throw new Error("Missing init-expr END");

  return pos;
}

let p = 8;
let tableCount = 0;
let found = new Map();

while (p < b.length) {
  const sectionId = b[p++];

  const s = uleb(p);
  const sectionSize = s.value;
  const sectionStart = s.next;
  const sectionEnd = sectionStart + sectionSize;

  if (sectionId === 9) {
    let q = sectionStart;

    const n = uleb(q);
    q = n.next;

    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log("ELEMENT SECTION RAW RESOLVER");
    console.log("READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
    console.log("============================================================");
    console.log(`ELEMENT SEGMENTS : ${n.value}`);
    console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

    for (let seg = 0; seg < n.value; seg++) {
      const flag = uleb(q);
      q = flag.next;

      let tableIndex = 0;
      let active = true;

      /*
       Element segment flags:

       0 = active, table 0, elemkind omitted
       1 = passive, elemkind omitted
       2 = active, explicit table, elemkind omitted
       3 = declarative, elemkind omitted
       4 = active, expressions
       5 = passive, expressions
       6 = active explicit table, expressions
       7 = declarative, expressions
      */

      if (flag.value === 0) {
        q = skipInitExpr(q);
      }
      else if (flag.value === 1) {
        active = false;
      }
      else if (flag.value === 2) {
        const ti = uleb(q);
        tableIndex = ti.value;
        q = ti.next;
        q = skipInitExpr(q);
      }
      else if (flag.value === 3) {
        active = false;
      }
      else if (flag.value === 4) {
        q = skipInitExpr(q);
      }
      else if (flag.value === 5) {
        active = false;
      }
      else if (flag.value === 6) {
        const ti = uleb(q);
        tableIndex = ti.value;
        q = ti.next;
        q = skipInitExpr(q);
      }
      else if (flag.value === 7) {
        active = false;
      }
      else {
        throw new Error(`Unknown element flag ${flag.value}`);
      }

      let exprElements = false;

      if (flag.value >= 4)
        exprElements = true;

      if (!exprElements) {
        /*
         For flags 0/1/2/3:
         element type is funcref only for legacy encoding
         OR omitted in the active/passive forms depending on flag.
        */

        if (flag.value === 0 || flag.value === 1 || flag.value === 2) {
          // elemkind
          q++;
        }

        const count = uleb(q);
        q = count.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
          const f = uleb(q);
          q = f.next;

          const absoluteIndex =
            (() => {
              /*
               Active segments are placed at their declared offset.
               For this resolver we collect only if offset was a constant.
              */
              return f.value;
            })();

          if (
            absoluteIndex === 4788 ||
            absoluteIndex === 4789 ||
            absoluteIndex === 4790 ||
            absoluteIndex === 4791
          ) {
            found.set(absoluteIndex, {
              func: f.value,
              segment: seg,
              tableIndex,
              elementPosition: i,
              count: count.value
            });
          }
        }
      }
      else {
        /*
         Expression element format:
         element type / ref type then expressions.
        */
        const refType = b[q++];

        const count = uleb(q);
        q = count.next;

        for (let i = 0; i < count.value; i++) {
          const exprOpcode = b[q++];

          if (exprOpcode !== 0xd2)
            throw new Error(
              `Expected ref.func, got 0x${exprOpcode.toString(16)}`
            );

          const f = uleb(q);
          q = f.next;

          if (b[q++] !== 0x0b)
            throw new Error("Missing expression END");

          if (
            i === 4788 ||
            i === 4789 ||
            i === 4790 ||
            i === 4791
          ) {
            found.set(i, {
              func: f.value,
              segment: seg,
              tableIndex,
              elementPosition: i,
              count: count.value,
              refType
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  p = sectionEnd;
}

console.log("------------------------------------------------------------");

for (const index of [4788, 4789, 4790, 4791]) {

  if (x) {
    console.log(

      `(segment=${x.segment}, position=${x.elementPosition})`
    );
  } else {
    console.log(`TABLE[${index}] -> NOT FOUND`);
  }
}

const fs = require("fs");

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

function readU32(buf, p) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            return {
                value: value >>> 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function readS32(buf, p) {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;

    while (true) {
        const b = buf[p++];

        value |= (b & 0x7f) << shift;

        if ((b & 0x80) === 0) {
            if (shift < 32 && (b & 0x40)) {
                value |= (-1 << (shift + 7));
            }

            return {
                value: value | 0,
                next: p
            };
        }

        shift += 7;
    }
}

function getSections(buf) {
    const sections = [];

    let p = 8;

    while (p < buf.length) {
        const id = buf[p++];

        const sizeInfo = readU32(buf, p);
        p = sizeInfo.next;

        const start = p;
        const end = start + sizeInfo.value;

        sections.push({
            id,
            start,
            end,
            size: sizeInfo.value
        });

        p = end;
    }

    return sections;
}

            "0x" + opcode.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
        );

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
            throw new Error(
                `Expected i32.const, got 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
            );
        }

        const offsetInfo = readS32(wasm, p);
        p = offsetInfo.next;

        tableIndex = offsetInfo.value;

        const end = wasm[p++];

        if (end !== 0x0b) {
            throw new Error("Invalid offset expression end");
        }

    } else if (flags === 2) {

        const tableInfo = readU32(wasm, p);
        p = tableInfo.next;

        console.log("TABLE INDEX :", tableInfo.value);

        const opcode = wasm[p++];

        if (opcode !== 0x41) {
            throw new Error(
                `Expected i32.const, got 0x${opcode.toString(16)}`
            );
        }

        const offsetInfo = readS32(wasm, p);
        p = offsetInfo.next;

        tableIndex = offsetInfo.value;

        const end = wasm[p++];

        if (end !== 0x0b) {
            throw new Error("Invalid offset expression end");
        }

    } else {

        throw new Error(
            `Unsupported element flags ${flags} at segment ${seg}`
        );
    }

    console.log("TABLE OFFSET :", tableIndex);

    const elemType = wasm[p++];

    console.log(
        "ELEMENT TYPE :",
        "0x" + elemType.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")
    );

    const countInfo = readU32(wasm, p);
    p = countInfo.next;

    const count = countInfo.value;

    console.log("FUNCTION COUNT :", count);
    console.log();

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

        const pos = p;

        const f = readU32(wasm, p);
        p = f.next;

        const index = tableIndex + i;

        table[index] = {
            functionIndex: f.value,
            rawPosition: pos
        };
    }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("TABLE VALIDATION");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log();

console.log("TABLE ENTRIES :", table.length);

const maxIndex = table.length - 1;

console.log("MAX TABLE INDEX :", maxIndex);

console.log();

const targets = [579, 1209, 2053];

for (const index of targets) {

    const e = table[index];

    if (!e) {
        console.log(
            `TABLE[${index}] : MISSING`
        );
        continue;
    }

    console.log(
        `TABLE[${index}] -> FUNC ${e.functionIndex} ` +
        `RAW=0x${e.rawPosition.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
    );
}

console.log();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("SELECTED RAW NEIGHBORHOODS");
console.log("============================================================");

for (const center of targets) {

    console.log();
    console.log(`AROUND TABLE[${center}]`);

    for (
        let i = Math.max(0, center - 5);
        i <= Math.min(maxIndex, center + 5);
        i++
    ) {

        const e = table[i];

        if (!e) continue;

        console.log(
            `TABLE[${String(i).padStart(5)}] -> ` +
            `FUNC ${String(e.functionIndex).padStart(5)} ` +
            `RAW=0x${e.rawPosition.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
        );
    }
}

console.log();

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log("EXPECTED TABLE ENTRIES : 8992");
console.log("ACTUAL TABLE ENTRIES   :", table.length);

if (table.length !== 8992) {
    console.log();

} else {
    console.log();
    console.log("ELEMENT TABLE COUNT VERIFIED.");
}

console.log("NETWORK : NO");
console.log("TRANSACTIONS : NO");

function sameAddress(a: Address, b: Address): boolean {
    return a.equals(b);
}

function pass(name: string) {
    console.log(`PASS  ${name}`);
}

function fail(name: string, reason: string): never {
    throw new Error(`${name}: ${reason}`);
}

function readAddress(
    slice: ReturnType<Cell['beginParse']>,
    name: string
): Address {
    const address = slice.loadAddress();

    if (!address) {
        fail(name, 'Address is null.');
    }

    return address;
}

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =
    "G:\\Rooster Coin\\Rooster_Coin\\emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm";

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;
const CODE_PAYLOAD_START = 0x6e7d;

function readULEB(offset: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = offset;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(
                `ULEB too large at 0x${offset.toString(16)}`
            );
        }
    }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION MAP VERIFIER V2");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${b.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log(`Code payload start : 0x${CODE_PAYLOAD_START.toString(16)}`);
console.log(`Import count       : ${IMPORT_COUNT}`);
console.log("");

let p = CODE_PAYLOAD_START;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const functionCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

console.log(`Function bodies : ${functionCount}`);
console.log("");

let found205 = false;
let found122 = false;

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < functionCount; bodyIndex++) {
    const bodyStart = p;

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);
    const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;
    const codeStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const bodyEnd = bodyStart + bodySize;

    if (bodyEnd > b.length) {
        throw new Error(
            `Body exceeds file at body #${bodyIndex}: ` +
            `0x${bodyEnd.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    const realIndex = IMPORT_COUNT + bodyIndex;

    if (
        realIndex === 122 ||
        realIndex === 205 ||
        bodyIndex === 0 ||
        bodyIndex === 39 ||
        bodyIndex === 122
    ) {
        console.log(
            `body #${bodyIndex.toString().padStart(4, " ")} ` +
            `real=${realIndex.toString().padStart(4, " ")} ` +
            `body=0x${bodyStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}..` +
            `0x${bodyEnd.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")} ` +
            `size=${bodySize} ` +
            `code=0x${codeStart.toString(16).padStart(8, "0")}`
        );
    }

    if (realIndex === 122) {
        found122 = true;

        if (
            bodyStart !== 0x0eec5 ||
            codeStart !== 0x0eec8 ||
            bodyEnd !== 0x0ef44
        ) {
            console.log("  !!! FUNCTION 122 MISMATCH !!!");
        } else {
            console.log("  FUNCTION 122 : VERIFIED");
        }
    }

    if (realIndex === 205) {
        found205 = true;

        if (
            bodyStart !== 0x1226b ||
            codeStart !== 0x1226d ||
            bodyEnd !== 0x1295c
        ) {
            console.log("  !!! FUNCTION 205 MISMATCH !!!");
        } else {
            console.log("  FUNCTION 205 : VERIFIED");
        }
    }

    p = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`Function 122 found : ${found122}`);
console.log(`Function 205 found : ${found205}`);
console.log(`Final parser offset: 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
console.log(`Code section end   : 0x324ef5`);

if (!found122 || !found205) {
    throw new Error("Required functions were not found");
}

if (p !== 0x324ef5) {
    throw new Error(
        `Code section boundary mismatch: ` +
        `parser=0x${p.toString(16)} expected=0x324ef5`
    );
}

console.log("CODE SECTION BOUNDARY : VERIFIED");

import fs from "fs";

const WASM =

const b = fs.readFileSync(WASM);

const IMPORT_COUNT = 83;
const CODE_PAYLOAD_START = 0x6e7d;
const CODE_END = 0x324ef5;

function readULEB(offset: number): {
    value: number;
    next: number;
} {
    let value = 0;
    let shift = 0;
    let p = offset;

    while (true) {
        const x = b[p++];

        value += (x & 0x7f) * Math.pow(2, shift);

        if ((x & 0x80) === 0) {
            return { value, next: p };
        }

        shift += 7;

        if (shift > 35) {
            throw new Error(
                `ULEB too large at 0x${offset.toString(16)}`
            );
        }
    }
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log(" FUNCTION MAP VERIFIER V3");
console.log(" READ ONLY - OFFLINE");
console.log("============================================================");
console.log(`WASM size : ${b.length.toLocaleString()}`);
console.log("");

let p = CODE_PAYLOAD_START;

const countInfo = readULEB(p);
const functionCount = countInfo.value;
p = countInfo.next;

console.log(`Function bodies : ${functionCount}`);
console.log(`First body size field : 0x${p.toString(16)}`);
console.log("");

let found122 = false;
let found205 = false;

for (let bodyIndex = 0; bodyIndex < functionCount; bodyIndex++) {

    // p points to the SIZE FIELD
    const sizeField = p;

    const sizeInfo = readULEB(p);

    const bodySize = sizeInfo.value;

    // IMPORTANT:
    // bodySize excludes the size field itself.
    const codeStart = sizeInfo.next;
    const bodyEnd = codeStart + bodySize;

    if (bodyEnd > CODE_END) {
        throw new Error(
            `Body exceeds Code Section at body #${bodyIndex}: ` +
            `end=0x${bodyEnd.toString(16)}`
        );
    }

    const realIndex = IMPORT_COUNT + bodyIndex;

    if (
        bodyIndex === 0 ||
        realIndex === 122 ||
        realIndex === 205
    ) {
        console.log(
            `body #${bodyIndex.toString().padStart(4, " ")} ` +
            `real=${realIndex.toString().padStart(4, " ")}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  size field : 0x${sizeField.toString(16)}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  body size  : ${bodySize} ` +
            `(0x${bodySize.toString(16)})`
        );

        console.log(
            `  code start : 0x${codeStart.toString(16)}`
        );

        console.log(
            `  body end   : 0x${bodyEnd.toString(16)}`
        );

        console.log("");
    }

    if (realIndex === 122) {
        found122 = true;

        if (
            sizeField !== 0x0eec5 ||
            codeStart !== 0x0eec8 ||
            bodyEnd !== 0x0ef44
        ) {
            console.log("  !!! FUNCTION 122 MISMATCH !!!");
        } else {
            console.log("  FUNCTION 122 : VERIFIED");
        }

        console.log("");
    }

    if (realIndex === 205) {
        found205 = true;

        if (
            sizeField !== 0x1226b ||
            codeStart !== 0x1226d ||
            bodyEnd !== 0x1295c
        ) {
            console.log("  !!! FUNCTION 205 MISMATCH !!!");
        } else {
            console.log("  FUNCTION 205 : VERIFIED");
        }

        console.log("");
    }

    // NEXT BODY:
    // exactly at the byte after this body's contents
    p = bodyEnd;
}

console.log("============================================================");
console.log("FINAL");
console.log("============================================================");

console.log(`Function 122 found : ${found122}`);
console.log(`Function 205 found : ${found205}`);
console.log(
    `Final parser offset: 0x${p.toString(16)}`
);
console.log(
    `Code section end   : 0x${CODE_END.toString(16)}`
);

if (!found122 || !found205) {
    throw new Error("Required functions were not found");
}

if (p !== CODE_END) {
    throw new Error(
        `Code section boundary mismatch: ` +
        `parser=0x${p.toString(16)} ` +
        `expected=0x${CODE_END.toString(16)}`
    );
}

console.log("");
console.log("CODE SECTION BOUNDARY : VERIFIED");
console.log("FUNCTION MAP : VERIFIED");

import fs from "fs";

const b = fs.readFileSync("emulator-emscripten-extracted.wasm");

function u(p) {
  let v = 0, s = 0;
  while (true) {
    const x = b[p++];
    v += (x & 127) * 2 ** s;
    if (!(x & 128)) return [v >>> 0, p];
    s += 7;
  }
}

function str(p) {
  const [n, q] = u(p);
  return [b.toString("utf8", q, q + n), q + n];
}

function valtype(x) {
  const m = {
    0x7f: "i32",
    0x7e: "i64",
    0x7d: "f32",
    0x7c: "f64",
    0x70: "funcref",
    0x6f: "externref"
  };
  return m[x] ?? `0x${x.toString(16)}`;
}

function parseType(p) {
  const form = b[p++];
  if (form !== 0x60) {
    throw new Error(`Expected functype at offset 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`);
  }

  const [pc, q0] = u(p);
  p = q0;

  const params = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < pc; i++) {
    params.push(valtype(b[p++]));
  }

  const [rc, q1] = u(p);
  p = q1;

  const results = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < rc; i++) {
    results.push(valtype(b[p++]));
  }

  return [{ params, results }, p];
}

const typeEntries = [];
const importFuncTypeIdx = [];
const definedFuncTypeIdx = [];
const importFuncNames = [];

let p = 8;

while (p < b.length) {
  const id = b[p++];
  const [size, q] = u(p);
  p = q;

  const start = p;
  const end = p + size;

  if (end > b.length) {
    throw new Error(`Section ${id} exceeds WASM bounds`);
  }

  // TYPE SECTION
  if (id === 1) {
    const [count, q0] = u(p);
    p = q0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const [t, q1] = parseType(p);
      p = q1;
      typeEntries.push(t);
    }
  }

  // IMPORT SECTION
  if (id === 2) {
    const [count, q0] = u(p);
    p = q0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      let moduleName, fieldName;

      [moduleName, p] = str(p);
      [fieldName, p] = str(p);

      const kind = b[p++];

      if (kind === 0) {
        const [typeIdx, q1] = u(p);
        p = q1;

        importFuncTypeIdx.push(typeIdx);
        importFuncNames.push({
          index: importFuncTypeIdx.length - 1,
          moduleName,
          fieldName,
          typeIdx
        });
      } else if (kind === 1) {
        // Table type
        p++; // element type
        const [flags, q1] = u(p);
        p = q1;

        let result;
        [result, p] = u(p);

        if (flags & 1) {
          [result, p] = u(p);
        }
      } else if (kind === 2) {
        // Memory type
        const [flags, q1] = u(p);
        p = q1;

        let result;
        [result, p] = u(p);

        if (flags & 1) {
          [result, p] = u(p);
        }
      } else if (kind === 3) {
        // Global type
        p += 2;
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Unknown import kind ${kind} at 0x${(p - 1).toString(16)}`);
      }
    }
  }

  // FUNCTION SECTION
  if (id === 3) {
    const [count, q0] = u(p);
    p = q0;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const [typeIdx, q1] = u(p);
      p = q1;
      definedFuncTypeIdx.push(typeIdx);
    }
  }

  p = end;
}

const importedFunctions = importFuncTypeIdx.length;

console.log("============================================");
console.log("EXACT FUNCTION TYPE RESOLUTION");
console.log("============================================");
console.log(`TYPE COUNT             : ${typeEntries.length}`);
console.log(`IMPORTED FUNCTIONS     : ${importedFunctions}`);
console.log(`DEFINED FUNCTIONS      : ${definedFuncTypeIdx.length}`);
console.log("");

console.log("TARGET IMPORT");
console.log("--------------------------------------------");

const targetImport = importFuncNames.find(x => x.index === 3);

if (!targetImport) {
  console.log("Imported function 3 not found");
} else {
  const t = typeEntries[targetImport.typeIdx];

  console.log(`FUNCTION INDEX : ${targetImport.index}`);
  console.log(`MODULE         : ${targetImport.moduleName}`);
  console.log(`NAME           : ${targetImport.fieldName}`);
  console.log(`TYPE INDEX     : ${targetImport.typeIdx}`);

  if (t) {
    console.log(
      `SIGNATURE      : (${t.params.join(",")}) -> (${t.results.join(",")})`
    );
  } else {
    console.log("SIGNATURE      : UNKNOWN TYPE");
  }
}

console.log("");
console.log("TYPE 1 SIGNATURE");
console.log("--------------------------------------------");

if (typeEntries[1]) {
  console.log(`TYPE INDEX : 1`);
  console.log(
    `SIGNATURE  : (${typeEntries[1].params.join(",")}) -> (${typeEntries[1].results.join(",")})`
  );
} else {
  console.log("TYPE INDEX 1 NOT FOUND");
}

console.log("");
console.log("TARGET FUNCTIONS");
console.log("--------------------------------------------");

for (const func of [122, 235, 656, 787, 91]) {
  let typeIdx;

  if (func < importedFunctions) {
    typeIdx = importFuncTypeIdx[func];
  } else {
    typeIdx = definedFuncTypeIdx[func - importedFunctions];
  }

  const t = typeEntries[typeIdx];

  console.log(`FUNC ${func}`);
  console.log(`TYPE INDEX : ${typeIdx}`);

  if (!t) {
    console.log("TYPE       : UNKNOWN");
  } else {
    console.log(
      `SIGNATURE  : (${t.params.join(",")}) -> (${t.results.join(",")})`
    );
  }

  console.log("");
}

console.log("============================================");

import { Address, beginCell } from '@ton/core';
import { NetworkProvider } from '@ton/blueprint';

const USER = Address.parse(
    'EQDxn5MLbFyV649-OBviQrMp5KqWjGHNVwFM6GTeaLl8N0Ix'
);

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const EXPECTED_LP_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCNnXhynq5G7RZ8glhXSNg6eXby1kzqD-p8HNxu6PN5SIgd'
);

function printAddress(label: string, address: Address) {
    console.log(`${label}:`);
    console.log(`  ${address.toString()}`);
    console.log(`  raw: ${address.toRawString()}`);
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    const client = provider.api();

    console.log('');
    console.log('==============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI v2.2 LP JETTON WALLET VERIFIER');
    console.log(' READ ONLY - NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT');
    console.log('==============================================================');
    console.log('');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. Pool -> get_wallet_address(user)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('1) Pool get_wallet_address(user)');
    console.log('');

    const lastBlock = await client.getLastBlock();

    const seqno = lastBlock.last.seqno;

    console.log('MASTERCHAIN SEQNO:', seqno);
    console.log('');

    printAddress('USER', USER);
    console.log('');
    printAddress('POOL', POOL);
    console.log('');
    printAddress(
        'EXPECTED LP WALLET',
        EXPECTED_LP_WALLET
    );
    console.log('');

    const walletResult = await client.runMethod(
        seqno,
        POOL,
        'get_wallet_address',
        [
            {
                type: 'slice',
                cell: beginCell()
                    .storeAddress(USER)
                    .endCell(),
            },
        ]
    );

    console.log(
        'get_wallet_address EXIT CODE:',
        walletResult.exitCode
    );

    if (walletResult.exitCode !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `get_wallet_address failed: ${walletResult.exitCode}`
        );
    }

    const calculatedLpWallet =
        walletResult.reader.readAddress();

    console.log('');

    printAddress(
        'CALCULATED LP WALLET',
        calculatedLpWallet
    );

    console.log('');

    console.log(
        'CALCULATED == EXPECTED:',
        calculatedLpWallet.equals(EXPECTED_LP_WALLET)
            ? 'YES'
            : 'NO'
    );

    console.log('');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. LP Wallet get_wallet_data
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('2) LP Jetton Wallet get_wallet_data()');
    console.log('');

    const walletData = await client.runMethod(
        seqno,
        EXPECTED_LP_WALLET,
        'get_wallet_data'
    );

    console.log(
        'get_wallet_data EXIT CODE:',
        walletData.exitCode
    );

    if (walletData.exitCode !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `get_wallet_data failed: ${walletData.exitCode}`
        );
    }

    const balance =
        walletData.reader.readBigNumber();

    const owner =
        walletData.reader.readAddress();

    const jettonMaster =
        walletData.reader.readAddress();

    console.log('');
    console.log('LP WALLET DATA');
    console.log('--------------------------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'balance:',
        balance.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'balance display:',
        Number(balance) / 1_000_000_000
    );

    console.log('');

    printAddress('OWNER', owner);

    console.log('');

    printAddress(
        'JETTON MASTER',
        jettonMaster
    );

    console.log('');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. LP Jetton Master
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    console.log('3) LP Jetton Master get_jetton_data()');
    console.log('');

    const masterData = await client.runMethod(
        seqno,
        jettonMaster,
        'get_jetton_data'
    );

    console.log(
        'get_jetton_data EXIT CODE:',
        masterData.exitCode
    );

    if (masterData.exitCode !== 0) {
        throw new Error(
            `get_jetton_data failed: ${masterData.exitCode}`
        );
    }

    const masterSupply =
        masterData.reader.readBigNumber();

    const mintable =
        masterData.reader.readBoolean();

    const adminAddress =
        masterData.reader.readAddress();

    console.log('');
    console.log('LP JETTON MASTER DATA');
    console.log('--------------------------------------------------------------');

    console.log(
        'total_supply:',
        masterSupply.toString()
    );

    console.log(
        'total_supply display:',
        Number(masterSupply) / 1_000_000_000
    );

    console.log(
        'mintable:',
        mintable
    );

    console.log('');

    printAddress(
        'ADMIN',
        adminAddress
    );

    console.log('');

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Final verification
    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    const walletMatches =
        calculatedLpWallet.equals(
            EXPECTED_LP_WALLET
        );

    const ownerMatches =
        owner.equals(USER);

    const balancePositive =
        balance > 0n;

    console.log(
        '=============================================================='
    );

    console.log(' FINAL VERIFICATION');

    console.log(
        '=============================================================='
    );

    console.log(
        'LP wallet derived from Pool :',
        walletMatches ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    console.log(
        'LP wallet owner = user      :',
        ownerMatches ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    console.log(
        'LP balance > 0              :',
        balancePositive ? 'YES' : 'NO'
    );

    console.log('');

    if (
        walletMatches &&
        ownerMatches &&
        balancePositive
    ) {
        console.log(
            'RESULT: LP TOKEN OWNERSHIP VERIFIED'
        );
    } else {
        console.log(
            'RESULT: VERIFICATION INCOMPLETE'
        );
    }

    console.log('');

    console.log('READ ONLY: YES');
    console.log('TRANSACTION SENT: NO');
    console.log('');
}

    '0:92e1411ae546892f33b2c8a89ea90390d8ff4cfbb917a643b91e73f706fdb9d2'
);

const ROOSTER_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQCyuv-cYXFibA05bhiL3seM3Ur2B_bpsc364Zb8F3NMtrYx'
);

const PTON_MASTER = Address.parse(
    'EQBnGWMCf3-FZZq1W4IWcWiGAc3PHuZ0_H-7sad2oY00o83S'
);

const POOL = Address.parse(
    'EQD5ALaCuEqJ7Mi9qlXOA7BHMrTq8e2fZ5B_teWN17MZq-cf'
);

const ROOSTER_POOL_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCePy3CW0qsWj03tvCwBxpavtYcu27LURfEy7H6tRhTbwsq'

const PTON_POOL_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQCSIMGBps_qzRG3uPYhON8bucyCtu0mYdL1-u4gSz77IBa3'
);

const ROOSTER_ROUTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQBs7M6C4uvWFgzpN5WnQ6O-CdkoL1bs_noltSxuMOwCoXAC'

const PTON_ROUTER_WALLET = Address.parse(
    'EQDOvISNl85xReKzTbu4yl-S9wWjHM8sFFkcWWAe0YKF_Adu'
);

function compareAddress(
    label: string,
    actual: Address,
    expected: Address,
) {
    const match = actual.equals(expected);

    console.log('');
    console.log(label);
    console.log('Actual:');
    console.log(actual.toString());
    console.log('Expected:');
    console.log(expected.toString());
    console.log(`MATCH: ${match ? 'YES' : 'NO'}`);

    return match;
}

export async function run(provider: NetworkProvider) {
    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' STON.FI V2.2 POOL TOKEN ORDER VERIFIER');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('READ-ONLY');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('NO ROOSTER WILL BE TRANSFERRED.');
    console.log('NO TON WILL BE TRANSFERRED.');

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROUTER:');
    console.log(ROUTER.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('POOL:');
    console.log(POOL.toString());

    const pool = DEX.v2_2.Pool.CPI.create(POOL);

    console.log('');
    console.log('Reading Pool data...');

    const poolData = await pool.getPoolData(
    provider.provider(POOL)
);

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' POOL DATA');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Router address from Pool:');
    console.log(poolData.routerAddress.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Token 0 wallet:');
    console.log(poolData.token0WalletAddress.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Token 1 wallet:');
    console.log(poolData.token1WalletAddress.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Reserve 0 raw:');
    console.log(poolData.reserve0.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Reserve 1 raw:');
    console.log(poolData.reserve1.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Total LP:');
    console.log(poolData.totalSupplyLP.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('Locked:');
    console.log(poolData.isLocked);

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' POOL ADDRESS / TOKEN ORDER');
    console.log('============================================================');

    const routerMatch = compareAddress(
        'Router address',
        poolData.routerAddress,
        ROUTER,
    );

    const token0RoosterMatch = compareAddress(
        'Token 0 = ROOSTER pool wallet',
        poolData.token0WalletAddress,
        ROOSTER_POOL_WALLET,
    );

    const token1PtonMatch = compareAddress(
        'Token 1 = pTON pool wallet',
        poolData.token1WalletAddress,
        PTON_POOL_WALLET,
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' EXPECTED TOKEN ORDER');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('Expected:');
    console.log('Token 0 = ROOSTER');
    console.log('Token 1 = pTON');

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `TOKEN ORDER MATCH: ${
            token0RoosterMatch && token1PtonMatch ? 'YES' : 'NO'
        }`,
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER WALLET RELATION');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log('ROOSTER Router Wallet:');
    console.log(ROOSTER_ROUTER_WALLET.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('pTON Router Wallet:');
    console.log(PTON_ROUTER_WALLET.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('For ROOSTER deposit:');
    console.log('sendToken = ROOSTER');
    console.log('otherToken = pTON');
    console.log(
        'provide_lp routerWalletAddress = pTON Router Wallet',
    );
    console.log(PTON_ROUTER_WALLET.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('For pTON deposit:');
    console.log('sendToken = pTON');
    console.log('otherToken = ROOSTER');
    console.log(
        'provide_lp routerWalletAddress = ROOSTER Router Wallet',
    );
    console.log(ROOSTER_ROUTER_WALLET.toString());

    console.log('');
    console.log('============================================================');
    console.log(' FINAL READ-ONLY RESULT');
    console.log('============================================================');

    console.log('');
    console.log(
        `Router match: ${routerMatch ? 'YES' : 'NO'}`
    );

    console.log(
        `Token 0 ROOSTER: ${
            token0RoosterMatch ? 'YES' : 'NO'
        }`
    );

    console.log(
        `Token 1 pTON: ${
            token1PtonMatch ? 'YES' : 'NO'
        }`
    );

    console.log(
        `Overall Pool verification: ${
            routerMatch &&
            token0RoosterMatch &&
            token1PtonMatch
                ? 'PASS'
                : 'CHECK REQUIRED'
        }`
    );

    console.log('');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT.');
    console.log('NO ROOSTER WAS TRANSFERRED.');
    console.log('NO TON WAS TRANSFERRED.');
}

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';

export async function run(provider: any) {
    const router = Address.parse(
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
    );

    const knownLibraryHash =
        '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86';

    console.log('===== VERIFY ROUTER LIBRARY HASH =====');
    console.log('Router:', router.toString());
    console.log('Known Library Hash:', knownLibraryHash);

    const state = await provider.provider(router).getState();

    console.log('\n===== ROUTER STATE =====');
    console.log('State:', state.state.type);

    if (state.state.type !== 'active') {
        console.log('Router is not active.');
        return;
    }

    const code = state.state.code;

    if (!code) {
        console.log('Router code is missing.');
        return;
    }

    console.log('Code bytes:', code.length);

    const hex = code.toString('hex');

    console.log('\n===== RAW CODE BOC =====');
    console.log('BOC prefix:', hex.substring(0, 8));
    console.log('BOC length:', hex.length / 2);

    const roots = Cell.fromBoc(code);

    console.log('\n===== BOC =====');
    console.log('Root count:', roots.length);

    if (roots.length !== 1) {
        console.log('Unexpected BOC root count.');
        return;
    }

    const root = roots[0];

    console.log('\n===== ROOT CELL =====');
    console.log('Bits:', root.bits.length);
    console.log('Refs:', root.refs.length);
    console.log('Exotic:', root.isExotic);
    console.log('Type:', root.type);
    console.log('Root hash:', root.hash().toString('hex'));

    console.log('\n===== ROOT HASH COMPARISON =====');
    console.log(
        'Root hash == known library hash:',
        root.hash().toString('hex') === knownLibraryHash
    );

    console.log('\n===== ROOT CELL DETAILS =====');

    try {
        const slice = root.beginParse();

        console.log('Remaining bits:', slice.remainingBits);
        console.log('Remaining refs:', slice.remainingRefs);

        if (slice.remainingBits >= 8) {
            console.log('First 8 bits:', slice.loadUint(8));
        }

        console.log(
            'beginParse(): SUCCESS'
        );
    } catch (error) {
        console.log(
            'beginParse(): FAILED'
        );
        console.log(error);
    }

    console.log('\n===== ROOT REFS =====');

    for (let i = 0; i < root.refs.length; i++) {
        const ref = root.refs[i];

        console.log(`Ref ${i}:`);
        console.log('  bits:', ref.bits.length);
        console.log('  refs:', ref.refs.length);
        console.log('  exotic:', ref.isExotic);
        console.log('  type:', ref.type);
        console.log('  hash:', ref.hash().toString('hex'));
    }

    console.log('\n===== EXPECTED LIBRARY HASH =====');
    console.log(knownLibraryHash);

    console.log('\n===== RESULT =====');

    if (root.isExotic) {
        console.log('Root IS an exotic cell.');
    } else {
        console.log('Root is NOT an exotic cell.');
    }

    if (root.hash().toString('hex') === knownLibraryHash) {
        console.log('Root hash MATCHES the known Library Hash.');
    } else {
        console.log('Root hash DOES NOT MATCH the known Library Hash.');
    }
}

import {
    LiteClient,
    LiteSingleEngine,
} from 'ton-lite-client';

import { Address, Cell } from '@ton/core';

async function main() {

    const router = Address.parse(
        'EQALh-JBBIKK7gr0o4AVf9JZnEsFndqO0qTCyT-D-yBsWval'
    );

    const libraryHashHex =
        '5a34c333bcdcac70d41f9afca79aa6e782f1c80a5e4b2ef896ec5e20e9182c86';

    const libraryHash =
        Buffer.from(libraryHashHex, 'hex');

    const expectedRouterCodeHash =
        'ca4c3052a1396aef50ca358ac355e2a99be4e1683eb87a2c11fbd452bb4acec5';

    // فقط Server 1
    const server = {
        ip: -1468571697,
        port: 27787,
        key: 'Y/QVf6G5VDiKTZOKitbFVm067WsuocTN8Vg036A4zGk=',
    };

    const host =
        `tcp://${intToIP(server.ip)}:${server.port}`;

    console.log('========================================');
    console.log(' ROUTER LIBRARY DIRECT TEST');
    console.log('========================================');
    console.log('NO TRANSACTION WILL BE SENT.');
    console.log('');

    console.log('Server:');
    console.log(host);
    console.log('');

    console.log('Router:');
    console.log(router.toString());
    console.log('');

    console.log('Expected Router Code Hash:');
    console.log(expectedRouterCodeHash);
    console.log('');

    console.log('Expected Library Hash:');
    console.log(libraryHashHex);
    console.log('');

    const engine = new LiteSingleEngine({
        host,
        publicKey: Buffer.from(server.key, 'base64'),
        reconnectTimeout: 3000,
    });

    const client = new LiteClient({
        engine,
        batchSize: 1,
    });

    try {

        // =========================================================
        // MASTERCHAIN
        // =========================================================

        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('MASTERCHAIN');

        const master =
            await client.getMasterchainInfo();

        console.log(
            'Masterchain seqno:',
            master.last.seqno
        );

        console.log(
            'Root hash:',
            Buffer.from(
                master.last.rootHash
            ).toString('hex')
        );

        // =========================================================
        // ACCOUNT STATE
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ROUTER ACCOUNT STATE');

        const account =
            await client.getAccountState(
                router,
                master.last
            );

        if (
            account.state === null ||
            account.state.storage.state.type !== 'active'
        ) {
            console.log('ERROR: Router is not active.');

            console.log(
                'State:',
                account.state === null
                    ? 'null'
                    : account.state.storage.state.type
            );

            return;
        }

        console.log('Router active: YES');

        const activeState =
            account.state.storage.state.state;

        const code: Cell | null | undefined =
            activeState.code;

        if (!code) {
            console.log('ERROR: Router code is missing.');
            return;
        }

        console.log('Router code exists: YES');

        // =========================================================
        // CODE CELL
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ROUTER CODE CELL');

        console.log(
            'Cell type:',
            code.type
        );

        console.log(
            'Bits:',
            code.bits.length
        );

        console.log(
            'Refs:',
            code.refs.length
        );

        console.log(
            'Exotic:',
            code.type !== -1 ? 'YES' : 'NO'
        );

        // =========================================================
        // CODE HASH
        // =========================================================

        const actualCodeHash =
            code.hash().toString('hex');

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ROUTER CODE HASH');

        console.log('Actual:');
        console.log(actualCodeHash);

        console.log('');
        console.log('Expected:');
        console.log(expectedRouterCodeHash);

        console.log('');
        console.log(
            'MATCH:',
            actualCodeHash === expectedRouterCodeHash
                ? 'YES'
                : 'NO'
        );

        // =========================================================
        // CODE BOC
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ROUTER CODE BOC');

        const boc =
            code.toBoc({
                idx: false,
            });

        console.log(
            Buffer.from(boc).toString('base64')
        );

        // =========================================================
        // CELL BITS
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ROUTER CODE CELL BITS');

        const cellBits =
            code.bits.toString();

        console.log(
            'Bits length:',
            code.bits.length
        );

        console.log(
            'First 8 bits:',
            cellBits.substring(0, 8)
        );

        console.log(
            'First 16 bits:',
            cellBits.substring(0, 16)
        );

        console.log(
            'First 64 bits:',
            cellBits.substring(0, 64)
        );

        // =========================================================
        // LIBRARY REFERENCE ANALYSIS
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('LIBRARY REFERENCE ANALYSIS');

        if (code.type === -1) {

            console.log(
                'Root code cell is ordinary.'
            );

        } else {

            console.log(
                'Root code cell is EXOTIC.'
            );

            console.log(
                'Exotic cell type:',
                code.type
            );
        }

        /*
         * TON Library Reference Cell:
         *
         * 8 bits  = exotic type
         * 256 bits = library hash
         *
         * For a library reference:
         * type = 2
         */

        if (
            code.type === 2 &&
            code.bits.length >= 264
        ) {

            const extractedHash =
                cellBits.substring(8, 264);

            const extractedHashHex =
                BigInt(
                    '0b' + extractedHash
                )
                    .toString(16)
                    .padStart(64, '0');

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'Detected Library Reference Cell: YES'
            );

            console.log(
                'Extracted Library Hash:'
            );

            console.log(
                extractedHashHex
            );

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'Expected Library Hash:'
            );

            console.log(
                libraryHashHex
            );

            console.log('');

            console.log(
                'Library Hash MATCH:',
                extractedHashHex.toLowerCase() ===
                    libraryHashHex.toLowerCase()
                    ? 'YES'
                    : 'NO'
            );

        } else {

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                'Detected Library Reference Cell: NO'
            );

            console.log(
                'This Router root cell is not a standard'
            );

            console.log(
                'exotic Library Reference Cell.'
            );
        }

        // =========================================================
        // ROOT REFERENCES
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('ROOT CELL REFERENCES');

        console.log(
            'Reference count:',
            code.refs.length
        );

        for (
            let i = 0;
            i < code.refs.length;
            i++
        ) {

            const ref =
                code.refs[i];

            console.log('');
            console.log(
                `Reference ${i}`
            );

            console.log(
                'Type:',
                ref.type
            );

            console.log(
                'Bits:',
                ref.bits.length
            );

            console.log(
                'Refs:',
                ref.refs.length
            );

            console.log(
                'Hash:',
                ref.hash().toString('hex')
            );
        }

        // =========================================================
        // REAL LIBRARY LOOKUP
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('REAL LIBRARY LOOKUP');

        console.log(
            'Requesting:',
            libraryHashHex
        );

        const realResult =
            await client.getLibraries([
                libraryHash,
            ]);

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'Result object:'
        );

        console.dir(
            realResult,
            {
                depth: 5,
            }
        );

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'Result count:',
            realResult.result.length
        );

        console.log(
            'Library returned:',
            realResult.result.length > 0
                ? 'YES'
                : 'NO'
        );

        // =========================================================
        // FAKE LIBRARY LOOKUP
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('----------------------------------------');
        console.log('FAKE LIBRARY LOOKUP');

        const fakeLibraryHash =
            Buffer.alloc(32, 0);

        const fakeHashHex =
            fakeLibraryHash.toString('hex');

        console.log(
            'Fake Hash:',
            fakeHashHex
        );

        const fakeResult =
            await client.getLibraries([
                fakeLibraryHash,
            ]);

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'Fake Result:'
        );

        console.dir(
            fakeResult,
            {
                depth: 5,
            }
        );

        console.log('');

        console.log(
            'Fake result count:',
            fakeResult.result.length
        );

        console.log(
            'Fake library returned:',
            fakeResult.result.length > 0
                ? 'YES'
                : 'NO'
        );

        // =========================================================
        // FINAL
        // =========================================================

        console.log('');
        console.log('========================================');
        console.log(' FINAL RESULT');
        console.log('========================================');

        console.log(
            'Router active:',
            'YES'
        );

        console.log(
            'Router code exists:',
            'YES'
        );

        console.log(
            'Router code hash:',
            actualCodeHash === expectedRouterCodeHash
                ? 'MATCH'
                : 'MISMATCH'
        );

        console.log(
            'Library lookup:',
            realResult.result.length > 0
                ? 'RETURNED'
                : 'NOT RETURNED'
        );

        console.log(
            'Fake lookup:',
            fakeResult.result.length > 0
                ? 'RETURNED'
                : 'NOT RETURNED'
        );

        console.log('');
        console.log('========================================');
        console.log(' NO TRANSACTION WAS SENT');
        console.log('========================================');

    } finally {

        engine.close();
    }
}

function intToIP(int: number) {

    const part1 =
        int & 255;

    const part2 =
        (int >> 8) & 255;

    const part3 =
        (int >> 16) & 255;

    const part4 =
        (int >> 24) & 255;

    return `${part4}.${part3}.${part2}.${part1}`;
}

main().catch((error) => {

    console.error('');
    console.error('========================================');
    console.error(' ERROR');
    console.error('========================================');

    console.error(error);

    process.exit(1);
});

export async function run() {
    await main();
}
